examples.english_sentence: Don't just know how to show off your muscles, you need to train other parts of your body too.

english_meaning: sink; washbasin
explanation_mandarin: 指洗脸或洗东西用的水盆；也可指厨房用的水槽。
explanation_english: Refers to a sink or washbasin used for washing face or objects; also refers to a kitchen sink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去廁所sink盆度洗下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ci3 so2 sink1 pun4 dou6 sai2 haa5 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去厕所水槽那里洗洗手吧。
examples.english_sentence: Go wash your hands at the sink in the toilet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個sink盆塞咗，要去通吓佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sink1 pun4 sak1 zo2, jiu3 heoi3 tung1 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水槽堵塞了，要去疏通一下。
examples.english_sentence: The sink is blocked; we need to unclog it.

synonyms: 星盆 (sing1 pun4) - more common for kitchen sinks

english_meaning: Closing price (in a downward trend); Market downturn at the end of the day; To drop significantly near closing time
explanation_mandarin: 香港股市用语，指股市收盘前价格大幅下跌的现象；引申义为事情进展到最后阶段出现不利局面或失败。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong stock market term referring to a significant drop in price shortly before the market closes. By extension, it refers to an unfavorable situation or failure occurring in the final stages of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日個股市又sink盤，好多人蝕錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 go3 gu2 si5 jau6 sink1 pun2, hou2 do1 jan4 sit3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天股市又尾盘大跌，很多人亏钱了。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market had a downturn again at closing today, many people lost money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份project差唔多搞掂，點知最後俾人sink盤，真係激死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 project caa1 m4 do1 gaau2 dim6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jan4 sink1 pun2, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的项目差不多完成了，没想到最后被搞砸了，真是气死人。
examples.english_sentence: My project was almost done, but unexpectedly it got ruined in the end. It's so frustrating.

english_meaning: to attend class; to sit in a lecture
explanation_mandarin: 指学生到教室上课、听课。
explanation_english: Refers to students attending class and listening to lectures in a classroom. It's a common way to describe attending a lesson in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇sit堂，因為唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 sit6 tong4, jan1 wai6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没上课，因为不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't attend class today because I wasn't feeling well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日晏晝要sit堂，記住唔好遲到啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 aan3 zau3 jiu3 sit6 tong4, gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下午要上课，记住不要迟到啊！
examples.english_sentence: We have a class tomorrow afternoon, remember not to be late!

english_meaning: sound card
explanation_mandarin: 电脑中的一种硬件，用于处理音频输入输出。
explanation_english: A computer hardware component that processes audio input and output.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦個sound卡壞咗，聽唔到聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 go3 saun1 kaat1 waai6 zo2, teng1 m4 dou2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电脑声卡坏了，听不到声音。
examples.english_sentence: My computer's sound card is broken, I can't hear any sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗張新嘅sound卡，話要錄歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 san1 ge3 saun1 kaat1, waa6 jiu3 luk6 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一张新的声卡，说要录歌。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new sound card, saying he wants to record songs.

english_meaning: Intern, gofer, someone who does menial tasks
explanation_mandarin: 指实习生或在公司里做杂务，做基层工作的人。通常指新人，需要听从指示完成任务。
explanation_english: Refers to an intern or someone who performs menial tasks and basic work in a company. It usually refers to newcomers who need to follow instructions to complete tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱入職，而家咪做緊sub仔囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 zik1, ji4 gaa1 mai1 zou6 gan2 sap1 zai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚入职，现在不就是当实习生嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He just joined the company and is now an intern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小啲sub仔，佢哋學嘢好快㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 sap1 zai2, keoi5 dei6 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些实习生，他们学东西很快的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate the interns, they learn very quickly.

english_meaning: To take drugs; to take things (often implying drugs); to get high
explanation_mandarin: “嘢”在粤语里是“东西”的意思。“take嘢”本意是拿东西，但现在更多时候指吸毒或者摄取毒品。取决于上下文，也可以指单纯的“拿东西”。
explanation_english: "嘢" (je5) in Cantonese means "things". "Take嘢" literally means "to take things", but it's often used as slang to mean taking drugs or getting high. It can also refer to simply 'taking things' depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧take嘢，好頹廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jau5 baa1 tek1 je5, hou2 teoi4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在酒吧吸毒，非常颓废。
examples.english_sentence: He often takes drugs at the bar, very decadent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁take嘢呀，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 tek1 je5 aa3, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱吃东西啊，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just take random things, it's not good for your body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要take嘢走，唔喺度食飯喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 tek1 je5 zau2, m4 hai2 dou6 sik6 faan6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要打包带走，不在（这）吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'll take the food to go, he won't eat here.

mandarin_meaning: 能说会道 / 擅长说话 / 有说服力
english_meaning: eloquent / good at speaking / persuasive / can talk well / presentable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话流利，口才好，或者事情说得通，有道理。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks fluently and eloquently, or something that is logical and makes sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好talk得，成日氹到人好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 tok3 dak1, seng4 jat6 tung2 dou3 jan4 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很会说话，总是哄得人很开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very eloquent person and always makes people happy with his words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份proposal talk得好好，所以先approve咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 proposal talk3 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 sin1 approve zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份提案说得很有说服力，所以才批准了。
examples.english_sentence: The proposal was presented persuasively, so it got approved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁talk得，叫你幫我同佢傾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 tok3 dak1, giu3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tung4 keoi5 king1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么会说话，叫你帮我和他谈一下。
examples.english_sentence: You're so good at talking, I'll ask you to help me talk to him.

synonyms: 口甜舌滑 (hau2 tim4 sit3 waat6)

english_meaning: to guess correctly; to predict accurately; to hit the mark
explanation_mandarin: 指猜对了，预测准确，符合预期。
explanation_english: Refers to guessing correctly, making an accurate prediction, or something aligning with expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我tip中咗今晚邊隊波會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tip1 zung1 zo2 gam1 maan1 bin1 deui2 bo1 wui5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜中了今晚哪队会赢球。
examples.english_sentence: I guessed correctly which team would win tonight's match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都tip中晒啲六合彩号码，真係好犀利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 tip1 zung1 saai3 di1 luk6 hap6 coi2 hou4 maa5, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都猜中所有的六合彩号码，真的很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He guesses all the Mark Six numbers every time; he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我tip中佢會辭職，因為佢好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tip1 zung1 keoi5 wui5 ci4 zik1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜中他会辞职，因为他很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: I guessed correctly that he would resign, because he's very unhappy.

english_meaning: To predict exam questions; To guess potential test questions
explanation_mandarin: 指考试前猜测或预测可能会考到的题目。
explanation_english: Refers to guessing or predicting questions that may appear on an exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻tip題，成日都tip中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 tip1 tai4, seng4 jat6 dou1 tip1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会押题，总是能猜中。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at predicting exam questions, he always guesses them right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係諗住靠tip題，都要自己溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 nam2 zyu6 kaau3 tip1 tai4, dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只想着靠押题，也要自己复习。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just rely on predicting exam questions, you still need to study yourself.

english_meaning: To hitchhike; to catch a ride; to mooch
explanation_mandarin: 乘坐他人的车，通常是不付费的。也指占他人便宜。
explanation_english: To ride in someone else's vehicle, usually without paying. Also refers to taking advantage of others or getting something for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇錢搭巴士，成日都dup人哋車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 cin2 daap3 baa1 si2, sing4 jat6 dou1 daap3 jan4 dei6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没钱坐巴士，总是搭别人的车。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have money for the bus, so he always hitches a ride with other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住dup人哋車啦，自己俾啲車費啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 daap3 jan4 dei6 ce1 laa1, zi6 gei2 bei2 di1 ce1 fai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别总是想着搭别人的车了，自己付点车费吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop always thinking about getting a free ride, pay your own fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住dup政府嘅福利，自己努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 daap3 zing3 fu2 ge3 fuk1 lei6, zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着占政府的福利便宜，自己努力一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about mooching off the government's welfare, work harder yourself.

synonyms: 搭順風車 (daap3 seon6 fung1 ce1)

english_meaning: to jiggle one's leg; to bounce one's leg (nervously or impatiently)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人坐着时，腿部不停抖动的行为，通常表示感到烦躁，焦虑，无聊或坐立不安。
explanation_english: Describes the action of shaking one's leg while sitting. It usually indicates feeling restless, anxious, bored, or impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好un un腳啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wan1 wan1 goek3 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别抖腿了，很吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stop jiggling your leg, it's noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都un un腳，唔知做乜咁心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 wan1 wan1 goek3, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1 gam3 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抖腿，不知道干嘛这么着急。
examples.english_sentence: He is always jiggling his leg; I don't know why he's so anxious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，我忍唔住un un腳，好緊張呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 wan1 wan1 goek3, hou2 gan2 zoeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试完之后，我忍不住抖腿，好紧张啊！
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, I couldn't help but jiggle my leg, I was so nervous!

english_meaning: to shake one's leg (nervously, impatiently, or habitually)
explanation_mandarin: 指由于紧张、焦虑、不耐烦等原因，不自觉地抖动腿部。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of shaking one's leg, often unconsciously, due to nervousness, anxiety, impatience, or as a habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再un腳啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 wan1 goek3 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再抖腿了，很吵！
examples.english_sentence: Stop shaking your leg, it's so noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試之前成日un腳，睇得出佢好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 zi1 cin4 seng4 jat6 wan1 goek3, tai2 dak1 chut1 keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试之前总是抖腿，看得出他很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: He always shakes his leg before exams, you can tell he's very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，我都開始un腳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ngo5 dou1 hoi1 chi2 wan1 goek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了这么久，我都开始抖腿了。
examples.english_sentence: After waiting so long, I'm starting to shake my leg.

mandarin_meaning: 无法招架的，令人难以忍受的
english_meaning: unbearable, intolerable, unacceptable
explanation_mandarin: 源于英文"unbearable"的音译与粤语融合，形容某事物令人无法忍受，极其糟糕。
explanation_english: A loanword adapted from the English word "unbearable" into Cantonese, describing something that is intolerable, unacceptable, or extremely bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日返工真係 un 頂able，啲嘢多到做唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 zan1 hai6 aan1 ding2 able, di1 je5 do1 dou3 zou6 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天上班真是无法忍受，事情多到做不完。
examples.english_sentence: Working today is absolutely unbearable, there's so much to do that I can't finish it all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情爛到 un 頂able。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 laan6 dou3 aan1 ding2 able.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情烂到难以忍受。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is so bad, it's unbearable.

mandarin_meaning: 形容人很笨，反应迟钝; 傻乎乎的
english_meaning: Describing someone as stupid, slow-witted, or dim-witted; acting foolishly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应慢，理解能力差，行为傻气。通常带有轻微的贬义，但有时也用于开玩笑。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to react, has poor comprehension, and acts foolishly. Usually carries a slight derogatory connotation but is sometimes used playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁 up up 貢，點搞得掂㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 ap1 ap1 gung3, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么笨手笨脚的，怎么能完成呢？
examples.english_sentence: How can you get it done if you're so clumsy and slow at doing things?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁 up up 貢 啦，快啲諗辦法！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ap1 ap1 gung3 laa1, faai3 di1 lam2 baan6 faat3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么傻了，快点想办法！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, think of a solution quickly!

mandarin_meaning: 心情煩躁; 感到苦惱; 令人苦惱
english_meaning: annoying; frustrating; feeling annoyed or frustrated; getting on someone's nerves
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或人令人感到煩躁、苦惱，或是形容自己感到煩躁、苦惱的心情。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or person that makes you feel annoyed or frustrated, or describes one's own feeling of being annoyed or frustrated. It suggests something is bothersome or irritating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲功課真係up頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 di1 gung1 fo3 zan1 hai6 ap1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的作业真的让人烦躁。
examples.english_sentence: The homework lately is really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好up頭，成日嘈住晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 ap1 tau4, seng4 jat6 caau4 zyu6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的太烦人了，整天吵吵闹闹的。
examples.english_sentence: He is really annoying, always making noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到我好up頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 ngo5 hou2 ap1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵得我好烦。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is making me so frustrated.

mandarin_meaning: 胜利地带; 成功之处
english_meaning: Area of Victory; Winning Zone; Where one excels or is successful
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人擅长、有优势、容易取得成功的领域或环境。
explanation_english: Refers to an area or environment where someone excels, has advantages, and is likely to succeed. It implies a domain where one can leverage their strengths to achieve victory or favorable outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌就係佢嘅 V Zone 地喇，次次比賽都攞獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 zau6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 wai1 zeon1 dei2 laa3, ci3 ci3 bei2 coi3 dou1 lo2 zo2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱歌就是他的胜利地带了，每次比赛都得奖。
examples.english_sentence: Singing is his winning zone; he wins awards in every competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於呢個 project 嚟講，佢喺 V Zone 地，肯定搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 ni1 go3 projek1 lei4 gong2, keoi5 hai2 wai1 zeon1 dei2, hang2 ding6 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于这个项目来说，他处于他的胜利地带，肯定能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, he's in his winning zone, he'll definitely be able to handle it.

english_meaning: minibus, public light bus (PLB)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港的一种公共交通工具，通常是载客量较小的巴士，线路灵活。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of public transportation in Hong Kong, typically a small bus with flexible routes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭van仔去旺角最快㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 waan1 zai2 heoi3 wong6 gok3 zeoi3 faai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐小巴去旺角最快了。
examples.english_sentence: Taking the minibus to Mong Kok is the fastest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架van仔啲位好迫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 waan1 zai2 di1 wai2 hou2 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆小巴的位置很挤。
examples.english_sentence: The seats on this minibus are very cramped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紅van仔同綠van仔有咩分別？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 waan1 zai2 tung4 luk6 waan1 zai2 jau5 me1 fan1 bit6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 红色小巴和绿色小巴有什么区别？
examples.english_sentence: What's the difference between the red minibus and the green minibus?

english_meaning: To hype up the atmosphere, to cheer on, to warm up the scene, to get the ball rolling, to be a hype man
explanation_mandarin: 指在活动或聚会中积极互动，活跃气氛，使场面更加热闹。
explanation_english: To actively participate in an event or gathering to liven up the atmosphere and make the scene more lively. Often involves cheering on performers or participants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識wet場㗎，有佢喺度氣氛一定好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 wet1 coeng4 gaa3, jau5 keoi5 hai2 dou6 hei3 fan1 jat1 ding6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会活跃气氛，有他在气氛肯定很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at hyping up the atmosphere, with him around, the atmosphere will definitely be great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上台表演嘅時候，我哋一定會落力wet場㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 lok6 lik6 wet1 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上台表演的时候，我们一定会尽力捧场的。
examples.english_sentence: When you go on stage to perform, we will definitely cheer you on enthusiastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先個場騷，要唔要搵人wet場先？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 go3 coeng4 so1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 wan2 jan4 wet1 coeng4 sin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那场演出，要不要找人来捧场一下？
examples.english_sentence: For the show just now, should we find someone to hype it up first?

synonyms: 炒熱氣氛 (caau2 jit6 hei3 fan1)

mandarin_meaning: 幼稚的女孩; 不成熟的女孩; 容易受骗的女孩
english_meaning: Naive girl; gullible girl; easily influenced girl
explanation_mandarin: 指涉世未深、容易受骗、心智不够成熟的年轻女孩。通常带有贬义，暗示其缺乏判断力，容易被利用或欺骗。
explanation_english: Refers to a young girl who is naive, gullible, and lacks worldly experience. It often carries a derogatory connotation, implying a lack of judgment and susceptibility to being taken advantage of or deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁傻啦，你俾人呃咗都唔知，真係wet妹嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 gam3 so4 laa1, nei5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1, zan1 hai6 wet1 mui1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻啦，你被人骗了都不知道，真是个幼稚的女孩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, you don't even know when you're being scammed, you're such a naive girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁wet妹，好易俾啲壞男人呃嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 wet1 mui1, hou2 ji6 bei2 di1 waai6 naam4 jan2 aak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么幼稚，很容易被坏男人骗的。
examples.english_sentence: She's so naive, she's easily scammed by bad guys.

english_meaning: To lose face; to be disgraced; to be humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常丢脸，颜面尽失，令人难堪。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone has completely lost face, is deeply embarrassed, and humiliated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試肥佬已經好慘，仲要俾老師喺全班面前鬧，真係we爛塊面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 fei4 lou2 ji5 ging1 hou2 caam2, zung6 jiu3 bei2 lou5 si1 hai2 cyun4 baan1 min6 cin4 nau6, zan1 hai6 wai1 laan6 faai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格已经很惨了，还要被老师在全班面前骂，真是丢尽了脸。
examples.english_sentence: Failing the exam was already bad enough, but being scolded by the teacher in front of the whole class really made me lose face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大庭廣眾下面俾人踢爆佢講大話，真係we爛塊面走都冇地方走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 haa6 min6 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 wai1 laan6 faai3 min6 zau2 dou1 mou5 dei6 fong1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大庭广众之下被人揭穿说谎，真是颜面扫地，无地自容。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for lying in public, and was so humiliated that he had nowhere to hide.

english_meaning: to pick up girls, to chase girls, to flirt with girls
explanation_mandarin: 指男性追求女性，通常带有轻浮或玩弄的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a man pursuing a woman, often with a frivolous or playful connotation. It implies an active effort to attract a woman for romantic or sexual purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧度yo女，但係次次都失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 zau1 baa1 dou6 diu2 neoi5, daan6 hai6 ci3 ci3 dou1 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在酒吧泡妞，但是每次都失败。
examples.english_sentence: He's always picking up girls at the bar, but he fails every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住剩係識得yo女，都係搵份工做吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 sing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 diu2 neoi5, dou1 hai6 wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别只想著泡妞，也找份工作做做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just think about chasing girls, you should find a job to do as well.

mandarin_meaning: 达到...程度就不羡慕了; 不稀罕
english_meaning: To reach a point where you no longer desire something; To be so… that you don’t care about something anymore; Don't even want it
explanation_mandarin: 表示达到某种程度，以至于不再羡慕或渴望某事物。通常用于表达已经拥有或体验过某种事物，因此不再对其抱有特别的期待或渴望。
explanation_english: Indicates reaching a certain level or experience where one no longer envies or desires something. Often used to express having already possessed or experienced something, thus no longer harboring special expectations or desires for it. The '……' represents what is being reached or experienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都食魚翅，食到唔恨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 jat1 dou1 sik6 jyu4 ci3, sik6 dou3 m4 han6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都吃鱼翅，吃到都不想吃了。
examples.english_sentence: I eat shark fin every day, I've eaten so much that I don't even want it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日去旅行，去到唔恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, heoi3 dou3 m4 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常去旅行，去到不想去了。
examples.english_sentence: I travel all the time, I've traveled so much that I don't even want to go anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都拍拖，拍到唔恨結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 jat1 dou1 paak3 to1, paak3 dou3 m4 han6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都约会，约会到都不想结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They go on dates every day, they've dated so much that they don't even want to get married anymore.

english_meaning: … until satisfied / … to one's heart's content / … to the fullest
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种行为或状态持续到令人满意、足够或达到极致的程度。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state continues until one is satisfied, it is enough, or it reaches an extreme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓到夠先起身啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 dou3 gau3 sin1 hei2 san1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡到够再起床吧！
examples.english_sentence: Sleep until you're satisfied before getting up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚要玩到夠！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jiu3 waan2 dou3 gau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚要玩个够！
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to have my fill of fun tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食到夠飽先走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 dou3 gau3 baau2 sin1 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃到饱再走吧。
examples.english_sentence: Eat until you're full before leaving.

english_meaning: … to death / extremely ... / so … that you could die
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，强调某种状态或者行为的程度非常高，几乎达到极限。可以放在形容词或者动词后面，表示“非常”、“极其”的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates an extreme degree, emphasizing that the state or action is very intense, almost to the limit. It can be placed after an adjective or verb to express 'very' or 'extremely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攰到死！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gui6 dou3 sei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 累死了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm exhausted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好食到死！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 sik6 dou3 sei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吃死了！
examples.english_sentence: It's so delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眼瞓到死！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan5 fan3 dou3 sei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 困死了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm so sleepy!

english_meaning: … extremely; … to the max; … very much
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极高，非常，十分。常用于形容词或动词后，表示程度达到顶点。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree or extent; extremely, very much, to the max. Often used after adjectives or verbs to express that the degree has reached its peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日型到爆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 jing4 dou3 baau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天帅极了！
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely handsome today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好食到爆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 dou3 baau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物好吃极了！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is extremely delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家忙到爆，冇時間覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 mong4 dou3 baau3, mou5 si4 gaan3 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在忙死了，没时间回复你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm extremely busy right now, I don't have time to reply to you.

english_meaning: …like crazy; …to the extreme; …incredibly well; to be over the top
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，达到极点，非常厉害。形容事物非常成功，非常受欢迎，或者某种状态非常严重。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is done to an extreme, incredibly well, or is very popular. It implies a high degree or intensity. Can also be used to describe a situation being overly dramatic or intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到飛起，好多人都鍾意聽佢唱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dou3 fei1 hei2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 teng1 keoi5 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得非常棒，很多人都喜欢听他唱。
examples.english_sentence: He sings incredibly well; many people like to listen to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢間餐廳嘅生意好到飛起，日日都排晒隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 saang1 ji3 hou2 dou3 fei1 hei2, jat1 jat1 dou1 paai4 saai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他的餐厅生意好到飞起，每天都排满了队。
examples.english_sentence: His restaurant's business is booming like crazy lately; there's a queue every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚啲氣氛high到飛起！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 di1 hei3 fan1 hai1 dou3 fei1 hei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的气氛嗨到飞起！
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere tonight is incredibly high!

english_meaning: ……that's unlikely/……that's hard to believe/……I'd be surprised if...
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况的不相信或者觉得不可能发生。 通常用于反语，表达如果不是这样，那才奇怪呢。
explanation_english: Expresses disbelief or the feeling that something is unlikely to happen. Often used sarcastically to imply that the opposite is actually the case; essentially meaning 'it would be surprising if it wasn't the case'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，會自己做功課就假啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, wui5 zi6 gei2 zou6 gung1 fo3 zau6 gaa2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，会自己做作业才怪呢。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, I'd be surprised if he did his homework himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日嘈交，話唔會分手就假啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, waa6 m4 wui5 fan1 sau2 zau6 gaa2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天吵架，说不会分手才怪呢。
examples.english_sentence: They argue all the time, I'd be surprised if they didn't break up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孤寒，會請你食飯就假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4, wui5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6 zau6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么吝啬，会请你吃饭才怪。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy, I'd be surprised if he treated you to a meal.

synonyms: 點會 (dim2 wui5) - how could it be

english_meaning: Anything, anything at all, whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示随便什么东西，不太在意具体是什么。
explanation_english: Used to indicate anything or whatever, implying a lack of specific preference or concern about the exact item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想食啲乜嘢呀？是但度嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 sik6 di1 mat1 je5 aa3? si6 daan6 dou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想吃点什么啊？随便什么东西都行。
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to eat? Anything is fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買是但度嘢俾我就得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 si6 daan6 dou6 je5 bei2 ngo5 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你随便买点什么东西给我就行了。
examples.english_sentence: You can just buy me anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去邊度玩呀？是但度嘢都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3? si6 daan6 dou6 je5 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去哪里玩啊？随便什么地方都可以。
examples.english_sentence: Where shall we go to play? Anywhere is fine.

english_meaning: to be able to make it; to have enough time to do something; to be in time
explanation_mandarin: 表示在时间或能力上能够赶得上，可以完成某事。
explanation_english: Indicates being able to make it in terms of time or ability, being able to complete something. It implies that there is enough time to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕唔趕得切去睇場戲啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 m4 gon2 dak1 cit3 heoi3 tai2 coeng4 hei3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶得上看一场电影吗？
examples.english_sentence: Will I be able to make it to see a movie?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家出門口都應該趕得切嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 cheut1 mun4 hau2 dou1 jing1 goi1 gon2 dak1 cit3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在出门应该也还来得及。
examples.english_sentence: You should still be able to make it if you leave now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再拖啦，再拖就趕唔切交功課㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa1, zoi3 to1 zau6 gon2 m4 cit3 gaau1 gung1 fo3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再拖延了，再拖延就赶不上交作业了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't procrastinate anymore, if you do you won't be able to hand in your homework on time.

english_meaning: and; also; moreover; in addition to; while being
explanation_mandarin: 表示在具备某种特性的同时，还具备另外一种特性。可以连接两个形容词或动词短语。
explanation_english: Indicates that something possesses a certain characteristic in addition to another. It can connect two adjectives or verb phrases, expressing a simultaneous or consequential attribute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好味得嚟又唔貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 mei6 dak1 lai4 jau6 m4 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物好吃而且不贵。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's food is delicious and not expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人聰明得嚟又勤力，梗會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 cung1 ming4 dak1 lai4 jau6 kan4 lik6, gang2 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他既聪明又勤奋，肯定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: He is smart and hardworking, so he will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲搞笑得嚟又有啲感動位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 gaau2 siu3 dak1 lai4 jau6 jau5 di1 gam2 dung6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影既搞笑又有一些感人的地方。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is funny and has some touching moments as well.

english_meaning: pretty; nice; good; wonderful; used as an intensifier or general adjective of approval
explanation_mandarin: “靓”在粤语中表示漂亮、好看、美好。 “…個靚…” 可以放在名词或动词前，表示程度加深或者赞赏。 语境不同，意思也略有变化，可能是表示程度很高，也可能是纯粹的赞美或肯定。
explanation_english: "Leng3" in Cantonese means pretty, beautiful, or good. "... go3 leng3 ..." can be placed before a noun or verb to intensify the degree or express appreciation. The meaning varies slightly depending on the context; it may indicate a high degree, or it may be purely praise or affirmation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係好鬼靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真的很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is really delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日嘅表現都幾靚仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 ge3 biu2 hin3 dou1 gei2 leng3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天的表现挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: His performance yesterday was pretty good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃都幾靚喎，可行性好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 gei2 leng3 wo3, ho2 hang4 sing3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划挺好的，可行性很高。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is pretty good, it has a high feasibility.

english_meaning: ...is a small matter, ...is a big matter / ...is less important, ...is more important / To make light of... and focus on...
explanation_mandarin: 表示相比于前者，后者才是更重要的事情。通常用来说明应该优先考虑后者。
explanation_english: Indicates that the latter is more important than the former. Usually used to explain that the latter should be given priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 錢事小，條命事大呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin2 si6 siu2, tiu4 meng6 si6 daai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱是小事，命才是大事啊！
examples.english_sentence: Money is a small matter, life is a big matter!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到事小，冇交功課事大！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 si6 siu2, mou5 gaau1 gung1 fo3 si6 daai6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到是小事，没交作业才是大事！
examples.english_sentence: Being late is a small matter, not handing in your homework is a big matter!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 輸波事小，冇咗士氣事大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 bo1 si6 siu2, mou5 zo2 si6 hei3 si6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 输球是小事，没了士气才是大事。
examples.english_sentence: Losing the game is a small matter; losing morale is a big matter.

english_meaning: ...my foot, ...you wish, ...no way
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定、不相信、反驳或轻蔑的语气。通常用于回应别人说的话，表示说话人认为对方所说的事情不太可能发生、不切实际或荒谬。
explanation_english: Expresses denial, disbelief, rebuttal, or contempt. It's usually used in response to something someone else says, indicating that the speaker finds the other person's statement unlikely to happen, unrealistic, or absurd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 升職加人工？你個頭！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 zik1 gaa1 yan4 gung1? nei5 go3 tau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 升职加薪？想得美！
examples.english_sentence: Get promoted and get a raise? My foot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢會幫我還錢，你個頭！佢根本唔會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 bong1 ngo5 waan4 cin2, nei5 go3 tau4! keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会帮我还钱，才怪！他根本不会。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd help me pay back the money, my foot! He definitely won't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估我會信你？你個頭啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 ngo5 wui5 seon3 nei5? nei5 go3 tau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为我会相信你？才怪！
examples.english_sentence: You think I'll believe you? No way!

english_meaning: Serves you right; you deserve it; that's what you get
explanation_mandarin: 表示幸灾乐祸或认为某人遭到的不幸是其咎由自取。
explanation_english: Expresses schadenfreude or the sentiment that someone deserves the misfortune that has befallen them. It implies that their suffering is a direct result of their own actions or choices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日偷懶，今次考試肥佬，抵你條命啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tau1 laan5, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, dai2 nei5 tiu4 ming6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是偷懒，这次考试不及格，你活该。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off. He failed the exam this time. Serves you right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔聽人講，依家衰咗，抵你條命啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ting1 jan4 gong2, ji1 gaa1 seoi1 zo2, dai2 nei5 tiu4 ming6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不听人劝告，现在失败了，你活该。
examples.english_sentence: You didn't listen to advice and now you've failed. You deserve it.

mandarin_meaning: 结束他的生命；要他的命
english_meaning: To take his life; to kill him; to be the death of him (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是夺取某人的生命。也可以引申为某事物给某人带来极大的痛苦或伤害，以至于要了他的命。
explanation_english: Literally means to take someone's life. It can also be used figuratively to describe something that causes someone great suffering or harm, to the point of being the death of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工真係執佢條命，日日OT到三更半夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 zap1 keoi5 tiu4 ming6, jat1 jat1 OT dou3 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作真是要了他的命，每天加班到半夜三更。
examples.english_sentence: This job is really going to be the death of him, working overtime until the wee hours every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔小心駕駛，分分鐘會執你條命㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 siu2 sam1 gaa3 sai2, fan1 fan1 cung1 wui5 zap1 nei5 tiu4 ming6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不小心驾驶，随时会要你的命的！
examples.english_sentence: If you drive carelessly, it could take your life at any moment!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭錢真係會執人條命，好多人都因為賭錢而家破人亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 cin2 zan1 hai6 wui5 zap1 jan4 tiu4 ming6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 jan1 wai6 dou2 cin2 ji4 gaa1 po3 jan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赌钱真的会要人命，很多人都因为赌钱而家破人亡。
examples.english_sentence: Gambling can really be the death of people, many families have been ruined because of it.

mandarin_meaning: ...来...去 (indicating a back-and-forth or repetitive action)
english_meaning: ...and back, ...to and fro, back and forth ...ing, to ... and back again (indicating repeated actions in opposite directions or locations)
explanation_mandarin: 表示重复动作，来回，反覆不断。通常中间会加上一个动作或形容词。
explanation_english: Indicates a repetitive action, going back and forth. Usually, an action or adjective is inserted between '來' and '去'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行嚟行去，唔知諗緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 loi4 hang4 heoi3, m4 zi1 naam2 gan2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走来走去，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's walking back and forth; I wonder what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講嚟講去都係咁，冇乜新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 loi4 gong2 heoi3 dou1 hai6 gam2, mou5 mat1 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说来说去都是那样，没什么新意。
examples.english_sentence: It's the same thing said over and over again; nothing new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘈嚟嘈去都係為咗啲小事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cou4 loi4 cou4 heoi3 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵来吵去都是为了些小事。
examples.english_sentence: They're arguing back and forth over trivial matters.

jyutping: daai6 ceot1 si6 jau4 daai6 ceot1 gai1
english_meaning: To bleed heavily; To lose a lot of money; To suffer a significant financial loss.
explanation_mandarin: 原本形容大量出血，现在多用来比喻在经济上遭受重大损失，损失惨重。
explanation_english: Originally used to describe heavy bleeding, it is now often used metaphorically to describe a significant financial loss or suffering a heavy financial blow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資真係大出血，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 zan1 hai6 daai6 ceot1 si6 jau4, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资真是大出血，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment was a real bloodbath, I lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司突然要搬office，真係大出血呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 dat6 jin4 jiu3 bun1 office, zan1 hai6 daai6 ceot1 si6 jau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司突然要搬办公室，真是大出血啊！
examples.english_sentence: The company suddenly has to move offices, it's a real financial hemorrhage!

synonyms: 損手爛腳 (syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3)
血本無歸 (hyut3 bun2 mou4 gwai1)

jyutping: dou1 ceot1 si6 jau4 dou1 ceot1 gai1
mandarin_meaning: 都说有，都说好 (指口头上答应得很好，实际上没有行动或兑现)
english_meaning: Everyone says yes, everyone says it's good (referring to giving lip service but not actually following through or fulfilling promises)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人们口头上答应得很好，或者对某件事情赞不绝口，但实际上并没有采取行动，也没有真正实现。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people verbally agree to something or praise something enthusiastically, but in reality, they don't take any action or actually fulfill their promises. It's often used to criticize insincerity or lack of commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班友仔呀，成日都話會幫手，但係⋯出豉油⋯出雞，根本冇人嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 jau2 zai2 aa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 wui5 bong1 sau2, daan6 hai6 dou1 ceot1 si6 jau4 dou1 ceot1 gai1, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那帮家伙啊，整天都说会帮忙，但是都说有都说好，根本没人来。
examples.english_sentence: That group of guys, they always say they'll help, but it's all talk, no action, no one actually comes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會俾升職加薪，但係⋯出豉油⋯出雞，到而家都冇聲氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 bei2 sing1 zik1 gaa1 san1, daan6 hai6 dou1 ceot1 si6 jau4 dou1 ceot1 gai1, dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5 seng1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说会升职加薪，但是都说有都说好，到现在都没有消息。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would promote me and give me a raise, but it was all talk, and now there's no news.

synonyms: 得個講字 (dak1 go3 gong2 zi6)
講一套做一套 (gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3)

english_meaning: (Describes someone) very stingy, miserly
explanation_mandarin: 这是一个比喻，形容某人像挤鸡屁股挤不出油、挤不出酱油一样，非常吝啬，不愿意付出。
explanation_english: This is a metaphor comparing someone to squeezing a chicken's rear end and not being able to squeeze out any oil or soy sauce, implying they are very stingy and unwilling to give.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係出雞出豉油，同佢夾錢食飯都蝕底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zan1 hai6 ceot1 gai1 ceot1 si6 jau4, tung4 keoi5 gaap3 cin2 sik6 faan6 dou1 sit6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的很小气，跟他凑钱吃饭都吃亏。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy. It's a loss to split the bill with him for meals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁出雞出豉油啦，請朋友食飯都唔捨得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 gai1 ceot1 si6 jau4 laa1, ceng2 pang4 jau5 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 se2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么小气了，请朋友吃饭都不舍得。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy. You can't even bear to treat your friends to a meal.

synonyms: 一毛不拔 (jat1 mou4 bat1 bat6)

jyutping: dau1 ceot1 gai1, dau1 ceot1 si6 jau4*
english_meaning: Miserly; stingy; cheap
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money. Literally, it means 'Dropping chicken, dropping soy sauce', implying that even small amounts are precious and not to be wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係度縮到出鷄出豉油，一蚊都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 dou6 suk1 dou3 dau1 ceot1 gai1 dau1 ceot1 si6 jau4, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是抠门到极点，一分钱都舍不得花。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy that he wouldn't even spend a cent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁出鷄出豉油啦，請我飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dau1 ceot1 gai1 dau1 ceot1 si6 jau4 laa1, cheng2 ngo5 yam2 bui1 ye5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么小气啦，请我喝一杯东西嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just buy me a drink.

english_meaning: Extremely..., Very...
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常深，通常用来形容颜色鲜艳、程度强烈、状态夸张等。前面的词语可以是形容词或动词。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree or intensity. It is often used to describe vibrant colors, strong degrees, or exaggerated states. The preceding word can be an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到九彩呀，唔好搞佢住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 gau2 coi2 aa3, m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常生气，别惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely angry, don't bother him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫紅到九彩，好搶眼喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 hung4 dou3 gau2 coi2, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服红得非常鲜艳，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is extremely red, very eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個sweet到九彩，羨慕死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sweet dou3 gau2 coi2, sin6 mou6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个非常甜蜜，羡慕死人了。
examples.english_sentence: They are extremely sweet, making everyone jealous.

english_meaning: to an extreme extent; extremely; unparalleled; unique
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，达到无人能及的地步。 通常用来形容某件事物或人的特质非常突出，与众不同。
explanation_english: Expresses an extreme degree, to the point of being unparalleled. Usually used to describe something or someone's characteristic being outstanding and unique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人懶到冇人有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 laan5 dou3 mou5 jan4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人懒到无人能比。
examples.english_sentence: He is lazy beyond compare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲橋真係衰到冇人有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 kiu2 zan1 hai6 seoi1 dou3 mou5 jan4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的点子真是差到极点。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are extremely bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食貴到冇人有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gwai3 dou3 mou5 jan4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西贵到没边了。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is outrageously expensive.

english_meaning: …to the extreme; …to the point of dripping; so…that…; excessively…
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，达到令人印象深刻的地步。通常用于形容某个行为、状态或品质达到了极致。
explanation_english: Expresses a state or action reaching an extreme level, often to an impressive or exaggerated degree. Used to emphasize the intensity or excessiveness of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋sweet到出汁呀，日日都喺IG放閃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sweet dou3 ceot1 zap1 aa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 IG fong3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们甜到出汁了，每天都在IG上秀恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: They are so sweet that it's dripping; they show off their love on Instagram every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲悶到出汁，我睇咗十分鐘就瞓著咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 mun6 dou3 ceot1 zap1, ngo5 tai2 zo2 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 fan3 zoek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影闷到极点，我看了十分钟就睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is so boring that it's dripping; I fell asleep after watching it for ten minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食辣到出汁，唔係好食得辣嘅人唔好試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 laat6 dou3 ceot1 zap1, m4 hai6 hou2 sik6 dak1 laat6 ge3 jan4 m4 hou2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物辣到极致，不怎么能吃辣的人最好别尝试。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so spicy that it's dripping; people who can't handle spice shouldn't try it.

english_meaning: to the point of not desiring anymore; so much that you no longer want it
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，到达了不再渴望或不稀罕的程度。通常用于描述得到很多，以至于失去了兴趣或欲望。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree of something, to the point where you no longer desire or care for it. It usually describes having so much of something that you lose interest or desire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣好想有好多玩具，但係大個之後，有幾多都到唔恨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 soeng2 jau5 hou2 do1 waan2 geoi6, daan6 hai6 daai6 go3 zi1 hau6, jau5 gei2 do1 dou3 m4 han6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很想要很多玩具，但是长大后，有多少都不稀罕了。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I really wanted a lot of toys, but now that I'm older, I don't desire them anymore, no matter how many I have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都食鮑魚，食到唔恨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 sik6 baau1 jyu4, sik6 dou3 m4 han6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都吃鲍鱼，吃到不稀罕了。
examples.english_sentence: He eats abalone every day, he's eaten it so much that he doesn't desire it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲小朋友乜都有，寵到佢哋到唔恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 mat1 dou1 jau5, cung2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 dou3 m4 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的小朋友什么都有，宠到他们什么都不稀罕。
examples.english_sentence: Kids these days have everything, they're spoiled to the point of not desiring anything.

english_meaning: ⋯ to the point of throwing up electricity; ⋯ to the extreme; ⋯ to the point of being sick of it
explanation_mandarin: “嘔電”比喻非常厌烦，感到非常恶心。整个短语表示某件事到达了令人极度厌恶的地步，程度非常强烈。
explanation_english: "嘔電" (au2 din6) literally means "throwing up electricity", figuratively meaning extremely annoyed or disgusted. The whole phrase indicates that something has reached a point of extreme disgust or aversion; the degree is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日喺度呻，呻到我嘔電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 hai2 dou6 san1, san1 dou3 ngo5 au2 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在抱怨，抱怨得我都要吐了。
examples.english_sentence: He complains every day, to the point that I'm sick of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲客好麻煩，問嚟問去都係問埋啲無聊嘢，問到我嘔電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 haak3 hou2 maa4 faan4, man6 lei4 man6 heoi3 dou1 hai6 man6 maai4 di1 mou4 liu1 je5, man6 dou3 ngo5 au2 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些顾客很麻烦，问来问去都问些无聊的问题，问得我都要吐了。
examples.english_sentence: Those customers are so annoying, asking the same silly questions over and over again, I'm sick of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老闆成日開會講埋啲廢話，講到我嘔電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 hoi1 wui2 gong2 maai4 di1 fai3 waa6, gong2 dou3 ngo5 au2 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是开会讲些废话，讲得我都想吐。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always talks nonsense in meetings, to the point where I'm sick of it.

english_meaning: enough, sufficient, to one's heart's content
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，达到足够的程度。通常放在动词后，表示动作进行到足够的程度。
explanation_english: Indicates degree, meaning to reach a sufficient level. Usually placed after a verb, indicating the action is performed to a sufficient degree or to one's satisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你瞓到夠未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan3 dou3 gau3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你睡够了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you slept enough?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要玩到夠！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 jiu3 waan2 dou3 gau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要玩个够！
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to have my fill of fun tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食到夠就唔好再食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 dou3 gau3 zau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饱了就不要再吃了。
examples.english_sentence: If you've eaten enough, don't eat any more.

english_meaning: Very, extremely, tightly, firmly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，状态很牢固。 通常放在形容词或动词之后，表示程度加强。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree or a very firm state. Usually placed after an adjective or verb to emphasize the degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捉住我隻手捉到實一實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zuk1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zuk1 dou3 sat6 jat1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抓着我的手抓得紧紧的。
examples.english_sentence: He held my hand very tightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個櫃鎖到實一實，唔驚會跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwai6 so2 dou3 sat6 jat1 sat1, m4 geng1 wui5 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个柜子锁得牢牢的，不用担心会掉下来。
examples.english_sentence: This cabinet is locked very tightly, no need to worry about it falling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我好到實一實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 dou3 sat6 jat1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我非常好。
examples.english_sentence: He is extremely good to me.

english_meaning: ⋯ to the max; ⋯ extremely; ⋯ to the fullest extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，强调某种状态或情况已经达到了极限，不能再进一步。
explanation_english: Expresses a very high degree, emphasizing that a certain state or situation has reached its limit and cannot be further enhanced. Often used with descriptive adjectives or verbs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忙到應一應，冇時間食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong4 dou3 ying1 yat1 ying1, mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忙得不可开交，没时间吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely busy, he doesn't have time to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好食到應一應，日日都好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ye5 sik6 hou2 sik6 dou3 ying1 yat1 ying1, yat1 yat1 dou1 hou2 do1 yan4 paai4 deui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物好吃极了，每天都有很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is extremely delicious; there are many people queuing up every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋開心到應一應，不停咁笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi1 sam1 dou3 ying1 yat1 ying1, bat1 ting4 gam2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们高兴得不得了，不停地笑。
examples.english_sentence: They are extremely happy, laughing non-stop.

english_meaning: Extremely ... / To the point of nuclear explosion
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，达到极点，有夸张的意味。比喻像核爆炸一样强烈。
explanation_english: Expresses an extremely high degree or extent of something, often with exaggeration. The phrase implies a level of intensity comparable to a nuclear explosion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到核爆，唔肯同我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 hat6 baau3, m4 hang2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气到了极点，不肯跟我说话。
examples.english_sentence: He's so angry he could explode; he refuses to talk to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試難到核爆，我諗住肥硬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 naan4 dou3 hat6 baau3, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 fei4 ngaang6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试难到了极点，我想我肯定要挂科了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam was incredibly difficult; I think I'm going to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食好食到核爆，下次一定要再嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 dou3 hat6 baau3, haa6 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoi3 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的东西好吃到了极点，下次一定要再来！
examples.english_sentence: The food at that restaurant was unbelievably delicious; I definitely have to come again!

english_meaning: very, extremely, perfectly, exactly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很高，到达了某种状态的顶点。通常用来形容事物的品质、状态或结果非常理想或完美。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree or that something has reached its peak state. It is often used to describe the quality, state, or result of something as being very ideal or perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心做得好到正！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 zou6 dak1 hou2 dou3 zeng3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心做得非常好！
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant is extremely well made!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到正，簡直好似原唱咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dou3 zeng3, gaan2 zik6 hou2 ci5 jyun4 coeng3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得很好，简直好像原唱一样。
examples.english_sentence: He sings extremely well, almost like the original singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫到正，冇得彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 zeng3, mou5 dak1 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告写得很好，无可挑剔。
examples.english_sentence: His report is written perfectly, there's nothing to criticize.

mandarin_meaning: ...到死, ...死了 (literally: ...until death, so ... to death)
english_meaning: ...to death; so ... that it's like dying; to a great extent; extremely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，类似于“死了”或“要命”的意思。前面的动词或形容词表达的是一种行为或状态，后面加上“到死”表示程度达到了极致，有时略带夸张的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates an extreme degree, similar to "to death" or "terribly". The preceding verb or adjective describes an action or state, and adding "到死" indicates that the degree has reached its extreme, sometimes with a slightly exaggerated meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚到死啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 dou3 sei2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吓死了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm scared to death!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忙到死，成日都OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong4 dou3 sei2, seng4 jat6 dou1 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忙死了，每天都加班。
examples.english_sentence: He's so busy that he's like dying; he always works overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好食到死呀呢個蛋糕！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 sik6 dou3 sei2 aa3 ni1 go3 daan6 gou1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕好吃死了！
examples.english_sentence: This cake is so delicious, it's amazing!

english_meaning: ... to the point of exhaustion/ ... to the point of almost coughing up a lung/ extremely...
explanation_mandarin: 形容程度很深，非常厉害，几乎达到极限，有时也带夸张的意味。多用来形容动作、状态或感觉的强烈程度，表示做某事非常努力或者某种感受非常强烈。
explanation_english: Describes something done to an extreme degree, often implying exhaustion or near-exhaustion. It is used to emphasize the intensity of an action, state, or feeling, suggesting that someone has done something with immense effort or experienced something very intensely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋頭先跑樓梯跑到甩肺啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tau4 sin1 paau2 lau2 tai1 paau2 dou3 lat1 fai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚才跑楼梯跑得要命啊！
examples.english_sentence: We just ran up the stairs until we were about to cough up a lung!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢溫書溫到甩肺，希望今次考試攞到好成績啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 lat1 fai3, hei1 mong6 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 lo2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他复习功课复习得要命，希望这次考试能取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He studied so hard, to the point of exhaustion, I hope he gets good grades this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日打麻雀打到甩肺，搞到依家都好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 daa2 maa4 zoek3 daa2 dou3 lat1 fai3, gaau2 dou3 ji1 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天打麻将打得要命，弄得现在都很累。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I played mahjong to the point of exhaustion, and I'm still tired now.

english_meaning: …to the point of pants falling off (exaggeratedly)
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度极深，夸张地形容达到极致的程度，好像兴奋、笑、或者疲惫到裤子都要掉下来一样。
explanation_english: An exaggerated phrase used to describe something reaching an extreme degree. It suggests that something is so extreme (e.g., funny, tired, exciting) that it's like your pants are falling off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套戲好好笑，我笑到甩褲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hei3 hou2 hou2 siu3, ngo5 siu3 dou3 lat1 fu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影太好笑了，我笑得裤子都要掉了！
examples.english_sentence: That movie was so funny, I laughed my pants off!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日返工返到甩褲，攰到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 lat1 fu3, gui6 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天上班上到累得要死，累爆了。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I worked so hard I was exhausted to the point of my pants falling off; I was totally worn out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日演唱會，我興奮到甩褲啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jin2 coeng3 wui2, ngo5 hing3 fan5 dou3 lat1 fu3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的演唱会，我兴奋得要裤子都掉了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm so excited for tomorrow's concert, I'm practically bursting with excitement!

english_meaning: ⋯to the point of numbness
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，达到麻木的状态。常用于形容身体部位长时间保持一个姿势，或者某种情绪或感觉达到极点。
explanation_english: Indicates a deep degree, reaching a state of numbness. It's often used to describe a body part being held in one position for a long time, or an emotion or feeling reaching its extreme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐咗成日，Pat pat 坐到痹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 zo2 seng4 jat6, pat1 pat1 co5 dou3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐了一整天，屁股都坐麻木了。
examples.english_sentence: Sat all day, my butt is numb from sitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等到頸都長，等到痹！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 dou3 geng2 dou1 coeng4, dang2 dou3 bei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等到脖子都长了，等到麻木了！
examples.english_sentence: Waited until my neck is long, waited till I'm numb from waiting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇到啲戲悶到痹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 dou3 di1 hei3 mun6 dou3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看那些戏闷到麻木。
examples.english_sentence: I find those movies so boring that I'm numb.

english_meaning: numb; to the point of numbness; extremely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，达到麻木的程度。通常用来形容感觉、动作或状态的强烈程度。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree to the point of numbness. Usually used to describe the intensity of feelings, actions, or states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢講嘅嘢，我嬲到痺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, ngo5 nau1 dou3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他说的话，我气得都麻木了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing what he said, I was so angry I was numb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行咗成日，對腳攰到痺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 zo2 seng4 jat6, deoi3 goek3 gui6 dou3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走了一整天，脚累得都麻木了。
examples.english_sentence: After walking all day, my legs are so tired they're numb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 忙到痺，根本冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong4 dou3 bei3, gan1 bun2 mou5 si4 gaan3 hiu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忙得麻木了，根本没有时间休息。
examples.english_sentence: So busy I'm numb, there's simply no time to rest.

english_meaning: Extremely..., very...
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，相当于“非常...”，“极度...”，通常修饰形容词或动词，表达一种夸张、强烈的情感或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree, equivalent to "extremely...", "very...". It usually modifies adjectives or verbs to express an exaggerated, strong emotion or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攰到隻狗噉呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gui3 dou3 zek3 gau2 gam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 累得像狗一样！(非常累！)
examples.english_sentence: So tired like a dog! (Extremely tired!)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到隻狗咁，唔好惹佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zek3 gau2 gam2, m4 hou2 ze2 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得像狗一样，别惹他！(他非常生气！)
examples.english_sentence: He is angry like a dog, don't mess with him! (He's extremely angry!)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餓到隻狗咁，快啲煮嘢食啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo6 dou3 zek3 gau2 gam2, faai3 di1 zyu2 je5 sik6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 饿得像狗一样，快点做饭吧！(非常饿！)
examples.english_sentence: I'm hungry like a dog, hurry up and cook something! (Extremely hungry!)

english_meaning: extremely...; excessively...; to a ridiculous extent; so much that it's 'flying high'
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，达到夸张的程度。强调某种状态或性质非常突出。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree or extent, to the point of exaggeration. Emphasizes that a certain state or characteristic is very prominent. Often used to describe something that is excessively good, bad, busy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近忙到飛起，日日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 mong4 dou3 fei1 hei2, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近忙到起飞，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: He's been extremely busy lately, he has to work overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好食到飛起，排隊都抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 dou3 fei1 hei2, paai4 deoi2 dou1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好吃到飞起，排队都值得。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so delicious, it's worth the queue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日睇咗套戲，好笑到飛起！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 tai2 zo2 tou3 hei3, hou2 siu3 dou3 fei1 hei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天看了一部电影，好笑到起飞！
examples.english_sentence: I watched a movie yesterday, it was hilariously funny!

english_meaning: …to a crazy extent; …to the extreme; …to the point of being insane
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常深，接近疯狂或无法理解的程度。通常用于形容某事物令人难以置信、过度或极端的性质。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is to an extreme degree, approaching madness or incomprehensibility. Usually used to describe the unbelievable, excessive, or extreme nature of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到黐肺，日日都打通宵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 ci1 fai3, jat1 jat1 dou1 daa2 tung1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他玩游戏玩到疯狂，每天都玩通宵。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games to a crazy extent, playing all night every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食貴到黐肺，唔抵食嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gwai3 dou3 ci1 fai3, m4 dai2 sik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西贵得要命，不值得吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is ridiculously expensive, it's not worth eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意佢鍾意到黐肺，成日跟住人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 keoi5 zung1 ji3 dou3 ci1 fai3, seng4 jat1 gaang1 zeoi6 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她喜欢他喜欢到发狂，总是跟着人家。
examples.english_sentence: She likes him to the point of being obsessed, always following him.

jyutping: jau6 m4 hai6... jau6 m4 hai6...
english_meaning: It's not like...it's not like...
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种反驳的语气，强调某种情况并非如此，或用于辩解、推脱。
explanation_english: Used to express a sense of rebuttal or justification. It emphasizes that something is not the case, or is used to excuse or deflect responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想去飲嘢啫，又唔係唔畀錢，又唔係搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 jam2 je5 ze1, jau6 m4 hai6 m4 bei2 cin2, jau6 m4 hai6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是不想去喝东西而已，又不是不付钱，又不是捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: I just don't want to go for drinks, it's not like I'm not paying, it's not like I'm causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到又唔係第一次，又唔係故意嘅，使唔使咁勞氣呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 jau6 m4 hai6 dai6 jat1 ci3, jau6 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ge3, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 lou4 hei3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迟到又不是第一次，又不是故意的，需要这么生气吗？
examples.english_sentence: It's not the first time he's late, and it's not on purpose, does it warrant getting so angry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又唔係細路仔，又唔係唔識字，自己睇咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 m4 hai6 sai3 lou6 zai2, jau6 m4 hai6 m4 sik1 zi6, zi6 gei2 tai2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又不是小孩子，又不是不识字，自己看就好了。
examples.english_sentence: You're not a child, and you're not illiterate, just look at it yourself.

english_meaning: back and forth; to and fro; repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态的重复、反复，或方向的来回。
explanation_english: Indicates repetition, frequency, or back-and-forth movement of an action or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度行嚟行去，好似好心急噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, hou2 ci5 hou2 sam1 gap1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这里走来走去，好像很着急的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's walking back and forth here, looking very anxious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嚟講去都係嗰啲嘢，悶死人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 lai4 gong2 heoi3 dou1 hai6 go2 di1 je5, mun6 sei2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你来说来说去都是那些事，烦死了。
examples.english_sentence: You keep saying the same things over and over, it's so boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗嚟諗去都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 lai4 nam2 heoi3 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想来想去也不知道该怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: I keep thinking and thinking but I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: ...I wouldn't believe it
explanation_mandarin: 表示说话人不相信或认为不可能发生的事情。通常放在句子后面，表示反讽或不相信的语气。
explanation_english: Used at the end of a sentence to express disbelief, sarcasm, or the feeling that something is highly unlikely. Essentially means '...I wouldn't believe it' or '...as if!'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話聽日會準時返工，咁就假啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1, gam2 zau6 gaa2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他明天会准时上班，那才怪！
examples.english_sentence: He said he'll be on time for work tomorrow, as if!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢好鍾意做嘢，咁就假啦！佢日日都詐病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 zou6 je5, gam2 zau6 gaa2 laa1! keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zaa3 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他很喜欢工作，那才怪！他每天都装病。
examples.english_sentence: He said he loves working, yeah right! He fakes being sick every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢會戒煙，咁就假啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 gaai3 jin1, gam2 zau6 gaa2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会戒烟，才怪！
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd quit smoking, yeah right!

english_meaning: It would be strange if...
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 句子结构 (jùzi jiégòu, sentence structure)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种反语，暗示某件事情不太可能发生，或者如果发生了会令人惊讶。
explanation_english: Used to express sarcasm or disbelief; implying that something is highly unlikely or that it would be surprising if it happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶, 今次考試合格就奇囉!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hap6 gaak3 zau6 kei4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，这次考试合格才怪呢！
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, it would be a miracle if he passed this exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔溫書, 考到好成績就奇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 wan1 syu1, haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1 zau6 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不复习，考到好成绩才怪呢。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't study, it would be a surprise if you get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉樣搞法, 間公司唔執笠就奇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 gaau2 faat3, gaan1 gung1 si1 m4 zap1 lap1 zau6 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样搞下去，公司不倒闭才怪。
examples.english_sentence: If things continue this way, it would be strange if the company didn't go bankrupt.

english_meaning: extremely limited; very limited; not much
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常有限，数量或能力不大。
explanation_english: Indicates a very limited degree, small quantity, or limited ability.  Used after a noun or verb phrase to denote the extent is very restricted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅經驗極有限，唔可以委以重任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ging1 gim6 gik1 jau5 haan6, m4 ho2 ji5 wai2 ji5 cung5 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的经验非常有限，不能委以重任。
examples.english_sentence: His experience is very limited; we cannot entrust him with important tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅資源極有限，要慳住用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi1 jyun4 gik1 jau5 haan6, jiu3 haan1 zyu6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的资源极其有限，要省着点用。
examples.english_sentence: Our resources are extremely limited, we need to use them sparingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識嘅英文極有限，可能幫唔到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 ge3 ying1 man2 gik1 jau5 haan6, ho2 nang4 bong1 m4 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我懂的英文非常有限，可能帮不了你。
examples.english_sentence: My English is very limited, I may not be able to help you.

mandarin_meaning: 非常, 很, 极度 (very, extremely)
english_meaning: Very, extremely, excessively; to a great degree
explanation_mandarin: 放在形容词后面，表示程度很高，非常，很，极度。
explanation_english: Used after an adjective to indicate a high degree of intensity, meaning 'very', 'extremely', or 'excessively'. Can also denote an undesirable excess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好唔開心流流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1 lau4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天非常不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He is extremely unhappy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳貴流流，唔抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 gwai3 lau4 lau4, m4 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅贵得要命，不划算。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is excessively expensive and not worth the price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱流流，去游水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 lau4 lau4, heoi3 jau4 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热得很，去游泳吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's extremely hot, let's go swimming.

english_meaning: sun-dried; thoroughly sun-dried
explanation_mandarin: 指物品经过阳光直接曝晒干燥。
explanation_english: Refers to something that has been dried by direct exposure to the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我婆婆成日喺天台生晒啲咸魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 po4 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 tin1 toi4 saang1 saai3 di1 haam4 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶经常在天台上晒咸鱼。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma often sun-dries salted fish on the rooftop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲系生晒嘅瑶柱，特别香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 saang1 saai3 ge3 yiu4 cyu5, dak6 bit1 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是日晒的瑶柱，特别香。
examples.english_sentence: These are sun-dried scallops, they are particularly fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生晒海味，味道好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 saai3 hoi2 mei6, mei6 dou6 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 日晒的海味，味道更好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Sun-dried seafood tastes better.

english_meaning: ...system, ...base (numerical)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种计数方式或系统。前面的部分表示进位的基数。
explanation_english: Indicates a counting system or base. The part before '進制' indicates the base number for carrying over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二進制係電腦嘅基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 zeon3 zai3 hai6 din6 nou5 ge3 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二进制是电脑的基础。
examples.english_sentence: Binary is the foundation of computers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用嘅係十進制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yung6 ge3 hai6 sap6 zeon3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用的是十进制。
examples.english_sentence: We use the decimal system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲文化用十六進制計數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 man4 faa3 yung6 sap6 luk6 zeon3 zai3 gai3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些文化用十六进制计数。
examples.english_sentence: Some cultures use hexadecimal to count.

mandarin_meaning: 办法总比困难多 / 总能找到出路
english_meaning: Where there's a will, there's a way / There's always a solution if you try hard enough
explanation_mandarin: 表示只要肯努力想办法，总能找到解决问题的方法。
explanation_english: It means that as long as you are willing to work hard and find a way, you can always find a solution to the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心嘅，做開有條路㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ge3, zou6 hoi1 jau5 tiu4 lou6 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么担心，总会有办法的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, there's always a way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然好難，但做開有條路，試吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hou2 naan4, daan6 zou6 hoi1 jau5 tiu4 lou6, si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然很难，但努力尝试总能找到方法，试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Although it's difficult, where there's a will, there's a way. Give it a try.

english_meaning: mischievous; playful; witty; full of tricks
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常调皮、古灵精怪，充满幽默感和创意，经常出人意料。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is mischievous, playful, witty, and full of unexpected tricks or clever ideas. Often used to describe a humorous and unpredictable personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鬼馬，成日諗埋啲古靈精怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gwai2 maa5, sing4 jat6 lam2 maai4 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很古灵精怪，整天想一些奇奇怪怪的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very mischievous person, always thinking up strange and quirky things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲嘅主角好鬼馬，好搞笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 chut1 hei3 ge3 zyu2 gok3 hou2 gwai2 maa5, hou2 gau2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的主角很调皮，非常搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: The protagonist of this movie is very playful and funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁鬼馬啦，正經啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gwai2 maa5 laa1, zing3 ging1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么调皮啦，正经一点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so mischievous, be serious!

mandarin_meaning: 黑乎乎的一片; 全部是黑色的
english_meaning: Completely dark; pitch black; everything is black
explanation_mandarin: 形容全部都是黑色的，程度比“黑”更深。 “冚”在这里表示“全部，整个”的意思。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything is completely dark, more intense than just 'black'. 'Ham6' here means 'all' or 'entire'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房冇開燈，黑麻麻冚咁，乜都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 mou5 hoi1 dang1, hak1 maa4 maa4 ham6 gam3, mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间没开灯，黑乎乎的一片，什么都看不到。
examples.english_sentence: The room is dark because the light isn't on, pitch black, you can't see anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完大雨之後，條街黑麻麻冚，好多泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 daai6 jyu5 zi1 hau6, tiu4 gaai1 hak1 maa4 maa4 ham6, hou2 do1 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完大雨之后，街道黑乎乎的一片，很多泥。
examples.english_sentence: After the heavy rain, the street is completely dark and full of mud.

english_meaning: to finish, to complete, to get something done, to settle (a problem)
explanation_mandarin: 完成，做好，解决。
explanation_english: To finish, complete, or successfully manage something; to settle a problem or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要搞掂份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau2 dim6 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要搞定这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: I need to finish this report tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞掂咗，唔使擔心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dim6 zo2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情已经搞定了，不用担心了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is settled, no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使急，我好快搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gap1, ngo5 hou2 faai3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用着急，我很快搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush, I'll finish it quickly.

english_meaning: Speaking in a sneaky or furtive way, a whispering sound suggesting something suspicious is happening.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话的声音像老鼠一样，偷偷摸摸的，表示说话者可能正在做一些不为人知或是不光彩的事情。
explanation_english: Describes a speaking manner that's sneaky, like a mouse. It implies the speaker may be doing something secretive or not above board. The 'seng1' emphasizes the sound of whispering or hushed tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋喺度鬼鬼鼠鼠聲講乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 hai2 dou6 gwai2 gwai2 syu2 syu2 seng1 gong2 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们在这里偷偷摸摸地说话，在说什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you guys whispering about so sneakily here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼鬼鼠鼠聲咁同老闆講嘢，唔知搞乜鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gwai2 syu2 syu2 seng1 gam3 tung4 lou5 baan2 gong2 je5, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天偷偷摸摸地跟老板说话，不知道搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always whispering to the boss in a sneaky way, I wonder what's going on.

mandarin_meaning: 害怕得发抖; 胆怯; 畏惧
english_meaning: To be scared stiff; to be trembling with fear; to be chicken
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因为害怕而发抖或退缩。 比喻胆小，畏惧。
explanation_english: Describes a person trembling or backing down due to fear. Metaphorically means to be cowardly or afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到阿Sir就淆底震，乜都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 a3 Sir1 zau6 ngaau4 dai2 zan3, mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到老师就吓得发抖，什么都不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared when he saw the teacher that he didn't dare to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淆底震啦，試下咪知得唔得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ngaau4 dai2 zan3 laa1, si3 haa5 mai1 zi1 dak1 m4 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要害怕，试一下就知道行不行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be chicken, try it and you'll know if it works.

english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to blabber; to speak without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话颠三倒四，没有条理，胡说八道。也指说话随便，不负责任。
explanation_english: Describes speaking incoherently, illogically, and nonsensically. Also refers to speaking casually and irresponsibly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又喺度口亂歌柄，唔好信佢講嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 hai2 dou6 hau2 lyun6 go1 beng3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又在那里胡说八道了，不要相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He's blabbering again. Don't believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好口亂歌柄，講嘢要負責任㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hau2 lyun6 go1 beng3, gong2嘢 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 jam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要信口开河，说话要负责任。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak without thinking; you need to be responsible for what you say.

english_meaning: noisy and chaotic; loud and disruptive
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常吵闹，喧嚣，像很多鬼在吵架一样。
explanation_english: Describes a very noisy and chaotic situation, as if many ghosts are arguing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路喺度嘈嘩鬼震，真係冇時停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 hai2 dou6 cou4 waa1 gwai2 zan3, zan1 hai6 mou5 si4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群小孩子在这里吵闹喧哗，真是一刻不停。
examples.english_sentence: Those kids are being noisy and chaotic here, they never stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房嘈嘩鬼震，根本冇辦法集中精神做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 cou4 waa1 gwai2 zan3, gan1 bun2 mou5 baan6 faat3 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 zou6嘢。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里吵闹喧哗，根本没有办法集中精神工作。
examples.english_sentence: The room is so noisy and chaotic, it's impossible to concentrate on work.

english_meaning: Asshole, go to hell, damn it
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词, 动词, 感叹词
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语骂人话，表示诅咒对方遭遇不幸或死亡。
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese swear word, expressing a curse for someone to encounter misfortune or death. The literal translation is 'fall on the street'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係仆街嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 puk1 gaai1 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做真是混蛋！
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is really awful!
