examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆街，我部電話跌咗落地!
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 gaai1, ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕，我的电话掉地上了！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, my phone fell on the ground!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友仔好仆街，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 puk1 gaai1, seng4 jat6 ngaak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家伙真混蛋，总是骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is such an asshole, always cheating people out of their money.

english_meaning: bus
explanation_mandarin: 一种公共交通工具，通常用于城市内的短途运输。
explanation_english: A public transportation vehicle, usually used for short-distance travel within a city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都搭巴士返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都坐公共汽车上班。
examples.english_sentence: I take the bus to work every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架巴士啱啱走咗，我要等下一班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 baa1 si2 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 zo2, ngo5 jiu3 dang2 haa6 jat1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公共汽车刚刚走了，我要等下一班。
examples.english_sentence: The bus just left, I have to wait for the next one.

english_meaning: loose; relaxed; to have spare capacity (e.g., money, time)
explanation_mandarin: “鬆水”形容财务状况或时间安排上比较宽裕，有剩余空间或弹性。也可以表示比较放松的状态。
explanation_english: "Sung Seoi" describes a financial situation or schedule that is relatively relaxed, with spare capacity or flexibility. It can also mean being in a relaxed state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家手頭鬆水啲，不如去旅行放鬆下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sau2 tau4 sung1 seoi2 di1, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 fong3 sung1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在手头宽裕些，不如去旅行放松一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Now that I have some money to spare, why don't we go on a trip to relax?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排好鬼忙，時間一啲都唔鬆水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 hou2 gwai2 mong4, si4 gaan3 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 sung1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近很忙，时间一点都不宽裕。
examples.english_sentence: I've been really busy lately, and I don't have any free time at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司最近生意好咗，財政都鬆水咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2, coi4 zing3 dou1 sung1 seoi2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近生意好多了，财政也宽裕了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business has improved recently, and the finances are much looser.

english_meaning: Poached egg in sweet ginger soup
explanation_mandarin: 一种广东甜品，将荷包蛋放在加了姜和糖的水中煮熟。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dessert consisting of a poached egg served in a sweet soup flavored with ginger and sugar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔舒服，阿媽煮咗碗糖水蛋俾我食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6, aa3 maa1 zyu2 zo2 wun2 tong4 seoi2 daan2 bei2 ngo5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不舒服，妈妈煮了一碗糖水荷包蛋给我吃。
examples.english_sentence: I wasn't feeling well, so my mom cooked me a bowl of poached egg in sweet ginger soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日都食糖水蛋當宵夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sik6 tong4 seoi2 daan2 dong3 siu1 je2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常吃糖水荷包蛋当宵夜。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often ate poached egg in sweet ginger soup as a late-night snack.

english_meaning: buck teeth; protruding teeth
explanation_mandarin: 指上颌牙齿明显向前突出，覆盖下颌牙齿。
explanation_english: Refers to a condition where the upper teeth protrude significantly forward, overlapping the lower teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有啲哨牙，所以成日合唔埋口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 di1 saau3 ngaa4, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 hap6 m4 maai4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有点龅牙，所以经常合不拢嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He has a bit of buck teeth, so he often can't close his mouth properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣唔戴牙箍，大個咗就變咗哨牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 m4 daai3 ngaa4 ku1, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 bin3 zo2 saau3 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候不戴牙套，长大了就变成了龅牙。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't wear braces when I was young, and I developed buck teeth when I grew up.

mandarin_meaning: 忙得要死，累得半死 (máng de yào sǐ, lèi de bàn sǐ)
english_meaning: To work oneself to the bone; to be extremely busy and tired; to bust one's ass.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常忙碌，筋疲力尽。常带抱怨或无奈的语气。(xíngróng fēicháng mánglù, jīnpílìjìn. cháng dài bàoyuàn huò wúnài de yǔqì.)
explanation_english: Describes being extremely busy and exhausted, working very hard. Often carries a tone of complaint or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗呢個project，我哋搞生搞死，終於搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 ni1 go3 project, ngo5 dei6 gaau2 sang1 gaau2 sei2, zung1 jyu1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这个项目，我们忙得要死，终于完成了。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, we worked ourselves to the bone, and finally finished it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都搞生搞死，都唔知為乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 dou1 gaau2 sang1 gaau2 sei2, dou1 m4 zi1 wai4 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都忙得要死，都不知道为了什么。
examples.english_sentence: I'm working myself to the bone every day, and I don't even know what for.

synonyms: 做到嘔泡 (zou6 dou3 au2 pou5)

english_meaning: Shut up and keep quiet; to silence someone completely
explanation_mandarin: 意思是让某人闭嘴，并且完全不发出任何声音，带有强烈的命令或威胁意味。
explanation_english: Means to tell someone to shut up and remain completely silent, often with a strong command or threatening tone.  It implies suppressing any form of vocal expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再嘈，我收聲吞咗你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 cou4, ngo5 sau1 seng1 tan1 zo2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再吵，我就让你闭嘴！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep making noise, I'll shut you up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老板嬲到收聲吞咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 nau1 dou3 sau1 seng1 tan1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板生气地让他闭嘴。
examples.english_sentence: The boss was so angry that he told him to shut up completely.

english_meaning: Having nothing to eat at all; having no food available.
explanation_mandarin: 表示什么东西都没有得吃，形容非常贫困或者食物匮乏的情况。
explanation_english: This phrase emphasizes the complete lack of food. It is used to describe situations of extreme poverty or scarcity of food. '乜' means 'anything', '都' means 'also/even', '冇' means 'don't have', '得' (dak1) indicates possibility/permission, and '食' means 'to eat'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 窮到乜都冇得食，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kung4 dou3 mat1 dou1 mou5 dak1 sik6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穷到什么都没有得吃，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: So poor that they have nothing to eat, it's truly pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風之後，啲菜爛晒，乜都冇得食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 zi1 hau6, di1 coi3 laan6 saai3, mat1 dou1 mou5 dak1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风之后，蔬菜都烂掉了，什么都没有得吃。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, all the vegetables were ruined, there's nothing to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺嗰個偏遠嘅地方，成日都乜都冇得食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 go2 go3 pin1 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1, seng4 jat6 dou1 mat1 dou1 mou5 dak1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在那个偏远的地方，经常什么都没有得吃。
examples.english_sentence: They live in that remote place, and they often have nothing to eat.

cantonese: 㓟個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐
jyutping: tai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 把头砍下来给你当凳子坐
english_meaning: I'd cut off my head and give it to you to use as a stool
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常愿意为对方牺牲，表达极大的忠诚或顺从。是非常夸张的说法，通常用于开玩笑或表达对对方的极端尊重和服从。
explanation_english: A hyperbolic expression used to show extreme loyalty, respect, or willingness to sacrifice for someone. It's an exaggerated statement, usually used jokingly or to express extreme deference and obedience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大佬，你講乜都啱，㓟個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lou2, nei5 gong2 mat1 dou1 ngaam1, tai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大哥，你说的都对，把头砍下来给你当凳子坐都可以。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, you're right about everything, I'd even cut off my head and give it to you to use as a stool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係服咗你，㓟個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐都唔過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 fuk6 zo2 nei5, tai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 m4 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真服了你，把头砍下来给你当凳子坐都不算过分。
examples.english_sentence: I'm truly impressed by you; even offering my head as a stool wouldn't be an exaggeration.

english_meaning: to cut the throat; to gouge the throat; to cut someone's throat; figuratively, to drastically reduce prices (in business); price war; cut-throat pricing
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义为割断喉咙。引申为商业竞争中，采取极具侵略性的定价策略，以大幅度降低价格的方式来打击竞争对手。
explanation_english: Literally means to cut the throat. Figuratively, it refers to aggressive pricing strategies in business, where prices are drastically reduced to undermine competitors; often referred to as a 'price war' or 'cut-throat pricing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲公司為咗搶客，搞到㓤喉式減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gung1 si1 wai4 zo2 coeng2 haak3, gaau2 dou3 gaat3 hau4 sik1 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些公司为了抢客户，搞得像割喉一样降价。
examples.english_sentence: Those companies are engaging in cut-throat price reductions in order to snatch customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅競爭好激烈，簡直係㓤喉戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1烈, gaan2 zik6 hai6 gaat3 hau4 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的竞争非常激烈，简直是割喉战。
examples.english_sentence: Their competition is very fierce, it's simply a cut-throat battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔減價，就會俾對手㓤喉㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 gaam2 gaa3, zau6 wui5 bei2 deoi3 sau2 gaat3 hau4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不降价，就会被对手割喉了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't lower our prices, we'll be undercut by our competitors.

synonyms: 削價競爭 (soek3 gaa3 ging6 zang1)

english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; butterfingers
explanation_mandarin: 形容人动作笨拙，不灵巧。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, awkward, or has butterfingers.  They tend to drop things or perform tasks inelegantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好㔆手㗎，成日跌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cou3 sau2 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dit1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很笨手笨脚的，总是掉东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's very clumsy, he's always dropping things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁㔆手啦，小心整爛啲嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cou3 sau2 laa1, siu2 sam1 zeng2 laan6 di1 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨手笨脚的，小心弄坏东西啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, be careful not to break things!

english_meaning: Young man, lad (often carrying connotations of being unsophisticated, immature, or inexperienced)
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的男性，通常带有不太成熟，缺乏经验的含义。 在某些语境下可能带有轻微贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a young man or lad. It often carries connotations of being unsophisticated, immature, or inexperienced. In some contexts, it can be slightly derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個㗎仔乜都唔識，真係幫唔上忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gaa3 zai2 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 bong1 m4 soeng5 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小伙子什么都不懂，真是帮不上忙。
examples.english_sentence: That young man doesn't know anything; he's really not helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲係個㗎仔，唔好期望佢有幾成熟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 hai6 go3 gaa3 zai2, m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 keoi5 jau5 gei2 sing4 suk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还是个小伙子，不要期望他有多成熟。
examples.english_sentence: He's still a young lad, don't expect him to be very mature.

english_meaning: Caucasian man, foreigner (usually white male)
explanation_mandarin: 指外国人，尤其指白人男性。带有一定的口语化和非正式色彩，有时也带有一点点轻微的贬义或戏谑的意味，具体语境决定。
explanation_english: Refers to a foreigner, especially a white male. It is colloquial and informal, and sometimes carries a slightly derogatory or jocular tone, depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先有個㗎佬問我哋路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 jau5 go3 gaa3 lou2 man6 ngo5 dei6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才有个外国人问我们路。
examples.english_sentence: A foreigner just asked us for directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁歧視啲㗎佬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 kei4 si6 di1 gaa3 lou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要歧视那些外国人啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discriminatory towards those foreigners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢娶咗個㗎妹，好幸福噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheui2 zo2 go3 gaa3 mui1, hou2 hang6 fuk1 gam2 yeung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他娶了一个外国女孩，看起来很幸福。
examples.english_sentence: He married a foreign girl and seems very happy.

english_meaning: just, only, that's all
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，表示仅此而已，没什么大不了。
explanation_english: A particle used at the end of a sentence to indicate that something is just, only, or nothing more than what has been stated. It often minimizes the significance of the statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個包㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 baau1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是买了一个包而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only bought one bun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係問下啫，唔係想逼你㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1, m4 hai6 soeng2 bik1 nei5 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是问问而已，不是想逼你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just asking, I don't want to force you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，小事一樁㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, siu2 si6 jat1 zong1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，只是一件小事而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, it's just a small matter.

english_meaning: Really? Is that so? Isn't it?
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问、反问或不确定语气。通常用于句尾，表示说话者对先前所说内容的疑问或惊讶。
explanation_english: An interrogative/rhetorical particle used at the end of a sentence to express doubt, surprise, or questioning. It often implies the speaker's uncertainty about something previously stated or assumed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢聽日唔嚟㗎咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 m4 lei4 gaa3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他明天不来吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said he's not coming tomorrow, is that so?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴㗎咩？我以為平啲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 gaa3 me1? ngo5 ji5 wai4 peng4 di1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵吗？我以为便宜一点呢。
examples.english_sentence: Is it that expensive? I thought it would be cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來你識佢㗎咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 nei5 sik1 keoi5 gaa3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来你认识他啊？
examples.english_sentence: So you know him, do you?

english_meaning: Alright, Okay, That's it, That's enough, It's settled
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意，认可，事情结束或已解决，带有轻松或无奈的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses agreement, acceptance, completion, or resolution. Often carries a sense of ease, resignation, or finality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦好啦，我知㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1 hou2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好啦好啦，我知道了！
examples.english_sentence: Alright, alright, I know!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂㗎啦，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 gaa3 laa1, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定了，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: It's done, no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得㗎啦，夠晒㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 gaa3 laa1, gau3 saai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以了，足够了。
examples.english_sentence: That's enough, more than enough.

english_meaning: that's all / just / simply
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的程度很轻微，语气缓和，相当于“而已”、“罢了”。常用于解释、辩解或安慰。
explanation_english: Indicates that the matter is minor, with a gentle tone, equivalent to 'that's all', 'just', or 'simply'. Often used for explanation, justification, or comfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我咪遲到咗五分鐘㗎啫，使唔使咁大反應呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mai1 ci4 dou3 zo2 ng5 fan1 zung1 gaa3 ze1, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 daai6 faan2 jing3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不过是迟到了五分钟而已，用不着这么大反应吧？
examples.english_sentence: I was just five minutes late, do you have to overreact like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係問下啫，唔好咁緊張啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1, m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只是问问而已，不要这么紧张啦。
examples.english_sentence: We're just asking, don't be so nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試下㗎啫，唔啱咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 gaa3 ze1, m4 ngaam1 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试试而已，不合适就算了。
examples.english_sentence: I'll just try it, if it doesn't fit, then forget it.

english_meaning: Alright; Okay; That's it; That's enough
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情已经完成，或者表示同意、肯定。语气较为轻松。
explanation_english: Indicates completion, agreement, or affirmation. It often carries a casual and reassuring tone. It can mean 'it's done', 'okay', 'that's it', or 'that's enough' depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得㗎喇，唔使再講喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 gaa3 laa3, m4 sai2 zoi3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，不用再说了。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, no need to say anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂㗎喇，放心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 gaa3 laa3, fong3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定了，放心吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's done, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 知㗎喇，你唔使重複咁多次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 gaa3 laa3, nei5 m4 sai2 cung4 fuk1 gam3 do1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 知道了，你不用重复那么多次。
examples.english_sentence: I know, you don't have to repeat it so many times.

english_meaning: particle indicating obviousness, suggestion, or mild surprise; 'you know'
explanation_mandarin: “㗎”和“喎”都是语气助词。“㗎”表示陈述语气，带有明显的意味。“喎”表示轻微的疑问或提醒，有时也表示一种理所当然的态度。组合使用“㗎喎”通常用于在已经很明显的情况下再次强调某事，或者带有略微提醒的语气，有时也表示“你知道的”。
explanation_english: "㗎" and "喎" are both particles. "㗎" indicates a statement and conveys a sense of obviousness. "喎" indicates a slight question or reminder, sometimes conveying an attitude of self-evidence. The combination "㗎喎" is usually used to re-emphasize something that is already obvious, or with a slightly reminding tone, sometimes meaning "you know".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨㗎喎，記得帶遮呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 gaa3 wo3, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨了啊，记得带伞啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, you know. Remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎喎，你唔知咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3 wo3, nei5 m4 zi1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害的，你不知道吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's really good, you know? Don't you know?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經同你講咗㗎喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tung4 nei5 gong2 zo2 gaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经跟你说过了啊。
examples.english_sentence: I've already told you, you know.

mandarin_meaning: 不是...吗 / 难道...吗 (softening the tone)
english_meaning: Isn't it?/ Isn't that so?/ You know?
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，用于句尾，表示说话人认为对方理应知道或理解某事，带有确认或强调语气，也可软化语气。
explanation_english: A modal particle used at the end of a sentence to indicate that the speaker expects the listener to know or understand something, implying confirmation or softening the tone. It suggests that something is obvious or self-evident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約咗聽日見㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yeuk3 zo2 ting1 jat6 gin3 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约好明天见面了呀。
examples.english_sentence: We arranged to meet tomorrow, you know?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔㗎嘛，實搞得掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 zai2 gaa3 maa3, sat6 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么聪明，肯定能搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so clever, he'll definitely be able to handle it, you know?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度咁貴㗎嘛，梗係好食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 gam3 gwai3 gaa3 maa3, gang2 hai6 hou2 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里这么贵，当然好吃啦。
examples.english_sentence: This place is so expensive, of course it's delicious, you know?

english_meaning: Japanese girl
explanation_mandarin: 指日本年轻女性，有时带有对日本流行文化或时尚的喜爱的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a young Japanese girl or woman. Sometimes carries the connotation of interest in Japanese pop culture or fashion. It can sometimes be used in a slightly playful or teasing way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街好多㗎妹喎，應該嚟香港旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 hou2 do1 gaa3 mui1 wo3, jing1 goi1 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街上好多日本女孩啊，应该是来香港旅行的。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of Japanese girls on this street, they must be here for travelling in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮㗎妹，着衫都好kawaii。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 gaa3 mui1, zoek3 saam1 dou1 hou2 kawaii.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是打扮成日本女孩，穿衣服也很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: She always dresses like a Japanese girl, and her clothes are very kawaii.

english_meaning: Japanese language
explanation_mandarin: 香港口语中，指日语。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong colloquial Cantonese, it refers to the Japanese language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講流利㗎文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 lau4 lei6 gaa3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说流利的日语。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak fluent Japanese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇得明㗎文嘅漫畫咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 dak1 ming4 gaa3 man2 ge3 maan6 waa2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看得懂日文漫画吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you understand Japanese manga?

english_meaning: Really? Is that so? Is it?
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问或确认的语气，常用于句尾，表达惊讶、不相信或寻求确认等。
explanation_english: A modal particle used at the end of a sentence to express doubt, surprise, disbelief, or to seek confirmation. It's used to convey a questioning or confirmatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢辭咗職，㗎話？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 ci4 zo2 zik1, gaa3 waa2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他辞职了，真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said he resigned, really?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴，㗎話？我以為好平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3, gaa3 waa2? ngo5 ji5 wai4 hou2 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵，真的吗？我还以为很便宜。
examples.english_sentence: So expensive, really? I thought it was cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日唔嚟，㗎話？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 m4 lai4, gaa3 waa2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天不来，是吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's not coming tomorrow, is he?

english_meaning: thing; stuff; belongings; gear
explanation_mandarin: 指物件、东西，通常指个人物品或工具。
explanation_english: Refers to things, stuff, belongings, or gear, often personal items or tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執齊啲㗎頭準備搬屋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 cai4 di1 gaa3 tau4 zeon2 bei6 bun1 uk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把东西收拾好，准备搬家吧。
examples.english_sentence: Pack up your stuff, get ready to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好多㗎頭要帶去露營。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 do1 gaa3 tau4 jiu3 daai3 heoi3 lou6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很多东西要带去露营。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of gear to take camping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我嘅㗎頭，唔好亂咁掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gaa3 tau4, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我的东西，不要乱动。
examples.english_sentence: These are my things, don't touch them randomly.

english_meaning: To shout loudly, to make a racket; usually refers to babies/children crying loudly or people arguing noisily.
explanation_mandarin: 形容婴儿哭闹或人们吵闹的声音很大。
explanation_english: Describes the sound of babies crying loudly, or people arguing noisily and vehemently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB喺度㗱㗱聲咁喊，唔知係咪肚餓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bi1 bi1 hai2 dou6 gwaak1 gwaak1 seng1 gam3 haam3, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 tou5 ngo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个婴儿一直在哇哇大哭，不知道是不是饿了。
examples.english_sentence: That baby is crying loudly, I wonder if it's hungry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離屋兩公婆成日都㗱㗱聲咁嘈交，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 uk1 loeng5 gung1 po4 seng4 jat6 dou1 gwaak1 gwaak1 seng1 gam3 cou4 gaau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁家的夫妻经常吵架吵得很凶，真烦人。
examples.english_sentence: The couple next door always argues loudly, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: Rustling sound; rustling noise
explanation_mandarin: 形容细微而连续的摩擦声音，比如风吹树叶、纸张摩擦等发出的声音。
explanation_english: Describes a soft, rustling sound, often continuous, produced by friction, such as the sound of wind blowing through leaves or the rubbing of paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到窗外面有㗾㗾聲，好似落緊雨咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting3 dou2 coeng1 ngoi6 min6 jau5 sa4 sa4 seng1, hou2 ci5 lok6 ging2 jyu5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到窗外有沙沙声，好像在下雨一样。
examples.english_sentence: I hear a rustling sound outside the window, it sounds like it's raining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風吹住啲樹葉，發出㗾㗾聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 ceoi1 zyu6 di1 syu6 jip6, faat3 ceot1 sa4 sa4 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风吹着树叶，发出沙沙声。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is blowing through the leaves, making a rustling sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係度摷緊啲文件，搞到㗾㗾聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 jau2 gan2 di1 man4 gin2, gaau2 dou3 sa4 sa4 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在翻找文件，发出沙沙声。
examples.english_sentence: He's rummaging through the documents, making rustling noises.

english_meaning: wasteful, extravagant, to squander
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人花钱或者用东西非常浪费，没有节制。也可以用作动词，表示浪费的行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who spends money or uses things wastefully and without restraint. Can also be used as a verb to describe the act of wasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日㗾哆錢，唔識儲蓄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 saai1 do1 cin2, m4 sik1 chyu5 chuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是浪费钱，不懂得储蓄。
examples.english_sentence: He always wastes money and doesn't know how to save.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁㗾哆啲食物，要珍惜啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 saai1 do1 di1 sik6 mat6, jiu3 zan1 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么浪费食物，要珍惜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste food like that, you should cherish it.

english_meaning: Gay rape, male-on-male sexual assault
explanation_mandarin: 指男性对男性进行的性侵犯行为，属于同性性侵犯的一种。这是一个非常严肃的指控，关乎法律和道德问题。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of sexual assault committed by a male against another male. It is a type of same-sex sexual assault. This is a very serious accusation involving legal and moral issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知呢單案件係咪真係㚻奸，但係性侵犯無論咩性別都應該受到譴責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 ni1 daan1 on3 gin2 hai6 mai1 zaan1 hai6 gaan1 gaan1, daan6 hai6 sing3 cam1 faan6 mou4 leon6 me1 sing3 bit6 dou1 jing1 goi1 sau6 dou3 hin2 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道这个案件是不是真的是男同性恋性侵犯，但是性侵犯无论什么性别都应该受到谴责。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know if this case is actually gay rape, but sexual assault, regardless of gender, should be condemned.

english_meaning: useless; rubbish; crap; garbage; shit
explanation_mandarin: 指人或物没有用，差劲，质量低劣。是粗俗的用语。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that is useless, of poor quality, or generally bad. It is a vulgar expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做啲嘢咁㞗屎，邊個會用啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 di1 je5 gam3 gau1 si2, bin1 go3 wui5 yung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做的东西这么差劲，谁会用啊？
examples.english_sentence: What you made is so useless, who would use it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦真係㞗屎，成日hang機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 gau1 si2, seng4 jat6 hang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑真垃圾，经常死机。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is rubbish, it always freezes.

english_meaning: under the buttocks; figuratively, someone who is a follower, lackey, or yes-man
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指屁股的下面。引申为指听命于人、唯唯诺诺的人；指地位卑微、受人指使的人。
explanation_english: Literally means 'under the buttocks'. Figuratively, it refers to someone who is subservient, a follower, a lackey, or a yes-man. It implies a low social standing and being at someone's beck and call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺老細㞘底，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 juk1 dai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是跟在老板屁股后面，真是很讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always following the boss around like a lackey, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做人㞘底，要有自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 juk1 dai2, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做别人的跟屁虫，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone's lackey; you should have your own opinions.

english_meaning: To support; to back someone up; to cheer someone on; to hype something up; to boost (a person, event, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指给予支持，捧场，使场面更加热闹或提高某人的声势。
explanation_english: To provide support, to boost morale, to liven up a scene or to increase someone's popularity or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂！幫手㧬吓火啦，唔係我一個人撐唔住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3! bong1 sau2 bong2 haa5 fo2 laa1, m4 hai6 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 caang1 m4 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂！帮帮忙，捧捧场吧，不然我一个人撑不住的。
examples.english_sentence: Hey! Please help support me, otherwise I can't hold on by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳開張，梗係要搵多啲朋友嚟㧬吓火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 hoi1 zoeng1, gang2 hai6 jiu3 wan2 do1 di1 pang4 jau5 lai4 bong2 haa5 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅开张，当然要找多些朋友来捧捧场。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is opening, of course, we need to find more friends to support it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得咁精彩，我一定要㧬你場啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 gam3 zing1 coi2, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bong2 nei5 coeng4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讲得这么精彩，我一定要给你捧场了！
examples.english_sentence: You spoke so wonderfully, I must support you!

mandarin_meaning: 推开; 拨开; 挪开
english_meaning: to push aside; to shove open; to push away; to clear a path (by pushing things aside)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或物体将东西推开，使其分开或腾出空间。
explanation_english: To push something aside with hands or an object, creating space or separating things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好企喺度，㧬開啲啦，阻住晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 dou6, bung2 hoi1 di1 laa1, zo2 zyu6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要站在那里，让开一点，挡住路了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand there, move aside a little, you're blocking the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢㧬開人群，衝咗入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bung2 hoi1 yan4 kwan4, cung1 zo2 yap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推开人群，冲了进去。
examples.english_sentence: He pushed through the crowd and rushed in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 㧬開啲頭髮，畀我睇下你塊面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bung2 hoi1 di1 tau4 faat3, bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5 nei5 faai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把头发拨开一些，让我看看你的脸。
examples.english_sentence: Push your hair aside a bit, let me see your face.

english_meaning: To praise non-stop, to keep singing praises
explanation_mandarin: 形容不停地赞美或夸奖，像嘴巴和鼻子都在不停地说话一样。
explanation_english: Describes praising or complimenting someone or something incessantly, as if both the mouth and nose are constantly talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗獎之後，啲人咪㧻口㧻鼻讚佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 zoeng2 zi1 hau6, di1 jan4 mai1 lap1 hau2 lap1 bei6 zaan3 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得奖之后，人们就赞不绝口地夸奖他。
examples.english_sentence: After he won the award, people kept praising him incessantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使㧻口㧻鼻咁讚我，我都唔會請你食飯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 lap1 hau2 lap1 bei6 gam3 zaan3 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用这样赞不绝口地夸我，我也不会请你吃饭的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to praise me so excessively; I still won't treat you to a meal.

mandarin_meaning: 揀選次等的、退而求其次
english_meaning: To settle for second best; to choose a less desirable option; to make do
explanation_mandarin: 原本是象棋术语，表示在没有更好选择的情况下，只能选择兵卒。引申为在诸多选择中，无奈之下选择较差或不理想的选项。
explanation_english: Originally a chess term, meaning choosing a pawn when there are no better options.  It is now used figuratively to mean settling for a less desirable option when better options are unavailable or unattainable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇辦法啦，冇錢買樓，唯有㨂卒租劏房住囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 baan6 faat3 laa1, mou5 cin2 maai5 lau2, wai4 jau5 dung2 zeot1 zu1 tong1 fong2 zyu6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没办法了，没钱买楼，只好退而求其次租劏房住了。
examples.english_sentence: There's no other way. I don't have money to buy a flat, so I have to settle for renting a subdivided flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明可以揀更好嘅工，但係佢為咗離屋企近啲，所以㨂卒揀咗份人工低啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 ho2 ji5 gaan2 gang3 hou2 ge3 gung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 wai6 zo2 lei4 uk1 kei5 gan6 di1, so2 ji5 dung2 zeot1 gaan2 zo2 fan6 jan4 gung1 dai1 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明可以选择更好的工作，但是他为了离家近一些，所以退而求其次选择了一份工资低一些的。
examples.english_sentence: He could have chosen a better job, but he settled for a lower-paying one to be closer to home.

english_meaning: To help, to assist, to lend a hand
explanation_mandarin: 提供帮助，协助别人完成某事。
explanation_english: To provide assistance or help to someone in completing a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該㨂手幫我攞高啲啲嘢吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 dung2 sau2 bong1 ngo5 lo2 go1 di1 di1 je5 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦帮我拿高一点东西好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me reach those things on the top shelf?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁多人，一定夠人㨂手搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam3 do1 jan4, jat1 ding6 gau3 jan4 dung2 sau2 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这么多人，肯定够人帮忙搬家。
examples.english_sentence: With so many of us, we definitely have enough people to help with the move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔識做，我可以㨂手教你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 sik1 zou6, ngo5 ho2 ji5 dung2 sau2 gaau3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不会做，我可以帮忙教你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't know how to do it, I can help and teach you.

english_meaning: to choose, to select, to pick
explanation_mandarin: 挑选、选择。从多个选项中选取合适的。
explanation_english: To choose or select from multiple options. To pick out something suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去餐廳食飯，你想㨂擇食啲乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6, nei5 soeng2 dung2 zaak6 sik6 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去餐厅吃饭，你想选择吃什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: We're going to a restaurant to eat. What do you want to choose to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度咁多衫，畀你慢慢㨂擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 gam3 do1 saam1, bei2 nei5 maan6 maan2 dung2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里这么多衣服，让你慢慢选择。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many clothes here, take your time to choose.

english_meaning: To be picky; to choose a floor (in a building)
explanation_mandarin: 选择楼层。也指挑剔，对选择对象要求很高。
explanation_english: To choose a floor, often referring to selecting a specific floor in a building. Also, it can mean to be picky or particular, having high standards when choosing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買樓好㨂樓，睇咗好多間都唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 lau2 hou2 dung2 lau2, tai2 zo2 hou2 do1 gaan1 dou1 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买房子很挑剔，看了很多套都不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He's very picky when buying a house; he's seen many places but none of them are suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想㨂高啲嘅樓層，風景會靚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 dung2 gou1 di1 ge3 lau2 cang4, fung1 ging2 wui5 leng3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想选高一些的楼层，风景会漂亮一些。
examples.english_sentence: We want to choose a higher floor so the view will be nicer.

english_meaning: to pick and choose; to be picky; to select carefully
explanation_mandarin: 本义是挑选蟋蟀，后引申为挑剔、精挑细选的意思。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to choose crickets,' but is used to describe being picky, carefully selecting, or scrutinizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁㨂蟀啦，是但買件咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 dung2 seot1 laa1, si6 daan6 maai5 gin6 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么挑剔了，随便买一件就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, just buy something and be done with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話我㨂蟀，搵男朋友要求太高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 dung2 seot1, wan2 naam4 pang4 jau5 jiu1 kau4 taai3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说我挑剔，找男朋友要求太高。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always says I'm picky and have too high standards when looking for a boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買嘢好㨂蟀，一定要揀最好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 je5 hou2 dung2 seot1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaan2 zeoi3 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买东西很挑剔，一定要选最好的。
examples.english_sentence: He's very picky when buying things; he always has to choose the best.

english_meaning: to choose, to select
explanation_mandarin: 挑选选择。在多个选项中选取一个或多个。
explanation_english: To pick and choose; to select from multiple options.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以㨂選你想食嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 dung2 syun2 nei5 soeng2 sik6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以选择你想吃的东西。
examples.english_sentence: You can choose what you want to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知應該㨂選邊個好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 jing1 goi1 dung2 syun2 bin1 go3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道应该选择哪个好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know which one I should choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有權㨂選自己嘅生活方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 kwan4 dung2 syun2 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有权选择自己的生活方式。
examples.english_sentence: He has the right to choose his own lifestyle.

english_meaning: To be picky about food and drink; to be choosy; fastidious
explanation_mandarin: 形容对食物和饮料非常挑剔，选择的标准很高。
explanation_english: Describes being very picky about food and drinks, with high standards for selection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好㨂飲擇食㗎，茶餐廳啲嘢佢好多都唔啱食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dung2 jam2 zaak6 sik6 gaa3, caa4 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 keoi5 hou2 do1 dou1 m4 ngaam1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很挑食，茶餐厅的东西他很多都不喜欢吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's very picky about food; he doesn't like a lot of things from the 'cha chaan teng' (Hong Kong style cafe).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥唔好咁㨂飲擇食，樣樣都要試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 go1 m4 hou2 gam3 dung2 jam2 zaak6 sik6, joeng2 joeng2 dou1 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不要这么挑食，什么都要尝试一下。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't be so picky about food; you should try everything.

mandarin_meaning: 哄骗；使（人）开心；使（人）满意
english_meaning: to coax; to placate; to make someone happy; to sweet-talk
explanation_mandarin: 用甜言蜜语或行动使人高兴、满意或听从。多指哄小孩或恋人。
explanation_english: To coax someone with sweet words or actions to make them happy, satisfied, or willing to obey. Often used in the context of哄ing children or lovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔扭計，要㨃冧佢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 nau2 gai2, jiu3 tung3 lam1 keoi5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子耍赖，要先哄他才行。
examples.english_sentence: My son is being difficult, I need to coax him first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲咗，你要諗辦法㨃冧返佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 zo2, nei5 jiu3 nam2 baan2 faat3 tung3 lam1 faan1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她生气了，你要想办法哄回她。
examples.english_sentence: She's angry, you need to find a way to sweet-talk her back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使㨃冧我，我知你講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 tung3 lam1 ngo5, ngo5 zi1 nei5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用哄我，我知道你在说谎。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother placating me, I know you're lying.

english_meaning: to write a draft, to rough out, to sketch out (ideas or plans)
explanation_mandarin: 指初步拟定、起草计划或文章。也指草率应付。
explanation_english: Refers to drafting a plan or article in a preliminary way. It can also mean to do something perfunctorily or sloppily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要㨃草先，然後先可以寫份正式嘅報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wat6 cou2 sin1, jin4 hau6 sin1 ho2 ji5 se2 fan6 zing3 sik1 ge3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先打草稿，然后才能写一份正式的报告。
examples.english_sentence: We need to write a draft first, and then we can write a formal report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁㨃草啦，做得認真啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 wat6 cou2 laa1, zou6 dak1 jing6 zan1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么草率，认真一点行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sloppy, can't you be more serious?

mandarin_meaning: 劝酒, 硬要别人喝酒
english_meaning: To urge someone to drink (alcohol), to pressure someone to drink
explanation_mandarin: 指强迫或者过分劝说别人喝酒。通常带有负面含义，表示给对方造成压力。
explanation_english: To force or excessively urge someone to drink alcohol. It usually has a negative connotation, indicating putting pressure on the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再㨃酒啦，佢已經飲醉曬喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 pong3 zau2 laa1, keoi5 ji5 ging1 yam2 zeoi3 saai3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再劝酒了，他已经喝醉了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't urge him to drink anymore, he's already completely drunk!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最憎啲人係咁㨃酒，好冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zang1 di1 yan4 hai6 gam2 pong3 zau2, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最讨厌那些一直劝酒的人，非常没有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: I hate people who keep urging others to drink, it's very impolite.

english_meaning: to humour someone, to please someone, to placate someone
explanation_mandarin: 指用言语或行动去取悦、哄骗或安抚某人，使其心情愉快或平息怒气。
explanation_english: To humour someone, please someone, or placate someone with words or actions, making them happy or calming their anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為講幾句好聽嘅嘢就㨆到人山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 gong2 gei2 geui3 hou2 teng1 ge3 je5 zau6 hong6 dou3 jan4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为说几句好听的话就能哄得人开心了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can please everyone by just saying a few nice things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽嬲咗，你快啲㨆下佢人山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 nau1 zo2, nei5 faai3 di1 hong6 haa5 keoi5 jan4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈生气了，你快点哄哄她。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is angry, you should quickly try to please her.

english_meaning: To ruin one's reputation; to tarnish one's image; to screw up
explanation_mandarin: 比喻搞壞名譽，使聲譽受損。
explanation_english: To ruin one's reputation or tarnish one's image; to do something that damages someone's or something's good name. It suggests a deliberate or careless action leading to a negative outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係㨘緊公司招牌呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 luk1 gan2 gung1 si1 ziu1 paai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做真是砸公司的招牌啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're really ruining the company's reputation by doing this!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋繼續賣假貨，遲早都會㨘埋自己嘅招牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 gai3 zuk6 maai6 gaa2 fo3, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 luk1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 ziu1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们继续卖假货，迟早都会砸了自己的招牌。
examples.english_sentence: If they continue to sell fake goods, they will eventually ruin their own reputation.

english_meaning: to brag, to boast, to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指吹嘘自己，说大话，夸大事实。
explanation_english: To boast or brag about oneself, exaggerating achievements or abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都㨘牛王，話自己好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fat6 ngau4 wong4, waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是吹牛，说自己很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He always brags, saying he is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢，佢個人鍾意㨘牛王㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 go3 jan4 zung1 ji3 fat6 ngau4 wong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他，他这个人喜欢吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe him, he likes to brag.

english_meaning: To grope (someone), usually in a sexual manner; to touch inappropriately; to cop a feel.
explanation_mandarin: 这是一个粗俗的粤语俚语，比喻非礼女性的胸部。字面意思是“抚摸黄花鱼”。
explanation_english: This is a vulgar Cantonese slang term that euphemistically refers to groping a woman's breasts. The literal translation is "to grope yellow croaker fish."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士上面㨘黃魚，真係好變態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6 wat6 wong4 jyu2, zan1 hai6 hou2 bin3 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公共汽车上摸女性的胸部，真的很变态。
examples.english_sentence: He groped someone on the bus, he's really perverted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為可以隨便㨘黃魚呀，小心俾人告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 wat6 wong4 jyu2 aa3, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为你可以随便摸女性的胸部啊，小心被人告。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can just grope people, be careful you get sued.

english_meaning: to grab someone's hand; to hold someone's hand (firmly)
explanation_mandarin: 用手抓住别人的手。一般指用力抓住，不让对方离开或摆脱。
explanation_english: To grab or hold someone's hand, often firmly. Implies a sense of holding on tight, preventing the other person from leaving or getting away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚我會走咗，所以㩉住我隻手唔放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 ngo5 wui5 zau2 zo2, so2 ji5 nap1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 m4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他怕我会走掉，所以抓着我的手不放。
examples.english_sentence: He was afraid I would leave, so he grabbed my hand and wouldn't let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友喺街度蕩失路，即刻㩉住阿媽隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 dong6 sat1 lou6, zik1 hak1 nap1 zyu6 a3 maa1 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小朋友在街上迷路了，立刻抓住妈妈的手。
examples.english_sentence: The little kid got lost on the street and immediately grabbed his mother's hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到㩉實拳頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 nap1 sat6 kyun4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地紧握拳头。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he clenched his fist tightly.

english_meaning: Quickly, readily, readily agreeable; crisp
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事爽快，或者形容食物口感脆。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is quick and decisive in their actions, or describes the crisp texture of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承得好㩋㩋脆，應該無問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing3 sing4 dak1 hou2 lung4 lung4 ceoi3, jing1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应得很爽快，应该没问题了吧。
examples.english_sentence: He agreed readily, so there shouldn't be any problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲炸雞皮㩋㩋脆，好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zaa3 gai1 pei4 lung4 lung4 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些炸鸡皮很脆，非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: These fried chicken skins are crispy, very delicious!

mandarin_meaning: 装模作样；假装努力；敷衍了事
english_meaning: To pretend to be working hard; to go through the motions; to feign effort; to play the role (but without genuine commitment)
explanation_mandarin: 表面上装作努力工作，实际上并没有真正投入。比喻敷衍了事，做表面功夫。
explanation_english: Literally, it translates to "pressing on the ground to swim." This idiom describes someone who appears to be working hard, but is actually just going through the motions and not putting in genuine effort. It implies a lack of sincerity or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前㩒地游水，扮曬嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 gam6 dei6 jau4 seoi2, baan6 saai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前装模作样，假装很努力。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to work hard in front of the boss, acting like he's doing a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係㩒地游水，真係要用心去做先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gam6 dei6 jau4 seoi2, zan1 hai6 jiu3 jung6 sam1 heoi3 zou6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是装模作样，真的要用心去做才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just pretend to work hard; you really need to put your heart into it.

english_meaning: to press a button
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或其他物体按下按钮。
explanation_english: To press a button, typically with a finger or other object, to activate a device or system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 㩒掣開門啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam6 zai3 hoi1 mun4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按按钮开门吧！
examples.english_sentence: Press the button to open the door!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁㩒掣呀，會壞嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gam6 zai3 aa3, wui5 waai6 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱按按钮，会坏的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't press the buttons randomly, it will break!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你㩒咗邊個掣呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam6 zo2 bin1 go3 zai3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你按了哪个按钮？
examples.english_sentence: Which button did you press?

english_meaning: Playing on the phone; fiddling with a mobile phone
explanation_mandarin: 指玩手机，尤其指专注地在手机上进行各种操作，例如玩游戏、看视频、刷社交媒体等。
explanation_english: Refers to playing on a mobile phone, especially focusing on various operations like playing games, watching videos, or browsing social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都㩒機，唔理人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gam2 gei1, m4 lei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在玩手机，不理人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always on his phone, ignoring people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺課堂上面㩒機啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 min6 gam2 gei1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在课堂上玩手机！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play on your phone in class!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我㩒咗成日機，對眼好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam2 zo2 seng4 jat6 gei1, deoi3 ngaan5 hou2 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我玩了一整天手机，眼睛很累。
examples.english_sentence: I've been on my phone all day, my eyes are tired.

english_meaning: to nail down; to confirm; to finalize
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把事情确定下来，不再更改。也指在会议或讨论中最终确认某事。
explanation_english: Figuratively, it means to nail down a decision, plan, or arrangement, making it final and unchangeable. Also refers to confirming something during a meeting or discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經㩒釘咗下個禮拜開會嘅時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 gam6 ding1 zo2 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经确定了下周开会的时间。
examples.english_sentence: We have already confirmed the meeting time for next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約仲未㩒釘，仲有啲嘢要傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 oek3 zung6 mei6 gam6 ding1, zung6 jau5 di1 je5 jiu3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同还没有最后确定，还有些事情要谈。
examples.english_sentence: This contract hasn't been finalized yet, there are still some things to discuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋而家就㩒釘埋細節佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zau6 gam6 ding1 maai4 sai3 zit3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们现在就把细节确定下来吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we nail down the details now?

english_meaning: to withdraw money, to get money from an ATM
explanation_mandarin: 从自动柜员机（ATM）或银行柜台提取现金。
explanation_english: To withdraw cash from an ATM (automated teller machine) or from a bank teller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏啲要去㩒錢，準備聽日去旅行用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 di1 jiu3 heoi3 gam2 cin2, zeon2 bei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚点要去取钱，准备明天去旅行用。
examples.english_sentence: I need to withdraw money later, to prepare for travelling tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔夠錢使，陣間出去㩒啲錢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gau3 cin2 sai2, zan6 gaan1 cheut1 heoi3 gam2 di1 cin2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不够用，一会儿出去取点钱先。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have enough money, I'll go out and withdraw some money later.

english_meaning: to withdraw money (from an ATM or bank)
explanation_mandarin: 从自动提款机或银行提取现金。
explanation_english: To withdraw cash, usually from an ATM (Automated Teller Machine) or from a bank teller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我陣間去㩒鐳，你使唔使幫你㩒埋呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 heoi3 gam6 lei4, nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 bong1 nei5 gam6 maai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一会儿去提款，你要不要我帮你一起提？
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to withdraw money later, do you want me to withdraw some for you too?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部提款機壞咗，㩒唔到鐳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 tai4 kwan2 gei1 waai6 zo2, gam6 m4 dou2 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那台提款机坏了，取不了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The ATM is broken, I can't withdraw money.

english_meaning: To kill time; to dawdle; to procrastinate
explanation_mandarin: 指无所事事，浪费时间；或者故意拖延时间。
explanation_english: Refers to idling away time, wasting time; or deliberately delaying time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好係度㩒鷓鴣啦，快啲做完嘢佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gam6 ze3 gu1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 je5 ge3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里磨时间了，快点把事情做完吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle here, finish your work quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇嘢做，淨係係屋企㩒鷓鴣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 je5 zou6, zing6 hai6 hai2 uk1 kei2 gam6 ze3 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没事做，只是在家里磨时间。
examples.english_sentence: I have nothing to do today, just killing time at home.

english_meaning: chattering incessantly; talkative; nagging
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话很多，不停地说，有时带有一些埋怨或者烦躁的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person who talks a lot, constantly speaking, sometimes with a hint of complaint or annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度㩧㩧聲，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 bik1 bik1 seng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶整天在那里喋喋不休，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is always chattering away there, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再㩧㩧聲啦，我知錯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 bik1 bik1 seng1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 co3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再唠叨了，我知道错了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop nagging, I know I was wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好㩧㩧聲，成日講埋啲無聊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 bik1 bik1 seng1, sing4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 mou4 liu4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很爱说话，总是说一些无聊的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very talkative person, always saying boring things.

mandarin_meaning: 小声嘀咕；自言自语；碎碎念
english_meaning: To mumble; to mutter; to murmur; to talk to oneself quietly
explanation_mandarin: 指小声地自言自语，有时带有一些抱怨或不满的情绪。
explanation_english: Refers to talking to oneself quietly, often with a hint of complaint or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路行一路㩧㩧齋，唔知喺度諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 haang4 jat1 lou6 mok1 mok1 zai1, m4 zi1 hai2 dou6 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一路走一路小声嘀咕，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was mumbling to himself as he walked, I don't know what he was thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度㩧㩧齋啦，有咩嘢直接講出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 mok1 mok1 zai1 laa1, jau5 me1 je5 zik6 zip3 gong2 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里嘀嘀咕咕的，有什么直接说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mutter to yourself here, just say what you want to say.

english_meaning: idiot, fool, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人愚笨，反应迟钝。有时也带有轻蔑或开玩笑的语气。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is foolish, slow-witted, or dull. Sometimes used with a tone of contempt or as a joke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係㩧佬嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 fat1 lou2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这都不明白，真是个傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: You don't even understand this? You're really an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁㩧佬啦，醒醒定定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fat1 lou2 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻了，清醒一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, wake up!

english_meaning: To mess around; to fool around; to screw things up; to be incompetent; to be a screw-up
explanation_mandarin: 指做事敷衍了事，馬虎，或者能力不足導致把事情搞砸。带有负面含义，批评意味。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things perfunctorily, carelessly, or having insufficient ability that leads to messing things up. Carries a negative connotation and criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再㩧嘢啦，次次都係咁!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 pok1 je5 laa1, ci3 ci3 dou1 hai6 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再胡闹了，每次都是这样！
examples.english_sentence: Stop messing around, it's always like this!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工做得好㩧嘢，老細好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 hou2 pok1 je5, lou5 sai3 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作做得太马虎了，老板很不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He does his job very incompetently, the boss is very dissatisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪㩧嘢啦，认真啲做嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 pok1 je5 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别胡闹了，认真点工作！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around, do your work seriously!

english_meaning: to be cuckolded, to be cheated on (by one's spouse/partner)
explanation_mandarin: 指配偶或伴侣出轨，使对方蒙羞。
explanation_english: To be cheated on by one's spouse or partner; to be cuckolded, causing shame and humiliation to the betrayed party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆同佢啲朋友搞埋一齊，佢真係俾人㩧咗頂大帽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po2 tung4 keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 gaau2 maai4 jat1 cai4, keoi5 zan1 hai6 bei2 jan4 paak3 zo2 ding2 daai6 mou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老婆和他的一些朋友搞在一起了，他真的被戴了一顶大绿帽子。
examples.english_sentence: His wife slept with some of his friends, he really got cuckolded big time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁老土啦，仲用㩧帽嚟形容人哋嘅感情事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou5 tou2 laa1, zung6 yung6 paak3 mou2 lai4 jing4 yung4 yan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 cing4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么老土了，还用戴绿帽子来形容别人的感情事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so old-fashioned, still using "cuckolded" to describe other people's relationships.

english_meaning: To loaf around; to hang out idly; to waste time
explanation_mandarin: 指没有目标，到处闲逛，浪费时间。
explanation_english: Refers to wandering around aimlessly without any specific goal, wasting time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日都喺屋企㩧槌，都唔出去搵嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 fu4 ceoi4, dou1 m4 cheot1 heoi3 wan2 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整天都在家闲混，都不出去找点事情做。
examples.english_sentence: You're just loafing around at home all day, not even going out to find something to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日㩧槌啦，做啲有意義嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 fu4 ceoi4 laa1, zou6 di1 jau5 ji3 yi6 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要整天游手好闲了，做一些有意义的事情吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just loaf around all day, do something meaningful.

english_meaning: Sloppy, messy, careless (in work or personal appearance)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事马虎，不认真，或者外表不整洁、邋遢。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is sloppy, careless in their work, or untidy in their appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好㩧溼，成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 lap1 sap1, seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很马虎，经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's very sloppy in his work and makes mistakes all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁㩧溼啦，執拾下間房啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lap1 sap1 laa1, zap1 sap6 haa5 gaan1 fong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么邋遢了，收拾一下房间吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so messy, clean up your room.

english_meaning: Sloppy, messy, dirty, unkempt
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境或物品脏乱，不整洁。
explanation_english: Describes an environment or object that is dirty, messy, or unkempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房咁㩧濕，快啲執乾淨佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 lap1 sap1, faai3 di1 zap1 gon1 zing6 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么邋遢，快点收拾干净吧！
examples.english_sentence: The room is so messy, tidy it up quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好㩧濕，成日唔換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 lap1 sap1, seng4 jat6 m4 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很邋遢，经常不换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He is very sloppy, often doesn't change his clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 敲竹杠的团伙，诈骗集团
english_meaning: scam artists, swindlers, extortion gang
explanation_mandarin: 指以不正当手段欺骗、勒索他人财物的团伙。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people who deceive or extort money from others through illegitimate means. Literally: 'Bashing Head Party' (implying a hard approach to extract money).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信佢哋啊，佢哋係㩧頭黨嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6 aa3, keoi5 dei6 hai6 hon6 tau4 dong2 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信他们，他们是诈骗团伙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust them, they are a bunch of scam artists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司根本係㩧頭黨，專呃啲老人家嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gan1 bun2 hai6 hon6 tau4 dong2, zyun1 aak1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa3 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司根本是诈骗集团，专门骗老年人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: This company is basically a scam, specializing in cheating old people out of their money.

english_meaning: to show off, to act pretentious, to put on airs, to flaunt wealth (often beyond one's means)
explanation_mandarin: 指人故意炫耀自己的财富或地位，装作很有钱或很有势力，通常带有负面含义，表示不真实或虚荣。
explanation_english: Refers to someone deliberately showing off their wealth or status, pretending to be rich or powerful. It usually carries a negative connotation, indicating that it's insincere or vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日㪗大氣啦，你都唔係咁有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sing4 jat6 pong3 daai6 hei3 laa1, nei5 dou1 m4 hai6 gam3 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是摆阔气了，你又不是那么有钱。
examples.english_sentence: Stop showing off all the time, you're not even that rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最鍾意喺啲女仔面前㪗大氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 hai2 di1 neoi5 zai2 min6 cin4 pong3 daai6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最喜欢在女孩子面前摆阔气。
examples.english_sentence: He loves to show off in front of girls.

english_meaning: Boiling hot; bubbly; excited; in high spirits; lively
explanation_mandarin: 形容温度很高，热气腾腾；也形容气氛热烈、兴奋，情绪高涨。
explanation_english: Describes something that is boiling hot and emitting steam; also describes a lively, excited atmosphere or a state of high spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碗湯啱啱煲好，仲㷫烚烚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun2 tong1 ngaam1 ngaam1 bou1 hou2, zung6 hing3 hap6 hap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤刚刚煲好，还热腾腾的。
examples.english_sentence: This soup has just been boiled and is still boiling hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班人玩得好㷫烚烚，氣氛好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 jan4 waan2 dak1 hou2 hing3 hap6 hap6, hei3 fan1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群人玩得很开心，气氛很好。
examples.english_sentence: The group of people are having a great time, the atmosphere is wonderful.

mandarin_meaning: 非常兴奋，非常热闹，气氛热烈
english_meaning: Extremely excited, hyped up, very lively atmosphere, on fire (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 形容气氛非常热烈，情绪高涨，像燃烧的火屎一样。火屎指的是燃烧的炭灰，形容极其兴奋和热闹。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely lively atmosphere and high emotions, like burning embers. '火屎' refers to burning charcoal ash, depicting extreme excitement and a vibrant, bustling environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚演唱會真係㷫過火屎，全場啲人都係咁嗌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 maan1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 zan1 hai6 hing3 gwo3 fo2 si2, cyun4 coeng4 di1 jan4 dou1 hai6 gam2 aai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚演唱会真是气氛热烈，全场的人都在尖叫。
examples.english_sentence: The concert last night was really on fire; everyone in the venue was screaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去海洋公園哈囉喂，肯定㷫過火屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jyun2 haa1 lo1 wai1, hang2 ding6 hing3 gwo3 fo2 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天去海洋公园万圣节活动，肯定气氛热烈。
examples.english_sentence: Going to Ocean Park for Halloween tomorrow, it's definitely going to be wild.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，成條街都㷫過火屎，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hing3 gwo3 fo2 si2, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，整条街都非常热闹，气氛热烈。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, the whole street is extremely lively and bustling with excitement.

english_meaning: Extremely excited; hyped up; over the top
explanation_mandarin: 形容情绪非常高涨，兴奋到极点，就像被火烧过的鸡一样，非常夸张。焫鸡是指用火去除鸡毛的过程，鸡会因为被烧而非常激动和乱动。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme excitement or being hyped up, often to an exaggerated degree.  "焫雞 (laat6 gai1)" refers to the process of singeing a chicken's feathers over a fire, which would cause the chicken to be agitated and frantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日演唱會呀！我哋個個都㷫過焫雞！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jin2 coeng3 wui2 aa3! ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有演唱会呀！我们每个人都兴奋得不得了！
examples.english_sentence: There's a concert tomorrow! We're all extremely hyped up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩頭獎，㷫過焫雞，周圍同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2, hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票头奖，兴奋得不得了，到处和人说。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery first prize, he's extremely excited and telling everyone.

synonyms: 興奮到不得了 (hing1 fan5 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5)

mandarin_meaning: 非常热闹；非常火热；气氛热烈
english_meaning: Extremely lively; extremely heated; atmosphere is very enthusiastic; more excited than a chicken being scalded with boiling water to remove its feathers.
explanation_mandarin: 形容气氛非常热烈，热闹非凡。源于杀鸡褪毛的过程，滚烫的热水淋在鸡身上，鸡会剧烈挣扎，引申形容气氛或情绪非常高涨。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely lively and enthusiastic atmosphere. It originates from the process of scalding a chicken with boiling water to remove its feathers, causing the chicken to struggle violently. It is used to describe a highly charged atmosphere or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚個演唱會㷫過焫鷄，全場觀眾都high到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 ngaan5 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, cyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 dou1 hai1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的演唱会气氛非常热烈，全场观众都嗨翻了。
examples.english_sentence: Last night's concert was extremely lively; the whole audience was hyped up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅周年晚宴，一定搞到㷫過焫鷄！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3, jat1 ding6 gaau2 dou3 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的周年晚宴，一定要办得非常热闹！
examples.english_sentence: This year's anniversary dinner will definitely be extremely lively!

mandarin_meaning: 比辣椒还辣；非常热闹；气氛热烈
english_meaning: Hotter than spicy chicken; extremely lively; with a very enthusiastic atmosphere
explanation_mandarin: 形容气氛或活动非常热闹，情绪非常高涨，如同吃了非常辣的辣椒一样刺激。
explanation_english: Describes an atmosphere or event as extremely lively and exciting, with emotions running high, as stimulating as eating very spicy chili peppers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚個演唱會㷫過辣雞，全場氣氛high到爆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 maan1 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, cyun4 coeng4 hei3 fan1 hai1 dou3 baau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的演唱会气氛热烈，全场气氛嗨到爆！
examples.english_sentence: Last night's concert was extremely lively, the atmosphere was bursting with excitement!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒吧嘅氣氛㷫過辣雞，啲人玩得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 baa1 ge3 hei3 fan1 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, di1 jan4 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间酒吧的气氛非常热闹，人们玩得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere in that bar is extremely lively, people are having a lot of fun.

mandarin_meaning: 非常兴奋，气氛热烈；形容非常受欢迎或热门
english_meaning: Extremely excited; having a very lively atmosphere; extremely popular or trending.
explanation_mandarin: “㷫”在粤语中表示热烈、兴奋。“辣鸡”指辣味鸡，形容非常刺激。“㷫过辣鸡”比喻气氛非常热烈，或者形容某事物非常受欢迎、非常热门。
explanation_english: "㷫" (hing3) in Cantonese means excited or lively. "辣鸡" (laat6 gai1) refers to spicy chicken, describing something stimulating. "㷫過辣鷄*" compares something to being more exciting or popular than even spicy chicken, implying a very lively atmosphere, immense popularity, or a trending topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚演唱會㷫過辣鷄，氣氛勁正！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, hei3 fan1 ging6 zeng3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的演唱会气氛非常热烈，气氛好极了！
examples.english_sentence: Last night's concert was extremely exciting, the atmosphere was amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新手機㷫過辣鷄，一出就俾人搶曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 hing3 gwo3 laat6 gai1, jat1 ceot1 zau6 bei2 jan4 coeng2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款新手机非常热门，一上市就被抢购一空。
examples.english_sentence: This new mobile phone is extremely popular, it was all snapped up as soon as it was released.

english_meaning: Okapi
explanation_mandarin: 一种非洲中部的哺乳动物，外形像鹿，但与长颈鹿有亲缘关系。
explanation_english: An African mammal resembling a deer but related to the giraffe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺動物園見到一隻㺢㹢狓，佢個樣好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dung6 mat6 jyun2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 hoek3 zoek3 pei1, keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在动物园里看到一只霍加狓，它长得很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I saw an Okapi in the zoo, it looked very cute.

english_meaning: painful, suffering, to feel bad (emotionally)
explanation_mandarin: 指身体或精神上感到痛苦难受。
explanation_english: Describes a state of physical or emotional pain and suffering. It can also refer to feeling unwell in a general sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日唔舒服，成個人㾓痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, seng4 go3 jan4 gou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天不舒服，整个人很难受。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't feel well yesterday, and my whole body felt painful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我心都㾓痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 sam1 dou1 gou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他这么说，我心里也感到痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that made my heart ache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，每日都覺得好㾓痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, mui5 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 gou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，每天都觉得很痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up, he felt very painful every day.

english_meaning: to close one's eyes; to turn a blind eye (to); to pretend not to see
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为闭上眼睛。引申含义为对某事视而不见，假装没看见。
explanation_english: Literally means to close one's eyes. Figuratively, it means to turn a blind eye to something; to pretend not to see something, usually something negative or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日䁋埋眼，當啲問題冇發生過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nap1 maai4 ngaan5, dong3 di1 man6 tai4 mou5 faat3 sang1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是闭上眼睛，当那些问题没发生过。
examples.english_sentence: He always turns a blind eye, acting like those problems never happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆明明知道有人偷嘢，但係佢䁋埋眼唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 ming4 ming4 zi1 dou3 jau5 jan4 tau1嘢, daan6 hai6 keoi5 nap1 maai4 ngaan5 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板明明知道有人偷东西，但是他闭上眼睛不理。
examples.english_sentence: The boss clearly knows someone is stealing, but he turns a blind eye and ignores it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以䁋埋眼，唔理啲細路嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 nap1 maai4 ngaan5, m4 lei5 di1 sai3 lou6 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能闭上眼睛，不理那些孩子的行为。
examples.english_sentence: You can't turn a blind eye and ignore the children's behavior.

english_meaning: to take a nap, to snooze, to doze off
explanation_mandarin: 指短暂的睡眠，通常是白天小睡一会儿。
explanation_english: Refers to a short period of sleep, usually a nap during the day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日晚瞓得唔好，晏晝想䁪下眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 maan5 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2, aan3 zau3 soeng2 naap1 haa5 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天晚上没睡好，下午想小睡一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep well last night, I want to take a nap this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都眼瞓啦，䁪下眼先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 ngaan5 fan3 laa1, naap1 haa5 ngaan5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都困了，先小睡一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: You are sleepy, take a nap first.

english_meaning: To wink and make eyes; to flirt (with winks and gestures); to give suggestive looks
explanation_mandarin: 形容用眼神和面部表情表达某种暗示或调情，通常带有不正经或暧昧的意味。
explanation_english: Describes the act of using eye contact and facial expressions to convey a hint, flirt, or suggestive intention, often carrying a lighthearted or ambiguous connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺度䁪眉䁪眼，唔知搞乜鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 dou6 sap1 mei4 sap1 ngaan5, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在那里挤眉弄眼，不知道在搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are winking and making eyes at each other; I don't know what they're up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度䁪眉䁪眼啦，好核突㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sap1 mei4 sap1 ngaan5 laa1, hou2 hat6 dat1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里挤眉弄眼了，很恶心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wink and make eyes here, it's disgusting.

synonyms: 拋眉弄眼 (paau1 mei4 nung6 ngaan5)

english_meaning: to blink, in the blink of an eye; momentarily; a very short time
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常短，一会儿。
explanation_english: Describes a very short amount of time; in a moment; very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢䁪眼就唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaap3 ngaan5 zau6 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眨眼就不见了。
examples.english_sentence: He disappeared in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 䁪眼十年就過去咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap3 ngaan5 sap6 nin4 zau6 gwo3 heoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一眨眼十年就过去了。
examples.english_sentence: Ten years have passed in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你䁪眼都認唔到我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaap3 ngaan5 dou1 jing6 m4 dou2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你很快就认不出我啦！
examples.english_sentence: You won't recognize me in the blink of an eye!

english_meaning: to glance, to squint, to peek
explanation_mandarin: 用眼睛迅速地看，通常带有一种轻蔑或怀疑的意味。
explanation_english: To look quickly and sideways, often with a sense of contempt, suspicion, or furtiveness; to glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日䁽眼望住我，唔知想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nim1 ngaan5 mong5 zyu6 ngo5, m4 zi1 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是斜眼看着我，不知道想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps glancing at me, I don't know what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日䁽眼人哋，咁樣好冇禮貌嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nim1 ngaan5 jan4 dei6, gam2 joeng2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是斜眼看别人，这样很没有礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always squint at people, it's impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我䁽眼見到佢偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nim1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我瞥了一眼看到他偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: I caught a glimpse of him stealing something.

english_meaning: wet nurse, nanny who breastfeeds
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇为人哺乳的妇女。
explanation_english: A woman employed to breastfeed another's child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲大戶人家先會請䏱奶㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1 sin1 wui5 ceng2 laai5 naai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有钱人家才会请奶妈的。
examples.english_sentence: Only rich families used to hire wet nurses in the past.

english_meaning: to feel stifled, to feel depressed, to be sulky or disgruntled, to feel suffocated
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情不舒畅，感到压抑、烦闷，生闷气。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of discomfort, oppression, and frustration; to be sulky and resentful, feeling stifled or suffocated emotionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都䏱氣，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 wat1 hei3, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都闷闷不乐的，不知道为什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's sulking all the time, I don't know why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢咁辛苦，梗係覺得䏱氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 gam3 san1 fu2, gang2 hai6 gok3 dak1 wat1 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么辛苦，当然觉得郁闷啦。
examples.english_sentence: Working so hard, of course you'll feel depressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好䏱氣啦，有咩唔開心講出嚟嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wat1 hei3 laa1, jau5 me1 m4 hoi1 sam1 gong2 chut1 lai4 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要闷闷不乐了，有什么不开心说出来嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be sulky, if you're unhappy, tell me about it.

english_meaning: To make a wrong step; to make a mistake; to take a wrong turn; to stumble.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是指走路时不小心踩错了地方，引申为做错了事情，犯了错误。
explanation_english: Literally means to step on the wrong spot while walking, metaphorically it means to make a mistake, to do something wrong, or to take a wrong turn in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時䟕錯腳，先會咁樣做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 caa3 co3 goek3, sin1 wui5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时失足，才会这样做。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake for a moment, that's why he did it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好怪佢啦，佢都係䟕錯腳啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 caa3 co3 goek3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别怪他了，他也只是失误而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him, he just made a mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好䟕錯腳，行差踏錯就後悔莫及啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 caa3 co3 goek3, haang4 caa1 daap6 co3 zau6 hau6 fui3 mok6 kap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要做错事，一旦走错路就后悔莫及了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ever make a mistake, once you take the wrong path, you will regret it for life.

english_meaning: To fidget with one's legs; to jiggle one's legs (often nervously or impatiently)
explanation_mandarin: 指双腿或者单腿有节奏地上下抖动，通常表示紧张、不安、不耐烦或习惯。
explanation_english: Refers to the rhythmic shaking or jiggling of one's legs, often indicating nervousness, anxiety, impatience, or habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度䟴䟴腳啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zan3 zan3 goek3 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里抖腿了，很吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Please don't jiggle your legs here, it's noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好緊張，一路都䟴䟴腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, jat1 lou6 dou1 zan3 zan3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很紧张，一直都在抖腿。
examples.english_sentence: He is very nervous and has been jiggling his legs all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，我都等到䟴䟴腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ngo5 dou1 dang2 dou3 zan3 zan3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了这么久，我都等到抖腿了。
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for so long that I'm starting to jiggle my legs out of impatience.

english_meaning: to jiggle one's leg, to bounce one's leg, to fidget one's leg
explanation_mandarin: 指坐着时有节奏地抖动腿部。
explanation_english: Refers to the rhythmic shaking or bouncing of one's leg, typically while seated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日䟴腳，好似好唔耐煩咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 can2 goek3, hou2 ci5 hou2 m4 noi6 faan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是抖腿，好像很不耐烦的样子。
examples.english_sentence: You're always jiggling your leg, as if you're very impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我緊張嘅時候就會忍唔住䟴腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gan2 zoeng1 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 can2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我紧张的时候就会忍不住抖腿。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I can't help but jiggle my leg when I'm nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢䟴腳䟴得好勁，好明顯佢覺得好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can2 goek3 can2 dak1 hou2 ging6, hou2 ming4 hin2 keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抖腿抖得很厉害，很明显他觉得很无聊。
examples.english_sentence: He's bouncing his leg very vigorously, it's obvious he's bored.

english_meaning: to fidget; to twitch; restless; uneasy
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体不安分地抖动，或者形容一个人焦躁不安的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the act of fidgeting or twitching restlessly, or describes a person who is impatient or uneasy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度䟴身䟴勢啦，搞到我都好心煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zan3 san1 zan3 sai3 laa1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 hou2 sam1 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里抖来抖去了，搞得我都很心烦。
examples.english_sentence: Stop fidgeting, you're making me annoyed.
