examples.cantonese_sentence: 見佢一路䟴身䟴勢，就知道佢好緊張啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 jat1 lou6 zan3 san1 zan3 sai3, zau6 zi1 dou3 keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他一直抖来抖去的，就知道他很紧张了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him fidgeting all the time, you can tell he's nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐唔定，成日都䟴身䟴勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 m4 ding6, seng4 jat6 dou1 zan3 san1 zan3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐不住，总是抖来抖去。
examples.english_sentence: He can't sit still, he's always fidgeting.

english_meaning: to show off; to brag; to boast
explanation_mandarin: 指夸大自己的能力、财富或成就，以引起别人的注意或羡慕。
explanation_english: To exaggerate one's abilities, wealth, or accomplishments in order to attract attention or envy from others. It implies showing off and bragging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度䟴高自己幾有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zan1 gou1 zi6 gei2 gei2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里炫耀自己多么有钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's always here showing off how rich he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度䟴高啦，冇人想聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zan1 gou1 laa1, mou5 jan4 soeng2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里炫耀了，没有人想听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off here, no one wants to listen.

english_meaning: to be perfunctory; to do things carelessly and superficially; to go through the motions
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真、马马虎虎，只做表面功夫。
explanation_english: Describes doing things carelessly, superficially, and without putting in genuine effort. It emphasizes doing only what's minimally required.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都䠄床䠄席，所以老闆唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 haat3 cong4 haat3 zik6, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是敷衍了事，所以老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things perfunctorily, so the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好䠄床䠄席，認真啲做好份功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 haat3 cong4 haat3 zik6, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 hou2 fan6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要敷衍了事，认真地做好这份功课。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be perfunctory, do your homework properly and diligently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想䠄床䠄席咁交份報告，想做到最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 haat3 cong4 haat3 zik6 gam2 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3, soeng2 zou6 dou3 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想敷衍了事地交这份报告，想做到最好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to hand in this report perfunctorily, I want to do my best.

english_meaning: Stingy; miserly; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係䠄牀䠄席，一蚊都唔捨得攞出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 haak1 chong4 haak1 jik6, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 lo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个吝啬鬼，一毛钱都不舍得拿出来。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy, unwilling to take out even a single cent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁䠄牀䠄席啦，請朋友飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 haak1 chong4 haak1 jik6 laa1, cheng2 pang4 jau5 yam2 bui1 ye5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气了，请朋友喝一杯东西嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just treat your friend to a drink.

english_meaning: to satisfy an addiction, to get a kick out of something, to enjoy something excessively, to get one's fill (of something)
explanation_mandarin: 指满足某种瘾，或者享受某种事物到极致。
explanation_english: Refers to satisfying an addiction or enjoying something to the fullest extent. It implies getting a kick or thrill out of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇呢套戲真係䠄曬癮，劇情又刺激又緊湊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 lai1 saai3 jan5, kek6 ching4 jau6 ci3 gik1 jau6 gan2 chau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看这部电影真是过足了瘾，剧情又刺激又紧凑。
examples.english_sentence: Watching this movie was truly satisfying, the plot was exciting and gripping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日打機，佢都䠄曬癮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 daa2 gei1, keoi5 dou1 lai1 saai3 jan5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都打游戏，他都过足了瘾了。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games every day, he's really getting his fill of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咁多甜嘢，你想䠄癮啊？小心蛀牙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 gam3 do1 tim4 je5, nei5 soeng2 lai1 jan5 aa3? siu2 sam1 zyu3 ngaa4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃这么多甜的东西，你想过瘾啊？小心蛀牙！
examples.english_sentence: Eating so much sweet stuff, you want to indulge your sweet tooth? Watch out for cavities!

english_meaning: reckless; rash; careless; impulsive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不经过大脑，轻率冒失，考虑不周全。
explanation_english: Describes a person who acts without thinking, recklessly, rashly, and without considering the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁䡣路啦，諗清楚先好做呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 ling4 lou6 laa1, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 zou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么鲁莽，想清楚再做啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so reckless in what you do; think it through before you act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好䡣路，成日撞板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ling4 lou6, seng4 jat6 zong6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很冒失，总是碰壁。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very reckless person, and he often runs into problems.

english_meaning: Fool, idiot, simpleton
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语中，指愚笨、迟钝的人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial language, it refers to a person who is foolish, dull, or slow-witted. It's a derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁蠢，真係一條䱽魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ceon2, zan1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 lou4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨，真是一个傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: You're so stupid, you're really a fool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁蠢啦，唔好做䱽魚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 lou4 jyu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么笨了，别做傻瓜了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't be a fool.

english_meaning: one
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，最小的正整数，也用于表示第一。
explanation_english: Represents the number one, the smallest positive integer. Also used to indicate the first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得一個蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 jat1 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一个苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I have one apple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我第一個朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的第一个朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is my first friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係一月一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 jat1 jyut6 jat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是1月1日。
examples.english_sentence: Today is January 1st.

english_meaning: to do something in one take (without retakes); to pass something on the first try
explanation_mandarin: 指一次性完成某事，没有重来，或者指一次性通过（考试、测试等）。常用于拍摄电影电视等行业，也用于形容考试、做事情一次成功。
explanation_english: Refers to completing something in one take without needing to redo it. It can also mean passing something (like an exam or a test) on the first try. Commonly used in the film and television industry, but also used to describe succeeding at something on the first attempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍戲好叻，好多場戲都一 take 過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 hei3 hou2 lek1, hou2 do1 coeng4 hei3 dou1 jat1 tek1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他演戏很厉害，很多场戏都是一次通过。
examples.english_sentence: He's a great actor, he does many scenes in one take.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今次考試可以一 take 過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ho2 ji5 jat1 tek1 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望这次考试可以一次通过。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can pass the exam on the first try this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我整呢個蛋糕一 take 過就成功咗，真係好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing2 ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 jat1 tek1 gwo3 zau6 sing4 gung1 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做这个蛋糕一次就成功了，真是幸运。
examples.english_sentence: I succeeded in making this cake on the first try, I'm so lucky.

english_meaning: To clear the table in one shot (snooker/pool); To deal with something completely and efficiently in one go.
explanation_mandarin: 原指桌球运动中，一杆将所有球击入袋中，清空球桌。引申指一次性彻底解决问题或完成任务。
explanation_english: Originally refers to clearing all the balls on a snooker/pool table with a single shot. By extension, it means to deal with a problem or complete a task completely and efficiently in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試好犀利，一Q清枱，攞曬A。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hou2 sai1 lei6, jat1 kiu1 cing1 toi2, lo2 saai3 ei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试非常厉害，一次性全A。
examples.english_sentence: He was very impressive in this exam, clearing the table, getting all As.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話要我哋一Q清枱，喺星期五之前搞掂曬啲project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 kiu1 cing1 toi2, hai2 sing1 kei5 ng5 zi1 cin4 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要我们一次性解决，在星期五之前完成所有项目。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we need to clear the table and finish all the projects before Friday.

english_meaning: To pot all the balls with one shot (in billiards/pool); to accomplish something completely and effortlessly; one-shot clearance.
explanation_mandarin: 源自台球术语，指一杆之内将所有球全部击入袋中。比喻一次性完成某事，达到完美的结果，或者非常轻松地完成任务。
explanation_english: Originating from billiards/pool terminology, it refers to potting all the balls with a single shot. It's used metaphorically to describe completing something perfectly in one go, or accomplishing a task very easily and effortlessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波好勁，成日都一Q清袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 hou2 ging6, seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 kiu1 cing1 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打台球很厉害，经常一杆清台。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at playing pool, he often clears the table with one shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢温书好有效率，考公开试一Q清袋，科科都攞A。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan1 syu1 hou2 jau5 haau6 leot2, haau2 gung1 hoi1 si3 jat1 kiu1 cing1 doi2, fo1 fo1 dou1 lo2 ei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他复习效率很高，考公开考试一举成功，每科都拿A。
examples.english_sentence: He studies very efficiently, he aced the public exams in one go, getting A's in every subject.

english_meaning: A lump of mud; a mess; a muddle
explanation_mandarin: 指一团泥土，也可比喻事情搞砸，乱七八糟的状态。
explanation_english: Literally means a lump of mud. Figuratively, it describes a situation that is a complete mess, muddled, or badly handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司俾佢搞到一pat泥噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou3 jat1 paat1 nai4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司被他搞得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up the company completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搞落去啦，已經一pat泥㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 lok6 heoi3 laa1, ji5 ging1 jat1 paat1 nai4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再弄了，已经一团糟了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch it anymore, it's already a mess.

english_meaning: a lump of mud; a gob of mud
explanation_mandarin: 表示一团或一坨泥土。
explanation_english: Refers to a lump or gob of mud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踩咗一pet泥，搞到對鞋好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caai2 zo2 jat1 pet1 nai4, gaau2 dou3 deoi3 haai4 hou2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踩到一坨泥，把鞋子弄得很脏。
examples.english_sentence: He stepped in a lump of mud and got his shoes very dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺花園玩，全身都係一pet pet泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 faa1 jyun4 waan2, cyun4 san1 dou1 hai6 jat1 pet1 pet1 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在花园玩，全身都是一坨一坨的泥。
examples.english_sentence: The children were playing in the garden and were covered in gobs of mud.

english_meaning: to do something in one take; to pass something on the first try; to get it right the first time
explanation_mandarin: 指一次性顺利通过，通常用于表演、拍摄、考试等场合，表示一次成功，无需重来。
explanation_english: Refers to successfully completing something in one take, often used in the context of performance, filming, exams, etc., indicating success on the first attempt without needing to redo it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試希望可以一take過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 tek1 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这次考试可以一次通过。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can pass the exam on the first try this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢演技咁好，一定可以一take過拍完呢場戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jin2 gei6 gam3 hou2, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 jat1 tek1 gwo3 paak3 jyun4 ni1 coeng4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技这么好，一定可以一次通过拍完这场戏。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a good actor, he'll definitely film this scene in one take.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套戲佢哋好多場戲都一take過搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hei3 keoi5 dei6 hou2 do1 coeng4 hei3 dou1 jat1 tek1 gwo3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部戏他们很多场戏都一次完成。
examples.english_sentence: They finished a lot of scenes in one take in that movie.

english_meaning: one by one, one after another, individually, in detail
explanation_mandarin: 表示按顺序，逐个地，详细地。
explanation_english: Indicates proceeding one by one, in order, or in detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一一解釋曬啲步驟俾我聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 gaai2 sik1 saai3 di1 bou6 zau6 bei2 ngo5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一一解释了所有的步骤给我听。
examples.english_sentence: He explained all the steps to me one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨一一搬上車喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 jat1 jat1 bun1 soeng5 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货物都一一搬上车了。
examples.english_sentence: The goods have all been loaded onto the car one by one.

english_meaning: Clearly and distinctly; step by step; one by one; in an orderly fashion
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事或说话非常有条理，清晰，明白，不含糊。也指按步骤，一步一步地来。
explanation_english: Describes doing things or speaking in a very organized, clear, and unambiguous way. Also refers to doing things step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一一二二咁解釋件事嘅來龍去脈，我哋終於明白發生乜嘢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 ji6 ji6 gam2 gaai2 sik1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ming4 baak6 faat3 sang1 mat1 je5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把事情的来龙去脉解释得清清楚楚，我们终于明白发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the whole story clearly and distinctly, and we finally understood what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一一二二咁寫低啲步驟，咁就唔會搞錯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 jat1 ji6 ji6 gam2 se2 dai2 di1 bou6 zau6, gam2 zau6 m4 wui5 gaau2 co3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一步一步地把步骤写下来，这样就不会搞错了。
examples.english_sentence: Write down the steps one by one, so you won't make any mistakes.

synonyms: 清清楚楚 (cing1 cing1 co2 co2)

english_meaning: A little bit; very small amount; tiny
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量非常少，指很小的一点儿。
explanation_english: Describes a very small quantity; refers to a tiny amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔肯分一丁錢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 fan1 jat1 ding1 cin2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都不肯分一点钱给我。
examples.english_sentence: He's not even willing to give me a single penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係食咗一丁飯咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik6 zo2 jat1 ding1 faan6 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是吃了一点点饭而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only ate a tiny bit of rice.

english_meaning: all alone; by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容独自一人，没有朋友或同伴。多带有一种孤单、寂寞的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone being all alone, without friends or companions. Often carries a sense of loneliness or solitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都一丁友喺屋企睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 jat1 ding1 jau2 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是独自一人在家看电视。
examples.english_sentence: He is always all alone watching TV at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山最好搵啲朋友一齊去，唔好一丁友去，危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 zeoi3 hou2 wan2 di1 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 heoi3, m4 hou2 jat1 ding1 jau2 heoi3, ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山最好找些朋友一起去，不要独自一人去，危险的。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to find some friends to go hiking together, don't go alone, it's dangerous.

english_meaning: Nissin Demae Ramen (instant noodles)
explanation_mandarin: 指日清食品公司生产的“出前一丁”方便面。在香港非常流行，几乎成为方便面的代名词。
explanation_english: Refers to Nissin's "Demae Ramen" instant noodles. It is very popular in Hong Kong and has almost become a synonym for instant noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我肚餓啊，煮個一丁麵俾我食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tou5 ngo6 aa3, zyu2 go3 jat1 ding1 min6 bei2 ngo5 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我饿了，煮碗出前一丁给我吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm hungry, cook me a bowl of Demae Ramen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都食一丁麵，唔怕冇營養咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 sik6 jat1 ding1 min6, m4 paa3 mou5 ying1 yeung5 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都吃出前一丁，不怕没有营养吗？
examples.english_sentence: He eats Demae Ramen every day, isn't he worried about not getting enough nutrition?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔想煮飯，求其食個一丁麵算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 seung2 zyu2 faan6, kau4 kei4 sik6 go3 jat1 ding1 min6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不想做饭，随便吃碗出前一丁就算了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't feel like cooking tonight, I'll just have a bowl of Demae Ramen.

english_meaning: a little bit; a moment; briefly; once
explanation_mandarin: 表示短时间或尝试。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time, a brief action, or a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我一下儿。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試下一下，睇下得唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 haa5 jat1 haa5, tai2 haa5 dak1 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试一下，看看行不行。
examples.english_sentence: Try it once and see if it works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗下一下先決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 haa5 jat1 haa5 sin1 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先想一下再决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: Think about it for a while before deciding.

english_meaning: in a short while; in a moment; all of a sudden; briefly; for a short period
explanation_mandarin: 表示很短的时间或者动作很快完成。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time or that an action is completed quickly. Can also mean 'all of a sudden'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一下子就做完功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 haa5 zi2 zau6 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一会儿就做完功课了。
examples.english_sentence: I'll finish my homework in a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一下子就跑咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 haa5 zi2 zau6 paau2 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子就跑出去了。
examples.english_sentence: He ran out all of a sudden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你等我一下子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dang2 ngo5 jat1 haa5 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你等我一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me for a moment.

jyutping: jat1 bat1 zou6 ji6 bat1 jau1
english_meaning: In for a penny, in for a pound; once you've started something, you might as well finish it.
explanation_mandarin: 事情既然已经做了开头，索性就做到底。表示下定了决心，不达目的不罢休。
explanation_english: Once you've started something, you might as well finish it. It expresses a determination to see something through to the end, regardless of the challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然我哋已經開始咗裝修，咁就一不做二不休，將成間屋都翻新埋佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 zo2 zong1 sau1, gam2 zau6 jat1 bat1 zou6 ji6 bat1 jau1, zoeng1 sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 faan1 san1 maai4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然我们已经开始装修了，那就一不做二不休，把整间房子都翻新了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since we've already started renovating, let's go all the way and renovate the whole house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你已經辭咗職，一不做二不休，不如自己創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 ji5 ging1 chi4 zo2 jik1, jat1 bat1 zou6 ji6 bat1 jau1, bat1 jyu4 ji5 gei2 chong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你已经辞职了，一不做二不休，不如自己创业。
examples.english_sentence: Now that you've quit your job, you might as well go all the way and start your own business.

english_meaning: a lifetime, a whole life, for life, forever
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人从出生到死亡的整个时期，或者表示终身，永远。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire period from a person's birth to death, or indicates lifelong, forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我愛你一世㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 oi3 nei5 jat1 sai3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会爱你一辈子的！
examples.english_sentence: I will love you for life!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆一世都咁恩愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 jat1 sai3 dou1 gam3 yan1 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩一辈子都那么恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: That couple is so loving throughout their whole life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫咗我咁多，我會記住你一世嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, ngo5 wui5 gei3 zyu6 nei5 jat1 sai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮了我这么多，我会记住你一辈子的。
examples.english_sentence: You have helped me so much, I will remember you for the rest of my life.

english_meaning: a lifetime; one's whole life
explanation_mandarin: 指人的一生，整个生命。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's entire life; one's whole lifespan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以同你一世人喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 sai3 jan4 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以和你一辈子在一起。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can be with you for a lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個話要愛大家一世人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 waa6 jiu3 oi3 daai6 gaa1 jat1 sai3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个说要爱彼此一辈子。
examples.english_sentence: They both said they would love each other for a lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工我諗住做一世人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 zou6 jat1 sai3 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作我想着做一辈子的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of doing this job for a lifetime.

jyutping: jat1 sai3 jan4 loeng5 hing1 dai6
english_meaning: Brothers for life; lifelong brothers
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常亲密，一辈子都是好兄弟。强调兄弟情谊深厚，无论发生什么都会互相支持。
explanation_english: Describes a very close relationship between brothers or friends, implying a lifelong bond and mutual support. It emphasizes deep brotherhood and the commitment to stand by each other regardless of circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋由細玩到大，一世人兩兄弟，有咩事都撐你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau4 sai3 waan2 dou3 daai6, jat1 sai3 jan4 loeng5 hing1 dai6, jau5 me1 si6 dou1 caang1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从小一起玩到大，一辈子是兄弟，有什么事都支持你。
examples.english_sentence: We've been playing together since we were kids. We are brothers for life, and I will support you no matter what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋雖然唔係親兄弟，但感情好到好似一世人兩兄弟咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 can1 hing1 dai6, daan6 gam2 cing4 hou2 dou3 hou2 ci5 jat1 sai3 jan4 loeng5 hing1 dai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们虽然不是亲兄弟，但是感情好得像一辈子是兄弟一样。
examples.english_sentence: Although they are not biological brothers, their relationship is so good that they are like brothers for life.

english_meaning: Lifetime reputation, a lifetime of good name/fame
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人一生积累的好名声，也指因为某件事而毁掉了一生的好名声。
explanation_english: Refers to the good reputation a person has accumulated throughout their life. It can also refer to the ruining of a lifetime of good reputation due to a particular event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做，真係會毁咗佢一世英名㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 wui2 hui2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 sai3 jing1 ming4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，真的会毁了他的毕生英名的！
examples.english_sentence: If he does that, it will really ruin his lifetime reputation!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗少少利益，就賠上一世英名，唔值得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 siu2 siu2 lei6 jik1, zau6 pui4 soeng5 jat1 sai3 jing1 ming4, m4 dak1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了少许利益，就赔上一生英名，不值得啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not worth sacrificing a lifetime of reputation for a small amount of benefit.

english_meaning: birds of a feather; a bunch of jackals from the same mound; people cut from the same cloth; of the same ilk
explanation_mandarin: 比喻彼此一样坏，没有什么差别。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe people who are of the same bad character or share similar negative qualities, with little to distinguish between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係貪污犯，根本就係一丘之貉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 taam1 wu1 faan2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 jau1 zi1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是贪污犯，根本就是一丘之貉。
examples.english_sentence: They are both corrupt officials, they are essentially birds of a feather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同佢哋嚟往啦，班人一丘之貉，冇個好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 lai4 wong5 laa1, baan1 jan4 jat1 jau1 zi1 hok6, mou5 go3 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要和他们来往了，那群人都是一丘之貉，没有一个好人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't associate with them; that group is a bunch of jackals, not a single good person among them.

english_meaning: completely clean, spotless; thoroughly, completely
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常干净，一点也不剩，也指彻底干净，一丝不苟。
explanation_english: Describes something as being completely clean and spotless, leaving nothing behind. Can also mean thoroughly or completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將間屋執到一乾二淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 zap1 dou3 jat1 gon1 ji6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把房间收拾得干干净净。
examples.english_sentence: I cleaned the room until it was completely spotless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋食晒啲嘢，食到一乾二淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sik6 saai3 di1 je5, sik6 dou3 jat1 gon1 ji6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把东西都吃光了，吃得干干净净。
examples.english_sentence: They ate all the food, completely finishing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次測驗我溫書溫到一乾二淨，肯定冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 cak1 jim6 ngo5 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 jat1 gon1 ji6 zing6, hang2 ding6 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我复习得非常彻底，肯定没问题。
examples.english_sentence: I studied for this exam thoroughly, so I definitely won't have any problems.

english_meaning: Once this is settled, everything else will be resolved; one solves all.
explanation_mandarin: 指解决了一个主要的问题，其他的问题也就容易解决了。
explanation_english: Means that once a major problem is solved, other problems become easier to resolve. Often used to describe a situation where dealing with the main issue eliminates or greatly reduces other related concerns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱，你哋搞掂咗個客投訴，咁之後嘅嘢咪一了百了囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laa4, nei5 dei6 gaau2 dim6 zo2 go3 haak3 tau4 sou3, gam2 zi1 hau6 ge3 je5 mai1 jat1 liu5 baak3 liu5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把顾客的投诉处理好了，之后的事情不就一了百了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you handle the customer's complaint well, then the rest will be easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋快啲將件事查清楚，咁樣就可以一了百了，唔使日日咁煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 zoeng1 gin6 si6 caa4 cing1 co2, gam2 joeng2 zo6 ji5 ho2 ji5 jat1 liu5 baak3 liu5, m4 sai2 jat1 jat1 gam3 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们快点把这件事查清楚，这样就可以一了百了，不用每天这么烦。
examples.english_sentence: Let's investigate this matter quickly, so that we can solve all the problems and don't have to be bothered every day.

english_meaning: one thing; an affair; a matter
explanation_mandarin: 一件事情，通常用于比较正式或严肃的场合。
explanation_english: One thing; a matter; an affair. Often used in more formal or serious contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要認真處理呢一事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jing6 zan1 cyu2 lei5 ni1 jat1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要认真处理这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to handle this matter seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗呢一事，我失眠咗幾晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ni1 jat1 si6, ngo5 sat1 min4 zo2 gei2 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这件事，我失眠了好几个晚上。
examples.english_sentence: Because of this affair, I've had sleepless nights for several evenings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢一事牽涉到好多人嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 jat1 si6 hin1 sip3 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事牵涉到很多人的利益。
examples.english_sentence: This matter involves the interests of many people.

english_meaning: accomplish nothing; achieve nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指什么事情也没做成功，没有任何成就。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has failed to achieve anything in their life or career; someone who lacks accomplishments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶惰，驚佢第時會一事無成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5 do6, geng1 keoi5 dai6 si4 wui5 jat1 si6 mou4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒惰，怕他将来会一事无成。
examples.english_sentence: He is so lazy; I'm afraid he'll accomplish nothing in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔努力，好容易就會一事無成㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 nou5 lik6, hou2 yung4 yi6 jau5 wui2 jat1 si6 mou4 sing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不努力，很容易就会一事无成。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work hard, it's easy to end up achieving nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想自己一事無成，就要付出努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 zi6 gei2 jat1 si6 mou4 sing4, zau6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想自己一事无成，就要付出努力。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to accomplish nothing, you have to put in effort.

english_meaning: Whatever; any old way; do as you please
explanation_mandarin: 表示随便、怎么样都行。指做事不认真，马马虎虎，敷衍了事。也表示对方想怎样就怎样，无所谓。
explanation_english: Indicates that something can be done however one pleases, without care for quality or details. Can also indicate indifference, allowing someone to do as they wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一二便整就算啦，到時唔好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ji6 bin6 zing2 zau6 syun3 laa1, dou3 si4 m4 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你随便弄弄就算了，到时候不要后悔。
examples.english_sentence: You can just do it any old way, but don't regret it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好一二便㗎，唔好期望佢做得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jat1 ji6 bin6 gaa3, m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很随便的，不要期望他做得好。
examples.english_sentence: He does things very casually; don't expect him to do a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意點咪點囉，一二便啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 dim2 mai1 dim2 lo1, jat1 ji6 bin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想怎样就怎样吧，随便啦。
examples.english_sentence: Do whatever you want, whatever.

english_meaning: a little bit; a small amount; slightly
explanation_mandarin: 表示很少的量，相当于普通话的“一点点”、“少许”、“稍微”。通常用于形容数量、程度等。
explanation_english: Indicates a very small amount, equivalent to 'a little bit', 'a small amount', or 'slightly' in Mandarin. Usually used to describe quantities, degree, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我手，俾一二角時間我就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2, bei2 jat1 ji6 gok3 si4 gaan3 ngo5 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我一下吗？给我一点点时间就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me? Just give me a little bit of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔舒服，所以淨係食咗一二角嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 zing6 hai6 sik6 zo2 jat1 ji6 gok3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不舒服，所以只吃了一点点东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's not feeling well today, so he only ate a little bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餸一二角辣啫，唔會太辣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sung3 jat1 ji6 gok3 laat6 ze1, m4 wui2 taai3 laat6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个菜只有一点点辣，不会太辣的。
examples.english_sentence: This dish is only slightly spicy, it won't be too spicy.

english_meaning: Just about; approximately; give or take; more or less
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概的数量或时间。指不精确的数字，或者范围。
explanation_english: Indicates an approximate quantity or time. Refers to an imprecise number or range; roughly, approximately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住一二邊點就會到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 jat1 ji6 bin1 dim2 zau6 wui dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想着一点左右就会到。
examples.english_sentence: I think I'll arrive around 1 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會俾一二邊萬蚊我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui bei2 jat1 ji6 bin1 maan6 man1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说会给我们大概一两万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would give us about ten to twenty thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工一二邊年先升到職㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 jat1 ji6 bin1 nin4 sin1 sing1 dou2 zik1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作大概要一两年才能升职。
examples.english_sentence: It takes about one or two years to get promoted in this job.

english_meaning: in detail; thoroughly; explicitly; to give a full account
explanation_mandarin: 表示详细地、完整地叙述或说明事情的经过和细节。
explanation_english: To recount or explain something in full detail, leaving nothing out. It emphasizes completeness and thoroughness in the description.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一五一十咁同我講返琴日發生嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ng5 jat1 sap6 gam2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 faan1 kam4 jat6 faat3 sang1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一五一十地把昨天发生的事情告诉我。
examples.english_sentence: Tell me in detail everything that happened yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將成件事嘅經過一五一十咁寫咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 ging1 gwo3 jat1 ng5 jat1 sap6 gam2 se2 zo2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把整件事的经过一五一十地写了出来。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote down a detailed account of what happened.

synonyms: 原原本本 (jyun4 jyun4 bun2 bun2)
詳詳細細 (coeng4 sai3 coeng4 sai3)

english_meaning: some, a few, a little
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量，指不确定的数量。
explanation_english: Indicates a small and indefinite quantity; some, a few, a little bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一些生果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 se1 sang1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一些水果。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得閒會睇一些書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 haan4 wui5 tai2 jat1 se1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有空会看一些书。
examples.english_sentence: He reads some books when he's free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比啲時間我，我需要一些空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 ngo5, ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 se1 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我点时间，我需要一些空间。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some time, I need some space.

jyutping: jat1 jan4 zou6 si6 jat1 jan4 dong1
english_meaning: One who does the deed bears the responsibility; To take responsibility for one's actions.
explanation_mandarin: 做了事情就要自己承担责任，敢作敢当。
explanation_english: This idiom means that one should take responsibility for one's actions, both good and bad. It emphasizes accountability and being brave enough to face the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次衰咗，唔緊要，一人做事一人當啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 seoi1 zo2, m4 gan2 jiu3, jat1 jan4 zou6 si6 jat1 jan4 dong1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次失败了，不要紧，一人做事一人承担嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We failed this time, but it's alright. I'll take responsibility for my actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話一人做事一人當，所以就自己去同老細解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jat1 jan4 zou6 si6 jat1 jan4 dong1, so2 ji5 zau6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 tung4 lou5 sai3 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说一人做事一人承担，所以就自己去跟老板解释。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd take responsibility for his actions, so he went to explain to the boss himself.

english_meaning: Each person takes a step (towards a solution); meet each other halfway; compromise.
explanation_mandarin: 指双方各让一步，互相妥协以解决问题。
explanation_english: Refers to both parties making concessions and compromising to solve a problem. It implies a collaborative effort and willingness to find a middle ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如一人行一步，你減啲價，我哋就買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 jan4 haang4 jat1 bou6, nei5 gaam2 di1 gaa3, ngo5 dei6 zau6 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如各走一步，你降一点价，我们就买了。
examples.english_sentence: How about we meet each other halfway? If you lower the price a bit, we'll buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢肯讓步，我哋都可以一人行一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 hang2 joeng6 bou6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 ho2 ji5 jat1 jan4 haang4 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他肯让步，我们也可以各走一步。
examples.english_sentence: If he is willing to compromise, we can also meet each other halfway.

synonyms: 互相讓步 (wu6 soeng1 joeng6 bou6)
各退一步 (gok3 teoi3 jat1 bou6)

jyutping: jat1 jan4 gai3 dyun2, ji6 jan4 gai3 coeng4
mandarin_meaning: 一个人考虑问题会有局限，两个人一起考虑会更全面。
english_meaning: One person's planning is limited, two people's planning is more comprehensive/thoughtful; Two heads are better than one.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人思考问题可能考虑不周全，但两个人一起商量，可以集思广益，考虑得更全面、周到。
explanation_english: This idiom means that one person's planning or thinking can be limited, but when two people discuss and brainstorm together, they can come up with more comprehensive and thoughtful solutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁複雜，不如我哋一人計短，二人計長，睇吓點解決好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 jan4 gai3 dyun2, ji6 jan4 gai3 coeng4, tai2 haa5 dim2 gaai2 kyut3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么复杂，不如我们一起想办法，看看怎么解决更好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated, why don't we put our heads together and see how to solve it better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一人計短，二人計長，大家一齊諗吓計，一定可以解決到呢個問題嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jan4 gai3 dyun2, ji6 jan4 gai3 coeng4, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nam2 haa5 gai3, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 dou3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个人考虑问题会有局限，两个人一起想办法，一定可以解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: Two heads are better than one. If everyone puts their heads together, we can definitely solve this problem.

english_meaning: Each person takes a step back; to compromise; meet halfway.
explanation_mandarin: 表示双方各做让步，以达成共识或解决冲突。
explanation_english: Indicates that both parties make concessions in order to reach a consensus or resolve a conflict.  It suggests finding a middle ground by both giving up some ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如大家一人退一步，咁件事就解決到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 daai6 ga1 jat1 jan4 teoi3 jat1 bou6, gam2 gin6 si6 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如大家各退一步，这样事情就能解决了。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we all compromise a little? That way the matter can be resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都唔肯讓，如果唔係一人退一步，件事好難傾掂數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 m4 hang2 joeng6, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 jat1 jan4 teoi3 jat1 bou6, gin6 si6 hou2 naan4 king1 dim6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都不肯让步，如果不是各退一步，事情很难谈妥。
examples.english_sentence: Neither of them is willing to budge. If they don't compromise, it will be difficult to settle the matter.

synonyms: 各讓一步 (gok3 joeng6 jat1 bou6)

english_meaning: stumbling and staggering; falling repeatedly; fumbling and bumbling
explanation_mandarin: 形容走路不稳，多次跌倒的样子。也形容做事很不顺利，经常遇到挫折。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unsteady on their feet and falls repeatedly. It can also describe someone who is very clumsy or experiences many setbacks when trying to accomplish something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日飲醉咗，行路一仆一碌咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 jam2 zeoi3 zo2, haang4 lou6 jat1 puk1 jat1 luk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天喝醉了，走路跌跌撞撞的。
examples.english_sentence: He got drunk today and was stumbling and staggering while walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學緊踩單車，成日都一仆一碌，好搞笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 gan2 caai2 daan1 ce1, seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 puk1 jat1 luk1, hou2 gaau2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在学骑自行车，总是跌跌撞撞的，很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: He's learning to ride a bike and is always falling and stumbling, it's really funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔係一帆風順㗎，可能會一仆一碌，但係唔好放棄呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 m4 hai6 jat1 faan4 fung1 seon6 gaa3, ho2 nang4 wui5 jat1 puk1 jat1 luk1, daan6 hai6 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不是一帆风顺的，可能会遇到很多挫折，但是不要放弃啊！
examples.english_sentence: Doing business isn't always smooth sailing; you might face many setbacks, but don't give up!

synonyms: 趎趎趄趄 (ceoi4 ceoi4 ceoi1 ceoi1)

english_meaning: stumbling along; to proceed with difficulty; to be on a very difficult path
explanation_mandarin: 形容行走或做事非常艰难，不断遇到挫折和困难。仆指跌倒，轆指滚动。
explanation_english: Describes walking or doing things with great difficulty, constantly encountering setbacks and difficulties.  '仆' refers to falling down, and '轆' refers to rolling (as in rolling due to instability or clumsiness).  The idiom paints a picture of someone constantly falling and stumbling along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司啱啱起步，一仆一轆咁捱過咗頭幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ngaam ngaam hei2 bou6, jat1 puk1 jat1 luk1 gam2 ngaai4 gwo3 zo2 tau4 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司刚刚起步，跌跌撞撞地熬过了头几年。
examples.english_sentence: His company was just starting out, and they stumbled along with great difficulty for the first few years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻腳受咗傷，行路一仆一轆咁，睇見都覺得辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 goek3 sau6 zo2 soeng1, haang4 lou6 jat1 puk1 jat1 luk1 gam2, tai2 gin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脚受伤了，走路跌跌撞撞的，看着都觉得辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: His foot is injured, he walks with a stumble, and it looks painful to watch.

english_meaning: generation; a period in history; a lifetime; a whole life; a dynasty
explanation_mandarin: 指一个时代，一代人，或者一个朝代。
explanation_english: Refers to a generation, a period of history, or a dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢一代後生仔好重視自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 jat1 doi6 hau6 sang1 zai2 hou2 zung6 si6 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这一代年轻人很重视自由。
examples.english_sentence: Our generation of young people values freedom a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一代宗師嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 doi6 zung1 si1 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位一代宗师。
examples.english_sentence: He is a grandmaster (of his generation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手機係一代傳一代嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 gei1 hai6 jat1 doi6 cyun4 jat1 doi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手机是一代传一代的。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is passed down from generation to generation.

english_meaning: One-piece (referring to clothing, swimwear, etc.); Integrated; All-in-one
explanation_mandarin: 指整体是一件，没有分开的部件。常用于描述服装，例如连体泳衣。也可指整合式的物品。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is a single, whole piece, without separate parts. Often used to describe clothing items like one-piece swimsuits. Can also refer to integrated or all-in-one items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗件紅色嘅一件頭泳衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hung4 sik1 ge3 jat1 gin6 tau4 wing6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一件红色的连体泳衣。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a red one-piece swimsuit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機係一件頭設計，慳好多位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hai6 jat1 gin6 tau4 sai3 gai3, haan1 hou2 do1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器是一体式设计，节省很多空间。
examples.english_sentence: This machine has an all-in-one design, saving a lot of space.

english_meaning: a member of; one of; part of
explanation_mandarin: 表示属于某个团体或组织的一员，或者某个事物的一部分。
explanation_english: Indicates being a member of a group or organization, or a part of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋團隊嘅一份子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 jat1 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们团队的一份子。
examples.english_sentence: He is a member of our team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你都可以成為呢個計劃嘅一份子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 dou1 ho2 ji5 sing4 wai4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 jat1 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你也可以成为这个计划的一份子。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you can also become part of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都應該出一份力，做社會嘅一份子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 ga1 dou1 ying1 goi1 chut1 jat1 fan6 lik6, zou6 se5 wui2 ge3 jat1 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都应该出一份力，做社会的一份子。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone should contribute and be a part of society.

english_meaning: together; at the same time; simultaneously; all together
explanation_mandarin: 表示同时或一起进行。表示把几件事或几个东西合并在一起。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something simultaneously or together. Indicates combining several things or matters together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會一併處理埋啲文件同電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 jat1 bing3 cyu2 lei5 maai4 di1 man4 gin2 tung4 din6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会把文件和邮件一起处理掉。
examples.english_sentence: I'll deal with the documents and emails together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一併去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 bing3 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we go eat together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲垃圾一併掉晒去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 laap6 saap3 jat1 bing3 diu1 saai3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把垃圾一起扔掉。
examples.english_sentence: Throw all the rubbish away together.

english_meaning: Firstly; in the first place; one reason is; on one hand
explanation_mandarin: 表示首先提出的原因或理由；有时和“二來”连用，表示两个方面。
explanation_english: Indicates the first reason or point mentioned. Often used in conjunction with '二來' (ji6 lai4) to present two sides of an argument or explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一來佢唔夠經驗，二來佢又唔夠勤力，所以咪做唔好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 lai4 keoi5 m4 gau3 ging1 jim6, ji6 lai4 keoi5 jau6 m4 gau3 kan4 lik6, so2 ji5 mai1 zou6 m4 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一方面他经验不足，另一方面他又不够勤奋，所以才做不好。
examples.english_sentence: Firstly, he lacks experience, and secondly, he's not diligent enough, that's why he's not doing well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去旅行，一來可以放鬆下，二來可以增廣見聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, jat1 lai4 ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 haa5, ji6 lai4 ho2 ji5 zang1 gwong2 gin3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去旅行，一方面可以放松一下，另一方面可以增长见闻。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a trip, firstly to relax, and secondly to broaden our horizons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一來我唔得閒，二來我都唔想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 lai4 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, ji6 lai4 ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一方面我没空，另一方面我也不想去。
examples.english_sentence: Firstly, I don't have time, and secondly, I don't want to go.

english_meaning: back and forth, to and fro, reciprocal exchange
explanation_mandarin: 形容双方之间有来有回，进行互动或交流。
explanation_english: Describes a back-and-forth interaction or exchange between two parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個打乒乓波，一來一往，好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 ping1 pong1 bo1, jat1 loi4 jat1 wong5, hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人打乒乓球，一来一回，非常精彩。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are playing ping pong, back and forth, it's very exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一來一往咁傾偈，傾得好投契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 loi4 jat1 wong5 gam2 king1 gai2, king1 dak1 hou2 tau4 kei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一来一回地聊天，聊得很投机。
examples.english_sentence: They are chatting back and forth and getting along very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一來一往咁討論，先至得出結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 loi4 jat1 wong5 gam2 tou2 leon6, sin1 zi3 dak1 ceot1 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一来一回地讨论，才得出结论。
examples.english_sentence: We discussed back and forth before reaching a conclusion.

english_meaning: conveniently; in passing; on the way; while you're at it; handily
explanation_mandarin: 顺道，方便。指在做某件事的时候，顺便做另一件事；或者指某件事做起来很方便。
explanation_english: Conveniently, in passing, or on the way. Refers to doing something else while doing something else; or it can refer to something being very convenient to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行過超級市場，一便買埋啲餸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 gwo3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4, jat1 bin6 maai5 maai4 di1 sung3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路过超市，顺便把菜也买了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since we're passing the supermarket, let's buy some groceries while we're at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你得閒嘅話，一便幫我攞埋份文件啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dak1 haan4 ge3 waa2, jat1 bin6 bong1 ngo5 lo2 maai4 fan6 man4 gin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有空的话，顺便帮我拿一下那份文件吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you're free, could you handily grab that document for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機好細部，攞出街都幾一便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hou2 sai3 bou6, lo2 chut1 gaai1 dou1 gei2 jat1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器很小，带出门也很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is small, it's quite handy to bring out.

english_meaning: Either... or; Otherwise; Maybe
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择关系，相当于“要么...要么...”；也可以表示一种推测或可能性，相当于“也许”。
explanation_english: Expresses a choice between alternatives, similar to 'either... or'. It can also express a possibility or suggestion, similar to 'maybe' or 'otherwise'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一係你嚟我屋企，一係我就去你屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 hai6 nei5 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2, jat1 hai6 ngo5 zau6 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要么你来我家，要么我就去你家。
examples.english_sentence: Either you come to my house, or I go to your house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日一係落雨，一係就好曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jat1 hai6 lok6 jyu5, jat1 hai6 zau6 hou2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要么下雨，要么就很晒。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow it's either going to rain, or it's going to be very sunny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一係佢唔知，一係佢扮唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 hai6 keoi5 m4 zi1, jat1 hai6 keoi5 baan3 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也许他不知道，也许他假装不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe he doesn't know, or maybe he's pretending not to know.

mandarin_meaning: 一起, 一同, 一并
english_meaning: together, all together, all at once, along with
explanation_mandarin: 表示一起, 一同的意思。 将几样东西或几件事情一起处理。
explanation_english: Indicates doing things together, all at once or including something else. Processing several things or matters together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一倂去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 bing3 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲衫一倂洗咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 saam1 jat1 bing3 sai2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把这些衣服一起洗了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Wash all these clothes together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會將所有嘅問題一倂解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 man6 tai4 jat1 bing3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会将所有的问题一并解决。
examples.english_sentence: I will solve all the problems all at once.

english_meaning: One by one; each and every one; individually
explanation_mandarin: 表示逐个、一个个地；用于强调或表达不满时，含有责备或不满的语气。
explanation_english: Used to mean 'one by one' or 'each and every one'. It can also be used to express dissatisfaction or blame, implying that each individual is contributing to a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋一個二個都唔聽話，真係激死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 jat1 go3 ji6 go3 dou1 m4 ting1 waa6, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们一个个都不听话，真是气死我了。
examples.english_sentence: You all don't listen, it's really making me angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生一個二個都交唔齊功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 jat1 go3 ji6 go3 dou1 gaau1 m4 cai4 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们一个个都没有交齐作业。
examples.english_sentence: The students haven't submitted their homework completely, one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆鬧我哋一個二個都唔識做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 naau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 go3 ji6 go3 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板骂我们一个个都不会做事。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolded us, saying none of us knew how to work.

english_meaning: a person; alone; by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指单独的一个人，或独自做某事的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a single person or the state of doing something alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意一個人去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢一个人去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I like travelling alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人搞掂晒所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 dim6 saai3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人搞定了所有事情。
examples.english_sentence: He managed everything by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳通常都係一個人嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 lai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅通常都是一个人来吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: People usually eat alone at this restaurant.

mandarin_meaning: 一个两个 (yí ge liǎng ge)
english_meaning: One by one; individually; a few at a time; one after another
explanation_mandarin: 表示逐个或者少量地处理或者出现，通常带有不耐烦或者否定的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates dealing with things or people individually or in small quantities, often with an impatient or negative tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪一個兩個嚟問啦，一次過講晒佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 jat1 go3 loeng5 go3 lai4 man6 laa1, jat1 ci3 gwo3 gong2 saai3 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别一个一个地来问，一次性说完！
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask one by one, tell me everything at once!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你哋唔好一個兩個咁遲到啦，好影響工作嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 loeng5 go3 gam3 ci4 dou3 laa1, hou2 jing2 hoeng2 gung1 zok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你们不要一个两个地都迟到，很影响工作的。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't be late one or two at a time, it's affecting the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人一個兩個咁走晒，淨低我喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 jat1 go3 loeng5 go3 gam3 zau2 saai3, zing6 dai1 ngo5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人一个一个地都走光了，只剩下我在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Those people left one by one, leaving only me here.

english_meaning: one or two; a few
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量，大概一两个的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity, meaning approximately one or two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話得閒會搵我飲茶，不過都係一個半個禮拜先覆我機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 dak1 haan4 wui5 wan2 ngo5 jam2 caa4, bat1 gwo3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 bun3 go3 lai5 baai3 sin1 fuk1 ngo5 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说有空会找我喝茶，不过都要过一两个星期才回复我信息。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd ask me out for tea when he's free, but it'll probably be one or two weeks before he replies to my message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚應該得一個半個人會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 jing1 goi1 dak1 jat1 go3 bun3 go3 jan4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚应该只有一两个人会来。
examples.english_sentence: There will probably only be one or two people coming tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 稍微、一点点；一个；不客气（较少用）
english_meaning: A little bit; one; you're welcome (less common)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 量词; 副词; 感叹词 (罕用)
explanation_mandarin: （1）表示数量“一个”加上礼貌语“唔该”，通常用于请求帮助时，希望能得到少量或小份的帮助或服务。（2）有时单独用作“唔该”的变体，但表示感谢或“不客气”的情况较少见，通常只在非常熟悉的人之间使用。
explanation_english: (1) A combination of the quantity 'one' and the polite phrase 'm4 goi1' (please/thank you). Typically used when requesting help or service, indicating a small amount or small portion is desired. (2) Can sometimes be used as a variant of 'm4 goi1' on its own, but it's rarely used to express gratitude or 'you're welcome'. Usually only used between very close friends/family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個唔該，幫我攞盒紙巾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 m4 goi1, bong1 ngo5 lo2 hap6 zi2 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦帮我拿一盒纸巾。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please grab me a box of tissues?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆，一個唔該，切少少燒肉俾我試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2, jat1 go3 m4 goi1, cit3 siu2 siu2 siu1 juk6 bei2 ngo5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，麻烦切一点点烧肉给我试试。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, could you please cut a little bit of roasted pork for me to try?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁客氣，一個唔該啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3, jat1 go3 m4 goi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么客气，不用谢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so polite, you're welcome (but not common).

mandarin_meaning: 总之；总而言之; 一句话
english_meaning: In short; in a word; to put it simply
explanation_mandarin: 表示用一句话概括所有的内容；相当于“总之”、“总而言之”。
explanation_english: Used to summarize everything in one sentence; equivalent to "in short" or "to sum up."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰格，一個字：賤！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, jat1 go3 zi6: zin6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么没品，一句话：贱！
examples.english_sentence: He's such a despicable person, in a word: cheap!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工又辛苦又冇前途，一個字：唔掂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 jau6 san1 fu2 jau6 mou5 cin4 tou4, jat1 go3 zi6: m4 dim6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作又辛苦又没前途，总之：不行！
examples.english_sentence: This job is hard work and has no future, in a word: not good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好唔掂，一個字：差！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 m4 dim6, jat1 go3 zi6: caa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很难吃，一句话：差！
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is terrible, in a word: bad!

english_meaning: a pair; a couple
explanation_mandarin: 用于成对的物品，例如鞋子、筷子等。
explanation_english: Used for items that come in pairs, such as shoes, chopsticks, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個對鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 deoi3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一双鞋。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a pair of shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度得返一個對筷子咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 dak1 faan1 jat1 go3 deoi3 faai3 zi2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里只剩下一双筷子了。
examples.english_sentence: There's only one pair of chopsticks left here.

english_meaning: Having no money at all; broke; penniless
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常贫穷，一分钱都没有。崩：指以前的一种小面额的硬币。
explanation_english: Describes being completely broke, having no money at all. '崩' (bang1) refers to a small denomination coin previously used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我窮到一個崩都冇呀，點請你食飯啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kung4 dou3 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5 aa3, dim2 cheng2 nei5 sik6 faan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我穷到一分钱都没有，怎么请你吃饭啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm so broke, I don't have a single penny. How can I treat you to a meal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸到一個崩都冇，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 chin2 syu1 dou3 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5, zan1 hai6 chaam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输到一分钱都没有了，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his money gambling and doesn't have a single penny left. It's really pathetic.

synonyms: 身無分文 (san1 mou4 fan1 man4)

jyutping: jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5 siu2 dou3
english_meaning: Not a penny less; every penny accounted for
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量或价值完全没有减少，一点也没少。指全部，完全。
explanation_english: Describes that the quantity or value hasn't decreased at all, not even a little. It refers to the whole amount, completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爭我啲錢，最後一個崩都冇少到咁還返俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang1 ngo5 di1 cin2, zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5 siu2 dou3 gam2 waan4 faan1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠我的钱，最后一点都没少地还给了我。
examples.english_sentence: He owed me money, and in the end, he paid me back every penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好嚴格，計糧嘅時候，一個崩都唔會少俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 jim4 gaak3, gai3 loeng4 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 m4 wui5 siu2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很严格，算工资的时候，一分钱都不会少给你的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very strict, when calculating salaries, they won't pay you a penny less.

english_meaning: Not a single penny / completely broke / penniless
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常贫穷，身上一分钱都没有。崩，指旧时的硬币，价值很小。整个短语强调完全的缺乏。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being extremely poor, having no money at all. '崩' refers to old small-value coins. The entire phrase emphasizes a complete lack of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我窮到一個崩都無，仲爭人好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kung4 dou3 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5, zung6 zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我穷到一分钱都没有，还欠别人很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so broke I don't have a single penny; I even owe people a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸到一個崩都無，真係抵死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 dou3 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5, zan1 hai6 dai2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输得一分钱都没有，真是活该。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled away all his money and is left with not a single penny. Serves him right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大洗啦，好快會一個崩都無㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 sai2 laa1, hou2 faai3 wui5 jat1 go3 bang1 dou1 mou5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大手大脚了，很快就会一分钱都没有的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spend so much, you'll quickly end up without a penny.

cantonese: 一個招牌砸落嚟都砸死幾件
jyutping: jat1 go3 ziu1 paai4 zaap3 lok6 lai4 dou1 zaap3 sei2 gei2 gin6
mandarin_meaning: 比喻高手众多，随便一抓就有一大堆人才。
english_meaning: Describes a situation where there are so many talented people that even a random selection would yield several capable individuals.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在某个领域，人才济济，随便挑选一下，都能发现许多优秀的人才。常用于形容某个行业或地区人才辈出。
explanation_english: This idiom metaphorically describes a situation where talent is so abundant that even a random selection would yield several capable individuals. It's often used to describe industries or regions with a wealth of skilled people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲大學生咁多，真係一個招牌砸落嚟都砸死幾件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 daai6 hok6 sang1 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 ziu1 paai4 zaap3 lok6 lai4 dou1 zaap3 sei2 gei2 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的大学生这么多，真是随便一抓就是一大堆人才。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many university students nowadays, you can find plenty of talented people just by randomly picking some.

jyutping: jat1 go3 syun1 mui2 loeng5 go3 wat6
english_meaning: Killing two birds with one stone; achieving two things at once
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用一个办法同时达到两个目的。
explanation_english: It's a metaphor for achieving two goals with a single action or method. Similar to 'killing two birds with one stone'. The idea is that a sour plum normally has one pit, but this hypothetical one has two, giving you twice the benefit from a single plum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次活動既可以宣傳環保，又可以籌款，真係一個酸梅兩個核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 ge3 ho2 ji5 syun1 cyun4 waan4 bou2, jau6 ho2 ji5 cau4 fun2, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 syun1 mui2 loeng5 go3 wat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动既可以宣传环保，又可以筹款，真是一举两得。
examples.english_sentence: This activity can both promote environmental protection and raise funds; it's really killing two birds with one stone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話既可以溝通到香港人，又可以睇香港嘅電影，真係一個酸梅兩個核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 ho2 ji5 kau1 tung1 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4, jau6 ho2 ji5 tai2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 din6 ying2, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 syun1 mui2 loeng5 go3 wat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语既可以和香港人沟通，又可以看香港的电影，真是一举两得。
examples.english_sentence: Learning Cantonese can both allow you to communicate with Hongkongers and watch Hong Kong movies; it's really killing two birds with one stone.

synonyms: 一舉兩得 (jat1 geoi2 loeng5 dak1)
事半功倍 (si6 bun3 gung1 bei5)

english_meaning: one hour
explanation_mandarin: 表示一小时的时间长度。
explanation_english: Refers to a duration of one hour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等你一個鐘，你都未到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 nei5 jat1 go3 zung1, nei5 dou1 mei6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等你一个小时了，你都没到。
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for you for an hour, and you still haven't arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲有一個鐘半咁長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau5 jat1 go3 zung1 bun3 gam3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影有一个半小时那么长。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is one and a half hours long.

english_meaning: To bear the burden alone; to handle something solo; to go it alone
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人独自承担责任或完成某事，没有别人的帮助或支持。
explanation_english: Refers to someone bearing the responsibility or completing something alone, without help or support from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個Project咁趕，佢要自己一個開晒佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 Project gam3 gon2, keoi5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 hoi1 saai3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么赶，他要自己一个人全扛下来了。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so urgent, he has to handle it all by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想麻煩人，所以自己一個開晒啲家務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 maa4 faan4 jan4, so2 ji5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 hoi1 saai3 di1 gaa1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想麻烦别人，所以自己一个人承担所有的家务。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to bother others, so he handles all the housework by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係靠你一個開啦，冇人幫到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 kaau3 nei5 jat1 go3 hoi1 laa1, mou5 jan4 bong1 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的要靠你一个人承担了，没有人能帮你。
examples.english_sentence: This time you really have to bear it alone, no one can help you.

synonyms: 自己搞掂 (zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim3)
單打獨鬥 (daan1 daa2 duk6 dau3)

jyutping: jat1 go3 jyun6 daa2, jat1 go3 jyun6 ngaai4
mandarin_meaning: 一个愿打，一个愿挨 (yí ge yuàn dǎ, yí ge yuàn ái)
english_meaning: One is willing to hit, the other is willing to be hit; both parties are willing to accept the situation.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个愿意施加暴力或占便宜，另一个愿意承受，形容双方都心甘情愿。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a situation where one party is willing to inflict harm or take advantage, and the other party is willing to endure it. It describes a situation where both parties are consenting to the dynamic, even if it seems unequal or unfair to an outsider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係好奇怪，一個願打，一個願捱，外人真係唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, jat1 go3 jyun6 daa2, jat1 go3 jyun6 ngaai4, ngoi6 jan4 zan1 hai6 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的关系很奇怪，一个愿打，一个愿挨，外人真是不明白。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is very strange, one is willing to hit and the other is willing to be hit, outsiders really don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日OT都唔俾錢，啲同事又照做，真係一個願打，一個願捱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 OT dou1 m4 bei2 cin2, di1 tung4 si6 jau6 ziu3 zou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 jyun6 daa2, jat1 go3 jyun6 ngaai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板经常加班都不给钱，同事们也照样做，真是一个愿打，一个愿挨。
examples.english_sentence: The boss often makes them work overtime without pay, and the colleagues still do it, it's really one willing to hit, the other willing to be hit.

english_meaning: Single, alone, one person
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容一个人，单独的，没有伴侣或家人的状态。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is single, alone, or without a partner or family. It can also refer to simply 'one person'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人骨喺香港住咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 gwat1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在香港住了很久。
examples.english_sentence: He has been living alone in Hong Kong for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好丟低我一個人骨喺度呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 diu1 dai1 ngo5 jat1 go3 gwat1 hai2 dou6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把我一个人丢在这里啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave me here all alone!

jyutping: jat1 go3 bei6 go1 lung1 cheut1 hei3
mandarin_meaning: 一鼻孔出气 / 形容关系非常密切，步调一致
english_meaning: To breathe through the same nostril; to be in complete agreement; to be in cahoots; to be inseparable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，想法和行动完全一致。比喻彼此串通一气，沆瀣一气。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a very close relationship where two or more people have the same ideas and act in complete unison. It often implies a negative connotation, suggesting that they are in cahoots or conspiring together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟真係一個鼻哥窿出氣，成日一齊搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 bei6 go1 lung1 cheut1 hei3, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟真是一鼻孔出气，整天一起捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: Those two brothers are really in cahoots; they're always causing trouble together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢哋啊，佢哋成班人一個鼻哥窿出氣，專登呃你錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6 aa3, keoi5 dei6 sing4 baan1 jan4 jat1 go3 bei6 go1 lung1 cheut1 hei3, zyun1 dang3 ngaak1 nei5 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他们，他们一伙人沆瀣一气，专门骗你的钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust them; that whole group is in cahoots, deliberately trying to cheat you out of your money.

jyutping: jat1 cyun4 sap6, sap6 cyun4 baak3
english_meaning: It spreads from one to ten, from ten to a hundred; rumors spread like wildfire.
explanation_mandarin: 形容消息传播得非常快，范围很广，尤其指谣言或消息迅速传播。
explanation_english: Describes how information, especially rumors or gossip, spreads very quickly and widely. It implies a rapid and exponential spread of news, often with the implication of exaggeration or distortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂講嘢呀，一傳十，十傳百，到時就唔係咁嘅樣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5 aa3, jat1 cyun4 sap6, sap6 cyun4 baak3, dou3 si4 zau6 m4 hai6 gam2 ge3 joeng2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要乱说话啊，一传十，十传百，到时候就不是这个样子了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense, it spreads from one to ten, from ten to a hundred, and it won't be like this later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一傳十，十傳百，而家成個社區嘅人都知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 cyun4 sap6, sap6 cyun4 baak3, ji4 gaa1 seng4 go3 se5 keoi1 ge3 jan4 dou1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一传十，十传百，现在整个社区的人都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: This thing spread from one to ten, from ten to a hundred, and now everyone in the whole community knows about it.

english_meaning: One-dollar auction; penny auction
explanation_mandarin: 一种拍卖方式，通常以非常低的价格（例如一元）起拍，吸引买家竞标。 竞拍者每次加价，最终由出价最高者获得商品。
explanation_english: An auction format where bidding starts at a very low price, typically one dollar or penny, to attract buyers. Bidders increase the price incrementally, and the item is sold to the highest bidder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間鋪頭成日搞一元拍賣，好多人去搶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou1 tau2 sing4 jat6 gaau2 jat1 jyun4 paak3 maai6, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家商店经常搞一元拍卖，很多人去抢购。
examples.english_sentence: That shop often holds one-dollar auctions, and many people go to snatch up the bargains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一元拍賣度用咗十蚊就買到部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 jyun4 paak3 maai6 dou6 yung6 zo2 sap6 man1 zau6 maai5 dou2 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一元拍卖中花了十块钱就买到了一部电话。
examples.english_sentence: He managed to buy a phone for ten dollars at a one-dollar auction.

english_meaning: altogether; in total; in all
explanation_mandarin: 表示总数，全部；或者表示一起，一同。
explanation_english: Indicates the total amount; altogether. Can also mean together, jointly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日買嘢一共用咗幾多錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 maai5 je5 jat1 gung6 jung6 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天买东西一共用了多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much did you spend altogether on shopping today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一共六個人去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gung6 luk6 go3 jan4 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一共六个人去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: There are six of us going to have dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一共花咗我哋三個月時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 gung6 faa1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jyut6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一共花了我们三个月时间。
examples.english_sentence: This matter took us three months altogether.

english_meaning: repeatedly, again and again
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或情况重复发生，强调次数多。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or situation happens repeatedly, emphasizing the numerous occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一再提醒你唔好遲到，你都係遲到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zoi3 tai4 sing2 nei5 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3, nei5 dou1 hai6 ci4 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一再提醒你不要迟到，你还是迟到！
examples.english_sentence: I repeatedly reminded you not to be late, but you still are!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一再嘗試，終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zoi3 soeng4 si3, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一再尝试，终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: He tried repeatedly and finally succeeded.

english_meaning: One concave, one convex; uneven; imbalanced; not a good match (often in personality)
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个物体表面一个是凹陷，一个是凸起。也用来比喻两个人性格不合，难以相处，或者两件事物不协调。
explanation_english: Describes a surface where one part is concave and another is convex. Metaphorically, it describes two people with incompatible personalities who have difficulty getting along, or two things that are uncoordinated or mismatched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格一凹一凸，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 jat1 au1 jat1 dat6, seng4 jat6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格一凹一凸，总是吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are very different; they're always arguing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩塊木板一凹一凸，根本黐唔埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 faai3 muk6 baan2 jat1 au1 jat1 dat6, gan1 bun2 chi1 m4 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两块木板一凹一凸，根本粘不到一起。
examples.english_sentence: These two pieces of wood are uneven; they won't stick together at all.

english_meaning: To sever completely; to make a clean break; to cut ties definitively
explanation_mandarin: 比喻关系完全断绝，毫不留情。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a relationship or connection is completely severed, leaving no room for reconciliation. It implies a decisive and irreversible break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一刀兩斷，以後唔好再見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 dou1 loeng5 dyun3, ji5 hau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一刀两断，以后不要再见面。
examples.english_sentence: We are making a clean break. Don't see me again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為啲錢銀問題，最後一刀兩斷，反晒面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 di1 cin2 ngan4 man6 tai4, zeoi3 hau6 jat1 dou1 loeng5 dyun3, faan2晒 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为金钱问题，最后闹翻了，一刀两断。
examples.english_sentence: They fell out over money issues and ended up severing ties completely.

synonyms: 斷絕關係 (dyun6 zyut6 gwaan1 hai6)

english_meaning: one-size-fits-all, blanket approach
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处理事情简单粗暴，不考虑具体情况，采取统一的方式。
explanation_english: Describes a rigid, inflexible, and simplistic approach to dealing with problems or situations, ignoring specific details and individual circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔可以一刀切咁樣處理所有嘅個案㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 dou1 cit3 gam2 joeng2 cyu5 lei5 so2 jau5 ge3 go3 on3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不能一刀切地处理所有的个案。
examples.english_sentence: The government can't handle all cases with a one-size-fits-all approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住一刀切咁樣解決所有問題啦，每個情況都唔同㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 jat1 dou1 cit3 gam2 joeng2 gaai2 kyut3 so2 jau5 man6 tai4 laa1, mui5 go3 cing4 fong3 dou1 m4 tung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着一刀切地解决所有问题，每个情况都不同。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can solve all problems with a blanket approach; every situation is different.

english_meaning: every cent, every penny; meticulously; scrupulously
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常细致地计算或珍惜每一笔钱。
explanation_english: Describes calculating or cherishing every single penny with extreme meticulousness. Emphasizes being extremely careful and thorough with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好孤寒㗎，一分一毫都計到盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gu1 hon4 gaa3, jat1 fan1 jat1 hou4 dou1 gai3 dou3 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很吝啬，每一分钱都算得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He's very stingy, he calculates every single cent to the last.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做生意一分一毫都唔可以錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 seng1 ji3 jat1 fan1 jat1 hou4 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做生意一分一厘都不能错。
examples.english_sentence: In their business, every single cent must be accurate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要節省啲，一分一毫都要慳住用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zit3 saang2 di1, jat1 fan1 jat1 hou4 dou1 jiu3 haan1 zyu6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要节省一些，每一分钱都要省着用。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be more frugal, we must save and use every single cent carefully.

english_meaning: a member, one of (a group), a component
explanation_mandarin: 指一个群体或组织中的一个成员或组成部分。
explanation_english: Refers to a member or component of a group or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係呢間公司嘅一分子，應該為公司嘅發展出一分力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jat1 fan6 zi2, ying1 goi1 wai4 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2 chut1 jat1 fan6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是这家公司的一份子，应该为公司的发展出一份力。
examples.english_sentence: We are all members of this company, and we should contribute to its development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經成為咗呢個團隊嘅重要一分子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 zo2 ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jat1 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经成为了这个团队的重要一份子。
examples.english_sentence: He has become an important member of this team.

english_meaning: to divide into two
explanation_mandarin: 指将一个整体分成两个部分，强调事物既有优点也有缺点，看待问题要全面。
explanation_english: To divide one into two; to see both sides of an issue; to see the good and bad in something. Emphasizes the importance of looking at things comprehensively, acknowledging both the positive and negative aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要一分為二咁睇，唔可以淨係睇壞嘅一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 jat1 fan1 wai4 ji6 gam2 tai2, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 tai2 waai6 ge3 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要一分为二地看，不能只看坏的一面。
examples.english_sentence: We need to look at this matter from both sides; we can't just look at the bad side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分析問題要一分為二，避免以偏概全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sik1 man6 tai4 jiu3 jat1 fan1 wai4 ji6, bei2 min5 ji5 pin1 gaai3 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分析问题要一分为二，避免以偏概全。
examples.english_sentence: When analyzing problems, we need to divide them into two aspects to avoid generalization.

english_meaning: To divide into two; to split something into two opposing parts.
explanation_mandarin: 将一个事物或问题分为两个部分或方面，通常暗示着对立或对立的观点。
explanation_english: To divide something into two, often implying opposing views or aspects. It can also refer to a situation where something is seen from two different perspectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔可以一分爲二睇，我哋要睇埋佢背後嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 fan1 wai4 ji6 tai2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 maai4 keoi5 bui3 hau6 ge3 jyun4 yan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不能简单地一分为二来看，我们还要看看它背后的原因。
examples.english_sentence: We can't simply look at this matter from two opposing sides; we need to look at the reasons behind it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人鍾意將所有嘢都一分爲二，好似得啱同錯咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 zoeng1 so2 jau5 je5 dou1 jat1 fan1 wai4 ji6, hou2 ci5 dak1 ngaam1 tung4 co3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人喜欢把所有的事情都一分为二，好像只有对和错一样。
examples.english_sentence: Some people like to divide everything into two, as if there are only right and wrong.

jyutping: jat1 fan1 gaang1 wan4 jat1 fan1 sau1 wok6
english_meaning: You reap what you sow; No pain, no gain; As you sow, so shall you reap.
explanation_mandarin: 形容付出多少努力，就能获得相应的回报。强调努力和回报之间的因果关系。
explanation_english: Describes how the amount of effort you put in directly relates to the rewards you receive. It emphasizes the causal relationship between effort and reward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試要考得好，一定要努力溫書，記住一分耕耘一分收穫啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 jiu3 haau2 dak1 hou2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 wan1 syu1, gei3 zyu6 jat1 fan1 gaang1 wan4 jat1 fan1 sau1 wok6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要想考试考得好，一定要努力复习，记住一分耕耘一分收获啊！
