examples.english_sentence: If you want to do well in the exam, you must study hard, remember, you reap what you sow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力做嘢，真係一分耕耘一分收穫，升職加薪都係應份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 jat1 fan1 gaang1 wan4 jat1 fan1 sau1 wok6, sing1 jik1 gaa1 san1 dou1 hai6 ying3 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么努力工作，真是一分耕耘一分收获，升职加薪都是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard; it's truly a case of you reap what you sow. His promotion and raise are well-deserved.

jyutping: jat1 fan1 cin2 jat1 fan1 fo3
mandarin_meaning: 一分钱一分货 (yī fēn qián yī fēn huò)
english_meaning: You get what you pay for.
explanation_mandarin: 指付出多少代价，就能获得多少质量的商品或服务。强调价格与质量成正比。
explanation_english: This idiom means that the quality of goods or services is directly proportional to the price you pay. It emphasizes that you get the quality you pay for; cheaper prices usually mean lower quality, and higher prices generally mean better quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢雖然貴啲，但係一分錢一分貨，耐用好多㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 seoi1 jin4 gwai3 di1, daan6 hai6 jat1 fan1 cin2 jat1 fan1 fo3, noi6 jung6 hou2 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西虽然贵一点，但是一分钱一分货，耐用很多。
examples.english_sentence: These things are a bit more expensive, but you get what you pay for; they are much more durable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳咁貴，但係啲嘢食真係一分錢一分貨，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 gwai3, daan6 hai6 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 jat1 fan1 cin2 jat1 fan1 fo3, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这家餐厅那么贵，但是食物真是一分钱一分货，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: His restaurant is so expensive, but the food is really worth the price; it's delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買嘢唔好貪平，要記住一分錢一分貨呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 je5 m4 hou2 taam1 peng4, jiu3 gei3 zyu6 jat1 fan1 cin2 jat1 fan1 fo3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买东西不要贪便宜，要记住一分钱一分货啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be greedy for cheap things when you buy things. Remember you get what you pay for.

english_meaning: everything, all, all things
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部的事物、全部的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to everything, all things, or all circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放棄咗一切，走咗去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hei3 zo2 jat1 cai3, zau2 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了一切，去了外国。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up everything and went abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡我一切嘅努力去幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 ngo5 jat1 cai3 ge3 nou5 lik6 heoi3 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽我一切的努力去帮助你。
examples.english_sentence: I will do everything I can to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一切順利嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 cai3 seon6 lei6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一切顺利吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is everything going smoothly?

english_meaning: a moment, a short time
explanation_mandarin: 表示很短的时间，通常指很短暂的时刻。
explanation_english: Refers to a very short period of time, usually a brief moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度等咗你一刻咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 dang2 zo2 nei5 jat1 hak1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在这里只等了你一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: We've only been waiting for you here for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一刻都唔想留低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hak1 dou1 m4 soeng2 lau4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一刻都不想留下。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to stay for even a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀我一刻時間諗諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 ngo5 jat1 hak1 si4 gaan3 nam2 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一点时间想想。
examples.english_sentence: Give me a moment to think.

english_meaning: an instant, a split second, a blink of an eye
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常短，一下子。
explanation_english: Describes a very short period of time, an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸車揸得好快，一剎那就唔見咗佢嘅影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 che1 zaa1 dak1 hou2 faai3, jat1 saat3 na5 zau6 m4 gin3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开车开得很快，一瞬间就看不见他的身影了。
examples.english_sentence: He drives very fast; in an instant, his shadow disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋淨係分開咗一剎那，點解會發生咁多事嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zing6 hai6 fan1 hoi1 zo2 jat1 saat3 na5, dim2 gaai2 wui faat3 sang1 gam3 do1 si6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只是分开了一瞬间，为什么会发生这么多事呢？
examples.english_sentence: We were only separated for an instant, why did so many things happen?

english_meaning: Little by little; bit by bit; gradually
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极少，一点一点地积累或发生。
explanation_english: Describes a process happening gradually, bit by bit, often referring to accumulation or slow progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一剔一點咁儲錢，終於都夠錢買樓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 tik1 jat1 dim2 gam2 chu5 chin2, chung1 yu1 dou1 gau3 chin2 maai5 lau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一点一点地存钱，终于够钱买房子了。
examples.english_sentence: He saved money little by little, and finally he had enough to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲知識要一剔一點咁累積，冇得一步登天㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ji3 sik1 jiu3 jat1 tik1 jat1 dim2 gam2 lei5 jik1, mou5 dak1 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 知识要一点一滴地积累，不可能一步登天。
examples.english_sentence: Knowledge needs to be accumulated bit by bit, you can't achieve it in one step.

english_meaning: to do something in one go; to pass something smoothly; without interruption; seamlessly
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次性完成某事，没有中断或阻碍；顺利通过。
explanation_english: Describes doing something in one continuous action without stopping or encountering problems; to pass something smoothly without issues or needing to revisit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次考試希望可以一剔過啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 tik1 gwo3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这次考试希望能够一次通过！
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can pass this exam in one go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學車一剔過，好叻啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 ce1 jat1 tik1 gwo3, hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学车一次通过，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He passed his driving test in one go, he's amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project我哋要一剔過搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 tik1 gwo3 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目我们要一次性把它搞定。
examples.english_sentence: We need to complete this project in one go.

english_meaning: to bear the responsibility single-handedly; to take full responsibility; to shoulder the burden alone
explanation_mandarin: 指独自承担所有责任或负担，不依赖他人。
explanation_english: To take on the entire responsibility or burden alone, without relying on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我一力承擔，唔關其他人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 lik6 sing4 daam1, m4 gwaan1 kei4 taa1 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我独自承担，不关其他人的事。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take full responsibility for this; it has nothing to do with anyone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話如果有咩問題，佢會一力承擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 jau5 me1 man6 tai4, keoi5 wui5 jat1 lik6 sing4 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说如果有什么问题，他会独自承担。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said that if there are any problems, he will take full responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定一力承擔所有嘅後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 jat1 lik6 sing4 daam1 so2 jau5 ge3 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定独自承担所有的后果。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to bear all the consequences single-handedly.

synonyms: 一手包辦 (jat1 sau2 baau1 baan6)
獨力承擔 (duk6 lik6 sing4 daam1)

jyutping: jat1 dung6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 zing6
mandarin_meaning: 少动不如静止；以静制动
english_meaning: Better to do nothing than to make a move; Better to remain still than to take action; Sometimes it's better to leave things as they are
explanation_mandarin: 指在某些情况下，行动可能会带来负面效果，不如保持现状，静观其变。强调避免轻举妄动，保持冷静和观察。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that in certain situations, taking action might lead to undesirable consequences. Therefore, it's better to remain still, observe, and avoid rash moves. It emphasizes the importance of patience and observation before acting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家個市咁波動，一動不如一靜，最好都係唔好亂咁投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go3 si5 gam3 bo1 dung6, jat1 dung6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 zing6, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在市场这么波动，少动不如静止，最好还是不要乱投资。
examples.english_sentence: The market is so volatile right now. It's better to do nothing than to make a move. It's best not to invest recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住幫佢，點知越幫越忙，都係一動不如一靜，由得佢自己搞掂算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 bong1 keoi5, dim2 zi1 yut6 bong1 yut6 mong4, dou1 hai6 jat1 dung6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 zing6, jau4 dak1 keoi5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来想帮他，结果越帮越忙，还是少动不如静止，让他自己解决算了。
examples.english_sentence: I intended to help him, but the more I helped, the worse it got. It's better to do nothing; I'll let him sort it out himself.

mandarin_meaning: 一劳永逸 (yī láo yǒng yì)
english_meaning: Once and for all; to get something done once and for all; to solve a problem permanently
explanation_mandarin: 形容一次把事情做好，以后就不用再费力气了。
explanation_english: Describes doing something once properly so that no further effort is required later on; to achieve a permanent solution after one effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋可以設計一套完美嘅系統，就可以一勞永逸解決問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 sai3 gai3 jat1 tou3 waan4 mei5 ge3 hai6 tung2, zau6 ho2 ji5 jat1 lou4 wing5 jat6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们能设计一套完美的系统，就可以一劳永逸地解决问题了。
examples.english_sentence: If we can design a perfect system, we can solve the problem once and for all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇嘢可以一勞永逸，你要持續努力先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 je5 ho2 ji5 jat1 lou4 wing5 jat6, nei5 jiu3 ci4 zuk6 nu5 lik6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有什么是可以一劳永逸的，你需要持续努力才行。
examples.english_sentence: Nothing is a once and for all thing; you need to keep putting in effort.

english_meaning: Very long (and usually tedious), never-ending, long-winded
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或文章很长，通常带有负面含义，表示内容冗长乏味，令人厌烦。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very long, usually referring to speech or writing that is tedious, boring, and never-ending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢一匹布咁長，聽到我都想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jat1 pat1 bou3 gam3 coeng4, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话太长了，听得我都想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was so long-winded, I felt like falling asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告一匹布咁長，都唔知佢寫咗啲乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jat1 pat1 bou3 gam3 coeng4, dou1 m4 zi1 gei2 se2 zo2 di1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告很长，都不知道他写了些什么。
examples.english_sentence: This report is so long, I don't even know what he wrote.

synonyms: 長篇大論 (coeng4 pin1 daai6 leon6)

english_meaning: one thousand
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，等于一千。
explanation_english: A numeral representing the quantity of one thousand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦賣一千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 maai6 jat1 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑卖一千块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This computer sells for one thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有成一千個員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 sing4 jat1 cin1 go3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有整整一千个员工。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has as many as one thousand employees.

jyutping: jat1 cin1 gei2 baak3 jau4 jyu4 laap6 saap3
mandarin_meaning: 一千几百块钱就像垃圾一样
english_meaning: A thousand or so dollars is like garbage (worthless)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人非常富有，认为一千几百块钱微不足道，如同垃圾一样不值钱。通常带有一种炫耀或不屑的语气。
explanation_english: This phrase describes someone who is very wealthy and considers a thousand or so dollars to be insignificant and worthless, like garbage. It often carries a tone of boasting or disdain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有錢，一千幾百猶如垃圾咁使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 cin2, jat1 cin1 gei2 baak3 jau4 jyu4 laap6 saap3 gam2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么有钱，一千几百块钱就像垃圾一样花。
examples.english_sentence: He's so rich that he spends a thousand or so dollars like it's nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對佢嚟講，一千幾百猶如垃圾，根本唔會放喺眼入邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2, jat1 cin1 gei2 baak3 jau4 jyu4 laap6 saap3, gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 fong3 hai2 ngaan5 jap6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对他来说，一千几百块钱就像垃圾一样，根本不会放在眼里。
examples.english_sentence: For him, a thousand or so dollars is like garbage; he wouldn't even notice it.

synonyms: 九牛一毛 (gau2 ngau4 jat1 mou4) (Cantonese pronunciation)

mandarin_meaning: 很多; 非常多; 数不胜数
english_meaning: countless; a great many; an endless number
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量非常多，多到难以计数。 虽然字面意思是“一千零一”，但并不表示确切的数字，而是一种夸张的说法。
explanation_english: Describes a quantity that is so large it's practically uncountable. While literally 'one thousand and one,' it signifies a vast, immeasurable number, an exaggerated expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅收藏品一千零一件咁多，真係睇都睇唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau1 cong4 ban2 jat1 cin1 ling4 jat1 gin6 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 tai2 dou1 tai2 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的收藏品多得数不清，真的看不完。
examples.english_sentence: He has countless collectibles; it's impossible to see them all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會啲飛一開賣就一千零一個人爭住買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 di1 fei1 jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 jat1 cin1 ling4 jat1 go3 jan4 zang1 zyu6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票一开卖就有很多人争着买。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the concert tickets went on sale, countless people rushed to buy them.

english_meaning: half
explanation_mandarin: 表示整体的二分之一。
explanation_english: One of two equal or nearly equal parts into which something is or may be divided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕我食咗一半。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 ngo5 sik6 zo2 jat1 bun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕我吃了一半。
examples.english_sentence: I ate half of this cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一人一半。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 jan4 jat1 bun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一人一半。
examples.english_sentence: Let's split it half and half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢，一半真一半假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, jat1 bun3 zan1 jat1 bun3 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话，一半真一半假。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is half true and half false.

english_meaning: Half and half; fifty-fifty; so-so; neither good nor bad; mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 表示一半一半，也形容不好不坏，一般般。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is half and half. Can also describe something that is neither good nor bad, just so-so or mediocre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試成績一半半啫，唔算好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 sing4 zik1 jat1 bun3 bun3 ze1, m4 syun3 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试成绩一般般，不算很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results were so-so this time; not particularly good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食一半半，有啲好食，有啲唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 jat1 bun3 bun3, jau5 di1 hou2 sik6, jau5 di1 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一半一半，有些好吃，有些不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is hit or miss; some dishes are good, and some are not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢廣東話講得一半半，聽得明但係講得唔流利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 jat1 bun3 bun3, teng1 dak1 ming4 daan6 hai6 gong2 dak1 m4 lau4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的广东话说得一半一半，听得懂但是说得不流利。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese is so-so; he can understand but can't speak fluently.

english_meaning: gone and never to return; irretrievable
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间或事物一旦过去，就永远不会再回来。
explanation_english: Describes something (time, opportunity, a person) that is gone forever and will never return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲青春一去不返，要好好珍惜而家嘅時光啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cing1 ceon1 jat1 heoi3 bat1 faan2, jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1 ji4 gaa1 ge3 si4 gwong1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 青春一去不复返，要好好珍惜现在的时光啊。
examples.english_sentence: Youth is gone and never to return, so we must cherish the present time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間一去不返，唔好浪費時間啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 jat1 heoi3 bat1 faan2, m4 hou2 long6 fai3 si4 gaan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间一去不复返，不要浪费时间了。
examples.english_sentence: Time is gone and never to return, don't waste time.

english_meaning: contrary to one's usual behavior; to act out of character; to do something that is not one's usual way
explanation_mandarin: 指行为、态度或情况与平时的状态截然不同。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone's behaviour, attitude, or circumstances are drastically different from their usual state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時好靜嘅，但今日一反常態，喺度勁咁講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 hou2 zing6 ge3, daan6 gam1 jat6 jat1 faan2 soeng4 taai3, hai2 dou6 ging6 gam2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时很安静的，但是今天一反常态，在这里不停地说。
examples.english_sentence: He's usually very quiet, but today he's acting completely out of character, talking non-stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥平時唔會幫手做家務㗎，今日一反常態，竟然主動清潔間房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 ping4 si4 m4 wui5 bong1 sau2 zou6 gaa1 mou6 gaa3, gam1 jat6 jat1 faan2 soeng4 taai3, ging2 jin4 zyu2 dung6 cing1 git3 gaan1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥平时不会帮忙做家务的，今天一反常态，竟然主动清洁房间。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother usually doesn't help with housework, but today he's acting out of character and even volunteered to clean his room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向都唔鍾意食辣嘢，但係今次一反常態，食咗好多麻辣火鍋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6 je5, daan6 hai6 gam1 ci3 jat1 faan2 soeng4 taai3, sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 maa4 laat6 fo2 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向都不喜欢吃辣的，但是这次一反常态，吃了很多麻辣火锅。
examples.english_sentence: He never liked spicy food, but this time he acted out of character and ate a lot of mala hot pot.

english_meaning: a mouthful; one sip; one bite; a gulp; (of language) fluent
explanation_mandarin: 量词，表示吃、喝等动作的单位，或形容语言流利。
explanation_english: Measure word for a mouthful, sip, bite, or gulp; can also describe someone speaking a language fluently (in one go).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我飲咗一口咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jam2 zo2 jat1 hau2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喝了一口咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I took a sip of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講廣東話講得好流利，一口氣講咗成段嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6, jat1 hau2 hei3 gong2 zo2 seng4 dyun6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说广东话说得很流利，一口气说了整段话。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks Cantonese very fluently, he said the whole passage in one breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一口食晒成個包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hau2 sik6 saai3 sing4 go3 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口吃掉了整个包子。
examples.english_sentence: He ate the whole bun in one bite.

english_meaning: fixed price; one price; non-negotiable price
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或服务只有一个价格，不能讨价还价。
explanation_english: Refers to a fixed price for a product or service, meaning the price is non-negotiable and cannot be haggled over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭啲嘢全部都係一口價，唔講價㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 jat1 hau2 gaa3, m4 gong2 gaa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店里的东西都是一口价，不讲价的。
examples.english_sentence: Everything in this shop is at a fixed price, no bargaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢部車係一口價賣，唔接受議價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 bou6 ce1 hai6 jat1 hau2 gaa3 maai6, m4 zip3 sau6 ji5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这辆车是一口价卖，不接受议价。
examples.english_sentence: He said this car is being sold at a fixed price, and he doesn't accept price negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程係一口價收費，唔會中途加價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 hai6 jat1 hau2 gaa3 sau1 fai3, m4 wui5 zung1 tou4 gaa1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程是一口价收费，不会中途加价。
examples.english_sentence: This course has a fixed price fee, and the price won't increase mid-way.

english_meaning: to assert categorically, to maintain stubbornly, to insist on something
explanation_mandarin: 指非常肯定地说，坚持认定，不容置疑。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone asserts something very strongly and categorically, refusing to back down or admit any doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一口咬定係我偷咗佢嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hau2 ngaau5 ding6 hai6 ngo5 tau1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口咬定是我偷了他的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He categorically stated that I stole his money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論我點解釋，佢都一口咬定我講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 ngo5 dim2 gaai2 sik1, keoi5 dou1 jat1 hau2 ngaau5 ding6 ngo5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论我怎么解释，他都一口咬定我说谎。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how I explained, he still insisted that I was lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人捉住佢，佢一口咬定自己冇犯法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan4 zuk1 zyu6 keoi5, keoi5 jat1 hau2 ngaau5 ding6 zi6 gei2 mou5 faan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓住他，他一口咬定自己没有犯法。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested him, but he insisted that he had not committed any crime.

synonyms: 斬釘截鐵 (zaam2 ding1 zit3 tit3)

english_meaning: to refuse outright, to reject immediately, to give a flat refusal
explanation_mandarin: 指立刻，干脆地拒绝。
explanation_english: Refers to refusing something immediately and decisively, giving a flat rejection without hesitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問佢借錢，佢一口拒絕咗我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 keoi5 ze3 cin2, keoi5 jat1 hau2 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问他借钱，他一口拒绝了我。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him to borrow money, and he refused me outright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一口拒絕咗我哋嘅提議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 hau2 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tai4 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一口拒绝了我们的提议。
examples.english_sentence: They rejected our proposal immediately.

synonyms: 斷然拒絕 (dyun3 jin4 keoi5 zyut6)

english_meaning: In one breath; in one go; without stopping
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次性完成某事，没有停顿。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in one go, without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一口氣飲晒成支汽水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 hau2 hei3 jam2 saai3 sing4 zi1 hei3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一口气喝完了整瓶汽水。
examples.english_sentence: I drank the whole bottle of soda in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一口氣跑上十樓，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hau2 hei3 paau2 soeng5 sap6 lau2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气跑上了十楼，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He ran up to the tenth floor in one breath; he's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一口氣講晒所有嘢，我都唔知佢講緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hau2 hei3 gong2 saai3 so2 jau5 je5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气说完了所有事情，我都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He said everything in one breath, I don't even know what he's talking about.

jyutping: jat1 geoi3 m4 goi1 sai2 sei2 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 说一句谢谢要了他的命似的
english_meaning: Saying 'thank you' would kill him/her (expressing extreme stinginess or unwillingness to say thank you)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常吝啬，连说一句“唔该”（谢谢）都好像要了他的命一样。表示责备对方小气，不肯付出。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is extremely stingy or unwilling to even say 'thank you'. It expresses criticism towards someone who is cheap and unwilling to offer even a simple courtesy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孤寒，一句唔該使死人咁款！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4, jat1 geoi3 m4 goi1 sai2 sei2 jan4 gam2 kwan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么小气，说一句谢谢就像要了他的命一样！
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy, saying 'thank you' is like killing him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使唔使咁呀？一句唔該使死人咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 m4 sai2 gam2 aa3? jat1 geoi3 m4 goi1 sai2 sei2 jan4 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用得着这样吗？说一句谢谢要了你的命吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have to be like that? Is saying 'thank you' going to kill you?

mandarin_meaning: 一句话说完; 总而言之
english_meaning: In a nutshell; To sum it up; To put it briefly
explanation_mandarin: 用一句话概括全部内容，表示简洁明了地表达核心意思。
explanation_english: To summarize everything in one sentence; Used to express the core idea concisely and clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一句講晒，呢個計劃唔可行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 geoi3 gong2 saai3, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 ho2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，这个计划不可行。
examples.english_sentence: To sum it up, this plan is not feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一句講晒，佢根本就唔想幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 geoi3 gong2 saai3, keoi5 gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 soeng2 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一句话，他根本就不想帮你。
examples.english_sentence: In a nutshell, he just doesn't want to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一句講晒，我哋冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 geoi3 gong2 saai3, ngo5 dei6 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，我们没钱。
examples.english_sentence: To put it briefly, we have no money.

jyutping: jat1 geoi3 hei2 loeng5 geoi3 zi2
english_meaning: To start something and quickly finish it; to do something half-heartedly; to give something a superficial treatment.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，开始做一点就很快结束，敷衍了事。
explanation_english: Describes doing something superficially or half-heartedly, starting something and quickly stopping after a minimal effort. Suggests a lack of commitment or thoroughness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好求其㗎，成日都一句起兩句止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 kau4 kei4 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 geoi3 hei2 loeng5 geoi3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很随便，经常都是草草了事。
examples.english_sentence: He's very casual in his work, always finishing things half-heartedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告佢一句起兩句止咁寫完就算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 keoi5 jat1 geoi3 hei2 loeng5 geoi3 zi2 gam2 se2 jyun4 zau6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告他随便写完就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He just wrote this report superficially and considered it done.

english_meaning: together; at the same time; in the same place
explanation_mandarin: 表示在同一时间、地点或状态下。
explanation_english: Indicates being at the same time, place, or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一同事放工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 tung4 si6 fong3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起下班。
examples.english_sentence: We finish work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一同去睇戲啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 tung4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起去看电影吧？
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we go to see a movie together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一同合作完成咗個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 tung4 hap6 zok3 waan4 sing4 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一起合作完成了这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: They collaborated together to complete this project.

english_meaning: always, all along, consistently, formerly, hitherto
explanation_mandarin: 表示从前到现在都是如此，强调持续性和常态。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has been the case from the past until now, emphasizing continuity and normality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向都好勤力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向都很勤奋的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always been very diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一向都唔鍾意飲咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 jam2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直都不喜欢喝咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I've never liked coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳一向都好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅一直都很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is always crowded.

english_meaning: Always; constantly; invariably; only; just
explanation_mandarin: 表示总是、一概，或表示只做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates always, invariably, or only doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一味話我錯，咁你有冇諗過自己都有問題呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 mei6 waa6 ngo5 co3, gam2 nei5 jau5 mou5 nim2 gwo3 zi6 gei2 dou1 jau5 man6 tai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是说我错，那你想过你自己也有问题吗？
examples.english_sentence: You always say I'm wrong, but have you ever considered that you might also have problems?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一味掛住打機，都唔做功課嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 mei6 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1, dou1 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着玩游戏，都不做功课的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about playing games, and doesn't do his homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一味靠人，自己都要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 mei6 kaau3 jan4, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是依靠别人，自己也要努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on others, you need to work hard yourself.

english_meaning: To solely rely on someone; to always sponge off someone; to be utterly dependent
explanation_mandarin: 指完全依赖别人，只知道依靠别人，没有自己的主见或能力。
explanation_english: Refers to completely relying on others, only knowing how to depend on them, lacking one's own opinions or abilities. It often carries a negative connotation, implying a lack of self-reliance and potentially exploiting others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一味靠黐屋企人，自己又唔搵嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 mei6 kaau3 ci1 uk1 kei2 jan4, zi6 gei2 jau6 m4 wan2 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是依靠家里人，自己又不去找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He always relies on his family and doesn't even bother looking for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一味靠黐我哋，都要學吓自己解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 mei6 kaau3 ci1 ngo5 dei6, dou1 jiu3 hok6 haa5 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是依靠我们，也要学着自己解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on us; you need to learn to solve problems yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一味靠黐，要學識獨立思考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 mei6 kaau3 ci1, jiu3 hok6 sik1 duk6 lap6 si1 haau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是依赖别人，要学会独立思考。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on others; learn to think independently.

english_meaning: to receive a hundred responses to a single call; to be very influential; to command a large following
explanation_mandarin: 形容有极高的号召力，一发出号召，立刻有很多人响应。
explanation_english: Describes someone with immense influence and the ability to rally a large number of people immediately upon making a call to action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有威望，一呼百應㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 wai1 mong6, jat1 fu1 baak3 jing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司很有威望，一呼百应。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of prestige in the company and commands a large following.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞個慈善籌款，好多人都捐錢，真係一呼百應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 go3 ci4 sin6 cau4 fun2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gyun1 cin2, zan1 hai6 jat1 fu1 baak3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他组织了一个慈善募款，很多人都捐钱，真是一呼百应。
examples.english_sentence: He organized a charity fundraiser, and many people donated money. He truly commands a large following.

jyutping: jat1 ming6 ji6 wan6 saam1 fung1 seoi2
english_meaning: First, fate; second, luck; third, feng shui (destiny is predetermined, but luck and feng shui can be influenced)
explanation_mandarin: 这是一个俗语，说明影响人生的几个重要因素：先天命格、后天运气和风水。 命是指一个人的出生时间和先天条件，运是指后天的机遇和发展，风水是指环境对人的影响。虽然命是天生的，但运和风水是可以改变和调整的，从而改善人生。
explanation_english: This is an idiom that explains the important factors influencing a person's life: innate destiny, acquired luck, and feng shui. Destiny refers to a person's birth time and inherent conditions. Luck refers to opportunities and development after birth. Feng shui refers to the influence of the environment on a person. While destiny is predetermined, luck and feng shui can be changed and adjusted to improve one's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢咁成功都係因為佢信「一命二運三風水」，所以成日睇風水同埋做好事積福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gam3 sing4 gung1 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 seon3 「jat1 ming6 ji6 wan6 saam1 fung1 seoi2」, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 tai2 fung1 seoi2 tung4 maai4 zou6 hou2 si6 zik1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他这么成功都是因为他相信“一命二运三风水”，所以经常看风水并且做好事积福。
examples.english_sentence: He said that his success is all because he believes in 'first, fate; second, luck; third, feng shui', so he often consults feng shui masters and does good deeds to accumulate blessings.

mandarin_meaning: 一命呜呼 (yī mìng wū hū)
english_meaning: To die; to kick the bucket; to pass away
explanation_mandarin: 指死亡，生命结束。语气比较夸张或幽默。
explanation_english: Refers to death; the end of life. Often used in a slightly exaggerated or humorous way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸電單車炒車，即刻一命嗚呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 din6 maan1 ce1 caau2 ce1, zik1 hak1 jat1 ming6 wu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骑摩托车出了车祸，当场一命呜呼了。
examples.english_sentence: He crashed his motorcycle and died instantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果考試唔合格，我就一命嗚呼㗎啦，俾阿媽鬧死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, ngo5 zau6 jat1 ming6 wu1 fu1 gaa3 laa1, bei2 aa3 maa1 naau6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果考试不及格，我就完蛋了，会被妈妈骂死。
examples.english_sentence: If I fail the exam, I'm dead! My mom will scold me to death.

english_meaning: Poinsettia
explanation_mandarin: 一种观赏植物，红色叶片是其特征，常在圣诞节前后开花。
explanation_english: An ornamental plant characterized by its red bracts (often mistaken for petals), commonly flowering around Christmas time. Poinsettia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節嘅時候，好多人都會買一品紅嚟裝飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 maai5 jat1 ban2 hung4 lai4 zong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞节的时候，很多人都会买一品红来装饰。
examples.english_sentence: During Christmas time, many people buy poinsettias to decorate.

english_meaning: to swarm; to rush forward all at once; to pile on
explanation_mandarin: 形容许多人一起涌上去。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where many people rush forward at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當個明星一出現，啲粉絲就一哄而上想攞簽名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 go3 ming4 sing1 jat1 ceot1 hin3, di1 fan2 si1 zau6 jat1 hung3 ji4 soeng5 soeng2 lo2 cim1 ming2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当那个明星一出现，粉丝们就一拥而上想签名。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as that celebrity appeared, the fans swarmed around him wanting autographs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到有嘢跌咗落地，班細路就一哄而上爭住執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jau5 je5 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, baan1 sai3 lou6 zau6 jat1 hung3 ji4 soeng5 zaang1 zyu6 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到有东西掉在地上，孩子们就一拥而上抢着捡。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing something fall to the ground, the children rushed forward to pick it up.

synonyms: 蜂擁而至 (fung1 jung2 ji4 zi3)

english_meaning: to disperse in a hubbub; to scatter helter-skelter; to break up in disorder
explanation_mandarin: 形容人群一下子吵吵嚷嚷地走散。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a crowd disperses noisily and quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨嘅消息一傳開，啲人就一哄而散喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 siu1 sik1 jat1 cyun4 hoi1, di1 jan4 zau6 jat1 hung3 ji4 saan3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到明天要下雨的消息一传开，人们就一哄而散了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the news spread that it would rain tomorrow, people dispersed in a hubbub.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人一嚟，啲賭仔就一哄而散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan4 jat1 lai4, di1 dou2 zai2 zau6 jat1 hung3 ji4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察一来，赌徒们就一哄而散。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the police arrived, the gamblers scattered helter-skelter.

english_meaning: to rise up in a hubbub, to swarm (up), to rush up all at once
explanation_mandarin: 形容许多人同时行动或发生骚动。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a large number of people act simultaneously or a commotion occurs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到跌咗嘢，班細路一哄而起去執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 dit3 zo2 je5, baan1 sai3 lou6 jat1 hung3 ji4 hei2 heoi3 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到掉东西了，孩子们一哄而起去捡。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing something fall, the children rushed to pick it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講話有免費嘢派，啲人就一哄而起咁衝埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 waa6 jau5 min5 fai3 je5 paai3, di1 jan4 zau6 jat1 hung3 ji4 hei2 gam2 cung1 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说有免费的东西派发，人们就一哄而起地冲过去。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that there were free things being given out, people swarmed and rushed towards it.

synonyms: 蜂擁而上 (fung1 jung2 ji4 soeng5)

mandarin_meaning: 老大, 佼佼者, 最棒的
english_meaning: Number one; top guy; the best; leading figure
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域或团体中最优秀、最权威的人。 通常用于形容男性。
explanation_english: Refers to the most outstanding and authoritative person in a certain field or group. Usually used to describe a male.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係警隊嘅一哥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ging2 deoi6 ge3 jat1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是警队的老大。
examples.english_sentence: He is the top cop in the police force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌咁好聽，真係樂壇一哥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheong3 go1 gam3 hou2 teng1, zan1 hai6 lok6 taan4 jat1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌这么好听，真是乐坛的老大。
examples.english_sentence: He sings so well, he really is the number one in the music industry.

english_meaning: Otherwise; or else; if not
explanation_mandarin: 表示两种可能性之间的选择，语气较随意，相当于“不然就是”，“要不然”。通常用于口语中。
explanation_english: Expresses a choice between two possibilities, with a casual tone. Equivalent to "otherwise" or "or else". Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日嚟唔嚟呀？一唔係我哋自己去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 lai4 m4 lai4 aa3? jat1 m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天来不来啊？要不然我们自己去了。
examples.english_sentence: Are you coming tomorrow or not? Otherwise, we'll go ourselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲做完功課，一唔係今晚冇得睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3, jat1 m4 hai6 gam1 maan1 mou5 dak1 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点做完功课，不然今晚就没得看电视了。
examples.english_sentence: Finish your homework quickly, or else you won't be able to watch TV tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下打俾佢，一唔係send個message囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 daa2 bei2 keoi5, jat1 m4 hai6 send go3 message lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试着打个电话给他，要不然就发个短信吧。
examples.english_sentence: Try calling him, otherwise just send him a message.

mandarin_meaning: 一唱一和 (yī chàng yī hè)
english_meaning: to sing in chorus; to echo one another; to be in cahoots; to act in collusion; to cooperate in something negative
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人或多个人互相呼应，配合默契。有时含贬义，指互相勾结。
explanation_english: Describes two or more people responding to each other and cooperating tacitly. Sometimes carries a derogatory connotation, referring to collusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺度一唱一和，明顯想呃我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 dou6 jat1 coeng3 jat1 wo6, ming4 hin2 soeng2 ngaak1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在这里一唱一和，明显想骗我们。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are in cahoots here, clearly trying to trick us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一唱一和咁樣講，真係好鬼似做戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 coeng3 jat1 wo6 gam2 joeng2 gong2, zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 ci5 zou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一唱一和地那样说，真的很像在演戏。
examples.english_sentence: The way they're talking in chorus really looks like they're acting.

synonyms: 同聲同氣 (tung4 seng1 tung4 hei3)

english_meaning: a mouthful, a bite, a sip
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次吞咽的量，通常指食物或饮料。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount taken in one swallow, bite, or sip, usually referring to food or drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我飲咗一啖咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jam2 zo2 jat1 daam6 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喝了一口咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I took a sip of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食咗一啖蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 zo2 jat1 daam6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吃了一口蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: He took a bite of cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細細啖，慢慢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 sai3 daam6, maan6 maan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小口小口地，慢慢吃。
examples.english_sentence: Take small bites and eat slowly.

jyutping: jat1 daam6 saa1 tong2 jat1 daam6 si2
mandarin_meaning: 先甜后苦; 苦乐参半
english_meaning: A spoonful of sugar, a spoonful of shit; Alternating between good and bad; Bitter-sweet
explanation_mandarin: 形容先尝到甜头，后尝到苦头；或指人生中苦乐交织，好的坏的轮流出现。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one experiences something sweet followed by something bitter, or refers to life being a mixture of joy and sorrow, good and bad alternating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工就係一啖砂糖一啖屎，人工高但係壓力都好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zau6 hai6 jat1 daam6 saa1 tong2 jat1 daam6 si2, jan4 gung1 gou1 daan6 hai6 aat3 lik6 dou1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作就是先甜后苦，工资高但是压力也很大。
examples.english_sentence: This job is a bittersweet experience, the salary is high but the pressure is also immense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 愛情就好似一啖砂糖一啖屎，有開心嘅時候，亦都有傷心嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: oi3 cing4 zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 daam6 saa1 tong2 jat1 daam6 si2, jau5 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6, jik6 dou1 jau5 soeng1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爱情就像苦乐参半，有开心的时候，也有伤心的时候。
examples.english_sentence: Love is like a bittersweet experience, there are happy times, and there are also sad times.

english_meaning: some, a little, a bit
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量、一点，相当于普通话的“一些”、“一点”。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity or amount; equivalent to "some" or "a little" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係識講一啲啲廣東話咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeng6 hai6 sik1 gong2 jat1 di1 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会说一点点广东话而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only know how to speak a little bit of Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢我唔識整，你幫我搞一啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 ngo5 m4 sik1 zing2, nei5 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 jat1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西我不会弄，你帮我弄一些吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to fix these things. Can you help me with some of it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日凍凍地，飲一啲熱嘢暖下身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dung3 dung3 dei2, yam2 jat1 di1 jit6 je5 nyun5 haa5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有点冷，喝一些热的东西暖暖身子。
examples.english_sentence: It's a bit chilly today, drink something hot to warm yourself up.

english_meaning: a little bit; a tiny bit; slightly
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量非常少或程度很轻微。
explanation_english: Indicates a very small quantity or a slight degree. It often implies 'just a little'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識講一啲啲廣東話啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 gong2 jat1 di1 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会说一点点广东话而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only speak a little bit of Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗一啲啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 jat1 di1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了一点点。
examples.english_sentence: He's a little bit sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳貴咗一啲啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gwai3 zo2 jat1 di1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅贵了一点点。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is a bit more expensive.

english_meaning: in one go; with one action; suddenly; at once; one hit; one try
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次性的动作或事件，强调迅速、果断或猛烈。也可用作量词，表示一次。
explanation_english: Indicates a single action or event, emphasizing speed, decisiveness, or force. It can also be used as a measure word, meaning 'one time' or 'one hit'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嘢搶咗我個電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 je5 coeng2 zo2 ngo5 go3 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子抢了我的电话。
examples.english_sentence: He snatched my phone in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一嘢飲晒杯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 je5 yam2 saai3 bui1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一口气喝完了这杯东西。
examples.english_sentence: I drank the whole drink in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嘢打爆咗個玻璃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 je5 daa2 baau3 zo2 go3 bo1 lei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一击打碎了玻璃。
examples.english_sentence: He smashed the glass with one hit.

english_meaning: a lump of mud; covered in mud
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是一堆泥土，也用来形容某人全身都是泥土，非常脏。
explanation_english: Literally means a lump of mud. It's also used to describe someone who is covered in mud, very dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢，跌親地下，成身一噼泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5, dit3 can1 dei6 haa2, sing4 san1 jat1 pek1 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他，摔倒在地上，全身都是泥土。
examples.english_sentence: Look at him, he fell on the ground and is covered in mud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨，啲路一噼泥，好難行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5, di1 lou6 jat1 pek1 nai4, hou2 naan4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨，路上一堆泥，很难走。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, the road is full of mud and it's difficult to walk.

mandarin_meaning: 一来; 首先; 一开始
english_meaning: Firstly; to begin with; as soon as; once; at the beginning
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的时间或顺序在先，有“首先”、“一来”的意思。也可以表示“一旦”或“一…就…”的含义。
explanation_english: Indicates the occurrence or order of things, meaning 'firstly', 'to begin with', 'once'. It can also imply 'as soon as' or 'once...then...'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一嚟到步就打電話俾我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 lai4 dou3 bou6 zau6 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一到埗就打电话给我吧。
examples.english_sentence: Call me as soon as you arrive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一嚟就話我錯，咁唔公平嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 lai4 zau6 waa6 ngo5 co3, gam3 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一开始就说我错，这样不公平吧？
examples.english_sentence: You said I was wrong from the start, isn't that unfair?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一嚟佢就問我攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 lai4 keoi5 zau6 man6 ngo5 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一来他就向我要钱。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he arrived, he asked me for money.

mandarin_meaning: 一块块; 一团团; 形容物体呈块状
english_meaning: In lumps; lumpy; in chunks; describing something being in multiple pieces that are not smooth or refined.
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体呈现不规则的块状形态。可以指具体的食物或物品，也可以形容抽象的事物给人以块状的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes something that is in an irregular, lumpy form. Can refer to concrete food or objects, or abstract things that give a chunky feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲薯蓉整到一嚿嚿，好核突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu4 jung4 zing2 dou3 jat1 gau6 gau6, hou2 wat6 dat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 土豆泥做得一块块的，好难看。
examples.english_sentence: The mashed potatoes are lumpy, it looks disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲肌肉操到一嚿嚿，好鬼大隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gei1 juk6 cou1 dou3 jat1 gau6 gau6, hou2 gwai2 daai6 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的肌肉练得一块块的，好壮。
examples.english_sentence: His muscles are built into chunks, he's very muscular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲油炸鬼擺咗喺度好耐，淋曬一嚿嚿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jau4 zaa3 gwai2 baai2 zo2 hai2 dou6 hou2 noi6, lam4 saai3 jat1 gau6 gau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些油条放了很久，软趴趴的一块一块的。
examples.english_sentence: Those fried dough sticks have been sitting there for a long time, they're all soggy and in chunks.

mandarin_meaning: 木头; 笨拙; 迟钝
english_meaning: A block of wood; wooden; blockhead; slow-witted; dense
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“一块木头”。比喻某人反应迟钝，不灵活，像木头一样。
explanation_english: Literally means "a block of wood". Figuratively refers to someone who is slow-witted, inflexible, or unresponsive, like a block of wood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解咁一嚿木㗎？講咗咁多次都唔明！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 jat1 gau6 muk6 gaa3? gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨？ 说了这么多次都不明白！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so dense? I've told you so many times and you still don't understand!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢个人好一嚿木，唔识变通嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 jat1 gau6 muk6, m4 sik1 bin3 tung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很木讷，不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very wooden person, he doesn't know how to be flexible.

english_meaning: One hundred dollars (Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: “嚿”是量词，相当于“块”。“水”在这里代指钱，因为以前钞票印刷容易弄湿，所以用“水”来代替钱。
explanation_english: "一嚿水" literally translates to "one lump of water". "嚿 (gau6)" is a measure word, similar to "piece" or "lump". "水 (seoi2)" refers to money, likely originating from the fact that paper money could easily get wet. It specifically refers to one hundred Hong Kong dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爭佢一嚿水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zaang1 keoi5 jat1 gau6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我欠他一百块。
examples.english_sentence: I owe him one hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫賣幾錢啊？一嚿水唔使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 maai6 gei2 cin2 aa3? jat1 gau6 seoi2 m4 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服卖多少钱？不用一百块。
examples.english_sentence: How much does this shirt cost? It's less than one hundred dollars.

english_meaning: A cloud; clueless, dazed, confused, not paying attention.
explanation_mandarin: 原指天空中一团云。 比喻人思绪不清晰、反应迟钝、或者是不明白状况。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a cloud in the sky. Figuratively, it describes someone who is clueless, dazed, confused, or not paying attention; someone whose mind is "in the clouds."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先同佢講嘢，佢好似一嚿雲咁，完全唔知我講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5, keoi5 hou2 ci5 jat1 gau6 wan4 gam2, wun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 ngo5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才和他说事情，他好像一团雾一样，完全不知道我在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: I was just talking to him, and he seemed completely clueless, like a cloud, not understanding a word I was saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日一嚿雲咁啦，做嘢醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 jat1 gau6 wan4 gam2 laa1, zou6 je5 sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是迷迷糊糊的，工作的时候要机灵点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so dazed all the time, be more alert when you work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽書聽到一嚿雲咁，乜都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 syu1 teng1 dou3 jat1 gau6 wan4 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听课听得一头雾水，什么都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: He was so confused during the lecture, he understood nothing.

english_meaning: Idiot, fool, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 形容人笨拙，反应迟钝，像一团饭一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being clumsy, slow-witted, and lacking intelligence, like a lump of rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係一嚿飯嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 jat1 gau6 faan6 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这都不会，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this? You're really an idiot!

english_meaning: one thing, the same thing, one and the same thing, a matter, an affair
explanation_mandarin: 表示是同一件事或性质相同。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is the same thing or of the same nature. Can also refer to a matter or affair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講就一回事，做又係另一回事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zau6 jat1 wui4 si6, zou6 jau6 hai6 ling6 jat1 wui4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说是一回事，做又是另一回事。
examples.english_sentence: Talking is one thing, but doing is another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋講緊嘅根本唔係一回事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gong2 gan2 ge3 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 jat1 wui4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们说的根本不是一回事。
examples.english_sentence: What we're talking about are not the same thing at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估簡單到好似飲啖水咁，根本就唔係一回事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 gaan2 daan1 dou3 hou2 ci5 jam2 daam6 seoi2 gam3, gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 hai6 jat1 wui4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为简单得像喝口水一样，根本就不是一回事。
examples.english_sentence: You think it's as simple as taking a sip of water, it's not the same thing at all.

mandarin_meaning: 一国两制 (yī guó liǎng zhì)
english_meaning: One Country, Two Systems
explanation_mandarin: 中华人民共和国针对香港、澳门提出的政治制度安排，即在一个中国的前提下，香港和澳门可以保持原有的社会制度和经济制度。
explanation_english: A political arrangement proposed by the People's Republic of China for Hong Kong and Macau, allowing them to maintain their existing social and economic systems under the premise of one country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一國兩制喺香港實行咗咁多年，好多嘢都變咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 gwok3 loeng5 zai3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sat6 hang4 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 bin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一国两制在香港实行了这么多年，很多东西都变了。
examples.english_sentence: One Country, Two Systems has been implemented in Hong Kong for so many years, and many things have changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋討論緊一國兩制嘅未來發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 to2 leon6 gan2 jat1 gwok3 loeng5 zai3 ge3 mei6 loi4 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在讨论一国两制的未来发展。
examples.english_sentence: They are discussing the future development of One Country, Two Systems.

english_meaning: Co-location Arrangement (where Mainland and Hong Kong laws are enforced in different zones within the same location)
explanation_mandarin: 指在中国大陆的口岸或香港的口岸，同时设立香港和大陆的边检站，对往来两地的旅客进行出入境检查。
explanation_english: Refers to a cross-border arrangement where both Hong Kong and Mainland Chinese immigration and customs controls are implemented within the same geographical location (either in Mainland China or Hong Kong). This usually involves designated zones where respective laws and regulations apply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府堅持要喺香港實施一地兩檢，引嚟唔少爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gin1 ci4 jiu3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sat6 si1 jat1 dei6 loeng5 gim2, jan5 lai4 m4 siu2 zaang1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府坚持要在香港实行一地两检，引起了不少争议。
examples.english_sentence: The government insisted on implementing the co-location arrangement in Hong Kong, which has caused considerable controversy.

english_meaning: A complete mess; a scene of total devastation; shattered pieces everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容场面混乱不堪，像满地都是碎眼镜片一样。
explanation_english: Describes a scene of utter chaos and mess, as if the ground is covered in shattered pieces of eyeglasses. It's often used metaphorically to depict a situation that has gone completely wrong or is in a state of total disarray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司畀佢搞到一地眼鏡碎，唔知點收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou3 jat1 dei6 ngaan5 geng3 seoi3, m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司被他搞得一片狼藉，不知道怎么收场。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up the company so badly that it's a complete mess. I don't know how to clean it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢哋離婚之後，成個屋企都好似一地眼鏡碎咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 dei6 lei4 fan1 zi1 hau6, sing4 go3 uk1 kei2 dou1 hou2 ci5 jat1 dei6 ngaan5 geng3 seoi3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他们离婚之后，整个家都好像一片狼藉一样。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since they got divorced, the whole family seems to be in a state of complete disarray.

english_meaning: Everywhere; all over the place; a mess
explanation_mandarin: 形容某个东西数量很多，遍布于地面各处。通常带有凌乱、散乱的含义。
explanation_english: Describes something that is present in large quantities and scattered all over the ground. Usually implies a messy or scattered situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌爛咗個西瓜，一地都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 laan6 zo2 go3 sai1 gwaa1, jat1 dei6 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 西瓜摔烂了，地上到处都是。
examples.english_sentence: The watermelon broke, and it's all over the place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開完party，一地都係垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 jyun4 party, jat1 dei6 dou1 hai6 laap6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开完派对，地上到处都是垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: After the party, there's trash all over the place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊到一地都係眼淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 dou3 jat1 dei6 dou1 hai6 ngaan5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她哭得满地都是眼泪。
examples.english_sentence: She cried so much there were tears all over the floor.

synonyms: 周圍都係 (zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6)

english_meaning: A lump of mud; a clueless person; someone easily manipulated
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“一团泥”。引申义形容一个人愚笨、反应迟钝，容易被骗或被操控。
explanation_english: Literally means 'a lump of mud.' Figuratively, it describes someone who is clueless, slow to react, easily deceived, or easily manipulated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，真係一坺泥咁，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, zan1 hai6 jat1 fat6 nai4 gam3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么笨，简直就是一团泥，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he's really like a lump of mud, doesn't understand anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易信人哋啦，唔好俾人當你係一坺泥咁樣玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 jan4 dei6 laa1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 dong3 nei5 hai6 jat1 fat6 nai4 gam3 joeng2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易相信别人了，不要被人当你是一团泥一样玩弄。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, don't let them treat you like a lump of mud and manipulate you.

english_meaning: A game/match/show/performance; a bout; a period of time; a round; a burst; a whole lot; a spree; a session; in vain; all for nothing; a scene (e.g. of a drama)
explanation_mandarin: 量词，用于文娱活动、体育比赛等。名词，表示一段时间或一段经历，也指白费力气。
explanation_english: Measure word, used for entertainment activities, sports games, etc. Noun, indicating a period of time or an experience. Can also mean in vain or all for nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋睇咗一場戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tai2 zo2 jat1 coeng4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们看了一场电影。
examples.english_sentence: We watched a movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗌咗一場大交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aai3 zo2 jat1 coeng4 daai6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵了一架。
examples.english_sentence: They had a big fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住會贏，點知到頭嚟都係一場空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 wui5 wing4, dim2 zi1 dou3 tau4 lai4 dou1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为会赢，没想到到头来都是一场空。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I would win, but in the end it was all for nothing.

english_meaning: Since we're here, Now that we've come all this way
explanation_mandarin: 表示既然已经到达了某个地方，就应该做些什么或者采取某种行动。
explanation_english: Indicates that since we have already arrived somewhere, we should do something or take some action. It implies making the most of the opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一場嚟到，不如入去飲杯嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 coeng4 lai4 dou3, bat1 jyu4 jap6 heoi3 yam2 bui1 ye5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然来了，不如进去喝一杯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since we're here, why don't we go in and have a drink?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一場嚟到主題樂園，玩埋呢個過山車先走啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 coeng4 lai4 dou3 zyu2 tai4 lok6 jyun4, waan2 maai4 ni1 go3 gwo3 saan1 ce1 sin1 zau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然来了主题乐园，玩完这个过山车再走吧！
examples.english_sentence: Now that we've come all the way to the theme park, let's ride this roller coaster before we leave!

english_meaning: All in vain; come to nothing; all for naught
explanation_mandarin: 形容最终什么也没得到，一切努力都白费了。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where all efforts are wasted and nothing is gained in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁多年嘅感情，點知到最後都係一場空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 gam2 cing4, dim2 zi1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么多年的感情，没想到最后还是竹篮打水一场空。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship of so many years, who knew it would all come to nothing in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為今次一定成功，點知都係一場空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 sing4 gung1, dim2 zi1 dou1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这次一定成功，没想到还是竹篮打水一场空。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I would definitely succeed this time, but it all came to nothing.

english_meaning: together; a piece; a lump; a chunk
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词, 量词, 名词
explanation_mandarin: 1. (副词) 一起，一同。 2. (量词) 用于块状物。3. (名词) 块状物。
explanation_english: 1. (adverb) together, at the same time. 2. (measure word) used for things in pieces or lumps. 3. (noun) a piece, a lump, a chunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一塊去睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 faai3 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the movies together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢舊石頭好大塊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gau6 sek6 tau4 hou2 daai6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头很大。
examples.english_sentence: This stone is very large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 切一塊蛋糕俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cit3 jat1 faai3 daan6 gou1 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 切一块蛋糕给你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll cut a piece of cake for you.

english_meaning: a complete mess; in a terrible state; utterly ruined
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常糟糕、混乱、无法收拾的局面或状态。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or state that is extremely bad, chaotic, and beyond repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考到一塌糊塗，咩都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dou3 jat1 taap3 wu4 tou4, me1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得一塌糊涂，什么都不会。
examples.english_sentence: He did terribly on this exam, he doesn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋執到一塌糊塗，都冇位企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zap1 dou3 jat1 taap3 wu4 tou4, dou1 mou5 wai2 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子收拾得一塌糊涂，都没地方站了。
examples.english_sentence: This house is such a mess; there's no place to stand.

english_meaning: spotless, immaculate, pristine
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常干净，没有一点灰尘或污垢。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely clean and free from any dust or dirt. Can also be used figuratively to describe someone with pure intentions or a clean record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋執到一塵不染，好犀利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 zap1 dou3 jat1 can4 bat1 jim5, hou2 sai1 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她把房子收拾得一尘不染，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: She cleaned her house until it was spotless, amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅名譽一塵不染，好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ming4 jyu6 jat1 can4 bat1 jim5, hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名誉一尘不染，很难得。
examples.english_sentence: His reputation is untainted, which is rare.

synonyms: 乾乾淨淨 (gon1 gon1 ging6 ging6)

english_meaning: overnight, in the space of one night
explanation_mandarin: 表示在非常短的时间内发生巨大的变化或进展。
explanation_english: Refers to a massive change or progress happening within a very short time, essentially overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一夜之間就變咗百萬富翁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 zau6 bin3 zo2 baak3 maan6 fu3 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一夜之间就变成了百万富翁。
examples.english_sentence: He became a millionaire overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一夜之間傳遍成個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 bin3 sing4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一夜之间传遍了整个城市。
examples.english_sentence: This incident spread throughout the whole city overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市一夜之間大跌，好多人都損失慘重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 daai6 dit3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 syun2 sat1 caam2 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市一夜之间大跌，很多人都损失惨重。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed overnight, and many people suffered heavy losses.

jyutping: jat1 je6 fu1 cai1 baak3 ji6 man1
mandarin_meaning: 短暂的夫妻情分只值很少的钱; 比喻关系短暂且利益驱动。
english_meaning: A night as husband and wife is only worth 120 dollars; implying a short-lived relationship motivated by money.
explanation_mandarin: 这句话形容关系非常短暂而且以利益为先。其中的“百二蚊”指很少的钱，说明这种关系非常廉价且短暂，完全是为了利益而存在。
explanation_english: This saying describes a very short-lived relationship motivated solely by financial gain.  "Baak3 ji6 man1" (120 dollars) represents a small amount of money, highlighting that the relationship is cheap, fleeting, and purely transactional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚只係為咗錢，真係一夜夫妻百二蚊囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 cin2, zan1 hai6 jat1 je6 fu1 cai1 baak3 ji6 man1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚只是为了钱，真是一夜夫妻百二蚊。
examples.english_sentence: They got married just for money; it's truly a husband-and-wife relationship worth only 120 dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快信佢，佢咁樣對你好可能係有目的㗎，一夜夫妻百二蚊啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 gam3 joeng2 deoi3 nei5 hou2 ho2 nang4 hai6 jau5 muk6 dik1 gaa3, jat1 je6 fu1 cai1 baak3 ji6 man1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快相信他，他这样对你好可能有目的的，可能只是短暂的利益关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him so quickly, he might be nice to you for a reason, it might just be a short-term transactional relationship.

jyutping: jat1 je6 fu1 cai1 baak3 je6 yan1
english_meaning: Even a one-night stand as husband and wife creates a hundred nights of favor/kindness; indicating that even a brief relationship should be treated with respect and consideration.
explanation_mandarin: 形容即使是短暂的夫妻关系，也应该珍惜并报答对方的恩情。即使只有一夜夫妻情分，也应该记住对方的好，并以百倍的恩情回报。
explanation_english: This idiom describes that even a very short marital relationship should be cherished and reciprocated with kindness. It emphasizes the importance of remembering and appreciating even a brief connection, and repaying it with significant kindness and consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋離婚咗好耐，但係一夜夫妻百夜恩，佢重係會幫佢前妻嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 lei4 fan1 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 jat1 je6 fu1 cai1 baak3 je6 yan1, keoi5 zung6 hai6 wui5 bong1 keoi5 cin4 cai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们离婚很久了，但是一日夫妻百日恩，他还是会帮助他的前妻的。
examples.english_sentence: Although they divorced a long time ago, even a one-night stand as husband and wife creates a hundred nights of favor, so he still helps his ex-wife.

english_meaning: one-night stand
explanation_mandarin: 指只发生一次性关系的性行为。
explanation_english: A sexual encounter with someone with whom one has no intention of having a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺酒吧識，之後就發生咗一夜情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 jau5 baa1 sik1, ji4 hau6 zau6 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 je6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在酒吧认识，之后就发生了一夜情。
examples.english_sentence: They met at a bar, and then had a one-night stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔贊成一夜情，覺得太過隨便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zaan3 sing4 jat1 je6 ching4, gok3 dak1 taai3 gwo3 ceoi4 bin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不赞成一夜情，觉得太随便。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't approve of one-night stands, she thinks it's too casual.

mandarin_meaning: 全部完蛋了；彻底完蛋了
english_meaning: Completely finished; all gone; everything's ruined; all is lost.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情完全失败，没有任何希望；也可以指东西被用光或吃光。
explanation_english: Expresses a situation where everything is completely finished, with no hope left. It can also mean that something is completely used up or eaten up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試衰咗，一日光晒，冇書讀咯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 seoi1 zo2, jat1 tin1 gwong1 saai3, mou5 syu1 duk6 lok3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考砸了，全完了，没书读了！
examples.english_sentence: This time I failed the exam, it's all over, I won't be able to study anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢一日光晒，下個月點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 jat1 tin1 gwong1 saai3, haa6 go3 jyut6 dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱全部用光了，下个月怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: The money is all gone, what will we do next month?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成班人食飯，啲嘢一日光晒，好快就無晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 baan1 jan4 sik6 faan6, di1 je5 jat1 tin1 gwong1 saai3, hou2 faai3 zau6 mou5 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群人吃饭，东西很快就吃光了，很快就没了。
examples.english_sentence: A group of people are eating, the food is quickly being finished, it will be gone soon.

mandarin_meaning: 全部都结束了；一下子全都完蛋了
english_meaning: Everything is finished; all is lost; all gone
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情完全结束，毫无希望，或者资源、机会等全部耗尽。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything is finished, there is no hope left, or resources/opportunities are completely exhausted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕咗咁多錢，一日都光晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, jat1 tin1 dou1 gwong1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司亏损了这么多钱，一下子就完蛋了。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost so much money, it's all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲錢一日都光晒，唔夠俾租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cin2 jat1 tin1 dou1 gwong1 saai3, m4 gau3 bei2 zu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的钱一下子都花光了，不够付房租。
examples.english_sentence: All my money is gone, not enough to pay the rent.

english_meaning: One man guarding the pass is enough to keep ten thousand men from getting through; impassable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容地势险要，易守难攻。也比喻一个人把关，就能阻挡住许多人。
explanation_english: Describes a strategically important and easily defended location that is difficult to attack. Also used as a metaphor to describe someone who, through their actions, can block or stop many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度地勢險要，真係一夫當關，萬夫莫開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 dei6 sai3 him2 jiu3, zan1 hai6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里的地势险要，真可谓一夫当关，万夫莫开。
examples.english_sentence: The terrain there is treacherous; it's truly a case of one man guarding the pass, impenetrable by ten thousand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人喺度睇住條橋，真係一夫當關噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 dou6 tai2 zyu6 tiu4 kiu4, zan1 hai6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在那里看着桥，真像一夫当关一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's guarding the bridge alone, just like one man guarding the pass.

jyutping: jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 dik6
english_meaning: One man guarding the pass, ten thousand cannot break through; describing an extremely strategic and easily defended position.
explanation_mandarin: 形容地势险要，易守难攻。也形容一个人非常勇敢，有以一当万的魄力。
explanation_english: Describes a strategic and easily defended position. It can also describe a person who is extremely brave and has the power to defeat many enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度一夫當關，萬夫莫敵，敵人想攻入嚟都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 dik6, dik6 jan4 soeng2 gung1 jap6 lai4 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里一夫当关，万夫莫开，敌人想攻进来都很困难。
examples.english_sentence: That place is a strategic pass, virtually impregnable, it's very difficult for the enemy to invade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好勇猛，簡直係一夫當關，萬夫莫敵噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jung5 maang5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 dik6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很勇敢，简直是一夫当关，万夫莫开一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is really brave, almost like one man guarding the pass, an unstoppable force.

jyutping: jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 hoi1
english_meaning: One man guarding the pass, ten thousand cannot get through; Describes an extremely strong and strategic defense.
explanation_mandarin: 形容地势险要，易守难攻。也形容一人抵挡众人，形势非常有利。
explanation_english: Describes a strategic position that is easy to defend but difficult to attack. It also describes a situation where one person can hold off a large number of opponents, highlighting a significant advantage in strength or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅地形真係一夫當關，萬夫莫開，敵人好難攻入嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 dei6 ying4 zan1 hai6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 hoi1, dik6 yan4 hou2 naan4 gung1 yap6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的地形真是一夫当关，万夫莫开，敌人很难攻进来。
examples.english_sentence: The terrain here is truly a case of 'one man guarding the pass, ten thousand cannot get through,' it will be very difficult for the enemy to invade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人守住條路，真係一夫當關，萬夫莫開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 yan4 sau2 zyu6 tiu4 lou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 fu1 dong1 gwaan1, maan6 fu1 mok6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人守住这条路，真是一夫当关，万夫莫开。
examples.english_sentence: He's guarding this road by himself; it's truly a case of 'one man guarding the pass, ten thousand cannot get through.'

jyutping: jat1 sat1 zuk1 sing4 cin1 gu2 han6
mandarin_meaning: 一失足成千古恨 (yī shī zú chéng qiān gǔ hèn)
english_meaning: One wrong step leads to eternal regret; A single slip may cause a lasting sorrow.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一旦犯下错误，就可能造成长久的遗憾和无法弥补的损失。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where a single mistake or wrong decision can lead to lasting regret and irreparable consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家做嘅嘢咁危險，真係一失足成千古恨㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 ge3 je5 gam3 ngai4 him2, zan1 hai6 jat1 sat1 zuk1 sing4 cin1 gu2 han6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在做的事情这么危险，真是一失足成千古恨啊。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is so dangerous; it really is a case of one wrong step leading to eternal regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭錢呢啲嘢，好易一失足成千古恨，所以千祈唔好掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 cin2 ni1 di1 je5, hou2 ji6 jat1 sat1 zuk1 sing4 cin1 gu2 han6, so2 ji5 cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赌博这种东西，很容易一失足成千古恨，所以千万不要碰。
examples.english_sentence: Gambling is the kind of thing where it's easy to take one wrong step and regret it forever, so you absolutely mustn't touch it.

english_meaning: as before, as usual, just like, the same as
explanation_mandarin: 表示和以前一样，或者像某种情况一样。
explanation_english: Indicates something is the same as before or like a certain situation.  It can function to compare something to something else, or to indicate consistency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現一如以往咁出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 jat1 jyu4 ji5 wong5 gam3 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现和以往一样出色。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is as outstanding as it always has been.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅發展一如我所料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 faat3 zin2 jat1 jyu4 ngo5 so2 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情的发展就像我预料的一样。
examples.english_sentence: The development of the matter is just as I expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日嘅天氣一如今日咁熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hei3 jat1 jyu4 gam1 jat6 gam3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的天气和今天一样热。
examples.english_sentence: The weather tomorrow will be as hot as today.

english_meaning: as before, as usual, as always
explanation_mandarin: 和以前一样，没有改变。
explanation_english: The same as before; unchanged from the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年嘅成績一如以往咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 ge3 sing1 zik1 jat1 jyu4 ji5 wong5 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年的成绩一如既往地好。
examples.english_sentence: His grades this year are as good as always.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食一如以往咁好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 jat1 jyu4 ji5 wong5 gam3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一如既往地好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is as delicious as always.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日嘅天氣預測都係一如以往咁熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hei3 jyu6 caak1 dou1 hai6 jat1 jyu4 ji5 wong5 gam3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的天气预报还是一如既往地热。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow's weather forecast is as hot as always.

english_meaning: as expected; just as one predicted
explanation_mandarin: 事情的发展正如之前所预料的那样。形容事情的结果不出人意料。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation or outcome that occurs exactly as one anticipated or predicted. It expresses a lack of surprise or unexpectedness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，佢肥佬一如所料啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, keoi5 fei4 lou2 jat1 jyu4 so2 liu6 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: The exam was so difficult, he failed as expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市大跌，一如所料，好多人輸錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 daai6 dit3, jat1 jyu4 so2 liu6, hou2 do1 jan4 syu1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市大跌，正如所料，很多人赔钱了。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed, as expected, and many people lost money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會落雨，天文台都咁講，一如所料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, tin1 man4 toi4 dou1 gam2 gong2, jat1 jyu4 so2 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会下雨，天文台都这么说，正如所料。
examples.english_sentence: It will rain tomorrow, the observatory says so, as expected.

english_meaning: as before, as always, just as in the past
explanation_mandarin: 指情况仍旧和过去一样，没有变化。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation remains the same as in the past, without any changes. Describes a continuation of a previous state or behavior.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一如既往地努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: He studies diligently as always.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅服務一如既往咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 jat1 jyu4 gei3 wong5 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务一如既往地好。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is as good as always.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會一如既往咁支持你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jat1 jyu4 gei3 wong5 gam3 zi1 chi4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会一如既往地支持你。
examples.english_sentence: We will support you as always.

english_meaning: as before; just as in the past; as always
explanation_mandarin: 指完全和过去一样，没有改变。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or action that remains unchanged and continues as it has in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後，一如既往咁努力工作。

examples.english_sentence: After graduation, he continued to work hard as always.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然經濟唔好，但係佢一如既往咁支持本地創作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 jyu4 gei3 wong5 gam2 zi1 chi4 bun2 dei6 chong3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然经济不好，但是他一如既往地支持本地创作。
examples.english_sentence: Although the economy is bad, he continues to support local creations as always.

english_meaning: Top female, leading lady, number one female
explanation_mandarin: 指某个领域中最顶尖、最受欢迎或最有影响力的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to the top, most popular, or most influential female in a particular field, often in entertainment or business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電視台係當之無愧嘅一姐。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一直都想做公司的领头人（女性）。
examples.english_sentence: She has always wanted to be the leading lady in the company.

jyutping: jat1 zi2 co3, mun5 pun4 gaai1 lok6 sok3
english_meaning: One wrong move, and the whole game is lost.
explanation_mandarin: 形容下棋时一步走错，导致整个棋局失败。比喻一件事情中一个小小的失误，可能会导致全局性的失败，造成无法挽回的局面。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where a single wrong move in a game of chess leads to the loss of the entire game. It is used metaphorically to illustrate how a small mistake in a larger situation can have catastrophic consequences and lead to irreversible failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅投資好關鍵，如果一子錯，滿盤皆落索㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 tau4 zi1 hou2 gwaan1 gin6, jyu4 gwo2 jat1 zi2 co3, mun5 pun4 gaai1 lok6 sok3 gaa3!

examples.english_sentence: This investment is crucial. If we make one wrong move, we'll lose everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要小心啲，唔好以為淨係小事，一子錯，滿盤皆落索，到時後悔都冇用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zing6 hai6 siu2 si6, jat1 zi2 co3, mun5 pun4 gaai1 lok6 sok3, dou3 si4 hau6 fui3 dou1 mou5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作要小心一点，不要以为只是小事，一步走错，满盘皆输，到时候后悔也没用。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you work; don't think it's just a small thing. One wrong move, and the whole game is lost. It'll be useless to regret it then.

english_meaning: not to mention a single word; to avoid mentioning something completely
explanation_mandarin: 指完全不提及某事。
explanation_english: Refers to completely avoiding mentioning something; to make no mention of something at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對件事一字不提，好似冇發生過咁。
