examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事只字不提，好像没发生过一样。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't mention the matter at all, as if it never happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆對我哋嘅要求一字不提，真係唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jiu1 kau4 jat1 zi6 bat1 tai4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.

examples.english_sentence: The boss didn't mention our requirements at all, I really don't know what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋離婚嘅原因，佢哋一字不提，可能唔想公開啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们离婚的原因，他们只字不提，可能不想公开吧。
examples.english_sentence: They don't mention the reason for their divorce at all, probably because they don't want to make it public.

english_meaning: not missing a single word; verbatim
explanation_mandarin: 指完整地、毫不遗漏地记下或说出所有内容，一个字也不遗漏。
explanation_english: Means to record or say everything completely and without omission, not missing a single word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將老細講嘅嘢一字不漏咁記低咗。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把老板说的话一个字不漏地记下来了。
examples.english_sentence: He recorded everything the boss said verbatim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽佢講嗰個故仔聽到一字不漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 keoi5 gong2 go2 go3 gu3 zai2 teng1 dou3 jat1 zi6 bat1 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听他讲的那个故事听得一个字也不漏。
examples.english_sentence: I listened to the story he told without missing a single word.

english_meaning: Extremely simple, so easy that even a single character can explain it.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常简单，容易理解，甚至只需要一个字就能表达清楚。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely simple and easy to understand, to the point where a single character is sufficient to explain it. The phrase implies that the concept is self-explanatory and requires no further elaboration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數一字咁淺，你都唔識計？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 jat1 zi6 gam3 cin2, nei5 dou1 m4 sik1 gai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题非常简单，你都不会算？
examples.english_sentence: This question is so simple, and you still don't know how to solve it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢一字咁淺，明眼人都睇得出佢講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jat1 zi6 gam3 cin2, ming4 ngaan5 jan4 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6.

examples.english_sentence: What he said was so obvious, anyone could tell he was lying.

english_meaning: Polysemy (one word, multiple meanings)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个字有多种不同的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a single word having multiple different meanings.

examples.mandarin_sentence: “打”这个字就是一个很好的例子，证明了一字多义。
examples.english_sentence: The word "daa2" (hit/make/play) is a good example of polysemy.

english_meaning: to line up in a row, arranged in a single line

explanation_english: Describes things or people lined up in a straight line.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 巴士一字排开，很壮观啊。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一字排开，等着长官来检阅。
examples.english_sentence: They lined up in a row, waiting for the officer to inspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 檯面上面擺咗一字排開嘅獎盃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi2 min6 soeng6 min6 baai2 zo2 jat1 zi6 paai4 hoi1 ge3 zoeng2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌面上摆了一字排开的奖杯。
examples.english_sentence: There's a row of trophies displayed on the table.

english_meaning: unibrow, monobrow
explanation_mandarin: 指两道眉毛连在一起，形成一条线的眉毛。
explanation_english: Refers to eyebrows that grow together, forming a single line across the forehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條一字眉好有特色㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jat1 zi6 mei4 hou2 jau5 te6 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的连心眉很有特色。

examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I also had a faint unibrow.

english_meaning: Straight shoulder; square shoulder; shoulders that are level and straight; responsibility solely on one person.

explanation_english: Literally refers to straight shoulders. Figuratively, it means someone bears all the responsibility alone, without anyone else to share the burden. It can also describe someone having a physical feature of straight, level shoulders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成件事都係佢一字膊扛起，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 gin6 si6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 jat1 zi6 bok3 kong1 hei2, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整件事都是他一个人扛起来的，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He is carrying the whole thing on his shoulders alone; it's really tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生得一副一字膊，着衫好好睇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长了一副平肩，穿衣服很好看。
examples.english_sentence: He has straight shoulders, he looks good in clothes.

english_meaning: dead end, blind alley, corner
explanation_mandarin: 指没有出路的角落或情况，比喻陷入困境。
explanation_english: Refers to a corner or situation with no way out; figuratively, a dead end, a blind alley, or being stuck in a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅計劃行到一字角，冇得再繼續落去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 haang4 dou3 jat1 zi6 gok3, mou5 dak1 zoi3 gai3 zuk6 lok6 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划走到了死胡同，没法再继续下去了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan has reached a dead end and we can't continue anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好鑽入一字角，到時就冇路行㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: chin1 kai4 m4 hou2 jyun3 jap6 jat1 zi6 gok3, dou3 si4 zau6 mou5 lou6 haang4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要钻入死胡同，到时候就没路可走了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get yourself into a dead end, otherwise you won't have anywhere to go.

english_meaning: splits (gymnastics, dance)
explanation_mandarin: 一种劈腿的姿势，两腿成一直线，身体下降到地面。常见于舞蹈、体操等运动中。
explanation_english: A split, a physical position in which the legs are extended in opposite directions, forming a straight line (180 degrees) and lowered to the ground. Commonly seen in dance, gymnastics, and other sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好犀利，可以隨時隨地做一字馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sai1 lei6, ho2 ji5 ceoi4 si4 ceoi4 dei6 zou6 jat1 zi6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很厉害，可以随时随地做一字劈腿。
examples.english_sentence: She's very good; she can do the splits anytime, anywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學跳舞一定要練好一字馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 tiu3 mou5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lin6 hou2 jat1 zi6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学跳舞一定要练好一字劈腿。
examples.english_sentence: You must practice the splits well to learn dancing.

english_meaning: a small official position; a minor post
explanation_mandarin: 指很小的官职或职位，不值得一提。
explanation_english: Refers to a small or insignificant official position, not worth mentioning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵到份一官半職，都好威咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 dou2 fan6 jat1 gun1 bun3 zik1, dou1 hou2 wai1 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找到一份小官，就显得很威风的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He found a minor official position and acts like he is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗一官半職，爭崩頭都抵唔返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jat1 gun1 bun3 zik1, zaang1 bang1 tau4 dou1 dai2 m4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了一个小小官职，争得头破血流也不值得。
examples.english_sentence: It's not worth fighting to the death for a small official position.

english_meaning: certainly, definitely, surely; fixed, definite; a certain amount
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定、确定；表示固定、确定的；表示某种程度或数量。
explanation_english: Expresses certainty or definiteness; indicates something fixed or definite; indicates a certain degree or amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一定會幫你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一定会帮你的。
examples.english_sentence: I will definitely help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係一定唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jat1 ding6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系一定不错。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship must be good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度一定要預約先有位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jyu6 joek3 sin1 jau5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里一定要预约才有座位。
examples.english_sentence: You definitely need to make a reservation to get a seat here.

english_meaning: Head of the household; patriarch
explanation_mandarin: 指一个家庭中拥有主要决策权和责任的人，通常是父亲或长辈。
explanation_english: Refers to the person who holds the primary decision-making power and responsibility in a family, usually the father or a senior member.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個屋企嘅一家之主，咩都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 uk1 kei2 ge3 jat1 gaa1 zi1 zyu2, me1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个家的家长，什么都他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's the head of this household, he makes all the decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從阿爸走咗之後，阿哥就變成咗一家之主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 aa3 baa1 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, aa3 go1 zau6 bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 gaa1 zi1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从爸爸去世后，哥哥就变成了家里的顶梁柱。
examples.english_sentence: Since Dad passed away, my older brother has become the head of the household.

jyutping: jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3
mandarin_meaning: 双方都有好处；彼此有利
english_meaning: It's beneficial for both parties; a win-win situation
explanation_mandarin: 指做某件事能让双方都得到好处，达到双赢的效果。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where both parties involved benefit from a particular action or outcome, creating a win-win situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個合作計劃一家便宜兩家着，對大家都好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 jok3 gai3 waak6 jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3, deoi3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个合作计划对双方都有好处，对大家都好。
examples.english_sentence: This collaboration plan is beneficial for both parties, it's good for everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減價之後，生意好咗，一家便宜兩家着啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 gaa3 zi1 hau6, saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2, jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 降价之后，生意好起来了，双方都有好处。
examples.english_sentence: After the price reduction, the business improved, it's a win-win for everyone.

jyutping: jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3
mandarin_meaning: 两全其美; 互惠互利
english_meaning: A win-win situation; everyone benefits; one party benefits, both parties gain an advantage.
explanation_mandarin: 指一方做出让步或提供便利，使得双方都获得好处，达到双赢的局面。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where one party makes a concession or provides convenience, resulting in benefits for both parties and achieving a win-win outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次你讓一步，咁咪一家便宜兩家着數囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nei5 joeng6 jat1 bou6, gam2 mai1 jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次你让一步，这样不就是两全其美了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you concede a little this time, isn't that a win-win situation?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋合作搞呢個project，一家便宜兩家着數，大家都開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hap6 zok3 gaau2 ni1 go3 project, jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们合作搞这个项目，互惠互利，大家都开心。
examples.english_sentence: We'll collaborate on this project, it's a win-win situation, everyone will be happy.

jyutping: jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek6
english_meaning: Both parties benefit; a win-win situation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示双方都从中得到好处，达到双赢的局面。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where both parties involved benefit, resulting in a win-win scenario.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次合作，對我哋嚟講都算係一家便宜兩家著啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 hap6 jok6, deoi3 ngo5 dei6 lai4 gong2 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次合作，对我们来说也算是两家都得到好处了。
examples.english_sentence: This collaboration can be considered a win-win situation for both of us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果可以傾掂數，咁咪一家便宜兩家著囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 king1 dim6 sou3, gam2 mai1 jat1 gaa1 bin6 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果可以谈妥，那不就是两家都受益了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we can reach an agreement, then it's a win-win for both of us.

jyutping: jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3
english_meaning: A win-win situation; One party benefiting leads to both parties benefiting.
explanation_mandarin: 指一件事情，如果一方得到好处，那么另一方也会跟着得到好处，达到双赢的效果。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to a situation where one party's benefit also leads to the benefit of another party, creating a win-win outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋合作搞呢個project，一家便宜兩家著數，對大家都好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hap6 zok3 gaau2 ni1 go3 project, jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3, deoi3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们合作搞这个项目，两全其美，对大家都好。
examples.english_sentence: If we collaborate on this project, it's a win-win situation, it will be good for everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你幫我，就一家便宜兩家著數，我會記得你嘅人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 bong1 ngo5, zau6 jat1 gaa1 bin1 ji4 loeng5 gaa1 zoek3 sou3, ngo5 wui5 gei3 dak1 nei5 ge3 jan4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你帮我，就是两全其美，我会记得你的人情。
examples.english_sentence: If you help me, it's a win-win situation, and I'll remember your favor.

jyutping: jat1 gaa1 m4 zi1 jat1 gaa1 si6
mandarin_meaning: 家家有本难念的经 (jiājiā yǒu běn nán niàn de jīng)
english_meaning: Every family has its own problems / One family doesn't know the affairs of another.
explanation_mandarin: 指各家各户都有自己的难处，外人难以了解。强调家庭内部的复杂性和个体差异。
explanation_english: This idiom means that every family has its own problems and difficulties that are often unknown to outsiders. It highlights the complexity and individual differences within families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥成日以為我好得閒，但係一家唔知一家事，佢唔知我湊仔湊到冇停手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 sing4 jat6 ji5 wai4 ngo5 hou2 dak1 haan4, daan6 hai6 jat1 gaa1 m4 zi1 jat1 gaa1 si6, keoi5 m4 zi1 ngo5 cau3 zai2 cau3 dou3 mou5 ting4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥总是以为我很闲，但是家家有本难念的经，他不知道我带孩子忙得停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: My brother always thinks I have a lot of free time, but every family has its own problems, he doesn't know how busy I am taking care of the kids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便評論人哋嘅家庭，一家唔知一家事，你又點知人哋屋企發生咩事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 ping3 leon6 yan4 dei6 ge3 gaa1 ting4, jat1 gaa1 m4 zi1 jat1 gaa1 si6, nei5 jau6 dim2 zi1 yan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便评论别人的家庭，家家有本难念的经，你怎么知道他们家发生了什么事？
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually comment on other people's families, every family has its own problems, how do you know what's happening in their home?

english_meaning: family reunion, family gathering
explanation_mandarin: 指全家人聚集在一起。
explanation_english: Refers to the gathering of the entire family together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每年新年都一定會一家團聚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 jat1 ding6 wui5 jat1 gaa1 tyun4 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每年新年都一定会一家团圆。
examples.english_sentence: We definitely have a family reunion every New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 移民咗咁耐，今年終於可以一家團聚喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi4 man4 zo2 gam3 noi6, gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 jat1 gaa1 tyun4 zeoi6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 移民这么久了，今年终于可以一家团圆了！
examples.english_sentence: We've immigrated for so long, we can finally have a family reunion this year!

english_meaning: the whole family; the entire household
explanation_mandarin: 指整个家庭，包括大人和小孩。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire family, including adults and children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，一家大細都返嚟團年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 gaa1 daai6 sai3 dou1 faan1 lai4 tyun4 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，全家老小都回来团圆。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, the whole family comes back for the reunion dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一家大細移民咗去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gaa1 daai6 sai3 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 na4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家老小移民去了加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: Their entire family immigrated to Canada.

english_meaning: Solid, sturdy, firm, substantial, reliable
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体坚固，不易损坏；也形容人实在，可靠。
explanation_english: Describes something solid and durable, not easily damaged; also describes a person as reliable and dependable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張凳好一實，坐得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 dang3 hou2 jat1 sat6, co5 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张凳子很结实，坐得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This chair is very sturdy, it's comfortable to sit on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好一實，交俾佢做就放心喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jat1 sat6, gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6 zau6 fong3 sam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很实在可靠，交给他做就放心了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very reliable in his work, you can rest assured if you leave it to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樓起得好一實，唔怕地震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lau2 hei2 dak1 hou2 jat1 sat6, m4 paa3 dei6 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些楼房盖得很坚固，不怕地震。
examples.english_sentence: These buildings are built very solidly, they're not afraid of earthquakes.

jyutping: jat1 cyun3 gwong1 jam1 jat1 cyun3 gam1
english_meaning: Time is gold; every moment is precious.
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常宝贵，要珍惜时间。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the preciousness of time. It suggests that time is as valuable as gold and should be used wisely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好掛住打機喇，一寸光陰一寸金呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1 laa1, jat1 cyun3 gwong1 jam1 jat1 cyun3 gam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别光顾着玩游戏了，一寸光阴一寸金啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just keep playing games. Time is gold!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就嚟，一寸光陰一寸金，我哋要努力溫書啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zau6 lai4, jat1 cyun3 gwong1 jam1 jat1 cyun3 gam1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 wan1 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试就要来了，一寸光阴一寸金，我们要努力复习啊！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming up, time is gold, we need to study hard!

jyutping: jat1 zau6 jat1 ji6 zau6 ji6
english_meaning: What is one is one, what is two is two; To be precise, meticulous, and not ambiguous; To be strict in following the rules.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事非常认真，一丝不苟，条理清晰，不含糊。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very serious, meticulous, and clear in their work; not ambiguous or sloppy; precise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢一就一二就二，唔會馬馬虎虎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 zau6 jat1 ji6 zau6 ji6, m4 wui5 maa5 maa5 fu2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事一是一，二是二，不会马马虎虎。
examples.english_sentence: He does things strictly by the book, not sloppy at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一定要一就一二就二咁處理，唔可以有任何偏差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jat1 zau6 jat1 ji6 zau6 ji6 gam2 cyu2 lei5, m4 ho2 ji5 jau5 jam6 ho4 pin1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一定要一丝不苟地处理，不能有任何偏差。
examples.english_sentence: This matter must be handled with absolute precision, without any deviation.

jyutping: jat1 zau6 jat1, ji6 zau6 ji6
english_meaning: What's one is one, what's two is two; be precise and no nonsense; things should be clear and distinct.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事认真，一丝不苟，黑白分明，毫不含糊。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is serious and meticulous in doing things, clear-cut in distinguishing right from wrong, and not ambiguous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要一就一，二就二，唔可以求其。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 jat1 zau6 jat1, ji6 zau6 ji6, m4 ho2 ji5 kau4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要一是一，二是二，不可以随便。
examples.english_sentence: When doing things, you have to be precise; what's one is one, and what's two is two. You can't be careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格就係咁，一就一，二就二，唔鍾意轉彎抹角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 zau6 hai6 gam2, jat1 zau6 jat1, ji6 zau6 ji6, m4 zung1 ji3 zyun3 waan1 mut3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格就是这样，一是一，二是二，不喜欢拐弯抹角。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is like that; what's one is one, what's two is two. He doesn't like being indirect.

english_meaning: shallow understanding; superficial; not in-depth
explanation_mandarin: 比喻对事物的理解或认识非常肤浅，不够深入。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a superficial understanding or knowledge of something, not going deep enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢都係一尺水，冇乜真材實料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 dou1 hai6 jat1 cek3 seoi2, mou5 mat1 zan1 coi4 sat6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话都很肤浅，没什么真才实学。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is all superficial; he doesn't have much real ability or knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁一尺水啦，深入啲研究下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 cek3 seoi2 laa1, sam1 jap6 di1 jin4 gau3 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么肤浅，深入研究一下再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so superficial; study it in more depth first.

jyutping: jat1 saan1 waan4 jau5 jat1 saan1 gou1
english_meaning: There's always someone better; There's always a bigger fish.
explanation_mandarin: 形容没有最好，只有更好；比喻人外有人，天外有天，不可骄傲自满。
explanation_english: Describes that there is always someone better or something greater. Implies that one should not be complacent or arrogant because there will always be someone more skilled or capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁驕傲，一山還有一山高，叻嘅人多的是。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 giu1 ngou6, jat1 saan1 waan4 jau5 jat1 saan1 gou1, lek1 ge3 jan4 do1 dik1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么骄傲，强中自有强中手，厉害的人多的是。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant. There's always someone better, there are plenty of talented people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司算幾醒目，但係一山還有一山高，始終都仲有好多嘢要學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 syun3 gei2 sing2 muk6, daan6 hai6 jat1 saan1 waan4 jau5 jat1 saan1 gou1, ci2 chung1 dou1 jung4 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司算挺聪明的，但是强中自有强中手，始终还是有很多东西要学。
examples.english_sentence: He is considered quite clever in the company, but there's always someone better, and ultimately he still has a lot to learn.

english_meaning: scattered, intermittent, sporadic
explanation_mandarin: 形容东西或事情分散不集中，或时间间隔长而频率低。
explanation_english: Describes something scattered, dispersed, not concentrated, or occurring at long intervals with low frequency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅聯絡一岩一窟咁，好耐先見一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lyun4 lok6 jat1 ngaam4 jat1 fat1 gam2, hou2 noi6 sin1 gin3 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的联系零零星星的，很久才见一次面。
examples.english_sentence: Their contact is sporadic, they only see each other after a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鋪頭一岩一窟噉開，唔係好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pou1 tau3 jat1 ngaam4 jat1 fat1 gam2 hoi1, m4 hai6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店铺零零星星地开着，不是很多。
examples.english_sentence: The shops are scattered, there aren't many.

english_meaning: Hiding everywhere, constantly concealing oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容人害怕被人发现，到处躲藏，遮遮掩掩的样子。也指到处躲藏的地方。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is afraid of being discovered and is constantly hiding in various places, trying to conceal themselves. It can also refer to places where one hides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借咗人好多錢，依家一巖一窟咁，驚俾人追債。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 zo2 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2, ji1 gaa1 jat1 ngaam4 jat1 fat1 gam2, geng1 bei2 jan4 zeoi1 zaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借了别人很多钱，现在到处躲藏，害怕被人追债。
examples.english_sentence: He borrowed a lot of money from people and is now hiding everywhere, afraid of being chased for debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賊仔成日一巖一窟，匿埋喺啲後巷度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caak6 zai2 seng4 jat6 jat1 ngaam4 jat1 fat1, nik1 maai4 hai2 di1 hau6 hong6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小偷总是到处躲藏，躲在后巷里。
examples.english_sentence: The thief is always hiding everywhere, concealing himself in the back alleys.

english_meaning: selfish desires, personal greed
explanation_mandarin: 指只顾自己，满足个人私利的欲望。
explanation_english: Refers to desires that are solely for one's own benefit and the satisfaction of personal selfish interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗一己私慾，乜嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jat1 gei2 si1 juk6, mat1 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了他自己的私欲，他什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: For his own selfish desires, he's capable of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾一己私慾蒙蔽咗你嘅雙眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jat1 gei2 si1 juk6 mung4 bai3 zo2 nei5 ge3 soeng1 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让一己私欲蒙蔽了你的双眼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let selfish desires blind you.

english_meaning: smooth sailing; plain sailing; everything goes well
explanation_mandarin: 比喻旅程或工作等非常顺利，没有阻碍。也用于祝愿。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning everything goes smoothly and successfully, without any obstacles. Often used as a blessing or well-wishing for someone's journey, career, or endeavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新一年一帆風順，萬事如意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 jat1 nin4 jat1 faan4 fung1 seon6, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年一帆风顺，万事如意！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a smooth sailing new year and that everything goes well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你嘅事業一帆風順啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 ge3 si6 jip6 jat1 faan4 fung1 seon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你的事业一帆风顺。
examples.english_sentence: I hope your career goes smoothly.

english_meaning: a place to stand; a foothold; a niche
explanation_mandarin: 指很小的一块地方或地位。比喻立身的地方或容身之处。
explanation_english: Refers to a small piece of land or position. A metaphor for a place to stand or a place to live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，你想爭一席之地，就要落多啲苦功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, nei5 soeng2 zaang1 jat1 sik6 zi1 dei6, zau6 jiu3 lok6 do1 di1 fu2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家公司，你想争得一席之地，就要多下苦功夫。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to gain a foothold in this company, you need to work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，後生仔想置業，真係好難搵到一席之地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, hau6 sang1 zai2 soeng2 zi3 jip6, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 wan2 dou3 jat1 sik6 zi1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房价这么贵，年轻人想置业，真的很难找到立足之地。
examples.english_sentence: With such expensive housing prices in Hong Kong, it is really hard for young people to find a place to settle down.

english_meaning: area; region; zone; belt
explanation_mandarin: 指某个区域或者地带。
explanation_english: Refers to a certain area, region, or zone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 九龍塘一帶都係豪宅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau2 lung4 tong4 jat1 daai3 dou1 hai6 hou4 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 九龙塘一带都是豪宅。
examples.english_sentence: The area around Kowloon Tong is full of luxury houses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢一帶嘅治安唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 jat1 daai3 ge3 zi6 on1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这一带的治安不错。
examples.english_sentence: The security in this area is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旺角一帶好多嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong6 gok3 jat1 daai3 hou2 do1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旺角一带有很多吃的。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of food in the Mong Kok area.

english_meaning: Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国提出的“丝绸之路经济带”和“21世纪海上丝绸之路”倡议，旨在加强中国与沿线国家的经济合作。
explanation_english: Refers to the "Silk Road Economic Belt" and the "21st Century Maritime Silk Road" initiative proposed by China, aimed at strengthening economic cooperation between China and countries along the routes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺「一帶一路」入面可以扮演重要角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai2 "jat1 daai3 jat1 lou6" jap6 min6 ho2 ji5 baan1 jin2 zung6 jiu3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港在“一带一路”中可以扮演重要角色。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong can play an important role in the Belt and Road Initiative.

english_meaning: a group of people, a bunch of people
explanation_mandarin: 指一群人，通常带有轻微的贬义或戏谑意味，用于描述一群人聚集在一起。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people, often with a slightly derogatory or playful tone. It's used to describe a group of people gathered together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日都見到佢哋一干人等喺樓下吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 jat1 gon1 jan4 dang2 hai2 lau4 haa6 cheoi1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是看到他们一伙人在楼下聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I always see that group of them chatting downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知一干人等又搞咩搞到咁嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 jat1 gon1 jan4 dang2 jau6 gaau2 me1 gaau2 dou3 gam3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道这群人又在搞什么，这么吵。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what that bunch is up to, it's so noisy.

english_meaning: a bunch of stuff; a series of things; a load of things
explanation_mandarin: 指一系列或一堆事物。通常用于非正式场合，表示数量较多或种类繁杂。
explanation_english: Refers to a series or a bunch of things. Usually used in informal settings to indicate a large quantity or variety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一干嘢返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gon1 je5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一大堆东西回家。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a load of things back home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搞掂呢一干嘢真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaau2 dim6 ni1 jat1 gon1 je5 zan1 hai6 m4 yung4 yi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要搞定这一系列的事情真是不容易。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not easy to deal with this series of things.

english_meaning: Annual; once a year
explanation_mandarin: 每年一次的。形容某事或活动每年都会举行。
explanation_english: Occurring once a year; annual. Describes an event or activity that happens every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港小姐選舉係一年一度嘅盛事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 siu2 ze2 syun2 geoi2 hai6 jat1 nin4 jat1 dou6 ge3 sing6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港小姐选举是一年一度的盛事。
examples.english_sentence: The Miss Hong Kong pageant is an annual event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司一年一度都會搞周年晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jat1 nin4 jat1 dou6 dou1 wui gaa2 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司每年都会举办周年晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: Our company holds an annual anniversary dinner every year.

cantonese: 一年之計在於春，一日之計在於晨
jyutping: jat1 nin4 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 ceon1, jat1 jat6 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 san4
mandarin_meaning: 一年的计划在于春天，一天的计划在于早晨
english_meaning: The planning of a year lies in spring; the planning of a day lies in the morning. (Early planning is crucial for success.)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做事要在开始时就做好打算。一年最重要的时间是春天，一天最重要的时间是早晨，所以要抓紧时间。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of early planning and preparation for success. Just as spring is the crucial time for planting and nurturing crops for the whole year, and the morning is the most productive time of day, effective planning at the outset is essential for achieving desired outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年嘅計劃都係根據「一年之計在於春，一日之計在於晨」呢句說話去部署㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ge3 gai3 waak6 dou1 hai6 gan1 geoi3 "jat1 nin4 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 ceon1, jat1 jat6 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 san4" ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 heoi3 bou6 syu5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年的计划都是根据“一年之计在于春，一日之计在于晨”这句话去部署的。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's plans for this year are all deployed according to the saying, 'The planning of a year lies in spring; the planning of a day lies in the morning.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要記住「一年之計在於春，一日之計在於晨」，早啲準備考試，唔好臨急抱佛腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 "jat1 nin4 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 ceon1, jat1 jat6 zi1 gai3 zoi6 jyu1 san4", zou2 di1 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3, m4 hou2 lam4 gap1 pou5 fat6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要记住“一年之计在于春，一日之计在于晨”，早点准备考试，不要临时抱佛脚。
examples.english_sentence: You need to remember 'The planning of a year lies in spring; the planning of a day lies in the morning,' prepare for the exam early, don't cram at the last minute.

english_meaning: all year round; throughout the year; the whole year
explanation_mandarin: 表示从年初到年尾，整个一年，强调持续性。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire year, from the beginning to the end, emphasizing continuity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一年到晚都好忙咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nin4 dou3 maan5 dou1 hou2 mong4 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一年到头都好像很忙的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be very busy all year round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭一年到晚都咁多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jat1 nin4 dou3 maan5 dou1 gam3 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店一年到头都有很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people queuing up at this shop all year round.

english_meaning: a year or so; about a year; a year and a half
explanation_mandarin: 表示大约一年或一年半的时间，形容时间不长但也不算短。
explanation_english: Indicates a period of approximately one year or one and a half years. It describes a time that is not long but not short either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程預計要一年半載先可以完工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jyu6 gai3 jiu3 jat1 nin4 bun3 zoi3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程预计要一年半载才能完工。
examples.english_sentence: This project is expected to take about a year and a half to complete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要出去旅行一年半載，可能好耐先返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 ceot1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 jat1 nin4 bun3 zoi3, ho2 nang4 hou2 noi6 sin1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要出去旅行一年半载，可能很久才回来。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's going traveling for about a year, so he might not be back for a long time.

english_meaning: all year round; the four seasons
explanation_mandarin: 指一年中的春夏秋冬四个季节，表示全年。
explanation_english: Refers to the four seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter; meaning all year round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港一年四季都好潮濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jat1 nin4 sei3 gwai3 dou1 hou2 ciu4 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港一年四季都很潮湿。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is very humid all year round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳一年四季都提供新鮮嘅海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jat1 nin4 sei3 gwai3 dou1 tai4 gung1 san1 sin1 ge3 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅一年四季都提供新鲜的海鲜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant offers fresh seafood all year round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方一年四季嘅天氣都好適合旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 jat1 nin4 sei3 gwai3 ge3 tin1 hei3 dou1 hou2 sik1 hap6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方一年四季的天气都很适合旅行。
examples.english_sentence: The weather in this place is suitable for travelling all year round.

english_meaning: once; at one time; for a time; briefly
explanation_mandarin: 表示过去曾经有过某种情况或行为。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened or was done once in the past; for a period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一度以為佢唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 dou6 ji5 wai4 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一度以为他不会来。
examples.english_sentence: I once thought he wouldn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司一度陷入財政危機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jat1 dou6 ham6 jap6 coi4 zing1 ngai4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司一度陷入财政危机。
examples.english_sentence: This company was once in a financial crisis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一度諗住搬去外國住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 dou6 nam2 zyu6 bun1 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一度想过搬去国外住。
examples.english_sentence: We once thought about moving to live abroad.

english_meaning: wishful thinking; one-sided wish; one-sided love
explanation_mandarin: 指单方面的愿望或想法，不考虑对方的意愿和实际情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a one-sided wish or idea, without considering the other party's wishes or the actual situation. Implies a lack of reciprocity or realism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一廂情願啦，佢根本對你冇意思㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 soeng1 cing4 jyun6 laa1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 deoi3 nei5 mou5 ji3 si1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一厢情愿了，他根本对你没意思的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wishful, he/she has no feelings for you at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想一廂情願咁付出，到最後乜都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 jat1 soeng1 cing4 jyun6 gam2 fu6 ceot1, dou3 zeoi3 hau6 mat1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想一厢情愿地付出，到最后什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to give everything wishfully, only to end up with nothing in the end.

english_meaning: exactly the same; all; complete set
explanation_mandarin: 指完全相同，没有差别；也指全部，所有的。
explanation_english: Refers to being exactly the same, without any difference; also means all, the entire set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹着嘅衫一式一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 zoek3 ge3 saam1 jat1 sik1 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹穿的衣服一模一样。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes worn by the two sisters are exactly the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅嘢食一式都咁好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 je5 sik6 jat1 sik1 dou1 gam3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的东西全部都这么好吃。
examples.english_sentence: All the food here is so delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買呢個套餐一式有齊晒你想要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ni1 go3 tou3 caan1 jat1 sik1 jau5 cai4 saai3 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买这个套餐，所有你想要的东西都有了。
examples.english_sentence: Buy this set meal, and you'll have everything you want.

english_meaning: exactly the same; identical
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个或多个事物在各个方面都完全相同，没有差异。
explanation_english: Describes two or more things that are exactly the same in every aspect, with no differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹買咗對一式一樣嘅鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 maai5 zo2 deoi3 jat1 sik1 jat1 joeng6 ge3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹买了一模一样的鞋。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters bought identical pairs of shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅產品一式一樣，根本分唔出邊間好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 jat1 sik1 jat1 joeng6, gan1 bun2 fan1 m4 ceot1 bin1 gaan1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的产品一模一样，根本分不出哪家好。
examples.english_sentence: The products of these two companies are identical; you can't tell which is better.

english_meaning: deeply devoted; deeply in love; unwavering affection
explanation_mandarin: 形容对人或事物用情很深，一直不改变。
explanation_english: Describes a deep and unchanging affection towards a person or thing; unwavering love and devotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢老婆一往情深，結婚幾十年都冇變過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 lou5 po2 jat1 wong5 cing4 sam1, git3 fan1 gei2 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 bin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的妻子一往情深，结婚几十年都没有变过。
examples.english_sentence: He is deeply devoted to his wife, and it hasn't changed even after being married for several decades.

english_meaning: to advance bravely, to forge ahead, undaunted and unstoppable
explanation_mandarin: 形容勇猛地前进，毫不畏惧。勇往直前，无所顾忌。
explanation_english: Describes advancing bravely without fear. To move forward courageously, without hesitation or restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋抱住一往無前嘅精神，終於成功克服咗所有困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 pou5 zyu6 jat1 wong5 mou4 cin4 ge3 zing1 san4, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 kok3 fuk1 zo2 so2 jau5 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抱着一往无前的精神，终于成功克服了所有困难。
examples.english_sentence: They embraced the spirit of advancing bravely and finally overcame all difficulties.

english_meaning: uniformly; all; without exception
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有例外，全部都一样。
explanation_english: Indicates that there are no exceptions, everything is the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司規定所有員工一律要着制服返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 jat1 leot6 jiu3 zoek3 zai3 fuk6 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司规定所有员工一律要穿制服上班。
examples.english_sentence: Our company stipulates that all employees must wear uniforms to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲嘢一律十蚊一件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 jat1 leot6 sap6 man1 jat1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的东西一律十块钱一件。
examples.english_sentence: Everything here is ten dollars apiece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，所有學生一律平等對待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, so2 jau5 hok6 sang1 jat1 leot6 ping4 dang2 deoi3 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，所有学生一律平等对待。
examples.english_sentence: For this exam, all students will be treated equally without exception.

english_meaning: wholeheartedly; single-mindedly; with all one's heart
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人专心致志，全心全意地投入到某件事情中。
explanation_english: Describes a person's focus and devotion to a certain task or goal, doing something wholeheartedly and single-mindedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一心諗住考入大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sam1 nam2 zyu6 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一心想着考入大学。
examples.english_sentence: He is wholeheartedly focused on getting into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一心想幫你，你唔好咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 sam1 soeng2 bong1 nei5, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一心想帮你，你不要这样。
examples.english_sentence: I wholeheartedly want to help you, don't be like this.

english_meaning: wholeheartedly; with single-minded devotion; with heart and soul
explanation_mandarin: 形容心思集中，专心致志。
explanation_english: Describes focusing one's mind and dedicating oneself wholeheartedly to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一心一意想考入大學，所以日日都好努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sam1 jat1 ji3 soeng2 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6, so2 ji5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一心一意想考入大学，所以每天都很努力学习。
examples.english_sentence: He is wholeheartedly dedicated to getting into university, so he studies very hard every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明對佢女朋友一心一意，大家都覺得佢哋好sweet。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 deoi3 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 jat1 sam1 jat1 ji3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 hou2 sweet.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明对他的女朋友一心一意，大家都觉得他们很甜蜜。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is wholeheartedly devoted to his girlfriend, everyone thinks they are very sweet.

english_meaning: to multitask, to do two things at once, to have divided attention
explanation_mandarin: 同时做两件事情。形容注意力分散，效率可能不高。
explanation_english: To do two things at the same time. Describes having divided attention, which may lead to reduced efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一路睇電視一路做功課啦，一心二用好難集中精神㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 lou6 tai2 din6 si6 jat1 lou6 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1, jat1 sam1 ji6 jung6 hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要一边看电视一边做功课，一心二用很难集中精神的。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't watch TV and do your homework at the same time. It's hard to concentrate when you're multitasking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己可以一心二用，一邊開會一邊覆email。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 ho2 ji5 jat1 sam1 ji6 jung6, jat1 bin1 hoi1 wui2 jat1 bin1 fuk1 email.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己可以一心二用，一边开会一边回复邮件。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he can multitask, attending the meeting and replying to emails at the same time.

english_meaning: a moment's carelessness; a momentary slip; a difference of a thought; a single wrong thought
explanation_mandarin: 指由于一时的想法错误而导致了不好的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to a bad consequence resulting from a momentary wrong thought or decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時一念之差，做咗啲後悔嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 jat1 nim6 zi1 caa1, zou6 zo2 di1 hau6 fui3 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时糊涂，做了一些后悔的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He made some regrettable decisions in a moment of carelessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多罪案都係因為一念之差而發生嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 zeoi6 on3 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 jat1 nim6 zi1 caa1 ji4 faat3 sang1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多罪案都是因为一念之差而发生的。
examples.english_sentence: Many crimes happen because of a moment's lapse in judgment.

english_meaning: in a fit of anger; in a moment of anger; in a rage
explanation_mandarin: 指因为一时生气，失去理智而做出的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to actions taken out of anger, resulting in a loss of reason and control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一怒之下辭咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nou6 zi1 haa6 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一气之下辞掉了工作。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job in a fit of anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一怒之下撕爛咗佢封信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 nou6 zi1 haa6 si1 laan6 zo2 keoi5 fung1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一气之下撕烂了他的信。
examples.english_sentence: I tore up his letter in a moment of anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽一怒之下趕咗佢出門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat1 nou6 zi1 haa6 gon2 zo2 keoi5 ceot1 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈一气之下把他赶出了家门。
examples.english_sentence: His mother, in a rage, kicked him out of the house.

mandarin_meaning: 尚有一口气; 还有一口气
english_meaning: While there's life, there's hope; As long as one has breath; Still alive (barely)
explanation_mandarin: 形容生命垂危，但仍然有生存的希望。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being near death, but still having a chance of survival. It emphasizes the persistence of hope even in dire circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然傷得好重，但係一息尚存，我哋一定要盡力救佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 soeng1 dak1 hou2 cung5, daan6 hai6 jat1 sik1 soeng6 cyun4, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 gau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然伤得很重，但是还有一口气，我们一定要尽力救他。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's severely injured, he's still alive. We must do our best to save him.

english_meaning: in a moment, in an instant, in the blink of an eye
explanation_mandarin: 形容极短的时间，相当于“一会儿”、“瞬间”。
explanation_english: Describes a very short period of time, equivalent to "in a moment", "in an instant", or "in the blink of an eye".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一息間就瞓著咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sik1 gaan1 zau6 fan3 zoek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子就睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell asleep in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車一息間就消失咗喺我嘅视线范围入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 jat1 sik1 gaan1 zau6 siu1 sat1 zo2 hai2 ngo5 ge3 si6 sin3 faan6 wai4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车一下子就消失在我的视线里。
examples.english_sentence: The car disappeared from my sight in an instant.

english_meaning: to insist on having one's own way; to be obstinate; to ignore advice and act independently
explanation_mandarin: 指不听取别人的意见，固执地按照自己的意思行事。
explanation_english: Refers to acting obstinately according to one's own ideas, without listening to the opinions of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一意孤行喇，聽下其他人嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 ji3 gu1 hang4 laa1, teng1 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一意孤行了，听一下其他人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't insist on having your own way, listen to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一意孤行，最後搞到成件事都失敗咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ji3 gu1 hang4, zeoi3 hau6 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 dou1 siu1 baai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一意孤行，最后导致整件事都失败了。
examples.english_sentence: He insisted on having his own way, which ultimately led to the failure of the whole thing.

synonyms: 独断专行 (duk6 dyun3 zyun1 hang4)

english_meaning: complete; all-inclusive; having everything that one expects to find
explanation_mandarin: 形容一切都已准备齐全，应有的都有，无所不缺。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything is complete and readily available; having all the necessary items or features; complete and comprehensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店嘅設施一應俱全，咩都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 sai3 si1 jat1 jing3 geoi1 cyun4, me1 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的设施应有尽有，什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel's facilities are complete, it has everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜單一應俱全，中西餐都有得揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 daan1 jat1 jing3 geoi1 cyun4, zung1 sai1 caan1 dou1 jau5 dak1 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜单应有尽有，中餐和西餐都可以选择。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's menu is all-inclusive, you can choose from both Chinese and Western dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢準備嘅工具一應俱全，唔使擔心唔夠用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeon2 bei6 ge3 gung1 geoi6 jat1 jing3 geoi1 cyun4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 m4 gau3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他准备的工具应有尽有，不用担心不够用。
examples.english_sentence: The tools he prepared are complete; you don't have to worry about not having enough.

english_meaning: unchanging; constant; remaining the same
explanation_mandarin: 指一点也没有变化，始终如一。
explanation_english: Describes something that remains completely unchanged, consistently the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工咁多年嚟都一成不變，都冇加過人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 jat1 gam3 do1 nin4 lai4 dou1 jat1 sing4 bat1 bin3, dou1 mou5 gaa1 gwo3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资这么多年来都一成不变，一点也没涨过。
examples.english_sentence: His salary has been unchanging for so many years, and he hasn't received a raise at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅餐牌十年嚟都一成不變，食到我都悶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 caan1 paai4 sap6 nin4 lai4 dou1 jat1 sing4 bat1 bin3, sik6 dou3 ngo5 dou1 mun6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜单十年来都一成不变，我都吃腻了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's menu has been unchanging for ten years, I'm bored of eating here.

english_meaning: Nothing at all; didn't get anything; zero result
explanation_mandarin: 表示完全没有获得，一点都没有。形容结果是零，什么都没得到。
explanation_english: It means absolutely nothing was obtained or achieved. It describes a situation where the result is zero, nothing was gained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買六合彩買咗十年，一戙都冇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 maai5 zo2 sap6 nin4, jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了十年六合彩，什么都没中！
examples.english_sentence: I've been buying Mark Six for ten years, and I haven't won anything at all!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我溫晒書，點知一戙都冇中！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 wan1 saai3 syu1, dim2 zi1 jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5 zung3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我复习了所有的书，结果一道题都没考到！
examples.english_sentence: I studied all the books for this exam, but I didn't get any questions right!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問咗佢好耐，佢都係一戙都冇講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6, keoi5 dou1 hai6 jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问了他很久，他什么都没说。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him for a long time, but he didn't say anything at all.

mandarin_meaning: 一仗; 一次重要的比赛或竞争
english_meaning: A battle; a crucial match or competition; a single attempt or trial
explanation_mandarin: 指一次重要的战斗、比赛或竞争。也指一次尝试或努力。
explanation_english: Refers to an important battle, match, or competition. It can also refer to a single attempt or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚場波我哋要一戰功成！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 zin3 gung1 sing4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的比赛我们一定要一战成功！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's game, we must succeed in one battle!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係最後一戰，一定要盡力呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 zin3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是最后一战了，一定要尽力啊！
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the final battle, you must do your best!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考車牌一戰就過，真係好叻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 ce1 paai4 jat1 zin3 zau6 gwo3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考驾照一次就通过，真的很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: Passed the driving test in one go, really impressive!

english_meaning: first-hand; personally; single-handedly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 量词; 形容词; 副词
explanation_mandarin: 量词：用于掌握的信息或技术。形容词：指直接的，第一手的。副词：指亲自或独立地。
explanation_english: Quantifier: used for information or skills acquired. Adjective: refers to something direct, first-hand. Adverb: refers to doing something personally or independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係我一手資料嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 ngo5 jat1 sau2 zi1 liu2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是我的第一手资料。
examples.english_sentence: These are all my first-hand information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一手湊大佢個仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sau2 cau3 daai6 keoi5 go3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一手把他的儿子带大。
examples.english_sentence: He single-handedly raised his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一手包辦曬所有嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 sau2 baau1 baan6 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一手包办了所有的事。
examples.english_sentence: I handled everything single-handedly.

english_meaning: single-handedly; doing everything by oneself; with one's own hands and feet
explanation_mandarin: 形容凡事都自己做，不依赖他人。
explanation_english: Describes doing everything by oneself, without relying on others. It emphasizes personal involvement and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司佢一手一腳搞起㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 keoi5 jat1 sau2 jat1 goek3 gaau2 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司是他一手一脚创立的。
examples.english_sentence: He built this company from the ground up single-handedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我哋要一手一腳去做，先至可以學到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 sau2 jat1 goek3 heoi3 zou6, sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 hok6 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我们需要亲力亲为去做，才可以学到东西。
examples.english_sentence: We need to do this ourselves from start to finish in order to learn something.

english_meaning: to handle everything single-handedly; to do everything on one's own; to take care of everything
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人负责全部工作或事务。
explanation_english: Refers to handling all tasks or matters entirely by oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞結婚啲嘢全部一手包辦，真係好叻女！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 git3 fan1 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 jat1 sau2 baau1 baan6, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 neoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她筹办结婚的事情全部一手包办，真是个能干的女孩！
examples.english_sentence: She handled all the wedding preparations single-handedly, she's really a capable girl!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project佢一手包辦，做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project keoi5 jat1 sau2 baau1 baan6, zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目她一手包办，做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: She handled this project entirely on her own and did a very good job.

english_meaning: to be the sole cause of; to create single-handedly; to be responsible for (usually negative outcome)
explanation_mandarin: 指完全由一个人造成，通常指不好的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to something entirely caused by one person, usually implying a negative outcome or consequence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁嘅樣都係你一手造成㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 ge3 joeng2 dou1 hai6 nei5 jat1 sau2 zou6 sing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情变成这样都是你一手造成的。
examples.english_sentence: The matter turned out like this all because of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司破產，佢要負上全部責任，根本就係佢一手造成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 po3 saan2, keoi5 jiu3 fu6 soeng5 cyun4 bou6 zaak3 jam3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 sau2 zou6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司破产，他要负全部责任，根本就是他一手造成的。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt. He is fully responsible, it was all his doing.

english_meaning: a special skill or talent
explanation_mandarin: 指具有某方面的技能或专长。
explanation_english: Refers to having a particular skill, talent, or expertise in a certain area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然學歷唔高，但係有一技之長，識整錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hok6 lik6 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 jau5 jat1 gei6 zi1 coeng4, sik1 zing2 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然学历不高，但是有一技之长，会修表。
examples.english_sentence: Although he doesn't have a high education, he has a special skill, he knows how to repair watches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會，有一技之長好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2, jau5 jat1 gei6 zi1 coeng4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会，有一技之长很重要。
examples.english_sentence: In this society, having a special skill is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想搵工，最好都係學返一技之長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 wan2 gung1, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 hok6 faan1 jat1 gei6 zi1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想找工作，最好还是学一门手艺。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to find a job, it's best to learn a skill.

english_meaning: to have a skill to rely on; to have a useful skill to support oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有一项技能，可以依靠这项技能谋生。
explanation_english: Refers to having a skill that can be relied upon to make a living; possessing a marketable skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，最好都係學返一技傍身，第時搵食都容易啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 hok6 faan1 jat1 gei6 pong4 san1, dai6 si4 wan2 sik6 dou1 jung4 ji6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人们，最好还是学一项技能傍身，以后找工作也更容易些。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people should learn a skill to fall back on, it will be easier to find a job in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸成日都話要我學多門手藝，等我第時可以一技傍身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 hok6 do1 mun4 sau2 ngai6, dang2 ngo5 dai6 si4 ho2 ji5 jat1 gei6 pong4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸总是说要我多学门手艺，让我以后可以一技傍身。
examples.english_sentence: Dad always tells me to learn a trade, so that I can have a skill to rely on in the future.

mandarin_meaning: 上了年纪; 年纪大了
english_meaning: getting on in years; of advanced age; old
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪比较大，通常略带婉转或者负面的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is getting old, often with a slightly euphemistic or negative connotation. It can imply that the person should know better or is too old to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都一把年紀喇，仲咁鬼馬！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jat1 baa2 nin4 gei2 laa3, zung6 gam3 gwai2 maa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么大年纪了，还这么调皮！
examples.english_sentence: You're getting on in years, and you're still so mischievous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一把年紀，仲咁努力工作，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 baa2 nin4 gei2, zung6 gam3 nu5 lik6 gung1 zok3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上了年纪，还这么努力工作，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting on in years, and he's still working so hard. He's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一把年紀都唔識得照顧自己，真係要人擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 baa2 nin4 gei2 dou1 m4 sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2, zan1 hai6 jiu3 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么大年纪了还不知道照顾自己，真是让人担心。
examples.english_sentence: At such an advanced age, you still don't know how to take care of yourself; it's truly worrying.

synonyms: 咁大年紀 (gam3 daai6 nin4 gei2)

mandarin_meaning: 一肚子火; 非常生气
english_meaning: A bellyful of anger; extremely angry; a burst of anger; to be enraged.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常生气，心中充满怒火。
explanation_english: Describes someone being extremely angry, with a bellyful of fire; an expression of extreme anger or rage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，真係惹我一把火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 ye5 ngo5 jat1 baa2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是迟到，真让我生气。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, it really makes me angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我即刻一把火上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zik1 hak1 jat1 baa2 fo2 soeng5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他这样说，我立刻火冒三丈。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I immediately got really angry.

mandarin_meaning: 拖拖拉拉，不干脆，慢吞吞
english_meaning: sluggish, slow and unenthusiastic, dilly-dallying
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事拖延，行动缓慢，不积极。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow and sluggish in their actions, lacking enthusiasm or initiative; dilly-dallying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好一抽一掕啦，快啲搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 jat1 cau1 jat1 lang3 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要拖拖拉拉的，快点搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sluggish with your work, get it done quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一抽一掕咁行路，唔知諗緊咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 cau1 jat1 lang3 gam2 haang4 lou6, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慢吞吞地走路，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's walking so slowly and unenthusiastically, I wonder what he's thinking about.

mandarin_meaning: 靠不住；不认真；吊儿郎当
english_meaning: Unreliable; irresponsible; careless; sloppy; lackadaisical
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事不认真，不负责任，吊儿郎当，靠不住。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious or responsible, careless, and unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁一抽二掕啦，會搞衰晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 cau1 ji6 lang3 laa1, wui5 gaau2 seoi2晒 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么吊儿郎当的，会搞砸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless when you work, you'll mess things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢一向都一抽二掕，唔可以信佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 jat1 cau1 ji6 lang3, m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事一向都不认真，不能相信他的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always been unreliable when it comes to work; you can't trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 拖泥带水，办事不利索，不干脆
english_meaning: inefficient, sloppy, dragging one's feet, procrastinating; messy, unorganized
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事拖泥带水，不干脆，效率低下。也形容事情处理得不够干净利落。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is inefficient, sloppy, drags their feet, or procrastinates in their work. Can also describe a task that is not handled cleanly and efficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁一抽二褦啦，快啲搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 cau1 ji6 nang3 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么拖泥带水，快点把它弄好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inefficient in your work, finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事搞到一抽二褦，都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 jat1 cau1 ji6 nang3, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事搞得一塌糊涂，都不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has become a complete mess, I don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 一拍两散 (yī pāi liǎng sàn)
english_meaning: To break up; to end on bad terms; to split completely; to go separate ways with nothing left; to have a relationship completely fail.
explanation_mandarin: 指双方关系破裂，彻底决裂，没有任何挽回的余地。比喻合作失败，或者感情破裂。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a relationship between two parties completely breaks down, with no hope of reconciliation. It can refer to a failed collaboration, a broken relationship, or any situation where things fall apart irretrievably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗層樓嘅問題傾唔掂數，結果一拍兩散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 cang4 lau2 ge3 man6 tai4 king1 m4 dim6 sou3, git3 gwo2 jat1 paak3 loeng5 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了房产的问题谈不拢，结果一拍两散。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them couldn't agree on the property issue, and ended up breaking up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅合伙人因為意見不合，最後一拍兩散，各自發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hap6 fo2 jan4 jan1 wai6 ji3 gin3 bat1 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 jat1 paak3 loeng5 saan3, gok3 zi6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的合伙人因为意见不合，最后不欢而散，各自发展。
examples.english_sentence: The partners of the company had disagreements and eventually parted ways, each pursuing their own development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果再係咁樣落去，我哋嘅關係一定會一拍兩散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 hai6 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, ngo5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jat1 ding6 wui5 jat1 paak3 loeng5 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再这样下去，我们的关系一定会破裂。
examples.english_sentence: If things continue like this, our relationship will definitely fall apart.

english_meaning: to hit it off immediately; to click; to be on the same wavelength
explanation_mandarin: 形容双方意见或想法十分一致，很容易达成共识。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two or more parties have similar ideas or opinions and easily reach an agreement; to have instant rapport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢哋一拍即合，好快就決定咗合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dei6 jat1 paak3 zik1 hap6, hou2 faai3 zau6 kyut3 ding6 zo2 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他们一拍即合，很快就决定合作了。
examples.english_sentence: I hit it off immediately with them, and we quickly decided to collaborate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅音樂理念一拍即合，所以好容易就組成咗樂隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 yam1 ngok6 lei5 nim6 jat1 paak3 zik1 hap6, so2 ji5 hou2 yung4 yi6 zau6 zu2 sing4 zo2 ngok6 deui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的音乐理念一拍即合，所以很容易就组成了乐队。
examples.english_sentence: Our musical ideas clicked instantly, so it was easy to form a band.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格好似，一見面就一拍即合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 ci5, jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 jat1 paak3 zik1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格很像，一见面就一拍即合。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are very similar; they hit it off as soon as they met.

english_meaning: To hit it off immediately; to click
explanation_mandarin: 形容双方很合得来，想法一致，很快就能达成共识或成为朋友。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two parties get along very well, have similar ideas, and quickly reach a consensus or become friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一拍行，好快就變成咗好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 paak3 haang4, hou2 faai3 zau6 bin3 sing4 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一拍即合，很快就成了好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them hit it off immediately and quickly became good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同個新同事一拍行，合作得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 go3 san1 tung4 si6 jat1 paak3 haang4, hap6 jok3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和新同事一拍即合，合作得很好。
examples.english_sentence: I clicked with the new colleague and we're working together very well.

mandarin_meaning: 一招半式 (yī zhāo bàn shì)
english_meaning: A few tricks; a smattering of skills; a little bit of knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 指只有少量或不完整的技能或知识。
explanation_english: Refers to having only a small amount or incomplete set of skills or knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗一招半式就以為自己好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 jat1 ziu1 bun3 sik1 zau6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了一招半式就以为自己很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He learned a few tricks and thought he was very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你得一招半式，點同人哋鬥啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak1 jat1 ziu1 bun3 sik1, dim2 tung4 jan4 dei6 dau3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只有一招半式，怎么和别人斗呢？
examples.english_sentence: You only have a few tricks up your sleeve, how can you compete with others?

synonyms: 三腳貓功夫 (saam1 goek3 maau1 gung1 fu1)

english_meaning: together; to do together; to risk it all; to go all out; to put everything on the line
explanation_mandarin: 1. 表示一起，共同。2. 表示豁出去，不顾一切地做某事。
explanation_english: 1. Indicates doing something together. 2. Indicates going all out, risking everything to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一拼做完佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ping1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起把它做完吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's finish it together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗成功，我哋要一拼搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 sing4 gung1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 ping1 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了成功，我们要拼命努力。
examples.english_sentence: In order to succeed, we need to work hard and give it our all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算冇把握，都要一拼試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 mou5 baa2 ak1, dou1 jiu3 jat1 ping1 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使没有把握，也要冒险试一下。
examples.english_sentence: Even if we're not confident, we still need to risk it and give it a try.

english_meaning: one press; a single press
explanation_mandarin: 指按一下，或按一次。作为量词时，表示按压的次数。
explanation_english: Refers to pressing something once, or a single press. When used as a measure word, it indicates the number of times something is pressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一按個掣，佢就會自動開機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ngon3 go3 zai3, keoi5 zau6 wui5 zi6 dung6 hoi1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你按一下那个按钮，它就会自动开机。
examples.english_sentence: If you press the button once, it will automatically turn on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係一按，就影咗張相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 jat1 ngon3, zau6 ying2 zo2 zoeng1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只按了一下，就拍了一张照片。
examples.english_sentence: He just pressed once and took a picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試過一按，都係冇反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 gwo3 jat1 ngon3, dou1 hai6 mou5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试过按一下，还是没有反应。
examples.english_sentence: I tried pressing it once, but there's still no response.

english_meaning: To sweep away completely; to clear out; to sell out completely; to be all sold out.
explanation_mandarin: 形容全部清除或完全卖光，什么也不剩。
explanation_english: Describes something being completely cleared away or sold out, leaving nothing behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲特價貨一推出就俾人一掃而空喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dak6 gaa3 fo3 jat1 teoi1 ceot1 zau6 bei2 jan4 jat1 sou3 ji4 hung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些特价商品一推出就被人一扫而空了。
examples.english_sentence: The special-offer items were all sold out as soon as they were released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好快咁將檯面上嘅嘢食一掃而空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 faai3 gam2 zoeng1 toi2 min6 soeng5 ge3 je5 sik6 jat1 sou3 ji4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很快地把桌子上的食物一扫而空。
examples.english_sentence: They quickly cleared all the food off the table.

english_meaning: a row; a line; a while; a spell
explanation_mandarin: 表示排列成行的一组事物; 也可以表示一段时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a set of things arranged in a row or line; can also refer to a period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 課室入邊有幾一排枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo3 sat1 jap6 bin1 jau5 gei2 jat1 paai4 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教室里面有几排桌子。
examples.english_sentence: There are several rows of desks in the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗佢一排，佢都冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 paai4, keoi5 dou1 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了他一会儿，他都没来。
examples.english_sentence: I waited for him for a while, but he didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢一排天氣都幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 jat1 paai4 tin1 hei3 dou1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气都挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been quite good lately.

english_meaning: a series of unfortunate events; a streak of bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 形容连续发生一系列倒霉的事情，让人觉得非常不顺心。
explanation_english: Describes a series of unfortunate events happening in a row, making one feel very unlucky and frustrated. It implies a string of failures or mishaps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排真係一排瀨，唔見銀包又整爛電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 zan1 hai6 jat1 paai4 laai6, m4 gin3 ngan4 baau1 jau6 zing2 laan6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近真是倒霉透了，丢了钱包又弄坏了电话。
examples.english_sentence: I've really been having a streak of bad luck lately, I lost my wallet and broke my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢失業之後，就好似一排瀨咁，乜都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 paai4 laai6 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他失业之后，就好像一连串倒霉事，什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he lost his job, it's like a streak of bad luck; nothing goes smoothly for him.

english_meaning: to investigate thoroughly; to get to the bottom of something; to find out the truth
explanation_mandarin: 彻底地调查研究，弄清楚事情的来龙去脉。
explanation_english: To thoroughly investigate and understand the whole story; to get to the bottom of the matter; to find out the truth of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要一探究竟，睇吓件事嘅真相係點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jat1 taam3 gau3 ging2, tai2 haa5 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 hai6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要一探究竟，看看事情的真相是什么。
examples.english_sentence: We must investigate thoroughly to see what the truth of the matter is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗解開個謎團，佢決定一探究竟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 gaai2 hoi1 go3 mai4 tyun4, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 jat1 taam3 gau3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了解开这个谜团，他决定一探究竟。
examples.english_sentence: In order to solve the mystery, he decided to investigate thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新聞記者好想一探究竟，睇吓間公司係咪真係呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 man4 gei3 ze2 hou2 soeng2 jat1 taam3 gau3 ging2, tai2 haa5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 mai1 zan1 hai6 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些新闻记者很想一探究竟，看看这家公司是不是真的骗人。
examples.english_sentence: The news reporters really want to investigate thoroughly to see if this company is really scamming people.

english_meaning: To do something perfunctorily; to do something carelessly; to go through the motions; to give minimal effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事敷衍了事，随便应付，不认真。
explanation_english: Describes doing something in a perfunctory manner, just going through the motions without genuine effort or attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課一撇水咁交咗就算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 jat1 pit3 seoi2 gam2 gaau1 zo2 zau6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把作业敷衍了事地交了就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He just handed in his homework perfunctorily and that was that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一撇水咁做嘢，要認真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 pit3 seoi2 gam2 zou6 je5, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要敷衍了事地工作，要认真一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do your work so carelessly, you need to be more diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你唔好一撇水咁樣去搞個活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 pit3 seoi2 gam2 joeng2 heoi3 gaau2 go3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你不要敷衍了事地搞这个活动。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't just go through the motions when organizing this event.

synonyms: 是是但但 (si6 si6 daan6 daan6)

english_meaning: To catch fire easily; To be easily ignited; To have a short fuse; Easily provoked
explanation_mandarin: 形容某物极易燃烧，也比喻人一点就生气，脾气暴躁。
explanation_english: Literally means 'lights up immediately upon striking'. It describes something that ignites very easily. Figuratively, it refers to someone who is easily provoked or has a short temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好燥底，一撻即着㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 cou3 dai2, jat1 taat3 zik1 zoek3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人脾气很暴躁，一点就着。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very short temper, he's easily provoked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊報紙好易一撻即着，燒嘢食一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2 hou2 ji6 jat1 taat3 zik1 zoek3, siu1 je5 sik6 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧报纸很容易一点就着，用来烧烤东西最好了。
examples.english_sentence: These old newspapers catch fire easily, they're perfect for barbecuing.

english_meaning: a lot, a heap, a whole bunch
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，尤指令人不愉快的、难以处理的事物。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity, especially of unpleasant or difficult things to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲功課一擔擔，做到冇停手。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 di1 faan4 nou5 si6 jat1 daam3 daam3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.

examples.english_sentence: There's a whole heap of troubles recently, I really don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好俾咁多壓力自己，唔係嘅話，啲問題就會一擔擔咁湧埋嚟㗎啦。

english_meaning: a lump of mud; a pile of mud

explanation_english: Describes a lump or pile of mud.

examples.english_sentence: That little kid was covered in lumps of mud after playing.

english_meaning: to throw away money like dirt, to spend money lavishly
explanation_mandarin: 形容花钱非常豪爽，一次性花费大量的金钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who spends money extravagantly, spending a large amount of money at once. It implies being very wealthy and not caring about the cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗買件珠寶，一擲千金，真係好豪氣。

examples.english_sentence: He spent a fortune on a piece of jewelry. He's really generous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人中咗六合彩之後，就開始一擲千金，結果好快就洗晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 ci2 jat1 zaak6 cin1 gam1, git3 gwo2 hou2 faai3 zau6 sai2 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人中了彩票之后，就开始一掷千金，结果很快就把钱花光了。
examples.english_sentence: Some people, after winning the lottery, start spending money like water and quickly run out of money.

english_meaning: Alone; by oneself; solo
explanation_mandarin: 表示一个人独自行动，没有同伴或帮助。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is alone, doing something without companions or help. It can sometimes imply a sense of loneliness or self-reliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚得我一支公喺屋企睇電視。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一支公搞掂晒啲嘢，真係好叻。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人搞定所有事情，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He managed everything alone, he's really capable.

mandarin_meaning: 飞快地；匆忙地；迫不及待地
english_meaning: like an arrow; very quickly; eagerly; headlong
explanation_mandarin: 形容速度很快，或者形容非常迫不及待的样子。就像箭一样飞速射出。
explanation_english: Describes something that moves very quickly or someone who is very eager and impatient. Literally means 'one arrow', implying the speed and directness of an arrow being shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到有得放工，一支箭咁衝咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 jau5 dak1 fong3 gung1, jat1 zi1 zin3 gam2 cung1 zo2 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到可以下班，像箭一样冲了出去。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he heard that he could leave work, he rushed out like an arrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到offer，一支箭咁覆咗人哋。

examples.english_sentence: He received the job offer and replied immediately, like an arrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一講到食好嘢，佢就一支箭咁彈起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 gong2 dou3 sik6 hou2 je5, keoi5 zau6 jat1 zi1 zin3 gam2 taan4 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一说到有好吃的，他就立刻跳了起来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as you mention good food, he jumps up immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 稍微修改; 改变一下
english_meaning: to modify slightly; to change a little

explanation_english: To modify slightly; a minor change or alteration.

english_meaning: utter defeat; a crushing defeat; completely routed

explanation_english: Describes a state of complete and utter defeat, leaving no hope for recovery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今次投資失利，搞到一敗塗地。

examples.english_sentence: He gambled until he was completely defeated, losing all his possessions.

english_meaning: worthless, of no value, not worth a penny

examples.english_sentence: These broken things are worthless, just throw them away.

english_meaning: on the one hand; in one aspect
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某个角度来说；表示事物的一个方面。

examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 fong1 min6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 ling6 jat1 fong1 min6 jau6 paa3 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 gei2 taa1 jat1 go3.

examples.english_sentence: On the one hand, I think this method is very good, but on the other hand, I'm also afraid it will affect other people.

english_meaning: let's do it; to decide firmly; definitely; might as well; in that case
explanation_mandarin: 表示下定决心，干脆地做出决定。有时也表示“既然如此，不如…”。
explanation_english: Expresses a firm decision or resolution. It can also imply 'since that's the case, might as well...'

examples.mandarin_sentence: 好啊，今晚看电影，就这么定了！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, let's watch a movie tonight, that's settled!

english_meaning: group, clan, tribe; a group of people with shared characteristics or interests
explanation_mandarin: 指具有共同特征或兴趣爱好的一群人，通常用于形容新兴的群体或现象。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people sharing common characteristics or interests, often used to describe emerging groups or phenomena.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一天都没有空。

jyutping: jat1 jat6 bat1 gin3, jyu4 gaak3 saam1 cau1

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掛住你掛到一日不見，如隔三秋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaa3 zyu6 nei5 gwaa3 dou3 jat1 jat6 bat1 gin3, jyu4 gaak3 saam1 cau1 aa3!

explanation_mandarin: 表示整个白天或一天的时间，强调持续不断的状态。
