examples.english_sentence: It's been raining heavily lately, and it's wet all day long.

english_meaning: all day long; the whole day; from morning till night
explanation_mandarin: 表示从早到晚，整个一天的时间。 通常带有负面含义，表示某件事持续发生，或者某人总是做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates the entire day, from morning to night. It often carries a negative connotation, suggesting that something happens continuously, or that someone is always doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一日到黑掛住打機，都唔做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat6 dou3 hak1 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1, dou1 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一天到晚只顾着玩游戏，都不做作业。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all day playing video games and doesn't do his homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排一日到黑都落雨，真係好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jat1 jat6 dou3 hak1 dou1 lok6 jyu5, zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近整天都在下雨，真麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: It's been raining all day lately, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽一日到黑都係度鬧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat1 jat6 dou3 hak1 dou1 hai6 dou6 naau6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈整天都在骂我。
examples.english_sentence: My mom is scolding me all day long.

mandarin_meaning: 一日千里 (yī rì qiān lǐ)
english_meaning: a thousand li in a day; rapid progress; by leaps and bounds
explanation_mandarin: 比喻进展极快。形容事业或发展非常迅速。
explanation_english: A metaphor for extremely rapid progress or development, describing how something is advancing very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅科技發展一日千里，好快就超越咗其他城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 fo1 gei6 faat3 zin2 jat1 jat6 cin1 lei5, hou2 faai3 zau6 ciu1 jyut6 zo2 kei4 taa1 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的科技发展一日千里，很快就超越了其他城市。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's technological development is progressing rapidly, and it will soon surpass other cities.

synonyms: 突飛猛進 (dat6 fei1 maang5 zeon3)

english_meaning: once; in case; if; now that
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设或一旦发生某种情况就会产生的后果。
explanation_english: Indicates a hypothesis or the consequences that will arise once a certain situation occurs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一旦落咗雨，我哋就唔可以去行山喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 daan3 lok6 zo2 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一旦下雨了，我们就不能去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: Once it rains, we won't be able to go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一旦决定咗嘅嘢，就好难改变。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 daan3 kyut3 ding6 zo2 ge3 je5, zau6 hou2 naan4 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一旦决定了的事情，就很难改变。
examples.english_sentence: Once he has decided on something, it's hard to change his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一旦你开始咗，就唔好放弃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 daan3 nei5 hoi1 chi2 zo2, zau6 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一旦你开始了，就不要放弃。
examples.english_sentence: Once you start, don't give up.

english_meaning: early morning; early on
explanation_mandarin: 指早晨的时间，或很早就做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to the time in the morning, or doing something very early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一早起身就去咗跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zou2 hei2 san1 zau6 heoi3 zo2 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上一起床就去跑步了。
examples.english_sentence: I went jogging as soon as I got up in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一早知佢會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zou2 zi1 keoi5 wui5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他早就知道他会来。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he would come early on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一早應該準備好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 zou2 jing1 goi1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该早就准备好了。
examples.english_sentence: You should have been prepared a long time ago.

english_meaning: a short time; for a while; temporarily; at once; suddenly
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暂的时间，或指在短时间内发生的动作或情况；有时也表示立刻、马上。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time, or an action or situation occurring within a short time. It can also mean immediately or at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只係一時意見唔同，唔使咁認真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 jat1 si4 ji3 gin3 m4 tung4, m4 sai2 gam3 jing6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只是一时意见不同，不用那么认真。
examples.english_sentence: We just have different opinions for a while, no need to be so serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時衝動買咗架跑車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 maai5 zo2 gaa3 paau2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时冲动买了辆跑车。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a sports car on impulse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時諗唔起佢叫咩名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 lam2 m4 hei2 keoi5 giu3 me1 ming2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时想不起他叫什么名字。
examples.english_sentence: I can't remember his name for the moment.

english_meaning: inconsistent; fickle; constantly changing
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物的状态经常变化，没有稳定性。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing whose state changes frequently and lacks stability. It implies inconsistency and fickleness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人一時一樣，你都唔知信唔信得過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 jat1 si4 jat1 joeng6, nei5 dou1 m4 zi1 seon3 m4 seon3 dak1 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人变化无常，你都不知道能不能相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's so inconsistent, you don't even know if you can trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲天氣一時一樣，陣間落雨，陣間又出太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tin1 hei3 jat1 si4 jat1 joeng6, zan6 gaan1 lok6 jyu5, zan6 gaan1 jau6 chut1 taai3 yeung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这天气变化无常，一会儿下雨，一会儿又出太阳。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so unpredictable, one minute it's raining, the next it's sunny.

english_meaning: a short period of time, a little while, momentarily
explanation_mandarin: 指很短的时间，一会儿的工夫。
explanation_english: Refers to a very short period of time, a little while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你等我一時三刻，我搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dang2 ngo5 jat1 si4 saam1 hak1, ngo5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你等我一会儿，我就能搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a short while, and I'll get it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一時三刻都唔得閒，真係好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 si4 saam1 hak1 dou1 m4 dak1 haan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连一会儿空闲时间都没有，真的很忙。
examples.english_sentence: I don't even have a moment to spare, I'm really busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一時三刻學唔識嘅嘢，唔使咁心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 si4 saam1 hak1 hok6 m4 sik1 ge3 ye5, m4 sai2 gam3 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一时半会儿学不会的东西，不用那么着急。
examples.english_sentence: You don't have to rush to learn something you can't learn in a short time.

english_meaning: a moment of pleasure; momentary gratification; acting on impulse; driven by a fleeting desire
explanation_mandarin: 指为了短暂的快乐或满足而做出不理智或不计后果的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something rash or without considering the consequences, solely for a brief moment of pleasure or satisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗一時之快，洗晒啲錢去賭錢，而家後悔都冇用啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jat1 si4 zi1 faai3, sai2晒啲錢 heoi3 dou2錢, ji4 gaa1 hau6 fui3 dou1 mou5 jung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了追求一时痛快，把所有的钱都拿去赌博了，现在后悔也没用了。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled away all his money for a moment of pleasure, and now it's no use regretting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為咗一時之快，食咁多甜嘢，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 jat1 si4 zi1 faai3, sik6 gam3 do1 tim4 je5, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为了贪图一时的快乐，吃那么多甜的东西，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't indulge in so many sweets for a fleeting moment of pleasure, it's not good for your health.

english_meaning: in a short space of time; for a short while; suddenly; momentarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示在很短的时间内，通常表示突然发生或一时难以反应的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time, often referring to a sudden occurrence or a situation where it's difficult to react immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一時之間諗唔到咁多嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 si4 zi1 gaan1 nam2 m4 dou2 gam3 do1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一时之间想不了那么多东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: I can't think of so many things all of a sudden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時之間唔知點做好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 zi1 gaan1 m4 zi1 dim2 zou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时之间不知道怎么做好。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't know what to do for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，我一時之間反應唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 jat1 si4 zi1 gaan1 faan2 jing3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息，我一时之间反应不过来。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing this news, I couldn't react for a moment.

english_meaning: a short period of time; a little while; not long
explanation_mandarin: 表示很短的时间，一段时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a short period of time; a little while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時半時都搞唔掂，要等多陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 bun3 si4 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6, jiu3 dang2 do1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时半会儿都搞不定，要再等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I won't be able to finish it in a little while, I need to wait a bit longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題一時半時都解釋唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jat1 si4 bun3 si4 dou1 gaai2 sik1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题一时半会儿也解释不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This problem can't be explained clearly in a short time.

english_meaning: slip of the tongue; to speak without thinking; to say something unintentionally or carelessly
explanation_mandarin: 指说话不经大脑，无意中说出了不该说的话。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking without thinking, unintentionally saying something that should not be said; a slip of the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係有心嘅，一時口快講錯咗嘢，唔好嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3, jat1 si4 hau2 faai3 gong2 co3 zo2 je5, m4 hou2 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是故意的，一时嘴快说错了话，别生气了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't mean it. It was a slip of the tongue, I said the wrong thing. Don't be angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時口快，將公司嘅秘密講咗畀其他人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 hau2 faai3, zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 bei3 mat6 gong2 zo2 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时嘴快，把公司的秘密告诉了其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke without thinking and revealed the company's secrets to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哎呀，我一時口快，唔小心踢爆咗佢嘅秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1, ngo5 jat1 si4 hau2 faai3, m4 siu2 sam1 tek3 baau3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀，我一时嘴快，不小心揭穿了他的秘密。
examples.english_sentence: Oops, I blurted it out. I accidentally revealed his secret.

jyutping: jat1 si4 m4 tau1 gai1 zau6 zou6 bou2 zoeng2
mandarin_meaning: 一会儿不耍滑头就当领导/官
english_meaning: If you don't cut corners for a while, you become a leader/official.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人如果长时间不投机取巧，老老实实，反而能够获得更高的职位或权力。带有讽刺意味，暗示社会上一些人靠不正当手段上位。
explanation_english: This idiom sarcastically describes a situation where someone who refrains from cutting corners or being opportunistic for a period of time ends up in a higher position or gaining power. It implies that some people in society rise to power through dishonest means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界就係咁㗎啦，一時唔偷雞就做保長，好多嘢都要識得變通先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, jat1 si4 m4 tau1 gai1 zau6 zou6 bou2 zoeng2, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 jiu3 sik1 dak1 bin3 tung1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界就是这样的，一会儿不耍滑头就当领导，很多事情都要懂得变通才行。
examples.english_sentence: That's just how the world is. If you don't cut corners for a while, you become a leader. You have to know how to be flexible.

jyutping: jat1 si4 m4 tau1 gai1 zau6 zou6 bou2 zoeng2*
mandarin_meaning: 一会儿不占小便宜就吃亏
english_meaning: If you don't take small advantages (cheat/skive) occasionally, you're a fool.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人如果不偶尔占些小便宜，就会吃亏。多用于劝人或调侃人要学会变通，不要太老实。*偷鷄（tou1 gai1）指偷鸡摸狗，占小便宜。保长（bou2 zoeng2）是旧时地方官职，相当于现在的村长，这里引申为老实本分的人。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone believes that if they don't occasionally take small advantages or 'cheat the system', they will be at a disadvantage. It is often used to advise or tease someone to be more flexible and less naive. *偷鷄 (tau1 gai1) refers to 'stealing chickens' or taking small advantages. 保長 (bou2 zoeng2) was a local official in the past, similar to a village head, and here it implies someone who is honest and straightforward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔識得偷雞嘅話，真係一時唔偷鷄就做保長㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 sik1 dak1 tau1 gai1 ge3 waa2, zan1 hai6 jat1 si4 m4 tau1 gai1 zau6 zou6 bou2 zoeng2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你工作不知道偷懒，那你真是不占小便宜就要吃亏了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't know how to slack off at work, you'll really be at a disadvantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁老實啦，一時唔偷鷄就做保長㗎，學精啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou5 sat6 laa1, jat1 si4 m4 tau1 gai1 zau6 zou6 bou2 zoeng2 gaa3, hok6 zing1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么老实啦，你不占点小便宜就要吃亏了，学聪明点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so honest, you'll be a fool if you don't take some advantage sometimes, learn to be a bit smarter.

english_meaning: spur of the moment; acting on impulse; carried away by momentary passion or emotions
explanation_mandarin: 指因为一时的情绪或冲动而做出的决定或行为，缺乏冷静思考。
explanation_english: Refers to making decisions or actions based on momentary emotions or impulses, lacking calm consideration. It often implies that the action might be regretted later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時意氣，就辭咗份工，而家後悔都嚟唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 ji3 hei3, zau6 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, ji4 gaa1 hau6 fui3 dou1 lai4 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时冲动，就把工作辞了，现在后悔也来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: He acted on impulse and quit his job, and now he regrets it but it's too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一時意氣同人爭，蝕底嘅都係自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 si4 ji3 hei3 tung4 jan4 zaang1, sit6 dai2 ge3 dou1 hai6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一时冲动和别人争，吃亏的都是自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act impulsively and argue with others, you'll only be the one who loses out.

english_meaning: sometimes; occasionally; now and then
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间频率不高，不是经常发生，但是会发生。 相当于“偶尔”、“有时”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens infrequently, not regularly, but it does happen. Equivalent to "sometimes" or "occasionally".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時時都會返嚟探我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 si4 dou1 wui5 faan1 lai4 taam3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有时会回来探望我们。
examples.english_sentence: He sometimes comes back to visit us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時時都會諗起以前嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 si4 dou1 wui5 nam2 hei2 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我偶尔会想起以前的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I occasionally think about things from the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一時時落雨，一時時又出太陽，真係奇怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 si4 si4 lok6 jyu5, jat1 si4 si4 jau6 ceot1 taai3 joeng4, zan1 hai6 kei4 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一会儿下雨，一会儿又出太阳，真奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes it rains, and sometimes the sun comes out, it's really strange.

mandarin_meaning: 独一无二，一时没有可以相比的
english_meaning: unrivaled, unparalleled, one of a kind, unmatched for a time
explanation_mandarin: 形容在一段时间内，没有可以与之相比的，独一无二的。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is unparalleled or unmatched for a certain period of time. Implies being the best or unique for a given duration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌聲喺樂壇真係一時無兩，冇人可以取代佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 seng1 hai2 ngok6 taan4 zan1 hai6 jat1 si4 mou4 loeng5, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 tai3 doi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌声在乐坛真是独一无二，没有人可以取代他。
examples.english_sentence: His singing voice is truly unrivaled in the music scene; no one can replace him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心做得一時無兩，日日都排哂長龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 zou6 dak1 jat1 si4 mou4 loeng5, jat1 jat1 dou1 paai4 saai3 coeng4 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心做得一时无两，每天都排着长队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dim sum is unparalleled, there's a long queue every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺運動方面嘅天賦，真係一時無兩，好少人可以做到佢咁嘅程度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wan6 dung6 fong1 min6 ge3 tin1 fu3, zan1 hai6 jat1 si4 mou4 loeng5, hou2 siu2 jan4 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou2 keoi5 gam3 ge3 cheng4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在运动方面的天赋，真是一时无两，很少人能达到他这样的程度。
examples.english_sentence: His talent in sports is truly unmatched, very few people can achieve his level.

english_meaning: on a whim, on the spur of the moment, acted on impulse
explanation_mandarin: 指突然产生的念头或兴趣，并因此而行动。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden idea or interest that leads to immediate action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時興起就買咗張飛去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 hing3 hei2 zau6 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 fei1 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时兴起就买了张票去日本。
examples.english_sentence: On a whim, I bought a ticket to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時興起話要學游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 hing3 hei2 waa6 jiu3 hok6 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时兴起说要学游泳。
examples.english_sentence: On the spur of the moment, he said he wanted to learn swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一時興起就去咗食宵夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 si4 hing3 hei2 zau6 heoi3 zo2 sik6 siu1 je2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一时兴起就去吃宵夜了。
examples.english_sentence: On impulse, we went to have a midnight snack.

synonyms: 心血來潮 (sam1 hyut3 lai4 ciu4)

english_meaning: for a short while; for a time; momentarily; suddenly
explanation_mandarin: 表示很短的时间或一段时间；也表示突然。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time; can also mean suddenly or for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時間諗唔起佢個名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 gaan3 lam2 m4 hei2 keoi5 go3 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时想不起他的名字。
examples.english_sentence: I can't recall his name for the moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時間唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 gaan3 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时不知道该怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't know what to do for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時間反應唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 gaan3 faan2 jing3 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时反应不过来。
examples.english_sentence: I couldn't react in time for a moment/I was too slow to react.

english_meaning: a while, a moment, a little while
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暂的时间，相当于“一会儿”。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time; equivalent to 'a while' or 'a moment'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我一會，我搞掂啲嘢就過嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 jat1 wui2, ngo5 gaau2 dim6 di1 je5 zau6 gwo3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我一会儿，我把这些东西弄完就过来。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a while, I'll come over after I finish these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一會見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 wui2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一会儿见。
examples.english_sentence: See you in a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以畀多一會時間我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 do1 jat1 wui2 si4 gaan3 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以再给我一点时间啊？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a little more time?

english_meaning: a little while; a moment; in a little while; soon
explanation_mandarin: 表示很短的一段时间；表示稍后、一会儿。
explanation_english: Refers to a short period of time; indicates 'a little while later', 'soon'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一會兒返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 wui2 ji4 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一会儿回来。
examples.english_sentence: I'll be back in a little while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你等我一會兒，我搞掂啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dang2 ngo5 jat1 wui2 ji4, ngo5 gaau2 dim6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你等我一会儿，我处理完一些事情。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a moment, I'll finish up some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一會兒就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 wui2 ji4 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一会儿就到。
examples.english_sentence: He will arrive in a little while.

english_meaning: January
explanation_mandarin: 公历的第一个月。
explanation_english: The first month of the Gregorian calendar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常喺一月去日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hai2 jat1 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常在一月去日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I usually go to Japan for travel in January.

english_meaning: A puff of smoke; a short period of time; quickly vanished
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常短暂，或者东西很快消失不见。
explanation_english: Describes something that happens very quickly or disappears rapidly, like a puff of smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似一朕煙咁，轉眼就唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jat1 zan6 jin1 gam2, zyun2 ngaan5 zau6 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像一阵烟似的，转眼就不见了。
examples.english_sentence: He was like a puff of smoke; he disappeared in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅感情好似一朕煙咁，好快就散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gam2 cing4 hou2 ci5 jat1 zan6 jin1 gam2, hou2 faai3 zau6 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的感情好像一阵烟一样，很快就散了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship was like a puff of smoke; it dissolved very quickly.

english_meaning: boundless; vast; as far as the eye can see
explanation_mandarin: 形容一眼看不到边际，非常辽阔。
explanation_english: Describes something so vast that it stretches as far as the eye can see, without any visible boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋企喺山頂，望落去一片一望無際嘅田野。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kei5 hai2 saan1 deng2, mong6 lok6 heoi3 jat1 pin3 jat1 mong6 mou4 zai3 ge3 tin4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们站在山顶，往下看是一片一望无际的田野。
examples.english_sentence: We stood on the mountaintop and looked down at the boundless fields.

english_meaning: overnight, in a short period of time, a day and a night
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间短暂或事情并非一蹴而就，需要长时间的积累。
explanation_english: Describes a short period of time or that something cannot be achieved overnight and requires long-term accumulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學語言唔係一朝一夕嘅事，要持之以恆先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyu5 jin4 m4 hai6 jat1 ziu1 jat1 zik6 ge3 si6, jiu3 ci4 zi1 ji5 hang4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习语言不是一朝一夕的事情，要持之以恒才行。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a language is not an overnight thing; you have to persevere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅成功唔係一朝一夕嘅，係經過好多人嘅努力先有今日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 jat1 ziu1 jat1 zik6 ge3, hai6 ging1 gwo3 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 nu5 lik6 sin1 jau5 gam1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的成功不是一朝一夕的，是经过很多人的努力才有今天的成就。
examples.english_sentence: This company's success was not achieved overnight; it was the result of the efforts of many people to get to where it is today.

jyutping: jat1 ciu4 tin1 zi2 jat1 ciu4 san4
english_meaning: A new emperor, a new set of officials. (With a change in leadership, there's also a change in personnel.)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻改朝换代，官员也会随着改变。也指领导者更换，下属也会跟着调整。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where, with a change in dynasty or leadership, the officials and personnel also change. It implies a shift in power and influence, as the new leader brings in their own people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司畀新老闆收購咗之後，真係一朝天子一朝臣，好多舊人都要走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 san1 lou5 baan2 sau1 gau3 zo2 zi1 hau6, zan1 hai6 jat1 ciu4 tin1 zi2 jat1 ciu4 san4, hou2 do1 gau6 jan4 dou1 jiu3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司被新老板收购之后，真是一朝天子一朝臣，很多旧人都要走了。
examples.english_sentence: After the company was acquired by the new boss, it really became a case of a new emperor, a new set of officials; many of the old staff had to leave.

english_meaning: suddenly successful; to become successful overnight
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人突然获得成功或权力后，态度傲慢、得意忘形。
explanation_english: Describes someone who becomes arrogant and conceited after suddenly achieving success or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩之後，一朝得志，連啲舊朋友都唔認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 zi1 hau6, jat1 ziu1 dak1 zi3, lin4 di1 gau6 pang4 jau5 dou1 m4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票之后，一时得志，连老朋友都不认了。
examples.english_sentence: After he won the lottery, he became suddenly successful and wouldn't even acknowledge his old friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快一朝得志呀，仲有好多嘢要學㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 jat1 ziu1 dak1 zi3 aa3, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 hok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快就得意忘形，还有很多东西要学的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't become too proud too quickly, there's still a lot to learn.

english_meaning: early in the morning
explanation_mandarin: 指很早的早上，通常指刚起床的时间段。
explanation_english: Refers to the early morning, usually the time period right after waking up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一朝早就要返工，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ziu1 zou2 zau6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一大早就要上班，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work early in the morning. It's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一朝早起身，飲杯咖啡提下神先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1, yam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 tai4 haa5 san4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一大早起床，先喝杯咖啡提提神。
examples.english_sentence: Wake up early in the morning, drink a cup of coffee to refresh myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一朝早做乜咁嘈呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ziu1 zou2 zou6 mat1 gaa3 gam3 cou4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一大早在吵什么呀？
examples.english_sentence: What are you making so much noise about early in the morning?

english_meaning: One time, one meeting; treasure every encounter because it will never be exactly the same again.
explanation_mandarin: 源自日本茶道，强调珍惜每次相遇的机会，因为人、事、时、地都不会完全一样，每次都是独一无二的。提醒人们要珍惜当下，真诚待人。
explanation_english: Originating from Japanese tea ceremony, this idiom emphasizes the importance of cherishing every encounter, as the people, events, time, and place will never be exactly the same again. It reminds people to treasure the present moment and treat others sincerely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每次見面都要當一期一會咁珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 ci3 gin3 min6 dou1 jiu3 dong3 jat1 kei4 jat1 wui2 gam2 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每次见面都要当作一生一次那样珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: We should cherish every time we meet as if it's a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機會好難得，要一期一會咁把握住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 wui2 hou2 naan4 dak1, jiu3 jat1 kei4 jat1 wui2 gam2 baa2 ak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机会很难得，要当作一生一次那样把握住。
examples.english_sentence: This opportunity is rare, we should seize it as if it's a once-in-a-lifetime chance.

mandarin_meaning: 一本书; 认真; 死板
english_meaning: One book; serious; rigid; inflexible; by the book
explanation_mandarin: （1）一本：字面意思是一本书。（2）形容人做事认真，死板，不知变通。也可指这个人很古板，按部就班。
explanation_english: (1) One book: The literal meaning is one book. (2) To describe someone who is serious, rigid, and inflexible in their work. It can also refer to someone who is old-fashioned and follows procedures strictly; by the book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好一本㗎，一步一步跟足程序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jat1 bun2 gaa3, jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 gan1 zuk1 cing4 seoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很死板，一步一步都按照程序。
examples.english_sentence: He is very rigid in his work, following the procedures step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁一本啫，有啲嘢可以靈活處理嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 jat1 bun2 ze1, jau5 di1 je5 ho2 ji5 ling4 wok6 cyu5 lei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么死板嘛，有些事情可以灵活处理的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid, some things can be handled flexibly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書好有趣，我可以睇成晚
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 jau5 cheoi3, ngo5 ho2 ji5 tai2 sing4 maan5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很有趣，我可以看一整晚
examples.english_sentence: This book is very interesting, I can read it all night.

english_meaning: deadly serious; with a straight face; in all seriousness
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度严肃认真，非常正经的样子。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude that is serious, solemn, and proper, often to the point of being unintentionally humorous or overly formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明講笑，但係一本正經噉樣，搞到我都唔知佢係咪真係講緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 gong2 siu3, daan6 hai6 jat1 bun2 zing3 ging1 gam2 joeng2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 mai4 zan1 hai6 gong2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明在开玩笑，但是一本正经的样子，搞得我都不知道他是不是真的在说。
examples.english_sentence: He was obviously joking, but he was so deadly serious that I couldn't tell if he was actually being serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁一本正經啦，輕鬆啲咪好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 bun2 zing3 ging1 laa1, hing1 sung1 di1 mai1 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么一本正经啦，轻松一点不好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so serious, isn't it better to relax a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一本正經咁話要辭職，嚇咗我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bun2 zing3 ging1 gam2 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1, haak3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一本正经地说要辞职，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to resign with a straight face, which gave me quite a scare.

english_meaning: High profit with little investment; A great return for a small investment; To make a killing
explanation_mandarin: 用少量的本钱获取极大的利润。形容投资少，收益大。
explanation_english: Describes a business or investment that yields a very high profit with minimal initial investment. It implies making a large fortune with little effort or risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅投資策略真係一本萬利，短短幾年就賺咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 tau4 zi1 chak3 lyut6 zan1 hai6 jat1 bun2 maan6 lei6, dyun2 dyun2 gei2 nin4 zau6 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司投资策略真是一本万利，短短几年就赚了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's investment strategy is truly high profit with little investment, they've earned a lot of money in just a few years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果做生意可以做到一本萬利就好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zou6 seng1 ji3 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou3 jat1 bun2 maan6 lei6 zau6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果做生意可以做到一本万利就好了。
examples.english_sentence: It would be great if doing business could be so profitable that it's high profit with little investment.

jyutping: jat1 bun2 tung1 syu1 tai2 dou3 lou5
english_meaning: To stick rigidly to old principles; inflexible; unable to adapt to change; someone who learns something once and never deviates from it.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻思想固执，食古不化，不会根据实际情况改变。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to someone who rigidly adheres to old principles and refuses to adapt to new circumstances. They are seen as inflexible and unwilling to change their ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁一本通書睇到老啦，時代唔同咗，方法都要變㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 bun2 tung1 syu1 tai2 dou3 lou5 laa1, si4 doi6 m4 tung4 zo2, fong1 faat3 dou1 jiu3 bin3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么食古不化，时代不同了，方法也要改变。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inflexible, times have changed, methods need to adapt too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一本通書睇到老，啲新嘢佢完全唔接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 bun2 tung1 syu1 tai2 dou3 lou5, di1 san1 je5 keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是食古不化，新的东西他完全不接受。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stuck in his ways, he doesn't accept anything new.

jyutping: jat1 do2 sin1 faa1 caap3 zoi6 ngau4 fan3 soeng6
english_meaning: A beautiful flower planted in cow dung; A beautiful/good woman married to an ugly/worthless man.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻美好的事物与丑恶的事物结合在一起，多指年轻貌美的女子嫁给其貌不扬或品行不端的人。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe a situation where something beautiful or precious is wasted on or associated with something ugly, undesirable, or unworthy. It is most commonly used to describe a situation where a beautiful, kind, or virtuous woman is married to a man who is unattractive, unpleasant, or morally questionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁靚女，點解會嫁個咁樣衰嘅男人，真係一朵鮮花插在牛糞上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 leng3 neoi2, dim2 gaai2 wui5 gaa3 go3 gam3 joeng2 seoi2 ge3 naam4 jan2, zan1 hai6 jat1 do2 sin1 faa1 caap3 zoi6 ngau4 fan3 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么漂亮，为什么会嫁给那么丑的男人，真是一朵鲜花插在牛粪上。
examples.english_sentence: She's so beautiful, why would she marry such an ugly man? It's really a beautiful flower planted in cow dung.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個靚女醫生竟然同個爛賭鬼一齊，真係一朵鮮花插在牛糞上呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 leng3 neoi2 ji1 sang1 ging2 jin4 tung4 go3 laan6 dou2 gwai2 jat1 cai4, zan1 hai6 jat1 do2 sin1 faa1 caap3 zoi6 ngau4 fan3 soeng6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个漂亮女医生竟然和那个赌徒在一起，真是一朵鲜花插在牛粪上啊。
examples.english_sentence: That beautiful female doctor is actually together with that gambler, it's really a beautiful flower planted in cow dung.

mandarin_meaning: 单身汉; 单干户; 独自一人
english_meaning: Single; loner; doing something alone; operating solo; one-man band
explanation_mandarin: 指单身汉，也指独自一人做事情，没有同伴或帮助。形容人独立自主，或孤单。
explanation_english: Refers to a single man, or someone who does things alone without companions or help. Describes a person who is independent or lonely and self-reliant, doing things alone without support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁多年都係一枝公，都慣晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 do1 nin4 dou1 hai6 jat1 zi1 gung1, dou1 gwaan3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么多年都是单身，已经习惯了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been single for so many years, he's used to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司得佢一個一枝公咁做晒所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 jat1 zi1 gung1 gam2 zou6 saai3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司只有他一个人像单干户一样做完所有的事情。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, he's the only one doing everything like a one-man band.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想一枝公去旅行，想搵個人陪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 jat1 zi1 gung1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 wan2 go3 jan4 pui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想独自一人去旅行，想找个人陪。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to travel alone, I want to find someone to come with me.

english_meaning: to stand out from the crowd; to be the only one that excels; to shine brightly
explanation_mandarin: 形容在同类事物中，只有一样特别突出，非常优秀。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where only one entity stands out and excels among others of its kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺嗰間公司入面，一枝獨秀，好快就升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 jap6 min6, jat1 zi1 duk6 sau3, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司里，一枝独秀，很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He stood out in that company and was quickly promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱得咁好，喺成個比賽度真係一枝獨秀。

explanation_mandarin: 指一个人单独行动，没有同伴。也可以指单身人士，或者形容某人性格孤僻。

english_meaning: of one heart; united; with one mind; wholeheartedly
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家思想一致，齐心协力，共同努力。

english_meaning: in one breath; without stopping; in one go; nonstop; continuously
explanation_mandarin: 指一口气完成，中间不停顿。
explanation_english: Refers to completing something in one breath, without stopping in between. It can also mean doing something continuously or without interruption.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气讲完了整件事情的经过。

explanation_mandarin: 指提供全面、连续的服务，从头到尾一条线完成。

examples.english_sentence: Their all-in-one wedding package is very convenient.

english_meaning: Two apartments per floor (referring to a building layout)
explanation_mandarin: 指住宅楼房每层只有两户人家。

explanation_mandarin: 表示完全没有，连一个都没有。形容数量为零，或者指没有任何收获、结果。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两件衣服一模一样，你怎么分辨哪件是哪件？
examples.english_sentence: These two shirts are exactly the same, how can you tell which is which?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個複製本同正本一模一樣，簡直係真假難分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fuk1 zai3 bun2 tung4 zeng3 bun2 jat1 mou4 jat1 joeng6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 zan1 gaa2 naan4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个复制品和正本一模一样，简直是真假难辨。
examples.english_sentence: This copy is exactly the same as the original; it's practically impossible to tell them apart.

english_meaning: same; identical; alike; equally; just like
explanation_mandarin: 表示性质、状态相同或相似；也表示程度相同。
explanation_english: Indicates that the nature or state is the same or similar; also indicates the same degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個着住一樣嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zoek3 zyu6 jat1 joeng6 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个穿着一样的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: They are both wearing the same clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣同琴日一樣咁熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 tung4 kam4 jat6 jat1 joeng6 gam3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气和昨天一样热。
examples.english_sentence: The weather today is just as hot as yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同我一樣咁諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 ngo5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和我一样这么想。
examples.english_sentence: You think the same way as me.

jyutping: jat1 joeng6 mai5 joeng5 baak3 joeng6 jan4
english_meaning: One rice feeds a hundred kinds of people; People vary even though they share similar circumstances; Different strokes for different folks.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻同样的环境和条件，会造就出各种各样不同的人。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people are different even if they are raised in the same environment or under the same circumstances. It highlights the diversity of human nature and that people will have different characters, behaviors, and personalities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司咁多同事，真係一樣米養百樣人，咩性格嘅人都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gam3 do1 tung4 si6, zan1 hai6 jat1 joeng6 mai5 joeng5 baak3 joeng6 jan4, me1 sing3 gaak3 ge3 jan4 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司这么多同事，真是一方水土养百样人，什么性格的人都有。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many colleagues in this company, it's really true that one rice feeds a hundred kinds of people, there are people with all sorts of personalities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解佢哋兩兄弟性格差咁遠嘅？真係一樣米養百樣人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gai2 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 sing3 gaak3 caa1 gam3 jyun5 ge3? zan1 hai6 jat1 joeng6 mai5 joeng5 baak3 joeng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为什么他们两兄弟性格差别这么大？真是一方水土养百样人。
examples.english_sentence: Why are the personalities of the two brothers so different? It really is true that one rice feeds a hundred kinds of people.

jyutping: jat1 syu6 lei4 faa1 aat3 hoi2 tong4
english_meaning: An old man marries a young woman
explanation_mandarin: 比喻老夫少妻的情况，多含戏谑意味。 梨花形容老翁如雪白的头发，海棠形容年轻貌美的女子。
explanation_english: A metaphor for an old man marrying a young woman. Often used in a humorous or slightly mocking way.  The pear blossoms (梨花) symbolize the old man's white hair, while the begonia (海棠) symbolizes the young and beautiful woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个年纪差咁远结婚，真系一樹梨花壓海棠咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 nin4 gei2 caa1 gam3 jyun5 git3 fan1, zan1 hai6 jat1 syu6 lei4 faa1 aat3 hoi2 tong4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个年龄差那么多结婚，真是老夫少妻啊。
examples.english_sentence: They got married with such a big age gap, it's really an old man marrying a young woman.

english_meaning: time and time again; again and again; repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情重复发生多次，强调重复的频率。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens repeatedly, emphasizing the frequency of the repetition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一次又一次咁原諒佢，但係佢都係唔生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 gam2 jyun4 loeng6 keoi5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 si6 m4 sang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一次又一次地原谅他，但他还是不争气。
examples.english_sentence: I forgave him time and time again, but he still hasn't improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一次又一次咁遲到，老闆嬲到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 gam2 ci4 dou3, lou5 baan2 nau1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一次又一次地迟到，老板非常生气。
examples.english_sentence: He's late time and time again, and the boss is furious.

jyutping: jat1 ci3 saang1 loeng5 ci3 suk6
english_meaning: Practice makes perfect; first time is unfamiliar, the second time is easier.
explanation_mandarin: 第一次做某件事情可能不太熟悉，第二次就会熟练很多。
explanation_english: The first time doing something might be unfamiliar, but the second time will be much easier and more skillful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，一次生兩次熟啫，下次就會好啲嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, jat1 ci3 saang1 loeng5 ci3 suk6 ze1, haa6 ci3 zau6 wui5 hou2 di1 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用害怕，一次生二回熟嘛，下次就会好一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, practice makes perfect, you'll do better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢都係咁㗎啦，一次生兩次熟，慢慢就上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 dou1 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, jat1 ci3 saang1 loeng5 ci3 suk6, maan6 maan2 zau6 soeng5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作就是这样的，一回生二回熟，慢慢就熟练了。
examples.english_sentence: That's how work is, you get better with practice, and you'll get the hang of it.

english_meaning: all at once; in one go; once and for all; lump sum
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次完成，不分多次；一次性解决问题。
explanation_english: Refers to completing something at once, without doing it in multiple stages. It can also mean resolving an issue in a single instance or transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住一次過搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 jat1 ci3 gwo3 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想一次性把这件事办完。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to get this done all at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲稅一次過交晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 seoi3 jat1 ci3 gwo3 gaau2 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把这些税一次性全部交了。
examples.english_sentence: Pay all these taxes in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一次過買咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一次性买了好多东西。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lot of things all at once.

english_meaning: step by step, gradually
explanation_mandarin: 表示按次序，循序渐进地进行。
explanation_english: Describes doing something in order, gradually, step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一步步嚟，唔可以心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 bou6 bou6 lai4, m4 ho2 ji5 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一步步来，不能着急。
examples.english_sentence: We need to take it step by step, we can't be impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一步步咁爬上去，終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bou6 bou6 gam2 paa4 soeng5 heoi3, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一步步地往上爬，终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: He climbed up step by step and finally succeeded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習語言要一步步打好基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jyu5 jin4 jiu3 jat1 bou6 bou6 daa2 hou2 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习语言要一步步打好基础。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a language requires building a solid foundation step by step.

english_meaning: to ascend to heaven in one step; to achieve instant success; to reach the sky in a single bound
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一下子就达到很高的境界或地位。 也比喻幻想一下子成功。
explanation_english: Metaphorically describes achieving a very high level or position instantly. Also refers to fantasizing about instant success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔好諗住一步登天，要腳踏實地先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1, jiu3 goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不要想着一步登天，要脚踏实地才行。
examples.english_sentence: In life, don't think about achieving instant success; you need to be down-to-earth and work hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想靠炒股一步登天，點知蝕到一乾二淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 kaau3 caau2 gu2 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1, dim2 zi1 sit6 dou3 jat1 gon1 ji6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想靠炒股一步登天，结果亏得一干二净。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to get rich quickly by speculating in stocks, but ended up losing everything.

synonyms: 平步青雲 (ping4 bou6 cing1 wan4)

mandarin_meaning: 满眶眼泪; 泪流满面
english_meaning: A face full of tears; on the verge of tears; about to cry a lot
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常伤心，眼泪几乎要从眼眶里溢出来，或者已经哭了出来，满脸都是眼泪。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely sad, on the verge of crying a lot, or already crying with a face full of tears. It emphasizes the abundance of tears and the intense sadness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗好多錢，喊到一殼眼淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, haam3 dou3 jat1 hok3 ngaan5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了很多钱，哭得满脸是泪。
examples.english_sentence: He was cheated out of a lot of money and cried a face full of tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完呢套戲，我感動到一殼眼淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 ni1 tou3 hei3, ngo5 gam2 dung6 dou3 jat1 hok3 ngaan5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完这部电影，我感动得泪流满面。
examples.english_sentence: After watching this movie, I was so touched that I cried a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，日日都一殼眼淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat1 dou1 jat1 hok3 ngaan5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她失恋之后，每天都哭得泪流满面。
examples.english_sentence: After her heartbreak, she cried every day.

english_meaning: stingy; extremely tight-fisted; unwilling to give up even a feather
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常吝啬，连一根毫毛都不肯拔下来。比喻极其自私，不肯付出或帮助别人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely stingy, unwilling to part with even a single hair. It's a metaphor for extreme selfishness, refusing to give or help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一毛不拔，請佢食餐飯都難過登天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 mou4 bat1 bat6, cheng2 keoi5 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 naan4 gwo3 dang1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一毛不拔，请他吃顿饭都难如登天。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy, it's as difficult as climbing to heaven to treat him to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁一毛不拔啦，請同事飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 mou4 bat1 bat6 laa1, cheng2 tung4 si6 yam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么一毛不拔了，请同事喝一杯饮料而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, it's just treating your colleague to a drink.

english_meaning: in one go; in one breath; without stopping; all at once; consistent style
explanation_mandarin: 表示连续不断地完成某个动作，中间没有停顿。
explanation_english: Describes completing an action continuously without interruption; in a single burst.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一氣讀曬成本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hei3 duk6 saai3 sing4 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气读完了整本书。
examples.english_sentence: He read the whole book in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一氣講咗成個故仔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hei3 gong2 zo2 sing4 go3 gu3 zai2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气把整个故事都讲出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He told the whole story in one breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一氣搞掂曬啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 hei3 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一口气把所有的事情都搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: They finished all the things in one go.

english_meaning: to do something in one go; to accomplish something at one stroke; to complete in one breath; in one continuous effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容文章结构紧凑，文气连贯。也比喻一件事情自始至终一口气做成。
explanation_english: Describes a piece of writing with a tight structure and coherent style. Also used to describe completing something from beginning to end in one continuous effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目佢用咗成個月時間準備，最後一氣呵成咁完成咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 keoi5 yung6 zo2 sing4 go3 jyut6 si4 gaan3 zhun2 bei6, zeui3 hau6 jat1 hei3 ho1 sing4 gam2 waan4 sing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这个项目准备了一个月，最后一口气完成了。
examples.english_sentence: He prepared for this project for a whole month, and finally completed it in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫畫好叻，成幅畫一氣呵成，好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 hou2 lek1, sing4 fuk1 waa2 jat1 hei3 ho1 sing4, hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画很厉害，整幅画一气呵成，很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at painting; the whole painting was completed in one continuous effort, with great momentum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個故仔佢一氣呵成咁講完，聽眾都覺得好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gu3 zai2 keoi5 jat1 hei3 ho1 sing4 gam2 gong2 yun4, ting1 zhung3 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 jing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气讲完了这个故事，听众都觉得很精彩。
examples.english_sentence: He finished telling the story in one breath, and the audience found it very exciting.

english_meaning: carbon monoxide
explanation_mandarin: 一种无色无味的有毒气体，化学式为CO。
explanation_english: A colorless, odorless, and poisonous gas with the chemical formula CO.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天要小心煤氣爐嘅一氧化碳中毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 mui4 hei3 lou4 ge3 jat1 joeng5 faa3 taan3 zung3 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天要小心煤气炉的一氧化碳中毒。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful of carbon monoxide poisoning from gas stoves in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為吸入過多一氧化碳而暈咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 kap1 jap6 gwo3 do1 jat1 joeng5 faa3 taan3 ji4 wan4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为吸入过多一氧化碳而晕倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He fainted because he inhaled too much carbon monoxide.

english_meaning: stagnant water; a situation that is stagnant and lacking in progress or vitality
explanation_mandarin: 比喻停滞不前，毫无生气的事物或环境。
explanation_english: Literally means 'a pool of dead water'. Figuratively, it describes a situation, organization, or environment that is stagnant, lacking innovation, and without progress or vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好似一池死水咁，做嘢冇晒動力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 jat1 ci4 si2 seoi2 gam2, zou6 je5 mou5 saai3 dung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司好像一潭死水一样，做事都没动力了。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like a pool of stagnant water; there's no motivation to work anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係已經變成一池死水，冇晒激情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ji5 ging1 bin3 sing4 jat1 ci4 si2 seoi2, mou5 saai3 gik1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系已经变成一潭死水，没有激情了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has become stagnant and lifeless; there's no passion left.

english_meaning: To have a showdown, to determine the winner, to settle the matter once and for all
explanation_mandarin: 指通过一次决定性的比赛或争斗来决定胜负。
explanation_english: Refers to determining the winner of a competition or dispute through a decisive match or battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日喺波場一決勝負！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 hai2 bo1 coeng4 jat1 kyut3 sing4 fu6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天在球场一决胜负！
examples.english_sentence: We'll have a showdown on the field tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試就係一決勝負嘅時候喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zau6 hai6 jat1 kyut3 sing4 fu6 ge3 si4 hau6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试就是一决胜负的时候了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is the time to determine the winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋玩鋪啤牌一決勝負啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 waan2 pou1 be1 paai4 jat1 kyut3 sing4 fu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们玩一局扑克牌一决胜负吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we play a round of poker to decide who wins?

english_meaning: to have a showdown; to decide who is superior
explanation_mandarin: 指通过竞争或比赛来决定谁更优秀、更强。
explanation_english: To compete in order to determine who is superior or the winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如嚟一場波，一決高下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 lai4 jat1 coeng4 bo1, jat1 kyut3 gou1 haa6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如来一场比赛，一决胜负吧！
examples.english_sentence: How about we play a game and have a showdown!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗呢個項目嘅負責人，決定一決高下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 fu6 zaak3 jan4, kyut3 ding6 jat1 kyut3 gou1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了这个项目的负责人，决定一决胜负。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them decided to compete to decide who would be in charge of this project.

english_meaning: to collapse and never recover; to fall and not be able to rise again; to be down and out
explanation_mandarin: 形容遭受重大挫折后，丧失信心和能力，无法重新振作。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone suffers a significant setback and loses confidence and ability, making it impossible to recover or bounce back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經歷咗場金融風暴之後，一沉不起啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 lik6 zo2 coeng4 gam1 jung4 fung1 bou6 zi1 hau6, jat1 cam4 bat1 hei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司经历了金融风暴后，一蹶不振了。
examples.english_sentence: That company collapsed and never recovered after experiencing the financial crisis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從失業之後，就好似一沉不起咁，日日都喺屋企飲酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 cam4 bat1 hei2 gam2, jat1 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 jam2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自从失业之后，就好像一蹶不振一样，每天都在家里喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he lost his job, he's been down and out, drinking at home every day.

synonyms: 一蹶不振 (jat1 kyut3 bat1 zan3)

mandarin_meaning: 墙倒众人推 (qiáng dǎo zhòng rén tuī)
english_meaning: To kick someone when they're down; to pile on someone who's already in trouble; when a person is down on their luck, everyone abuses them.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人一旦失势，就会受到众人的欺压和落井下石。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone who has fallen from grace or is in a difficult situation is further abused and taken advantage of by others. It suggests a lack of empathy and a tendency to exploit someone's vulnerability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司執笠之後，啲債主一沉百踩，搞到佢好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1 zi1 hau6, di1 zaai3 zyu2 jat1 cam4 baak3 caai2, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他公司倒闭之后，那些债主都落井下石，搞得他很惨。
examples.english_sentence: After his company went bankrupt, the creditors all piled on him, making things even worse for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗錯，就俾人一沉百踩，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 co3, zau6 bei2 jan4 jat1 cam4 baak3 caai2, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了错，就被大家落井下石，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake, and everyone kicked him when he was down, it's really pathetic.

mandarin_meaning: 一口气, 瞬间的气势或力量
english_meaning: A burst of energy or enthusiasm; a flash in the pan; a temporary surge of motivation or power
explanation_mandarin: 形容短暂的、爆发式的能量或动力，通常用来形容某人或某事在短暂时间内表现出很强的劲头，但很快就消失。
explanation_english: Describes a short-lived burst of energy, enthusiasm, or motivation. It's often used to describe someone or something that shows a strong initial surge, but quickly fades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先仲好落力咁做嘢，依家好似洩咗一泡氣噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 zung6 hou2 lok6 lik6 gam2 zou6 je5, ji1 gaa1 hou2 ci5 sit3 zo2 jat1 paau3 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才还很努力地工作，现在好像泄了一口气一样。
examples.english_sentence: He was working very hard just now, but now it's like he's lost all his energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅新計劃只係得一泡氣，冇耐就失敗咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 gai3 waak6 zi2 hai6 dak1 jat1 paau3 hei3, mou5 noi6 zau6 sat1 baai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的新计划只是一时的兴头，没多久就失败了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's new plan was just a flash in the pan; it failed soon after.

english_meaning: full of twists and turns, many setbacks; to have a tortuous course
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情在进行中曲折多变，一再遇到阻碍。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is full of unexpected twists, turns, and obstacles; a process that is far from smooth and is subject to multiple setbacks and reversals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅計劃真係一波三折，好彩最後都成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 jat1 bo1 saam1 zit3, hou2 coi2 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划真是一波三折，幸好最后还是成功了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan was really full of twists and turns, luckily we succeeded in the end.

jyutping: jat1 bo1 mei6 ping4, jat1 bo1 jau6 hei2
mandarin_meaning: 一波未平，一波又起 (yī bō wèi píng, yī bō yòu qǐ)
english_meaning: One wave subsides, another rises; one trouble is not settled before another crops up; out of the frying pan, into the fire.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个问题还没有解决，新的问题又出现了。形容事情接连不断，困难重重。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one problem has barely been resolved before another arises. It implies a continuous stream of troubles and difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司最近真係一波未平，一波又起，日日都聽到佢哋話要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 zan1 hai6 jat1 bo1 mei6 ping4, jat1 bo1 jau6 hei2, jat1 jat6 dou1 teng1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司最近真是一波未平，一波又起，每天都能听到他们说要加班。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has been facing a series of problems one after another recently, you hear them saying they need to work overtime everyday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢哋搬咗屋之後，一波未平，一波又起，先係水管爆裂，之後又無啦啦停電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 dei6 bun1 zo2 uk1 zi1 hau6, jat1 bo1 mei6 ping4, jat1 bo1 jau6 hei2, sin1 hai6 seoi2 gun2 baau3 lit6, zi1 hau6 jau6 mou4 laa1 laa1 ting4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他们搬家后，一波未平，一波又起，先是水管爆裂，之后又莫名其妙地停电。
examples.english_sentence: Since they moved house, it's been one problem after another. First the water pipes burst, and then there was a sudden power outage.

synonyms: 雪上加霜 (syut3 soeng6 gaa1 soeng1)

english_meaning: utter nonsense; a load of rubbish; complete balderdash
explanation_mandarin: 指完全没有根据，不负责任的话。
explanation_english: Describes speech or writing that is completely unfounded, irresponsible, and nonsensical. It implies that the speaker is talking rubbish or lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢簡直係一派胡言，唔可以信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 paai3 wu4 jin4, m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话简直是一派胡言，不可以相信的。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is utter nonsense, you can't trust it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好聽佢一派胡言，佢成日都亂講嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 jat1 paai3 wu4 jin4, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lyun6 gong2 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要听他一派胡言，他总是乱说话的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense, he always talks rubbish.

mandarin_meaning: 一流, 顶尖, 最好
english_meaning: first-class, top-notch, excellent, superb
explanation_mandarin: 指品质、水平等方面达到最好的程度，顶尖的。
explanation_english: Refers to the best quality, level, etc.; top-notch, excellent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物一流呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 jat1 lau1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一流啊！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is first-class!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅英文水平一流，可以做翻譯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ying1 man2 sui2 ping4 jat1 lau1, ho2 ji5 zou6 faan1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语水平一流，可以做翻译。
examples.english_sentence: His English level is top-notch, he can work as a translator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅性能一流，又慳油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 hing3 nang4 jat1 lau1, jau6 haan1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的性能一流，又省油。
examples.english_sentence: The performance of this car is excellent, and it's also fuel-efficient.

english_meaning: wave after wave; one after another; continuously
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或事情的影响连续不断地发生，一个接一个，连绵不绝。
explanation_english: Describes events or the impact of events happening continuously, one after another, without end; like waves constantly coming one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威者嘅情緒一浪接一浪咁高漲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 ze2 ge3 ching4 seoi5 jat1 long6 zip3 jat1 long6 gam3 go1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威者的情绪一波接一波地高涨。
examples.english_sentence: The emotions of the protesters are rising wave after wave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟衰退嘅影響一浪接一浪，好多公司都頂唔順執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 jai3 seoi1 teoi3 ge3 ying2 heong2 jat1 long6 zip3 jat1 long6, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济衰退的影响一波接一波，很多公司都顶不住倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The impact of the economic recession is coming one after another, and many companies cannot withstand it and are closing down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾日嘅新聞一浪接一浪咁爆，真係睇到我眼花繚亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 jat6 ge3 san1 man2 jat1 long6 zip3 jat1 long6 gam3 baau3, zan1 hai6 tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这几天的新闻一波接一波地爆发，真看得我眼花缭乱。
examples.english_sentence: The news these past few days has been breaking one after another, it's really dazzling.

english_meaning: perfectly clear; crystal clear; distinct; very clear
explanation_mandarin: 形容对事情或情况非常清楚，明白。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or matter that is perfectly clear, understood, and distinct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢解釋得一清二楚，我哋全部都明晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai2 sik1 dak1 jat1 cing1 ji6 co2, ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 ming4 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他解释得一清二楚，我们全都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: He explained it so clearly that we all understood it completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅來龍去脈，佢講得一清二楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 maak6, keoi5 gong2 dak1 jat1 cing1 ji6 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的来龙去脉，他讲得一清二楚。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the whole story of the matter very clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師將個概念解釋得一清二楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zoeng1 go3 koi3 nim6 gaai2 sik1 dak1 jat1 cing1 ji6 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师将这个概念解释得一清二楚。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher explained the concept perfectly clearly.

english_meaning: in a puff of smoke; in a flash; very quickly; vanished like smoke
explanation_mandarin: 形容速度非常快，像一股烟一样瞬间消失或离开。
explanation_english: Describes something happening very quickly, like a puff of smoke disappearing instantly, or someone leaving very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到阿sir嚟就一溜煙咁走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 aa3 sir1 lai4 zau6 jat1 lau6 jin1 gam2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到老师来了就一溜烟地跑了。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the teacher coming and ran away in a flash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車一啟動就一溜煙咁開走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 jat1 kai2 dung6 zau6 jat1 lau6 jin1 gam2 hoi1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车一启动就一溜烟地开走了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the car started, it drove off in a puff of smoke.

english_meaning: stagnant water; a stagnant pool; lacking vitality or progress; lifeless; dull
explanation_mandarin: 比喻停滞不前、毫无生气或进步的状况。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a situation that is stagnant, lifeless, and without progress. Describes something lacking vitality or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好似一潭死水咁，完全冇發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 jat1 taam4 si2 seoi2 gam2, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司就像一潭死水，完全没有发展。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like a stagnant pool, with absolutely no development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係變咗一潭死水，大家都唔想付出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 bin3 zo2 jat1 taam4 si2 seoi2, daai6 ga1 dou1 m4 soeng2 fu6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系变成了一潭死水，大家都 不想付出。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has become stagnant, and neither of them wants to put in the effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業已經一潭死水好耐，急需創新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 ji5 ging1 jat1 taam4 si2 seoi2 hou2 noi6, gap1 seoi1 cong3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业已经一潭死水很久了，急需创新。
examples.english_sentence: This industry has been stagnant for a long time and urgently needs innovation.

synonyms: 暮氣沉沉 (mu6 hei3 cam4 cam4)

mandarin_meaning: 一石二鸟; 一举多得
english_meaning: To kill two birds with one stone; to achieve multiple goals with a single action
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用一个方法或行为达到多个目的，得到多种好处。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a situation where a single action or method achieves multiple goals or benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個promotion真係一炮多響，清埋貨尾又吸到新客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 promotion zan1 hai6 jat1 paau3 do1 hoeng2, cing1 maai4 fo3 mei1 jau6 kap1 dou2 san1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的促销活动真是一石二鸟，既清理了库存，又吸引了新客户。
examples.english_sentence: This promotion really kills two birds with one stone, clearing out old stock and attracting new customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢份兼職一炮多響，又可以賺錢，又可以學嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 fan6 gim1 zik1 jat1 paau3 do1 hoeng2, jau6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 cin2, jau6 ho2 ji5 hok6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做这份兼职一举多得，既能赚钱，又能学习。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this part-time job is like killing two birds with one stone: he can earn money and learn something at the same time.

mandarin_meaning: 一举成名, 一鸣惊人
english_meaning: to become famous overnight, to be an instant success, to hit it big with the first shot
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一下子就成名，迅速走红。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to become famous instantly or to achieve remarkable success with one's first attempt. The "first shot" analogy refers to immediately hitting the mark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次拍戲就一炮而紅，真係好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 paak3 hei3 zau6 jat1 paau3 ji4 hung4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次拍戏就一炮而红，真是幸运。
examples.english_sentence: He became famous overnight with his first movie role, he's really lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌一推出就一炮而紅，好多人都鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 jat1 teoi1 ceot1 zau6 jat1 paau3 ji4 hung4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌一推出就一炮而红，很多人都喜欢听。
examples.english_sentence: This song became an instant hit as soon as it was released, many people like to listen to it.

mandarin_meaning: 一次性完成; 一次成功
english_meaning: To get it done in one shot; to succeed at the first attempt; to finish something in one go.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一次性完成某事，通常带有一种期望一次成功，不做重复或修改的意味。
explanation_english: Metaphorically means to complete something in one shot, often with the expectation of success on the first try, without repetition or modification. It implies a desire to achieve the desired result quickly and efficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望呢次考試可以一炮過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 ho2 ji5 jat1 paau3 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望这次考试可以一次通过。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can pass this exam on the first try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想一炮過搞掂晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jat1 paau3 gwo3 gaau2 dim6晒啲嘢。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想一次性把所有的事情都搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get everything done in one shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望可以一炮過，唔好再搞咁多嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 paau3 gwo3, m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望可以一次成功，不要再搞这么多事情了。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, it can be done in one go, let's not complicate things any further.

jyutping: jat1 wai4 san4 gung1 ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 既为了自己的利益，也为了提拔后辈。
english_meaning: Primarily for one's own benefit, secondarily for the sake of one's disciples/successors.
explanation_mandarin: 这句话的意思是，做事情的主要目的是为了自己能够获利或得到好处，其次才是为了培养或提拔自己的下属或学生。体现了一种先利己再利人的思想。
explanation_english: This idiom means that the primary motivation for doing something is for one's own benefit or gain, while the secondary motivation is to train or promote one's subordinates or students. It reflects a philosophy of prioritizing self-interest before the interests of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職咁快，其實都係一為神功二為弟子啫，升自己上去，順便帶埋啲親信上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 gam3 faai3, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 jat1 wai4 san4 gung1 ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2 ze1, sing1 zi6 gei2 soeng5 heoi3, seon6 bin6 daai3 maai4 di1 can1 seon3 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职这么快，其实也是为了自己的利益，顺便也提拔了自己的亲信。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted so quickly, it's really just for his own benefit, and to bring his close associates up with him.

jyutping: jat1 wai4 san4 gung1, ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 一为神功，二为弟子 (literal translation); 比喻一举两得，为了自身利益也为了下属/学生
english_meaning: One for the divine feat (personal gain), two for the disciples (others); Describes a situation where something benefits both oneself and others, especially one's subordinates or students; Killing two birds with one stone.
explanation_mandarin: 指做一件事情同时为了自身的利益和为了下属/学生的好处。带有比较自私的意味，通常是先考虑到自己，再考虑到他人。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something that benefits both oneself (often seen as the 'divine feat' or main purpose) and others, particularly one's subordinates or students (secondary benefit). Often implies a degree of self-interest, where the benefit to oneself is the primary motivation, followed by consideration for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力幫公司爭取到個大project，一為神功，二為弟子，一方面升職有望，另一方面又可以帶領團隊成員學到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nu5 lik6 bong1 gung1 si1 zang1 ceoi2 dou3 go3 daai6 project, jat1 wai4 san4 gung1, ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2, jat1 fong1 min6 sing1 zik1 jau5 mong6, ling6 jat1 fong1 min6 jau6 ho2 ji5 daai3 ling5 tyun4 deoi2 sing4 jyun4 hok6 dou3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力帮公司争取到这个大项目，一为神功，二为弟子，一方面升职有望，另一方面又可以带领团队成员学到东西。
examples.english_sentence: He worked so hard to get this big project for the company, one for the divine feat, two for the disciples. On one hand, he has a good chance of getting promoted, and on the other hand, he can lead the team members to learn something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細推呢個計劃，一為神功，二為弟子，想提升公司盈利嘅同時，亦都想訓練下啲新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 tui1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, jat1 wai4 san4 gung1, ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2, soeng2 tai4 sing1 gung1 si1 ying4 lei6 ge3 tung4 si4, jik6 dou1 soeng2 fan3 lin6 haa5 di1 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板推行这个计划，一为神功，二为弟子，想提升公司盈利的同时，也想训练一下新人。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is pushing this plan, one for the divine feat, two for the disciples. He wants to increase the company's profit and also train the new staff.

synonyms: 一箭雙鵰 (jat1 zin3 soeng1 diu1)

english_meaning: to have nothing at all, to be left with nothing, penniless
explanation_mandarin: 指什么都没有。形容非常贫穷。
explanation_english: Describes a state of having absolutely nothing. Characterizes extreme poverty or loss of everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸晒，而家一無所有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 saai3, ji4 gaa1 jat1 mou4 so2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输光了，现在一无所有。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his money gambling and now has nothing at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咗場火災，佢哋間屋燒晒，變到一無所有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 zo2 coeng4 fo2 zoi1, keoi5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 siu1 saai3, bin3 dou3 jat1 mou4 so2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过了一场火灾，他们的房子烧光了，变得一无所有。
examples.english_sentence: After the fire, their house was burned down completely, and they were left with absolutely nothing.

english_meaning: to gain nothing, to come away empty-handed, to achieve nothing
explanation_mandarin: 没有任何收获。形容毫无所得。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one achieves nothing or gains no results after an effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考咗好多次車牌，但係都一無所獲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 ce1 paai4, daan6 hai6 dou1 jat1 mou4 so2 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考了好多次驾照，但是都一无所获。
examples.english_sentence: I've taken the driving test many times, but I've achieved nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搵咗成日都一無所獲，乜都搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wan2 zo2 seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 mou4 so2 wok6, mat1 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们找了一整天都一无所获，什么都没找到。
examples.english_sentence: We searched the whole day but gained nothing, we couldn't find anything.

english_meaning: to know nothing at all; completely ignorant
explanation_mandarin: 指对某事完全不了解，什么都不知道。
explanation_english: Refers to being completely unaware or ignorant of something; knowing nothing at all about a particular matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事一無所知，唔好問佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 mou4 so2 zi1, m4 hou2 man6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事一无所知，别问他了。
examples.english_sentence: He knows nothing about this matter, don't ask him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅過去一無所知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 gwo3 heoi2 jat1 mou4 so2 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的过去一无所知。
examples.english_sentence: I know nothing about his past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對未來一無所知，所以要珍惜每一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 mei6 loi4 jat1 mou4 so2 zi1, so2 ji5 jiu3 zan1 sik1 mui5 jat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对未来一无所知，所以要珍惜每一天。
examples.english_sentence: We know nothing about the future, so we must cherish every day.

english_meaning: completely useless, good for nothing, utterly worthless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物没有任何优点或长处。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that has no redeeming qualities or merits; utterly useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懶到死，又唔肯做嘢，真係一無是處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laan5 dou3 sei2, jau6 m4 hang2 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 jat1 mou4 si6 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他懒得要命，又不肯工作，真是一无是处。
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely lazy and unwilling to work, he's completely useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁灰心，就算今次失敗咗，都唔代表你一無是處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1, zau6 syun3 gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 zo2, dou1 m4 doi6 biu2 nei5 jat1 mou4 si6 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么灰心，就算这次失败了，也不代表你一无是处。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged, even if you fail this time, it doesn't mean you're completely useless.

jyutping: jat1 wai4 san4 gung1, ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 既要炫耀武功，也要招收徒弟
english_meaning: Primarily for demonstrating one's martial arts skills, and secondarily for recruiting disciples.
explanation_mandarin: 主要目的是为了炫耀武功，其次才是招收徒弟。形容主要目的和次要目的。
explanation_english: The primary objective is to showcase one's martial arts prowess, with recruiting disciples as a secondary goal. Describes the main and secondary purposes of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力咁做好事，一為神功，二為弟子啫，想建立形象，第時選舉嗰陣贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6 gam3 hou2 zou6 hou2 si6, jat1 wai4 san4 gung1, ji6 wai4 dai6 zi2 ze1, soeng2 gin3 lap6 jing4 zoeng6, dai6 si4 syun2 geoi2 go2 zan6 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么勤奋地做好事，无非就是既要炫耀武功，又要招收徒弟罢了，想建立形象，以后选举的时候赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's working so hard doing good deeds, it's really just a case of 'primarily for demonstrating one's martial arts skills, and secondarily for recruiting disciples'; he wants to build an image so he can win in the election later.

english_meaning: a piece, a slice, a patch, a stretch, a scene, completely
explanation_mandarin: 作为量词，表示一片、一块等。作为副词，表示完全地、彻底地。
explanation_english: As a classifier, it indicates a piece, a slice, a patch, etc. As an adverb, it means completely, thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地下跌咗一片餅乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 haa2 dit3 zo2 jat1 pin3 beng2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地上掉了一片饼干。
examples.english_sentence: A piece of cookie fell on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 望落去，一片綠油油嘅田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong6 lok6 heoi3, jat1 pin3 luk6 jau4 jau4 ge3 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看下去，是一片绿油油的田。
examples.english_sentence: Looking down, it's a stretch of lush green fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我一片真心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 jat1 pin3 zan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我是完全真心。
examples.english_sentence: He is completely sincere towards me.

english_meaning: utter loyalty, a heart of unwavering loyalty, completely devoted
explanation_mandarin: 比喻非常忠诚的心。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone with a heart of unwavering loyalty and devotion. It implies complete sincerity and dedication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一片丹心為公司，日頭黑夜都做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 pin3 daan1 sam1 wai6 gung1 si1, jat6 tau4 hak1 je2 dou1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一片丹心为公司，白天黑夜都工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is utterly loyal to the company, working day and night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生一片丹心，希望可以幫助到更多嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 saang1 jat1 pin3 daan1 sam1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 dou2 gang3 do1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生一片丹心，希望可以帮助到更多的人。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee is completely devoted to helping more people.

english_meaning: a bright future; full of hope; everything looks promising
explanation_mandarin: 形容未来充满希望，一片美好。
explanation_english: Describes a future filled with hope and promise; everything looks bright and optimistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多次嘅失敗，佢終於見到一片光明喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 ci3 ge3 sat1 baai6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dou2 jat1 pin3 gwong1 ming4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多次的失败，他终于看到一片光明了。
examples.english_sentence: After so many failures, he finally sees a bright future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港經濟開始復甦，前途一片光明啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3 hoi1 ci2 fuk1 sou1, cin4 tou4 jat1 pin3 gwong1 ming4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港经济开始复苏，前途一片光明啊。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economy is starting to recover, the future looks bright.

english_meaning: a wholehearted sincerity, a sincere heart
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常真诚的心意，没有虚假。
explanation_english: Describes a very sincere heart and intention, without any falsehood or pretense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一片眞心對你，你唔好辜負佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 pin3 zan1 sam1 deoi3 nei5, nei5 m4 hou2 gu1 fu6 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一片真心对你，你不要辜负他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He has a sincere heart towards you, don't let him down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一片眞心想幫你，希望你可以接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 pin3 zan1 sam1 soeng2 bong1 nei5, hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一片真心想帮你，希望你可以接受。
examples.english_sentence: I sincerely want to help you, I hope you can accept it.

synonyms: 誠心誠意 (sing4 sam1 sing4 ji3)
真心誠意 (zan1 sam1 sing4 ji3)

english_meaning: a sincere heart; a wholehearted sincerity; with all one's heart
explanation_mandarin: 指非常真诚的心意，没有虚假。
explanation_english: Refers to a very sincere intention, without any pretense or falsehood. It expresses genuine sincerity and honesty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一片真心對你，你唔好辜負我啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 pin3 zan1 sam1 deoi3 nei5, nei5 m4 hou2 gu1 fu6 ngo5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对你一片真心，你不要辜负我啊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm being completely sincere with you, don't let me down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送份禮物俾我，話係佢一片真心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 ngo5, waa6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 pin3 zan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送我一份礼物，说是他的一片真心。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a gift, saying it was from the bottom of his heart.

synonyms: 誠心誠意 (sing4 sam1 sing4 ji3)

english_meaning: a complete blank; mind blank; to draw a blank
explanation_mandarin: 形容脑海中什么也想不起来，完全没有印象或思路。
explanation_english: Describes a state where one's mind is completely blank, unable to recall anything or form any coherent thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考緊試嘅時候我突然間一片空白，乜都唔記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gan2 si5 ge3 si4 hau6 ngo5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 jat1 pin3 hung1 baak6, mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候我突然一片空白，什么都忘记了。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, I suddenly drew a complete blank, and I forgot everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到一片空白，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hak1 dou3 jat1 pin3 hung1 baak6, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得一片空白，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that his mind went blank, and he didn't know what to do.
