english_meaning: a heart full of painstaking effort; well-intentioned but perhaps misguided effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了别人着想，花费了很多心思，但结果可能不尽如人意。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone puts in a lot of thought and effort for the benefit of others, but the outcome may not be desirable or appreciated. It often implies well-intentioned but perhaps ultimately unsuccessful efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣鬧你，都係一片苦心啫，你唔好咁介意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 naau6 nei5, dou1 hai6 jat1 pin3 fu2 sam1 ze1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaai3 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样骂你，也是一片苦心罢了，你不要太在意了。
examples.english_sentence: The way he scolded you, it's all with the best of intentions. Don't take it too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道你一片苦心想幫我，但係呢件事我真係想自己處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 jat1 pin3 fu2 sam1 soeng2 bong1 ngo5, daan6 hai6 ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你一片苦心想帮我，但是这件事我真的想自己处理。
examples.english_sentence: I know you mean well and want to help me, but I really want to handle this matter myself.

cantonese: 一物治一物，糯米治木虱
jyutping: jat1 mat6 zi6 jat1 mat6, no6 mai5 zi6 muk6 sat1
mandarin_meaning: 一物降一物，糯米治木虱
english_meaning: Everything has its nemesis; glutinous rice kills fleas.
explanation_mandarin: 世间万物，总有一种东西可以克制另一种东西。用糯米能治木虱来比喻这个道理，但实际上糯米并不能有效杀死木虱，只是作为一种比喻。
explanation_english: Everything has its counter or weakness. Used to describe how someone who is usually difficult to handle can be subdued by someone else. The literal translation is that glutinous rice can kill fleas, although this is not scientifically proven and serves as a metaphorical example of the principle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時咁惡死，點知畀佢老婆食住，真係一物治一物，糯米治木虱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 gam3 ok3 sei2, dim2 zi1 bei2 keoi5 lou5 po4 sik6 zyu6, zan1 hai6 jat1 mat6 zi6 jat1 mat6, no6 mai5 zi6 muk6 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时那么凶恶，没想到被他老婆管得服服帖帖，真是一物降一物。
examples.english_sentence: He's usually so fierce, but surprisingly his wife keeps him under control. It's really a case of everything having its nemesis.

cantonese: 一物治一物，糯米治木蝨
jyutping: jat1 mat6 zi6 jat1 mat6, no6 mai5 zi6 muk6 sat1
mandarin_meaning: 一物降一物，糯米治木虱
english_meaning: Everything has its natural enemy; glutinous rice cures bed bugs.
explanation_mandarin: 指每样东西都有克制它的东西。后半句“糯米治木虱”是一个例子，过去人们认为糯米可以去除床虱（木虱）。比喻总有一种方法可以解决问题或制服对方。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everything has something that can control or defeat it. The second part, "glutinous rice cures bed bugs," is an example, based on the past belief that glutinous rice could get rid of bed bugs. It's used to illustrate that there's always a way to solve a problem or to subdue someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心嘅，一物治一物，糯米治木蝨，總會有辦法解決嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ge3, jat1 mat6 zi6 jat1 mat6, no6 mai5 zi6 muk6 sat1, zung2 wui5 jau5 baan6 faat3 gai2 kyut3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么担心，一物降一物，糯米治木虱，总会有办法解决的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much. Everything has its natural enemy; glutinous rice cures bed bugs. There will always be a solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁惡嘅性格，一定有人可以搞得掂佢嘅，一物治一物，糯米治木蝨嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ok3 ge3 sing3 gaak3, jat1 ding6 jau5 jan4 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dak1 dim6 keoi5 ge3, jat1 mat6 zi6 jat1 mat6, no6 mai5 zi6 muk6 sat1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格这么恶劣，一定有人可以搞定他的，一物降一物，糯米治木虱嘛。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is so awful, there must be someone who can handle him. Everything has its natural enemy; glutinous rice cures bed bugs.

jyutping: jat1 lei5 tung1 baak3 lei5 ming4
english_meaning: Understanding one principle leads to understanding many others; Once you understand one thing, you can understand everything else.
explanation_mandarin: 明白了一个道理，就能明白许多道理。形容掌握了事物发展的普遍规律，就能理解同类事物。
explanation_english: Once you understand a core principle, you can apply it to understand many related things. It describes how grasping the universal laws of development allows one to understand similar things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀書唔係死記硬背，要理解背後嘅道理，咁先可以一理通百理明㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 m4 hai6 sei2 gei3 ngaang6 bui3, jiu3 lei5 gaai2 bui3 hau6 ge3 dou6 lei5, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 jat1 lei5 tung1 baak3 lei5 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 读书不是死记硬背，要理解背后的道理，这样才能一理通百理明。
examples.english_sentence: Studying isn't about rote memorization; you need to understand the reasoning behind it, and that's how you can understand one thing and apply it to many others.

english_meaning: link, part, aspect, segment, ring
explanation_mandarin: 事情发展过程中的一个组成部分，一个环节。
explanation_english: A component or link in a process or series of events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅成功，你嘅努力係重要嘅一環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 gung1, nei5 ge3 nou5 lik6 hai6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jat1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的成功，你的努力是重要的一个环节。
examples.english_sentence: Your efforts are an important part of the success of this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教育係社會發展唔可以缺少嘅一環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 juk6 hai6 se5 wui2 faat3 zin2 m4 ho2 ji5 kyut3 siu2 ge3 jat1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育是社会发展不可缺少的一个环节。
examples.english_sentence: Education is an indispensable part of social development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 溝通係解決問題嘅重要一環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau1 tung1 hai6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jat1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沟通是解决问题的重要环节。
examples.english_sentence: Communication is an important aspect of solving problems.

english_meaning: lifetime; all one's life
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人从出生到死亡的整个时间。
explanation_english: The entire duration of a person's life, from birth to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望一生都可以同你一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 jat1 sang1 dou1 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望一生都可以和你在一起。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can be with you for my whole life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗理想，貢獻咗一生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 lei5 soeng2, gung3 hin3 zo2 jat1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了理想，贡献了一生。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his whole life to his ideals.

english_meaning: a lifetime, for life, forever
explanation_mandarin: 指人的一生，表示时间很长，长久，一辈子。
explanation_english: Refers to one's entire life, indicating a very long time, lasting, for a lifetime. Often used to express a promise of enduring love or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一生一世都喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 sang1 jat1 sai3 dou1 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一辈子都在一起。
examples.english_sentence: We will be together for life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話要一生一世愛對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 jat1 sang1 jat1 sai3 oi3 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说要一辈子爱对方。
examples.english_sentence: They said they would love each other for life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住一生一世都留喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 jat1 sang1 jat1 sai3 dou1 lau4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算一辈子都留在香港。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to stay in Hong Kong for life.

english_meaning: a bout; a spell; a round; a measure (of effort); quite a bit; considerably
explanation_mandarin: 表示一次行动、一番努力、一段时间或某种程度。
explanation_english: Indicates a bout, a spell, a round, a measure of effort, a period of time, or a certain degree or extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾咗一番偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 zo2 jat1 faan1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们聊了一会儿天。
examples.english_sentence: They chatted for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功，你需要付出一番努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1, nei5 seoi1 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 jat1 faan1 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成功，你需要付出一番努力。
examples.english_sentence: To succeed, you need to put in some effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落咗一番大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 zo2 jat1 faan1 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下了好一阵大雨。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily this morning.

english_meaning: Long-winded; tedious; very long (like a bolt of cloth)
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或文章非常冗长，像一匹布那么长。比喻内容空洞，没有重点。
explanation_english: Describes speech or writing that is excessively long and tedious, like the length of a bolt of cloth. It implies that the content is empty, without any real substance or focus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告一疋布咁長，睇到人都眼瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 jat1 pat1 bou3 gam3 coeng4, tai2 dou3 jan4 dou1 ngaan5 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告长篇大论，看得人都想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: His report was so long-winded that it made everyone sleepy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講到一疋布咁長啦，簡單啲講重點就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 dou3 jat1 pat1 bou3 gam3 coeng4 laa1, gaan2 daan1 di1 gong2 zung2 dim2 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说得那么冗长，简单地说重点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded, just simply state the main points.

jyutping: jat1 faat3 bat1 ho2 sau1 si4
english_meaning: become uncontrollable; get out of hand; go too far
explanation_mandarin: 指事情一旦开始，就发展到无法控制的程度。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that, once started, develops to a point where it cannot be controlled or stopped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢一發不可收拾，搞到家破人亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 jat1 faat3 bat1 ho2 sau1 si4, gaau2 dou3 gaa1 po3 jan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱一发不可收拾，搞得家破人亡。
examples.english_sentence: His gambling got out of hand and led to the destruction of his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project一開始唔小心，之後就一發不可收拾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project jat1 hoi1 ci2 m4 siu2 sam1, zi1 hau6 zau6 jat1 faat3 bat1 ho2 sau1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目一开始不小心，之后就一发不可收拾。
examples.english_sentence: The project started carelessly and then got completely out of control.

english_meaning: Fair skin covers three blemishes/makes up for other flaws.
explanation_mandarin: 形容皮肤白皙能掩盖其他外貌上的缺点。常用来形容只要皮肤白，即使五官不够精致，也会显得漂亮。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how fair skin can make up for other physical imperfections. It suggests that having fair skin can make someone appear more attractive, even if they have other less desirable features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然個鼻唔夠高，但係皮膚好白，真係一白遮三醜啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 go3 bei6 m4 gau3 gou1, daan6 hai6 pei4 fu1 hou2 baak6, zan1 hai6 jat1 baak6 ze1 saam1 cau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然她的鼻子不够挺，但是皮肤很白，真是一白遮百丑啊。
examples.english_sentence: Although her nose isn't very high, her skin is very fair. Fair skin really makes up for other flaws.

english_meaning: one hundred
explanation_mandarin: 数目，表示一百。
explanation_english: The number one hundred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服一百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is one hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考咗一百分，好叻呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 zo2 jat1 baak3 fan1, hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了一百分，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got one hundred marks in the exam, he's so good!

mandarin_meaning: 一王二后 (yī wáng èr hòu)
english_meaning: One emperor and two empresses; referring to a situation with one male and two female partners in a relationship, often used ironically or disapprovingly.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“一个皇帝和两个皇后”。通常用来形容一个男性同时拥有两个女性伴侣的关系，多含讽刺或不赞成的意味。
explanation_english: Literally "one emperor and two empresses." It typically describes a relationship where a man has two female partners. Often used with a negative or ironic connotation, implying disapproval of polygamy or a similar arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好似一皇兩后咁，好威風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 jat1 wong4 loeng5 hau6 gam2, hou2 wai1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说自己好像一王二后一样，很威风。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's like an emperor with two empresses, feeling very proud of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲電視劇成日都係一皇兩后嘅劇情，悶死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 din6 si6 kek6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 jat1 wong4 loeng5 hau6 ge3 kek6 ching4, mun6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在电视剧总是这种一王二后的剧情，闷死了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, TV dramas always have plots like one emperor and two empresses, it's so boring.

synonyms: 三妻四妾 (saam1 cai1 sei3 cip3)

mandarin_meaning: 一夫多妻制，一个皇帝多个皇后
english_meaning: One emperor with multiple empresses; Polygyny (in a derogatory sense)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指古代帝王制度，一个皇帝可以有很多个皇后。现在常用来形容或讽刺一个男人有很多女朋友，关系混乱。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the imperial system in ancient China where an emperor could have multiple empresses. Now often used to describe or satirize a man who has many girlfriends, implying a chaotic and problematic relationship setup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁花心，根本就係一皇多后嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 faa1 sam1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 wong4 do1 hau6 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么花心，根本就是一夫多妻的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He's so unfaithful, his life is basically polygyny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁一皇多后啦，對每個女仔都公平啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 wong4 do1 hau6 laa1, deoi3 mui5 go3 neoi5 zai2 dou1 gung1 ping4 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么搞一夫多妻了，对每个女孩都公平点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like you have multiple wives, be fair to each girl.

synonyms: 周圍溝女 (zau1 wai4 gau1 neoi5) - Picking up girls everywhere

english_meaning: One Emperor and two Empresses; (figuratively) a situation with one dominant figure and two important supporting figures, often used to describe a power structure or relationship dynamics.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个主要的领导者或者核心人物，和两个重要的辅助人物。多用于描述权力结构或者人际关系。
explanation_english: Describes a primary leader or core figure with two important supporting figures. Often used to describe power structures or relationship dynamics, implying a hierarchical arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅架構就係一皇雙后，老細話晒事，兩個經理就幫佢手做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gaa3 gau3 zau6 hai6 jat1 wong4 soeng1 hau6, lou5 sai3 waa6 saai3 si6, loeng5 go3 ging1 lei5 zau6 bong1 keoi5 sau2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的架构就是一王二后，老板说了算，两个经理就帮他做事。
examples.english_sentence: The structure of this company is one Emperor and two Empresses. The boss has the final say, and the two managers help him with the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三個嘅關係好似一皇雙后咁，佢係最叻嘅，另外兩個就成日聽佢支笛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 jat1 wong4 soeng1 hau6 gam2, keoi5 hai6 zeoi3 lek1 ge3, ling6 ngoi6 loeng5 go3 zau6 seng4 jat6 teng1 keoi5 zi1 dek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三个的关系好像一王二后那样，他是最厉害的，另外两个人总是听他的。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the three of them is like one Emperor and two Empresses. He is the most capable, and the other two always listen to him.

english_meaning: A lot of money, a large sum of money (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语俚语中，指一大笔钱。通常是几千或几万块。 相当于“一大叠钱”。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, it refers to a large sum of money, usually thousands or tens of thousands of dollars. Equivalent to "a stack of money."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗架新車，用咗成一皮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 san1 ce1, yung6 zo2 seng4 jat1 pei4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆新车，花了一万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car and spent a thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋都成一皮，咁貴嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 dou1 seng4 jat1 pei4, gam3 gwai3 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包都一万块钱，真贵啊！
examples.english_sentence: This handbag costs ten thousand dollars, it's so expensive!

english_meaning: A pot of tea and two dim sum dishes
explanation_mandarin: 指喝茶时搭配的一盅茶和两件点心，是粤式饮茶的常见搭配。
explanation_english: Refers to a pot of tea and two dim sum dishes, a common combination when having Cantonese-style 'yum cha' (drinking tea with dim sum).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋去飲茶，叫返個一盅兩件先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 cha4, giu3 faan1 go3 jat1 zung1 loeng5 gin6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期天我们去喝茶，先点一份一盅两件。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for dim sum on Sunday and order a pot of tea with two dishes first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯日日都喺茶樓嘆一盅兩件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 cha4 lau2 taan3 jat1 zung1 loeng5 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯伯每天都在茶楼享受一盅两件。
examples.english_sentence: The old man enjoys a pot of tea and two dim sum dishes at the tea house every day.

mandarin_meaning: 一盘散沙 (yī pán sàn shā)
english_meaning: a sheet of loose sand; a disorganized mass; a lack of cohesion; disjointed; fragmented; a complete lack of unity
explanation_mandarin: 形容像一盘散开的沙子一样，没有凝聚力，各自为政，不能形成合力。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is a lack of unity and cohesion, like a plate of loose sand. People are disunited and each acts independently, unable to work together effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好似一盤散沙咁，冇人肯合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 jat1 pun4 saan2 saa1 gam2, mou5 jan4 hang2 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司就像一盘散沙，没有人愿意合作。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like a sheet of loose sand, no one is willing to cooperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個團隊一盤散沙，點搞都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 tyun4 deoi2 jat1 pun4 saan2 saa1, dim2 gaau2 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个团队一盘散沙，怎么搞都搞不好。
examples.english_sentence: This team is a disorganized mass; no matter what we do, we can't get things done properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔團結，就會變成一盤散沙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 tyun4 git3, zau6 wui bin3 sing4 jat1 pun4 saan2 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不团结，就会变成一盘散沙。
examples.english_sentence: If we are not united, we will become a sheet of loose sand.

synonyms: 烏合之眾 (wu1 hap6 zi1 zung3)
離心離德 (lei4 sam1 lei4 dak1)

english_meaning: All efforts wasted, gone to waste, down the drain
explanation_mandarin: 比喻全部的努力或投资都白费了，没有任何回报。类似于“竹篮打水一场空”。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to all efforts or investments being wasted, resulting in no returns. Similar to 'water drawn with a bamboo basket, all in vain'. Suggests that something has completely failed and all the effort put into it has come to nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資失利，啲錢咪一盤水囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, di1 cin2 mai1 jat1 pun4 seoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资失败，那些钱就都白费了。
examples.english_sentence: The investment failed, and all the money went down the drain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗咁多時間準備考試，點知突然病咗，真係一盤水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 gam3 do1 si4 gaan3 zyun2 bei6 haau2 si3, dim2 zi1 dat6 jin4 beng6 zo2, zan1 hai6 jat1 pun4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了这么多时间准备考试，谁知道突然生病了，真是白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: He spent so much time preparing for the exam, but suddenly got sick. It was all a waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起咗咁耐嘅樓，依家爛尾，發展商啲錢咪一盤水囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 zo2 gam3 noi6 ge3 lau2, ji1 gaa1 laan6 mei5, faat3 zin2 soeng1 di1 cin2 mai1 jat1 pun4 seoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖了这么久的楼，现在成了烂尾楼，开发商的钱不就白费了吗。
examples.english_sentence: The building has been under construction for so long, but now it's an unfinished project. The developer's money has gone to waste.

synonyms: 竹籃打水一場空 (zuk1 laam4 daa2 seoi2 jat1 coeng4 hung1)

english_meaning: clear at a glance; easily understood
explanation_mandarin: 一眼就能看清楚，形容事物非常清楚明白，一看就懂。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very clear and easy to understand at a glance. The meaning is immediately obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得好清楚，一目了然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2, jat1 muk6 liu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得很清楚，一目了然。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written very clearly, it's clear at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個圖表設計得好好，所有數據都一目了然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tou4 biu2 cai3 gai3 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 jau5 sou3 geoi3 dou1 jat1 muk6 liu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个图表设计得很好，所有数据都一目了然。
examples.english_sentence: This chart is well-designed, all the data is clear at a glance.

synonyms: 顯而易見 (hin2 ji4 jik6 gin3)

english_meaning: crystal clear, obvious at a glance
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常清楚，一看就明白。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very clear and easily understood at a glance; immediately obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得好清楚，啲數據一目瞭然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2, di1 sou3 geoi3 jat1 muk6 liu4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得很清楚，数据一目了然。
examples.english_sentence: The report is written very clearly; the data is crystal clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個圖表做得幾好，所有嘅趨勢都一目瞭然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tou4 biu2 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2, so2 jau5 ge3 ceoi1 sai3 dou1 jat1 muk6 liu4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个图表做得很好，所有的趋势都一目了然。
examples.english_sentence: This chart is well-made; all the trends are obvious at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意圖一目瞭然，就係想攞多啲錢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 tou4 jat1 muk6 liu4 jin4, zau6 hai6 soeng2 lo2 do1 di1 cin2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意图一目了然，就是想多要点钱。
examples.english_sentence: His intention is crystal clear: he just wants more money.

english_meaning: straight; continuously; always; all along
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间、方向或状态的持续性，没有中断或改变。
explanation_english: Indicates the continuity of time, direction, or state, without interruption or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直都好鍾意食點心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直都很喜欢吃点心。
examples.english_sentence: I have always liked eating dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一直向前行，就會見到間戲院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 zik6 hoeng3 cin4 haang4, zau6 wui5 gin3 dou2 gaan1 hei3 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一直往前走，就会看到电影院。
examples.english_sentence: Go straight ahead, and you will see the cinema.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都没来。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't come all along.

english_meaning: a glance, a look, a glimpse; in a short while
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暂的时间或动作，看一眼。
explanation_english: Used to describe a brief period of time or action, especially a quick look or glance. Can also mean 'soon' or 'in a moment'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一眼就認得出你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 jing6 dak1 chut1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一眼就认出你了。
examples.english_sentence: He recognized you at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我一眼，我好快搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5, ngo5 hou2 faai3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我一下，我很快搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a moment, I'll finish up quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一眼睇落去，佢好似好開心咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ngaan5 tai2 lok6 heoi3, keoi5 hou2 ci5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乍一看，他好像很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: At first glance, he seems very happy.

english_meaning: in an instant; in the blink of an eye; immediately
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发生得非常快，像灯光一闪而过一样。
explanation_english: Describes something happening very quickly, like a light flashing on and off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一眼燈就跑咗出門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ngaan5 dang1 zau6 paau2 zo2 chut1 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子就跑出了门口。
examples.english_sentence: He ran out the door in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一眼燈都唔記得咗佢叫咩名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 dang1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 keoi5 giu3 me1 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一下子就忘记他叫什么名字了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot his name in the blink of an eye.

english_meaning: to see everything at a glance; to be able to see everything clearly and completely at once
explanation_mandarin: 一眼就能全部看完，比喻情况简单明了，一看就明白。
explanation_english: To be able to see everything completely with a single glance. It implies that the situation is simple and clear, and easy to understand at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網站設計得好好，一眼睇晒所有資訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 sai3 gai3 dak1 hou2 hou2, jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3 so2 jau5 zi1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个网站设计得很好，一眼就能看到所有信息。
examples.english_sentence: This website is well designed, you can see all the information at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告好簡潔，一眼睇晒重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 hou2 gaan2 git3, jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3 zung2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告很简洁，一眼就能看到重点。
examples.english_sentence: The report is concise, you can see the main points at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個展覽唔係好大，一眼睇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 go3 zin2 laam5 m4 hai6 hou2 daai6, jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个展览不是很大，一眼就能看完。
examples.english_sentence: The whole exhibition isn't very big, you can see it all at a glance.

jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zam1 mou5 loeng5 tau4 lei6
english_meaning: You can't have it both ways; one thing can't be advantageous on both sides.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“只有一只眼的针没有两头锋利”。比喻任何事物都不可能十全十美，得到一面就失去另一面。
explanation_english: Literally, "a needle with one eye is not sharp on both ends." This idiom implies that you can't have it both ways; nothing is perfect. Gaining something on one side often means losing something on the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想又搵得多錢，又嘆世界，一眼針冇兩頭利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jau6 wan2 dak1 do1 cin2, jau6 taan2 sai3 gaai3, jat1 ngaan5 zam1 mou5 loeng5 tau4 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想既能挣很多钱，又能享受生活，哪有这么两全其美的事情。
examples.english_sentence: You want to earn a lot of money and enjoy life at the same time? You can't have it both ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢咁忙，又想照顧到屋企人，一眼針冇兩頭利，你總要犧牲啲嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 gam3 mong4, jau6 soeng2 ziu3 gu3 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4, jat1 ngaan5 zam1 mou5 loeng5 tau4 lei6, nei5 zung2 jiu3 hei1 saang1 di1 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么忙，又想照顾到家人，没有两全其美的事情，你总要牺牲一些事情的。
examples.english_sentence: Being so busy with work and wanting to take care of your family at the same time? You can't have it both ways, you will have to sacrifice something.

english_meaning: to be very observant; to pay attention to everything at once; to have an eye for detail; to be quick-witted and alert
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常机警，观察力敏锐，能同时注意到许多事物。一眼就如同关照七个方向，形容一个人反应迅速，注意力集中。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very alert and observant, able to notice many things at once. It implies quick reactions and focused attention, as if one eye can attend to seven different directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好快手，一眼關七，咩都睇到晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 sau2, jat1 ngaan5 gwaan1 cat1, me1 dou1 tai2 dou2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事非常快，眼观六路耳听八方，什么都看得到。
examples.english_sentence: He works very quickly, paying attention to everything at once, and sees everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做保安一定要一眼關七，先可以保障到大家嘅安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bou2 on1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jat1 ngaan5 gwaan1 cat1, sin1 ho2 ji5 bo2 zoeng3 dou3 daai6 ga1 ge3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做保安一定要眼观六路耳听八方，才可以保障大家的安全。
examples.english_sentence: Security guards must be very observant to ensure everyone's safety.

english_meaning: a crowd, a group, all of (them/you/us)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一群人，通常指人数较多，有一定的集体性。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people, usually a large number with a sense of collectivity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一眾同事今晚去咗飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zung3 tung4 si6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 zo2 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群同事今晚去喝酒了。
examples.english_sentence: A group of colleagues went for drinks tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一眾歌迷都好期待佢嘅演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zung3 go1 mai4 dou1 hou2 kei4 doi6 keoi5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群歌迷都很期待他的演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: All the fans are really looking forward to his concert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一眾學生都支持罷課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zung3 hok6 sang1 dou1 zi1 ci4 baa6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群学生都支持罢课。
examples.english_sentence: A group of students all support the strike.

english_meaning: in an instant, in the blink of an eye, a flash
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常短的时间，瞬间。
explanation_english: Describes a very short period of time, an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一瞬間就跑咗過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 seon3 gaan1 zau6 paau2 zo2 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一瞬间就跑过去了。
examples.english_sentence: He ran past in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定都係一瞬間嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 dou1 hai6 jat1 seon3 gaan1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定也是一瞬间的事情。
examples.english_sentence: This decision was made in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一瞬間嘅快樂，好快就消失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 seon3 gaan1 ge3 faai3 lok6, hou2 faai3 zau6 siu1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瞬间的快乐，很快就消失了。
examples.english_sentence: Instant happiness disappears quickly.

english_meaning: To hit the bullseye with one arrow; to be spot on; to be exactly right; to hit the mark
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一次就达到目的或说中要害。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes hitting the target or bullseye with a single arrow. Figuratively, it means to hit the mark perfectly, to be spot on, or to achieve the desired result with a single effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢估到個兇手係邊個，真係一矢中的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu2 dou3 go3 hung1 sau2 hai6 bin1 go3, zan1 hai6 jat1 ci2 dik1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他猜到凶手是谁，真是猜中了。
examples.english_sentence: He guessed who the murderer was, it was spot on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意見一矢中的，解決咗所有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3 jat1 ci2 dik1 zung1, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 so2 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意见一针见血，解决了所有问题。
examples.english_sentence: His opinion was right on the mark and solved all the problems.

english_meaning: to kill two birds with one stone
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做一件事情同时达到两个目的。
explanation_english: An idiom that means to achieve two goals with a single action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資搞掂，真係一矢雙鵰，又賺到錢，又可以提升公司嘅知名度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 gaau2 dim6, zan1 hai6 jat1 si2 soeng1 diu1, jau6 zaan6 dou2 cin2, jau6 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 ming4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资成功，真是一箭双雕，既赚了钱，又可以提升公司的知名度。
examples.english_sentence: This investment was a success, truly killing two birds with one stone; we both made money and increased the company's visibility.

english_meaning: to have a smattering of knowledge; to have only a superficial understanding
explanation_mandarin: 知道得很少，理解得不透彻。形容了解不深，认识不全面。
explanation_english: Describes having limited and superficial knowledge about something; lacking a thorough understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事嘅睇法都係一知半解，唔好信佢嘅話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 dou1 hai6 jat1 zi1 bun3 gaai2, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事的看法都是一知半解，不要相信他的话。
examples.english_sentence: His understanding of this matter is only superficial, don't trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係一知半解，唔敢俾意見住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 jat1 zi1 bun3 gaai2, m4 gam2 bei2 ji3 gin3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是一知半解，不敢先给意见。
examples.english_sentence: I only have a smattering of knowledge, so I don't dare to give my opinion yet.

synonyms: 略知一二 (loek6 zi1 jat1 ji6)

mandarin_meaning: 一石二鸟 (yī shí èr niǎo)
english_meaning: Kill two birds with one stone
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做一件事情，得到两种好处。
explanation_english: A metaphor that means achieving two objectives or benefits with a single action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住學埋整蛋糕，咁咪一石二鳥，又可以有嘢食，又可以學到新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 hok6 maai4 zing2 daan6 gou1, gam2 mai1 jat1 sek6 ji6 niu5, jau6 ho2 ji5 jau5 je5 sik6, jau6 ho2 ji5 hok6 dou2 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算学习做蛋糕，这样岂不是一石二鸟，既可以有东西吃，又可以学到新东西。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to learn how to make cakes, wouldn't that be killing two birds with one stone? I can have something to eat, and I can learn something new.

mandarin_meaning: 呆头呆脑, 笨拙, 不懂人情世故
english_meaning: Wooden, stiff, awkward, insensitive, clueless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人反应迟钝，不懂得变通，或者不善于表达情感，像一块木头一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slow to react, inflexible, or not good at expressing emotions, like a log of wood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都一碌木咁，真係唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 luk1 muk6 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是呆头呆脑的，真不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so wooden, I really don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁一碌木啦，人哋講笑咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 luk1 muk6 laa1, jan4 dei6 gong2 siu3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么呆头呆脑的，人家只是开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stiff, they're just joking.

synonyms: 唔識變通 (m4 sik1 bin3 tung1)

english_meaning: A blockhead, a dolt, someone who is wooden and unresponsive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，像木头一样，不灵活。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slow-witted, unresponsive, and wooden like a log of wood. It implies a lack of intelligence or social awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔出聲，真係一碌杉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 ceot1 seng1, zan1 hai6 jat1 luk1 caam3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天不说话，真像个木头人。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't say anything all day; he's really like a block of wood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁一碌杉啦，講下嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jat1 luk1 caam3 laa1, gong2 haa5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么呆头呆脑的，说点什么吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a dolt; say something!

english_meaning: idiot, blockhead, dummy
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人愚笨，反应迟钝。 碌葛是一种植物的根茎，形容人像葛的根茎一样木讷。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is foolish, slow-witted, and unresponsive. 'Luk got' refers to the root of a plant (kudzu), and the phrase compares the person to the inert root.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係一碌葛嚟嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 jat1 luk1 got3 lai4 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样都不明白，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You can't even understand this, you're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁一碌葛啦，醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam2 jat1 luk1 got3 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么笨啦，清醒一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, wake up!

english_meaning: idiot, a blockhead, someone who is slow-witted
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很笨，反应迟钝。 “碌薯”指红薯或白薯，因为其形状简单，质地粗糙，所以被用来比喻愚笨的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being stupid, slow-witted, or a blockhead. "Luk Syu" refers to sweet potato or potato, and due to its simple shape and rough texture, it is used to metaphorically describe a foolish person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係一碌薯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 jat1 luk1 syu4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不懂，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this, you're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁講人哋啦，雖然佢有啲一碌薯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, seui1 jin4 keoi5 jau5 di1 jat1 luk1 syu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说人家啦，虽然他有点傻。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about him, even though he's a bit slow.

english_meaning: One thing at a time; One thing is separate from another; Let bygones be bygones (to a limited extent); Each matter should be dealt with separately.
explanation_mandarin: 指事情一件一件地处理，互不牵连。即使两件事有关联，也要分开处理，不互相影响。强调独立性，公平公正。
explanation_english: This idiom means to deal with each matter separately and independently. Even if two matters are related, they should be addressed individually without influencing each other. It emphasizes independence, fairness, and justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到係佢嘅事，佢嘅工作能力係另一回事，一碼還一碼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 si6, keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 nang4 lik6 hai6 ling6 jat1 wui4 si6, jat1 maa5 waan4 jat1 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迟到是他的事，他的工作能力是另一回事，一码归一码。
examples.english_sentence: His being late is his own business. His work ability is another thing. Let's deal with each matter separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係你嘅朋友，但係如果佢做錯嘢，都要罰，一碼還一碼嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 nei5 ge3 pang4 jau5, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, dou1 jiu3 fat6, jat1 maa5 waan4 jat1 maa5 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他是你的朋友，但是如果他做错事，也要惩罚，一事归一事嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is your friend, if he does something wrong, he should still be punished. One thing at a time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為佢上次幫過你，今次佢做錯事就唔罰佢，一碼還一碼先至公平㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 keoi5 soeng6 ci3 bong1 gwo3 nei5, gam1 ci3 keoi5 zou6 co3 si6 zau6 m4 fat6 keoi5, jat1 maa5 waan4 jat1 maa5 sin1 zai3 gung1 ping4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为他上次帮过你，这次他做错事就不罚他，一事归一事才公平。
examples.english_sentence: Don't not punish him this time because he helped you last time. Fairness requires dealing with each matter separately.

jyutping: jat1 zyun1 dau6 fu6 hong6 sing1 sin1
english_meaning: Extremely easy; a piece of cake; a walk in the park
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常容易完成，就像用一块豆腐撞击脖子就能升天成仙一样。比喻事情简单到不可思议。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely easy to accomplish, just like ascending to heaven by hitting one's neck with a block of tofu. It implies that the task is so simple that it seems unbelievable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數咁簡單，簡直係一磚豆腐項升仙啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 gam3 gaan2 daan1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 zyun1 dau6 fu6 hong6 sing1 sin1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题这么简单，简直是轻而易举！
examples.english_sentence: This question is so easy, it's a piece of cake!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好叻，呢啲任務對佢嚟講簡直係一磚豆腐項升仙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 lek1, ni1 di1 jam6 mou6 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 zyun1 dau6 fu6 hong6 sing1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很厉害，这些任务对他来说简直是轻而易举。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at his job; these tasks are a walk in the park for him.

synonyms: 易如反掌 (ji6 jyu4 faan2 zoeng2)
輕而易舉 (hing1 ji4 jik6 geoi2)

english_meaning: Monotheism
explanation_mandarin: 指信仰唯一神祇的宗教，如基督教、伊斯兰教、犹太教等。
explanation_english: The belief in and worship of one God, as opposed to polytheism (the belief in multiple gods). Examples include Christianity, Islam, and Judaism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 基督教係一個一神敎，信耶穌基督係唯一嘅神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 duk1 gaau3 hai6 jat1 go3 jat1 san4 gaau3, seon3 je4 sou1 gei1 duk1 hai6 wai4 jat1 ge3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 基督教是一种一神教，相信耶稣基督是唯一的神。
examples.english_sentence: Christianity is a monotheistic religion that believes in Jesus Christ as the only God.

english_meaning: Monotheism
explanation_mandarin: 指信仰一个神祇的宗教，如犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教。
explanation_english: A religion that believes in only one God, such as Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人認為一神教同多神教好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 jing6 wai4 jat1 san4 gaau3 tung4 do1 san4 gaau3 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人认为一神教和多神教很不同。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that monotheism and polytheism are very different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 基督教係一個一神教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 duk1 gaau3 hai6 jat1 go3 jat1 san4 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 基督教是一个一神教。
examples.english_sentence: Christianity is a monotheistic religion.

english_meaning: swarm; mob; to follow the crowd blindly
explanation_mandarin: 形容许多人一下子拥挤着去某处或做某事；盲目跟风，没有主见。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a large group of people rush to do something at the same time, often without thinking critically. Implies following the crowd blindly without independent judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭一做優惠，啲人就一窩蜂咁衝去買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 jat1 zou6 jau1 wai2, di1 jan4 zau6 jat1 wo1 fung1 gam2 cung1 heoi3 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店一打折，人们就一窝蜂地冲去买东西。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as that shop offered a discount, people rushed to buy things like a swarm of bees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好人哋做乜你就做乜，唔好一窩蜂咁跟風呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan4 dei6 zou6 mat1 nei5 zau6 zou6 mat1, m4 hou2 jat1 wo1 fung1 gam2 gan1 fung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要别人做什么你就做什么，不要一窝蜂地跟风啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just do whatever other people are doing. Don't follow the crowd blindly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市一升，啲人就一窩蜂去買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 jat1 sing1, di1 jan4 zau6 jat1 wo1 fung1 heoi3 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价一涨，人们就一窝蜂地去买房。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the housing market went up, people rushed to buy apartments.

english_meaning: poor and blank; starting from scratch; utterly destitute
explanation_mandarin: 形容一无所有，基础薄弱。比喻经济、文化等方面非常落后。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme poverty and backwardness, lacking both material wealth and cultural development. It implies starting from nothing, with no resources or foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以前一窮二白，但係靠自己嘅努力，而家生活好富裕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 cin4 jat1 kung4 ji6 baak6, daan6 hai6 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6, ji4 gaa1 sang1 wut6 hou2 fu3 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以前一穷二白，但是靠自己的努力，现在生活很富裕。
examples.english_sentence: They used to be utterly destitute, but through their own efforts, they now live a very prosperous life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起步嘅時候一窮二白唔緊要，最緊要係有決心同埋毅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 bou6 ge3 si4 hau6 jat1 kung4 ji6 baak6 m4 gan2 jiu3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 jau5 kyut3 sam1 tung4 mai4 ngai6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起步的时候一穷二白不要紧，最重要的是有决心和毅力。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter if you're starting from scratch, the most important thing is to have determination and perseverance.

english_meaning: totally clueless; completely ignorant; doesn't understand a thing
explanation_mandarin: 比喻什么都不懂，一无所知。
explanation_english: Describes a state of complete ignorance or lack of understanding about something. It signifies being totally clueless and not grasping even the most basic concepts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對電腦一竅不通㗎，你都係搵第二個幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 din6 nou5 jat1 hiu3 bat1 tung1 gaa3, nei5 dou1 hai6 wan2 dai6 ji6 go3 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对电脑一窍不通，你还是找别人帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm completely clueless about computers. You should ask someone else for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對廣東話一竅不通，你同佢講英文啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jat1 hiu3 bat1 tung1, nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ying1 man2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对广东话一窍不通，你跟他讲英文吧。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't understand a word of Cantonese. Just speak to him in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條題目咁難，我真係一竅不通呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 tai4 muk6 gam3 naan4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 hiu3 bat1 tung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题这么难，我真是一窍不通啊！
examples.english_sentence: This question is so difficult, I really don't understand it at all!

jyutping: jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4
english_meaning: To tar everyone with the same brush; To condemn all alike; To punish the innocent along with the guilty.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不加分析地把一群人视为同一类，冤枉好人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for treating a group of people as one type without analysis, thus wronging the innocent. It means to condemn all alike, without differentiating between the good and the bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一竹篙打一船人，唔係個個後生仔都咁廢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4, m4 hai6 go3 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 gam3 fai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一概而论，不是每个年轻人都这么没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tar everyone with the same brush; not all young people are useless like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為有幾個同事遲到，就一竹篙打一船人話成間公司啲人都唔守時啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 jau5 gei2 go3 tung4 si6 ci4 dou3, zau6 jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4 waa6 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 jan4 dou1 m4 sau2 si4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为有几个同事迟到，就一概而论说整个公司的人都不守时。
examples.english_sentence: Don't condemn everyone just because a few colleagues are late, saying that everyone in the company is not punctual.

jyutping: jat1 zuk1 gou1 naam2 cam4 jat1 syun4 jan4
english_meaning: To tar everyone with the same brush; To condemn everyone based on one person's fault; To punish the many for the wrongdoing of one.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻因为某一个人的过失而牵连到所有人，把所有人都看作有罪。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where everyone is blamed or punished because of the mistake or wrongdoing of one person. It suggests judging or treating everyone the same way, regardless of their individual actions or innocence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一竹篙揇沉一船人啦，唔係個個都係咁諗嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 zuk1 gou1 naam2 cam4 jat1 syun4 jan4 laa1, m4 hai6 go3 go3 dou1 hai6 gam2 nam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一竿子打翻一船人，不是每个人都这么想的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tar everyone with the same brush, not everyone thinks that way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以因為佢哋其中一個遲到，就一竹篙揇沉一船人，罰晒全部人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 jan1 wai4 keoi5 dei6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 ci4 dou3, zau6 jat1 zuk1 gou1 naam2 cam4 jat1 syun4 jan4, fat6 saai3 cyun4 bou6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能因为他们其中一个人迟到，就一竿子打翻一船人，惩罚所有人啊。
examples.english_sentence: You can't punish everyone just because one of them was late, don't punish the many for the wrongdoing of one.

synonyms: 一概而論 (jat1 koi3 ji4 leon6)

jyutping: jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4
english_meaning: To punish or condemn everyone in a group because of the actions of a few; to tar everyone with the same brush.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻因为个别人的错误而牵连到全体，不加区分地一概否定或打击。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to unfairly blaming or punishing an entire group of people for the misdeeds of a few members within that group. It implies a lack of discernment and a tendency to generalize negatively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一竹蒿打一船人啦，唔係個個都係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4 laa1, m4 hai6 go3 go3 dou1 hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一竿子打翻一船人，不是每个人都这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tar everyone with the same brush, not everyone is like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以因為個別員工嘅問題，就一竹蒿打一船人，要客觀噉評估每個員工嘅表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 jan1 wai6 go3 bit6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 man6 tai4, zau6 jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 jat1 syun4 jan4, jiu3 haak3 gun1 gam2 ping4 gu3 mui5 go3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 biu2 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能因为个别员工的问题，就一竿子打翻一船人，要客观地评估每个员工的表现。
examples.english_sentence: We can't punish everyone because of individual employee problems; we need to objectively evaluate each employee's performance.

synonyms: 一概而論 (jat1 koi3 ji4 leon6)
以偏概全 (ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4)

english_meaning: to laugh it off; to dismiss with a laugh; to brush aside
explanation_mandarin: 用一笑来对待它；表示不值得认真对待。形容轻视，不在意。
explanation_english: To treat something with a laugh, indicating that it is not worth taking seriously. Describes a dismissive or indifferent attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢咁離譜，我哋一笑置之就算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gam3 lei4 pou2, ngo5 dei6 jat1 siu3 zi3 zi1 zau6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话这么离谱，我们一笑置之就算了。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is so absurd, let's just laugh it off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日遲到，大家唯有一笑置之。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, daai6 gaa1 wai4 jau5 jat1 siu3 zi3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板经常迟到，大家唯有一笑置之。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always late, everyone can only laugh it off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人嘅批評唔啱聽，唔使理佢哋，一笑置之就得㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 ge3 pai1 ping4 m4 ngaam1 teng1, m4 sai2 lei5 keoi5 dei6, jat1 siu3 zi3 zi1 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人的批评不好听，不用理他们，一笑置之就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Those people's criticisms are unpleasant to hear, no need to pay them any attention, just laugh them off.

synonyms: 不以為意 (bat1 ji5 wai4 ji3)
置之不理 (zi3 zi1 bat1 lei5)

english_meaning: to write off (a debt, mistake, etc.); to cancel; to annul
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把全部账务、罪行等一概抹掉，不再追究。
explanation_english: To completely cancel or write off something, such as a debt, mistake, or past grievances; to forgive and forget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 之前嘅事，我哋一筆勾銷，以後重新開始啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 cin4 ge3 si6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 bat1 gau1 siu1, ji5 hau6 cung4 san1 hoi1 chi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的事情，我们一笔勾销，以后重新开始吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's write off what happened before and start fresh from now on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢做錯咗好多嘢，但係老闆決定一筆勾銷，俾多次機會佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, daan6 hai6 lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 jat1 bat1 gau1 siu1, bei2 do1 ci3 gei1 wui6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他做错了很多事，但是老板决定一笔勾销，再给他一次机会。
examples.english_sentence: Although he made many mistakes, the boss decided to write them all off and give him another chance.

synonyms: 既往不咎 (gei3 wong5 bat1 gau3)

mandarin_meaning: 一笔画; 一口气完成
english_meaning: Complete in one stroke; Do something continuously without interruption; Single-stroke drawing
explanation_mandarin: 原本指一种绘画技巧，即一笔完成绘画，不中断。引申义为一口气做完某事，中途不停顿。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a drawing technique of completing a picture with a single, continuous line without lifting the pen.  Figuratively, it means to complete something in one go without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想一筆畫寫完份報告，但係最後都係要分開幾次先搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jat1 bat1 waak6 se2 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 gei2 ci3 sin1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想一口气写完报告，但是最后还是要分开几次才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to finish writing the report in one go, but in the end, he had to break it down into several times to complete it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫係一筆畫嘅，好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hai6 jat1 bat1 waak6 ge3, hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画是一笔画的，很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is a single-stroke drawing, it's amazing.

english_meaning: lump sum; all at once; in one go
explanation_mandarin: 一次性地付清或處理完畢，不再分期或分步驟。
explanation_english: A lump sum payment or dealing with something all at once, without installments or steps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定一筆過俾晒所有學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jat1 bat1 gwo3 bei2 saai3 so2 jau5 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定一次性付清所有学费。
examples.english_sentence: We decided to pay all the tuition fees in one lump sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想將所有嘅債務一筆過清還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 zaai3 mou6 jat1 bat1 gwo3 cing1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想把所有的债务一次性还清。
examples.english_sentence: They want to clear all their debts in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話想將個項目一筆過判俾你哋公司做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 soeng2 zoeng1 go3 hong6 muk6 jat1 bat1 gwo3 paan3 bei2 nei5 dei6 gung1 si1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说想把这个项目一次性地判给你们公司做。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he wants to award the project to your company in one go.

english_meaning: Tit for tat; to settle each debt/score separately
explanation_mandarin: 指每一笔账都单独结算，互不相欠；也指报复行为，以其人之道还治其人之身。
explanation_english: Refers to settling each debt or score separately; also refers to revenge, returning the same treatment one received.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住上次幫過我就乜都得，一筆還一筆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 soeng6 ci3 bong1 gwo3 ngo5 zau6 mat1 dou1 dak1, jat1 bat1 waan4 jat1 bat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为上次帮过我就可以为所欲为，一码归一码。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can do whatever you want just because you helped me last time. It's tit for tat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到要同你一筆還一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 jiu3 tung4 nei5 jat1 bat1 waan4 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气到要跟你一码归一码。
examples.english_sentence: He's so angry that he wants to settle the score with you, tit for tat.

english_meaning: first-class, top-notch, excellent
explanation_mandarin: 指质量或水平非常高，最好的。
explanation_english: Describes something that is of the highest quality or standard; the best of the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係一等一㗎，你一定要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 jat1 dang2 jat1 gaa3, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真的是头等棒，你一定要试一下。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really top-notch, you must try it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績喺班入面係一等一嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 jik1 hai2 baan1 jap6 min6 hai6 jat1 dang2 jat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩在班里是第一等的。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are the best in the class.

english_meaning: a deep-seated hatred, a grudge that must be avenged; a burning desire for revenge
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常深的仇恨，一定要报复。
explanation_english: Describes a very deep hatred, a grudge that must be avenged. It implies a strong determination to take revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家嘅一箭之仇，唔係咁容易可以化解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 ge3 jat1 jin3 zi1 sau4, m4 hai6 gam3 jung4 yi6 ho2 ji5 faa3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家的深仇大恨，不是那么容易可以化解的。
examples.english_sentence: The deep-seated hatred between the two families is not so easy to resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗報一箭之仇，佢忍辱負重咗好多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bou3 jat1 jin3 zi1 sau4, keoi5 jan2 juk6 fu6 cung5 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了报仇雪恨，他忍辱负重了很多年。
examples.english_sentence: In order to avenge his deep-seated hatred, he endured hardship and humiliation for many years.

english_meaning: To secure victory with a single decisive action; to achieve success in one stroke
explanation_mandarin: 比喻通过一次关键的行动或决策，就能决定整个局势的胜负，取得最终的成功。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where a single, decisive action or decision determines the outcome of an entire situation, leading to ultimate success. It implies a high degree of impact and finality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺決賽嘅最後一球，真係一箭定江山，幫球隊贏咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kyut3 coi3 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 kau4, zan1 hai6 jat1 zin3 ding6 gong1 saan1, bong1 kau4 deoi2 wing4 zo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在决赛的最后一球，真是一锤定音，帮助球队赢得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: His final shot in the finals was truly a game-winner, helping the team win the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅計劃如果成功，就一箭定江山，公司嘅地位就會穩如泰山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gai3 waak6 jyu4 gwo2 sing4 gung1, zau6 jat1 zin3 ding6 gong1 saan1, gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 wai2 zau6 wun2 jyu4 taai3 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这次计划成功，就能一举定乾坤，公司的地位就会稳如泰山。
examples.english_sentence: If this plan succeeds, it will secure our position and make the company's status as stable as Mount Tai.

english_meaning: to kill two birds with one stone
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做一件事情同时达到两个目的。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to accomplish two different things at the same time with one action; to kill two birds with one stone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又可以學到嘢，又可以賺到錢，真係一箭雙鵰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 ho2 ji5 hok6 dou2 je5, jau6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou2 cin2, zan1 hai6 jat1 jin3 soeng1 diu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他既可以学到东西，又可以赚到钱，真是一箭双雕。
examples.english_sentence: He can learn something and earn money at the same time, it's really killing two birds with one stone.

mandarin_meaning: 过了一个节日，淡了三个集市
english_meaning: One festival's slackness affects three market days; The effects of one day of inactivity can be felt for a long time; A missed opportunity can lead to prolonged setbacks.
explanation_mandarin: 形容错过一个好的时机，会造成长期的影响或损失。也比喻暂时的疏忽会带来严重的后果。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how missing a good opportunity can have long-term effects or losses. It also serves as a metaphor for how temporary negligence can lead to serious consequences. It emphasizes the importance of seizing opportunities and being diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為放假幾日冇咩嘢，一節淡三墟，到時做唔晒就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 fong3 gaa3 gei2 jat6 mou5 me1 je5, jat1 zit3 daam6 saam1 heoi1, dou3 si4 zou6 m4 saai3 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为放假几天没什么，一节淡三墟，到时候做不完就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that taking a few days off is nothing, one festival's slackness affects three market days, if you can't finish the work by then, it will be troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次股市跌咗咁多，真係一節淡三墟，唔知幾時先升得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 jat1 zit3 daam6 saam1 heoi1, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 sing1 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次股市跌了这么多，真是一节淡三墟，不知道什么时候才能涨回来。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has dropped so much this time, it's really like one festival's slackness affects three market days, I don't know when it will recover.

english_meaning: a basketful; a whole bunch; a package
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，指很多，全部包含在内，类似于“一揽子”。
explanation_english: Indicates a quantity, meaning a lot, all-inclusive, similar to "a package" or "a whole bunch". It is often used to describe a collection of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司解決咗一籃子嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 jat1 laam4 zi2 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司解决了一揽子问题。
examples.english_sentence: This company solved a whole bunch of problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一籃子生果返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 laam4 zi2 sang1 gwo2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一篮子水果回家。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a basketful of fruits and went home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃包括咗一籃子嘅措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 baau1 kut3 zo2 jat1 laam4 zi2 ge3 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划包括了一揽子的措施。
examples.english_sentence: This plan includes a package of measures.

english_meaning: basket of currencies
explanation_mandarin: 指一组选定的货币，通常被用作确定汇率或限制汇率波动的基础。
explanation_english: A portfolio of currencies, usually weighted, used as a benchmark or as a basis for pegging a currency's value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅聯繫匯率制度就係將港元同一個美元嘅一籃子貨幣掛鉤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lyun4 hai6 wui6 leot2 zai3 dou6 zau6 hai6 zoeng1 gong2 jyun4 tung4 jat1 go3 mei5 jyun4 ge3 jat1 laam4 zi2 fo3 bai6 gwaa3 huk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的联系汇率制度是将港元与一个美元的一篮子货币挂钩。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's linked exchange rate system pegs the Hong Kong dollar to a basket of currencies, with the US dollar playing a major role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗穩定匯率，政府可能會考慮用一籃子貨幣嚟衡量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wing2 ding6 wui6 leot2, zing3 fu2 ho2 nang4 wui5 hau2 leoi6 yung6 jat1 laam4 zi2 fo3 bai6 lai4 hang4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了稳定汇率，政府可能会考虑用一篮子货币来衡量。
examples.english_sentence: To stabilize exchange rates, the government might consider using a basket of currencies for measurement.

english_meaning: at one's wits' end; at a loss; unable to find a solution
explanation_mandarin: 一点计策也施展不出，一点办法也没有。
explanation_english: To be at a complete loss; unable to think of any solutions or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到呢個難題，我哋真係一籌莫展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 ni1 go3 naan4 tai4, ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jat1 cau4 mok6 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到这个问题，我们真是束手无策。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with this problem, we are really at our wits' end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺考試入面遇到條難題，一籌莫展，唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 haau2 si3 jap6 min6 jyu6 dou3 tiu4 naan4 tai4, jat1 cau4 mok6 zin2, m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在考试中遇到一道难题，一筹莫展，不知道怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: He encountered a difficult problem in the exam, was at a loss, and didn't know how to do it.

english_meaning: A lot of; heaps of; piles of
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，像一箩筐又一箩筐。多用于形容数量多且杂乱的事物。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity, like baskets and baskets full of something. Often used to describe a large quantity of things that are numerous and disorganized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企嘅雜物一籮籮咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 ge3 zaap6 mat6 jat1 lo4 lo4 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里的杂物很多很多。
examples.english_sentence: There are heaps of clutter in his house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試之後，啲功課一籮籮咁交上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zi1 hau6, di1 gung1 fo3 jat1 lo4 lo4 gam3 gaau1 soeng5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试之后，作业像小山一样堆上来了。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, piles of homework were handed in.

mandarin_meaning: 一点东西，一个东西；指某人/某事（常带贬义或轻蔑）
english_meaning: a small thing; something; someone (often with a derogatory or dismissive tone)
explanation_mandarin: “一粒”本意指很小的一颗东西，例如一粒米、一粒沙等。但粤语中“一粒嘢”常用来指代某个不具体的人或事物，语气常带有轻视或不屑，有时也用作泛指，类似于普通话的“玩意儿”或“东西”。
explanation_english: "一粒" literally means a small grain or particle, like a grain of rice or sand. However, in Cantonese, "一粒嘢" is often used to refer to an unspecified person or thing, often with a dismissive or contemptuous tone. Sometimes it's used as a generic term, similar to "thingy" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好叻，其實都係一粒嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 jat1 lap1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很厉害，其实也就是个小角色。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's so great, but he's really just a nobody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好理佢，佢只不過係一粒嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 lap1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别理他，他只不过是个小人物。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with him; he's just a nobody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢都係一粒嘢嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 dou1 hai6 jat1 lap1 je5 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西都只是小东西而已。
examples.english_sentence: These things are just trivial things.

mandarin_meaning: 很厉害的人; 了不起的人
english_meaning: A very capable person; a talented individual; someone outstanding
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在某方面非常出色、厉害，像神一样。指精通某项技能或者能力极强的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is exceptionally talented or skilled in a particular area, like a god. Refers to someone who is proficient in a skill or has a very strong ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機真係一粒神嚟㗎，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 zan1 hai6 jat1 lap1 san4 lei4 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打游戏真是个大神，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a god at playing games, he wins every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺數學方面簡直係一粒神，咩難題都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sou3 hok6 fong1 min6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 lap1 san4, me1 naan4 tai4 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在数学方面简直就是个大神，什么难题都能解决。
examples.english_sentence: He's simply a genius in mathematics, he can solve any difficult problem.

english_meaning: A small amount of money, small profit, or small gain
explanation_mandarin: 形容很小的利润或收获。
explanation_english: Describes a very small profit or gain. Often used to describe something that's almost negligible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次做生意賺咗一粒花啫，唔夠交租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zou6 seng1 ji3 zaan6 zo2 jat1 lap1 faa1 ze1, m4 gau3 gaau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次做生意只赚了一点点钱，不够交租金。
examples.english_sentence: This time doing business only made a tiny bit of money, not enough to pay the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工雖然辛苦，但都係賺一粒花，唔值得做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 seoi1 jin4 san1 fu2, daan6 dou1 hai6 zaan6 jat1 lap1 faa1, m4 dak1 zik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作虽然辛苦，但只是赚一点点钱，不值得做。
examples.english_sentence: Although this job is hard, it only earns a small profit, not worth doing.

synonyms: 蝇头小利 (jing4 tau4 siu2 lei6)

jyutping: jat1 lap1 lai6 zi1 saam1 baa2 fo2
english_meaning: One lychee, three fires.
explanation_mandarin: 形容荔枝吃多了容易上火。荔枝性热，吃太多会导致身体燥热，出现口干舌燥、便秘等症状。
explanation_english: Describes how eating too many lychees can cause internal heat or inflammation in the body. Lychees are considered a 'heaty' food, and overconsumption can lead to symptoms like a dry mouth, sore throat, constipation, and acne.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多荔枝啦，一粒荔枝三把火，小心喉嚨痛啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 lai6 zi1 laa1, jat1 lap1 lai6 zi1 saam1 baa2 fo2, siu2 sam1 hau4 lung4 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别吃那么多荔枝了，一颗荔枝三把火，小心喉咙痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so many lychees, one lychee, three fires! Be careful of getting a sore throat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排生暗瘡，都唔敢食荔枝，始終一粒荔枝三把火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 saang1 am3 cong1, dou1 m4 gam2 sik6 lai6 zi1, ci2 cung1 jat1 lap1 lai6 zi1 saam1 baa2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近长痘痘，都不敢吃荔枝，毕竟一颗荔枝三把火。
examples.english_sentence: I've been getting acne lately, so I don't dare eat lychees, after all, one lychee, three fires.

english_meaning: one hour
explanation_mandarin: 量词，表示一个小时的时间。
explanation_english: A measure word meaning 'one hour'. It is a colloquial way to say 'one hour' in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲有冇一粒鐘先走？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 mou5 jat1 lap1 zung1 sin1 zau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还有没有一个小时才走？
examples.english_sentence: Do we still have one hour before we leave?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗你成粒鐘啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 seng4 lap1 zung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了你整整一个小时了！
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for you for a whole hour!

mandarin_meaning: 一点儿/微不足道/小角色
english_meaning: a nobody, insignificant, small fry
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人地位低下，微不足道，或者事情的规模很小。比喻小角色或无关紧要的人或事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is insignificant, of low status, or something of a small scale. It's a metaphor for a small role or someone/something unimportant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司只係一粒骰啫，冇乜話事權嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zi2 hai6 jat1 lap1 sik1 ze1, mou5 mat1 waa6 si6 kuen4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司只是个小角色，没有什么发言权。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a nobody in the company, he doesn't have much say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事對佢嚟講只不過係一粒骰，唔會影響到佢嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 lap1 sik1, m4 wui5 ying2 hoeng2 dou3 keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事对他来说只不过是微不足道的小事，不会影响到他的计划。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is just a small thing to him, it won't affect his plans.

english_meaning: a series of, a string of, a range of
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物连续出现，数量较多。
explanation_english: Indicates a continuous occurrence of things, usually in a large quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司推出咗一系列新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tui1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 hai6 lit6 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司推出了一系列新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company launched a series of new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋遇到一系列嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jyu6 dou2 zo2 jat1 hai6 lit6 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们遇到了一系列的问题。
examples.english_sentence: They encountered a series of problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳提供一系列嘅特色菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tai4 gung1 jat1 hai6 lit6 ge3 dak6 sik1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅提供一系列的特色菜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant offers a series of specialty dishes.

mandarin_meaning: 一级; 最高级; 特别好
english_meaning: first class; top grade; excellent; superb
explanation_mandarin: 指等级中的最高级别，或者形容事物非常优秀。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest level in a grading system, or describes something as very excellent or superb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績係全班一級嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 hai6 cyun4 baan1 jat1 gap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩是全班最好的。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are the best in the whole class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務真係一級嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 jat1 gap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务真是太棒了。
examples.english_sentence: The service in this restaurant is truly top-notch.

english_meaning: Formula One (F1)
explanation_mandarin: 指一级方程式赛车，是赛车运动中的最高级别赛事。
explanation_english: Refers to Formula One racing, the highest class of single-seater auto racing sanctioned by the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇一級方程式，覺得好刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jat1 kap1 fong1 cheng3 sik1, gok3 dak1 hou2 ci3 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢看一级方程式赛车，觉得很刺激。
examples.english_sentence: I really like watching Formula One, I find it very exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅一級方程式賽事，邊個車手最有機會贏？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 jat1 kap1 fong1 cheng3 sik1 coi3 si6, bin1 go3 che1 sau2 zeoi3 jau5 gei1 wui2 wing4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的方程式赛车比赛，哪个车手最有机会赢？
examples.english_sentence: Which driver has the best chance of winning this year's Formula One race?

mandarin_meaning: 一级片 (香港用语，指普通电影)
english_meaning: Category I film (Hong Kong term for a general audience film)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港电影分级制度中，一级片是指适合所有年龄段观看的电影，内容无不适宜儿童观看的成分。
explanation_english: In the Hong Kong film rating system, Category I films are suitable for all ages and contain no material inappropriate for children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲係一級片嚟㗎，細路仔都啱睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 hai6 jat1 kap1 pin3 lei4 gaa3, sai3 lou5 zai2 dou1 ngaam1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是一级片，小孩子也适合看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is a Category I film, suitable for children to watch.

english_meaning: To have a son at the first try; First attempt results in a son.
explanation_mandarin: 指第一次尝试就生了儿子，是传统观念中非常吉利的说法。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to having a son with the first pregnancy. It is considered a very auspicious and fortunate event in traditional Chinese culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚一年就一索得男，真係好彩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 jat1 nin4 zau6 jat1 sok3 dak1 naam4, zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚一年就一举得男，真是幸运啊！
examples.english_sentence: They had a son in their first year of marriage, so lucky!

english_meaning: unique; unparalleled; unsurpassed; the best of its kind; a special skill or talent
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人的技能、特点非常突出，独一无二，没有可以与之相比的。也可指某人拥有的绝技或一流的技能。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone's skill or characteristic as outstanding, unique, and unparalleled. It can also refer to a person possessing a unique skill or first-rate talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢煮嘅叉燒真係一絕，成條街都冇人煮得好過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu2 ge3 caa1 siu1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zyut6, seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 mou5 jan4 zyu2 dak1 hou2 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的叉烧真是一绝，整条街都没有人做得比他更好。
examples.english_sentence: His barbecued pork (char siu) is truly unparalleled; no one on the whole street can make it better than him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅書法喺香港都算係一絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 syu1 faat3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的书法在香港也算是独一无二的。
examples.english_sentence: His calligraphy can be considered unique in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心真係一絕，一定要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zyut6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心真是一绝，一定要尝试一下。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dim sum is truly outstanding; you must try it.

english_meaning: to unify the world; to rule the world under one system; to dominate the market
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代帝王统一全国，也比喻在某个领域占据绝对优势，独占鳌头。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the unification of China under a single emperor, it now also describes dominating a specific field or market, achieving a position of absolute dominance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅產品喺市場上幾乎一統天下，冇人夠佢哋鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 gei2 fu1 jat1 tung2 tin1 haa6, mou5 jan4 gau3 keoi5 dei6 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的产品在市场上几乎统一天下，没有人能和他们竞争。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's products practically dominate the market; no one can compete with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺電競界一統天下，成為最勁嘅玩家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 din6 ging6 gaai3 jat1 tung2 tin1 haa6, sing4 wai4 zeoi3 ging6 ge3 waan2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在电竞界统一天下，成为最厉害的玩家。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to dominate the e-sports scene and become the best player.

english_meaning: a trace; a hint; a shred; a bit
explanation_mandarin: 表示极少量或极细的东西。
explanation_english: Indicates a very small amount or something very thin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面上面有 一絲 笑容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 soeng6 min6 jau5 jat1 si1 siu3 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脸上有一丝笑容。
examples.english_sentence: There was a trace of a smile on his face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽唔到 一絲 聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 m4 dou2 jat1 si1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听不到一丝声音。
examples.english_sentence: I can't hear a single sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲有 一絲 希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 jau5 jat1 si1 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还有一丝希望。
examples.english_sentence: He still has a shred of hope.

english_meaning: stark naked, completely naked, without a stitch of clothing
explanation_mandarin: 形容赤裸裸，身上没有任何遮盖物。
explanation_english: Describes being completely naked, without any covering on the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢沖完涼，一絲不掛咁行出嚟，真係嚇我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 jyun4 loeng4, jat1 si1 bat1 gwaa3 gam2 haang4 ceot1 lai4, zan1 hai6 haak3 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他洗完澡，一丝不挂地走出来，真是吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He came out completely naked after showering, it really gave me a fright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一絲不掛咁喺屋企走嚟走去啦，會俾人睇到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 si1 bat1 gwaa3 gam2 hai2 uk1 kei2 zau2 lai4 zau2 heoi3 laa1, wui5 bei2 jan4 tai2 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一丝不挂地在家里走来走去啦，会被人看到的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk around the house completely naked, people will see you.

english_meaning: meticulous; scrupulous; paying extreme attention to detail; impeccable
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事非常认真、仔细，一点也不马虎。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very serious and careful in their work, paying extreme attention to detail and leaving no room for carelessness or sloppiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢一絲不苟，老細好欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 si1 bat1 gau2, lou5 sai3 hou2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作一丝不苟，老板很欣赏他。
examples.english_sentence: He is meticulous in his work, and the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告要寫得一絲不苟，唔可以有任何錯漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 se2 dak1 jat1 si1 bat1 gau2, m4 ho2 ji5 jau5 jam6 ho4 co3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告要写得一丝不苟，不可以有任何错漏。
examples.english_sentence: This report must be written meticulously, with no errors or omissions.

english_meaning: a glimmer of hope, a ray of hope
explanation_mandarin: 形容极其微小的希望。
explanation_english: Describes a very small amount of hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然情況好差，但係我哋都仲要保持一絲希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ching4 fong3 hou2 chaa1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jung4 jiu3 bo2 chi4 jat1 si1 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然情况很糟糕，但是我们仍然要保持一丝希望。
examples.english_sentence: Although the situation is terrible, we still need to maintain a glimmer of hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲有一絲希望可以康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung4 jau5 jat1 si1 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还有一丝希望可以康复。
examples.english_sentence: He still has a glimmer of hope that he can recover.

english_meaning: To catch the whole lot in one fell swoop; to round up all at once
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一次性地将所有罪犯或目标全部抓获。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to capture or catch all criminals or targets in one go, leaving none behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方部署咗好耐，終於可以一網成擒，將成個犯罪集團瓦解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 bou6 syu3 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 jat1 mong5 sing4 kam4, zoeng1 sing4 go3 faan2 zeoi6 zaap6 tyun4 wa2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方部署了很久，终于可以一网打尽，将整个犯罪集团瓦解。
examples.english_sentence: The police had been planning for a long time, and finally they were able to round up the whole lot, dismantling the entire criminal syndicate.

english_meaning: to catch everything in one net; to round up the whole lot; to capture or eliminate all at once
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一次性全部抓住或彻底消灭。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to catch everything in one go, either literally (like in fishing) or figuratively, meaning to capture or eliminate everything or everyone involved in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方今次行動要將啲毒販一網打盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gam1 ci3 hang4 dung6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 duk6 faan2 jat1 mong5 daa2 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方这次行动要将毒贩一网打尽。
examples.english_sentence: The police operation this time aims to catch all the drug dealers in one fell swoop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想喺股市度一網打盡，點知輸到渣都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 hai2 gu2 si5 dou6 jat1 mong5 daa2 zeon6, dim2 zi1 syu1 dou3 zaa1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想在股市中一网打尽，没想到输得一无所有。
examples.english_sentence: They wanted to make a killing in the stock market, but ended up losing everything.

synonyms: 斬草除根 (zaam2 cou2 ceoi4 gan1)

english_meaning: A narrow margin; a thread; a glimmer of hope; top tier; first class
explanation_mandarin: 可以指非常细的一条线，也常用来比喻极其微小的希望、机会，或者指某事物达到了顶尖水平。
explanation_english: Can refer to a very thin line. It's also often used metaphorically to describe a very small hope or opportunity, or to indicate that something has reached the top level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅實力只係差一線啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat6 lik6 zi2 hai6 caa1 jat1 sin3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的实力只差一线而已。
examples.english_sentence: The difference in strength between the two of them is only a narrow margin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳喺香港算係一線嘅餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 syun3 hai6 jat1 sin3 ge3 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅在香港算是顶级的餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is considered a top-tier restaurant in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有一線生機，唔好放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 jat1 sin3 sang1 gei1, m4 hou2 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 还有一线生机，不要放弃。
examples.english_sentence: There's still a glimmer of hope, don't give up.

english_meaning: by a hair's breadth; a narrow margin; a close call
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常接近，只差一点点，结果就会完全不同。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is very close to being different, and a slight change would have completely altered the outcome. It implies a narrow margin between success and failure or two different results.
