examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試我差一線之差就合格喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 ngo5 caa1 jat1 sin3 zi1 caa1 zau6 hap6 gaak3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试我差一点就及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I missed passing the exam by a hair's breadth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅票數一線之差，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 piu3 sou3 jat1 sin3 zi1 caa1, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的票数非常接近，竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The number of votes between them was a narrow margin, the competition was very intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋隊一線之差輸咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 jat1 sin3 zi1 caa1 syu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们队差一点就赢了，但输了。
examples.english_sentence: Our team lost this competition by a narrow margin.

english_meaning: Bound by a thread of fate, brought together by fate, destined romance
explanation_mandarin: 比喻两人之间有命运的联系，通常指姻缘。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to a connection between two people dictated by fate, usually in the context of a romantic relationship or marriage. It suggests that the couple is destined to be together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個咁啱喺飛機上面識，真係一線牽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam3 ngaam1 hai2 fei1 gei1 soeng6 min6 sik1, zan1 hai6 jat1 sin3 hin1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个竟然在飞机上认识，真是一线牵啊！
examples.english_sentence: They happened to meet on a plane, it's truly a thread of fate!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我相信緣份，可能我哋嘅緣份係一線牽掛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 jyun4 fan6, ho2 nang4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyun4 fan6 hai6 jat1 sin3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我相信缘分，可能我们的缘分是一线牵。
examples.english_sentence: I believe in fate, maybe our fate is a thread that binds us.

english_meaning: a glimmer of hope, a ray of hope, a slim chance of survival
explanation_mandarin: 指在非常危险的情况下，仍然存在微小的生存或成功的希望。
explanation_english: Refers to a very slim chance of survival or success in an extremely dangerous or difficult situation.  It indicates that even when things look bleak, there is still a small possibility of a positive outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢嘅情況好危險，但係醫生話仲有一線生機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ge3 ching4 fong3 hou2 ngai4 him2, daan6 hai6 yi1 sang1 waa6 jung4 jau5 jat1 sin3 sang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他的情况很危险，但是医生说仍然有一线生机。
examples.english_sentence: Although his condition is very dangerous, the doctor said there is still a glimmer of hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算機會渺茫，我哋都唔可以放棄，要盡力爭取嗰一線生機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 gei1 wui2 miu5 mong4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 ho2 yi5 fong3 hei3, yiu3 zeon6 lik6 zaang1 chui2 go2 jat1 sin3 sang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使机会渺茫，我们也不能放弃，要尽力争取那一线生机。
examples.english_sentence: Even if the chances are slim, we can't give up; we must try our best to seize that ray of hope.

english_meaning: Slovenly; unkempt; dishevelled; not properly dressed; scruffy.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人衣着不整洁，不修边幅，看起来邋遢。
explanation_english: Describes a person's appearance when they are not well-dressed, unkempt, and look scruffy.  Implies a lack of attention to one's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都一纊掕咁，執執佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 kwaang3 laang6 gam2, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是这么邋遢，收拾一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're always so slovenly, tidy yourself up a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放假嘅時候成日都一纊掕，唔修邊幅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 gaa3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 kwaang3 laang6, m4 sau1 bin1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放假的时候总是邋邋遢遢的，不修边幅。
examples.english_sentence: He's always scruffy when he's on holiday, not bothering to dress properly.

jyutping: jat1 ji4 zoi3, zoi3 ji4 saam1
english_meaning: Again and again, repeatedly, time and time again
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或行为重复多次发生。强调重复的次数很多。
explanation_english: Describes something happening or being done repeatedly. Emphasizes the multiple occurrences of the repetition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一而再，再而三咁遲到，我真係忍你唔住喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ji4 zoi3, zoi3 ji4 saam1 gam2 ci4 dou3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 jan2 nei5 m4 zyu6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一次又一次地迟到，我真的忍受不了你了！
examples.english_sentence: You are late again and again. I really can't stand it anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一而再，再而三噉犯同樣嘅錯誤，真係冇藥醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ji4 zoi3, zoi3 ji4 saam1 gam2 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3 ng6, zan1 hai6 mou5 joek6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一次又一次地犯同样的错误，真是没救了。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps making the same mistakes again and again, he's hopeless.

english_meaning: without a word; silently; quietly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人沉默不语，不发出任何声音。
explanation_english: Describes a person who remains silent and doesn't make any noise or say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，一聲不響噉返埋位做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, jat1 seng1 bat1 hoeng2 gam2 faan1 maai4 wai2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，一声不吭地回到座位工作。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he silently returned to his seat and continued working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到一聲不響，睇嚟真係激親佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 jat1 seng1 bat1 hoeng2, tai2 lai4 zan1 hai6 gik1 can1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得一声不吭，看来真的是惹到他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so angry that he's not saying a word. Seems like he's really been provoked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聲不響就走咗去旅行，真係估佢唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 seng1 bat1 hoeng2 zau6 zau2 zo2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一声不吭就去旅行了，真是没想到。
examples.english_sentence: He went on a trip without saying a word; I really didn't expect it.

english_meaning: at a single command; at the drop of a hat (when ordered); as soon as the order is given
explanation_mandarin: 指接到命令后立即行动，通常形容执行力强。
explanation_english: Refers to acting immediately upon receiving an order, usually describing strong execution ability. It emphasizes the promptness and decisiveness of action following a command.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細一聲令下，我哋即刻開始做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jat1 seng1 ling6 haa6, ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 hoi1 chi2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板一声令下，我们立刻开始工作。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the boss gave the order, we immediately started working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿sir一聲令下，啲學生就即刻企起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir2 jat1 seng1 ling6 haa6, di1 hok6 saang1 zau6 zik1 hak1 kei5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师一声令下，学生们就立刻站了起来。
examples.english_sentence: At the teacher's command, the students immediately stood up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聲令下，成班人即刻衝出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 seng1 ling6 haa6, seng4 baan1 jan4 zik1 hak1 cung1 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一声令下，整班人立刻冲了出去。
examples.english_sentence: At his command, the whole group rushed out immediately.

english_meaning: full of anger; seething with rage; extremely annoyed
explanation_mandarin: 形容心中充满怒气，非常生气。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being filled with anger and resentment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，真係令我一肚氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 jat1 tou5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，真让我一肚子气。
examples.english_sentence: He is always late, which really fills me with anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易一肚氣啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 jat1 tou5 hei3 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易就一肚子气了，对身体不好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get so easily angered, it's not good for your health.

english_meaning: full of anger; seething with rage
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常生气，心里充满怒火。
explanation_english: Describes being very angry, with the heart full of rage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，搞到我一肚火！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tou5 fo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，搞得我一肚子火！
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, it makes me so angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細無理取鬧，真係令人一肚火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 mou4 lei5 ceoi2 naau6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 jat1 tou5 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板无理取闹，真让人一肚子火。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is being unreasonable, it's really infuriating.

english_meaning: to stem from the same source; to trace one's origin to the same stock; to follow in the same vein; passed down from one line
explanation_mandarin: 指从同一血统或思想、学说传下来，延续不断。
explanation_english: Describes something that is inherited or passed down from the same lineage, thought, or doctrine, continuing uninterrupted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅點心做法，一脈相承，保持咗傳統風味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 zou6 faat3, jat1 mak6 soeng1 sing4, bou2 ci4 zo2 tyun4 tung2 fung1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的点心做法一脉相承，保持了传统风味。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum making method in this tea restaurant stems from the same source, maintaining the traditional flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫風同佢師傅一脈相承，一眼就睇得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 fung1 tung4 keoi5 si1 fu6 jat1 mak6 soeng1 sing4, jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画风和他的师傅一脉相承，一眼就看得出来。
examples.english_sentence: His painting style follows in the same vein as his master's, you can tell at a glance.

english_meaning: Covered in mud (lit. covered in cow dung)/Extremely unlucky; in a very unfortunate situation; in deep trouble
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“踩到一脚牛粪”。比喻陷入麻烦，倒霉透顶，或者弄得一身污秽。
explanation_english: Literally means "stepping in cow dung with one foot". It is used metaphorically to describe someone who is in deep trouble, extremely unlucky, or has gotten themselves into a messy situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借咗大耳窿錢，而家真係一腳牛屎，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 zo2 daai6 ji5 lung1 cin2, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 jat1 goek3 ngau4 si2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借了高利贷，现在真是倒霉透顶，不知道该怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: He borrowed money from loan sharks, and now he's really in deep trouble, I don't know what he should do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次衰咗，真係一腳牛屎，唔知點向老細交代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 seoi1 zo2, zan1 hai6 jat1 goek3 ngau4 si2, m4 zi1 dim2 hoeng3 lou5 sai3 gaau1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次失败了，真是倒霉，不知道怎么向老板交代。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this time and I'm in a mess, I don't know how to explain it to my boss.

synonyms: 鑊鑊新鮮鑊鑊甘 (wok6 wok6 san1 sin1 wok6 wok6 gam1)

english_meaning: to two-time; to play the field; to sit on the fence
explanation_mandarin: 比喻同时与两个人或多个对象保持暧昧关系，或者同时采取两种不同的立场，想获得两方面的好处。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes being romantically involved with two or more people at the same time, or trying to please two opposing sides or have the best of both worlds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁花心，成日都想一腳踏兩船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 faa1 sam1, seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 jat1 goek3 daap6 loeng5 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很花心，总是想脚踏两条船。
examples.english_sentence: He's so unfaithful, he always wants to two-time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住一腳踏兩船，到時兩邊都得唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 jat1 goek3 daap6 loeng5 syun4, dou3 si4 loeng5 bin1 dou1 dak1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着脚踏两条船，到时候两边都得不到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about two-timing, you won't get either side in the end.

english_meaning: to be two-timing; to juggle multiple relationships; to have a foot in several camps
explanation_mandarin: 比喻同时与多人保持恋爱关系，或者同时在多个方面发展。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where someone is involved in multiple romantic relationships simultaneously, or pursuing multiple interests/opportunities at the same time, often in a disloyal or unsustainable way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日一腳踏幾船，所以啲女朋友成日同佢嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jat1 goek3 daap6 gei2 syun4, so2 ji5 di1 neoi5 pang4 jau5 seng4 jat6 tung4 keoi5 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是脚踏几条船，所以他的女朋友们总是和他吵架。
examples.english_sentence: He is always two-timing, so his girlfriends always argue with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔可以一腳踏幾船，要專注先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 goek3 daap6 gei2 syun4, jiu3 zyun1 zyu3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不能脚踏几条船，要专注才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: You can't have a foot in several camps when doing business; you need to focus.

english_meaning: to do everything yourself; to be a one-man band
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人负责所有的事情，独自完成所有工作。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where one person is responsible for doing everything; to handle all aspects of a task or project alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司好細，老闆要一腳踢，乜都要自己做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 sai3, lou5 baan2 jiu3 jat1 goek3 tek3, mat1 dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司很小，老板要一手包办，什么都要自己做。
examples.english_sentence: His company is very small, the boss has to do everything himself, doing everything on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project得我一個人做，真係要一腳踢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project dak1 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 jat1 goek3 tek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目只有我一个人做，真的要一手包办。
examples.english_sentence: This project is done by me alone, I really have to do everything myself.

english_meaning: a helping hand; a contribution; a shoulder to lean on
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从旁协助的力量，帮助别人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for the power of assistance from the sidelines; to help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要盡力幫佢哋一把，俾佢哋一臂之力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 bong1 keoi5 dei6 jat1 baa2, bei2 keoi5 dei6 jat1 bei3 zi1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要尽力帮助他们，给他们一份力量。
examples.english_sentence: We must do our best to help them and give them a helping hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你需要幫手，隨時搵我，我一定會俾一臂之力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2, ceoi4 si4 wan2 ngo5, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 bei2 jat1 bei3 zi1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你需要帮忙，随时找我，我一定会尽力帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: If you need help, come find me anytime, I will definitely give you a helping hand.

english_meaning: a look of helplessness; a helpless expression
explanation_mandarin: 形容脸上带着无奈的表情。
explanation_english: Describes someone with a helpless or resigned expression on their face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽完老細嘅無理要求之後，一臉無奈咁應承咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jyun4 lou5 sai3 ge3 mou4 lei5 jiu1 kau4 zi1 hau6, jat1 lin5 mou4 noi6 gam2 ying3 sing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听完老板的无理要求之后，一脸无奈地答应了。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the boss's unreasonable request, he reluctantly agreed with a look of helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽一臉無奈咁睇住個仔玩爛啲玩具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat1 lin5 mou4 noi6 gam2 tai2 zyu6 go3 zai2 waan2 laan6 di1 wun6 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈一脸无奈地看着儿子把玩具弄坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The mother watched her son destroy the toys with a helpless expression.

synonyms: 無可奈何 (mou4 ho2 noi6 ho4)

english_meaning: in one go; at one stroke; with one move; all at once; in a single action

english_meaning: every action; every move; all one's actions
explanation_mandarin: 指人的每一个动作、举止。形容人的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to every action or movement of a person. Describes a person's behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要小心自己嘅一舉一動，唔好影響其他人。

examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 keoi5 bong1 sau2, jat1 geoi2 loeng5 dak1, keoi5 ge3 ho2 ji5 zaan6 cin2, jau6 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请他帮忙，一举两得，他既可以赚钱，又可以帮我解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Asking him for help is killing two birds with one stone; he can earn money and help me solve the problem.

english_meaning: to become famous overnight; to achieve instant fame
explanation_mandarin: 指一下子就出了名。

examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tong4 jung4 m4 wan4, gaau2 jyun4 dou1 hai6 jat1 gau6 gau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糖溶不均匀，搅拌完还是一块块的。
examples.english_sentence: The sugar didn't dissolve evenly; it's still in clumps after stirring.

english_meaning: general; common; ordinary; so-so
explanation_mandarin: 指普通、平常、不特别。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is common, ordinary, and not special.

english_meaning: ordinary person, average person

english_meaning: generally speaking, in general

explanation_english: Indicates a situation or condition that is generally or usually the case.

english_meaning: To take something to heart; To be bothered by; To lower oneself to argue with someone; To be petty or argumentative
explanation_mandarin: 指因为某人的言行而生气或计较，认为对方不够好或不值得认真对待。
explanation_english: It refers to getting angry or taking issue with someone's words or actions, considering the other person not good enough or not worth taking seriously. It implies that to engage would be to lower oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁衰，你唔使同佢一般見識嘅。

explanation_english: Refers to being completely the same, without any differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個孖生姊妹，睇落一色一樣噉。

english_meaning: A falling leaf heralds the coming of autumn; a small sign indicates a major trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟開始唔好，好多公司都裁員，真係一葉知秋呀。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济开始不好，很多公司都裁员，真是一叶知秋啊。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is starting to decline, and many companies are laying off staff. It's truly a sign of things to come.

english_meaning: Number One, first-class, top-notch, (in the context of Typhoon signals in Hong Kong) Standby Signal
explanation_mandarin: 既可以表示第一号，也可以表示一流的，最好的。在香港，也指台风信号中的一号风球。
explanation_english: Can mean 'Number One' or 'first-class, top-notch'. In Hong Kong, it also refers to Typhoon Signal Number 1, the Standby Signal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功課永遠都係一號㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 fo3 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 jat1 hou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功课永远都是第一名。
examples.english_sentence: His homework is always number one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會掛一號風球，你出門口要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 gwaa3 jat1 hou6 fung1 kau4, nei5 chut1 mun4 hau2 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会挂一号风球，你出门要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The Standby Signal will be hoisted tomorrow, be careful when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務真係一號，冇得彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 jat1 hou6, mou5 dak1 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务真是一流，无可挑剔。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is truly top-notch, impeccable.

english_meaning: Tropical Cyclone Signal No. 1
explanation_mandarin: 香港的热带气旋警告信号系统中的最低级别。表示有热带气旋集结，可能影响香港。
explanation_english: The lowest level of the Tropical Cyclone Warning Signals in Hong Kong. It indicates that a tropical cyclone is centered within 800 kilometers of Hong Kong and may affect the territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台掛咗一號波，大家出街要留意天氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 gwaa3 zo2 jat1 hou6 bo1, daai6 gaa1 ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 lau4 ji3 tin1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台挂了一号风球，大家出门要注意天气。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Observatory has hoisted Tropical Cyclone Signal No. 1. Everyone should pay attention to the weather when going out.

english_meaning: Tropical Cyclone Signal No. 1
explanation_mandarin: 香港天文台发出的热带气旋警告信号，表示有热带气旋集结在香港约800公里范围内，可能影响香港。
explanation_english: Tropical Cyclone Warning Signal No. 1 issued by the Hong Kong Observatory, indicating that a tropical cyclone is located within about 800 kilometers of Hong Kong and may affect the territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台掛咗一號風球，大家出街要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 gwaa3 zo2 jat1 hou6 fung1 kau4, daai6 gaa1 ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台挂了一号风球，大家出门要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Observatory has hoisted Tropical Cyclone Signal No. 1. Everyone should be more careful when going out.

english_meaning: one dollar
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语俚语中，通常指代一块钱。 “雞” (gai1)在这里是语气助词，并非指动物。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, it generally refers to one dollar. "雞" (gai1) is used as a modal particle here, not referring to the animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個麵包只係賣一蚊雞咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 min6 baau1 zi2 hai6 maai6 jat1 man1 gai1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个面包只卖一块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This bread only costs one dollar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你借一蚊雞俾我搭車得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ze3 jat1 man1 gai1 bei2 ngo5 daap3 ce1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你借一块钱给我坐车行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me one dollar for the bus fare?

mandarin_meaning: 一块钱的妓女；非常廉价的东西
english_meaning: A one-dollar prostitute; something extremely cheap and low-quality
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常廉价或低劣的东西或服务。原指价格极低的妓女，现在多用于比喻。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely cheap or of very low quality. Originally referring to a prostitute with a very low price (one dollar), it is now mostly used metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨咁cheap，簡直係一蚊鷄貨色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 gam3 cheap1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 man1 gai1 fo3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货这么便宜，简直是廉价货。
examples.english_sentence: These goods are so cheap, they're practically dirt cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾咁少錢，仲想人哋做到好好？一蚊鷄都唔得啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 gam3 siu2 cin2, zung6 soeng2 jan4 dei6 zou6 dou3 hou2 hou2? jat1 man1 gai1 dou1 m4 dak1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给这么点钱，还想别人做得很好？一块钱的妓女都做不到！
examples.english_sentence: You pay so little, yet you expect people to do a good job? Even a one-dollar prostitute wouldn't do that!

jyutping: jat1 haai5 bat1 jyu4 jat1 haai5
mandarin_meaning: 一代不如一代, 每况愈下
english_meaning: Each generation is worse than the last; going from bad to worse; a gradual decline in quality or performance
explanation_mandarin: 形容一代不如一代，情况越来越差。比喻事物越来越糟糕。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where each generation or iteration is worse than the previous one. It implies a continuous decline and things are getting worse and worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲電視劇，一蟹不如一蟹，冇以前咁好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 din6 si6 kek6, jat1 haai5 bat1 jyu4 jat1 haai5, mou5 ji5 cin4 gam3 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的电视剧，一代不如一代，没有以前那么好看了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, TV dramas are getting worse and worse; they're not as good as they used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品，一蟹不如一蟹，品質下降得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2, jat1 haai5 bat1 jyu4 jat1 haai5, ban2 zat1 haang4 gaang3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的产品，一代不如一代，品质下降得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The products of this company are getting worse and worse; the quality has declined significantly.

english_meaning: a crowd; a group of people; everybody
explanation_mandarin: 表示一群人，大家。通常用于描述一群人共同做某事或处于某种状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people, everyone. Usually used to describe a group of people doing something together or being in a certain state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一衆同事今晚去飲嘢慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zung3 tung4 si6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jam2 je5 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群同事今晚去喝酒庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: A group of colleagues are going for drinks tonight to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一衆人都覺得呢個提議唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zung3 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都觉得这个提议不错。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone thinks this proposal is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聲令下，一衆人就開始行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 seng1 ling6 haa6, jat1 zung3 jan4 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一声令下，一群人就开始行动。
examples.english_sentence: At his command, the whole group started to act.

english_meaning: a row; a line; a profession; an industry
explanation_mandarin: 表示一行或一列，也指行业或职业。
explanation_english: Refers to a row or line. It can also refer to a profession or industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋企成一行，好齊整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kei5 sing4 jat1 hong4, hou2 cai4 zeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们站成一排，很整齐。
examples.english_sentence: They stood in a row, very neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行行出狀元。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 hang4 ceot1 zong6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各行各业都能出类拔萃的人才。
examples.english_sentence: There is always a champion in every profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉咗行，而家做IT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 zo2 hang4, ji4 gaa1 zou6 ai1 ti1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他转行了，现在做IT。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his profession and now works in IT.

english_meaning: Of striking appearance; a handsome man; presentable; of distinguished appearance
explanation_mandarin: 形容男子仪表出众，容貌堂堂，气宇轩昂。
explanation_english: Describes a man with outstanding appearance, handsome features, and a dignified and impressive demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生得一表人才，好受女仔歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saang1 dak1 jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4, hou2 sau6 neoi5 zai2 faan1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长得一表人才，很受女孩子欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He is handsome and popular with girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新人一表人才，睇嚟好有潛力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 jan4 jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4, tai2 lai4 hou2 jau5 cim4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新人一表人才，看起来很有潜力。
examples.english_sentence: This new person is very presentable, it seems like he has great potential.

synonyms: 英俊瀟灑 (jing1 zeon3 siu1 saa2)
相貌堂堂 (seung3 maau6 tong4 tong4)

english_meaning: Of striking appearance; handsome and imposing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的外貌英俊潇洒，很有气派。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is handsome, imposing, and has a striking appearance. Often used to describe a man with good looks and a dignified bearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一表人材，好多女仔都鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4, hou2 do1 neoi5 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一表人才，很多女孩都喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly handsome and striking, many girls like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿輝一表人材，所以做模特兒好適合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 fai1 jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4, so2 ji5 zou6 mo1 dak1 ji4 hou2 sik1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿辉一表人才，所以做模特很适合。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Fai is handsome and imposing, so he is well-suited to be a model.

english_meaning: having a refined and genteel appearance; appearing scholarly and well-mannered
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人外表看起来文雅、有礼貌。通常指外表，不一定代表内在。
explanation_english: Describes someone who appears refined, polite, and scholarly on the outside. Often refers to appearance, not necessarily reflecting their inner character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一表斯文，點知做嘢咁鬼鼠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 biu2 si1 man4, dim2 zi1 zou6 je5 gam3 gwai2 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来很斯文，没想到做事这么狡猾。
examples.english_sentence: He looks so refined, who knew he'd be so sneaky when working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢一表斯文嘅外表呃到，佢好蠱惑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 jat1 biu2 si1 man4 ge3 ngoi6 biu2 aak1 dou3, keoi5 hou2 gu2 waak6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他斯文的外表骗了，他很狡猾的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his refined appearance, he's very cunning.

synonyms: 文質彬彬 (man4 zat1 ban1 ban1)
斯斯文文 (si1 si1 man4 man4)

english_meaning: to feel like old friends at first meeting
explanation_mandarin: 第一次见面就像老朋友一样，形容彼此很投缘。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of instant connection and familiarity with someone upon first meeting, as if you have been friends for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢喺個派對上面一見如故，傾咗成晚偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai2 go3 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 min6 jat1 gin3 jyu4 gu3, king1 zo2 seng4 maan5 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他在派对上相见恨晚，聊了一整个晚上。
examples.english_sentence: I met him at the party, and we hit it off right away. We talked all night.

mandarin_meaning: 一见钟情 (yī jiàn zhōng qíng)
english_meaning: love at first sight
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间第一次见面就产生了强烈的爱情。
explanation_english: Refers to a strong feeling of love between a man and a woman upon their first meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺機場一見鍾情，真係好浪漫呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gei1 coeng4 jat1 gin3 zung1 cing4, zan1 hai6 hou2 long5 maan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是在机场一见钟情，真的很浪漫啊！
examples.english_sentence: We fell in love at first sight at the airport, it's so romantic!

english_meaning: to treat everyone equally; impartiality
explanation_mandarin: 指看待人或事物一样看待，不分厚薄。
explanation_english: To treat everyone equally and impartially, without showing favoritism or discrimination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋老闆對所有員工都一視同仁，唔會偏袒任何人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lou5 baan2 deoi3 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 dou1 jat1 si6 tung4 yan4, m4 wui5 pin1 taan2 jam6 ho2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的老板对所有员工都一视同仁，不会偏袒任何人。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss treats all employees equally and doesn't show favoritism to anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教書好公平，對所有學生都一視同仁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 syu1 hou2 gung1 ping4, deoi3 so2 jau5 hok6 sang1 dou1 jat1 si6 tung4 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教书很公平，对所有学生都一视同仁。
examples.english_sentence: He is a fair teacher and treats all his students equally.

synonyms: 平等對待 (ping4 dang2 deoi3 doi6)

english_meaning: To kiss a beautiful woman; to be intimate with a beautiful woman; to experience someone's charm and grace (often in a romantic context)
explanation_mandarin: 芳泽指女子身上的香味或恩泽。一亲芳泽，比喻能够亲近、接近美女，多指得到美女的亲吻或发生亲密关系。
explanation_english: "芳澤 (fong1 zaak6)" refers to a woman's fragrance or grace. "一親芳澤 (jat1 can1 fong1 zaak6)" figuratively means to get close to a beautiful woman, often implying getting a kiss or engaging in intimate relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想有一日可以一親女神芳澤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 jau5 jat1 jat6 ho2 ji5 jat1 can1 nui5 san4 fong1 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他梦想有一天可以亲吻女神的芳泽。
examples.english_sentence: He dreams of one day being able to kiss his goddess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住點樣可以一親芳澤，真係咸濕佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 jat1 can1 fong1 zaak6, zan1 hai6 haam4 sip1 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天想着怎样才能亲泽美女，真是个色狼。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks about how to kiss a beautiful woman; he's such a pervert.

english_meaning: a quick look; a brief survey; to scan
explanation_mandarin: 快速地浏览一遍；概括地看一遍。
explanation_english: To take a quick look or survey of something; to scan or view briefly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾你睇一覽份報告先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 nei5 tai2 jat1 laam5 fan6 bou3 gou3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先给你看一下这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: Let me give you a quick look at this report first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一覽咗成個博物館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 laam5 zo2 seng4 go3 bok3 mat6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们浏览了整个博物馆。
examples.english_sentence: We had a quick look at the whole museum.

english_meaning: to have a panoramic view; to see everything at a glance; to see all details clearly
explanation_mandarin: 一眼看去，所有的景物都毫无遗漏地呈现出来。形容视野开阔，什么都看得见。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything can be seen at a glance, without anything being missed. It emphasizes a clear and unobstructed view of all details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺山頂度，成個城市嘅景色都可以一覽無遺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 saan1 ding2 dou6, seng4 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 ging2 sik1 dou1 ho2 ji5 jat1 laam5 mou4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在山顶上，整个城市的景色都可以一览无遗。
examples.english_sentence: From the mountaintop, the entire city's scenery can be seen at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅設計好開放，入到去一眼就可以將所有嘢一覽無遺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 hoi1 fong3, jap6 dou2 heoi3 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 je5 jat1 laam5 mou4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的设计很开放，进去一眼就可以将所有东西一览无余。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this house is very open, so you can see everything at a glance when you enter.

english_meaning: On the verge of exploding; about to erupt; a touchy situation.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事态发展到十分紧张的阶段，稍一触动就会爆发。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is highly tense and volatile, where even the slightest provocation could trigger an explosion or outbreak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係好差，一觸即發噉，隨時都會嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 caa1, jat1 zuk1 zik1 faat3 gam2, ceoi4 si4 dou1 wui2 caau2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的关系很差，一触即发，随时都会吵架。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the two of them is very bad; it's a powder keg, and they're likely to quarrel at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家局勢一觸即發，大家要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 guk6 sai3 jat1 zuk1 zik1 faat3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在局势一触即发，大家要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The situation is on the verge of exploding right now; everyone needs to be more careful.

synonyms: 劍拔弩張 (gim3 bat6 nu5 zoeng1)

english_meaning: every word and deed; every action and saying; all words and actions
explanation_mandarin: 指人的每一句话，每一个行动。形容人的一举一动。
explanation_english: Refers to every word and action of a person. Describes a person's every move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個公眾人物，佢嘅一言一行都備受關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 gung1 zung3 jan4 mat6, keoi5 ge3 jat1 jin4 jat1 hang4 dou1 bei6 sau6 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个公众人物，他的一言一行都备受关注。
examples.english_sentence: As a public figure, his every word and deed is closely watched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家長應該以身作則，注意自己嘅一言一行，俾仔女樹立好榜樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zoeng2 ying1 goi1 ji5 san1 zok3 zak1, zyu3 yi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 jat1 jin4 jat1 hang4, bei2 zai2 neoi5 syu6 lap6 hou2 bong2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家长应该以身作则，注意自己的一言一行，给子女树立好榜样。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should lead by example, pay attention to their words and deeds, and set a good example for their children.

mandarin_meaning: 一句话说不到一起去; 一句话没说好
english_meaning: a disagreement over a single sentence; to disagree sharply; to start arguing over a minor disagreement
explanation_mandarin: 指因为一句话没说好，双方就产生争执或冲突，通常带有夸张或幽默的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where a disagreement or conflict arises from a single badly-spoken sentence. It is often used with exaggeration or humor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一言不合就嘈交，真係冇眼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 jin4 bat1 hap6 zau6 cou4 gaau1, zan1 hai6 mou5 ngaan5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩一言不合就吵架，真是没眼看。
examples.english_sentence: Those two start arguing over a tiny disagreement, it's unbearable to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲網民真係一言不合就開火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 mong5 man4 zan1 hai6 jat1 jin4 bat1 hap6 zau6 hoi1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的网民真是一言不合就开战。
examples.english_sentence: These days, netizens start arguing fiercely over the smallest disagreement.

english_meaning: not uttering a single word; remaining silent; to keep mum
explanation_mandarin: 形容沉默不语，一声不吭。
explanation_english: Describes a state of complete silence, not uttering a single word or making a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到一言不發，我諗佢真係好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 jat1 jin4 bat1 faat3, ngo5 lam2 keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得一言不发，我想他真的很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he didn't say a single word, I think he's really mad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老闆鬧完之後，一路都一言不發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 baan2 nau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, jat1 lou6 dou1 jat1 jin4 bat1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，一直都一言不发。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he remained silent all the way.

synonyms: 默不作聲 (mak6 bat1 zok3 seng1)
噤若寒蟬 (gam3 joek6 hon4 sim4)

english_meaning: One word carries the weight of nine tripods; a word of great weight and authority; a promise that is absolutely reliable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话很有分量，一句话抵得上九个鼎的重量。比喻说话很有力量，能起很大作用。
explanation_english: Describes a word carrying immense weight and authority. It means a single promise or statement is as weighty as nine tripods, symbolizing trustworthiness and significance. It's used to describe someone whose words are highly respected and influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢一言九頂，你唔使擔心佢會走數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jat1 jin4 gau2 ding2, nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 keoi5 wui5 zau2 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话一言九鼎，你不用担心他会赖账。
examples.english_sentence: His words carry a lot of weight, you don't have to worry about him going back on his promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，老闆嘅說話就一言九頂，冇人敢反對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, lou5 baan2 ge3 syut3 waa2 zau6 jat1 jin4 gau2 ding2, mou5 jan4 gam2 faan2 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这间公司，老板说的话一言九鼎，没有人敢反对。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, the boss's words are absolute, and nobody dares to object.

synonyms: 擲地有聲 (zaak6 dei6 jau5 seng1)
金口玉言 (gam1 hau2 juk6 jin4)

english_meaning: Words carry great weight; a promise that carries a lot of influence; a word worth its weight in gold.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话很有分量，说话算数，一旦说出，就非常可靠。
explanation_english: Describes words that carry great weight and influence. A promise that is reliable and trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅地位好高，講嘢一言九鼎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 wai2 hou2 gou1, gong2 je5 jat1 jin4 gau2 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司地位很高，说话一言九鼎。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very high position in the company; his words carry great weight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅承諾一言九鼎，你可以放心信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 nok6 jat1 jin4 gau2 ding2, nei5 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的承诺一言千金，你可以放心地相信他。
examples.english_sentence: His promise is worth its weight in gold, you can trust him with confidence.

english_meaning: In a nutshell; to sum it up in a word; in short
explanation_mandarin: 用一句话来概括。
explanation_english: To summarize or encapsulate something in a single phrase or statement. Often used to express a concise conclusion or opinion after a longer discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一言以蔽之，佢就係一個懶人啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jin4 ji5 bai3 zi1, keoi5 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 laan5 jan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，他就是一个懒人。
examples.english_sentence: In a nutshell, he's just a lazy person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅會議一言以蔽之就係浪費時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 wui5 ji5 jat1 jin4 ji5 bai3 zi1 zau6 hai6 long6 fai3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的会议总而言之就是浪费时间。
examples.english_sentence: To sum up this meeting, it was a waste of time.

english_meaning: one-man rule; a place where only one person's opinion counts; a dictatorial style
explanation_mandarin: 形容领导独断专行，一个人说了算，听不进别人的意见。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a leader makes decisions unilaterally, ignoring the opinions of others; a dictatorial style of leadership or decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅決策全部都係老闆話事，根本就係一言堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 zaak3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 lou5 baan2 waa6 si6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 jin4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的决策全部都是老板说了算，根本就是一言堂。
examples.english_sentence: All the decisions of the company are made by the boss; it's essentially a one-man show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會應該俾大家發表意見，唔好搞到好似一言堂咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 jing1 goi1 bei2 daai6 gaa1 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3, m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 hou2 ci5 jat1 jin4 tong4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会应该让大家发表意见，不要搞得像一言堂一样。
examples.english_sentence: Meetings should allow everyone to express their opinions; don't let it become a one-man show.

mandarin_meaning: 一言既出，驷马难追 (yī yán jì chū, sì mǎ nán zhuī)
english_meaning: A word spoken cannot be unspoken; what is said cannot be unsaid; a promise is a promise.
explanation_mandarin: 指话说出口，就不能再收回，形容说话算数，信守承诺。
explanation_english: This idiom means that once a word is spoken, it cannot be taken back. It emphasizes the importance of keeping one's promises and being true to one's word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一言既出，駟馬難追，講咗嘅嘢就要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, sei3 maa5 naan4 zeoi1, gong2 zo2 ge3 je5 zau6 jiu3 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一言既出，驷马难追，说过的话就要负责任。
examples.english_sentence: A word spoken cannot be unspoken, you need to be responsible for what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我信你嘅，你一言既出，我梗係信你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon3 nei5 ge3, nei5 jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, ngo5 gang2 hai6 seon3 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我相信你，你一言既出，我当然相信你啦。
examples.english_sentence: I believe you. You've given your word, of course I believe you.

synonyms: 金口玉言 (gam1 hau2 juk6 jin4)
言而有信 (jin4 ji4 jau5 seon3)

jyutping: jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, sei3 maa5 naan4 zeoi1
mandarin_meaning: 一言既出，驷马难追 (yī yán jì chū, sì mǎ nán zhuī)
english_meaning: A word once spoken cannot be overtaken even by a team of four horses.
explanation_mandarin: 指话说出口，就无法再收回，形容说话算数，信守诺言。
explanation_english: Once a word is spoken, it cannot be retracted. This idiom emphasizes the importance of keeping one's word and being trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都應承咗人哋幫手，一言既出，駟馬難追，唔好後悔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jing3 sing4 zo2 jan4 dei6 bong1 sau2, jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, sei3 maa5 naan4 zeoi1, m4 hou2 hau6 fui3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都答应帮人家了，一言既出，驷马难追，不要后悔了。
examples.english_sentence: You've already promised to help, a word once spoken cannot be overtaken by a team of four horses, don't regret it now.

jyutping: jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, si3 maa5 naan4 zeoi1
english_meaning: A word once spoken cannot be overtaken even by a team of four horses.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说出的话不能收回，要信守承诺。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of keeping one's promises. Once a word is spoken, it cannot be taken back, highlighting the need for careful consideration before making commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應承咗幫佢，一言旣出，駟馬難追，點都要做到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing3 sing4 zo2 bong1 keoi5, jat1 jin4 gei3 ceot1, si3 maa5 naan4 zeoi1, dim2 dou1 jiu3 zou6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我答应帮他了，一言既出，驷马难追，无论如何都要做到。
examples.english_sentence: I promised to help him. A word once spoken cannot be overtaken by a team of four horses, so I must do it no matter what.

english_meaning: It's a deal; Agreed; Let's seal the deal
explanation_mandarin: 指一句话说定了，不再更改。
explanation_english: Means that a promise has been made and will not be changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁我哋聽日喺戲院門口見，一言為定呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 hai2 hei3 jyun2 mun4 hau2 gin3, jat1 jin4 wai4 ding6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那我们明天在电影院门口见，一言为定啊！
examples.english_sentence: Then let's meet at the cinema entrance tomorrow, it's a deal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗幫我手，一言為定，唔好反口呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 sing4 zo2 bong1 ngo5 sau2, jat1 jin4 wai4 ding6, m4 hou2 faan2 hau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应帮我忙了，一言为定，不要反悔啊！
examples.english_sentence: You promised to help me, it's a deal, don't go back on your word!

english_meaning: It's a deal; That settles it; Let's make it a deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示双方达成协议，不再更改。说话算数，承诺确定。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that an agreement has been reached and will not be changed. It signifies a firm commitment and a promise that will be kept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁我哋一言爲定，聽日見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 jin4 wai4 ding6, ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那我们一言为定，明天见啦！
examples.english_sentence: Then it's a deal, see you tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗㗎，一言爲定，唔可以反悔㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 sing4 zo2 gaa3, jat1 jin4 wai4 ding6, m4 ho2 ji5 faan2 fui3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应了的，一言为定，不可以反悔的！
examples.english_sentence: You promised, it's a deal, you can't go back on it!

jyutping: jat1 jin4 hing1 bong1, jat1 jin4 song3 bong1
mandarin_meaning: 一句话可以使国家兴盛，一句话也可以使国家衰亡
english_meaning: One word can make a nation prosper; one word can ruin a nation.
explanation_mandarin: 指说话的重要性，特别是在政治方面，统治者或重要人物的言论可能对国家产生巨大影响。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of words, especially in politics. The words of rulers or important figures can have a significant impact on the nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅身份，講嘢真係要小心啲，一言興邦，一言喪邦㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 san1 fan2, gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, jat1 jin4 hing1 bong1, jat1 jin4 song3 bong1 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以他的身份，说话真的要小心一些，一句话可以兴邦，一句话也可以丧邦啊。
examples.english_sentence: With his status, he really needs to be careful with his words. One word can make a nation prosper, one word can ruin a nation, you know.

mandarin_meaning: 一言难尽 (yī yán nán jìn)
english_meaning: Hard to explain in a few words; it's a long story; difficult to put into words
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情复杂，难以用简单几句话说清楚。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is complicated and difficult to explain simply in a few words. It implies that the situation has many facets or a complex backstory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅故事真係一言難盡，要慢慢同你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gu3 si2 zan1 hai6 jat1 jin4 naan4 zeon6, jiu3 maan6 maan6 tung4 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的故事真是一言难尽，要慢慢地跟你讲。
examples.english_sentence: Our story is really hard to explain in a few words; I need to tell you slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業嘅原因一言難盡，總之就好複雜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 ge3 jyun4 yan1 jat1 jin4 naan4 zeon6, zung2 zi1 zau6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业的原因一言难尽，总之就很复杂啦。
examples.english_sentence: The reason for his unemployment is hard to explain in a few words; in short, it's very complicated.

synonyms: 千言萬語 (chin1 yin4 maan6 yu5)

jyutping: jat1 jin4 ging1 sing2 mung6 zung1 jan4
english_meaning: A word can wake up someone in a dream; A word to the wise is enough; A single remark awakens the dreamer; A word to the wise.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻听了精辟深刻的劝告或开导后，忽然醒悟过来。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to suddenly awaken to the truth or realize something after receiving insightful advice or a revelation. It's like being woken up from a dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢真係一言驚醒夢中人，我終於明白自己錯喺邊度喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 jat1 jin4 ging1 sing2 mung6 zung1 jan4, ngo5 zung1 jyu1 ming4 baak6 zi6 gei2 co3 hai2 bin1 dou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话真是一语惊醒梦中人，我终于明白自己错在哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: What he said really woke me up, I finally understand where I was wrong.

jyutping: jat1 jin4 ging1 sing2 lok6 hak1 jan4
english_meaning: A word to wake up Rockman (lit.); a word to awaken the person in a dream (idiomatic); a word of advice that suddenly makes someone understand something they hadn't before; a eureka moment.
explanation_mandarin: “洛克人”是香港的用语，指“老实人”或“老实可靠的人”。全句的意思是，一句话惊醒了老实人，使其突然明白过来，类似于“一语惊醒梦中人”。
explanation_english: "洛克人 (lok6 hak1 jan4)" is a Hong Kong slang term referring to a simple, honest, and sometimes naive person (literally, "Rockman", referring to the video game character Mega Man/Rockman). The idiom means that a single word or phrase awakens or enlightens such a person, causing them to suddenly understand something they previously did not. It's similar to the Mandarin idiom “一语惊醒梦中人 (yī yǔ jīng xǐng mèng zhōng rén)", but specifically applied to someone who is perceived as simple and trusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢咁樣分析，我先至覺得自己一直諗錯咗，真係一言驚醒洛克人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 fan1 sik1, ngo5 sin1 zi3 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 jat1 zik6 nam2 co3 zo2, zan1 hai6 jat1 jin4 ging1 sing2 lok6 hak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他这样分析，我才觉得我自己一直想错了，真是一语惊醒梦中人。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to his analysis, I realized I had been wrong all along, it really was a word to awaken the person in a dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗好耐都諗唔通，點知佢一句話就一言驚醒洛克人，我即刻明白晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 nam2 m4 tung1, dim2 zi1 keoi5 jat1 geoi3 waa6 zau6 jat1 jin4 ging1 sing2 lok6 hak1 jan4, ngo5 zik1 hak1 ming4 baak6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了很久都想不通，没想到他一句话就一语惊醒梦中人，我立刻明白了。
examples.english_sentence: I thought about it for a long time but couldn't figure it out, but unexpectedly, one sentence from him woke me up, and I immediately understood everything.

synonyms: 醍醐灌頂 (tai4 wu4 gun3 ding2) (Cantonese pronunciation: tai4 wu4 gun3 ding2)
茅塞頓開 (maau4 sak1 deon6 hoi1) (Cantonese pronunciation: maau4 sak1 deon6 hoi1)

jyutping: jat1 si3 bin6 zi1 lung4 jyu5 fung6
english_meaning: A single try will reveal the dragon and the phoenix; a single attempt reveals who is truly exceptional.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一经尝试，便能看出谁是杰出人才，谁是平庸之辈。龙和凤在中国传统文化中是吉祥、尊贵的象征，此处比喻优秀的人才。
explanation_english: This idiom means that a single attempt or trial is enough to reveal who possesses exceptional talent and who is merely ordinary. 'Dragon and Phoenix' are symbols of auspiciousness and nobility in Chinese culture, used here to represent outstanding individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個方案都好似幾好咁，但係一試便知龍與鳳，到時就知邊個先至係最掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 fong1 on3 dou1 hou2 ci5 gei2 hou2 gam2, daan6 hai6 jat1 si3 bin6 zi1 lung4 jyu5 fung6, dou3 si4 zau6 zi1 bin1 go3 sin1 zeoi3 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个方案看起来都不错，但是一试便知龙凤，到时候就知道哪个才是最好的。
examples.english_sentence: Both of these plans seem good, but a single try will reveal the dragon and the phoenix; we'll know which one is truly the best then.

english_meaning: To hit the nail on the head, to be right on target, to put one's finger on it
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话一下子就说中要害或关键。
explanation_english: Describes speaking that immediately hits the vital point or key issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係一語中的，我諗法俾你睇穿晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 jat1 jyu5 dik1 zung3, ngo5 lam2 faat3 bei2 nei5 tai2 cyun1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是一语道破，我的想法全被你看穿了。
examples.english_sentence: You really hit the nail on the head; you've completely seen through my thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅分析一語中的，解釋咗點解間公司會失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fan1 sik1 jat1 jyu5 dik1 zung3, gaai2 sik1 zo2 dim2 gaai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 wui5 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的分析一语中的，解释了为什么这家公司会失败。
examples.english_sentence: His analysis hit the nail on the head and explained why the company failed.

english_meaning: A prophecy fulfilled; a prediction that comes true; to prove prophetic
explanation_mandarin: 指本来是随口说出的一句话，结果却应验了，像预言一样。
explanation_english: Refers to a casual remark that inadvertently comes true, as if it were a prophecy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我之前話佢實會衰，點知真係一語成讖，佢間公司執咗笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 cin4 waa6 keoi5 sat1 wui seoi1, dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 jat1 jyu5 sing4 cim3, keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 zo2 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我之前说他一定会倒霉，没想到真的一语成谶，他的公司倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: I said before that he would definitely have bad luck, who knew it would actually prove prophetic, his company went bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂講嘢呀，如果一語成讖就弊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 jat1 jyu5 sing4 cim3 zau6 bai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱说话啊，如果一语成谶就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just say anything carelessly, it would be terrible if it proves prophetic.

english_meaning: to hit the nail on the head; to speak to the point; to reveal the truth with a single remark
explanation_mandarin: 用一句话就说穿了事情的真相或关键。
explanation_english: To reveal the truth or the key point of a matter with a single remark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就一語道破件事嘅重點，真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 jat1 jyu5 dou6 po3 gin6 si6 ge3 zung1 dim2, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就一语道破了事情的重点，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: You hit the nail on the head so quickly, you're really clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一語道破咗我哋計劃嘅缺點，真係不得不佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jyu5 dou6 po3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 ge3 kyut3 dim2, zan1 hai6 bat1 dak1 bat1 pui3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一语道破了我们计划的缺点，真是不得不佩服。
examples.english_sentence: He pointed out the flaws in our plan with a single remark, I have to admire him.

english_meaning: A promise worth a thousand pieces of gold; a promise that must be kept.
explanation_mandarin: 形容承诺的分量很重，一旦做出承诺，必须坚守信用，不能轻易改变。
explanation_english: Describes a promise that is extremely valuable and must be kept at all costs. It emphasizes the importance of integrity and fulfilling one's commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要一諾千金，講咗嘅嘢就要做到。

examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, and the boss just walked away, the employees are in a terrible situation.

english_meaning: Farewell; Have a good journey (said to someone who is dying or deceased)

explanation_english: Originally, this phrase wished someone a safe and smooth journey. However, in Cantonese, it is commonly used as a euphemism to express condolences to someone who is dying or has passed away, hoping they have a good journey in the afterlife. It's important to note that using this phrase in other contexts might cause misunderstandings.

examples.english_sentence: Don't get involved in so many things, you'll end up in hot water, who can help you?

english_meaning: To be in a lot of trouble; to be covered in ants (literally, but usually used figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻惹了很多麻烦或事情缠身，像身上爬满了蚂蚁一样难受。
explanation_english: A metaphor for being in a lot of trouble or having many problems to deal with, like being covered in ants and feeling uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次瀨嘢瀨到一身蟻，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 laai6 je5 laai6 dou3 jat1 san1 ngai5, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次惹的麻烦太大了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: He's gotten himself into a lot of trouble this time, and doesn't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔做功課，到時考試唔合格，就一身蟻㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, dou3 si4 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, zau6 jat1 san1 ngai5 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不做功课，到时候考试不及格，就会惹一身麻烦！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't do your homework, you'll fail the exam and be in a lot of trouble!

english_meaning: to feel relaxed; to be free from burdens or worries; to be relieved
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体或心情感到轻松、没有压力或负担的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of feeling relaxed, without pressure or burdens, physically or mentally. It can also refer to being relieved after a stressful event or completing a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完晒啲嘢，而家一身鬆晒啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4晒啲嘢，ji4 gaa1 jat1 san1 sung1晒 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完所有的事，现在感觉一身轻松！
examples.english_sentence: Having finished all the tasks, I feel completely relaxed now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考完，真係一身鬆晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 jyun4, zan1 hai6 jat1 san1 sung1晒!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考完了，真是感觉一身轻松！
examples.english_sentence: Having finished the exam, I really feel so relieved!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project搞掂咗，真係一身鬆晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project gaau2 dim6 zo2, zan1 hai6 jat1 san1 sung1晒!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 项目完成了，真是感觉一身轻松！
examples.english_sentence: The project is completed, I feel so relieved!

english_meaning: to have a contest to see who is better; to compete to see who is superior
explanation_mandarin: 比试一下，看看谁更厉害。常用于竞争的场合。
explanation_english: To compete or contend with someone to determine who is superior or more skilled. Often used in competitive situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如一較高下，睇下邊個跑得快啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 gaau3 gou1 haa6, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 paau2 dak1 faai3 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如一较高下，看看谁跑得快？
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we have a contest to see who can run faster?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司喺市場上一直都想一較高下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 jat1 gaau3 gou1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司在市场上一直都想一较高下。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies have always wanted to compete against each other in the market.

english_meaning: lifetime, all one's life
explanation_mandarin: 一生，整个生命期间。
explanation_english: A lifetime; the whole of one's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以同你一輩子都喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 bui3 zi2 dou1 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以和你一辈子都在一起。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can be with you for a lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一輩子都好努力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bui3 zi2 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子都很努力工作。
examples.english_sentence: He worked very hard all his life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事會影響你一輩子嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 wui5 jing2 heong2 nei5 jat1 bui3 zi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事会影响你一辈子的。
examples.english_sentence: This matter will affect your whole life.

english_meaning: Non-stop talking; a stream of words; a torrent of words; to rattle on
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话不停，像机关枪一样，连续不断。
explanation_english: Describes someone talking non-stop, like a machine gun firing a continuous stream of words. Can also be used as an adverb indicating the action of talking without pause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一輪咀咁鬧我，我都唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 leon4 zeoi2 gam2 naau6 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他滔滔不绝地骂我，我都不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He scolded me non-stop, I don't even know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上講嘢，一輪咀講咗成個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng2 gong2 je5, jat1 leon4 zeoi2 gong2 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上讲话，滔滔不绝地讲了一个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He was talking on stage, rattling on for a whole hour.

mandarin_meaning: 喋喋不休, 滔滔不绝
english_meaning: Speaking non-stop, talking a mile a minute, chattering away
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人说话很快，不停地说，而且说很多。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks very fast, non-stop, and says a lot. Often used when someone is talking so much that it's hard to get a word in edgewise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一輪嘴咁講，我完全聽唔到佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 leon4 zeoi2 gam2 gong2, ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 dou2 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喋喋不休地说，我完全听不到他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was talking a mile a minute, I couldn't hear what he was saying at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個sales一嚟就一輪嘴咁sell啲產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sales jat1 lai4 zau6 jat1 leon4 zeoi2 gam2 sell di1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个销售一来就喋喋不休地推销产品。
examples.english_sentence: The salesperson started selling the products non-stop as soon as they arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嬲就一輪嘴咁鬧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 jat1 leon4 zeoi2 gam2 naau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生气就喋喋不休地骂人。
examples.english_sentence: When he's angry, he scolds people non-stop.

english_meaning: continuously; in a row; one after another; series of
explanation_mandarin: 表示连续不断地发生或出现。也可作量词，表示一连串的事情。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens or appears continuously. Can also be used as a measure word to indicate a series of events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一連講咗三個鐘頭，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lin4 gong2 zo2 saam1 go3 zung1 tau4, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一连讲了三个小时，真是很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke continuously for three hours, he's really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳一連攞咗三年米芝蓮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jat1 lin4 lo2 zo2 saam1 nin4 mai5 zi1 lin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅一连拿了三年米其林。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has received Michelin stars for three consecutive years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一連加班咗五日，好攰啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 lin4 gaa1 baan1 zo2 ng5 jat6, hou2 gui6 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一连加班了五天，好累啊！
examples.english_sentence: I've worked overtime for five consecutive days, I'm so tired!

english_meaning: a series of, a chain of
explanation_mandarin: 表示连续不断的一系列事物或事件。
explanation_english: Refers to a continuous series of things or events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司最近發生咗一連串嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司最近发生了一系列的问题。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has had a series of problems recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會之後，佢哋經歷咗一連串嘅慶祝活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 ging1 lik6 zo2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 hing3 zuk1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会之后，他们经历了一系列的庆祝活动。
examples.english_sentence: After the concert, they went through a series of celebrations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情關係，我哋取消咗一連串嘅旅行計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jik6 cing4 gwaan1 hai6, ngo5 dei6 tau4 siu1 zo2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 leoi5 hang4 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情的关系，我们取消了一系列的旅行计划。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, we cancelled a series of travel plans.

english_meaning: definitely; resolutely; might as well; to simply do it
explanation_mandarin: 表示下定决心，干脆去做某事；或者表示一定会怎么样。
explanation_english: Expresses a firm decision to do something resolutely or indicates certainty about a future event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一於噉樣做啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jyu1 gam2 joeng2 zou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 干脆就这么做吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's just do it this way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨，一於唔出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, jat1 jyu1 m4 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨，一定不出门。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, I definitely won't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你咁想去，一於去啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 gam3 soeng2 heoi3, jat1 jyu1 heoi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你这么想去，那就去吧！
examples.english_sentence: Since you want to go so much, might as well go!

mandarin_meaning: 一起; 一同; 一块儿
english_meaning: together; along with; in company
explanation_mandarin: 表示共同进行或一起行动。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something together or acting as a company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一道去睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 dou6 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the cinema together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一道食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 dou6 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起吃饭？
examples.english_sentence: How about we have dinner together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一道返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 dou6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一起回家。
examples.english_sentence: They went home together.

english_meaning: one side; on one hand; while; at the same time
explanation_mandarin: 表示方位或同时进行两个动作。
explanation_english: Indicates a location or two actions happening simultaneously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一邊食嘢一邊睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bin1 sik6 je5 jat1 bin1 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。
examples.english_sentence: He eats and watches TV at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋嘅一邊望住海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 ge3 jat1 bin1 mong5 zyu6 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子的一边朝着大海。
examples.english_sentence: One side of the house faces the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行去巴士站嘅一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 heoi3 baa1 si2 zaam6 ge3 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走到巴士站的一边。
examples.english_sentence: Walk to one side of the bus stop.

english_meaning: a part; a portion; a segment; a section
explanation_mandarin: 整体中的一个部分。
explanation_english: A part of a whole; a section or portion of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅一部份已經完成咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6 ji5 ging1 waan4 sing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的一部分已经完成了。
examples.english_sentence: A part of this plan has already been completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅時間有一部份用咗喺工作度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 si4 gaan3 jau5 jat1 bou6 fan6 jung6 zo2 hai2 gung1 zok3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的一部分时间用在了工作上。
examples.english_sentence: A portion of my time is spent on work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅一部份我已經睇完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的一部分我已经看完了。
examples.english_sentence: I have already finished reading a part of this book.

english_meaning: part; portion; section
explanation_mandarin: 整体中的一个局部或组成部分。
explanation_english: A portion or component part of a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅一部分好有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6 hou2 jau5 cheoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的一部分很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: A part of this book is very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係理解咗呢個計劃嘅一部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 hai6 lei5 gaai2 zo2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只理解了这个计划的一部分。
examples.english_sentence: I only understood a part of this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一部分人認為應該加稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 bou6 fan6 jan4 wing4 wai4 ying1 goi1 ga1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一部分人认为应该加税。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think taxes should be increased.

english_meaning: to hit the nail on the head; to get right to the point; incisive and accurate
explanation_mandarin: 比喻说话、文章等简明扼要，一下子就击中要害。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes speaking, writing, etc., in a concise and accurate manner, hitting the crucial point immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢一針見血，真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jat1 zam1 gin3 hyut3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话一针见血，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks incisively and accurately; he's really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇評論寫得一針見血，將問題嘅核心清楚咁指出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 ping3 leon6 se2 dak1 jat1 zam1 gin3 hyut3, zoeng1 man6 tai4 ge3 hat6 sam1 cing1 co2 gam2 zi2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇评论写得一针见血，把问题的核心清楚地指了出来。
examples.english_sentence: This review is spot on, clearly pointing out the core of the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 一把梭哈 / 一次性输光
english_meaning: to go all in and lose everything; to bet the whole lot and lose; to lose everything in one go
explanation_mandarin: 赌博用语，指一次性把所有的筹码都押上，结果输光了。也比喻一次性投入全部资源，结果失败。
explanation_english: A gambling term referring to betting all your chips at once and losing everything. Figuratively, it also means to invest all your resources at once and fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢成日都一鋪清袋，真係抵死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 pou3 cing1 doi2, zan1 hai6 dai2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱总是喜欢一把梭哈，真活该。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes all in when gambling and loses everything, he deserves it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動呀，唔好一鋪清袋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6 aa3, m4 hou2 jat1 pou3 cing1 doi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么冲动啊，不要一把梭哈啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, don't bet it all!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資失利，一鋪清袋，依家乜都冇曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, jat1 pou3 cing1 doi2, ji1 gaa1 mat1 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资失败，一次性输光了，现在什么都没有了。
examples.english_sentence: He failed in his investment, lost everything in one go, and now he has nothing left.

english_meaning: to make a final decision; to have the final say; the final word
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在关键时刻做出决定，有决定性的作用。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to making a final and decisive decision at a crucial moment, having a conclusive effect, like the final strike of a gavel that seals a deal or resolves a dispute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話要佢一錘定音，決定用邊個設計方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 keoi5 jat1 ceoi4 ding6 jam1, kyut3 ding6 yung6 bin1 go3 sat3 gai3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要他一锤定音，决定用哪个设计方案。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he has the final say on which design proposal to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好緊要，要搵個有份量嘅人嚟一錘定音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gan2 jiu3, jiu3 wan2 go3 jau5 fan6 leong6 ge3 yan4 lai4 jat1 ceoi4 ding6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很重要，要找一个有分量的人来一锤定音。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very important, we need to find someone influential to make the final decision.

english_meaning: To make repeated mistakes; to continue making errors; to err repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 指犯了一个错误之后，不吸取教训，又犯了同样的或类似的错误。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake and then repeating the same or a similar mistake without learning from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好一錯再錯啦，收手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 co3 zoi3 co3 laa1, sau1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一错再错了，收手吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep making mistakes! Stop now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一錯再錯，搞到成間公司都損失慘重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 co3 zoi3 co3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 syun2 sat1 caam2 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一错再错，搞得整个公司都损失惨重。
examples.english_sentence: He kept making mistakes, causing the entire company to suffer heavy losses.

english_meaning: To expose everything; to uncover the whole story; to reveal all the dirty secrets; to bring everything to light.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻将所有事情，尤其是丑闻或不正当行为，全部揭发出来，让真相大白于天下。
explanation_english: A metaphor for uncovering and revealing all matters, especially scandals or illicit activities, bringing the truth to light and exposing everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢咁大鑊，實一鑊撬起㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 wok6, sat1 jat1 wok6 kiu5 hei2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情这么严重，肯定会被全部揭发的。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so serious, it's bound to be exposed completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅貪污案，遲早都一鑊撬起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 taam1 wu1 on3, ci4 zou2 dou1 jat1 wok6 kiu5 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的贪污案件，迟早都会被彻底揭发的。
examples.english_sentence: The corruption case in their company will eventually be exposed completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢肯合作，就可以一鑊撬起成個犯罪集團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 hang2 hap6 jok3, zau6 ho2 ji5 jat1 wok6 kiu5 hei2 sing4 go3 faan2 zeoi6 zaap6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他肯合作，就可以彻底揭发整个犯罪集团。
examples.english_sentence: If he is willing to cooperate, the whole criminal group can be completely exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 一团糟; 糟糕; 搞砸了
english_meaning: a complete mess; a fiasco; to screw up completely
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情完全失败，变成一团糟。比喻情况非常糟糕，无可挽回。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that has completely failed and become a mess. It implies a situation is so bad that it cannot be salvaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考到一鑊泡，肯定俾阿媽鬧死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 haau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 pou4, hang2 ding6 bei2 aa3 maa1 naau6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考得一塌糊涂，肯定会被妈妈骂死。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up completely on this exam; my mom will surely scold me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司俾佢搞到一鑊泡，執笠都似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 pou4, zap1 laap1 dou1 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司被他搞得一团糟，看起来要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a complete mess of the company; it looks like it's going to close down.

english_meaning: to stir-fry everything together; to fire (someone) or cause a major incident that leads to multiple people being affected (fired, arrested, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 本义是指把所有东西放在一个锅里一起炒。比喻指一件事情引发连锁反应，导致很多人同时受到牵连，通常是不利的结果，例如被解雇、被捕等。
explanation_english: Literally means to stir-fry everything in one wok together. Figuratively, it refers to a situation where one incident triggers a chain reaction, leading to many people being involved or affected, usually with negative consequences such as being fired or arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢咁大鑊，好多人都驚會一鑊炒起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 wok6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 geng1 wui5 jat1 wok6 caau2 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，很多人都害怕会被一起炒掉。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, many people are afraid that everyone will be fired together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆嬲到震，話要將成team人一鑊炒起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 nau1 dou3 zan3, waa6 jiu3 zoeng1 sing4 team jan4 jat1 wok6 caau2 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板气得发抖，说要把整个团队一起炒掉。
examples.english_sentence: The boss was so angry that he said he would fire the whole team.

english_meaning: to be finished together; to be in the same boat and suffer the same fate; to be cooked together
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一起遭到失败或毁灭，共同承担后果。源于烹饪，指一锅煮熟，比喻牵连在一起，无法逃脱。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where everyone is in the same boat and suffers the same fate or consequence, often implying a negative outcome. It originates from the image of cooking ingredients together in a wok, implying that everyone is interconnected and cannot escape the shared fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋嘅計劃失敗，我哋成個團隊咪一鑊熟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 sat1 baai6, ngo5 dei6 sing4 go3 teoi1 deoi2 mai1 jat1 wok6 suk6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们的计划失败，我们整个团队就一起完蛋了。
examples.english_sentence: If their plan fails, the whole team will be finished together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔認真做嘢，到時出咗事，我哋就一鑊熟喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 jing6 zan1 zou6 je5, dou3 si4 cheut1 zo2 si6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jat1 wok6 suk6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不认真工作，到时候出了事，我们就一起倒霉了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work seriously, if something goes wrong, we'll all be in trouble!

english_meaning: a complete mess; a total disaster; everything is in chaos
explanation_mandarin: 形容情况非常混乱，事情完全失控，像煮成一锅粥一样。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is completely chaotic and out of control, like a pot of congee that has become a mess. It implies everything has gone wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project搞到一鑊粥，唔知點收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1, m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目搞得一团糟，不知道怎么收场。
examples.english_sentence: This project has become a complete mess; I don't know how to clean it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢嚟咗之後，成間公司變咗一鑊粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 lai4 zo2 zi1 hau6, seng4 gaan1 gung1 si1 bin3 zo2 jat1 wok6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他来了之后，整间公司变成了一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: Since he came, the whole company has become a complete mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到一鑊粥，唔知幾時先返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵得一团糟，不知道什么时候才能回到家。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is a total mess; I don't know when I'll get home.

english_meaning: a skill; a trade; a craft
explanation_mandarin: 指一种可以用来谋生的技能或手艺。
explanation_english: Refers to a skill, trade, or craft that can be used to earn a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識整錶，都算係有一門手藝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 zing2 biu1, dou1 syun3 hai6 jau5 jat1 mun4 sau2 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会修表，也算有一门手艺。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to repair watches, so he can be said to have a skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學返一門手藝傍身，第時都唔怕冇飯開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 faan1 jat1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 pong4 san1, dai6 si4 dou1 m4 paa3 mou5 faan6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学一门手艺傍身，以后也不怕没饭吃。
examples.english_sentence: Learn a skill to fall back on, and you won't have to worry about not having food to eat in the future.

english_meaning: fleeting, ephemeral, transient, to flash and disappear
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物出现的时间非常短暂，迅速消失。
explanation_english: Describes something that appears for a very short time and quickly disappears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容好似一閃即逝咁，我差啲睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 hou2 ci5 jat1 sim2 jik1 sai6 gam2, ngo5 caa1 di1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的笑容像转瞬即逝一样，我差点没看到。
examples.english_sentence: Her smile was like a fleeting moment, I almost didn't see it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機會一閃即逝，要好好把握。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 wui2 jat1 sim2 jik1 sai6, jiu3 hou2 hou2 baa2 ak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机会转瞬即逝，要好好把握。
examples.english_sentence: Opportunities are fleeting, you need to seize them well.

mandarin_meaning: 出手阔绰之后，花费更大。
english_meaning: Once you get used to spending lavishly, you spend even more.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人一旦习惯了大手大脚地花钱，花费就会越来越大，难以控制。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where once someone becomes accustomed to spending money lavishly, their expenses tend to increase further and become difficult to control. It highlights the snowball effect of excessive spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗職之後，日日都食好嘢，真係一闊三大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat6 dou1 sik6 hou2 je5, zan1 hai6 jat1 fut3 saam1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职以后，每天都吃好吃的，真是出手阔绰之后，花费更大。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he got promoted, he's been eating good food every day, it's really a case of 'once you get used to spending lavishly, you spend even more'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱中咗六合彩，但係佢亂咁使錢，好快就一闊三大，使晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 lyun6 gam2 sai2 cin2, hou2 faai3 zau6 jat1 fut3 saam1 daai6, sai2 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚中了彩票，但是他乱花钱，很快就变得花费更大，把钱都花光了。
examples.english_sentence: He just won the lottery, but he's spending money recklessly, and it quickly became a case of 'once you get used to spending lavishly, you spend even more', and he spent all the money.

english_meaning: a while, a moment; a burst, a gust; for a short period
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间很短，一会儿；也可表示一阵风、一阵雨等。
explanation_english: Refers to a short period of time, a while; can also refer to a gust of wind, a burst of rain, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我一陣，我即刻搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 jat1 zan6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我一会儿，我马上就好。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me a moment, I'll finish it right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先落咗一陣雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 lok6 zo2 jat1 zan6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才下了一阵雨。
examples.english_sentence: It rained for a short while earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲咗一陣就冇事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 zo2 jat1 zan6 zau6 mou5 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气了一会儿就没事了。
examples.english_sentence: He was angry for a while but he's okay now.

english_meaning: a while, a short period of time
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暂的一段时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a short period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住休息一陣子先做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 hiu1 sik1 jat1 zan6 zi2 sin1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算休息一会儿再工作。
