explanation_mandarin: 原为日本动漫招式名称，后引申为形容事物变化迅速、令人眼花缭乱。也可指像旋转切割一样快速的动作或改变。
explanation_english: Originally a name of a move in Japanese anime, it has been extended to describe things that change rapidly and are dazzling. It can also refer to rapid actions or changes like a spinning slash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲橋真係七旋斬咁，次次都唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 kiu2 zan1 hai6 cat1 syun4 zaam2 gam2, ci3 ci3 dou1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的点子真是像七旋斩一样，每次都不一样。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are really like a spinning slash, always different every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個樓市七旋斬咁變，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lau4 si5 cat1 syun4 zaam2 gam2 bin3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个楼市变得像七旋斩一样，真的不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The housing market is changing like a spinning slash, I really don't know what to do.

synonyms: 千变万化 (chin1 bin3 maan6 faa3)
眼花缭乱 (ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6)

english_meaning: Short-lived enthusiasm; a flash in the pan; a week-long wonder
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人对某事物只有短暂的兴趣，很快就失去热情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who only has a short-lived enthusiasm for something; the interest fades quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對學結他都係七日鮮啫，過幾日就唔學㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 hok6 git3 taa1 dou1 hai6 cat1 jat6 sin1 ze1, gwo3 gei2 jat6 zau6 m4 hok6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对学吉他也只是一时新鲜罢了，过几天就不学了。
examples.english_sentence: He's only having a short-lived enthusiasm for learning the guitar. He'll probably quit in a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲減肥方法通常都係七日鮮，好難堅持落去嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaam2 fei4 fong1 faat3 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 cat1 jat6 sin1, hou2 naan4 gin1 chi4 lok6 heoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些减肥方法通常都只是三分钟热度，很难坚持下去的。
examples.english_sentence: These weight loss methods are usually just a flash in the pan. It's difficult to stick with them.

english_meaning: Thug; hoodlum; small-time gangster; delinquent
explanation_mandarin: 指那些不务正业，在街头游荡，惹是生非的年轻男子。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to young men who are idle, loitering on the streets, and causing trouble. Usually carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺後巷聚集，好似啲七星仔咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 hau6 hong6 zeoi6 zeoi6, hou2 ci5 di1 cat1 sing1 zai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天在后巷聚集，像一些小混混一样。
examples.english_sentence: They gather in the back alley all day long, like some thugs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好行埋啲七星仔度，費事惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haang4 maai4 di1 cat1 sing1 zai2 dou6, fai3 si6 je5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要靠近那些小混混，免得惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go near those hoodlums, lest you get into trouble.

english_meaning: Seven Star Tea (a type of Chinese herbal tea)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中药冲剂，通常给婴儿和儿童饮用，用于清热、祛湿、开胃、定惊等。
explanation_english: A type of Chinese herbal tea, usually given to babies and children to clear heat, remove dampness, improve appetite, and calm the nerves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日話BB仔飲七星茶好，可以清熱氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 waa6 BB zai2 jam2 cat1 sing1 caa4 hou2, ho2 ji5 cing1 jit6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是说婴儿喝七星茶好，可以清热。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always says it's good for babies to drink Seven Star Tea, as it can clear internal heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個仔唔肯飲七星茶，話好苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zai2 m4 hang2 jam2 cat1 sing1 caa4, waa6 hou2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子不愿意喝七星茶，说很苦。
examples.english_sentence: My son doesn't want to drink Seven Star Tea, saying it's too bitter.

english_meaning: July, the seventh month of the lunar calendar, Ghost Month
explanation_mandarin: 指阳历的七月，也指农历的七月。农历七月在中国传统文化中被称为“鬼月”，人们认为鬼门关会在这个月打开，阴间的鬼魂会到人间游荡。
explanation_english: Refers to July in the Gregorian calendar, and also the seventh month of the lunar calendar. The seventh month of the lunar calendar is known as "Ghost Month" in Chinese traditional culture. It is believed that the gates of hell open during this month, and ghosts from the underworld roam the human realm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅七月特別多雨水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 cat1 jyut6 dak6 bit6 do1 jyu5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的七月特别多雨。
examples.english_sentence: There's been a lot of rain this July.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 七月十四唔好亂咁出街呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cat1 jyut6 sap6 sei3 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 ceot1 gaai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 七月十四不要乱出门啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't go out randomly on the 14th day of the seventh lunar month!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係七月嘅最後一日喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 cat1 jyut6 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 jat6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是七月的最后一天了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the last day of July.

cantonese: 七月有立秋，遲禾冇得收
jyutping: cat1 jyut6 jau5 lap6 cau1, ci4 wo4 mou5 dak1 sau1
mandarin_meaning: 立秋如果在农历七月出现，晚稻就无法丰收。
english_meaning: If the Beginning of Autumn falls within the seventh lunar month, the late rice crop will not be harvested (a poor harvest is expected for the late rice).
explanation_mandarin: 这句谚语指的是如果立秋节气在农历七月到来，那么晚稻的收成就会不好。这是因为立秋早，天气变化剧烈，会影响水稻的生长。也比喻错过时机就难以成功。
explanation_english: This proverb refers to a situation where if the Beginning of Autumn solar term occurs within the seventh lunar month, the late rice harvest will be poor. This is because an early Beginning of Autumn leads to drastic weather changes, which can affect the growth of rice. It is also used as a metaphor for missing an opportunity, making it difficult to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日講「七月有立秋，遲禾冇得收」，所以佢好擔心今年嘅收成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 gong2 "cat1 jyut6 jau5 lap6 cau1, ci4 wo4 mou5 dak1 sau1", so2 ji5 keoi5 hou2 dung1 sam1 gam1 nin4 ge3 sau1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是说“七月有立秋，晚稻没得收”，所以她很担心今年的收成。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always says, "If the Beginning of Autumn falls within the seventh lunar month, the late rice crop will not be harvested," so she is very worried about this year's harvest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再拖啦，「七月有立秋，遲禾冇得收」，再唔做就嚟唔切㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa1, "cat1 jyut6 jau5 lap6 cau1, ci4 wo4 mou5 dak1 sau1", zoi3 m4 zou6 zau6 lai4 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再拖延了，“七月有立秋，晚稻没得收”，再不做就来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't procrastinate anymore, "If the Beginning of Autumn falls within the seventh lunar month, the late rice crop will not be harvested," if you don't do it soon, it will be too late.

jyutping: cat1 jyut6 lok6 gam1, baat3 jyut6 lok6 ngan4
mandarin_meaning: 形容农历七月和八月是收获的季节，农作物产量很高。
english_meaning: Describes the seventh and eighth lunar months as harvest season with abundant crops.
explanation_mandarin: 形容农历七月和八月是农作物丰收的季节，产量丰富，价值很高。七月像落下黄金一样，八月像落下白银一样。比喻收成很好，生活富足。
explanation_english: Describes the seventh and eighth lunar months (according to the lunar calendar) as seasons of abundant harvests, with high yields and value. The seventh month is like dropping gold, and the eighth month is like dropping silver. It's a metaphor for a good harvest and a prosperous life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年風調雨順，一定七月落金，八月落銀啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 fung1 diu4 jyu5 seon6, jat1 ding6 cat1 jyut6 lok6 gam1, baat3 jyut6 lok6 ngan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年风调雨顺，一定七月像下黄金，八月像下白银一样。
examples.english_sentence: This year the weather is favorable, so it will definitely be like dropping gold in the seventh month and dropping silver in the eighth month (abundant harvest).

english_meaning: messy; in a mess; disordered; helter-skelter
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品摆放杂乱无章，毫无秩序。
explanation_english: Describes a state of disorder or messiness where things are scattered and disorganized without any apparent order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間房永遠都咁七橫八豎，好似打完仗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 wing5 jyun5 dou1 gam2 cat1 waang4 baat3 syu6, hou2 ci5 daa2 jyun4 zoeng3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间永远都这么乱七八糟的，像打完仗一样。
examples.english_sentence: His room is always such a mess, like a battlefield.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢七橫八豎咁擺喺度，執都唔知點執好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 cat1 waang4 baat3 syu6 gam2 baai2 hai2 dou6, zap1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 zap1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西乱七八糟地放在那里，整理都不知道怎么整理好。
examples.english_sentence: The things are placed there in a mess, I don't even know how to tidy them up.

mandarin_meaning: 农历六月和七月通常是淡季，生意不好做。
english_meaning: The sixth and seventh lunar months are usually slow periods for business; a difficult time to make money.
explanation_mandarin: 农历六月和七月通常气候炎热或者多雨，人们出行和消费意愿降低，因此商家生意比较难做。 另外，七月是鬼月，传统上人们会避免进行重大活动，例如搬家、结婚、开业等，也会影响商业活动。
explanation_english: The idiom refers to the sixth and seventh months of the lunar calendar, which are traditionally considered slow periods for business. This is often attributed to the hot and rainy weather reducing people's desire to go out and spend money. Additionally, the seventh lunar month is considered 'Ghost Month,' during which people traditionally avoid major activities like moving houses, getting married, or starting a business, which further impacts commercial activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年經濟咁差，加上七窮六絕，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, gaap3 soeng5 cat1 kung4 luk6 zyut6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年经济这么差，加上七穷六绝，真不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad this year, and with the slow season of the sixth and seventh lunar months, I really don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今年七窮六絕會特別嚴重，要預早做好準備先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gam1 nin4 cat1 kung4 luk6 zyut6 wui5 dak6 bit6 jim4 zung6, jiu3 jyu6 zou2 zou2 hou2 zeon2 bei6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说今年七穷六绝会特别严重，要提前做好准备才行。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that this year's slow season will be particularly bad, so we need to prepare early.

english_meaning: fuming mad, so angry that smoke comes out of one's orifices
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常生气，怒火极盛的样子。七窍指人的眼、耳、鼻、口。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone being extremely angry, so much so that it's as if smoke is coming out of their seven orifices (eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢咁樣講，我真係激到七竅生煙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gik1 dou3 cat1 hiu3 sang1 jin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听他这样说，我真是气得七窍生烟！
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I was so angry I was fuming mad!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就激到七竅生煙㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 ting1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 gik1 dou3 cat1 hiu3 sang1 jin1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就要气得七窍生烟了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to me again, I'm going to be fuming mad!

english_meaning: Extremely stupid, very foolish
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常笨，像七级的猪一样，比喻程度很深。
explanation_english: Describes someone as extremely stupid, comparing them to a grade 7 pig, implying a high degree of foolishness. The 'grade' refers to something being exceptionally low in quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做啲咁蠢嘅嘢，真係七級豬咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 di1 gam3 ceon2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 cat1 gap1 zyu1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是做这么蠢的事情，真是蠢得像猪一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always does such stupid things, he's really as dumb as a pig.

mandarin_meaning: 七言绝句 (Qī yán jué jù)
english_meaning: Seven-character-quatrain (a form of classical Chinese poetry)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种每首四句，每句七个字的近体诗。是唐代流行的诗歌形式之一。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of classical Chinese poetry consisting of four lines, each with seven characters. It was a popular poetic form during the Tang dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋中文老師教咗我哋點樣寫七絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 man4 lou5 si1 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 se2 cat1 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的中文老师教了我们怎样写七言绝句。
examples.english_sentence: Our Chinese teacher taught us how to write seven-character-quatrains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李白寫咗好多出名嘅七絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 baak6 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 ceot1 ming4 ge3 cat1 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李白写了很多著名的七言绝句。
examples.english_sentence: Li Bai wrote many famous seven-character-quatrains.

english_meaning: very old; elderly; advanced in years
explanation_mandarin: 形容人年纪很大，非常老。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very old and frail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都七老八十，行路都行唔穩喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 cat1 lou5 baat3 sap6, haang4 lou6 dou1 haang4 m4 wan2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都七老八十了，走路都走不稳了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very old, he can't even walk steadily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 七老八十嘅人唔好咁操勞啦，要注意身體呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cat1 lou5 baat3 sap6 ge3 jan4 m4 hou2 gam3 cou1 lou4 laa1, jiu3 zyu3 yi3 san1 tai2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 七老八十的人不要这么操劳了，要注意身体啊。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people shouldn't overwork themselves so much, they should pay attention to their health.

english_meaning: Mental hospital; lunatic asylum; madhouse
explanation_mandarin: 指精神病院，旧时香港人对精神病院的一种俗称。因为香港青山医院的门牌号码曾经是七号。
explanation_english: Refers to a mental hospital. It's a colloquial term used by Hong Kong people for mental hospitals, specifically referencing Castle Peak Hospital, whose address was once number 7.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發晒癲咁滯，睇怕遲早要入七號差館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 saai3 din1 gam2 zai6, tai2 paa3 chi4 zou2 jiu3 jap6 cat1 hou6 caai1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都疯疯癫癫的了，恐怕迟早要进精神病院。
examples.english_sentence: He's completely lost it; I'm afraid he'll end up in a mental hospital sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽醫生話，小心畀人送入七號差館呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 yi1 sang1 waa6, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 sung3 jap6 cat1 hou6 caai1 gun2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听医生的话，小心被人送进精神病院啊。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to the doctor, you might get sent to a mental hospital!

english_meaning: Heptagon
explanation_mandarin: 一种有七条边和七个角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A polygon with seven sides and seven angles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫咗個七角形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 zo2 go3 cat1 gok3 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画了一个七边形。
examples.english_sentence: He drew a heptagon.

mandarin_meaning: 七里香; 一种植物，也指某些特定部位的腺体（尤其是在指某些动物或人时，有时带有戏谑或轻微贬义的意味）
english_meaning: Orange Jessamine (a plant); Also used to refer to the scent glands of animals or humans, especially on certain body parts (sometimes used playfully or slightly derogatorily).
explanation_mandarin: 原本指芸香科植物七里香，也指这种植物散发出的香气。在口语中，有时会用来戏称人体或动物身上的特定腺体（例如腋下），带有玩笑或者轻微贬义的意味。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the Orange Jessamine plant and its fragrance. In colloquial Cantonese, it's sometimes used playfully or slightly derogatorily to refer to specific scent glands on the human or animal body (e.g., armpits).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搽咗咩嘢啊？咁香嘅，好似七里香咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 caa4 zo2 me1 je5 aa3? gam3 hoeng1 ge3, hou2 ci5 cat1 lei5 hoeng1 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你擦了什么啊？这么香的，好像七里香一样。
examples.english_sentence: What did you put on? It's so fragrant, like Orange Jessamine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔沖涼，啲七里香勁到呢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 cung1 loeng4, di1 cat1 lei5 hoeng1 ging6 dou3 ne1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常不洗澡，那些味道可真够劲的！
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't shower often, the 'seven-mile fragrance' is really strong!

english_meaning: After various deductions; to deduct repeatedly; after numerous subtractions.
explanation_mandarin: 形容经过多次扣除，剩下的东西已经不多了。表示扣除项目繁多，实际所得甚少。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where after numerous deductions or subtractions, very little remains. It implies a lot of deductions are made, and the actual amount received is much less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份糧七除八扣，扣埋稅同埋強積金，都冇剩幾多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 loeng4 cat1 ceoi4 baat3 kau3, kau3 maai4 seoi3 tung4 maai4 koeng4 jik1 gam1, dou1 mou5 sing6 gei2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资扣除各种费用，扣除税和强制性公积金后，就没剩多少了。
examples.english_sentence: After all the deductions from his salary, including taxes and mandatory provident fund, there's not much left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我地做咁多嘢，七除八扣，到最後先知原來根本冇錢分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 gam3 do1 je5, cat1 ceoi4 baat3 kau3, dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 gan1 bun2 mou5 cin2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做了这么多事情，七扣八扣，到最后才知道原来根本没有钱分。
examples.english_sentence: We did so much work, and after all the deductions, we realized in the end there was no money to distribute.

english_meaning: To tear down completely; to dismantle completely; to break apart thoroughly; in a state of disrepair.
explanation_mandarin: 形容拆卸或破坏得非常彻底，零零散散的样子。
explanation_english: Describes something that has been dismantled or broken apart completely, leaving it in a scattered and disorganized state. Often implies a state of disrepair or chaos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舊屋已經俾人拆到七除八拆，冇得住㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gau6 uk1 ji5 ging1 bei2 jan4 caak3 dou3 cat1 ceoi4 baat3 caak3, mou5 dak1 zyu6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间旧房子已经被拆得七零八落，没法住人了。
examples.english_sentence: That old house has been torn down completely, it's not habitable anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架爛車俾佢撞到七除八拆，都唔知整唔整得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 laan6 ce1 bei2 keoi5 zong6 dou3 cat1 ceoi4 baat3 caak3, dou1 m4 zi1 zing2 m4 zing2 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆破车被他撞得七零八落，都不知道能不能修好。
examples.english_sentence: That broken-down car was smashed to pieces by him, I don't even know if it can be repaired.

english_meaning: scattered; in disarray; disorganized; fragmented
explanation_mandarin: 形容东西散乱，不完整，或事情处理得不妥当。
explanation_english: Describes something scattered and incomplete, or a matter being handled improperly and chaotically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執房執到啲嘢七零八落，唔知擺邊好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zap1 fong2 zap1 dou3 di1 je5 cat1 ling4 baat3 lok6, m4 zi1 baai2 bin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾房间，东西弄得乱七八糟，不知道放哪里好。
examples.english_sentence: Cleaning the room, things are scattered everywhere, I don't know where to put them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project做得七零八落，要重新嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project zou6 dak1 cat1 ling4 baat3 lok6, jiu3 cung4 san1 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目做得七零八落，要重新来过。
examples.english_sentence: The project was done in a disorganized way, we need to start over.

english_meaning: ten thousand; myriad; all; a very large number
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，等于一万。形容数量极多。
explanation_english: Represents the number ten thousand. Also used to describe a very large quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有成萬蚊喺身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 seng4 maan6 man1 hai2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身上有成千上万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He has ten thousand dollars or more on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好味到不得了，真係萬中無一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 mei6 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, zan1 hai6 maan6 zung1 mou4 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物美味极了，真是万里挑一。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is incredibly delicious; it's truly one in a million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好遲到呀，萬事拜託！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3 aa3, maan6 si6 baai3 tok3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要迟到啊，万事拜托！
examples.english_sentence: Please don't be late, I'm counting on you!

english_meaning: Mokkei (a Chinese compound surname)
explanation_mandarin: 万俟是一个中文复姓。
explanation_english: Mokkei is a Chinese compound surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅姓氏好特別，叫做万俟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 si6 hou2 dak6 bit6, giu3 zou6 mok6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的姓氏很特别，叫做万俟。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is very special, it's Mokkei.

english_meaning: husband
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚的男性配偶。
explanation_english: Refers to a married male spouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個丈對我好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zoeng6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的丈夫对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: My husband is very good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話佢個丈好錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 go3 zoeng6 hou2 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说她的丈夫很疼爱她。
examples.english_sentence: She always says her husband loves her very much.

english_meaning: husband
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚的男子，配偶。
explanation_english: A married man; a male spouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅丈夫好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 zoeng6 fu1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的丈夫很疼我的。
examples.english_sentence: My husband loves me very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱同佢丈夫結咗婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 tung4 keoi5 zoeng6 fu1 git3 zo2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她刚刚和她的丈夫结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: She just got married to her husband.

english_meaning: To measure; to size up (a situation or person); to estimate one's capabilities or limits; to assess one's position.
explanation_mandarin: 原本指测量土地的面积。引申为评估，衡量，估量自己的能力，处境等。
explanation_english: Originally referring to measuring land area. By extension, it means to assess, measure, or estimate one's own abilities, situation, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗我都要丈量約份先，睇吓自己有冇能力搞掂呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zoeng6 loeng4 joek3 fan6 sin1, tai2 haa5 zi6 gei2 jau5 mou5 nang4 lik6 gaau2 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想我得先衡量一下，看看自己有没有能力搞定这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I think I need to size myself up first and see if I have the ability to handle this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好都係丈量約份先，唔好亂咁應承人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 zoeng6 loeng4 joek3 fan6 sin1, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 jing3 sing4 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好还是先衡量一下，不要随便答应别人。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better assess your own capabilities first, don't just casually promise people.

english_meaning: three
explanation_mandarin: 数字，表示数量为三。
explanation_english: The number three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗三個蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 saam1 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了三个苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought three apples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年三歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 saam1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年三岁。
examples.english_sentence: He is three years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個數字係三。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 hai6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数字是三。
examples.english_sentence: This number is three.

english_meaning: threesome (sexual activity)
explanation_mandarin: 指三个人之间的性行为，通常指两男一女或两女一男。
explanation_english: Refers to sexual activity involving three people, typically two men and one woman or two women and one man; a threesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋玩三P俾人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waan2 saam1 pi1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们玩三人性行为被人抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: They were caught having a threesome.

english_meaning: Triple Threat (referring to a person who can do many things well or is highly versatile/multi-talented)
explanation_mandarin: 源自香港赛马会的“三T”彩池，意指选中连续三场赛事的头马。后来引申为形容一个人在不同方面都很出色，就像中了大奖一样。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the 'Triple Trio' (三T) lottery pool in Hong Kong horse racing, where one has to pick the winners of three consecutive races. It's now used metaphorically to describe someone who excels in multiple areas or possesses diverse talents, akin to winning the lottery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係三T，又識唱歌又識跳舞又識做戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 saam1 ti1, jau6 sik1 cheung3 go1 jau6 sik1 tiu3 mou5 jau6 sik1 zou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个三号强心针，既会唱歌又会跳舞又会演戏。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a triple threat, he can sing, dance, and act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好受歡迎，因為佢做嘢好快又好靚，真係三T。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4, yan1 wai6 keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 jau6 hou2 leng3, zan1 hai6 saam1 ti1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司很受欢迎，因为他做事又快又好，真是个三号强心针。
examples.english_sentence: He's very popular at the company because he works quickly and well, he's truly a triple threat.

mandarin_meaning: 不死不活, 半死不活
english_meaning: half-dead, barely alive, so-so, mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 形容状态不佳，接近死亡或质量很差，不上不下，不上不下的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being in poor condition, close to death or of very poor quality, in a mediocre or so-so state; neither here nor there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，成日都三三四噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 saam1 sei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，整天都半死不活的。
examples.english_sentence: He has been sick for a long time, and is always half-dead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食三三四，唔好去食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 saam1 saam1 sei3, m4 hou2 heoi3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很一般，不要去吃了。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is mediocre, don't go there to eat.

english_meaning: to do something quickly and sloppily; to do something in a rough and ready way; to rush through something; haphazardly; without care
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事粗心大意，草率马虎，没有仔细考虑。
explanation_english: Describes doing something carelessly, hastily, and without careful consideration. It implies a lack of attention to detail and a rushed approach, often resulting in a less than satisfactory outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好三下五落二咁做嘢，小心會出錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 saam1 haa5 ng5 lok6 ji6 gam2 zou6嘢, siu2 sam1 wui5 chut1 co3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要三下五除二地做事，小心会出错的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things so quickly and carelessly; you might make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告三下五落二咁寫完就算，所以老闆唔收貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 saam1 haa5 ng5 lok6 ji6 gam2 se2 jyun4 zau6 syun3, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 sau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告马马虎虎地写完就算了，所以老板不接受。
examples.english_sentence: He just rushed through the report, so the boss didn't accept it.

english_meaning: every now and then, occasionally, from time to time
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的频率不高，但也不算完全没有发生，属于一种间断的、不规律的发生。
explanation_english: Describes something that happens irregularly and infrequently, but not completely absent. It implies intermittent occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三不五時就嚟搵我飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 bat1 ng5 si4 zau6 lai4 wan2 ngo5 yam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他时不时就来找我喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He comes to find me for a drink every now and then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦三不五時就hang機，好鬼麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 saam1 bat1 ng5 si4 zau6 hang1 gei1, hou2 gwai2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑时不时就死机，很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: This computer freezes every now and then, it's very annoying.

synonyms: 有時有陣 (yau5 si4 yau5 zan6)

mandarin_meaning: 三不管地带; 无人管; 没有人负责
english_meaning: a no man's land; a place where no one is in charge; an area outside of anyone's jurisdiction; uncontrolled; lawless
explanation_mandarin: 指没有人管辖、没有责任人负责的地区或事物。也可形容某事物处于无人负责、无人过问的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to an area or matter where no one has jurisdiction or responsibility. It can also describe a situation where something is left unattended or unmanaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個公園長期都三不管，啲設施爛曬都冇人整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 jyun2 coeng4 kei4 dou1 saam1 bat1 gun2, di1 cit3 si1 laan6 saai3 dou1 mou5 jan4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个公园长期处于三不管状态，设施都坏了也没人修理。
examples.english_sentence: This park has been a no man's land for a long time; the facilities are broken, and no one fixes them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係好似三不管咁，一時好一時唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 saam1 bat1 gun2 gam2, jat1 si4 hou2 jat1 si4 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系好像三不管地带一样，一会儿好一会儿不好。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is like a no man's land; it's good one moment and bad the next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤係三不管嘅地方，好多嘢都唔合規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun2 hai6 saam1 bat1 gun2 ge3 dei6 fong6, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 hap6 kwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工地是个三不管地带，很多事情都不符合规矩。
examples.english_sentence: This construction site is a no man's land; many things don't comply with the rules.

english_meaning: in total; all together; everything included
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示总共，加起来的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning 'in total', 'altogether', 'everything included'. It is often used when summing up a cost or quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次食飯三九兩丁七用咗五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sik6 faan6 saam1 gau2 loeng5 ding1 cat1 yung6 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次吃饭总共花了五百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This time eating out cost 500 dollars in total.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋三個人三九兩丁七買咗十幾隻蟹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4 saam1 gau2 loeng5 ding1 cat1 maai5 zo2 sap6 gei2 zek3 haai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们三个人一共买了十几只螃蟹。
examples.english_sentence: The three of us bought more than ten crabs in total.

mandarin_meaning: 不认识；毫不相干；风马牛不相及
english_meaning: To not know someone at all; to be completely unfamiliar with someone; to be unrelated or irrelevant.
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全不认识某人，或者形容两件事物之间毫不相干，毫无关系。
explanation_english: Describes being completely unfamiliar with someone or something. It is used to emphasize a lack of knowledge or connection between two people or things. Literally translates to 'three and nine don't know seven'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個三九唔識七，點會合作㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 saam1 gau2 m4 sik1 cat1, dim2 wui5 hap6 jok3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个根本不认识，怎么会合作呢？
examples.english_sentence: Those two don't know each other at all, how would they collaborate?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰個人，我三九唔識七，唔好問我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 go3 jan4, ngo5 saam1 gau2 m4 sik1 cat1, m4 hou2 man6 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的这个人，我根本不认识，别问我了。
examples.english_sentence: The person you're talking about, I have no idea who they are, don't ask me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢同件事三九唔識七，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 tung4 gin6 si6 saam1 gau2 m4 sik1 cat1, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的事情和这件事毫不相干，别理他。
examples.english_sentence: What he's saying is completely irrelevant to this matter, don't pay attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 乱七八糟；不三不四; 做事没长性
english_meaning: Messy; Disorganized; Half-hearted; Inconsistent; In a chaotic state
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物混乱，没有条理；也指一个人做事不认真，没有恒心，马马虎虎。
explanation_english: Describes something that is messy and disorganized; also refers to someone who is not serious about their work and lacks perseverance, doing things haphazardly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間房真係三五七，亂到冇地方落腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 zan1 hai6 saam1 ng5 cat1, lyun6 dou3 mou5 dei6 fong1 lok6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间真是乱七八糟的，乱得都没地方下脚了。
examples.english_sentence: His room is such a mess, so disorganized that there's no place to step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢唔好咁三五七，要認真啲先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 ng5 cat1, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作不要这么马马虎虎的，要认真一点才可以。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so half-hearted with your work, you need to be more serious.

synonyms: 亂七八糟 (lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1)

english_meaning: in small groups; forming small cliques
explanation_mandarin: 形容人们三三两两地聚集在一起。
explanation_english: Describes people gathering in small groups or forming small cliques, typically implying a casual or informal gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日三五成羣喺公園度傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是三五成群地在公园聊天。
examples.english_sentence: They always gather in small groups to chat in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放學之後，啲學生三五成羣咁去咗食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hok6 zi1 hau6, di1 hok6 sang1 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 gam2 heoi3 zo2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放学之后，学生们三五成群地去吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: After school, the students went to eat in small groups.

english_meaning: in small groups; forming small groups
explanation_mandarin: 形容人们聚集成小群体。指数量不多，但确实形成了一定的组织或团体。
explanation_english: Describes people gathering in small groups. It indicates a small number of people, but they have indeed formed a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放學之後，啲學生三五成羣咁喺學校門口傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hok6 zi1 hau6, di1 hok6 sang1 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 gam2 hai2 hok6 haau6 mun4 hau2 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放学后，学生们三五成群地在学校门口聊天。
examples.english_sentence: After school, the students were chatting in small groups at the school gate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三五成羣噉行入咗間酒吧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 gam2 haang4 jap6 zo2 gaan1 jiu2 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三五成群地走进了酒吧。
examples.english_sentence: They walked into the bar in small groups.

english_meaning: in small groups; in clusters; to gather in small groups
explanation_mandarin: 形容三三两两地聚集在一起。
explanation_english: Describes people gathering in small groups, usually without a specific purpose or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日放學都三五成群咁去打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 fong3 hok6 dou1 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 gam2 heoi3 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天放学都三五成群地去打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: They go to play video games in small groups every day after school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路仔喺公園三五成群咁玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou5 zai2 hai2 gung1 jyun2 saam1 ng5 sing4 kwan4 gam2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们在公园里三五成群地玩耍。
examples.english_sentence: The children are playing in the park in small groups.

english_meaning: a few close friends; a small group of intimate friends
explanation_mandarin: 指三到五个非常了解，可以互相倾诉，关系密切的好朋友。
explanation_english: Refers to a small group of three to five close, intimate friends who understand each other well and can confide in each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，我哋成日都會約埋三五知己出嚟飲嘢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 joek3 maai4 saam1 ng5 zi1 gei2 chut1 lai4 jam2 je5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我们经常会约上三五个知己出来喝酒聊天。
examples.english_sentence: After work, we often gather with a few close friends to have drinks and chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有三五知己喺身边支持你，真系好好多㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 saam1 ng5 zi1 gei2 hai2 san1 bin1 zi1 chi4 nei5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有三五个知心朋友在身边支持你，真的好很多啊。
examples.english_sentence: Having a few close friends supporting you is really so much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生得一知己, 死而無憾，更何況三五知己呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 dak1 jat1 zi1 gei2, sei2 ji4 mou4 ham6, gang3 ho4 kwong3 saam1 ng5 zi1 gei2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生得一知己, 死而无憾，更何况三五个知己呢？
examples.english_sentence: To have one true friend in life is enough to die without regrets, let alone three or five close friends?

mandarin_meaning: 三人成虎 (sān rén chéng hǔ)
english_meaning: If enough people say something is true, it will be believed, even if it's not; truth can be obscured by repeated falsehoods; hearsay becomes fact through repetition.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻谣言重复多次，就能使人信以为真。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if a lie is repeated enough times, people will begin to believe it to be true, even if it is absurd. It highlights the power of rumor and the importance of critical thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信曬佢哋講嘅嘢，三人成虎吖嘛，可能根本就冇咁嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 keoi5 dei6 gong2 ge3 je5, saam1 jan4 sing4 fu2 aa1 maa3, ho2 nang4 gan1 bun2 zau6 mou5 gam2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要全信他们说的话，三人成虎嘛，可能根本就没有这样的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe everything they say. It's like 'three men make a tiger'. Maybe nothing like that even happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算好多人講佢壞話，你都要自己判斷，唔好俾三人成虎影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 hou2 do1 jan4 gong2 keoi5 waai6 waa6, nei5 dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 pun3 dyun3, m4 hou2 bei2 saam1 jan4 sing4 fu2 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算很多人说他的坏话，你都要自己判断，不要被三人成虎影响。
examples.english_sentence: Even if many people speak ill of him, you still need to judge for yourself and not be influenced by 'three men make a tiger'.

synonyms: 眾口鑠金 (zung3 hau2 soek3 gam1)

jyutping: saam1 yan4 hang4 bit1 yau5 ngo5 si1
english_meaning: Among three people walking together, at least one can be my teacher.
explanation_mandarin: 指应该虚心向别人学习，即使是自己不如自己的人，也有值得学习的地方。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of being humble and willing to learn from others, even those who might seem less knowledgeable or experienced than oneself. It suggests that everyone possesses unique strengths and insights from which we can benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢後生過我，但係三人行必有我師，我都可以學到嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 keoi5 hau6 saang1 gwo3 ngo5, daan6 hai6 saam1 yan4 hang4 bit1 yau5 ngo5 si1, ngo5 dou1 ho2 ji5 hok6 dou2 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使他比我年轻，但是三人行必有我师，我也可以学到东西的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he is younger than me, "among three people walking together, at least one can be my teacher", I can still learn something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁自大啦，三人行必有我師，要謙虛啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zi6 daai6 laa1, saam1 yan4 hang4 bit1 yau5 ngo5 si1, jiu3 him1 heoi1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么自大啦，三人行必有我师，要谦虚一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, "among three people walking together, at least one can be my teacher", you should be more humble.

english_meaning: to repeatedly give orders and instructions; to reiterate a command
explanation_mandarin: 指多次命令告诫。形容多次命令和告诫。
explanation_english: Refers to repeatedly issuing orders and warnings. It describes the act of giving orders and warnings multiple times, often emphasizing importance and clarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir已經三令五申叫我哋要準時交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 Sir4 ji5 ging1 saam1 ling6 ng5 san1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师已经三令五申地告诉我们一定要准时交作业。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher has repeatedly told us that we must submit our homework on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋老細成日三令五申，叫我哋做嘢要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 saam1 ling6 ng5 san1, giu3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们老板总是三令五申，叫我们做事要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss always repeatedly tells us to be more careful when working.

english_meaning: Three-piece set; three-piece suit
explanation_mandarin: 通常指西装的三件套，包括外套、马甲和裤子。也可能指其他成套的三件物品。
explanation_english: Typically refers to a three-piece suit, including a jacket, waistcoat (vest), and trousers. It can also refer to any set of three matching or related items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗套三件頭返工，好正式呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 tou3 saam1 gin6 tau4 faan1 gung1, hou2 zing3 sik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿着三件套上班，很正式啊！
examples.english_sentence: He wore a three-piece suit to work today, very formal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間傢俬鋪賣嘅梳化係三件頭嘅，包括一張長梳化同兩張單人梳化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaa1 si1 pou3 maai6 ge3 so1 faa2 hai6 saam1 gin6 tau4 ge3, baau1 kut3 jat1 zoeng1 coeng4 so1 faa2 tung4 loeng5 zoeng1 daan1 jan4 so1 faa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家家具店卖的沙发是三件套的，包括一张长沙发和两张单人沙发。
examples.english_sentence: The sofa set sold in this furniture store is a three-piece set, including a long sofa and two armchairs.

english_meaning: Trinity; a union of three distinct entities into one
explanation_mandarin: 源自基督教神学，指圣父、圣子、圣灵三者合一，同为一体。现在也用来比喻三个不同部分紧密结合为一个整体。
explanation_english: Originally from Christian theology, referring to the Holy Trinity: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, three distinct persons in one God. It's now used metaphorically to describe three different parts or entities closely integrated into a single, unified whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅成功，係靠銷售、市場推廣同埋客戶服務三位一體嘅合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1, hai6 kaau3 siu1 sau6, si5 cheung4 tui1 gwong2 tung4 maai4 haak3 wu6 fuk6 mou6 saam1 wai2 jat1 tai2 ge3 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的成功，是依靠销售、市场推广和客户服务三位一体的合作。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this company relies on the unified cooperation of sales, marketing, and customer service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府、商界、同埋學術界應該三位一體，共同解決社會問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2, seung1 gaai3, tung4 maai4 hok6 seot6 gaai3 ying1 goi1 saam1 wai2 jat1 tai2, gung6 tung4 gaai2 kyut3 se5 wui2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府、商界和学术界应该三位一体，共同解决社会问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government, business sector, and academia should work together as a unified body to solve social problems.

jyutping: saam1 go3 neoi5 jan2 jat1 go3 heoi1
english_meaning: Three women make a market; where there are many women, there will be a lot of noise and gossip.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女人多的地方，嘈杂喧闹，容易产生是非。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a noisy and bustling environment, similar to a marketplace, that is created when there are many women present. It often implies gossip and trivial discussions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢哋三個一齊傾偈，嘈到拆天咁，真係三個女人一個墟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 jat1 cai4 king1 gai2, cou4 dou3 caak3 tin1 gam3, zan1 hai6 saam1 go3 neoi5 jan2 jat1 go3 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看她们三个一起聊天，吵得天翻地覆，真是三个女人一台戏。
examples.english_sentence: Look at those three chatting together, it's so loud you'd think the sky is falling. It's really three women making a market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間office好多女同事，成日講是非，真係三個女人一個墟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 office hou2 do1 neoi5 tung4 si6, seng4 jat6 gong2 si6 fei1, zan1 hai6 saam1 go3 neoi5 jan2 jat1 go3 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办公室里有很多女同事，总是说闲话，真是三个女人一台戏。
examples.english_sentence: There are many female colleagues in the office, and they always gossip. It's really three women making a market.

cantonese: 三個臭皮匠，勝過一個諸葛亮
jyutping: saam1 go3 cau3 pei4 zoeng6, sing3 gwo3 jat1 go3 zyu1 got3 loeng6
mandarin_meaning: 三个臭皮匠，胜过一个诸葛亮
english_meaning: Two heads are better than one; Three cobblers with their wits combined equal Zhuge Liang (a famous strategist).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人多智慧多，集体力量大。
explanation_english: This idiom means that multiple people brainstorming and contributing ideas can be more effective than a single brilliant person working alone. It emphasizes the power of collective wisdom and teamwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好難搞，不如我哋集思廣益，三個臭皮匠，勝過一個諸葛亮吖嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4 gaau2, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 zaap6 si1 gwong2 jik1, saam1 go3 cau3 pei4 zoeng6, sing3 gwo3 jat1 go3 zyu1 got3 loeng6 aak3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很难搞，不如我们集思广益，三个臭皮匠，胜过一个诸葛亮嘛。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is difficult. Why don't we brainstorm together? Two heads are better than one, you know.

english_meaning: Triple plus; Excellent (often used to describe service or quality)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用来形容服务或质量非常好，比“好”还要好。 表示超出预期的优秀程度。可以理解为“非常棒”，“极好”，“好上加好”。
explanation_english: Usually used to describe service or quality that is exceptionally good, even better than just 'good'. Indicates a level of excellence exceeding expectations. Can be understood as 'fantastic', 'excellent', or 'superb'. It suggests something is outstandingly positive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務真係三個骨，啲嘢又好食，服務又周到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 saam1 go3 gwat1, di1 je5 jau6 hou2 sik6, fuk6 mou6 jau6 zau1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务真是太棒了，东西又好吃，服务又周到。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is truly excellent. The food is delicious, and the service is very attentive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得三個骨，全部科都攞A。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 saam1 go3 gwat1, cyun4 bou6 fo1 dou1 lo2 A.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得非常好，所有科目都拿了A。
examples.english_sentence: He did exceptionally well in the exam this time, getting A's in all subjects.

mandarin_meaning: 很差勁的; 不怎麼樣的
english_meaning: terrible; awful; very poor (quality)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物非常差勁，质量或表现非常不好。
explanation_english: Describes something as being terrible, of very poor quality, or performing very badly. Often used to express strong disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲真係三個骨褲，悶到瞓著覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cheut1 hei3 zan1 hai6 saam1 go3 gwat1 fu3, mun6 dou3 fan3 zoek3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真的很差劲，闷得我都睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is terrible; it was so boring I fell asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到三個骨褲，走晒音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheung3 go1 cheung3 dou3 saam1 go3 gwat1 fu3, zau2 saai3 yam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得很糟糕，完全走音。
examples.english_sentence: His singing was awful, completely out of tune.

english_meaning: to invite someone repeatedly and earnestly; to beg someone to come
explanation_mandarin: 多次催促邀请。形容邀请的诚意和次数很多。
explanation_english: To repeatedly urge and invite someone. Describes the sincerity and frequency of the invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆病咗，我哋三催四請先請到佢嚟睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 beng6 zo2, ngo5 dei6 saam1 ceoi1 sei3 ceng2 sin1 ceng2 dou3 keoi5 lai4 tai2 yi1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶生病了，我们再三邀请才请到她来看医生。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma was sick, and we had to beg her repeatedly before she finally agreed to see the doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋三催四請，佢都唔肯去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saam1 ceoi1 sei3 ceng2, keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们再三邀请，他都不肯去。
examples.english_sentence: We invited him repeatedly, but he still refused to go.

english_meaning: To achieve top honors in all three levels of the imperial examinations; to achieve a triple first; to pass all three top-level civil service exams
explanation_mandarin: 古代科举考试中，乡试、会试、殿试都获得第一名，称为「连中三元」，即解元、会元、状元都是你。
explanation_english: In the ancient imperial examinations system, it refers to achieving the top rank (first place) in all three levels: the provincial examination (乡试), the metropolitan examination (会试), and the palace examination (殿试). Specifically, it means being the top scholar (解元) in the provincial exam, the top scholar (会元) in the metropolitan exam, and the top scholar (状元) in the palace exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要考到三元及第，真係好難㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 haau2 dou3 saam1 jyun4 kap6 dai6, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要考到连中三元，真的很难啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's really difficult to achieve a triple first!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人好叻，希望三元及第，光宗耀祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 jan4 hou2 lek1, hei1 mong6 saam1 jyun4 kap6 dai6, gwong1 zung1 jiu3 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人很厉害，希望连中三元，光宗耀祖。
examples.english_sentence: People in the past were very talented, hoping to achieve a triple first to bring honor to their ancestors.

mandarin_meaning: 三两下工夫 / 简单几招
english_meaning: A few simple moves; a couple of tricks; a brief demonstration of skill; to do something quickly and easily.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事快速、简单，用少量动作或技巧就完成了某事。多含轻视或不费力的意味。
explanation_english: Describes doing something quickly and easily, using only a few simple moves or skills. Often implies disdain or ease in accomplishing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三兩下手勢就整好部電腦喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 loeng5 haa6 sau2 sai3 zau6 zing2 hou2 bou6 din6 nou5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三两下工夫就把电脑修好了。
examples.english_sentence: He fixed the computer with just a few simple moves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢後生，佢耍劍嘅時候，三兩下手勢就打贏咗人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 hau6 saang1, keoi5 saa2 gim3 ge3 si4 hau6, saam1 loeng5 haa6 sau2 sai3 zau6 daa2 wing4 zo2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他年轻，他耍剑的时候，三两下就赢了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him because he's young. When he's fencing, he wins with just a few quick moves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢，我三兩下手勢就搞掂啦，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5, ngo5 saam1 loeng5 haa6 sau2 sai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 laa1, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西，我三两下就搞定了，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: I can finish these things in a few simple moves, don't worry.

english_meaning: Silly; Foolish; Scatterbrained (usually referring to a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用来形容女性，指她行为举止轻浮、傻气，或头脑不清楚。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Typically used to describe a woman who is silly, foolish, or scatterbrained. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁三八啦，靜啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 baat3 laa1, zing6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么傻了，安静一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, be quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好三八，成日喺度大聲講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 saam1 baat3, seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这个人很傻，整天在那里大声说话。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very silly person, always talking loudly.

mandarin_meaning: 界线; 分界线; 互不干涉的界限
english_meaning: Demarcation line; Dividing line; Borderline; often used to describe a clear boundary separating people or territories, sometimes used humorously
explanation_mandarin: 原本指朝鲜战争时期的军事分界线。现在常用来比喻人与人之间划定的界限，或互不干涉的范围。有时带有玩笑的意味。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the Korean War military demarcation line. Now often used metaphorically to describe a boundary or dividing line between people, or an area where people do not interfere with each other. Sometimes used with a humorous connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺張枱中間劃條三八線，你唔好過界呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 zung1 gaan1 waak6 tiu4 saam1 baat3 sin3, nei5 m4 hou2 gwo3 gaai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在桌子中间划一条三八线，你不要过界啊！
examples.english_sentence: We'll draw a demarcation line in the middle of the table, don't cross it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹成日都劃三八線，唔睬對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 seng4 jat6 dou1 waak6 saam1 baat3 sin3, m4 cai2 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹经常划三八线，不理对方。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters often draw a line between themselves and ignore each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢哋鬧交之後，就喺屋企劃咗條三八線，各自負責自己嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 zi1 hau6, zau6 hai2 uk1 kei2 waak6 zo2 tiu4 saam1 baat3 sin3, gok3 zi6 fu6 zaak3 zi6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他们吵架之后，就在家里划了一条三八线，各自负责自己的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Since they had a fight, they've drawn a line in the house, and each takes care of their own things.

mandarin_meaning: 合伙做庄家; 三个人合伙
english_meaning: To partner in being the banker (in a gambling game); three-person partnership
explanation_mandarin: 指三个人合伙出资做庄家，或者指三个人合伙。
explanation_english: Refers to three people pooling their resources to act as the banker (in a gambling context, often mahjong) or simply a partnership of three people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋三公夾錢買六合彩，睇下中唔中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saam1 gung1 gaap3 cin2 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2, tai2 haa5 zung3 m4 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们三个人合伙买彩票，看看能不能中。
examples.english_sentence: The three of us are pooling our money to buy lottery tickets, let's see if we win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三公喺麻雀枱上面鬥到你死我活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 gung1 hai2 maa4 zoek2 toi2 soeng6 min6 dau3 dou3 nei5 sei2 ngo5 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三个人在麻将桌上斗得你死我活。
examples.english_sentence: The three of them are battling to the death at the mahjong table.

mandarin_meaning: 疏忽; 不小心; 马虎
english_meaning: Careless; negligent; sloppy; inattentive
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不仔细、不认真，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes being careless, negligent, and prone to making mistakes due to a lack of attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁三六，實會出錯㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 saam1 luk6, sat6 wui5 chut1 cho3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么马虎，肯定会出错的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so careless with your work, you're bound to make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好三六㗎，唔可以畀佢負責重要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 saam1 luk6 gaa3, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 fu6 zaak3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很马虎，不能让他负责重要的事。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very careless person; you can't let him be responsible for important things.

synonyms: 是是但但 (si6 si6 daan6 daan6)

mandarin_meaning: 三教九流; 形形色色的人
english_meaning: Various kinds of people; all sorts of people; people of all walks of life
explanation_mandarin: 原指宗教和学术上的各种流派，后来泛指社会上各种不同身份、地位和职业的人。
explanation_english: Originally referring to various schools of thought in religion and academia, it later came to refer to people of different identities, statuses, and professions in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司咩三六九嘅人都有，好難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 me1 saam1 luk6 gau2 ge3 jan4 dou1 jau5, hou2 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司什么三教九流的人都有，很难搞。
examples.english_sentence: This company has all sorts of people, it's hard to manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會就係咁㗎啦，三六九等，乜人都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, saam1 luk6 gau2 dang2, mat1 jan4 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会就是这样，三教九流，什么样的人都有。
examples.english_sentence: That's just how society is, all kinds of people.

english_meaning: To toss and turn; to go back and forth on something (often indecisive); to keep changing one's mind.
explanation_mandarin: 形容反复考虑，犹豫不决，或者事情来回折腾，没有定论。
explanation_english: Describes the act of repeatedly considering something, being indecisive, or a situation that keeps going back and forth without resolution. Implies a lack of decisiveness or a state of flux.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工人工唔錯，但係啲嘢好悶，我諗咗好耐都係三六滾一滾，唔知辭唔辭好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 yan4 gung1 m4 co3, daan6 hai6 di1 ye5 hou2 mun6, ngo5 lam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 hai6 saam1 luk6 gwan2 jat1 gwan2, m4 zi1 ci4 m4 ci4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作工资不错，但是工作内容很无聊，我想了很久还是翻来覆去，不知道辞不辞好。
examples.english_sentence: The salary of this job is good, but the work is very boring. I've been thinking about it for a long time and still keep going back and forth, unsure whether to quit or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再三六滾一滾啦，快啲決定去唔去旅行啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 saam1 luk6 gwan2 jat1 gwan2 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再翻来覆去了，快点决定去不去旅行吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep going back and forth! Decide quickly whether to go on the trip or not!

english_meaning: Dog meat
explanation_mandarin: 指狗肉。“三六”并非指数字，而是一种隐晦的说法。 在粤语中，人们有时会用委婉的方式来指代某些食物，尤其是那些有争议的食物。
explanation_english: Refers to dog meat. The "three six" is not a literal numerical value but a euphemism used to refer to dog meat. In Cantonese, people sometimes use subtle ways to refer to certain foods, especially those that are controversial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意食三六香肉，話好滋補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 saam1 luk6 hoeng1 juk6, waa6 hou2 zi1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢吃狗肉，说很有营养。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to eat dog meat, saying it's very nutritious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家香港好少地方有得食三六香肉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 siu2 dei6 fong1 jau5 dak1 sik6 saam1 luk6 hoeng1 juk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在香港很少地方能吃到狗肉了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, there are very few places in Hong Kong where you can eat dog meat.

mandarin_meaning: 形容极其残酷、严厉的惩罚或考验; 比喻遭受极其严酷的考验。
english_meaning: Describe an extremely cruel and severe punishment or test; A metaphor for undergoing extremely harsh trials.
explanation_mandarin: 原指黑社会成员加入帮会时所受的酷刑，用刀在身上刺伤，并用香火烫伤口，以示忠诚。现在多用来比喻经历极其严酷的考验或遭遇极其悲惨的境遇。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the cruel torture endured by triad members when joining a gang, involving cutting the body with knives and burning the wounds with incense sticks to demonstrate loyalty. Now, it's often used metaphorically to describe undergoing extremely harsh trials or encountering extremely tragic circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅競爭入面真係經歷咗一番三刀六洞，先至可以升到上經理嘅位置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 ging6 zang1 jap6 min6 zan1 hai6 ging1 lik6 zo2 jat1 faan1 saam1 dou1 luk6 dung6, sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 sing1 dou3 soeng5 ging1 lei5 ge3 wai6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的竞争中真是经历了一番三刀六洞，才能够升到经理的位置。
examples.english_sentence: He really went through an extremely harsh ordeal in the company's competition before he could be promoted to the position of manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業真係唔容易，好多人都要經歷三刀六洞先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6, ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 jiu3 ging1 lik6 saam1 dou1 luk6 dung6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业真是不容易，很多人都要经历三刀六洞才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: Starting a business is really not easy, many people have to go through a very difficult process before they can succeed.

mandarin_meaning: 千刀万剐 (qiān dāo wàn guǎ)
english_meaning: To be utterly cruel and merciless; to inflict countless cuts and wounds (literally: three knives, six eyes); severely punished; extremely harsh treatment
explanation_mandarin: 形容极其残酷，手段极其狠毒。也用来比喻受到非常严厉的惩罚。
explanation_english: Describes extreme cruelty and mercilessness, where the means are extremely harsh. It is also used to describe receiving severe punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，抵佢俾人三刀六眼啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, dai2 keoi5 bei2 jan4 saam1 dou1 luk6 ngaan5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，活该他被人千刀万剐！
examples.english_sentence: He's so bad, he deserves to be utterly punished!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日都三刀六眼咁對啲員工，遲早都會俾人告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 dou1 luk6 ngaan5 gam2 deoi3 di1 jyun4 gung1, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 bei2 jan4 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是那么残酷地对待员工，迟早都会被人告的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always so harsh towards his employees; sooner or later, he'll get sued.

english_meaning: Three-point shot (basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 篮球比赛中，在三分线外投篮并命中的球。投中一个三分球得三分。
explanation_english: In basketball, a shot made from beyond the three-point line on the court, worth three points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢射咗個三分波，勁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se6 zo2 go3 saam1 fan1 bo1, ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投了一个三分球，真棒！
examples.english_sentence: He shot a three-pointer, amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場波佢入咗好多個三分波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bo1 keoi5 jap6 zo2 hou2 do1 go3 saam1 fan1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛他进了好多三分球。
examples.english_sentence: He scored many three-pointers in this game.

english_meaning: Nine-day wonder; flash in the pan; to be enthusiastic for only a short period
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人对事物只有短暂的兴趣，很快就失去热情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is only enthusiastic about something for a short time and quickly loses interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都三分鐘熱度，乜都做唔長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 fan1 zung1 jit6 dou6, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是三分钟热度，什么都做不长。
examples.english_sentence: He always has a short attention span when it comes to work, he can't stick to anything for long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好三分鐘熱度啦，既然開始咗學琴就要堅持落去啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saam1 fan1 zung1 jit6 dou6 laa1, gei3 jin4 hoi1 chi2 zo2 hok6 kam4 zau6 jiu3 gin1 chi4 lok6 heoi3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要三分钟热度了，既然开始学琴就要坚持下去啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a flash in the pan, now that you've started learning the piano, you have to persevere.

jyutping: saam1 fan1 ngaan4 sik1 soeng5 daai6 hung4
mandarin_meaning: 稍有姿色便自以为了不起；有点本事就骄傲自满
english_meaning: To be conceited and arrogant because of a little bit of talent or beauty; to let a little bit of success go to one's head
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人稍微有点姿色或才华，就自以为很了不起，骄傲自满，目中无人。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who becomes arrogant and self-important after achieving a small amount of success or possessing a minor talent or attractive quality. They overestimate their abilities and look down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個比賽第三名，就三分顏色上大紅，成日喺度曬命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 bei2 coi3 dai6 saam1 ming4, zau6 saam1 fan1 ngaan4 sik1 soeng5 daai6 hung4, seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 saai3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了个比赛第三名，就有点成绩就骄傲自满，整天在那炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He won third place in the competition and now he's letting it go to his head, always showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好三分顏色上大紅啦，你嘅成功都仲未穩固㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saam1 fan1 ngaan4 sik1 soeng5 daai6 hung4 laa1, nei5 ge3 sing4 gung1 dou1 zung1 mei6 wan2 gu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别得意忘形，你的成功还不太稳固。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let it go to your head too much, your success isn't secure yet.

mandarin_meaning: 危险的位置；不安全的位置
english_meaning: A dangerous position; an unsafe location (literally, 'three brake positions')
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处于危险、不利的境地或位置。也指容易出事的地方。
explanation_english: A metaphor for being in a dangerous or disadvantageous situation or position. It can also refer to a place where accidents are likely to happen. The 'three brakes' likely refer to the need to brake frequently due to danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺呢間公司咁樣做嘢，遲早都會搞到自己喺三剎位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hai2 saam1 saat3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这家公司这样工作，迟早会让自己处于危险的境地。
examples.english_sentence: The way you work at this company, sooner or later, you'll put yourself in a dangerous position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條馬路好多車衝紅燈，企喺路邊都好似喺三剎位噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 maa5 lou6 hou2 do1 ce1 cung1 hung4 dang1, kei5 hai2 lou6 bin1 dou1 hou2 ci5 hai2 saam1 saat3 wai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条马路很多车闯红灯，站在路边都好像在危险地带一样。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of cars run red lights on this road. Standing on the side of the road feels like being in a dangerous zone.

english_meaning: lousy; terrible; awful; substandard
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物表现非常糟糕，质量很差，令人失望。
explanation_english: Describes something of very poor quality, terrible performance, or generally disappointing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得好三劃啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 hou2 saam1 waak6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得太差了！
examples.english_sentence: I did terribly on this exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係好三劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 saam1 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真难吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really awful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲拍得好三劃，唔好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 paak3 dak1 hou2 saam1 waak6, m4 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影拍得很差，不好看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is terribly made and not worth watching.

mandarin_meaning: 只会写笔画简单的字的人; 菜鸟; 水平差的人
english_meaning: Someone who only knows how to write simple strokes (often used to describe someone who is illiterate or has very poor writing skills); novice; someone with low skill level
explanation_mandarin: 指只会写很少笔画的字的人，常用来形容识字不多或者写作能力很差的人。 也可引申为技能水平很低，不熟练的人，类似于“菜鸟”。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only knows how to write characters with very few strokes, often used to describe someone with limited literacy or poor writing skills. It can also be extended to refer to someone with low skill level or inexperience, similar to "newbie" or "rookie."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁多嘢都唔識，簡直係三劃王啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 do1 ye5 dou1 m4 sik1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 saam1 waak6 wong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么多东西都不会，简直就是个菜鸟。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know so much stuff, he's practically a newbie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇小佢，佢以前係三劃王，依家啲字寫得好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 saam1 waak6 wong4, ji1 gaa1 di1 zi6 se2 dak1 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看他，他以前是个写字很差的人，现在字写得很漂亮了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, he used to be someone who could barely write, but now his handwriting is very beautiful.

english_meaning: primary colors
explanation_mandarin: 指可以混合成各种颜色的三种基本颜色，通常是红、黄、蓝。
explanation_english: Refers to the three basic colors that can be mixed to create a wide range of colors, usually red, yellow, and blue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 油畫通常用三原色溝埋嚟畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 waa2 tung1 soeng4 jung6 saam1 jyun4 sik1 gau1 maai4 lai4 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 油画通常用三原色混合起来画。
examples.english_sentence: Oil paintings are usually painted by mixing the primary colors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識分三原色啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 fan1 saam1 jyun4 sik1 aa3?

examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 saam1 caa1 sou1 laan6 zo2, jung6 m4 dou2 go3 din6 faan6 bou1 laa3.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了个新的三脚插头来换。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new three-pronged plug to replace it.

english_meaning: Triple Champion; Passing all three levels of imperial examinations; A congee dish with various ingredients.
explanation_mandarin: 原本指科举时代，一个人连续通过乡试、会试、殿试，取得解元、会元、状元，即连中三元。现在也指一种粥，里面通常有猪肝、猪肉丸和粉肠等食材。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to someone in the imperial examination system who consecutively passed the provincial examination (乡试), the metropolitan examination (会试), and the palace examination (殿试), achieving the titles of Jie Yuan (解元), Hui Yuan (会元), and Zhuang Yuan (状元) respectively. It literally means winning all three levels. Nowadays, it also refers to a congee dish, usually containing pig liver, pork meatballs, and pork intestines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好叻，考到個個都話佢有機會攞三及第。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1, haau2 dou3 go3 go3 dou1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 gei1 wui2 lo2 saam1 kap6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很厉害，考的每个人都说他有机会连中三元。
examples.english_sentence: He is really smart. Everyone says he has a chance to become a triple champion in the exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食碗三及第粥啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 wun2 saam1 kap6 dai2 zuk1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一碗三及第粥啊。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat a bowl of San Ge Di Congee.

english_meaning: Everyone talking at once; many voices talking at the same time; a cacophony of voices.
explanation_mandarin: 形容很多人同时说话，声音嘈杂混乱。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where many people are talking at the same time, creating a chaotic and noisy environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，大家三口兩脷，嘈到阿頭聽唔到佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6, daai6 gaa1 saam1 hau2 loeng5 lei6, cou4 dou3 aa3 tau4 teng1 m4 dou2 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，大家七嘴八舌的，吵得领导听不到他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, everyone was talking at once, so noisy that the leader couldn't hear what he was saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路一放學就三口兩脷，好鬼嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 jat1 fong3 hok6 zau6 saam1 hau2 loeng5 lei6, hou2 gwai2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们一放学就七嘴八舌的，非常吵闹。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the kids were dismissed from school, they all started talking at once, it was so noisy.

english_meaning: publicly; in front of everyone; openly; face to face with multiple people
explanation_mandarin: 指在许多人面前，公开地，不私下进行。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something publicly, in front of many people, not privately or secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩嘢你三口六面講清楚佢啦，唔好喺背後講人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 je5 nei5 saam1 hau2 luk6 min6 gong2 cing1 co2 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 hai2 bui3 hau6 gong2 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么事你当着大家的面说清楚吧，不要在背后议论别人。
examples.english_sentence: If there's anything, you should clarify it in front of everyone, don't gossip about others behind their backs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三口六面咁樣鬧我，真係好冇面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 hau2 luk6 min6 gam2 joeng2 nau6 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当着大家的面这样骂我，真是很没面子。
examples.english_sentence: He scolded me like that in front of everyone, it's really embarrassing.

jyutping: saam1 geoi3 bat1 lei4 bun2 hong4
english_meaning: One always talks about their profession; Cannot stop talking about one's profession; Always refers back to one's own field of expertise.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话总是离不开自己的本职工作或专业领域。
explanation_english: Describes someone who constantly talks about their own profession or area of expertise, even when the conversation shifts to other topics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係三句不離本行，食飯都喺度講緊佢啲股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 saam1 geoi3 bat1 lei4 bun2 hong4, sik6 faan6 dou1 hai2 dou6 gong2 gan2 keoi5 di1 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是三句话不离本行，吃饭都在讲他的股票。
examples.english_sentence: He really can't stop talking about his profession, even talking about his stocks while eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明做老師嘅，次次見到佢，佢都三句不離本行，講啲教育理念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 zou6 lou5 si1 ge3, ci3 ci3 gin3 dou2 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 saam1 geoi3 bat1 lei4 bun2 hong4, gong2 di1 gaau3 juk6 lei5 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是当老师的，每次见到他，他都三句话不离本行，讲一些教育理念。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is a teacher, every time I see him, he always talks about his profession, discussing educational philosophies.

jyutping: saam1 geoi3 m4 maai4 loeng5 geoi3
english_meaning: In a few words; without finishing a sentence; often used to describe someone who is impatient or speaks abruptly
explanation_mandarin: 指说话很快，没说完几句就结束了。形容说话草率，不耐烦，或者说话内容简洁。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks abruptly or impatiently, not finishing sentences or conversations properly. It implies a lack of patience or a concise way of speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日三句唔埋兩句就鬧人，真係好難頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 saam1 geoi3 m4 maai4 loeng5 geoi3 zau6 naau6 jan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是三言两语就骂人，真是很难忍受。
examples.english_sentence: He always scolds people in a few words, it's really unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁三句唔埋兩句啦，講清楚啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 saam1 geoi3 m4 maai4 loeng5 geoi3 laa1, gong2 cing1 co2 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样三言两语的，说清楚点行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so abrupt, can you explain more clearly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆講嘢好快，成日都三句唔埋兩句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gong2 je5 hou2 faai3, sing4 jat6 dou1 saam1 geoi3 m4 maai4 loeng5 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说话很快，经常三言两语。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma speaks very fast and often doesn't finish her sentences.

english_meaning: Joint trial by the three high judicial organs; A joint trial by senior judicial officials
explanation_mandarin: 古代中国的一种高级审判制度，由刑部、都察院、大理寺三个司法机关联合审理重大案件。
explanation_english: An ancient Chinese judicial system where significant and important cases were jointly tried by the Ministry of Justice (刑部), the Censorate (都察院), and the Court of Revision (大理寺). It signifies a high-level, thorough legal review.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單咁大鑊嘅案，一定要三司會審先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 gam3 daai6 wok6 ge3 on3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 saam1 si1 wui2 sam2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件这么严重的案子，一定要三司会审才行。
examples.english_sentence: This case is so serious that it definitely requires a joint trial by the three high judicial organs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代啲皇帝好少會用到三司會審呢個制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 di1 wong4 dai3 hou2 siu2 wui5 jung6 dou3 saam1 si1 wui2 sam2 ni1 go3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的皇帝很少会用到三司会审这个制度。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient emperors rarely used the joint trial system.

english_meaning: concrete
explanation_mandarin: 一种建筑材料，由水泥、沙子和碎石混合而成。
explanation_english: A construction material made of cement, sand, and gravel mixed together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓要用好多三合土㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau4 jiu3 yung6 hou2 do1 saam1 hap6 tou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖楼要用很多水泥的。
examples.english_sentence: Building a house requires a lot of concrete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園嘅石凳係用三合土整嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园的石凳是用混凝土做的。
examples.english_sentence: The stone benches in this garden are made of concrete.

english_meaning: Triad (Chinese organized crime)
explanation_mandarin: 指华人黑社会组织。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese organized crime societies, known for their ritualistic initiations and hierarchical structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢撈緊三合會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 lou1 gan2 saam1 hap6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他混黑社会。
examples.english_sentence: They say he's involved with the Triads.

mandarin_meaning: 滋味; 感受; 情况
english_meaning: Taste; feeling; situation; what it's like
explanation_mandarin: 指某种感觉、滋味或情况。也可指某种状态或境地。
explanation_english: Refers to a particular feeling, taste, or situation. It can also refer to a certain state or predicament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試吓先啦，咪知咩三味囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 sin1 laa1, mai6 zi1 me1 saam1 mei6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先试一下吧，不就知道是什么滋味了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Try it first, then you'll know what it's like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢份工嘅三味真係唔好受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 saam1 mei6 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这份工作的感觉真是不好受。
examples.english_sentence: The feeling of doing this job is really unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔讀書嘅三味，你第日就會知㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 duk6 syu1 ge3 saam1 mei6, nei5 dai6 jat6 zau6 wui5 zi1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不读书的滋味，你以后就会知道的。
examples.english_sentence: You'll know what it's like not to study in the future.

english_meaning: shamisen (a three-stringed traditional Japanese musical instrument)
explanation_mandarin: 日本传统乐器，一种三弦乐器，通常用拨子演奏。
explanation_english: A three-stringed traditional Japanese musical instrument, typically played with a plectrum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥好鍾意聽人彈三味線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 jan4 taan4 saam1 mei6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥很喜欢听人弹三味线。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother really likes listening to people play the shamisen.

english_meaning: not knowing someone at all; totally unfamiliar
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全不认识某人，一点都不熟悉。通常指双方没有任何关联或交集。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where you don't know someone at all, completely unfamiliar with them. It usually implies there's no connection or interaction between the two parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢三唔識七，點會幫佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 saam1 m4 sik1 cat1, dim2 wui5 bong1 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他完全不认识，怎么会帮他呢？
examples.english_sentence: I don't know him at all, how could I help him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你三唔識七就問人借錢，人哋睬你都傻啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 saam1 m4 sik1 cat1 zau6 man6 jan4 ze3 cin2, jan4 dei6 caai2 nei5 dou1 so4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和别人完全不认识就问人借钱，别人理你才怪。
examples.english_sentence: Asking to borrow money from someone you don't know at all? They would be stupid to even acknowledge you.

english_meaning: Three Kingdoms (historical period)
explanation_mandarin: 中国历史上的一个时期，指公元220年至280年间魏、蜀、吴三个国家鼎立的时期。
explanation_english: The Three Kingdoms is a period in Chinese history (220–280 AD) when China was divided into three states: Wei, Shu, and Wu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意睇關於三國嘅故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 gwaan1 jyu1 saam1 gwok3 ge3 gu3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢看关于三国的故事情节。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I really liked reading stories about the Three Kingdoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好熟悉三國歷史，可以講成個故仔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 suk6 sik1 saam1 gwok3 lik6 si2, ho2 ji5 gong2 sing4 go3 gu3 zai2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对三国历史很熟悉，可以讲出整个故事。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with the history of the Three Kingdoms and can tell the whole story.

english_meaning: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
explanation_mandarin: 中国古典四大名著之一，描写了从东汉末年到西晋初年近百年的历史故事。
explanation_english: One of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. It depicts the historical events from the late Eastern Han dynasty to the early Western Jin dynasty, spanning nearly a century.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，阿爺成日講三國演義嘅故仔俾我哋聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 gong2 saam1 gwok3 jin2 ji6 ge3 gu3 zai2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，爷爷经常讲三国演义的故事给我们听。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my grandfather often told us stories from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三國演義入面我最鍾意嘅角色係趙雲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 gwok3 jin2 ji6 jap6 min6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 gok3 sik1 hai6 ziu6 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在三国演义里我最喜欢的角色是赵云。
examples.english_sentence: My favorite character in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms is Zhao Yun.

english_meaning: bust, waist, and hips (measurements of a woman's body)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的胸围、腰围和臀围的尺寸。
explanation_english: Refers to the measurements of a woman's bust, waist, and hips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅三圍比例好好，好鬼吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 saam1 wai4 bei2 lai6 hou2 hou2, hou2 gwai2 kap1 yan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的三围比例很好，非常吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: Her bust, waist, and hip proportions are very good; she is very attractive.

mandarin_meaning: 三件大事; 重要的事情
english_meaning: Three big things; Three major events; Important matters
explanation_mandarin: 通常指三件重要的事情或者三个显著的方面。
explanation_english: Typically refers to three important things or three significant aspects. Can refer to recent happenings or things to be considered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今年有三大搞作，你要留意啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 jau5 saam1 daai6 gaau2 zok3, nei5 jiu3 lau4 ji3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年有三个大项目，你要留意啊。
examples.english_sentence: The company has three major projects this year, you need to pay attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生三大樂事：瞓到自然醒，數錢數到手軟，有人錫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 saam1 daai6 lok6 si6: fan3 dou3 zi6 jin1 seng2, sou2 cin2 sou2 dou3 sau2 jyun5, jau5 jan4 sek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生三大乐事：睡到自然醒，数钱数到手软，有人疼。
examples.english_sentence: The three great pleasures in life: waking up naturally, counting money until your hands are sore, and having someone care for you.

english_meaning: Plywood
explanation_mandarin: 用奇数层薄木片胶合制成的板材。每相邻两层木片的纹理方向互相垂直。常用于家具、建筑等。
explanation_english: A sheet material manufactured from thin layers or 'plies' of wood veneer that are glued together with adjacent layers having their wood grain rotated up to 90 degrees to one another. It is commonly used in furniture and construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用三夾板做咗個櫃。
