examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yung6 saam1 gaap3 baan2 zou6 zo2 go3 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用胶合板做了一个柜子。
examples.english_sentence: We made a cabinet using plywood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張枱嘅檯面係用三夾板整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 ge3 toi2 min6 hai6 yung6 saam1 gaap3 baan2 zeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子的桌面是用胶合板做的。
examples.english_sentence: The tabletop of this table is made of plywood.

mandarin_meaning: 第三者; 情妇; 小三
english_meaning: mistress; third party in a relationship; (derogatory) concubine
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚男子在妻子之外所拥有的第三者，通常带有贬义。特指在妻子之外，公开或秘密长期保持关系的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who has a relationship with a married man, typically in addition to his wife. It carries a derogatory connotation and specifically refers to a woman who maintains a long-term relationship with the man, either openly or secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人踢爆咗養咗個三奶，搞到家嘈屋閉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 zo2 joeng5 zo2 go3 saam1 naai5, gaau2 dou3 gaa1 cou4 uk1 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭发养了情妇，搞得家里鸡犬不宁。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for having a mistress, causing chaos in his family.

english_meaning: to have many wives and concubines; polygamy
explanation_mandarin: 形容男人有很多妻子和妾侍。在古代社会，有权有势的男人可以娶多个妻子和妾侍。
explanation_english: Describes a man having many wives and concubines. In ancient society, powerful and wealthy men could have multiple wives and concubines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅皇帝真係可以三妻四妾㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 wong4 dai3 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 saam1 cai1 sei3 cip3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时的皇帝真的可以妻妾成群啊。
examples.english_sentence: The emperors in the old days really could have many wives and concubines.

english_meaning: gossipy women; busybodies; matchmakers and fortune-tellers
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指从事不正当职业的妇女。也比喻爱搬弄是非的女人。
explanation_english: Refers to women engaged in disreputable professions in the past. It also refers to women who like to gossip and stir up trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理啲三姑六婆講乜嘢，做好你自己就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 di1 saam1 gu1 luk6 po4 gong2 mat1 je5, zou6 hou2 nei5 zi6 gei2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要理会那些三姑六婆说什么，做好你自己就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to what those gossipy women say, just be yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋班三姑六婆成日喺度講人是非，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baan1 saam1 gu1 luk6 po4 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 jan4 si6 fei1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们那群三姑六婆整天在那里说人坏话，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: That group of gossipy women are always talking behind people's backs, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: Three Character Classic; a traditional Chinese primer for children, often used derogatorily to refer to simplistic or overly repetitive advice.
explanation_mandarin: 《三字经》是中国古代蒙学课本，内容以三字一句的形式编写，易于诵读和记忆。在口语中，有时用来比喻简单、重复、说教式的道理或话语，带有贬义。
explanation_english: "Three Character Classic" is a traditional Chinese primer for children, written in three-character phrases, easy to recite and remember. In colloquial speech, it is sometimes used to metaphorically refer to simple, repetitive, and didactic principles or words, often with a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日講埋啲三字經啦，我聽都聽到厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 saam1 zi6 ging1 laa1, ngo5 ting1 dou1 ting1 dou3 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是说那些老生常谈的道理，我听都听腻了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking about those same old clichés, I'm tired of hearing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好似背緊三字經咁，悶死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 ci5 bui6 gan2 saam1 zi6 ging1 gam2, mun6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话好像在背三字经一样，无聊死了。
examples.english_sentence: He talks like he's reciting the Three Character Classic, it's so boring.

jyutping: saam1 cyun3 bat1 laan6 zi1 sit3
english_meaning: silver tongue, persuasive eloquence, an eloquent and persuasive tongue
explanation_mandarin: 形容口才很好，很会说话，能把死的说成活的。
explanation_english: Describes someone with a very eloquent and persuasive tongue, able to argue convincingly and turn a situation to their advantage through skillful speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條三寸不爛之舌，真係死都俾佢講翻生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 saam1 cyun3 bat1 laan6 zi1 sit3, zan1 hai6 sei2 dou1 bei2 keoi5 gong2 faan1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那三寸不烂之舌，真是死的都能被他说活了。
examples.english_sentence: His silver tongue is so persuasive, he could literally talk the dead back to life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住佢條三寸不爛之舌，成功sell咗呢單生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 keoi5 tiu4 saam1 cyun3 bat1 laan6 zi1 sit3, sing4 gung1 sell zo2 ni1 daan1 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠着他的三寸不烂之舌，成功地推销了这笔生意。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully sold this deal thanks to his persuasive tongue.

english_meaning: short person; shorty
explanation_mandarin: 形容身材矮小的人，多含贬义或调侃。
explanation_english: A derogatory or playful term to describe a person of short stature. Literally means "three-inch nail".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇佢係三寸釘，佢打籃球好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 keoi5 hai6 saam1 cyun3 ding1, keoi5 daa2 laam4 kau4 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他个子矮，他打篮球很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him just because he's short, he's really good at playing basketball.

english_meaning: angular; having many sharp edges and corners; eccentric; difficult to get along with; prickly personality
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体有很多尖锐的角；比喻人的性格怪僻，难以相处。
explanation_english: Describes an object with many sharp edges and corners. Figuratively, it describes a person's personality as eccentric, difficult to get along with, or prickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張檯啲邊位三尖八角，小心撞親呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 di1 bin1 wai2 saam1 zim1 baat3 gok3, siu2 sam1 zong6 can1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子的边缘有很多尖角，小心撞到！
examples.english_sentence: The edges of this table are sharp and angular, be careful not to bump into them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好三尖八角，冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 saam1 zim1 baat3 gok3, mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人性格很古怪，没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very prickly personality and doesn't have many friends.

english_meaning: Three Gorges
explanation_mandarin: 指长江上的三峡：瞿塘峡、巫峡、西陵峡。
explanation_english: Refers to the Three Gorges on the Yangtze River: Qutang Gorge, Wu Gorge, and Xiling Gorge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃緊下年去三峽旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 gan2 haa6 nin4 heoi3 saam1 haap6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在计划明年去三峡旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to travel to the Three Gorges next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三峽大壩對環境影響好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 haap6 daai6 baa3 deoi3 waan4 ging2 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 三峡大坝对环境影响很大。
examples.english_sentence: The Three Gorges Dam has a big impact on the environment.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻胆小怕事，懦弱的人
english_meaning: To be timid, cowardly; a person who is easily scared or worried.
explanation_mandarin: 源于盖三条被子都觉得冷，比喻人胆小怕事，非常懦弱。
explanation_english: The idiom comes from the idea of someone feeling cold even when covered with three blankets. It is used to describe someone who is timid, easily scared, and lacks courage. It is often used to describe a person who overreacts to minor issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係三幅被，行夜路都驚驚地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 saam1 fuk1 pei5, haang4 je6 lou6 dou1 geng1 geng1 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个胆小鬼，走夜路都怕怕的。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a coward, he's even scared to walk at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁三幅被啦，有咩好驚啫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 saam1 fuk1 pei5 laa1, jau5 me1 hou2 geng1 ze1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么胆小了，有什么好怕的？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a scaredy-cat, what's there to be afraid of?

cantonese: 三年唔發市，發市當三年
jyutping: saam1 nin4 m4 faat3 si5, faat3 si5 dong3 saam1 nin4
mandarin_meaning: 三年不开张，开张吃三年
english_meaning: After a long period of no business, one successful transaction makes up for the previous three years.
explanation_mandarin: 形容长时间生意不好，一旦做成一笔生意，就能赚取相当于过去三年的利润。也比喻长时间没有进展，一旦取得进展，就会有很大的收获。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone has been experiencing a long period of no business or progress. A single successful transaction or achievement is so significant that it compensates for the lack of activity in the previous three years. It can also mean that a long period of inactivity is followed by a significant breakthrough with substantial rewards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭之前一直都冇生意，不過最近接到個大單，真係三年唔發市，發市當三年啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 zi1 cin4 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 saang1 ji3, bat1 gwo3 zeoi3 gan6 zip3 dou2 go3 daai6 daan1, zan1 hai6 saam1 nin4 m4 faat3 si5, faat3 si5 dong3 saam1 nin4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店之前一直没有生意，不过最近接到了一个大单，真是三年不开张，开张吃三年啊！
examples.english_sentence: This shop had no business before, but recently it got a big order, it's really like 'after a long period of no business, one successful transaction makes up for the previous three years'!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司研究咗咁耐，終於研發出新產品，可以話係三年唔發市，發市當三年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 jin4 gau3 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 jin4 faat3 ceot1 san1 caan2 pan2, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 saam1 nin4 m4 faat3 si5, faat3 si5 dong3 saam1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司研究了这么久，终于研发出新产品，可以说是三年不开张，开张吃三年。
examples.english_sentence: Their company researched for so long, and finally developed a new product. You could say it's 'after a long period of no business, one successful transaction makes up for the previous three years'.

jyutping: saam1 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6
english_meaning: Once in a blue moon; extremely rare
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事情非常罕见，非常难得发生。闰月在历法上比较少见，三年才有可能碰到一次。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely rare and hardly ever happens. Leap months in the lunar calendar are relatively uncommon; they might occur only once every three years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孤寒，請食飯真係三年唔逢一潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4, ceng2 sik6 faan6 zan1 hai6 saam1 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么吝啬，请吃饭真是难得一遇。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy that him treating someone to a meal is truly a once-in-a-blue-moon occurrence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到佢肯主動幫人，真係三年唔逢一潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 hang2 zyu2 dung6 bong1 jan4, zan1 hai6 saam1 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到他肯主动帮助别人，真是太难得了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him willingly help others is a very rare thing indeed.

synonyms: 千載難逢 (chin1 zoi2 naan4 fung4)

english_meaning: To have two children within three years; a blessing for quickly conceiving multiple children.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子生育能力强，在三年之内生育两个孩子。通常用于祝福新婚夫妇，祝愿他们早生贵子。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a woman's strong fertility, indicating she has given birth to two children within three years. It's typically used to bless newly married couples, wishing them to have children soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿玲結婚冇耐就話有咗，大家都話佢好快會三年抱倆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ling4 git3 fan1 mou5 noi6 zau6 waa6 jau5 zo2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hou2 faai3 wui5 saam1 nin4 pou5 loeng5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿玲结婚没多久就说怀孕了，大家都说她很快就会三年抱两个了。
examples.english_sentence: Ling got married not long ago and already announced her pregnancy; everyone says she'll probably have two children within three years.

english_meaning: To have two children within three years (of marriage/starting a family); to have children in quick succession.
explanation_mandarin: 形容生育频繁，多用于赞扬妻子生育能力强，或者夫妻生育速度快。
explanation_english: Describes a couple having two children within a relatively short period, usually within three years. It is often used to praise the wife's fertility or the couple's rapid childbearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚冇耐就三年抱兩，真係好快手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 mou5 noi6 zau6 saam1 nin4 pou5 loeng5, zan1 hai6 hou2 faai3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚没多久就三年生两个孩子，真是很快。
examples.english_sentence: They had two children within three years of marriage, that's really fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嫂真係好叻女，嫁咗過嚟三年抱兩，屋企人都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 so2 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 neoi2, gaa3 zo2 gwo3 lai4 saam1 nin4 pou5 loeng5, uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫂子真的很能干，嫁过来三年就生了两个孩子，家里人都很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: My sister-in-law is really capable, she had two children within three years of marrying into the family, and everyone at home is very happy.

jyutping: saam1 nin4 ling4 baat3 go3 jyut6
english_meaning: Three years and eight months; specifically referring to the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong during World War II.
explanation_mandarin: 指香港日治时期，从1941年12月25日香港沦陷到1945年8月15日日本投降的这段时期。
explanation_english: Refers to the period of the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong during World War II, from December 25, 1941, when Hong Kong fell, to August 15, 1945, when Japan surrendered. It is often used to represent a period of hardship and suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三年零八個月嘅日子好難捱，好多人都冇嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 nin4 ling4 baat3 go3 jyut6 ge3 jat6 zi2 hou2 naan4 ngaai4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 mou5 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 三年零八个月的日子很难熬，很多人都没有东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: The three years and eight months were hard to endure; many people had nothing to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老一輩嘅人成日講起三年零八個月嘅經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jat1 bui3 ge3 jan4 seng4 jat6 gong2 hei2 saam1 nin4 ling4 baat3 go3 jyut6 ge3 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老一辈的人经常提起三年零八个月的经历。
examples.english_sentence: The older generation often talk about their experiences during the three years and eight months.

english_meaning: a few; several; three or four
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定的少量，大约三到五个。
explanation_english: Indicates an indefinite small quantity, approximately three to five.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗三幾本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 saam1 gei2 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了三五本书。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a few books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識得三幾個人喺嗰度做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 dak1 saam1 gei2 go3 jan4 hai2 go2 dou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认识三五个人在那里工作。
examples.english_sentence: I know a few people who work there.

english_meaning: three or four; a few
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概三四个，不确定的数量。
explanation_english: Indicates approximately three or four of something. It suggests a small, indefinite quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有三幾個蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 jau5 saam1 gei2 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有三四个苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I have three or four apples at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得三幾個朋友咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 saam1 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只有三四个朋友而已。
examples.english_sentence: He only has three or four friends.

english_meaning: Same old routine; the same old tricks; to use the same methods over and over again
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做事总是用老一套的方法，没有新意或改变。
explanation_english: A metaphor for using the same old methods or routines repeatedly, lacking creativity or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢永遠都係三度板斧，睇到都悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 saam1 dou6 baan2 fu2, tai2 dou3 dou1 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事永远都是老一套，看着都觉得闷。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things the same old way; it's boring to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以下下都用三度板斧嘅，要諗下新方法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 haa6 haa6 dou1 jung6 saam1 dou6 baan2 fu2 ge3, jiu3 nam2 haa5 san1 fong1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能每次都用老办法，要想想新的方法了。
examples.english_sentence: You can't keep using the same old tricks every time; you need to think of new methods.

english_meaning: The three obediences and four virtues (traditional virtues imposed on women in ancient China)
explanation_mandarin: 封建礼教束缚妇女的道德标准，指妇女要服从父亲、丈夫、儿子，具备妇德、妇言、妇容、妇功四种德行。
explanation_english: A set of traditional moral principles imposed on women in ancient China. "Three obediences" refer to a woman's obedience to her father before marriage, her husband during marriage, and her son in widowhood. "Four virtues" refer to morality, proper speech, modest manner, and diligent work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲女仔邊會信咩三從四德㗎，佢哋要獨立自主啊嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 neoi5 zai2 bin1 wui seon3 me1 saam1 cung4 sei3 dak1 gaa3, keoi5 dei6 jiu3 duk6 laap6 zi6 zyu2 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的女孩子谁会相信什么三从四德啊，她们要独立自主啊。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, no girls would believe in these three obediences and four virtues, they want to be independent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再用舊嗰套三從四德嚟衡量現代女性啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 yung6 gau6 go2 tou3 saam1 cung4 sei3 dak1 lai4 hang4 loeng4 hiun3 doi6 neoi5 sing3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再用旧的那套三从四德来衡量现代女性了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use that old set of the three obediences and four virtues to judge modern women anymore.

english_meaning: indecisive, fickle, half-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 形容犹豫不决，意志不坚定。常常用于形容在选择时无法下定决心，一会儿想这样做，一会儿又想那样做。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is indecisive, fickle, or has a half-hearted attitude. Often used to describe someone who can't make up their mind when making a choice, changing their mind frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁三心兩意啦，快啲決定去唔去好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 sam1 loeng5 ji3 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么三心二意了，快点决定去不去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so indecisive, make up your mind quickly whether you want to go or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀女朋友成日都三心兩意，所以到而家都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 sam1 loeng5 ji3, so2 ji5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他选女朋友总是三心二意的，所以到现在都没有。
examples.english_sentence: He is always indecisive when choosing a girlfriend, so he still doesn't have one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢唔可以咁三心兩意，專心啲先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 saam1 sam1 loeng5 ji3, zyun1 sam1 di1 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事不可以这么三心二意，专心一点才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be so half-hearted when doing things; you need to be focused to succeed.

english_meaning: think thrice; think carefully; look before you leap
explanation_mandarin: 指反复思考，慎重考虑后再行动。
explanation_english: To think carefully and thoroughly before acting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做呢個決定之前，最好三思吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4, zeoi3 hou2 saam1 si1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做这个决定之前，最好三思一下。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better think twice before making this decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓係人生大事，要三思而後行啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 hai6 jan4 sang1 daai6 si6, jiu3 saam1 si1 ji4 hau6 hang4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房是人生大事，要三思而后行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Buying a house is a major life event, you have to think carefully before acting.

synonyms: 深思熟慮 (sam1 si1 suk6 leoi6)

english_meaning: Think thrice before you act; Look before you leap
explanation_mandarin: 指经过多次考虑再行动，形容非常谨慎。
explanation_english: It means to think carefully and thoroughly before taking action, emphasizing the importance of prudence and caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做決定之前，你都係三思而後行啦，唔好咁衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4, nei5 dou1 hai6 saam1 si1 ji4 hau6 hang4 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做决定之前，你还是三思而后行吧，不要那么冲动。
examples.english_sentence: Before making a decision, you should think thrice before you act, don't be so impulsive.

english_meaning: Think thrice before you act; Look before you leap; Think carefully before acting.
explanation_mandarin: 指做事情之前要多次思考，不要冲动。
explanation_english: Means to think carefully and thoroughly before taking action, avoiding impulsiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做任何決定之前都要三思而行，唔好咁衝動啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jam6 ho4 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 dou1 jiu3 saam1 si1 ji4 hang4, m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做任何决定之前都要三思而后行，不要这么冲动啊。
examples.english_sentence: Think carefully before making any decisions, don't be so impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商業上，三思而行好重要，唔係好容易蝕錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 jip6 soeng6, saam1 si1 ji4 hang4 hou2 cung5 jiu3, m4 hai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 sit6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商业上，三思而后行很重要，不然很容易亏钱的。
examples.english_sentence: In business, it's important to think before you act, otherwise it's easy to lose money.

mandarin_meaning: 人有三急 (rén yǒu sān jí)
english_meaning: urgent need to go to the toilet (pee, poop, vomit)
explanation_mandarin: 指人有三种紧急的生理需求：尿急、便急、呕吐。多用于口语，表示需要尽快解决生理需求。
explanation_english: Refers to the three urgent physiological needs a person may have: the urge to urinate, defecate, or vomit. Commonly used in colloquial Cantonese to indicate a need to quickly address these bodily needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我突然間有三急，要即刻去廁所！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 jau5 saam1 gap1, jiu3 zik1 hak1 heoi3 coi3 so2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我突然间有三急，要立刻去厕所！
examples.english_sentence: I suddenly have an urgent need to go to the toilet, I need to go immediately!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有三急，走咗入去洗手間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 saam1 gap1, zau2 zo2 jap6 heoi3 sai2 sau2 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他有三急，走进了洗手间。
examples.english_sentence: He said he had an urgent need and went into the restroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗咁多嘢，梗係有三急啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, gang2 hai6 jau5 saam1 gap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了那么多东西，当然会有三急啦。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking so much, of course you'd have to go.

mandarin_meaning: 手忙脚乱, 笨手笨脚
english_meaning: clumsy, awkward, fumbling, all thumbs
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作笨拙，手脚不灵活。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, awkward, and uncoordinated, especially when handling objects or performing tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁三手兩腳啦，會整爛嘢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 sau2 loeng5 goek3 laa1, wui5 zing2 laan6 je5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨手笨脚的，会弄坏东西的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you'll break something!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整嘢成日都三手兩腳，真係睇見都眼冤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 sau2 loeng5 goek3, zan1 hai6 tai2 gin3 dou1 ngaan5 jyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事情总是笨手笨脚的，真是看着都烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always clumsy when he's doing things, it's really annoying to watch.

english_meaning: Third-hand smoke
explanation_mandarin: 指吸烟后残留在衣物、墙壁、家具等表面的烟草残留物，即使烟雾已经散去，这些残留物仍然会对健康产生危害。
explanation_english: Third-hand smoke refers to residual nicotine and other chemicals left on indoor surfaces by tobacco smoke. This residue is left behind on surfaces like walls, furniture, and clothing even after the smoke has cleared, and it can pose health risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算你喺出面食煙，啲三手煙都會黏喺你啲衫度，帶返屋企影響到屋企人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 nei5 hai2 ceot1 min6 sik6 jin1, di1 saam1 sau2 jin1 dou1 wui5 nim1 hai2 nei5 di1 saam1 dou6, daai3 faan1 uk1 kei2 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使你在外面抽烟，三手烟也会附着在你的衣服上，带回家影响到家人。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you smoke outside, the third-hand smoke will stick to your clothes and affect your family when you bring it back home.

english_meaning: braid (hair)
explanation_mandarin: 一种将头发分成三股编织起来的发型，也叫麻花辫。
explanation_english: A hairstyle made by braiding hair into three strands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扎住條三手辮，好可愛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaat3 zyu6 tiu4 saam1 sau2 bin1, hou2 ho2 oi3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她扎着麻花辫，好可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a braid; she's so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日俾阿媽紮三手辮返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 bei2 aa3 maa1 zaat3 saam1 sau2 bin1 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候总是被妈妈扎麻花辫上学。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom would always braid my hair before school.

english_meaning: to stir quickly and carelessly; to do something quickly and carelessly; in a few quick motions
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作快速而粗略，不认真仔细。
explanation_english: Describes a quick and careless action, lacking thoroughness and attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三扒兩撥就將啲餸炒好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 paa1 loeng5 but6 zau6 zoeng1 di1 sung3 caau2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三两下就把菜炒好了。
examples.english_sentence: He stirred the dish a few times and it was ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好三扒兩撥咁做嘢，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saam1 paa1 loeng5 but6 gam3 zou6 je5, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要草率地做事，要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush things; be careful.

english_meaning: to make excuses, to push back on something, to be evasive
explanation_mandarin: 形容用各种借口推卸责任或拒绝承担任务。
explanation_english: Describes using various excuses to shirk responsibility or refuse to undertake a task.  It emphasizes the repeated and various attempts to avoid doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叫佢幫手搬嘢啫，佢就三推四搪，話自己唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: giu3 keoi5 bong1 sau2 bun1 je5 ze1, keoi5 zau6 saam1 teoi1 sei3 tong4, waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让他帮忙搬东西而已，他就推三阻四，说自己没空。
examples.english_sentence: Just asked him to help move things, but he made all sorts of excuses and said he was busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再三推四搪喇，份報告趕住要交㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 saam1 teoi1 sei3 tong4 laa3, fan6 bou3 gou3 gon2 zyu6 jiu3 gaau1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再推三阻四了，这份报告赶着要交的！
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses, the report needs to be submitted urgently!

english_meaning: To offer incense to the deceased; to be close to death; in deep trouble.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指祭拜死者所用的三根香，也引申为即将死亡或遇到非常严重的麻烦。
explanation_english: Literally means 'three sticks of incense,' which are typically offered to the deceased. Figuratively, it refers to being close to death or being in deep trouble, almost like being 'finished'. It often implies that someone is in a hopeless situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次真係攞咗三支香，乜都冇曬喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 lo2 zo2 saam1 zi1 hoeng1, mat1 dou1 mou5 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次真的完蛋了，什么都没了。
examples.english_sentence: He's really done for this time. He's lost everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺年紀咁大，真係攞咗三支香咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 nin4 gei2 gam3 daai6, zan1 hai6 lo2 zo2 saam1 zi1 hoeng1 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷年纪这么大了，真的是快不行了。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa is so old, he's practically on his last legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔努力，考試攞三支香就唔好怪我冇提醒你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 nou5 lik6, haau2 si3 lo2 saam1 zi1 hoeng1 zau6 m4 hou2 gwaai3 ngo5 mou5 tai4 sing2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不努力，考试完蛋了就不要怪我没有提醒你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, you're going to fail the exam, and don't blame me for not warning you.

english_meaning: People from all walks of life; people of various social classes; a motley crew.
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上各种行业和各种身份的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people from various professions and social statuses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間賭場入面，乜嘢三敎九流嘅人都見得到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 dou2 coeng4 jap6 min6, mat1 je5 saam1 gaau3 gau2 lau4 ge3 jan4 dou1 gin3 dak1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家赌场里面，什么三教九流的人都能见到。
examples.english_sentence: In that casino, you can see people from all walks of life.

english_meaning: people from all walks of life; people of different occupations and social statuses; a mixed bag of people
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上各种行业和各种身份的人。最初指宗教流派和学术流派，后来泛指各种行业的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people from all walks of life, different occupations and social statuses. Originally referring to religious and academic schools, it later broadly refers to people of various occupations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方乜人都有，真係三教九流㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 mat1 jan4 dou1 jau5, zan1 hai6 saam1 gaau3 gau2 lau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方什么人都有，真是三教九流的。
examples.english_sentence: This place has all sorts of people, it's truly a mixed bag of people.

english_meaning: sandwich
explanation_mandarin: 一种用两片或多片面包夹肉、蔬菜等食物的食品。
explanation_english: A food typically consisting of fillings, such as meat, cheese or vegetables, placed on or between slices of bread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日早餐食咗份三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou2 caan1 sik6 zo2 fan6 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早餐吃了一份三明治。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a sandwich for breakfast today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲三文治好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 saam1 man4 zi6 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的三明治很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The sandwiches at this restaurant are very delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 鲑鱼, 三文鱼 (sān wén yú)
english_meaning: Salmon
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的食用鱼类，肉质呈橙红色，富含营养。
explanation_english: A common type of edible fish with orange-pink flesh, rich in nutrients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食啲三文魚刺身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 di1 saam1 man4 jyu2 ci3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一些三文鱼刺身。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat some salmon sashimi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅三文魚好新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 saam1 man4 jyu2 hou2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的三文鱼很新鲜。
examples.english_sentence: The salmon in this restaurant is very fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 三项全能; 多重身份
english_meaning: Triple threat; Someone with skills in three areas; Multiple roles/identities.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人在三个不同方面都表现出色，或者一个人身兼数职，扮演多种角色。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who excels in three different areas or someone who holds multiple positions or plays multiple roles. It is used to describe a person who possesses a diverse range of skills and talents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又識唱歌又識跳舞又識演戲，真係三料藝人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 sik1 cheung3 go1 jau6 sik1 tiu3 mou5 jau6 sik1 yin2 hei3, jan1 hai6 saam1 liu2 ngai6 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她既会唱歌，又会跳舞，又会演戏，真是个三料艺人。
examples.english_sentence: She can sing, dance, and act. She's truly a triple-threat performer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司又做經理，又做會計，又做埋人事，真係三料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jau6 zou6 ging1 lei5, jau6 zou6 wui6 gai3, jau6 zou6 maai4 yan4 si6, jan1 hai6 saam1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司既当经理，又当会计，又兼任人事，真是身兼多职。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a manager, accountant, and HR personnel in the company; he really wears multiple hats.

jyutping: saam1 jat6 m4 maai4 loeng5 jat6
english_meaning: every few days; frequently; often
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发生的频率很高，几乎每隔几天就发生一次。
explanation_english: Describes something happening frequently, almost every few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三日唔埋兩日都唔返工，老闆好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 jat6 m4 maai4 loeng5 jat6 dou1 m4 faan1 gung1, lou5 baan2 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三天两头都不来上班，老板很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't come to work every few days, the boss is very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強三日唔埋兩日就話唔舒服，唔知係咪扮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 saam1 jat6 m4 maai4 loeng5 jat6 zau6 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, m4 zi1 hai6 m4 hai6 baan6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强三天两头就说不舒服，不知道是不是装的。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung says he's not feeling well every few days, I don't know if he's pretending.

english_meaning: sandwich
explanation_mandarin: 一种用两片或多片面包夹馅料做成的食物。
explanation_english: A food consisting of two or more slices of bread with a filling between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日早餐食咗份火腿三明治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou2 caan1 sik6 zo2 fan6 fo2 tui2 saam1 ming4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早餐吃了一份火腿三明治。
examples.english_sentence: I had a ham sandwich for breakfast today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間咖啡店啲三明治好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 di1 saam1 ming4 zi6 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家咖啡店的三明治很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The sandwiches at that cafe are very famous.

english_meaning: late at night; the third watch of the night (11 pm - 1 am)
explanation_mandarin: 古代把夜晚分为五更，三更指夜里11点到凌晨1点。
explanation_english: In ancient times, the night was divided into five 'geng' (watches). 'San geng' refers to the third watch of the night, which is from 11 pm to 1 am.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三更半夜唔好周圍走啦，危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 gaang1 bun3 je2 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2 laa1, ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 半夜三更的，不要到处乱走，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wander around in the middle of the night, it's dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做到三更半夜先瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zou6 dou3 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je2 sin1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是工作到半夜三更才睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: He always works until late at night before going to sleep.

english_meaning: in the dead of night; in the middle of the night; very late at night
explanation_mandarin: 指深夜，一般指凌晨时分。
explanation_english: Refers to the middle of the night, usually around midnight or early morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三更半夜，唔好嘈住人瞓覺啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6, m4 hou2 cou4 zyu6 jan4 fan3 gaau3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 半夜三更，不要吵别人睡觉了！
examples.english_sentence: In the middle of the night, don't disturb people's sleep!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日三更半夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是半夜三更才回家。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets home in the dead of night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三更半夜仲打電話嚟，搞乜鬼呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6 zung2 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4, gaau2 mat1 gwai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 半夜三更还打电话来，搞什么鬼啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you calling in the middle of the night? What's going on?

jyutping: saam1 gaang1 kung4 ng5 gaang1 fu3
mandarin_meaning: 一夜暴富; 时来运转
english_meaning: Poor in the third watch (late at night), rich in the fifth watch (early morning); overnight riches; a sudden turn of fortune.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人突然间从贫穷变得富有，比喻时来运转，运气变好。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a sudden turn of fortune from poverty to wealth. It implies that someone's luck has changed drastically, leading to unexpected riches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗隻股票，點知突然間升到爆，真係三更窮五更富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zek3 gu2 piu3, dim2 zi1 dat6 jin4 gaan1 sing1 dou3 baau3, zan1 hai6 saam1 gaang1 kung4 ng5 gaang1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一只股票，没想到突然暴涨，真是三更穷五更富。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a stock, and unexpectedly it skyrocketed. It's really a case of overnight riches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司之前爭啲執笠，點知而家接到個大單，真係三更窮五更富啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zi1 cin4 zaang1 di1 zap1 laap1, dim2 zi1 ji4 gaa1 zip3 dou2 go3 daai6 daan1, zan1 hai6 saam1 gaang1 kung4 ng5 gaang1 fu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司之前差点倒闭，没想到现在接到一个大订单，真是三更穷五更富啊。
examples.english_sentence: This company was almost bankrupt before, but unexpectedly it received a large order. It's really a case of rags to riches!

english_meaning: The three letters and six rituals (of traditional Chinese marriage)
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统婚姻习俗中，男方迎娶女方时需要准备的文书和礼仪。三书指聘书、礼书、迎书；六礼指纳采、问名、纳吉、纳征、请期、亲迎。
explanation_english: The three letters and six rituals are the traditional Chinese wedding customs. The three letters are the betrothal letter, gift letter, and wedding letter. The six rituals are proposal, name inquiry, auspiciousness confirmation, presentation of betrothal gifts, selection of wedding date, and welcoming the bride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前結婚好注重三書六禮，但係而家好多都簡化咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 git3 fan1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 saam1 syu1 luk6 lai5, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 dou1 gaan2 faa3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前结婚很注重三书六礼，但是现在很多都简化了。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, weddings paid great attention to the three letters and six rituals, but nowadays many have been simplified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企好傳統，結婚一定要跟足三書六禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hou2 cyun4 tung2, git3 fan1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gan1 zuk1 saam1 syu1 luk6 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家很传统，结婚一定要按照三书六礼来。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very traditional, so they must follow the three letters and six rituals for their wedding.

english_meaning: March
explanation_mandarin: 一年中的第三个月份。
explanation_english: The third month of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住三月去日本睇櫻花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 saam1 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 tai2 ying1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算三月去日本看樱花。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to go to Japan in March to see the cherry blossoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅三月天氣唔太穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 saam1 jyut6 tin1 hei3 m4 taai3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的三月天气不太稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The weather in March this year is not very stable.

mandarin_meaning: 三两天；不经常；断断续续
english_meaning: Every few days; intermittently; off and on; sporadically; not regularly
explanation_mandarin: 指不经常，断断续续地做某事。形容频率不高，时间间隔短。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something infrequently or intermittently. Describes a low frequency with short time intervals. It implies a lack of consistency or regularity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返工三朝兩日就請假，好難升職嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 gung1 saam1 ciu4 loeng5 jat6 zau6 ceng2 gaa3, hou2 naan4 sing1 zik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作三两天就请假，很难升职的。
examples.english_sentence: He takes leave every few days he works, it's hard for him to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我間中會去健身室，三朝兩日咁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaan1 zung1 wui5 heoi3 gin6 san1 sat1, saam1 ciu4 loeng5 jat6 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我偶尔会去健身房，大概三两天去一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: I go to the gym occasionally, maybe every few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三朝兩日都唔交功課，老師好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 ciu4 loeng5 jat6 dou1 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, lou5 si1 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三两天都不交作业，老师很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't hand in his homework every few days, the teacher is very angry.

english_meaning: unreliable, untrustworthy, not serious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不认真，说话不算数，不靠谱。也指不正经，不稳重。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not serious in their work, doesn't keep their word, and is unreliable. Can also refer to someone who is not proper or stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人三板六，講嘢唔可以信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 saam1 baan2 luk6, gong2 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不靠谱，说的话不能相信。
examples.english_sentence: He's an unreliable person; you can't trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁三板啦，做嘢認真啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 baan2 laa1, zou6 je5 jing6 zan1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么不正经了，工作认真点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unserious, be more serious at work.

english_meaning: three axe blows; initial tactics; limited repertoire
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一开始使用的一些有限的手段或招数，用完就没了。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to one's limited repertoire or initial tactics, often used to describe someone who only has a few tricks up their sleeve and quickly runs out of ideas or approaches. It's like someone who only knows how to swing an axe three times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢得嗰三板斧，好快就俾人睇穿晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 dak1 go2 saam1 baan2 fu2, hou2 faai3 zau6 bei2 jan4 tai2 cyun1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事只有三招，很快就被人看穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He only has three tricks when he works, and he's quickly seen through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢得三板斧就睇佢唔起，有時夠用就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 dak1 saam1 baan2 fu2 zau6 tai2 keoi5 m4 hei2, jau5 si4 gau3 jung6 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为他只有三招就看不起他，有时候够用就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him just because he only has three tricks. Sometimes it's enough.

mandarin_meaning: 差劲; 不行; 不可靠
english_meaning: useless; unreliable; no good; bad
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物质量差，能力不足，不可靠。通常用于贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being of poor quality, lacking ability, or unreliable. Usually used in a derogatory sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦真係三柴，成日hang機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 saam1 caai4, seng4 jat6 hang4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑真差劲，总是死机。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is really useless, it freezes all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好三柴，咩都做唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 saam1 caai4, me1 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很不可靠，什么都做不好。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very unreliable person, he can't do anything well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搵佢幫手啊，佢好三柴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2 aa3, keoi5 hou2 saam1 caai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要找他帮忙，他很不可靠的。
examples.english_sentence: You better not ask him for help, he's very unreliable.

mandarin_meaning: 非常糟糕；很差劲；极其糟糕
english_meaning: terrible; awful; extremely bad; hopeless
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或情况非常糟糕，极差，让人感到失望或不满。
explanation_english: Describes something that is terrible, awful, extremely bad, or disappointing. It implies a very low quality or unfavorable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考得三條九，一定俾阿媽鬧死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 haau2 dak1 saam1 tiu4 gau2, jat1 ding6 bei2 aa3 maa1 naau6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考得很糟糕，肯定会被妈妈骂死。
examples.english_sentence: I did terribly in this exam, my mom will definitely scold me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係三條九，下次都唔會再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 saam1 tiu4 gau2, haa6 ci3 dou1 m4 wui5 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真的很糟糕，下次都不会再来了。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is terrible, I won't come again next time.

english_meaning: separation of powers (trias politica)
explanation_mandarin: 指立法、行政、司法三种权力互相独立、互相制衡的政治制度。
explanation_english: Refers to a political system where legislative, executive, and judicial powers are independent and check and balance each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人認為香港應該實行三權分立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 jing6 wai4 hoeng1 gong2 jing1 goi1 sat6 hang4 saam1 kyun4 fan1 lap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人认为香港应该实行三权分立。
examples.english_sentence: Some people believe that Hong Kong should implement the separation of powers.

english_meaning: Three-dimensional (3D); Reality; the real world
explanation_mandarin: 源自日语，指三维空间或现实世界，与二次元（动漫、游戏等虚拟世界）相对。在网络用语中，常用于形容现实中的人物或事物。
explanation_english: Borrowed from Japanese, refers to three-dimensional space or the real world, as opposed to 'two-dimensional' (anime, games, etc., virtual worlds). In online slang, it is often used to describe people or things in reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得二次元嘅嘢好正，但係三次元嘅生活先係最重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ji6 ci4 jyun4 ge3 je5 hou2 zeng3, daan6 hai6 saam1 ci4 jyun4 ge3 sang1 wut6 sin1 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得二次元的东西很棒，但是三次元的生活才是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: I think two-dimensional things are great, but three-dimensional life (real life) is the most important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都掛住打機，好少理三次元嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1, hou2 siu2 lei5 saam1 ci4 jyun4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着打游戏，很少理会现实世界的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is always thinking about playing games and rarely cares about things in the real world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅三次元效果做得好好，好逼真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 saam1 ci4 jyun4 haau6 gwo2 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2, hou2 bik1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的3D效果做得很好，非常逼真。
examples.english_sentence: The 3D effects in this movie are very well done and realistic.

jyutping: saam1 bou6 bat1 ceot1 kwai1 mun4
english_meaning: Never leaving the house; confined to one's own room; very sheltered.
explanation_mandarin: 形容旧时女子深居简出，活动范围很小。多指未婚女子很少出门。
explanation_english: Describes a woman in olden times who rarely left her house, with a very limited range of activity. Often refers to unmarried women who rarely go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽以前好保守，成日都三步不出閨門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 ji5 cin4 hou2 bou2 sau2, seng4 jat6 dou1 saam1 bou6 bat1 ceot1 kwai1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她妈妈以前很保守，整天都大门不出，二门不迈。
examples.english_sentence: Her mother used to be very conservative and never left the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲女仔邊會好似以前咁，三步不出閨門㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 neoi5 zai2 bin1 wui5 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam2, saam1 bou6 bat1 ceot1 kwai1 mun4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的女孩子怎么会像以前那样，大门不出，二门不迈呢？
examples.english_sentence: How could girls nowadays be like those of the past, never leaving the house?

jyutping: saam1 bou6 laap6 maai4 loeng5 bou6
english_meaning: Taking three steps as two; to rush; to hurry
explanation_mandarin: 形容步伐很快，赶时间的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone rushing and hurrying, taking three steps as if they were only two, indicating a rapid pace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試喇，佢三步擸埋兩步噉趕住翻屋企溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si5 laa3, keoi5 saam1 bou6 laap6 maai4 loeng5 bou6 gam2 gon2 zyu6 faan1 uk1 kei2 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要考试了，他急匆匆地赶回家复习功课。
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, he's rushing home to study, taking three steps as two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢三步擸埋兩步，唔知趕去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 saam1 bou6 laap6 maai4 loeng5 bou6, m4 zi1 gon2 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他急匆匆的样子，不知道赶去哪里。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him rushing like that, I don't know where he's hurrying to.

mandarin_meaning: 从小看大；江山易改，本性难移
english_meaning: What's learned in the cradle is carried to the grave; As the twig is bent, so grows the tree; Old habits die hard.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人从小形成的性格或习惯很难改变，会持续到老。
explanation_english: Describes how a person's character or habits formed in their childhood are difficult to change and will likely persist into old age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣已經咁懶，真係三歲定八十，大個咗都唔會勤力得去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 gam3 laan5, zan1 hai6 saam1 seoi3 ding6 baat3 sap6, daai6 go3 zo2 dou1 m4 wui5 kan4 lik6 dak1 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就这么懒，真是从小看大，长大了也不会勤快到哪里去。
examples.english_sentence: He was so lazy when he was little. What's learned in the cradle is carried to the grave. He won't be much more diligent when he grows up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以改變佢，三歲定八十㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 keoi5, saam1 seoi3 ding6 baat3 sap6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着可以改变他，江山易改本性难移。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can change him. Old habits die hard.

mandarin_meaning: 廉价小说; 低俗小说
english_meaning: Cheap novel; pulp fiction
explanation_mandarin: 指内容低俗、情节简单、印刷粗糙的廉价小说。以前香港三毫子可以买到这类小说，故得名。
explanation_english: Refers to cheap novels with vulgar content, simple plots, and poor printing quality. They used to cost three 'hou' (cents) in Hong Kong, hence the name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇啲三毫子小說，唔睇文學名著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 tai2 di1 saam1 hou4 zi2 siu2 syut3, m4 tai2 man4 hok6 ming4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢看那些廉价小说，不看文学名著。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to read those cheap novels, not literary classics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本三毫子小說嘅情節真係好老套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 saam1 hou4 zi2 siu2 syut3 ge3 cing4 zit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本廉价小说的情节真的很老套。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this pulp fiction is really cliché.

synonyms: 地攤小說 (dei6 taan1 siu2 syut3)

mandarin_meaning: 廉价小说, 不入流的小说
english_meaning: cheap novel, pulp fiction, trashy novel
explanation_mandarin: 指内容粗俗、情节简单、价格低廉的小说。通常指不入流的、质量差的小说。
explanation_english: Refers to cheap novels with vulgar content, simple plots, and low prices. It usually refers to novels of low quality and lacking artistic merit; pulp fiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇咁多三毫子小説啦，浪費時間！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 gam3 do1 saam1 hou4 zi2 siu2 syut3 laa1, long6 fai3 si4 gaan3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看那么多廉价小说了，浪费时间！
examples.english_sentence: Don't read so many pulp fictions, it's a waste of time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅嘢全部都係三毫子小説，冇乜深度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 saam1 hou4 zi2 siu2 syut3, mou5 mat1 sam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的东西全部都是廉价小说，没什么深度。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he writes is just pulp fiction, there's not much depth.

english_meaning: Three Principles of the People (Nationalism, Democracy, and People's Livelihood)
explanation_mandarin: 孙中山先生提出的政治纲领，即民族主义、民权主义、民生主义。
explanation_english: The political philosophy developed by Sun Yat-sen as part of a philosophy to make China a free, prosperous, and powerful nation. The three principles are: Nationalism, Democracy, and People's Livelihood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孫中山提倡三民主義嚟建設一個新嘅中國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun1 zung1 saan1 tai4 coeng3 saam1 man4 zyu2 ji6 lai4 gin3 cit3 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 zung1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孙中山提倡三民主义来建设一个新中国。
examples.english_sentence: Sun Yat-sen advocated the Three Principles of the People to build a new China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前讀書嘅時候，對三民主義好有研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 duk6 syu1 ge3 si4 hau6, deoi3 saam1 man4 zyu2 ji6 hou2 jau5 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前读书的时候，对三民主义很有研究。
examples.english_sentence: He used to study the Three Principles of the People a lot when he was studying.

english_meaning: clear; neat; tidy; to get rid of; to settle
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物清楚、干净、利落，或指处理事情完毕。
explanation_english: Describes something as clear, neat, and tidy. Can also mean to clear things up, get rid of something, or settle something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執拾間房執到三清六潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 sap6 gaan1 fong2 zaap1 dou3 saam1 cing1 luk6 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把房间收拾得非常干净。
examples.english_sentence: The room was cleaned until it was spick and span.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞掂咗，咪當三清囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dim6 zo2, mai1 dong3 saam1 cing1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情解决了，就算完事了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that the matter is settled, let's consider it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢哋有瓜葛，一於同佢哋三清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 jau5 gwaa1 got3, jat1 jyu1 tung4 keoi5 dei6 saam1 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他们有任何瓜葛，就和他们断绝关系。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to have anything to do with them, so I'm going to sever ties with them.

english_meaning: Rehash, redo something already done (often negatively connoted)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻重复或再次进行已经做过的事情，通常带有负面含义，表示没有新意或质量下降。
explanation_english: To rehash, redo, or repeat something that has already been done. Often used with a negative connotation implying a lack of originality or a decline in quality. Can also refer to a poorly done remake or revision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情同上一集差唔多，簡直係三炒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 tung4 soeng6 jat1 zaap6 caa1 m4 do1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 saam1 caau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情和上一集差不多，简直是翻炒。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is similar to the last episode; it's basically a rehash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係三炒以前嘅橋，冇啲新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 saam1 caau2 ji5 cin4 ge3 kiu2, mou5 di1 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是翻炒以前的创意，没有一点新意。
examples.english_sentence: He always rehashes old ideas; there's no originality.

mandarin_meaning: 风水上的凶位; 不吉利的位置
english_meaning: Inauspicious location in Feng Shui; Unlucky position; The Three Killings position
explanation_mandarin: 在风水学中，指一个不吉利的位置，通常被认为会带来灾祸或厄运。 每年对应的三煞位都不同，取决于当年的生肖。
explanation_english: In Feng Shui, it refers to an inauspicious location believed to bring misfortune or bad luck. The specific location of the Three Killings varies each year based on the Chinese zodiac.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年間屋嘅西南位係三煞位，最好唔好喺嗰度動土。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gaan1 uk1 ge3 sai1 naam4 wai2 hai6 saam1 saat3 wai2, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 hai2 go2 dou6 dung6 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年房子的西南方位是三煞位，最好不要在那里动土。
examples.english_sentence: This year, the southwest direction of the house is the Three Killings location, it's best not to start any construction there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話張床唔可以對住三煞位，唔係會瞓得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 zoeng1 cong4 m4 ho2 ji5 deoi3 zyu6 saam1 saat3 wai2, m4 hai6 wui5 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说床不可以对着三煞位，不然会睡不好。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said that the bed shouldn't face the Three Killings direction, or you won't sleep well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水師傅話大門開喺三煞位會招惹是非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 si1 fu6 waa6 daai6 mun4 hoi1 hai2 saam1 saat3 wai2 wui5 ziu1 je5 si6 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水师傅说大门开在三煞位会招惹是非。
examples.english_sentence: The Feng Shui master said that having the main door facing the Three Killings position can attract disputes.

english_meaning: in a few strokes; quickly; in a jiffy; without much effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作迅速敏捷，毫不费力就完成。
explanation_english: Describes doing something quickly, easily, and effortlessly. It suggests a task is completed with minimal effort and time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三爬兩撥就將個箱搬咗上樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 paa4 loeng5 but6 zau6 zoeng1 go3 soeng1 bun1 zo2 soeng5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三下两下就把箱子搬上楼了。
examples.english_sentence: He carried the box upstairs in a few strokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好簡單，我三爬兩撥就搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 gaan2 daan1, ngo5 saam1 paa4 loeng5 but6 zau6 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很简单，我三下两下就解决了它。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very simple, I'll solve it in a jiffy.

english_meaning: Three sacrificial animals
explanation_mandarin: 祭祀时用的三种牲畜，通常指猪、鸡、鱼或猪、鸡、鸭。
explanation_english: Three kinds of sacrificial animals offered during rituals, usually referring to pork, chicken, and fish or pork, chicken, and duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜山嘅時候，阿婆準備咗好多三牲祭祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6, aa3 po4 zyun2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 saam1 sang1 zai3 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 扫墓的时候，奶奶准备了很多三牲祭拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: When visiting the ancestral graves, grandma prepared a lot of three sacrificial animals to worship the ancestors.

english_meaning: Elaborate sacrificial offerings (including three kinds of livestock and five kinds of offerings); traditional wedding gifts (between families)
explanation_mandarin: 指古代祭祀时用的丰盛供品，包括三种牲畜（猪、牛、羊）和五种祭品（谷物等）。也指传统婚礼中男方送给女方的聘礼，表示隆重和诚意。
explanation_english: Refers to elaborate sacrificial offerings used in ancient rituals, typically including three kinds of livestock (pig, cow, and sheep) and five kinds of offerings (grains, etc.). It also refers to traditional wedding gifts given by the groom's family to the bride's family, signifying solemnity and sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嗰陣，男家準備咗好多三牲五禮，好隆重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 go2 zan6, naam4 gaa1 zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 saam1 sang1 ng5 lai5, hou2 lung4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚的时候，男方准备了很多丰盛的聘礼，非常隆重。
examples.english_sentence: When they got married, the groom's family prepared a lot of elaborate gifts, it was very grand.

english_meaning: It's a great honor; thrice fortunate
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常幸运，难得的机会或事情。通常用于表达对对方的感激之情。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely fortunate, a rare opportunity or event. Usually used to express gratitude to the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次可以同你合作，真係三生有幸呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 hap6 zok3, zan1 hai6 saam1 sang1 jau5 hang6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次能和你合作，真是三生有幸啊！
examples.english_sentence: Being able to cooperate with you this time is truly a great honor!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以喺呢度聽到你嘅演唱會，我三生有幸！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 dou6 ting1 dou2 nei5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2, ngo5 saam1 sang1 jau5 hang6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能够在这里听到你的演唱会，我三生有幸！
examples.english_sentence: Being able to hear your concert here, I am thrice fortunate!

english_meaning: Top three, first three (winners in a competition or ranking)
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛或评选中获得前三名的人或队伍。也用于比喻最好的几个人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the top three people or teams in a competition or ranking. It can also be used metaphorically to describe the best few people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺歌唱比賽攞到三甲，真係好叻呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou3 saam1 gaap3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在歌唱比赛中获得前三名，真的很棒啊！
examples.english_sentence: He got into the top three in the singing competition, he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要考入大學三甲學系，競爭好激烈㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6 saam1 gaap3 hok6 hai6, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要考入大学最好的几个专业，竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The competition to get into the top three departments in university is very fierce.

mandarin_meaning: 屡次, 再三, 一而再再而三
english_meaning: repeatedly, again and again, time and time again
explanation_mandarin: 形容次数很多，一遍又一遍。
explanation_english: Describes doing something repeatedly, time and time again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我三番四次叫你唔好噉做，你都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 saam1 faan1 sei3 ci3 giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, nei5 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我三番五次叫你不要这样做，你都不听。
examples.english_sentence: I've told you again and again not to do that, but you don't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三番四次遲到，老闆好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 faan1 sei3 ci3 ci4 dou3, lou5 baan2 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他屡次迟到，老板很不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He's been late repeatedly, and the boss is very dissatisfied.

english_meaning: The Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors (of Chinese mythology and history)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国上古时代的神话传说中的帝王，通常被认为是中华文明的奠基人。具体指哪些人物存在多种说法。
explanation_english: Refers to mythical rulers in ancient Chinese legends, generally regarded as the founders of Chinese civilization. There are varying accounts of who these figures specifically are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日講啲三皇五帝嘅古仔，我聽到都悶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 saam1 wong4 ng5 dai3 ge3 gu2 zai2, ngo5 teng1 dou3 mun6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是讲一些三皇五帝的故事，我都听腻了。
examples.english_sentence: They always tell stories about the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, I'm tired of hearing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國歷史咁長，由三皇五帝開始計，到而家都幾千年啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 gam3 coeng4, jau4 saam1 wong4 ng5 dai3 hoi1 ci2 gai3, dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 gei2 cin1 nin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中国历史那么长，从三皇五帝开始算，到现在都几千年了。
examples.english_sentence: Chinese history is so long, starting from the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, it's been several thousand years until now.

english_meaning: To flatter, to suck up to, to brown-nose, to kiss ass
explanation_mandarin: 指为了讨好某人而进行谄媚的行为，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of flattering someone in order to please them, often with a negative connotation. It implies insincerity and opportunism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前三督屁，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 saam1 duk1 pei3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前拍马屁，想升职啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's always sucking up to the boss, he wants to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日三督屁啦，做返你自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 saam1 duk1 pei3 laa1, zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是拍马屁了，做回你自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop sucking up all the time, just be yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 指技能低劣，水平很差，不中用的人或事
english_meaning: Worthless, useless, of very poor quality (person or thing)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物非常差劲，没有价值，质量很差。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being extremely poor, worthless, and of very low quality. Generally used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你寫嘅程式真係三篤屁，完全用唔到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 se2 ge3 cing4 sik1 zan1 hai6 saam1 duk1 pei3, jyun4 cyun4 yung6 m4 dou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你写的程序真是太差劲了，完全不能用！
examples.english_sentence: The program you wrote is absolutely useless, completely unusable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食三篤屁，唔好去食啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 saam1 duk1 pei3, m4 hou2 heoi3 sik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很差劲，不要去吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: The food at that restaurant is awful, don't go there to eat!

english_meaning: (police officer) three stars, Senior Superintendent
explanation_mandarin: 香港警衔的一种，指警司级别。因为警司肩章上有三枚星徽。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Police rank, referring to the rank of Senior Superintendent. This is because Senior Superintendents have three star badges on their shoulder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱升咗做三粒星，好威水呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sing1 zo2 zou6 saam1 lap1 sing1, hou2 wai1 seoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚升职做了警司，好威风啊！
examples.english_sentence: He just got promoted to Senior Superintendent, very impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我老豆喺警隊做到三粒星就退休喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou5 dau2 hai2 ging2 deoi6 zou6 dou3 saam1 lap1 sing1 zau6 teoi3 jau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸在警察部队做到警司就退休了。
examples.english_sentence: My father retired from the police force as a Senior Superintendent.

mandarin_meaning: 不值钱，不怎么样，没什么本事
english_meaning: Worthless, insignificant, lacking ability
explanation_mandarin: 形容某个人或事物不值钱、不重要，或者缺乏能力和价值。常用于贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as worthless, insignificant, or lacking ability and value. Often used in a derogatory sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗰啲提議三粒花啫，冇人會聽你講㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go2 di1 tai4 ji5 saam1 lap1 faa1 ze1, mou5 jan4 wui5 teng1 nei5 gong2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的那些建议没什么价值，没人会听你的。
examples.english_sentence: Your suggestions are worthless; no one will listen to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫嗰啲畫三粒花，根本唔值錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 go2 di1 waa2 saam1 lap1 faa1, gan1 bun2 m4 zik6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画的那些画不值钱，根本不值钱。
examples.english_sentence: The paintings he draws are worthless; they are not worth anything at all.

english_meaning: Category III films, pornography, erotic films
explanation_mandarin: 在香港电影分级制度中，指含有暴力、色情等成人内容的电影。
explanation_english: In the Hong Kong film rating system, refers to films containing adult content such as violence and pornography. Often refers to pornographic films or softcore erotic films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣拍過好多三級片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 paak3 gwo3 hou2 do1 saam1 gap1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候拍过很多三级片。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of Category III films when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好少睇三級片㗎喇，上網睇乜嘢都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 siu2 tai2 saam1 gap1 pin3 gaa3 laa3, soeng5 mong5 tai2 mat1 je5 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人很少看三级片了，上网什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people rarely watch Category III films, you can find everything online.

english_meaning: Category III film (Hong Kong film rating)
explanation_mandarin: 香港电影分级制度下的第三级电影，通常指包含大量性内容或暴力内容的电影。
explanation_english: Category III films are films rated as such under the Hong Kong motion picture rating system. They typically contain graphic sexual content or violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣拍咗好多三級片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 paak3 zo2 hou2 do1 saam1 gap1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候拍了很多三级片。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of Category III films when he was young.

english_meaning: Stupid, foolish, slow-witted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应慢，脑筋不灵活，有点笨。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to react, not quick-witted, and a bit foolish or stupid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁三索啦，人哋都講到咁白你都唔明！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saam1 sok3 laa1, yan4 dei6 dou1 gong2 dou3 gam3 baak6 nei5 dou1 m4 ming4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨了，人家都说得这么明白了你都不明白！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, they've already explained it so clearly and you still don't understand!

english_meaning: troublemaker / nuisance / pain in the neck
explanation_mandarin: 指经常惹麻烦，让人感到厌烦的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who constantly causes trouble and is annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日搞事，真係一條三索線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 gaau2 si6, zan1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 saam1 sok3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都惹事，真是个烦人精。
examples.english_sentence: He causes trouble every day, he's such a pain in the neck.

english_meaning: Three shredded ingredients
explanation_mandarin: 指三种切成丝状的食材，通常指肉丝、蔬菜丝等。常见于菜名中。
explanation_english: Refers to three kinds of shredded ingredients, usually shredded meat, shredded vegetables, etc. Commonly found in dish names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食三絲炒麵，好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 saam1 si1 caau2 min6, hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃三丝炒面，很好吃的！
examples.english_sentence: I like eating stir-fried noodles with three shredded ingredients, it's very delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個三絲羹啲料好足，好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saam1 si1 gang1 di1 liu2 hou2 zuk1, hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个三丝羹的料很足，很划算。
examples.english_sentence: This three-shredded-ingredient soup has a lot of ingredients, it's a good deal.

english_meaning: to keep one's mouth shut; to be tight-lipped; to maintain absolute silence
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话谨慎，不轻易开口。也指沉默不语，不发表意见。
explanation_english: Describes being cautious in speech, not easily opening one's mouth. It can also refer to remaining silent and not expressing opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢件事，我地最好都係三緘其口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6, ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 saam1 gaam1 kei4 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于这件事，我们最好还是闭口不谈吧。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this matter, it's best if we all keep our mouths shut.

english_meaning: One person short (usually in the context of mahjong or a similar game requiring a certain number of players)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指打麻将等需要四个人才能玩的游戏，现在还缺一个人。
explanation_english: Literally 'three missing one'. It describes a situation where a group is one person short of the required number to play a game, most commonly mahjong which requires four players. It can also be used more generally to describe needing one more person for any activity or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想打牌，但係三缺一喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 soeng2 daa2 paai4, daan6 hai6 saam1 kyut3 jat1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想打牌，但是还差一个人。
examples.english_sentence: I want to play cards tonight, but we're still one person short.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，有冇人得閒？我哋三缺一啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, jau5 mou5 jan4 dak1 haan4? ngo5 dei6 saam1 kyut3 jat1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，有人有空吗？我们还差一个人！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, is anyone free? We're one person short!

english_meaning: triplets
explanation_mandarin: 指一次怀孕生下三个胎儿的情况，也就是三胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to the instance of a pregnancy resulting in the birth of three offspring; triplets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企啱啱生咗三胞胎，真係好熱鬧！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei1 ngaam1 ngaam1 saang1 zo2 saam1 baau1 taai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6 naau6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家刚刚生了三胞胎，真是热闹！
examples.english_sentence: They just had triplets in their family, it's really lively!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生三胞胎嘅機率好低㗎，好罕見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 saam1 baau1 taai1 ge3 gei1 leut6 hou2 dai1 gaa3, hou2 haam2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生三胞胎的几率很低的，很罕见。
examples.english_sentence: The odds of having triplets are very low, it's very rare.

mandarin_meaning: 三条腿的凳子; 比喻不稳固
english_meaning: three-legged stool; unstable (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是指有三条腿的凳子。比喻不稳固、不可靠。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to a stool with three legs. Figuratively, it means unstable or unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅財政狀況好似三腳凳咁，隨時會冧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 zong6 fong3 hou2 ci5 saam1 goek3 dang3 gam2, ceoi4 si4 wui5 lam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财政状况好像三脚凳一样，随时会倒塌。
examples.english_sentence: This company's financial situation is like a three-legged stool, it could collapse at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個計劃仲係三腳凳，好多嘢都未諗清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 hai6 saam1 goek3 dang3, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 mei6 nam2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划仍然是不稳固的，很多东西都还没有想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is still unstable, many things haven't been thought through clearly.

english_meaning: Three-pin plug; Electrical plug
explanation_mandarin: 指带有三个插脚的电源插头。香港、英国等地常用，与两脚插头不同。
explanation_english: Refers to an electrical plug with three pins. Commonly used in Hong Kong, the UK, and other regions. It is different from the two-pin plug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得帶個三腳插嘅轉插器啊，香港用唔同嘅插頭㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daai3 go3 saam1 goek3 caap3 ge3 zyun2 caap3 hei3 aa3, hoeng1 gong2 yung6 m4 tung4 ge3 caap3 tau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得带一个三脚插的转换器啊，香港用不同的插头。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a three-pin plug adapter, Hong Kong uses different plugs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電器嘅插頭係三腳插，屋企嘅插座啱唔啱用㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 hei3 ge3 caap3 tau4 hai6 saam1 goek3 caap3, uk1 kei2 ge3 caap3 zo6 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 yung6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电器的插头是三脚插，家里的插座能不能用呢？
examples.english_sentence: This appliance has a three-pin plug, will it fit the sockets at home?

english_meaning: three-pin plug; three-legged plug
explanation_mandarin: 指有三个插脚的电源插头。
explanation_english: Refers to a power plug with three pins, commonly used in Hong Kong and the UK.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅電飯煲，但係佢係兩腳插蘇，屋企嘅插座係三腳插蘇，用唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 din6 faan6 bou1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai6 loeng5 goek3 caap3 sou1, uk1 kei5 ge3 caap3 zo6 hai6 saam1 goek3 caap3 sou1, jung6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的电饭煲，但是它是两脚插头，家里的插座是三脚插头，用不了。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new rice cooker, but it has a two-pin plug, and the sockets at home are three-pin plugs, so I can't use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個轉插器可以將兩腳插蘇轉做三腳插蘇，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyun2 caap3 hei3 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 loeng5 goek3 caap3 sou1 zyun2 zou6 saam1 goek3 caap3 sou1, hou2 faan1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个转换插头可以将两脚插头转换成三脚插头，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This adapter can convert a two-pin plug into a three-pin plug, it's very convenient.

english_meaning: three-pin plug; (slang) a third wheel
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指电器的三脚插头。 引申义是比喻多余的人，第三者，电灯泡。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a three-pin plug for electrical appliances. Figuratively refers to a superfluous person, a third party, or a gooseberry (someone who is unwanted or a nuisance).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我好似變咗三腳插頭咁，打擾你哋拍拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 hou2 ci5 bin3 zo2 saam1 goek3 caap3 tau4 gam2, daa2 jiu2 nei5 dei6 paak3 to1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我好像变成电灯泡了，打扰你们约会了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, it seems like I've become a third wheel, disturbing your date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電器嘅三腳插頭爛咗，要換過一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 hei3 ge3 saam1 goek3 caap3 tau4 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 gwo3 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电器的三脚插头坏了，要换一个新的。
examples.english_sentence: The three-pin plug of this appliance is broken and needs to be replaced.

synonyms: 電燈膽 (din6 dang1 daam2) - light bulb, third wheel

english_meaning: tripod
explanation_mandarin: 一种有三条腿的支撑架，通常用于固定相机、望远镜等设备。
explanation_english: A three-legged stand used for supporting equipment such as cameras and telescopes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅三腳架，影相好穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 saam1 goek3 gaa2, ying2 seung2 hou2 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的三脚架，拍照很稳固。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new tripod, it's very stable for taking pictures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用三腳架可以避免相機震動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yung6 saam1 goek3 gaa2 ho2 ji5 bei6 min5 seung2 gei1 zan3 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用三脚架可以避免相机震动。
examples.english_sentence: Using a tripod can prevent camera shake.

english_meaning: three-legged stool; unstable situation
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是三条腿的凳子。 比喻基础不稳，情况不稳固，容易倒塌或失败。
explanation_english: Literally, a three-legged stool. Metaphorically, it describes an unstable foundation or situation that is easily toppled or likely to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好似三腳櫈咁，隨時執笠都唔出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 saam1 goek3 dang3 gam2, ceoi4 si4 zaap1 laap1 dou1 m4 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司好像三脚凳一样，随时倒闭也不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like a three-legged stool; it wouldn't be surprising if it closes down any time now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃好似三腳櫈咁，缺乏周詳考慮，一定唔會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 hou2 ci5 saam1 goek3 dang3 gam2, kyut3 fat6 zau1 coeng4 hau2 leoi6, jat1 ding6 m4 wui sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划就像三脚凳一样，缺乏周全考虑，一定不会成功。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is like a three-legged stool; lacking thorough consideration, it definitely won't succeed.

english_meaning: a dabbler; a jack-of-all-trades, master of none; possessing only a superficial knowledge or skill
explanation_mandarin: 比喻技艺不精，只会一点皮毛功夫的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only possesses superficial skills or knowledge; a dabbler or a jack-of-all-trades who is a master of none. Often used to describe someone with limited abilities or expertise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識少少嘢，咪三腳貓囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 siu2 siu2 je5, mai1 saam1 goek3 maau1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只懂一点点，就是个三脚猫。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows a little, he's just a dabbler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己識整電腦，點知整咗成日都搞唔掂，真係三腳貓嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 zing2 din6 nou5, dim2 zi1 zing2 zo2 seng4 jat6 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6, zan1 hai6 saam1 goek3 maau1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己会修电脑，结果弄了一整天都没修好，真是个三脚猫。
examples.english_sentence: He said he knew how to fix computers, but he couldn't fix it all day. He's really just a dabbler.

mandarin_meaning: 三脚猫功夫, 一瓶子不满半瓶子晃荡
english_meaning: A smattering of knowledge or skill; superficial skills; a jack of all trades, master of none.
explanation_mandarin: 形容功夫不到家，只是略懂皮毛。比喻学艺不精，只有表面功夫。
explanation_english: Describes someone with superficial skills or knowledge; not proficient at anything; someone who only knows the basics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾個月就話自己識功夫，其實都係三腳貓功夫啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 gung1 fu1, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 saam1 goek3 maau1 gung1 fu1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几个月就说自己会功夫，其实只是三脚猫功夫而已。
examples.english_sentence: He claimed to know Kung Fu after learning for a few months, but it's just a smattering of skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢畫得好，佢都係三腳貓功夫，亂咁嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 waa2 dak1 hou2, keoi5 dou1 hai6 saam1 goek3 maau1 gung1 fu1, lyun6 gam2 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为他画得很好，他只是三脚猫功夫，乱画而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think he paints well, he just has superficial skills and is just messing around.

mandarin_meaning: 不稳固的人或事物，靠不住的人或事物
english_meaning: unstable person or thing; unreliable person or thing; a dodgy character; something shaky
explanation_mandarin: 比喻根基不稳固、不可靠的人或事物。例如，形容一个人的地位不稳，或者一个建筑结构不稳固。
explanation_english: A metaphor for something or someone unstable, unreliable, or lacking a solid foundation. Can be used to describe someone's position being precarious, or a structure that is shaky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅地位好似三腳雞咁，隨時都會俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 wai2 hou2 ci5 saam1 goek3 gai1 gam2, ceoi4 si4 dou1 wui5 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的地位像个不稳固的凳子一样，随时都会被解雇。
examples.english_sentence: His position in the company is like a three-legged chicken; he could be fired at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋起得咁求其，真係三腳雞嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hei2 dak1 gam3 kau4 kei4, zan1 hai6 saam1 goek3 gai1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子建得这么马虎，真是不牢固。
examples.english_sentence: This house was built so carelessly; it's really unstable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信佢講嘅嘢？佢條友仔三腳雞嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5? keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 saam1 goek3 gai1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信他说的话？他那个人靠不住的。
examples.english_sentence: Do you believe what he says? He's an unreliable person.

english_meaning: prostitute, woman of loose morals (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指行为不端，作风不正派的女性，常带有贬义。通常指从事性交易的女性。
explanation_english: Derogatory term for a woman who is considered sexually promiscuous or a prostitute. Literally translates to "three-legged chicken."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日喺街邊撩啲三腳鷄啦，污糟邋遢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 liu1 di1 saam1 goek3 gai1 laa1, wu1 zou1 laat6 taat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是去街边招惹那些妓女，又脏又邋遢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pick up prostitutes on the street, they are dirty and scruffy.

mandarin_meaning: TVB电视台 (香港电视广播有限公司)
english_meaning: TVB (Television Broadcasts Limited)
explanation_mandarin: 香港电视广播有限公司（TVB）的俗称，因为TVB台徽是红、绿、蓝三色组成。
explanation_english: A nickname for Television Broadcasts Limited (TVB), a major television station in Hong Kong. It's called 'Three-color Station' because TVB's logo consists of the three primary colors: red, green, and blue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日睇三色台嘅卡通片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 tai2 saam1 sik1 toi4 ge3 kaa1 tung1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常看TVB的卡通片。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often watched cartoons on TVB.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲人好多都唔睇三色台啦，轉晒睇Netflix。
