examples.english_sentence: He is very knowledgeable about ancient history.

english_meaning: to go on stage; to come to power; to rise to the occasion
explanation_mandarin: 登上舞台表演；当权；有好的表现。
explanation_english: To go on stage to perform; to come to power; to rise to the occasion, to perform well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要上台唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 soeng5 toi4 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚要上台唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He has to go on stage to sing tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上台之後，啲政策就唔同晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 toi4 zi1 hau6, di1 zing3 caak3 zau6 m4 tung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上台之后，政策就完全不同了。
examples.english_sentence: After he came to power, the policies became completely different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明考試嗰陣，佢上台發揮得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 haau2 si5 go2 zan6, keoi5 soeng5 toi4 faat3 fai1 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明考试的时候，他发挥得很好。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, Ah Ming rose to the occasion and performed very well.

english_meaning: boss, superior, supervisor
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作单位或组织中，级别高于自己的领导或主管。
explanation_english: A person in a higher position than you in a company or organization; a boss, supervisor, or superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個上司好嚴㗎，成日都捉我哋啲錯處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 soeng5 si1 hou2 yim4 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 zuk1 ngo5 dei6 di1 co3 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的上司很严格，总是抓住我们的错误。
examples.english_sentence: My boss is very strict and always catches our mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想升職，所以好努力咁討好上司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing1 zik1, so2 ji5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 tou2 hou2 soeng5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想升职，所以很努力地讨好上司。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get promoted, so he tries very hard to please his boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好準時交功課，唔好激嬲你嘅上司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, m4 hou2 gik1 nau1 nei5 ge3 soeng5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好准时交作业，不要惹恼你的上司。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better hand in your work on time, don't annoy your boss.

english_meaning: to hang oneself, to commit suicide by hanging
explanation_mandarin: 指用绳索等物将自己悬挂起来，导致窒息而死，一种自杀方式。
explanation_english: To hang oneself, to commit suicide by suspending oneself by the neck from a rope or similar object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為欠債太多，最後選擇咗上吊自殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 him3 zaai3 taai3 do1, zeoi3 hau6 syun2 zaak6 zo2 soeng5 diu3 zi6 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为欠债太多，最后选择了上吊自杀。
examples.english_sentence: He chose to hang himself because he had too much debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗埋啲咁負面嘅嘢，唔好諗住上吊啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 maai4啲 gam3 fu6 min6 ge3 je5, m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 soeng5 diu3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想那些负面的事情，不要想着上吊啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about such negative things, don't think about hanging yourself!

english_meaning: to vomit and have diarrhea; to have severe vomiting and diarrhea
explanation_mandarin: 形容同时出现呕吐和腹泻的症状。
explanation_english: Describes the simultaneous symptoms of vomiting and diarrhea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日食咗啲唔乾淨嘅嘢，搞到而家上吐下瀉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 sik6 zo2 di1 m4 gon1 zing6 ge3 je5, gaau2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 soeng5 tou3 haa6 se3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天吃了一些不干净的东西，搞得现在上吐下泻。
examples.english_sentence: He ate something unclean yesterday, which caused him to vomit and have diarrhea now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣轉變大，好多人都上吐下瀉，可能係腸胃炎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 zyun2 bin3 daai6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng5 tou3 haa6 se3, ho2 nang4 hai6 coeng2 wai2 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气变化大，很多人都上吐下泻，可能是肠胃炎。
examples.english_sentence: Recently the weather has been changing a lot, many people are vomiting and having diarrhea, it might be gastroenteritis.

english_meaning: to be getting on in years; to be getting old; elderly
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄渐长，开始衰老。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of becoming older and showing signs of aging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上咗年紀，行路都慢咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 zo2 nin4 gei2, haang4 lou6 dou1 maan6 zo2 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上了年纪，走路都慢了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting on in years, he walks much slower now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆上咗年紀，要特別照顧佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 soeng5 zo2 nin4 gei2, jiu3 dak6 bit1 ziu3 gu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶上了年纪，要特别照顾她。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is elderly, we need to take special care of her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上咗年紀嘅人，要多啲注意身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 zo2 nin4 gei2 ge3 jan4, jiu3 do1 di1 zyu3 ji3 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上了年纪的人，要多注意身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people need to pay more attention to their health.

english_meaning: upper lip
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴巴上方的嘴唇。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper lip of the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忍唔住咬住上唇，好似好緊張噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 jaau5 zyu6 soeng6 seon4, hou2 ci5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忍不住咬着上嘴唇，好像很紧张的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't help but bite his upper lip, as if he was very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上面嘅上唇有粒癦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 min6 ge3 soeng6 seon4 jau5 lap1 mek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的上嘴唇上面有一颗痣。
examples.english_sentence: He has a mole on his upper lip.

english_meaning: to come up; to go up (towards the speaker)
explanation_mandarin: 表示从低处往高处移动，朝向说话者方向移动。
explanation_english: Indicates movement from a lower place to a higher place, towards the speaker. Implies ascending or approaching the speaker's location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你快啲上嚟啦，我喺度等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 faai3 di1 soeng5 lai4 laa1, ngo5 hai2 dou6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你快点上来吧，我在这里等你。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, come up quickly, I'm waiting for you here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫我攞啲嘢上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 di1 je5 soeng5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我拿些东西上来。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me bring some things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日冇上嚟返工，可能病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 soeng5 lai4 faan1 gung1, ho2 nang4 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天没上来上班，可能生病了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come up to work today, he's probably sick.

english_meaning: bust size; upper circumference (typically of a woman's chest)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性胸部的尺寸，通常用作服装尺寸或评价身材的指标。
explanation_english: Refers to the size of a woman's chest, usually used as an indicator of clothing size or body shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上圍好豐滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 wai4 hou2 fung1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的胸围很丰满。
examples.english_sentence: Her bust size is very full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫太細，我上圍著唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 taai3 sai3, ngo5 soeng6 wai4 zoek3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服太小了，我的胸围穿不下。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too small; my bust size can't fit into it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭啲內衣好多唔同上圍嘅選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 di1 noi6 ji1 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 soeng6 wai4 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的内衣有很多不同胸围的选择。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has a lot of different bust size choices for lingerie.

english_meaning: the above-mentioned address; the address above
explanation_mandarin: 指前面提到过的地址。
explanation_english: Refers to the address mentioned previously or above in the text or document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請將信寄去上址。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 zoeng1 seon3 gei3 heoi3 soeng6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请将信寄到上述地址。
examples.english_sentence: Please mail the letter to the address above.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搬咗屋，唔好再寄信去上址啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun1 zo2 uk1, m4 hou2 zoi3 gei3 seon3 heoi3 soeng6 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我搬家了，不要再寄信到上述地址了。
examples.english_sentence: I've moved, please don't send any more letters to the address above.

english_meaning: to attend class, to go to class, to have class
explanation_mandarin: 去上课，参加课堂。
explanation_english: To attend a class or lesson. To go to a class that is part of a school or course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要上堂，唔可以同你出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 tong4, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 chut1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要上课，不可以和你出去。
examples.english_sentence: I have class tomorrow, so I can't go out with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔上堂，所以考試肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 soeng5 tong4, so2 ji5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常不上课，所以考试不及格。
examples.english_sentence: He often skips classes, so he failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾點上堂呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 dim2 soeng5 tong4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 几点上课啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time is class?

english_meaning: to be reported in the news, to make the news, to be publicized
explanation_mandarin: 指事件或消息被报纸、电视等媒体报道。
explanation_english: Refers to an event or news being reported by media such as newspapers and television.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢咁大鑊，肯定會上報㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 wok6, hang2 ding6 wui5 soeng5 bou3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么严重，肯定会上报的。
examples.english_sentence: This incident is so serious, it will definitely be reported in the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想自己嘅發明上報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 zi6 ge3 faat3 ming4 soeng5 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想自己的发明被报道。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants his invention to be reported in the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔小心，分分鐘會上報㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 siu2 sam1, fan1 fan1 zung1 wui5 soeng5 bou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不小心，很可能会上报的。
examples.english_sentence: If we are not careful, it could very well end up in the news.

english_meaning: to go on stage; to enter (a competition, etc.); to take the field; to come into use; to appear
explanation_mandarin: （1）指演员、运动员等开始表演或比赛；（2）指商品开始销售或使用；（3）比喻某事物开始发生作用或起作用。
explanation_english: (1) Refers to actors, athletes, etc. going on stage to perform or compete; (2) Refers to goods being sold or used; (3) A metaphor for something beginning to take effect or play a role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日就要上場比賽啦，依家好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 soeng5 coeng4 bei2 coi3 laa1, ji1 gaa1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天就要上场比赛了，现在很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: He's going to compete tomorrow, and he's very nervous now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電腦上場之後，工作效率提升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 nou5 soeng5 coeng4 zi1 hau6, gung1 zok3 haau2 leot2 tai4 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台新电脑投入使用后，工作效率提高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After this new computer came into use, work efficiency increased a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技好好，一上場就吸引住所有觀眾嘅目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei3 hou2 hou2, jat1 soeng5 coeng4 zau6 kap1 jan5 zyu6 so2 jau5 gun1 zung3 ge3 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技很好，一上台就吸引住所有观众的目光。
examples.english_sentence: His acting is very good, and he attracts the attention of all the audience as soon as he goes on stage.

mandarin_meaning: 提升自己；提升層次; (引申) 越級挑戰
english_meaning: to improve oneself; to level up; (by extension) to challenge someone/something beyond one's capabilities
explanation_mandarin: 本意指爬上土墩或堤壩，引申為提升自身能力或水平。有時也用來指越級挑戰，帶有冒險或不自量力的意味。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to climb onto a mound or embankment. Figuratively, it means to improve oneself, level up one's abilities or status. It can also mean to challenge someone or something beyond one's current capabilities, implying risk or overestimation of one's own abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都好努力咁讀書，想上壆呀嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 duk6 syu1, soeng5 bok3 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都很努力地读书，想要提升自己啊。
examples.english_sentence: He studies very hard every day because he wants to improve himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都未學行，就想跑，真係想上壆呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 mei6 hok6 haang4, zau6 soeng2 paau2, zan1 hai6 soeng2 soeng5 bok3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都还没学会走路，就想跑，真是想越级挑战吗？
examples.english_sentence: You haven't even learned to walk, and you want to run? Are you seriously trying to challenge someone beyond your level?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢個課程可以幫我上壆，提升自己嘅競爭力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 soeng5 bok3, tai4 sing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 ging6 zang1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这个课程可以帮我提升自己，提高自己的竞争力。
examples.english_sentence: I think this course can help me improve myself and enhance my competitiveness.

english_meaning: systolic blood pressure
explanation_mandarin: 医学术语，指心脏收缩时，动脉血压达到的最高值。
explanation_english: Medical term: The maximum arterial pressure during contraction of the heart's left ventricle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我上壓有啲高，要留意飲食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 soeng6 aat3 jau5 di1 gou1, jiu3 lau4 yi3 jam2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的收缩压有点高，要注意饮食。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my systolic blood pressure is a bit high, so I need to pay attention to my diet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日量嘅上壓幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 loeng4 ge3 soeng6 aat3 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天量的收缩压是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What was your systolic blood pressure reading today?

mandarin_meaning: 升天; 去世; 上帝
english_meaning: ascend to heaven; to pass away (euphemism); God; heaven
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指升到天堂。2. 婉辞，指去世。3. 上帝，天主。
explanation_english: 1. Literally means to ascend to heaven. 2. Euphemism for passing away or dying. 3. God; heaven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爺爺上個禮拜上天咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 je4 je4 soeng5 go3 lai5 baai3 soeng5 tin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷上个星期去世了。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed away last week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我信上天會保佑我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon3 soeng5 tin1 wui5 bou2 jau6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我相信上帝会保佑我们。
examples.english_sentence: I believe God will bless us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我可以上天就好啦，乜嘢煩惱都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 soeng5 tin1 zau6 hou2 laa1, mat1 je5 faan4 nou5 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我可以升到天堂就好了，什么烦恼都没了。
examples.english_sentence: It would be great if I could ascend to heaven, all my worries would be gone.

synonyms: 過身 (gwo3 san1) - (only applies for 'to pass away')

jyutping: soeng6 tin1 jau5 hou2 sang1 zi1 dak1
mandarin_meaning: 上天有好生之德 (shàng tiān yǒu hǎo shēng zhī dé)
english_meaning: Heaven has the virtue of cherishing life; Heaven values life.
explanation_mandarin: 指上天有好生养万物的仁慈之心。常用来劝人不要轻易杀生，要珍惜生命，或在困境中给予希望，相信上天会给予生机。
explanation_english: It refers to the merciful heart of heaven in cherishing and nurturing all living things. It is often used to persuade people not to kill easily, to cherish life, or to give hope in difficult situations, believing that heaven will provide an opportunity for survival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢遇到咁多困難，但係上天有好生之德，佢最終都克服咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 jyu6 dou6 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, daan6 hai6 soeng6 tin1 jau5 hou2 sang1 zi1 dak1, keoi5 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hak1 fuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他遇到了这么多困难，但是上天有好生之德，他最终都克服了。
examples.english_sentence: Although he encountered so many difficulties, Heaven has the virtue of cherishing life, and he eventually overcame them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，上天有好生之德，放咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, soeng6 tin1 jau5 hou2 sang1 zi1 dak1, fong3 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了吧，上天有好生之德，放了他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, Heaven values life, let him go.

mandarin_meaning: 达到极限；达到顶点；触及天花板
english_meaning: To hit the ceiling; to reach the limit; to max out
explanation_mandarin: 比喻达到某种能力的极限或事物发展的顶点，无法再提高或发展。
explanation_english: A metaphor for reaching the limit of one's ability or the peak of something's development, making it impossible to improve or develop further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅銷售額已經上天花板，再賣唔到更多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu1 sau6 ngaak2 ji5 ging1 soeng5 tin1 faa1 baan2, zoi3 maai6 m4 dou2 gang3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的销售额已经达到极限，再也卖不出更多了。
examples.english_sentence: His sales have already hit the ceiling, he can't sell any more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅預算已經上天花板，唔可以再加錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 ji5 ging1 soeng5 tin1 faa1 baan2, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 gaa1 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的预算已经到达顶峰，不能再增加预算了。
examples.english_sentence: The budget for this project has hit the ceiling, we can't add any more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學廣東話嘅程度已經上天花板，好難再進步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 cing4 dou6 ji5 ging1 soeng5 tin1 faa1 baan2, hou2 naan4 zoi3 zeon3 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习广东话的程度已经达到顶峰，很难再进步了。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese level has hit the ceiling, it's difficult for him to improve any further.

english_meaning: to become sworn siblings; to become godparents and godchildren
explanation_mandarin: 指没有血缘关系的人通过仪式结为亲戚关系，通常指认干爹干妈，或结为干兄弟姐妹。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of people who are not related by blood forming a kinship relationship through a ceremony, usually referring to recognizing godparents or becoming sworn siblings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋細個嗰陣上契，感情好似親生兄弟咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 soeng5 kai3, gam2 cing4 hou2 ci5 can1 saang1 hing1 dai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们小时候结为干兄弟，感情就像亲兄弟一样。
examples.english_sentence: They became sworn brothers when they were young, and their relationship is like that of real brothers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住幫個仔上契，搵個可靠嘅人做佢契爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 bong1 go3 zai2 soeng5 kai3, wan2 go3 ho2 kaau3 ge3 jan4 zou6 keoi5 kai3 je4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算给儿子认个干爹，找个可靠的人做他的干爹。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to have my son have a godfather, to find a reliable person to be his godfather.

jyutping: soeng6 hou2 cam4 hoeng1 dong3 laan6 caai4
mandarin_meaning: 把上好的沉香当作烂柴火。
english_meaning: To treat the finest agarwood as worthless firewood; to fail to recognize the value of something precious; to misjudge talent.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不识货，把珍贵的东西当成不值钱的东西；也比喻不识人才，埋没人才。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone fails to recognize the value of something precious, treating it as worthless. It can also refer to failing to recognize talent in a person and thus wasting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個天才畫家當咗普通人，真係上好沉香當爛柴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 tin1 coi4 waa2 gaa1 dong3 zo2 pou2 tung1 jan4, zan1 hai6 soeng6 hou2 cam4 hoeng1 dong3 laan6 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那个天才画家当成了普通人，真是把上好的沉香当烂柴烧了。
examples.english_sentence: He treated that talented painter like an ordinary person; he really treated the finest agarwood as worthless firewood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好上好沉香當爛柴呀，呢啲古董好值錢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 soeng6 hou2 cam4 hoeng1 dong3 laan6 caai4 aa3, ni1啲 gu2 dung2 hou2 zik6 cin2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把上好的沉香当烂柴啊，这些古董很值钱的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat the finest agarwood as worthless firewood; these antiques are very valuable!

english_meaning: to put on makeup, to apply makeup
explanation_mandarin: 指在脸上涂抹化妆品，使容貌更美丽。
explanation_english: To apply makeup to the face, typically to enhance one's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日返工之前都要上妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 zi1 cin4 dou1 jiu3 soeng5 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天上班之前都要化妆。
examples.english_sentence: She puts on makeup every day before going to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上咗妝之後靚咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 zo2 zong1 zi1 hau6 leng3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她化了妆之后漂亮了很多。
examples.english_sentence: She looks much prettier after putting on makeup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我要去影婚紗相，所以要上個靚妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 ying2 fan1 saa1 soeng2, so2 ji5 jiu3 soeng5 go3 leng3 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我要去拍婚纱照，所以要化个漂亮的妆。
examples.english_sentence: Today I'm going to take wedding photos, so I need to put on nice makeup.

english_meaning: to go to school; to attend school
explanation_mandarin: 去学校学习。指学生到学校进行学习活动。
explanation_english: To go to school for learning; usually refers to students attending school for academic activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我要上學，唔可以出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 jiu3 soeng5 hok6, m4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我要上学，不可以出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to school tomorrow, so I can't go out to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都好準時上學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4 soeng5 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都很准时上学。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to school on time every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾時開始上學啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2 soeng5 hok6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你什么时候开始上学啊？
examples.english_sentence: When do you start going to school?

english_meaning: Superior, boss, higher-up
explanation_mandarin: 指职级比自己高的官员或领导。
explanation_english: Refers to officials or leaders who are higher in rank than oneself; a superior or boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好淨係諗住敷衍上官，最緊要對得住自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 nam2 zyu6 fu1 jin2 soeng5 gun1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 deoi3 dak1 zyu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要只想敷衍上司，最重要的是对得起自己。
examples.english_sentence: When you work, don't just think about perfunctorily dealing with your superiors. The most important thing is to be true to yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得討好上官，所以升得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 tou2 hou2 soeng5 gun1, so2 ji5 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得讨好上司，所以升得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to please his superiors, so he gets promoted very quickly.

english_meaning: To pick up passengers; To have passengers board (a vehicle, especially taxi)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指的士、公共汽车等交通工具开始搭载乘客。
explanation_english: Typically refers to taxis, buses, and other transportation vehicles beginning to take on passengers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架的士喺轉角位上咗個客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 dik1 si2 hai2 zyun2 gok3 wai2 soeng5 zo2 go3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出租车在转角处载了一位乘客。
examples.english_sentence: The taxi picked up a passenger at the corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日生意唔錯，上咗好多客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 seng1 ji3 m4 co3, soeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天生意不错，载了很多客人。
examples.english_sentence: Business is good today, I've picked up a lot of passengers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架巴士已經上晒客，準備開車喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 baa1 si2 ji5 ging1 soeng5 saai3 haak3, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 ce1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公交车已经上满乘客，准备开车了。
examples.english_sentence: The bus is already full of passengers and ready to depart.

english_meaning: Previous company; Previous supplier; The player to your left (in card games/Mahjong)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指之前的公司或机构。2. 指供应链的上游，即供应商。3. 麻将或纸牌游戏中，坐在你左边的玩家。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the previous company or organization where someone worked. 2. Refers to the upstream of the supply chain, i.e., the supplier. 3. In Mahjong or card games, it refers to the player sitting to your left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我舊年喺上家公司做嘢做到好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gau6 nin4 hai2 soeng6 gaa1 gung1 si1 zou6嘢zou3 dou3 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去年在上家公司工作很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: I was very unhappy working at my previous company last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要同上家傾好個價錢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 soeng6 gaa1 king1 hou2 go3 gaa3 chin2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要和供应商谈好价格才行。
examples.english_sentence: We need to negotiate the price with the supplier first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打麻雀要睇住上家，佢出咩牌好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 maa4 zoek3 jiu3 tai2 zyu6 soeng6 gaa1, keoi5 ceot1 me1 paai2 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻将要看着上家，他出什么牌很重要。
examples.english_sentence: When playing Mahjong, you need to pay attention to the player to your left, what cards they discard is very important.

cantonese: 上屋搬下屋，唔見一籮穀
jyutping: soeng6 uk1 bun1 haa6 uk1, m4 gin3 jat1 lo4 guk1
english_meaning: Moving from one house to another, a basket of rice is lost; implying that moving often leads to losses and disorganization.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻搬家过程中容易遗失物品，或形容做事效率低下，忙来忙去反而损失更多。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the situation where moving from one house to another results in the loss of a basket of rice. It implies that moving or any undertaking involving change or rearrangement can often lead to unexpected losses, disorganization, or inefficiency. It can also suggest that someone is busy but ultimately loses more than they gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日轉工，但係人工都冇加過，真係上屋搬下屋，唔見一籮穀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zyun2 gung1, daan6 hai6 jan4 gung1 dou1 mou5 gaa1 gwo3, zan1 hai6 soeng6 uk1 bun1 haa6 uk1, m4 gin3 jat1 lo4 guk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是换工作，但是工资都没有涨过，真是搬家丢失东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always changes jobs, but his salary never increases. It's truly like moving from one house to another and losing a basket of rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咗咁耐，間鋪頭都仲係蝕錢，真係上屋搬下屋，唔見一籮穀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, gaan1 pou3 tau2 dou1 zung6 hai6 sit3 cin2, zan1 hai6 soeng6 uk1 bun1 haa6 uk1, m4 gin3 jat1 lo4 guk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞了这么久，店还是亏钱，真是搬家丢失东西。
examples.english_sentence: After working on it for so long, the store is still losing money. It's truly like moving from one house to another and losing a basket of rice.

english_meaning: upper level, upper class, the higher-ups
explanation_mandarin: 通常指位置较高的楼层，也可以指社会地位较高的人群。
explanation_english: Generally refers to the upper floor of a building, or people of higher social status or position, i.e. the higher-ups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺上層，風景好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 soeng6 cang4, fung1 ging2 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在上层，风景很好。
examples.english_sentence: They live on the upper level, the view is great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上層嘅人好少理我哋啲下層嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 cang4 ge3 jan4 hou2 siu2 lei5 ngo5 dei6 di1 haa6 cang4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上层的人很少理会我们下层的感受。
examples.english_sentence: The higher-ups rarely care about the feelings of us subordinates.

english_meaning: to go uphill; to go to the mountains; (slang) to die; to be executed
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思指去山上。俚语中也指死亡，尤其指被处决。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to go up the mountain'. In slang, it also refers to death, especially execution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日上山行山呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 soeng5 saan1 haang4 saan1 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去山上爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We are going hiking up the mountain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢殺人放火，聽日就要上山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2, ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 soeng5 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他杀人放火，明天就要被处决了。
examples.english_sentence: He committed murder and arson; he will be executed tomorrow.

synonyms: 瓜老襯 (gwaa1 lou5 can3) - slang for death

english_meaning: to go up mountains and down to the sea; to go everywhere; to explore far and wide
explanation_mandarin: 形容到处奔波，经历各种各样的事情。
explanation_english: Describes going everywhere and experiencing all sorts of things. It implies exploring extensively or travelling widely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵到好嘅拍攝地點，佢哋成日上山下海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 dou2 hou2 ge3 se3 ying2 dei6 dim3, keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 soeng5 saan1 haa5 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找到好的拍摄地点，他们整天上山下海。
examples.english_sentence: In order to find good filming locations, they are constantly going up mountains and down to the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工要周圍走，真係上山下海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 jiu3 zau1 wai4 zau2, zan1 hai6 soeng5 saan1 haa5 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作需要到处跑，真是上山下海。
examples.english_sentence: His job requires him to travel everywhere; it's really going up mountains and down to the sea.

mandarin_meaning: 脱离苦海；考上公务员；金盆洗手
english_meaning: To reach shore; to get out of a difficult situation; to land a secure job (especially civil servant); to retire from a life of crime; to turn over a new leaf.
explanation_mandarin: 原意指船只靠岸。比喻摆脱困境，获得成功。也常用来指考上公务员或金盆洗手，退出黑社会等。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to a boat reaching the shore. Figuratively, it means to escape a difficult situation and achieve success. It is also often used to refer to passing the civil service exam or retiring from a life of crime (e.g., 'washing one's hands' in a gangster context).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到政府工，終於上岸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 zing3 fu2 gung1, zung1 jyu1 soeng5 ngon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了公务员，终于上岸了。
examples.english_sentence: He passed the civil servant exam and finally made it (landed a secure job).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話以後唔撈偏門，想上岸做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ji5 hau6 m4 lou1 pin1 mun4, soeng2 soeng5 ngon6 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说以后不做不正当的行业了，想金盆洗手做生意。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't do illegal things anymore and wants to retire from that life and start a business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 捱咗咁耐，希望可以快啲上岸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaai4 zo2 gam3 noi6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 soeng5 ngon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熬了这么久，希望可以快点摆脱困境。
examples.english_sentence: Having struggled for so long, I hope to get out of this difficult situation soon.

english_meaning: to go to work; to start work; to be on duty
explanation_mandarin: 开始工作，去上班。
explanation_english: To go to work; to begin one's shift or job duties; to be on duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要上工，唔可以去玩啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 gung1, m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 waan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要上班，不能去玩啊。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work tomorrow, I can't go out and play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日幾點上工啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gei2 dim2 soeng5 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天几点上班啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time do you start work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱上工，仲未熟習啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 soeng5 gung1, zung6 mei6 suk6 zaap6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚上班，还没熟悉那些东西。
examples.english_sentence: He just started working, he's not familiar with things yet.

english_meaning: to go public (of a company); to be listed (on the stock market)
explanation_mandarin: 公司发行股票，可以在证券交易所公开买卖。
explanation_english: When a company issues shares and they can be publicly traded on the stock exchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司聽日就上市喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ting1 jat6 zau6 soeng5 si5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司明天就要上市了。
examples.english_sentence: That company will go public tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上市之後，佢哋嘅股價升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 si5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 gu2 gaa3 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上市之后，他们的股价涨了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After going public, their stock price rose a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃三年之後上市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 saam1 nin4 zi1 hau6 soeng5 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划三年后上市。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to go public in three years.

english_meaning: God
explanation_mandarin: 指基督教、犹太教等宗教中至高无上的神。
explanation_english: Refers to the supreme being in religions such as Christianity and Judaism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好信上帝，每個禮拜都會去教堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 seon3 soeng5 dai3, mui5 go3 lai5 bai3 dou1 wui5 heoi3 gaau2 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常相信上帝，每个星期都会去教堂。
examples.english_sentence: He is a devout believer in God and goes to church every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得上帝會保佑佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 soeng5 dai3 wui5 bou2 jau6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得上帝会保佑他。
examples.english_sentence: He believes that God will bless him.

mandarin_meaning: 上帝视角；以上帝的视角
english_meaning: God's-eye view; bird's-eye view; omniscient perspective
explanation_mandarin: 指从一个全知的、超越的角度来看待事物。 类似于“旁观者清”的意思。也常用于游戏术语，指可以俯瞰全局的视角。
explanation_english: Refers to looking at things from an all-knowing, transcendent perspective. Similar to the idea that "an outsider sees the game." It is also often used as a game term to refer to a perspective that allows you to see the entire game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時諗嘢唔好咁執着，企喺上帝視角睇下，可能會有唔同嘅發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 nam2 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6, kei5 hai2 soeng5 dai3 si6 gok3 tai2 haa5, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 faat3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候想事情不要太执着，站在上帝视角看看，可能会有不同的发现。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes, don't be so hung up on things. Try looking at it from a God's-eye view, and you might have different discoveries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 玩呢隻策略遊戲要用上帝視角嚟部署部隊，先容易贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan2 ni1 zek3 caak3 loek6 jau4 hei3 jiu3 jung6 soeng5 dai3 si6 gok3 lai4 bou6 syu5 bou6 deoi2, sin1 jung4 ji6 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩这个策略游戏要用上帝视角来部署部队，才容易赢。
examples.english_sentence: To play this strategy game, you need to use a God's-eye view to deploy troops, which makes it easier to win.

english_meaning: last year
explanation_mandarin: 指刚刚过去的一年，即去年的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to the year that just passed; the previous year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上年去咗日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 nin4 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去年去了日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Japan on a trip last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上年畢業嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 nin4 bat1 jip6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是去年毕业的。
examples.english_sentence: He graduated last year.

english_meaning: to go to bed, to sleep; (euphemism) to have sex
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是上床睡觉，也常被用作委婉说法表示发生性关系。
explanation_english: Literally means to go to bed, to sleep. It is also often used as a euphemism for having sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好眼瞓，想早啲上床瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3, soeng2 zou2 di1 soeng5 cong4 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很困，想早点上床睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very sleepy, I want to go to bed early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋識咗唔夠一個月就上床啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sik1 zo2 m4 gau3 jat1 go3 jyut6 zau6 soeng5 cong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们认识不到一个月就上床了。
examples.english_sentence: They slept together less than a month after meeting each other.

english_meaning: to go to bed; to sleep; to have sex
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义为到床上去，引申为睡觉的意思。也常用于委婉地表达发生性关系。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to go to bed.' It can mean simply going to bed to sleep. It is also often used as a euphemism for having sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好眼瞓啊，想即刻上床瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3 aa3, soeng2 zik1 hak1 soeng5 cong4 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好困啊，想立刻上床睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so sleepy, I want to go to bed right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗拖幾個月就上咗床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 to1 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 soeng5 zo2 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈恋爱几个月就上床了。
examples.english_sentence: They had sex after dating for a few months.

mandarin_meaning: 就座; 入席; 安排在尊贵的位置
english_meaning: to take one's seat (usually in a formal setting); to be seated (in a position of honor); to invite someone to be seated in a place of honor; to be formally seated (e.g., at a banquet)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 就座，尤指在正式场合或重要位置就座。2. 安排客人坐在尊贵的位置。
explanation_english: 1. To take a seat, especially in a formal setting or a position of importance. 2. To arrange for a guest to be seated in a place of honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺今日生日，佢要坐上座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gam1 jat6 saang1 jat6, keoi5 jiu3 co5 soeng6 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷今天生日，他要坐在上座。
examples.english_sentence: It's Grandpa's birthday today, he should sit in the seat of honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你上座啦，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 soeng6 zo6 laa1, m4 sai2 hak1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请您入座吧，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: Please be seated, no need to be so polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋專登安排咗佢坐上座，表示尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun1 dang1 on1 paai4 zo2 keoi5 co5 soeng6 zo6, biu2 si6 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们特意安排他坐在上座，表示尊重。
examples.english_sentence: They deliberately arranged for him to sit in the seat of honor to show respect.

english_meaning: to go to court; to attend court
explanation_mandarin: 指去法院参加诉讼或审判。
explanation_english: To go to court, typically as a defendant, witness, or someone involved in a legal case; to attend a court hearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日要上庭，因為佢俾人告咗襲擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 ting4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 bei2 jan4 gou3 zo2 zaap6 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天要上法庭，因为他被人告了袭击。
examples.english_sentence: He has to go to court tomorrow because he's being sued for assault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師叫我哋一定要準時上庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 soeng5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律师叫我们一定要准时上法庭。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer told us we must be on time for court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔認罪，就要上庭同法官解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 jing6 zeoi6, zau6 jiu3 soeng5 ting4 tung4 faat3 gun1 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不认罪，就要上法庭跟法官解释。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't plead guilty, you have to go to court and explain to the judge.

english_meaning: First quarter moon
explanation_mandarin: 农历每月初七、初八左右出现的半月形月亮，月亮东边呈现凸出的形状。
explanation_english: The first quarter moon, appearing around the 7th or 8th day of the lunar month, when the eastern half of the moon is illuminated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚嘅上弦月好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 ngaam5 ge3 soeng6 jyun4 jyut6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的上弦月真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: The first quarter moon was so beautiful last night!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約咗喺上弦月嗰晚去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 zo2 hai2 soeng6 jyun4 jyut6 go2 maan5 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约好了在上弦月的那晚去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed to go hiking on the night of the first quarter moon.

english_meaning: To load bullets (into a firearm); to prepare; to get ready; to be primed and ready.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是给枪支装填子弹。引申义是做好准备，进入某种状态。
explanation_english: Literally means to load bullets into a firearm. Figuratively means to prepare, get ready, or enter a certain state, especially in anticipation of something challenging or exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，我今日要上彈溫書先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 daan6 wan1 syu1 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，我今天得准备好复习了。
examples.english_sentence: I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to prepare and study hard today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話聽日有大project，大家要上彈準備定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 ting1 jat6 jau5 daai6 project, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 soeng5 daan6 zyun2 bei6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说明天有个大项目，大家要准备好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said there's a big project tomorrow, everyone needs to get prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似上咗彈咁，成日都好興奮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 soeng5 zo2 daan6 gam2, seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 hing1 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像上了发条，总是很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be all charged up, he's always very excited.

jyutping: soeng5 dak1 saan1 do1 zung1 jyu6 fu2
mandarin_meaning: 常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋
english_meaning: If you keep going to the mountain, you will eventually meet a tiger; Doing something risky often enough will eventually lead to trouble; You can't get away with it forever.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻经常冒险做坏事，迟早会遇到危险或受到惩罚。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if you repeatedly engage in risky or dangerous activities, you will eventually encounter trouble or face the consequences. It's a warning against persistent risky behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭錢，上得山多終遇虎，遲早都會輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou2 cin2, soeng5 dak1 saan1 do1 zung1 jyu6 fu2, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui1 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是赌钱，常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋，迟早都会输光所有的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always gambles, eventually he'll meet his match and lose all his money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再非法賽車啦，上得山多終遇虎，到時出咗事就後悔都嚟唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 fei1 faat3 soi3 ce1 laa1, soeng5 dak1 saan1 do1 zung1 jyu6 fu2, dou3 si4 ceot1 zo2 si6 zau6 hau6 fui3 dou1 lai4 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再非法赛车了，常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋，到时候出了事后悔都来不及。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't illegally race cars anymore. If you keep pushing your luck, you'll eventually get into an accident and it'll be too late to regret it.

synonyms: 夜路走多了，总会遇到鬼 (jaa6 lou6 zau2 do1 liu5, zung2 wui5 jyu6 dou3 gwai2)

jyutping: soeng5 dak1 saan1 do1 jyu6 zoek6 fu2
mandarin_meaning: 常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋
english_meaning: If you do something often enough, you're bound to get into trouble eventually; the more you do something, the more likely you are to encounter problems.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻经常做坏事或冒险的事，总有一天会遇到麻烦或危险。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that if you frequently engage in risky or questionable behavior, you are bound to encounter trouble or danger eventually. The more often you engage in a specific activity, the higher the probability of encountering associated problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭錢，上得山多遇着虎，遲早都會輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou2 cin2, soeng5 dak1 saan1 do1 jyu6 zoek6 fu2, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui1 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是赌钱，常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋，迟早都会把钱都输光的。
examples.english_sentence: He gambles all the time. If you play with fire, you're bound to get burned. Sooner or later, he'll lose all his money.

synonyms: 夜路走多了总会遇到鬼 (yè lù zǒu duō le zǒng huì yù dào guǐ)

jyutping: soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 laai1 bei6 ham6
english_meaning: To pull the blanket after getting into bed; to take remedial action only after the damage is done; locking the stable door after the horse has bolted.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情发生之后才采取补救措施，通常已经为时已晚，效果不佳。强调事前的预防远比事后的补救更重要。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone takes action to fix a problem only after it has already occurred. It implies that the damage has been done and the remedial efforts are often too late or ineffective. It emphasizes the importance of prevention over cure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等到考試肥佬先嚟溫書，上得床嚟拉被冚啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 dou3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2 sin1 lai4 wan1 syu1, soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 laai1 bei6 ham6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等到考试不及格才来温习功课，亡羊补牢，为时已晚！
examples.english_sentence: Waiting until you fail the exam to start studying is like locking the stable door after the horse has bolted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司等到蝕大本先嚟諗計仔補救，真係上得床嚟拉被冚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 dang2 dou3 sit3 daai6 bun2 sin1 lai4 nam2 gai3 zai2 bou2 gau3, zan1 hai6 soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 laai1 bei6 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司等到亏损严重才想办法补救，真是亡羊补牢。
examples.english_sentence: Their company waited until they suffered heavy losses before trying to find ways to fix it, it's really locking the stable door after the horse has bolted.

synonyms: 亡羊補牢 (wáng yáng bǔ láo)

jyutping: soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 hin1 bei6 ham6*
english_meaning: To do something unnecessary and redundant; to do something pointless after it's already been done.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做多余的事情，已经睡觉了才来掀被子盖住身体，属于多此一举，毫无意义。
explanation_english: This idiom literally translates to 'to pull up the blanket after already getting into bed.' It refers to doing something that is redundant, unnecessary, or pointless because it's already too late or the action is no longer needed. It implies a lack of foresight or acting after the opportune moment has passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都搞掂晒先嚟問我點樣做，咪即係上得床嚟掀被冚囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gaau2 dim6 saai3 sin1 lai4 man6 ngo5 dim2 joeng2 zou6, mai1 zik1 hai6 soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 hin1 bei6 ham6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都做完才来问我怎么做，这不是多此一举吗？
examples.english_sentence: You finished everything already and then ask me how to do it, isn't that just doing something redundant?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經走咗，你而家先嚟道歉，真係上得床嚟掀被冚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2, nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 dou6 hip3, zan1 hai6 soeng5 dak1 cong4 lai4 hin1 bei6 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经走了，你现在才来道歉，真是多此一举。
examples.english_sentence: He's already left, and you're apologizing now, it's really a pointless gesture.

synonyms: 畫蛇添足 (waak6 se4 tim1 zuk1)
事後孔明 (si6 hau6 hung2 ming4)

jyutping: soeng5 dak1 cong4 lei4 hin1 bei6 ham2
english_meaning: To pretend to be innocent or reluctant after already benefiting; to kick away the ladder once you've climbed up; to pretend reluctance after already gaining an advantage; to be hypocritical after receiving a benefit.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻得到好处后反而装作不愿意或不知情的样子，含有讽刺意味。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who pretends to be reluctant or innocent after already receiving a benefit or advantage. It carries a sarcastic tone, implying hypocrisy or opportunism. It's akin to kicking away the ladder once you've climbed to the top or pretending you didn't want something after you've already obtained it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明攞晒着數，仲要喺度上得牀嚟掀被冚，真係令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 lo2 saai3 zoek3 sou3, zung6 jiu3 hai2 dou6 soeng5 dak1 cong4 lei4 hin1 bei6 ham2, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明占尽了便宜，还要在这里得了便宜还卖乖，真是令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly took all the advantages, and now he's pretending to be reluctant after already benefiting. It's really disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好上得牀嚟掀被冚啦，大家都知你升職係靠關係嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 soeng5 dak1 cong4 lei4 hin1 bei6 ham2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 sing1 zik1 hai6 kaau3 gwaan1 hai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别得了便宜还卖乖了，大家都知道你升职是靠关系的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend you didn't want it. Everyone knows you got promoted because of your connections.

english_meaning: to take to heart; to pay attention to; to put one's heart into; to be concerned about
explanation_mandarin: 指把某件事情放在心上，非常在意，认真对待。
explanation_english: Refers to taking something to heart, paying close attention to it, and treating it seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好上心呢份工㗎，日日都OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng5 sam1 ni1 fan6 gung1 gaa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很在意这份工作，每天都加班。
examples.english_sentence: He really takes this job to heart; he works overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢我會上心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 ngo5 wui5 soeng5 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的话我会放在心上的。
examples.english_sentence: I will take what you said to heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁上心嘅，輕鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 soeng5 sam1 ge3, hing1 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么在意，轻松一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to take it so seriously, relax a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 开始；着手；容易掌握；之前的；熟练
english_meaning: to start; to begin; to get started; easy to learn; previous; experienced; skillful
explanation_mandarin: 1. 开始，着手：指开始做某事。2. 容易掌握：指学习或操作起来比较容易。 3. 之前的：指上一个，上一次。4. 熟练：指对某项技能非常熟练，经验丰富。
explanation_english: 1. To start, to begin: Refers to starting to do something. 2. Easy to learn: Refers to something that is easy to learn or operate. 3. Previous: Refers to the previous one, the last time. 4. Experienced, skillful: Refers to being very skilled at something, with a lot of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project聽日要上手做喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng2 sau2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目明天就要开始做了。
examples.english_sentence: This project needs to be started tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個software好快上手，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 software hou2 faai3 soeng2 sau2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个软件很容易上手，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: This software is easy to learn, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上手個同事做咗好耐，經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 sau2 go3 tung4 si6 zou6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ging1 jim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 之前的那个同事做了很久，经验很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: The previous colleague worked for a long time and has a lot of experience.

mandarin_meaning: 上手；比自己资历老或地位高的人
english_meaning: Senior; someone more experienced or in a higher position than oneself; one's boss/superior
explanation_mandarin: 指资历较老，经验较丰富或职位较高的人。类似于“前辈”，“老手”，“上司”。
explanation_english: Refers to someone with more seniority, experience, or a higher position than oneself. Similar to 'senior', 'veteran', or 'boss'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿輝係我哋嘅上把，有咩唔識都可以問佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 fai1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 soeng6 baa2, jau5 me1 m4 sik1 dou1 ho2 ji5 man6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿辉是我们的上司，有什么不懂的都可以问他。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Fai is our boss, you can ask him anything you don't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗呢行咁耐，都算係上把嚟㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 ni1 hang4 gam3 noi6, dou1 syun3 hai6 soeng6 baa2 lai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这行这么久，也算是前辈了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in this industry for so long, he can be considered a senior figure.

synonyms: 大佬 (daai6 lou2) - Big brother (in a company context, often referring to a senior colleague or boss)

english_meaning: Dominant position; to take the upper hand; to be in charge
explanation_mandarin: 指在群体或组织中占据主导、控制或有利的位置。 也指在竞争或博弈中取得优势。
explanation_english: Refers to a dominant, controlling, or advantageous position within a group or organization. It can also mean gaining an advantage in a competition or game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想喺公司攞到上把位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 hai2 gung1 si1 lo2 dou2 soeng6 baa2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想在公司获得主导地位。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to gain a dominant position in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢場談判入面，我哋一定要攞到上把位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 coeng4 taam4 paan3 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lo2 dou2 soeng6 baa2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这场谈判中，我们一定要取得优势。
examples.english_sentence: In this negotiation, we must gain the upper hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑住佢嘅實力，成功上位，攞到上把位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pang4 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 sat6 lik6, sing4 gung1 soeng5 wai2, lo2 dou2 soeng6 baa2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他凭借他的实力，成功上位，获得了主导地位。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully climbed up the ladder and gained a dominant position with his strength.

english_meaning: top row; above; on top of
explanation_mandarin: 指在垂直方向上靠上的位置或排列。
explanation_english: Refers to the top position or arrangement in a vertical direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲書擺喺上排嘅架上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu1 baai2 hai2 soeng6 paai4 ge3 gaa2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些书摆在上面一排的架子上。
examples.english_sentence: The books are placed on the shelves in the top row.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺戲院坐上排，睇得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hei3 yun2 co5 soeng6 paai4, tai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在电影院坐在上面几排，看得非常清楚。
examples.english_sentence: We sat in the top rows at the cinema, and we could see very clearly.

english_meaning: to rise; to go up; to increase; to turn upwards (e.g., corners of the mouth into a smile); to raise
explanation_mandarin: 指位置、数量、程度等的向上升或提高。也指嘴角向上翘起。
explanation_english: Refers to a rise or increase in position, quantity, or degree. It can also refer to the corners of the mouth turning upwards, often indicating a smile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司嘅業績不斷上揚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 jik1 bat1 dyun6 soeng5 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的业绩不断上升。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's performance is constantly rising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到好消息，佢嘴角微微上揚。

examples.english_sentence: Hearing the good news, the corners of his mouth turned up slightly.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近房价又开始上涨了。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, housing prices have started to rise again.

english_meaning: to report upwards; to tally up; to count up
explanation_mandarin: 有两种含义。一种是指向上级汇报情况。另一种是指清点数目。
explanation_english: Has two meanings. One is to report a situation to a superior. The other is to tally up or count numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將呢件事上數畀老細知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 ni1 gin6 si6 soeng5 sou3 bei2 lou5 sai3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把这件事向上汇报给老板知道。
examples.english_sentence: We need to report this matter to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我上數吓啲貨，睇下啱唔啱數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 soeng5 sou3 haa5 di1 fo3, tai2 haa5 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我点算一下这些货，看看数量对不对。
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me tally up these goods to see if the numbers are correct?

english_meaning: above, the preceding text, previous passage
explanation_mandarin: 指前面的文章或内容。
explanation_english: Refers to the preceding text or content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以參考返上文嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 caam1 kaau2 faan1 soeng6 man4 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以参考上文的资料。
examples.english_sentence: We can refer back to the information in the preceding text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正如上文所講，呢個方法係有效嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng2 jyu4 soeng6 man4 so2 gong2, ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hai6 jau5 haau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正如上文所说，这个方法是有效的。
examples.english_sentence: As mentioned above, this method is effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上文提到嘅問題，我哋會盡快解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 man4 tai4 dou2 ge3 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 wui5 zeon6 faai3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上文提到的问题，我们会尽快解决。
examples.english_sentence: We will resolve the problems mentioned in the previous passage as soon as possible.

english_meaning: Context; Coherence; Logical Connection; Sense
explanation_mandarin: 指文章或说话的上下文逻辑和条理，也指事情的来龙去脉，前因后果。
explanation_english: Refers to the logical connection and coherence of the context of an article or speech. Also refers to the ins and outs, causes and consequences of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢冇上文下理，我聽唔明佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 soeng6 man4 haa6 lei5, ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话没有逻辑，我听不明白他想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's not speaking coherently. I can't understand what he's trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫文章要注重上文下理，先可以清楚表達你嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 man4 zoeng1 jiu3 zyu3 zung6 soeng6 man4 haa6 lei5, sin1 ho2 ji5 cing1 co2 biu2 daat6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写文章要注重上下文的逻辑，才可以清楚地表达你的意思。
examples.english_sentence: When writing an article, you should pay attention to the context so you can clearly express your meaning.

english_meaning: to go uphill; uphill
explanation_mandarin: 指向上坡路行走或处于斜坡之上。
explanation_english: Refers to moving upwards on a slope or being on an incline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車上斜好慢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 soeng5 ce4 hou2 maan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车上坡好慢啊！
examples.english_sentence: This car is so slow going uphill!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路好上斜，踩單車好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 soeng5 ce4, caai2 daan1 ce1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很陡，骑自行车很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: This road is very steep uphill, it's hard to ride a bicycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行咗好多上斜路，好攰呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng5 ce4 lou6, hou2 gui6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走了很多上坡路，好累啊！
examples.english_sentence: We walked a lot of uphill roads, so tiring!

english_meaning: last time, previous time, the other day
explanation_mandarin: 指不久前发生的事情，相当于“上次”、“上回”。
explanation_english: Refers to something that happened not long ago, equivalent to 'last time', 'the other day', or 'previously'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上日我去咗睇戲，好好睇呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 jat6 ngo5 heoi3 zo2 tai2 hei3, hou2 hou2 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次我去看电影了，很好看啊！
examples.english_sentence: I went to see a movie the other day, it was really good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上日先見過佢咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 jat6 sin1 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上次才见过他。
examples.english_sentence: I only saw him the other day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上日話想食海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 jat6 waa6 soeng2 sik6 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次说想吃海鲜。
examples.english_sentence: He said the other day that he wanted to eat seafood.

english_meaning: the first ten days of a month
explanation_mandarin: 每个月的前十天。
explanation_english: The first ten days of a month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋上旬會交貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng6 ceon4 wui5 gaau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们上旬会交货。
examples.english_sentence: We will deliver the goods in the first ten days of the month.

english_meaning: to show (a film); to release (a film)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影或戏剧等公开播映。同普通话。
explanation_english: To release or show a film publicly. Same meaning as in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲下個禮拜就上映啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 soeng5 jing2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影下个星期就要上映了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie will be released next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好期待呢套戲上映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 kei5 doi6 ni1 tou3 hei3 soeng5 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常期待这部电影上映。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really looking forward to this movie being released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅新戲上映咗幾日，票房都好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 hei3 soeng5 jing2 zo2 gei2 jat6, piu3 fong2 dou1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的新电影上映了几天，票房都很好。
examples.english_sentence: Their new movie has been released for a few days and the box office is doing very well.

english_meaning: morning (late morning, roughly 9am-12pm)
explanation_mandarin: 指上午时段，通常指较晚的上午，大概是早上九点到中午十二点之间的时间。
explanation_english: Refers to the late morning period, generally from around 9am to 12pm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上晝要去銀行搞啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 zau3 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 gaau2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上午要去银行办点事情。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the bank to handle some things this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上晝返工遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 zau3 faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上午上班迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: He was late for work this morning.

english_meaning: to take out a loan (especially for a car or property); to arrange financing; hire purchase
explanation_mandarin: 指申请贷款或分期付款，通常用于购买汽车或房地产等大额商品。
explanation_english: Refers to applying for a loan or hire purchase, usually for large purchases like cars or properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部新車，要上會先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ce1, jiu3 soeng5 wui2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆新车，需要贷款才行。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car, he needs to take out a loan first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇足夠嘅現金，就唯有上會買樓喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 mou5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 hin6 gam1, zau6 wai4 jau5 soeng5 wui2 maai5 lau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有足够的现金，就只能贷款买房了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't have enough cash, you can only buy a house with a mortgage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想上會，寧願儲多幾年錢先買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 soeng5 wui2, ning4 jyun2 chu5 do1 gei2 nin4 cin2 sin1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想贷款，宁愿多存几年钱再买。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to take out a loan, I'd rather save money for a few more years before buying.

synonyms: 按揭 (on3 git3) - mortgage (more specific to property)

english_meaning: last month
explanation_mandarin: 指刚刚过去的月份。
explanation_english: Refers to the month that has just passed.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个月搬了新家。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to a new house last month.

english_meaning: To attend the imperial court (said of emperors and officials in feudal China)
explanation_mandarin: 古代皇帝和官员去朝廷处理政事。
explanation_english: To attend the imperial court; refers to the act of emperors and officials attending the imperial court to handle state affairs in feudal China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲皇帝日日都要上朝㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 wong4 dai3 jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 soeng5 ciu4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的皇帝每天都要上朝的。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, emperors had to attend the imperial court every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想好似以前啲官員咁，每日上朝噉樣為國家服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 di1 gun1 jyun4 gam2, mui5 jat6 soeng5 ciu4 gam2 joeng2 wai6 gwok3 gaa1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想像以前的官员那样，每天上朝一样为国家服务。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to serve the country like the officials in the past, attending the imperial court every day.

english_meaning: last issue; previous period; last term
explanation_mandarin: 指之前的某一期，例如杂志、报纸的上一期；也指上一个时期或阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the previous issue, such as the last issue of a magazine or newspaper; it also refers to the previous period or stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇咗上期本雜誌，幾好睇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 zo2 soeng6 kei4 bun2 zaap6 zi3, gei2 hou2 tai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看了上一期的杂志，挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: I read the last issue of the magazine, it was pretty good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上期嘅考試我考得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 kei4 ge3 haau2 si5 ngo5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次的考试我考得不好。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well on the last exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上期彩票我冇中獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 kei4 coi2 piu3 ngo5 mou5 zung3 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上一期彩票我没有中奖。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't win the lottery last time.

english_meaning: to be put on shelves; to be launched (product); to be released (film, song, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 将商品放到货架上；指新产品或作品发布、上市。
explanation_english: To place goods on shelves for sale; to launch or release a new product, film, song, etc.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新的游戏明天就要上架了。
examples.english_sentence: This new game will be released tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲生果今日啱啱上架，好新鮮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saang1 gwo2 gam1 jat6 ngaam1 ngaam1 soeng5 gaa2, hou2 san1 sin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水果今天刚上架，很新鲜的。
examples.english_sentence: These fruits were just put on the shelves today, they are very fresh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隻新歌幾時上架啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zek3 san1 go1 gei2 si4 soeng5 gaa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的新歌什么时候发布啊？
examples.english_sentence: When will their new song be released?

english_meaning: Colonel
explanation_mandarin: 军衔，高于中校，低于准将。
explanation_english: A military rank above lieutenant colonel and below brigadier general; colonel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位上校，喺軍隊入面好有地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 soeng6 haau6, hai2 gwan1 deoi2 jap6 min6 hou2 jau5 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位上校，在军队里很有地位。
examples.english_sentence: He is a colonel, he has a high position in the army.

english_meaning: to be on a list; to make the list; to rank; to be selected; to be successful (e.g., in an exam)
explanation_mandarin: 指在名单上出现，或在比赛、考试中取得好的成绩而入选。
explanation_english: To be included on a list, to succeed in a competition or examination and be selected; to achieve a ranking on a list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到第一名，當然上榜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, dong1 jin4 soeng5 bong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了第一名，当然上榜了。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place, of course he's on the list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅評分好高，所以成日都上榜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ping3 fan1 hou2 gou1, so2 ji5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng5 bong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的评分很高，所以经常上榜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has very high ratings, so it's often on the list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌好hit，一定上到流行榜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 hou2 hit3, jat1 ding6 soeng5 dou2 lau4 hang4 bong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌很火，肯定能上流行榜。
examples.english_sentence: His song is very popular, it's sure to make the charts.

jyutping: soeng5 loeng4 bat1 zing3 haa6 loeng4 waai1
english_meaning: If the upper beam is crooked, the lower beam will be askew; the example set by superiors is followed by subordinates.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在上的人行为不正，下面的人也跟着做坏事。指上梁不正，下梁必然歪。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where superiors or leaders set a bad example, leading their subordinates to behave improperly or follow suit. It emphasizes the importance of leadership and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日偷雞摸狗，啲伙記咪上樑不正下樑歪囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2, di1 fo2 gei2 mai1 soeng5 loeng4 bat1 zing3 haa6 loeng4 waai1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是偷奸耍滑，员工们自然是上梁不正下梁歪了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always cutting corners and being sneaky, so the employees naturally follow his bad example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥嘅行為好受父母影響，如果父母品行唔好，就好容易上樑不正下樑歪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 sau6 fu6 mou5 jing2 hoeng2, jyu4 gwo2 fu6 mou5 ban2 hang6 m4 hou2, zau6 hou2 jung4 ji6 soeng5 loeng4 bat1 zing3 haa6 loeng4 waai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子的行为很大程度上受父母影响，如果父母品行不好，就很容易上梁不正下梁歪。
examples.english_sentence: Children's behavior is greatly influenced by their parents. If the parents' character is not good, it is very easy for the upper beam to be crooked and the lower beam to be askew.

english_meaning: To go upstairs; To go to someone's apartment; (In the context of housing) To move into a bigger/better apartment
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“上楼”，指从楼下到楼上。也可以指去某人的公寓。在香港，也常用来指搬入更大的、更好的公寓。
explanation_english: Literally means "to go upstairs." Can refer to going from downstairs to upstairs. It can also mean to go to someone's apartment. In Hong Kong, it is also commonly used to refer to moving into a larger or better apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋上去佢屋企上樓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seung5 heoi3 keoi5 uk1 kei2 soeng5 lau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去他家上楼吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go upstairs to his apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發咗達，終於可以上樓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 zo2 daat6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 soeng5 lau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发财了，终于可以搬到更好的公寓了。
examples.english_sentence: They got rich and can finally move into a better apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行樓梯上樓，當做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 lau1 tai1 soeng5 lau2, dong3 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走楼梯上楼，当做运动。
examples.english_sentence: Take the stairs up, consider it exercise.

english_meaning: last time
explanation_mandarin: 指之前的一次，最近的一次。
explanation_english: Refers to a previous time, the most recent time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋上次喺邊度見㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng6 ci3 hai2 bin1 dou6 gin3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们上次在哪里见的？
examples.english_sentence: Where did we meet last time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次你講過話要請我食飯，唔知幾時有時間呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 nei5 gong2 gwo3 waa6 jiu3 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 jau5 si4 gaan3 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次你说过要请我吃饭，不知道什么时候有时间呢？
examples.english_sentence: Last time you said you'd treat me to a meal, I wonder when you'll have time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次考試佢考得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 haau2 si5 keoi5 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次考试他考得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He did very well in the last exam.

english_meaning: Salutation (in formal writing, such as letters or scrolls); the name/title written at the beginning of a letter/scroll before the main content; the recipient's name in a formal greeting.
explanation_mandarin: 书信、卷轴等正式文书抬头处的称谓，即收信人的姓名或职称。
explanation_english: The salutation at the beginning of formal documents like letters or scrolls, specifically the recipient's name or title.

examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 lei6 si6 ge3 soeng6 fun2 se2 bin1 go3 ming4 hou2 ne1?

examples.english_sentence: Whose name should I write on the salutation of the red envelope?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫揮春嘅時候，上款通常會寫啲吉祥嘅字句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 fai1 ceon1 ge3 si4 hau6, soeng6 fun2 tung1 soeng4 wui5 se2 di1 gat1 cheung4 ge3 zi6 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写挥春的时候，抬头通常会写一些吉祥的字句。
examples.english_sentence: When writing Fai Chun (Chinese New Year decorations), the salutation usually contains auspicious phrases.

examples.english_sentence: The salutation of this letter is unclear, I don't know who to send it to.

jyutping: soeng6 hei3 m4 zip3 haa6 hei3

explanation_mandarin: 形容呼吸急促、困难，上气不接下气。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being out of breath, panting heavily, and having difficulty breathing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步之後，我上氣唔接下氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 soeng6 hei3 m4 zip3 haa6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步以后，我气喘吁吁。
examples.english_sentence: After running, I was out of breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行咗幾層樓梯，已經上氣唔接下氣喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 zo2 gei2 cang4 lau4 tai1, ji5 ging1 soeng6 hei3 m4 zip3 haa6 hei3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了几层楼梯，已经气喘吁吁了。
examples.english_sentence: He was already out of breath after walking up a few flights of stairs.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dak1 taai3 faai3, gaau2 dou3 soeng6 hei3 m4 zip3 haa6 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说得太快了，搞得气喘吁吁的。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke so fast that he was out of breath.

english_meaning: to go to Sheung Shui (a town in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 前往香港的上水地區。
explanation_english: To go to the Sheung Shui area in Hong Kong's New Territories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要上水搞啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 seoi2 gaau2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去上水办点事。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to Sheung Shui tomorrow to handle some things.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 soeng5 seoi2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去上水买东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to Sheung Shui to buy things.

english_meaning: upper class; high society; refined
explanation_mandarin: 指社会地位高、经济条件好、生活方式精致的人群或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to people or things of high social status, good economic conditions, and refined lifestyles; upper class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企好有錢，係上流社會嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hou2 jau5 cin2, hai6 soeng6 lau4 se5 wui2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家很有钱，是上流社会的人。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very rich, they are people from high society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅興趣都好上流，例如聽古典音樂同埋去藝術展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 dou1 hou2 soeng6 lau4, lai6 jyu4 ting1 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6 tung4 ma4 heoi3 ngai6 seot6 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的兴趣爱好都很上流，例如听古典音乐和去艺术展览。
examples.english_sentence: His hobbies are very refined, such as listening to classical music and going to art exhibitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修好靚，食物又精緻，俾人一種好上流嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 hou2 leng3, sik6 mat6 jau6 zing1 zi3, bei2 jan4 jat1 zung2 hou2 soeng6 lau4 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修很漂亮，食物又精致，给人一种很上流的感觉。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is beautifully decorated and the food is exquisite, giving people a very high-class feeling.

english_meaning: to miss out, to make a fool of oneself, to be embarrassed, to screw up
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，指错过机会、丢脸、出丑或者把事情搞砸。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang. To miss an opportunity, to be embarrassed, to make a fool of oneself, or to screw things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，尋日我唔記得帶文件，搞到喺老闆面前上海咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aai1, cam4 jat6 ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 man4 gin2, gaau2 dou3 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 soeng6 hoi2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，昨天我忘了带文件，结果在老板面前丢脸了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh, yesterday I forgot to bring the documents, which made me embarrass myself in front of my boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺台上講嘢，我一時口快快，真係上海咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 toi4 soeng6 gong2 je5, ngo5 jat1 si4 hau2 faai3 faai3, zan1 hai6 soeng6 hoi2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在台上讲话，我一时口快，真是出丑了。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking on stage just now, I spoke too fast, I really made a fool of myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搞啦，再搞落去就上海㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 laa1, zoi3 gaau2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 soeng6 hoi2 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再弄了，再弄下去就要搞砸了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with it anymore, if you keep messing with it, you'll screw it up!

english_meaning: upstream; upper reaches (of a river); figuratively, advanced position; higher level
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是河流的上部。比喻领先的地位或较高的水平。
explanation_english: Literally, the upper part of a river. Figuratively, it refers to a leading position or a higher level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司喺科技方面一直都喺上游。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 fo1 gei6 fong1 min6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai2 soeng6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司在科技方面一直处于上游。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has always been at the forefront of technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺呢個行業做上游份子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 zou6 soeng6 jau4 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在这个行业成为领先人物。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be a leading figure in this industry.

english_meaning: superior broth; high-quality stock
explanation_mandarin: 用多种食材（如鸡、鸭、猪肉、火腿等）长时间熬制而成的高级汤品，味道鲜美浓郁，常用于烹饪高档菜肴。
explanation_english: A superior broth or high-quality stock made by simmering various ingredients such as chicken, duck, pork, and ham for a long time. It has a rich and flavorful taste and is often used in high-end cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個上湯浸時蔬好鮮甜呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng6 tong1 zam3 si4 syu1 hou2 sin1 tim4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个上汤浸时蔬好鲜甜呀！
examples.english_sentence: This seasonal vegetables poached in superior broth are so fresh and sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅上湯龍蝦伊麵好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 soeng6 tong1 lung4 haa1 ji1 min6 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的上汤龙虾伊面很有名的。
examples.english_sentence: Their braised e-fu noodles with lobster in superior broth are very famous.

english_meaning: to trace back to; to date back to
explanation_mandarin: 向上追寻根源、历史或原因。
explanation_english: To trace back to the origin, history, or cause of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個習俗可以上溯到幾百年前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaap6 suk1 ho2 ji5 soeng5 sok3 dou3 gei2 baak3 nin4 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个习俗可以追溯到几百年前。
examples.english_sentence: This custom can be traced back hundreds of years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要上溯返歷史嘅源頭，先可以了解佢嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 soeng5 sok3 faan1 lik6 si2 ge3 jyun4 tau4, sin1 ho2 ji5 liu5 gaai2 keoi5 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要追溯到历史的源头，才可以了解它的发展。
examples.english_sentence: We need to trace back to the origin of history in order to understand its development.

english_meaning: to stage (a play); to perform; to enact; to put on a show; to play out; to unfold
explanation_mandarin: 指戏剧、电影等开始演出，也指某种情况、事件发生或发展。
explanation_english: Refers to the performance of a play, movie, etc. It can also refer to the occurrence or development of a situation or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日戲院會上演一齣新戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hei3 yun2 wui5 soeng5 jin2 jat1 ceot1 san1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天电影院将会上演一部新戏。
examples.english_sentence: A new movie will be staged at the cinema tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺街頭上演咗一幕鬧劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 gaai1 tau4 soeng5 jin2 zo2 jat1 mok6 naau6 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在街头上演了一幕闹剧。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them staged a farce on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史正喺度上演緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 zing3 hai2 dou6 soeng5 jin2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史正在上演。
examples.english_sentence: History is unfolding.

english_meaning: to rise, to go up, to increase (in price, amount, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指价格、数量等向上升。
explanation_english: Refers to an increase in price, quantity, or other values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲菜價上漲得好犀利呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 dik1 coi3 gaa3 soeng5 zoeng2 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近菜价涨得非常厉害啊。
examples.english_sentence: The price of vegetables has increased significantly recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 油價又上漲喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 gaa3 jau6 soeng5 zoeng2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 油价又上涨了！
examples.english_sentence: The price of petrol has gone up again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓價不斷上漲，好難買樓呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 gaa3 bat1 dyun6 soeng5 zoeng2, hou2 naan4 maai5 lau4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价不断上涨，很难买房啊。
examples.english_sentence: House prices are constantly rising, it's difficult to buy a house.

english_meaning: to go to bed
explanation_mandarin: 指睡觉，到床上。
explanation_english: To go to bed, to get into bed to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好眼瞓啊，想即刻上牀瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3 aa3, soeng2 zik1 hak1 soeng5 cong4 fan3 gaau3.

examples.english_sentence: I'm so sleepy, I want to go to bed and sleep right away.
