examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上班，早点上床睡觉吧。
examples.english_sentence: You have to go to work tomorrow, go to bed early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，已經上咗牀休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, ji5 ging1 soeng5 zo2 cong4 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，已经上床休息了。
examples.english_sentence: He is sick and has already gone to bed to rest.

english_meaning: to go to work; to start work; to be on duty
explanation_mandarin: 指开始工作或到工作地点。
explanation_english: To go to work; to start one's working day; to be on duty at one's workplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝朝九點上班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ciu1 ciu1 gau2 dim2 soeng5 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天早上九点上班。
examples.english_sentence: I go to work at nine o'clock every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日幾點上班啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gei2 dim2 soeng5 baan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天几点上班啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time do you go to work today?

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 beng6 zo2, so2 ji5 mou5 soeng5 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天病了，所以没上班。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick yesterday, so he didn't go to work.

english_meaning: working class; office workers; people who go to work
explanation_mandarin: 指每天需要上班工作的人群。
explanation_english: Refers to the group of people who work every day, typically in office settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多都係上班一族，生活壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 soeng5 baan1 jat1 zuk6, sang1 wut6 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多人都是上班族，生活压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: Many people in Hong Kong are working class, and the pressure of life is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係上班一族，放工咪想輕鬆下囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 soeng5 baan1 jat1 zuk6, fong3 gung1 mai6 soeng2 hing1 sung1 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是上班族，下班就想放松一下嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We're all working class, so we just want to relax after work.

english_meaning: office worker, working class
explanation_mandarin: 指以办公室工作为主要工作方式的群体，通常是白领。
explanation_english: Refers to people whose primary work style involves working in an office, typically white-collar workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅上班族生活壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 soeng5 baan1 zuk6 sang1 wut6 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的上班族生活压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: Office workers in Hong Kong face a lot of pressure in their lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係上班族，放工之後想輕鬆吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 soeng5 baan1 zuk6, fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 soeng2 hing1 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是上班族，下班后想放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: We are all office workers, we want to relax after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多上班族都帶飯返公司食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 soeng5 baan1 zuk6 dou1 daai3 faan6 faan1 gung1 si1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多上班族都带饭回公司吃。
examples.english_sentence: Many office workers bring their own lunch to eat at the company.

english_meaning: Sheung Wan (a district in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港岛的一个地区名称，位于中环的西边。
explanation_english: A district on Hong Kong Island, located west of Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去上環買啲海味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 soeng6 waan4 maai5 di1 hoi2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去上环买一些海味。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Sheung Wan tomorrow to buy some dried seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上環有好多舊樓同埋傳統嘅舖頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 waan4 jau5 hou2 do1 gau6 lau2 tung4 maai4 cyun4 tung2 ge3 pou3 tau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上环有很多老旧的楼房和传统的店铺。
examples.english_sentence: Sheung Wan has a lot of old buildings and traditional shops.

english_meaning: to be released (film), to open (movie)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影开始在电影院放映。
explanation_english: Refers to a film being released and screened in cinemas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲幾時上畫呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 si4 soeng5 waa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影什么时候上映啊？
examples.english_sentence: When is this movie going to be released?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好期待呢套戲上畫，聽講好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 ni1 tou3 hei3 soeng5 waa2, teng1 gong2 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很期待这部电影上映，听说很好看。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really looking forward to this movie being released, I heard it's really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日上畫嘅戲，今日已經好多人討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 soeng5 waa2 ge3 hei3, gam1 jat6 ji5 ging1 hou2 do1 jan4 to2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天上映的电影，今天已经很多人讨论了。
examples.english_sentence: The movie that was released yesterday is already being discussed by many people today.

english_meaning: to be fooled; to be taken in; to be duped; to be deceived
explanation_mandarin: 指受到欺骗，信以为真，从而导致损失或不利。
explanation_english: To be deceived or tricked into believing something that is not true, resulting in loss or disadvantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁易上當啦，呢啲擺明係詐騙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 ji6 soeng5 dong3 laa1, ni1 di1 baai2 ming4 hai6 zaa3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易上当啦，这些明显是诈骗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easily fooled, these are clearly scams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上次買咗啲假嘢，真係上咗大當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 ci3 maai5 zo2 di1 gaa2 je5, zan1 hai6 soeng5 zo2 daai6 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上次买了一些假货，真是上了大当。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some fake goods last time, I was really taken for a ride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到天花龍鳳咁，好彩我冇上當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 tin1 faa1 lung4 fung6 gam2, hou2 coi2 ngo5 mou5 soeng5 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说得天花乱坠的，幸好我没有上当。
examples.english_sentence: He/She talked about it so extravagantly, luckily I wasn't fooled.

english_meaning: to become addicted; to get hooked on
explanation_mandarin: 指对某种事物产生强烈的依赖性，难以摆脱。
explanation_english: To become addicted to something; to develop a strong habit or dependency on something, making it difficult to stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇咗呢套劇之後上咗癮，日日都追。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 zo2 ni1 tou3 kek6 zi1 hau6 soeng5 zo2 jan5, jat1 jat1 dou1 zeoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看了这部剧之后就上瘾了，每天都追。
examples.english_sentence: I got hooked on this drama after watching it, and I'm following it every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到上癮，乜都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 soeng5 jan5, mat1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打游戏打到上瘾，什么都不管了。
examples.english_sentence: He's addicted to playing video games and doesn't care about anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食辣嘢好容易上癮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 laat6 je5 hou2 jung4 ji6 soeng5 jan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃辣的东西很容易上瘾的。
examples.english_sentence: Eating spicy food is very easy to get addicted to.

mandarin_meaning: 上半场; 上限; 看好
english_meaning: First half (of a sports game); Upper limit/maximum; To be optimistic about; To favour (a team or outcome in gambling/sports)
explanation_mandarin: （1）体育比赛中的上半场。（2）指事物的上限或最高限额。（3）在赌博或体育比赛中，看好某一方，认为其胜算较大。
explanation_english: (1) First half of a sports game. (2) The upper limit or maximum amount of something. (3) In gambling or sports, to be optimistic about a certain team or outcome; to favour them to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上半場踢成點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 bun3 coeng4 tek3 sing4 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上半场踢成什么样了？
examples.english_sentence: How did the first half go?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗上盤，希望贏錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 soeng5 pun4, hei1 mong6 weng4 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了上半场赢，希望赢钱。
examples.english_sentence: He bet on the first half (team) to win, hoping to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢已經係上盤啦，冇得再高㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 ji5 ging1 hai6 soeng5 pun4 laa1, mou5 dak1 zoi3 gou1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格已经是上限了，不能再高了。
examples.english_sentence: This price is already the maximum; it can't get any higher.

english_meaning: To be deified; to be put on a pedestal; to be idealized or glorified (often unrealistically)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指把神像放到神台上供奉。现在多用来比喻把某人或某事物过分美化或理想化，使之超越实际情况，受到不应有的崇拜。
explanation_english: Originally referring to placing a deity on an altar for worship. Now, it is often used metaphorically to describe the act of idealizing or glorifying someone or something excessively, surpassing the actual situation, and receiving undue worship or admiration. It implies an unrealistic or exaggerated view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將佢上神枱啦，佢都係普通人啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 keoi5 soeng5 san4 toi2 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别把他捧上神坛了，他也只是个普通人而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put him on a pedestal. He's just an ordinary person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲媒體成日將啲明星上神枱，搞到佢哋好似乜都識噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mei4 tai2 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 di1 ming4 sing1 soeng5 san4 toi2, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 mat1 dou1 sik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体总是把明星捧上神坛，搞得他们好像什么都懂一样。
examples.english_sentence: The media always puts celebrities on a pedestal, making them seem like they know everything.

mandarin_meaning: 被供奉起来；过誉；被神化
english_meaning: To be placed on the altar; to be overly praised; to be deified; to be idealized after death or retirement
explanation_mandarin: 本意是把某物或某人放在神台上供奉。引申义为过分赞扬或神化某人或事物，通常指在某人去世或退休后，对其评价过高，将其理想化。
explanation_english: Literally means to place something or someone on an altar for worship. Figuratively, it means to overly praise or deify someone or something, often referring to the exaggerated and idealized evaluation of someone after their death or retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退咗休之後，啲人就開始將佢上神檯，講到佢好似完美嘅聖人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 zo2 jau1 zi1 hau6, di1 jan4 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zoeng1 keoi5 soeng5 san4 toi2, gong2 dou3 keoi5 hou2 chi5 wan4 mei5 ge3 sing3 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，人们就开始把他神化，把他说的好像完美的圣人一样。
examples.english_sentence: After he retired, people started to deify him, talking about him as if he were a perfect saint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快將佢上神檯啦，等我哋睇多一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 zoeng1 keoi5 soeng5 san4 toi2 laa1, dang2 ngo5 dei6 tai2 do1 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快把他捧上天，让我们再观察一段时间。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put him on a pedestal so quickly, let's observe for a while longer.

mandarin_meaning: 天空; 上方; 空中
english_meaning: sky; above; overhead; air
explanation_mandarin: 指天空，上方或空中。
explanation_english: Refers to the sky, above, or the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機喺我哋嘅上空飛過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 soeng6 hung1 fei1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机在我们上空飞过。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane flew over us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋見到有隻雀仔喺上空盤旋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2 hai2 soeng6 hung1 pun4 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们看到有一只鸟在空中盘旋。
examples.english_sentence: We saw a bird hovering in the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋嘅上空唔可以起高樓大廈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu4 ge3 soeng6 hung1 m4 ho2 ji5 hei2 gou1 lau4 daai6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桥的上方不能建高楼大厦。
examples.english_sentence: High-rise buildings cannot be built above the bridge.

mandarin_meaning: 上等, 优质, 优等
english_meaning: superior, first-class, top-grade, high-quality
explanation_mandarin: 指品质、等级非常高，属于最好的。
explanation_english: Refers to something of very high quality or rank, belonging to the best category.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食材都係上等貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 coi4 dou1 hai6 soeng6 dang2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食材都是上等货。
examples.english_sentence: The ingredients in this restaurant are all top-grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅英文水平真係上等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jing1 man4 seoi2 ping4 zan1 hai6 soeng6 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语水平真是上等。
examples.english_sentence: His English proficiency is truly top-notch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車係上等嘅歐洲車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 hai6 soeng6 dang2 ge3 au1 zau1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车是上等的欧洲车。
examples.english_sentence: This car is a high-quality European car.

english_meaning: best policy; best course of action; optimal strategy
explanation_mandarin: 最好的办法；最好的策略。
explanation_english: The best policy or strategy to follow; the most optimal course of action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家咁嘅情況，走為上策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 gam2 ge3 cing4 fong3, zau2 wai4 soeng6 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这种情况，走是最好的办法。
examples.english_sentence: Given the current situation, running away is the best course of action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到危險嘅時候，冷靜思考係上策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 ngai4 him2 ge3 si4 hau6, laang5 zing6 si1 kaau3 hai6 soeng6 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到危险的时候，冷静思考是上策。
examples.english_sentence: When encountering danger, thinking calmly is the best strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要解決呢個問題，尋求專家嘅意見係上策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, cam4 kiu4 zhun1 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3 hai6 soeng6 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要解决这个问题，寻求专家的意见是上策。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to solve this problem, seeking expert advice is the best policy.

english_meaning: worth it, worthwhile, cost-effective, a good deal
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事或某物是划算的，值得做的。表示付出之后能够得到相应的或者超过预期的回报。
explanation_english: Refers to something being worth it, worthwhile, or cost-effective. It indicates that the return on investment or effort is equal to or exceeds expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢都幾上算嘅，買啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 dou1 gei2 soeng6 syun3 ge3, maai5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价钱还挺划算的，买吧！
examples.english_sentence: This price is quite a good deal, buy it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做義工雖然冇錢，但係都好上算，可以幫到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ji6 gung1 seoi1 jin4 mou5 cin2, daan6 hai6 dou1 hou2 soeng6 syun3, ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做义工虽然没钱，但是也很值得，可以帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: Although volunteering doesn't pay, it's still very worthwhile because you can help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家買樓上算唔上算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 maai5 lau2 soeng6 syun3 m4 soeng6 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在买房划算不划算啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is it worth it to buy a house now?

english_meaning: to make a layup (in basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 篮球运动中，一种靠近篮筐的投篮方式，通常指运球后跳起，单手将球放入篮筐。
explanation_english: In basketball, a shot taken close to the basket, typically involving dribbling, jumping, and using one hand to shoot the ball into the hoop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日練上籃，想比賽嘅時候入多啲波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lin6 soeng5 laam4, soeng2 bei2 coi3 ge3 si4 hau6 jap6 do1 di1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都练习上篮，想比赛的时候多进几个球。
examples.english_sentence: He practices layups every day, hoping to score more points during the game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個上籃好靚，幾乎每次都入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 soeng5 laam4 hou2 leng3, gei2 fu1 mui5 ci3 dou1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的上篮很漂亮，几乎每次都进。
examples.english_sentence: His layup is very skillful, he scores almost every time.

english_meaning: to apply foundation (makeup)
explanation_mandarin: 指在脸上涂抹粉底，用于化妆。
explanation_english: Refers to applying foundation makeup to the face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都上粉沙打先出街嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 soeng5 fan2 saa1 daa2 sin1 ceot1 gaai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都打粉底才出门。
examples.english_sentence: She applies foundation every day before going out.

english_meaning: superior; higher level; boss; senior
explanation_mandarin: 指在组织机构中级别较高的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing of a higher rank or level in an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅上級嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 soeng6 kap1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们的上级。
examples.english_sentence: He is our superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得要尊重上級呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 soeng6 kap1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得要尊重上级啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to respect your superiors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向上級匯報呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoeng3 soeng6 kap1 wui6 bou3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向上级汇报这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to report this matter to our superiors.

english_meaning: to escalate a minor issue to a political or ideological level; to blow things out of proportion; to make a mountain out of a molehill (with political or ideological implications)
explanation_mandarin: 指将小事、个人行为或言论提升到政治、意识形态的高度进行批判或解读，带有夸大和过度解读的意味。
explanation_english: To escalate a minor issue, personal behavior, or statement to the level of politics or ideology for criticism or interpretation. It implies exaggeration and over-interpretation, often with political or ideological motivations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁上綱上線啦，佢只係講笑啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 soeng5 gong1 soeng5 sin3 laa1, keoi5 zi2 hai6 gong2 siu3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么上纲上线啦，他只是开玩笑而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't escalate things so much, he was just joking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好容易上綱上線，講嘢真係要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 jung4 ji6 soeng5 gong1 soeng5 sin3, gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人很容易上纲上线，说话真的要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: People nowadays easily escalate things, you really need to be careful when you speak.

synonyms: 小題大作 (siu2 tai4 daai6 zok3)
無限上綱 (mou4 haan6 soeng5 gong1)

english_meaning: to go online, to surf the internet
explanation_mandarin: 指连接到互联网，浏览网页、使用在线服务等活动。
explanation_english: To connect to the internet and browse websites, use online services, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日放工都上網睇下新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 fong3 gung1 dou1 soeng5 mong5 tai2 haa5 san1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天下班都上网看看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: I go online to read the news every day after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日上網，小心用多咗數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 soeng5 mong5, siu2 sam1 yung6 do1 zo2 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是上网，小心用了太多数据。
examples.english_sentence: You're always online, be careful you don't use too much data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲學生好多時間都係上網打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hok6 sang1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 dou1 hai6 soeng5 mong5 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的学生很多时间都在上网玩游戏。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many students spend a lot of time playing games online.

english_meaning: is doing; is in the process of; currently (doing something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示正在进行某个动作或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state is currently in progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上緊堂，陣間覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng5 gan2 tong4, zan6 gaan1 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在上课，一会儿回复你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in class right now, I'll reply to you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上緊廁所，唔得閒聽電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 gan2 ci3 so2, m4 dak1 haan4 teng1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在上厕所，没空接电话。
examples.english_sentence: He's in the bathroom right now, he's not free to answer the phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機上緊load，要等一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 soeng5 gan2 load, jiu3 dang2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器正在加载，要等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: The machine is loading, you have to wait a while.

english_meaning: to go online, to log on, online
explanation_mandarin: 指连接到互联网，或将服务、产品等置于互联网上运行。也可指在网络上活跃的状态。
explanation_english: To connect to the internet, to log on. It can also refer to bringing a service, product, etc. online. It can also refer to the state of being active online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏啲會上線同你傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 di1 wui5 soeng5 sin3 tung4 nei5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚点会上线和你聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go online and chat with you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻新game聽日上線，好期待呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 san1 geim1 ting1 jat6 soeng5 sin3, hou2 kei5 doi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个新游戏明天上线，好期待啊！
examples.english_sentence: The new game is going online tomorrow, I'm really looking forward to it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掛住上線打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 soeng5 sin3 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天想着上线打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about going online to play games.

english_meaning: to hand over to a higher authority, to turn in, to submit (funds, documents, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 把物品、金钱等交给上级或有关部门。
explanation_english: To hand over something (money, documents, etc.) to a superior or relevant department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要將所有錢上繳公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 so2 jau5 cin2 soeng5 gok3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要把所有的钱上交给公司。
examples.english_sentence: They have to hand over all the money to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得上繳份報告啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 soeng5 gok3 fan6 bou3 gou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得上交这份报告啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to submit the report.

english_meaning: (Cantonese phonology) rising tone (tone 2)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语声调之一，指从较低音调升高的声调。是粤语六个声调中的第二个（阴上）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese phonology, '上聲' (soeng5 seng1) refers to the rising tone, also known as tone 2 (high rising tone). It describes a pitch that rises from a lower to a higher level. It is one of the six tones of Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「我」字係上聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi6 hai6 soeng5 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “我”字是上声。
examples.english_sentence: The character "我" is in the rising tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你學緊粵語嘅九聲六調，要分清楚平上去入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hok6 gan2 jyut6 jyu5 ge3 gau2 seng1 luk6 diu6, jiu3 fan1 cing1 co2 ping4 soeng5 heoi3 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你正在学粤语的九声六调，要分清楚平上去入。
examples.english_sentence: You are learning the nine tones and six registers of Cantonese. You need to distinguish between level, rising, departing, and entering tones.

english_meaning: upper limb, upper extremity
explanation_mandarin: 指人体的胳膊，包括肩、肘、腕等部位。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper part of the human body, including the shoulder, elbow, wrist, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打籃球嘅時候整親咗上肢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 laam4 kau4 ge3 si4 hau6 zing2 can1 zo2 soeng6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打篮球的时候伤到了上肢。
examples.english_sentence: He injured his upper limb while playing basketball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舉高手可以鍛鍊上肢嘅肌肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi2 gou1 sau2 ho2 ji5 duen3 lin6 soeng6 zi1 ge3 gei1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 举高手可以锻炼上肢的肌肉。
examples.english_sentence: Raising your arms can exercise the muscles of your upper limbs.

mandarin_meaning: 入迷, 着迷, 上瘾
english_meaning: To be obsessed, to be consumed by a thought/idea/feeling, to get stuck in one's head, to be fixated
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事或想法占据了你的头脑，使你难以摆脱，甚至影响你的行为和判断。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where something, an idea, or a feeling occupies your mind to the point where it's difficult to get rid of, and it might even affect your behavior and judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到上晒腦，咩都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 soeng5 saai3 nou5, me1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌到完全着迷，什么都不管了。
examples.english_sentence: He's completely obsessed with gambling, and doesn't care about anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 首歌好洗腦，聽完之後成日上腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 go1 hou2 sai2 nou5, teng1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 soeng5 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很洗脑，听完之后经常在脑海里挥之不去。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very catchy; it's always stuck in my head after listening to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住呢件事，諗到上晒腦都冇用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 ni1 gin6 si6, nam2 dou3 soeng5 saai3 nou5 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着这件事，想得太入迷也没有用啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep thinking about this; it's no use being obsessed with it.

english_meaning: to go on stage; to come into power; to take office; (of food) to be served
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指演员或表演者登上舞台进行表演。2. 指某人开始执政或担任重要职位。3.（食物）上菜。
explanation_english: 1. To go on stage, referring to a performer commencing a performance. 2. To come into power, take office or assume an important position. 3. (Of food) To be served (at a restaurant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要上臺表演唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚要上台表演唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He's going on stage to sing tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅政府上臺之後，推出咗好多新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 zing3 fu2 soeng5 toi4 zi1 hau6, tui1 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政府上台之后，推出了很多新政策。
examples.english_sentence: After the new government came into power, they introduced many new policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲餸未上臺，我哋再等等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sung3 mei6 soeng5 toi4, ngo5 dei6 zoi3 dang2 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜还没上，我们再等等。
examples.english_sentence: The dishes haven't been served yet, let's wait a bit longer.

english_meaning: Upper bunk (of a bunk bed)
explanation_mandarin: 指上下铺中的上层床位。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper bunk of a bunk bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞓上舖，你瞓下舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan3 soeng6 pou3, nei5 fan3 haa6 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我睡上铺，你睡下铺。
examples.english_sentence: I'll sleep on the upper bunk, you sleep on the lower bunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我成日都想瞓上舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 fan3 soeng6 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我总是想睡上铺。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I always wanted to sleep on the upper bunk.

mandarin_meaning: 上颜色; 给...着色; 涂色; 形容受诱惑、被教唆
english_meaning: to color; to paint; to dye; to influence (someone negatively); to incite; to corrupt (someone); to give someone ideas (often negative ones)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 涂颜色，上色。2. 比喻受诱惑，被教唆。
explanation_english: 1. To apply color, to paint, to dye. 2. Figuratively, to be influenced negatively, to be incited or corrupted, to be given bad ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫幅畫上色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 fuk1 waa2 soeng5 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给这幅画上色。
examples.english_sentence: He's coloring this painting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢上色，佢諗埋啲衰嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 soeng5 sik1, keoi5 nam2 maai4 di1 seoi1 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他教唆你，他只会想一些坏事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him influence you; he only thinks of bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾班損友上咗色，而家成日都唔返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 baan1 syun2 jau5 soeng5 zo2 sik1, ji4 gaa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被那些坏朋友教唆了，现在经常不回家。
examples.english_sentence: He has been corrupted by those bad friends, and now he often doesn't come home.

mandarin_meaning: 担任学生会干部；竞选学生会职位
english_meaning: To take up a position in a student society executive committee; to run for election to a student society executive committee.
explanation_mandarin: 指在大学或学院中，学生参加学生会或学会的选举并成功当选，成为该组织的管理人员之一。也指参与竞选学生会或学会职位的过程。
explanation_english: In universities or colleges, '上莊' refers to the process of running for and successfully being elected to a position on the executive committee of a student society or union. It can also refer to the act of running for such a position, regardless of whether one is elected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年都想上莊，服務吓同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 dou1 soeng2 soeng5 zong1, fuk6 mou6 haa5 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年也想竞选学生会职位，服务一下同学。
examples.english_sentence: I want to run for a position in the student union next year to serve my fellow students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年上咗莊，做宣傳嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 soeng5 zo2 zong1, zou6 syun1 cyun4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年当选了学生会干部，负责宣传工作。
examples.english_sentence: He was elected to the student union this year, and he is in charge of publicity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上莊真係好忙，但係都好有意義嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 zong1 zan1 hai6 hou2 mong4, daan6 hai6 dou1 hou2 jau5 ji3 ji6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 担任学生会干部真的很忙，但是也很有意义。
examples.english_sentence: Being on the student union is really busy, but it's also very meaningful.

english_meaning: to serve dishes (in a restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 饭店、餐厅等把做好的菜端上来。
explanation_english: To serve dishes (in a restaurant setting). Refers to the action of bringing the cooked dishes to the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姐，快啲上菜啦，我哋好肚餓呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je1, faai3 di1 soeng5 coi3 laa1, ngo5 dei6 hou2 tou5 ngo6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员，快点上菜吧，我们很饿啊！
examples.english_sentence: Waiter, please serve the dishes quickly, we are very hungry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，都仲未上菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 zung1 mei6 soeng5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了这么久，都还没上菜。
examples.english_sentence: We've waited so long, and the food still hasn't been served.

english_meaning: tens of thousands; upwards of ten thousand
explanation_mandarin: 表示超过一万的数量，但不一定是确切的数字。
explanation_english: Indicates a quantity exceeding ten thousand, but not necessarily an exact number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅員工上萬人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 waan4 gung1 soeng6 maan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司有上万名员工。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has tens of thousands of employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個演唱會嘅門票炒到上萬蚊一張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 mun4 piu3 caau2 dou3 soeng6 maan6 man1 jat1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个演唱会的门票炒到上万元一张。
examples.english_sentence: Tickets for this concert have been scalped for upwards of ten thousand dollars each.

english_meaning: to go up and down; to get on and off (a vehicle); to load and unload
explanation_mandarin: 表示从高处到低处或从低处到高处的动作； 也指上下车，装卸货物等。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of going from a high place to a low place or vice versa. It can also refer to getting on and off a vehicle, loading and unloading goods, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士站喺斜路度，上落好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zaam6 hai2 ce4 lou6 dou6, soeng5 lok6 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 巴士站是在斜坡上，上下车很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: The bus stop is on a slope, it's tiring to get on and off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲工人喺度上落貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gung1 jan4 hai2 dou6 soeng5 lok6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人们正在装卸货物。
examples.english_sentence: The workers are loading and unloading goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭地鐵上落都幾多人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dei6 tit3 soeng5 lok6 dou1 gei2 do1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乘坐地铁上下车的人都挺多的。
examples.english_sentence: There are quite a lot of people getting on and off the subway.

english_meaning: to pick up and drop off passengers
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆在某个地方让乘客上车和下车。
explanation_english: Refers to a vehicle allowing passengers to get on and off at a specific location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士站唔可以隨便上落客㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zaam6 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 soeng5 lok6 haak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公共汽车站不可以随便上下客的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just pick up and drop off passengers anywhere at a bus stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 的士喺路邊上落客係好平常嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik1 si2 hai2 lou6 bin1 soeng5 lok6 haak3 hai6 hou2 ping4 soeng4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出租车在路边上下客是很平常的事情。
examples.english_sentence: It's quite normal for taxis to pick up and drop off passengers on the roadside.

english_meaning: Cover; Lid; Superstructure (of a building, often referring to the part built above an existing structure)
explanation_mandarin: 指覆盖在物体上面的盖子，也可指建筑物上方加建的部分，例如地铁站或巴士站上方的住宅或商业楼宇。
explanation_english: Refers to a cover or lid placed on top of something. It can also refer to the superstructure of a building, particularly residential or commercial buildings built above transportation hubs like subway stations or bus terminals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個煲冇上蓋，好易彈油㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bou1 mou5 soeng6 goi3, hou2 ji6 taan4 jau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个锅没有盖子，很容易溅油的。
examples.english_sentence: This pot doesn't have a lid, it's easy for oil to splatter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地鐵站上蓋發展咗好多住宅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 soeng6 goi3 faat3 zin2 zo2 hou2 do1 zyu6 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地铁站上盖开发了很多住宅。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of residential buildings have been developed above this subway station.

english_meaning: to tighten screws; to get your act together; to get things in order; to pull yourself together
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拧紧螺丝钉。引申意义是指让人打起精神，认真对待事物，或者整理好思绪和状态，做好准备。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to tighten a screw. Figuratively, it means to tell someone to get their act together, to focus, to become more disciplined, or to get things in order. It can also mean to mentally prepare oneself or others for a task or challenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁求其啦，上螺絲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 kau4 gei2 laa1, soeng5 lo4 si1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么随便，认真一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless in your work, get your act together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試喇，你快啲上螺絲溫書啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si3 laa3, nei5 faai3 di1 soeng5 lo4 si1 wan1 syu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要考试了，你快点好好复习吧！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, you better pull yourself together and study!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽就嚟開始，大家上螺絲，一定要贏！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zau6 lei4 hoi1 ci2, daai6 gaa1 soeng5 lo4 si1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 wing4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛就要开始了，大家打起精神，一定要赢！
examples.english_sentence: The competition is about to begin, everyone focus and let's win!

english_meaning: to go shopping; to go out in the street; to take to the streets (for a protest, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 外出到街道上，通常指去购物、逛街或者参加示威游行等活动。
explanation_english: To go out onto the streets, usually to go shopping, stroll around, or participate in demonstrations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日上街買嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 soeng5 gaai1 maai5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去逛街买东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go shopping tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人上街示威，反對政府嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 soeng5 gaai1 si6 wai1, faan2 doi3 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人上街示威，反对政府的政策。
examples.english_sentence: Many people took to the streets to protest against the government's policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都上街，好鍾意行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng5 gaai1, hou2 zung1 ji3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是上街，很喜欢逛街。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes out shopping; he really likes strolling around.

english_meaning: upper garment, top
explanation_mandarin: 指穿在上半身的衣服，例如衬衫、T恤等。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing worn on the upper body, such as shirts, T-shirts, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件上衣幾靚喎，邊度買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 soeng6 ji1 gei2 leng3 wo3, bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件上衣挺漂亮的，在哪儿买的？
examples.english_sentence: This top is quite nice, where did you buy it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日著咗件白色嘅上衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 baak6 sik1 ge3 soeng6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天穿了一件白色的上衣。
examples.english_sentence: I wore a white top today.

english_meaning: top (clothing), upper garment
explanation_mandarin: 指穿在上半身的衣服，如衬衫、毛衣、外套等。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing worn on the upper body, such as shirts, sweaters, jackets, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件上裝幾靚喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 soeng6 zong1 gei2 leng3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件上衣真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: This top is so pretty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗好多新嘅上裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 soeng6 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了好多新的上衣。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lot of new tops today.

english_meaning: appeal
explanation_mandarin: 指向上一级法院提出诉讼，请求重新审理。
explanation_english: To apply to a higher court for a reversal of the decision of a lower court; to make an appeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對判決唔滿意，決定上訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 pun3 gyut3 m4 mun5 yi3, kyut3 ding6 soeng5 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对判决不满意，决定上诉。
examples.english_sentence: He was not satisfied with the verdict and decided to appeal.

english_meaning: Appellant, Petitioner
explanation_mandarin: 指对法院判决或裁定不服，依法提起上诉的人。
explanation_english: The party who appeals a decision to a higher court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上訴人認為原審判決證據不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 sou3 jan4 jing6 wai4 jyun4 sam2 pun3 kyut3 zing3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上诉人认为原审判决证据不足。
examples.english_sentence: The appellant believes that the evidence in the original trial was insufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今次案件嘅上訴人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 ci3 on3 gin2 ge3 soeng5 sou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这次案件的上诉人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the appellant in this case.

english_meaning: Court of Appeal
explanation_mandarin: 指可以对下级法院判决提出上诉的法庭。
explanation_english: Refers to a court where appeals from lower courts are heard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔滿意高等法院嘅判決，決定上訴去上訴庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 mun5 ji3 gou1 dang2 faat3 jyun2 ge3 pun3 kyut3, kyut3 ding6 soeng5 sou3 heoi3 soeng5 sou3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不满意高等法院的判决，决定上诉到上诉法庭。
examples.english_sentence: He was not satisfied with the High Court's ruling and decided to appeal to the Court of Appeal.

english_meaning: Court of Appeal
explanation_mandarin: 处理上诉案件的法院。
explanation_english: A court that hears appeals from lower courts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定將呢單案上訴到上訴法庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zoeng1 ni1 daan1 on3 soeng5 sou3 dou3 soeng5 sou3 faat3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定将这件案子上诉到上诉法院。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to appeal this case to the Court of Appeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上訴法庭推翻咗初級法院嘅判決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 sou3 faat3 ting4 teoi1 faan1 zo2 co1 kap1 faat3 yun2 ge3 pun3 gyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上诉法院推翻了初级法院的判决。
examples.english_sentence: The Court of Appeal overturned the judgment of the lower court.

english_meaning: to try; to test; to give it a go
explanation_mandarin: 尝试做某事；进行试验，看看效果如何。
explanation_english: To attempt to do something; to try out or test something to see its effect or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知點解壞咗，我上試下整啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 dim2 gai2 waai6 zo2, ngo5 soeng5 si3 haa5 zing2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道为什么坏了，我试一下修理吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why it's broken. I'll try to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新產品，你想唔想上試下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 caan2 ban2, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 soeng5 si3 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新产品，你想不想尝试一下？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to try out this new product?

english_meaning: to attend class, to go to class, to start class
explanation_mandarin: 指去学校或参加课程学习。
explanation_english: To attend classes or take courses for study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要上課，唔得閒同你出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 fo3, m4 dak1 haan4 tung4 nei5 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要上课，没空和你出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: I have classes tomorrow, I don't have time to go out with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每日朝早八點半就上課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 bun3 zau6 soeng5 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天早上八点半就上课。
examples.english_sentence: They start classes at 8:30 every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上緊邊個老師嘅課啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 gan2 bin1 go3 lou5 si1 ge3 fo3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你正在上哪个老师的课啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which teacher's class are you attending?

english_meaning: to adjust upwards; to raise; to increase; to upgrade
explanation_mandarin: 向上调整，提高。
explanation_english: To adjust upwards, increase, or upgrade something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定上調所有員工嘅薪金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 soeng6 diu6 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 ge3 san1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定上调所有员工的薪金。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to increase the salaries of all employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於通脹，銀行要上調利率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 tung1 zoeng3, ngan4 hong4 jiu3 soeng6 diu6 lei6 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于通货膨胀，银行要上调利率。
examples.english_sentence: Due to inflation, the bank needs to raise the interest rate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋部門嘅預算上調咗百分之十。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4 ge3 jyu6 syun3 soeng6 diu6 zo2 baak3 fan1 zi1 sap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们部门的预算上调了百分之十。
examples.english_sentence: Our department's budget has been increased by ten percent.

english_meaning: to stock up, to replenish stock, to put goods on shelves
explanation_mandarin: 指商家或店铺购进货物并摆放到货架或销售区域。
explanation_english: Refers to merchants or stores purchasing goods and placing them on shelves or in sales areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要上貨，今晚要早啲瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 fo3, gam1 maan5 jiu3 zou2 di1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要进货，今晚要早点睡。
examples.english_sentence: We need to stock up tomorrow, so I need to sleep earlier tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨啱啱上咗貨咋，仲未擺好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 ngaam1 ngaam1 soeng5 zo2 fo3 zaa3, zung6 mei6 baai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货刚刚才上架，还没摆好。
examples.english_sentence: These goods have just been stocked, they haven't been arranged properly yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姐，幫手上貨啦，唔夠人手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je1, bong1 sau2 soeng5 fo3 laa1, m4 gau3 jan4 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨，帮忙上货吧，人手不够啊！
examples.english_sentence: Auntie, please help with stocking, we don't have enough manpower!

english_meaning: honored guest, VIP
explanation_mandarin: 指受到高度尊重和款待的客人，通常是社会地位较高或对主办方有重要意义的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a highly respected and well-treated guest, usually someone of high social status or of significant importance to the host.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好招待呢位上賓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 ziu1 doi6 ni1 wai2 soeng6 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要好好招待这位贵宾。
examples.english_sentence: We must treat this honored guest very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將佢當做上賓噉款待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 keoi5 dong3 zou6 soeng6 ban1 gam2款 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把他当作贵宾来招待。
examples.english_sentence: They treated him as a VIP.

mandarin_meaning: 出发; 顺利; 开窍
english_meaning: to set off; to get on the road; to be on the right track; to get the hang of something; to be sensible
explanation_mandarin:
1. 出发，开始行程。
2. 形容事情进展顺利，进入正轨。
3. 形容人开窍，变得懂事或明白事理。
explanation_english:
1. To set off on a journey, to depart.
2. To describe something progressing smoothly and getting on the right track.
3. To describe someone becoming enlightened, sensible, or understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽朝七點就上路喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 ziu1 cat1 dim2 zau6 soeng5 lou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天早上七点就出发了。
examples.english_sentence: We're setting off at 7 am tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好快就上路，好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 zau6 soeng5 lou6, hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很快就上手，很棒的。
examples.english_sentence: He gets the hang of his work very quickly, he's great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路終於上路，唔再咁曳喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 zung1 jyu1 soeng5 lou6, m4 zoi3 gam3 jai6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那孩子终于懂事了，不再那么顽皮了。
examples.english_sentence: The child has finally become sensible and is no longer so naughty.

mandarin_meaning: 附身；穿上（上半身的衣服）；惹麻烦
english_meaning: possessed; to be taken over (by a spirit); to put on (upper body clothing); to implicate
explanation_mandarin: 1. (迷信) 指鬼神附在人身上。 2. 穿上（上半身的衣服）。 3. 比喻事情牵涉到某人，引申为惹麻烦。
explanation_english: 1. (Superstition) To be possessed by a spirit or deity. 2. To put on (clothing for the upper body). 3. Figuratively, to implicate someone in a matter, implying getting them into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢俾鬼上身，行為好怪異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 bei2 gwai2 soeng5 san1, hang4 wai4 hou2 gwaai3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他被鬼附身了，行为很怪异。
examples.english_sentence: He said he was possessed by a ghost, and his behavior was very strange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲上身件衫，凍親就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 soeng5 san1 gin6 saam1, dung3 can1 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点穿上衣服，冻着了就不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: Put your clothes on quickly, it's not good if you catch a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢咁麻煩，唔好搞到我上身啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gam3 maa4 faan4, m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 soeng5 san1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么麻烦，别扯上我啊！
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so troublesome, don't get me involved!

mandarin_meaning: 赶上（某种机会、潮流等）; 买房
english_meaning: To get on board (a trend, opportunity); To buy property (especially one's first property)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为上车，引申为抓住机会，特别是投资机会，也常用于指购买房产，特别是第一次买房。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to get on a vehicle'. It is often used metaphorically to mean 'to get on board' with a trend, opportunity (especially investment opportunities).  It frequently refers to buying property, particularly one's first property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓價咁貴，我都唔知幾時先可以上車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 ho2 ji5 soeng5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价这么贵，我都不知道什么时候才能买房。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices are so expensive, I don't know when I'll be able to buy a property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻股票升得咁勁，你上咗車未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 sing1 dak1 gam3 ging6, nei5 soeng5 zo2 ce1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支股票涨得这么厉害，你赶上了吗？（你买了吗？）
examples.english_sentence: This stock is rising so rapidly, have you gotten on board yet? (Have you bought it yet?)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想上車就快啲決定啦，唔好諗咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 soeng5 ce1 zau6 faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 laa1, m4 hou2 lam2 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想买房就快点决定吧，不要想那么多。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to buy a property, make a decision quickly, don't think too much.

mandarin_meaning: 走上正轨; 步入正轨
english_meaning: to be on the right track; to be on track; to be running smoothly; to be in order
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情或工作开始步入正常或顺利的轨道。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a situation or work that is starting to run normally or smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 盤生意做咗幾年，終於上軌道喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pun4 seng1 ji3 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4, zung1 jyu1 soeng5 gwai2 dou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意做了几年，终于走上正轨了。
examples.english_sentence: This business has been running for a few years, and it's finally on the right track.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃開始咗幾個月，而家總算上軌道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 hoi1 chi2 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, ji4 gaa1 zung2 syun3 soeng5 gwai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划开始了几个月，现在总算步入正轨了。
examples.english_sentence: The project started a few months ago, and it's finally on track now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等啲嘢上返軌道，我哋就可以放鬆啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 di1 je5 soeng5 faan1 gwai2 dou6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等事情回到正轨，我们就可以放松一点了。
examples.english_sentence: Once things are back on track, we can relax a bit.

english_meaning: to upload
explanation_mandarin: 指将数据（如文件、照片、视频等）从本地设备传输到远程服务器或网络的过程。
explanation_english: To transfer data (such as files, photos, videos, etc.) from a local device to a remote server or network.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想上載啲相上網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 soeng5 zoi3 di1 soeng3 soeng5 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想上传一些照片到网上。
examples.english_sentence: I want to upload some photos online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上載咗份報告未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 zoi3 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上传了报告了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you uploaded the report yet?

english_meaning: close to, near to, approaching
explanation_mandarin: 指时间或距离上接近某个点或某个时刻。
explanation_english: Refers to being close to a certain point or moment in time or distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就上近中秋節啦，好快又有得放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 soeng6 gan6 zung1 cau1 zit3 laa1, hou2 faai3 jau6 jau5 dak1 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就快到中秋节了，很快又能放假了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is almost Mid-Autumn Festival, soon we can have holidays again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企上近地鐵站，好方便嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 soeng6 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6, hou2 fong1 bin6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家靠近地铁站，很方便的。
examples.english_sentence: My home is close to the MTR station, it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅年紀上近五十歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nin4 gei2 soeng6 gan6 ng5 sap6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的年龄接近五十岁。
examples.english_sentence: He is approaching fifty years old.

english_meaning: aforementioned, above-mentioned, aforesaid
explanation_mandarin: 指前面提到过的事物或情况。
explanation_english: Referring to something mentioned previously; above-mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上述嘅問題都好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seung6 seot6 ge3 man6 tai4 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上述的问题都很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The aforementioned problems are all very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會根據上述嘅結果嚟決定下一步點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 gan1 geoi3 seung6 seot6 ge3 git3 gwo2 lai4 kyut3 ding6 haa6 jat1 bou6 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会根据上述的结果来决定下一步怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: We will decide what to do next based on the above-mentioned results.

english_meaning: last week
explanation_mandarin: 指刚刚过去的一周。
explanation_english: Refers to the week that has just passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上週去咗香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 zau1 heoi3 zo2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上周去了香港。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Hong Kong last week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上週落咗成個禮拜雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 zau1 lok6 zo2 seng4 go3 lai5 baai3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上周下了一个星期的雨。
examples.english_sentence: It rained for a whole week last week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上週考完試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 zau1 haau2 jyun4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上周考完试了。
examples.english_sentence: He finished his exams last week.

english_meaning: motivated, ambitious, aspiring
explanation_mandarin: 指努力向上，积极进取，有追求和目标。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is motivated, ambitious, and strives for improvement and progress; someone who has goals and aspirations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好上進㗎，日日都努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng5 zeon3 gaa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很上进，每天都努力学习。
examples.english_sentence: He is very motivated, studying hard every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望我嘅仔女個個都咁上進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ngo5 ge3 zai2 neoi5 go3 go3 dou1 gam2 soeng5 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望我的孩子们都这么上进。
examples.english_sentence: I hope all my children are so motivated.

english_meaning: ambition, drive, aspiration, motivation to improve
explanation_mandarin: 积极进取，努力提升自己，追求更高成就的愿望。
explanation_english: The desire to actively improve oneself and strive for greater achievements; ambition, drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有上進心，日日都好勤力咁讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 soeng5 zeon3 sam1, jat1 jat1 dou1 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有上进心，每天都很努力地读书。
examples.english_sentence: He's very ambitious and studies diligently every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想成功，就一定要有上進心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 sing4 gung1, zau6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 soeng5 zeon3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想成功，就一定要有上进心。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to be successful, you must have ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司需要啲有上進心嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 di1 jau5 soeng5 zeon3 sam1 ge3 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司需要一些有上进心的员工。
examples.english_sentence: This company needs employees with ambition.

english_meaning: to report to a higher authority, to convey upwards
explanation_mandarin: 向上级或有关部门报告、传达情况或意见。
explanation_english: To report or convey information, opinions, or situations to a higher authority or relevant department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一定要將呢件事上達畀老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoeng1 ni1 gin6 si6 soeng5 daat6 bei2 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要把这件事汇报给老板。
examples.english_sentence: You must report this matter to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會將你嘅意見上達畀有關部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 soeng5 daat6 bei2 jau5 gwaan1 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会把你的意见传达给有关部门。
examples.english_sentence: I will convey your opinions to the relevant department.

english_meaning: above; on top; upper part
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置在上方的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a location that is above or on top.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺枱上邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 soeng6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书在桌子上面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is on top of the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個天花板上邊有啲灰塵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 tin1 faa1 baan2 soeng6 bin1 jau5 di1 fui1 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天花板上面有一些灰尘。
examples.english_sentence: There is some dust on the ceiling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將份文件放咗喺你個櫃上邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 fan6 man4 gin2 fong3 zo2 hai2 nei5 go3 gwai6 soeng6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把文件放在了你的柜子上面。
examples.english_sentence: I put the document on top of your cabinet.

english_meaning: to be hooked (literally and figuratively); to fall for something; to be taken in; to be duped
explanation_mandarin: 本意指鱼被钓上钩。 引申义指人被欺骗、迷惑，中了圈套。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to be hooked' (as in fishing). Figuratively, it means to be tricked, deceived, or fooled into doing something; to fall for a scam or trap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，一定會上釣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, jat1 ding6 wui5 soeng5 diu3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么笨，肯定会上当的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he'll definitely fall for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我差啲就上釣，好彩醒覺咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 caa1 di1 zau6 soeng5 diu3, hou2 coi2 sing2 gok3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我差点就上当了，幸好醒悟了。
examples.english_sentence: I almost fell for it, luckily I woke up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易上釣呀，呢啲明顯係騙局嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 soeng5 diu3 aa3, ni1 di1 ming4 hin2 hai6 pin3 guk6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易上当啊，这些明显是骗局来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fall for it so easily, these are obviously scams.

english_meaning: to wind up (a mechanical device), to get wound up (emotionally), to become agitated or worked up
explanation_mandarin: 原本指给机械装置上发条，使其运转。引申指情绪变得激动、紧张或焦虑。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to winding up a mechanical device to make it work. By extension, it means becoming emotionally agitated, tense, or anxious. It can also be used literally for winding up toys or other mechanical devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易上錬，放鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 soeng5 lin2, fong3 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么容易激动，放松点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get so easily worked up, relax a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日買咗個上錬嘅玩具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 soeng5 lin2 ge3 wun6 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天买了一个上发条的玩具。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a wind-up toy yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講親呢件事就上錬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 can1 ni1 gin6 si6 zau6 soeng5 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一提到这件事就激动起来。
examples.english_sentence: He gets worked up whenever he talks about this.

mandarin_meaning: 上发条; 准备好; 启动
english_meaning: To wind up (a clockwork mechanism); to get wound up (emotionally); to be ready; to be prepared; to get going; to initiate
explanation_mandarin: 原指给机械装置（如钟表）上发条。引申指为某种活动或行动做好准备，或形容情绪变得激动兴奋。
explanation_english: Originally refers to winding up a mechanical device like a clockwork watch. By extension, it means to prepare for an activity or action, or to describe becoming emotionally excited or agitated. Can also mean to initiate or get going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試，我今晚要上鍊溫書喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si3, ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 soeng5 lin2 wan1 syu1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要考试了，我今晚要好好准备复习了。
examples.english_sentence: I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to be prepared and study hard tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講起足球就上晒鍊咁，講唔停嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 hei2 zuk1 kau4 zau6 soeng5 saai3 lin2 gam2, gong2 m4 ting4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一说起足球就兴奋得不得了，说个不停。
examples.english_sentence: He gets so wound up and excited when talking about football, he can't stop talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要上鍊開始做嘢喇，唔好再拖啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 soeng5 lin2 hoi1 ci2 zou6 je5 laa3, m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得开始工作了，别再拖延了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to get going and start working, let's not procrastinate anymore.

english_meaning: to lock (something)
explanation_mandarin: 将锁锁上。
explanation_english: To fasten with a lock; to lock something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得出門口嘅時候要上鎖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 chut1 mun4 hau2 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 soeng5 so2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得出门的时候要上锁啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door when you go out!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚有人入嚟偷嘢，所以上鎖咗道門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 jau5 jan4 jap6 lai4 tau1 je5, so2 ji5 soeng5 so2 zo2 dou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕有人进来偷东西，所以锁了门。
examples.english_sentence: I was afraid someone would come in to steal, so I locked the door.

mandarin_meaning: 上发条; 拧紧发条; 机械启动
english_meaning: To wind up (a clockwork mechanism); to wind up (a person), to get someone going, to excite or agitate someone
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指给机械装置（如钟表）上发条，使其能够运转。 2. 比喻使人兴奋、激动或开始行动。
explanation_english: 1. Literally, to wind up a clockwork mechanism, such as a watch or toy. 2. Figuratively, to wind up a person, meaning to excite them, agitate them, or get them started on something, often in a playful or teasing way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺仲係用上鏈嘅手錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 zung6 hai6 yung6 soeng5 lin2 ge3 sau2 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷还在用上发条的手表。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather still uses a wind-up watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日上鏈佢，佢會當真㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 soeng5 lin2 keoi5, keoi5 wui5 dong3 zan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是逗他，他会当真的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wind him up all the time, he'll take it seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一講起政治就俾人上咗鏈咁，停都停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gong2 hei2 zing3 zi6 zau6 bei2 jan4 soeng5 zo2 lin2 gam2, ting4 dou1 ting4 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一谈起政治就像上了发条一样，停也停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: Once they start talking about politics, they're like they've been wound up, they can't stop.

english_meaning: to be photogenic; to look good on camera/screen
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物在外貌上适合拍照或录像，在照片或视频中看起来比实际更好看。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something that looks good in photos or videos, often looking better on camera/screen than in real life. It implies being visually appealing when captured by a camera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好上鏡，拍戲一定好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng5 geng3, paak3 hei3 jat1 ding6 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很上相，拍戏一定好看。
examples.english_sentence: She's very photogenic, she'll definitely look good acting in movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅相機好勁，影乜都好上鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 soeng3 gei1 hou2 ging6, ying2 mat1 dou1 hou2 soeng5 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机的相机很厉害，拍什么都很好看。
examples.english_sentence: This phone's camera is great, everything looks good on camera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真人仲靚過上鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 jan4 zung6 leng3 gwo3 soeng5 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真人比照片还漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She's even prettier in person than she is on camera.

english_meaning: to call on; to visit; to go to someone's home
explanation_mandarin: 到别人家去；亲自去拜访。
explanation_english: To visit someone at their home; to make a house call; to go to someone's door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日會上門幫我整電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 soeng5 mun4 bong1 ngo5 zing2 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天会上门帮我修电脑。
examples.english_sentence: He will come to my place tomorrow to help me fix the computer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日叫我得閒上門探下佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 dak1 haan4 soeng5 mun4 taam3 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是叫我有空上门看看她。
examples.english_sentence: My mother always tells me to visit her when I have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多推銷員上門賣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 tui1 siu1 jyun4 soeng5 mun4 maai6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多推销员上门卖东西。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, many salespeople are coming to the door to sell things.

english_meaning: upper limit; ceiling; cap
explanation_mandarin: 指最高的限度，最高的界限。
explanation_english: The highest limit; the upper bound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀我哋嘅預算上限係五萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 soeng6 haan6 hai6 ng5 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给我们的预算上限是五万元。
examples.english_sentence: The company's budget limit for us is fifty thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位嘅年薪上限係一百萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 ge3 nin4 san1 soeng6 haan6 hai6 jat1 baak3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职位的年薪上限是一百万。
examples.english_sentence: The annual salary ceiling for this position is one million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅信用咭簽賬額都有上限㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 seon3 jung6 kaat1 cim1 zoeng3 ngaak2 dou1 jau5 soeng6 haan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的信用卡签账额也是有上限的。
examples.english_sentence: Your credit card spending limit also has a ceiling.

english_meaning: to go into battle, to enter the field, to take the stage, to go into action, to step up (to a challenge)
explanation_mandarin: 指上战场、出场比赛、开始行动或面对挑战。
explanation_english: Refers to going into battle, entering a competition, starting an action, or facing a challenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就到我上陣比賽喇，好緊張呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 dou3 ngo5 soeng5 zan6 bei2 coi3 laa3, hou2 gan2 zoeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就轮到我上场比赛了，好紧张啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's my turn to compete tomorrow, I'm so nervous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅project好重要，要你親自上陣先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 project hou2 cung5 jiu3, jiu3 nei5 can1 zi6 soeng5 zan6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的企划很重要，要你亲自出马才行。
examples.english_sentence: This project is very important, you have to take the field yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗解決呢個問題，佢決定親自上陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 can1 zi6 soeng5 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了解决这个问题，他决定亲自出马。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, he decided to step up himself.

jyutping: soeng5 zan6 bat1 lei4 fu6 zi2 bing1
english_meaning: Like father, like son; Fathers and sons fight together.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻父子或关系密切的人同心协力，共同作战或完成任务。强调团结合作，尤其是在困难的情况下。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that fathers and sons (or people with a very close relationship) work together and fight together, especially during difficult times. It emphasizes the importance of unity and cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅工程咁困難，好彩佢哋上陣不離父子兵，終於搞掂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 gung1 cing4 gam3 kwan3 naan4, hou2 coi2 keoi5 dei6 soeng5 zan6 bat1 lei4 fu6 zi2 bing1, zung1 jyu1 gaau2 dim6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的工程这么困难，幸好他们上阵父子兵，终于搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: This project was so difficult, luckily they worked together like father and son, and finally managed to complete it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩父子上陣不離父子兵，一齊打理間公司，生意越做越大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 fu6 zi2 soeng5 zan6 bat1 lei4 fu6 zi2 bing1, jat1 cai4 daa2 lei5 gaan1 gung1 si1, saang1 ji3 jyut6 zou6 jyut6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们父子俩上阵父子兵，一起打理公司，生意越做越大。
examples.english_sentence: The father and son worked together like father and son to manage the company, and the business is growing bigger and bigger.

english_meaning: Mixed ingredients; assorted items (often referring to offal in Cantonese cuisine)
explanation_mandarin: 指多种不同的食材混合在一起，在粤菜中通常指内脏、肉类等混合的食品。
explanation_english: Refers to a mixture of different ingredients, commonly referring to a mix of offal and meat in Cantonese cuisine. It generally implies a variety of inexpensive cuts or parts of animal products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食碗上雜麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 wun2 soeng6 zaap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一碗什锦面。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat a bowl of noodles with mixed ingredients (offal).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪嘅上雜好好食，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 soeng6 zaap6 hou2 hou2 sik6, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的什锦很好吃，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's assorted ingredients are very delicious; many people are lining up.

mandarin_meaning: 通电; 开机; 供电
english_meaning: to power on; to turn on (an electronic device); to electrify
explanation_mandarin: 指给电子设备或系统接通电源，使其开始工作。也指供电。
explanation_english: Refers to providing power to an electronic device or system, allowing it to start functioning. It can also mean to supply electricity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，幫我上電個電腦吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, bong1 ngo5 soeng5 din6 go3 din6 nou5 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，帮我把电脑开机。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, can you turn on the computer for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機上電之後冇反應，可能壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 soeng5 din6 zi1 hau6 mou5 faan2 ying3, ho2 nang4 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器通电后没有反应，可能坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The machine doesn't respond after being powered on, it might be broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停電之後，成個屋苑都冇得上電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 din6 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 uk1 jyun2 dou1 mou5 dak1 soeng5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停电之后，整个小区都不能供电。
examples.english_sentence: After the power outage, the whole estate has no electricity.

english_meaning: above, on top of, up
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置在高处或表面。
explanation_english: Indicates a position at a higher place or on the surface of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺檯上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在桌子上面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺佢上面一層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 keoi5 soeng6 min6 jat1 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在他的楼上一层。
examples.english_sentence: I live one floor above him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上面講嘅嘢，你要記住啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 min6 gong2 ge3 je5, nei5 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上面说的，你要记住啊。
examples.english_sentence: You have to remember what I said above.

english_meaning: coming from above; sent down from higher authority; from headquarters; from above
explanation_mandarin: 指来自上级机关或领导下派的人员或指令。也泛指来自更高层级或来源。
explanation_english: Refers to personnel or instructions sent from higher authorities or leaders. Also generally refers to something originating from a higher level or source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會有上面落嚟嘅人巡視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 jau5 soeng6 min6 lok6 lai4 ge3 jan4 ceon4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会有上头下来的人巡视。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow, people from above will come to inspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定係上面落嚟嘅，我哋都要跟住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 soeng6 min6 lok6 lai4 ge3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 gan1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定是上头下来的，我们都要跟着做。
examples.english_sentence: This decision came from above, and we all have to follow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係上面落嚟㗎？難怪咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 soeng6 min6 lok6 lai4 gaa3? naan4 gwaai3 gam3 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是上面派来的吗？难怪这么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Are you sent down from above? No wonder you're so capable.

cantonese: 上面蒸鬆糕，下面賣涼粉
jyutping: soeng6 min6 zing1 sung1 gou1, haa6 min6 maai6 loeng4 fan2
english_meaning: Hypocritical; Two-faced; Double-dealing; Acting one way on the surface and another underneath.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人表面上做着正经体面的事情，实际上却在做一些不正当或者见不得人的事情。如同上面蒸着鬆糕（寓意好，吉利），下面却卖着凉粉（通常是比较廉价的食品）。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone presents a respectable or upright appearance on the surface, while secretly engaging in dishonest or disreputable activities. It's like steaming *sung gou* (a festive steamed cake symbolizing prosperity) on top while selling *loeng fan* (a cheap and common jelly dessert) underneath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮嘢，上面蒸鬆糕，下面賣涼粉，我哋唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 je5, soeng6 min6 zing1 sung1 gou1, haa6 min6 maai6 loeng4 fan2, ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装模作样，表里不一，我们不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be something he's not, he's two-faced, we shouldn't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司表面上話環保，但係實際上不停咁排放污染物，真係上面蒸鬆糕，下面賣涼粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 biu2 min6 soeng6 waa6 waan4 bou2, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeoi3 soeng6 bat1 ting4 gam2 paai3 fong3 wu1 juk6 mat6, zan1 hai6 soeng6 min6 zing1 sung1 gou1, haa6 min6 maai6 loeng4 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司表面上说环保，但实际上不停地排放污染物，真是表里不一。
examples.english_sentence: This company claims to be environmentally friendly on the surface, but in reality, it continuously discharges pollutants. It's truly hypocritical.

synonyms: [口是心非 (hau2 si6 sam1 fei1) (Cantonese-style Mandarin)

english_meaning: to hit the target; to be a victim of a scam or trick; to be taken advantage of
explanation_mandarin: 原指射击时击中目标。引申为被骗，受人利用，成为攻击或欺骗的对象。
explanation_english: Originally refers to hitting the target in shooting. By extension, it means to be scammed, taken advantage of, or become the target of an attack or deception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，好易上靶嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, hou2 ji6 soeng5 baa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么笨，很容易上当的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he's easy to be scammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾佢哋上靶呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 soeng5 baa2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心一点，不要让他们得逞。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't let them take advantage of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估佢今次一定上靶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 soeng5 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜他这次肯定要中招。
examples.english_sentence: I guess he will definitely be the victim this time.

mandarin_meaning: 头脑发昏; 酒劲上来; 上级
english_meaning: Dizzy; lightheaded; intoxicated; above (in authority/hierarchy)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 形容头脑发昏，感觉不舒服。2. 指酒劲上来，醉意朦胧。3. 指上级领导或部门。
explanation_english: 1. Describes a feeling of dizziness or lightheadedness. 2. Refers to the feeling of being intoxicated or drunk. 3. Refers to superiors or upper-level departments (in an organization or hierarchy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我飲咗兩杯啤酒就開始有啲上頭喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jam2 zo2 loeng5 bui1 be1 zau2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 jau5 di1 soeng6 tau4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喝了两杯啤酒就开始有点头晕了。
examples.english_sentence: I started to feel a bit dizzy after drinking two glasses of beer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日上頭會嚟視察㗎，大家醒醒定定啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 soeng6 tau4 wui5 lei4 si6 caat3 gaa3, daai6 gaa1 sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天上头会来视察的，大家精神点！
examples.english_sentence: The higher-ups will come to inspect tomorrow, everyone be alert!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都淨係識得奉承上頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 fung6 sing4 soeng6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是只懂得奉承上级。
examples.english_sentence: He always only knows how to flatter his superiors.

english_meaning: advantage; upper hand; favourable position
explanation_mandarin: 指在竞争、辩论或冲突中占据有利的地位。
explanation_english: Refers to having an advantage or favorable position in a competition, debate, or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論比賽入面攞到上風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 lo2 dou2 soeng6 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论比赛中占据了上风。
examples.english_sentence: He gained the upper hand in the debate competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要攞到上風先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lo2 dou2 soeng6 fung1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要取得优势才行。
examples.english_sentence: We must gain the advantage first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢場生意競爭入面，佢哋暫時攞住上風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 coeng4 saang1 ji3 ging6 zang1 jap6 min6, keoi5 dei6 zaam6 si4 lo2 zyu6 soeng6 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这场商业竞争中，他们暂时占据着优势。
examples.english_sentence: They currently hold the advantage in this business competition.

english_meaning: to burn incense (usually in religious contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 在神佛像前点燃香，表示敬意或祈求。
explanation_english: To burn incense sticks, typically in front of a deity or ancestor, as a sign of respect or to make a wish or prayer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日去廟上香㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 miu2 soeng5 hoeng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常去庙里烧香的。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often goes to the temple to burn incense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多人會去黃大仙上香祈福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 wong4 daai6 sin1 soeng5 hoeng1 kei4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人会去黄大仙烧香祈福。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many people go to Wong Tai Sin Temple to burn incense and pray for good fortune.

english_meaning: to start; to commence; to mount (a horse); to begin (a project)
explanation_mandarin: 可以指开始做某件事情，启动一个项目，也可以指骑马的动作。
explanation_english: Can refer to starting to do something, launching a project, or the action of mounting a horse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個工程下個禮拜就上馬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gung1 cing4 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 soeng5 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程下个星期就要开始了。
examples.english_sentence: This project will start next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好細個就學上馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sai3 go3 zau6 hok6 soeng5 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很小的时候就学骑马。
examples.english_sentence: He learned to ride horses when he was very young.

english_meaning: thigh
explanation_mandarin: 指腿的上半部分，连接臀部和膝盖的部分。
explanation_english: The upper part of the leg, the part connecting the hip and the knee; the thigh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑步嘅時候拉傷咗上髀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 bou6 ge3 si4 hau6 laai1 soeng1 zo2 soeng6 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑步的时候拉伤了大腿。
examples.english_sentence: He strained his thigh while running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙太短，遮唔住上髀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 taai3 dyun2, ze1 m4 zyu6 soeng6 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子太短，遮不住大腿。
examples.english_sentence: The skirt is too short, it doesn't cover the thigh.

english_meaning: above; on top of; upwards
explanation_mandarin: 指位置在上面，高于某个参考物。
explanation_english: Refers to a position that is above, higher than a certain reference point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺櫃上高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 gwai6 soeng6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在柜子上面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is on top of the cabinet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺我哋樓上高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 dei6 lau4 soeng6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在我们楼上。
examples.english_sentence: He lives upstairs from us.

english_meaning: down; below; under; next; a bit; indicates a short duration or a trial action
explanation_mandarin: 表示方位、位置；表示动作或行为的短时性或尝试；表示次数。
explanation_english: Indicates a direction or position; indicates the short duration or a trial action of an action or behavior; indicates frequency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓下有間餐廳好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 haa5 jau5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼下有一家餐厅很有名。
examples.english_sentence: There's a very famous restaurant downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我諗下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 nam2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我想一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let me think about it for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次再見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 zoi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次再见。
examples.english_sentence: See you next time.

english_meaning: next one
explanation_mandarin: 指顺序上的下一个。
explanation_english: Refers to the next one in a sequence or order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下一個到你啦，快啲準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 jat1 go3 dou3 nei5 laa1, faai3 di1 zyun2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下一个轮到你了，快点准备。
examples.english_sentence: You're next, get ready quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下一個節目係咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 jat1 go3 zit3 muk6 hai6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下一个节目是什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's the next program?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望下一個工作會更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 haa6 jat1 go3 gung1 zok3 wui5 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望下一个工作会更好。
examples.english_sentence: I hope the next job will be better.

english_meaning: every time, always, at every turn, invariably
explanation_mandarin: 表示每次都这样，含有略带不耐烦或责备的语气。强调事情发生的频率很高，每一次都如此。
