explanation_english: Indicates that something happens every time, often with a tone of impatience or reproach. Emphasizes the high frequency of the event, happening every single time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下下都遲到，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 haa6 dou1 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都迟到，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下下都話自己啱，都唔聽人哋講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 haa6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 aam1, dou1 m4 teng1 yan4 dei6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己是对的，都不听别人说。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's right, and doesn't listen to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好下下都靠晒人哋，自己都要努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haa6 haa6 dou1 kaau3 saai3 yan4 dei6, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nu5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要每次都依赖别人，自己也要努力啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on others, you have to work hard yourself.

english_meaning: Not to be taken as a precedent; this will not happen again.
explanation_mandarin: 表示这次是例外，下次不会再这样做了。通常用于宽恕某人一次犯错，但警告以后不能再犯。
explanation_english: This is an exception, and will not be repeated. Used to excuse someone's mistake once, with a warning that it shouldn't happen again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次你遲到，下不為例啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nei5 ci4 dou3, haa6 bat1 wai4 lai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次你迟到了，下不为例啊！
examples.english_sentence: You were late this time; don't let it happen again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知你趕時間，所以俾你插隊，不過下不為例㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 nei5 gon2 si4 gaan3, so2 ji5 bei2 nei5 chaap3 deoi2, bat1 gwo3 haa6 bat1 wai4 lai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你赶时间，所以让你插队，不过下不为例啊。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're in a hurry, so I'll let you cut in line, but don't expect this to happen again.

english_meaning: This will not happen again; This is not to be taken as a precedent; Never again.
explanation_mandarin: 表示这次是一个特例，下次不能再这样做了。
explanation_english: Indicates that this time is a special case and should not be repeated in the future. It implies a warning or setting a boundary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次畀你遲到，下不爲例啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 nei5 ci4 dou3, haa6 bat1 wai4 lai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次让你迟到，下不为例啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'll let you be late this time, but never again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次特別批准你嘅申請，下不爲例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 dak6 bit6 pat1 zyun1 nei5 ge3 san1 cheng2, haa6 bat1 wai4 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次特别批准你的申请，下不为例。
examples.english_sentence: Your application is approved this time as a special case, never again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下不爲例啊，下次再咁樣我會嬲㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 bat1 wai4 lai6 aa3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 ngo5 wui5 nau1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下不为例啊，下次再这样我会生气的！
examples.english_sentence: This is not to be taken as a precedent! If you do this again next time, I'll be angry!

english_meaning: next life; afterlife; the next reincarnation
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后的下一辈子。佛教轮回观念，认为人死后灵魂会转世重生。
explanation_english: Refers to the next life after death. Based on the Buddhist concept of reincarnation, it is believed that the soul is reborn after death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係有下世，我希望可以做一隻自由自在嘅小鳥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 jau5 haa6 sai3, ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zou6 jat1 zek3 zi6 jau4 zi6 zoi6 ge3 siu2 niu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的有来世，我希望可以做一只自由自在的小鸟。
examples.english_sentence: If there really is an afterlife, I hope to be a free bird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁激氣啦，當係上世欠咗佢，下世還返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gik1 hei3 laa1, dong3 hai6 soeng6 sai3 him3 zo2 keoi5, haa6 sai3 waan4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么生气了，就当是上辈子欠了他的，下辈子还给他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, just think of it as you owed him in the previous life, and you'll pay him back in the next.

english_meaning: servant, domestic worker
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇于人，负责家务或其他杂事的人。通常带有封建社会的色彩，现代用法较少。
explanation_english: A person employed to do household work or other menial tasks, typically in a large house or estate. The term often carries connotations of feudal society and is less common in modern usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲大戶人家好多時都會請下人嚟幫手做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1 hou2 do1 si4 dou1 wui2 ceng2 haa6 jan4 lai4 bong1 sau2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的大户人家很多时候都会请佣人来帮忙做事。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, wealthy families often hired servants to help with the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將我當咗下人咁使喚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 ngo5 dong3 zo2 haa6 jan4 gam2 sai2 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把我当成佣人一样使唤。
examples.english_sentence: They treat me like a servant.

english_meaning: to order; to command; to decree
explanation_mandarin: 发出命令。
explanation_english: To issue an order or command.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細下令要我哋聽日加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 haa6 ling6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板下令我们要我们明天加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss ordered us to work overtime tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官下令將佢拘捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 haa6 ling6 zoeng1 keoi5 keoi1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官下令将他拘捕。
examples.english_sentence: The judge ordered his arrest.

english_meaning: below, underneath, under
explanation_mandarin: 指位置在下方。
explanation_english: Refers to the position being below or underneath something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺枱下低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 haa6 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在桌子下面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is under the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲嘢擺喺梳化下低，好難執㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 je5 baai2 hai2 so1 faa2 haa6 dai1, hou2 naan4 zaap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把东西放在沙发下面，很难捡的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put things under the sofa, it's difficult to pick them up.

mandarin_meaning: 低级; 低俗; 不入流
english_meaning: low-class; vulgar; despicable; beneath one's dignity; cheap; low-down
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或行为卑鄙、下流、低俗，不符合道德标准或社会规范。 贬义词。
explanation_english: Describes a person or behavior that is despicable, vulgar, or low-class, not meeting ethical standards or social norms. A derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做啲嘢咁下作，真係令人睇唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 di1 je5 gam3 haa6 zok3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tai2 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情这么低俗，真是让人看不起。
examples.english_sentence: The things he does are so vulgar, it's really despicable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用呢啲下作嘅手段去贏，就算贏咗都唔光彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ni1 di1 haa6 zok3 ge3 sau2 dyun6 heoi3 wing4, zau6 syun3 wing4 zo2 dou1 m4 gwong1 caai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用这些低级的手段去赢，就算赢了也不光彩。
examples.english_sentence: Using such low-class methods to win, even if you win, it's not honorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁下作啦，講嘢要有啲品味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 haa6 zok3 laa1, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 di1 ban2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么低俗啦，说话要有点品味。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so vulgar, you should have some taste when you speak.

english_meaning: to come down; to descend; afterwards; then; to record; to write down; to continue
explanation_mandarin: 表示从高处向低处移动，或表示事情的延续、记录等。
explanation_english: Indicates movement from a higher to a lower position, or the continuation, recording, etc. of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨喇，快啲收衫落嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 laa3, faai3 di1 sau1 saam1 lok6 lai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，快点收衣服下来吧！
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, quickly take the clothes down!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將呢件事記低落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 ni1 gin6 si6 gei3 dai1 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把这件事记录下来。
examples.english_sentence: You record this matter down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭職之後打算做啲乜，遲啲會揭曉落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zik1 zi1 hau6 daa2 syun3 zou6 di1 mat1, ci4 di1 wui5 kit3 hiu2 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后打算做什么，晚一点会揭晓下来。
examples.english_sentence: What he plans to do after resigning will be revealed later.

english_meaning: below; underneath; the following
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置在下方，也可以表示接下来、下面的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a location below something. It can also mean 'the following' or 'next'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺張枱下便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 haa6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在桌子下面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is under the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下便我會講多啲關於呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 bin6 ngo5 wui5 gong2 do1 di1 gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 接下来我会多讲一些关于这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I will talk more about this matter later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗唔到下便嘅步驟應該點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 m4 dou2 haa6 bin6 ge3 bou6 zau6 jing1 goi1 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想不到下面的步骤应该怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: I can't think of how to do the next steps.

english_meaning: next month
explanation_mandarin: 指当前月份的下一个月份。
explanation_english: Refers to the month following the current month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月去日本旅行呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月去日本旅行啊！
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Japan next month!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月嘅考試好重要㗎，你要努力溫書啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 haau2 si5 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 nu5 lik6 wan1 syu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月的考试很重要，你要努力复习啊。
examples.english_sentence: Next month's exam is very important, you need to study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月我搬新屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 ngo5 bun1 san1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月我搬新家。
examples.english_sentence: I'm moving to a new house next month.

english_meaning: to descend from heaven; to come down to earth (usually implying a celestial being coming to the mortal realm); to be unusually good or attractive (especially of a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 原指神仙、仙女从天上来到人间。现在也用来形容某人（通常是女性）非常漂亮、完美，好像是从天上降临到人间一样。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a deity or celestial being descending from heaven to the mortal realm. Now it's also used to describe someone (usually a woman) who is exceptionally beautiful and perfect, as if they came down from heaven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靚到好似仙女下凡咁啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 leng3 dou3 hou2 ci5 sin1 neoi5 haa6 faan4 gam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她美得像仙女下凡一样！
examples.english_sentence: She's so beautiful, like a fairy descended from heaven!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗佢一定係仙女下凡嚟拯救我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hai6 sin1 neoi5 haa6 faan4 lai4 cing2 gau3 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想她一定是仙女下凡来拯救我的。
examples.english_sentence: I think she must be a fairy descended from heaven to save me.

english_meaning: following; below; the following
explanation_mandarin: 指接下来或下面所列出的内容。
explanation_english: Refers to the items or content listed below or following this point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下列係我哋公司嘅規矩，請你哋睇清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 lit6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 kwai1 geoi2, cing2 nei5 dei6 tai2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下列是我们公司的规定，请你们看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The following are our company's rules, please read them carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下列選項邊個啱？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 lit6 syun2 haak3 bin1 go3 ngaam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下列选项哪个是对的？
examples.english_sentence: Which of the following options is correct?

mandarin_meaning: 下工夫; 花心思; 努力
english_meaning: To put in effort; to devote time and energy; to work hard at something; to spend time and energy
explanation_mandarin: 付出时间和精力，努力去做某事。
explanation_english: To put in the time and effort to do something; to work diligently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想學好廣東話，一定要下功夫先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 haa5 gung1 fu1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想学好粤语，一定要下功夫才行。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to learn Cantonese well, you must put in the effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試之前下咗好多功夫，所以成績好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 zi1 cin4 haa5 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 fu1, so2 ji5 sing4 jik1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试之前下了很多功夫，所以成绩很好。
examples.english_sentence: He put in a lot of effort before the exam, so his grades are very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢個項目，一定要下功夫研究清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 haa5 gung1 fu1 jin4 gau3 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这个项目，一定要下功夫研究清楚。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, you must put in the effort to research it thoroughly.

english_meaning: afternoon
explanation_mandarin: 指中午到傍晚之间的时间。
explanation_english: The time of day between noon and evening; afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下午三點喺咖啡店見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 ng5 saam1 dim2 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下午三点在咖啡店见。
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet at the coffee shop at 3 p.m.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日下午落大雨，你記得帶遮啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 haa6 ng5 lok6 daai6 jyu5, nei5 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下午下大雨，你记得带伞啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily this afternoon, remember to bring an umbrella!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下午冇乜嘢做，可以陪你行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 ng5 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6, ho2 ji5 pui4 nei5 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午没什么事做，可以陪你逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much to do this afternoon, I can go shopping with you.

english_meaning: afternoon tea
explanation_mandarin: 指下午三点到五点之间享用的茶点，通常包括茶、点心、三明治等。
explanation_english: Afternoon tea, a light meal typically enjoyed between 3 PM and 5 PM, consisting of tea, pastries, sandwiches, and other small snacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋去食個下午茶啦，好耐冇見你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 go3 haa6 ng5 caa4 laa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们去吃个下午茶吧，好久没见你了。
examples.english_sentence: How about we go for afternoon tea? I haven't seen you in a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅下午茶好出名，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 haa6 ng5 caa4 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的下午茶很有名，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: The afternoon tea at this hotel is very famous, lots of people are queuing up.

english_meaning: latter half; second half
explanation_mandarin: 指时间、事物等的后半部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the latter half or second half of a time period, event, or object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場波下半場好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bo1 haa6 bun3 coeng4 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场球下半场很好看。
examples.english_sentence: The second half of this game is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下半世都唔使憂柴憂米啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 bun3 sai3 dou1 m4 sai2 yau1 caai4 yau1 mai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下半辈子都不用担心柴米油盐了。
examples.english_sentence: We don't have to worry about daily necessities for the rest of our lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下半身癱瘓咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 bun3 san1 taan1 wun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下半身瘫痪了。
examples.english_sentence: His lower body is paralyzed.

english_meaning: the rest of one's life; the latter half of one's life
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人生命中的后半段时光。
explanation_english: Refers to the latter half of a person's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住退休之後，搵個地方舒舒服服咁過下半世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, wan2 go3 dei6 fong1 syu1 syu1 fuk1 fuk1 gam2 gwo3 haa6 bun3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算退休以后，找个地方舒舒服服地过下半辈子。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to find a place to live comfortably for the rest of my life after retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗頭家奔波咗咁耐，都希望下半世可以享下清福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 tau4 gaa1 ban1 bo1 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 hei1 mong6 haa6 bun3 sai3 ho2 ji5 hoeng2 haa5 cing1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了家庭奔波了这么久，都希望下半辈子可以享清福。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working hard for his family for so long, he hopes to enjoy a peaceful life for the rest of his days.

english_meaning: to fly a flag at half-mast
explanation_mandarin: 为表示哀悼或纪念，将旗帜降至杆顶与杆底之间的中间位置。
explanation_english: To lower a flag to half-mast as a sign of mourning or respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗悼念死難者，政府決定今日下半旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 dou6 nim6 sei2 naan6 ze2, zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 gam1 jat6 haa6 bun3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了悼念死难者，政府决定今天降半旗。
examples.english_sentence: In order to mourn the victims, the government decided to fly the flag at half-mast today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次有重要人物過身，都會下半旗致哀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 jau5 zung6 jiu3 jan4 mat6 gwo3 san1, dou1 wui5 haa6 bun3 kei4 zi3 oi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次有重要人物去世，都会降半旗致哀。
examples.english_sentence: Every time an important figure passes away, the flag is flown at half-mast to express condolences.

english_meaning: to go down; to continue; downwards
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态的延续，也表示从高处到低处。
explanation_english: Indicates the continuation of an action or state; also indicates moving from a high place to a low place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨落到聽日都唔停，咁落法落下去，實浸晒啲田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 lok6 dou3 ting1 jat6 dou1 m4 ting4, gam2 lok6 faat3 lok6 haa6 heoi3, sat6 zim3 saai3 di1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨下到明天都不停，这样下下去，肯定会淹没田地。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining and won't stop until tomorrow. If it continues to rain like this, the fields will definitely be flooded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣落去唔得㗎，要努力啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3 m4 dak1 gaa3, jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样下去不行，要努力一些才行。
examples.english_sentence: You can't go on like this; you need to work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行下去睇下有咩食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 haa6 heoi3 tai2 haa5 jau5 me1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走下去看看有什么吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's walk down and see what there is to eat.

english_meaning: to step down (from a position), to get off the stage; to back down, to admit defeat; to be humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 原指从舞台上下来。引申为辞职，卸任；承认失败，放弃立场；处境尴尬，难堪。
explanation_english: Originally means to step down from a stage. By extension, it means to resign from a position, to step down from office; to admit defeat, to give up one's position; to be in an embarrassing situation, to be humiliated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人踢爆咗講大話，逼住要下台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 zo2 gong2 daai6 waa6, bik1 zyu6 jiu3 haa6 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭穿说了谎，被迫下台。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for lying and was forced to step down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢一定落唔到台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 jat1 ding6 lok6 m4 dou2 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他肯定下不了台。
examples.english_sentence: He definitely won't be able to save face this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔認錯，就冇下台階㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 jing6 co3, zau6 mou5 haa6 toi4 gaai1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不认错，就没有台阶下了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't admit your mistake, you won't have a way to back down.

mandarin_meaning: 找台阶下 / 给台阶下
english_meaning: to find a way out of an embarrassing situation / to give someone a way out (save face)
explanation_mandarin: 指在尴尬的局面下，给自己或别人找一个摆脱困境的理由或借口，保全面子。
explanation_english: To find or provide a way out of an embarrassing or difficult situation, often to save face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講錯嘢，好彩老細畀個下台階佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 co3 je5, hou2 coi2 lou5 sai3 bei2 go3 haa6 toi1 gaai1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说错了话，幸好老板给了他一个台阶下。
examples.english_sentence: He said something wrong, but luckily the boss gave him a way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾個下台階佢啦，唔好再鬧佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 go3 haa6 toi1 gaai1 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 naau6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给他一个台阶下吧，不要再骂他了。
examples.english_sentence: Give him a way out, don't scold him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都要自己搵個下台階，唔可以咁樣衰落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 wan2 go3 haa6 toi1 gaai1, m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 seoi1 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我也要自己找个台阶下，不能这么丢脸下去。
examples.english_sentence: I also need to find a way to save face, I can't be this embarrassed anymore.

english_meaning: lower lip
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴巴下方的嘴唇。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower lip of the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咬住下唇，好似諗緊啲嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaau5 zyu6 haa6 seon4, hou2 ci5 nam2 gan2 di1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他咬着下嘴唇，好像在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was biting his lower lip, as if he was thinking about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔開心嘅時候，會忍唔住咬下唇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6, wui5 jan2 m4 zyu6 ngaau5 haa6 seon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不开心的时候，会忍不住咬下嘴唇。
examples.english_sentence: When he's unhappy, he can't help but bite his lower lip.

english_meaning: a breath of fresh air / a breather / a respite
explanation_mandarin: 指在忙碌或困难之后得到休息或放松的机会，就像能够舒畅地呼吸一样。
explanation_english: Refers to an opportunity to rest or relax after being busy or going through difficulties, like being able to take a refreshing breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗咁耐嘢，俾我抖下啖氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 je5, bei2 ngo5 dau2 haa5 daam6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了这么久工作，让我休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working for so long, let me have a breather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試終於考完，可以抖下啖氣喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zung1 jyu1 haau2 jyun4, ho2 ji5 dau2 haa5 daam6 hei3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试终于考完了，可以喘口气了。
examples.english_sentence: The exams are finally over, I can finally take a breath of fresh air.

mandarin_meaning: 好不好嘛; 怎麼樣嘛
english_meaning: Okay?; Why not?; Come on!; Adding a soft persuasive tone to a request or suggestion.
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種商量、請求或者勸說的語氣，帶有稍微撒嬌或者希望對方同意的意味。
explanation_english: A particle used to soften a request, suggestion, or plea, often conveying a slightly pleading or coaxing tone. It expresses a desire for agreement or compliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你幫我手下嘛，我一個人搞唔掂呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 haa5 maa3, ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 m4 dim6 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我一下嘛，我一个人搞不定啊。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a hand, okay? I can't manage it alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一齊去睇戲下嘛，好耐冇見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 haa5 maa3, hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一起去看电影吧，好久没见了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go see a movie together, okay? It's been a long time since we've seen each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試下嘛，可能啱你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 haa5 maa3, ho2 nang4 ngaam1 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试试嘛，可能适合你。
examples.english_sentence: Try it, why not? It might suit you.

english_meaning: To be continued; to be explained next time
explanation_mandarin: 指故事、小说等连载作品在某处戛然而止，留待下一次再继续讲述、说明。
explanation_english: An idiom typically used at the end of a chapter or episode in a serialized story, novel, or show, indicating that the story will continue and be explained further in the next installment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔嘅結局係點呢？下回分解啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 git3 guk1 hai6 dim2 ne1? haa6 wui4 fan1 gaai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的结局是什么呢？下回分解吧！
examples.english_sentence: What's the ending of this story? To be continued!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解佢會咁做？下回分解！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 keoi5 wui5 gam2 zou6? haa6 wui4 fan1 gaai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为什么要这样做？下次分解！
examples.english_sentence: Why did he do that? To be explained next time!

english_meaning: lower body measurement, hip measurement
explanation_mandarin: 指下半身，通常指臀部周围的围度，尤其指女性。
explanation_english: Refers to the measurement around the lower body, especially the hips, often referring to women's measurements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙好窄，顯得佢下圍好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 zaak3, hin2 dak1 keoi5 haa6 wai4 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的裙子很紧，显得她的臀围很大。
examples.english_sentence: Her skirt is too tight, making her hips look big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅設計啱晒下圍比較豐滿嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 saai3 gai3 ngaam1 saai3 haa6 wai4 bei2 gaau3 fung1 mun5 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的设计非常适合下半身比较丰满的人。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is designed perfectly for people with fuller hips.

english_meaning: to droop, to sag, to hang down
explanation_mandarin: 指向下掉落，下坠。
explanation_english: To hang down loosely; to sag or droop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眼皮下垂，睇落好攰咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 pei4 haa6 seoi4, tai2 lok6 hou2 gui6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的眼皮下垂，看起来很累。
examples.english_sentence: Her eyelids are drooping, she looks very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲條帶鬆咗，搞到條褲開始下垂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 tiu4 daai2 sung1 zo2, gaau2 dou3 tiu4 fu3 hoi1 chi2 haa6 seoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裤子的腰带松了，导致裤子开始下垂。
examples.english_sentence: The belt of the trousers loosened, causing the trousers to start sagging.

english_meaning: ending, outcome, fate, consequence
explanation_mandarin: 结局，后果，命运。
explanation_english: The ending, outcome, fate or consequence of an event, situation, or person's actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到咁大，遲早都冇好下場㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 gam3 daai6, ci4 zou2 dou1 mou5 hou2 haa6 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌得这么大，迟早都没有好下场。
examples.english_sentence: He gambles so heavily; sooner or later, he'll come to a bad end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔努力啲，考試嘅下場就一定唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 nou5 lik6 di1, haau2 si5 ge3 haa6 coeng4 zau6 jat1 ding6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不努力点，考试的下场一定不好。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, the outcome of the exam will definitely be bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅下場好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 haa6 coeng4 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的结局很惨。
examples.english_sentence: The ending of this movie is very tragic.

english_meaning: to fall, to drop, to descend
explanation_mandarin: 指向下落或者下降。
explanation_english: Refers to falling or descending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機突然下墜，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 dat6 jin4 haa6 zeoi6, haak3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机突然下坠，吓死我了。
examples.english_sentence: The plane suddenly dropped, it scared me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波下墜得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 haa6 zeoi6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球下落得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The ball is falling very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好驚坐升降機，驚佢會突然下墜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 geng1 co5 sing1 gong3 gei1, geng1 keoi5 wui5 dat6 jin4 haa6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很害怕坐电梯，怕它会突然下坠。
examples.english_sentence: He's afraid of taking the elevator, afraid it will suddenly drop.

english_meaning: to suppress, to put pressure on, to repress, to depress (prices, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指向下施加压力，通常指压制或降低。可以指实际的物理压力，也可以指象征性的压力，例如压制意见或降低价格。
explanation_english: To apply pressure downwards; often refers to suppression or lowering. Can refer to actual physical pressure, or symbolic pressure, such as suppressing opinions or lowering prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想下壓啲樓價，但係都唔成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 haa6 aat3 di1 lau2 gaa3, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想压低房价，但是都没成功。
examples.english_sentence: They wanted to suppress the property prices, but they didn't succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府下壓言論自由，好唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 haa6 aat3 jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4, hou2 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府压制言论自由，很不对。
examples.english_sentence: It's not right that the government is suppressing freedom of speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日下壓我哋嘅人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 haa6 aat3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是压低我们的工资。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always suppressing our salaries.

english_meaning: to marry down; (of a woman) to marry a man of lower social standing
explanation_mandarin: 指地位高的女子嫁给地位低的男子。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman of higher social standing marrying a man of lower social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人覺得公主下嫁畀平民係好罕見嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 jan4 gok3 dak1 gung1 zyu2 haa6 gaa3 bei2 ping4 man4 hai6 hou2 ham2 gin3 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人觉得公主下嫁给平民是很罕见的事。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people thought it was very rare for a princess to marry a commoner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢好有錢，但係佢唔介意下嫁俾一個普通嘅打工仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hou2 jau5 cin2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 gaai3 ji3 haa6 gaa3 bei2 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 ge3 daa2 gung1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然她很有钱，但是她不介意下嫁给一个普通的上班族。
examples.english_sentence: Although she is very rich, she doesn't mind marrying down to an ordinary office worker.

english_meaning: Next player (in card games, mahjong, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指打牌、麻将等游戏中坐在自己右手边的玩家。
explanation_english: Refers to the player sitting to one's right in games like cards, mahjong, etc. It can also, more broadly, refer to the next person in line or the next company in a process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔好彩啊，下家成日碰我哋嘅牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hou2 coi2 aa3, haa6 gaa1 seng4 jat6 pung3 ngo5 dei6 ge3牌.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真倒霉，下家总是碰我们出的牌。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so unlucky, the next player keeps claiming our discards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個項目入面，我哋公司嘅下家係邊間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 haa6 gaa1 hai6 bin1 gaan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个项目中，我们公司的下一家是谁？
examples.english_sentence: In this project, which company is our next in line?

english_meaning: lower level; lower class; bottom tier
explanation_mandarin: 指较低的楼层，社会阶层，或组织的较低级别。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower floor, social class, or lower level of an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋住喺大廈嘅下層，出入都方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 daai6 haa6 ge3 haa6 cang4, ceot1 jap6 dou1 faang1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们住在大厦的下层，进出都方便些。
examples.english_sentence: We live on the lower level of the building, it's more convenient to get in and out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話下層社會嘅人生活好艱苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 haa6 cang4 se5 wui2 ge3 jan4 sang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说下层社会的人生活很艰苦。
examples.english_sentence: He said that the people in the lower class have a very hard life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅下層員工福利唔算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 haa6 cang4 wun4 gung1 fuk1 lei6 m4 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的下层员工福利不算好。
examples.english_sentence: The benefits for lower-level employees at this company are not very good.

english_meaning: subordinate, underling
explanation_mandarin: 职位低于自己的人，接受自己指挥的人。
explanation_english: Someone who is lower in rank than you, someone who reports to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅下屬，做得嘢都幾勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 haa6 suk6, zou6 dak1 je5 dou1 gei2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的下属，工作还挺勤奋的。
examples.english_sentence: He is my subordinate, and he is quite diligent in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個上司，要好好照顧你嘅下屬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 soeng6 si1, jiu3 hou2 hou2 ziu3 gu3 nei5 ge3 haa6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个上司，要好好照顾你的下属。
examples.english_sentence: As a boss, you should take good care of your subordinates.

english_meaning: laid off, to be laid off, to be made redundant, to be retrenched; (euphemism for) unemployed
explanation_mandarin: 指中国国有企业改革时期，工人因企业经营不善或其他原因而失去工作。是一种委婉的说法，实际上指的是失业。
explanation_english: Refers to the situation of workers losing their jobs in China's state-owned enterprises during the reform period due to poor business performance or other reasons. It is a euphemism for unemployment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間工廠執咗笠，好多工人都要下崗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 chong2 zap1 zo2 laap1, ho2 do1 gung1 jan4 dou1 jiu3 haa6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的工厂倒闭了，很多工人都要下岗。
examples.english_sentence: Their factory closed down, and many workers will be laid off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都擔心會下崗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 daam1 sam1 wui5 haa6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都担心会下岗。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is not good, and many people are worried about being laid off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下崗之後，佢試過好多唔同嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 gong2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 si3 gwo3 ho2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下岗之后，他尝试过很多不同的工作。
examples.english_sentence: After being laid off, he tried many different jobs.

english_meaning: chin
explanation_mandarin: 指脸部位于嘴唇以下的部分。
explanation_english: The part of the face below the lower lip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個下巴尖尖哋，幾靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 haa6 baa1 zim1 zim1 dei2, gei2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的下巴有点尖，挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: Her chin is a bit pointy, quite pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好托住個下巴發夢啦，做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tok3 zyu6 go3 haa6 baa1 faat3 mung6 laa1, zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别托着下巴做白日梦了，工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop daydreaming with your chin in your hand, get to work!

english_meaning: Glib; to speak carelessly; to talk without thinking; irresponsible talk
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人说话轻率，不负责任，容易轻易承诺或泄露秘密。
explanation_english: Describes a person who speaks glibly and irresponsibly, readily making promises or revealing secrets without due consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人下巴輕輕㗎，乜嘢都講得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 haa5 baa1 hing1 hing1 gaa3, mat1 je5 dou1 gong2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人说话很轻率，什么话都说得出口。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very glib person; he'll say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你下巴輕輕，唔好周圍同人講啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa5 baa1 hing1 hing1, m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别说话轻率，不要到处跟人说这些事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak carelessly; don't go around telling people these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次講嘢小心啲，唔好下巴輕輕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 gong2 je5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 haa5 baa1 hing1 hing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次说话小心一点，别这么轻率。
examples.english_sentence: Be more careful next time you speak, don't be so glib.

english_meaning: next year
explanation_mandarin: 指接下来的一年，即现在的年份之后的下一个年份。
explanation_english: Refers to the year immediately following the current year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年會去英國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin2 wui5 heoi3 ying1 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年会去英国读书。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to the UK to study next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下年嘅樓市唔知會點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 nin2 ge3 lau4 si5 m4 zi1 dou3 wui5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明年的房地产市场不知道会怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what the housing market will be like next year.

english_meaning: below; under; underneath; bottom
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置，指在某物的下方。
explanation_english: Indicates a position below something; the bottom part of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺檯下底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 haa6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书在桌子下面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is under the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將啲嘢收埋喺床下底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 je5 sau1 maai4 hai2 cong4 haa6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们将东西藏在床下面。
examples.english_sentence: We hid the things under the bed.

english_meaning: to cook; to prepare a meal
explanation_mandarin: 指进入厨房做饭，亲自烹饪。
explanation_english: Refers to going into the kitchen to cook and prepare a meal personally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我下廚煮飯俾你食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 haa5 cyu4 zyu2 faan6 bei2 nei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我下厨房做饭给你吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'll cook for you tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識下廚，通常都係叫外賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 haa5 cyu4, tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 giu3 ngoi6 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会做饭，通常都是叫外卖。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to cook, so I usually order takeout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少下廚，因為佢好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 haa5 cyu4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很少下厨房，因为他很忙。
examples.english_sentence: He rarely cooks because he is very busy.

english_meaning: Last quarter moon, waning gibbous
explanation_mandarin: 农历每月二十二、二十三日左右所见的月相，其形状是月面西边亮，东边暗，好像弯弓的下半部分。
explanation_english: The last quarter moon, a lunar phase when the moon is half illuminated, specifically the western half in the northern hemisphere. It occurs about 3 weeks into the lunar cycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅下弦月好靚啊，我哋出去睇吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ge3 haa6 jyun4 jyut6 hou2 leng3 aa3, ngo5 dei6 cheut1 heoi3 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的下弦月很漂亮啊，我们出去看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: The last quarter moon is so beautiful tonight, let's go out and take a look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我記得嗰晚係下弦月，個海面都好光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 dak1 go2 maan1 hai6 haa6 jyun4 jyut6, go3 hoi2 min6 dou1 hou2 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我记得那天晚上是下弦月，海面也很亮。
examples.english_sentence: I remember that night was the last quarter moon, the sea surface was very bright.

english_meaning: subconscious; subconsciously; involuntarily
explanation_mandarin: 指在没有意识到的情况下做出的反应或动作；指潜意识的。
explanation_english: Referring to a reaction or action made without conscious awareness; subconscious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下意識咁摸咗下個頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 ji3 sik1 gam2 mo2 zo2 haa5 go3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下意识地摸了一下头。
examples.english_sentence: He subconsciously touched his head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下意識就應承咗佢，之後先覺得後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 ji3 sik1 zau6 jing3 sing4 zo2 keoi5, zi1 hau6 sin1 gok3 dak1 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下意识就答应了他，之后才觉得后悔。
examples.english_sentence: I subconsciously agreed to him, and only later did I regret it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個動作佢下意識會做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dung6 zok3 keoi5 haa6 ji3 sik1 wui5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个动作他下意识会做。
examples.english_sentence: He will do this action subconsciously.

english_meaning: to start; to begin; to set about doing something; to lay one's hands on (something)
explanation_mandarin: 开始做某事；动手。
explanation_english: To start doing something; to begin; to put one's hands on something (often implying an action like attacking or stealing, but also can be neutral depending on context).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要快啲下手搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 haa6 sau2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要快点开始把它搞定。
examples.english_sentence: We need to start quickly and get it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該唔好對啲展品下手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 m4 hou2 deoi3 di1 zin2 ban2 haa6 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请不要对展品动手啊！
examples.english_sentence: Please don't touch the exhibits!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾時下手寫個報告呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 haa6 sau2 se2 go3 bou3 gou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你什么时候开始写报告啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you going to start writing the report?

english_meaning: chin
explanation_mandarin: 指脸部最下面的部分，嘴巴以下的部位。
explanation_english: The part of the face below the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個下扒尖尖哋，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 haa6 baa1 jim1 jim1 dei2, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的下巴尖尖的，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Her chin is a bit pointy, it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心撞到佢個下扒，搞到佢好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zong6 dou2 keoi5 go3 haa6 baa1, gaau2 dou2 keoi5 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心撞到他的下巴，弄得他很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally bumped into his chin, making him feel very painful.

english_meaning: unreliable; untrustworthy; fickle
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事或者说话不踏实，不可靠，容易改变主意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not reliable, untrustworthy, or easily changes their mind; fickle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人下扒輕輕，講嘅嘢唔好信咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 haa6 baa1 hing1 hing1, gong2 ge3嘢 m4 hou2 seon3 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不靠谱，说的话不要太相信。
examples.english_sentence: He's unreliable, don't trust what he says too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搵佢做嘢喇，佢下扒輕輕，好易甩底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wan2 keoi5 zou6嘢 laa3, keoi5 haa6 baa1 hing1 hing1, hou2 ji6 lat1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别找他做事了，他靠不住，很容易临阵退缩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask him to do anything, he's unreliable and easily backs out.

mandarin_meaning: 助手, 部下, 能力弱的人
english_meaning: Assistant, subordinate, someone less capable or skilled
explanation_mandarin: 指助手、部下。也指能力较弱的人。
explanation_english: Refers to an assistant or subordinate. Also, refers to someone who is less capable or skilled than oneself. It often carries a slightly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日叫我幫佢做嘢，當我係佢嘅下把咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 zou6 je5, dong3 ngo5 hai6 keoi5 ge3 haa6 baa2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是叫我帮他做事，把我当成他的下属一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always asks me to help him, treating me like his subordinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢好似好叻咁，其實佢都只係得個樣，真係做嘢都係我呢個下把搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 hou2 ci5 hou2 lek1 gam2, kei4 sat6 keoi5 dou1 zi2 hai6 dak1 go3 joeng2, zan1 hai6 zou6 je5 dou1 hai6 ngo5 ni1 go3 haa6 baa2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他好像很厉害，其实他只是个样子，真正做事都是我这个助手搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think he's so great; he's just for show. It's his assistant (me) who actually gets things done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司一路都做下把，冇乜機會升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jat1 lou6 dou1 zou6 haa6 baa2, mou5 mat1 gei1 wui2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司一直都做助手，没什么机会升职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always been a subordinate in the company and hasn't had much chance for promotion.

mandarin_meaning: 次要位置; 不重要的角色
english_meaning: Subordinate position; Underling; Being in a weaker position; Being at a disadvantage
explanation_mandarin: 指在权力、地位或影响力方面处于较低或较弱的位置。比喻在关系中处于被动或受制于人的地位。
explanation_english: Refers to a position that is lower or weaker in terms of power, status, or influence. It is often used metaphorically to describe being in a passive or subordinate position in a relationship or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，佢永遠都係下把位，冇發言權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, keoi5 wing2 jyun5 dou1 hai6 haa6 baa2 wai2, mou5 faat3 jin4 kuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家公司，他永远都是次要的位置，没有发言权。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, he's always in a subordinate position and has no say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想成日都做下把位，我想有自己嘅決定權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sing4 jat6 dou1 zou6 haa6 baa2 wai2, ngo5 soeng2 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 kuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想总是处于次要位置，我想有自己的决定权。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to always be in a subordinate position; I want to have my own decision-making power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企永遠都係下把位，咩都要聽老婆嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 wing2 jyun5 dou1 hai6 haa6 baa2 wai2, me1 dou1 jiu3 teng1 lou5 po4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里永远都是次要位置，什么都要听老婆的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always in a subordinate position at home and has to listen to his wife in everything.

english_meaning: to decline, to fall, to slump (e.g., prices, stock market)
explanation_mandarin: 指（价格、指数、行情等）向下降低或下跌。
explanation_english: Refers to a downward movement or fall in (prices, indices, market conditions, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市今日下挫咗好多啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 gam1 jat6 haa6 co3 zo2 hou2 do1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天股市下跌了很多啊。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market fell a lot today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟下挫，好多公司都裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 haa6 co3, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济下滑，很多公司都在裁员。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the economic downturn, many companies are laying off employees.

english_meaning: to delegate; to decentralize; to devolve; to transfer (power, authority, responsibility) downwards
explanation_mandarin: 将权力或责任转移到较低的层级。
explanation_english: To delegate power, authority, or responsibility to a lower level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定將一啲權力下放俾地區經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zo2 joeng6 jat1 di1 kuen4 lik6 haa6 fong3 bei2 dei6 keoi1 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定将一些权力下放给地区经理。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to delegate some power to the regional managers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下放權力可以提高效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 fong3 kuen4 lik6 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 haau2 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下放权力可以提高效率。
examples.english_sentence: Decentralizing power can improve efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該下放更多資源俾基層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 haa6 fong3 gang3 do1 zi1 jyun4 bei2 gei1 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该下放更多资源给基层。
examples.english_sentence: The government should allocate more resources to the grassroots level.

english_meaning: the following text; the next part; continuation; sequel
explanation_mandarin: 指文章、讲话等接下来要说的部分，或事情的后续发展。
explanation_english: Refers to the part that follows in a text, speech, etc., or the subsequent development of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想知下文點發展就要等下一集喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 zi1 haa6 man4 dim2 faat3 zin2 zau6 jiu3 dang2 haa6 jat1 zaap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想知道接下来的发展就要等下一集了。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to know what happens next, you'll have to wait for the next episode.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下文自有分曉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 man4 zi6 jau5 fan1 hiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下文自有分晓。
examples.english_sentence: The sequel will reveal the answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇埋下文先決定買唔買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 maai4 haa6 man4 sin1 kyut3 ding6 maai5 m4 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完下文再决定买不买吧。
examples.english_sentence: Read the following text before deciding whether to buy it or not.

english_meaning: the last ten days of a month
explanation_mandarin: 指一个月中的最后十天。
explanation_english: Refers to the last ten days of a month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下旬先至可以交貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 seon4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gaau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下旬才能交货。
examples.english_sentence: We can only deliver the goods in the last ten days of the month.

english_meaning: afternoon; after midday
explanation_mandarin: 指中午过后，下午的时间段。
explanation_english: Refers to the time period after midday, the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下晏要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 aan3 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 yi1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午要去医生那里看病。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the doctor this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下晏茶餐廳好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 aan3 caa4 caan1 teng1 hou2 do1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下午茶餐厅很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The 'cha chaan teng' (Hong Kong style cafe) is very crowded in the afternoon.

english_meaning: afternoon
explanation_mandarin: 指从中午到傍晚的时间段。
explanation_english: The time of day between noon and evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下晝要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 zau3 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午要去去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go see the doctor this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你下晝得唔得閒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa6 zau3 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你下午有空吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free this afternoon?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常下晝三點飲下午茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 haa6 zau3 saam1 dim2 yam2 haa6 ng5 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常下午三点喝下午茶。
examples.english_sentence: I usually have afternoon tea at 3 p.m.

english_meaning: to send a letter of invitation; to invite someone (especially formally or in writing); to issue an invitation (especially to a rival/opponent)
explanation_mandarin: 正式地发出邀请或聘请函。多用于邀请对方来挑战、比赛、合作等场合。
explanation_english: To formally issue a letter of invitation. Often used to invite someone to a challenge, competition, collaboration, or similar event. It carries a somewhat formal or even combative tone, implying a degree of seriousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下書挑戰我哋籃球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 syu1 tiu1 zin3 ngo5 dei6 laam4 kau4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们给我们篮球队下了战书。
examples.english_sentence: They sent a challenge to our basketball team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想下書請佢做顧問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 haa6 syu1 cheng2 keoi5 zou6 gu3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想发邀请函请他做顾问。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to send him a letter of invitation to be a consultant.

synonyms: 發邀請函 (faat3 yiu1 ching2 haam4)

english_meaning: next issue; next period; next term
explanation_mandarin: 指下一个周期或阶段。例如，杂志的下一期，课程的下一学期。
explanation_english: Refers to the next period or stage. For example, the next issue of a magazine, or the next term of a course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下期再見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 kei4 zoi3 gin3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下期再见啦！
examples.english_sentence: See you next time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本雜誌下期有我偶像嘅專訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 haa6 kei4 jau5 ngo5 ngau5 zoeng3 ge3 zyun1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本杂志下期有我偶像的专访。
examples.english_sentence: The next issue of this magazine will have an interview with my idol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下期會選修呢門課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 kei4 wui5 syun2 sau1 ni1 mun4 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下学期会选修这门课。
examples.english_sentence: I will take this course next term.

english_meaning: to stay (at a hotel); to put up (at a hotel); to lodge
explanation_mandarin: 指旅客到旅店住宿。比较正式的说法。
explanation_english: Formal term referring to a traveler staying at a hotel or lodging. It's a more formal way of saying 'to stay at a hotel'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下榻喺半島酒店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 taap3 hai2 bun3 dou2 zau2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下榻在半岛酒店。
examples.english_sentence: They are staying at the Peninsula Hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺香港下榻邊間酒店好呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 haa6 taap3 bin1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 hou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在香港下榻哪家酒店好呢？
examples.english_sentence: Which hotel should we stay at in Hong Kong?

english_meaning: low-grade, inferior, menial
explanation_mandarin: 指质量低劣、不体面的事物或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to things or work that are of low quality, inferior, or menial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲下欄嘢你都做得出？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haa6 laan2 je5 nei5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么低劣的事情你也做得出来？
examples.english_sentence: You're actually capable of doing something so low-grade?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做啲下欄工啦，搵份好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 di1 haa6 laan2 gung1 laa1, wan2 fan6 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做那些低下的工作了，找份好一点的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do menial jobs, find something better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇下欄嘢，冇品味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 yi3 tai2 haa6 laan2 je5, mou5 ban2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢看低俗的东西，没品味。
examples.english_sentence: He likes watching low-grade things, he has no taste.

mandarin_meaning: 次品冒充上品，滥竽充数
english_meaning: Inferior goods posing as top-quality; putting on airs; passing something off as better than it is; cheap imitation
explanation_mandarin: 形容质量低劣的东西冒充质量好的东西，或者形容能力差的人装作很有能力的样子。
explanation_english: Describes inferior quality goods passing off as superior ones, or someone with poor ability pretending to be capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明乜都唔識，但係都要喺會議上面扮專家，真係下欄扮上菜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 baan6 zhun1 gaa1, zan1 hai6 haa6 laan6 baan6 soeng5 coi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明什么都不懂，却还要在会议上装专家，真是次品冒充上品！
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't know anything, but he still pretends to be an expert in the meeting, it's really inferior goods posing as top-quality!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲翻版貨下欄扮上菜，買咗肯定後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faan1 baan2 fo3 haa6 laan6 baan6 soeng5 coi3, maai5 zo2 hang2 ding6 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些盗版货以次充好，买了肯定后悔。
examples.english_sentence: These pirated goods are posing as the real thing, you'll definitely regret buying them.

synonyms: 魚目混珠 (jyu4 muk6 wan6 zyu1)
濫竽充數 (laam6 jyu4 cung1 sou3)

english_meaning: petty cash, small money, trivial amount of money
explanation_mandarin: 指数量不多的钱，或者来源不正当的小钱。
explanation_english: Refers to a small amount of money, often implying that it's of low value or earned through questionable means. It can also simply refer to petty cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想搵啲下欄錢使吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 wan2 di1 haa6 laan6 cin2 sai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想找点零钱花花。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to find some petty cash to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲只係下欄錢，唔值得咁上心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zi2 hai6 haa6 laan6 cin2, m4 zik6 dak1 gam3 soeng5 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些只是小钱，不值得这么上心。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a trivial amount of money, not worth taking it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠炒賣股票賺咗啲下欄錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 caau2 maai6 gu2 piu3 zaan6 zo2 di1 haa6 laan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠炒股赚了点小钱。
examples.english_sentence: He earned some small money by speculating in stocks.

english_meaning: next time
explanation_mandarin: 指时间上未来的一次；下一次。
explanation_english: Refers to the next time in the future; next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下次再去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 ci3 zoi3 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下次再去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次小心啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次小心一点儿吧！
examples.english_sentence: Be more careful next time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果下次你再咁樣做，我就唔會幫你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haa6 ci3 nei5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 zou6, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 bong1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果下次你再这样做，我就不会帮你了。
examples.english_sentence: If you do that again next time, I won't help you.

english_meaning: Signature (below the main text); complimentary close and signature
explanation_mandarin: 指书信或文件末尾的署名，通常包含姓名和日期等信息。
explanation_english: The signature at the end of a letter or document, typically including the name and date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 封信嘅下款寫住佢個名同埋日期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seon3 ge3 haa6 fun2 se2 zyu6 keoi5 go3 ming4 tung4 ma4 jat6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 信的落款写着他的名字和日期。
examples.english_sentence: The signature at the end of the letter included his name and the date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得喺份合約嘅下款度簽名啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 hai2 fan6 hap6 oek3 ge3 haa6 fun2 dou6 cim1 ming4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得在合同的落款处签名啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to sign at the signature line of the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇下份email嘅下款，睇下邊個send嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 haa5 fan6 email ge3 haa6 fun2, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 send3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看一下邮件的落款，看看是谁发的。
examples.english_sentence: Check the signature at the end of the email to see who sent it.

english_meaning: to poison; poisoning
explanation_mandarin: 指在食物、饮料或其他物质中加入毒药。
explanation_english: To add poison to food, drink, or other substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺食物度下毒想害死佢個仇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sik6 mat6 dou6 haa6 duk6 soeng2 hoi6 sei2 keoi5 go3 sau4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在食物里下毒想害死他的仇人。
examples.english_sentence: He poisoned the food to kill his enemy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁講嘢，好似話人哋下毒咁，會俾人告㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2 je5, hou2 ci5 waa6 jan4 dei6 haa6 duk6 gam2, wui5 bei2 jan4 gou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱说话，好像说别人下毒那样，会被人告的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense, like saying someone poisoned something, you could be sued!

english_meaning: to calm down; to subside (of anger, upset); to vent
explanation_mandarin: 指情绪平复，消解怒气或不快的心情。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of calming down, easing anger or unpleasant feelings. It can also refer to actions taken to help someone calm down or release their emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嬲啦，飲杯茶下下氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 laa1, jam2 bui1 caa4 haa6 haa6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么生气了，喝杯茶消消气吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, have a cup of tea to calm down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都要搵啲嘢發洩下氣先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 jiu3 wan2 di1 je5 faat3 se3 haa6 hei3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我得找点什么发泄一下才能消气。
examples.english_sentence: I need to find something to vent before I can calm down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講咗咁耐，佢都未下氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6, keoi5 dou1 mei6 haa6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说了这么久，他都还没消气。
examples.english_sentence: We've been talking for so long, but he still hasn't calmed down.

english_meaning: Offal; organ meats
explanation_mandarin: 指动物的内脏，例如猪的肝、肠、肺等。
explanation_english: Refers to the internal organs of animals, such as the liver, intestines, lungs, etc. of pigs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候唔鍾意食下水，而家就覺得好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 haa6 seoi2, ji4 gaa1 zau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候不喜欢吃内脏，现在就觉得很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't like eating offal when I was a kid, but now I think it's delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢檔嘢嘅下水粥好出名，好多人排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dong3 je5 ge3 haa6 seoi2 zuk1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的内脏粥很有名，很多人排队买。
examples.english_sentence: This stall's offal congee is very famous, many people queue up to buy it.

english_meaning: Newbie, novice, inexperienced person (literally: ship just launched into water)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻刚刚开始，经验不足的人。下水指新船下水，比喻刚刚开始做某事。
explanation_english: Metaphor for a person who is new to something and lacks experience. '下水' refers to a newly launched ship, symbolizing someone just starting something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱畢業咋，仲係條下水船，唔好咁嚴苛啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 bat1 jip6 zaa3, zung6 hai6 tiu4 haa6 seoi2 syun4, m4 hou2 gam3 jim4 ho1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚毕业而已，还是个新手，不要太苛刻啦。
examples.english_sentence: He just graduated, he's still a newbie, don't be so harsh on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，邊個唔係下水船出身㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, bin1 go3 m4 hai6 haa6 seoi2 syun4 cheot1 san1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，谁不是从新手出身的呢？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, who wasn't a newbie to begin with?

english_meaning: to sink, to submerge, to decline, to deteriorate
explanation_mandarin: 指向下沉降，沉没，或指情况、状态变得更差。
explanation_english: Refers to sinking, submerging, or the decline/deterioration of a situation or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻船就嚟下沉喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 syun4 zau6 lai4 haa6 cam4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船就要沉了！
examples.english_sentence: The boat is about to sink!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅生意越嚟越下沉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 saang1 ji3 yuet6 lai4 yuet6 haa6 cam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的生意越来越差。
examples.english_sentence: This company's business is declining more and more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢情緒好低落，好似下沉咗落去咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ching4 seoi5 hou2 dai1 lok6, hou2 chi5 haa6 cam4 zo2 lok6 heoi3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他情绪很低落，好像沉下去了似的。
examples.english_sentence: He is feeling very down, as if he has sunk into something.

english_meaning: to place a bet, to bet
explanation_mandarin: 在赌博或比赛中下赌注。
explanation_english: To place a bet in gambling or a competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺場馬度下注咗一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 coeng4 maa5 dou6 haa5 zyu3 zo2 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这场赛马中下注了一百元。
examples.english_sentence: I bet one hundred dollars on this horse race.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你下注邊隊贏啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa5 zyu3 bin1 deui2 wing4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你下注哪一队会赢？
examples.english_sentence: Which team are you betting on to win?

mandarin_meaning: 下流, 卑鄙, 猥琐
english_meaning: vulgar, obscene, indecent, lewd, base, mean
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的行为或言语粗俗、低级，令人反感。
explanation_english: Describes behavior or speech that is vulgar, indecent, base, or offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好下流，真係冇家教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2嘢 hou2 haa6 lau4, zan1 hai6 mou5 gaa1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很下流，真没家教。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is so vulgar, he really has no manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講啲咁下流嘅嘢，好核突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2啲 gam3 haa6 lau4 ge3嘢, hou2 hat6 dat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说这么下流的东西，很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say such vulgar things, it's disgusting.

english_meaning: Despicable and vulgar, base and shameless, morally reprehensible
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为、言语低俗，品格卑劣，令人不齿。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose behavior or speech is vulgar, whose character is base and despicable, and who is considered morally reprehensible and disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做啲嘢咁下流賤格，真係冇眼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 di1 je5 gam3 haa6 lau4 zin6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 mou5 ngaan5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情这么下流无耻，真是没眼看。
examples.english_sentence: The things he does are so despicable and vulgar, it's unbearable to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁下流賤格啦，講嘢尊重啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 haa6 lau4 zin6 gaak3 laa1, gong2 je5 zyun1 zung6 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么下流无耻了，说话尊重一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so despicable and vulgar, show some respect when you speak!

english_meaning: to enter the business world; to go into business (from a previous government job or other more stable occupation); to go into prostitution (euphemistically)
explanation_mandarin: 原指离开稳定工作（如政府部门）而从事商业活动，带有冒险意味。也常用于委婉地指从事色情行业。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to leaving a stable job (such as in a government department) to engage in commercial activities, implying a sense of risk. It is also often used euphemistically to refer to engaging in the sex industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前喺政府做嘢，而家下海搞生意喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 hai2 zing3 fu2 zou6 je5, ji4 gaa1 haa6 hoi2 gaau2 sang1 ji3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前在政府工作，现在下海做生意了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to work for the government, but now he's gone into business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲女仔因為經濟問題而被迫下海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 neoi5 zai2 jan1 wai6 ging1 gai3 man6 tai4 ji4 bei6 bik1 haa6 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些女孩因为经济问题而被逼迫下海。
examples.english_sentence: Some girls are forced into prostitution due to economic problems.

english_meaning: downstream; the lower reaches (of a river); (figuratively) lower level (in a hierarchy); the last stage
explanation_mandarin: 河流的下游；比喻等级或过程的末端。
explanation_english: The lower reaches of a river; figuratively, the lower level in a hierarchy or the final stage of a process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廠喺條河嘅下游，啲污水就咁排落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 cong2 hai2 tiu4 ho4 ge3 haa6 jau4, di1 wu1 seoi2 zau6 gam2 pai4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂在河流的下游，污水就这么排下去。
examples.english_sentence: The factory is located downstream of the river, and the wastewater is discharged directly into it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係供應鏈嘅下游，通常要等好耐先收到貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 gung1 jing3 lin2 ge3 haa6 jau4, tung1 soeng4 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6 sin1 sau1 dou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是供应链的下游，通常要等很久才能收到货。
examples.english_sentence: We are downstream in the supply chain, so we usually have to wait a long time to receive the goods.

english_meaning: to decline, to drop, to fall, to slide down
explanation_mandarin: 指数量、价值、质量等方面下降或衰退。
explanation_english: Refers to a decline or deterioration in quantity, value, or quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅經濟下滑得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 ging1 zai3 haa6 waat6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的经济下滑得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The economy has declined sharply this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅銷售額下滑咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 siu1 sau3 ngaak2 haa6 waat6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的销售额下降了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Their sales figures have dropped significantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從新政策實施之後，樓價開始下滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 san1 zing3 caak3 sat6 si1 zi1 hau6, lau4 gaa3 hoi1 chi2 haa6 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从新政策实施之后，房价开始下降。
examples.english_sentence: Since the new policy was implemented, house prices have started to decline.

english_meaning: to reduce internal heat, to cool down (the body), to alleviate symptoms of inflammation
explanation_mandarin: 中医理论认为，体内积热会导致各种不适症状，如口干舌燥、便秘等。“下火”指通过饮食或药物等方法来消除这些体内积热，减轻症状。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese medicine, internal heat is believed to cause various discomforts such as dry mouth, constipation, etc. "下火 (haa6 fo2)" refers to the process of reducing this internal heat and alleviating the related symptoms through diet or medication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排成日捱夜，好似好熱氣，要飲啲涼茶下火先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je2, hou2 ci5 hou2 jit6 hei3, jiu3 jam2 di1 loeng4 caa4 haa6 fo2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近总是熬夜，好像很上火，要喝点凉茶去火才行。
examples.english_sentence: I've been staying up late a lot recently, and I feel like I'm having a lot of internal heat. I need to drink some herbal tea to cool down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咁多煎炸嘢，梗係要下下火啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 gam3 do1 zin1 zaa3 je5, gang2 hai6 jiu3 haa6 haa6 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这么多油炸的东西，肯定要降降火了。
examples.english_sentence: After eating so much fried food, you definitely need to cool down your body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯竹蔗茅根水下火啦，對身體好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 bui1 zuk1 ze3 maau4 gan1 seoi2 haa6 fo2 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝杯竹蔗茅根水去去火吧，对身体好的。
examples.english_sentence: Drink a cup of sugarcane and imperata cylindrica tea to reduce internal heat. It's good for your health.

english_meaning: chin
explanation_mandarin: 指脸部下方的、嘴巴下方的突出部分。
explanation_english: The part of the face below the mouth; the lower part of the face below the lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅下爬好尖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 haa6 paa4 hou2 zim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的下巴很尖。
examples.english_sentence: His chin is very pointy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我撞瘀咗下爬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zong6 yu2 zo2 haa6 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我撞伤了下巴。
examples.english_sentence: I bruised my chin.

english_meaning: to get off work, to finish work
explanation_mandarin: 结束工作；从工作岗位离开。
explanation_english: To finish work and leave one's workplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日下班一齊去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 haa6 baan1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天一起下班去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat together after work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日幾點下班啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gei2 dim2 haa6 baan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天几点下班啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time do you get off work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都好晏先下班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 aan3 sin1 haa6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都很晚才下班。
examples.english_sentence: He gets off work very late every day.

english_meaning: lower body; foundation; (figurative) stability; lower abdomen
explanation_mandarin: 指身体的下半部分，尤其指臀部和大腿。也引申指基础，稳固程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower part of the body, especially the hips and thighs. It can also figuratively refer to the foundation, stability or lower abdomen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下盤好穩，企得好實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 pun4 hou2 wan2, kei5 dak1 hou2 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的下盘很稳，站得很牢。
examples.english_sentence: His lower body is very stable, he stands firmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅下盤唔穩，好易執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 haa6 pun4 m4 wan2, hou2 ji6 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的基础不稳，很容易倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This company's foundation is unstable, it's easy to go bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跳舞要練好下盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu3 mou5 jiu3 lin6 hou2 haa6 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跳舞要练好下盘。
examples.english_sentence: You need to train your lower body well for dancing.

english_meaning: to put pen to paper; to begin writing; to start writing
explanation_mandarin: 开始写作或绘画。指开始用笔。
explanation_english: To begin writing or drawing. It refers to the act of starting to use a pen or brush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗好耐都唔知點樣下筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 haa5 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了很久都不知道怎么下笔。
examples.english_sentence: I've been thinking for a long time and still don't know how to start writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一諗到個故仔嘅結局，就即刻下筆寫低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lam2 dou2 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 git3 guk6, zau6 zik1 hak1 haa5 bat1 se2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一想到故事的结局，就立刻下笔写下来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he thought of the ending of the story, he immediately started writing it down.

english_meaning: low-grade, inferior, of low quality
explanation_mandarin: 指等级或质量较低的，不好的。
explanation_english: Refers to something of low grade or quality; inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨全部都係下等貨，唔好買呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 haa6 dang2 fo3, m4 hou2 maai5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货全部都是下等货，不要买啊！
examples.english_sentence: These goods are all low-grade, don't buy them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人咁下等，真係唔想同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gam3 haa6 dang2, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人品这么差，真不想和他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a low-class person, I really don't want to be friends with him.

english_meaning: subordinate, junior level, lower rank
explanation_mandarin: 指职位或级别较低的人或事物。在工作环境中，指下属。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing of lower position or level. In a work environment, it refers to a subordinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣同下級講嘢，好唔尊重人喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 tung4 haa6 kap1 gong2 je5, hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 jan4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样和下级说话，很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk to subordinates like that, it's very disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得點樣管理下級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 dim2 joeng2 gun2 lei5 haa6 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得如何管理下级。
examples.english_sentence: He knows very well how to manage subordinates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為上司，要尊重下級嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 soeng6 si1, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 haa6 kap1 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为上司，要尊重下级的意见。
examples.english_sentence: As a supervisor, you should respect the opinions of your subordinates.

english_meaning: lower limb(s), leg(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指人或动物的下半身肢体，通常指腿。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower limbs of a person or animal, typically referring to the legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車撞斷咗下肢，要坐輪椅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zong6 dyun2 zo2 haa6 zi1, jiu3 co5 leon4 ji2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他车祸撞断了下肢，需要坐轮椅。
examples.english_sentence: He broke his lower limbs in a car accident and needs to use a wheelchair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動員嘅下肢肌肉好發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 jyun4 ge3 haa6 zi1 gei1 yuk6 hou2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动员的下肢肌肉很发达。
examples.english_sentence: The athlete's lower limb muscles are very developed.

mandarin_meaning: 边角料，残次品; 不成器的人
english_meaning: Scrap material; substandard goods; worthless person; good-for-nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指剩余的、质量差的材料或产品；也用来形容没有用处、不争气的人。
explanation_english: Refers to leftover or substandard materials or products; also used to describe someone who is useless or worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲下腳料唔要得㗎，全部都係爛布。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haa6 goek3 liu2 m4 jiu3 dak1 gaa3, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 laan6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些边角料不能要，全部都是烂布。
examples.english_sentence: These scraps are unusable; they're all torn cloth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，又唔肯做嘢，遲早變成社會下腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, jau6 m4 hang2 zou6 je5, ci4 zou2 bin3 sing4 se5 wui2 haa6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，又不肯工作，迟早会变成社会的废物。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy and unwilling to work; sooner or later, he'll become a burden to society.

synonyms: 冇用嘅人 (mou5 jung6 ge3 jan4)

english_meaning: Scrap material, offcuts, waste
explanation_mandarin: 指生产过程中剩余的、质量较差或不合格的材料，通常被视为废料或边角料。
explanation_english: Refers to leftover, low-quality, or substandard materials from a manufacturing process. Usually considered scrap or offcuts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠啲下腳料好多，唔知點處理好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 di1 haa6 goek3 liu2 hou2 do1, m4 zi1 dim2 cyu2 lei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂的边角料很多，不知道怎么处理好。
examples.english_sentence: This factory has a lot of scrap material, I don't know how to deal with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用啲下腳料整咗啲小手工藝品，幾得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 di1 haa6 goek3 liu2 zing2 zo2 di1 siu2 gung1 sau2 ngai6 ban2, gei2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用一些边角料做了一些小手工艺品，挺有趣的。
examples.english_sentence: He used some scrap material to make some small handicrafts, they are quite interesting.

mandarin_meaning: 下台阶; 给个台阶; 找台阶下
english_meaning: To find a way out of an embarrassing situation; to save face; to give someone a way out; to provide a face-saving opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指走下台阶，引申为在尴尬或困境中寻找摆脱困境的方法，或是为了保全面子而采取的行动。也指给别人提供脱身的机会。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to go down the stairs'. Figuratively, it refers to finding a way out of an embarrassing or difficult situation, or an action taken to save face. It also means to provide someone with an opportunity to extricate themselves from a predicament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見佢咁尷尬，咪俾個下臺階佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 keoi5 gam3 gaam3 gaai3, mai1 bei2 go3 haa6 toi4 gaai1 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看他那么尴尬，就给他个台阶下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I saw he was so embarrassed, so I gave him a way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆鬧錯咗人，佢自己都要搵返個下臺階落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 naau6 co3 zo2 jan4, keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 wan2 faan1 go3 haa6 toi4 gaai1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板骂错了人，他自己也要找个台阶下。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolded the wrong person, and he himself needs to find a way to save face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好逼得佢太緊，俾返個下臺階佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bik1 dak1 keoi5 taai3 gan2, bei2 faan1 go3 haa6 toi4 gaai1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别逼他太紧，给他个台阶下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push him too hard, give him a way to save face.

mandarin_meaning: 楼下是商铺，楼上是住宅
english_meaning: Shop below, residence above; Shops on the ground floor, residential units above.
explanation_mandarin: 一种建筑风格，指建筑物的一楼通常为商铺，而楼上则是住宅单位。
explanation_english: A type of building style where the ground floor is typically occupied by shops (commercial space), and the floors above are residential units.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前香港啲舊樓好多都係下舖上居㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 di1 gau6 lau2 ho2 do1 dou1 hai6 haa6 pou3 soeng6 geoi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前香港的旧楼很多都是楼下是商铺，楼上是住宅的。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many old buildings in Hong Kong were designed with shops on the ground floor and residences above.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅設計就係下舖上居，買嘢好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 sai3 gai3 zau6 hai6 haa6 pou3 soeng6 geoi1, maai5 je5 hou2 faan1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的设计就是楼下是商铺，楼上是住宅，买东西很方便。
examples.english_sentence: The design here is 'shop below, residence above', so it's very convenient for shopping.

english_meaning: Next round; next game; next turn
explanation_mandarin: 指在牌局或游戏中，轮到下一个人做庄家，或开始下一轮。也可泛指下一个阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the next person to be the banker (dealer) in a card game or game, or the start of the next round. It can also generally refer to the next stage or phase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今鋪我輸咗，下莊你嚟做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 pou1 ngo5 syu1 zo2, haa6 zong1 nei5 lai4 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这局我输了，下一局你来做庄家吧。
examples.english_sentence: I lost this round, you be the banker next round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下莊就到你喇，諗定點樣玩未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 zong1 zau6 dou3 nei5 laa3, nam2 ding6 dim2 joeng2 waan2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下一轮就到你了，想好怎么玩了吗？
examples.english_sentence: It's your turn next round, have you thought about how to play?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂呢個project，下莊就到搞年尾party喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 ni1 go3 project, haa6 zong1 zau6 dou3 gaau2 nin4 mei5 party laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成这个项目后，下一个阶段就是筹办年终派对了。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing this project, the next stage is to organize the year-end party.

english_meaning: whereabouts; location; trace; fate; destiny (depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某物所处的位置或情况；去向。
explanation_english: Refers to the whereabouts, location, or situation of a person or thing; destination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失咗蹤幾日，到而家都冇下落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 zo2 zung1 gei2 jat6, dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5 haa6 lok6.
