explanation_english: Referring to something that never fades away and lasts forever. Commonly used to describe achievements, spirits, or artistic works etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅音樂作品被視為不朽嘅經典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 zuk1 ban2 bei6 si6 wai4 bat1 jau2 ge3 ging1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的音乐作品被认为是永恒的经典。
examples.english_sentence: His musical works are regarded as immortal classics.

mandarin_meaning: 没有白活这一辈子；不虚此生
english_meaning: to have lived a worthwhile life; to have no regrets in life
explanation_mandarin: 表示这一生过得很有意义，没有虚度。
explanation_english: Indicates that one's life has been meaningful and well-spent, not wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以同你一齊，我真係覺得不枉此生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 bat1 wong2 ci2 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能够和你在一起，我真的觉得不枉此生。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to be with you, I truly feel that I have lived a worthwhile life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果可以親眼睇到佢攞獎，我諗我真係不枉此生喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 can1 ngaan5 tai2 dou2 keoi5 lo2 zoeng2, ngo5 lam2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 bat1 wong2 ci2 sang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果能亲眼看到他得奖，我想我真的不虚此生了。
examples.english_sentence: If I can see him win an award with my own eyes, I think I will truly have lived a worthwhile life.

english_meaning: to part on bad terms; to break up unhappily; to end in discord
explanation_mandarin: 指双方因意见不合或发生争执，最后很不愉快地分手。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two or more parties part ways unhappily due to disagreement, argument, or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個傾唔埋，結果不歡而散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 king1 m4 maai4, git3 gwo2 bat1 fun1 ji4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人谈不拢，结果不欢而散。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them couldn't agree, so they ended up parting on bad terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為價錢問題，我哋同間餐廳嘅經理不歡而散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gaa3 cin2 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 tung4 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ging1 lei5 bat1 fun1 ji4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为价格问题，我们和餐厅的经理不欢而散。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the price issue, we parted on bad terms with the restaurant manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅會議因為太多爭拗而搞到不歡而散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 wui6 ji5 jan1 wai6 taai3 do1 zang1 aau3 ji4 gaau2 dou3 bat1 fun1 ji4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的会议因为太多争执而导致不欢而散。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's meeting ended on bad terms due to too many arguments.

english_meaning: not only, more than, not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出某个范围或数量，不仅仅是。
explanation_english: Indicates exceeding a certain range or quantity; meaning 'not just' or 'more than'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔止叻仔，仲好勤力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi2 lek1 zai2, zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不只是聪明，还很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He's not only smart, but also very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔止有一個朋友嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi2 jau5 jat1 go3 pang4 jau5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不止有一个朋友来。
examples.english_sentence: More than one friend is coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食唔止好味，仲好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 m4 zi2 hou2 mei6, zung6 hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物不仅好吃，还很划算。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is not only delicious, but also very affordable.

english_meaning: Undead creature, undead being
explanation_mandarin: 指虚构故事中不会真正死亡的生物，例如僵尸、吸血鬼等。
explanation_english: Refers to a creature in fiction that cannot truly die, such as zombies, vampires, etc. Undead beings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喪屍係不死生物嘅一種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: song3 si1 hai6 bat1 sei2 sang1 mat6 ge3 jat1 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 僵尸是不死生物的一种。
examples.english_sentence: Zombies are a type of undead creature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多奇幻故事都有不死生物出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 kei4 faan3 gu3 si6 dou1 jau5 bat1 sei2 sang1 mat6 ceot1 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多奇幻故事都有不死生物出现。
examples.english_sentence: Many fantasy stories feature undead creatures.

mandarin_meaning: 不长草木的地方；荒凉贫瘠的土地
english_meaning: barren land; desolate place; wasteland
explanation_mandarin: 指土地贫瘠，不生长草木的地方。也比喻文化、经济等落后的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to barren land where no vegetation grows. It can also be used metaphorically to describe places with backward culture, economy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度一片不毛之地，咩都冇得種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jat1 pin3 bat1 mou4 zi1 dei6, me1 dou1 mou5 dak1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里一片不毛之地，什么都种不了。
examples.english_sentence: That place is a barren land, nothing can be grown there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業喺香港曾經係不毛之地，但係近年發展得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 cang4 ging1 hai6 bat1 mou4 zi1 dei6, daan6 hai6 gan6 nin4 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业在香港曾经是不毛之地，但是近年来发展得很快。
examples.english_sentence: This industry used to be a wasteland in Hong Kong, but it has developed very quickly in recent years.

mandarin_meaning: 自给自足；不需要依靠别人
english_meaning: self-sufficient; self-reliant; no need to ask for help
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物不需要依靠别人，能够独立完成或解决问题。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is self-sufficient and does not need to rely on others; able to accomplish or solve problems independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好不求人㗎，咩都自己搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bat1 kiu4 jan4 gaa3, me1 dou1 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很自给自足的，什么都自己搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He's very self-reliant, he takes care of everything himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社會要培養不求人嘅精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 jiu3 pui4 joeng5 bat1 kiu4 jan4 ge3 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社会要培养自力更生的精神。
examples.english_sentence: This society needs to cultivate a spirit of self-reliance.

synonyms: 自力更生 (zi6 lik6 gang1 sang1)

english_meaning: not seeking thorough understanding; content with a superficial understanding; skimming the surface
explanation_mandarin: 指读书或学习等不深入钻研，只求了解大概，不求透彻理解。
explanation_english: Refers to not delving deeply into reading or learning, but only seeking a general understanding, not a thorough understanding. It suggests a lack of in-depth study and a preference for a superficial grasp of the subject matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試之前剩係求求其其咁睇一次啲 notes，根本就係不求甚解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 zi1 cin4 sing6 hai6 kiu4 kiu4 gei1 gei1 gam2 tai2 jat1 ci3 di1 notes, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 bat1 kiu4 sam6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试之前只是马马虎虎地看了一遍笔记，根本就是不求甚解。
examples.english_sentence: He just glanced at the notes before the exam, he was basically not seeking thorough understanding at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得學語言，不求甚解都唔係一個好方法，始終要了解背後嘅文化同埋語法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hok6 jyu5 jin4, bat1 kiu4 sam6 gaai2 dou1 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 fong1 faat3, ci2 zung1 jiu3 liu4 gaai2 bui3 hau6 ge3 man4 faa3 tung4 ma4 jyu5 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得学语言，不求甚解不是一个好方法，始终要了解背后的文化和语法。
examples.english_sentence: I think that when learning a language, not seeking thorough understanding is not a good method, you still need to understand the culture and grammar behind it.

mandarin_meaning: 不治之症; 没得治; 无法医治
english_meaning: incurable; untreatable; hopeless (of a disease); beyond cure
explanation_mandarin: 形容疾病严重，无法治疗。
explanation_english: Describes a disease as being severe and untreatable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢個病已經不治，冇得醫喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 go3 beng6 ji5 ging1 bat1 zi6, mou5 dak1 ji1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的病已经是不治之症，没法医治了。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his illness is already incurable, there's no cure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果太遲發現，好多癌症都會變成不治之症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 taai3 ci4 faat3 yin6, hou2 do1 ngaam4 zing3 dou1 wui5 bin3 sing4 bat1 zi6 zi1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果发现太晚，很多癌症都会变成不治之症。
examples.english_sentence: If discovered too late, many cancers will become incurable.

english_meaning: incurable disease, terminal illness
explanation_mandarin: 指无法医治的疾病。也比喻无法挽救的局面或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to a disease that cannot be cured. It can also be used metaphorically to describe a hopeless situation or something beyond saving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢嗰個係不治之症，冇得醫喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 go2 go3 hai6 bat1 zi6 zi1 zing3, mou5 dak1 yi1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他那个是不治之症，没法治了。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that his disease is incurable, there's no way to cure it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污好似不治之症噉，點搞都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 hou2 ci5 bat1 zi6 zi1 zing3 gam2, dim2 gaau2 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污好像不治之症一样，怎么搞都搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: Corruption is like an incurable disease, no matter how you try to deal with it, you can't.

english_meaning: illegal, unlawful
explanation_mandarin: 指违反法律，不符合法律规定的。
explanation_english: Referring to something that violates the law or does not comply with legal regulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲不法嘅嘢，俾警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 bat1 faat3 ge3 je5, bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了一些不合法的事情，被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He did some illegal things and was arrested by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不法商人利用漏洞嚟搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 faat3 soeng1 jan4 lei6 jung6 lou6 dung6 lai4 wan2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不法商人利用漏洞来赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: Unscrupulous merchants exploit loopholes to make money.

english_meaning: lawless elements, outlaw, criminal
explanation_mandarin: 指不遵守法律、为非作歹的人。
explanation_english: People who do not obey the law and commit crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班不法之徒專門呃啲老人家嘅錢，真係好衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 bat1 faat3 zi1 tou4 zyun1 mun4 aak1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa3 ge3 cin2, zan1 hai6 hou2 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群不法之徒专门骗老年人的钱，真是太坏了。
examples.english_sentence: This group of criminals specifically swindles money from the elderly, it's really terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正全力追緝呢班不法之徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 cyun4 lik6 zeoi1 cap1 ni1 baan1 bat1 faat3 zi1 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在全力追捕这群不法之徒。
examples.english_sentence: The police are making every effort to hunt down this group of outlaws.

english_meaning: lawbreakers, criminals, illegal elements
explanation_mandarin: 指从事非法活动的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who engage in illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方全力打擊不法分子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 cyun4 lik6 daa2 gik1 bat1 faat3 fan6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方全力打击不法分子。
examples.english_sentence: The police are making every effort to crack down on lawbreakers.

english_meaning: Needless to say, it goes without saying, obviously
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情非常明显，不需要再多加解释。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is very obvious and needs no further explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁多人肥佬，不消說係阿Sir教得唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 do1 jan4 fei4 lou2, bat1 siu1 syut3 hai6 aa3 Sir1 gaau3 dak1 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么多人不及格，不用说是老师教得不好。
examples.english_sentence: So many people failed this exam, needless to say, it's because the teacher didn't teach well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風，不消說梗係唔使返工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1, bat1 siu1 syut3 gang2 hai6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天刮台风，不用说肯定不用上班了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a typhoon tomorrow, it goes without saying that we don't have to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁鍾意佢女朋友，不消說乜嘢都肯為佢做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 zung1 ji3 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5, bat1 siu1 syut3 mat1 je5 dou1 hang2 wai4 keoi5 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么喜欢他的女朋友，不用说什么都愿意为她做。
examples.english_sentence: He likes his girlfriend so much, needless to say, he's willing to do anything for her.

synonyms: 無須多講 (mou4 seoi1 do1 gong2)

english_meaning: Needless to say; It goes without saying
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情显而易见，无需多言。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is obvious and does not need to be stated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫條女，不消説啦，一定乜都買畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 tiu4 neoi2, bat1 siu1 syut3 laa1, jat1 ding6 mat1 dou1 maai5 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么疼爱女朋友，不用说，肯定什么都买给她。
examples.english_sentence: He loves his girlfriend so much, needless to say, he will definitely buy her anything she wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，不消説啦，一定好多人肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, bat1 siu1 syut3 laa1, jat1 ding6 hou2 do1 jan4 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么难，不用说，肯定很多人不及格。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is so difficult, it goes without saying that many people will fail.

english_meaning: unforeseen, unexpected, mishap, accident
explanation_mandarin: 指无法预料的灾祸或意外事件。也形容事情难以预料。
explanation_english: Refers to an unpredictable disaster or accident. Also describes something that is difficult to predict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有好多不測嘅事，所以要珍惜眼前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 jau5 hou2 do1 bat1 caak1 ge3 si6, so2 ji5 jiu3 zan1 sik1 ngaan5 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有很多不可预测的事情，所以要珍惜眼前。
examples.english_sentence: There are many unforeseen events in life, so we should cherish what we have in front of us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為交通意外而離世，真係不測之禍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 ji4 lei4 sai3, zan1 hai6 bat1 caak1 zi1 wo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为交通事故而去世，真是飞来横祸。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away due to a traffic accident, a truly unexpected disaster.

english_meaning: not smooth, not fluent, clumsy
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作或行为不流畅，不够利索，有点笨拙的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes an action or behavior that is not smooth, not fluent, and somewhat clumsy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似唔舒服咁，做嘢都唔溜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6 gam2, zou6 je5 dou1 m4 lau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像不太舒服，做事都不利索。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't seem well today, and he's not doing things smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我廣東話講得唔溜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 m4 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我的粤语说得不流利。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, my Cantonese is not fluent.

english_meaning: dissatisfied; discontented; unhappy; dissatisfaction
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种事物不满意，感到不高兴或不认可。
explanation_english: Expressing dissatisfaction, unhappiness, or disapproval regarding something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個結果好不滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 hou2 bat1 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个结果很不满意。
examples.english_sentence: I am very dissatisfied with this result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對公司嘅安排好不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 on1 paai4 hou2 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对公司的安排很不满。
examples.english_sentence: He is very dissatisfied with the company's arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋表達咗對政府政策嘅不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 biu2 daat6 zo2 deoi3 zing3 fu2政策 ge3 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们表达了对政府政策的不满。
examples.english_sentence: They expressed their dissatisfaction with the government's policies.

synonyms: 嬲 (nau1) - when combined with a specific reason for anger

english_meaning: no good, not up to standard, useless, hopeless, in poor condition
explanation_mandarin: 指质量或能力差，达不到标准。形容事情或人的情况不好，不顺利。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is not up to standard, of poor quality or ability. Can also refer to a situation that is not going well or a person in poor condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦好不濟，成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 hou2 bat1 zai3, seng4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑很差劲，总是坏。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is no good, it always breaks down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排身體好不濟，成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai1 san1 tai2 hou2 bat1 zai3, seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近身体很不好，总是生病。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been feeling well lately, he's always sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廣東話好不濟，完全聽唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 bat1 zai3, jyun4 cyun4 ting1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的粤语很差劲，完全听不懂。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese is terrible, I can't understand him at all.

english_meaning: unknown to people; not widely known; little known; obscure
explanation_mandarin: 指不被大众所了解或知道的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is not understood or known by the general public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅拿手小菜不為人知，但係味道真係一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 laa1 sau2 siu2 coi3 bat1 wai4 jan4 zi1, daan6 hai6 mei6 dou6 zan1 hai6 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的拿手小菜不为人知，但是味道真是一流。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's specialty dishes are not widely known, but the taste is truly first-class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背後嘅辛酸不為人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 hau6 ge3 san1 syun1 bat1 wai4 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背后的辛酸不为人知。
examples.english_sentence: The hardships behind him are unknown to others.

english_meaning: unmoved; unaffected; impervious; not to be swayed
explanation_mandarin: 指内心坚定，不受外界事物的影响或干扰。
explanation_english: Refers to being resolute and not swayed or affected by external factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論佢哋點樣勸佢，佢都依然不為所動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 keoi5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 hyun3 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 ji1 jin4 bat1 wai4 so2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论他们怎么劝他，他都依然不为所动。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how they tried to persuade him, he remained unmoved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多嘅壓力，佢都表現得不為所動，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 ge3 aat3 lik6, keoi5 dou1 biu2 hin3 dak1 bat1 wai4 so2 dung6, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多的压力，他都表现得不为所动，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so much pressure, he remained unmoved, which is really amazing.

english_meaning: not excessive; not an overstatement; it's not an exaggeration to say...
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种说法或者评价并不过分，是恰当的。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain statement or evaluation is not excessive and is appropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話佢係天才，一啲都唔為過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 keoi5 hai6 tin1 coi3, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 wai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说他是天才，一点都不过分。
examples.english_sentence: It's not an overstatement to say he's a genius.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁勤力，話你係模範員工都唔為過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 kan4 lik6, waa6 nei5 hai6 mou4 faan6 wun4 gung1 dou1 m4 wai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么勤奋，说你是模范员工都不过分。
examples.english_sentence: You are so diligent that it is not an exaggeration to say you are a model employee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅食物咁好食，話佢係全香港最好食嘅餐廳都唔為過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 gam3 hou2 sik6, waa6 keoi5 hai6 cyun4 hoeng1 gong2 zeoi3 hou2 sik6 ge3 caan1 teng1 dou1 m4 wai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物这么好吃，说它是全香港最好吃的餐厅都不过分。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is so delicious that it's not an exaggeration to say it's the best restaurant in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: not without; not entirely without; not lacking; not a little
explanation_mandarin: 表示并非没有，带有一定的肯定意味，但程度较弱。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not entirely absent or lacking. It has a slightly affirmative tone but suggests a weak degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，佢不無壓力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, keoi5 bat1 mou4 aat3 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，他并非没有压力。
examples.english_sentence: He's not without pressure this time in the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫不無可取嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 bat1 mou4 ho2 cheui2 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画并非没有可取之处。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings are not without their merits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事不無可能發生嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 bat1 mou4 ho2 nang4 faat3 sang1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事并非没有可能发生。
examples.english_sentence: It is not impossible for this to happen.

english_meaning: otherwise, if not, or else
explanation_mandarin: 表示如果不是这样，就会出现另一种情况。
explanation_english: Used to introduce an alternative possibility or consequence if the preceding statement is not the case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲做完功課，不然阿媽會鬧你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3, bat1 jin4 aa3 maa1 wui5 naau6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点做完作业，不然妈妈会骂你。
examples.english_sentence: Finish your homework quickly, otherwise your mom will scold you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日要早啲起身，不然會遲到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 di1 hei2 san1, bat1 jin4 wui5 ci4 dou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天要早点起床，不然会迟到的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to get up earlier tomorrow, otherwise you'll be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買個新電話，不然舊嗰個太慢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 go3 san1 din6 waa2, bat1 jin4 gau6 go2 go3 taai3 maan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买个新电话，不然旧的太慢了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of buying a new phone, otherwise the old one is too slow.

synonyms: 唔係嘅話 (m4 hai6 ge3 waa2)
如果唔係 (jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6)

english_meaning: not trying hard enough; disappointing; letting (someone) down
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人没有上进心，不努力，令人失望。通常用来批评某人。也表示辜负了别人的期望。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks ambition, doesn't try hard enough, and is disappointing. It's often used to criticize someone for failing to meet expectations or letting someone down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁懶惰，真係唔爭氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laan5 do6, zan1 hai6 m4 zaang1 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么懒惰，真是不争气！
examples.english_sentence: You're so lazy, you're really disappointing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔讀書唔叻，但係佢好努力，唔算唔爭氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 duk6 syu1 m4 lek1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6, m4 syun3 m4 zaang1 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子读书不聪明，但是他很努力，不算不争气吧。
examples.english_sentence: My son isn't smart in his studies, but he works hard, so I wouldn't say he's letting me down.

english_meaning: unknown to people; not known to the public; secret
explanation_mandarin: 指不被人们所知道。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is not known to people; something kept secret or hidden from the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢默默做咗好多嘢，但係好多都係不爲人知嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mak6 mak6 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, daan6 hai6 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 bat1 wai4 jan4 zi1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他默默地做了很多事，但是很多都是不为人知的。
examples.english_sentence: He did a lot of things quietly, but many of them are unknown to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅秘製醬汁，配方一直不爲人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 bei3 zai3 zoeng3 zap1, pui3 fong1 jat1 zik6 bat1 wai4 jan4 zi1.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅真相，可能永遠都不爲人知。

english_meaning: unmoved; unaffected; not to be swayed; impervious

explanation_english: Describes a state of being calm and undisturbed, not affected or swayed by external events or influences.

examples.english_sentence: No matter how they persuaded him, he remained unmoved and insisted on doing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多困難，佢依然不爲所動，繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, keoi5 ji1 jin4 bat1 wai4 so2 dung6, gai3 zuk6 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多困难，他依然无动于衷，继续努力。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many difficulties, he remained unmoved and continued to work hard.

explanation_mandarin: 表示某種描述或行為是合理的，並未超出應有的限度。
explanation_english: Indicates that a description or action is reasonable and does not exceed the appropriate limit; not an overstatement.

examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 keoi5 hai6 tin1 coi3, dou1 m4 syun3 bat1 wai4 gwo3.

examples.english_sentence: It wouldn't be an overstatement to say he's a genius.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁努力，攞第一名都唔爲過。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么努力，拿第一名也不为过。
examples.english_sentence: You've worked so hard, it's not excessive to get first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗咁多獎，話佢係呢個領域嘅專家都唔爲過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 gam3 do1 zoeng2, waa6 keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 ling5 wik6 ge3 zhun1 gaa1 dou1 m4 wai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得了这么多奖，说他是这个领域的专家也不为过。
examples.english_sentence: Having won so many awards, it's not an overstatement to say that he is an expert in this field.

synonyms: 唔算誇張 (m4 syun3 kwaa1 zoeng1)

english_meaning: not only; not just; more than that

explanation_english: Indicates a progressive relationship, emphasizing that the degree or scope goes further than what was previously stated. Not only this, but also...

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅英语好，中文也很流利。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only good at English, but also fluent in Chinese.

english_meaning: not only; more than that; not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系，相当于“不但”、“不仅”。
explanation_english: Expresses a progressive relationship, similar to "not only," "not just," or "moreover."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不特止叻仔，重好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 dak6 zi2 lek1 zai2, zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食不特止好味，價錢重好合理。

examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is not only delicious, but also reasonably priced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不特止冇道歉，重惡人先告狀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 dak6 zi2 mou5 dou6 hip3, zung6 ok3 jan4 sin1 gou3 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅没有道歉，还恶人先告状。
examples.english_sentence: Not only did he not apologize, but he also falsely accused me.

english_meaning: not only; more than that; further
explanation_mandarin: 表示不仅限于某个方面，还有其他方面。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not limited to one aspect; there are other aspects as well. It implies 'not only' but also 'more than that'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔特止叻仔，仲好有責任感㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 dak6 zi2 lek1 zai2, zung6 hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam1 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不止聪明，还很有责任感。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart, but also very responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔特止影響到我，仲影響到成間公司。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不止影响到我，还影响到整个公司。
examples.english_sentence: This matter not only affects me, but also the entire company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔特止鍾意食點心，仲鍾意飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 dak6 zi2 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1, zung6 zung1 ji3 yam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不止喜欢吃点心，还喜欢喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: I not only like to eat dim sum, but also like to drink tea.

english_meaning: not only; not just; not merely
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系，相当于“不但”、“不只”。
explanation_english: Indicates a progressive relationship, equivalent to "not only" or "not just". It emphasizes that what follows is in addition to what has already been stated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聰明不獨止讀書叻，做運動都好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 ming4 bat1 duk6 zi2 duk6 syu1 lek1, zou6 wan6 dung6 dou1 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聪明不只学习好，运动也很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is intelligent, not only is he good at studying, but he is also good at sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次經濟唔好，不獨小公司受影響，大公司都一樣。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次经济不好，不只小公司受到影响，大公司也一样。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad this time, not only are small companies affected, but large companies are too.

english_meaning: unwilling; not reconciled; not resigned; unsatisfied
explanation_mandarin: 表示不情愿，不甘心接受某种结果或情况。
explanation_english: Expressing unwillingness, not reconciled to a certain outcome or situation; feeling resentful about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗場比賽，好不甘心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3, hou2 bat1 gam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了比赛，很不甘心。
examples.english_sentence: He lost the competition and is very unwilling to accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明佢做得好好，但係冇升職，佢梗係不甘㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 mou5 sing1 zik1, keoi5 gang2 hai6 bat1 gam1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明他做得很好，但是没有升职，他肯定不甘心。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly did a great job, but he didn't get promoted, he must be unwilling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁不甘啦，下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bat1 gam1 laa1, haa6 ci3 nou5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么不甘心啦，下次努力一点就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unwilling, just work harder next time.

english_meaning: not content with loneliness; unwilling to be lonely; restless and seeking company
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不喜欢独处，渴望被关注和参与社交活动。
explanation_english: Describes a person who dislikes being alone and craves attention and social interaction. They are unwilling to accept loneliness and actively seek out company and stimulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出去蒲，真係不甘寂寞嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 heoi3 pou4, zan1 hai6 bat1 gam1 zik6 mok6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是出去玩，真是个不甘寂寞的人。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes out to party; he's really someone who can't stand being lonely.

examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hou2 bat1 gam1 zik6 mok6, caam1 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6.

examples.english_sentence: Since retiring, he really can't stand being lonely, so he has joined many volunteer activities.

english_meaning: Not willing to be outdone; unwilling to lag behind; determined not to be second best
explanation_mandarin: 不愿意落在别人后面，想要争先。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unwilling to be inferior to others and strives to be the best or at least keep up with the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由細到大都唔甘後人，次次考試都要考第一。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明好唔甘後人㗎，見到人哋升職，佢自己都發奮讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hou2 m4 gam1 hau6 jan4 gaa3, gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 sing1 zik1, keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 faat3 fan5 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明很不甘落后，看到别人升职，他自己也发奋读书。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is very unwilling to be outdone. Seeing others get promoted, he is also determined to study hard.

english_meaning: unwilling to be outdone; not wanting to admit defeat; refusing to concede
explanation_mandarin: 不愿意表现得比别人差；不甘心示弱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unwilling to admit defeat or be seen as inferior to others. They strive to compete and not be outdone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個由細到大都好競爭，成日都不甘示弱。

examples.english_sentence: The two of them have been competitive since they were young, and they always refuse to be outdone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算輸咗，佢都唔會不甘示弱，會繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 syu1 zo2, keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 bat1 gam1 si6 joek6, wui5 gai3 zuk6 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算输了，他也不会不甘示弱，会继续努力。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he loses, he won't refuse to concede and will continue to work hard.

mandarin_meaning: 不太明白; 一知半解

examples.english_sentence: This theory is very profound; even after reading the book, I still don't really understand it.

english_meaning: no need, unnecessary, don't use
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要，不必。

examples.english_sentence: You're welcome, no need to say thank you.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 jung6 daam1 sam1, ngo5 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: No need to worry, I can handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔用返工，放假呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 jung6 faan1 gung1, fong3 gaa3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不用上班，放假了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to go to work today, it's a holiday.

english_meaning: without explanation; not allowing any argument; peremptorily
explanation_mandarin: 不给人任何解释或争辩的机会。形容态度强硬，不容置疑。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone doesn't allow any explanation or argument, acting decisively and leaving no room for doubt.

examples.english_sentence: He peremptorily packed up my belongings and left without explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽不由分說咁樣幫我哋決定晒所有嘢。

examples.english_sentence: Mom decided everything for us without allowing us to argue.

english_meaning: not allowing any explanation; without any explanation; peremptorily; to brook no argument
explanation_mandarin: 不允许辩解或解释，直接采取行动。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone doesn't allow any explanation or argument and acts directly or forcefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不由分說就拉咗我走。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不容分说地骂了他一顿。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolded him without any explanation.

english_meaning: not allowing explanation; peremptorily; without giving a chance to explain
explanation_mandarin: 不容许解释，不给对方辩解的机会，就采取行动。
explanation_english: Describing an action taken without allowing explanation or argument from the other party. To do something peremptorily or without giving a chance to explain oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不由分説就搶走咗我啲嘢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不容分说就抢走了我的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He snatched my things away without giving me a chance to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細不由分説就炒咗佢魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 bat1 jau4 fan1 syut3 zau6 caau2 zo2 keoi5 jau4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不容分说就把他解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired him without any explanation.

english_meaning: can't help but, involuntarily, cannot refrain from
explanation_mandarin: 表示控制不住自己，情不自禁地做了某事。
explanation_english: Indicates being unable to control oneself and doing something involuntarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，我哋不由得笑咗出嚟。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息，我们不由得笑了出来。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing this news, we couldn't help but laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁慘，我哋不由得覺得好心痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 dei6 bat1 jau4 dak1 gok3 dak1 hou2 sam1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么惨，我们不由得觉得很心痛。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him in such a miserable state, we couldn't help but feel very heartbroken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個故仔實在太感人，我不由得流眼淚。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 故事实在太感人，我不由自主地流眼泪。
examples.english_sentence: The story was so touching, I couldn't help but shed tears.

english_meaning: involuntarily; cannot help but; against one's will
explanation_mandarin: 指行动不由自己做主，多指受环境或感情的影响。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one's actions are not controlled by one's own will, often influenced by environment, emotions, or other external factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到呢啲感人嘅情節，我哋不由自主噉流眼淚。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这些感人的情节，我们不由自主地流眼泪。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing these touching scenes, we couldn't help but shed tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅歌聲，我哋不由自主噉拍起手掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 go1 seng1, ngo5 dei6 bat1 jau4 zi6 zyu2 gam2 paak3 hei2 sau2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到她的歌声，我们不由自主地鼓起掌。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing her singing, we couldn't help but start clapping.

english_meaning: showing no mercy; without holding back; relentless; ruthless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事或说话毫不顾忌，不留情面，非常直接。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts or speaks without any consideration, showing no mercy or holding back. Very direct and uncompromising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鬧人真係不留㗎，講嘢好尖酸刻薄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 bat1 lau4 gaa3, gong2 waa2 hou2 zim1 syun1 hak1 bok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骂人真是毫不留情，说话很尖酸刻薄。
examples.english_sentence: He really shows no mercy when scolding people; his words are very sharp and mean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次老細炒人炒得好不留，好多人一聲招呼都冇就俾人炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 lou5 sai3 caau2 jan4 caau2 dak1 hou2 bat1 lau4, hou2 do1 jan4 jat1 seng1 zaau1 fu1 dou1 mou5 zau6 bei2 jan4 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次老板炒人炒得很不留情面，很多人连招呼都没打就被炒了。
examples.english_sentence: This time the boss fired people without any mercy; many people were fired without even a goodbye.

english_meaning: inappropriate; improper; unsuitable; undue
explanation_mandarin: 指不符合标准、不适宜、不恰当的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation that is not up to standard, unsuitable, or inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講嘢好不當㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5 hou2 bat1 dong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说话很不恰当。
examples.english_sentence: The way you're talking is very inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢咁樣做有啲不當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 jau5 di1 bat1 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他这样做有些不适当。
examples.english_sentence: I think what he did was a bit inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公眾場所大聲講電話，好不當嘅行為嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 zung3 coeng4 so2 daai6 seng1 gong2 din6 waa2, hou2 bat1 dong3 ge3 hang4 wai4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公共场所大声讲电话，是很不适当的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking loudly on the phone in public is very inappropriate behavior.

mandarin_meaning: 不痛不痒 (bù tòng bù yǎng)
english_meaning: painless and not itchy; not a matter of concern; insignificant; inconsequential; neither here nor there
explanation_mandarin: 形容无关紧要，不值得重视；也可形容态度冷漠，漠不关心。
explanation_english: Describes something as being insignificant, not worth paying attention to; can also describe a cold and indifferent attitude, lacking concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢不痛不癢，根本解決唔到問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 bat1 tung3 bat1 joeng5, gan1 bun2 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的话不痛不痒，根本解决不了问题。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is neither here nor there; it doesn't solve the problem at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事嘅態度不痛不癢，好似唔關佢事咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 taai3 dou6 bat1 tung3 bat1 joeng5, hou2 ci5 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事的态度不痛不痒，好像与他无关。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude towards this matter is indifferent, as if it doesn't concern him.

synonyms: 無關痛癢 (mou4 gwaan1 tung3 joeng5)
無足輕重 (mou4 zuk1 hing1 cung5)

english_meaning: not completely; not finished; incomplete; not to the fullest extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物未达到完全或完美的程度，或者事情未完成。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not complete or perfect, or that something is not finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事講得唔係咁不盡，仲有啲細節未講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gong2 dak1 m4 hai6 gam2 bat1 zeon6, zung6 jau5 di1 sai3 zit3 mei6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事讲得不太完全，还有一些细节没说。
examples.english_sentence: The matter wasn't explained completely; there are still some details that haven't been mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢份工嘅熱情真係用之不盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jit6 cing4 zan1 hai6 yung6 zi1 bat1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这份工作的热情真是用之不竭。
examples.english_sentence: His passion for this job is truly inexhaustible.

mandarin_meaning: 不完全真实; 有水分
english_meaning: not entirely true; not completely honest; partly false; embellished
explanation_mandarin: 指说话或叙述不完全是真实的，带有夸大或隐瞒成分。
explanation_english: Describes something said or narrated that is not entirely true, containing elements of exaggeration or concealment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢不盡不實，你唔好完全相信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 bat1 zeon6 bat1 sat6, nei5 m4 hou2 wun4 cyun4 soeng1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不完全是真实的，你不要完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is not entirely true, you shouldn't believe it completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告啲數據有啲不盡不實，要再查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 di1 sou3 geoi3 jau5 di1 bat1 zeon6 bat1 sat6, jiu3 zoi3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据有些不完全真实，要再查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report is somewhat embellished, we need to investigate it further.

mandarin_meaning: 未必完全如此; 不一定
english_meaning: not necessarily; not entirely; not always
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况并非完全如此，含有一定的保留或否定意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation is not completely true or so, implying reservation or negation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢不盡然啱晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 bat1 zeon6 jin4 ngaam1晒gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不尽然都对。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is not entirely correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貴嘅嘢不盡然好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwai3 ge3 je5 bat1 zeon6 jin4 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贵的东西不一定好。
examples.english_sentence: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成功不盡然靠努力，有時都要睇運氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gung1 bat1 zeon6 jin4 kaau3 nu5 lik6, jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 tai2 wan6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成功不完全依靠努力，有时也要看运气。
examples.english_sentence: Success doesn't entirely depend on hard work; sometimes you need luck.

english_meaning: neck and neck; about the same; equally matched; on par
explanation_mandarin: 形容两者水平、能力、程度等差不多，没有明显的差别。
explanation_english: Describes two things or people that are roughly equal in skill, ability, or degree; there is no significant difference between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个嘅实力不相上下，真系好难分胜负。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 si4 lik6 bat1 soeng1 soeng1 haa6, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fan1 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的实力不相上下，真是很难分胜负。
examples.english_sentence: The strength of the two of them is neck and neck; it's really hard to determine a winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 两间公司嘅产品质量不相上下，所以竞争好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 zat1 loeng6 bat1 soeng1 soeng1 haa6, so2 ji5 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两家公司的产品质量不相上下，所以竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The product quality of the two companies is about the same, so the competition is very fierce.

english_meaning: neck and neck; equally matched; about the same
explanation_mandarin: 形容两者水平相当，难分高下。
explanation_english: Describes two things or people being roughly equal in ability or quality; hard to distinguish which is better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅實力不相伯仲，好難分出勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat6 lik6 bat1 soeng1 baak3 zung6, hou2 naan4 fan1 ceot1 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的实力不相上下，很难分出胜负。
examples.english_sentence: Their abilities are neck and neck, it's hard to tell who will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅產品不相伯仲，都咁好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 bat1 soeng1 baak3 zung6, dou1 gam3 hou2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的产品不相上下，都那么好用。
examples.english_sentence: The products of these two companies are equally matched, both are so good to use.

english_meaning: unconscious, senseless, to lose consciousness
explanation_mandarin: 指失去知觉，昏迷不醒的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of being unconscious and unresponsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒，攤喺街邊，不省人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zau2, taan1 hai2 gaai1 bin1, bat1 sing2 yan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒，躺在街边，不省人事。
examples.english_sentence: He was drunk and lying on the street, unconscious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車之後，當場不省人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6, dong1 coeng4 bat1 sing2 yan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞车之后，当场不省人事。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, he lost consciousness on the spot.

english_meaning: sleepless and without rest; working/doing something non-stop
explanation_mandarin: 指不停地工作或做某事，不睡觉也不休息。
explanation_english: Describes working or doing something continuously without sleep or rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗趕起份報告，佢不眠不休做咗成個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 gon2 hei2 fan6 bou3 gou3, keoi5 bat1 min4 bat1 jau1 zou6 zo2 sing4 go3 lai5 baai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赶完那份报告，他一个星期不眠不休地工作。
examples.english_sentence: To finish that report, he worked sleeplessly and without rest for a whole week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就嚟到喇，啲學生哥不眠不休咁溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zau6 lai4 dou3 laa3, di1 hok6 sang1 go1 bat1 min4 bat1 jau1 gam2 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试快到了，学生们不眠不休地复习功课。
examples.english_sentence: The exams are coming up, and the students are studying without sleep and without rest.

english_meaning: to ignore completely, to give the cold shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 形容对人冷淡，不理不睬。
explanation_english: Describes a cold and indifferent attitude towards someone, completely ignoring them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲咗我，成日都不瞅不睬我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 zo2 ngo5, sing4 jat6 dou1 bat1 cau2 bat1 coi2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生我的气了，整天都不理不睬我。
examples.english_sentence: He's angry with me, so he ignores me all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好不瞅不睬人哋啦，有咩事咪講清楚囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bat1 cau2 bat1 coi2 jan4 dei6 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 mai6 gong2 cing1 co2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要不理不睬人家啦，有什么事就说清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ignore people, if there's something wrong, just make it clear.

english_meaning: unconsciously; unwittingly; without realizing
explanation_mandarin: 没有意识到，没有觉察到。
explanation_english: Without realizing; unconsciously; unaware; happening or developing without one noticing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我不知不覺就飲咗成罐汽水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bat1 zi1 bat1 gok3 zau6 jam2 zo2 seng4 gun3 hei3 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知不觉就喝了一整罐汽水了。
examples.english_sentence: I unconsciously drank a whole can of soda.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間過得真係快，唔知不覺已經到咗年尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 gwo3 dak1 zan1 hai6 faai3, m4 zi1 bat1 gok3 ji5 ging1 dou3 zo2 nin4 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间过得真快，不知不觉已经到年底了。
examples.english_sentence: Time flies, it's the end of the year before I knew it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔知不覺咁鍾意咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi1 bat1 gok3 gam2 zung1 ji3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不知不觉地喜欢上了她。
examples.english_sentence: He fell in love with her without realizing it.

english_meaning: unknown, unnamed, anonymous
explanation_mandarin: 不为人所知的，没有名字的，或者名字不重要的。
explanation_english: Not known or recognized; unnamed; anonymous. Refers to something that is not famous, or whose name is not important or relevant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲甜品好正，不過係一啲不知名嘅小店整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 hou2 zeng3, bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 di1 bat1 zi1 ming4 ge3 siu2 dim3 zing2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的甜点很好吃，但是是一些不知名的小店做的。
examples.english_sentence: The desserts in this restaurant are delicious, but they are made by some unknown small shops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到一份不知名嘅禮物，唔知邊個送嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou2 jat1 fan6 bat1 zi1 ming4 ge3 lai5 mat6, m4 zi1 bin1 go3 sung3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到一份不知名的礼物，不知道是谁送的。
examples.english_sentence: I received an anonymous gift, I don't know who sent it.

jyutping: bat1 zi1 tin1 gou1 dei6 hau5
mandarin_meaning: 不知道天有多高，地有多厚 (比喻狂妄无知，不自量力)
english_meaning: not know the immensity of heaven and earth; be ignorant of one's limitations; be arrogant and presumptuous
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人狂妄自大，不了解事情的严重性和自己的能力不足，非常自以为是。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is arrogant and doesn't understand the seriousness of things or their own limitations, being overly self-opinionated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就想做老細，真係唔知天高地厚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 sang1 zau6 soeng2 zou6 lou5 sai3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 tin1 gou1 dei6 hau5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就想当老板，真是不知道天高地厚！
examples.english_sentence: He's so young and already wants to be a boss, he really doesn't know the immensity of heaven and earth!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁唔知天高地厚啦，人哋都唔睬你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 m4 zi1 tin1 gou1 dei6 hau5 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 m4 caai2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么不知天高地厚了，人家都不理你了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, people are ignoring you.

synonyms: 目中無人 (muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4)
自以為是 (zi6 ji5 wai4 si6)

english_meaning: extremely; very; awfully; incredibly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，相当于“非常”、“很”、“极其”。语气强烈。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree of intensity, equivalent to 'extremely', 'very', or 'incredibly'. It has a strong emphatic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔嚟，你知唔知佢有幾唔開心啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 lei4, nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 gei2 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天没来，你知道他有多不开心吗？
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come today, do you know how incredibly unhappy he is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食不知幾好食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 bat1 zi1 gei2 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is awfully delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我不知幾鍾意睇佢嘅戲啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bat1 zi1 gei2 zung1 ji3 tai2 keoi5 ge3 hei3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢看他的电影！
examples.english_sentence: I incredibly like watching his movies!

mandarin_meaning: 不知廉耻 (bù zhī lián chǐ)
english_meaning: shameless; without any sense of shame; brazen
explanation_mandarin: 指没有羞耻之心，不知羞愧。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has no sense of shame or doesn't know how to be ashamed; brazen or shameless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人做咗咁多衰嘢都唔知廉恥，真係冇得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5 dou1 m4 zi1 lim4 ci2, zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人做了这么多坏事都不知道羞耻，真是没救了。
examples.english_sentence: That person has done so many bad things and is still shameless, truly hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢畀人捉到，仲好似冇嘢發生過咁，真係唔知廉恥！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2, zung6 hou2 ci5 mou5 je5 faat3 sang1 gwo3 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 lim4 ci2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷东西被人抓到，还好像什么都没发生过一样，真是不知廉耻！
examples.english_sentence: He was caught stealing, but acted as if nothing had happened. He is truly shameless!

synonyms: 厚顏無恥 (hau5 ngaan4 mou4 ci2)

english_meaning: to not know what to do; to be at a loss; to be perplexed
explanation_mandarin: 形容遇到突发情况或复杂问题时，不知道该如何应付或处理。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one is unsure of what to do or how to react when faced with a sudden or complex situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢突然間辭職，我哋個個都唔知所措。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 ci4 zik1, ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 m4 zi1 so2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他突然辞职，我们每个人都不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that he suddenly resigned, all of us were at a loss.

mandarin_meaning: 不知去向; 下落不明
english_meaning: to disappear without a trace; to vanish; whereabouts unknown; to have an unknown fate
explanation_mandarin: 指不知道最终的结局或下落。指人或物消失后，不知道去了哪里，最终怎么样。
explanation_english: Refers to not knowing the final outcome or whereabouts. It indicates that a person or thing has disappeared and it is not known where they went or what happened to them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從失蹤之後就一直不知所終，可能已經唔喺人世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 sat1 zung1 zi1 hau6 zau6 jat1 zik6 bat1 zi1 so2 zung1, ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 m4 hai2 jan4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他失踪后就一直下落不明，可能已经不在人世了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been missing without a trace since his disappearance, and he might not be alive anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢唔知點解會不知所終，完全搵唔到去咗邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 m4 zi1 dim2 gai2 wui bat1 zi1 so2 zung1, jyun4 cyun4 wan2 m4 dou2 heoi3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道为什么钱会不知去向，完全找不到去了哪里。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why the money disappeared without a trace, I can't find where it went at all.

english_meaning: incomprehensible; nonsensical; talking rubbish; doesn't know what one is talking about
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人说话或行为毫无逻辑，令人无法理解；也可表示某人胡说八道，说一些没有意义或不靠谱的话。
explanation_english: Describes someone's speech or behavior as illogical and incomprehensible; also indicates that someone is talking nonsense, saying meaningless or unreliable things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講啲嘢咁不知所謂，邊有人會信你啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 di1 je5 gam3 bat1 zi1 so2 wai6, bin1 jau5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的这些话这么莫名其妙，谁会相信你啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're talking such nonsense, who's going to believe you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫到不知所謂，完全唔知佢想表達啲乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 bat1 zi1 so2 wai6, jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告简直莫名其妙，完全不知道他想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: His report is totally incomprehensible; I have no idea what he's trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度不知所謂啦，快啲講清楚發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 bat1 zi1 so2 wai6 laa1, faai3 di1 gong2 cing1 co2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里胡说八道了，快点说清楚发生什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense and tell me clearly what happened.

english_meaning: Ignorance is no crime (or, one is not to be blamed for what one does in ignorance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示对于不知道情况的人，不应该责怪他们。
explanation_english: This idiom means that someone who is unaware of a situation or rule should not be blamed for violating it. It implies that culpability requires knowledge of wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次嚟，唔知规矩，不知者不罪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4, m4 zi1 kwai1 geoi2, bat1 zi1 ze2 bat1 zeoi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是第一次来，不知道规矩，不知者无罪。

explanation_english: Describes two things that are not equal or not the same. As a verb, it means 'not equal to'.

english_meaning: no matter (what, who, etc.); regardless of; no matter; whether or not; to not care about; to ignore; to disregard

examples.english_sentence: He is very busy; no matter how I call him, he ignores me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不管落雨唔落雨，我哋都要出街。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不管下不下雨，我们都要出门。
examples.english_sentence: Whether it rains or not, we have to go out.

english_meaning: to do something in unison without prior arrangement; coincidentally
explanation_mandarin: 事先没有约定而彼此行动或想法一致。
explanation_english: Describing a situation where people do the same thing or have the same idea without previously agreeing to do so; a coincidence.

examples.english_sentence: They both raised their hands to answer the question coincidentally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不約而同咁揀咗同一間餐廳食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 joek3 ji4 tung4 gam2 gaan2 zo2 tung4 jat1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6.
