examples.english_sentence: The boss always ignores the opinions of his subordinates, which makes morale very low.

english_meaning: unfilial; undutiful (to parents); degenerate (son)
explanation_mandarin: 指子女不孝顺父母，品行不端。
explanation_english: Describes a child who is unfilial, undutiful, or degenerate towards their parents. Implies poor character or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個仔咁唔生性，真係不肖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zai2 gam3 m4 sang1 sing3, zan1 hai6 bat1 siu3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子这么不成器，真是个不孝子啊！
examples.english_sentence: The son is so useless; he's really an unfilial child!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多衰嘢，簡直係不肖子孫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 bat1 siu3 zi2 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，简直是不肖子孙。
examples.english_sentence: He's done so many bad things, he's simply an undutiful descendant.

english_meaning: infertile; sterile
explanation_mandarin: 指男性或女性没有生育能力，无法自然怀孕。
explanation_english: Refers to the inability of a male or female to conceive or bear children naturally; infertility; sterility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢哋夫婦兩個都有啲不育嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 fu1 fu2 loeng5 go3 dou1 jau5 di1 bat1 juk6 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他们夫妇两个都有一些不孕不育的问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that both of them, as a couple, have some infertility problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不育嘅原因可以好複雜，要詳細檢查先知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 juk6 ge3 jyun4 yan1 ho2 ji5 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jiu3 cheung4 sai3 gim2 cha4 sin1 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不孕不育的原因可能很复杂，要详细检查才知道。
examples.english_sentence: The cause of infertility can be very complex; a detailed examination is required to find out.

english_meaning: Cannot be fully recorded; cannot list everything; not everything can be included
explanation_mandarin: 表示由于数量太多或内容过于繁杂，无法将所有细节都记录下来或列举出来。
explanation_english: Indicates that due to a large quantity or complexity, it is impossible to record or list all the details or items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚演唱會嘅精彩moment真係太多，不能盡錄呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 zing1 coi2 moment zan1 hai6 taai3 do1, bat1 nang4 zeon6 luk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚演唱会的精彩瞬间真的太多了，不能全部记录下来啊！
examples.english_sentence: There were so many wonderful moments at tonight's concert, it's impossible to record them all!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講咗好多理由，不能盡錄，總之就係唔想去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 lei5 jau2, bat1 nang4 zeon6 luk6, zung2 zi1 zau6 hai6 m4 soeng2 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说了很多理由，不能完全记录下来，总之就是不想去啦。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a lot of reasons, I can't list them all, but basically, he doesn't want to go.

english_meaning: unable to control oneself; beside oneself; uncontrollable
explanation_mandarin: 形容情感激动，无法控制自己。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being so emotionally excited or overwhelmed that one loses control of their actions or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個好消息之後，興奮到不能自已。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, hing1 fan5 dou3 bat1 nang4 zi6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个好消息之后，兴奋得不能自拔。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the good news, he was so excited he couldn't control himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到咁感人嘅戲，我忍唔住喊到不能自已。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou3 gam3 gam2 jan4 ge3 hei3, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 haam3 dou3 bat1 nang4 zi6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这么感人的戏，我忍不住哭得不能自拔。
examples.english_sentence: Watching such a touching movie, I couldn't help but cry uncontrollably.

english_meaning: unable to extricate oneself; unable to free oneself; incapable of escaping; beyond redemption
explanation_mandarin: 形容陷得很深，无法自制或摆脱。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is deeply mired in something, unable to control themselves or escape from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢沉迷賭博，而家已經不能自拔喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 mai4 dou2 bok3, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 bat1 nang4 zi6 bat6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沉迷赌博，现在已经不能自拔了。
examples.english_sentence: He is addicted to gambling and is now unable to extricate himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢隻遊戲上咗癮，已經不能自拔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 zek3 jau4 hei3 soeng5 zo2 jan5, ji5 ging1 bat1 nang4 zi6 bat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这个游戏上瘾了，已经不能自拔了。
examples.english_sentence: He's addicted to this game and can't free himself.

english_meaning: To spread like wildfire; to become widely known without effort.
explanation_mandarin: 指没有腿也能跑，比喻事物无需推行，就已迅速传播开来。
explanation_english: This idiom describes something that spreads quickly and widely without any effort or promotion. It literally translates to "to run without legs."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單醜聞好快就唔脛而走，冇人唔知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 chau2 man4 hou2 faai3 zau6 m4 ging3 ji4 zau2, mou5 jan4 m4 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件丑闻很快就传开了，没有人不知道了。
examples.english_sentence: This scandal spread like wildfire, everyone knows about it.

english_meaning: to overestimate one's capabilities; to bite off more than one can chew; to be unaware of one's limitations
explanation_mandarin: 指过高地估计自己的能力，形容一个人不了解自身的能力和水平。
explanation_english: Describes someone who overestimates their abilities and doesn't understand their own limitations and capabilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁瘦都想搬起張梳化，真係不自量力！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sau3 dou1 soeng2 bun1 hei2 zoeng1 so1 faa2, zan1 hai6 bat1 zi6 loeng6 lik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么瘦还想搬起这张沙发，真是自不量力！
examples.english_sentence: He's so skinny and wants to lift that sofa, he's really biting off more than he can chew!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇經驗就想做經理？唔好咁不自量力啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 ging1 jim6 zau6 soeng2 zou6 ging1 lei5? m4 hou2 gam3 bat1 zi6 loeng6 lik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你没有经验就想当经理？不要这么不自量力。
examples.english_sentence: You want to be a manager without any experience? Don't overestimate yourself so much.

synonyms: 自不量力 (zi6 bat1 loeng6 lik6 - using 自 instead of 不)
高估自己 (gou1 gu1 zi6 gei2)

english_meaning: not to the extent of; not so; not necessarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度或结果不会达到某种极端情况。
explanation_english: Indicates that the degree or result will not reach a certain extreme situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢遲到，但係都唔至於要炒佢魷魚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ci4 dou3, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 zi3 jyu1 jiu3 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他迟到了，但也不至于要解雇他。
examples.english_sentence: Although he was late, it's not so bad that he has to be fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試雖然唔係考得好好，但都唔至於肥佬嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2, daan6 dou1 m4 zi3 jyu1 fei4 lou1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试虽然考得不是很好，但也不至于不及格。
examples.english_sentence: Although I didn't do very well in this exam, it's not so bad that I'll fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧交鬧得好勁，但係都唔至於會分手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 naau6 dak1 hou2 ging6, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 zi3 jyu1 wui5 fan1 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架吵得很厉害，但也不至于会分手。
examples.english_sentence: They are arguing fiercely, but it's not to the extent that they will break up.

english_meaning: not to the point of; not so as to; unlikely to
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度较轻，不会发展到某种地步；不会发生某种情况。
explanation_english: Indicates a lesser degree; not to the point of something; unlikely to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔舒服啫，不致於要入院嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 syu1 fuk6 ze1, bat1 zi3 jyu1 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不舒服而已，不至于要住院的。
examples.english_sentence: He's just feeling unwell; it's unlikely that he needs to be hospitalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔合格，但都不致於要留班嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 hap1 gaak3, daan6 dou1 bat1 zi3 jyu1 jiu3 lau4 baan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，但还不至于要留级的。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam, but it's not so bad that I have to repeat the grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋吵架啫，不致會分手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 caau2 gaa3 ze1, bat1 zi3 wui5 fan1 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们只是吵架而已，不至于会分手的。
examples.english_sentence: They are just arguing; it's unlikely that they will break up.

english_meaning: erectile dysfunction, impotence
explanation_mandarin: 指男性生殖器官无法勃起或维持勃起的状态，导致无法进行性行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the inability of a male's reproductive organ to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse; erectile dysfunction; impotence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑自己有不舉嘅問題，好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 zi6 gei2 jau5 bat1 geoi2 ge3 man6 tai4, hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他怀疑自己有阳痿的问题，很担心。
examples.english_sentence: He suspects he has erectile dysfunction and is very worried.

english_meaning: bad, undesirable, unhealthy, delinquent
explanation_mandarin: 指不好，不健康，不道德，或不符合标准。
explanation_english: Refers to something bad, undesirable, unhealthy, immoral, or not up to standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好不良，成日搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 bat1 loeng4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很不良，总是惹事。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is very bad, he's always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不良飲食習慣會影響健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 loeng4 jam2 sik6 zaap6 gwaan3 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不良的饮食习惯会影响健康。
examples.english_sentence: Unhealthy eating habits will affect your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲不良分子成日喺嗰度搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bat1 loeng4 fan6 zi2 seng4 jat6 hai2 go2 dou6 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些不良分子总是在那里惹事。
examples.english_sentence: Those delinquents are always causing trouble there.

english_meaning: adverse reaction, side effect
explanation_mandarin: 指身体对药物、疫苗或其他治疗方式产生的负面或有害的影响。
explanation_english: An unwanted or harmful effect caused by a drug, vaccine, or other treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗呢隻藥之後，我個人有啲不良反應，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 ni1 zek3 joek6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 go3 jan4 jau5 di1 bat1 loeng4 faan2 jing3, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这种药之后，我个人有一些不良反应，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: After taking this medicine, I'm experiencing some adverse reactions, feeling very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打咗針之後，有啲人會有輕微嘅不良反應，例如發燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zo2 zam1 zi1 hau6, jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 jau5 hing1 mei1 ge3 bat1 loeng4 faan2 jing3, laap6 jyu4 faat3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打针之后，有些人会有轻微的不良反应，例如发烧。
examples.english_sentence: After getting the injection, some people may have mild adverse reactions, such as fever.

english_meaning: unable to walk properly; having difficulty walking; impaired mobility
explanation_mandarin: 指因为疾病、受伤或其他原因，导致行走困难或无法正常行走。
explanation_english: Describes a condition where someone has difficulty walking or is unable to walk normally due to illness, injury, or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢早排撞車撞親咗隻腳，而家不良於行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou2 paai4 zong6 ce1 zong6 can1 zo2 zek3 goek3, ji4 gaa1 bat1 loeng4 jyu1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他前段时间出了车祸，撞伤了脚，现在行动不便。
examples.english_sentence: He had a car accident a while ago and injured his leg, so he has difficulty walking now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆年紀大，不良於行，出入都要用拐杖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po2 nin4 gei2 daai6, bat1 loeng4 jyu1 hang4, ceot1 jap6 dou1 jiu3 yung6 gwaai1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶年纪大了，行动不便，出入都要用拐杖。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is old and has difficulty walking, so she needs to use a walking stick when going out.

english_meaning: not inclined to smile; serious and stern; unsmiling
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不爱说笑，态度严肃。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not inclined to smile or joke, and has a serious and stern demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人不苟言笑，好難接近咁嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 bat1 gau2 jin4 siu3, hou2 naan4 zip3 gan6 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不苟言笑，很难接近的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He is the type of person who doesn't smile easily, making him hard to approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿 Sir 成日不苟言笑，搞到啲學生好驚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 sing4 jat6 bat1 gau2 jin4 siu3, gaau2 dou3 di1 hok6 sang1 hou2 ging1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师总是板着脸，搞得学生们很怕他。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is always unsmiling, which makes the students afraid of him.

mandarin_meaning: 价值不低, 价格昂贵
english_meaning: considerable (price, value); not cheap; expensive; substantial
explanation_mandarin: 指价值或价格很高，不便宜。
explanation_english: Describes something that is of considerable value or has a high price, not cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅價錢都幾不菲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 gaa3 cin2 dou1 gei2 bat1 fei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的价格还是相当贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The price of this car is quite considerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工真係不菲，難怪咁多人想入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 zan1 hai6 bat1 fei2, naan4 gwaai3 gam3 do1 jan4 soeng2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资真的很高，难怪这么多人想进去。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is really substantial, no wonder so many people want to join.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食雖然好食，但係價錢都唔不菲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 seoi1 jin4 hou2 sik6, daan6 hai6 gaa3 cin2 dou1 m4 bat1 fei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西虽然好吃，但是价格也不便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Although the food in this restaurant is delicious, the price is not cheap.

english_meaning: not staying at home; always out; a rolling stone
explanation_mandarin: 形容人经常在外，很少待在家里。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is frequently away from home and rarely stays in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔落家，唔知去咗邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 lok6 gaa1, m4 zi1 heoi3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都不在家，不知道去哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: He's never home these days. I don't know where he's gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從做咗 sales 之後，就變得唔落家喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 zou6 zo2 sales zi1 hau6, zau6 bin3 dak1 m4 lok6 gaa1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他做了销售之后，就变得不回家了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he became a salesman, he's been spending more time away from home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唔落家，屋企人會擔心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 m4 lok6 gaa1, uk1 kei2 jan4 wui5 daam1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不着家，家里人会担心的。
examples.english_sentence: You're always away from home; your family will worry about you.

english_meaning: unrealistic, impractical, irrelevant, far-fetched
explanation_mandarin: 形容想法或说话不切实际，不着调，不靠谱。
explanation_english: Describes ideas, words, or behavior that are unrealistic, impractical, irrelevant, or far-fetched. It implies a lack of connection to reality and a sense of being unreliable or untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲不著邊際嘅嘢，冇人信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 bat1 zoek6 bin1 zai3 ge3 je5, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一些不切实际的话，没人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always says unrealistic things, no one believes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再諗啲咁不著邊際嘅嘢啦，實際啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 lam2 di1 gam3 bat1 zoek6 bin1 zai3 ge3 je5 laa1, sat6 zai3 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再想那些不切实际的东西了，实际一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about such unrealistic things anymore, it's better to be more practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃太不著邊際，根本冇可能成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 taai3 bat1 zoek6 bin1 zai3, gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划太不切实际，根本没有可能成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is too unrealistic, there's simply no chance of success.

english_meaning: Healed without medicine; Cured spontaneously; Self-healing
explanation_mandarin: 没有用药就痊愈了。形容病情自然好转，无需治疗。
explanation_english: To heal or recover without any medication or treatment. It describes a situation where an illness or condition improves on its own without external intervention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我原本以為要睇醫生㗎，點知瞓醒就唔葯而癒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jyun4 bun2 ji5 wai4 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1 gaa3, dim2 zi1 fan3 sing2 zau6 m4 joek6 ji4 jyu6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我原本以为要去看医生的，没想到睡醒就不药而愈了。
examples.english_sentence: I originally thought I needed to see a doctor, but unexpectedly I healed without medicine after waking up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲病真係唔使食葯都會不葯而癒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 beng6 zan1 hai6 m4 sai2 sik6 joek6 dou1 wui bat1 joek6 ji4 jyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些病真的不用吃药也会不药而愈的。
examples.english_sentence: Some illnesses really do heal on their own without medication.

english_meaning: to heal without medicine; to recover without medical treatment; to get better on its own
explanation_mandarin: 不吃药也能痊愈。形容病情自愈，无需药物治疗。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where an illness recovers without the need for medication or treatment. The condition heals naturally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢感冒咗幾日，估唔到唔睇醫生都不藥而癒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 mou6 zo2 gei2 jat6, gu2 m4 dou3 m4 tai2 ji1 sang1 dou1 bat1 joek6 ji4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他感冒了几天，没想到不看医生也不药而愈。
examples.english_sentence: He had a cold for a few days, but unexpectedly, he got better on his own without seeing a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係心理作用啦，自从佢哋分手之后，佢嘅情傷竟然不藥而癒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 hai6 sam1 lei5 zok3 jung6 laa1, zi6 cung4 keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 cing4 soeng1 ging2 jin4 bat1 joek6 ji4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是心理作用吧，自从他们分手之后，他的情伤竟然不药而愈。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe it's psychological, but since they broke up, his heartbreak has healed without any help.

english_meaning: Cannot, not allowed, no way, won't do, not suitable, impossible
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，不允许，不能做，不合适等意思。
explanation_english: Expresses negation, not allowed, unable to do, unsuitable, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔得㗎，呢度唔可以停车嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 dak1 gaa3, ni1 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 ting4 ce1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不行的，这里不可以停车的。
examples.english_sentence: No way, you can't park here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁贵嘅嘢，我哋唔得闲买啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5, ngo5 dei6 m4 dak1 haan4 maai5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的东西，我们没空买啊。
examples.english_sentence: Such expensive things, we can't afford to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我唔得闲，听日得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我没空，明天行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tonight, is tomorrow okay?

english_meaning: Don't want; Not want; No need; Alright; It's okay; Never mind
explanation_mandarin: 表示不想要、不需要；也可以表示沒關係，不要緊。
explanation_english: Expresses not wanting or needing something. It can also mean 'alright', 'it's okay', or 'never mind'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔要啊，唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 jiu3 aa3, m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不要了，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want it anymore, thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意嘅話，咪唔要囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 waa2, mai6 m4 jiu3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不喜欢的话，就不要好了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't like it, then don't take it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔緊要，唔要緊嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gan2 jiu3, m4 jiu3 gan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没关系，不要紧的。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay, never mind.

english_meaning: It's okay, never mind, don't worry
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情不严重，没有关系，不用担心。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not serious, it doesn't matter, don't worry about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗嘢啊？唔要緊嘅，執返起咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 je5 aa3? m4 jiu3 gan2 ge3, zap1 faan1 hei2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西掉了？不要紧，捡起来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Did you drop something? It's okay, just pick it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到咗少少，唔要緊，仲趕得切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 zo2 siu2 siu2, m4 jiu3 gan2, zung6 gon2 dak1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到了一点，不要紧，还赶得上。
examples.english_sentence: You're a little late, but it's okay, you can still make it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔小心打爛咗個杯，唔要緊啦，我嚟抹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 zo2 go3 bui1, m4 jiu3 gan2 laa1, ngo5 lai4 maat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不小心打碎了杯子，不要紧，我来擦。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally broke the cup. It's okay, I'll wipe it up.

english_meaning: to not see; to disappear; to be missing
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有看见，或者东西丢失，消失不见。
explanation_english: Indicates not seeing something, or something being lost or disappearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵唔到我本鎖匙，唔見咗喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 ngo5 bun2 so2 si4, m4 gin3 zo2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找不到我的钥匙，不见了！
examples.english_sentence: I can't find my keys, they're missing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好耐冇返學，唔見咗佢嘅人影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 noi6 mou5 faan1 hok6, m4 gin3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 jan4 jeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很久没有上学，不见了他的身影。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been to school for a long time, he's disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書明明喺度，點解突然唔見咗嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ming4 ming4 hai2 dou6, dim2 gaai2 dat6 jin4 m4 gin3 zo2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书明明在这里，为什么突然不见了？
examples.english_sentence: The book was clearly here, why did it suddenly disappear?

english_meaning: be there or be square; will wait until we meet
explanation_mandarin: 表示约定好时间和地点，无论如何都会在那里等待，直到见面为止。
explanation_english: Indicates a promise to meet at a specific time and place, and that the speaker will wait there no matter what until the meeting occurs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日九點鐘喺地鐵站門口等，不見不散呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gau2 dim2 zung1 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 mun4 hau2 dang2, bat1 gin3 bat1 saan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天九点钟在地铁站门口等，不见不散啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you at the subway station entrance at 9 o'clock tomorrow. Be there or be square!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚蘭桂坊酒吧見，不見不散！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 laan4 gwai3 fong1 zau2 baa1 gin3, bat1 gin3 bat1 saan3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚兰桂坊酒吧见，不见不散！
examples.english_sentence: We'll meet at the Lan Kwai Fong bar tonight. Be there or be square!

mandarin_meaning: 暗无天日; 不得见天日
english_meaning: no light of day; without sunlight; without hope; bleak; dismal
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境黑暗，不见阳光；也比喻处境悲惨，看不到希望。
explanation_english: Describes an environment that is dark and without sunlight; also used metaphorically to describe a miserable situation with no hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠入面不見天咁，啲工人好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 jap6 min6 bat1 gin3 tin1 gam3, di1 gung1 jan4 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂里面暗无天日，工人们很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This factory is so dark and dismal; the workers are suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢破產之後，日日都愁眉苦臉，好似不見天咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 po3 caan2 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat1 dou1 sau4 mei4 ku2 lim5, hou2 ci5 bat1 gin3 tin1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他破产之后，每天都愁眉苦脸，好像没有希望一样。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he went bankrupt, he's been gloomy and depressed every day, like there's no hope.

english_meaning: to never see the light of day; to be deprived of light; to be kept in the dark; to be suppressed
explanation_mandarin: 形容黑暗、不见阳光，也比喻社会黑暗或处境悲惨，没有希望。
explanation_english: Describes a dark, sunless environment. Also used metaphorically to describe a dark society or a miserable situation with no hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間黑心工廠做嘢，日日都好似不見天日咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 hak1 sam1 gung1 cong2 zou6 je5, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 bat1 gin3 tin1 jat6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家黑心工厂工作，每天都好像不见天日。
examples.english_sentence: Working in this unscrupulous factory, it's like never seeing the light of day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時嘅社會好黑暗，好多人都覺得不見天日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 ge3 se5 wui2 hou2 hak1 am3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 bat1 gin3 tin1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个时候的社会很黑暗，很多人都觉得没有希望。
examples.english_sentence: The society was very dark at that time, and many people felt hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢俾人誣告之後，就好似不見天日咁，人生都冇哂希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 bei2 jan4 wu1 gou3 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 ci5 bat1 gin3 tin1 jat6 gam2, jan4 sang1 dou1 mou5 saai2 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他被人诬告之后，就像不见天日一样，人生都没有希望了。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he was falsely accused, it's like he never sees the light of day, and he has no hope in life.

english_meaning: not necessarily; not likely; may not
explanation_mandarin: 表示未必，不一定的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates uncertainty; not necessarily; not always true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻，但係都唔見得次次都考第一嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 gin3 dak1 ci3 ci3 dou1 haau2 dai6 jat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么聪明，但是也不见得每次都考第一的。
examples.english_sentence: He is so smart, but it's not necessarily true that he gets first place every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有錢唔見得開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cin2 m4 gin3 dak1 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有钱不见得就开心。
examples.english_sentence: Having money doesn't necessarily mean you're happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讀名校唔見得第日一定搵到好工嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 ming4 haau6 m4 gin3 dak1 dai6 jat6 jat1 ding6 wan2 dou2 hou2 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你读名校不见得将来一定能找到好工作。
examples.english_sentence: Just because you study at a prestigious school doesn't necessarily mean you'll find a good job in the future.

english_meaning: obscure; unknown; of no renown
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物没有名气，不被人们所熟知。通常用来形容出身卑微，没有历史记载的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something that is not famous or well-known. Usually used to describe people or things of humble origins with no historical record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前都係個不見經傳嘅小演員，而家就變成咗國際巨星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 dou1 hai6 go3 bat1 gin3 ging1 cyun4 ge3 siu2 jin2 jyun4, ji4 gaa1 zau6 bin3 sing4 zo2 gwok3 zai3 geoi6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前只是一个默默无闻的小演员，现在已经变成了国际巨星。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be an obscure little actor, but now he's become an international superstar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳喺一條不見經傳嘅小巷入面，但係啲嘢食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 jat1 tiu4 bat1 gin3 ging1 cyun4 ge3 siu2 hong6 jap6 min6, daan6 hai6 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅位于一条默默无闻的小巷里，但是东西很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is located in an obscure alley, but the food is delicious.

synonyms: 無名小卒 (mou4 ming4 siu2 zeot1)

english_meaning: unconsciously; unknowingly; without realizing
explanation_mandarin: 没有察觉，没有意识到。
explanation_english: Without being aware; without realizing; unconsciously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我不覺意咁樣撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bat1 gok3 yi3 gam2 joeng2 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不觉意地撞到他了。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into him unconsciously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間不覺過得咁快，轉眼就畢業喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 bat1 gok3 gwo3 dak1 gam3 faai3, zyun2 ngaan5 zau6 bat1 jip6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间不知不觉过得这么快，转眼就要毕业了。
examples.english_sentence: Time passed so quickly without realizing it, and we are graduating in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不覺已經喊濕咗成個枕頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 gok3 ji5 ging1 haam3 sap1 zo2 seng4 go3 zam2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不觉已经哭湿了整个枕头。
examples.english_sentence: Without realizing it, he had already soaked the entire pillow with tears.

english_meaning: self-evident; it goes without saying; obvious
explanation_mandarin: 不用说话就能明白，形容道理很明显。
explanation_english: So obvious that it doesn't need to be explained; self-evident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁開心，明眼人都睇得出佢升咗職，呢個都唔算係不言而喻嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hoi1 sam1, ming4 ngaan5 jan4 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, ni1 go3 dou1 m4 syun3 hai6 bat1 jin4 ji4 jyu6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么开心，明眼人都能看出来他升职了，这也可以算是不言而喻的事了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so happy, anyone can tell he got promoted, this can also be considered as a self-evident thing.

english_meaning: countless, innumerable
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，无法计算。
explanation_english: Describes a quantity that is too large to count; countless; innumerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 維多利亞港嘅夜景，燈光璀璨，不計其數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 do1 lei6 aa3 gong2 ge3 je6 ging2, dang1 gwong1 cui1 caan3, bat1 gai3 kei4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 维多利亚港的夜景，灯光璀璨，数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: The night view of Victoria Harbour is brilliantly illuminated with countless lights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅飛，喺幾分鐘之內就畀人搶晒，想買嘅人不計其數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin2 cheung3 wui2 ge3 fei1, hai2 gei2 fan1 jung1 zi1 noi6 jau6 bei2 yan4 cheung2 saai3, seung2 maai5 ge3 yan4 bat1 gai3 kei4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票，在几分钟之内就被抢光了，想买的人数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets were sold out within minutes, there were countless people who wanted to buy them.

english_meaning: No change given
explanation_mandarin: 表示不提供找零服务。通常出现在自动售货机、捐款箱等场合。
explanation_english: Indicates that no change will be given. Commonly seen on vending machines, donation boxes, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機唔設找續，你最好準備啱啱好嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 m4 sat6 zaau2 zuk6, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zeon2 bei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器不设找零，你最好准备正好金额的钱。
examples.english_sentence: This machine doesn't give change, you better prepare the exact amount of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個慈善箱上面寫住「不設找續」，所以你唔可以放銀紙落去，然後攞返錢走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ci4 sin6 soeng1 soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 "bat1 sat6 zaau2 zuk6", so2 ji5 nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 ngan4 zi2 lok6 heoi3, jin4 hau6 lo2 faan1 cin2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个慈善箱上面写着“不设找零”，所以你不能放纸币进去，然后拿回钱走。
examples.english_sentence: The charity box says 'No change given', so you can't put a banknote in and take money back.

english_meaning: not allowed; forbidden; not permitted
explanation_mandarin: 不允许，不许可。
explanation_english: To prohibit or forbid; not to allow something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁樣做，我唔不許你咁樣做！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, ngo5 m4 bat1 heoi2 nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这样做，我不允许你这样做！
examples.english_sentence: You can't do it like that, I won't allow you to do it like that!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽不許我咁夜返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 bat1 heoi2 ngo5 gam3 je6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈不准我这么晚回家。
examples.english_sentence: My mom doesn't allow me to go home so late.

english_meaning: unknown, not known, unclear, unspecified
explanation_mandarin: 指细节或信息不清楚，没有详细的记录或说明。
explanation_english: Refers to details or information that are unclear, with no detailed records or explanations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅死因到而家都仲係不詳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si2 jan1 dou3 ji4 ga1 dou1 zung1 hai6 bat1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的死因到现在仍然不详。
examples.english_sentence: The cause of his death is still unknown to this day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地址不詳，我唔知點寄俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zi2 bat1 coeng4, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 gei3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地址不详，我不知道怎么寄给你。
examples.english_sentence: The address is unknown, I don't know how to send it to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份報告話損失金額仍然不詳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 waa6 sun2 sat1 gam1 ngak6 jing4 jin4 bat1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份报告说损失金额仍然不详。
examples.english_sentence: The report states that the amount of loss is still unknown.

english_meaning: You wouldn't know unless you were told.
explanation_mandarin: 表示如果没人告诉你，你就不会知道。说明某些事情不通过告知，很难自行了解。
explanation_english: Indicates that you wouldn't know something unless someone told you. It implies that some things are difficult to understand on your own without being informed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我唔知規矩，真係唔說不知呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 zi1 kwai1 geoi2, zan1 hai6 bat1 syut3 bat1 zi1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我不知道规矩，真的是不说不知道啊。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I didn't know the rules, I really wouldn't have known unless someone told me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳執咗笠啦，我唔係聽你講，都唔說不知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zap1 zo2 lap1 laa1, ngo5 m4 hai6 teng1 nei5 gong2, dou1 m4 syut3 bat1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅倒闭了，如果不是听你说，我都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant closed down, I wouldn't have known if you hadn't told me.

english_meaning: You wouldn't know if you weren't told; I wouldn't know if you didn't tell me.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是如果不说出来，就无从得知。表示某件事或情况自己原本不了解，需要别人告知才能知道。
explanation_english: It means that if something is not said or explained, you wouldn't know about it. It expresses that you didn't know something until someone told you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你話我知，如果唔係你講，不説不知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 waa6 ngo5 zi1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 nei5 gong2, bat1 syut3 bat1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你告诉我，如果不是你说的，我根本不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for telling me, I wouldn't have known if you hadn't said it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，原來佢哋離婚㗎？真係不説不知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 dei6 lei4 fan1 gaa3? zan1 hai6 bat1 syut3 bat1 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: Wow, they got divorced? I really wouldn't have known if you hadn't told me!
examples.english_sentence: Wow, they're divorced? I really wouldn't have known!

mandarin_meaning: 不请自来；未经邀请自行到来
english_meaning: to show up uninvited
explanation_mandarin: 未经邀请就自行到来或参与。
explanation_english: Arrive or join without being invited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冇打招呼就闖入嚟，真係不請自來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mou5 daa2 ziu1 fu1 zau6 coeng2 jap6 lei4, zan1 hai6 bat1 cing2 zi6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们没打招呼就闯进来，真是不请自来。
examples.english_sentence: They barged in without saying a word—truly showing up uninvited.

english_meaning: regardless of; no matter (what, who, etc.); whether...or...
explanation_mandarin: 表示排除任何条件，用于引出两种或多种情况，表示在任何一种情况下结果都相同。
explanation_english: Expresses the exclusion of any conditions. Used to introduce two or more possibilities, indicating that the outcome is the same in any case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不論你點樣做，我都會支持你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 leon6 nei5 dim2 joeng2 zou6, ngo5 dou1 wui5 zi1 chi4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论你怎么做，我都会支持你。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how you do it, I will support you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不論晴天定落雨，我哋都會去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 leon6 cing4 tin1 ding6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论是晴天还是下雨，我们都会去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: Whether it's sunny or rainy, we will go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不論係香港人定外國人，都要遵守香港嘅法律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 leon6 hai6 Hoeng1 Gong2 jan4 ding6 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4, dou1 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 faat3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论是香港人还是外国人，都要遵守香港的法律。
examples.english_sentence: Whether you are a Hongkonger or a foreigner, you must abide by Hong Kong laws.

english_meaning: not familiar with, not conversant with, to be unacquainted with
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事物不熟悉，不精通，缺乏了解或经验。
explanation_english: Indicates unfamiliarity with something, lack of proficiency, understanding, or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢方面嘅嘢一啲都唔諳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 je5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 am1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这方面的事情一点都不熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: He is not at all familiar with this area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔諳水性，所以唔敢落水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 am1 seoi2 sing3, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 lok6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不熟悉水性，所以不敢下水。
examples.english_sentence: I am not familiar with swimming, so I don't dare to go into the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔諳廣東話，所以我哋用英文同佢溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 am1 gwong2 dung1 waa2, so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 yung6 ying1 man2 tung4 keoi5 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不熟悉广东话，所以我们用英语和他沟通。
examples.english_sentence: He is not familiar with Cantonese, so we communicate with him in English.

english_meaning: to coincide; to agree without prior consultation; to happen to hold the same view
explanation_mandarin: 事先没有商量过，意见或行动却完全一致。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two or more people reach the same conclusion or take the same action without having discussed it beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅諗法竟然不謀而合，真係好有緣分啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3 ging2 jin4 bat1 mau4 ji4 hap6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jyun4 fan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的想法竟然不谋而合，真是很有缘分啊！
examples.english_sentence: Our thoughts surprisingly coincided; we're really destined!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅設計概念不謀而合，最後贏咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat3 gai3 gai3 nim6 bat1 mau4 ji4 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 win4 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的两个设计理念不谋而合，最后赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Their two design concepts coincided, and they won the competition in the end.

english_meaning: to not know what's good for you; to not appreciate kindness; ungrateful; to bite the hand that feeds you
explanation_mandarin: 指不明白好壞，不辨是非，不領情，不知感恩。通常用於批評或責備別人。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who doesn't understand or appreciate kindness, doesn't know what's good for them, and is ungrateful. It's often used to criticize or scold someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我咁幫你，你仲話我，真係不識好歹！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam3 bong1 nei5, nei5 zung6 waa6 ngo5, zan1 hai6 bat1 sik1 hou2 daai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这么帮你，你还说我，真是不知好歹！
examples.english_sentence: I helped you so much, and you still criticize me. You really don't know what's good for you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁對你，你仲要幫佢，你都不識好歹嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 deoi3 nei5, nei5 zung6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5, nei5 dou1 bat1 sik1 hou2 daai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对你，你还要帮他，你真是不知好歹。
examples.english_sentence: He treats you like that, and you still want to help him. You really don't know what's good for you.

synonyms: 唔識抬舉(m4 sik1 toi4 geoi2)

mandarin_meaning: 不识抬举 (bù shí tái jǔ)
english_meaning: to not appreciate someone's kindness; to not know how to be grateful; to not recognize a good thing when you see it
explanation_mandarin: 指不领情，不识好歹，对别人的好意或提拔不理解、不感激，反而轻视或拒绝。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unappreciative, doesn't recognize kindness, and doesn't understand or appreciate someone else's good intentions or promotion of them, instead belittling or rejecting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我咁好心幫佢，佢竟然咁樣對我，真係不識抬舉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam3 hou2 sam1 bong1 keoi5, keoi5 ging2 jin4 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5, zan1 hai6 bat1 sik1 toi4 geoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我那么好心帮他，他竟然这样对我，真是不识抬举！
examples.english_sentence: I was so kind to help him, and he actually treats me this way. He's so ungrateful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆升你職你仲唔開心，真係不識抬舉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sing1 nei5 zik1 nei5 zung6 m4 hoi1 sam1, zan1 hai6 bat1 sik1 toi4 geoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板升你职你还不开心，真是不识抬举！
examples.english_sentence: The boss promoted you and you're still not happy. You're so ungrateful!

synonyms: 唔識好歹 (m4 sik1 hou2 daai2)
不知好歹 (bat1 zi1 hao3 dai3)

english_meaning: to live up to expectations; to not disappoint
explanation_mandarin: 没有辜负大家的期望。指表现或结果符合大众的期望。
explanation_english: To not disappoint the expectations of the public; to perform or achieve in a way that meets general expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試攞到第一名，真係不負眾望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 bat1 fu6 zung3 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试得了第一名，真是不负众望。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam this time, truly living up to expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅新菜式不負眾望，好好味！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 san1 coi3 sik1 bat1 fu6 zung3 mong6, hou2 hou2 mei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的新菜式不负众望，很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's new dishes live up to expectations, they're delicious!

english_meaning: to live up to expectations, to not let people down
explanation_mandarin: 没有使大家的期望落空。指表现或结果符合大众的期望。
explanation_english: To not disappoint the public's expectations; to perform or achieve results that meet the expectations of the majority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運會攞咗金牌，真係不負衆望啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 lo2 zo2 gam1 paai4, zan1 hai6 bat1 fu6 zung3 mong6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在奥运会上获得了金牌，真是不负众望啊！
examples.english_sentence: He won a gold medal at the Olympics, truly living up to expectations!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新戲嘅票房咁好，證明佢哋冇不負衆望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 hei3 ge3 piu3 fong2 gam3 hou2, zing3 ming4 keoi5 dei6 mou5 bat1 fu6 zung3 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新电影的票房这么好，证明他们没有辜负众望。
examples.english_sentence: The box office of this new movie is so good, proving they didn't let people down.

english_meaning: irresponsible
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏责任感，不承担应有的责任。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks a sense of responsibility and does not take on the duties they should.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好不負責任，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 bat1 fu6 zaak3 jam4, seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很不负责任，经常迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very irresponsible person, always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做嘢好不負責任㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5 hou2 bat1 fu6 zaak3 jam4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样工作很不负责任！
examples.english_sentence: You're being very irresponsible doing things this way!

jyutping: bat1 fai3 cheoi1 fui1 zi1 lik6
english_meaning: with no effort at all; effortlessly; as easy as blowing off dust
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常容易，不用花费任何力气。
explanation_english: Describes something as extremely easy, requiring no effort at all. Literally, 'not expending the effort of blowing away dust'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個考試對佢嚟講，不費吹灰之力就搞掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haau2 si5 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2, bat1 fai3 cheoi1 fui1 zi1 lik6 zau6 gaau2 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对他来说，这次考试毫不费力就能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: For him, this exam will be a piece of cake; he can finish it with no effort at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 解決呢個問題，對佢哋嚟講簡直係不費吹灰之力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, deoi3 keoi5 dei6 lei4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 bat1 fai3 cheoi1 fui1 zi1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 解决这个问题对他们来说简直是不费吹灰之力。
examples.english_sentence: Solving this problem is absolutely effortless for them.

mandarin_meaning: 不靠谱, 不牢靠, 不可靠
english_meaning: Unreliable, untrustworthy, not dependable, flakey
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事不认真，不负责任，不可靠。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not serious, irresponsible, and unreliable in their actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友仔好唔貼式㗎，搵佢幫手盞搞鑊粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 m4 tip3 sik1 gaa3, wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2 zaan2 gaau2 wok6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很不靠谱，找他帮忙只会把事情搞砸。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is very unreliable. Asking him for help will only mess things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲產品好唔貼式，成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 caan2 ban2 hou2 m4 tip3 sik1, seng4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的产品很不牢靠，经常坏。
examples.english_sentence: This company's products are very unreliable; they often break down.

english_meaning: Without further ado; not to belabor the point; Needless to say; No more to be said.
explanation_mandarin: 表示不再需要重复或详细说明，可以直接进入下一步或已知结论。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no need to repeat or elaborate further, and one can proceed directly to the next step or known conclusion. Often used to avoid being redundant or pedantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不贅啦，我哋直接開始啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 zeoi6 laa1, ngo5 dei6 zik6 zip3 hoi1 chi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不多说了，我们直接开始吧。
examples.english_sentence: Without further ado, let's begin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詳細嘅過程不贅喇，總之我哋成功咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cheung4 sai3 ge3 gwo3 ching4 bat1 zeoi6 laa3, zung2 zi1 ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 详细的过程就不多说了，总之我们成功了。
examples.english_sentence: I won't elaborate on the details, the point is we succeeded.

synonyms: 廢話少講 (fai3 waa6 siu2 gong2)

english_meaning: insufficient; not enough; inadequate; deficiency; lack
explanation_mandarin: 不够；缺乏。
explanation_english: Not enough; lacking; insufficient; inadequate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 錢唔夠，唔足夠畀晒啲費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin2 m4 gau3, m4 zuk1 gau3 bei2 saai3 di1 fai3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不够，不足以支付所有费用。
examples.english_sentence: There isn't enough money; it's insufficient to pay for all the expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經驗不足，處理唔到呢個複雜嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 yim6 bat1 zuk1, cyu2 lei5 m4 dou2 ni1 go3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经验不足，处理不了这个复杂的问题。
examples.english_sentence: He lacks sufficient experience to handle this complex problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睡眠不足會影響健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi6 min5 bat1 zuk1 wui5 ying2 heong2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡眠不足会影响健康。
examples.english_sentence: Lack of sleep will affect your health.

english_meaning: unbelievable; not trustworthy; not credible; of questionable reliability
explanation_mandarin: 指不可相信，不值得信任。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not believable or trustworthy; of questionable reliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢不足為信，你唔好信晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 bat1 zuk1 wai4 seon3, nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不可信，你不要全信他。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is not believable, don't believe everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據不足為信，要再查證吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1 wai4 seon3, jiu3 zoi3 caa4 zing3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据不足为信，需要再核实一下。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report is not credible, it needs to be verified again.

english_meaning: not surprising; nothing strange; no wonder
explanation_mandarin: 不值得奇怪。表示某种情况的发生是意料之中的，没有什么可惊讶的。
explanation_english: Not worth regarding as strange; nothing to be surprised about. Indicates that a certain situation happening is expected and there's nothing surprising about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，年青人買唔起樓都唔係乜嘢不足為奇嘅事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau4 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, nin4 cing1 jan4 maai5 m4 hei2 lau2 dou1 m4 hai6 mat1 je5 bat1 zuk1 wai4 kei4 ge3 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房价这么贵，年轻人买不起房也不是什么不足为奇的事情了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's property prices are so high, it's not surprising that young people can't afford to buy a home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，考試唔合格都不足為奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3 dou1 bat1 zuk1 wai4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，考试不及格也不足为奇。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, it's not surprising that he failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家咁多公司執笠，失業率上升都唔係不足為奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gam3 do1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1, sat1 jip6 leot2 soeng5 sing1 dou1 m4 hai6 bat1 zuk1 wai4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这么多公司倒闭，失业率上升也不足为奇。
examples.english_sentence: With so many companies closing down now, it's not surprising that the unemployment rate is rising.

english_meaning: unbelievable; not trustworthy; not credible; unreliable
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或说法不值得相信，可靠性不高。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not worthy of belief or trust; lacking credibility or reliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢不足爲信，你唔好咁認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 bat1 zuk1 wai4 seon3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不足为信，你不要太认真。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is not to be believed, don't take it too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據不足爲信，可能需要重新檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1 wai4 seon3, ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 cung4 san1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据不足为信，可能需要重新检查。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report is unreliable, it may need to be re-checked.

english_meaning: not surprising; nothing to be surprised at; unsurprising; nothing out of the ordinary
explanation_mandarin: 指某种事物或现象是意料之中的，没有什么可惊讶的。
explanation_english: This idiom means that something is not surprising or unexpected, and there's no reason to be amazed by it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港咁多人用智能手機，呢啲都唔係乜嘢新聞，不足爲奇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gam3 do1 jan4 yung6 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1, ni1 di1 dou1 m4 hai6 mat1 je5 san1 man4, bat1 zuk1 wai4 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港这么多人用智能手机，这根本不是什么新闻，不足为奇了。
examples.english_sentence: So many people in Hong Kong use smartphones, it's not news at all, it's not surprising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，考試攞高分根本不足爲奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, haau2 si5 lo2 gou1 fan1 gan1 bun2 bat1 zuk1 wai4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，考试取得高分根本不足为奇。
examples.english_sentence: He is so diligent, it's not surprising at all that he gets high scores in the exam.

english_meaning: dishonest; wicked; rebellious; treacherous; improper; illicit; with ulterior motives
explanation_mandarin: 指行为不正当，心怀鬼胎，有不好的意图或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to dishonest or wicked behavior, harboring ulterior motives, and having bad intentions or actions. Can also refer to rebellious or treacherous conduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼鬼祟祟，我覺得佢一定心懷不軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gwai2 seoi3 seoi3, ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 jat1 ding6 sam1 waai4 bat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是鬼鬼祟祟的，我觉得他一定心怀不轨。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting suspiciously, I think he definitely has ulterior motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要小心啲佢，佢個人成日諗埋啲不軌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 keoi5, keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 bat1 gwai2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要小心他，他这个人总是想些不正当的事情。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be careful of him, he's always thinking of improper things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想對公司啲錢不軌，好彩俾我哋發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 deoi3 gung1 si1 di1 cin2 bat1 gwai2, hou2 coi2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想对公司的钱不轨，幸好被我们发现了。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to embezzle the company's money, luckily we discovered it.

english_meaning: to spare no effort; to not shrink from toil; to work hard despite hardship
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常勤劳，不怕辛苦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very diligent and not afraid of hardship or hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆不辭勞苦咁湊大佢哋幾兄弟姊妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 bat1 ci4 lou4 fu2 gam2 cau3 daai6 keoi5 dei6 gei2 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶不辞辛劳地把他们几个兄弟姐妹抚养长大。
examples.english_sentence: The grandmother spared no effort in raising all her grandchildren.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫你，我唔會不辭勞苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bong1 nei5, ngo5 m4 wui5 bat1 ci4 lou4 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮助你，我不会怕辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: In order to help you, I won't shrink from any hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不辭勞苦咁做義工，真係好值得敬佩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 ci4 lou4 fu2 gam2 zou6 ji6 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 zik6 dak1 ging3 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不辞辛劳地做义工，真的很值得敬佩。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard as a volunteer, which is really admirable.

english_meaning: to leave without saying goodbye; to slip away unnoticed
explanation_mandarin: 没有告别就离开了。形容悄悄地离开。
explanation_english: To leave without saying goodbye, often implying a sudden or secretive departure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一声都冇出就唔聲唔聲噉不辭而別，真係令人失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 seng1 dou1 mou5 ceot1 zau6 m4 seng1 m4 seng1 gam2 bat1 ci4 ji4 bit6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 si1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一声不吭就不辞而别了，真令人失望。
examples.english_sentence: He left without a word, just slipped away without saying goodbye, which is really disappointing.

english_meaning: inhuman; unreasonable; insensitive; lacking empathy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人缺乏人情味，不考虑别人的感受，行事不合情理。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks empathy, doesn't consider other people's feelings, and acts unreasonably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細咁樣要求員工加班，真係不近人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam2 joeng2 jiu1 kiu4 jyun4 gung1 gaa1 baan1, zan1 hai6 bat1 gan6 jan4 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板这样要求员工加班，真是很不近人情。
examples.english_sentence: It's really unreasonable for the boss to ask the employees to work overtime like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁堅持原則，有時會覺得佢不近人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gin1 chi4 jyun2 zak1, jau5 si4 wui5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 bat1 gan6 jan4 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坚持原则，有时候会觉得他不近人情。
examples.english_sentence: Because he insists on his principles so much, sometimes you feel he is unreasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個情況下，仲要人準時交功課，真係不近人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ching4 kwong3 haa6, zung6 jiu3 jan4 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, zan1 hai6 bat1 gan6 jan4 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种情况下，还要人准时交作业，真是不近人情。
examples.english_sentence: In this situation, it's really insensitive to still ask people to submit their homework on time.

english_meaning: unaspirated consonant
explanation_mandarin: 语音学上的概念，指发音时声带振动后，口腔中气流较弱的辅音。普通话中有送气音和不送气音的区别，例如 "b"、"d"、"g" 是不送气音，而 "p"、"t"、"k" 是送气音。
explanation_english: A concept in phonetics referring to consonants that have relatively weak airflow in the mouth after the vocal cords vibrate. Mandarin Chinese distinguishes between aspirated and unaspirated consonants. For example, "b," "d," and "g" are unaspirated consonants, while "p," "t," and "k" are aspirated consonants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 粵語都有啲不送氣音嘅字，例如「打」字就係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyut6 jyu5 dou1 jau5 di1 bat1 sung3 hei3 jam1 ge3 zi6,例如「打」zi6 jau6 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粤语也有一些不送气音的字，例如“打”字就是。
examples.english_sentence: Cantonese also has some words with unaspirated consonants, for example, the word "打" (daa2, to hit).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學普通話要留意送氣音同不送氣音嘅分別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 pou2 tung1 waa2 jiu3 lau4 yi3 sung3 hei3 jam1 tung4 bat1 sung3 hei3 jam1 ge3 fan1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习普通话要注意送气音和不送气音的区别。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Mandarin, you need to pay attention to the difference between aspirated and unaspirated consonants.

mandarin_meaning: 不请自来的人; 不受欢迎的人
english_meaning: uninvited guest; unwelcome visitor
explanation_mandarin: 指没有邀请而自己来的客人。多指不受欢迎的来访者。
explanation_english: Refers to a guest who arrives without invitation. It often refers to an unwelcome visitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋突然嚟咗，真係不速之客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dat6 jin4 lai4 zo2, zan1 hai6 bat1 suk1 zi1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们突然来了，真是个不速之客。
examples.english_sentence: They suddenly came, they're really uninvited guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想見佢，佢成日做啲不速之客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gin3 keoi5, keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 bat1 suk1 zi1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想见他，他总是做一些不速之客的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to see him, he always shows up uninvited.

english_meaning: unsatisfactory; not fulfilling one's wishes; unsuccessful
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发展不顺利，未能达到预期的目标或愿望。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things don't go smoothly and one's desired goals or wishes are not achieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試成績唔遂佢意，所以好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 sing4 zik1 m4 seoi6 keoi5 ji3, so2 ji5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试成绩不让他满意，所以很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: His exam results were not to his liking this time, so he is very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事發展得唔遂人意，可能要再諗諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 faat3 zin2 dak1 m4 seoi6 jan4 ji3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zoi3 lam2 lam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情发展得不如人意，可能要再考虑考虑。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is not developing as desired, we may need to reconsider it.

mandarin_meaning: 不過 / 但是 / 可是
english_meaning: but; however; only; merely
explanation_mandarin: 表示轉折關係，相當於「但是」、「可是」。也可用於表示程度不深，相當於「僅僅」、「只不過」。
explanation_english: Indicates a contrast or change of subject, similar to 'but' or 'however'. Can also indicate a small degree or quantity, meaning 'only' or 'merely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去，不過冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3, bat1 gwo3 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去，不過没时间。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to go, but I don't have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不過係一個細路仔，唔好咁嚴厲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2, m4 hou2 gam2 jim4 lai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不过是个小孩子，不要这么严厉啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a kid, don't be so strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我不過隨口講下啫，你唔使咁認真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bat1 gwo3 ceoi4 hau2 gong2 haa5 ze1, nei5 m4 sai2 gam2 jing6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不过随便说说而已，你不用这么认真的。
examples.english_sentence: I was just saying it casually, you don't have to take it so seriously.

english_meaning: so-so, mediocre, neither good nor bad, just okay
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或表现既不好也不坏，处在一个中间状态，没有特别的优点或缺点。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is neither good nor bad, in an average or mediocre state. It lacks outstanding qualities or significant flaws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工不過不失啦，搵到食，但係冇乜發展空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 bat1 gwo3 bat1 sat1 laa1, wan2 dou2 sik6, daan6 hai6 mou5 mat1 faat3 zin2 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作平平淡淡，能挣到钱，但是没什么发展空间。
examples.english_sentence: His job is just so-so, he can make a living, but there's not much room for career development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食不過不失，唔會話好好食，但係都唔難食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 bat1 gwo3 bat1 sat1, m4 wui5 waa6 hou2 hou2 sik6, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 naan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西普普通通，不会说很好吃，但是也不难吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is just okay; it's not delicious, but it's not bad either.

english_meaning: not at all inferior; on a par with; equally good
explanation_mandarin: 表示两者水平相当，没有谁比谁更强。形容两者程度或质量接近，可以互相比较。
explanation_english: Used to describe two things or people that are comparable in quality or ability; neither is significantly better than the other. It implies a level of competitiveness or similarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅畫功都好好，真係不遑多讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 waa2 gung1 dou1 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 bat1 wong4 do1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的画技都很好，真是不相上下。
examples.english_sentence: Both of them are very skilled in painting; they are really on a par with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅產品，品質不遑多讓，所以競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2, ban2 zat1 bat1 wong4 do1 joeng6, so2 ji5 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的产品，品质不相上下，所以竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The products of these two companies are of comparable quality, so the competition is very fierce.

english_meaning: not regarding a thousand li as far; to go to the trouble of traveling a long distance
explanation_mandarin: 形容不以路途遥远为意，不辞辛苦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who doesn't mind the long distance and doesn't shrink from the hardship of traveling a great distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不遠千里嚟香港，就係為咗見你一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jyun5 cin1 lei5 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, zau6 hai6 wai6 zo2 gin3 nei5 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不远千里来到香港，就是为了见你一面。
examples.english_sentence: He traveled a great distance to Hong Kong just to see you.

english_meaning: uncomfortable, unwell, not feeling well
explanation_mandarin: 指身体或心理上感到不舒服或不适应的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of physical or mental discomfort or unease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先食咗啲嘢，依家覺得有啲不適。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 sik6 zo2 di1 je5, ji1 ga1 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 bat1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才吃了一些东西，现在觉得有点不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I ate something earlier, and now I feel a bit unwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果覺得不適，就應該睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gok3 dak1 bat1 sik1, zau6 jing1 goi1 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果觉得不舒服，就应该去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel unwell, you should see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對新嘅環境好不適應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 san1 ge3 waan4 ging2 hou2 bat1 sik1 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对新的环境很不适应。
examples.english_sentence: He is very uncomfortable/ill-adapted to the new environment.

english_meaning: to spare no effort; to do one's utmost; to go all out
explanation_mandarin: 指把所有的力量都使出来，一点也不保留。
explanation_english: Describes putting in maximum effort and holding nothing back in order to achieve something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗幫你，真係不遺餘力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bong1 nei5, zan1 hai6 bat1 wai4 jyu4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了帮你，真是不遗余力。
examples.english_sentence: He really went all out to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會不遺餘力咁支持你嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bat1 wai4 jyu4 lik6 gam2 zi1 chi4 nei5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会不遗余力地支持你的决定。
examples.english_sentence: We will support your decision with all our might.

synonyms: 竭盡所能 (kit3 zeon6 so2 nang4)

english_meaning: Not going home until drunk
explanation_mandarin: 不到喝醉绝不回家。形容喝酒尽兴，一定要喝到酩酊大醉才罢休。
explanation_english: Not returning home until completely drunk. It describes the intention to drink until one is heavily intoxicated before considering going home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋要不醉無歸啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat1 zeoi3 mou4 gwai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们要不醉不归啊！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're not going home until we're drunk!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班friend聚會，每次都話要不醉無歸。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一群朋友聚会，每次都说要不醉不归。
examples.english_sentence: When that group of friends gets together, they always say they're not going home until they're drunk.

english_meaning: stainless steel
explanation_mandarin: 一种具有防锈性能的合金钢。
explanation_english: An alloy of steel with chromium and other elements that is resistant to rust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻煲係用不銹鋼整嘅，好襟用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 bou1 hai6 yung6 bat1 sau2 gong3 zing2 ge3, hou2 kam1 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个锅是用不锈钢做的，很耐用。
examples.english_sentence: This pot is made of stainless steel, it's very durable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲餐具全部都係不銹鋼，好衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei1 caan1 geoi6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 bat1 sau2 gong3, hou2 wai6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的餐具全部都是不锈钢，很卫生。

explanation_mandarin: 一种耐腐蚀的合金钢，主要成分是铁、铬和镍。

examples.english_sentence: This pot is made of stainless steel, it's very durable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不銹鋼餐具易清潔，又唔易生鏽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 sau2 gong3 caan1 geoi6 ji6 ching1 git3, jau6 m4 ji6 sang1 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不锈钢餐具容易清洁，又不容易生锈。
examples.english_sentence: Stainless steel cutlery is easy to clean and doesn't rust easily.

english_meaning: Stainless steel
explanation_mandarin: 一种耐腐蚀的合金钢，主要成分是铁、铬、镍等。
explanation_english: A corrosion-resistant alloy of steel containing chromium, nickel, and other elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個煲係不銹鐵造嘅，唔容易生銹嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个锅是不锈钢做的，不容易生锈的。
examples.english_sentence: This pot is made of stainless steel, it doesn't rust easily.

english_meaning: not bad; pretty good; quite good; not wrong
explanation_mandarin: 表示还可以，挺好，不差的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is acceptable, quite good, or not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日件衫幾唔錯喎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天这件衣服挺不错的。
examples.english_sentence: Your clothes look pretty good today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食都幾唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 dou1 gei2 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西都还不错。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人唔錯，可以信賴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 m4 co3, ho2 ji5 seon3 laai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不错，可以信赖的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a good person, reliable.

english_meaning: stainless steel
explanation_mandarin: 一种耐腐蚀的合金钢。
explanation_english: A corrosion-resistant alloy of steel.

english_meaning: stainless steel
