examples.english_sentence: This pot is stainless steel, it's very durable.

english_meaning: indecent, unrefined, inelegant, improper
explanation_mandarin: 形容行为、言语、举止等不符合社会规范或审美标准，令人感到不舒服或反感。
explanation_english: Describes behavior, speech, actions, etc. that do not conform to social norms or aesthetic standards, causing discomfort or repulsion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公眾場合大聲講粗口係好不雅嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 zung2 coeng4 hap6 daai6 seng1 gong2 cou1 hau2 hai6 hou2 bat1 ngaa5 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公共场合大声说脏话是很不雅的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Swearing loudly in public is a very indecent behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅衣着打扮非常不雅，惹嚟唔少人嘅側目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji1 zoek3 daa2 bun6 fei1 soeng4 bat1 ngaa5, je5 lei4 m4 siu2 yan4 ge3 zak1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的穿着打扮非常不雅观，引来了不少人的侧目。
examples.english_sentence: Her clothing was very indecent, attracting a lot of sideways glances.

english_meaning: Never to abandon; to never leave or forsake; to stick with through thick and thin.
explanation_mandarin: 形容永远不分离，不抛弃，永远在一起，无论遇到什么困难都不放弃对方。
explanation_english: Describes a relationship where individuals will never separate, abandon each other, or give up on each other, regardless of the difficulties encountered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論發生咩事，我哋都會不離不棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 bat1 lei4 bat1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论发生什么事，我们都会不离不弃。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what happens, we will never abandon each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個不離不棄，真係好令人羨慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 bat1 lei4 bat1 hei3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ling6 jan4 sin6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个不离不弃，真令人羡慕。
examples.english_sentence: They will never abandon each other, which is truly enviable.

english_meaning: No comment
explanation_mandarin: 表示不愿意对某个问题或事件发表评论，保持沉默。
explanation_english: Expressing a refusal to comment on a particular issue or event; to remain silent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者問佢對單嘢有咩睇法，佢話不願置評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 man6 keoi5 deoi3 daan1 je5 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3, keoi5 waa6 bat1 jyun6 zi3 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者问他对这件事有什么看法，他说不愿评论。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter asked him what he thought about the matter, and he said, "No comment."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於指控，政府發言人表示不願置評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 zi2 gung3, zing3 fu2 faat3 jin4 jan4 biu2 si6 bat1 jyun6 zi3 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于指控，政府发言人表示不愿评论。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding the accusations, the government spokesperson said, "No comment."

synonyms: 無可奉告 (mou4 ho2 fung6 gou3)

english_meaning: to disregard; to ignore; to pay no attention to; regardless of
explanation_mandarin: 不考虑；不理会。
explanation_english: To disregard; to ignore; to pay no attention to; regardless of; without considering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔顧自己嘅安全，衝入火場救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gu3 zi6 gei2 ge3 on1 cyun4, cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不顾自己的安全，冲入火场救人。
examples.english_sentence: He disregarded his own safety and rushed into the fire to save people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗達成目標，佢不顧一切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 daat6 sing4 muk6 biu1, keoi5 bat1 gu3 jat1 cai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了达成目标，他不顾一切。
examples.english_sentence: In order to achieve his goal, he disregards everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不顧屋企人嘅反對，堅持要辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 gu3 uk1 kei5 jan4 ge3 faan2 doi3, gin1 ci4 jiu3 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不顾家人的反对，坚持要辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He insisted on resigning despite his family's opposition.

english_meaning: regardless of the consequences; recklessly; at all costs; stop at nothing
explanation_mandarin: 不考虑任何后果，不惜付出任何代价。
explanation_english: Acting without considering the consequences or potential risks; willing to do anything to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗救佢個仔，不顧一切咁衝入火場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gau3 keoi5 go3 zai2, bat1 gu3 jat1 cai3 gam2 cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了救他的儿子，他不顾一切地冲进火场。
examples.english_sentence: To save his son, he recklessly rushed into the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗贏呢場比賽，不顧一切，甚至用埋非法手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jeng4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, bat1 gu3 jat1 cai3, sam6 zi3 yung6 maai4 fei1 faat3 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场比赛，他不顾一切，甚至使用了非法手段。
examples.english_sentence: To win this game, he stopped at nothing, even resorting to illegal methods.

jyutping: bat1 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2
english_meaning: to be aloof from worldly affairs; to be otherworldly; to be above mundane concerns
explanation_mandarin: 形容人高雅脱俗，不食人间食物，比喻人远离尘世，不关心世俗之事，或者指人的生活清苦。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is refined and detached from the world, not eating worldly food. It is used as a metaphor for someone who is far from the mundane world, not concerned with worldly affairs, or whose life is simple and austere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度研究哲學，好似不食人間煙火噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 jin1 gau3 zit3 hok6, hou2 ci5 bat1 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在研究哲学，好像不食人间烟火一样。
examples.english_sentence: He studies philosophy all day long, like he's detached from the real world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做藝術嘅人，有時會俾人覺得不食人間煙火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ngai6 seot1 ge3 jan4, jau5 si4 wui5 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 bat1 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做艺术的人，有时候会被人觉得不食人间烟火。
examples.english_sentence: People who do art are sometimes perceived as being detached from the world.

english_meaning: to despise; to scorn; to disdain
explanation_mandarin: 表示鄙视，认为不值得一提或不屑于和其为伍。
explanation_english: Expressing contempt, considering something unworthy of mention or unworthy of associating with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為令人不齒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 ling4 jan4 bat1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为令人不齿。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is contemptible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都不齒佢做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 bat1 ci2 keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都鄙视他做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: We all despise what he did.

english_meaning: to beg
explanation_mandarin: 乞求，向人要东西。
explanation_english: To beg, to ask people for things (usually money or food).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺條街度丐食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 koi2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在街上乞讨食物。
examples.english_sentence: He begs for food on the street every day.

english_meaning: ugly; unsightly; shameful; scandalous
explanation_mandarin: 形容外貌不好看，或指行为令人感到羞耻。
explanation_english: Describes an unpleasant appearance, or refers to behavior that is shameful or scandalous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好丑樣呀，唔好著出街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 cau2 joeng2 aa3, m4 hou2 zoek3 ceot1 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很丑，不要穿出门了。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very ugly, don't wear it outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做啲嘢咁丑，真係丟架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 di1 je5 gam3 cau2, zan1 hai6 diu1 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情这么丑陋，真是丢人。
examples.english_sentence: What he did was so shameful, it's really embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 滑稽角色, 喜剧角色 (戏曲)
english_meaning: Clown role (in Chinese opera); comic role; buffoon
explanation_mandarin: 在粤剧等戏曲中，扮演滑稽或丑陋角色的演员。 主要负责制造笑料，活跃气氛。
explanation_english: An actor who plays a comic or buffoon role in Cantonese opera and other Chinese operas. They are mainly responsible for creating laughter and enlivening the atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做丑生做得好鬼攪笑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 cau2 sang1 zou6 dak1 hou2 gwai2 gaau2 siu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他演丑生演得很搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: He plays the clown role very hilariously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個丑生出場，大家都忍唔住笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cau2 sang1 chut1 coeng4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 丑生一出场，大家都忍不住笑了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the clown came on stage, everyone couldn't help but laugh.

english_meaning: clown; buffoon; comical role; someone who plays a silly or ridiculous role
explanation_mandarin: 指戏曲或表演艺术中扮演滑稽、可笑的角色的人；也比喻在生活中或团体中，为了活跃气氛而故意做出滑稽动作或说笑话的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who plays a comical or ridiculous role in opera or performance art; also used metaphorically to describe someone who deliberately makes silly gestures or tells jokes in life or in a group to liven up the atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個話劇度做丑角，專登搞gag引人笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 waa6 kek6 dou6 zou6 cau2 gok3, zyun1 dang3 gaau2 gag1 yan5 jan5 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那个话剧里演丑角，专门讲笑话引人发笑。
examples.english_sentence: He played the clown in the play, deliberately telling jokes to make people laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日扮丑角啦，正經少少得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 baan6 cau2 gok3 laa1, zing3 ging1 siu2 siu2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是扮丑角了，正经一点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting like a clown all the time, can't you be a little more serious?

english_meaning: furthermore, moreover, and also
explanation_mandarin: 表示并列关系，相当于“而且”。
explanation_english: Indicates a coordinate relationship, equivalent to 'and also' or 'moreover'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靚女且聰明，好受歡迎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 leng3 neoi2 ce2 cung1 ming4, hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她漂亮而且聪明，很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: She is beautiful and intelligent, so she is very popular.

english_meaning: Hold on; wait a moment; not so fast
explanation_mandarin: 表示暂停或阻止某事，稍等一下的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a pause or halt to something; means 'wait a moment' or 'hold on'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 且慢！等埋我啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce2 maan6! dang2 maai4 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 且慢！等等我啊！
examples.english_sentence: Hold on! Wait for me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 且慢決定住，俾我哋再諗諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce2 maan6 kyut3 ding6 zyu6, bei2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 nam2 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 且慢决定，让我们再想想。
examples.english_sentence: Hold off on the decision, let us think about it some more.

english_meaning: Let's wait and see; Let's see; We'll see
explanation_mandarin: 表示观察事情的未来发展；让我们看看接下来会发生什么。
explanation_english: An expression indicating that one will observe the future development of events; Let's wait and see what happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事最後點收科，且看下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 zeoi3 hau6 dim2 sau1 fo1, ce2 hon3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情最后怎么收场，且看着吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's see how this matter will end up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有信心，且看佢點樣搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 seon3 sam1, ce2 hon3 keoi5 dim2 joeng2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有信心，且看他怎么搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: He's so confident, let's see how he handles it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 且看下個禮拜股市會點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce2 hon3 haa5 go3 lai5 baai3 gu2 si5 wui5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 且看下个星期股市会怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: Let's see what the stock market will be like next week.

english_meaning: great, large; grand
explanation_mandarin: 通常用于形容宏大的事物或事业，带有庄重的意味。在粤语中，比较少单独使用，更多出现在书面语或者成语中。
explanation_english: Generally used to describe grand things or undertakings, carrying a solemn meaning. In Cantonese, it is rarely used alone and appears more often in written language or idioms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅事業非常宏丕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 si6 jip6 fei1 soeng4 wang4 pei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的事业非常宏大。
examples.english_sentence: Their enterprise is very grand.

english_meaning: generation; world; lifetime; era
explanation_mandarin: 指一个时代，辈分，或者世界。
explanation_english: Refers to a generation, a lifetime, or the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋幾代都住喺呢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gei2 doi6 dou1 zyu6 hai2 ni1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们几代都住在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has lived here for generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界真係好細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界真的很小。
examples.english_sentence: This world is really small.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢過咗身，離開咗呢個世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwo3 zo2 san1, lei4 hoi1 zo2 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去世了，离开了这个世界。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away and left this world.

english_meaning: The best in the world, number one
explanation_mandarin: 世界第一，最好的，最棒的。用于形容某事物或某人在某方面非常优秀，无可比拟。
explanation_english: World's best, number one. Used to describe something or someone as exceptionally excellent and incomparable in a particular area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我心目中嘅世一呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 sai3 jat1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在我心目中是世界第一呀！
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the best in the world in my eyes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅叉燒飯真係世一！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 caa1 siu1 faan6 zan1 hai6 sai3 jat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的叉烧饭真是世界第一！
examples.english_sentence: The char siu rice at this restaurant is truly the best in the world!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅廚藝真係世一呀，好犀利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 cyu4 ngai6 zan1 hai6 sai3 jat1 aa3, hou2 sai1 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的厨艺真是世界第一啊，好厉害！
examples.english_sentence: Your cooking skills are truly the best in the world, so amazing!

english_meaning: in the world, on earth
explanation_mandarin: 指人世间；世界上。
explanation_english: Refers to the world; in the world, on earth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世上冇免費午餐嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 soeng6 mou5 min5 fai3 ng5 caan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世上没有免费的午餐。
examples.english_sentence: There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得世上最幸福嘅人就係佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 sai3 soeng6 zeoi3 hang6 fuk1 ge3 jan4 zau6 hai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得世上最幸福的人就是他。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he is the happiest person in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世上嘅事好多都好難預料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 soeng6 ge3 si6 hou2 do1 dou1 hou2 naan4 jyu6 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世上的事情很多都很难预料。
examples.english_sentence: Many things in the world are hard to predict.

cantonese: 世上無難事，只怕有心人
jyutping: sai3 soeng6 mou4 naan4 si6, zek3 paa3 jau5 sam1 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 世上无难事，只怕有心人 (shì shàng wú nán shì, zhǐ pà yǒu xīn rén)
english_meaning: Nothing is impossible to a willing heart.
explanation_mandarin: 指只要有决心和毅力，世上就没有做不成的事情。
explanation_english: This proverb means that as long as you have determination and perseverance, nothing is impossible to achieve. It emphasizes the importance of willpower and dedication in overcoming challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然學電腦好難，但係世上無難事，只怕有心人，我相信我可以學識嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hok6 din6 nou5 hou2 naan4, daan6 hai6 sai3 soeng6 mou4 naan4 si6, zek3 paa3 jau5 sam1 jan4, ngo5 seung1 seon3 ngo5 ho2 ji5 hok6 sik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然学电脑很难，但是世上无难事，只怕有心人，我相信我可以学会的。
examples.english_sentence: Although learning computers is difficult, nothing is impossible to a willing heart, and I believe I can learn it.

english_meaning: generation after generation; for generations; from generation to generation
explanation_mandarin: 指延续很多代，一代又一代。
explanation_english: Refers to continuing for many generations, one generation after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要保護環境，留個美好嘅世界俾世世代代嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2, lau4 go3 mei5 hou2 ge3 sai3 gaai3 bei2 sai3 sai3 doi6 doi6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要保护环境，留给世世代代的人一个美好的世界。
examples.english_sentence: We must protect the environment and leave a beautiful world for generations to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望呢個傳統可以世世代代咁傳落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ni1 go3 cyun4 tung2 ho2 ji5 sai3 sai3 doi6 doi6 gam2 cyun4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这个传统可以世世代代地传承下去。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, this tradition can be passed down from generation to generation.

english_meaning: worldly affairs, the ways of the world, human affairs, life's experiences
explanation_mandarin: 指人世间的事情、情况、道理。
explanation_english: Refers to the affairs, situations, and principles of the human world. It often carries a connotation of the complexities and uncertainties of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世事難料，千祈唔好咁肯定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 si6 naan4 liu6, cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 gam3 ken2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世事难料，千万不要这么肯定。
examples.english_sentence: Life is unpredictable, so don't be so certain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷過咁多世事，佢已經睇開咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 gwo3 gam3 do1 sai3 si6, keoi5 ji5 ging1 tai2 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历过这么多世事，他已经看开了许多事情。
examples.english_sentence: Having experienced so much in life, he has become more easygoing about things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好後生，唔係好識得啲世事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hau6 saang1, m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 dak1 di1 sai3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很年轻，不太懂人情世故。
examples.english_sentence: He is very young and doesn't really understand the ways of the world.

english_meaning: Life is impermanent; nothing is constant; vicissitudes of life
explanation_mandarin: 指世间的事情变化不定，没有什么是永恒不变的。
explanation_english: Refers to the impermanence of worldly affairs; nothing is permanent or unchanging. Emphasizes the unpredictable and ever-changing nature of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好太過執著啦，世事無常㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 taai3 gwo3 zap1 zoek6 laa1, sai3 si6 mou4 soeng4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也不要太执着了，世事无常嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't be too attached, life is impermanent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經商嘅嘢，真係世事無常，可能今日賺大錢，聽日就蝕到渣都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 soeng1 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 sai3 si6 mou4 soeng4, ho2 nang4 gam1 jat6 zaan6 daai6 cin2, ting1 jat6 zau6 sit3 dou3 zaa1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意的事情，真是世事无常，可能今天赚大钱，明天就赔得什么都不剩。
examples.english_sentence: In business, things are truly unpredictable. You might make a fortune today and lose everything tomorrow.

english_meaning: family friends (for generations)
explanation_mandarin: 指两家世代交好，有着深厚友谊的关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a relationship between two families who have been friends for generations and have a deep friendship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家係世交嚟㗎，由爺爺嗰代已經係好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 hai6 sai3 gaau1 lai4 gaa3, jau4 je4 je4 go2 daai6 ji5 ging1 hai6 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家是世交，从爷爷那一代已经是好朋友了。
examples.english_sentence: Those two families are family friends, they've been good friends since their grandfathers' generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爸同佢阿爸係世交，所以佢哋關係好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 baa1 tung4 keoi5 aa3 baa1 hai6 sai3 gaau1, so2 ji5 keoi5 dei6 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸和他爸爸是世交，所以他们的关系很好。
examples.english_sentence: My father and his father are family friends, so their relationship is very good.

english_meaning: people in the world; the general public; everyone
explanation_mandarin: 指世界上的人，一般大众。
explanation_english: Refers to the people in the world, the general public, or everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事搞到世人皆知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 sai3 jan4 gaai1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事搞得世人皆知。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has become known to everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅貢獻，世人永誌不忘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung3 hi献, sai3 jan4 wing5 zi3 bat1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的贡献，世人永远铭记不忘。
examples.english_sentence: His contribution will be forever remembered by the world.

english_meaning: hereditary enemy; blood feud; long-standing hatred
explanation_mandarin: 指世代相传的仇恨，多指两个家族或团体之间长期存在的严重敌对关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-standing hatred passed down through generations, often between two families or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家人係世仇，見面就眼紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 jan4 hai6 sai3 cau4, gin3 min6 zau6 ngaan5 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家是世仇，见面就眼红。
examples.english_sentence: Those two families are hereditary enemies, they become enraged whenever they meet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋同佢哋公司係競爭對手，但唔係世仇啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2, daan6 m4 hai6 sai3 cau4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们和他们公司是竞争对手，但不是世仇啊。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is a competitor with them, but we are not hereditary enemies.

english_meaning: generation, era, age
explanation_mandarin: 指一个时代或者世系；一辈又一辈的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a generation, era, or a lineage; successive generations of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生世代好幸福，生活喺一個咁繁榮嘅社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 sai3 dai6 hou2 hang6 fuk1, sang1 wut6 hai2 jat1 go3 gam3 faan4 wing4 ge3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻世代很幸福，生活在一个这么繁荣的社会。
examples.english_sentence: The younger generation nowadays is very fortunate, living in such a prosperous society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個世代都有佢哋自己嘅挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 sai3 dai6 dou1 jau5 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个世代都有他们自己的挑战。
examples.english_sentence: Every generation has its own challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將呢啲傳統文化傳承俾下一世代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 ni1 di1 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 cyun4 sing4 bei2 haa6 jat1 sai3 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要将这些传统文化传承给下一世代。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pass on these traditional cultures to the next generation.

english_meaning: passed down through generations; handed down from generation to generation
explanation_mandarin: 指一样事物或者技艺等一代接一代地流传下去。
explanation_english: Refers to something, such as a skill or tradition, that is passed down from one generation to the next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅秘製醬汁係佢哋世代相傳嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 bei3 zai3 zoeng3 zap1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 sai3 dai6 soeng1 cyun4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的秘制酱汁是他们世代相传的。
examples.english_sentence: The secret sauce of this restaurant has been passed down through generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企嘅玉鐲係世代相傳嘅傳家之寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 juk6 zuk2 hai6 sai3 dai6 soeng1 cyun4 ge3 cyun4 gaa1 zi1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的玉镯是世代相传的传家之宝。
examples.english_sentence: Our family's jade bracelet is a family heirloom passed down through generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種傳統手工藝已經世代相傳咗幾百年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 cyun4 tung2 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ji5 ging1 sai3 dai6 soeng1 cyun4 zo2 gei2 baak3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种传统手工艺已经世代相传了几百年。
examples.english_sentence: This traditional craft has been passed down through generations for hundreds of years.

mandarin_meaning: 伯父; 叔父 (比自己父親年長的男性長輩)
english_meaning: uncle (a polite term of address for a man of one's parents' generation; often used to address the father of a friend or acquaintance)
explanation_mandarin: 对长辈男性的一种尊称，通常用于称呼朋友或熟人的父亲，表示尊敬。
explanation_english: A respectful term of address for an older male, usually the father of a friend or acquaintance. It implies respect and is often used as a polite way to address someone of your parents' generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世伯，你好！我係阿明嘅朋友阿強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 baak3, nei5 hou2! ngo5 hai6 aa3 ming4 ge3 pang4 jau5 aa3 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父，您好！我是阿明的的朋友阿强。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, hello! I'm Ah Ming's friend, Ah Keung.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去你屋企拜年，到時見世伯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4, dou3 si4 gin3 sai3 baak3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去你家拜年，到时候见伯父啦。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to your house for Chinese New Year tomorrow, we'll see your father then.

english_meaning: Nephew of one's generation; used to address a younger man who is of a generation below one's peer
explanation_mandarin: 对朋友或熟人的晚辈的称呼，表示亲近和客气。辈分上低于自己一个辈分，年纪也小于自己。
explanation_english: A term used to address a younger man who is of a generation below one's peer, often the son of a friend or acquaintance. It implies familiarity and politeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，李生，呢位係我個世侄，阿明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, lei5 saang1, ni1 wai2 hai6 ngo5 go3 sai3 zat6, aa3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，李先生，这位是我的世侄，阿明。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Mr. Lee, this is my nephew of one's generation, Ah Ming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好客氣，世侄，當自己屋企就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hak3 hei3, sai3 zat6, dong3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别客气，世侄，就把这儿当自己家就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be polite, treat this place like your own home, young man.

english_meaning: grand-niece (humble/polite term of address from a senior generation)
explanation_mandarin: 对晚辈女性的客气称呼，表示对方是自己晚辈的女儿辈。
explanation_english: A polite and humble way to address a younger female, indicating that she is the daughter of one's junior. It's a term used by someone of a senior generation to show respect and cordiality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生，呢位係我世侄女，佢喺英國讀書返嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1, ni1 wai2 hai6 ngo5 sai3 zat6 neoi5, keoi5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 duk6 syu1 faan1 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生，这位是我的世侄女，她从英国读书回来探望我。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee, this is my grand-niece. She's back from studying in England to visit me.

english_meaning: worldly, secular, mundane, conventional
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上普遍存在的、与宗教或精神层面相对立的，与物质、享乐相关的思想、行为或事物。
explanation_english: Relating to or characteristic of the world or its values, especially with regard to material rather than spiritual things. Often refers to conventional and mundane aspects of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔理世俗嘅眼光，決定做自己想做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 lei5 sai3 zuk6 ge3 ngaan5 gwong1, kyut3 ding6 zou6 zi6 gei2 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不在意世俗的眼光，决定做自己想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't care about worldly opinions and decided to do what she wants to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅生活好世俗，每日都係返工放工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sang1 wut6 hou2 sai3 zuk6, mui5 jat6 dou1 hai6 faan1 gung1 fong3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生活很世俗，每天都是上班下班。
examples.english_sentence: His life is very mundane, just going to work and going home every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會風氣越嚟越世俗化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 fung1 hei3 yut6 lai4 yut6 sai3 zuk6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会风气越来越世俗化。
examples.english_sentence: Society's atmosphere is becoming more and more secularized.

english_meaning: Uncle (a term of respect for an older male who is a friend of one's parents or a senior figure)
explanation_mandarin: 对长辈男性朋友的尊称，一般是父母的朋友或比自己年长很多的人。
explanation_english: A respectful term of address for an older male, typically a friend of one's parents or someone significantly older than oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生，唔好咁客氣，叫我阿強就得喇，你都係我老豆嘅世叔啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1, m4 hou2 gam3 haak3 hei3, giu3 ngo5 aa3 keung4 zau6 dak1 laa3, nei5 dou1 hai6 ngo5 lou5 dau2 ge3 sai3 suk1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生，别这么客气，叫我阿强就行了，您都是我爸爸的世叔了。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee, don't be so polite, just call me Ah Keung, you are my father's old friend after all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日提住佢以前點樣同佢老爺個世叔去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 tai4 zyu6 keoi5 ji5 cin4 dim2 joeng2 tung4 keoi5 lou5 je4 go3 sai3 suk1 heoi3 jam2 cha4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是提起她以前怎么样和她公公的老朋友去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always mentions how she used to go for tea with her father-in-law's old friend.

english_meaning: embarrassing, shameful, humiliating
explanation_mandarin: 指令人感到羞愧、尴尬或丢脸的情景或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation or behavior that is embarrassing, shameful, or humiliating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多人面前跌親，真係好世史呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai3 si2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前摔倒，真是太丢脸了。
examples.english_sentence: Falling in front of so many people, it's really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當眾俾人拒絕，好世史㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 zung3 bei2 jan4 keoi5 zyut6, hou2 sai3 si2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当众被人拒绝，很丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: He was rejected in public, it's very embarrassing.

english_meaning: Shangri-La, a paradise, an isolated haven
explanation_mandarin: 指不受外界干扰的理想境界或安乐舒适的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to an idyllic place isolated from the outside world, a haven of peace and comfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度環境咁靚，真係好似世外桃源咁呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 waan4 ging2 gam3 leng3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 sai3 ngoi6 tou4 jyun4 gam3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的环境这么漂亮，真像世外桃源一样啊。
examples.english_sentence: The environment here is so beautiful, it's really like a Shangri-La.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搬咗去鄉下住，過住好似世外桃源嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun1 zo2 heoi3 hoeng1 haa6 zyu6, gwo3 zyu6 hou2 ci5 sai3 ngoi6 tou4 jyun4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搬到乡下住了，过着像世外桃源一样的生活。
examples.english_sentence: They moved to the countryside and are living a Shangri-La-like life.

mandarin_meaning: 隐士高人; 世外高人
english_meaning: reclusive master; hermit of great ability; enlightened person living outside of society
explanation_mandarin: 指避世隐居，具有高超技能或智慧的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who lives in seclusion from the world and possesses extraordinary skills or wisdom; an enlightened person who has withdrawn from society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺深山度住，真係好似世外高人噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 sam1 saan1 dou6 zyu6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 sai3 ngoi6 gou1 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是住在深山里，真像个世外高人。
examples.english_sentence: He always lives deep in the mountains, he's really like a reclusive master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢係個世外高人，識得好多失傳嘅武功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai6 go3 sai3 ngoi6 gou1 jan4, sik1 dak1 hou2 do1 sat1 cyun4 ge3 mou5 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他是个世外高人，懂得很多失传的武功。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he is a reclusive master who knows many lost martial arts skills.

english_meaning: son or daughter of a good friend; a junior in terms of seniority or acquaintance
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对朋友儿子的称呼；也用来称呼辈分较晚，认识已久的人。
explanation_english: A term of address for the son or daughter of a good friend, used as a sign of respect and affection. Also used to address a younger acquaintance one has known for a long time, implying a friendly and informal relationship despite the age difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯，你咪咁客氣啦，叫我世姪仔咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3, nei5 mai5 gam3 haak3 hei3 laa1, giu3 ngo5 sai3 zat6 zai2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父，您不用这么客气，叫我世侄就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, you don't have to be so polite, just call me your friend's son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生見到王先生個仔，好親切咁叫佢做世姪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 gin3 dou2 wong4 sin1 saang1 go3 zai2, hou2 can1 cit3 gam2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 sai3 zat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生见到王先生的儿子，很亲切地叫他世侄。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee saw Mr. Wang's son and affectionately called him his friend's son.

english_meaning: Crown Prince; Heir Apparent (in feudal China/Korea/Vietnam)
explanation_mandarin: 指古代封建王朝诸侯王的继承人，即未来的君王。
explanation_english: Refers to the heir apparent of a prince or king in ancient feudal dynasties (particularly in China, Korea, and Vietnam). The future ruler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係嗰個國嘅世子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go2 go3 gwok3 ge3 sai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是那个国家的世子。
examples.english_sentence: He is the Crown Prince of that country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代，世子嘅地位非常之高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6, sai3 zi2 ge3 dei6 wai2 fei1 soeng4 zi1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，世子的地位非常之高。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, the status of the Crown Prince was very high.

english_meaning: aristocratic family; prominent family; prestigious family (with a long history of influence)
explanation_mandarin: 指世代为官或有声望的家族。
explanation_english: Refers to a family with a long history of holding official positions or having a prominent reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係香港嘅名門世家，好多人都識佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ming4 mun4 sai3 gaa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是香港的名门世家，很多人都认识他们。
examples.english_sentence: They are a prominent family in Hong Kong, and many people know them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司由一個歷史悠久嘅世家創立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jau4 jat1 go3 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2 ge3 sai3 gaa1 cong3 lap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司由一个历史悠久的世家创立。
examples.english_sentence: This company was founded by a family with a long history.

english_meaning: World-Honored One (a respectful title for the Buddha)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，是佛的十种称号之一，表示受到世人尊敬的人。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term, one of the ten epithets of the Buddha, indicating a person who is respected by the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世尊喺佛教裏面係一個好重要嘅稱呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 zyun1 hai2 fat6 gaau3 leoi5 min6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 ching1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世尊在佛教里是一个很重要的称呼。
examples.english_sentence: "World-Honored One" is a very important title in Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學習世尊嘅智慧同慈悲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 sai3 zyun1 ge3 ji3 wai3 tung4 ci4 bei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习世尊的智慧和慈悲。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn from the Buddha's wisdom and compassion.

english_meaning: world situation; international situation; global landscape
explanation_mandarin: 指世界范围内的政治、经济、文化等方面的形势和格局。
explanation_english: Refers to the political, economic, and cultural situation and landscape on a global scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅世局咁混亂，真係唔知將來會點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 sai3 guk6 gam3 wan6 lyun6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 zoeng1 loi4 wui5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的世界局势这么混乱，真不知道将来会怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: The world situation is so chaotic now, I really don't know what the future holds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好關心世局發展，成日睇新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 sai3 guk6 faat3 zin2, sing4 jat6 tai2 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很关心世界局势的发展，经常看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He is very concerned about the development of the world situation and watches the news often.

english_meaning: worldliness, worldly affairs, human affairs, the ways of the world, understanding of human nature and social conventions
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上的人情事理，对人情世故的理解和经验。
explanation_english: Refers to the affairs and principles of human society, and the understanding and experience of human nature and social conventions. It often implies a degree of sophistication or cynicism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好單純，乜都唔識，對世情一竅不通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daan1 seon4, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, deoi3 sai3 cing4 jat1 kiu3 bat1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很单纯，什么都不懂，对人情世故一窍不通。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very naive person, doesn't know anything, and is completely ignorant of the ways of the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷過咁多嘢，佢都睇透世情啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 gwo3 gam3 do1 je5, keoi5 dou1 tai2 tau3 sai3 cing4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历过这么多事情，他都看透了人情世故了。
examples.english_sentence: Having experienced so much, he has seen through the ways of the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，真係唔識世情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2, zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 sai3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，真是不懂人情世故。
examples.english_sentence: Young people these days really don't understand the ways of the world.

english_meaning: The fickleness of human relationships; The world is cold and heartless; Fair-weather friends
explanation_mandarin: 指人情冷暖，世俗风气随着权势而变化。 得势时，趋炎附势的人多，失势时，冷酷无情的人多。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the fickleness and coldness of human relationships, where people are quick to befriend those in power but become indifferent or cruel to those who have fallen from grace. It highlights the opportunistic nature of human interactions, changing with one's social status and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢破產之後，先至睇清楚世態炎涼，以前班friend個個都唔見晒影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 po3 caan2 zi1 hau6, sin1 zi3 tai2 ching1 chu2 sai3 taai3 yim4 loeng4, ji5 cin4 baan1 friend go3 go3 dou1 m4 gin3 saai3 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他破产之后，才看清楚世态炎凉，以前那帮朋友个个都消失了。
examples.english_sentence: After he went bankrupt, he finally understood the fickleness of human relationships; all his previous friends disappeared.

mandarin_meaning: 世故; 老练; 圆滑
english_meaning: worldly; sophisticated; experienced; politic; tactful; smooth
explanation_mandarin: 形容人处世圆滑老练，懂得人情世故，善于应付各种复杂局面。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is worldly, sophisticated, and knows how to deal with people and situations tactfully. They are experienced in handling complex social situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好世故㗎，唔會得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sai3 gu3 gaa3, m4 wui5 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很世故，不会得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: He's very worldly, he wouldn't offend anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要識得啲世故先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 sik1 dak1 di1 sai3 gu3 sin1 dak1.
