explanation_mandarin: 世界貿易組織，一個處理國家或經濟體之間貿易規則的國際組織。
explanation_english: The World Trade Organization (WTO), an international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations or economies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係世貿成員之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 sai3 mau6 sing4 jyun4 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是世界贸易组织成员之一。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a member of the World Trade Organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世貿嘅規則有助促進國際貿易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 mau6 ge3 kwai1 zak1 jau5 zo6 zuk1 zeon3 gwok3 zai3 mau6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世界贸易组织的规则有助于促进国际贸易。
examples.english_sentence: The WTO's rules help promote international trade.

english_meaning: World Games
explanation_mandarin: 世界运动会，是一项由国际世界运动会协会（IWGA）主办的国际性综合运动会，主要面向那些未列入奥林匹克运动会的体育项目。
explanation_english: The World Games is an international multi-sport event organized by the International World Games Association (IWGA), primarily featuring sports and disciplines that are not contested in the Olympic Games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年會去睇世運嘅開幕禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 wui5 heoi3 tai2 sai3 wan6 ge3 hoi1 muk6 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年会去看世界运动会的开幕式。
examples.english_sentence: We will go to see the opening ceremony of the World Games this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺上屆世運攞咗金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng6 gaai3 sai3 wan6 lo2 zo2 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在上一届世界运动会拿了金牌。
examples.english_sentence: He won a gold medal in the last World Games.

mandarin_meaning: 世道; 世情; 社会风气
english_meaning: the state of the world; the ways of the world; social customs; public morality; the times
explanation_mandarin: 指社会状况、人情世故、社会风气等。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of society, human relationships, social customs, and public morality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲世道真係好難撈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 sai3 dou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 lou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的世道真是不好混。
examples.english_sentence: The state of the world these days is really hard to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世道，唔係你諗得咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 dou6, m4 hai6 nei5 nam2 dak1 gam3 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世道，不是你想的那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: The ways of the world are not as simple as you think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有錢就大晒，而家啲世道就係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cin2 zau6 daai6 saai3, ji4 gaa1 di1 sai3 dou6 zau6 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有钱就了不起，现在的世道就是这样。
examples.english_sentence: Having money is everything, that's the way of the world these days.

english_meaning: world; in the world; human realm; society
explanation_mandarin: 指人世间、社会。
explanation_english: Refers to the world, society, or the human realm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世間好多唔公平嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaan1 ho2 do1 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世间有很多不公平的事情。
examples.english_sentence: There are many unfair things in this world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對世間嘅事已經睇得好淡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sai3 gaan1 ge3 si6 ji5 ging1 tai2 dak1 hou2 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对世间的事情已经看得很淡。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very detached view of worldly matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世間冇完美嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gaan1 mou5 jyun4 mei5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世间没有完美的东西。
examples.english_sentence: There is no perfect thing in the world.

english_meaning: world affairs; aspects of society; one's experience of life; to have seen the world; to have wide experience
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上各种情况，阅历；也指场面。
explanation_english: Refers to various aspects of society, one's experiences in life; can also refer to a scene or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生仔嚟，未見過咩世面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 zai2 lei4, mei6 gin3 gwo3 me1 sai3 min6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个年轻人，没见过什么世面。
examples.english_sentence: He is a young man, he hasn't seen much of the world yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該俾小朋友多啲機會出去睇吓世面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 do1 di1 gei1 wui2 cheut1 heoi3 tai2 haa5 sai3 min6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该给孩子们更多机会出去看看世面。
examples.english_sentence: We should give children more opportunities to go out and see the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳個場地好大，真係好有世面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 go3 cheung4 dei6 hou2 daai6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sai3 min6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的场地很大，真的很有气派。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has a large venue, it really looks grand.

mandarin_meaning: 世风日下 (shì fēng rì xià)
english_meaning: The world is going downhill; morals are declining; a sign of the times; things are getting worse.
explanation_mandarin: 指社会风气越来越坏。形容社会道德水平不断下降，人们的思想变得越来越坏。
explanation_english: Describes the deteriorating social morality and values. It implies that societal standards are declining, and people's thoughts and behaviors are becoming worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔越來越唔尊重老人家，真係世風日下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 yut6 lai4 yut6 m4 zyun1 zung6 lou5 jan4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 sai3 fung1 jat6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人越来越不尊重老人，真是世风日下。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people are becoming increasingly disrespectful to the elderly, it's truly a sign of the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從金融風暴之後，好多人都變得好現實，覺得世風日下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gam1 yung4 fung1 bou6 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bin3 dak1 hou2 jin6 sat6, gok3 dak1 sai3 fung1 jat6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从金融风暴之后，很多人都变得很现实，觉得世风日下。
examples.english_sentence: Since the financial crisis, many people have become very pragmatic and feel that the world is going downhill.

synonyms: 道德淪亡 (dou6 dak1 leon4 mong4)

english_meaning: small hill; mound; grave
explanation_mandarin: 小的山包。也指坟墓。
explanation_english: A small hill or mound. Can also refer to a grave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度有座小丘，風景好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jau5 zo6 siu2 jau1, fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有一座小山丘，风景很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There's a small hill there, the scenery is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺葬咗喺嗰個山丘上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 zong3 zo2 hai2 go2 go3 saan1 jau1 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爷爷葬在了那个山丘上面。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather was buried on that hill.

english_meaning: hills; rolling hills
explanation_mandarin: 连绵的小山。
explanation_english: A region of hills; a land with rolling hills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多丘陵，所以好少平地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 jau1 ling4, so2 ji5 hou2 siu2 ping4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多丘陵，所以很少平地。
examples.english_sentence: There are many hills here, so there is little flat land.

english_meaning: bad, poor, third (in order); stupid (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指成绩或者表现不好，也可以用来形容人笨。
explanation_english: Usually refers to bad grades or performance. It can also be used as slang to describe someone as stupid or clumsy. It can also refer to the third item in a series, or Grade C in an exam or assessment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我攞咗個丙，衰咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 lo2 zo2 go3 bing2, seoi1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我拿了个丙，考砸了。
examples.english_sentence: I got a C in this exam. I failed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係丙㗎喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 bing2 gaa3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不会，真笨啊！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this? You're so stupid!

mandarin_meaning: 事业; 行业; 学业; 功课
english_meaning: occupation; industry; business; studies; homework; karma
explanation_mandarin: 在不同的语境下有不同的含义，可以指事业，行业，学业，功课等。也指佛教中的因果报应。
explanation_english: Depending on the context, it can mean occupation, industry, business, studies, homework. It can also refer to karma in Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞緊間大嘅公司，佢嘅业仔真係好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 gan2 gaan1 daai6 ge3 gung1 si1, keoi5 ge3 jip6 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在经营一家大公司，他的事业真的很大。
examples.english_sentence: He's running a big company; his business is really big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你读紧咩业啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 gan2 me1 jip6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在读什么专业啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you studying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔做功课啊？快啲做业啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3 aa3? faai3 di1 zou6 jip6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不做功课吗？快点做作业吧。
examples.english_sentence: Aren't you doing your homework? Hurry up and do your homework.

english_meaning: east
explanation_mandarin: 方位词，指太阳升起的方向。
explanation_english: A noun indicating the direction where the sun rises; east.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺中国嘅东南边。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai2 zung1 gwok3 ge3 dung1 naam4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港在中国东南部。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is in the southeast of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺学校嘅东边。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 hok6 haau6 ge3 dung1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在学校的东边。
examples.english_sentence: I live east of the school.

english_meaning: to assist; to aid; to accomplish; to succeed
explanation_mandarin: 帮助，辅佐，成就。在粤语中，这个字单独使用的情况不多见，通常出现在一些成语或短语中，表示辅助、帮助的意思。
explanation_english: To assist, to aid, to accomplish, or to succeed. In Cantonese, this word is not commonly used alone; it typically appears in idioms or short phrases, indicating assistance or help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個互相扶丞，先至搞得掂呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wu6 soeng1 fu4 sing4, sin1 zi3 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个互相扶助，才搞定了这件事。
examples.english_sentence: They helped each other to finally get this thing done.

english_meaning: Prime Minister, Chancellor
explanation_mandarin: 古代官名，相当于现在的总理或首相。
explanation_english: An ancient official title, equivalent to the current Prime Minister or Chancellor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諸葛亮係三國時期嘅蜀漢丞相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu1 gat3 loeng6 hai6 saam1 gwok3 si4 kei4 ge3 suk6 hon3 sing4 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诸葛亮是三国时期的蜀汉丞相。
examples.english_sentence: Zhuge Liang was the Prime Minister of the Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似想做公司嘅丞相咁，乜都要管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 soeng2 zou6 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 soeng3 gam2, mat1 dou1 jiu3 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像想做公司的宰相一样，什么都要管。
examples.english_sentence: He acts like he wants to be the Prime Minister of the company, controlling everything.

english_meaning: to throw, to lose, to abandon, to discard
explanation_mandarin: 表示扔掉、丢失、遗失等意思。
explanation_english: To throw away, to lose, to discard, or to abandon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁丟垃圾呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 diu1 laap6 saap3 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔垃圾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't litter!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心將銀包丟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 ngan4 baau1 diu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把钱包丢了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally lost my wallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢丟低晒啲嘢就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 diu1 dai1 saai3 di1 je5 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他丢下所有东西就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned everything and left.

mandarin_meaning: 丢人现眼 (diū rén xiàn yǎn)
english_meaning: to lose face; to be a disgrace; to make a spectacle of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指做出令人感到羞耻的事情，使自己在众人面前丢脸。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something shameful that causes one to lose face in front of others, making a spectacle of oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺咁多人面前跌親，真係丟人現眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 diu1 jan4 jin6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当着这么多人的面摔倒了，真是丢人现眼。
examples.english_sentence: He fell in front of so many people, it was really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度嘈啦，丟人現眼呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 caau4 laa1, diu1 jan4 jin6 ngaan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里吵闹了，丢人现眼啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make so much noise here, it's embarrassing!

mandarin_meaning: 丢下, 留下, 放弃
english_meaning: To leave behind, to abandon, to drop off, to leave (something/someone)
explanation_mandarin: 表示将某物或某人留下，放弃，或简单地放下。
explanation_english: To leave something or someone behind, to abandon, to drop something off, or to simply leave something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個細路丟低咗喺公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 sai3 lou2 diu1 dai1 zo2 hai2 gung1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把小孩丢在公园里了。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned the child in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日將啲嘢丟低喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zoeng1 di1 je5 diu1 dai1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是把东西随便丢在那里。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always just leave your things lying around there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺呢個路口丟低我就可以啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ni1 go3 lou6 hau2 diu1 dai1 ngo5 zau6 ho2 ji5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这个路口把我放下就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: You can just drop me off at this intersection.

english_meaning: To take leave; to apply for leave (from work or school)
explanation_mandarin: 指向上级或负责人申请休假。
explanation_english: Refers to applying for leave (vacation, sick leave, etc.) from a superior or person in charge, typically at work or school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日想丟假去睇醫生呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 soeng2 diu1 gaa2 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天想请假去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take leave tomorrow to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常都丟假，唔怪得老闆唔鍾意佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 seung4 dou1 diu1 gaa2, m4 gwaai3 dak1 lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 yi3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常请假，难怪老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He often takes leave, no wonder the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使唔使丟假休息吓啊？你睇落好攰咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 diu1 gaa2 yau1 sik1 haa5 aa3? nei5 tai2 lok6 hou2 gui6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要请假休息一下吗？你看上去很累。
examples.english_sentence: Do you need to take leave to rest? You look very tired.

english_meaning: to lose (something); to mislay
explanation_mandarin: 失去，遗失。
explanation_english: To lose something, to mislay something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗銀包，可能喺街度丟失咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 ngan4 baau1, ho2 nang4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 diu1 sat1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我钱包不见了，可能在街上丢了。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my wallet, maybe I lost it in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲啊，唔好丟失重要文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3, m4 hou2 diu1 sat1 zung6 jiu3 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心点啊，不要丢失重要文件。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't lose important documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺機場丟失咗行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 diu1 sat1 zo2 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在机场丢失了行李。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his luggage at the airport.

english_meaning: to throw away, to discard, to lose
explanation_mandarin: 扔掉、失去。
explanation_english: To throw away, to discard something, or to lose something (less common than 'lost' in English, often implies carelessness or intention).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔要嘅嘢咪丟掉佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 jiu3 ge3 je5 mai1 diu1 diu6 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要的东西就扔掉它吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want it, just throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都亂咁擺嘢，好容易丟掉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lyun6 gam2 baai2 je5, hou2 yung4 yi6 diu1 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是乱放东西，很容易丢掉。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts things everywhere, it's easy to lose them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快丟掉希望呀，仲有機會嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 diu1 diu6 hei1 mong6 aa3, zung6 jau5 gei1 wui2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快放弃希望啊，还有机会的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up hope so quickly, there's still a chance.

english_meaning: to show off knowledge; to flaunt one's learning; to be pedantic
explanation_mandarin: 指人卖弄学问，炫耀知识，说话喜欢引用书本上的内容，让人觉得刻意显摆自己。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who shows off their knowledge, flaunts their learning, and likes to quote from books when speaking, making people feel that they are deliberately showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺度丟書包啦，大家都唔想聽你講咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 diu1 syu1 baau1 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 teng1 nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是在这里卖弄学问了，大家都不想听你讲那么多东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always show off your knowledge here, no one wants to listen to you talk so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鍾意丟書包，講嘢成日引經據典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 diu1 syu1 baau1, gong2 je5 sing4 jat6 jan5 ging1 geoi3 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很喜欢卖弄学问，说话总是引经据典。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to show off his knowledge, always quoting classical texts when he speaks.

english_meaning: to lose face, to be disgraced, to be embarrassed
explanation_mandarin: 指失去面子，出丑，令人感到羞愧。
explanation_english: To lose face, to be disgraced, to be embarrassed. It refers to situations where someone's actions or behaviour cause them or others to feel ashamed or humiliated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺咁多人面前鬧佢，好丟架㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 nau6 keoi5, hou2 diu1 gaa2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这么多人面前骂他，很丢脸的！
examples.english_sentence: You're scolding him in front of so many people, it's very embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果考試唔合格，真係丟架死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 diu1 gaa2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果考试不及格，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: If I fail the exam, I'll be so embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲咁嘅嘢，成間公司都俾佢丟架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 bei2 keoi5 diu1 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这样的事，整个公司都被他丢脸了。
examples.english_sentence: He did such things, the whole company was disgraced by him.

english_meaning: to discard; to abandon; to throw away
explanation_mandarin: 指将不再需要或不再使用的东西扔掉；抛弃。
explanation_english: To get rid of something that is no longer needed or useful; to abandon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁輕易丟棄啲嘢，可能第日有用呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 diu1 hei3 di1 je5, ho2 nang4 dai6 jat6 jau5 jung6 ne1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么轻易丢弃东西，也许以后有用呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things away so easily, they might be useful in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定丟棄所有嘅舊信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 diu1 hei3 so2 jau5 ge3 gau6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定丢弃所有的旧信。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to throw away all the old letters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以隨便丟棄垃圾㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 diu1 hei3 laap6 saap3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以随便丢弃垃圾的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just throw garbage anywhere.

english_meaning: To be fussy and difficult; to play hard to get; to be deliberately obstructive; to make things difficult by being picky or evasive.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事或说话不干脆，故意找麻烦，推诿拖延，或提出苛刻的要求，令人难以应付。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is fussy, difficult, and deliberately makes things hard for others. They might be evasive, picky, or refuse to cooperate willingly, making the task more challenging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁丟橋扭擰啦，快啲決定好唔好呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 diu1 kiu4 nau2 ning6 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么耍花招刁难了，快点决定好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so fussy and difficult, just quickly decide whether it's okay or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好丟橋扭擰，好多嘢都唔肯合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 diu1 kiu4 nau2 ning6, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 m4 hang2 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很喜欢耍花招刁难，很多事情都不肯合作。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very difficult person to deal with, he refuses to cooperate on many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆買嘢好丟橋扭擰，成日要人平啲再平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 maai5 ye5 hou2 diu1 kiu4 nau2 ning6, seng4 jat6 jiu3 jan4 peng4 di1 zoi3 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶买东西很挑剔刁难，总是要人家便宜一点再便宜一点。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady is very picky when buying things, always asking for even cheaper prices.

synonyms: 奄尖腥悶 (yim1 zim1 seng1 mun6)

english_meaning: to fade; to grow apart; to become distant; to lose interest; to dilute
explanation_mandarin: 指感情、关系、兴趣等逐渐变淡，变得疏远。
explanation_english: Refers to the gradual fading of feelings, relationships, interests, etc., becoming distant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗咁耐拖，最近好似有啲丟淡噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 gam3 noi6 to1, zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 diu1 daam6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了这么久恋爱，最近好像有点疏远了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for so long, but recently it seems like they've grown a bit distant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個自從畢業之後，聯絡就開始丟淡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zi6 cung4 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, lyun4 lok3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 diu1 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个自从毕业之后，联系就开始变淡。
examples.english_sentence: Since we graduated, our contact has started to fade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快丟淡對呢件事嘅興趣啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 diu1 daam6 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快对这件事失去兴趣啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lose interest in this so quickly.

english_meaning: to lose face, to be embarrassed, to make a fool of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指失去面子，感到难堪，或者做出令人尴尬的事情。
explanation_english: To lose face; to be embarrassed; to make a fool of oneself in public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個presentation度講錯晒啲嘢，真係丟生呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 presentation dou6 gong2 co3 saai3 di1 je5, zan1 hai6 diu1 sang1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在报告里说错了所有东西，真是丢脸啊！
examples.english_sentence: He messed up everything in the presentation, it was so embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺咁多人面前鬧佢啦，佢會好丟生㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 naau6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 wui5 hou2 diu1 sang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这么多人面前骂他，他会很丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him in front of so many people, he will be very embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞搞震，唔係我哋會丟生㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 diu1 sang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要捣乱，不然我们会丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around, or we'll lose face.

english_meaning: negligent, careless, inattentive, to overlook
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为粗心大意而忽略或者疏忽了某件事情。
explanation_english: Describes being negligent or careless and overlooking something due to inattention or carelessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時丟疏，唔記得咗帶鎖匙出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 diu1 so1, m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 so2 si4 chut1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时疏忽，忘记带钥匙出门了。
examples.english_sentence: He was momentarily negligent and forgot to bring his keys out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢千祈唔好咁丟疏，會搞出人命㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 chin1 kai4 m4 hou2 gam3 diu1 so1, wui5 gaau2 chut1 jan4 ming6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作千万不要这么疏忽，会出人命的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so negligent at work, it could cost someone's life!

english_meaning: to give a flirtatious glance; to bat one's eyelashes; to make eyes at someone
explanation_mandarin: 用眼神暗示或挑逗对方，带有轻佻的意味。
explanation_english: To give a flirtatious glance or to make eyes at someone, often with a slightly frivolous or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住啲靚仔丟眼角，真係好鬼馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 di1 leng3 zai2 diu1 ngaan5 gok3, zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是对着那些帅哥抛媚眼，真是古灵精怪。
examples.english_sentence: She's always batting her eyelashes at those handsome guys, she's such a mischievous person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日丟眼角啦，專心聽書啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 diu1 ngaan5 gok3 laa1, zyun1 sam1 ting1 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是抛媚眼了，专心听课吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop flirting and pay attention to the lesson.

english_meaning: to lose face, to be disgraced, to be humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 指做了不光彩的事情，使自己或相关的人感到羞耻。
explanation_english: To lose face or be disgraced, usually due to an action that brings shame upon oneself or others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做真係好丟臉㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 lim5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做真的很丢脸！
examples.english_sentence: What you did is really embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多人面前講錯嘢，真係丟臉死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, zan1 hai6 diu1 lim5 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前说错话，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: I misspoke in front of so many people, it's so embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果考試唔合格，真係會比阿爸阿媽覺得丟臉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 wui5 bei2 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa4 gok3 dak1 diu1 lim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果考试不及格，真的会被爸爸妈妈觉得丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: If I fail the exam, my parents will really think it's embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 荒废; 撂荒; 闲置
english_meaning: to leave uncultivated; to abandon (land); to neglect; to waste
explanation_mandarin: 指土地荒芜，没有耕种；也指东西闲置，没有利用。
explanation_english: Refers to land being left uncultivated or abandoned; can also refer to something being left unused or neglected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊田丟荒咗好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 tin4 diu1 fong1 zo2 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块地荒废很久了。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of land has been left uncultivated for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦買咗返嚟都冇用過，咪即係丟荒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 maai5 zo2 faan1 lei4 dou1 mou5 yung6 gwo3, mai1 jik1 hai6 diu1 fong1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑买了回来都没用过，不就是闲置吗？
examples.english_sentence: The computer was bought but never used, isn't that just leaving it unused?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲資源丟荒啊，可以循環再用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 zi1 jyun4 diu1 fong1 aa3, ho2 ji5 ceon4 waan4 zoi3 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要浪费这些资源，可以循环再用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste these resources, they can be recycled.

english_meaning: Fuck your mother
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语脏话，表示辱骂和不满，相当于普通话的“肏你妈”。 (Fēicháng cūsú de Yuèyǔ zànghuà, biǎoshì rǔmà hé bùmǎn, xiāngdāng yú Pǔtōnghuà de “cào nǐ mā”.)
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese swear word expressing insult and dissatisfaction, equivalent to the Mandarin "cào nǐ mā" (fuck your mother).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再嘈我，我屌那媽你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 cou4 ngo5, ngo5 diu1 naa5 maa1 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再吵我，我肏你妈！ (nǐ zài chǎo wǒ, wǒ cào nǐ mā!)
examples.english_sentence: If you bother me again, I'll fuck your mother!

english_meaning: two; tael (unit of weight/currency)
explanation_mandarin: 量词，用于重量单位；数字，相当于“二”；也指旧时的一种货币单位。
explanation_english: A classifier for weight, equivalent to the Chinese tael (approximately 37.5 grams). Also used as a number meaning "two," often in compound words related to money or measurements. Historically also a unit of currency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾両蚊得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 leong5 man1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给两块钱行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is it okay if I give you two dollars?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗両斤蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 leong5 gan1 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了二斤苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two catties of apples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有両間舖頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 leong5 gaan1 pou3 tau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有两间店铺。
examples.english_sentence: He owns two shops.

english_meaning: to lose; to throw away; to abandon; to cast
explanation_mandarin: 表示遗失，失去，丢弃等含义。
explanation_english: Indicates losing, discarding, or abandoning something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心丢咗条锁匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 diu1 zo2 tiu4 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把钥匙丢了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally lost my key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易丢咗你嘅梦想啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 diu1 zo2 nei5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易丢掉你的梦想啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't easily give up your dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢将啲垃圾丢晒落垃圾桶度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 laap1 saap3 diu1 saai3 lok6 laap1 saap3 tung2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把垃圾全部丢到垃圾桶里了。
examples.english_sentence: He threw all the trash into the trash can.

english_meaning: two, tael (unit of weight)
explanation_mandarin: 表示数字2。也用作重量单位，即“两”。
explanation_english: Represents the number 2. Also used as a unit of weight, 'tael'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想买两斤橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 gan1 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买两斤橙子。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy two catties of oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢条鱼有几重啊？大概有两斤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 yu2 jau5 gei2 cung5 aa3? daai6 koi3 jau5 loeng5 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条鱼有多重啊？大概有两斤。
examples.english_sentence: How heavy is this fish? About two catties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾两蚊搭车。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 loeng5 man1 daap3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给两块钱坐车。
examples.english_sentence: Give two dollars to take the bus.

english_meaning: and; furthermore; actually; definitely
explanation_mandarin: 连接词，表示并列或递进关系；副词，表示强调或肯定。
explanation_english: As a conjunction, it connects clauses or phrases, indicating addition or progression. As an adverb, it emphasizes or affirms something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意食蘋果並且食橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 yi3 sik6 ping4 gwo2 bing6 ce2 sik6 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃苹果并且喜欢吃橙子。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating apples and oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並唔係咁叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 m4 hai6 gam3 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他实际上并没有那么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's actually not that capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你並無錯到喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bing6 mou5 co3 dou3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你并没有错啊。
examples.english_sentence: You're definitely not wrong.

english_meaning: and; moreover; furthermore; in addition
explanation_mandarin: 表示并列关系，连接两个或两个以上的成分。
explanation_english: Indicates a coordinate relationship, connecting two or more components.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，並且好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, bing3 ce2 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，并且很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart and very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食蘋果，並且鍾意食橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2, bing3 ce2 zung1 ji3 sik6 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃苹果，并且喜欢吃橙子。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat apples and I like to eat oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢好食，並且價錢都合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 hou2 sik6, bing3 ce2 gaa3 cin2 dou1 hap6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好吃，并且价格也合理。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is delicious, and the prices are reasonable.

english_meaning: did not; have not; do not
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，强调没有发生或存在某事。
explanation_english: A negative adverb used to emphasize that something has not happened or does not exist. It's stronger than simply saying '冇' (mou5).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我並冇講過呢啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bing6 mou5 gong2 gwo3 ni1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我并没有说过这些话。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't say these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並冇嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 mou5 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并没有来过。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋並冇見過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bing6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们并没有见过他。
examples.english_sentence: We haven't seen him.

english_meaning: parallel; to stand side by side; to list side by side; juxtaposition
explanation_mandarin: 指并排排列，或者指两种事物具有同等地位或重要性。
explanation_english: Refers to things arranged side by side, or two things having equal status or importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司喺業界係並列第一嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 ngaai5 gaai3 hai6 bing6 lit6 dai6 jat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司在业界是并列第一的。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are tied for first place in the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩幅畫並列咁掛喺牆上面，好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 fuk1 waa2 bing6 lit6 gam2 gwaa3 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 min6, hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两幅画并列挂在墙上，很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: These two paintings are hung side by side on the wall, they are very beautiful.

english_meaning: to coexist; to exist simultaneously
explanation_mandarin: 同时存在。
explanation_english: To exist at the same time; to coexist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，中西文化並存，形成咗一種獨特嘅文化氛圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2, zung1 sai1 man4 faa3 bing6 cyun4, jing4 sing4 zo2 jat1 zung2 duk6 dak6 ge3 man4 faa3 fan1 wai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，中西方文化并存，形成了一种独特的文化氛围。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, Chinese and Western cultures coexist, forming a unique cultural atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲病徵可能會同時並存，令到診斷變得複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 beng6 zing1 ho2 nang4 wui5 tung4 si4 bing6 cyun4, ling6 dou3 can2 dyun3 bin3 dak1 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些病症可能会同时并存，使得诊断变得复杂。
examples.english_sentence: Some symptoms may coexist, making diagnosis complicated.

english_meaning: side by side; abreast
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个事物在同一水平线上排列在一起。
explanation_english: Describes two or more things arranged next to each other on the same horizontal line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個並排坐喺度傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 bing6 paai4 co5 hai2 dou6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人并排坐在那里聊天。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them sat side by side, chatting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車並排泊喺路邊，好阻地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 bing6 paai4 paak3 hai2 lou6 bin1, hou2 zo2 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子并排停在路边，很占地方。
examples.english_sentence: The cars are parked side by side on the roadside, taking up a lot of space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間鋪頭並排開喺商場入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 pou1 tau2 bing6 paai4 hoi1 hai2 seong1 coeng4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两家商店并排开在商场里面。
examples.english_sentence: The two shops are opened side by side inside the shopping mall.

english_meaning: not yet; has not; have not
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情还没有发生或者完成。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has not yet happened or been completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋並未決定去邊度旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bing6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们尚未决定去哪里旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They have not yet decided where to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事並未解決，仲要再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 bing6 mei6 gaai2 kyut3, zung6 jiu3 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情尚未解决，还需要再谈。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has not been resolved yet, we still need to discuss it further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋並未收到佢嘅回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bing6 mei6 sau1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还没有收到他的回复。
examples.english_sentence: We haven't received his reply yet.

english_meaning: does not have; does not exist; not at all
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，强调没有或者不存在。
explanation_english: Indicates negation, emphasizing that something does not exist or is not the case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我並無諗過會咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bing6 mou4 lam2 gwo3 wui5 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我并没有想过会这样。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't think it would be like this at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度並無位坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 bing6 mou4 wai2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里并没有座位。
examples.english_sentence: There are no seats here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並無講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 mou4 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并没有说谎。
examples.english_sentence: He did not lie at all.

english_meaning: to use together; to use in conjunction; to combine and use
explanation_mandarin: 同时使用；一并使用。
explanation_english: To use two or more things together; to use something in conjunction with something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩種方法可以並用，效果會更加好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leung5 zung2 fong1 faat3 ho2 ji5 bing3 yung6, haau6 gwo2 wui5 gang3 ga1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种方法可以并用，效果会更好。
examples.english_sentence: These two methods can be used together, the effect will be better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以將傳統嘅方法同現代科技並用，去解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jeung1 chuen4 tung2 ge3 fong1 faat3 tung4 hiun3 doi6 fo1 gei6 bing3 yung6, heui3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以将传统的方法和现代科技并用，去解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: We can use traditional methods in conjunction with modern technology to solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並用英文同廣東話同客人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 bing3 yung6 ying1 man2 tung4 gwong2 dung1 waa2 tung4 haak3 yan4 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并用英语和广东话与客人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: He uses both English and Cantonese to communicate with customers.

english_meaning: to be called jointly; to be jointly known as
explanation_mandarin: 一并称呼，共同被称作。
explanation_english: To be jointly called or known as; to be referred to together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都好叻，成日俾人並稱為「雙傑」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hou2 lek1, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 bing6 cing1 wai4 "seung1 git6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都很厉害，总是被人并称为“双杰”。
examples.english_sentence: They are both very capable and are often jointly known as the "Double Heroes".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個畫家，風格唔同，但係實力相當，所以俾人並稱為藝壇嘅「南北二雄」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 waak6 gaa1, fung1 gaak3 m4 tung4, daan6 hai6 sat6 lik6 soeng1 dong1, so2 ji5 bei2 jan4 bing6 cing1 wai4 ngai6 taan4 ge3 "naam4 bak1 ji6 hung4".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两位画家，风格不同，但是实力相当，所以被人并称为艺坛的“南北二雄”。
examples.english_sentence: These two painters have different styles but comparable strengths, so they are jointly called the "Two Heroes of the Art Scene, North and South."

english_meaning: side by side; shoulder to shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 指两人或多人肩并着肩，形容关系密切或共同行动。
explanation_english: To stand or walk side by side, shoulder to shoulder; used to describe close relationships or joint actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會並肩作戰，一齊克服所有困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bing6 gin1 zok3 zin3, jat1 cai4 kok3 fuk6 so2 jau5 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会并肩作战，一起克服所有困难。
examples.english_sentence: We will fight side by side and overcome all difficulties together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋並肩行喺沙灘上面，好浪漫啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bing6 gin1 haang4 hai2 saa1 taan1 soeng6 min6, hou2 long6 maan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们并肩走在沙滩上，好浪漫啊。
examples.english_sentence: They were walking side by side on the beach, so romantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要並肩努力，先可以達到目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bing6 gin1 nu5 lik6, sin1 ho2 ji5 daat6 dou3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要并肩努力，才可以达到目标。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard side by side in order to achieve our goal.

english_meaning: to fight shoulder to shoulder; to fight side by side; to work together closely
explanation_mandarin: 形容紧密合作，共同战斗或努力。
explanation_english: Describes working closely together, fighting together, or striving together towards a common goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要並肩作戰，先可以打贏呢場仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bing6 gin1 zok3 zin3, sin1 ho2 ji5 daa2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要并肩作战，才能打赢这场仗。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fight shoulder to shoulder in order to win this battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗完成呢個項目，我哋一定要並肩作戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bing6 gin1 zok3 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了完成这个项目，我们一定要并肩作战。
examples.english_sentence: In order to complete this project, we must work together closely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多困難，我哋更加要並肩作戰，互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 gang3 gaa1 jiu3 bing6 gin1 zok3 zin3, wu6 soeng1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多困难，我们更要并肩作战，互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many difficulties, we need to work together even more and support each other.

english_meaning: growing side by side; (of flowers) two blossoms on one stem; united (of lovers); a happy marriage
explanation_mandarin: 指两朵花生长在同一根茎上，比喻夫妻恩爱，感情深厚。
explanation_english: Refers to two flowers growing on the same stem, symbolizing a loving and harmonious marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似並蒂蓮咁，感情好到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 bing6 dai3 lin4 gam2, gam2 cing4 hou2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个就像并蒂莲一样，感情好得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: They are like lotus flowers growing side by side on the same stem; their relationship is exceptionally good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你哋新婚快樂，永結並蒂蓮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 dei6 san1 fan1 faai3 lok6, wing5 git3 bing6 dai3 lin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你们新婚快乐，永结并蒂莲。
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a happy marriage, and that you forever remain like twin lotus flowers on a single stalk.

english_meaning: to attach equal importance to; to give equal weight to; to lay stress on both
explanation_mandarin: 同时重视两个或多个方面，给予相同的关注。
explanation_english: To give equal importance or weight to two or more aspects; to consider both sides equally important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司好並重員工嘅福利同埋培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hou2 bing6 zung6 yun4 gung1 ge3 fuk1 lei6 tung4 mai4 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司很重视员工的福利和培训。
examples.english_sentence: Our company attaches great importance to employee benefits and training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教育制度應該並重學術同埋品德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 yuk6 zai3 dou6 ying1 goi1 bing6 zung6 hok6 seot6 tung4 mai4 ban2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育制度应该并重学术和品德。
examples.english_sentence: The education system should attach equal importance to academic performance and moral character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並重工作同埋家庭，盡量攞個平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 zung6 gung1 zok3 tung4 mai4 gaa1 ting4, zeon6 leung6 lo2 go3 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并重工作和家庭，尽量取得平衡。
examples.english_sentence: He attaches equal importance to work and family, trying his best to find a balance.

english_meaning: not; not really; not so
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，不是，并非如此。
explanation_english: Indicates negation, meaning 'not', 'not really', 'not so'. It emphasizes that something is not what it seems or is claimed to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並非我哋嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 fei1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并非我们的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is not our friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事並非咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 bing6 fei1 gam3 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事并非那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is not that simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢並非唔想幫你，而係佢真係冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing6 fei1 m4 soeng2 bong1 nei5, ji4 hai6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他并非不想帮你，而是他真的没时间。
examples.english_sentence: It's not that he doesn't want to help you, but he really doesn't have time.

english_meaning: To run neck and neck; to keep pace with; to be on par with; to go hand in hand
explanation_mandarin: 比喻彼此的力量或才能不相上下，並列前進。
explanation_english: An idiom describing two or more entities progressing at the same pace and level, being equally powerful or talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅大學喺研究方面，希望可以同國際頂尖大學並駕齊驅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daai6 hok6 hai2 jin4 gau3 fong1 min6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 tung4 gwok3 zai3 ding2 zim1 daai6 hok6 bing6 gaa3 cai4 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的大学在研究方面，希望可以和国际顶尖大学并驾齐驱。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong universities hope to be on par with the world's top universities in terms of research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅實力並駕齊驅，所以今次比賽好難講邊個會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat6 lik6 bing6 gaa3 cai4 keoi1, so2 ji5 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 hou2 naan4 gong2 bin1 go3 wui5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的实力并驾齐驱，所以这次比赛很难说谁会赢。
examples.english_sentence: Their strengths are neck and neck, so it's hard to say who will win this competition.

english_meaning: Vertical line; stroke in Chinese characters
explanation_mandarin: 汉字基本笔画之一，即竖。在粤语中，有时也用来表示“一” (jat1) 的一种简写形式，尤其是在快速书写或打字时。
explanation_english: One of the basic strokes in Chinese characters, meaning 'vertical'. In Cantonese, it can sometimes be used as a shorthand for "一" (jat1), especially in quick writing or typing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫個「十」字，先打橫，後打丨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 go3 sap6 zi6, sin1 daa2 waang4, hau6 daa2 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写一个“十”字，先写横，后写竖。
examples.english_sentence: To write the character “十”, first write the horizontal stroke, then the vertical stroke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢欠我丨舊水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him3 ngo5 gwan3 gau6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠我一百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He owes me one hundred dollars. (Here it represents 'one' in one hundred.)

english_meaning: Classifier (general, for people and many other things)
explanation_mandarin: 通用的量词，用于人和很多其他事物。
explanation_english: A general classifier used for people and a wide variety of countable objects. It's the most common classifier in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢个人好靓仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 leng3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很帅。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very handsome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我买咗三个苹果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 saam1 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了三个苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought three apples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有几多个学生？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 gei2 do1 go3 hok6 sang1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有多少个学生？
examples.english_sentence: How many students are there?

english_meaning: particle indicating suggestion, emphasis, or question; often used at the end of a sentence
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，常用于句尾，表示疑问、建议、肯定等语气，具体含义需根据语境判断。
explanation_english: A particle used at the end of a sentence to indicate a suggestion, emphasis, or a question. Its specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行街丫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 gaai1 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去逛街吗？
examples.english_sentence: Going shopping?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好攰丫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 gui6 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好累呀！
examples.english_sentence: I'm so tired!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯未丫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten yet?

mandarin_meaning: 岔子, 叉子, 麻烦
english_meaning: fork, problem, trouble, something going wrong
explanation_mandarin: 原指形状像“丫”字的叉子。引申指意外出现的麻烦、岔子。也指道路分叉口。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a fork-shaped object resembling the letter 'Y'. By extension, it refers to an unexpected problem or trouble. It can also refer to a fork in the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃原本好順利，但係突然間出現咗好多丫叉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 jyun4 bun2 hou2 seon6 lei6, daan6 hai6 dat6 jin4 gaan1 ceot1 jin6 zo2 hou2 do1 aa1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划本来很顺利，但是突然间出现了许多问题。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan was going smoothly, but suddenly many problems appeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路喺前面分咗丫叉，你要揀啱邊條先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 hai2 cin4 min6 fan1 zo2 aa1 caa1, nei5 jiu3 gaan2 aam1 bin1 tiu4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面的路分叉了，你要选对哪一条才行。
examples.english_sentence: The road forks ahead, you have to choose the right one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞出咁多丫叉，真係唔知點收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 ceot1 gam3 do1 aa1 caa1, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弄出这么多麻烦，真不知道该怎么收场。
examples.english_sentence: Causing so much trouble, I really don't know how to clean up the mess.

english_meaning: fork; forked (shape); Y-shaped
explanation_mandarin: 指物体分叉成Y字形，也指叉子。
explanation_english: Refers to something that splits into a Y-shape, or a fork (utensil).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞住條丫杈嘅樹枝玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zyu6 tiu4 aa1 caa3 ge3 syu6 zi1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着一根分叉的树枝玩。
examples.english_sentence: He's playing with a forked branch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用丫杈食意粉方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 aa1 caa3 sik6 yi3 fan2 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用叉子吃意大利面方便一点。
examples.english_sentence: It's easier to eat spaghetti with a fork.

english_meaning: Woof woof (onomatopoeia)
explanation_mandarin: 模仿狗叫的聲音
explanation_english: An onomatopoeic word imitating the sound of a dog barking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗喺度丫烏丫烏噉吠緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 hai2 dou6 aa1 wu1 aa1 wu1 gam2 fai6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗正在那里汪汪地叫着。
examples.english_sentence: The dog is barking "woof woof" over there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你扮狗仔丫烏幾聲嚟聽下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baan6 gau2 zai2 aa1 wu1 gei2 seng1 lai4 teng1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你学小狗叫几声来听听。
examples.english_sentence: Imitate a puppy and bark "woof woof" a few times for us to hear.

mandarin_meaning: 老太太, 年老的妇女
english_meaning: old woman, elderly lady
explanation_mandarin: 指年老的婦女。 通常帶有尊敬或客气的意味，有时也可以带有轻微的调侃。
explanation_english: Refers to an elderly woman. Usually carries a respectful or polite connotation, but can sometimes be slightly playful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋讓個位俾嗰個丫烏婆坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joeng6 go3 wai2 bei2 go2 go3 aa1 wu1 po4 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们让个座位给那位老太太坐吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's give up our seat for that old woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆級嘅丫烏婆都識得用智能手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po4 kap1 ge3 aa1 wu1 po4 dou1 sik1 dak1 yung6 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶辈的老太太们都会用智能手机了。
examples.english_sentence: Even grandmothers-level old ladies know how to use smartphones.

english_meaning: Double bun hairstyle (typically worn by young girls in traditional Chinese style)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种将头发梳成两个对称的发髻，分别位于头部两侧的发型，常见于旧时女童。
explanation_english: A hairstyle in which the hair is arranged into two symmetrical buns, one on each side of the head. It was a common hairstyle for young girls in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲細路女成日紮丫角髻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 sai3 lou2 neoi5 seng4 jat6 zaat3 aa1 gok3 gai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的小女孩经常扎丫髻。
examples.english_sentence: Young girls used to often wear the double bun hairstyle.

english_meaning: Girl; lass; (old-fashioned) maidservant
explanation_mandarin: 丫头，原指女孩子，有时也指女佣（旧时用法）。在粤语中，丫头通常指年轻的女孩或小女孩，有时带有亲昵或宠溺的意味。 旧时，也可指年轻的女佣。
explanation_english: "丫頭" originally refers to a girl. It can also refer to a maidservant (old-fashioned). In Cantonese, "丫頭" generally refers to a young girl or lass, sometimes with a sense of endearment or affection. In older times, it could also refer to a young female servant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個丫頭仔幾得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 aa1 tau4 zai2 gei2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小女孩真可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: That little girl is so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣，成日俾阿媽話我係傻丫頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, seng4 jat6 bei2 aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 hai6 so4 aa1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，常常被妈妈说我是傻丫头。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom often called me a silly girl.

english_meaning: maidservant, slave girl
explanation_mandarin: 旧时富家雇用的女仆，多指未婚的年轻女性。
explanation_english: A maidservant or slave girl, typically young and unmarried, employed in wealthy households in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大戶人家做丫鬟，受咗好多委屈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1 zou6 aa1 waan4, sau6 zo2 ho2 do1 wai2 kwik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在富贵人家做丫鬟，受了很多委屈。
examples.english_sentence: She worked as a maidservant in a wealthy family and suffered a lot.

english_meaning: to hit; to attain; to win; to suit; right; correct; to be affected by
explanation_mandarin: 1. 击中目标：例如中奖、中枪。2. 达到某种状态：例如中毒、中暑。3. 符合心意或标准：例如中意。4. 正确，对：例如中肯。
explanation_english: 1. To hit a target: for example, to win a prize, to be shot. 2. To attain a certain state: for example, to be poisoned, to have a heatstroke. 3. To be to one's liking or meet a standard: for example, to like something. 4. Correct, right: for example, to be pertinent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張六合彩飛，希望會中頭獎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 luk6 hap6 coi2 fei1, hei1 mong6 wui5 zung1 tau4 zoeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一张彩票，希望可以中头奖啊。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lottery ticket, hoping to win the first prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好中意對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 zung1 ji3 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩很喜欢对方。
examples.english_sentence: They like each other very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢幾中肯喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 gei2 zung1 hang2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西挺中肯的。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is quite pertinent.

english_meaning: above average; fairly good; decent
explanation_mandarin: 指程度在中等之上，接近好的水平，但未达到最好的程度。
explanation_english: Refers to a level that is above average, approaching good, but not quite the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績都算中上，考入大學應該冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 jik1 dou1 syun3 zung1 soeng6, haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6 ying1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩也算中上，考入大学应该没问题。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are above average, so he shouldn't have any problem getting into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物質素中上啦，唔會令人失望嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 so3 zung1 soeng6 laa1, m4 wui5 ling6 jan4 sat1 mong6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物质量中上吧，不会令人失望的。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of the food in this restaurant is above average; it won't disappoint you.

english_meaning: Middle Ages; Medieval period
explanation_mandarin: 指欧洲历史上的一个时期，大约从公元5世纪到15世纪。
explanation_english: Refers to a period in European history from approximately the 5th to the 15th centuries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇中世紀嘅歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 yi3 tai2 zung1 sai3 gei2 ge3 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看中世纪的历史。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to read about the history of the Middle Ages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中世紀嘅歐洲生活都幾艱苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 sai3 gei2 ge3 au1 zau1 sang1 wut6 dou1 gei2 gaan1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中世纪的欧洲生活挺艰苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Life in medieval Europe was quite tough.

english_meaning: so-so; just okay; mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度一般，不是很好，也不是很差。相当于“还可以”、“一般般”。
explanation_english: Indicates a mediocre level, neither good nor bad. Equivalent to "so-so" or "just okay".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得呢間餐廳嘅嘢食點呀？中中啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 dim2 aa3? zung1 zung1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得这家餐厅的食物怎么样？一般般吧。
examples.english_sentence: What do you think of the food at this restaurant? Just okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試你考成點呀？中中啦，合格就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 nei5 haau2 sing4 dim2 aa3? zung1 zung1 laa1, hap6 gaak3 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试你考得怎么样？一般般啦，及格就行。
examples.english_sentence: How did you do on the exam this time? So-so, passing is enough.

english_meaning: Slightly, a bit, somewhat
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，指稍微，有点。常用于形容词或动词前，表示程度不高。
explanation_english: Indicates a slight degree or extent. Often used before adjectives or verbs to express that something is only slightly so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人中中哋傻嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zung1 zung1 dei2 so4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人有点傻。
examples.english_sentence: He is a little bit silly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯咖啡中中哋甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 zung1 zung1 dei2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯咖啡稍微有点甜。
examples.english_sentence: This coffee is a bit sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我中中哋唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 zung1 dei2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有点不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a bit unwell.

english_meaning: So-so, alright, not bad
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度一般，还可以，不是特别好，也不是特别差。
explanation_english: Indicates a moderate level or degree, meaning 'so-so,' 'alright,' or 'not bad.' It suggests something is acceptable but not exceptional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得中中地啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 zung1 zung1 dei2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得一般般而已。
examples.english_sentence: He only did alright on this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食中中地啦，唔算特別好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 zung1 zung1 dei2 laa1, m4 syun3 dak6 bit1 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一般般吧，不算特别好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so-so, not particularly delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日心情中中地，唔係好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sam1 ching4 zung1 zung1 dei2, m4 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天心情一般般，不是很开心。
examples.english_sentence: I'm feeling so-so today, not very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 一般般，还可以，马马虎虎
english_meaning: So-so, just okay, passable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物一般，不够好也不够差。表示程度一般，勉强可以接受。
explanation_english: Describes something as being average, neither good nor bad. It indicates a moderate level, just barely acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績中中挺挺啦，唔算好亦都唔算差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 zung1 zung1 ting5 ting5 laa1, m4 syun3 hou2 jik6 dou1 m4 syun3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩一般般吧，不算好也不算差。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results this time are so-so, not good but not bad either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食中中挺挺，唔會專登再去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zung1 zung1 ting5 ting5, m4 wui5 zyun1 dang1 zoi3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一般般，不会特意再去。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is just okay; I wouldn't go there again on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工中中挺挺，夠生活就算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zung1 zung1 ting5 ting5, gau3 sang1 wut6 jau6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作一般般，够生活就算了。
examples.english_sentence: His job is just so-so, enough to get by.

english_meaning: Eighth-grader syndrome, Middle schooler syndrome, Chuunibyou
explanation_mandarin: 指青少年时期，特别是初中二年级左右的学生，所表现出的一种自以为是、喜欢幻想、沉浸在自己的世界中的状态。他们常常认为自己很特别，并尝试用一些夸张或中二的行为来吸引别人的注意。
explanation_english: Refers to a state exhibited by adolescents, especially around the eighth grade, characterized by delusions of grandeur, fantasy proneness, and immersion in their own world. They often believe they are special and try to attract attention with exaggerated or 'cringe' behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己有超能力，真係中二病發作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 jau5 ciu1 nang4 lik6, zan1 hai6 zung1 ji6 beng6 faat3 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己有超能力，真是中二病发作了。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he has superpowers, he's really having a case of eighth-grader syndrome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁中二病啦，成熟啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zung1 ji6 beng6 laa1, sing4 suk6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么中二病了，成熟一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so chuunibyou, be more mature.

english_meaning: Central Asia
explanation_mandarin: 指亚洲中部地区，通常包括哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦。
explanation_english: Refers to the central region of Asia, typically including Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗中亞旅行，話嗰度嘅文化好特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 zung1 aa3 leoi5 hang4, waa6 go2 dou6 ge3 man4 faa3 hou2 dak6 bit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了中亚旅行，说那里的文化很特别。
examples.english_sentence: He went to Central Asia for travel and said the culture there is very special.

english_meaning: so-so; mediocre; not bad; passable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物水平一般，不算好也不算差；还可以，勉强可以接受。
explanation_english: Describes something that is mediocre, not particularly good or bad; passable; acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得中亭，唔算好，但都合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 zung1 ting1, m4 syun3 hou2, daan6 dou1 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得一般，不算好，但是及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I did so-so on this exam, not great, but I passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食只可以話中亭，唔算特別好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zi2 ho2 ji5 waa6 zung1 ting1, m4 syun3 dak6 bit1 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物只能说一般，不算特别好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is only so-so, not particularly delicious.

english_meaning: intermediary; agent; brokerage; to mediate
explanation_mandarin: 指在两个或多个当事人之间起联系、沟通作用的个人或机构。可以指充当中间人，进行撮合。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual or organization that acts as a liaison or facilitator between two or more parties. Can also refer to acting as an intermediary to bring people together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搵咗間地產中介幫手搵樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wan2 zo2 gaan1 dei6 caan2 zung1 gaai3 bong1 sau2 wan2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们找了一家房产中介帮忙找房子。
examples.english_sentence: We hired a real estate agent to help us find an apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緊保險中介。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gan2 bou2 him2 zung1 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在做保险中介。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as an insurance broker.

english_meaning: intermediary, agent, broker
explanation_mandarin: 在两个或多个主体之间进行沟通和协调，以促成交易或协议的人。
explanation_english: A person who acts as a go-between or mediator between two or more parties to facilitate a transaction or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係地產中介人，專門幫人買賣樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dei6 paan2 zung1 gaai3 jan4, zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 maai5 maai6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是房地产中介人，专门帮人买卖房子。
examples.english_sentence: He's a real estate agent, specializing in helping people buy and sell houses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵個中介人傾下，可能可以解決到啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 go3 zung1 gaai3 jan4 king1 haa5, ho2 nang4 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 di1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找个中间人谈谈，可能可以解决一些问题。
examples.english_sentence: Find an intermediary to talk to, it might be able to resolve some of the problems.

english_meaning: to fall into a trap; to be tricked; to be scammed; to walk into an ambush
explanation_mandarin: 本意指军事上中了埋伏。引申为被人欺骗，落入圈套，遭遇不好的事情。
explanation_english: Originally referring to being ambushed in a military context.  By extension, it means to be deceived, to fall into a trap, or to encounter something unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺網上買嘢，點知中咗伏，買咗啲假貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 mong5 soeng5 maai5 je5, dim2 zi1 zung3 zo2 fuk6, maai5 zo2 di1 gaa2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在网上买东西，结果中了圈套，买了一些假货。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought something online and got scammed, buying some fake goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信佢講嘅嘢，小心會中伏㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, siu2 sam1 wui5 zung3 fuk6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信他说的话，小心会上当的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust what he says, be careful you might fall into a trap!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資真係中咗伏，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 zan1 hai6 zung3 zo2 fuk6, sit8 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资真是中了圈套，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment was really a trap, I lost a lot of money.

english_meaning: median
explanation_mandarin: 一组数据按大小顺序排列后，位于中间位置的数。
explanation_english: The middle value in a sorted list of numbers. If there is an even number of data points, the median is the average of the two middle numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份人工嘅中位數係萬五蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 jan4 gung1 ge3 zung1 wai2 sou3 hai6 maan6 ng5 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工资的中位数是一万五千元。
examples.english_sentence: The median salary for this job is fifteen thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要計呢堆數字嘅中位數，首先要將佢哋排序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gai3 ni1 deui1 sou3 zi6 ge3 zung1 wai2 sou3, sau2 sin1 jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 paai4 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要计算这堆数字的中位数，首先要把它们排序。
examples.english_sentence: To calculate the median of these numbers, you first need to sort them.

english_meaning: to pause, to stop temporarily, intermission
explanation_mandarin: 暂停一段时间，暂时停止。
explanation_english: To pause or stop temporarily; to have an intermission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋踢波踢咗好耐，不如中停休息吓先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tek3 bo1 tek3 zo2 hou2 noi6, bat1 jyu4 zung1 ting4 hiu1 sik1 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们踢球踢了很久，不如暂停休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've been playing football for a long time, how about we take a break?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會中途會中停十五分鐘俾觀眾休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 cheung3 wui2 zung1 tou4 wui2 zung1 ting4 sap6 ng5 fan1 jung1 bei2 gun1 zung3 hiu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会中途会暂停十五分钟给观众休息。
examples.english_sentence: The concert will have a 15-minute intermission for the audience to rest.

english_meaning: to slander, to libel, to defame
explanation_mandarin: 用不实的话损害别人的名誉。
explanation_english: To damage someone's reputation by making false and malicious statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺背後中傷我，話我偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bui3 hau6 zung3 soeng1 ngo5, waa6 ngo5 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在背后中伤我，说我偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: He slandered me behind my back, saying I stole things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢嘅話，佢成日中傷人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3 waa2, keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung3 soeng1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他的话，他经常中伤别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he often slanders people.

english_meaning: Hungry Ghost Festival ceremony; Ullambana Festival ceremony
explanation_mandarin: 佛教或道教在农历七月十五日（中元节）举行的超度亡魂的仪式。
explanation_english: A Buddhist or Taoist ceremony held on the 15th day of the seventh lunar month (Hungry Ghost Festival) to liberate and transfer merit to wandering spirits and ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年農曆七月，好多寺廟都會搞中元法會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 nung4 lik6 cat1 jyut6, hou2 do1 zi2 miu2 dou1 wui2 gaau2 zung1 jyun4 faat3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年农历七月，很多寺庙都会举办中元法会。
examples.english_sentence: Every year in the seventh lunar month, many temples hold Hungry Ghost Festival ceremonies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今年嘅中元法會好盛大，有好多人參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gam1 nin4 ge3 zung1 jyun4 faat3 wui2 hou2 sing6 daai6, jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说今年的中元法会很盛大，有很多人参加。
examples.english_sentence: I heard this year's Hungry Ghost Festival ceremony is very grand, with many people participating.

english_meaning: Chinese Communist Party (CCP)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国共产党。
explanation_english: Refers to the Chinese Communist Party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日鬧中共，話佢哋冇人權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 naau6 zung1 gung6, waa6 keoi5 dei6 mou5 jan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常骂中国共产党，说他们没有人权。
examples.english_sentence: They often criticize the Chinese Communist Party, saying they have no human rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅政治局勢同中共嘅關係好密切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 zi6 guk6 sai3 tung4 zung1 gung6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 mat6 cit3.
