examples.english_sentence: Knowing that I got into university, but also having to leave home, I have such mixed feelings.

english_meaning: Incompetent; useless; half-baked; not up to par
explanation_mandarin: 比喻能力不足，做事不靠谱，像载重五吨半的卡车，装不满也开不好，形容人没有真才实学，不中用。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone who is incompetent, useless, or not up to par. The imagery is that of a 5.5-ton truck that is either not fully loaded or cannot be driven properly, implying a lack of real skills or abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁hea，真係五噸半㗎喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 hea1, zan1 hai6 ng5 deon1 bun3 gaa3 wo3.

examples.english_sentence: He's still like this after studying for several months, he's really incompetent.

english_meaning: facial features; five sense organs
explanation_mandarin: 指人的五个感觉器官，通常指眼、耳、鼻、口、舌；也指人的容貌，面貌。
explanation_english: Refers to the five sense organs of a person, typically the eyes, ears, nose, mouth, and tongue; also refers to a person's appearance or features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢五官好標緻，好多人讚佢靚女。

examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined the patient's facial features.

english_meaning: The Five Ridges (mountain range in Southern China)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国南方由越城岭、都庞岭、萌渚岭、骑田岭、大庾岭五座山脉组成的山脉群。
explanation_english: Refers to the mountain range in Southern China consisting of five major ridges: Yuecheng Ridge, Dupang Ridge, Mengzhu Ridge, Qitian Ridge, and Dayu Ridge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五嶺分隔咗中國南北嘅氣候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 ling5 fan1 gaak3 zo2 zung1 gwok3 naam4 bak1 ge3 hei3 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 五岭分隔了中国南北的气候。
examples.english_sentence: The Five Ridges separate the climates of Southern and Northern China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃下年去五嶺探險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 ng5 ling5 taam3 him2.

examples.english_sentence: We plan to explore the Five Ridges next year.

english_meaning: multicolored; a riot of color; colorful
explanation_mandarin: 形容颜色繁多，非常好看。
explanation_english: Describes something with a variety of colors, very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅花車巡遊真係五彩繽紛，好靚呀！

examples.english_sentence: This year's float parade is really multicolored and beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜景五彩繽紛，吸引咗好多遊客。

examples.english_sentence: The night view of Hong Kong is multicolored, attracting many tourists.

english_meaning: Chest of drawers, dresser (with five drawers)
explanation_mandarin: 一种有五个抽屉的柜子，通常用于存放衣物。
explanation_english: A chest of drawers, typically with five drawers, used for storing clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我間房太細，擺唔落五斗櫃。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈帮我整理好衣服，都放进五斗橱里了。
examples.english_sentence: My mom helped me organize my clothes and put them all in the chest of drawers.

english_meaning: Five-starred red flag (flag of the People's Republic of China)
explanation_mandarin: 中华人民共和国国旗，旗面为红色，左上方缀有五颗黄色五角星。
explanation_english: The national flag of the People's Republic of China. It has a red field with five golden stars in the upper left corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校升五星旗嘅時候，我哋要企直同埋唱國歌。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在维多利亚公园里看到很多人挥舞五星红旗。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, he saw many people waving the five-starred red flag in Victoria Park.

english_meaning: Five-star Red Flag (National flag of the People's Republic of China)
explanation_mandarin: 中华人民共和国的国旗，红色象征革命，五颗星象征中国共产党领导下的各民族人民。
explanation_english: The national flag of the People's Republic of China. The red color symbolizes the revolution, and the five stars symbolize the unity of the people of all nationalities under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運會上面見到五星紅旗升起，好激動啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 soeng6 min6 gin3 dou2 ng5 sing1 hung4 kei4 sing1 hei2, hou2 gik1 dung6 aa3!

examples.english_sentence: He was very excited to see the Five-star Red Flag raised at the Olympic Games!

english_meaning: five-star; top-notch; luxurious
explanation_mandarin: 形容品质极佳、服务周到、非常豪华的。通常用来形容酒店、餐厅、服务等。
explanation_english: Describes something of excellent quality, with attentive service, and very luxurious. Commonly used to describe hotels, restaurants, services, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店啲服務真係五星級嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 di1 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 ng5 sing1 kap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的服务真是五星级的。
examples.english_sentence: The service in this hotel is truly five-star.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的护理是五星级的，你不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: His care is five-star, you don't need to worry.

jyutping: ng5 si4 faa1 luk6 si4 bin3
mandarin_meaning: 变化无常, 变化很快
english_meaning: Unpredictable, changing rapidly, fickle
explanation_mandarin: 形容变化非常快，难以预测。例如，一个人的态度或天气变化很快。
explanation_english: Describes something that changes very quickly and unpredictably, often used to describe a person's attitude or the weather.

examples.english_sentence: His personality is so unpredictable; one minute he says it's good, the next he says it's not. I really don't know what to do.

english_meaning: A metaphor for someone who urges others to wake up early; early riser.

explanation_english: Refers to the rooster crowing in the early morning hours (around 3-5 AM). Metaphorically, it describes someone or something that urges others to wake up early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽真係五更雞，鬧鐘都未響就已經叫我起身啦。

english_meaning: May
explanation_mandarin: 指一年中的第五个月份。
explanation_english: Refers to the fifth month of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋五月去日本旅行。

english_meaning: Dragon Boat Festival
explanation_mandarin: 指农历五月初五的传统节日端午节，又称端阳节。
explanation_english: Refers to the Dragon Boat Festival, a traditional festival celebrated on the fifth day of the fifth month of the lunar calendar.

examples.english_sentence: Where are you planning to go for fun this Dragon Boat Festival?

mandarin_meaning: 很不靠谱；不牢靠；不稳当
english_meaning: Unreliable; untrustworthy; shaky; unstable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物很不牢靠，不值得信任。因为五根旗杆看起来很细很弱，给人不稳当的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as unreliable, not trustworthy, or shaky. The imagery comes from the idea that five flagpoles seem thin and weak, giving a feeling of instability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢五枝旗杆噉，真係唔敢交畀佢搞。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财政状况很不稳定，随时倒闭都不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: The financial situation of this company is very shaky; it wouldn't be surprising if it closed down at any time.

english_meaning: Sweet and sour fish
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤菜，将鱼炸过后，淋上用糖、醋、酸姜等材料制成的甜酸酱汁。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 lau5 jyu2 zou6 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4, hou2 hoi1 wai6.

examples.english_sentence: The sweet and sour fish at this restaurant is excellent. It's sweet and sour, and very appetizing.

english_meaning: Stupid, useless, brainless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨、没用，像五斗柜一样只会占据地方，没有其他用处。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone as stupid, useless, like a five-drawer chest that only takes up space and serves no other purpose. Implies someone is dull and lacking intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁唔醒目，真係好似五桶櫃咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 m4 sing2 muk6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 ng5 tung2 gwai6 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事这么不机灵，真像个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He's so clumsy at work, he's really like a blockhead.

english_meaning: 50 Cent Party; Internet commentator paid to post pro-government propaganda (often disparagingly)
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇于政府或机构，在网络上发表亲政府或亲某组织言论，以引导舆论、维护形象的人员。 他们通常被认为每发表一篇评论可以获得五毛钱的报酬 (虽然实际情况可能并非如此)。 通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to individuals employed (or perceived to be employed) by the government or organizations to post pro-government or pro-organization comments online in order to guide public opinion and maintain a positive image. They are often thought to be paid 50 cents per comment (although this may not be the actual situation). Usually used in a derogatory sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上發表啲咁嘅嘢，實係五毛啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在网上发表这种东西，肯定是五毛了。
examples.english_sentence: He always posts stuff like that online, he must be a 50 Cent Party member.

english_meaning: 50 Cent Party; Internet commentators hired to post pro-government propaganda online
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇于中国政府或相关机构的网络评论员，他们通过在网络上发布支持政府的言论来引导舆论，据称每发一条评论可获得五毛钱的报酬。
explanation_english: Refers to Internet commentators hired by the Chinese government or related organizations to post pro-government propaganda online and guide public opinion. They are allegedly paid 50 cents (五毛) for each comment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上啲評論唔好盡信，好多都係五毛黨嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 di1 ping4 leon6 m4 hou2 zeon6 seon3, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 ng5 mou1 dong2 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上的评论不要全信，很多都是五毛党。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely trust the comments online, many of them are 50 Cent Party members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上讚政府，唔知係咪五毛黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng5 zaan3 zing3 fu2, m4 zi1 hai6 m4 hai6 ng5 mou1 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在网上称赞政府，不知道是不是五毛党。
examples.english_sentence: He often praises the government online, I wonder if he's a 50 Cent Party member.

english_meaning: Five oils and three liquids (routine car maintenance check)
explanation_mandarin: 指汽车日常保养需要检查的五个油类和三种液体。五个油类包括：发动机油（机油）、变速箱油、差速器油、刹车油、方向盘助力油。三种液体包括：冷却液（水箱水）、玻璃水、电瓶水（有些电池是免维护的，则没有电瓶水）
explanation_english: Refers to the routine car maintenance check which includes five types of oils and three types of liquids. The five oils are: engine oil, transmission oil, differential oil, brake fluid, and power steering fluid. The three liquids are: coolant, windshield washer fluid, and battery electrolyte (some batteries are maintenance-free and do not require electrolyte).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸車之前記得檢查清楚五油三水啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 ce1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 gim2 caa4 cing1 co2 ng5 yau4 saam1 seoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车之前记得检查清楚五油三水啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to check the five oils and three liquids clearly before driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，每個星期都幫架車檢查五油三水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 bong1 gaa3 ce1 gim2 caa4 ng5 yau4 saam1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤劳，每个星期都帮车检查五油三水。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and checks the five oils and three liquids of the car every week.

mandarin_meaning: 四面八方；指全国各地，也指世界各地
english_meaning: all corners of the country; everywhere; all over the world; from all directions
explanation_mandarin: 指全国各地，有时也指世界各地。形容来自四面八方，非常广泛。
explanation_english: Refers to all regions of the country or even the world. Describes something that comes from all directions and is very widespread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅客戶嚟自五湖四海㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 haak3 wu6 lei4 zi6 ng5 wu4 sei3 hoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的客户来自五湖四海。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's customers come from all over the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢周圍去旅行，識咗五湖四海嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau1 wai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, sik1 zo2 ng5 wu4 sei3 hoi2 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处去旅行，认识了来自四面八方的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He travels everywhere and has made friends from all over the world.

mandarin_meaning: 五爪金龙 (古代皇帝的象征)
english_meaning: Five-clawed golden dragon (symbol of the emperor in ancient China)
explanation_mandarin: 古代中国，五爪金龙是皇帝的象征，只有皇帝才能使用。也用来比喻地位尊贵的人或事物。
explanation_english: In ancient China, the five-clawed golden dragon was a symbol of the emperor and could only be used by him. It is also used as a metaphor for people or things of high status and prestige.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅皇帝先至可以用五爪金龍嘅圖案㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 wong4 dai3 sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 yung6 ng5 zaau2 gam1 lung4 ge3 tou4 on3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的皇帝才能使用五爪金龙的图案。
examples.english_sentence: Only emperors in the past could use the five-clawed golden dragon pattern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅裝修好似五爪金龍噉，好豪華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 ci5 ng5 zaau2 gam1 lung4 gam2, hou2 hou4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的装修像五爪金龙一样，非常豪华。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this hotel is like a five-clawed golden dragon, very luxurious.

mandarin_meaning: 积劳成疾, 形容身体极度虚弱
english_meaning: Seriously ill and weak from excessive labor and strain; utterly exhausted and weakened; suffering from all sorts of illness and injury.
explanation_mandarin: 指因长期过度劳累，导致身体各方面都受到损伤，非常虚弱。 "五癆"和"七傷"都是中医的病症名称，形容身体内部的各种损耗。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to a state of extreme weakness and ill-health caused by long-term overwork and strain, affecting various parts of the body. "Five strains" (五癆) and "Seven injuries" (七傷) are traditional Chinese medicine terms referring to various internal damages and depletion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日OT做到三更半夜，搞到五癆七傷咁，真係唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 OT zou6 dou3 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6, gaau2 dou3 ng5 lou4 cat1 soeng1 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天加班到深夜，搞得自己积劳成疾，实在不值得。
examples.english_sentence: He works overtime until late at night every day, making himself extremely exhausted and ill. It's really not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁搏命啦，小心五癆七傷啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bok3 ming6 laa1, siu2 sam1 ng5 lou4 cat1 soeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么拼命了，小心积劳成疾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, be careful you don't become seriously ill!

english_meaning: the five blessings; good fortune
explanation_mandarin: 传统上指长寿、富贵、康宁、好德、善终这五种福气。
explanation_english: Traditionally refers to the five blessings: longevity, wealth, health, love of virtue, and a peaceful death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新年快樂，五福臨門！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, ng5 fuk1 lam4 mun4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年快乐，五福临门！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year! May the five blessings descend upon your home!

english_meaning: Pentaprism
explanation_mandarin: 一种具有五个反射面的棱镜，用于将光线偏转特定角度而不反转图像。常用于单反相机中，将图像垂直显示在取景器中。
explanation_english: A prism with five faces, used to deflect a beam of light through a constant angle, usually 90 degrees, without inverting or otherwise changing the image. It is commonly used in single-lens reflex (SLR) cameras to view the image upright in the viewfinder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部單反相機嘅五稜鏡好似有啲花，影響咗取景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 daan1 faan2 soeng3 gei1 ge3 ng5 ling4 geng3 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 faa1, jing2 hoeng2 zo2 ceoi2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我单反相机的五棱镜好像有点花了，影响了取景。
examples.english_sentence: The pentaprism in my SLR camera seems to be a bit scratched, affecting the viewfinder.

english_meaning: the five cereals; staple grains
explanation_mandarin: 指古代中国最重要的五种粮食作物，具体所指说法不一。通常泛指多种谷物，是粮食的总称。
explanation_english: Refers to the five most important cereal crops in ancient China, though the specific grains vary depending on the source. Generally refers to various grains and is a general term for food crops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以前啲人靠種五穀維生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 kaau3 zung2 ng5 guk1 wai4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以前的人靠种植五谷为生。
examples.english_sentence: People in the past relied on growing the five cereals to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人飲食咁豐富，唔似以前咁重視五穀啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 jam2 sik6 gam3 fung1 fu3, m4 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 zung6 si6 ng5 guk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人饮食那么丰富，不像以前那么重视五谷了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people's diets are so rich, they don't value the five cereals as much as they used to.

english_meaning: Abundant harvest; bumper harvest
explanation_mandarin: 形容年成好，粮食丰收。
explanation_english: Describes a year with a good harvest of all kinds of crops (typically referring to rice, millet, wheat, beans, and maize, though the specific grains can vary). It signifies a time of plenty and prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年風調雨順，希望五穀豐登啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 fung1 tiu4 jyu5 seon6, hei1 mong6 ng5 guk1 fung1 dang1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年风调雨顺，希望五谷丰登吧！
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been favorable this year, hopefully we'll have a bumper harvest!

mandarin_meaning: 五月穷，六月绝；股市五、六月通常表现不佳
english_meaning: "May is poor, June is disastrous"; the stock market usually performs poorly in May and June.
explanation_mandarin: 香港股市俚语，指每年五月和六月份股市表现通常都不好，股价下跌，令股民损失惨重。 "五穷"指五月份股市表现差强人意，"六绝"则指六月份的情况更糟糕，股价大幅下跌。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong stock market slang term that refers to the typically poor performance of the stock market in May and June each year, resulting in significant losses for investors. "May is poor" refers to the underwhelming performance of the stock market in May, while "June is disastrous" indicates that the situation is even worse in June, with a sharp drop in stock prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年又話五窮六絕，我決定五月前沽晒啲股票先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 jau6 waa6 ng5 kung4 luk6 zyut6, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ng5 jyut6 cin4 gu1 saai3 di1 gu2 piu3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年又说五穷六绝，我决定五月前把股票全部卖掉。
examples.english_sentence: They're saying it's 'May is poor, June is disastrous' again this year, so I've decided to sell all my stocks before May.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好彩，今年五窮六絕真係應驗咗，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 coi2, gam1 nin4 ng5 kung4 luk6 zyut6 zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2, sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 倒霉，今年的五穷六绝真的应验了，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Unfortunately, "May is poor, June is disastrous" really came true this year, and I lost a lot of money.

jyutping: ng5 kung4 luk6 jyut6 cat1 faan1 san1
mandarin_meaning: 五月穷，六月绝，七月翻身
english_meaning: Poor in May, desperate in June, rebound in July (referring to the stock market or business performance)
explanation_mandarin: 这句俗语形容股市或生意在五月和六月表现不佳，但在七月会有所好转，重新恢复生机。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a phenomenon where the stock market or business performance is poor in May and desperate in June, but then rebounds in July.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年股市都幾難搞，真係五窮六絕七翻身都唔奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gu2 si5 dou1 gei2 naan4 gaau2, zan1 hai6 ng5 kung4 luk6 jyut6 cat1 faan1 san1 dou1 m4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的股市很难搞，真的是五月穷，六月绝，七月翻身都不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: This year the stock market is quite difficult, it wouldn't be strange if it were poor in May, desperate in June, and rebounded in July.

english_meaning: awesome, excellent, superb, very good, amazing
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物非常出色，令人惊叹。在粤语中常用来表达对某人或某事的高度赞扬。
explanation_english: Describes something that is exceptionally outstanding and amazing. In Cantonese, it is often used to express high praise for someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係五絕！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 ng5 zyut6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真的太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is absolutely awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波打得咁勁，真係五絕呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 daa2 dak1 gam3 ging6, zan1 hai6 ng5 zyut6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球打得那么厉害，真是太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: He plays ball so well, it's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次演唱會嘅效果真係五絕！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 yin2 cheung3 wui2 ge3 hau6 gwo2 zan1 hai6 ng5 zyut6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次演唱会的效果真是太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: The effect of this concert is really superb!

english_meaning: musical staff, stave
explanation_mandarin: 乐谱上由五条平行横线组成的记谱法，用于记录音高。
explanation_english: A set of five horizontal lines and four spaces that each represent a different musical pitch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識得睇五線譜，所以好易學結他。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 dak1 tai2 ng5 sin3 pou2, so2 ji5 hou2 ji6 hok6 git3 taa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会看五线谱，所以很容易学吉他。
examples.english_sentence: He can read musical staff, so it's easy for him to learn the guitar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅五線譜好難睇呀，好多升降號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 ng5 sin3 pou2 hou2 naan4 tai2 aa3, hou2 do1 sing1 gong3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的五线谱很难看懂啊，好多升降号。
examples.english_sentence: The musical staff of this song is difficult to read, there are many sharps and flats.

english_meaning: Guangzhou (Canton); City of Five Rams
explanation_mandarin: 广州的别称。传说古代有五位仙人骑着五只羊，带着稻穗降临广州，因此广州被称为五羊城。
explanation_english: An alias for Guangzhou (Canton). Legend says that five immortals rode five rams, carrying rice ears, and descended upon Guangzhou. Therefore, Guangzhou is called the City of Five Rams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去五羊城探朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 ng5 joeng4 sing4 taam3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去广州看朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Guangzhou to visit my friend next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五羊城嘅天氣好潮濕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 joeng4 sing4 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 ciu4 sap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广州的天气很潮湿。
examples.english_sentence: The weather in Guangzhou is very humid.

english_meaning: the five internal organs (heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys)
explanation_mandarin: 中医理论中，指心、肝、脾、肺、肾五个主要的脏器。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese medicine, refers to the five major internal organs: heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫好注重五臟嘅平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 ng5 zong6 ge3 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医很注重五脏的平衡。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes the balance of the five internal organs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，話五臟唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, waa6 ng5 zong6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了，说五脏不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick and says his five internal organs feel uncomfortable.

english_meaning: internal organs (heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys; gall bladder, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, bladder, triple burner)
explanation_mandarin: 指人体内的主要器官，即心、肝、脾、肺、肾五脏和胆、胃、小肠、大肠、膀胱、三焦六腑。
explanation_english: Refers to the major internal organs of the human body, namely the heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys (the five viscera) and the gallbladder, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, bladder, and triple burner (the six bowels). Commonly used figuratively to describe a person's innermost thoughts or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到五臟六腑都震埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 ng5 zong6 luk6 fu2 dou1 zan3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得五脏六腑都在颤抖。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that his insides were shaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞到我五臟六腑唔舒服噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ng5 zong6 luk6 fu2 m4 syu1 fuk6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事让我感到五脏六腑都不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This matter makes me feel uncomfortable in my insides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢真係入心入肺，好似講到我五臟六腑噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 ye5 zan1 hai6 jap6 sam1 jap6 fai3, hou2 ci5 gong2 dou3 ngo5 ng5 zong6 luk6 fu2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话真是入心入肺，好像说到了我的五脏六腑。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was really touching, as if it spoke to my very core.

english_meaning: of all kinds; multifarious; a wide variety of
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物种类繁多，变化莫测。
explanation_english: Describes a wide variety of things or subjects; diverse and varied; of all descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個展覽嘅嘢五花八門，乜都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 zin2 laam5 ge3 je5 ng5 faa1 baat3 mun4, mat1 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次展览的东西五花八门，什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: The things in this exhibition are of all kinds, there's everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上面嘅廣告五花八門，搞到我眼花繚亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 min6 ge3 gwong2 gou3 ng5 faa1 baat3 mun4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上的广告五花八门，弄得我眼花缭乱。
examples.english_sentence: The advertisements on the street are so diverse that they make me dizzy.

english_meaning: to tie up securely; to truss up
explanation_mandarin: 用绳子等把人结结实实地捆起来。
explanation_english: To tie someone up securely with ropes, usually in a way that restricts their movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲賊將佢五花大綁，然後搶嗮啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 caak6 zoeng1 keoi5 ng5 faa1 daai6 bong2, jin4 hau6 coeng2 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盗贼把他五花大绑，然后抢走了所有的钱。
examples.english_sentence: The thieves tied him up securely and then robbed all the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察將個疑犯五花大綁咁帶走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zoeng1 go3 ji4 faan2 ng5 faa1 daai6 bong2 gam2 daai3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察把嫌疑犯五花大绑地带走了。
examples.english_sentence: The police took the suspect away, tied up securely.

english_meaning: Pork belly
explanation_mandarin: 指猪腹部的一块肉，层层相叠，肥瘦相间。
explanation_english: Pork belly, a cut of pork from the belly of the pig. It consists of alternating layers of fat and lean meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗舊五花肉，今晚整紅燒肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 gau6 ng5 faa1 juk6, gam1 maan5 zing2 hung4 siu1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一块五花肉，今晚做红烧肉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a piece of pork belly today, I'll make braised pork belly tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅五花肉做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 faa1 juk6 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的五花肉做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: The pork belly at this restaurant is very authentic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五花腩嘅肥膏唔可以太多，如果唔係會好膩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 faa1 naam5 ge3 fei4 gou1 m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 do1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 wui5 hou2 nei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 五花肉的肥肉不能太多，否则会很腻。
examples.english_sentence: The fat in pork belly shouldn't be too much, otherwise it will be too greasy.

english_meaning: Pork belly
explanation_mandarin: 指猪腹部的肉，肥瘦相间，层次分明。
explanation_english: Refers to the pork meat from the belly of a pig, characterized by alternating layers of fat and lean meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日買咗嚿五花腩，今晚炆東坡肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 gau6 ng5 faa1 laam6, gam1 maan1 man1 dung1 po1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天买了一块五花肉，今晚炖东坡肉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a piece of pork belly today. I'll braise Dongpo pork tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅咕嚕肉用五花腩整，特別好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 gu1 lou1 juk6 yung6 ng5 faa1 laam6 zeng2, dak6 bit6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的咕咾肉用五花肉做的，特别好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The sweet and sour pork in this restaurant is made with pork belly, it's especially delicious.

english_meaning: Five-flower tea
explanation_mandarin: 一种由多种花草药材熬制而成的凉茶，具有清热解毒、消暑利湿的功效。
explanation_english: A type of herbal tea made from a blend of five different flowers and herbs, traditionally believed to have cooling, detoxifying, and dampness-relieving properties. Often consumed during hot and humid weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，飲杯五花茶降下火啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6, yam2 bui1 ng5 faa1 caa4 gong3 haa5 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么热，喝一杯五花茶降降火吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot, let's have a cup of five-flower tea to cool down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日煲五花茶畀我哋飲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 bou1 ng5 faa1 caa4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 yam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈经常煲五花茶给我们喝的。
examples.english_sentence: My mom often makes five-flower tea for us to drink.

english_meaning: The Five Aggregates (Skandhas)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，指构成人身和宇宙的五种要素：色蕴、受蕴、想蕴、行蕴、识蕴。
explanation_english: In Buddhism, the five aggregates (skandhas) that constitute a person and the universe: form (rupa), sensation (vedana), perception (samjna), mental formations (samskara), and consciousness (vijnana).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日研究佛學，對五藴嘅道理都好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jin4 gau3 fat6 hok6, deoi3 ng5 wan5 ge3 dou6 lei5 dou1 hou2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常研究佛学，对五蕴的道理都很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He studies Buddhism a lot and understands the principles of the Five Aggregates very well.

english_meaning: The Five Aggregates (Skandhas)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教术语，指构成人的身心世界的五个要素：色、受、想、行、识。
explanation_english: Buddhist term referring to the five aggregates or heaps (skandhas) that constitute a person's mental and physical existence: form (rupa), sensation (vedana), perception (samjna), mental formations (samskara), and consciousness (vijnana). These are considered the five aspects that cause suffering and attachment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛教認為人生就係被五蘊困住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 gaau3 jing6 wai4 yan4 sang1 zau6 hai6 bei6 ng5 wan5 kwan3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛教认为人生就是被五蕴困住。
examples.english_sentence: Buddhism believes that life is trapped by the Five Aggregates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要了解佛教嘅道理，首先要明白五蘊嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yiu3 liu4 gaai2 fat6 gaau3 ge3 dou6 lei5, sau2 sin1 yiu3 ming4 baak6 ng5 wan5 ge3 yi3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要了解佛教的道理，首先要明白五蕴的意思。
examples.english_sentence: To understand Buddhist principles, one must first understand the meaning of the Five Aggregates.

english_meaning: Five-snake soup
explanation_mandarin: 五蛇羹是广东传统名菜，是用五种蛇肉丝制成的羹汤。 它通常与姜丝、柠檬叶丝、木耳丝等一起烹制，味道鲜美。
explanation_english: Five-snake soup is a traditional Cantonese dish made from the shredded meat of five different types of snakes. It's typically cooked with shredded ginger, lemon leaves, wood ear mushrooms, and other ingredients, resulting in a flavorful and savory soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍凍哋，飲碗五蛇羹暖下身就啱晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3 dung2 dei2, yam2 wun2 ng5 se4 gang1 nuon5 haa5 san1 zau6 ngaam1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气冷冷的，喝一碗五蛇羹暖暖身子就最适合了。
examples.english_sentence: When the weather is a bit cold, drinking a bowl of five-snake soup to warm up is just perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日同屋企人去蛇王店食五蛇羹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sing4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 heoi3 se4 wong4 dim3 sik6 ng5 se4 gang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常和家人去蛇王店吃五蛇羹。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to snake restaurants with my family to eat five-snake soup.

english_meaning: Five Elements (metal, wood, water, fire, earth)
explanation_mandarin: 中国古代哲学概念，指金、木、水、火、土五种构成万物的基本元素及其相互关系。
explanation_english: A fundamental concept in traditional Chinese philosophy, referring to the five elements (metal, wood, water, fire, and earth) that constitute all things in the universe and their interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水佬成日講五行相生相剋，我都唔係好明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 lou2 seng4 jat6 gong2 ng5 hang4 soeng1 sang1 soeng1 hak1, ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水先生总是说五行相生相克，我也不太明白。
examples.english_sentence: Feng shui masters always talk about the mutual generation and overcoming of the five elements, but I don't really understand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話我八字五行缺水，要戴啲藍色嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 baat3 zi2 ng5 hang4 kyut3 seoi2, jiu3 daai3 di1 laam4 sik1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说我的八字五行缺水，要戴一些蓝色的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He said that my birth chart lacks water in the five elements, and that I should wear something blue.

english_meaning: Deserves to be beaten; asking for a beating; sorely in need of a beating
explanation_mandarin: 指某人行为或言语非常令人讨厌，让人想揍他。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone whose behavior or words are so irritating or annoying that they deserve to be beaten up. It's a humorous way of expressing extreme annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講嘢，真係五行欠打喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 ng5 hang4 him3 daa2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说话，真是欠揍！
examples.english_sentence: The way you're talking, you really deserve a beating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度扮嘢，五行欠打咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baan3 je5, ng5 hang4 him3 daa2 gam2 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装模作样，一副欠揍的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on airs, he looks like he's asking for a beating.

english_meaning: Lacking water in the five elements; To be short of water in one's birth chart/destiny
explanation_mandarin: 在命理学中，五行（金、木、水、火、土）代表构成宇宙万物的基本元素。如果一个人的八字（出生年月日时）分析结果显示其命理中“水”元素不足，就称之为“五行欠水”。 通常认为缺少某种元素会影响人的运势，需要通过各种方式来补足。
explanation_english: In Chinese astrology and feng shui, the Five Elements (metal, wood, water, fire, and earth) are considered fundamental components of the universe. "五行欠水" refers to a situation where a person's birth chart (determined by their birth date and time) indicates a deficiency in the "water" element. It is believed that lacking a particular element can negatively impact one's luck and fortune, and efforts are often made to compensate for the deficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己五行欠水，所以鍾意游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 ng5 hang4 him3 seoi2, so2 ji5 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己五行缺水，所以喜欢游泳。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's lacking water in his five elements, so he likes to swim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講五行欠水嘅人應該多啲接觸水嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ng5 hang4 him3 seoi2 ge3 jan4 ying1 goi1 do1 di1 zip3 cuk1 seoi2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说五行缺水的人应该多接触水的东西。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that people who are lacking water in their five elements should have more contact with things related to water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅話我個仔五行欠水，叫我幫佢改個有水嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 waa6 ngo5 go3 zai2 ng5 hang4 him3 seoi2, giu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 gaai2 go3 jau5 seoi2 ge3 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅说我儿子五行缺水，让我帮他改个有水的名字。
examples.english_sentence: The master said my son is lacking water in his five elements, asking me to help him choose a name that includes water.

mandarin_meaning: 指某人很缺德，品行不正
english_meaning: Lacking virtue; lacking in moral character; morally deficient; needs to be struck by lightning (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: “五行”指金、木、水、火、土。 “欠炳”指缺乏闪电的劈打， 暗指应该被闪电劈打，形容某人行为不端，缺德，需要受到惩罚。
explanation_english: "Five elements" refers to metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. "欠炳" (him3 bing2) literally means lacking lightning, implying someone deserves to be struck by lightning. It describes someone who lacks virtue, acts immorally, and deserves punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日呃人錢，真係五行欠炳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4 cin2, zan1 hai6 ng5 hang4 him3 bing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是骗别人的钱，真是缺德。
examples.english_sentence: He's always cheating people out of their money; he's really morally deficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做埋啲咁嘅嘢，簡直係五行欠炳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ng5 hang4 him3 bing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做的这些事，简直是缺德。
examples.english_sentence: What you've done is absolutely immoral.

english_meaning: lacking the element of water in one's five elements (according to Chinese astrology); to be short of water element; to be in need of something (humorous, metaphorical)
explanation_mandarin: 指根据生辰八字推算，五行中缺少水这一元素。在比较轻松或开玩笑的语境下，也用来比喻缺乏某种重要的东西。
explanation_english: Literally means 'lacking the element of water in the five elements' according to Chinese astrology (based on one's birth date and time). Figuratively, it can be used humorously to describe someone who is lacking something essential or important, or is in need of something specific.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好dry，好似五行缺水咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 dry, hou2 ci5 ng5 hang4 kyut3 seoi2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很无趣，好像五行缺水一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very dry person, as if he's lacking the element of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好似五行缺水咁，啲資金周轉唔靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 ng5 hang4 kyut3 seoi2 gam2, di1 zi1 gam1 zau1 zyun2 m4 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司好像五行缺水一样，资金周转不灵。
examples.english_sentence: This company seems to be lacking water, the cash flow is not smooth.

english_meaning: Five senses; perception
explanation_mandarin: 指人的五种感觉，包括视觉、听觉、嗅觉、味觉和触觉。
explanation_english: Refers to the five human senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅五覺好靈敏，一聞到少少燶味就知係煮燶嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ng5 gok3 hou2 ling4 man5, jat1 man2 dou2 siu2 siu2 nung1 mei6 zau6 zi1 hai6 zyu2 nung1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的五官很灵敏，一闻到一点点糊味就知道是煮糊了东西。
examples.english_sentence: His senses are very sharp. As soon as he smells a slight burnt smell, he knows something is burnt while cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藝術家好注重五覺嘅體驗，將所有感覺融入佢嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngai6 seot1 gaa1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 ng5 gok3 ge3 tai2 jim6, zoeng1 so2 jau5 gam2 gok3 jung4 jap6 keoi5 ge3 zok3 pan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个艺术家很注重五官的体验，将所有的感觉融入他的作品。
examples.english_sentence: This artist emphasizes the experience of the five senses, incorporating all feelings into his work.

english_meaning: Pentagon
explanation_mandarin: 一种有五条边和五个角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A polygon with five sides and five angles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊黑板上面畫咗個五角形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 hak1 baan2 soeng6 min6 waa2 zo2 go3 ng5 gok3 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 黑板上画了一个五角形。
examples.english_sentence: There's a pentagon drawn on the blackboard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國嘅國防部大樓係五角形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 ge3 gwok3 fong4 bou6 daai6 lau2 hai6 ng5 gok3 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国的国防部大楼是五角形的。
examples.english_sentence: The Pentagon, the U.S. Department of Defense building, is a pentagon.

english_meaning: The Five Districts (of Guangdong)
explanation_mandarin: 指广东省的五个县级行政区，通常指新会、台山、开平、恩平、鹤山。
explanation_english: Refers to the five county-level administrative districts of Guangdong province: Xinhui, Taishan, Kaiping, Enping, and Heshan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺係五邑人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 ng5 jap1 jan4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是五邑人。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is from the Five Districts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多五邑人以前都去咗美國嘅唐人街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ng5 jap1 jan4 ji5 cin4 dou1 heoi3 zo2 mei5 gwok3 ge3 tong4 jan4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多五邑人以前都去了美国的唐人街。
examples.english_sentence: Many people from the Five Districts went to Chinatowns in the United States in the past.

english_meaning: hardware (metal tools and supplies)
explanation_mandarin: 指金、银、铜、铁、锡等五种金属，也泛指金属材料或金属制品。
explanation_english: Refers to five kinds of metals: gold, silver, copper, iron, and tin. It also refers generally to metal materials or metal products such as tools, fittings, and building supplies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要去五金鋪買啲螺絲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 heoi3 ng5 gam1 pou2 maai5 di1 lo4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要去五金店买些螺丝。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go to the hardware store to buy some screws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企裝修，好多嘢都要喺五金鋪買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 zong1 sau1, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 jiu3 hai2 ng5 gam1 pou2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里装修，很多东西都要在五金店买。
examples.english_sentence: Renovating the house, many things need to be bought at the hardware store.

english_meaning: Thunderstruck; as if struck by lightning (five bolts of lightning from the heavens); devastated by terrible news; extremely shocked and upset.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻突然遭受巨大的打击，精神上受到沉重的打击。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a sudden and devastating shock, as if struck by lightning from the heavens. It implies a severe emotional or mental blow, often caused by unexpected bad news or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸突然間走咗，簡直係五雷轟頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 dat6 jin4 gaan1 zau2 zo2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ng5 leoi4 gwang1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸突然去世了，简直是五雷轰顶。
examples.english_sentence: His father suddenly passed away; it was like being struck by lightning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到自己炒魷魚嘅消息，真係好似五雷轟頂咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 zi6 gei2 caau2 jau4 jyu4 ge3 siu1 sik1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 ng5 leoi4 gwang1 ding2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到自己被解雇的消息，真的感觉像是五雷轰顶。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news that I was fired really felt like being struck by lightning.

english_meaning: The five notes (of the pentatonic scale): Gong (宮), Shang (商), Jiao (角), Zhi (徵), and Yu (羽)
explanation_mandarin: 中国古代音乐的五种基本音阶，相当于现代音乐的1,2,3,5,6。也常用来比喻说话的音调和声音。
explanation_english: In ancient Chinese music, the five basic notes of the pentatonic scale. These correspond roughly to 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6 in modern music notation. It is also used figuratively to describe the tone and sound of speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唔準，五音不全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 m4 zeon2, ng5 jam1 bat1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌不准，五音不全。
examples.english_sentence: He sings off-key, he's tone-deaf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁大聲，五音都震埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 daai6 seng1, ng5 jam1 dou1 zan3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么大声，都震耳欲聋了。
examples.english_sentence: You are speaking so loudly, it's deafening.

english_meaning: tone-deaf, out of tune
explanation_mandarin: 形容人唱歌走调，不能准确地发出各个音阶的声音。
explanation_english: Describes someone who sings out of tune and cannot accurately produce the sounds of different musical scales; tone-deaf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌真係五音不全，聽佢唱歌簡直係攞命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 zan1 hai6 ng5 jam1 bat1 cyun4, teng1 keoi5 coeng3 go1 gaan2 zik6 hai6 lo2 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌真的很五音不全，听他唱歌简直是要命。
examples.english_sentence: He really sings out of tune. Listening to him sing is simply torturous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我五音不全，所以唔敢喺人面前唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ng5 jam1 bat1 cyun4, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我五音不全，所以不敢在别人面前唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: I'm tone-deaf, so I don't dare to sing in front of others.

english_meaning: colorful, of various colors
explanation_mandarin: 形容颜色种类繁多，色彩绚丽。
explanation_english: Describes something that has many different colors, often bright and vibrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲煙花真係好靚，五顏六色咁，好似彩虹咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 jin1 faa1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3, ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 gam2, hou2 ci5 coi2 hung4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的烟花真漂亮，五颜六色的，像彩虹一样。
examples.english_sentence: The fireworks today are really beautiful, so colorful, like a rainbow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房髹到五顏六色，睇落好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 sau1 tou2 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1, tai2 lok6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间漆得五颜六色的，看起来很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The room is painted in various colors, it looks very cheerful.

english_meaning: five-spice powder
explanation_mandarin: 一种由多种香料混合而成的粉末，常用于烹饪。
explanation_english: A spice mixture of five or more spices, used predominantly in Chinese and Asian cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用五香粉醃啲雞翼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 ng5 hoeng1 fan2 jim1 di1 gai1 yik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用五香粉腌制一些鸡翅。
examples.english_sentence: I like to marinate some chicken wings with five-spice powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個滷水蛋好香五香粉味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou5 seoi2 daan2 hou2 hoeng1 ng5 hoeng1 fan2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个卤蛋的五香粉味道很香。
examples.english_sentence: This braised egg has a very fragrant five-spice powder flavour.

english_meaning: Dismemberment by five horses, to be torn apart, extremely severe punishment
explanation_mandarin: 古代一种酷刑，用五匹马分别拴住犯人的头和四肢，然后同时拉动，将犯人撕裂。比喻极其残忍或严厉的惩罚。
explanation_english: An ancient form of torture where the victim's head and four limbs are tied to five separate horses, which are then driven in different directions, tearing the victim apart. Figuratively, it refers to extremely cruel or severe punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多衰嘢，真係應該五馬分屍！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, zan1 hai6 ying1 goi1 ng5 maa5 fan1 si1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，真应该五马分尸！
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things, he really deserves to be torn apart!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃失敗咗，啲錢五馬分屍咁冇曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 si1 baai6 zo2, di1 cin2 ng5 maa5 fan1 si1 gam2 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划失败了，钱就像五马分尸一样没了。
examples.english_sentence: The plan failed, and the money was completely scattered and lost.

english_meaning: to prostrate oneself before someone, to admire someone from the bottom of one's heart
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常钦佩或敬佩到极点。五体指双膝、双肘和头。投地指整个身体伏倒在地上。
explanation_english: Describes the ultimate admiration or respect for someone. 'Five points' refers to the two knees, two elbows, and head. 'Prostrate' means to lie face down on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就真係令我五體投地，咁後生就咁成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 ng5 tai2 tau4 dei6, gam3 hau6 sang1 zau6 gam3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就真的让我五体投地，这么年轻就这么成功。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements really make me admire him from the bottom of my heart; he's so successful at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢嘅演講，我對佢嘅智慧真係五體投地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2, ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zi3 wai3 zan1 hai6 ng5 tai2 tau4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的演讲，我对他 的智慧真是五体投地。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to his speech, I'm truly in awe of his wisdom.

mandarin_meaning: 农历五六月，比喻一年中最热的时候
english_meaning: The hottest months of the year (Lunar May and June); figuratively, the hardest time
explanation_mandarin: 农历五月和六月是一年中最热的时候，比喻最困难、最辛苦的时期。 因为这段时间也是农作物收割和播种的季节，所以农民非常辛苦。
explanation_english: Lunar May and June are the hottest months of the year in southern China. This idiom refers to this period of extreme heat and, figuratively, to the hardest and most difficult time. It's also the harvest and planting season for crops, making it a particularly busy and challenging time for farmers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五黃六月咁熱，真係熱到人都癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 wong4 luk6 jyut6 gam3 jit6, zan1 hai6 jit6 dou3 jan4 dou1 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历五六月这么热，真的热到人都要疯了。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot in Lunar May and June, it's really making people crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺五黃六月都要返工，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ng5 wong4 luk6 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在农历五六月都要上班，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: They have to work even during Lunar May and June, which is really tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司生意唔好，五黃六月咁難捱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, ng5 wong4 luk6 jyut6 gam3 naan4 aai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司生意不好，日子很难过。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business is bad, these are hard times.

english_meaning: well (water)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指人工挖掘的，用于提取地下水的深孔。
explanation_english: A deep hole dug in the ground to access groundwater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條村入面有口井，啲村民成日去嗰度攞水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 hau2 zeng2, di1 cyun1 man4 sing4 jat6 heoi3 go2 dou6 lo2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村里有一口井，村民们经常去那里取水。
examples.english_sentence: There's a well in the village, and the villagers often go there to fetch water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗落井度，好彩冇咩大礙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 lok6 zeng2 dou6, hou2 coi2 mou5 me1 daai6 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掉到井里了，幸好没什么大碍。
examples.english_sentence: He fell into the well, but luckily he's not seriously hurt.

english_meaning: orderly; in perfect order; systematic
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物安排得很有条理，有条不紊。
explanation_english: Describes something that is arranged in a very orderly and systematic manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲文件擺到井井有條，好容易搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin2 baai2 dou3 zing2 zing2 jau5 tiu4, hou2 jung4 ji6 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把文件摆放得井井有条，很容易找到。
examples.english_sentence: He arranged the documents in perfect order, making them easy to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project嘅進度井井有條，相信可以順利完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project ge3 zeon3 dou6 zing2 zing2 jau5 tiu4, soeng1 seon3 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的进度井井有条，相信可以顺利完成。
examples.english_sentence: The progress of this project is orderly, I believe it can be completed smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋雖然細，但係執拾得井井有條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 seoi1 jin4 sai3, daan6 hai6 zap1 sap6 dak1 zing2 zing2 jau5 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家虽然小，但是收拾得井井有条。
examples.english_sentence: Although his house is small, it is kept in perfect order.

english_meaning: a frog in a well; a person with a limited outlook
explanation_mandarin: 比喻见识短浅的人。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to a person with a very limited outlook, like a frog that lives at the bottom of a well and doesn't know much about the outside world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做井底之蛙啦，出多啲去見識吓世界啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 zeng2 dai2 zi1 waa1 laa1, ceot1 do1啲 heoi3 gin3 sik1 haa5 sai3 gaai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做井底之蛙了，多出去见识一下世界吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a frog in a well. Go out more and see the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔學習新知識，好快就會變成井底之蛙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 hok6 zaap6 san1 zi1 sik1, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 bin3 sing4 zeng2 dai2 zi1 waa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不学习新知识，很快就会变成井底之蛙。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't learn new knowledge, we will quickly become a frog in a well.

jyutping: zeng2 seoi2 bat1 faan6 ho4 seoi2
english_meaning: Each keeps to his own business; let's keep things separate; stay out of each other's way.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻互不相干，互不干涉。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning that each keeps to his own business and doesn't interfere with the other. It emphasizes maintaining separate spheres of influence or avoiding conflict by staying out of each other's affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋井水不犯河水，你搞你嗰瓣，我搞我嗰瓣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 zeng2 seoi2 bat1 faan6 ho4 seoi2, nei5 gaau2 nei5 go2 baan6, ngo5 gaau2 ngo5 go2 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们井水不犯河水，你做你的，我做我的。
examples.english_sentence: How about we keep things separate? You do your thing, and I'll do mine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以後井水不犯河水，唔好再有任何瓜葛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 hau6 zeng2 seoi2 bat1 faan6 ho4 seoi2, m4 hou2 zoi3 jau5 jam6 ho4 gwaa1 got3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以后井水不犯河水，不要再有任何瓜葛。
examples.english_sentence: From now on, we'll keep things separate and have nothing to do with each other.

english_meaning: orderly; well-arranged; in good order
explanation_mandarin: 形容有条理、有秩序。
explanation_english: Describes something that is well-organized, orderly, and systematic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅辦公室永遠都好井然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 baan6 gung1 sat1 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hou2 zing2 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的办公室总是井然有序。
examples.english_sentence: His office is always orderly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番整理之後，屋企嘅嘢擺得井然有致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 zeng2 lei5 zi1 hau6, uk1 kei2 ge3 je5 baai2 dak1 zing2 jin4 jau5 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番整理之后，家里的东西摆放得井然有序。
examples.english_sentence: After some tidying up, things in the house are arranged in an orderly fashion.

english_meaning: orderly, well-arranged, systematic
explanation_mandarin: 形容整齐有条理，安排得很好。
explanation_english: Describes something that is orderly, well-arranged, and systematic. It implies a state of neatness and good organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅書房執拾得井然有序，真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 syu1 fong2 zap1 sap1 dak1 zing2 jin4 jau5 seoi6, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的书房收拾得井井有条，真难得。
examples.english_sentence: His study is so orderly, it's really rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過我哋嘅努力，所有嘢都井然有序噉進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 nu5 lik6, so2 jau5 je5 dou1 zing2 jin4 jau5 seoi6 gam2 gan2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过我们的努力，所有事情都井井有条地进行。
examples.english_sentence: After our efforts, everything is proceeding in an orderly manner.

english_meaning: Hashtag, number sign, pound sign
explanation_mandarin: 表示井号，在电话拨号盘上、社交媒体标签等场合使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the hashtag, number sign, or pound sign. Used in contexts such as phone keypads and social media tags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺Twitter上面用井號可以幫你搵到同一個話題嘅post。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 Twitter soeng6 min6 yung6 zeng2 hou6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 wan2 dou3 tung4 jat1 go3 waa6 tai4 ge3 post.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在Twitter上使用井号可以帮助你找到同一个话题的帖子。
examples.english_sentence: Using a hashtag on Twitter can help you find posts on the same topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你電話個數字盤上面都有個井號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 din6 waa2 go3 sou3 zi6 pun4 soeng6 min6 dou1 jau5 go3 zeng2 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你电话的数字键盘上面也有个井号。
examples.english_sentence: There's also a number sign on your phone's number pad.

english_meaning: some; a few; a little
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量。相当于普通话的“一些”。
explanation_english: Indicates a small amount. Equivalent to "some" or "a few" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾啲嘢我食下啦，我好肚餓啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 je5 ngo5 sik6 haa5 laa1, ngo5 hou2 tou5 ngo6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一些东西吃吧，我好饿啊。
examples.english_sentence: Give me something to eat, I'm so hungry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲衫幾靚喎，買返幾些先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 saam1 gei2 leng3 wo3, maai5 faan1 gei2 se1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些衣服挺好看的，买几件回去。
examples.english_sentence: These clothes are quite nice, I'll buy a few.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等埋啲人齊先開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 maai4 di1 jan4 cai4 sin1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等人齐了再开始。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for everyone to be here before we start.

english_meaning: Sherry
explanation_mandarin: 一种 fortified 葡萄酒，原产于西班牙赫雷斯地区。
explanation_english: A fortified wine originally from Jerez, Spain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意喺煮餸嘅時候加啲些厘酒，會令到個味道豐富啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 zyu2 sung3 ge3 si4 hau6 ga1 di1 se1 lei4 zau2, wui5 ling6 dou3 go3 mei6 dou6 fung1 fu3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在做菜的时候加一些雪利酒，会让味道更丰富。
examples.english_sentence: I like to add some sherry when I'm cooking, it makes the flavor richer.

english_meaning: a little, a bit, slight, trifling, just a little bit
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量不多，程度不深。形容少量的、轻微的。
explanation_english: Indicates a small amount or a slight degree. Describes something that is small in quantity or minor in intensity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係啲些小嘢，唔使咁客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 di1 se1 siu2 je5, m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是一点小东西，不用这么客气。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a little something, no need to be so polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發燒得些小啫，唔使咁擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 siu1 dak1 se1 siu2 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是稍微发烧，不用那么担心。
examples.english_sentence: He only has a slight fever, no need to worry so much.

english_meaning: a little bit; a small amount
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量，不多。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity; not much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得返些少錢咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 faan1 se1 siu2 cin2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只剩下一点点钱了。
examples.english_sentence: I only have a little bit of money left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你畀啲耐心些少啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 di1 noi6 sam1 se1 siu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你多给一点耐心吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please be a little more patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講些少廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 se1 siu2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说一点点广东话。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak a little bit of Cantonese.

english_meaning: a little; slightly; a bit
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量、程度或体积很小，略微。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity, degree, or volume; slightly; a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係遲咗少少，遲咗些微啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 ci4 zo2 siu2 siu2, ci4 zo2 se1 mei4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是稍微迟到了一点点，迟到了一点点而已。
examples.english_sentence: I was only a little late, just a little bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅進步有啲些微，但係都係進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zeon3 bou6 jau5 di1 se1 mei4, daan6 hai6 dou1 hai6 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的进步有一点点，但是也是进步。
examples.english_sentence: His progress is a little, but it's still progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間有啲些微嘅誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 se1 mei4 ge3 ng6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间有些许的误会。
examples.english_sentence: There's a slight misunderstanding between us.

english_meaning: to share; to show off; to brag
explanation_mandarin: 原本指分享利益、好处，现在也指炫耀、卖弄（多含贬义）。
explanation_english: Originally referring to sharing benefits or advantages, it now also refers to showing off or flaunting (often with a negative connotation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部新車，成日都係度些牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ce1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 se1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了辆新车，整天都在炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car and is showing it off all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁些牙啦，人哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 se1 ngaa4 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么炫耀啦，别人会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off so much, people will be unhappy.

english_meaning: smug, complacent, self-satisfied
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因为取得一点小成就或占了小便宜而显得非常得意，甚至有些自以为是的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is smug or complacent because of a small achievement or advantage they have gained. Often implies an air of self-importance or arrogance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到個A就些粉到不得了，好似全世界得佢一個叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 go3 ei1 zau6 se1 fan2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, hou2 ci5 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了个A就得意洋洋的，好像全世界只有他一个人厉害似的。
examples.english_sentence: He got an A and became so smug, as if he were the only smart person in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁些粉嘅，下次小心啲就得㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 se1 fan2 ge3, haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么得意，下次小心点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smug, just be more careful next time.

mandarin_meaning: 次; 较差; 排名第二
english_meaning: Second; next to; inferior; -er (suffix)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 表示等级次于正的，第二的。2.用在亲属称谓或人名后，表示亲昵。3.表示在水平上较差或次一等。
explanation_english: 1. Indicates a level that is second to the primary one. 2. Used after kinship terms or names to express affection. 3. Indicates inferiority or being second-rate in terms of quality or level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢比賽攞咗亞軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 coi3 lo2 zo2 aa3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中获得了亚军。
examples.english_sentence: He got the second place in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亞媽，我返嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1, ngo5 faan1 lai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈，我回来了！
examples.english_sentence: Mom, I'm back!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲英文麻麻哋，得個亞字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 jing1 man2 maa4 maa4 dei2, dak1 go3 aa3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语水平一般，只能算差的。
examples.english_sentence: His English is just so-so, only second-rate.

english_meaning: Ahead of the curve, a trendsetter, a leader
explanation_mandarin: 指走在时代前沿，引领潮流的人或事物。通常形容具有创新精神，走在别人前面。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something that is ahead of the curve, a trendsetter, or a leader. It usually describes someone with an innovative spirit who is ahead of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好亞head㗎，成日用啲最新科技產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 aa3 hed1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 yung6 di1 zeoi3 san1 go1 gei6 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很前卫，经常使用最新的科技产品。
examples.english_sentence: He's very ahead of the curve, he always uses the latest technology products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲設計好亞head，所以好受年輕人歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 sai3 gai3 hou2 aa3 hed1, so2 ji5 hou2 sau6 nin4 hing1 yan4 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的设计很前卫，所以很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This company's designs are very ahead of the curve, so it's very popular among young people.

english_meaning: Alberta (Canadian province)
explanation_mandarin: 加拿大西部的一个省份，以其壮丽的自然风光和石油资源而闻名。
explanation_english: A province in Western Canada, known for its stunning natural landscapes and oil resources.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家移民去了艾伯塔。
examples.english_sentence: Their family immigrated to Alberta.

english_meaning: Acrylic; Acrylic plastic

examples.english_sentence: I want to order an acrylic display stand.

explanation_english: Relating to or being a particle smaller than an atom; relating to the constitution of an atom.

english_meaning: Aspirin
explanation_mandarin: 一种常用的解热镇痛药，具有解热、镇痛和抗炎作用。
explanation_english: A common medication used to reduce fever, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation.

examples.english_sentence: I have a headache, I'll take an aspirin first.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 a3 po4 mui5 jat6 sik6 jat1 lap1 aa3 si6 bat1 ling4, waa6 ho2 ji5 jyu6 fong4 sam1 zong6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫老奶奶每天吃一片阿司匹林，说可以预防心脏病。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told the grandma to take one aspirin a day, saying it can prevent heart disease.

english_meaning: Asia-Pacific
explanation_mandarin: 亚洲及太平洋地区的简称。
explanation_english: Abbreviation for the Asia-Pacific region.

examples.english_sentence: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) holds meetings every year.

english_meaning: Miss Asia
explanation_mandarin: 亞洲小姐選美比賽的簡稱。也指參加亞洲小姐選美比賽的女性。
explanation_english: Abbreviation for Miss Asia Pageant. Also refers to the female contestants in the Miss Asia Pageant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅亞姐質素好似麻麻地喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 aa3 ze2 zat1 so3 hou2 ci5 maa4 maa2 dei6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的亚洲小姐素质好像不太好啊。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this year's Miss Asia contestants seems so-so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前參加過亞姐，但係冇攞到獎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前参加过亚洲小姐，但是没拿到奖。
examples.english_sentence: She participated in Miss Asia before, but she didn't win any awards.

english_meaning: Mother, Mom, Mum
explanation_mandarin: 称呼母亲的一种方式，比较亲昵的说法。
explanation_english: A way of addressing one's mother, a more affectionate term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亞媽，我今晚唔返嚟食飯呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1, ngo5 gam1 maan1 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈，我今晚不回来吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: Mom, I won't be home for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我亞媽煮嘢好好食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zyu2 je5 hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈做饭很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: My mom cooks really well!

english_meaning: Police officer (derogatory, outdated)
explanation_mandarin: 对警察的一种贬义称呼，通常指来自印度或巴基斯坦的警察。现已过时，带有种族歧视色彩，不应使用。
explanation_english: A derogatory and outdated term for a police officer, typically referring to those of Indian or Pakistani descent. It is now considered offensive and racially charged and should not be used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日叫啲印巴裔嘅警察做亞差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 giu3 di1 jan3 baa1 jeoi6 ge3 ging2 caat3 zou6 aa3 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人经常叫那些印巴裔的警察做“亚差”。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people often called police officers of Indian or Pakistani descent 'Ah Chai'.

english_meaning: Aspirin
explanation_mandarin: 一种常用的解热镇痛药。
explanation_english: A common medication used as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭痛，食返粒亞斯匹靈先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 tung3, sik6 faan1 lap1 aa3 si1 bat1 ling4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我头痛，先吃一片阿司匹林。
examples.english_sentence: I have a headache, I'll take an aspirin first.

english_meaning: Idiot; fool; stupid person
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨、迟钝，反应慢。 通常带贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone as foolish, slow-witted, or slow to react. Usually derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係亞東魚嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 aa3 dung1 jyu2 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不明白，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even understand this? You're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁亞東魚啦，醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 aa3 dung1 jyu2 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻了，清醒一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, wake up!

english_meaning: Show off; to flaunt; to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 指人喜欢炫耀自己，表现自己很厉害的样子，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who likes to show off, trying to appear impressive or capable, often with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度亞枝竹，話自己幾叻幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 aa3 zi1 zuk1, waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 lek1 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是到处炫耀，说自己多么多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He is always showing off, saying how great he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺老闆面前亞枝竹，小心俾人覺得你囂張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 aa3 zi1 zuk1, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 nei5 hiu1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在老板面前炫耀，小心别人觉得你嚣张。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off in front of the boss, be careful that others don't think you're arrogant.

english_meaning: Asia
explanation_mandarin: 指地球上最大的大陆，通常包括中国、日本、韩国、印度等国家和地区。
explanation_english: The largest continent on Earth, typically including countries and regions such as China, Japan, South Korea, India, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺亞洲嘅一個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai2 aa3 zau1 ge3 jat1 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是亚洲的一个城市。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a city in Asia.

examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zau1 ge3 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 亚洲的经济发展很快。
examples.english_sentence: The economic development of Asia is very fast.

english_meaning: Asia Television (ATV, now defunct)
explanation_mandarin: 香港一家已经停止广播的免费电视台，简称亚视。曾经是香港历史最悠久的电视台。
explanation_english: A defunct free-to-air television broadcaster in Hong Kong, abbreviated as ATV. It was once the oldest television station in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日睇亞洲電視㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tai2 aa3 zau1 din6 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常看亚洲电视的节目。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often watched Asia Television.

english_meaning: Grandfather (paternal); Elderly man (often used respectfully or affectionately)
explanation_mandarin: 指爷爷，父亲的父亲。有时也用来尊称年长的男性，带有尊敬或亲切的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to one's paternal grandfather. Can also be used as a respectful and/or affectionate term for an elderly man.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常在爷爷家里玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often played at my grandfather's house.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 李爷爷今年八十多岁了，但是还很有精神。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa Li is over eighty years old this year, but he's still very energetic.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 亚洲四小龙以前经济发展得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The Four Asian Tigers used to have very rapid economic development.

english_meaning: Armenia
explanation_mandarin: 指位于西亚或东欧地区的国家亚美尼亚。
explanation_english: Refers to the country Armenia, located in Western Asia or Eastern Europe.

examples.english_sentence: He went to Armenia for travelling this year.

english_meaning: Asian (descent)

explanation_english: Refers to a person of Asian descent.

examples.english_sentence: He is an Asian Canadian.

english_meaning: Asia Television (ATV)

explanation_english: A Hong Kong television station that is now defunct. Its full name is Asia Television (ATV).

examples.english_sentence: ATV has closed down for a long time.

explanation_english: Refers to a cat, a common domestic animal.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家超市的东西很贵的。

english_meaning: Runner-up, second place
explanation_mandarin: 指竞赛或比赛中获得第二名的人或队伍。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or team that wins second place in a competition or contest.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队获得了这届的亚军。
examples.english_sentence: Our team won the runner-up in this year's competition.

english_meaning: Asian Games
explanation_mandarin: 亚洲地区的综合性运动会。
explanation_english: A pancontinental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的亚洲运动会在哪里举办啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where are the Asian Games being held this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想代表香港參加亞運會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 caam1 gaa1 aa3 wan6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想代表香港参加亚洲运动会。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to represent Hong Kong in the Asian Games.

english_meaning: Zinc
explanation_mandarin: 一种金属元素，化学符号为Zn。
explanation_english: A metallic chemical element with the symbol Zn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲鐵皮含亞鉛，所以唔容易生鏽。

english_meaning: Amazon River
explanation_mandarin: 南美洲的一条主要河流，以其巨大的流量和丰富的生物多样性而闻名。
explanation_english: A major river in South America, known for its large flow and rich biodiversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亞馬遜河係世界上最長嘅河流之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa5 seon3 ho4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 coeng4 ge3 ho4 lau4 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 亚马逊河是世界上最长的河流之一。

examples.english_sentence: We learned a lot about the Amazon River in geography class.

english_meaning: Flaxseed, Linseed
explanation_mandarin: 一种植物的种子，可以食用，也可以提取亚麻籽油。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日早餐都食亞麻仁，對身體好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 zou2 caan1 dou1 sik6 aa3 maa4 yan4, deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常早餐都吃亚麻籽，对身体很好。
examples.english_sentence: I often eat flaxseed for breakfast, it's good for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亞麻仁油可以攞嚟炒餸，都幾香㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa4 yan4 yau4 ho2 ji5 lo2 lei4 caau2 sung3, dou1 gei2 hoeng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 亚麻籽油可以用来炒菜，挺香的。
examples.english_sentence: Linseed oil can be used for cooking, it's quite fragrant.

english_meaning: Urgent; pressing; eager

explanation_english: Indicates something is very urgent, pressing, or urgently needed. In Cantonese, this character is rarely used alone and more commonly appears in written language or idioms. Other words are usually used to express similar meanings in spoken language.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们亟需资金去扩展业务。
examples.english_sentence: We urgently need funds to expand our business.

explanation_mandarin: 指生命结束，消失；也指国家或政权灭亡。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of life, to disappear; also refers to the fall of a country or regime.
