examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 san1, mong4 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经去世了，死了。
examples.english_sentence: He has already passed away, died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，我哋嘅文化就好快會亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nou5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 ge3 man4 faa3 zau6 hou2 faai3 wui5 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，我们的文化很快就会消失。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, our culture will disappear quickly.

english_meaning: to risk one's life; to flee for one's life; to live dangerously
explanation_mandarin: 为逃避危险或追求某种目标而不顾生命安危。形容生活状态非常危险，随时可能丧命。
explanation_english: To risk one's life in order to escape danger or pursue a certain goal. Describes a very dangerous lifestyle where one's life is constantly at risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗幫大佬報仇，走咗去亡命天涯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bong1 daai6 lou2 bou3 sau4, zau2 zo2 heoi3 mong4 ming6 tin1 ngaai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮老大报仇，他去亡命天涯了。
examples.english_sentence: To avenge his boss, he went on the run and risked his life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工好危險，幾乎係亡命嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hou2 ngai4 him2, gei2 fu1 hai6 mong4 ming6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作很危险，几乎是亡命的。
examples.english_sentence: His job is very dangerous, almost life-threatening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲毒販成日亡命咁走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 duk6 faan2 sing4 jat6 mong4 ming6 gam2 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些毒贩总是亡命般地逃跑。
examples.english_sentence: Those drug dealers are always running away as if their lives depend on it.

english_meaning: desperado, outlaw, fugitive, someone who lives recklessly
explanation_mandarin: 指不顾性命，为达目的而不择手段的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who disregards their own life and uses any means necessary to achieve their goals; a person who is reckless and often involved in dangerous or illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一班亡命之徒，咩嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 baan1 mong4 ming6 zi1 tou4, me1 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一群亡命之徒，什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: They are a group of desperadoes; they are capable of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢，佢分分鐘係個亡命之徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jik1 keoi5, keoi5 fan1 fan1 zung1 hai6 go3 mong4 ming6 zi1 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他，他很可能是一个亡命之徒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him; he might very well be a desperado.

english_meaning: to flee for one's life to the ends of the earth; to be on the run; fugitive life
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了逃避某种危险或追捕而被迫四处流浪，过着不安定、漂泊的生活。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is forced to wander around and live an unstable, nomadic life to escape some kind of danger or pursuit. It often implies a desperate situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗事，唯有亡命天涯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 si6, wai4 jau5 mong4 ming6 tin1 ngaai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了事，只好亡命天涯了。
examples.english_sentence: He committed a crime, so he has no choice but to be on the run.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強因為得罪咗黑社會，所以被迫亡命天涯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 jan1 wai6 dak1 zeoi2 zo2 hak1 se5 wui2, so2 ji5 bei2 bik1 mong4 ming6 tin1 ngaai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强因为得罪了黑社会，所以被迫亡命天涯。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung offended the Triads, so he was forced to flee for his life.

english_meaning: to lose a country; to perish as a nation; national subjugation
explanation_mandarin: 指国家灭亡，失去主权和独立。
explanation_english: Refers to the destruction of a country, losing its sovereignty and independence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，香港好快就會亡國啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nou5 lik6, hoeng1 gong2 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 mong4 gwok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，香港很快就会亡国了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, Hong Kong will soon perish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅貪污腐敗最終導致國家亡國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 taam1 wu1 fu6 baai6 zeoi3 chung1 dou2 zi3 gwok3 gaa1 mong4 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的贪污腐败最终导致国家灭亡。
examples.english_sentence: Their corruption eventually led to the demise of the country.

english_meaning: To mend the fold after the sheep have been lost; better late than never; to take precautions after suffering a loss.
explanation_mandarin: 羊丢失了再去修补羊圈，还不算晚。比喻出了问题以后想办法补救，可以防止继续受损失。
explanation_english: This idiom means to mend the sheepfold after the sheep have been lost. It signifies that it's not too late to take action to prevent further loss even after a mistake has been made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢考試考得唔好，但係亡羊補牢，而家努力都未遲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 mong4 joeng4 bou2 lou4, ji4 gaa1 nu5 lik6 dou1 mei6 ci4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他考试考得不好，但是亡羊补牢，现在努力还不晚。
examples.english_sentence: Although he didn't do well on the exam, it's better late than never; it's not too late to work hard now.

english_meaning: spirit of the dead, departed soul, ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指死去的人的灵魂。
explanation_english: Refers to the soul of a deceased person; spirit of the dead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋相信亡靈會返嚟探親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng1 seon3 mong4 ling4 wui5 faan1 lai4 taam3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们相信亡灵会回来探亲。
examples.english_sentence: They believe that the spirits of the dead will return to visit relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬聖節好多人扮鬼扮馬，話要同亡靈一齊慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 sing3 zit3 hou2 do1 jan4 baan6 gwai2 baan6 maa5, waa6 jiu3 tung4 mong4 ling4 jat1 cai4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万圣节很多人扮鬼扮马，说要和亡灵一起庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: Many people dress up for Halloween, saying they want to celebrate with the spirits of the dead.

english_meaning: departed spirit, deceased soul, ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指已故之人的灵魂。
explanation_english: Refers to the soul of a deceased person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話呢度成日都有亡魂出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 ni1 dou6 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 mong4 wan4 ceot1 hin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说这里经常有亡灵出现。
examples.english_sentence: They say ghosts often appear here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要超度啲亡魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ciu1 dou6 di1 mong4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要超度那些亡灵。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pray for the deliverance of those departed souls.

mandarin_meaning: 兴奋, 激动, 高昂
english_meaning: excited, agitated, high-spirited
explanation_mandarin: 形容情绪或状态兴奋、激动、高昂。
explanation_english: Describes a mood or state of being excited, agitated, or high-spirited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去旅行，我好亢奮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, ngo5 hou2 hong3 fan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要去旅行，我好兴奋啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, I'm so excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢講到好亢，好似飲咗興奮劑咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dou3 hou2 hong3, hou2 ci5 jam2 zo2 hing1 fan5 zai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话说得很激动，好像喝了兴奋剂一样。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very excitedly, as if he had taken stimulants.

english_meaning: excited, agitated, overstimulated
explanation_mandarin: 指情绪激动，精神振奋的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of intense excitement and heightened energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就去旅行喇，我好亢奮啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa3, ngo5 hou2 kong3 fan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要去旅行了，我好兴奋啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, I'm so excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗咖啡之後，個人變得好亢奮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zo2 gaa3 fe1 zi1 hau6, go3 yan4 bin3 dak1 hou2 kong3 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了咖啡之后，人变得很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking coffee, he became very excited.

mandarin_meaning: 交付; 递交; 结交
english_meaning: to hand over; to deliver; to pay (fees etc.); to make (friends); to intersect
explanation_mandarin: 给予；交付；递交；结交。
explanation_english: To hand over something; to deliver; to pay (fees, dues, etc.); to make friends or have relations with someone; to intersect (math).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要把作业交上去。
examples.english_sentence: I have to hand in my homework today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋交個朋友啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaau1 go3 pang4 jau5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们交个朋友吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's be friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢交咗好多學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau1 zo2 hou2 do1 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他交了很多学费。
examples.english_sentence: He paid a lot of tuition fees.

english_meaning: to hand over, to deliver, to entrust
explanation_mandarin: 把某物或任务交付给别人。
explanation_english: To hand over something, or entrust a task to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會將份文件交予經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 fan6 man4 gin2 gaau1 jyu5 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会把这份文件交给经理。
examples.english_sentence: I will hand over this document to the manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個波交予佢嘅隊友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 bo1 gaau1 jyu5 keoi5 ge3 deoi2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把球交给了他的队友。
examples.english_sentence: He passed the ball to his teammate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 主席將控制權交予新任總裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 zik6 zoeng1 hung3 zai3 kuen4 gaau1 jyu5 san1 jam6 zung2 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主席把控制权交给了新任总裁。
examples.english_sentence: The chairman handed over control to the new CEO.

english_meaning: to hand over a person (to the authorities, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指把某人移交给别人，通常指移交给警方或其他相关部门。
explanation_english: To hand over a person to someone, usually referring to handing someone over to the police or other relevant authorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人叫佢哋交人出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan2 giu3 keoi5 dei6 gaau1 jan4 ceot1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察让他们把人交出来。
examples.english_sentence: The police asked them to hand the person over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以交人，要保護佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 gaau1 jan4, jiu3 bou2 wu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能交人，要保护他。
examples.english_sentence: We can't hand him over, we have to protect him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋逼我交人，但我唔會屈服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bik1 ngo5 gaau1 jan4, daan6 ngo5 m4 wui wat1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们逼我交人，但我不会屈服。
examples.english_sentence: They are forcing me to hand the person over, but I won't give in.

english_meaning: to explain; to account for; to hand over; to confess; to brief; to tell; to finish; to explain oneself; to give an account; to give a clear explanation
explanation_mandarin: 解释清楚；把事情处理完结；移交；坦白承认。
explanation_english: To explain clearly; to finish a task or matter; to hand over; to confess or admit something frankly; to give an account or explanation for something, often to someone in authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我哋交代清楚件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 gaau1 daai2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我们交代清楚事情的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked us to explain the whole story clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗錯，一定要向公司交代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 co3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 hoeng3 gung1 si1 gaau1 daai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了错，一定要向公司交代。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and has to account for it to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經交代晒啲嘢畀佢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gaau1 daai2 saai3 di1 je5 bei2 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经把所有事情都交代给他了。
examples.english_sentence: I have already explained everything to him.

mandarin_meaning: 留下; 交代; 传承
english_meaning: to leave behind; to hand over; to pass down; to explain before leaving
explanation_mandarin: 有多种含义，包括留下（东西、信息等）、交代（事情）和传承（传统、技能等）。 具体含义取决于上下文。
explanation_english: Has several meanings, including to leave behind (objects, information, etc.), to explain or instruct before leaving, and to pass down (traditions, skills, etc.). The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨走嘅時候交低咗封信俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 zau2 ge3 si4 hau6 gaau1 dai1 zo2 fung1 seon3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临走的时候给你留下一封信。
examples.english_sentence: He left a letter for you before he left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺交低咗好多做人嘅道理俾我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gaau1 dai1 zo2 hou2 do1 zou6 jan4 ge3 dou6 lei5 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷留下了很多做人的道理给我们。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather passed down a lot of principles of life to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆交低咗啲嘢俾我跟手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gaau1 dai1 zo2 di1 ye5 bei2 ngo5 gan1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板留下了一些事情给我善后。
examples.english_sentence: The boss left some things for me to take care of.

english_meaning: To pass the buck to...
explanation_mandarin: 比喻将责任或难题推给他人。
explanation_english: A metaphor that means to pass on a responsibility, task, or problem to someone else, often to avoid dealing with it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日交個波俾我得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能不能不要总是把责任推给我？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please stop passing the buck to me all the time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到有問題就即刻交個波俾老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jau5 man6 tai4 zau6 zik1 hak1 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到有问题就立刻把责任推给老板。
examples.english_sentence: He passes the buck to the boss immediately when he sees a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好交個波俾啲後生仔，佢哋仲未夠經驗處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2, keoi5 dei6 zung6 mei6 gau3 ging1 jim6 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把责任推给年轻人，他们还没足够的经验处理。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pass the buck to the young people, they don't have enough experience to handle it.

synonyms: 推卸責任 (teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam1)

english_meaning: To pass the ball to...; to pass the responsibility to...
explanation_mandarin: 本义指把球传给某人。引申义指把责任或任务转交给某人。类似于推卸责任。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to pass the ball to someone. Figuratively, it means to pass the responsibility or task to someone else, often implying shirking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住交個波畀我呀，你自己都應該諗下辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 ngo5 aa3, nei5 zi6 gei2 dou1 jing1 goi1 nam2 haa5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着把责任推给我，你自己也应该想想办法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about passing the buck to me, you should think of a solution yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞唔掂，咪唯有交個波畀老細囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 m4 dim6, mai6 wai4 jau5 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 lou5 sai3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搞不定，只能把球传给老板了。
examples.english_sentence: If he can't handle it, he can only pass the responsibility to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咩都交個波畀下屬，你都要負責任㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 me1 dou1 gaau1 go3 bo1 bei2 haa6 suk6, nei5 dou1 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 jam3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要什么都把责任推给下属，你也是要负责任的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pass all the responsibility to your subordinates, you are also responsible.

synonyms: 推卸責任 (teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam3)

english_meaning: to hand over; to surrender; to give up
explanation_mandarin: 指把东西或权力等交给对方。
explanation_english: To hand over something, often something that is being demanded or required; to surrender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人叫佢交出身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 giu3 keoi5 gaau1 ceot1 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察让他交出身份证。
examples.english_sentence: The police officer asked him to hand over his ID card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賊仔逼佢交出啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaak6 zai2 bik1 keoi5 gaau1 ceot1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小偷逼他交出钱。
examples.english_sentence: The thief forced him to hand over the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔交出個秘密，我就唔放過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 gaau1 ceot1 go3 bei3 mat6, ngo5 zau6 m4 fong3 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不交出这个秘密，我就不放过你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't reveal this secret, I won't let you go.

english_meaning: to hand in homework / to submit an assignment / to fulfill a task (often in a perfunctory way)
explanation_mandarin: 本意是提交作业。也引申为敷衍了事地完成任务，或者为了应付而做某事。
explanation_english: Literally means to submit homework. Figuratively, it refers to completing a task in a perfunctory manner, or doing something just to get it over with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係想快啲交功課，所以求求其其做完就算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 faai3 di1 gaau1 gung1 fo3, so2 ji5 kau4 kau4 kei4 kei4 zou6 jyun4 zau6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只想快点交作业，所以随便做完就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He just wants to hand in his homework quickly, so he just finishes it carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告唔好交功課呀，要認真啲做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 m4 hou2 gaau1 gung1 fo3 aa3, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告不要敷衍了事啊，要认真一点做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just submit this report to get it over with, you need to do it more seriously.

english_meaning: to converge; to meet; confluence; intersection
explanation_mandarin: 指不同的方向汇集到一点。
explanation_english: Refers to different directions converging to one point; to meet or come together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係幾條主要道路嘅交匯處，所以成日塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 gei2 tiu4 zyu2 jiu3 dou6 lou6 ge3 gaau1 wui6 cyu3, so2 ji5 sing4 jat6 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是几条主要道路的交汇处，所以经常堵车。
examples.english_sentence: This place is the intersection of several main roads, so there are often traffic jams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩條河嘅水喺呢度交匯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 tiu4 ho4 ge3 seoi2 hai2 ni1 dou6 gaau1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两条河的水在这里交汇。
examples.english_sentence: The waters of the two rivers meet here.

english_meaning: Interchange; junction; confluence; intersection
explanation_mandarin: 多条道路或河流汇合的地方。
explanation_english: A place where multiple roads or rivers converge or intersect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面就係交匯處，你要睇清楚路牌先好轉彎啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 zau6 hai6 gaau1 wui6 cyu3, nei5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 lou6 paai4 sin1 hou2 zyun3 waan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面就是交汇处，你要看清楚路牌才能转弯啊。
examples.english_sentence: The interchange is ahead, you need to read the road signs carefully before turning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅交通好繁忙，因為係幾個主要幹道嘅交匯處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 gaau1 tung1 hou2 faan4 mong4, jan1 wai6 hai6 gei2 go3 zyu2 jiu3 gon3 dou6 ge3 gaau1 wui6 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的交通很繁忙，因为是几个主要干道的交汇处。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic here is very busy because it's an interchange of several major roads.

mandarin_meaning: 交叉; 混乱; 冲突
english_meaning: cross; intersect; criss-cross; mixed up; to have conflict; disagreement
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指两物相交或交叉。2. 形容事物混乱或意见不合。
explanation_english: 1. To cross or intersect. 2. Describes something that is mixed up or there is a disagreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅意見交叉咗，搞到好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 ji3 gin3 gaau1 caa1 zo2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的意见相左了，弄得很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions clashed, making them very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路同嗰條路喺前面交叉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 tung4 go2 tiu4 lou6 hai2 cin4 min6 gaau1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路和那条路在前面交叉。
examples.english_sentence: This road and that road intersect ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲文件交叉擺，執返好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin2 gaau1 caa1 baai2, zap1 faan1 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把文件乱放，整理好它们。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the documents in a mess, tidy them up.

english_meaning: cross-infection; cross-contamination
explanation_mandarin: 指在医疗场所或其他场所中，患者之间或患者与医护人员之间相互传播病原体，导致感染的情况。
explanation_english: The transmission of infectious agents between patients or between patients and healthcare workers in a healthcare setting or other environments, resulting in infection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院入面一定要做好防護措施，避免交叉感染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 yun2 yap6 min6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 fong4 wu6 co3 si1, bei2 min5 gaau1 caa1 gam2 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院里一定要做好防护措施，避免交叉感染。
examples.english_sentence: It is essential to implement good protective measures in the hospital to avoid cross-infection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔注意衛生，好容易會喺屋企造成交叉感染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 m4 zyu3 ji3 wai6 sang1, hou2 jung4 ji6 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 sing4 gaau1 caa1 gam2 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不注意卫生，很容易会在家里造成交叉感染。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't pay attention to hygiene, it's easy to cause cross-infection at home.

english_meaning: intersection; crossroads; point of intersection
explanation_mandarin: 指两条或多条道路、线等的交汇之处。也比喻事件发展中的转折点或关键时刻。
explanation_english: The point where two or more roads, lines, etc. intersect. Also used metaphorically to describe a turning point or critical moment in the development of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個路口係個主要嘅交叉點，好易塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou6 hau2 hai6 go3 zyu2 jiu3 ge3 gaau1 caa1 dim2, hou2 ji6 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个路口是一个主要的交叉点，很容易堵车。
examples.english_sentence: This intersection is a major crossroads, it's easy to get traffic jams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅事業喺呢個交叉點，要好好咁諗清楚下一步點行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 si6 jip3 hai2 ni1 go3 gaau1 caa1 dim2, jiu3 hou2 hou2 gam2 nim2 cing1 co2 haa6 jat1 bou6 dim2 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的事业正处于一个交叉点，要好好想清楚下一步怎么走。
examples.english_sentence: Our careers are at a crossroads, we need to think carefully about the next step.

english_meaning: to make friends, to socialize
explanation_mandarin: 指结交朋友，建立友谊。
explanation_english: To make friends, to establish friendships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意交友，識咗好多唔同嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 gaau1 jau5, sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢交朋友，认识了很多不同的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to make friends and has met many different friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲交友app都好方便，好容易識到新朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 gaau1 jau5 app dou1 hou2 fong1 bin6, hou2 rung4 yi3 sik1 dou2 san1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的交友App都很方便，很容易认识新朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, dating apps are very convenient and it's easy to meet new friends.

english_meaning: vacant possession; to hand over a property in a vacant state
explanation_mandarin: 指把房产或店铺以空置状态交还给业主或买家。
explanation_english: Refers to handing over a property (e.g., apartment, shop) to the owner or buyer in a vacant state, free of occupants and belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搬走咗之後，間舖頭就交吉畀業主喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun1 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, gaan1 pou3 tau2 zau6 gaau1 gat1 bei2 yip6 zyu2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搬走之后，这家店铺就空置交接给业主了。
examples.english_sentence: After they moved out, the shop was handed over to the landlord vacant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買嗰層樓係交吉嘅，所以可以即刻搬入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 go2 cang4 lau2 hai6 gaau1 gat1 ge3, so2 ji5 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 bun1 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买的那层楼是空置的，所以可以立刻搬进去。
examples.english_sentence: The apartment we bought is vacant possession, so we can move in immediately.

english_meaning: sexual intercourse, copulation
explanation_mandarin: 指男性和女性之间的性行为，一种比较正式和书面的说法。
explanation_english: A formal and somewhat literary term referring to sexual intercourse or copulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅行為已經構成咗非法嘅交媾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 wai4 ji5 ging1 kau3 sing4 zo2 fei1 faat3 ge3 gaau1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行为已经构成了非法的性交。
examples.english_sentence: Their actions already constitute illegal sexual intercourse.

english_meaning: to pay tuition fees; to learn a lesson (often the hard way); to pay a price for inexperience
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是缴纳学费。引申义为：因为缺乏经验或判断失误而付出代价。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to pay tuition fees. Figuratively, it means to pay a price or learn a lesson the hard way, often due to inexperience or poor judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資失敗，當交學費囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 si1 baai6, dong3 gaau1 hok6 fai3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资失败了，就当交学费了。
examples.english_sentence: This investment failed, consider it paying tuition fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次做生意就蝕咗好多錢，真係交咗唔少學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zou6 seng1 ji3 zau6 sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 gaau1 zo2 m4 siu2 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次做生意就亏了很多钱，真是交了不少学费。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money in his first business venture; he really paid a high price for his inexperience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個唔聽阿媽話，大個就知交學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 m4 ting1 aa3 maa1 waa6, daai6 go3 zau6 zi1 gaau1 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候不听妈妈的话，长大了就知道要付出代价。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to your mother when you're young, you'll learn the hard way when you grow up.

english_meaning: to mate, to copulate (of animals)
explanation_mandarin: 指动物进行交配的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of animals mating or copulating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下，嗰兩隻狗喺度交尾呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5, go2 loeng5 jek3 gau2 hai2 dou6 gaau1 mei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，那两只狗在那里交配呢。
examples.english_sentence: Look, those two dogs are mating there.

english_meaning: to deliver a result; to fulfill a task; to report to superiors; to get by; to muddle through
explanation_mandarin: 完成任务，向上级报告结果，或者勉强应付过去。
explanation_english: To deliver a result or report to superiors. It can also mean to get by or muddle through a task, sometimes implying a lack of enthusiasm or quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢求求其其咁交差就算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kau4 kau4 gei1 gei1 gam2 gaau1 caai1 zau6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他马马虎虎地交待一下就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He just does a perfunctory job and gets it over with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一定要做好呢份project，唔可以求其交差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 ni1 fan6 project, m4 ho2 ji5 kau4 kei4 gaau1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一定要做好这个项目，不可以随便交待。
examples.english_sentence: I must do this project well, I can't just deliver a shoddy result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢交差都交得幾好喎，唔錯喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau1 caai1 dou1 gaau1 dak1 gei2 hou2 wo3, m4 co3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完成得还不错，不错啊！
examples.english_sentence: He delivered quite well, not bad!

english_meaning: to explain clearly; to give instructions; to account for; to explain matters to someone
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情的來龍去脈清楚地說明，或給予明確的指示，以確保事情能順利進行。
explanation_english: To explain the details of a matter clearly, to give instructions or account for something to ensure things run smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨走之前，已經交帶晒啲工作俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 zau2 zi1 cin4, ji5 ging1 gaau1 daai3晒啲 gung1 zok3 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临走之前，已经把所有工作都交代给我了。
examples.english_sentence: Before he left, he had already explained and handed over all the work to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆要你交帶清楚點解件事會搞成咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jiu3 nei5 gaau1 daai3 cing1 co2 dim2 gaai2 gin6 si6 wui5 gaau2 sing4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板要你交代清楚事情为什么会变成这样。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants you to explain clearly why the matter turned out like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要交帶俾啲同事知，如果唔係佢哋唔知點做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 gaau1 daai3 bei2 di1 tung4 si6 zi1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 zi1 dim2 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要跟同事们交代一下，不然他们不知道怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: You also need to give instructions to the colleagues, otherwise they won't know how to do the work.

english_meaning: to associate with, to have dealings with, to date, to interact
explanation_mandarin: 互相来往，多指人与人之间的互动，可以是朋友、同事、恋人等关系。
explanation_english: To associate with; to have dealings with; to interact; often refers to the interaction between people, such as friends, colleagues, or lovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個交往咗幾年，就結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leong5 go3 kau1 wong5 zo2 gei2 nin4, zau6 git3 fan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个交往了几年，就要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for a few years and are getting married soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司同好多外國公司都有商業交往嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 tung4 ho2 do1 ngoi6 gwok3 gung1 si1 dou1 jau5 soeng1 jip6 kau1 wong5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司和很多外国公司都有商业往来的。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has business dealings with many foreign companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意同陌生人交往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 mak6 sang1 jan4 kau1 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不喜欢和陌生人交往。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like to associate with strangers.

english_meaning: to explain; to account for; to confess; to hand over; to finish; to settle (a matter); to arrange for (what will happen after one's death); to die
explanation_mandarin: 解释清楚；交代清楚；完成任务；安排后事；死亡。
explanation_english: To explain clearly; to give an account; to complete a task; to make arrangements for after one's death; to die.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔交待清楚，我唔會放過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 gaau1 daai3 cing1 co2, ngo5 m4 wui5 fong3 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不交代清楚，我不会放过你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't explain clearly, I won't let you off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病到咁，都仲要交待晒啲手尾先至肯休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dou3 gam2, dou1 zung1 jiu3 gaau1 daai3 saai3 di1 sau2 mei1 sin1 zi3 hang2 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病成这样，都还要把手头的工作交代完才肯休息。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he is so sick, he still insists on finishing up all his work before resting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗之後，都無交待過啲錢點樣分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, dou1 mou5 gaau1 daai3 gwo3 di1 cin2 dim2 joeng2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了之后，都没有交代过那些钱怎么分。
examples.english_sentence: After he passed away, he didn't make any arrangements about how to divide the money.

english_meaning: to confide in someone; to have a heart-to-heart talk; to be frank with each other; to open one's heart
explanation_mandarin: 指彼此坦诚相待，互相倾诉心事。
explanation_english: Refers to being honest and sincere with each other, sharing one's innermost thoughts and feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好耐冇交心喇，不如今晚出嚟傾吓計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 noi6 mou5 gaau1 sam1 laa3, bat1 jyu4 gam1 maan5 ceot1 lai4 king1 haa5 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们好久没交心了，不如今晚出来聊聊天。
examples.english_sentence: We haven't had a heart-to-heart talk in a long time, why don't we go out and chat tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個交心之後，關係好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gaau1 sam1 zi1 hau6, gwaan1 hai6 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个交心之后，关系好了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After they had a heart-to-heart talk, their relationship improved a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要同人交心，先要畀人信任你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 tung4 jan4 gaau1 sam1, sin1 jiu3 bei2 jan4 seon3 jam6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要和别人交心，首先要让别人信任你。
examples.english_sentence: To confide in someone, you must first gain their trust.

synonyms: 傾心吐意 (king1 sam1 tou3 ji3)

english_meaning: friendship; relationship; bond of friendship; feelings between friends
explanation_mandarin: 朋友之间的情谊，关系。
explanation_english: Friendship; the relationship or bond between friends; the feelings of friendship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間嘅交情唔錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gaau1 cing4 m4 co3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间的交情不错。
examples.english_sentence: We have a pretty good relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅交情好深，就算幾耐冇見都唔會生疏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gaau1 cing4 hou2 sam1, zau6 syun3 gei2 noi6 mou5 gin3 dou1 m4 wui1 saang1 so1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的交情很深，即使很久没见面也不会变得生疏。
examples.english_sentence: They have a deep friendship, even if they haven't seen each other for a long time, they won't become strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為交情嘅關係，佢先至會幫我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gaau1 cing4 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, keoi5 sin1 zi3 wui5 bong1 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为交情的关系，他才会帮助我的。
examples.english_sentence: Because of our friendship, he will help me.

english_meaning: to fall out; to become estranged; to become hostile; to turn sour (of a relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 关系变得恶劣，不友好。
explanation_english: To become hostile or unfriendly; to have a relationship turn sour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為一啲小事而交惡咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 jat1 dik1 siu2 si6 ji4 gaau1 ok3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为一些小事而交恶了。
examples.english_sentence: They fell out over some trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個國家交惡對大家都冇好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 gaau1 ok3 deoi3 daai6 ga1 dou1 mou5 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个国家交恶对大家都没好处。
examples.english_sentence: It's not good for anyone when two countries become hostile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢交惡，所以盡量避免同佢接觸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 gaau1 ok3, so2 ji5 zeon6 loeng6 bei6 min5 tung4 keoi5 zip3 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他交恶，所以尽量避免和他接触。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to fall out with him, so I try to avoid contact with him as much as possible.

english_meaning: to be at war; to fight; to wage war; warfare
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个国家或军队之间进行战争或战斗。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of two or more countries or armies engaging in war or combat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰兩個國家已經交戰咗好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ji5 ging1 gaau1 zin3 zo2 hou2 noi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那两个国家已经交战很久了。
examples.english_sentence: Those two countries have been at war for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔希望見到任何地方交戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hei1 mong6 gin3 dou3 jam6 ho4 dei6 fong1 gaau1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不希望看到任何地方交战。
examples.english_sentence: We don't want to see any place at war.

english_meaning: to act; to put on an act; to pretend; to fake it
explanation_mandarin: 指表演，演戏，通常带有一种为了达到某种目的而故意表现出来的意思。不仅仅指专业的演员表演，也指日常生活中为了掩饰真实情感或意图而装模作样。
explanation_english: Refers to acting, usually implying that the action is done deliberately to achieve a certain purpose. It not only refers to professional actors performing, but also refers to pretending in daily life to conceal real emotions or intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老細面前交戲，扮到好勤力噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 gaau1 hei3, baan6 dou3 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2.

english_meaning: negotiate, have dealings with, take up a matter with

examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a meeting point of Eastern and Western cultures.

english_meaning: exchange fire (in combat); engage in a firefight
explanation_mandarin: 指双方军队或武装人员互相射击，发生激烈的枪战。
explanation_english: Refers to an exchange of fire between two opposing forces or armed personnel; to engage in a firefight or gun battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條街上面交火，搞到啲居民好驚。

english_meaning: to hand over to; to entrust to; to leave to

examples.english_sentence: This love story is full of joy and sadness, with various emotions intertwined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市嘅燈光同車聲交織成一幅獨特嘅夜景。

examples.english_sentence: His experience is full of hope and despair, and these two feelings have always been intertwined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅交通工具好方便㗎。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車衝咗紅燈，撞到交通燈。

jyutping: gaau1 tung1 dang1 -- dim2 hung4 dim2 luk6
mandarin_meaning: 红绿灯——指手画脚，指指点点
english_meaning: Traffic light -- To criticize or instruct excessively; to nitpick; to micro-manage (often used to describe someone who gives too many instructions or unwanted advice). Also, to be overly controlling.
explanation_mandarin: 交通灯，红灯绿灯交替出现，比喻有人像交通灯一样，不停地给出指示，过分干涉或指指点点。通常带有负面含义，表示厌烦或不满。
explanation_english: Traffic lights, with their alternating red and green lights, are used as a metaphor for someone who constantly gives instructions or advice, often in an excessive or meddling way. It usually carries a negative connotation, expressing annoyance or dissatisfaction with the person's behaviour. It's like they're directing traffic in your life when you don't want them to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度交通燈——點紅點綠啦！我自己識做。

examples.english_sentence: Don't micro-manage me! I know what I'm doing.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么幸运，真是像亥时出生一样。
examples.english_sentence: You're so lucky, it's like you were born at the hour of Hai.

english_meaning: also; too; likewise
explanation_mandarin: 表示同样；也是。
explanation_english: Used to indicate similarity or addition; also; too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講英文，亦識講法文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 ying1 man2, jik6 sik1 gong2 faat3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说英语，也会说法語。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks English, and he also speaks French.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法有效，另一個方法亦都有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 jau5 haau6, ling6 jat1 go3 fong1 faat3 jik6 dou1 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法有效，另一个方法也有效。
examples.english_sentence: This method is effective, and the other method is also effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意食蘋果，我都亦鍾意食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2, ngo5 dou1 jik6 zung1 ji3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢吃苹果，我也喜欢吃。
examples.english_sentence: You like to eat apples, and I also like to eat them.

english_meaning: that is to say; which means; in other words
explanation_mandarin: 表示进一步解释或说明，相当于“也就是说”、“即”的意思。
explanation_english: Used to provide further explanation or clarification, equivalent to 'that is to say', 'which means', or 'in other words'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日唔得閒，亦即係冇時間同你行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4, jik6 zik1 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan3 tung4 nei5 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天没空，也就是说没时间跟你逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow, which means I don't have time to go shopping with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，亦即係佢唔會返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, jik6 zik1 hai6 keoi5 m4 wui5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，也就是说他不会上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, that is to say, he won't be coming to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度冇巴士站，亦即係你要行一段路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 mou5 baa1 si2 zaam6, jik6 zik1 hai6 nei5 jiu3 haang4 jat1 dyun6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里没有巴士站，也就是说你要走一段路。
examples.english_sentence: There's no bus stop here, which means you have to walk a bit.

english_meaning: Both teacher and friend; a relationship that combines mentorship and friendship.
explanation_mandarin: 既是老师又是朋友。形容两人之间既有师生关系，又有朋友情谊。
explanation_english: Describes a relationship where someone is both a teacher/mentor and a friend. It emphasizes the dual roles and close bond between individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同佢嘅老闆關係好好，亦師亦友咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 lou5 baan2 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2, jik6 si1 jik6 jau5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和他的老板关系很好，亦师亦友。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very good relationship with his boss, it's like a teacher and friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅教練唔單止教我哋打波，仲好似朋友咁同我哋傾偈，真係亦師亦友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gaau3 lin6 m4 daan1 zi2 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 daa2 bo1, zung6 hou2 ci5 pang4 jau5 gam2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 king1 gai2, zan1 hai6 jik6 si1 jik6 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的教练不仅教我们打球，还像朋友一样和我们聊天，真是亦师亦友。
examples.english_sentence: Our coach not only teaches us how to play ball, but also chats with us like a friend. It's truly a teacher and friend relationship.

mandarin_meaning: 亦步亦趋 (yì bù yì qū)
english_meaning: to slavishly imitate; to ape; to follow closely behind
explanation_mandarin: 形容紧紧地跟在别人后面模仿，一点也不敢离开。也比喻机械地照搬或追随别人。
explanation_english: Describes following someone closely and imitating them meticulously, without daring to deviate. It also implies mechanically copying or following others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都跟住老闆做，簡直係亦步亦趨咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 gan1 zyu6 lou5 baan2 zou6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jik6 bou6 jik6 ceoi1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都跟着老板做，简直是亦步亦趋。
examples.english_sentence: He follows the boss in everything; it's practically slavish imitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亦步亦趨咁學人哋，要有自己嘅風格先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jik6 bou6 jik6 ceoi1 gam2 hok6 yan4 dei6, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fung1 gaak3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要亦步亦趋地学别人，要有自己的风格才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just slavishly imitate others; you need to have your own style.

english_meaning: also, too, as well
explanation_mandarin: 表示同样，也是的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates 'also', 'too', or 'as well'. It is used to show that something is similar or additional to something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意食蘋果，亦都鍾意食橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2, jik6 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢吃苹果，也喜欢吃橙子。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to eat apples, and he also likes to eat oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要返工，你亦都要返工咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, nei5 jik6 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要上班，你也要上班吗？
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work tomorrow. Do you have to go to work too?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好食，價錢亦都合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 sik6, gaa3 cin4 jik6 dou1 hap6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好吃，价格也很合理。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is delicious, and the price is also reasonable.

mandarin_meaning: 顺利; 舒服; 幸运
english_meaning: Smoothly; comfortably; lucky; prosperous
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情进展顺利，或者生活舒适惬意。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things are going smoothly or living comfortably and pleasantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年生意做得幾亨下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 seng1 ji3 zou6 dak1 gei2 heng1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年生意做得挺顺利的。
examples.english_sentence: Business is doing quite well this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 住喺度好亨受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu6 hai2 dou6 hou2 heng1 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 住在这里很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Living here is very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢排幾亨呀，升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 paai4 gei2 heng1 aa3, sing1 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近挺走运的，升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been quite lucky lately, he got promoted.

english_meaning: prosperous, thriving, smooth, unobstructed
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物发展顺利，没有阻碍。
explanation_english: Describes something that is developing smoothly without obstruction; indicates prosperity and success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你生意興隆，萬事亨通！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 sang1 ji3 hing1 lung4, maan6 si6 hang1 tung1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你生意兴隆，万事亨通！
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a prosperous business and everything goes smoothly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望今年可以行個運，做乜嘢都亨通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 hang4 go3 wan6, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 hang1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望今年可以走好运，做什么都顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Hope I have good luck this year, and everything goes smoothly.

english_meaning: to enjoy, to benefit from
explanation_mandarin: 享受；享用。
explanation_english: To enjoy; to benefit from; to have the use of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好享受而家嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很享受现在的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He really enjoys his life now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你享下呢個特別優惠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hoeng2 haa5 ni1 go3 dak6 bit3 jau1 wai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你享受一下这个特别优惠吧。
examples.english_sentence: Enjoy this special offer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要珍惜眼前嘅嘢，好好去享佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zhen1 sik1 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 je5, hou2 hou2 heoi3 hoeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要珍惜眼前的事物，好好享受它。
examples.english_sentence: We should cherish what we have and enjoy it.

english_meaning: to enjoy, enjoyment
explanation_mandarin: 获得物质上或精神上的满足和快乐。
explanation_english: To derive pleasure from something; to have the benefit of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好享受而家嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很享受现在的生活。
examples.english_sentence: I really enjoy my current life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好享受沖涼嘅過程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 cung1 loeng4 ge3 gwo3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很享受洗澡的过程。
examples.english_sentence: He really enjoys the process of taking a bath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假期我哋要好好享受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 kei4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 hoeng2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假期我们要好好享受。
examples.english_sentence: We must enjoy this holiday to the fullest.

english_meaning: died at (a certain age)
explanation_mandarin: 指人去世时的年龄，多用于对长辈或值得尊敬的人的年龄的婉称。
explanation_english: To have lived to a certain age (often used when referring to the age at death of elders or respected figures). It's a polite way to state someone's age at the time of their death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢享年九十八歲，算係好長命啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 nin4 gau2 sap6 baat3 seoi3, syun3 hai6 hou2 coeng4 ming6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他享年九十八岁，算是很长寿了。
examples.english_sentence: He died at the age of 98, which is considered a long life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爺爺享年八十五歲，安詳離世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je4 je2 hoeng2 nin4 baat3 sap6 ng5 seoi3, on1 coeng4 lei4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷享年八十五岁，安详离世。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa died at the age of 85, passing away peacefully.

english_meaning: to enjoy, to possess, to have the right to enjoy
explanation_mandarin: 具有某种权利或利益，并加以享受。
explanation_english: To have the right or opportunity to enjoy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅市民享有言論自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 si5 man4 hoeng2 jau5 jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的市民享有言论自由。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong citizens enjoy freedom of speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢享有好高嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 seng1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他享有很高的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: He enjoys a very high reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退休人士享有好多福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 yau1 jan4 si6 hoeng2 jau5 hou2 do1 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退休人士享有许多福利。
examples.english_sentence: Retirees enjoy many benefits.

english_meaning: to enjoy life; to indulge in pleasure; enjoyment
explanation_mandarin: 享受快乐；寻欢作乐。
explanation_english: To enjoy life's pleasures; to indulge in enjoyment and pleasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都淨係識得享樂，唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hoeng2 lok6, m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天就知道享乐，不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to enjoy himself all day and doesn't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有錢嘅生活唔一定係享樂嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cin2 ge3 sang1 wut6 m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 hoeng2 lok6 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有钱的生活不一定是享乐的生活。
examples.english_sentence: A wealthy life is not necessarily a life of pleasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗歐洲享樂幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 au1 zau1 hoeng2 lok6 gei2 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了欧洲享乐几个月。
examples.english_sentence: They went to Europe to enjoy themselves for a few months.

english_meaning: to enjoy a life of leisure and comfort, to enjoy one's retirement
explanation_mandarin: 指享受清闲安逸的生活，通常指退休后的生活。
explanation_english: Refers to enjoying a peaceful and comfortable life, typically after retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後就日日喺屋企享清福啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3休 hau6 zau6 jat1 jat1 hai2 uk1 kei2 hoeng2 cing1 fuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休后就每天在家里享清福了。
examples.english_sentence: After he retired, he just enjoys a life of leisure at home every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗咁多年嘢，都應該享吓清福喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 je5, dou1 jing1 goi1 hoeng2 haa5 cing1 fuk1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么多年了，也应该享受一下清福了。
examples.english_sentence: After working for so many years, you should enjoy some leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺而家享緊清福，得閒就去飲茶同埋行公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 ji4 gaa1 hoeng2 gan2 cing1 fuk1, dak1 haan4 zau6 heoi3 jam2 chaa4 tung4 maai4 haang4 gung1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷现在正在享清福，有空就去喝茶和逛公园。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is enjoying his retirement now, he goes to yum cha and walks in the park when he's free.

english_meaning: to enjoy, to use and benefit from
explanation_mandarin: 享受，使用并从中获得利益。
explanation_english: To enjoy; to make use of and benefit from something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去食好嘢，好好享用下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 sik6 hou2 je5, hou2 hou2 hoeng2 jung6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去吃好吃的，好好享受一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat something nice tonight and enjoy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話功能咁多，你可以慢慢享用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 gung1 nang4 gam3 do1, nei5 ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 hoeng2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新电话功能这么多，你可以慢慢享受。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone has so many features, you can take your time to enjoy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店嘅設施你可以隨便享用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 dim3 ge3 sik1 si1 nei5 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 hoeng2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店的设施你可以随便享用。
examples.english_sentence: You can freely enjoy the hotel's facilities.

english_meaning: to enjoy good fortune; to live comfortably; to have a good life
explanation_mandarin: 享受幸福、安乐的生活。
explanation_english: To enjoy a life of comfort and happiness; to reap the rewards of hard work or good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後就開始享福喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hoeng2 fuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后就开始享福了。
examples.english_sentence: He started enjoying a good life after retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁辛苦工作，都係為咗將來可以享福啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 san1 fu2 gung1 zok3, dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 hoeng2 fuk1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么辛苦工作，都是为了将来可以享福啊。
examples.english_sentence: You work so hard, it's all so you can enjoy a good life in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔乜都唔做就想享福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 mat1 dou1 m4 zou6 zau6 soeng2 hoeng2 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在那些年轻人什么都不做就想享福。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, those young people want to enjoy a good life without doing anything.

english_meaning: to enjoy a reputation; to be well-known; to be renowned
explanation_mandarin: 指享有很高的名誉，广为人知。
explanation_english: To be widely recognized and admired for excellence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳喺香港享譽盛名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2 hoeng2 jyu6 sing6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅在香港享有盛誉。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant enjoys a great reputation in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅醫術享譽國際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji1 seot6 hoeng2 jyu6 gwok3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的医术享誉国际。
examples.english_sentence: His medical skills are renowned internationally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位作家享譽文壇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 zok3 gaa1 hoeng2 jyu6 man4 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位作家享誉文坛。
examples.english_sentence: This writer enjoys a reputation in the literary world.

english_meaning: to enjoy a great reputation; to be highly renowned; to be famous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物享有极高的声誉和名望，通常是经过长期积累获得的。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that enjoys a very high reputation and fame, usually acquired over a long period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李小龍係一位享負盛名嘅武術家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 siu2 lung4 hai6 jat1 wai2 hoeng2 fu6 sing4 ming4 ge3 mou5 seot6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李小龙是一位享负盛名的武术家。
examples.english_sentence: Bruce Lee is a highly renowned martial artist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心享負盛名，好多遊客都慕名而嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hoeng2 fu6 sing4 ming4, hou2 do1 jau4 haak3 dou1 mou6 ming4 ji4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心享负盛名，很多游客都慕名而来。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dim sum is highly renowned, and many tourists come here especially for it.

english_meaning: capital (of a country); Beijing
explanation_mandarin: 指首都，特指北京。
explanation_english: Refers to the capital of a country, specifically Beijing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下年去京城旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 ging1 sing4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算明年去北京旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to travel to Beijing next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 北京嘅京劇好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bak1 ging1 ge3 ging1 kek6 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 北京的京剧很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Beijing opera is very famous.

english_meaning: Peking opera, Beijing opera
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国戏曲剧种，以北京为中心，融合了多种地方戏曲的特点。
explanation_english: A form of Chinese opera, centered in Beijing, which integrates features from various regional opera styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候阿嫲成日帶我去睇京劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 aa3 maa4 seng4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 tai2 ging1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候奶奶经常带我去看京剧。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, my grandma often took me to watch Peking opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對京劇嘅造詣好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ging1 kek6 ge3 zou6 ngai6 hou2 sam1.

explanation_english: Refers to the capital city of a country or an important city.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想去首都发展。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to develop his career in the capital city.

english_meaning: Capital city
explanation_mandarin: 古代指京都，通常指首都。现较少单独使用，多见于古文或地名。
explanation_english: Ancient term for the capital city. Nowadays, it's rarely used alone and mostly appears in classical texts or place names.

examples.english_sentence: Beijing used to be called the capital city (京师).

english_meaning: dried fruits; preserved fruits
explanation_mandarin: 指北京出产的干果、蜜饯等食品。也泛指各种干果和蜜饯。
explanation_english: Refers to dried fruits and preserved fruits originally from Beijing. It is now a general term for various dried and preserved fruits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，屋企通常都會買啲京果嚟招呼客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, uk1 kei2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 maai5 di1 ging1 gwo2 lai4 zaau1 wu1 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，家里通常都会买一些干果来招待客人。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, families usually buy some dried fruits to entertain guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意食京果，尤其係杏脯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 ging1 gwo2, jau4 kei4 hai6 hang6 pou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢吃干果，尤其是杏脯。
examples.english_sentence: He likes eating dried fruits very much, especially dried apricots.

english_meaning: capital region, the area surrounding the capital
explanation_mandarin: 指首都附近的地方。范围通常包括首都和附近的州或省份。
explanation_english: Refers to the area surrounding the capital city. It typically includes the capital and nearby provinces or states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家北京嘅京畿一帶發展得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 bak1 ging1 ge3 ging1 gei1 jat1 daai3 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在北京的京畿一带发展得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The area surrounding Beijing is developing very fast now.

english_meaning: Peking cuisine; Beijing cuisine
explanation_mandarin: 指北京地区的菜肴，以宫廷菜和烤鸭闻名。
explanation_english: Refers to the cuisine of the Beijing region, famous for its imperial cuisine and Peking duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食京菜嘅北京填鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 ging1 coi3 ge3 bak1 ging1 tin4 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢吃北京菜的北京烤鸭。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating Peking duck from Beijing cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅京菜做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ging1 coi3 zou6 dak1 hou2 zeng3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的北京菜做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's Peking cuisine is very authentic.

english_meaning: Scallion, spring onion, green onion
explanation_mandarin: 一种葱，比普通葱长而粗，味道也更浓郁。
explanation_english: A type of onion that is longer and thicker than regular onions, and has a stronger flavor. Commonly used in Cantonese and other Chinese cuisines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋煮薑蔥炒蟹要用京葱至好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu2 goeng1 cung1 caau2 haai5 jiu3 yung6 ging1 cung1 zi3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做姜葱炒蟹要用大葱才好吃。
examples.english_sentence: We need to use scallions to make ginger and scallion crab taste good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟京葱爆牛肉真係好惹味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 ging1 cung1 baau3 ngau4 juk6 zan1 hai6 hou2 je5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘大葱爆牛肉真是很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of scallion beef stir-fry is really delicious.

english_meaning: Scallion; green onion; Welsh onion; spring onion
explanation_mandarin: 一种葱，茎粗大，常用作调味品。
explanation_english: A type of onion with a thick stem, commonly used as a seasoning in cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲京蔥返嚟炒牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 ging1 cung1 faan1 lai4 caau2 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一些大葱回来炒牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some scallions to stir-fry with beef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個湯加啲京蔥會更加香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tong1 gaa1 di1 ging1 cung1 wui5 gang3 gaa1 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个汤加点大葱会更香。
examples.english_sentence: Adding some scallions to this soup will make it more fragrant.

english_meaning: Kyoto
explanation_mandarin: 日本古都京都的名称
explanation_english: Name of Kyoto, the ancient capital of Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下年去京都睇櫻花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 ging1 dou1 tai2 ying1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算明年去京都看樱花。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to go to Kyoto next year to see the cherry blossoms.

english_meaning: Hot and Sour Soup
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤菜汤品，类似于酸辣汤，但具体配料和味道可能略有不同。通常以酸辣的味道为主。
explanation_english: A Cantonese soup dish, similar to hot and sour soup, but with potentially different ingredients and a slightly different flavor profile. It generally features a sour and spicy taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想飲碗京都汁，暖下胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 soeng2 jam2 wun2 ging1 dou1 zap1, nün5 haa5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想喝一碗酸辣汤，暖暖胃。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I want to drink a bowl of hot and sour soup to warm my stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅京都汁做得唔錯，夠酸又夠辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ging1 dou1 zap1 zou6 dak1 m4 co3, gau3 syun1 jau6 gau3 laat6.

examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's hot and sour soup is pretty good, it's sour and spicy enough.

english_meaning: Spareribs, pork ribs (usually cooked with a sweet and sour sauce)
explanation_mandarin: 一种烹饪方式制作的排骨，通常带有甜酸口味。起源可能与京菜有关，但具体已不可考。
explanation_english: Spareribs or pork ribs prepared in a specific style, typically with a sweet and sour sauce. The origin may be related to Beijing cuisine, but this is not definitively proven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日想食京都骨，唔知邊度有得賣呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 ging1 dou1 gwat1, m4 zi1 bin1 dou6 jau5 dak1 maai6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天想吃京都排骨，不知道哪里有卖呢？
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat Kyoto spareribs today, I wonder where I can buy some?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅京都骨整得好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ging1 dou1 gwat1 zing2 dak1 hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的京都排骨做得很好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: The Kyoto spareribs at this restaurant are delicious!

english_meaning: pavilion, kiosk
explanation_mandarin: 一种有顶无墙的建筑物，通常在花园或公园里。
explanation_english: A light, open structure, usually in a park or garden, with a roof but no walls; a pavilion or kiosk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺公園嘅亭入面休息一陣啦。

examples.english_sentence: Let's take a rest in the pavilion in the park.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 loeng4 ting4 jap6 min6 king1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在凉亭里聊天。
examples.english_sentence: They are chatting inside the pavilion.

english_meaning: slender and graceful; (of a woman) standing tall and graceful
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子身材修长苗条，姿态美好。
explanation_english: Describes a woman as being slender and graceful, with a beautiful posture. Often used to describe a young woman growing into adulthood and displaying elegance.

examples.english_sentence: Her daughter has grown up, standing tall and graceful, she's really beautiful.

examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 keoi5 hou2 paa3 cau2, gu2 m4 dou3 ji4 gaa1 bin3 sing4 zo2 go3 ting4 ting4 juk6 lap6 ge3 siu2 neoi2.

examples.english_sentence: She was very shy when she was young, I didn't expect her to have grown into such a slender and graceful young lady.

english_meaning: graceful and slender (of a woman); standing tall and graceful like a jade tree
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子身材修长苗条，体态优美。
explanation_english: Describes a woman as being tall and slender, with a graceful and elegant figure. It often implies beauty and refinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女越嚟越亭亭玉立，真係好靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi2 yuet6 lai4 yuet6 ting4 ting4 juk6 lap6, zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 neoi2.

examples.english_sentence: Her daughter is becoming more and more graceful and slender, she's really a beautiful woman.

english_meaning: pavilion; gazebo; kiosk
explanation_mandarin: 一种供人休息、避雨的建筑物，通常建在公园、花园等地。

english_meaning: bright; shiny; light
explanation_mandarin: 形容光线充足，明亮。也可以形容声音洪亮。
explanation_english: Describes something that is bright, shiny, or full of light. Can also describe a loud and clear voice.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 go3 taai3 joeng4 hou2 loeng6 aa3.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 loeng6, jat1 teng1 zau6 jing6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音很洪亮，一听就认得。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very loud and clear; you can recognize it immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房裝咗新燈，光猛咗好多，亮曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 zong1 zo2 san1 dang1, gwong1 maang5 zo2 hou2 do1, loeng6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间装了新灯，亮了很多，整个都亮堂了。

english_meaning: light; brightness; gleam
explanation_mandarin: 指物体发出的光芒，或者光线明亮的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the light emitted by an object, or the state of being bright and illuminated.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间没有窗户，所以没有什么光亮。
examples.english_sentence: The room has no windows, so there's not much light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢眼入面充滿住希望嘅亮光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan5 juk1 min6 cung1 mun5 zyu6 hei1 mong6 ge3 loeng6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼睛里充满了希望的光芒。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes were full of the gleam of hope.

mandarin_meaning: 拿出, 展示, 亮出来

explanation_english: To bring out (something that was hidden or not obvious); to display or reveal something.

examples.english_sentence: He revealed his evidence to prove his innocence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢亮出佢嘅新電話，好威水呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng6 ceot1 keoi5 ge3 san1 din6 waa2, hou2 wai1 seoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他亮出了他的新电话，好威风啊。

english_meaning: brightness, luminance

english_meaning: sparkling; glistening; twinkling

examples.mandarin_sentence: 星星在天上亮闪闪地闪耀。
examples.english_sentence: The stars are sparkling in the sky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對眼充滿希望，亮晶晶咁望住我。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鑽石亮晶晶，好吸引人。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 钻石亮闪闪的，非常吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The diamonds are sparkling and very attractive.

mandarin_meaning: 亮起灯, 显示结果 (通常指考试成绩)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日放榜，希望可以亮燈啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 fong3 bong2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 loeng6 dang1 laa1!

examples.english_sentence: My results will be released tomorrow, I hope I pass!

english_meaning: bright and beautiful; radiant; gorgeous
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物颜色鲜明美丽，光彩夺目。
explanation_english: Describing something as brightly colored and beautiful, dazzling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗件好亮麗嘅裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hou2 loeng6 lai6 ge3 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一条非常亮丽的裙子。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a very bright and beautiful dress today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市嘅夜景好亮麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 je6 ging2 hou2 loeng6 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个城市的夜景非常亮丽。
examples.english_sentence: The night view of this city is very beautiful.

english_meaning: two, both
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语中表示“二”或“两个”。较为口语化的表达方式。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, a colloquial way of saying "two" or "both". It's a more informal way of expressing the number two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有亱個人喺度傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 je2 go3 jan4 hai2 dou6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有两个人在那里聊天。
examples.english_sentence: There are two people chatting there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗亱個蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 je2 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了两个苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two apples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋亱個一齊去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 je2 go3 jat1 cai4 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们俩一起去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's both go together.

mandarin_meaning: 亲爱的, 亲近, 亲吻
english_meaning: dear, close, intimate, to kiss
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系密切，感情深厚；也指亲吻的动作。
explanation_english: Describes a close and affectionate relationship; also refers to the act of kissing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亲，我爱你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: can1, ngo5 oi3 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 亲爱的，我爱你！
examples.english_sentence: Dear, I love you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个好亲密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 can1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个很亲密。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are very close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺佢嘅脸度锡咗一下，锡佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 keoi5 ge3 lim5 dou6 sek3 zo2 jat1 haa5, sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在她的脸上亲了一下，亲她。
examples.english_sentence: He kissed her on the face, kissed her.

english_meaning: indeed; truly; really
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定，确实如此。比普通话说“的确”、“果真”等语气更重。
explanation_english: Expresses certainty and affirmation; indeed; truly; really. Carries a stronger tone than the Mandarin equivalents '的確 (díquè)' or '果真 (guǒzhēn)'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢亶係好叻㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan2 hai6 hou2 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他确实很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He is indeed very capable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事亶係要諗清楚先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 daan2 hai6 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的确需要仔细考虑清楚才行。
examples.english_sentence: This matter truly needs to be thought through carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你亶係夠膽死！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daan2 hai6 gau3 daam2 sei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是够胆大！
examples.english_sentence: You are really daring!

english_meaning: person, people, human being
explanation_mandarin: 指具有理性、感情、社会性等特征的生物；人类。
explanation_english: Refers to a human being; a member of the human race.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好多人啊，逼死人喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 do1 jan4 aa3, bik1 sei2 jan4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里好多人啊，要挤死人了！
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people here, it's suffocating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个好人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a good person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人好鍾意飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人很喜欢喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people really like to drink tea.

jyutping: jan4 jat1 sai3 mat6 jat1 sai3
english_meaning: You only live once; Life is short, make the most of it.
explanation_mandarin: 强调人生短暂，应该珍惜当下，及时行乐，做自己想做的事情，不要留下遗憾。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the brevity of life and encourages one to cherish the present, seize the day, do what one wants to do, and avoid regrets. It's similar to the English phrase 'You only live once' (YOLO).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人一世物一世，梗係要做啲自己鍾意嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jat1 sai3 mat6 jat1 sai3, gang2 hai6 jiu3 zou6 di1 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生只有一次，当然要做一些自己喜欢的事情了。
examples.english_sentence: You only live once, of course you should do things that you enjoy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人一世物一世，唔好咁慳啦，買貴啲嘅嘢獎勵下自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jat1 sai3 mat6 jat1 sai3, m4 hou2 gam3 haan1 laa1, maai5 gwai3 di1 ge3 je5 zoeng2 lai6 haa5 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生只有一次，不要那么节省了，买贵一点的东西奖励一下自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: You only live once, don't be so frugal, buy yourself something nice as a reward.

english_meaning: population; male offspring; manpower
explanation_mandarin: 指人口，尤指男丁。
explanation_english: Refers to the population, especially male offspring/men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條村嘅人丁越嚟越少喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 ge3 jan4 ding1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 siu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个村子的人口越来越少了。
examples.english_sentence: The population of this village is getting smaller and smaller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企人丁單薄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 jan4 ding1 daan1 bok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家男丁稀少。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has few male offspring/manpower.

english_meaning: small population; sparsely populated (referring to a family or group); having few descendants
explanation_mandarin: 形容家族或团体人丁稀少，后代不多。
explanation_english: Describes a family or group with a small population and few descendants. It usually implies that the family line is thin and vulnerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰條村人丁單薄，好多後生仔都搬走晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 tiu4 cyun1 jan4 ding1 daan1 bok6, hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 bun1 zau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那个村子人丁稀少，很多年轻人都搬走了。
examples.english_sentence: Their village has a small population; many young people have moved away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個家族一代不如一代，依家人丁單薄咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ga1 zuk6 jat1 doi6 bat1 jyu4 jat1 doi6, ji1 gaa1 jan4 ding1 daan1 bok6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个家族一代不如一代，现在人口单薄了很多。
examples.english_sentence: This family is not as prosperous as it used to be, and the population is much smaller now.

jyutping: jan4 bat1 ho2 ji5 maau6 soeng3
english_meaning: You can't judge a book by its cover; appearances can be deceiving.
explanation_mandarin: 不能只凭外貌来判断人。意思是说人的外貌和内心往往不一致，不能以外貌取人。
explanation_english: You shouldn't judge people based solely on their appearance. It means that a person's inner qualities and character are often different from how they look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好似好惡，但係人唔可以貌相，其實佢好熱心幫人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 ci5 hou2 ok3, daan6 hai6 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 maau6 soeng3, kei4 sat6 keoi5 hou2 jit6 sam1 bong1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来很凶，但是人不可貌相，其实他很热心帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: He looks fierce, but you can't judge a book by its cover. Actually, he's very helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快否定佢，人唔可以貌相㗎，畀個機會佢試吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fau2 ding6 keoi5, jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 maau6 soeng3 gaa3, bei2 go3 gei1 wui2 keoi5 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快否定他，人不可貌相，给他一个机会试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dismiss him so quickly. You can't judge a book by its cover. Give him a chance to try.

jyutping: jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6
english_meaning: If a person doesn't look out for himself, heaven and earth will destroy him (a common misinterpretation implying selfishness); Look out for yourself, or you'll be ruined.
explanation_mandarin: 这句话常被误解为鼓励自私自利，实际上，其原本含义是如果人不去修身养性，就会为天地所不容。现代常被用作一种调侃的说法，表示人要为自己打算，不为自己着想就会吃亏。
explanation_english: This phrase is often misinterpreted as advocating selfishness. Its original meaning is that if a person does not cultivate self-improvement, they will be rejected by heaven and earth. In modern usage, it is often used ironically to indicate that one must look out for oneself, or one will suffer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱，做嘢千祈唔好咁老實，人不為己，天誅地滅㗎嘛！
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa4, zou6 je5 cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 gam3 lou5 sat6, jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6 gaa3 maa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 告诉你，工作千万不要太老实，人不为己，天诛地灭嘛！
examples.english_sentence: Listen, don't be too honest at work. If you don't look out for yourself, you'll be ruined!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孤寒，真係應驗咗人不為己，天誅地滅呢句說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4, zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2 jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6 ni1句seot3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么吝啬，真是应验了人不为己，天诛地灭这句话。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy, it really fulfills the saying: 'If a person doesn't look out for himself, he'll be ruined.'

jyutping: jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6
english_meaning: If people don't look out for themselves, heaven and earth will condemn them (to destruction).
explanation_mandarin: 强调人应该为自己着想，否则会遭受天谴。这句话通常带有负面含义，用于批评自私自利的行为，但有时也被用于为个人行为辩解。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes that people should look out for their own interests, or they will be punished by heaven and earth. It often carries a negative connotation and is used to criticize selfish behavior, but it can also be used to justify one's actions by implying necessity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住自己，真係應驗咗「人不爲己，天誅地滅」呢句說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 zi6 gei2, zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2 "jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6" ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着自己，真是应验了“人不为己，天诛地灭”这句话。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks of himself; it really embodies the saying, "If people don't look out for themselves, heaven and earth will condemn them."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會生存，有時都要咁諗，唔係嘅話就蝕底㗎啦，人不為己，天誅地滅嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2 sang1 cyun4, jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 gam2 nam2, m4 hai6 ge3 waa6 zau6 sit6 dai2 gaa3 laa1, jan4 bat1 wai4 gei2, tin1 zyu1 dei6 mit6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会生存，有时候也要这么想，不然的话就会吃亏的，人不为己，天诛地灭嘛。
examples.english_sentence: In order to survive in this society, sometimes you have to think this way, or you'll get the short end of the stick. 'If people don't look out for themselves, heaven and earth will condemn them,' after all.

english_meaning: the world; human life; mortal life
explanation_mandarin: 指人类居住的世界，人间。
explanation_english: Refers to the world inhabited by humans; the mortal world; human life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經離開咗人世好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 lei4 hoi1 zo2 jan4 sai3 hou2 noi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经离开人世很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has passed away a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人世間，好多嘢都係冇辦法預料嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jan4 sai3 gaan1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3 jyu6 liu6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在人世间，很多事情都是没有办法预料的。
examples.english_sentence: In this world, many things are unpredictable.

english_meaning: philtrum (the vertical groove between the base of the nose and the upper lip)
explanation_mandarin: 指鼻子和上唇之间的那条纵沟。
explanation_english: The vertical groove between the base of the nose and the border of the upper lip; the philtrum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個人中好長喎，聽講人中長嘅人會比較長命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 jan4 zung1 hou2 coeng4 wo3, ting1 gong2 jan4 zung1 coeng4 ge3 jan4 wui5 bei2 gaau3 coeng4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的人中很长，据说人中长的人会比较长寿。
examples.english_sentence: Your philtrum is very long. It's said that people with long philtrums tend to live longer.

english_meaning: dragon among men; an outstanding person; a person of exceptional talent and ability
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人中豪杰，杰出的人才。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a hero among men, an outstanding talent. It describes a person of exceptional ability, often with leadership qualities and great potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就表現出過人嘅天賦，真係人中之龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 biu2 hin3 chut1 gwo3 jan4 ge3 tin1 fu6, zan1 hai6 jan4 zung1 zi1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就表现出过人的天赋，真是人中之龙。
examples.english_sentence: He showed extraordinary talent from a young age, truly a dragon among men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面好快就升職，大家都話佢係人中之龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zik1, daai6 ga1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 jan4 zung1 zi1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里很快就升职了，大家都说他是人中之龙。
examples.english_sentence: He was promoted quickly in the company, everyone says he's a dragon among men.

english_meaning: Person among dragons and phoenixes; outstanding individual; a paragon of virtue and talent
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人中豪杰，十分杰出的人才。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone who is an outstanding individual, a paragon of virtue and talent, someone who stands out among others; literally, "a dragon and phoenix among people."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做到經理，真係人中龍鳳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 dou3 ging1 lei5, zan1 hai6 jan4 zung1 lung4 fung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当上了经理，真是人中龙凤。
examples.english_sentence: He became a manager at such a young age; he's truly an outstanding individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個比賽嘅冠軍，絕對係人中龍鳳，實力非凡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 ge3 gwun1 gwan3, zyut6 deoi3 hai6 jan4 zung1 lung4 fung6, sat6 lik6 fei1 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个比赛的冠军，绝对是人中龙凤，实力非凡。
examples.english_sentence: The champion of this competition is definitely an outstanding individual with extraordinary abilities.

english_meaning: human nature; natural human feelings; only to be expected
explanation_mandarin: 指一般人通常具有的感情或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the feelings or behaviors that ordinary people usually have; it's only natural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁傷心都好正常啫，人之常情嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 soeng1 sam1 dou1 hou2 zeng3 soeng4 ze1, jan4 zi1 soeng4 cing4 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么伤心也很正常，这是人之常情嘛。
