examples.english_sentence: It's normal for him to be so sad. It's only human nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到咁嘅情況，忍唔住出手幫忙都係人之常情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gam3 ge3 cing4 fong3, jan2 m4 zyu6 ceot1 sau2 bong1 mong4 dou1 hai6 jan4 zi1 soeng4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这种情况，忍不住出手帮忙也是人之常情。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing this situation, it's only natural to want to help.

mandarin_meaning: 人的毛病; 人的弊病; 人性的弱点
english_meaning: Human failings; human weaknesses; the troubles or problems inherent in human nature
explanation_mandarin: 指人类普遍存在的缺点、毛病或问题，通常是负面的。
explanation_english: Refers to the common shortcomings, faults, or problems inherent in human nature. Usually implies something negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪心係人之患嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 sam1 hai6 jan4 zi1 waan6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪心是人的毛病。
examples.english_sentence: Greed is a human failing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 懶惰都係人之患，好多人都克服唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laan5 do6 dou1 hai6 jan4 zi1 waan6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 kok3 fuk1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 懒惰也是人性的弱点，很多人都克服不了。
examples.english_sentence: Laziness is also a human weakness, and many people can't overcome it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 妒忌心都係人之患，會令人做出好多壞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 gei3 sam1 dou1 hai6 jan4 zi1 waan6, wui5 ling6 jan4 zou6 ceot1 hou2 do1 waai6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫉妒心也是人的毛病，会让人做出很多坏事。
examples.english_sentence: Jealousy is also a human failing, which can cause people to do many bad things.

mandarin_meaning: 人事；人事变动；人事部门
english_meaning: personnel; human affairs; human resources; personnel changes
explanation_mandarin: 指人员方面的事情，可以指人事部门，人事变动，或者人情世故等。
explanation_english: Refers to personnel matters, which can refer to the human resources department, personnel changes, or human relationships and worldly wisdom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺人事部做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jan4 si6 bou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在人事部工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in the human resources department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近有好多人事變動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 si6 bin3 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近有很多的人事变动。
examples.english_sentence: The company has had a lot of personnel changes recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係基本嘅人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 gei1 bun2 ge3 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是基本的人情世故。
examples.english_sentence: These are all basic human affairs/worldly wisdom.

english_meaning: Human Resources Department
explanation_mandarin: 负责处理人员招聘、培训、薪资福利等人事相关事务的部门。
explanation_english: The department responsible for handling personnel-related matters such as recruitment, training, salary and benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺人事科做緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jan4 si6 fo1 zou6 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在人事部门工作。
examples.english_sentence: I work in the Human Resources Department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有咩問題可以問下人事科嘅同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 ho2 ji5 man6 haa5 jan4 si6 fo1 ge3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有什么问题可以问一下人事部门的同事。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any questions, you can ask the colleagues in the Human Resources Department.

synonyms: 人力資源部 (jan4 lik6 zi1 jyun4 bou6)

english_meaning: parrot; echo what others say; to have no opinion of one's own
explanation_mandarin: 指没有主见，只会重复别人说的话。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks independent thought and merely repeats what others say without their own opinion or judgement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日人云亦云，冇自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jan4 wan4 jik6 wan4, mou5 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是人云亦云，没有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He always parrots what others say and has no opinions of his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢唔好人云亦云，要獨立思考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 m4 hou2 jan4 wan4 jik6 wan4, jiu3 duk6 laap6 si1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作不要人云亦云，要独立思考。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just parrot others when working, you need to think independently.

english_meaning: everyone, everybody, each person
explanation_mandarin: 指每一个人，所有的人。
explanation_english: Refers to every person, all people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人人都想發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jan4 dou1 soeng2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人都想发达。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone wants to get rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度人人都講廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jan4 jan4 dou1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里每个人都说广东话。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone here speaks Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人人都知佢好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jan4 dou1 zi1 geoi5 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人都知道他很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone knows he's very capable.

jyutping: jan4 jan4 dak1 ji5 zyu1 zi1
english_meaning: Everyone is entitled to punish (him/her/it); Deserving of universal condemnation.
explanation_mandarin: 指某人罪大恶极，大家都应该起来杀掉他。表示痛恨某人到极点。
explanation_english: This idiom means that a person's crimes are so heinous that everyone is entitled to punish or kill them. It expresses extreme hatred towards someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，真係人人得以誅之。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, zan1 hai6 jan4 jan4 dak1 ji5 zyu1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么坏，真是人人得而诛之。
examples.english_sentence: He is so bad, he truly deserves to be punished by everyone.

jyutping: jan4 jan4 dak1 ji4 zyu1 zi1
english_meaning: Everyone has the right to kill him; deserving of universal condemnation and punishment; an outrage to public decency.
explanation_mandarin: 指某人罪大恶极，人人都应该杀掉他。表示对罪恶的极端憎恨。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is so evil that everyone has the right to kill them. Expresses extreme hatred for evil deeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅嘢咁喪盡天良，簡直係人人得而誅之！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 gam3 song3 zeon6 tin1 loeng4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jan4 jan4 dak1 ji4 zyu1 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情如此丧尽天良，简直是人人得而诛之！
examples.english_sentence: What he did was so depraved that he deserves to be killed by everyone!

english_meaning: Everyone feels insecure; everyone is in a state of alarm; everyone is afraid for their own safety.
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人都感到自身处境危险，感到恐惧或不安。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone feels threatened or unsafe, leading to fear and anxiety. Implies a general atmosphere of insecurity and potential danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員消息一出，搞到人人自危。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 caai4 jyun4 siu1 sik1 jat1 ceot1, gaau2 dou3 jan4 jan4 zi6 ngai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁员的消息一出，搞得人人自危。
examples.english_sentence: The announcement of company layoffs caused everyone to feel insecure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個政治環境下，好多人都人人自危，唔敢亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 zing3 zi6 waan4 ging2 haa6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 jan4 jan4 zi6 ngai4, m4 gam2 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种政治环境下，很多人都感到人人自危，不敢乱说话。
examples.english_sentence: In this political climate, many people feel insecure and are afraid to speak carelessly.

english_meaning: RMB, Renminbi, Chinese Yuan
explanation_mandarin: 指人民币，是中国大陆的法定货币单位。
explanation_english: Refers to Renminbi (RMB), the official currency of mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話幾錢啊？要成五千人仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 gei2 cin2 aa3? jiu3 sing4 ng5 cin1 jan4 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机多少钱啊？要五千人民币呢！
examples.english_sentence: How much is this phone? It costs 5000 RMB!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港用銀聯卡直接嘟人仔都得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2 jung6 ngan4 lyun4 kaat1 zik6 zip3 du1 jan4 zai2 dou1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港用银联卡直接刷人民币也可以的。
examples.english_sentence: I can directly pay in RMB using UnionPay card in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: small person; little person
explanation_mandarin: 形容人身材矮小。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being small in stature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人仔細細，但係好叻仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 zai2 sai3 sai3, daan6 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他个子小小的，但是很聪明的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a small person, but he's very smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人仔細細唔好咁大聲講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 zai2 sai3 sai3 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不要这么大声说话。
examples.english_sentence: Little kids shouldn't speak so loudly.

mandarin_meaning: 人仰马翻 (rén yǎng mǎ fān)
english_meaning: A chaotic and disorderly scene; utter confusion; complete disorder; all in a state of chaos.
explanation_mandarin: 形容混乱或失败的景象，通常指场面混乱、秩序颠倒，或指事情彻底失败，一败涂地。
explanation_english: Describes a chaotic or failed scene, usually referring to a chaotic situation, disordered order, or a complete failure, a total defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日個演唱會發生咗啲意外，搞到人仰馬翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 go3 jin2 cheung3 wui2 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 ji3 ngoi6, gaau2 dou3 jan4 joeng5 maa5 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天的演唱会发生了一些意外，搞得人仰马翻。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday's concert had some accidents, causing complete chaos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨之後，條街都人仰馬翻，啲嘢散哂噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, tiu4 gaai1 dou1 jan4 joeng5 maa5 faan1, di1 ye5 saan3 saai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨之后，这条街都人仰马翻，东西散落一地。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, the street was in complete disarray, with things scattered everywhere.

synonyms: 亂七八糟 (luan6 cat1 baat3 zou1)
一塌糊塗 (jat1 taap3 wu4 tou4)

english_meaning: people coming and going; busy traffic; bustling with activity
explanation_mandarin: 形容来来往往的人很多，非常热闹。
explanation_english: Describes a place with a lot of people coming and going, very lively and bustling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年宵市場人來人往，好鬼熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 siu1 si5 coeng4 jan4 loi4 jan4 wong5, hou2 gwai2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年宵市场人来人往，非常热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The Lunar New Year flower market is bustling with people coming and going, very lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係商業區，日頭人來人往，夜晚就靜晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 soeng1 jip6 khu1, jat6 tau4 jan4 loi4 jan4 wong5, je6 maan5 zau6 zing6晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是商业区，白天人来人往，晚上就安静了。
examples.english_sentence: This is a commercial district. There are a lot of people coming and going during the day, but it's quiet at night.

english_meaning: people; persons
explanation_mandarin: 指一群人，通常指不特定的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people; usually unspecified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲人們好注重健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 jan4 mun4 hou2 zyu3 zung6 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人们很注重健康。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people pay a lot of attention to their health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上面有好多人們行嚟行去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 mun4 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上有很多人们走来走去。
examples.english_sentence: There are many people walking back and forth on the street.

english_meaning: human relationships; the five cardinal relationships
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间应有的正常关系和道德规范。尤其指封建社会提倡的君臣、父子、夫妇、兄弟、朋友五种基本关系，以及维系这些关系的道德规范。
explanation_english: Refers to the normal relationships and moral principles that should exist between people. It particularly refers to the five cardinal relationships advocated in feudal society: ruler and subject, father and son, husband and wife, elder and younger brother, and friend, as well as the moral principles that maintain these relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆成日嘈交，真係破壞晒人倫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, zan1 hai6 po3 waai6 saai3 jan4 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两口子整天吵架，真是破坏了人伦。
examples.english_sentence: They quarrel all the time, it really damages the proper human relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳統社會好重視人倫關係，例如孝順父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tyun2 tung2 se5 wui2 hou2 zung6 si6 jan4 leon4 gwaan1 hai6, laap6 jyu4 haau3 seon2 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传统社会很重视人伦关系，例如孝顺父母。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional society places great importance on human relationships, such as filial piety to parents.

english_meaning: a place produces outstanding people
explanation_mandarin: 杰出的人才和优美的地方相互辉映。形容一个地方有出类拔萃的人才，也形容这个地方是个好地方。
explanation_english: A place produces outstanding people due to its favorable environment and resources; also implies that the place itself is blessed and special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方真係人傑地靈，出咗好多名人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 zan1 hai6 jan4 git6 dei6 ling4, ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方真是人杰地灵，出了很多名人。
examples.english_sentence: This place is truly a place that produces outstanding people; many celebrities have come from here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日話香港人傑地靈，所以我哋要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 waa6 Hoeng1 Gong2 jan4 git6 dei6 ling4, so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说香港人杰地灵，所以我们要更加努力。
examples.english_sentence: They always say Hong Kong is a place that produces outstanding people, so we need to work harder.

english_meaning: person-to-person transmission
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病或信息通过人与人之间的接触传播。
explanation_english: Refers to the transmission of a disease or information through contact between people.  Describes the mode of spread for contagious diseases or information dissemination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻病係人傳人㗎，所以要戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 beng6 hai6 jan4 cyun4 jan4 gaa3, so2 ji5 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种病是人传人的，所以要戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: This disease is transmitted person-to-person, so you need to wear a mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單新聞好快人傳人咁傳開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 san1 man4 hou2 faai3 jan4 cyun4 jan4 gam2 cyun4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条新闻很快就人传人地传开了。
examples.english_sentence: The news spread very quickly, person to person.

english_meaning: portrait
explanation_mandarin: 以人物为题材的画像或雕像。
explanation_english: A painting, drawing, photograph, or sculpture of a person, especially one depicting only the face or head and shoulders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你畫張人像啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 waak6 zoeng1 jan4 zoeng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你画一张人像吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll draw a portrait of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅人像畫得好生動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 jan4 zoeng6 waa2 dak1 hou2 saang1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅人像画得很生动。
examples.english_sentence: This portrait is painted very vividly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人像雕塑喺博物館展出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 zoeng6 diu1 suk3 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人像雕塑在博物馆展出。
examples.english_sentence: His portrait sculpture is on display at the museum.

jyutping: jan4 cin4 jan4 hau6 loeng5 go3 joeng2
english_meaning: Two-faced; different behaviour in public and in private; a Jekyll and Hyde personality
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人在人前和人后表现出截然不同的样子，表里不一，虚伪。
explanation_english: Describes someone who behaves completely differently in public and in private, indicating hypocrisy and being two-faced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老闆面前好勤力咁，人前人後兩個樣，放工就乜都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2, jan4 cin4 jan4 hau6 loeng5 go3 joeng2, fong3 gung1 zau6 mat1 dou1 bat1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前很勤奋，但人前人后两副面孔，下班后什么都不管。
examples.english_sentence: He pretends to be very diligent in front of the boss, but he's two-faced, and doesn't care about anything after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，佢人前人後兩個樣㗎，講一套做一套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 jan4 cin4 jan4 hau6 loeng5 go3 joeng2 gaa3, gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他人前人后两副面孔，说一套做一套。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he's two-faced, he says one thing and does another.

english_meaning: manpower; human resources; labor
explanation_mandarin: 指人的劳动能力；劳动力。
explanation_english: Refers to the labor capacity of people; workforce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司唔夠人力，好多嘢都做唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 m4 gau3 jan4 lik6, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 zou6 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司人手不够，很多事情都做不完。
examples.english_sentence: The company doesn't have enough manpower, and many things can't be finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目需要大量人力去完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 loeng6 jan4 lik6 heoi3 wan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目需要大量人力才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This project requires a lot of manpower to complete.

english_meaning: Human Resources (HR)
explanation_mandarin: 指组织中管理员工、招聘、培训、薪酬福利等方面的部门或职能。
explanation_english: The department or function within an organization that manages employees, including recruitment, training, compensation, and benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺間公司嘅人力資源部做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 lik6 zi1 jyun4 bou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公司的人力资源部工作。
examples.english_sentence: I work in the Human Resources department of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請緊人力資源經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cheng2 gan2 jan4 lik6 zi1 jyun4 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在招聘人力资源经理。
examples.english_sentence: They are hiring a Human Resources manager.

english_meaning: Rickshaw; jinricksha
explanation_mandarin: 一种由人力拉动的双轮 транспортное средство，旧时常见。
explanation_english: A two-wheeled vehicle pulled by a person, commonly seen in the old days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時香港有好多人力車，但係依家已經冇晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 lik6 ce1, daan6 hai6 ji1 ga1 ji5 ging1 mou5 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时香港有很多黄包车，但是现在已经没有了。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many rickshaws in Hong Kong, but now they're all gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠拉人力車嚟養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 laai1 jan4 lik6 ce1 lai4 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠拉黄包车来养家。
examples.english_sentence: He supports his family by pulling a rickshaw.

english_meaning: The people have left, and the building is empty; deserted; abandoned
explanation_mandarin: 人已离去，楼房空空如也。形容人去后留下的凄凉景象。
explanation_english: Describes a desolate scene after people have left a place, leaving it empty and forlorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家搬走咗之後，間屋就人去樓空，好淒涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 bun1 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, gaan1 uk1 zau6 jan4 heoi3 lau4 hung1, hou2 cai1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家搬走之后，房子就人去楼空，很凄凉。
examples.english_sentence: After their family moved away, the house became deserted, it's very desolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工廠執咗笠之後，成個工業區都好似人去樓空咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cong2 zap1 zo2 lap1 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 gung1 jip6 keoi1 dou1 hou2 ci5 jan4 heoi3 lau4 hung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工厂倒闭之后，整个工业区都好像人去楼空一样。
examples.english_sentence: After this factory closed down, the entire industrial area feels deserted.

english_meaning: ginseng
explanation_mandarin: 一种名贵的药材，多年生草本植物的根，有滋补强身的作用。
explanation_english: A valuable medicinal herb; the root of a perennial herbaceous plant, known for its tonic and strengthening properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日話人參好補㗎，叫我哋得閒煲啲嚟飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 waa6 jan4 sam1 hou2 bou2 gaa3, giu3 ngo5 dei6 dak1 haan4 bou1 di1 lai4 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是说人参很补，叫我们有空煲一些来喝。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always says ginseng is very nourishing and tells us to boil some to drink when we have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，醫生建議佢食啲人參補吓身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 sik6 di1 jan4 sam1 bou2 haa5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，医生建议他吃些人参补补身体。
examples.english_sentence: He has been sick for a long time, and the doctor suggested he take some ginseng to strengthen his body.

jyutping: jan4 jau6 lou5, cin2 jau6 mou5
english_meaning: Old and broke; getting old and having no money.
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪大了，经济状况也不好，生活比较窘迫。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is getting old and also doesn't have money, indicating a difficult and impoverished life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢做到成身病，到時人又老，錢又冇，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 zou3 dou3 sing4 san1 beng6, dou3 si4 jan4 jau6 lou5, cin2 jau6 mou5, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作搞得一身病，到时候人也老了，钱也没有了，真是惨。
examples.english_sentence: Working until you get sick, by then you'll be old and broke, it's really miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔好好儲錢，第日咪人又老，錢又冇囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 hou2 hou2 cyu5 cin2, dai6 jat6 mai1 jan4 jau6 lou5, cin2 jau6 mou5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不努力存钱，以后不就是人老了，钱也没了嘛。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't save money properly, won't you end up old and broke in the future?

english_meaning: crowd, throng, multitude of people
explanation_mandarin: 指聚集在一起的人群。
explanation_english: Refers to a gathering of people, a crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好逼入人叢呀，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bik1 jap6 jan4 cung4 aa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要挤进人群，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't squeeze into the crowd, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺人叢入面搵唔到你呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jan4 cung4 jap6 min6 wan2 m4 dou2 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在人群里找不到你。
examples.english_sentence: I can't find you in the crowd.

english_meaning: population
explanation_mandarin: 指一个地区或国家居住的总人数。
explanation_english: The total number of people living in a specific area or country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人口密度好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 hau2 mat6 dou6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的人口密度很高。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's population density is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年香港嘅人口有下跌嘅趨勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 hau2 jau5 haa6 dit3 ge3 ceoi1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来香港的人口有下跌的趋势。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, Hong Kong's population has had a downward trend.

english_meaning: population structure; demographic structure
explanation_mandarin: 指一个地区或国家的人口在年龄、性别、职业、教育程度等方面的构成情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the composition of a region's or country's population in terms of age, gender, occupation, education level, and other demographics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人口結構老化問題越來越嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 hau2 git3 kau3 lou5 faa3 man6 tai4 jyuet6 lai4 jyuet6 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的人口结构老龄化问题越来越严重。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's population aging problem is becoming increasingly serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府需要關注人口結構嘅變化，制定相應嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 gwaan1 zyu3 jan4 hau2 git3 kau3 ge3 bin3 faa3, zai3 ding6 soeng1 jing3 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府需要关注人口结构的变化，制定相应的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to pay attention to changes in population structure and formulate corresponding policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人口結構直接影響勞動力供應同埋社會福利負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 hau2 git3 kau3 zik6 zip3 jing2 hoeng2 lou4 dung6 lik6 gung1 jing3 tung4 maai4 se5 wui2 fuk1 lei6 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人口结构直接影响劳动力供应和社会福利负担。
examples.english_sentence: Population structure directly affects labor supply and social welfare burden.

english_meaning: human trafficking
explanation_mandarin: 指以暴力、欺骗等手段非法买卖人口的行为。
explanation_english: The illegal trade of human beings for the purposes of commercial sexual exploitation or forced labor: a modern-day form of slavery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人口販賣係一種非常嚴重嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan4 hau2 faan3 maai6 hai6 yat1 zung2 fei1 seung4 yim4 zung6 ge3 zui6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人口贩卖是一种非常严重的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: Human trafficking is a very serious crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方致力打擊人口販賣集團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zhi3 lik6 daa2 gik1 yan4 hau2 faan3 maai6 jit6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方致力于打击人口贩卖集团。
examples.english_sentence: The police are committed to combating human trafficking groups.

english_meaning: Everyone has their own aspirations; to each their own.
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人都有自己的志向和追求，不能强求一致。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone has their own ambitions, aspirations, and pursuits in life, and you shouldn't force them to conform to your own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想去外國讀書，人各有志啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1, jan4 gok3 jau5 zi3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想去国外读书，人各有志嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to study abroad. To each their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好逼佢做佢唔鍾意嘅嘢啦，人各有志㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bik1 keoi5 zou6 keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 laa1, jan4 gok3 jau5 zi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要逼他做他不喜欢的事了，人各有志嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him to do things he doesn't like. To each their own.

mandarin_meaning: 人心同理; 人同此心，心同此理
english_meaning: Everyone has the same feelings; All people share the same sentiment; Common humanity; Common sense; The same feelings or sympathies are shared by all.
explanation_mandarin: 指人们的心理、想法是一样的。强调人类共通的情感和感受，普遍存在。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the idea that people's feelings, thoughts, and desires are the same. It emphasizes the common emotions and feelings shared by all humans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢咁慘，我真係覺得人同此心，好想幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 jan4 tung4 ci2 sam1, hou2 soeng2 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么可怜，我真的觉得人同此心，很想帮助他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so miserable, I really feel a sense of common humanity and want to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道佢都唔係有心嘅，人同此心，俾次機會佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3, jan4 tung4 ci2 sam1, bei2 ci3 gei1 wui2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道他也不是故意的，人同此心，给他一次机会吧。
examples.english_sentence: I know he didn't mean to, everyone makes mistakes, give him another chance.

english_meaning: Name (of a person)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的名字。
explanation_english: Refers to the name of a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你寫低你嘅人名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 se2 dai1 nei5 ge3 jan4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你写下你的姓名。
examples.english_sentence: Please write down your name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人名我唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 ming4 ngo5 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个名字我不认识。
examples.english_sentence: I don't recognize this name.

english_meaning: human life, human lives
explanation_mandarin: 指人的生命。
explanation_english: Refers to human life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 交通意外好容易會攞走人命㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 hou2 jung4 ji6 wui5 lo2 zau2 jan4 ming6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 交通事故很容易会夺走人命的。
examples.english_sentence: Traffic accidents can easily take lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗救人命，佢哋願意冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gau3 jan4 ming6, keoi5 dei6 jyun4 ji3 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了救人命，他们愿意冒险。
examples.english_sentence: They are willing to risk their lives to save others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一條人命嚟㗎，唔係講笑!
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 tiu4 jan4 ming6 lai4 gaa3, m4 hai6 gong2 siu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一条人命，不是开玩笑！
examples.english_sentence: This is a life, it's not a joke!

english_meaning: casualties (injuries and/or deaths)
explanation_mandarin: 指人员的受伤或死亡情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of people being injured or killed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次交通意外造成咗唔少人命傷亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 zou6 sing4 zo2 m4 siu2 jan4 ming6 soeng1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次交通事故造成了不少人员伤亡。
examples.english_sentence: That traffic accident caused many casualties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震過後，救援人員正努力搜救，希望可以減少人命傷亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 gwo3 hau6, gau3 wun4 jan4 jyun4 zing3 nu5 lik6 sau1 gau3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gaan2 siu2 jan4 ming6 soeng1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震过后，救援人员正在努力搜救，希望可以减少人员伤亡。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, rescue workers are working hard to search for survivors, hoping to reduce casualties.

english_meaning: Human life is of utmost importance; a matter of life and death is of paramount importance.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人命攸关，非常重要。 指人的生命关系到天一样的大事，形容事情非常严重，应严肃对待。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the extreme importance of human life. It signifies that a matter concerning life and death is of the highest significance and should be treated with utmost seriousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢人命關天，唔可以輕率處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 jan4 ming6 gwaan1 tin1, m4 ho2 ji5 hing1 seut3 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事人命关天，不可以草率处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is of utmost importance concerning human life; it cannot be handled carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺災難現場，救人係人命關天嘅大事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zoi1 naan6 jin4 coeng4, gau3 jan4 hai6 jan4 ming6 gwaan1 tin1 ge3 daai6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在灾难现场，救人是人命关天的大事。
examples.english_sentence: At a disaster scene, saving lives is a matter of utmost importance.

english_meaning: moral character; personal integrity; reputation as a person
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的道德品质，行为作风，以及为人处世的态度。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's moral character, conduct, and attitude towards others and the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人品好好，所以好多人都信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 pan2 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人品很好，所以很多人都相信他。
examples.english_sentence: His moral character is very good, so many people trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人嘅人品真係有問題，成日講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 ge3 jan4 pan2 zan1 hai6 jau5 man6 tai4, seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人的人品真的有问题，总是说谎。
examples.english_sentence: This person's moral character is really questionable, they lie all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揀朋友好睇佢嘅人品，唔係睇佢有幾多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaan2 pang4 jau5 hou2 tai2 keoi5 ge3 jan4 pan2, m4 hai6 tai2 keoi5 jau5 gei2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我选择朋友很看重他们的人品，而不是看他们有多少钱。
examples.english_sentence: When choosing friends, I value their moral character, not how much money they have.

english_meaning: other people, others, someone else
explanation_mandarin: 指代除了自己或谈话对象之外的其他人。
explanation_english: Refers to other people besides oneself or the person being spoken to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人哋都話好食㗎，你試下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 dei6 dou1 waa6 hou2 sik6 gaa3, nei5 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别人都说很好吃，你试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Other people say it's delicious, you should try it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人哋都唔想同你玩，你咪再煩住人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 dei6 dou1 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 waan2, nei5 mai5 zoi3 faan4 zyu6 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别人都不想和你玩，你别再烦人家了。
examples.english_sentence: Other people don't want to play with you, so stop bothering them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日拎人哋啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 ling1 jan4 dei6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是拿别人的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always take other people's things.

english_meaning: personnel; staff; members
explanation_mandarin: 指从事某项工作或活动的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to people engaged in a particular job or activity; personnel; staff; members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅人員成日加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 jyun4 seng4 jat6 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的人员经常加班。
examples.english_sentence: The company's staff often works overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要更多嘅醫療人員去應付呢場疫情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 ge3 ji1 liu4 jan4 jyun4 heoi3 ying3 fu6 ni1 cheung4 yik6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多的医疗人员去应对这场疫情。
examples.english_sentence: We need more medical personnel to cope with this epidemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所有嘅工作人員都已經完成咗培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 jau5 ge3 gung1 jok3 jan4 jyun4 dou1 ji5 ging1 waan4 sing4 zo2 pui4 fun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的工作人员都已经完成了培训。
examples.english_sentence: All the staff members have completed their training.

jyutping: jan4 m4 siu3 gau2 dou1 fai6
mandarin_meaning: 连人都觉得可笑，狗都会叫
english_meaning: So ridiculous/laughable that even dogs would bark (at it)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或行为非常荒谬可笑，连狗都会感到奇怪而吠叫。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone so ridiculous or absurd that even a dog would find it strange and bark at it. It is used to express extreme ridicule or disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個髮型咁奇怪，真係人唔笑狗都吠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 faat3 ying4 gam3 kei4 gwai3, zan1 hai6 jan4 m4 siu3 gau2 dou1 fai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的发型这么奇怪，真是连人都觉得可笑，狗都会叫。
examples.english_sentence: His hairstyle is so weird, it's so ridiculous that even dogs would bark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗嘅計仔咁唔實際，人唔笑狗都吠㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 ge3 gai3 zai2 gam3 m4 sat6 zai3, jan4 m4 siu3 gau2 dou1 fai6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出的主意这么不实际，连人都觉得可笑，狗都会叫的。
examples.english_sentence: The idea you came up with is so impractical that it's so ridiculous even dogs would bark.

jyutping: jan4 m4 siu3 gwai1 dou1 gwai6
mandarin_meaning: 太离谱了，简直不可思议
english_meaning: It's so ridiculous/outrageous/absurd that even a turtle would kneel in submission/laughter; beyond belief; incredibly absurd.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情荒谬到极点，令人难以置信，甚至连乌龟都会觉得可笑而跪拜。
explanation_english: Describes something so absurd or outrageous that it's unbelievable and would even make a turtle kneel down either in submission (to the absurdity) or out of laughter. Emphasizes the extreme nature of the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然攞住張凳去追巴士，人唔笑龜都跪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 lo2 zyu6 zoeng1 dang3 heoi3 zeoi1 baa1 si2, jan4 m4 siu3 gwai1 dou1 gwai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然拿着一张凳子去追公交车，太离谱了。
examples.english_sentence: He actually chased after the bus while carrying a chair! It's unbelievably ridiculous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢信咗啲網上嘅假新聞，仲要周圍同人講，真係人唔笑龜都跪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 seon3 zo2 di1 mong5 soeng5 ge3 gaa2 san1 man4, zung6 jiu3 zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2, zan1 hai6 jan4 m4 siu3 gwai1 dou1 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他相信了网上的假新闻，还要到处跟人说，真是太离谱了。
examples.english_sentence: You're telling me he believed fake news online and then went around telling everyone about it? It's absolutely ridiculous.

english_meaning: Someone!
explanation_mandarin: 呼唤别人过来，类似于“有人吗？”、“来人啊！”。
explanation_english: A phrase used to call for someone's attention or assistance. Similar to 'Is there anybody there?' or 'Someone, come here!'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人嚟！幫我手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 lai4! bong1 ngo5 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 来人！帮帮我！
examples.english_sentence: Someone! Help me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，人嚟呀，呢度有人晕低咗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, jan4 lai4 aa3, ni1 dou6 jau5 jan4 wan4 dai1 zo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，有人吗，这里有人晕倒了！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, is there anybody there? Someone has fainted here!

cantonese: 人在屋簷下，不得不低頭
jyutping: jan4 zoi6 uk1 jim4 haa6, bat1 dak1 bat1 dai1 tau4
mandarin_meaning: 人在屋檐下，不得不低头
english_meaning: When one is under another's roof, one must bow one's head; One has to knuckle under when one is in a dependent position.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻受制于人，不得不屈服。
explanation_english: This idiom means that when you are in a subordinate or dependent position, you have no choice but to yield or submit to the wishes of those in authority or power. It suggests that you have to tolerate or accept things you might not agree with because you are in a position where you cannot assert your own will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細咁惡，為咗份工，我都人在屋簷下，不得不低頭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam3 ok3, wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1, ngo5 dou1 jan4 zoi6 uk1 jim4 haa6, bat1 dak1 bat1 dai1 tau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板那么凶，为了这份工作，我也人在屋檐下，不得不低头了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is so fierce. For the sake of this job, I have to knuckle under.

jyutping: jan4 zoi6 gong1 wu4, san1 bat1 jau4 gei2
mandarin_meaning: 人在江湖，身不由己 (rén zài jiāng hú, shēn bù yóu jǐ)
english_meaning: Once you're in the world (of martial arts/organized crime), you are no longer in control of your own destiny; Once you're involved, you have no choice but to follow the flow.
explanation_mandarin: 原指人在江湖中行走，受各种势力影响，无法完全掌握自己的命运。 现在也泛指人在社会上，会受到各种因素的制约，难以随心所欲。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to the situation of someone moving around in the 'jianghu' (a fictional world of martial arts and organized crime), influenced by various forces and unable to fully control their own destiny. Now, it generally refers to the situation of people in society who are constrained by various factors and find it difficult to do as they please.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，做呢行就係咁㗎啦，人在江湖，身不由己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, zou6 ni1 hang4 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, jan4 zoi6 gong1 wu4, san1 bat1 jau4 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎，做这行就是这样的啦，人在江湖，身不由己。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, that's how it is in this line of work, once you're in, you're no longer in control of your own destiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道你想退出，但係人在江湖，邊有咁容易抽身？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 soeng2 teoi3 ceot1, daan6 hai6 jan4 zoi6 gong1 wu4, bin1 jau5 gam3 jung4 ji6 cau1 san1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你想退出，但是人在江湖，哪有那么容易脱身？
examples.english_sentence: I know you want to quit, but once you're involved, how easy is it to get out?

synonyms: 迫於無奈 (bik1 jyu1 mou4 noi6)

english_meaning: per capita; average per person
explanation_mandarin: 平均每人，按人数平均计算。
explanation_english: Average per person; calculated by dividing the total amount by the number of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅人均消費大概三百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jan4 gwan1 siu1 fai3 daai6 gaai3 saam1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的人均消费大概三百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: The average spending per person at this restaurant is about three hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人均收入都幾高下㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 gwan1 sau1 jap6 dou1 gei2 gou1 haa6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的人均收入挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's per capita income is quite high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計下人均要畀幾多錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 haa5 jan4 gwan1 jiu3 bei2 gei2 do1 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们算一下人均要付多少钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's calculate how much each person needs to pay on average.

english_meaning: Per capita income
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或地区在一定时期内（通常为一年）平均每个人所获得的收入。
explanation_english: Refers to the average income earned by each person in a country or region over a specific period (usually one year).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人均收入都算幾高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 gwan1 sau1 jap6 dou1 syun3 gei2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的人均收入也算挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's per capita income is considered quite high.

english_meaning: Human Centipede (referring to the movie or the concept)
explanation_mandarin: 指代电影《人体蜈蚣》或类似概念，多用于形容某种令人厌恶、恶心的事物或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the movie 'The Human Centipede' or similar concepts. It's often used to describe something disgusting, repulsive, or morally objectionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個諗法真係好似人型蜈蚣咁，聽到都覺得嘔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 lam2 faat3 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 jan4 jing4 ng4 gung1 gam2, teng1 dou2 dou1 gok3 dak1 au2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法真的像人体蜈蚣一样，听了都觉得恶心。
examples.english_sentence: His idea is really like the Human Centipede; just hearing about it makes me feel nauseous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日睇埋啲人型蜈蚣嘅嘢，會影響你嘅價值觀㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tai2 maai4 di1 jan4 jing4 ng4 gung1 ge3 je5, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 nei5 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是看那些人体蜈蚣的东西，会影响你的价值观的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always watch those Human Centipede things; it'll affect your values.

english_meaning: person; figure; public figure; somebody; people
explanation_mandarin: 指特定身份或具有某种特征的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with a specific identity or characteristics; somebody; people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個出名嘅演藝人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 ceot1 ming4 ge3 jin2 ngai6 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个著名的演艺人士。
examples.english_sentence: He is a famous artist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重唔同背景嘅人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 m4 tung4 bo3 ging2 ge3 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重不同背景的人士。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect people from different backgrounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多商界人士都出席咗個研討會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 soeng1 gaai3 jan4 si6 dou1 ceot1 sik1 zo2 go3 jin4 tou2 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多商界人士都出席了那个研讨会。
examples.english_sentence: Many business people attended the seminar.

english_meaning: life insurance
explanation_mandarin: 一种保险，以人的寿命为标的，当被保险人在保险期间内死亡或生存至约定年龄时，保险公司给付保险金。
explanation_english: A type of insurance policy that provides a monetary benefit to a designated beneficiary upon the death of the insured person or after a specified period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買份人壽保險，保障吓屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 fan6 jan4 sau6 bou2 him2, bou2 zoeng3 haa5 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算买一份人寿保险，保障一下家人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to buy a life insurance policy to protect my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有人壽供咗幾耐啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 jan4 sau6 gung1 zo2 gei2 noi6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的人寿保险供了多久了？
examples.english_sentence: How long have you been paying for your life insurance?

english_meaning: life insurance
explanation_mandarin: 一种保险，以被保险人的寿命为标的，当被保险人身故或在保单规定的期限内生存时，保险公司依照保险合同的约定给付保险金。
explanation_english: A type of insurance policy that provides a monetary benefit to a designated beneficiary upon the death of the insured person, or sometimes upon survival to a stated age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗份人壽保險，保障佢屋企人嘅未來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 fan6 jan4 sau6 bou2 him2, bou2 zoeng3 keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 mei6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了份人寿保险，保障他家人的未来。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a life insurance policy to secure his family's future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住幾時買人壽保險啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 zyu6 gei2 si4 maai5 jan4 sau6 bou2 him2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算什么时候买人寿保险啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you planning to buy life insurance?

english_meaning: life insurance
explanation_mandarin: 人寿保险，为被保险人在身故或生存至一定年龄时提供经济保障的保险。
explanation_english: Life insurance: insurance providing financial protection to the insured in the event of death or survival to a certain age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企每個人都買咗人壽燕梳，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 maai5 zo2 jan4 sau6 jin3 so1, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家每个人都买了人寿保险，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone in my family has life insurance, just in case.

jyutping: jan4 ngoi6 jau5 jan4, tin1 ngoi6 jau5 tin1
mandarin_meaning: 人外有人，天外有天 (rén wài yǒu rén, tiān wài yǒu tiān)
english_meaning: There is always someone better than you; there's always a higher level.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不要骄傲自满，总会有比你更强的人或更高的境界。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to remind people not to be arrogant or complacent. It suggests that no matter how good you are, there will always be someone better or a higher level to reach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁驕傲啦，人外有人，天外有天，仲有好多嘢要學㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 giu1 ngou6 laa1, jan4 ngoi6 jau5 jan4, tin1 ngoi6 jau5 tin1, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 hok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么骄傲了，人外有人，天外有天，还有很多东西要学的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant. There's always someone better, there's always a higher level. There's still a lot to learn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然好叻，但係都知人外有人，天外有天，所以一路都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 dou1 zi1 jan4 ngoi6 jau5 jan4, tin1 ngoi6 jau5 tin1, so2 ji5 jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然很厉害，但是也知道人外有人，天外有天，所以一直都很努力。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is very capable, he knows there is always someone better, there is always a higher level, so he works very hard all the time.

english_meaning: Strength in numbers; there is power in numbers; a large crowd can exert great influence.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人数众多，力量强大。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a large number of people makes one powerful or influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋人多勢眾，我哋搞唔掂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan4 do1 sai3 zung3, ngo5 dei6 gaau2 m4 dim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们人多势众，我们搞不定啊。
examples.english_sentence: They have strength in numbers; we can't handle them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威者人多勢眾，令到政府唔敢輕舉妄動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 ze2 jan4 do1 sai3 zung3, ling6 dou3 zing3 fu2 m4 gam2 hing1 geoi2 mong5 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威者人多势众，使得政府不敢轻举妄动。
examples.english_sentence: The protesters had strength in numbers, which made the government afraid to act rashly.

english_meaning: strength in numbers; there is safety in numbers; a large number gives you an advantage
explanation_mandarin: 形容人多力量大，人数众多的一方往往更有优势。
explanation_english: Describes the idea that a large number of people gives you strength and advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋人多勢衆，我哋都唔夠佢哋打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan4 do1 sai3 zung3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 gau3 keoi5 dei6 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们人多势众，我们打不过他们。
examples.english_sentence: They have strength in numbers, we can't beat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次示威人多勢衆，政府都唔敢輕舉妄動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 si6 wai1 jan4 do1 sai3 zung3, zing3 fu2 dou1 m4 gam2 hing1 geoi2 mong5 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次示威游行声势浩大，政府都不敢轻举妄动。
examples.english_sentence: This demonstration has strength in numbers, the government doesn't dare to act rashly.

english_meaning: Too many people talking at once, making it hard to understand or reach a consensus; too many cooks spoil the broth.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人多，议论纷纷，意见不一致，难以统一。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are too many people talking or offering opinions, making it difficult to understand what is being said or to reach a consensus. Similar to 'too many cooks spoil the broth'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候人多口雜，傾咗好耐都冇結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6 jan4 do1 hau2 zaap6, king1 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候人多嘴杂，讨论了很久都没有结论。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, there were too many people talking, and after a long discussion, we still couldn't reach a conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要靜啲，如果人多口雜，就聽唔清楚醫生講咩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing6 di1, jyu4 gwo2 jan4 do1 hau2 zaap6, zau6 teng1 m4 cing1 co2 ji1 sang1 gong2 me1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要安静点，如果人多嘴杂，就听不清楚医生说什么了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be quieter. If there are too many people talking, we won't be able to hear what the doctor is saying clearly.

english_meaning: Many hands make light work
explanation_mandarin: 形容人多，办事就容易成功。
explanation_english: Describes the idea that having more people makes it easier to accomplish a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次搬屋咁多嘢，好彩有人幫手啫，人多好辦事嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bun1 uk1 gam3 do1 je5, hou2 coi2 jau5 jan4 bong1 sau2 ze1, jan4 do1 hou2 baan6 si6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次搬家这么多东西，幸好有人帮忙，人多力量大嘛。
examples.english_sentence: There's so much stuff to move this time, luckily there are people helping, many hands make light work.

english_meaning: Too many cooks spoil the broth; too many people working on something causes confusion and inefficiency.
explanation_mandarin: 形容参与的人太多，反而互相妨碍，导致事情无法顺利进行。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where having too many people involved in a task leads to confusion, inefficiency, and a poor outcome. The abundance of manpower hinders rather than helps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次搬屋咁多人幫手，反而人多手腳亂，好多嘢都唔知擺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bun1 uk1 gam3 do1 jan4 bong1 sau2, faan2 ji4 jan4 do1 sau2 goek3 lyun6, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 zi1 baai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次搬家这么多人帮忙，反而人多手杂，很多东西都不知道放哪了。
examples.english_sentence: So many people helped us move house this time, but it was chaotic with too many people. We don't know where a lot of things were placed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開party嘅時候，太多人喺廚房幫手，搞到人多手腳亂，最終都係得幾樣嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 party ge3 si4 hau6, taai3 do1 jan4 hai2 cyu4 fong2 bong1 sau2, gaau2 dou3 jan4 do1 sau2 goek3 lyun6, zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 dak1 gei2 joeng6 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开派对的时候，太多人在厨房帮忙，搞得人多手杂，最终还是只有几样东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: When we were having a party, too many people were helping in the kitchen, resulting in a chaotic situation and ultimately only a few dishes were made.

jyutping: jan4 do1 jik1 gau2 dou1 m4 nam4
mandarin_meaning: 人多力量大，但也并非万能
english_meaning: Even with a large crowd, you might not be able to soften a hard object (meaning even a large group may not be able to achieve something difficult or make someone change their mind).
explanation_mandarin: 这句话的意思是人多力量大，但如果面对非常顽固或困难的情况，即使人再多，也可能无法改变结果。 比喻即使团结也未必能成事。
explanation_english: This idiom means that while there's strength in numbers, even a large group may not be able to achieve something if the obstacle is too tough or someone is too stubborn. It's similar to saying 'you can't polish a turd' or 'you can't make a silk purse out of a sow's ear.' The 'hard object' is metaphorically a difficult problem or an unyielding person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咁多都冇用㗎啦，佢已經決定咗，人多熠狗都唔腍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zo2, jan4 do1 jik1 gau2 dou1 m4 nam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讲那么多也没用啦，他已经决定了，人多也没用。
examples.english_sentence: It's useless to say so much. He's already made up his mind; even a large group can't change his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁難搞，人多熠狗都唔腍，都係算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 naan4 gaau2, jan4 do1 jik1 gau2 dou1 m4 nam4, dou1 hai6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么难办，人多也没用，还是算了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so difficult to handle; even a large group can't solve it. Let's just give up.

english_meaning: Bullying the few by the many; Taking advantage of numerical superiority
explanation_mandarin: 形容仗恃人多势众欺负人少。指凭借人数上的优势欺压弱小。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where those with numerical superiority bully or take advantage of those who are fewer in number. It refers to using the advantage of numbers to oppress the weak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋咁多人蝦佢一個，人多蝦人少啫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gam3 do1 jan4 haa1 keoi5 jat1 go3, jan4 do1 haa1 jan4 siu2 ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们这么多人欺负他一个人，这不就是人多欺负人少吗！
examples.english_sentence: So many of you are bullying him alone, isn't this just bullying the few by the many!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好人多蝦人少啦，大家都係同學嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan4 do1 haa1 jan4 siu2 laa1, daai6 ga1 dou1 hai6 tung4 hok6 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以多欺少啦，大家都是同学嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bully the few by the many, we are all classmates.

english_meaning: adult, grown-up
explanation_mandarin: 指成年人。
explanation_english: Refers to an adult person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路哥大個咗就變咗人大啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 go1 daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 bin3 zo2 jan4 daai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们长大后就变成大人了。
examples.english_sentence: The kids grow up and become adults.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經係人大，唔好再當佢小朋友咁睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hai6 jan4 daai6, m4 hou2 zoi3 dong3 keoi5 siu2 pang4 jau5 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经是大人了，不要再把他当小孩看待。
examples.english_sentence: He's already an adult, don't treat him like a child anymore.

english_meaning: married man, husband
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚的男子，丈夫。
explanation_english: Refers to a married man, a husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結咗婚之後就變咗人夫樣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 bin3 zo2 jan4 fu1 joeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结婚之后就变得像个丈夫的样子了。
examples.english_sentence: After getting married, he started to look like a husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好顧家嘅人夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 gu3 gaa1 ge3 jan4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个很顾家的丈夫。
examples.english_sentence: He is a husband who takes good care of his family.

mandarin_meaning: 人与人的缘分，人与人之间的化学反应
english_meaning: Some people click with others; chemistry between people; some people have a natural affinity with others.
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间的一种缘分和相互吸引。 有些人天生就比较容易与某些人相处，而与另外一些人则可能不那么合拍。这个词语强调人际关系中主观的感觉和契合度。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the chemistry and affinity between people. Some individuals naturally get along better with certain people than others. It emphasizes the subjective feeling and compatibility in interpersonal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同個新同事好夾，真係人夾人緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 go3 san1 tung4 si6 hou2 gaap3, zan1 hai6 jan4 gaap3 jan4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和新同事很合得来，真是人与人之间的缘分。
examples.english_sentence: He gets along well with the new colleague; it's really a matter of chemistry between people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢就唔係好夾，可能真係人夾人緣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zau6 m4 hai6 hou2 gaap3, ho2 nang4 zan1 hai6 jan4 gaap3 jan4 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他不是很合得来，可能真是人与人之间的缘分吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really get along with him, maybe it's just a matter of people clicking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揀室友都好講究人夾人緣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 sat1 jau5 dou1 hou2 gong2 gau3 jan4 gaap3 jan4 jyun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选择室友也很讲究人与人的缘分。
examples.english_sentence: Choosing a roommate is also about finding someone you click with.

english_meaning: human milk, breast milk
explanation_mandarin: 指由人类母亲分泌的乳汁，通常用于喂养婴儿。
explanation_english: Human milk, milk produced by human mothers, typically used to feed infants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢餵緊人奶呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 gan2 jan4 naai5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她正在喂母乳。
examples.english_sentence: She is breastfeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人奶對BB嚟講係最好嘅營養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 naai5 deoi3 bi1 bi1 lai4 gong2 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 ying1 yeung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 母乳对宝宝来说是最好的营养。
examples.english_sentence: Breast milk is the best nutrition for babies.

mandarin_meaning: 人如其名 (rén rú qí míng)
english_meaning: The person lives up to their name; The name reflects the person's character or nature.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人的性格、行为或特点与他们的名字相符。名字通常暗示了某种品质或性格，而这个人恰好展现了这些品质或性格。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose character, behavior, or traits align with their name. The name usually implies a certain quality or characteristic, and the person happens to exhibit those qualities or characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係好豪爽，人如其名，真係叫做「大方」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou4 song2, jan4 jyu4 kei4 ming4, zan1 hai6 giu3 zou6 "daai6 fong1".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的很豪爽，人如其名，真的叫「大方」。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very generous person. True to his name, which is "Tai Fong" (meaning generous). He really lives up to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁斯文，真係人如其名，叫做「文靜」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 si1 man4, zan1 hai6 jan4 jyu4 kei4 ming4, giu3 zou6 "man4 zing6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么斯文，真是人如其名，叫「文静」。
examples.english_sentence: She's so gentle and refined, truly living up to her name, which is "Man Jing" (meaning gentle and quiet).

mandarin_meaning: 变性人; 跨性别者 (Biànxìng rén; kuàxìngbié zhě)
english_meaning: Transgender person (usually referring to trans women in Southeast Asia, often with a focus on entertainment or performance)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过手术或激素治疗等方式改变性别认同的人，通常指在东南亚从事演艺事业的变性女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a transgender person, typically a trans woman who has undergone surgery or hormone therapy. Often used in the context of trans women in Southeast Asia who work in entertainment or performance industries. It's important to note that the term can be considered offensive by some.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去泰國旅行嗰陣睇咗人妖表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 taai3 gwok3 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan6 tai2 zo2 jan4 jiu1 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去泰国旅行的时候看了人妖表演。
examples.english_sentence: He watched a trans woman performance when he traveled to Thailand.

english_meaning: married woman, wife
explanation_mandarin: 指已经结婚的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who is married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚之後就變成咗人妻啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 bin3 sing4 zo2 jan4 cai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她结婚之后就变成人妻了。
examples.english_sentence: She became a married woman after getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人妻味好濃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 cai1 mei6 hou2 nung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的成熟女性魅力很浓厚。
examples.english_sentence: She has a strong wife/married woman aura.

english_meaning: flip-flops, thongs
explanation_mandarin: 一种凉鞋，鞋面由一根人字形的带子连接前后两部分。
explanation_english: A type of sandal, usually made of rubber or plastic, with a thong between the big toe and the second toe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意着人字拖去沙灘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 jan4 zi6 to1 heoi3 saa1 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢穿人字拖去沙滩。
examples.english_sentence: I like to wear flip-flops to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好着人字拖返工，唔夠formal。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 jan4 zi6 to1 faan1 gung1, m4 gau3 formal.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要穿人字拖上班，不够正式。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wear flip-flops to work, it's not formal enough.

english_meaning: Man can conquer nature; human effort will overcome natural obstacles.
explanation_mandarin: 强调人的主观能动性，认为人的力量可以战胜自然。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the power of human agency and believes that human effort can overcome natural forces. It expresses the idea that human determination can triumph over seemingly insurmountable odds presented by nature or fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然環境好惡劣，但我哋相信人定勝天，一定可以克服困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 waan4 ging2 hou2 ok3 lyut6, daan6 ngo5 dei6 seung1 seon3 jan4 ding6 sing3 tin1, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 hak1 fuk6 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然环境很恶劣，但我们相信人定胜天，一定可以克服困难。
examples.english_sentence: Although the environment is very harsh, we believe that man can conquer nature, and we will definitely overcome the difficulties.

english_meaning: Guest; customer
explanation_mandarin: 指客人，顾客。通常用于商业场合。
explanation_english: Refers to guests or customers, commonly used in commercial settings like shops, restaurants, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，人客，想睇啲咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, jan4 hak3, soeng2 tai2 di1 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，客人，想看些什么？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, customer, what are you looking for?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，人客，呢度埋單，總共一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, jan4 hak3, ni1 dou6 maai4 daan1, zung2 gung1 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，客人，这里结账，一共一百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, customer, let's settle the bill here, it's a total of 100 dollars.

english_meaning: other people; others; another person; a respectable woman; (ironically) I; me
explanation_mandarin: 指别人，他人。有时也指自己（多带有娇嗔或自嘲的意味）。
explanation_english: Refers to other people. Can also refer to oneself, often used in a coy or self-deprecating manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋咁快就結婚，人家都未準備好做人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gam3 faai3 zau6 git3 fan1, jan4 gaa1 dou1 mei6 zyun2 bei6 hou2 zou6 jan4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们这么快就结婚了，我还没准备好给礼金呢。
examples.english_sentence: You guys are getting married so soon, I'm not even prepared to give a wedding gift yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人家都唔知點算好啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人家都不知道怎么办才好了！
examples.english_sentence: I don't even know what to do!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲，人家會聽到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1, jan4 gaa1 wui5 teng1 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声，别人会听到的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so loud, other people will hear.

english_meaning: huge crowds of people; a sea of people; shoulder to shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 形容聚集的人非常多，像山和海一样。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is extremely crowded with people, resembling mountains and seas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰日，維多利亞公園人山人海，好逼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 jat6, wai4 do1 lei6 a3 gung1 jyun2 jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2, hou2 bik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年那天，维多利亚公园人山人海，很拥挤！
examples.english_sentence: On New Year's Day, Victoria Park was packed with people, very crowded!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅時候，現場人山人海，勁多人啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 si4 hau2, hyun2 coeng4 jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2, ging6 do1 jan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的时候，现场人山人海，非常多人啊！
examples.english_sentence: During the concert, the venue was packed, so many people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 花車巡遊嗰陣時，條街人山人海，睇都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa1 ce1 ceon4 jau4 go2 zan6 si4, tiu4 gaai1 jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2, tai2 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花车巡游的时候，街道上人山人海，都看不到。
examples.english_sentence: During the float parade, the streets were packed, you couldn't see anything.

english_meaning: Salary, wage, manpower (rarely used in this context)
explanation_mandarin: 指工作所得的报酬，包括工资、薪水等。
explanation_english: Refers to the remuneration received for work done, including salary, wages, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份工人工唔錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 m4 co3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的工作工资还不错。
examples.english_sentence: My salary at work is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋加咗人工俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zo2 jan4 gung1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们给我涨了工资。
examples.english_sentence: They gave me a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對而家份工嘅人工滿唔滿意啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ji4 gaa1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 mun5 m4 mun5 ji3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对现在这份工作的工资满意吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you satisfied with the salary of your current job?

english_meaning: artificial insemination; assisted reproductive technology (ART)
explanation_mandarin: 一种辅助生殖技术，通过人为方法将精子注入女性体内，以达到受孕的目的。
explanation_english: A fertility treatment method in which sperm is artificially inserted into a woman's uterus or fallopian tubes to achieve pregnancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚好耐都冇小朋友，諗住試下人工受孕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 siu2 pang4 jau5, lam2 zyu6 si3 haa5 jan4 gung1 sau6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚很久都没有孩子，打算试试人工受精。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for a long time without having children, and they're thinking of trying artificial insemination.

synonyms: 試管嬰兒 (si3 gun2 ying1 yi4) - IVF (In Vitro Fertilization)

english_meaning: artificial respiration; CPR breathing
explanation_mandarin: 在紧急情况下，通过外部手段帮助他人进行呼吸的方法，例如口对口呼吸。
explanation_english: A technique to provide ventilation to someone who is not breathing or not breathing adequately, typically involving mouth-to-mouth resuscitation or using a bag valve mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢暈咗，快啲幫佢做人工呼吸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan4 zo2, faai3 di1 bong1 keoi5 zou6 jan4 gung1 fu1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他晕倒了，快点帮他做人工呼吸。
examples.english_sentence: He fainted, quickly perform artificial respiration on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學識人工呼吸好緊要，隨時救到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 sik1 jan4 gung1 fu1 kap1 hou2 gan2 jiu3, ceoi4 si4 gau3 dou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学会人工呼吸很重要，随时可以救人。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing how to perform artificial respiration is important, you can save someone's life at any time.

english_meaning: artificial island
explanation_mandarin: 由人类建造而非自然形成的岛屿。
explanation_english: An island that is built by humans, rather than being naturally formed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港機場就係建喺人工島上面㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 gei1 coeng4 zau6 hai6 gin3 hai2 jan4 gung1 dou2 soeng6 min6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港机场就是建在人工岛上的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong Airport is built on an artificial island.

english_meaning: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
explanation_mandarin: 指由人制造出来的机器所表现出的智能。
explanation_english: The intelligence demonstrated by machines, as opposed to natural intelligence displayed by humans and animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工智能嘅發展一日千里，好快就會影響到好多行業啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ge3 faat3 zin2 jat1 jat6 cin1 lei5, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 hou2 do1 hang4 jip6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人工智能的发展一日千里，很快就会影响到很多行业了。
examples.english_sentence: The development of Artificial Intelligence is advancing rapidly, and it will soon affect many industries.

english_meaning: induced abortion, artificial abortion
explanation_mandarin: 通过人为的方法终止妊娠，达到中止怀孕的目的。
explanation_english: The termination of a pregnancy by artificial means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為經濟問題，決定做人工流產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ging1 zai3 man6 tai4, kyut3 ding6 zou6 jan4 gung1 lau4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她因为经济问题，决定做人工流产。
examples.english_sentence: Because of financial problems, she decided to have an abortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工流產喺香港係合法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gung1 lau4 caan2 hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2 hai6 hap6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人工流产在香港是合法的。
examples.english_sentence: Abortion is legal in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: strong troops and sturdy horses; a powerful and well-equipped force; having a strong and capable workforce
explanation_mandarin: 形容兵力强盛，也用来形容人力充足，阵容强大。
explanation_english: Describes a military force that is strong and well-equipped. It can also be used to describe a situation where there are ample human resources and a strong lineup/team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家發展得好好，真係人強馬壯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 jan4 koeng4 maa5 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司现在发展得很好，真是兵强马壮。
examples.english_sentence: The company is developing very well now, it's really a strong and capable force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋球隊今年人強馬壯，一定可以攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kau4 deoi2 gam1 nin4 jan4 koeng4 maa5 zong3, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 lo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们球队今年兵强马壮，一定可以拿到冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Our team is strong this year, we will definitely win the championship.

english_meaning: Human Centipede (referring to the movie and the concept of surgically connecting people together)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影《人体蜈蚣》及其概念，即通过手术将人连接在一起。常用来形容令人恶心、反感的事物或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the movie "The Human Centipede" and the concept of surgically connecting people together. It's often used to describe something disgusting, repulsive, or morally objectionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個橋段真係人形蜈蚣，諗起都想嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 kiu2 dyun6 zan1 hai6 jan4 jing4 ng4 gung1, lam2 hei2 dou1 soeng2 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个情节真是人肉蜈蚣，想起就想吐。
examples.english_sentence: That plot is truly Human Centipede-like; just thinking about it makes me want to vomit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講咁多人形蜈蚣嘅嘢啦，我驚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 gong2 gam3 do1 jan4 jing4 ng4 gung1 ge3 je5 laa1, ngo5 geng1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说那么多人体蜈蚣的事情了，我害怕！
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so much about Human Centipede stuff, I'm scared!

english_meaning: human figure, silhouette
explanation_mandarin: 人的影子；人的轮廓。
explanation_english: The silhouette or vague image of a person; the shadow of a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚喺條街度行，乜人都冇，得返啲人影咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 haang4, mat1 je5 dou1 mou5, dak1 faan1 di1 jan4 jeng2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上在街上走，什么人都没有，只剩下一些人影。
examples.english_sentence: Walking on the street at night, there's no one around, only some human figures are left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係見到佢嘅人影閃過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gin3 dou2 keoi5 ge3 jan4 jeng2 sim2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是看到他的人影闪过。
examples.english_sentence: I only saw his silhouette flash by.

english_meaning: A person of low position carries little weight.
explanation_mandarin: 指地位低下的人说的话不受重视。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where a person with low social status or power has their opinions and suggestions ignored or dismissed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，我哋啲細薯仔人微言輕，講咩都冇人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, ngo5 dei6 di1 sai3 syu4 zai2 jan4 mei4 jin4 hing1, gong2 me1 dou1 mou5 jan4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这间公司，我们这些小人物人微言轻，说什么也没人听。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, we little people have little weight, no one listens to what we say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算我哋覺得呢個計劃有問題，都人微言輕，改變唔到啲咩㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 ngo5 dei6 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 man6 tai4, dou1 jan4 mei4 jin4 hing1, goi2 bin3 m4 dou2 di1 me1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使我们觉得这个计划有问题，也人微言轻，改变不了什么了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if we think this plan has problems, we are just small voices and can't change anything.

english_meaning: people's hearts; popular sentiment; the will of the people; human nature
explanation_mandarin: 指人们的心意、想法、愿望，也指人的本性。
explanation_english: Refers to people's hearts, thoughts, and desires; can also refer to human nature. It can also refer to popular sentiment or the will of the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 民意代表應該反映人民嘅人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man4 ji3 doi6 biu2 jing1 goi1 faan2 jing2 yan4 man4 ge3 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 民意代表应该反映人民的人心。
examples.english_sentence: Public representatives should reflect the will of the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做，真係失曬人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 sat1 saai3 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，真是失去了人心。
examples.english_sentence: What he did really lost him the support of the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家嘅人心唔古喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ge3 jan4 sam1 m4 gu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人心不古了。
examples.english_sentence: People's hearts are not as honest as they used to be (the good old days).

mandarin_meaning: 世风日下，人心不如从前
english_meaning: People's hearts are not as good as in the past; morality is declining.
explanation_mandarin: 指社会风气变得越来越坏，人们的心地不如从前纯朴善良。感叹社会道德沦丧，人们变得自私自利。
explanation_english: An idiom lamenting the decline of moral standards and the deterioration of people's hearts compared to the past. It implies that people have become more selfish and less virtuous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，真係人心不古，成日諗住一步登天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, zan1 hai6 jan4 sam1 bat1 gu2, seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，真是世风日下，总是想着一步登天。
examples.english_sentence: These young people nowadays, morality is really declining, they are always thinking of getting rich overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋細個嗰陣，啲人好純樸㗎，而家就人心不古啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, di1 jan4 hou2 seon4 pok3 gaa3, ji4 gaa1 zau6 jan4 sam1 bat1 gu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们小时候，人们很淳朴的，现在就世风日下啦。
examples.english_sentence: When we were young, people were very simple and honest, but now morality has declined.

jyutping: jan4 sam1 bat1 zuk1 se4 tan1 zoeng6
mandarin_meaning: 人心不足蛇吞象 (rén xīn bù zú shé tūn xiàng)
english_meaning: A snake trying to swallow an elephant - to describe insatiable greed and ambition; to bite off more than one can chew.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人贪心不足，想得到根本无法得到的东西。比喻人的欲望永远无法满足。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is excessively greedy and wants to obtain things that are fundamentally impossible. It is a metaphor for the insatiable nature of human desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都咁有錢喇，仲要咁多，真係人心不足蛇吞象喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gam3 jau5 cin2 laa3, zung6 jiu3 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 jan4 sam1 bat1 zuk1 se4 tan1 zoeng6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么有钱了，还要这么多，真是人心不足蛇吞象啊。
examples.english_sentence: You're already so rich, yet you still want more. It's really a case of a snake trying to swallow an elephant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想一年之内升到經理，根本係人心不足蛇吞象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jat1 nin4 zi1 noi6 sing1 dou3 ging1 lei5, gan1 bun2 hai6 jan4 sam1 bat1 zuk1 se4 tan1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想一年之内升到经理，根本是人心不足蛇吞象。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be promoted to manager within a year; it's simply a case of biting off more than he can chew.

mandarin_meaning: 人心惶惶 (rén xīn huáng huáng)
english_meaning: People's hearts are filled with fear and anxiety; everyone is in a state of panic.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人们因不安定的局势或某种重大事件而内心极度恐慌，无法安心。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people are extremely fearful and anxious due to an unstable situation or a major event, unable to find peace of mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從間公司傳出裁員嘅消息之後，搞到人心惶惶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 cyun4 ceot1 coi4 jyun4 ge3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, gaau2 dou3 jan4 sam1 wong4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司传出裁员的消息之后，搞得人心惶惶。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since the news of layoffs spread in the company, it has caused widespread panic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔景氣，成個社會都人心惶惶咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 hei3, seng4 go3 se5 wui2 dou1 jan4 sam1 wong4 wong4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不景气，整个社会都人心惶惶的。
examples.english_sentence: With the economic downturn, the whole society is in a state of panic.

mandarin_meaning: 人心都是肉长的; 人都有感情
english_meaning: People's hearts are made of flesh; Everyone has feelings; People are not heartless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人是有感情的，不是铁石心肠的，应该体谅他人。
explanation_english: Describes that people have feelings, are not heartless, and should be considerate of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁嬲佢啦，人心肉做啫，佢都唔係有心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 keoi5 laa1, jan4 sam1 juk6 zou6 ze1, keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么生他的气了，人心都是肉长的，他也不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry with him, people's hearts are made of flesh, he didn't do it on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢平時幾咁惡死，但係人心肉做，見到咁慘嘅情況，都會幫手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 keoi5 ping4 si4 gei2 gam3 ok3 sei2, daan6 hai6 jan4 sam1 juk6 zou6, gin3 dou3 gam3 caam2 ge3 cing4 fong3, dou1 wui5 bong1 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算他平时多么凶恶，但是人心都是肉长的，见到这么惨的情况，也会帮忙的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he is usually fierce, people's hearts are made of flesh, and seeing such a tragic situation, he will help.

english_meaning: People's hearts are made of flesh; people have feelings.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人都是有感情的，会感到悲伤、快乐、痛苦等。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people have feelings and are capable of empathy, sympathy, and emotional responses. It acknowledges that human hearts are not made of stone but are sensitive and vulnerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知你嬲，但係佢都唔係有心嘅，人心肉造啫，體諒下佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 nei5 nau1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3, jan4 sam1 juk6 zou6 ze1, tai2 loeng6 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你生气，但是他也不是故意的，人心都是肉长的，体谅他一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're angry, but he didn't do it on purpose. People's hearts are made of flesh, so please be understanding.

mandarin_meaning: 人心难测; 知人知面不知心
english_meaning: It's hard to know what's in someone's heart; You can never really know what someone is thinking.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人的心思难以猜测。
explanation_english: This idiom means it is difficult to know what someone is really thinking or feeling. You can't judge a book by its cover; people's true intentions are often hidden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係估唔到佢會咁做，真係人心隔肚皮呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 wui gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 jan4 sam1 gaak3 tou5 pei4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的没想到他会这么做，真是人心难测啊。
examples.english_sentence: I really didn't expect him to do this, you can never really know what someone is thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢合作要小心啲，人心隔肚皮，唔好咁容易相信人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, jan4 sam1 gaak3 tou5 pei4, m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 soeng1 seon3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和他合作要小心点，人心难测，不要轻易相信别人。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be careful when working with him, you can never really know what someone is thinking, don't trust people so easily.

jyutping: jan4 paa3 ceot1 ming4 zyu1 paa3 fei4
english_meaning: People fear fame, pigs fear fatness.
explanation_mandarin: 指人如果出了名，容易招来麻烦；猪如果长得太肥，就会被宰杀。形容出名或过度肥胖带来的危险。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people are afraid of becoming famous because fame can bring trouble, just as pigs are afraid of becoming too fat because they will be slaughtered. It describes the dangers that fame or excessive fatness can bring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚自己出咗名之後會有好多麻煩，所以佢一直好低調，真係人怕出名豬怕肥啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 zi6 gei2 ceot1 zo2 ming4 zi1 hau6 wui5 jau5 ho2 do1 maa4 faan4, so2 ji5 keoi5 jat1 zik6 hou2 dai1 diu6, zan1 hai6 jan4 paa3 ceot1 ming4 zyu1 paa3 fei4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他怕自己出名之后会有很多麻烦，所以他一直很低调，真是人怕出名猪怕壮啊。
examples.english_sentence: He is afraid of having a lot of trouble after becoming famous, so he has always kept a low profile. It really is true that people fear fame, pigs fear fatness.

jyutping: jan4 paa3 ngai6, mai5 paa3 sai1
mandarin_meaning: 人怕出名，猪怕壮 (ren pa chu ming, zhu pa zhuang)
english_meaning: People are afraid of becoming famous, rice is afraid of being sifted (lest the inferior grains are separated).
explanation_mandarin: 人怕出名后带来的各种麻烦和压力；米经过筛选，质量差的会被筛掉。比喻出名可能带来负面的影响，也暗示要经受考验才能得到认可。
explanation_english: People fear the trouble and pressure that comes with fame; rice that has been sifted has the poor-quality grains removed. It's a metaphor for how fame can bring negative consequences, and also suggests that one must undergo trials to be recognized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就咁出名，真係人怕囈，米怕篩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 gam3 ceot1 ming4, zan1 hai6 jan4 paa3 ngai6, mai5 paa3 sai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就这么出名，真是人怕出名，猪怕壮啊！
examples.english_sentence: He became so famous at such a young age, it's really like people being afraid of fame!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢做得好，自然會俾人知，但係人怕囈，米怕篩，到時又要應付好多嘢。
