examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 zou6 dak1 hou2, zi6 jin4 wui5 bei2 jan4 zi1, daan6 hai6 jan4 paa3 ngai6, mai5 paa3 sai1, dou3 si4 jau6 jiu3 ying3 fu6 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作做得好，自然会被人知道，但是人怕出名，猪怕壮，到时候又要应付很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: If you do a good job, people will naturally know, but people are afraid of fame, you'll have to deal with a lot of things then.

jyutping: jan4 paa3 cung1, mai5 paa3 sai1
english_meaning: People fear becoming famous, rice fears being sifted (to get to the best).
explanation_mandarin: 意思是人怕出名，出了名就会招惹麻烦；米怕被筛，因为会被挑出最好的，剩下的质量就会下降。 比喻人成名后会带来很多烦恼，或者东西被挑拣后质量会受到影响。
explanation_english: This proverb means that people fear becoming famous because fame brings trouble. Rice fears being sifted because the best grains are selected, leaving the rest of a lower quality. It's an analogy for how fame can bring troubles to people, or how selection can negatively impact the overall quality of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家咁出名，真係人怕𠼮，米怕篩啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 ceot1 ming4, zan1 hai6 jan4 paa3 cung1, mai5 paa3 sai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在这么出名，真是人怕出名，猪怕壮啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so famous now, it's really a case of people fearing fame and rice fearing being sifted.

english_meaning: human nature; humanity
explanation_mandarin: 指人类所固有的性质，包括理智、情感、意志等。
explanation_english: The inherent nature of human beings, including rationality, emotions, and will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做簡直係泯滅人性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 man5 mit6 jan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做简直是泯灭人性。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is simply destroying humanity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為反映咗人性嘅光輝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 faan2 jing2 zo2 jan4 sing3 ge3 gwong1 fai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为反映了人性的光辉。
examples.english_sentence: His actions reflect the brilliance of human nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時我真係搞唔清楚人性係好定壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 m4 cing1 co2 jan4 sing3 hai6 hou2 ding6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候我真搞不清楚人性是好是坏。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes I really can't figure out if human nature is good or bad.

english_meaning: humanized, user-friendly, people-oriented
explanation_mandarin: 指使事物更符合人的需求，考虑人的感受和利益。
explanation_english: Referring to making things more suitable for human needs, taking into consideration human feelings and interests; user-friendly; people-oriented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅政策好人性化，有好多福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zing3 caak3 hou2 jan4 sing3 faa3, jau5 hou2 do1 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的政策很人性化，有很多福利。
examples.english_sentence: This company's policies are very people-oriented, with many benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個網站設計得好人性化，好容易搵到想要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 mong5 zaam6 sat3 gai3 dak1 hou2 jan4 sing3 faa3, hou2 jung4 ji6 wan2 dou2 so2 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个网站设计得很人性化，很容易找到想要的东西。
examples.english_sentence: This website is designed to be very user-friendly; it's easy to find what you need.

english_meaning: favor; human feeling; social relationship; to do a favor; to be generous; courtesy; kindness
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间的情谊、情面。也指为了维持关系而送礼或帮忙的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the kindness, favors, and social relationships between people. It can also refer to the act of giving gifts or helping others to maintain relationships, showing courtesy and kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借錢都要還，唔好欠人情呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 cin2 dou1 jiu3 waan4, m4 hou2 him3 jan4 cing4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借钱都要还，不要欠人情啊。
examples.english_sentence: You have to repay the money you borrowed, don't owe favors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次幫咗我咁大嘅忙，真係欠咗佢一個人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 daai6 ge3 mong4, zan1 hai6 him3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次帮了我这么大的忙，真是欠了他一个人情。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me so much this time, I really owe him a favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 送禮都係為咗做人情啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sung3 lai5 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 zou6 jan4 cing4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 送礼都是为了做人情罢了。
examples.english_sentence: Giving gifts is just to maintain social relationships.

english_meaning: the ways of the world; understanding of human relationships and social interactions; social skills; tact and diplomacy
explanation_mandarin: 指为人处世的道理和方法，对人际关系和社会规则的理解和运用。
explanation_english: Refers to the principles and methods of dealing with people and situations, and the understanding and application of interpersonal relationships and social rules. It encompasses social skills, tact, and the ability to navigate complex social situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識人情世故，所以喺公司好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3, so2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂人情世故，所以在公司很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He is very savvy in the ways of the world, so he is very popular at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔識人情世故，講嘢比較直接。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 sik1 jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3, gong2 je5 bei2 gaau3 zik6 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不懂人情世故，说话比较直接。
examples.english_sentence: Children don't understand the ways of the world, they speak more directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意要識啲人情世故，先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 jiu3 sik1 di1 jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意要懂一些人情世故，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: To succeed in business, you need to understand the ways of the world.

synonyms: 處世之道 (cyu2 sai3 zi1 dou6)
待人接物 (doi6 jan4 zip3 mat6)

english_meaning: the fickleness of human relationships; the warmth and coldness of human affections; the ups and downs of human relations; how people treat you differently based on your circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 指人情世故随着地位、境遇的变化而变化，表示人情随着地位的变化而变得势利。比喻社会上的人情世故是冷酷无情的。
explanation_english: Describes how human relationships change with one's status or circumstances, highlighting the opportunistic and fickle nature of human interaction. It emphasizes that human feelings in society are often cold and heartless and depend on one's social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司執咗笠之後，啲朋友個個都對佢避之唯恐不及，真係人情冷暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zap1 zo2 lap1 zi1 hau6, di1 pang4 jau5 go3 go3 dou1 deoi3 keoi5 bei6 zi1 wai4 hung2 bat1 gap6, zan1 hai6 jan4 cing4 laang5 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司倒闭之后，朋友们都躲着他，真是世态炎凉。
examples.english_sentence: After his company closed down, all his friends avoided him like the plague. It really shows the fickleness of human relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺醫院入面，先至會睇到人情冷暖，有錢嘅咪有人理囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji1 jyun2 jap6 min6, sin1 zi3 wui2 tai2 dou2 jan4 cing4 laang5 nyun5, jau5 cin2 ge3 mai1 jau5 jan4 lei5 lo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在医院里，才能真正看到世态炎凉，有钱的才有人理。
examples.english_sentence: You only really see the fickleness of human relationships in the hospital. Only the rich get attention.

english_meaning: human touch; warmth; friendliness; a sense of human connection and empathy
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间真挚的情感、温暖的人际关系和互相帮助的精神。
explanation_english: Refers to genuine feelings, warm interpersonal relationships, and a spirit of mutual help among people. It suggests a friendly, welcoming, and supportive atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社區好有人情味，大家都好幫得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6, daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 bong1 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社区很有有人情味，大家都互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: This community has a lot of warmth; everyone is very helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前啲舊樓，街坊之間好有人情味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 di1 gau6 lau2, gaai1 fong1 zi1 gaan1 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前的旧楼，邻居之间很有有人情味。
examples.english_sentence: The old buildings in Hong Kong used to have a strong sense of community; the neighbors were very friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從搬咗去嗰度，我哋感受到好多人情味，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 bun1 zo2 heoi3 go2 dou6, ngo5 dei6 gam2 sau6 dou2 hou2 do1 jan4 cing4 mei6, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从搬到那里，我们感受到了很多人情味，很开心。
examples.english_sentence: Since we moved there, we've felt a lot of human warmth, and we're very happy.

english_meaning: Human relationships are as thin as paper; People's feelings and obligations towards each other are very shallow; The sense of human connection is weak.
explanation_mandarin: 形容社会上人与人之间的关系很淡漠，人情味很薄弱，指人们的感情和义务感变得浅薄。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where human relationships have become shallow and superficial. It suggests that people are less willing to help each other or fulfill their obligations, and the sense of community and connection is weak. It implies a decline in genuine concern and support among individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人情紙咁薄，借錢都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 cing4 zi2 gam3 bok6, ze3 cin2 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人情淡薄，借钱都很难。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, human relationships are so thin, it's difficult to even borrow money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前鄰居會互相幫忙，而家真係人情紙咁薄，自己顧自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 leon4 geoi1 wui5 wu6 soeng1 bong1 mong4, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 jan4 cing4 zi2 gam3 bok6, zi6 gei2 gu3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前邻居会互相帮忙，现在真是人情淡薄，各自顾各自。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, neighbours would help each other, but now human relationships are really thin, everyone just looks after themselves.

english_meaning: Human relationships are as thin as paper; human kindness is superficial; relationships are fragile and easily broken.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间的情谊非常淡薄，不堪一击，就像一张纸一样容易撕破。
explanation_english: Describes the superficiality and fragility of human relationships, suggesting that kindness and support are easily broken or withdrawn. It implies a lack of genuine connection and commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人情薄過紙，借錢唔還嘅情況好普遍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 cing4 bok6 gwo3 zi2, ze3 cin2 m4 waan4 ge3 cing4 kwong3 hou2 pou2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人情淡薄如纸，借钱不还的情况很普遍。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, human relationships are so fragile, the situation of borrowing money and not returning it is very common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，就唔認我呢個舊同學，真係人情薄過紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 m4 jing6 ngo5 ni1 go3 gau6 tung4 hok6, zan1 hai6 jan4 cing4 bok6 gwo3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，就不认我这个老同学了，真是人情淡薄如纸。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he didn't acknowledge me, his old classmate; it's truly a case of human relationships being as thin as paper.

synonyms: 世態炎涼 (sai3 taai3 jim4 loeng4)

cantonese: 人情還人情，數目要分明
jyutping: jan4 cing4 waan4 jan4 cing4, sou3 muk6 jiu3 fan1 ming4
mandarin_meaning: 人情归人情，账目要分明
english_meaning: Friendship is friendship, but accounts must be clear.
explanation_mandarin: 强调在处理财务问题时，即使是亲朋好友之间，也应该将人情关系和金钱关系分开，避免因为金钱问题而影响感情。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of keeping personal relationships separate from financial matters, even with close friends and family. It suggests avoiding blurring the lines between friendship and money to prevent potential conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋係好朋友，但係人情還人情，數目要分明，借咗你嘅錢我一定會準時還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 hai6 hou2 pang4 jau5, daan6 hai6 jan4 cing4 waan4 jan4 cing4, sou3 muk6 jiu3 fan1 ming4, ze3 zo2 nei5 ge3 cin2 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zeon2 si4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我们是好朋友，但是人情归人情，账目要分明，借你的钱我一定会准时还。
examples.english_sentence: Although we are good friends, friendship is friendship, but accounts must be clear. I will definitely repay the money I borrowed from you on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你地兩兄弟夾份做生意，記住人情還人情，數目要分明，先可以避免日後嘅爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 gaap3 fan6 zou6 saang1 ji3, gei3 zyu6 jan4 cing4 waan4 jan4 cing4, sou3 muk6 jiu3 fan1 ming4, sin1 ho2 ji5 bei6 min5 jat6 hau6 ge3 zaang1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两兄弟合伙做生意，记住人情归人情，账目要分明，才可以避免日后的争执。
examples.english_sentence: You two brothers are starting a business together, remember friendship is friendship, but accounts must be clear, only then can you avoid disputes in the future.

english_meaning: Common knowledge; widely known; universally acknowledged
explanation_mandarin: 指大家都知道的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to something that everyone knows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個國際城市，呢個係人所共知嘅事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 gwok3 zai3 sing4 si5, ni1 go3 hai6 jan4 so2 gung1 zi1 ge3 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个国际城市，这是一个众所周知的事实。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is an international city, which is a widely known fact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅才華係人所共知嘅，所以大家都好期待佢嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 coi4 waa4 hai6 jan4 so2 gung1 zi1 ge3, so2 ji5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 kei4 doi6 keoi5 ge3 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的才华是众所周知的，所以大家都非常期待他的作品。
examples.english_sentence: His talent is universally acknowledged, so everyone is looking forward to his work.

english_meaning: manpower; personnel; staff; hands

explanation_mandarin: 指人的数量。
explanation_english: Refers to the quantity or count of people.

english_meaning: humanities; culture; humanistic
explanation_mandarin: 指人类文化中的精神价值、艺术、道德、哲学等方面的体现。也指具有文化素养和精神追求的。
explanation_english: Refers to the spiritual values, arts, morals, philosophy, and other aspects embodied in human culture. It can also refer to someone with cultural literacy and spiritual pursuits.

examples.english_sentence: Studying humanities can cultivate critical thinking.

english_meaning: Humanities
explanation_mandarin: 研究人类文化、历史、哲学、文学、艺术等领域的学科。
explanation_english: The study of subjects such as literature, philosophy, history, etc., considered as a group; the humanities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀緊人文學。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 人文科学的研究范围很广泛。
examples.english_sentence: The scope of research in the humanities is very broad.

english_meaning: humanities
explanation_mandarin: 指研究人类文化现象的学科，包括哲学、文学、历史、语言学等。
explanation_english: The humanities are academic disciplines that study aspects of human society and culture. In the Renaissance, the term contrasted with divinity and referred to what is now classical studies, the main component of secular education. Today, the humanities are more frequently defined as fields of study pertaining to the human condition, employing methods that are primarily analytical, critical, or speculative, as distinguished from the mainly empirical approaches of the natural sciences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀緊大學嘅人文學科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6 ge3 jan4 man4 hok6 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在读大学的人文学科。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying humanities at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對人文學科嘅興趣好濃厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 man4 hok6 fo1 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 hou2 nung4 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对人文学科的兴趣很浓厚。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong interest in the humanities.

english_meaning: humanities
explanation_mandarin: 指研究人类文化、社会和思想的学科，包括哲学、历史、文学、语言学、艺术等。
explanation_english: The humanities are academic disciplines that study aspects of human society and culture. In the humanities, scholars generally use methods that are primarily analytic, critical, or speculative, as distinguished from the mainly empirical approaches of the natural sciences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊大學嘅人文科學系。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6 ge3 jan4 man4 fo1 hok6 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在读大学的人文科学系。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying in the humanities faculty at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人文科學嘅研究可以幫助我哋更加了解人類嘅歷史同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 man4 fo1 hok6 ge3 jin4 gau3 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 ngo5 dei6 gang3 gaa1 liu2 gaai2 jan4 leoi5 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人文科学的研究可以帮助我们更加了解人类的历史和文化。
examples.english_sentence: The study of humanities can help us better understand human history and culture.

examples.english_sentence: Universities in Hong Kong offer various humanities courses.

english_meaning: Human Day, Renri Festival (the seventh day of the Chinese New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 农历正月初七，是中国传统节日人日，也称“人胜节”、“人庆节”、“人口日”、“人七日”等。传说女娲创世，正月初一创造鸡，初二创造狗，初三创造猪，初四创造羊，初五创造牛，初六创造马，初七创造人，因此正月初七为人日。
explanation_english: Renri (人日), also known as Human Day or the Renri Festival, is a traditional Chinese festival celebrated on the seventh day of the Chinese New Year. According to legend, the goddess Nüwa created different animals on the first six days of the new year, and humans on the seventh day, hence the name 'Human Day'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係人日喇，傳統上要食七樣菜嘅粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 jan4 jat6 laa3, cyun4 tung2 soeng6 jiu3 sik6 cat1 joeng6 coi3 ge3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是人日了，传统上要吃七样菜的粥。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Human Day, traditionally we eat congee with seven kinds of vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人日呢日，好多人都會喺屋企祈福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jat6 ne1 jat6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 kei4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人日这天，很多人都会在家里祈福。
examples.english_sentence: On Human Day, many people will pray for blessings at home.

english_meaning: Everyone has three urgent needs (to urinate, defecate, and fart); everyone needs to relieve themselves.
explanation_mandarin: 指人有必须进行的生理需求，即尿急、便急和放屁（亦可指其他紧急情况）。表达了正常人都会遇到这些难以避免的生理现象。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the three basic and urgent physiological needs of a person: the need to urinate, the need to defecate, and the need to pass gas. It is used to acknowledge that everyone experiences these unavoidable biological functions and needs to relieve themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，人有三急，我借個洗手間先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, jan4 jau5 saam1 gap1, ngo5 ze3 go3 sai2 sau2 gaan1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，人有三急，我借用一下洗手间。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, everyone has three urgent needs, I need to use the restroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人有三急，忍唔住架，你都體諒下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 jau5 saam1 gap1, jan2 m4 zyu6 gaa3, nei5 dou1 tai2 loeng6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人有三急，忍不住的，你也体谅一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has three urgent needs, one can't help it, please be understanding.

jyutping: jan4 jau5 saam1 seoi1 luk6 wong6
mandarin_meaning: 人生有起有落，时运不济的时候，也有鸿运当头的时候。
english_meaning: Everyone has their ups and downs; there are times of misfortune and times of great fortune.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的一生并非一帆风顺，总会遇到倒霉的时候，但也会有好运降临的时候。强调命运的起伏不定。
explanation_english: This idiom describes that life is not always smooth sailing; there will be times of misfortune, but also times of good fortune. It emphasizes the fluctuating nature of fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁灰心嘅，人有三衰六旺啫，下次會好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 fui1 sam1 ge3, jan4 jau5 saam1 seoi1 luk6 wong6 ze1, haa6 ci3 wui5 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要灰心，人生有起有落，下次会好一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged. Everyone has their ups and downs. It will be better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年生意差唔代表永遠都咁差，人有三衰六旺嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 seng1 ji3 caa1 m4 doi6 biu2 wing5 jyun5 dou1 gam3 caa1, jan4 jau5 saam1 seoi1 luk6 wong6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的生意不好不代表永远都这样，人生有起有落嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Just because business is bad this year doesn't mean it will always be like this. Everyone has their ups and downs.

mandarin_meaning: 人有我也有; 见样学样
english_meaning: Keeping up with the Joneses; what others have, I must have too.
explanation_mandarin: 指看到别人有的东西，自己也想拥有，有一种攀比的心理。
explanation_english: Refers to the desire to have what others have, often driven by a competitive or envious mindset. Implies a desire to keep up appearances or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日人有我有，見人買咩貴嘢，佢哋都要買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jan4 jau5 ngo5 jau5, gin3 jan4 maai5 me1 gwai3 je5, keoi5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 maai5.

examples.english_sentence: They're always keeping up with the Joneses. If they see someone buy something expensive, they have to buy it too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好人有我有啦，買嘢要諗清楚自己係咪真係需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan4 jau5 ngo5 jau5 laa1, maai5 je5 jiu3 lam2 cing1 co2 zi6 gei2 hai6 mai1 zan1 hai6 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要人有我有了，买东西要考虑清楚自己是否真的需要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just buy things because everyone else has them. Think carefully about whether you really need it.

english_meaning: People resemble each other (in some ways); There are similarities between people.
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间存在相似之处，无论是外貌、性格还是经历，都可能存在共同点。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people resemble each other in some way. These similarities can be in appearance, personality, or even experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你有冇覺得佢同我個表哥人有相似？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 tung4 ngo5 go3 biu2 go1 jan4 jau5 soeng1 ci5?

examples.english_sentence: Hey, do you think he resembles my cousin?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋性格唔同，但係佢哋嘅遭遇都幾相似，真係人有相似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 sing3 gaak3 m4 tung4, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zou1 geoi6 dou1 gei2 soeng1 ci5, zan1 hai6 jan4 jau5 soeng1 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们的性格不同，但是他们的遭遇都挺相似的，真是人有相似之处。
examples.english_sentence: Although their personalities are different, their experiences are quite similar. People really do resemble each other.

english_meaning: People strive towards higher positions; people aspire to improve their situation; people naturally seek better opportunities.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人都有向上进取的愿望，追求更好的发展机会和更高的社会地位。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the inherent human desire to seek self-improvement, better opportunities, and higher social standing. It reflects the natural aspiration to advance one's circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力讀書，都係想人望高處啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, dou1 hai6 soeng2 jan4 mong6 gou1 cyu3 ze1.

examples.english_sentence: He studies so hard because he just wants to strive for a better future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人望高處，水向低流，呢啲都係自然現象。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 人往高处走，水往低处流，这些都是自然现象。
examples.english_sentence: People strive upwards and water flows downwards, these are natural phenomena.

english_meaning: talent; a person of ability
explanation_mandarin: 指有才能、有知识的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with talent and knowledge; a capable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好重視人材培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 jan4 coi4 pui4 fun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很重视人才培养。
examples.english_sentence: This company values talent development.

examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong needs more talent in technology.

english_meaning: personality; character; moral integrity; dignity
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人在思想、情感和行为上所表现出来的相对稳定的心理特征和行为模式。也指人的尊严和道德品质。
explanation_english: Refers to the relatively stable psychological characteristics and behavioral patterns exhibited by a person in thought, emotion, and behavior. It can also refer to a person's dignity and moral integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人幾好，人格都幾高尚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gei2 hou2, jan4 gaak3 dou1 gei2 gou1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人品很好，人格也很高尚。
examples.english_sentence: He's a good person, and his character is very noble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇人格，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 jan4 gaak3, seng4 jat6 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有人格，总是骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He has no integrity; he's always deceiving people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好尊重佢嘅人格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5 ge3 jan4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很尊重他的人格。
examples.english_sentence: I respect his dignity.

english_meaning: Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), split personality
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人拥有两个或多个不同的人格，这些人格在不同的时间表现出来。是一种心理疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to a mental disorder in which a person exhibits two or more distinct personalities that manifest at different times. It is also known as Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID) or, informally, split personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日轉變性格，好似有人格分裂咁。

examples.english_sentence: He changes his personality all the time, like he has a split personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人格分裂係一種複雜嘅精神疾病，需要專業治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gaak3 fan1 lit6 hai6 jat1 zung2 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 zing1 san4 zat6 beng6, seoi1 jiu3 zyun1 jip6 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人格分裂是一种复杂的精神疾病，需要专业治疗。
examples.english_sentence: Dissociative Identity Disorder is a complex mental illness that requires professional treatment.

english_meaning: Character assassination, defamation
explanation_mandarin: 指通过散布谣言、诽谤等手段，恶意破坏某人的名誉和人格。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of destroying someone's reputation and character through spreading rumors, slander, and defamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用盡方法想人格謀殺佢，實在太卑鄙喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 zeon6 fong1 faat3 soeng2 jan4 gaak3 mau4 saat3 keoi5, sat6 zoi6 taai3 bei1 pei1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用尽方法想人格谋杀他，实在太卑鄙了！
examples.english_sentence: They used every possible method to assassinate his character, it's really despicable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢嘅政治鬥爭好激烈，好多人格謀殺嘅手段都用埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 ge3 zing3 zi6 dau3 zaang1 hou2 gik1烈, hou2 do1 jan4 gaak3 mau4 saat3 ge3 sau2 dyun6 dou1 yung6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事情的政治斗争很激烈，很多人格谋杀的手段都用上了。
examples.english_sentence: The political struggle in this matter is very intense, and many character assassination methods have been used.

mandarin_meaning: 人格障碍 (rén gé zhàng ài)
english_meaning: Personality disorder
explanation_mandarin: 指一种长期存在的、影响个人认知、情感、人际关系和冲动控制的病态人格模式。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-standing, maladaptive pattern of personality traits that significantly impairs a person's functioning in areas such as cognition, affectivity, interpersonal relationships, and impulse control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為咁古怪，可能係有人格障礙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 gam3 gu2 gwaai3, ho2 nang4 hai6 jau5 jan4 gaak3 zoeng3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为这么古怪，可能是有人格障碍。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is so strange, he might have a personality disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇醫生話佢有反社會人格障礙，好難相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 faan2 se5 wui2 jan4 gaak3 zoeng3 ngoi6, hou2 naan4 soeng1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他有反社会人格障碍，很难相处。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has antisocial personality disorder, and he's difficult to get along with.

english_meaning: Buy when others are selling (and vice versa); Buy low, sell high; To take what others abandon
explanation_mandarin: 当别人都不想要的时候我才要，比喻逆向思维，在别人不看好的情况下采取行动。
explanation_english: A strategy of acquiring assets or opportunities that others are abandoning or avoiding, often with the expectation of future value or profit. It implies a contrarian investment approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市跌到咁低，咪啱啱好人棄我取囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 dit3 dou3 gam3 dai1, mai1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 jan4 hei3 ngo5 ceoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市跌到这么低，正好是人弃我取的好时机。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has fallen so low; it's a perfect time to buy when others are selling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市咁淡靜，可能係人棄我取嘅好時機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 gam3 daam6 zing6, ho2 nang4 hai6 jan4 hei3 ngo5 ceoi2 ge3 hou2 si4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市这么冷清，可能正是人弃我取的好机会。
examples.english_sentence: The property market is so quiet; it might be a good opportunity to buy when others are abandoning it.

english_meaning: Human Rights
explanation_mandarin: 指人作为人应该享有的基本权利和自由，包括生命权、自由权、政治权利、经济权利、社会权利和文化权利等。
explanation_english: Human rights are moral principles or norms for certain standards of human behaviour and are regularly protected as legal rights in national and international law. They are commonly understood as inalienable fundamental rights "to which a person is inherently entitled simply because she or he is a human being" and which are "inherent in all human beings", regardless of their nation, location, language, religion, ethnic origin or any other status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要捍衛我哋嘅人權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hon6 wai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jan4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要捍卫我们的人权。
examples.english_sentence: We need to defend our human rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 言論自由係基本人權嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4 hai6 gei1 bun2 jan4 kyun4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 言论自由是基本人权啊。
examples.english_sentence: Freedom of speech is a basic human right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府有責任保障市民嘅人權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jau5 zaak3 jam3 bou2 zoeng3 si5 man4 ge3 jan4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府有责任保障市民的人权。
examples.english_sentence: The government has a responsibility to protect the human rights of its citizens.

english_meaning: person-times, visitor-times, number of visits (by different people or the same person multiple times)
explanation_mandarin: 表示参观、访问、就诊等活动的总人数，包括重复计算。
explanation_english: A measure word indicating the total number of visits, participations, or accesses by individuals to a place or event. This includes repeat visits by the same person. It represents the total count of occurrences, not the number of distinct individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅書展，入場人次超過一百萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 syu1 zin2, jap6 coeng4 jan4 ci3 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 baak3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的书展，入场人次超过一百万。
examples.english_sentence: This year's book fair had over one million visitor-times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間醫院每日嘅求診人次都好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 mui5 jat6 ge3 kau4 can2 jan4 ci3 dou1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家医院每天的就诊人次都很多。
examples.english_sentence: This hospital has a high number of patient visits every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 主題公園嘅入場人次上升咗兩成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 tai4 gung1 jyun2 ge3 jap6 coeng4 jan4 ci3 soeng5 sing1 zo2 loeng5 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主题公园的入场人次上升了两成。
examples.english_sentence: The number of visits to the theme park increased by 20%.

jyutping: jan4 sei2 bat1 nang4 fuk1 sang1
english_meaning: The dead cannot be brought back to life; What's done is done.
explanation_mandarin: 指人死了就不能再活过来，表示事情已经发生，无法挽回。
explanation_english: This idiom means that once someone has died, they cannot be brought back to life. It also implies that what has happened cannot be undone or changed; what's done is done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道你好傷心，但係人死不能復生，你要節哀順變啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 hou2 soeng1 sam1, daan6 hai6 jan4 sei2 bat1 nang4 fuk1 sang1, nei5 jiu3 zit3 oi1 seon6 bin3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你很伤心，但是人死不能复生，你要节哀顺变啊。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're very sad, but the dead cannot be brought back to life, you must accept your fate and move on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事都過咗咁耐，人死不能復生，咪成日諗住啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dou1 gwo3 zo2 gam3 noi6, jan4 sei2 bat1 nang4 fuk1 sang1, mai5 sing4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情都过去这么久了，人死不能复生，别老想着了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has been over for so long, what's done is done, don't keep thinking about it.

english_meaning: Death is like a lamp going out; when a person dies, everything is extinguished.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人死后一切都消失，不复存在。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the belief that when a person dies, everything ends, and nothing remains. It suggests a finite existence without an afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得人死如燈滅，所以要及時行樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 jan4 sei2 jyu4 dang1 mit6, so2 ji5 jiu3 kap6 si4 hang4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得人死如灯灭，所以要及时行乐。
examples.english_sentence: He believes that death is the end of everything, so he wants to seize the day and enjoy life to the fullest.

english_meaning: Mother
explanation_mandarin: 指已经生育孩子的女性，即母亲。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who has given birth to a child; a mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成為咗人母之後，成個人都唔同晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 wai4 zo2 jan4 mou5 zi1 hau6, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 tung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她成为母亲之后，整个人都变了。
examples.english_sentence: After she became a mother, her whole person changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人母真係好偉大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 mou5 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai5 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当母亲真的很伟大。
examples.english_sentence: Being a mother is really great.

jyutping: jan4 bei2 jan4, bei2 sei2 jan4
english_meaning: Comparing oneself to others leads to frustration and unhappiness; comparison is the thief of joy.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说，人与人之间进行比较，只会让人感到沮丧和痛苦。因为总有人比你更优秀，与其不断比较，不如关注自身进步。
explanation_english: This proverb highlights the negative consequences of comparing oneself to others. It suggests that such comparisons inevitably lead to feelings of inadequacy, jealousy, and unhappiness because there will always be someone who seems better off. The focus should be on personal growth and contentment rather than external validation through comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日睇人哋點點點，人比人，比死人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tai2 jan4 dei6 dim2 dim2 dim2, jan4 bei2 jan4, bei2 sei2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是看别人怎么样，人比人，气死人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always look at what others are doing, comparing yourself to others only leads to unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到咁高分，你都唔使唔開心嘅，人比人，比死人啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 gam3 gou1 fan1, nei5 dou1 m4 sai2 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3, jan4 bei2 jan4, bei2 sei2 jan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了那么高的分数，你也不用不开心，人比人，气死人嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He got such a high score, you don't need to be upset, comparing yourself to others only leads to unhappiness.

english_meaning: person; figure; someone
explanation_mandarin: 指人，多用于介绍或描述身份不明或不愿透露姓名的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person, often used when introducing or describing someone whose identity is unknown or not revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方依家正追緝一名可疑人氏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ji1 gaa1 zeng3 zeoi1 cap1 jat1 ming4 ho2 ji4 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方现在正在追捕一名可疑人士。
examples.english_sentence: The police are currently pursuing a suspicious person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話收到消息，有重要人氏會出席個活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 sau1 dou2 siu1 sik1, jau5 zung6 jiu3 jan4 si6 wui5 cheot1 sik1 go3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说收到消息，有重要人士会出席这个活动。
examples.english_sentence: They said they received news that an important figure will attend the event.

english_meaning: people; the masses
explanation_mandarin: 指国家或某一地区的居民的总体。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire body of residents of a country or region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人民嘅力量係好強大嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 man4 ge3 lik6 loeng6 hai6 hou2 koeng4 daai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人民的力量是很强大的。
examples.english_sentence: The power of the people is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要為人民服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 wai6 jan4 man4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要为人民服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government should serve the people.

english_meaning: Renminbi (RMB), Chinese currency
explanation_mandarin: 中华人民共和国的法定货币，简称人民币。
explanation_english: The official currency of the People's Republic of China, abbreviated as RMB.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想換啲人民幣去大陸用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 di1 jan4 man4 bai6 heoi3 daai6 luk6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想换一些人民币去大陆用。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange some RMB to use in mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家人民幣匯率幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jan4 man4 bai6 wui6 leot2 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在人民币汇率是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's the RMB exchange rate now?

english_meaning: popularity; charisma; (internet slang) lively atmosphere (of a forum, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指受欢迎的程度，热闹的气氛。
explanation_english: Refers to the degree of popularity or charisma someone or something possesses; can also refer to a lively atmosphere, especially online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳人氣好旺，成日都要排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jan4 hei3 hou2 wong6, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅人气很旺，经常都要排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very popular, you always have to queue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人氣好高，好多粉絲支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 hei3 hou2 gou1, hou2 do1 fan2 si1 zi1 chi4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人气很高，很多粉丝支持他。
examples.english_sentence: He has high popularity, many fans support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網上論壇嘅人氣好淡，好少人留言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 soeng5 leon6 taan4 ge3 jan4 hei3 hou2 daam6, hou2 siu2 jan4 lau4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个网上论坛的人气很淡，很少人留言。
examples.english_sentence: This online forum has very little activity, very few people leave messages.

synonyms: 受歡迎程度 (sau6 fun1 jing4 cheng4 dou6)

english_meaning: popularity soars, popularity rises sharply, rapid increase in popularity
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在短时间内人气迅速增加。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone's popularity increases rapidly in a short period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加完個選秀節目之後，人氣急升，好多 fans 都好支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 jyun4 go3 syun2 sau3 zit3 muk6 zi1 hau6, jan4 hei3 gap1 sing1, hou2 do1 fans dou1 hou2 zi1 ci4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加完选秀节目之后，人气急剧上升，很多粉丝都支持他。
examples.english_sentence: After participating in the talent show, his popularity soared, and many fans are very supportive of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物相喺網上瘋傳，搞到佢哋嘅人氣急升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 soeng2 hai2 mong5 soeng6 fung1 cyun4, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jan4 hei3 gap1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物照片在网上疯传，导致他们的人气急剧上升。
examples.english_sentence: The food photos of this restaurant went viral online, causing their popularity to soar.

english_meaning: popularity chart; popularity ranking; trending list
explanation_mandarin: 指受欢迎程度的排行榜，通常用于评价人物、事物或作品的受欢迎程度。
explanation_english: A popularity chart or ranking list, usually used to assess the popularity of people, things, or works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺人氣榜上面排第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jan4 hei3 bong2 soeng6 min6 paai4 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在人气榜上排名第一。
examples.english_sentence: He's ranked number one on the popularity chart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲最近喺人氣榜度好hit。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 jan4 hei3 bong2 dou6 hou2 hit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影最近在人气榜上很火。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very popular on the trending list recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想提升自己嘅人氣，就要努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 tai4 sing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 jan4 hei3, zau6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想提高自己的人气，就要更加努力了。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to increase your popularity, you need to work harder.

english_meaning: rule by people; rule of man
explanation_mandarin: 指由个人或少数人根据个人意志进行统治，而非根据法律或制度。
explanation_english: Rule by individuals or a small group based on personal will, rather than rule by law or established systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方好明顯係人治，冇法律可言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 ming4 hin2 hai6 jan4 zi6, mou5 faat3 leot6 ho2 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方很明显是人治，没有法律可言。
examples.english_sentence: It's obvious that this place is ruled by people, there's no rule of law to speak of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋認為人治比較有彈性，可以根據情況嚟調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jing6 wai4 jan4 zi6 bei2 gaau3 jau5 daan6 sing3, ho2 ji5 gan1 geoi3 ching4 kwong3 lai4 tiu4 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们认为人治比较有弹性，可以根据情况来调整。
examples.english_sentence: They think that rule by people is more flexible and can be adjusted according to the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人治嘅問題係容易產生腐敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 zi6 ge3 man6 tai4 hai6 jung4 ji6 chan2 sang1 fu6 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人治的问题是容易产生腐败。
examples.english_sentence: The problem with rule by people is that it easily leads to corruption.

english_meaning: crowd; flow of people; abortion (surgical termination of pregnancy)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指人群的数量和流动情况。2. 指人工流产手术。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the number and movement of people; pedestrian traffic. 2. Refers to abortion, a surgical termination of pregnancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日旺角嘅人流好多呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 wong6 gok3 ge3 jan4 lau4 hou2 do1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天旺角的人流量很大。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of people in Mong Kok today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考慮緊做人流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 leui6 gan2 zou6 jan4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她正在考虑做人工流产。
examples.english_sentence: She is considering having an abortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅人流唔穩定，時多時少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jan4 lau4 m4 wan2 ding6, si4 do1 si4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的客流量不稳定，时多时少。
examples.english_sentence: The flow of customers in this restaurant is unstable, sometimes a lot, sometimes a few.

english_meaning: human wave; crowd surge
explanation_mandarin: 形容人群像波浪一样涌动、起伏的情景。通常指大规模人群的移动，例如演唱会、大型游行等场合。
explanation_english: Describes a scene where a crowd of people moves and undulates like a wave. It usually refers to the movement of a large crowd, such as at concerts or large parades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅時候，觀眾興奮到一齊企起身，形成一股人浪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, gun1 zung3 hing3 fan5 dou3 jat1 cai4 kei5 san1 hei2 san1, ying4 sing4 jat1 gu2 jan4 long6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的时候，观众兴奋地一起站起来，形成一股人浪。
examples.english_sentence: During the concert, the audience was so excited that they all stood up together, forming a human wave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺維園嘅年宵市場，啲人逼到好似人浪咁湧嚟湧去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wai4 yun2 ge3 nin4 siu1 si5 coeng4, di1 jan4 bik1 dou3 hou2 ci5 jan4 long6 gam2 jung2 lai4 jung2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在维多利亚公园的年宵市场，人们拥挤得像人浪一样涌来涌去。
examples.english_sentence: In the Lunar New Year fair at Victoria Park, people were packed so tightly that they surged back and forth like a human wave.

english_meaning: More people than work; overstaffing; redundancy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人员过多，工作岗位不够分配，效率低下。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are too many people for the amount of work available, leading to inefficiency and potential redundancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家好多人浮於事嘅情況，好多人都好得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 fau4 jyu1 si6 ge3 cing4 kwong3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这家公司有很多冗员，很多人都很闲。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of overstaffing in this company now, many people are very idle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多公司都人浮於事，隨時會裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 jan4 fau4 jyu1 si6, ceoi4 si4 wui5 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多公司都人多事少，随时会裁员。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, many companies are overstaffed and may lay off employees at any time.

english_meaning: a sea of people; a huge crowd
explanation_mandarin: 形容人群众多，像海洋一样。
explanation_english: Describes a large crowd of people, resembling a sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旺角永遠都係人海，行都行唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong6 gok3 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 jan4 hoi2, haang4 dou1 haang4 m4 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旺角永远都是人山人海，走都走不动。
examples.english_sentence: Mong Kok is always a sea of people, you can't even move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會門口逼滿晒人海，真係好墟冚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 cheung3 wui2 mun4 hau2 bik1 mun5 saai3 jan4 hoi2, jan1 hai6 hou2 hui1 ham2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会门口挤满了人山人海，真是很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The entrance of the concert was packed with a sea of people, it was really bustling.

mandarin_meaning: 人海战术 (rén hǎi zhàn shù)
english_meaning: Human wave tactics; overwhelming manpower; swarming tactics
explanation_mandarin: 一种战术，指在军事或商业等领域，投入大量人力以压倒对方。
explanation_english: A military tactic, or a strategy in business, etc., that involves using a large number of people to overwhelm the opposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想用人海戰術嚟搶佔市場。

english_meaning: a vast sea of people; lost in a crowd

explanation_english: Describes a large crowd of people, making it difficult to find or recognize someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人海茫茫嘅香港搵返佢，真係好似大海撈針咁難。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 人海茫茫，有缘的话总会再见的。

explanation_english: Refers to a person of low moral character and vile behavior; someone who is considered the scum of the earth.

examples.english_sentence: How could you treat him like that? You're really a piece of scum!

english_meaning: overcrowding; the problems caused by overpopulation; teeming with people
explanation_mandarin: 指人口过多带来的各种问题，如资源短缺、生活空间拥挤等。
explanation_english: Refers to the problems caused by excessive population, such as resource scarcity and crowded living spaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人滿之患好嚴重，樓價又貴，空間又細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 mun5 zi1 waan6 hou2 jim4 zung6, lau4 gaa3 jau6 gwai3, hung1 gaan1 jau6 sai3.

english_meaning: overcrowded, packed, bursting at the seams

explanation_english: Describes a place being overcrowded with people, exceeding its capacity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紅磡體育館開演唱會嗰陣時，人滿爲患，逼到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 ham3 tai2 juk6 gun2 hoi1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 go2 zan6 si4, jan4 mun5 wai4 waan6, bik1 dou3 sei2.

examples.english_sentence: When there's a concert at the Hong Kong Coliseum, it's overcrowded, so packed you could die.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅花車巡遊，條街人滿爲患，我哋都迫唔入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 faa1 ce1 ceon4 jau4, tiu4 gaai1 jan4 mun5 wai4 waan6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 bik1 m4 jap6 heoi3.

english_meaning: crowd (of people)
explanation_mandarin: 很多人聚集在一起的情形。
explanation_english: A large gathering or flow of people; a crowd.

english_meaning: artificial; man-made; caused by human action
explanation_mandarin: 指由人造成的，非自然形成的。
explanation_english: Referring to something caused by human action or made by humans, not naturally formed.

jyutping: jan4 mou4 waang4 coi4 bat1 fu3
english_meaning: A person cannot get rich without unexpected fortune; No crosswise wealth, no riches.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人如果只是靠辛勤劳动，很难变得富有，需要有一些意外的财富才能快速致富。强调了意外之财的重要性。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that it is difficult to become truly wealthy solely through hard work and diligence. It implies that unexpected or windfall gains are often necessary for rapid enrichment. It emphasizes the importance of unexpected wealth.

examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery jackpot, truly fulfilling the saying 'A person cannot get rich without unexpected fortune!'

examples.english_sentence: Although working hard is important, sometimes you need to rely on unexpected wealth, as the saying goes, 'A person cannot get rich without unexpected fortune.'

explanation_mandarin: 指那些在人生各方面都非常成功，似乎拥有完美生活的人。例如，事业有成，家庭幸福，健康良好等。
explanation_english: Refers to people who appear to be very successful in all aspects of life, seemingly possessing a perfect life. Examples include successful careers, happy families, good health, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗 CEO，真係人生勝利組。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 CEO, zan1 hai6 jan4 sang1 sing3 lei6 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了 CEO，真是人生赢家。
examples.english_sentence: He became CEO at such a young age, he's really one of life's winners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日羨慕人哋係人生勝利組，每個人都有自己嘅難處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sin6 mou6 jan4 dei6 hai6 jan4 sang1 sing3 lei6 zou2, mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 naan4 chu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是羡慕别人是人生赢家，每个人都有自己的难处。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always envy people who are life's winners, everyone has their own difficulties.

english_meaning: Life is over; My life is ruined.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对生活的绝望或极度沮丧。常用在遇到重大挫折或失败后，表达感到一切都结束了，没有希望了。
explanation_english: Expresses despair or extreme frustration with life. Commonly used after experiencing a major setback or failure, conveying a feeling that everything is over and there is no hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試肥佬，人生已完啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, jan4 sang1 ji5 jyun4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格，人生完了！
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam, my life is over!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老細炒魷魚，真係人生已完咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 sai3 caau2 jau4 jyu2, zan1 hai6 jan4 sang1 ji5 jyun4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被老板解雇了，真的感觉人生都完了。
examples.english_sentence: Being fired by the boss really feels like my life is over.

english_meaning: outlook on life; philosophy of life; view of life
explanation_mandarin: 对人生的根本看法和态度。
explanation_english: A person's general philosophy or attitude toward life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生觀好積極，成日都覺得有希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 gun1 hou2 jik1 gik1, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 jau5 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生观很积极，总是觉得有希望。
examples.english_sentence: His outlook on life is very positive; he always feels there is hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個人嘅人生觀都唔同，所以做事嘅方式都唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 jan4 sang1 gun1 dou1 m4 tung4, so2 ji5 zou6 si6 ge3 fong1 sik1 dou1 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人的世界观都不同，所以做事的方式都不一样。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has a different outlook on life, so the way they do things is different.

english_meaning: Life winner; A person who seems to have it all
explanation_mandarin: 指在人生中各个方面都非常成功，例如事业、家庭、财富等等，让人羡慕的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who appears to be extremely successful in all aspects of life, such as career, family, and wealth, making them enviable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗 CEO，真係人生贏家啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 CEO, zan1 hai6 jan4 sang1 jeng4 gaa1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了CEO，真是人生赢家啊！
examples.english_sentence: He became CEO at such a young age, he really is a life winner!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又靚又有錢，老公又咁錫你，簡直係人生贏家嘅典範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 leng3 jau6 jau5 chin2, lou5 gung1 jau6 gam3 sek3 nei5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jan4 sang1 jeng4 gaa1 ge3 din2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又漂亮又有钱，老公又这么疼你，简直是人生赢家的典范。
examples.english_sentence: You're beautiful and rich, and your husband loves you so much, you're simply the epitome of a life winner.

english_meaning: Unfamiliar with the place (literally: the road of life is unfamiliar)
explanation_mandarin: 指初到一个地方，对当地的情况不熟悉，没有经验。
explanation_english: Refers to being unfamiliar with a place, lacking local knowledge or experience, especially in a new environment. It suggests a lack of connection, knowledge, or experience with the area and its people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我第一次嚟呢度做嘢，人生路不熟，好多嘢都要問人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4 ni1 dou6 zou6 je5, jan4 sang1 lou6 bat1 suk6, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我第一次来这里工作，人生地不熟，很多事情都要问人。
examples.english_sentence: This is my first time working here, I'm unfamiliar with the place, I have to ask people about a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個去咗外國讀書，人生路不熟，肯定會遇到好多困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1, jan4 sang1 lou6 bat1 suk6, hang2 ding6 wui5 jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个去国外读书，人生地不熟，肯定会遇到很多困难。
examples.english_sentence: They went abroad to study, they're unfamiliar with the place, they'll definitely encounter many difficulties.

english_meaning: harmless (to humans and animals); inoffensive; innocuous
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物对人和动物都没有伤害，比喻性格温和、没有攻击性或威胁性。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is harmless to both humans and animals. Figuratively, it describes someone who is gentle, inoffensive, and lacks any aggressive or threatening qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣人畜無害咁，點知咁蠱惑！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 jan4 cuk1 mou4 hoi6 gam2, dim2 zi1 gam3 gu2 waak6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来人畜无害的样子，没想到这么狡猾！
examples.english_sentence: He looks so harmless, who knew he was so cunning!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新遊戲嘅宣傳話人畜無害，但係啲家長都係擔心入面有隱藏嘅暴力內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 jau4 hei3 ge3 syun1 cyun4 waa6 jan4 cuk1 mou4 hoi6, daan6 hai6 di1 gaa1 cheung2 dou1 hai6 daam1 sam1 yap6 min6 jau5 yan2 chong4 ge3 bou6 lik6 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新游戏的宣传说人畜无害，但是家长们还是担心里面有隐藏的暴力内容。
examples.english_sentence: The advertisement for this new game claims it's harmless, but parents are still worried about hidden violent content inside.

mandarin_meaning: 人人可嫁；比喻女子行为放荡，随便与男人发生关系。
english_meaning: Available to all men; Prostitute; (figuratively) promiscuous; indiscriminate
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子行为不检点，随便与男人发生性关系。带贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is unchaste, having sexual relations indiscriminately with men. It carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁爛滾，成日同唔同嘅男人一齊，真係人盡可夫噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan6 gwan2, sing4 jat6 tung4 m4 tung4 ge3 naam4 jan2 jat1 cai4, zan1 hai6 jan4 zeon6 ho2 fu1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么放荡，总是和不同的男人在一起，真是人尽可夫一样。
examples.english_sentence: She's so promiscuous, always with different men. It's like she's available to all men.

english_meaning: widely known; universally known; common knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或消息已经广泛传播，每个人都知道。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or piece of news that has spread widely and is known to everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅醜聞而家都人盡皆知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cau2 man4 ji4 gaa1 dou1 jan4 zeon6 gaai1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的丑闻现在已经众所周知了。
examples.english_sentence: His scandal is now widely known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅叉燒飯好好食，幾乎人盡皆知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 caa1 siu1 faan6 hou2 hou2 sik6, gei2 fu1 jan4 zeon6 gaai1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的叉烧饭很好吃，几乎是众所周知的。
examples.english_sentence: The barbecued pork rice at this restaurant is delicious; it's almost common knowledge.

english_meaning: arousing the anger of both gods and men; utterly outrageous; extremely unpopular
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人的行为或事件非常恶劣，连神和人都感到愤怒。
explanation_english: Describes an act or event so terrible that it angers both gods and men; used to describe something that is extremely outrageous, unjust, or unpopular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣呃人錢，真係人神共憤啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 ngaak1 jan4 cin2, zan1 hai6 jan4 san4 gung6 fan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样骗人钱，真是人神共愤啊！
examples.english_sentence: The way he swindles people out of their money is truly outrageous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府起咁多樓都唔理民生，簡直係人神共憤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hei2 gam3 do1 lau2 dou1 m4 lei5 man4 sang1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jan4 san4 gung6 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府盖这么多楼都不顾及民生，简直是人神共愤。
examples.english_sentence: The government is building so many buildings without considering people's livelihoods; it's simply outrageous.

english_meaning: man-made disaster; human-caused calamity
explanation_mandarin: 指由于人为因素造成的灾难或祸害。
explanation_english: A disaster or calamity caused by human error, negligence, or intentional actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次水災主要都係因為政府規劃失當，簡直係人禍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 seoi2 zoi1 zyu2 jiu3 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai4 zing3 fu2 gwai1 waak6 sat1 dong3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jan4 wo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次水灾主要是因为政府规划失当，简直是人祸。
examples.english_sentence: This flood was mainly due to the government's poor planning, it's simply a man-made disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次工廠爆炸明顯係人禍，唔係意外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 gung1 chong2 baau3 zaa3 ming4 hin2 hai6 jan4 wo6, m4 hai6 ji3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次工厂爆炸明显是人祸，不是意外。
examples.english_sentence: This factory explosion is clearly a man-made disaster, not an accident.

english_meaning: race, ethnicity
explanation_mandarin: 指人类在体质形态上表现出来的差异，如肤色、毛发、头型等。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people distinguished by certain similar and genetically transmitted physical characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔同嘅人種嘅人都有自己嘅文化特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 zung2 ge3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 man4 faa3 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不同种族的人都有自己的文化特色。
examples.english_sentence: People of different races all have their own cultural characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重唔同人種嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 m4 tung4 jan4 zung2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重不同种族的人。
examples.english_sentence: We need to respect people of different races.

english_meaning: commonly known as; known as; generally referred to as
explanation_mandarin: 人们通常称呼为…；大家一般叫做…。
explanation_english: Commonly known as, generally referred to as. Used to introduce someone or something's popular name or title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人稱「食神」，煮嘢食好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 cing1 "sik6 san4", zyu2 je5 sik6 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们称他为“食神”，做菜很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He is commonly known as the "God of Cookery", he's really good at cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳人稱「老字號」，開咗好多年啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jan4 cing1 "lou5 zi6 hou6", hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅俗称“老字号”，开了很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is commonly known as an "old brand name", it has been open for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人稱「數學王子」，細細個就好叻計數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 cing1 "sou3 hok6 wong4 zi2", sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 hou2 lek1 gai3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们称他为“数学王子”，从小就很会算数。
examples.english_sentence: He is known as the "Math Prince", he has been good at calculations since he was young.

english_meaning: Poor in wealth, but not in spirit; Poor but with ambition.
explanation_mandarin: 指人虽然贫穷，但是志向没有衰退。形容人有骨气，不因贫困而丧失理想和追求。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who, despite being poor, still maintains a strong will, ambition, and high aspirations. It emphasizes resilience and not letting poverty diminish one's goals and dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然冇乜錢，但係人窮志不窮，努力讀書，希望將來可以出人頭地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 mou5 mat1 cin2, daan6 hai6 jan4 kung4 zi3 bat1 kung4, nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1, hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 chut1 jan4 tau4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然没什么钱，但是人穷志不短，努力读书，希望将来可以出人头地。
examples.english_sentence: Although he doesn't have much money, he is poor in wealth, but not in spirit. He studies hard, hoping to be successful in the future.

synonyms: 窮且益堅 (kung4 ce2 jik1 gin1)
窮而不濫 (kung4 ji4 bat1 laam6)

english_meaning: Poverty diminishes ambition; A poor man's aspirations are limited.
explanation_mandarin: 指人因为贫穷，就失去了远大的志向。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the phenomenon where a person's ambition and aspirations are limited or diminished due to poverty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想創業，但係冇錢，真係人窮志短呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 cong3 jip6, daan6 hai6 mou5 cin2, zan1 hai6 jan4 kung4 zi3 dyun2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想创业，但是没有钱，真是人穷志短啊。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to start a business, but he doesn't have any money. It's really a case of poverty diminishing ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日話自己唔得，人窮志短啫，努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 dak1, jan4 kung4 zi3 dyun2 ze1, nu5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是说自己不行，人穷志短嘛，努力一点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always say you can't do it. It's just that poverty diminishes ambition. Just try harder and you can do it.

english_meaning: When people are poor, they start thinking about old debts (owed to them).
explanation_mandarin: 指人在困窘的时候，就会想起以前别人欠自己的钱，希望能够收回。也比喻陷入困境时，才会想到以前的得失。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the tendency for people in difficult financial situations to recall old debts owed to them, hoping to recover the money. It can also metaphorically describe someone in a difficult situation reflecting on past gains and losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近失業，成日都話邊個邊個爭佢錢，真係人窮思舊債。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sat1 jip6, seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 bin1 go3 bin1 go3 zaang1 keoi5 cin2, zan1 hai6 jan4 kung4 si1 gau6 zaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近失业了，总是说谁谁欠他钱，真是人穷回忆旧债。
examples.english_sentence: He recently lost his job and keeps talking about who owes him money. It's a classic case of 'when people are poor, they start thinking about old debts'.

english_meaning: and so on, etc., and others, and the like
explanation_mandarin: 表示同类的事物或人，与“等等”、“之类”意思相近。
explanation_english: Used to indicate things or people of the same kind, similar in meaning to 'and so on', 'etc.', 'and others'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗蘋果、橙、香蕉人等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 ping4 gwo2, caang2, hoeng1 ziu1 jan4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了苹果、橙子、香蕉等等。
examples.english_sentence: I bought apples, oranges, bananas, and so on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗朋友、親戚人等去飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 pang4 jau5, can1 cik1 jan4 dang2 heoi3 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了朋友、亲戚等等去参加婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: They invited friends, relatives, and the like to the wedding.

jyutping: jan4 syun3 bat1 jyu4 tin1 syun3
english_meaning: Man proposes, God disposes; the best laid plans of mice and men often go awry.
explanation_mandarin: 指人的计划往往不如天意，事情的发展变化常超出人的预料。
explanation_english: This idiom means that human plans are often thwarted by fate or divine will. Things often turn out differently than expected, no matter how carefully we plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋本來諗住去旅行，但係突然間打風，真係人算不如天算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bun2 lai4 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, daan6 hai6 dat6 jin4 gaan1 daa2 fung1, zan1 hai6 jan4 syun3 bat1 jyu4 tin1 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们本来计划去旅行，但是突然刮台风了，真是人算不如天算。
examples.english_sentence: We originally planned to go traveling, but suddenly there was a typhoon. It's true that man proposes, God disposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾好晒啲合作細節，點知最後佢哋間公司執笠，人算不如天算，冇得搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 hou2晒啲 hap6 zok3 sai3 jit3, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1, jan4 syun3 bat1 jyu4 tin1 syun3, mou5 dak1 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈好了所有的合作细节，没想到他们公司最后倒闭了，真是人算不如天算，没法做了。
examples.english_sentence: We had finalized all the cooperation details, but unexpectedly their company went bankrupt. Man proposes, God disposes; there's nothing we can do.

mandarin_meaning: 人精 / 非常聪明的人 / 老油条
english_meaning: shrewd person / clever person / cunning person / sly fox
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常聪明，精明，甚至带有一些狡猾的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely clever, shrewd, and even somewhat cunning. Can be used with admiration or disapproval depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係人精嚟㗎，永遠都唔會蝕底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jan4 zing1 lei4 gaa3, wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 sit3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个人精，永远都不会吃亏。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a shrewd person, he'll never let himself be taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路仔鬼咁醒目，真係人精噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 gwai2 gam2 sing2 muk6, zan1 hai6 jan4 zing1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩子非常聪明，真是个人精一样。
examples.english_sentence: This kid is so clever, he's like a little sly fox.

english_meaning: Young in age but wise (or cunning) beyond their years; precocious; a small child with adult-like cunning or cleverness.
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪小的人，却非常机灵、老练，甚至带有些许狡猾。
explanation_english: Describes a young person who is clever, shrewd, and sometimes even a little cunning, beyond what is expected for their age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個細路人細詭大，乜都識晒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 sai3 lou6 jan4 sai3 gwai2 daai6, mat1 dou1 sik1 saai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩人小鬼大，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is precocious, knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人細詭大，好識得氹人開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 sai3 gwai2 daai6, hou2 sik1 dak1 tam5 jan4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人小鬼大，很会哄人开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's cunning, he knows how to make people happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢人細細個，人細詭大㗎，分分鐘叻過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 jan4 sai3 sai3 go3, jan4 sai3 gwai2 daai6 gaa3, fan1 fan1 cung1 leng3 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他年纪小，人小鬼大，说不定比你还聪明。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him because he's young. He's precocious and might be smarter than you.

english_meaning: Young in age but mature/crafty/precocious for their age; wise beyond their years; little devil.
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪小的人却非常聪明、狡猾、懂事，像个小大人一样。
explanation_english: Describes a young person who is surprisingly clever, cunning, or mature for their age. They may understand things or act in ways that are more typical of an older person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然得五歲，但係人細鬼大，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 dak1 ng5 seoi3, daan6 hai6 jan4 sai3 gwai2 daai6, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然才五岁，但是人小鬼大，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's only five years old, he's young but clever, he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友人細鬼大，成日都扮大人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 jan4 sai3 gwai2 daai6, seng4 jat6 dou1 baan3 daai6 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小朋友人小鬼大，总是装大人说话。
examples.english_sentence: That child is young but precocious, always acting like a grown-up when speaking.

english_meaning: popularity; relations with people; having good rapport with others
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人与他人相处的关系，以及受人欢迎的程度。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's relationship with others and the degree to which they are well-liked and popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好好人，所以人緣都好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hou2 jan4, so2 ji5 jan4 jyun4 dou1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人很好，所以人缘也很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very nice person, so he's also very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上，人緣好係好重要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6, jan4 jyun4 hou2 hai6 hou2 cung5 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上，人缘好是很重要的。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, having good interpersonal relations is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人緣差到連同事都唔想同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 jyun4 caa1 dou3 lin4 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人缘差到连同事都不想和他合作。
examples.english_sentence: His interpersonal relations are so bad that even his colleagues don't want to cooperate with him.

synonyms: 人際關係 (jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6)

english_meaning: crowd; throng; multitude
explanation_mandarin: 指聚集在一起的人。数量较多。
explanation_english: A large number of people gathered together; a crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旺角啲人羣真係好多，逼到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong6 gok3 di1 jan4 kwan4 zan1 hai6 ho2 do1, bik1 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旺角的人群真的很多，挤死了。
examples.english_sentence: The crowds in Mong Kok are really huge, so crowded that it's suffocating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚咗行入人羣度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 zo2 haang4 jap6 jan4 kwan4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我害怕走入人群中。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid of walking into the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會吸引咗好多人羣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 cheung3 wui2 kap1 yan5 zo2 ho2 do1 jan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会吸引了很多人群。
examples.english_sentence: The concert attracted a large crowd.

english_meaning: crowd, multitude, throng
explanation_mandarin: 很多人聚集在一起的状态。
explanation_english: A large gathering of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日喺旺角好多人羣，行都行唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai2 wong6 gok3 hou2 do1 jan4 kwan4, haang4 dou1 haang4 m4 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天在旺角很多人，走都走不动。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people in Mong Kok today that you can hardly move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 避免去人羣聚集嘅地方，可以減少感染嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei6 min5 heoi3 jan4 kwan4 zeoi6 zaap6 ge3 dei6 fong1, ho2 ji5 gaam2 siu2 gam2 jim5 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 避免去人群聚集的地方，可以减少感染的机会。
examples.english_sentence: Avoiding crowded places can reduce the chances of infection.

english_meaning: crowd; throng; multitude
explanation_mandarin: 聚集在一起的人群。
explanation_english: A large number of people gathered together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵站入邊好多人群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 zaam6 jap6 bin6 hou2 do1 jan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁站里面很多人群。
examples.english_sentence: There are many crowds inside the subway station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢逼入人群度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bik1 jap6 jan4 kwan4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挤入人群中。
examples.english_sentence: He squeezed into the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋畀人群沖散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bei2 jan4 kwan4 cung1 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们被人群冲散了。
examples.english_sentence: We were scattered by the crowd.

english_meaning: past one's prime (usually refers to women)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻女子年老色衰，像珍珠失去了光澤一樣。
explanation_english: An idiom to describe a woman who is past her prime and has lost her beauty, similar to a pearl that has lost its luster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁悲觀啦，就算人老珠黃，都可以活得精彩嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bei1 gun1 laa1, zau6 syun3 jan4 lou5 zyu1 wong4, dou1 ho2 ji5 wut6 dak1 zing1 coi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么悲观啦，就算人老色衰，也可以活得很精彩的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pessimistic. Even if a woman is past her prime, she can still live a wonderful life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係選美冠軍，但係而家都人老珠黃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 syun2 mei5 gun1 gwan3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 dou1 jan4 lou5 zyu1 wong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前是选美冠军，但是现在也人老色衰了。
examples.english_sentence: She used to be a beauty pageant champion, but now she's past her prime.

jyutping: jan4 lou5 zing1 gwai2 lou5 ling4
mandarin_meaning: 人老了变得精明，鬼老了更加狡猾
english_meaning: Old people are shrewd, old ghosts are even more cunning; the older you get, the wiser (and possibly more cunning) you become.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人年纪越大，经验越丰富，也变得更加精明和狡猾。也指鬼魂活得越久越有灵性，更加难以对付。多含褒贬兼有的意味，视语境而定。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how people become more shrewd and cunning as they age due to their accumulated experience. It also implies that older ghosts are more powerful and difficult to deal with. The connotation can be both positive (wisdom, experience) and negative (cunning, deviousness), depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁老都仲咁醒目，真係人老精鬼老靈啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lou5 dou1 zung6 gam3 sing2 muk6, zan1 hai6 jan4 lou5 zing1 gwai2 lou5 ling4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么老了还这么精明，真是人老精鬼老灵啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so old but still so sharp, truly, old people are shrewd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以呃到佢，佢人老精鬼老靈，咩都睇得穿㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 aak1 dou3 keoi5, keoi5 jan4 lou5 zing1 gwai2 lou5 ling4, me1 dou1 tai2 dak1 cyun1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着可以骗到他，他人老精鬼老灵，什么都看得穿的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can fool him, he's an old fox and can see right through everything.

synonyms: 老奸巨猾 (lǎo jiān jù huá)
姜是老的辣 (jiāng shì lǎo de là)

jyutping: jan4 ji4 mou4 seon3, bat1 zi1 kei4 ho2
english_meaning: A man without credibility, I don't know what he is good for.
explanation_mandarin: 一个人如果不讲信用，真不知道他还能做什么。强调诚信的重要性。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of trustworthiness and integrity. If a person lacks credibility, it is difficult to see what value they can offer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意最緊要講信用，如果人而無信，不知其可，邊個仲敢同你合作啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 gong2 seon3 jung6, jyu4 gwo2 jan4 ji4 mou4 seon3, bat1 zi1 kei4 ho2, bin1 go3 zung1 gam2 tung4 nei5 hap6 jok3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意最重要的是讲信用，如果人而无信，不知其可，谁还敢跟你合作啊？
examples.english_sentence: In business, the most important thing is to be trustworthy. If a person lacks credibility, I don't know what he is good for. Who would dare to cooperate with you?

english_meaning: to doxx; to reveal someone's personal information online through collective online investigation
explanation_mandarin: 指通过网络上的集体力量，对某个人或事件进行调查，并公开其个人信息，例如姓名、住址、工作单位等。通常带有负面含义，涉及侵犯隐私。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of using the collective power of the internet to investigate a person or event and publicly reveal their personal information, such as their name, address, employer, etc. Usually has a negative connotation and involves invasion of privacy.  Commonly referred to as 'doxxing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為喺網上發表歧視言論，俾人「人肉」起底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 faat3 biu2 kei4 si5 jin4 leon6, bei2 jan4 "jan4 juk6" hei2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为在网上发表歧视言论，被人肉搜索曝光。
examples.english_sentence: He was doxxed for posting discriminatory remarks online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂咁講嘢，小心俾人「人肉」㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2 je5, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 "jan4 juk6" gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要乱说话，小心被人肉搜索啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just say anything, be careful you don't get doxxed!

english_meaning: suicide bomber; human bomb
explanation_mandarin: 指身上携带炸弹，以自杀方式进行恐怖袭击的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person carrying explosives on their body who commits a suicide attack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話嗰個係人肉炸彈，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 go2 go3 hai6 jan4 juk6 zaa3 daan2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说那个人是人体炸弹，要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: They said that person is a suicide bomber, we have to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視新聞報道有恐怖份子用人肉炸彈襲擊人群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 san1 man4 bou3 dou6 jau5 hung2 bou3 fan6 zi2 yung6 jan4 juk6 zaa3 daan2 sik1 gik1 yan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视新闻报道有恐怖分子用人体炸弹袭击人群。
examples.english_sentence: The TV news reported that terrorists used suicide bombers to attack crowds.

english_meaning: network of contacts, connections
explanation_mandarin: 指个人在社会交往中建立起来的关系网络，通常用于指能够带来利益或帮助的关系。
explanation_english: A network of personal connections and relationships established through social interactions, often referring to connections that can bring benefits or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意人脈好緊要㗎，識多人辦事都方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 sang1 ji3 jan4 mak6 hou2 gan2 jiu3 gaa3, sik1 do1 di1 jan4 baan6 si6 dou1 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意人脉很重要，认识的人多办事也方便些。
examples.english_sentence: Having a good network is very important for doing business. Knowing more people makes things easier to handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠晒佢屋企嘅人脈先搵到份咁好嘅工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 saai3 keoi5 uk1 kei2 ge3 jan4 mak6 sin1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gam3 hou2 ge3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全依靠他家里的关系才能找到这么好的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He completely relied on his family's connections to find such a good job.

synonyms: 關係網絡 (gwaan1 hai6 mong5 lok3)

english_meaning: manpower; personnel; staff
explanation_mandarin: 指做事所需的人力或人数。
explanation_english: Refers to the manpower or number of people needed to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔夠人腳啊，點搞掂咁多嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 gau3 jan4 goek3 aa3, dim2 gaau2 dim6 gam3 do1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们人手不够啊，怎么完成这么多东西？
examples.english_sentence: We don't have enough manpower, how are we going to finish so much stuff?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司請咗好多新人，人腳都齊曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 jan4, jan4 goek3 dou1 cai4 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司请了很多新人，人手都齐了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has hired many new people, we have a full staff now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日搬屋，你哋嚟幫手，當係湊人腳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 bun1 uk1, nei5 dei6 lei4 bong1 sau2, dong3 hai6 cou3 jan4 goek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天搬家，你们来帮忙，就当是凑人手了。
examples.english_sentence: We're moving tomorrow, come help out, consider it chipping in manpower.

english_meaning: facial recognition
explanation_mandarin: 一种通过分析人脸特征来识别身份的技术。
explanation_english: A technology that identifies a person's identity by analyzing facial features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間銀行用咗人臉識別技術嚟驗證客戶身份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4 yung6 zo2 jan4 lim5 sik1 bit1 gei6 seut6 lai4 yim6 zing3 haak3 wu6 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家银行使用了人脸识别技术来验证客户身份。
examples.english_sentence: This bank uses facial recognition technology to verify customer identities.

english_meaning: ginseng
explanation_mandarin: 一种名贵的中药材，有补气、生津等功效。
explanation_english: A precious Chinese medicinal herb with properties such as replenishing qi and promoting body fluid production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話飲人蔘雞湯對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 jam2 jan4 sam1 gai1 tong1 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说喝人参鸡汤对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: Mom says that ginseng chicken soup is good for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話食咗人蔘之後覺得精神咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 sik6 zo2 jan4 sam1 zi1 hau6 gok3 dak1 zing1 san4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说吃了人参之后觉得精神了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He said that he felt much more energetic after taking ginseng.

english_meaning: illegal immigrant; human snake
explanation_mandarin: 指通过非法途径进入某个国家或地区的移民。因为偷渡过程通常需要像蛇一样隐蔽行动，所以被称为“人蛇”。
explanation_english: Refers to illegal immigrants who enter a country or region through illegal channels. The term originates from the covert nature of the smuggling process, often requiring actions akin to a snake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋班人蛇俾海關捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baan1 jan4 se4 bei2 hoi2 gwaan1 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那批偷渡者被海关抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: That group of illegal immigrants was caught by the customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人蛇為咗搵更好嘅生活，不惜冒險偷渡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 se4 wai6 zo2 wan2 gang3 hou2 ge3 saang1 wut6, bat1 sik1 mou6 him2 tau1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多偷渡者为了寻找更好的生活，不惜冒险偷渡。
examples.english_sentence: Many illegal immigrants risk their lives to smuggle themselves in search of a better life.

english_meaning: Too stupid to be cured; Hopelessly stupid; Beyond help due to stupidity.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常愚蠢，已经到了无法通过任何方法改变或纠正的地步。通常带有强烈的贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being so stupid that they cannot be helped or changed. It carries a strong negative connotation.
