examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 jan4 ji6 dou6 dak1, daan6 hai6 bui3 hau6 zau6 zou6 maai4晒 di1 seoi1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在讲仁义道德，但是背后却做尽坏事。
examples.english_sentence: He talks about benevolence, righteousness, and morality every day, but behind the scenes, he does all sorts of bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲仁義道德嘅嘢，唔係人人都會遵守㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jan4 ji6 dou6 dak1 ge3 je5, m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 wui5 zeon1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些仁义道德的东西，不是每个人都会遵守的。
examples.english_sentence: Not everyone abides by these principles of benevolence, righteousness, and morality.

english_meaning: To have done everything possible (to help someone or fulfill one's duty); to have gone to the limit of benevolence and righteousness.
explanation_mandarin: 指仁义方面已经做到了最大限度，没有丝毫欠缺。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one has exhausted all possible means of benevolence and righteousness in their actions. It implies that one has gone above and beyond what is expected to help someone or fulfill their obligation, leaving nothing more to be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經對你仁至義盡，你仲想點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 deoi3 nei5 jan4 zi3 ji6 zeon6, nei5 zung2 soeng2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经对你仁至义尽了，你还想怎样？
examples.english_sentence: We've already gone above and beyond for you, what more do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀咗咁多機會你，都算仁至義盡㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 zo2 gam3 do1 gei1 wui6 nei5, dou1 syun3 jan4 zi3 ji6 zeon6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给了你这么多机会，也算是仁至义尽了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has given you so many opportunities, it can be considered to have done everything possible.

english_meaning: alone; solitary; isolated
explanation_mandarin: 形容孤单，没有依靠的样子。
explanation_english: Describes being alone, isolated, and without support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人喺街上面仃企咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 ding1 kei5 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在街上孤零零地站了好久。
examples.english_sentence: He stood alone on the street for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬咗去外國之後，覺得自己好仃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zi1 hau6, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬到国外之后，觉得自己很孤单。
examples.english_sentence: After moving abroad, I feel very lonely.

mandarin_meaning: 倾斜，歪斜; 不正; (地方)窄小
english_meaning: slanted, tilted; not straight; narrow (space)
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体倾斜或不正；也形容空间狭窄。
explanation_english: Describes something that is slanted, tilted or not straight; also describes a space that is narrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋好仄㗎，小心行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 zak1 gaa3, siu2 sam1 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子很倾斜的，小心走。
examples.english_sentence: The house is very slanted, be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅畫掛得好仄喎，較返正佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 waa2 gwaa3 dak1 hou2 zak1 wo3, gaau3 faan1 zeng3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画挂得很歪，把它弄正吧。
examples.english_sentence: The painting is hung crookedly, straighten it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路咁仄，車都過唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 gam3 zak1, ce1 dou1 gwo3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路这么窄，车都过不去。
examples.english_sentence: The road is so narrow that cars can't pass through.

english_meaning: To fold paper, folded paper
explanation_mandarin: 指把纸张折叠成特定的形状。既可以指折叠的动作，也可以指折叠后的纸张成品。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of folding paper into a specific shape. It can refer to the action of folding or the folded paper product itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻仄紙，乜嘢都仄到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 zak1 zi2, mat1 je5 dou1 zak1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长折纸，什么都能折。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at origami, he can fold anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日用報紙仄紙飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 yung6 bou3 zi2 zak1 zi2 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常用报纸折纸飞机。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often used newspapers to make paper airplanes.

english_meaning: Oblique tone (in classical Chinese prosody)
explanation_mandarin: 在古汉语声调体系中，除平声以外的声调，包括上声、去声、入声。与“平声”相对。
explanation_english: In classical Chinese prosody, tones other than the level tone (平聲), including rising (上聲), departing (去聲), and entering (入聲). It's the opposite of 'level tone'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺粵語入面，我哋都要留意啲字係平聲定係仄聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jyut6 jyu5 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 liu4 yi3 di1 zi6 hai6 ping4 seng1 ding6 hai6 zak1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在粤语里面，我们也要留意哪些字是平声还是仄声。
examples.english_sentence: In Cantonese, we also need to pay attention to whether words are level or oblique tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫舊詩嘅時候，要留意平仄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 gau6 si1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 liu4 yi3 ping4 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写旧诗的时候，要注意平仄。
examples.english_sentence: When writing classical poetry, you need to pay attention to level and oblique tones.

english_meaning: to fall; to tumble; to trip
explanation_mandarin: 摔倒，向前跌倒。
explanation_english: To fall forward; to tumble. Often implies a sudden, unexpected fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心仆親咗，擦損咗隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 puk1 can1 zo2, caat3 syun2 zo2 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心摔倒了，擦伤了手。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally fell and scraped my hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得太快，仆低咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 taai3 faai3, puk1 dai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走得太快，摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked too fast and fell down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇路啊，唔好仆親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lou6 aa3, m4 hou2 puk1 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看路啊，别摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: Watch out, don't fall.

english_meaning: Go to hell! / Damn you!
explanation_mandarin: 一句骂人的话，表示强烈的愤怒或不满，希望对方倒霉。
explanation_english: A curse phrase expressing strong anger or dissatisfaction, wishing misfortune on the other person. Literally translates to "Fall on the stinky street!"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呃我錢，仆你個臭街！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 aak1 ngo5 cin2, puk1 nei5 go3 cau3 gaai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你骗我的钱，去死！
examples.english_sentence: You cheated me out of my money, damn you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到咁，仆你個臭街!
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 gam2, puk1 nei5 go3 cau3 gaai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵成这样，真倒霉!
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is so bad, damn it!

english_meaning: Fuck you! / Damn it!
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的粤语脏话，表达愤怒、不满、惊讶等情绪。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese curse word used to express anger, dissatisfaction, surprise, etc. It's a strong expression of annoyance or frustration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆你個街！又塞車！
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 nei5 go3 gaai1! jau6 sak1 che1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他妈的！又堵车！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it! There's traffic again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆你個街，搞錯晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 nei5 go3 gaai1, gaau2 cho3 saai3 di1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去你的，全搞错了！
examples.english_sentence: Fuck you, you messed everything up!

synonyms: 屌你老母 (diu2 nei5 lou5 mou5)

english_meaning: Damn it!; Son of a bitch!; A general expression of annoyance or frustration.
explanation_mandarin: 一种粗俗的粤语表达，用于表达愤怒、不满、惊讶等负面情绪。 字面意思是“摔倒他的街道”，实际上是一种诅咒或表达强烈情绪的口语化方式。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese expression used to express anger, frustration, surprise, or other negative emotions. Literally meaning "fall on his street", it's actually a curse or a colloquial way of expressing strong emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆佢個街！又塞車！
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 keoi5 go3 gaai1! jau6 sak1 ce1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真讨厌！又堵车！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it! There's a traffic jam again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆佢個街，張單咁貴嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 keoi5 go3 gaai1, zoeng1 daan1 gam3 gwai3 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 该死的，账单这么贵？
examples.english_sentence: Son of a bitch, is the bill this expensive?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仆佢個街，我唔記得咗帶銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: puk1 keoi5 go3 gaai1, ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真糟糕，我忘记带钱包了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, I forgot to bring my wallet.

english_meaning: to fall (over)
explanation_mandarin: 指身体失去平衡而倒在地上。
explanation_english: To lose one's balance and fall to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，仆倒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, puk1 dou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't careful when walking and fell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥成日都跑跑跳跳，好容易仆倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 seng4 jat6 dou1 paau2 paau2 tiu3 tiu3, hou2 jung4 ji6 puk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子总是跑跑跳跳，很容易摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: Kids always run and jump around, so it's easy for them to fall.

english_meaning: to fall; to tumble; to trip
explanation_mandarin: 指失去平衡而倒在地上。比喻失败或遇到挫折。
explanation_english: Refers to losing balance and falling to the ground. It can also be used metaphorically to describe failure or encountering setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，仆到喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, buk1 dou3 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，摔倒在地上了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't careful while walking and fell to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經營不善，好快就仆到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 jing4 bat1 sin6, hou2 faai3 zau6 buk1 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司经营不善，很快就要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is poorly managed and will soon fail.

english_meaning: To rush to, to hurry to, to arrive immediately (usually implying eagerness or haste)
explanation_mandarin: 指立刻、火速地前往某地。带有急切、渴望或不得不去的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to rushing or hurrying to a place immediately, implying eagerness, urgency, or obligation to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有演唱會，我哋要一早就仆到去霸位呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 jin2 coeng3 wui2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 zou2 zau6 puk1 dou3 heoi3 baa3 wai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有演唱会，我们要一早就赶去占位置啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's a concert tomorrow, we have to rush there early in the morning to grab good spots!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話佢唔舒服，我即刻仆到去睇佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 keoi5 m4 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 puk1 dou3 heoi3 tai2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说她不舒服，我立刻赶去看看她。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said she wasn't feeling well, so I rushed to go and see her immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一聽到有減價，啲師奶即刻仆到去搶購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ting3 dou2 jau5 gaam2 gaa3, di1 si1 naai5 zik1 hak1 puk1 dou3 heoi3 coeng2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一听到有打折，那些师奶立刻赶去抢购。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as they heard about the sale, the housewives immediately rushed there to grab the bargains.

english_meaning: to fall and break one's nose; to fall flat on one's face (literally and figuratively); to suffer a heavy setback
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是跌倒撞断鼻子。常用来形容遭遇惨重的失败或挫折，狼狈不堪的样子。
explanation_english: Literally means to fall and break one's nose. It's often used metaphorically to describe a situation where someone suffers a significant failure or setback, leaving them in a miserable state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資嗰間公司執咗笠，真係仆崩鼻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 zo2 lap1, zan1 hai6 puk1 bang1 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资的那家公司倒闭了，真是摔得鼻青脸肿。
examples.english_sentence: The company he invested in went bankrupt, he really suffered a heavy setback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係仆崩鼻啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 puk1 bang1 bei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真是摔得鼻青脸肿了。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam this time, I really suffered a setback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺股市撈一筆，點知仆崩鼻，輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 gu2 si5 laau1 jat1 bat1, dim2 zi1 puk1 bang1 bei6, syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在股市捞一笔，没想到摔得鼻青脸肿，输光了所有的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to make a quick buck in the stock market, but he suffered a heavy loss and lost all his money.

english_meaning: wholeheartedly; with all one's heart and soul; to work oneself to the bone
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常努力，尽心尽力，不顾一切地付出。
explanation_english: Describes someone who works very hard, does their best, and dedicates themselves completely to a task, often to the point of exhaustion or neglecting their own well-being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗公司仆心仆命，搞到自己都病埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gung1 si1 buk1 sam1 buk1 ming6, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 dou1 beng6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了公司全心全意，搞得自己都病了。
examples.english_sentence: He worked himself to the bone for the company, to the point that he got sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁仆心仆命啦，身體緊要啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 buk1 sam1 buk1 ming6 laa1, san1 tai2 gan2 jiu3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么全心全意了，身体更重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, your health is more important.

english_meaning: to fall flat; to go bankrupt; to fail miserably
explanation_mandarin: 指跌倒，摔倒在地；引申义为倒闭，失败，彻底失败。
explanation_english: Literally means to fall down flat on one's face. Figuratively, it can mean to go bankrupt (referring to a business) or to fail miserably (in any endeavor).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心喺街度仆直咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 hai2 gaai1 dou6 puk1 zik6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心在街上摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell flat on his face in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經營不善，好快就仆直咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 ying4 bat1 sin6, hou2 faai3 zau6 puk1 zik6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司经营不善，很快就倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: That company was poorly managed and quickly went bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我仆直啦，肯定唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 puk1 zik6 laa1, hang2 ding6 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我肯定要失败了，肯定不及格。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to fail miserably in this exam, I'm definitely going to fail.

synonyms: 執笠 (zap1 lap1, close down - business)

english_meaning: Go to hell; Drop dead; (General expression of annoyance or frustration)
explanation_mandarin: 诅咒别人去死。 语气强烈，表示非常不满、生气或者鄙视。
explanation_english: A curse wishing someone to die or fail miserably. It is a strong expression of anger, frustration, or contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢搞成咁，仆街啦你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gaau2 sing4 gam2, puk1 gaai1 laa1 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干什么搞成这样，去死吧你！
examples.english_sentence: What did you do to mess things up like this? Drop dead!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲仆街，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 puk1 gaai1, seng4 jat6 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些骗子，整天骗人钱。
examples.english_sentence: These bastards, they cheat people out of their money all the time.

english_meaning: Bastard; son of a bitch; jerk; (mildly) you little rascal
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种强烈的厌恶或愤怒，指责对方卑鄙无耻，行为令人不齿。是比较粗俗的骂人话。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to express strong dislike, anger, or contempt towards someone. It implies that the person is despicable, shameless, and behaves in a disgusting manner. It is a rather vulgar insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，真係仆街仔嚟嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, zan1 hai6 puk1 gaai1 zai2 lai4 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，真是个混蛋！
examples.english_sentence: Doing something like that, you're really a bastard!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仆街仔呃咗我啲錢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 puk1 gaai1 zai2 aak1 zo2 ngo5 di1 cin2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个混蛋骗了我的钱！
examples.english_sentence: That bastard cheated me out of my money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就當你係仆街仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 dong3 nei5 hai6 puk1 gaai1 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就当你是个小杂种！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I'll treat you like a little rascal!

english_meaning: Go to hell; Drop dead; You bastard
explanation_mandarin: 表示强烈的诅咒和愤怒，希望对方去死。是非常粗俗的用语。
explanation_english: An extremely vulgar Cantonese expression used to express intense anger and curse someone. It literally translates to 'fall on the street and die'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我真係想你仆街死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 nei5 puk1 gaai1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要是再不听话，我真想你去死。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen again, I really want you to drop dead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰格，仆街死都抵啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, puk1 gaai1 sei2 dou1 dai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么差劲，去死都活该！
examples.english_sentence: He's such a bad person, he deserves to drop dead!

english_meaning: Trouble magnet; someone who attracts bad luck; a jinx
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人非常倒霉，总是遇到坏事，或者总是招惹麻烦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely unlucky, constantly encountering bad things or attracting trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係仆街磁石嚟㗎，行到邊衰到邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 buk1 gaai1 ci4 sek6 lei4 gaa3, haang4 dou3 bin1 seoi1 dou3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个倒霉鬼，走到哪衰到哪。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a trouble magnet, he brings bad luck wherever he goes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從識咗佢之後，我就好似變咗仆街磁石咁，乜嘢衰嘢都俾我撞到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 sik1 zo2 keoi5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 hou2 ci5 bin3 zo2 buk1 gaai1 ci4 sek6 gam2, mat1 je5 seoi1 je5 dou1 bei2 ngo5 zong6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从认识他之后，我就好像变成了倒霉鬼，什么倒霉事都让我碰到了。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since I met him, I feel like I've become a trouble magnet, I run into all sorts of bad luck.

english_meaning: to fall (over), to tumble
explanation_mandarin: 指失去平衡而倒地。
explanation_english: Refers to losing balance and falling to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得太快，仆轉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 taai3 faai3, buk1 zyun2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走太快了，摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked too fast and fell over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地下濕濕地，好易仆轉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 haa6 sip1 sip1 dei2, hou2 ji6 buk1 zyun2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地上湿漉漉的，很容易摔倒的。
examples.english_sentence: The ground is wet, it's easy to fall over.

english_meaning: Scatter; Disperse; Move aside; Get out of the way
explanation_mandarin: 表示迅速散开或让人走开，避免阻碍。
explanation_english: Indicates a quick scattering or a command for someone to move aside and not obstruct something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，仆開啲啦，唔好阻住晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, buk1 hoi1 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，让开点，不要挡住全部。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, move aside a bit, don't block everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 听到爆炸声，啲人即刻仆開晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 baau3 zaa3 seng1, di1 jan4 zik1 hak1 buk1 hoi1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到爆炸声，人们立刻都散开了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the explosion, people immediately scattered.

english_meaning: hatred, enmity, feud
explanation_mandarin: 仇恨；敌对关系。
explanation_english: Hatred; enmity; a state of deep-seated ill-will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢有仇，唔想見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 jau5 sau4, m4 soeng2 gin3 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他有仇，不想见到他。
examples.english_sentence: I have a feud with him and don't want to see him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 解開仇恨先可以得到真正嘅和平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai2 hoi1 sau4 han6 sin1 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 zan3 zing3 ge3 wo4 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化解仇恨才能得到真正的和平。
examples.english_sentence: Only by resolving hatred can true peace be achieved.

english_meaning: enemy, foe
explanation_mandarin: 指怀有仇恨的人；有深仇大恨的人。
explanation_english: A person who holds a grudge or hatred; a person with a deep-seated enmity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅仇人，我永遠都唔會原諒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 sau4 jan4, ngo5 wing2 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 jyun4 loeng6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的仇人，我永远都不会原谅他。
examples.english_sentence: He is my enemy, I will never forgive him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冤家宜解不宜结，唔好同人结仇做仇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun1 ga1 ji4 gaai2 bat1 ji4 git3, m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 git3 sau4 zou6 sau4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宜解不宜结，不要和别人结仇，成为仇人。
examples.english_sentence: It's better to resolve disputes than to create them; don't make enemies with others.

english_meaning: grudge; feud; animosity; to harbor a grudge
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间产生的仇恨或积怨。
explanation_english: Refers to the hatred or resentment that arises between people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家人有仇口，好耐冇來往啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 jan4 jau5 sau4 hau2, hou2 noi6 mou5 loi4 wong5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家人有仇恨，很久没有来往了。
examples.english_sentence: Those two families have a feud and haven't been in contact for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同人結仇口，對自己冇好處嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 git3 sau4 hau2, deoi3 zi6 gei2 mou5 hou2 cyu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和别人结仇，对自己没有好处的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hold grudges against others, it's not good for you.

english_meaning: enemy, foe, adversary
explanation_mandarin: 指有仇恨的人或家族。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or family with whom one has a feud or deep-seated hatred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家係世仇，遲早都會搵仇家報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 hai6 sai3 sau4, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui2 wan2 sau4 gaa1 bou3 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家是世仇，迟早都会找仇人报仇。
examples.english_sentence: Those two families are sworn enemies, sooner or later they'll seek revenge on their enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾仇家跟蹤，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 sau4 gaa1 gan1 zung1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被仇人跟踪，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: He's being followed by his enemies, it's very dangerous!

english_meaning: resenting the rich; anti-rich sentiment
explanation_mandarin: 对富人抱有仇恨或不满的情绪。
explanation_english: To resent or feel animosity towards wealthy people; describes the feeling of resentment towards the rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅貧富懸殊咁嚴重，有啲人開始有仇富心態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 pan4 fu3 hyun4 syu1 gam3 jim4 zung6, jau5 di1 jan4 hoi1 chi2 jau5 sau4 fu3 sam1 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的贫富差距这么严重，有些人开始有仇富心态。
examples.english_sentence: With such a severe wealth gap in Hong Kong, some people are starting to develop an anti-rich mentality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲有錢人嘅壞話，好似好仇富咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 jau5 cin2 jan4 ge3 waai6 waa6, hou2 ci5 hou2 sau4 fu3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说有钱人的坏话，好像很仇富似的。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks ill of the rich, it's like he really resents them.

english_meaning: hatred, animosity, enmity
explanation_mandarin: 强烈的憎恨或敌意。
explanation_english: A strong feeling of dislike; hatred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾仇恨控制你嘅一生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 cau4 han6 hung3 zai3 nei5 ge3 jat1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让仇恨控制你的一生。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let hatred control your life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢個仇人充滿仇恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 go3 cau4 jan4 cung1 mun5 cau4 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的仇人充满仇恨。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of hatred towards his enemy.

english_meaning: Hate speech
explanation_mandarin: 指煽动对特定群体（如种族、宗教、性别等）的仇恨、歧视或暴力的言论。
explanation_english: Speech that attacks or demeans a group based on attributes such as race, religion, ethnic origin, national origin, sex, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲仇恨言論喺網上越嚟越多，好令人擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cau4 han6 jin4 leon6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 yut6 lai4 yut6 do1, hou2 ling6 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些仇恨言论在网上越来越多，很令人担心。
examples.english_sentence: These hate speeches are becoming more and more prevalent online, which is very worrying.

english_meaning: enemy, foe, adversary
explanation_mandarin: 指有深仇大恨的敌人。
explanation_english: A bitter enemy or foe; someone one strongly dislikes or hates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家人係世仇，幾代都係仇敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 jan4 hai6 sai3 sau4, gei2 doi6 dou1 hai6 sau4 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家人是世仇，几代都是仇敌。
examples.english_sentence: Those two families are sworn enemies, they've been foes for generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將意見唔同嘅人睇成仇敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 ji3 gin3 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 tai2 sing4 sau4 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要将意见不同的人看成仇敌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat people with different opinions as enemies.

english_meaning: revenge killing; vendetta; blood feud
explanation_mandarin: 指因仇恨而进行的杀戮。
explanation_english: Killing someone as an act of revenge; a feud or vendetta.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個家族之間嘅仇殺持續咗幾十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gaa1 zuk6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 cau4 saat3 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个家族之间的仇杀持续了几十年。
examples.english_sentence: The blood feud between those two families lasted for decades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑呢單案係一宗仇殺案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 ni1 daan1 on3 hai6 jat1 zung1 cau4 saat3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑这起案件是一宗仇杀案。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect that this case is a revenge killing.

english_meaning: to regard with hatred; to be hostile towards
explanation_mandarin: 怀着仇恨的眼光看待；敌视。
explanation_english: To view with hatred; to be hostile towards someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔應該仇視任何種族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ying1 goi1 cau4 si6 jam6 ho4 zung2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不应该仇视任何种族。
examples.english_sentence: We should not hate any race.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋仇視外國人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cau4 si6 ngoi6 gwok3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们仇视外国人。
examples.english_sentence: They hate foreigners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好仇視失敗，要從中學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cau4 si6 sat1 baai6, yiu3 cung4 zung1 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要仇视失败，要从中学习。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hate failure, learn from it.

english_meaning: now, this (time/day/etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示现在或今天。
explanation_english: Indicates the present time or today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今做緊乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在在做什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚會出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 wui5 cheot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天晚上会出去。
examples.english_sentence: I will go out tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係大鑊啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 chi3 zan1 hai6 daai6 wok6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的是糟糕了！
examples.english_sentence: This time we are really in trouble!

english_meaning: this lifetime, this present life
explanation_mandarin: 指人的一生，现在的这一辈子。
explanation_english: Refers to one's life, this current lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今世可以做多啲善事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 sai3 ho2 ji5 zou6 do1 di1 sin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望今生可以多做一些善事。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to do more good deeds in this lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今世我哋能夠做朋友，真係好有緣份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 sai3 ngo5 dei6 nang4 gau3 zou6 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jyun4 fan6.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 kei4 zaap6 zi3 ge3 fung1 min2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这期杂志的封面很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The cover of this issue of the magazine is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今期我要交多啲學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 kei4 ngo5 jiu3 gaau1 do1 di1 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这期我要交更多的学费。
examples.english_sentence: I have to pay more tuition fees this term.

english_meaning: this time; this instance; this occasion
explanation_mandarin: 表示这一次，指的是当前或者最近发生的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to this time, indicating something happening currently or recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考得不好。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well in this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我請你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我请你吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: This time, I'll treat you to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅機會好難得，你要好好把握。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gei1 wui2 hou2 naan4 dak1, nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 baa2 ak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的机会很难得，你要好好把握。
examples.english_sentence: This is a rare opportunity, you should seize it.

english_meaning: this life, this lifetime
explanation_mandarin: 指人活着的这一辈子。
explanation_english: Refers to the current life that a person is living; this lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今生可以去環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 sang1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望今生可以去环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can travel around the world in this lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係有來生，我哋希望來生都可以再做朋友啦。但係就算冇，今生都認識到你，我已經覺得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 jau5 loi4 sang1, ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 loi4 sang1 dou1 ho2 ji5 zoi3 zou6 pang4 jau5 laa1. daan6 hai6 zau6 syun3 mou5, gam1 sang1 dou1 ying6 sik1 dou3 nei5, ngo5 ji5 ging1 gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的有来生，我们希望来生还能再做朋友。但就算没有，今生能认识你，我已经觉得很高兴了。
examples.english_sentence: If there really is an afterlife, we hope we can be friends again in the next life. But even if there isn't, I'm already very happy to have met you in this lifetime.

english_meaning: this lifetime, in this life, forever in this life
explanation_mandarin: 指这一辈子，这一生。表达一种坚定的承诺或决心，通常用于爱情或友谊方面。
explanation_english: Refers to this lifetime, this life. Expresses a firm commitment or determination, usually used in the context of love or friendship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今生今世都要一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 sang1 gam1 sai3 dou1 jiu3 yat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今生今世都要在一起。
examples.english_sentence: We will be together in this lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應承你，今生今世都會對你好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ying1 sing3 nei5, gam1 sang1 gam1 sai3 dou1 wui5 deoi3 nei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我答应你，今生今世都会对你好。
examples.english_sentence: I promise you, I will be good to you in this lifetime.

english_meaning: This time; this occasion; this trip
explanation_mandarin: 表示这一次、这回，通常指某一次具体的行动或经历。
explanation_english: Refers to 'this time' or 'this occasion', often indicating a specific action or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今趟旅行我哋去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 tong3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行我们去日本。
examples.english_sentence: This trip we are going to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今趟考試我一定要攞到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 tong3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lo2 dou3 hou2 sing4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我一定要取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: I must get good grades in this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今趟真係唔好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 tong3 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是不走运。
examples.english_sentence: This time is really unlucky.

english_meaning: This time; this round; this game (in a specific instance or situation)
explanation_mandarin: 用于表示某一次的具体情况，通常带有一种结果未知的意味。常用于口语，表示这一次、这回等。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a specific instance, often with an implication of uncertain outcome. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese to mean 'this time', 'this round', or 'this game', particularly when referring to a specific attempt or situation with a degree of risk or chance involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今鋪我一定要贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 pou1 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我一定要赢。
examples.english_sentence: This time I must win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今鋪真係大鑊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 pou1 zan1 hai6 daai6 wok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: This time we are really in big trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今鋪睇你點收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 pou1 tai2 nei5 dim2 sau1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次看你怎么收拾残局。
examples.english_sentence: Let's see how you clean up this mess this time.

english_meaning: Things are not what they used to be; A world of difference; Significant changes have occurred.
explanation_mandarin: 现在的情况和过去的情况相比发生了巨大的变化，有了显著的提升或改善。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where there has been a significant change or improvement compared to the past. It implies a considerable difference between the present and the past state of affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港呢幾年發展得好快，今非昔比喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ni1 gei2 nin4 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3, gam1 fei1 sik1 bei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港这几年发展很快，今非昔比了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has developed very quickly in recent years, it's not what it used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀咗大學之後，個人成熟咗好多，真係今非昔比呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 zo2 daai6 hok6 zi1 hau6, go3 jan4 sing4 suk6 zo2 hou2 do1, zan1 hai6 gam1 fei1 sik1 bei2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读了大学之后，个人成熟了很多，真是今非昔比啊。
examples.english_sentence: After attending university, he became much more mature, it's really a world of difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢努力工作之後，佢嘅生活今非昔比，越嚟越好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 sang1 wut6 gam1 fei1 sik1 bei2, yut6 lai4 yut6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他努力工作之后，他的生活今非昔比，越来越好。
examples.english_sentence: Since he started working hard, his life is not what it used to be, getting better and better.

mandarin_meaning: 在意， 关心， 谨慎
english_meaning: to mind, to care about, to be careful, to be cautious
explanation_mandarin: 表示在意、关心或小心谨慎的态度。可以指对某事物的关注程度，或者做事小心谨慎的态度。
explanation_english: Indicates an attitude of caring, concern, or caution. It can refer to the degree of attention paid to something, or a careful and prudent attitude in doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你介唔介意我坐喺你隔離啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaai3 m4 gaai3 ji3 ngo5 co5 hai2 nei5 gaak3 lei4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你介意我坐在你旁边吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you mind if I sit next to you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使介意，小事啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gaai3 ji3, siu2 si6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用在意，小事而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about it, it's a small matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好介意人哋點睇佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gaai3 ji3 yan4 dei6 dim2 tai2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很在意别人怎么看他。
examples.english_sentence: He cares a lot about what others think of him.

english_meaning: between; intermediate to; halfway between
explanation_mandarin: 表示在两个事物或状态之间。
explanation_english: Indicates being situated between two things or states; intermediate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績介乎A同B之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 gaai3 fu4 A tung4 B zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩介于A和B之间。
examples.english_sentence: His grade is between A and B.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻顏色介乎藍色同綠色之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 ngaan4 sik1 gaai3 fu4 laam4 sik1 tung4 luk6 sik1 zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个颜色介于蓝色和绿色之间。
examples.english_sentence: This color is between blue and green.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅關係介乎朋友同情侶之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 gaai3 fu4 pang4 jau5 tung4 cing4 leoi5 zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的关系介于朋友和情侣之间。
examples.english_sentence: Our relationship is somewhere between friends and lovers.

english_meaning: intervene, interfere, meddle
explanation_mandarin: 干涉，干预。指参与并影响某件事或某人的决定。
explanation_english: To intervene or interfere in a situation, often with the intention of influencing the outcome or someone's decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好介入人哋嘅家事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaai3 jap6 jan4 dei6 ge3 gaa1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要介入别人的家事。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't interfere in other people's family matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方介入調查呢單案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gaai3 jap6 diu6 caa4 ni1 daan1 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方介入调查这起案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police have intervened to investigate this case.

english_meaning: ring (finger ring)
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手指上的装饰品，通常用金属制成，有时镶有宝石等。
explanation_english: An ornamental band worn on a finger, typically made of metal and sometimes set with precious stones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗隻鑽石介子俾佢女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 zek3 zyun3 sek6 gaai3 zi2 bei2 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了一个钻石戒指给他的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a diamond ring to his girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻介子太緊，除唔甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 gaai3 zi2 taai3 gan2, ceoi4 m4 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的戒指太紧了，脱不下来。
examples.english_sentence: My ring is too tight, I can't take it off.

english_meaning: to mind, to care, to take offense, to object
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事或某人感到不舒服、不愉快或担心，有时也表示不赞成或反对。
explanation_english: To feel uncomfortable, displeased, or worried about something or someone; sometimes also indicates disapproval or objection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你介唔介意我食埋你個件蛋糕呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaai3 m4 gaai3 ji3 ngo5 sik6 maai4 nei5 go3 gin6 daan6 gou1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你介意我把你的蛋糕吃掉吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you mind if I eat your piece of cake?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔介意你講真話，最緊要係對我好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gaai3 ji3 nei5 gong2 zan1 waa6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不介意你说真话，最重要的是对我好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind you telling the truth, the most important thing is that you're good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我遲到，你介意嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ci4 dou3, nei5 gaai3 ji3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我迟到，你介意吗？
examples.english_sentence: Would you mind if I'm late?

english_meaning: to mind, to take to heart, to be concerned about, to worry about
explanation_mandarin: 指对某事或某人的行为、言语等感到在意，放在心上。
explanation_english: To mind something, to take something to heart, to be concerned or worried about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使介懷佢講嘅嘢，佢個人係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gaai3 waai4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 go3 jan4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用介意他说的话，他这个人就是这样。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to mind what he said, he's just like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔介懷你以前做過乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gaai3 waai4 nei5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不介意你以前做过什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind what you did in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好介懷人哋點睇佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gaai3 waai4 jan4 dei6 dim2 tai2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很在意别人怎么看他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very concerned about what others think of him.

english_meaning: to introduce; to present; to recommend; introduction
explanation_mandarin: 使双方或多方相识；推荐。
explanation_english: To introduce or recommend someone or something to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我介紹我個朋友俾你識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaai3 siu6 ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 bei2 nei5 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我介绍我的朋友给你认识。
examples.english_sentence: I'll introduce my friend to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我介紹咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 gaai3 siu6 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我介绍了一份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He introduced a job to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我介紹吓呢間餐廳嘅招牌菜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 gaai3 siu6 haa5 ni1 gaan1 can1 teng1 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我来介绍一下这家餐厅的招牌菜吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let me introduce the signature dishes of this restaurant.

english_meaning: letter of introduction; referral letter
explanation_mandarin: 用于介绍个人情况、推荐个人或单位的信件。
explanation_english: A letter introducing a person or organization, often used for job applications, referrals, or introductions to services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要寫返封介紹信俾個朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 se2 faan1 fung1 gaai3 siu6 seon3 bei2 go3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要写一封介绍信给一个朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I need to write a letter of introduction for a friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞住封介紹信去搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zyu6 fung1 gaai3 siu6 seon3 heoi3 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着介绍信去找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is using a letter of introduction to find a job.

english_meaning: preposition
explanation_mandarin: 用于连接名词、代词或名词性短语等与句子中其他成分，表示它们之间的关系。
explanation_english: A word governing, and usually preceding, a noun or pronoun and expressing a relation to another word or element in the clause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東話嘅「喺」字係一個好常用嘅介詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 "hai2" zi6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 soeng4 yung6 ge3 gaai3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粤语的“喺”字是一个很常用的介词。
examples.english_sentence: The Cantonese word "hai2" is a very commonly used preposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「喺」可以表示地點，時間，對象等等，用法好廣泛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: "hai2" ho2 ji5 biu2 si6 dei6 dim2, si4 gaan3, deoi3 zoeng6 dang2 dang2, yung6 faat3 hou2 gwong2 faan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “喺”可以表示地点，时间，对象等等，用法很广泛。
examples.english_sentence: "Hai2" can indicate location, time, object, etc. Its usage is very broad.

english_meaning: interface
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个系统、个体之间的交接面或交互方式，常见于计算机领域，也用于描述人与人之间的交往方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the point of interaction or communication between two or more systems or individuals. Commonly used in the field of computing, but also used to describe the way people interact with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個App嘅介面好易用喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 App ge3 gaai3 min6 hou2 ji6 yung6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个App的界面很好用。
examples.english_sentence: This app's interface is very easy to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個之間嘅介面一直都唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gaai3 min6 jat1 zik6 dou1 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个之间的关系一直不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the two of them has never been very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個新系統嘅使用者介面需要重新設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 san1 hai6 tung2 ge3 si2 yung6 ze2 gaai3 min6 seoi1 jiu3 cung4 san1 sat3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新系统的用户界面需要重新设计。
examples.english_sentence: The user interface of the new system needs to be redesigned.

english_meaning: still, yet, as before
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况持续不变或动作持续进行。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation remains unchanged or an action continues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾日，但係仍然返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, daan6 hai6 jing4 jin4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了几天，但是仍然上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for a few days, but he still goes to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗咁耐雨，而家仍然落緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 gam3 noi6 jyu5, ji4 gaa1 jing4 jin4 lok6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了这么久的雨，现在仍然在下。
examples.english_sentence: It's been raining for so long, and it's still raining now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊年嘅目標，今年仍然未達到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1, gam1 nin4 jing4 jin4 mei6 daat6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年的目标，今年仍然没有达到。
examples.english_sentence: Last year's goal has still not been achieved this year.

english_meaning: still, yet, as before
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况持续不变，没有改变。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation remains unchanged, with no alteration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗咁耐，我仍然咁掛住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ngo5 jing4 jin4 gam3 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了这么久，我仍然这么想念他。
examples.english_sentence: He's been gone for so long, but I still miss him so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗成日雨，而家仍然落緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 seng4 jat6 jyu5, ji4 gaa1 jing4 jin4 lok6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了一整天的雨，现在还在下。
examples.english_sentence: It has been raining all day, and it's still raining now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢已經退休，但仍然好關心公司嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 teoi3 jau1, daan6 jing4 jin4 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他已经退休了，但仍然很关心公司的发展。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has retired, he is still very concerned about the company's development.

english_meaning: still; yet; as before
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况没有改变，跟以前一样。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation has not changed and is the same as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，但係仍舊好精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 jing4 gau6 hou2 zing1 san4.

english_meaning: to follow, to obey, from
explanation_mandarin: 1. 跟随：跟在后面。2. 听从：按照别人的意愿行事。3. 介词：从，表示起始。
explanation_english: 1. To follow: to go after someone or something. 2. To obey: to act according to someone else's wishes. 3. Preposition: from, indicating a starting point.

english_meaning: Mother and child (usually refers to a mother and her young child, either son or daughter)
explanation_mandarin: 指母亲和她的孩子，通常指年幼的孩子，可以是儿子或女儿。
explanation_english: Refers to a mother and her child, typically a young child, either a son or a daughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到啲仔乸咁開心，我都覺得好安慰。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那些母子/母女这么开心，我也觉得很安慰。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing those mothers and children so happy, I also feel very comforted.

english_meaning: Family-run business; small-scale business run by family members
explanation_mandarin: 形容由家庭成员共同经营的小规模生意，通常指资源有限，规模较小。
explanation_english: Describes a small-scale business run by family members, typically implying limited resources and a small operational scale. It often suggests a lack of professionalism or sophisticated management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做緊仔乸生意，舖頭細細間，都幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 gan2 zai2 naa2 seng1 ji3, pou3 tau2 sai3 sai3 gaan1, dou1 gei2 san1 fu2.

examples.english_sentence: They're running a family business. The shop is small and it's quite hard work.

english_meaning: When sons grow up, they make their own world; Sons will be sons; Boys will be boys; As children grow up, they have their own lives.
explanation_mandarin: 形容儿子长大后有自己的想法和生活，父母不应过多干涉。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the situation where sons, upon reaching adulthood, have their own ideas and lives. Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都唔好管佢咁多啦，仔大仔世界，佢自己會識諗嘅。

examples.english_sentence: Let's not interfere with him so much. Boys will be boys, he'll figure it out himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都想控制我嘅生活，但我已經大個仔，仔大仔世界啦，我都要有自己嘅選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 hung3 zai3 ngo5 ge3 saang1 wut6, daan6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 daai6 go3 zai2, zai2 daai6 zai2 sai3 gaai3 laa1, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是想控制我的生活，但我已经长大了，儿大不由娘了，我都要有自己的选择。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always wants to control my life, but I'm already grown up. Sons will be sons, I need to have my own choices.

explanation_english: Refers to a dormitory room where boys or men reside, usually in a school or institution that provides communal housing.

examples.english_sentence: The boys' dormitory is noisy, with many boys chatting.

english_meaning: Young master; sir; boss (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对年轻男子的尊称，带有一定的戏谑或调侃意味。也可用于称呼不太熟悉或捉摸不透的人，表示客气或疏远。
explanation_english: An old term of respect for a young man, often used with a hint of jest or mockery. It can also be used to address someone you are not familiar with or cannot figure out, expressing politeness or distance.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 nei5 hai6 bin1 go3 zai2 je4 aa3, gam3 baa1 bei1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为你是哪位少爷啊，这么了不起？
examples.english_sentence: Who do you think you are, acting so important?

english_meaning: careful, meticulous, thorough
explanation_mandarin: 指做事认真、细致，考虑周到。
explanation_english: Describes being careful, meticulous, and thorough in one's actions; showing attention to detail and consideration.

mandarin_meaning: 生活安稳舒适，无后顾之忧
english_meaning: To have a comfortable and stable life with no worries (literally: careful business, wife, and young children)
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活安稳，生意顺利，有老婆孩子需要照顾，因此做事情会更加谨慎小心，力求安稳。也比喻生活幸福美满，没有后顾之忧。
explanation_english: Describes a stable and comfortable life. It implies that because one has a business to run carefully, a wife, and young children to care for, one will be more cautious and careful in one's actions, striving for stability. It also implies a happy and fulfilling life with no worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做生意做得幾好，又結咗婚生埋仔，真係仔細老婆嫩啦。

examples.english_sentence: He's doing well in his business now, and he's married and has children, he really has a comfortable and stable life.

examples.english_sentence: The gentry of the past paid much attention to their reputation.

english_meaning: Gentrification
explanation_mandarin: 指原本居住于城市贫民区的低收入居民，由于房价或租金上涨，被迫迁离家园，取而代之的是较为富裕的中产阶级或以上阶层居民，从而改变该区域的社会结构和文化特征的现象。
explanation_english: Gentrification refers to the process where low-income residents in an urban area are displaced due to rising property values or rent, and are replaced by wealthier, middle-class residents or higher. This changes the social structure and cultural characteristics of the area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊區越嚟越仕紳化，好多老街坊都搬走咗啦。

examples.english_sentence: This old neighborhood is becoming increasingly gentrified, and many old neighbors have moved away.

examples.english_sentence: The process of gentrification has a great impact on grassroots citizens.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 si6 tou4 soeng6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在仕途上发展得很顺利。

english_meaning: other people; others

explanation_english: Refers to people other than oneself.

examples.english_sentence: Don't always meddle in other people's business; take care of yourself first!

english_meaning: Tatami mat

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企嘅和室鋪滿咗他他米，好舒服㗎。

examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 di1 fong2 dou1 pou3 zo2 taa1 taa1 mai5, hou2 jau5 jat6 bun2 fung1 mei6.

english_meaning: Simp, someone who is overly eager to please someone they are romantically interested in, often to the point of being subservient or losing self-respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪做啲咁嘅嘢啦，唔好做個他他粉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 zou6 di1 gam2 ge3 je5 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 go3 taa1 taa1 fan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做那些事了，不要做一个舔狗了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do those things, don't be a simp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺佢條女面前扮晒嘢，真係他他粉到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 keoi5 tiu4 neoi2 min6 cin4 baan3 saai3 je5, zan1 hai6 taa1 taa1 fan2 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在他女朋友面前装模作样，真是舔狗到极点。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts up in front of his girlfriend, he's such a simp.

english_meaning: Tartar sauce
explanation_mandarin: 一种西式酱料，主要成分包括蛋黄酱、酸黄瓜、洋葱等。常用于搭配炸鱼或其他海鲜。
explanation_english: A cold sauce typically made from mayonnaise, chopped pickles, capers, and herbs. It is often served with seafood dishes, especially fried fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意用他他醬點炸魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 yung6 taa1 taa1 zoeng3 dim3 zaa3 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用塔塔酱蘸炸鱼。
examples.english_sentence: I like to dip fried fish in tartar sauce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個炸魚薯條配埋他他醬就完美啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaa3 yu2 syu4 tiu2 pui3 maai4 taa1 taa1 zoeng3 zau6 jyun4 mei5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个炸鱼薯条配上塔塔酱就完美了！
examples.english_sentence: This fish and chips is perfect with tartar sauce!

english_meaning: flippant, frivolous, flighty, not serious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人轻浮, 不稳重, 言行不严肃。
explanation_english: Describes a person as frivolous, flighty, and not serious in speech and behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好他佻，成日都嘻皮笑臉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 taa1 tiu3, seng4 jat6 dou1 hei1 pei1 siu3 lim5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很轻佻，整天都嬉皮笑脸的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very flippant person, always joking around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁他佻啦，認真啲做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 taa1 tiu3 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么轻佻了，认真一点工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so frivolous, be more serious with your work.

english_meaning: they
explanation_mandarin: 指代不止一个人，是第三人称复数。
explanation_english: Refers to more than one person. It is the third-person plural pronoun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係我嘅朋友，他們都好幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5, taa1 mun4 dou1 hou2 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是我的朋友，他们都很帮我。
examples.english_sentence: They are my friends, and they all help me a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日會同他們去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 tung4 taa1 mun4 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天会和他们去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We will go hiking with them tomorrow.

jyutping: taa1 saan1 zi1 sek6, ho2 ji5 gung1 juk6
mandarin_meaning: 他山的石头，可以用来琢磨玉器。 比喻借助外力或别人的经验来达到目的。
english_meaning: Stones from other hills can be used to polish jade; Using the experiences and skills of others to improve oneself or achieve one's goals; Learning from others' successes and failures.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻借鉴別人的經驗，改正自己的缺點，或完成自己的事業。
explanation_english: This idiom means that one can learn from the experiences of others to improve oneself, correct one's shortcomings, or achieve one's goals. It emphasizes the value of learning from outside sources and perspectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學習其他公司嘅成功經驗，他山之石，可以攻玉嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 kei4 taa1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1 ging1 jim6, taa1 saan1 zi1 sek6, ho2 ji5 gung1 juk6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习其他公司的成功经验，他山之石，可以攻玉嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn from the successful experiences of other companies. Stones from other hills can be used to polish jade, you know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功唔係偶然，佢經常參考其他人嘅方法，真係他山之石，可以攻玉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 ngau5 jin4, keoi5 ging1 soeng4 caam1 kaau2 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 fong1 faat3, zan1 hai6 taa1 saan1 zi1 sek6, ho2 ji5 gung1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功不是偶然的，他经常参考其他人的方法，真是他山之石，可以攻玉。
examples.english_sentence: His success is not accidental. He often refers to other people's methods. Truly, stones from other hills can be used to polish jade.

english_meaning: another day; in the future; someday
explanation_mandarin: 表示未来的某个时候，但不明确具体的日期。
explanation_english: Refers to some time in the future, but the specific date is not specified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 他日我哋一定會再見嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taa1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zoi3 gin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 日后我们一定会再见的。
examples.english_sentence: We will definitely meet again someday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知他日會唔會科技發達到可以瞬間移動呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 taa1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 fo1 gei6 faat3 daat6 dou3 ho2 ji5 seon3 gaan1 yi4 dung6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道将来科技会不会发展到可以瞬间移动呢？
examples.english_sentence: I wonder if technology will advance to the point where we can teleport in the future?

english_meaning: in the future; someday; one day
explanation_mandarin: 指未来的某一天，通常带有期望或预期的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to some day in the future, often with a sense of hope or anticipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 他朝有日，我哋一定會再見嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taa1 ciu4 jau5 jat6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zoi3 gin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将来有一天，我们一定会再见的。
examples.english_sentence: Someday, we will definitely meet again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望他朝可以喺其他地方見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 taa1 ciu4 ho2 ji5 hai2 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1 gin3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望以后可以在其他地方见到你。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to see you somewhere else in the future.

english_meaning: another option; alternative; other possibilities
explanation_mandarin: 指其他的途径或解决问题的方法。表示除了目前的方式之外，还有其他的选择。
explanation_english: Refers to other avenues or ways to solve a problem. It indicates that besides the current method, there are other options available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁執著啦，搵唔到佢合作咪搵他條囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6 laa1, wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5 hap6 jok3 mai6 wan2 taa1 tiu4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么执着了，找不到他合作就找别的出路吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so persistent, if you can't find him to cooperate with, find another option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔得咪試下他條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 m4 dak1 mai6 si3 haa5 taa1 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不成功就试试其他选择。
examples.english_sentence: If business doesn't work out, try other alternatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好死心，一定有他條嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sei2 sam1, jat1 ding6 jau5 taa1 tiu4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要灰心，一定有其他出路的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lose heart, there must be another way.

synonyms: 另一條路 (ling6 jat1 tiu4 lou6)
其他方法 (kei4 taa1 fong1 faat3)

english_meaning: Careless; sloppy; slapdash
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，粗心大意，质量不好。
explanation_english: Describes doing things carelessly, negligently, and with poor quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁他筆啦，會出錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 taa1 bat1 laa1, wui5 cheut1 cho3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么马虎，会出错的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless when you work, you'll make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫得太他筆，要重新寫過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 taai3 taa1 bat1, jiu3 chung4 san1 se2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得太马虎，要重新写过。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written too sloppily; it needs to be rewritten.

english_meaning: other expressions; other manifestations; other behaviors
explanation_mandarin: 指的是除了之前已经提及的之外，其他的表现或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to other expressions or behaviors besides those already mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢除咗唔肯聽話，仲有好多他表嘅嘢，例如成日發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceoi4 zo2 m4 hang2 ting1 waa6, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 taa1 biu2 ge3 je5,例jyu4 seoi4 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他除了不听话，还有很多其他的表现，例如经常发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: Besides not listening, he has many other behaviors, such as frequently throwing tantrums.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個病唔止發燒咁簡單，仲有好多他表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng6 m4 zi2 faat3 siu1 gam3 gaan2 daan1, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 taa1 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个病不只是发烧这么简单，还有很多其他的表现。
examples.english_sentence: This illness is not just a simple fever, there are many other manifestations.

english_meaning: out of tune; off-key
explanation_mandarin: 指唱歌、乐器演奏等音调不准确，跑调。
explanation_english: Refers to being out of tune, or off-key, when singing or playing a musical instrument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到好他調呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dou3 hou2 taa1 diu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得太跑调了！
examples.english_sentence: He's singing so off-key!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部鋼琴好似有啲他調，要搵人較下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gong3 kam4 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 taa1 diu6, jiu3 wan2 jan4 gaau3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这架钢琴好像有点跑调，要找人调一下。
examples.english_sentence: This piano seems a bit out of tune; we need to get someone to tune it.

english_meaning: foreign land, another place, away from home
explanation_mandarin: 指自己家乡以外的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a place other than one's hometown; a foreign land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺他鄉生活真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taa1 hoeng1 sang1 wut6 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在异乡生活真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: Living in a foreign land is really not easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢離開家鄉去咗他鄉工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 gaa1 hoeng1 heoi3 zo2 taa1 hoeng1 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他离开了家乡去了外地工作。
examples.english_sentence: He left his hometown and went to work in a foreign land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢佳節倍思親，喺他鄉就特別掛住屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 gaai1 zit3 pui5 si1 can1, hai2 taa1 hoeng1 zau6 dak6 bit3 gwaa3 zyu6 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢佳节倍思亲，在异乡就特别想念家。
examples.english_sentence: On festive occasions, one misses their relatives even more; being in a foreign land makes you especially miss home.

english_meaning: Meeting an old friend in a foreign land; a joyful reunion in an unexpected place
explanation_mandarin: 指在异地遇到老朋友，非常高兴。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the joy of meeting an old friend in a foreign or unfamiliar place. It implies a feeling of comfort and happiness amidst unfamiliar surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到喺英國都他鄉遇故知，撞到舊同學阿明！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou3 hai2 jing1 gwok3 dou1 taa1 hoeng1 jyu6 gu3 zi1, zong6 dou2 gau6 tung4 hok6 aa3 ming4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到在英国也能他乡遇故知，碰到了老同学阿明！
examples.english_sentence: I never thought I'd meet an old friend in a foreign land like the UK; I bumped into my old classmate Ah Ming!

english_meaning: to show off, to act pretentious, to put on airs, to be arrogant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人自视甚高，摆架子，装模作样，显得很了不起的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who thinks very highly of themselves, puts on airs, acts pretentious, and tries to appear impressive or important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後成日都他錶，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6 sing4 jat6 dou1 taa1 biu2, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财之后总是摆谱，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: After he got rich, he always shows off, which is very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺度他錶啦，大家都係打工仔啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 taa1 biu2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 daa2 gung1 zai2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是在这里摆架子了，大家都是打工的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop showing off all the time, we are all just employees.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on, to take advantage of (usually in a negative way)
explanation_mandarin: 依靠，凭借。通常带贬义，指仗势欺人。
explanation_english: To rely on, to depend on. Often used with a negative connotation, implying taking advantage of power or influence to bully or intimidate others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老豆係老細，佢成日都仗住佢老豆嚟蝦人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 dau2 hai6 lou5 sai3, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zoeng6 zyu6 keoi5 lou5 dau2 lai4 haa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是老板，他整天都仗着他爸爸来欺负人。
examples.english_sentence: His dad is the boss, so he always bullies people by relying on his dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好仗住自己識啲嘢就寸寸貢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng6 zyu6 zi6 gei2 sik1 di1 je5 zau6 cyun3 cyun3 gung3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要仗着自己懂一些东西就趾高气扬的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant just because you know a little bit.

english_meaning: righteous, willing to help others, loyal and supportive
explanation_mandarin: 指为人讲义气，肯帮助别人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is righteous, loyal, and willing to help others in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好仗義㗎，有咩事搵佢幫手一定得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zoeng6 ji6 gaa3, jau5 me1 si6 wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2 jat1 ding6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很仗义的，有什么事找他帮忙一定行。
examples.english_sentence: He is very righteous, if you need help with anything, he will definitely help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明為人仗義，好多朋友都鍾意同佢一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 wai4 jan4 zoeng6 ji6, hou2 do1 pang4 jau5 dou1 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明为人仗义，很多朋友都喜欢和他一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is a righteous person, many friends like to hang out with him.

english_meaning: to speak out for justice; to stand up for what is right; to uphold justice by speaking out
explanation_mandarin: 指为了正义而说公道话，敢于发表自己的意见，主持公道。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to speaking out in defense of justice and fairness, being willing to express one's opinions, and upholding righteousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到啲唔公平嘅事，我哋一定要仗義執言，唔可以袖手旁觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 di1 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 si6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoeng6 ji6 zap1 jin4, m4 ho2 ji5 sau3 sau2 pong4 guan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到不公平的事情，我们一定要仗义执言，不可以袖手旁观。
examples.english_sentence: When we see injustice, we must speak out for justice and not stand idly by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向都係個仗義執言嘅人，所以大家都好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hai6 go3 zoeng6 ji6 zap1 jin4 ge3 jan4, so2 ji5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向是个仗义执言的人，所以大家都非常信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been someone who speaks out for justice, so everyone trusts him a lot.

english_meaning: generous to the needy; ready to help others generously; chivalrous and generous
explanation_mandarin: 指为人讲义气，乐于解囊相助，慷慨地帮助有困难的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is righteous and willing to generously help those in need, often by providing financial assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個仗義疏財嘅人，成日幫啲有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 zoeng6 ji6 so1 coi4 ge3 jan4, seng4 jat6 bong1 di1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个仗义疏财的人，经常帮助那些需要帮助的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly a generous person, always helping those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生一向仗義疏財，所以好多人都好尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 sang1 jat1 hoeng3 zoeng6 ji6 so1 coi4, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生一向仗义疏财，所以很多人都很尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li has always been generous, so many people respect him.

english_meaning: to pay; to hand over; to devote
explanation_mandarin: 表示给予，支付或付出。 常用于金钱、努力或代价的付出。
explanation_english: To give, pay, or expend something, usually money, effort, or cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要付錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 fu6 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要付钱了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to pay now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗呢件事付出咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ni1 gin6 si6 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这件事付出了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He has devoted a lot to this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得準時付租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4 fu6 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得准时交租金。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pay the rent on time.

english_meaning: to consign to the flames, to burn to ashes, to destroy by fire
explanation_mandarin: 把东西用火烧掉，彻底摧毁。
explanation_english: To burn something completely to ashes; to destroy something utterly by fire. Figuratively means to completely destroy something, often hopes or plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工廠俾大火付之一炬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 cong2 bei2 daai6 fo2 fu6 zi1 jat1 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工厂被大火烧成灰烬。
examples.english_sentence: His factory was burned to the ground by a big fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢多年嘅心血，因為一次失敗嘅投資，付之一炬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 do1 nin4 ge3 sam1 hyut3, jan1 wai6 jat1 ci3 sat1 baai6 ge3 tau4 zi1, fu6 zi1 jat1 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他多年的心血，因为一次失败的投资，付之一炬。
examples.english_sentence: His hard work over many years was destroyed by a failed investment.

english_meaning: to go down the drain; to be washed away; to come to nothing; to be in vain
explanation_mandarin: 指希望、计划或努力完全落空，没有任何结果。比喻事情白费力气，毫无成效，如同水流向东方，一去不返。
explanation_english: Refers to hopes, plans, or efforts that are completely in vain, leading to no results. It's a metaphor for wasted effort and futile attempts, like water flowing eastward and never returning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁耐嘅努力，如果失敗嘅話，咪付之東流囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam3 noi6 ge3 nu5 lik6, jyu4 gwo2 sat1 baai6 ge3 waa2, mai1 fu6 zi1 dung1 lau4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这么久的努力，如果失败的话，不就付诸东流了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we fail after all this effort, wouldn't it all go down the drain?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅錢都攞去賭博，最後輸晒，搞到佢之前嘅儲蓄全部付之東流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 cin2 dou1 lo2 heoi3 dou2 bok3, zeoi3 hau6 syu1 saai3, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 zi1 cin4 ge3 cyu5 cuk1 cyun4 bou6 fu6 zi1 dung1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的钱都拿去赌博，最后输光了，搞得他之前的储蓄全都付诸东流。
examples.english_sentence: He took all his money to gamble and lost everything, causing all his previous savings to go down the drain.

english_meaning: to bestow, to grant, to entrust
explanation_mandarin: 给予，交给，赋予。
explanation_english: To give, hand over, or bestow something, often implying a formal or official transfer of power, responsibility, or quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府付予佢哋權力去執行呢個法例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fu6 jyu5 keoi5 dei6 kyun4 lik6 heoi3 zaak6 hang4 ni1 go3 faat3 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府赋予他们权力去执行这个法律。
examples.english_sentence: The government granted them the power to enforce this law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸將佢嘅遺產付予咗我哋三個仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa1 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 wai4 caan2 fu6 jyu5 zo2 ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸将他的遗产赋予了我们三个子女。
examples.english_sentence: Dad bequeathed his inheritance to his three children.

english_meaning: to pay; to expend; to invest (time, effort, etc.); to sacrifice
explanation_mandarin: 贡献出时间、精力、金钱等。
explanation_english: To contribute or expend time, effort, money, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功就要付出努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1 zau6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想要成功就要付出努力。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to succeed, you have to put in effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗家庭付出咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gaa1 ting4 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了家庭付出了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He sacrificed a lot for his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 愛情需要雙方付出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: oi3 cing4 seoi1 jiu3 soeng1 fong1 fu6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爱情需要双方付出。
examples.english_sentence: Love requires effort from both sides.

english_meaning: to send to press, to print
explanation_mandarin: 指将稿件交给印刷厂进行印刷。
explanation_english: Refers to sending a manuscript to the printing house for printing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份稿已經準備好喇，聽日就可以付印啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gou2 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa3, ting1 jat6 zau6 ho2 ji5 fu6 jan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 稿件已经准备好了，明天就可以付印了。
examples.english_sentence: The manuscript is ready. We can send it to press tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書已經付印，預計下個月可以上市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ji5 ging1 fu6 jan3, jyu6 gai3 haa6 go3 jyut6 ho2 ji5 soeng5 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书已经付印，预计下个月可以上市。
examples.english_sentence: The book has been sent to press and is expected to be released next month.

english_meaning: to pay the bill, to settle the account
explanation_mandarin: 支付账单；结清款项。
explanation_english: To pay the bill; to settle an account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完嘢記得付帳啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 dak1 fu6 zoeng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭记得结账啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pay the bill after you've finished eating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我想付帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 soeng2 fu6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我想结账。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I would like to pay the bill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢餐飯我請，唔使你付帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 caan1 faan6 ngo5 ceng2, m4 sai2 nei5 fu6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这顿饭我请客，不用你结账。
examples.english_sentence: I'll treat you to this meal, you don't need to pay the bill.

english_meaning: entrust; to entrust; to trust with
explanation_mandarin: 将事情、物品等委托给他人处理或保管。多用于郑重的场合。
explanation_english: To entrust something (a task, an item, etc.) to someone for handling or safekeeping. Often used in formal situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將公司嘅未來付托畀佢個仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 mei6 loi4 fu6 tok3 bei2 keoi5 go3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把公司的未来托付给他儿子。
examples.english_sentence: He entrusted the future of the company to his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好重要，我付托畀你一定要辦妥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 zung6 jiu3, ngo5 fu6 tok3 bei2 nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 baan6 to2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很重要，我委托你一定要办好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very important, I entrust you to handle it properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將病人嘅生命付托畀醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 beng6 jan4 ge3 sang1 ming6 fu6 tok3 bei2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把病人的生命托付给医生。
examples.english_sentence: They entrust the patients' lives to the doctors.

english_meaning: Payment; to pay
explanation_mandarin: 付出钱款，购买商品或服务的行为。也指支付的款项。
explanation_english: The act of paying money for goods or services. It also refers to the amount of money paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以用現金付款，定係要用信用卡付款呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 yung6 hin3 gam2 fu3 fun2, ding6 hai6 yiu3 yung6 seon3 yung6 kaat1 fu3 fun2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以用现金付款，还是用信用卡付款？
examples.english_sentence: Can we pay with cash, or do we have to pay with credit card?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份單嘅總付款係一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 daan1 ge3 zung2 fu3 fun2 hai6 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你账单的总付款是一百元。
examples.english_sentence: The total payment on your bill is one hundred dollars.

english_meaning: to grant, to give, to bestow, to entrust
explanation_mandarin: 给予；赋予。多用于比较正式的场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To grant, give, bestow, or entrust something, typically used in formal situations or written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會付與更多資源去幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 fu6 jyu5 gang3 do1 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会给予更多资源去帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: The government will grant more resources to help people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學付與畢業生好多發展嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 fu6 jyu5 bat1 jip6 sang1 hou2 do1 faat3 zin2 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学给予毕业生很多发展的机会。
examples.english_sentence: This university provides its graduates with many opportunities for development.

english_meaning: to put into practice, to implement, to put into effect
explanation_mandarin: 将想法、计划等实际实施。表示将某个抽象的事物转化为实际行动。
explanation_english: To put an idea, plan, or theory into practice; to implement or execute something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅建議終於可以付諸實行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gin3 ji5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fu6 zyu1 sat6 hang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的建议终于可以付诸实行了。
examples.english_sentence: Our suggestion can finally be put into practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃一直都冇辦法付諸行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3 fu6 zyu1 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划一直都没有办法付诸行动。
examples.english_sentence: His plan has never been able to be put into action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望呢個創新嘅諗法可以盡快付諸生產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ni1 go3 co3 san1 ge3 nam2 faat3 ho2 ji5 zeon6 faai3 fu6 zyu1 sang1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这个创新的想法可以尽快付诸生产。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, this innovative idea can be put into production as soon as possible.

english_meaning: to consign to the flames; to burn to the ground; to reduce to ashes
explanation_mandarin: 把东西用火烧掉，完全毁坏。 比喻把以前的努力或希望完全摧毁。
explanation_english: To burn something to ashes; to destroy completely with fire. Figuratively, it means to destroy past efforts or hopes completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間工廠俾場大火燒到付諸一炬，所有嘅心血都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 cong2 bei2 coeng4 daai6 fo2 siu1 dou3 fu6 zyu1 jat1 geoi6, so2 jau5 ge3 sam1 hyut3 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家工厂被一场大火烧得付之一炬，所有的心血都白费了。
examples.english_sentence: The factory was burned to the ground by a big fire, and all their hard work was gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔好好保存文物，好容易會俾戰火付諸一炬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 m4 hou2 hou2 bou2 cyun4 man4 mat6, hou2 jung4 ji6 wui5 bei2 zin3 fo2 fu6 zyu1 jat1 geoi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不小心保护文物，很容易会被战火付之一炬的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't protect cultural relics carefully, they can easily be destroyed by war.

english_meaning: to come to nothing, to vanish without trace, all efforts wasted, to go down the drain
explanation_mandarin: 指像水那样白白流掉，指希望或努力完全落空，毫无结果。
explanation_english: Refers to something being wasted like water flowing eastward, indicating that hopes or efforts are completely dashed, resulting in nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸晒啲錢，之前咁辛苦儲落嘅錢都付諸東流喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2, zi1 cin4 gam3 san1 fu2 cyu5 lok6 ge3 cin2 dou1 fu6 zyu1 dung1 lau4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输光了所有的钱，之前那么辛苦攒下来的钱都付诸东流了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his money gambling, all the money he had saved so hard was wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔合作，呢個項目嘅所有努力就會付諸東流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 hap6 zok3, ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 so2 jau5 nou5 lik6 zau6 wui5 fu6 zyu1 dung1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不合作，这个项目的所有努力就会付诸东流。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't cooperate, all the efforts on this project will be wasted.

synonyms: 功虧一簣 (gung1 kwai1 jat1 gwai6)

english_meaning: To come to nothing; to be washed down the drain; to go down the drain; to be in vain; to be for nothing
explanation_mandarin: 比喻前功尽弃，所有努力都白费了，没有得到任何结果。
explanation_english: An idiom that means all previous efforts have been wasted, and no results have been achieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗咁多時間去準備個計劃，點知最後都付諸流水，真係好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 gam3 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 zhun2 bei6 go3 gai3 waak6, dim2 zhi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 fu6 zyu1 lau4 seoi2, zhan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了这么多时间准备这个计划，没想到最后都付诸东流，真是太可惜了。
examples.english_sentence: He spent so much time preparing this plan, but unexpectedly it all went down the drain in the end. It's such a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力啲，咁之前嘅努力咪會付諸流水囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6 di1, gam2 zhi1 chin4 ge3 nu5 lik6 mai6 wui fu6 zyu1 lau4 seoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力一点，那之前的努力不就都付诸东流了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we don't try harder, won't all our previous efforts go down the drain?

english_meaning: to put into action, to implement, to carry out
