explanation_mandarin: 把想法、计划等落实到实际行动中。
explanation_english: To translate an idea, plan, etc., into actual action; to implement or carry out something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將呢個計劃付諸行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 fu6 zyu1 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把这个计划付诸行动。
examples.english_sentence: We need to put this plan into action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定將佢嘅理想付諸行動，開咗一間咖啡店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 lei5 soeng2 fu6 zyu1 hang4 dung6, hoi1 zo2 jat1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定把他的理想付诸行动，开了一家咖啡店。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to put his ideal into action and opened a coffee shop.

english_meaning: to pay; to pay a fee; paid
explanation_mandarin: 支付费用。
explanation_english: To pay a fee or charge; related to services or goods that require payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個應用程式係免費嘅，但係如果你想用進階功能就要付費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ying3 yung6 ching4 sik1 hai6 min5 fai3 ge3, daan6 hai6 yu4 gwo2 nei5 seung2 yung6 jun3 gaai1 gung1 nang4 jau6 yiu3 fu6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个应用程序是免费的，但是如果你想用高级功能就要付费。
examples.english_sentence: This app is free, but you need to pay if you want to use the advanced features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司會為員工提供付費醫療保險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 wui5 wai4 yung4 gung1 tai4 gung1 fu6 fai3 yi1 liu4 bo2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司会为员工提供付费医疗保险。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will provide paid medical insurance for employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋畀咗好多錢去下載付費遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 zo2 ho2 do1 chin2 heui3 haa6 zoi3 fu6 fai3 yau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们花了很多钱去下载付费游戏。
examples.english_sentence: They spent a lot of money downloading paid games.

english_meaning: to ship, to dispatch, to transport
explanation_mandarin: 将货物发送出去进行运输。
explanation_english: To send goods for transportation; to ship or dispatch merchandise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今日會付運一批貨去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 wui5 fu6 wan6 jat1 bat1 fo3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今天会发运一批货去美国。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will ship a batch of goods to the United States today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廠已經付運咗所有嘅訂單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 cong2 ji5 ging1 fu6 wan6 zo2 so2 jau5 ge3 ding3 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂已经发运了所有的订单。
examples.english_sentence: The factory has already shipped all of the orders.

mandarin_meaning: 神仙; 奇妙; 极好
english_meaning: immortal; celestial being; magical; wonderful; superb
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指神仙。2. 形容事物非常奇妙、美好或优秀。3. (口语)指人行为不切实际、飘忽不定。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to an immortal or celestial being. 2. Describes something as magical, wonderful, or superb. 3. (Colloquial) Describes someone whose behavior is unrealistic or unpredictable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似仙咁，成日唔知諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 sin1 gam2, seng4 jat6 m4 zi1 nim2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人好像神仙一样，整天不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's like an immortal, always lost in thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係好仙呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sin1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真的太好吃了！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is absolutely divine!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆講故仔，講到好似仙境咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gong2 gu3 zai2, gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 sin1 ging2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶讲故事，讲得像仙境一样。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma tells stories as if they take place in a fairyland.

english_meaning: elixir; panacea; magic pill; cure-all
explanation_mandarin: 传说中神仙炼制的丹药，吃了可以长生不老或治好一切疾病。也比喻能解决一切问题的灵药或方法。
explanation_english: In legends, a pill made by immortals that is believed to grant immortality or cure all diseases. It is also used figuratively to refer to a magic pill or method that can solve all problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇乜嘢仙丹可以即刻令人變瘦嘅，都要靠自己努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 mat1 je5 sin1 daan1 ho2 ji5 jik1 haak1 ling6 jan4 bin3 sau3 ge3, dou1 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有什么仙丹可以立刻让人变瘦的，都要靠自己努力。
examples.english_sentence: There is no magic pill that can make you lose weight instantly. You still need to work hard yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住有仙丹可以醫好你嘅懶病啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 jau5 sin1 daan1 ho2 ji5 ji1 hou2 nei5 ge3 laan5 beng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着有什么仙丹可以医好你的懒病啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think there's some magic pill that can cure your laziness.

synonyms: 靈丹妙藥 (ling4 daan1 miu6 joek6)

english_meaning: immortal / deity; a person with extraordinary abilities; an expert
explanation_mandarin: 1. 神话传说中具有超凡能力、长生不老的人。2. 形容能力超群的人，相当于“厉害的人”。3. (俗語)有時指行為脫序，不食人间烟火的人。
explanation_english: 1. In mythology and legends, a person with extraordinary abilities and immortality. 2. Used to describe a person with outstanding abilities; an expert. 3. (Colloquial) Sometimes refers to a person whose behavior is unconventional or out of touch with reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波好勁，簡直係仙人噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 hou2 ging6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sin1 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球很厉害，简直像神仙一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's so good at playing ball, it's as if he's an immortal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，真係仙人咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 sin1 jan4 gam2 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天不做事，真像个神仙一样。
examples.english_sentence: He does nothing all day, he's like an immortal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式員寫程式好叻，直頭係仙人級別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jyun4 se2 cing4 sik1 hou2 lek1, zik6 tau4 hai6 sin1 jan4 kap1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序员写程序很厉害，简直是神仙级别。
examples.english_sentence: This programmer is very skilled at coding; he's at an immortal level.

english_meaning: cactus
explanation_mandarin: 一种生长在干旱地区的植物，通常具有肉质茎，并有刺。
explanation_english: A plant that grows in dry regions, typically having a fleshy stem and spines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企種咗幾盆仙人掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 zung3 zo2 gei2 pun4 sin1 jan4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家种了几盆仙人掌。
examples.english_sentence: I planted a few pots of cactus in my house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仙人掌好襟旱，唔使成日淋水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 jan4 zoeng2 hou2 kam1 hon5, m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 lam4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 仙人掌很耐旱，不用经常浇水。
examples.english_sentence: Cacti are very drought-tolerant and don't need to be watered often.

english_meaning: fairyland, paradise, wonderland
explanation_mandarin: 神仙居住的地方，比喻美好的境地。
explanation_english: A place where immortals live; a metaphor for a beautiful or idyllic place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅風景靚到好似仙境咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 fung1 ging2 leng3 dou3 hou2 ci5 sin1 ging2 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的风景美得像仙境一样。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is so beautiful, it's like a fairyland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雲圍住山頂，真係好似仙境咁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan4 wai4 zyu6 saan1 ding2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 sin1 ging2 gam3 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 云雾缭绕山顶，真像仙境啊！
examples.english_sentence: The clouds surrounding the mountain peak, it really looks like a paradise!

english_meaning: fairy, goddess
explanation_mandarin: 指神话传说中的女性神仙，也用来形容非常美丽、气质出众的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a female immortal in myths and legends; also used to describe a very beautiful and elegant woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打扮到好似仙女咁，靚到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2 bun6 dou3 hou2 ci5 sin1 neoi5 gam3, leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得像仙女一样，漂亮极了。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed up like a fairy today, so beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，佢真係靚到好似仙女落凡間咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, keoi5 zan1 hai6 leng3 dou3 hou2 ci5 sin1 neoi5 lok6 faan4 gaan1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，她真的漂亮得像仙女下凡一样。
examples.english_sentence: Wow, she's really as beautiful as a fairy descending to earth.

english_meaning: Sparkler (firework)
explanation_mandarin: 一种小型的烟花，手持点燃后会发出闪光。
explanation_english: A type of hand-held firework that emits sparks when lit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我好鍾意玩仙女棒，覺得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waan2 sin1 neoi5 paang5, gok3 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我很喜欢玩仙女棒，觉得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I loved playing with sparklers, I thought they were very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多人會買仙女棒嚟慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 maai5 sin1 neoi5 paang5 lai4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人会买仙女棒来庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many people buy sparklers to celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 仙女; 女性道士; 女巫; 灵媒
english_meaning: Fairy maiden; female Taoist priest; female shaman; medium (female)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指仙女。2. 指女性道士。3. 在香港，有时指从事占卜、扶乩等活动的女性。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a fairy maiden. 2. Refers to a female Taoist priest. 3. In Hong Kong, it sometimes refers to a woman engaged in divination, spirit writing (fuji), or other spiritual practices; sometimes used as 'medium'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢屋企嗰個仙姑好靈㗎，好多人都搵佢問事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 go2 go3 sin1 gu1 hou2 ling4 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wan2 keoi5 man6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说她家的那个仙姑很灵验，很多人都找她问事。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the medium in her house is very effective. Many people seek her guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣成日幻想自己係仙姑，可以飛天遁地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 hai6 sin1 gu1, ho2 ji5 fei1 tin1 deon6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候经常幻想自己是仙女，可以飞天遁地。
examples.english_sentence: When she was little, she often fantasized that she was a fairy who could fly and escape the earth.

english_meaning: fool, idiot, moron
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，没脑子，是比较粗俗的骂人话。
explanation_english: A vulgar term used to describe someone as being foolish, stupid, or lacking intelligence; an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係仙屎嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 sin1 si2 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样都不明白，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even understand this? You're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢啦，佢條友仔仙屎嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 tiu4 yau5 zai2 sin1 si2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他了，他那个人就是个傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with him, that guy's a moron.

english_meaning: ethereal beauty; fairy-like aura; otherworldly charm
explanation_mandarin: 形容人外貌或气质超凡脱俗，给人一种不食人间烟火的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes a person's appearance or temperament as extraordinary and otherworldly, giving the impression that they are not of this world; possessing an ethereal or fairy-like quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着白色衫，成個人充滿仙氣咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 baak6 sik1 saam1, seng4 go3 jan4 cung1 mun5 sin1 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是穿白色衣服，整个人充满了仙气。
examples.english_sentence: She always wears white clothes, her whole person is full of an ethereal aura.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間咖啡店嘅裝修好有仙氣，好啱打卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 kaa3 fe1 dim3 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 jau5 sin1 hei3, hou2 ngaam1 daa2 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家咖啡店的装修很有仙气，很适合拍照打卡。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this cafe has an ethereal vibe, very suitable for taking photos and checking in.

mandarin_meaning: 仙股 (xiān gǔ), 垃圾股 (lājī gǔ)
english_meaning: Penny stock, junk stock
explanation_mandarin: 指股价非常低廉的股票。通常指价格低于一港元的股票，风险极高，投资价值较低。
explanation_english: Refers to stocks with very low prices, typically below one Hong Kong dollar. These stocks are considered very risky and have low investment value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻股票依家變咗仙股，唔好掂呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 ji1 gaa1 bin3 zo2 sin1 gu2, m4 hou2 dim6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支股票现在变成了仙股，不要碰它！
examples.english_sentence: This stock has now become a penny stock, don't touch it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都話仙股嘅風險好大，但係如果識揀，都有機會發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 sin1 gu2 ge3 fung1 him2 hou2 daai6, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 sik1 gaan2, dou1 jau5 gei1 wui2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都说仙股的风险很大，但是如果懂得选择，也有机会发财。
examples.english_sentence: Many people say that penny stocks are very risky, but if you know how to choose, you have a chance to get rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗好多仙股，希望可以一夜暴富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 sin1 gu2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 je6 bou6 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了很多仙股，希望可以一夜暴富。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a lot of penny stocks, hoping to become rich overnight.

english_meaning: mesona chinensis (a type of plant used to make herbal jelly); grass jelly
explanation_mandarin: 一种草本植物，常被用来制作仙草冻等甜品。
explanation_english: A herbaceous plant (Mesona chinensis) commonly used to make grass jelly and other desserts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁熱，食碗仙草凍最正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 jit6, sik6 wun2 sin1 cou2 dung3 zeoi3 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这么热，吃一碗仙草冻最好了。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today, eating a bowl of grass jelly is the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間甜品鋪嘅仙草好滑，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 tim4 ban2 pou3 ge3 sin1 cou2 hou2 waat6, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家甜品店的仙草很滑嫩，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The grass jelly from this dessert shop is very smooth and delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 去世, 逝世, 驾鹤西去
english_meaning: to pass away (euphemistic), to die, to go to heaven as an immortal
explanation_mandarin: 婉辞，指人去世。比喻人像仙人一样离开人世。
explanation_english: A euphemistic expression referring to someone passing away. It implies that the person has departed from the mortal world like an immortal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講李伯尋日仙遊咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 lei5 baak3 cam4 jat6 sin1 jau4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说李伯昨天去世了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that Uncle Lee passed away yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺上個月仙遊，屋企人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 soeng6 go3 jyut6 sin1 jau4, uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷上个月去世了，家里人都很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed away last month, and his family is very sad.

mandarin_meaning: 完全不灵验；一点也不灵
english_meaning: Not effective at all; Not working at all (despite what one might expect)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物原本应该非常有效或者神奇，但实际上却完全没有效果，丝毫不起作用。 “仙” 本指神仙，暗指神力，引申为灵验、有效。 强调完全无效的情况。
explanation_english: Describes something that should be very effective or magical, but in reality, it has no effect at all; not working at all. "仙" (sin1) refers to deities, implying divine power, extended to mean efficacious or effective. It emphasizes a complete lack of effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試咗好多方法減肥，但係仙都唔仙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 zo2 hou2 do1 fong1 faat3 gaam2 fei4, daan6 hai6 sin1 dou1 m4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试了很多减肥方法，但是一点效果也没有。
examples.english_sentence: I've tried many ways to lose weight, but none of them work at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥佢話好靈嘅，但我食咗仙都唔仙，都係咁痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 keoi5 waa6 hou2 ling4 ge3, daan6 ngo5 sik6 zo2 sin1 dou1 m4 sin1, dou1 hai6 gam2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这种药很灵验的，但是我吃了却一点用都没有，还是那么疼。
examples.english_sentence: He said this medicine was very effective, but it didn't work at all for me. I'm still in pain.

mandarin_meaning: 一点也不吝啬/毫不吝惜
english_meaning: Not stingy at all; extremely generous
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常大方，一点也不吝啬。 "仙" (sin1) 在这里是 "悭" (haan1) 的谐音，代表吝啬。 "都唔...下" 表示完全不。合起来表示完全不吝啬。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely generous and not stingy at all. "仙" (sin1) is a homophone of "悭" (haan1), meaning stingy. "都唔...下" (dou1 m4...haa5) means not at all. Together, it means not stingy at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請食飯仙都唔仙下，叫咗好多嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceng2 sik6 faan6 sin1 dou1 m4 sin1 haa5, giu3 zo2 hou2 do1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他请客吃饭一点也不吝啬，点了好多吃的。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't stingy at all when he treated us to dinner, he ordered a lot of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今次派花紅，仙都唔仙下，人人都有雙糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 ci3 paai3 faa1 hung4, sin1 dou1 m4 sin1 haa5, jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 soeng1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板这次发年终奖，一点也不吝啬，每个人都有双薪。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wasn't stingy at all this time giving out bonuses, everyone got double pay.

english_meaning: Same; together; identical
explanation_mandarin: 等同于“同”，表示相同，一起，一同等意思。在粤语中较少单独使用，常见于一些旧式书面语或姓名中。
explanation_english: Equivalent to "同" (tong2) in Mandarin, meaning same, together, identical. It is rarely used alone in modern Cantonese, and often appears in older written language or in names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋仝人一致同意呢個方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 jan4 jat1 zi3 tung1 ji3 ni1 go3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们所有人都一致同意这个方案。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone unanimously agreed to this proposal.

english_meaning: colleagues; fellow workers; all the staff
explanation_mandarin: 指同一单位或机构的工作人员。通常用于书面语或正式场合。
explanation_english: Refers to colleagues or fellow workers in the same unit or organization. Usually used in written language or formal occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仝人上下一心，一定可以完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 yan4 soeng6 haa6 yat1 sam1, yat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们全体同仁上下一心，一定可以完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: All of us colleagues are united as one, and we will definitely be able to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝仝人嘅支持，我哋先可以成功爭取到呢個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 tung4 yan4 ge3 zi1 chi4, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 zaang1 cheui2 dou3 ni1 go3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感谢各位同仁的支持，我们才能成功争取到这个机会。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to the support of all the colleagues, we were able to successfully seize this opportunity.

english_meaning: A unit of length in ancient China, equal to eight chi (尺); a fathom.
explanation_mandarin: 古代长度单位，周制八尺为一仞。形容很高或很深。
explanation_english: An ancient Chinese unit of length, equal to eight chi (Chinese foot). Often used to describe something very high or very deep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千仞高嘅懸崖，睇見都腳軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 jan6 gou1 ge3 hyun4 ngaai4, tai2 gin3 dou1 goek3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千仞高的悬崖，看着都腿软。
examples.english_sentence: A cliff that is thousands of fathoms high makes your legs weak just looking at it.

english_meaning: Thousand
explanation_mandarin: 数字，表示一千。
explanation_english: The number one thousand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架車要成幾仟蚊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 ce1 jiu3 seng4 gei2 cin1 man1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车要几千块钱呢。
examples.english_sentence: This car costs several thousand dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 代替; 世代; 代替
english_meaning: to replace; to substitute; generation; dynasty; on behalf of
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示代替，取代。作为名词，表示时代，世代；或者指代表。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to replace or substitute. As a noun, it refers to a generation, dynasty, or to represent someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日代我返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daai6 ngo5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天代替我上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's covering for me at work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個時代唔同以前啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si4 doi6 m4 tung4 ji5 cin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个时代跟以前不一样了。
examples.english_sentence: This era is different from the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我代你同佢講聲多謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 seng1 do1 ze6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我替你跟他说声谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: I'll say thank you to him on your behalf.

english_meaning: generation after generation; for generations
explanation_mandarin: 指一个家族或血统的延续，一代接一代。
explanation_english: Refers to the continuation of a family or lineage, from one generation to the next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力啲，希望下一代都可以生活得好啲，一代一代咁好落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1, hei1 mong6 haa6 jat1 doi6 dou1 ho2 ji5 sang1 wut6 dak1 hou2 di1, jat1 doi6 jat1 doi6 gam2 hou2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力一点，希望下一代都可以生活得好一点，一代一代这样好下去。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work harder, hoping that the next generation can also live better, and continue to be good generation after generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企嘅生意，代代都係咁樣傳落嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 saang1 ji3, doi6 doi6 dou1 hai6 gam2 joeng6 cyun4 lok6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家的生意，代代都是这样传下来的。
examples.english_sentence: Their family business has been passed down like this for generations.

english_meaning: passed down from generation to generation, handed down through generations
explanation_mandarin: 指从一代传到另一代，世代相传。
explanation_english: To be passed down or inherited from one generation to the next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個食譜係我哋屋企代代相傳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sik6 pu2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 doi6 doi6 soeng1 cyun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个食谱是我们家代代相传的。
examples.english_sentence: This recipe has been passed down in our family for generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將呢個故事代代相傳，所以後人都知道呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 ni1 go3 gu3 si6 doi6 doi6 soeng1 cyun4, so2 ji5 hau6 jan4 dou1 zi1 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们将这个故事代代相传，所以后人都知道这件事。
examples.english_sentence: They passed this story down from generation to generation, so later generations all know about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲傳統習俗要代代相傳落去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cyun4 tung2 zaap6 suk6 jiu3 doi6 doi6 soeng1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些传统习俗要代代相传下去。
examples.english_sentence: These traditional customs must be passed down from generation to generation.

english_meaning: to act as a substitute; to take over (a role)
explanation_mandarin: 代替他人履行职责或担任职务。
explanation_english: To substitute for someone in a duty or position; to act as a replacement or proxy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，我今日要代任佢嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 daai6 jam6 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了，我今天要代理他的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, so I have to cover his work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理放假，由副經理代任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 fong3 gaa3, jau4 fu3 ging1 lei5 daai6 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理休假，由副经理代理。
examples.english_sentence: The manager is on leave, so the deputy manager is acting as a substitute.

english_meaning: price, cost, consequence
explanation_mandarin: 为获得某种东西或达到某种目的所付出的代价。
explanation_english: The price or cost that must be paid to obtain something or achieve a goal; the consequence of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗賺錢，佢哋付出咗好多時間同精力，代價好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 zaan6 cin2, keoi5 dei6 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 tung4 zing1 lik6, doi6 gaa3 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚钱，他们付出了很多时间和精力，代价很大。
examples.english_sentence: In order to make money, they invested a lot of time and energy, the cost was high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做錯嘢係要付出代價㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 co3 je5 hai6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 doi6 gaa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做错事是要付出代价的。
examples.english_sentence: You have to pay the price for doing something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自由嘅代價係警惕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jau4 ge3 doi6 gaa3 hai6 ging2 tik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自由的代价是警惕。
examples.english_sentence: The price of freedom is vigilance.

english_meaning: to substitute; to put oneself in someone else's shoes; to project (oneself) into; empathy
explanation_mandarin: 将一个值代替另一个值；设身处地地去感受别人的处境和情感。
explanation_english: To substitute a value for another; to put oneself in someone else's shoes to understand their situation and feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下代入佢嘅處境去諗下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 daai6 jap6 keoi5 ge3 cyu2 ging2 heoi3 nam2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试着代入他的处境去想想。
examples.english_sentence: Try to put yourself in his situation and think about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好容易代入戲入面嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jung4 ji6 daai6 jap6 hei3 jap6 min6 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很容易代入戏里的角色。
examples.english_sentence: He easily projects himself into the role in the play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以代入你嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 daai6 jap6 nei5 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我无法代入你的感受。
examples.english_sentence: I can't empathize with your feelings.

english_meaning: Sense of immersion; feeling of identification; sense of involvement
explanation_mandarin: 指个人在观看、阅读或体验某种事物时，产生身临其境，仿佛自己就是其中一分子的感觉。
explanation_english: Refers to the feeling of immersion and identification that a person experiences when watching, reading, or experiencing something, as if they are a part of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情好真實，令我好有代入感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 hou2 zan1 sat6, ling6 ngo5 hou2 jau5 daai6 jap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很真实，让我很有代入感。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very realistic, making me feel very immersed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅主角經歷同我好似，睇到我覺得好有代入感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zyu2 gok3 ging1 lik6 tung4 ngo5 hou2 ci5, tai2 dou3 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 daai6 jap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的主角经历和我好像，看到我觉得很有代入感。
examples.english_sentence: The protagonist's experiences in this book are very similar to mine, reading it makes me feel very involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技好好，令觀眾好有代入感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 hou2 hou2, ling6 gun1 zung3 hou2 jau5 daai6 jap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技很好，让观众很有代入感。
examples.english_sentence: His acting is very good, giving the audience a strong sense of immersion.

english_meaning: to do something for someone, to do something in someone's place, to take the trouble to do something
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人做事情，帮忙做。
explanation_english: To do something for someone; to do something in someone's stead or on their behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫我代勞啦，我今日唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 daai6 lou4 laa1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我代劳了，我今天没空。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me do it, I'm not free today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，要你代勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, jiu3 nei5 daai6 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，要你代劳。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry to trouble you to do it for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好樂意幫人代勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lok6 ji3 bong1 jan4 daai6 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很乐意帮别人代劳。
examples.english_sentence: He is very willing to do things for others.

english_meaning: pronoun; substitute; byword
explanation_mandarin: 在语言学上，代名词是指用来代替名词或名词性短语的词。
explanation_english: In linguistics, a pronoun is a word that replaces a noun or noun phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「佢」係一個人稱代名詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 cing1 doi6 ming4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “他”是一个人称代词。
examples.english_sentence: "He" is a personal pronoun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成功嘅代名詞就係努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gung1 ge3 doi6 ming4 ci4 zau6 hai6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成功的代名词就是努力。
examples.english_sentence: The byword for success is hard work.

english_meaning: to sell on behalf of someone; consignment
explanation_mandarin: 代替他人出售物品。
explanation_english: To sell something on behalf of someone else; to sell on consignment. This often implies selling goods that belong to someone else and receiving a commission or fee for the service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你代售啲二手衫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 doi6 sau6 di1 ji5 sau2 saam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你代卖一些二手衣服吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll help you sell some of your secondhand clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭專門代售藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zyun1 mun4 doi6 sau6 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店专门代售艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: This shop specializes in selling artwork on consignment.

english_meaning: lip-synch, sing for someone else (ghost singer)
explanation_mandarin: 代替他人唱歌，常见于表演场合，指实际唱歌的人躲在幕后，由台前的表演者假唱。
explanation_english: To sing for someone else, especially in a performance context where the performer on stage lip-synchs or pretends to sing while someone else actually sings backstage. Refers to 'ghost singing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明就係代唱，竟然仲好意思攞獎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 doi6 coeng3, ging2 jin4 zung6 hou2 ji3 si1 lo2 zoeng2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明是代唱，竟然还好意思领奖！
examples.english_sentence: He was obviously lip-synching, and he even has the nerve to accept the award!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嗰晚，有傳聞話佢哋係代唱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 go2 maan5, jau5 cyun4 man4 waa6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 doi6 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会那天晚上，有传闻说他们是代唱。
examples.english_sentence: There were rumors that they were lip-synching at the concert that night.

english_meaning: surrogacy; surrogate pregnancy
explanation_mandarin: 指由一位女性（代孕母亲）为另一位女性或夫妇怀孕并分娩的过程。
explanation_english: The practice of one woman carrying a child for another woman or couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家代孕喺好多地方都重未合法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 doi6 zung6 hai2 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 zung6 mei6 hap6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在代孕在很多地方都还没合法。
examples.english_sentence: Surrogacy is still not legal in many places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋考慮緊搵代孕媽媽生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haau2 leui6 gan2 wan2 doi6 zung6 maa1 maa1 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在考虑找代孕妈妈生孩子。
examples.english_sentence: They are considering finding a surrogate mother to have children.

english_meaning: valet parking
explanation_mandarin: 指代替客人停车的服务。
explanation_english: Refers to the service of parking cars on behalf of customers, usually at restaurants, hotels, or other establishments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店有代客泊車服務，唔使自己搵位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 jau5 daai6 haak3 bok3 ce1 fuk6 mou6, m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 wan2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店有代客停车服务，不用自己找车位。
examples.english_sentence: This hotel has valet parking service, so you don't need to find a parking space yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯，我哋可以叫代客泊車幫我哋攞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 giu3 daai6 haak3 bok3 ce1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 lo2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭，我们可以叫代客停车帮我们取车。
examples.english_sentence: After dinner, we can call the valet parking to get our car.

english_meaning: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing), outsourcing manufacturing
explanation_mandarin: 指委托方提供设计和规格，由代工厂负责生产。
explanation_english: Refers to a manufacturing arrangement where a company (the client) provides the design and specifications, and another company (the manufacturer) produces the product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廠專門做代工㗎，幫好多名牌生產嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 cong2 zyun1 mun4 zou6 doi6 gung1 gaa3, bong1 hou2 do1 ming4 paai4 sang1 caan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂专门做代工，帮很多名牌生产东西。
examples.english_sentence: This factory specializes in OEM, producing goods for many famous brands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗降低成本，我哋將啲生產線搬咗去大陸代工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gong3 dai1 sing4 bun2, ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 sang1 caan2 sin3 bun1 zo2 heoi3 daai6 luk6 doi6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了降低成本，我们把一些生产线搬到了大陆代工。
examples.english_sentence: In order to reduce costs, we moved some of our production lines to the mainland for OEM manufacturing.

english_meaning: Token; Coin; Substitute currency
explanation_mandarin: 代替货币使用的金属或塑料小圆片，可在特定场所使用。
explanation_english: A small metal or plastic disc used as a substitute for currency, typically used in specific locations or for specific purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺遊戲機中心玩機要用代幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jau4 hei3 gei1 zung1 sam1 waan2 gei1 jiu3 yung6 daai6 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在游戏机中心玩游戏要用代币。
examples.english_sentence: You need tokens to play games at the arcade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個停車場淨係收代幣，唔收現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ting4 ce1 coeng4 zing6 hai6 sau1 daai6 bai3, m4 sau1 hin3 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个停车场只收代币，不收现金。
examples.english_sentence: This parking lot only accepts tokens, not cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲超級市場有時會推出印花換代幣嘅活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 jau5 si4 wui5 tui1 ceot1 yan3 faa1 wun6 daai6 bai3 ge3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些超市有时会推出集印花换代币的活动。
examples.english_sentence: Some supermarkets sometimes have promotions where you can collect stamps to exchange for tokens.

english_meaning: Pinch-hit; to substitute for someone
explanation_mandarin: 原指棒球运动中代替击球手出场。引申为代替别人完成某事，或临时顶替某人。
explanation_english: Originally referred to replacing a batter in baseball. By extension, it means to substitute for someone else to complete a task, or to temporarily fill in for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔舒服，我幫佢代打返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 bong1 keoi5 daai6 daa2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不舒服，我帮他代打上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's not feeling well today, I'll pinch-hit for him at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目咁趕，搵人代打幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 gam3 gan2, wan2 jan4 daai6 daa2 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么赶，找人顶替帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so urgent, let's find someone to fill in and help.

english_meaning: algebra
explanation_mandarin: 数学的一个分支，研究数、量及其关系的符号表示和运算规律。
explanation_english: A branch of mathematics that deals with symbols and the rules for manipulating those symbols; it is a unifying thread of almost all of mathematics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀書嗰陣時，覺得代數好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 syu1 go2 zan6 si4, gok3 dak1 doi6 sou3 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我读书的时候，觉得代数很难。
examples.english_sentence: When I was studying, I found algebra very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢數學好叻，代數都識晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 hok6 hou2 lek1, doi6 sou3 dou1 sik1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他数学很棒，代数都懂。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at math and knows algebra completely.

english_meaning: to replace; to substitute for; to take the place of
explanation_mandarin: 取代原来的事物或人。
explanation_english: To replace someone or something; to act as a substitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，我代替佢返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, ngo5 doi6 tai3 keoi5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，我代替他上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, so I'm substituting for him at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇人可以代替你喺我心目中嘅地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 doi6 tai3 nei5 hai2 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有人可以代替你在我心目中的地位。
examples.english_sentence: No one can replace your place in my heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵一個方案去代替而家嗰個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 jat1 go3 fong1 on3 heoi3 doi6 tai3 ji4 gaa1 go2 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找一个方案去代替现在的那个。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a solution to replace the current one.

english_meaning: substitute; replacement; alternative
explanation_mandarin: 用来代替原物的东西。
explanation_english: Something that takes the place of, or is used instead of, something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻茶葉賣晒喇，有無代替品介紹下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 caa4 jip6 maai6 saai3 laa3, jau5 mou5 daai6 tai3 ban2 gaai3 siu6 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种茶叶卖完了，有没有替代品介绍一下？
examples.english_sentence: This tea is sold out. Do you have any substitutes to recommend?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家糖好貴，可以用蜜糖做代替品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 tong4 hou2 gwai3, ho2 ji5 yung6 mat6 tong4 zou6 daai6 tai3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在糖很贵，可以用蜂蜜做替代品。
examples.english_sentence: Sugar is very expensive now, you can use honey as a substitute.

english_meaning: to get around; to travel short distances; a means of transportation
explanation_mandarin: 用某种交通工具作短途出行。
explanation_english: To use a means of transportation for short-distance travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常踩單車代步返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 caai2 daan1 ce1 daai6 bou6 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常骑自行车代步上班。
examples.english_sentence: I usually cycle to work as a means of getting around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部電動滑板車代步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 dung6 waat6 baan2 ce1 daai6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆电动滑板车代步。
examples.english_sentence: He bought an electric scooter to get around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，搭地鐵係最方便嘅代步方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, daap3 dei6 tit3 hai6 zeoi3 fong1 bin6 ge3 daai6 bou6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，乘坐地铁是最方便的代步方式。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, taking the MTR is the most convenient way to get around.

english_meaning: surrogate mother
explanation_mandarin: 代替他人怀孕并生育的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who carries and gives birth to a child for another person or couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家科技咁發達，有啲夫婦會搵代母幫佢哋生小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 fo1 gei6 gam3 faat3 daat6, jau5 di1 fu1 fu2 wui5 wan2 doi6 mou5 bong1 keoi5 dei6 saang1 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在科技这么发达，有些夫妇会找代孕母亲帮他们生孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Now that technology is so advanced, some couples find surrogate mothers to help them have children.

english_meaning: generation gap
explanation_mandarin: 指不同世代的人之间由于年龄、价值观、生活经历等方面的差异而产生的思想、观念上的隔阂和冲突。
explanation_english: Refers to the differences and conflicts in thoughts and values between people of different generations due to differences in age, values, life experiences, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同阿爸之間有代溝，好多嘢都傾唔埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 a3 baa4 zi1 gaan1 jau5 doi6 gau1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 king1 m4 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我爸之间有代沟，很多事情都谈不来。
examples.english_sentence: There's a generation gap between my dad and me, we can't agree on many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩婆媳之間嘅代溝好深，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 po4 sik1 zi1 gaan1 ge3 doi6 gau1 hou2 sam1, seng4 jat6 caau2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们婆媳之间的代沟很深，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: The generation gap between the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law is very deep, they often argue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要縮窄代溝，就要互相理解同尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 suk1 zaak3 doi6 gau1, zau6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 lei5 gaai2 tung4 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要缩小代沟，就要互相理解和尊重。
examples.english_sentence: To bridge the generation gap, we need to understand and respect each other.

english_meaning: to act on behalf of; to do in place of; to substitute for
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人做某事。
explanation_english: To do something on behalf of someone else; to act as a substitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以代為簽收呢份文件啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daai6 wai4 cim1 sau1 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我代签收这份文件吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please sign for this document on my behalf?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，要我代為處理啲事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, jiu3 ngo5 daai6 wai4 cyu2 lei5 di1 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了，要我代替他处理一些事务。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, so I need to handle some affairs on his behalf.

english_meaning: on behalf of; to do something for someone
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人去做某事；代表别人。
explanation_english: To do something in place of or on behalf of someone else; to represent someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你代我為佢道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 doi6 ngo5 wai4 keoi5 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你代替我向他道歉。
examples.english_sentence: Please apologize to him on my behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢代為保管啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 wai4 bou2 gun2 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他代为保管这些文件。
examples.english_sentence: He's keeping these documents safe for someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以代為安排?
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 doi6 wai4 on1 paai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以代为安排吗?
examples.english_sentence: Can you arrange it on my behalf?

english_meaning: agent; agency; to act as agent; to represent
explanation_mandarin: 代表个人或机构行使某种权力或职责的个人或机构；充当代理人。
explanation_english: A person or company that acts on behalf of another person or company; to act as an agent for someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司係呢隻產品嘅香港代理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 ni1 zek3 caan2 ban2 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 doi6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司是这种产品的香港代理。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is the Hong Kong agent for this product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你代理住先啦，你遲啲再自己搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 doi6 lei5 zyu6 sin1 laa1, nei5 ci4 di1 zoi3 zi6 gei2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你代理着先，你晚点再自己弄。
examples.english_sentence: I'll act as your agent for now, you can handle it yourself later.

english_meaning: agency; distributorship; franchise
explanation_mandarin: 代表他人或机构行使某种权利的权力。通常指在商业活动中，被授权代表销售、推广或管理某种产品或服务的权利。
explanation_english: The right to act on behalf of another person or organization. Usually refers to the right to represent, sell, promote, or manage a product or service in business activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司攞到呢個牌子嘅香港代理權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 lo2 dou2 ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 daai6 lei5 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司拿到了这个品牌的香港代理权。
examples.english_sentence: This company obtained the Hong Kong agency for this brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋爭緊呢隻藥嘅亞太區代理權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zaang1 gan2 ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 aa3 taai3 keoi1 daai6 lei5 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在争夺这种药的亚太区代理权。
examples.english_sentence: They are competing for the Asia-Pacific distributorship of this medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 代理權合約通常有好多細節要留意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lei5 kyun4 hap6 joek3 tung1 soeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 sai3 zit3 jiu3 liu1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 代理权合同通常有很多细节需要留意。
examples.english_sentence: Agency contracts usually have many details to pay attention to.

english_meaning: to use as a substitute; to substitute; to use something in place of something else
explanation_mandarin: 用其他的东西代替原来的东西使用。
explanation_english: To use something else as a replacement for the original item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇帶遮，可以用紙皮箱代用住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 daai3 ze1, ho2 ji5 yung6 zi2 pei4 soeng1 daai6 jung6 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没带伞，可以先用纸箱代替一下。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring an umbrella, you can use a cardboard box as a temporary substitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電池冇電，攞住舊電代用住先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 ci4 mou5 din6, lo2 zyu6 gau6 din6 daai6 jung6 zyu6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电池没电了，先拿个旧电池代替一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The battery is dead, let's use an old battery as a substitute for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇錢，咪用信用卡代用住囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 cin2, mai1 yung6 seon3 jung6 kaat1 daai6 jung6 zyu6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在没钱，就先用信用卡代替一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have any cash right now, so I'll just use my credit card as a substitute.

english_meaning: Code (computer programming)
explanation_mandarin: 指计算机程序中的指令或符号系统。
explanation_english: Refers to a system of instructions or symbols in a computer program; code.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你寫嘅代碼有啲問題，要debug吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 se2 ge3 doi6 maa5 jau5 di1 man6 tai4, jiu3 debug haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你写的代码有些问题，需要debug一下。
examples.english_sentence: There are some problems with the code you wrote, you need to debug it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻寫代碼㗎，咩語言都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 se2 doi6 maa5 gaa3, me1 jyu5 jin4 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长写代码，什么语言都会。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at writing code, he knows all the languages.

english_meaning: ghostwriting; to write on behalf of someone else
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人写作。可以指实际的代写行为，也可以指作品并非署名作者本人所写。
explanation_english: To write on behalf of someone else; ghostwriting. It can refer to the actual act of writing for someone else, or imply that the work was not written by the person whose name appears on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本書係搵人代筆嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 syu1 hai6 wan2 jan4 doi6 bat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的书是找人代笔的。
examples.english_sentence: His book was ghostwritten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢份功課都係阿媽代筆嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 dou1 hai6 aa3 maa1 doi6 bat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他的功课都是妈妈代笔的。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that his homework was all written by his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住揾人代筆寫論文呀，俾人捉到就大鑊㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 wan2 jan4 doi6 bat1 se2 leon6 man4 aa3, bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 daai6 wok6 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着找人代笔写论文啊，被别人抓到就糟了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about getting someone to ghostwrite your thesis, if you get caught, you'll be in big trouble!

english_meaning: Artificial sweetener, sugar substitute
explanation_mandarin: 代替天然糖的物质，通常用于控制血糖或减少热量摄入。
explanation_english: A substance used as a substitute for natural sugar, typically used to control blood sugar or reduce calorie intake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯齋啡，落啲代糖就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 yam2 bui1 zaai1 fe1, lok6 di1 doi6 tong4 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯黑咖啡，放点代糖就行了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a black coffee, just add some artificial sweetener.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我盡量唔好食糖，食代糖好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 zeon6 loeng6 m4 hou2 sik6 tong4, sik6 doi6 tong4 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我尽量不要吃糖，吃代糖好一些。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to avoid sugar as much as possible, it's better to use artificial sweetener.

english_meaning: to take the blame for someone else; to be a scapegoat; to bear the consequences for another's wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人承担罪责或过错。
explanation_english: To take responsibility for someone else's crime or mistake; to be a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人屈代罪，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wat1 daai6 zeoi6, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冤枉顶罪，真是很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He was wrongly accused and made to take the blame; it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以搵我哋代罪呀，冇可能嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 wan2 ngo5 dei6 daai6 zeoi6 aa3, mou5 ho2 nang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想找我们来替罪，不可能的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about finding us to take the blame for you, it's impossible.

english_meaning: scapegoat
explanation_mandarin: 比喻代人受过的人。
explanation_english: Someone who is blamed for the mistakes or wrongdoings of others, especially in order to protect those who are truly responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次咪又係做咗代罪羔羊囉，明明唔關佢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 mai1 jau6 hai6 zou6 zo2 doi6 zeoi6 gou1 joeng4 lo1, ming4 ming4 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次又成了替罪羊了，明明不关他的事。
examples.english_sentence: He's become a scapegoat again this time, even though it's clearly not his fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搵我做代罪羔羊呀，我唔會幫你揹鑊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wan2 ngo5 zou6 doi6 zeoi6 gou1 joeng4 aa3, ngo5 m4 wui5 bong1 nei5 bei1 wok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要找我做替罪羊啊，我不会帮你背黑锅的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to make me the scapegoat. I won't take the blame for you.

english_meaning: code name, code
explanation_mandarin: 代替名字或号码的符号，通常用于保密或简化称呼。
explanation_english: A symbol, name, or number used instead of a real name or number, usually for security or to simplify communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅行動代號係「閃電」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hang4 dung6 doi6 hou6 hai6 "sim2 din6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的行动代号是“闪电”。
examples.english_sentence: Our operation's code name is "Lightning."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅職員代號係 007。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zik1 jyun4 doi6 hou6 hai6 ling4 ling4 cat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的员工代号是 007。
examples.english_sentence: His employee code is 007.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個病人都有一個獨立嘅醫療代號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 beng6 jan4 dou1 jau5 jat1 go3 duk6 laap6 ge3 ji1 liu4 doi6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个病人都有一个独立的医疗代号。
examples.english_sentence: Each patient has an independent medical code.

english_meaning: to act on behalf of; to substitute for; to deputize
explanation_mandarin: 代替他人执行职务或完成任务。
explanation_english: To act in place of someone else; to perform duties or tasks on behalf of another person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理放假，由佢代行職務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 fong3 gaa3, jau4 keoi5 doi6 hang4 zik1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理休假，由他代理职务。
examples.english_sentence: The manager is on vacation, so he is acting in his place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔得閒，你可以代行佢嘅權力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 dak1 haan4, nei5 ho2 ji5 doi6 hang4 keoi5 ge3 kyun4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他没空，你可以代替他行使权力。
examples.english_sentence: If he's not available, you can act in his place to exercise his power.

english_meaning: represent, representative, on behalf of
explanation_mandarin: 动词：代替某人或某事物行使职权或表明态度；名词：被选出来代替集体或个人行使职权的人。
explanation_english: Verb: To act on behalf of someone or something; to symbolize. Noun: A person chosen to act on behalf of a group or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋代表咗成個團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daai6 biu2 zo2 sing4 go3 tyun4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们代表了整个团队。
examples.english_sentence: They represent the whole team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我代表公司嚟多謝你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 biu2 gung1 si1 lai4 do1 ze6 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我代表公司来感谢你们。
examples.english_sentence: I'm here on behalf of the company to thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅學生代表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hok6 sang1 daai6 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们的学生代表。
examples.english_sentence: He is our student representative.

english_meaning: masterpiece; representative work; signature work
explanation_mandarin: 指最能代表个人水平或风格的作品。
explanation_english: A work that best represents a person's level of skill or style; a representative work or masterpiece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲係佢嘅代表作，好多人都鍾意睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 daai6 biu2 zok3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是他的代表作，很多人都喜欢看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is his representative work, many people like to watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 《獅子山下》可以話係香港嘅代表作之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 zi2 saan1 haa5 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daai6 biu2 zok3 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 《狮子山下》可以说是香港的代表作之一。
examples.english_sentence: "Below the Lion Rock" can be said to be one of Hong Kong's representative works.

english_meaning: representative team; delegation
explanation_mandarin: 代表某个组织或国家参加比赛或活动的队伍。
explanation_english: A team that represents an organization, country, or region in a competition or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港代表隊喺奧運會攞咗好多獎牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 doi6 biu2 deoi2 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 lo2 zo2 hou2 do1 zoeng2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港代表队在奥运会获得了许多奖牌。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong representative team won many medals at the Olympics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗學校嘅籃球代表隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 hok6 haau6 ge3 laam4 kau4 doi6 biu2 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他进入了学校的篮球代表队。
examples.english_sentence: He got into the school's basketball representative team.

english_meaning: to endorse (a product); spokesperson
explanation_mandarin: 为某种产品或服务进行宣传或推广的人或行为；作为…的代表。
explanation_english: To publicly recommend or support a product or service; to act as a spokesperson for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗呢個牌子嘅代言人好多年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 doi6 jin4 jan4 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经做了这个品牌的代言人很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been the spokesperson for this brand for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明星通常都會搵公司簽約，幫佢哋嘅產品代言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 sing1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui2 wan2 gung1 si1 cim1 joek3, bong1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2 doi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明星通常都会找公司签约，帮他们的产品代言。
examples.english_sentence: Celebrities usually sign contracts with companies to endorse their products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司揾咗個好受歡迎嘅演員嚟代言佢哋嘅新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 wan2 zo2 go3 hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4 ge3 yin2 yun4 lai4 doi6 jin4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司找了一个很受欢迎的演员来代言他们的新产品。
examples.english_sentence: This company hired a very popular actor to endorse their new product.

english_meaning: spokesperson, representative, endorser
explanation_mandarin: 代表某个品牌或机构进行宣传推广的人。通常是名人或有影响力的人物。
explanation_english: A person who represents a brand, organization, or product and promotes it. Often a celebrity or influential figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個牌子嘅代言人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 doi6 jin4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个品牌的代言人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the spokesperson for this brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵個啱嘅代言人對公司形象好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 go3 ngaam1 ge3 doi6 jin4 jan4 deoi3 gung1 si1 jing4 zoeng6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找一个合适的代言人对公司形象很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Finding the right spokesperson is very important for the company's image.

english_meaning: pronoun
explanation_mandarin: 代替名词或名词性词组的词。
explanation_english: A word that is used in place of a noun or noun phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「你」、「我」、「佢」都係代詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5, ngo5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 doi6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “你”、“我”、“他”都是代词。
examples.english_sentence: "You", "I", and "He" are all pronouns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢句嘢入邊，「佢」就係主語代詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 geoi3 je5 jap6 bin1, keoi5 zau6 hai6 zyu2 jyu5 doi6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这句话里，“他”是主语代词。
examples.english_sentence: In this sentence, "he" is a subject pronoun.

english_meaning: to substitute teach, to cover a class
explanation_mandarin: 代替老师上课，临时担任教师的职务。
explanation_english: To substitute for a teacher; to temporarily fill a teaching position; to cover a class for an absent teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我唔得閒，可唔可以搵人幫我代課呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 wan2 jan4 bong1 ngo5 doi6 fo3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天没空，可不可以找人帮我代课啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow. Can you find someone to cover my class for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日病咗，要人代課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2, jiu3 jan4 doi6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天生病了，需要人代课。
examples.english_sentence: He is sick today and needs someone to cover his class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校好缺老師，成日要搵人代課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 hou2 kyut3 lou5 si1, seng4 jat6 jiu3 wan2 jan4 doi6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校很缺老师，经常要找人代课。
examples.english_sentence: Our school has a shortage of teachers and often needs to find substitutes.

english_meaning: metabolism
explanation_mandarin: 生物体内的物质转换和能量转换过程，包括合成和分解。
explanation_english: The chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動可以加快你嘅代謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 ga1 faai3 nei5 ge3 doi6 ze6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动可以加快你的新陈代谢。
examples.english_sentence: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅代謝好快，所以食幾多都唔肥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 doi6 ze6 hou2 faai3, so2 ji5 sik6 gei2 do1 dou1 m4 fei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的新陈代谢很快，所以吃多少都不胖。
examples.english_sentence: Her metabolism is fast, so she doesn't get fat no matter how much she eats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年紀大咗，代謝會慢啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 gei2 daai6 zo2, doi6 ze6 wui5 maan6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年纪大了，新陈代谢会慢一些。
examples.english_sentence: As you get older, your metabolism slows down.

english_meaning: Representative, Member of Parliament (MP)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过选举或其他方式产生的，代表选民或团体的利益，参与政治决策的人员，通常指议员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person elected or otherwise chosen to represent the interests of constituents or groups and participate in political decision-making, typically a member of parliament or congress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位代議士好關心民生問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai2 daai6 ji5 si6 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 man4 sang1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位议员非常关心民生问题。
examples.english_sentence: That representative is very concerned about people's livelihood issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民期望代議士可以反映佢哋嘅訴求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 kei4 mong6 daai6 ji5 si6 ho2 ji5 faan2 ying3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sou3 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民期望议员可以反映他们的诉求。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens expect representatives to reflect their demands.

english_meaning: Buying on behalf of someone; proxy shopping
explanation_mandarin: 指代替他人购买商品。通常是因为某些商品在该购买者所在的地区无法购买到，或者价格较高，所以委托他人从其他地区或国家购买。
explanation_english: Refers to buying goods on behalf of someone else. This is usually because certain goods are not available in the buyer's region, or the prices are higher, so they entrust someone else to purchase them from another region or country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日幫朋友代購日本嘅化妝品。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以身体不舒服为理由，没去上班。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't go to work under the pretext of being unwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以要溫書為由，拒絕咗我哋嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 jiu3 wan1 syu1 wai4 jau4, keoi5 jyut6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 yiu1 ching2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以要复习功课为理由，拒绝了我们的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: He refused our invitation on the grounds of needing to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以趕時間為由，冇同我哋食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 gon2 si4 gaan3 wai4 jau4, mou5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以赶时间为理由，没有和我们吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't have dinner with us using being in a hurry as an excuse.

english_meaning: using ... as a reason; on the grounds of
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词短语 (jiè cí duǎn yǔ)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以某种事物或情况作为借口或理由。
explanation_english: Expresses the use of something as an excuse, pretext, or reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以身體唔舒服爲由，請咗一日假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 san1 tai2 m4 syu1 fuk6 wai4 jau4, cheng2 zo2 yat1 jat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以身体不舒服为理由，请了一天假。
examples.english_sentence: He took a day off, using feeling unwell as a reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以趕功課爲由，推咗個約會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 gon2 gung1 fo3 wai4 jau4, tui1 zo2 go3 yoek3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以赶功课为理由，推掉了约会。
examples.english_sentence: He cancelled the date, using catching up on homework as a reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以忙碌為理由，唔照顧自己身體呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 mong4 luk1 wai4 jau4, m4 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2 san1 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以忙碌为理由，不照顾自己的身体啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't use being busy as a reason not to take care of your health!

english_meaning: above; over; more than; the above-mentioned
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置、数量、级别等超过某个标准。
explanation_english: Indicates that a position, quantity, level, etc., exceeds a certain standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司規定，經理級以上嘅職員先可以揸公司車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6, ging1 lei5 kap1 ji5 soeng6 ge3 zik1 jyun4 sin1 ho2 ji5 zaa1 gung1 si1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司规定，经理级别以上的职员才可以开公司车。
examples.english_sentence: Our company stipulates that only employees at or above the manager level can drive company cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消費滿一百蚊以上，就可以參加抽獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fai3 mun5 jat1 baak3 man1 ji5 soeng6, zau6 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1 cau1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消费满一百块钱以上，就可以参加抽奖。
examples.english_sentence: If you spend over a hundred dollars, you can participate in the lucky draw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以上就係我嘅報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 soeng6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以上就是我的报告。
examples.english_sentence: The above is my report.

english_meaning: below; under; the following
partOfSpeech_english: positional word; noun (when referring to 'the following')
explanation_mandarin: 在某物的下面；在时间或顺序上较后的。
explanation_english: Below or under something; later in time or order; the following.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以下嘅資料都係關於呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 haa6 ge3 zi1 liu2 dou1 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以下的资料都是关于这件事的。
examples.english_sentence: The following information is all about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺以下嘅地點集合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji5 haa6 ge3 dei6 dim2 zaap6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在以下的地点集合。
examples.english_sentence: Assemble at the following locations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以下嘅問題請回答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 haa6 ge3 man6 tai4 cing2 wui4 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以下的问题请回答。
examples.english_sentence: Please answer the following questions.

jyutping: ji5 bat1 bin3 jing3 maan6 bin3
english_meaning: To respond to all changes with a constant strategy; to take a passive approach in dealing with complex situations; to remain unchanged in the face of changing circumstances.
explanation_mandarin: 面对复杂多变的局面，采取不变的策略来应对。
explanation_english: A strategy of responding to changes by remaining unchanged; to deal with complexity by sticking to a fundamental approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家個市況咁波動，最好都係以不變應萬變啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go3 si5 fong3 gam3 bo1 dung6, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 ji5 bat1 bin3 jing3 maan6 bin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在市场行情这么波动，最好还是以不变应万变了。
examples.english_sentence: The market is so volatile now, it's best to stick to a constant strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多困難，我哋都係以不變應萬變，堅持到底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 ji5 bat1 bin3 jing3 maan6 bin3, gin1 ci4 dou3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多困难，我们还是以不变应万变，坚持到底。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many difficulties, we should stick to a constant strategy and persevere to the end.

english_meaning: to address the issue on its own merits; to deal with the matter at hand; to be objective and impartial
explanation_mandarin: 只针对事情本身进行讨论，不考虑其他无关因素。
explanation_english: To discuss or judge a matter purely on its own merits, without letting personal feelings or irrelevant factors influence the decision or judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該以事論事，唔好因為佢係你朋友就偏幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 ji5 si6 leon6 si6, m4 hou2 yan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 nei5 pang4 jau5 jau6 pin1 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该就事论事，不要因为他是你朋友就偏袒他。
examples.english_sentence: We should address the issue on its own merits, and not favour him just because he's your friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，大家最好以事論事，集中討論個方案嘅優缺點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge2 zan6, daai6 ga1 zeoi3 hou2 ji5 si6 leon6 si6, zaap6 zung1 tou2 leon6 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 yau1 kyut3 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，大家最好就事论事，集中讨论方案的优缺点。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, it's best if everyone addresses the issue on its own merits and focuses on discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要以事論事咁睇呢件事，唔好將個人情緒帶入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji5 si6 leon6 si6 gam2 tai2 ni1 gin6 si6, m4 hou2 zoeng1 go3 yan4 ching4 seoi5 daai3 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要就事论事地看待这件事，不要将个人情绪带入进去。
examples.english_sentence: We need to look at this matter objectively and not bring personal emotions into it.

english_meaning: since; since (a time)
explanation_mandarin: 表示从过去某时到现在的一段时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a period of time from a past time to the present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從畢業以來，我就一直喺呢間公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 bat1 jip6 ji5 loi4, ngo5 zau6 jat1 zik6 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从毕业以来，我就一直在这家公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: Since graduation, I have been working at this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排以來，佢嘅心情都唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai1 ji5 loi4, keoi5 ge3 sam1 ching4 dou1 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近来以来，他的心情都不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: Lately, he hasn't been in a good mood.

english_meaning: so that; in order to; so as to; for the purpose of; to facilitate
explanation_mandarin: 表示目的，常用于书面语，引导目的状语。
explanation_english: Expresses purpose, often used in formal writing, introducing an adverbial clause of purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會早啲到機場，以便有足夠時間辦理登機手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zou2 di1 dou3 gei1 coeng4, ji5 bin6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 si4 gaan3 baan6 lei5 dang1 gei1 sau2 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会早点到机场，以便有足够的时间办理登机手续。
examples.english_sentence: I will arrive at the airport earlier so that I have enough time to complete the check-in procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請提前預約，以便我哋可以安排最合適嘅時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 tai4 cin4 jyu6 joek3, ji5 bin6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 on1 paai4 zeoi3 hap6 sik1 ge3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请提前预约，以便我们可以安排最合适的时间。
examples.english_sentence: Please make an appointment in advance so that we can arrange the most suitable time.

english_meaning: To pass off the fake as genuine; to palm off counterfeit goods as genuine
explanation_mandarin: 用假的冒充真的，使人分辨不出真假。
explanation_english: To substitute imitation for the real thing; to present counterfeit goods as genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲翻版貨做得以假亂眞，真係好難分㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faan1 baan2 fo3 zou6 dak1 ji5 gaa2 lyun6 zan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些仿冒品做得以假乱真，真的很难分辨。
examples.english_sentence: These counterfeit goods are so well made that it's really hard to tell them apart from the real thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲演技以假亂眞，睇到我差啲就信咗佢哋講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dik1 jin2 gei3 ji5 gaa2 lyun6 zan1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 zau6 seon3 zo2 keoi5 dei6 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的演技以假乱真，我差点就相信他们说的话了。
examples.english_sentence: Their acting was so convincing that I almost believed what they were saying.

english_meaning: to pass off the fake as genuine; to palm off a fake as the real thing
explanation_mandarin: 用假的去冒充真的，使人分辨不出来。
explanation_english: To use fake items to imitate genuine ones, making it difficult for people to distinguish the difference. It describes something that is so well-imitated that it's hard to tell it's not real.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫畫得咁似，真係可以以假亂真㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waa2 waa2 dak1 gam3 ci5, zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 ji5 gaa2 lyun6 zan1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画的画太像了，真的可以以假乱真了！
examples.english_sentence: His paintings are so realistic that they can really pass off the fake as the real thing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲冒牌手袋做得咁好，簡直以假亂真，好難分真假！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 mou6 paai4 sau2 doi2 zou6 dak1 gam3 hou2, gaan2 zik6 ji5 gaa2 lyun6 zan1, hou2 naan4 fan1 zan1 gaa2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些假冒的手提包做得这么好，简直以假乱真，很难分辨真假！
examples.english_sentence: These fake handbags are made so well, it's practically impossible to tell them apart from the real thing!

mandarin_meaning: 以偏赅全，以部分代表全体
english_meaning: generalization; to generalize from a few examples; to judge the whole by a part
explanation_mandarin: 指用片面的、不全面的情况来概括整体情况，犯了逻辑错误。
explanation_english: To generalize from a part to the whole; to draw a general conclusion from incomplete evidence; a logical fallacy where one reaches a conclusion based on insufficient evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以偏概全啦，唔係個個後生仔都咁懶嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4 laa1, m4 hai6 go3 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 gam3 laan5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以偏概全，不是每个年轻人都这么懒惰的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't generalize. Not all young people are so lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以因為佢做錯咗一次就以偏概全，否定佢嘅所有努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 jan1 wai4 keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 jat1 ci3 zau6 ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4, fau2 ding6 keoi5 ge3 so2 jau5 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能因为他犯了一次错就以偏概全，否定他的所有努力。
examples.english_sentence: You can't generalize and negate all his efforts just because he made one mistake.

english_meaning: generalization; generalizing from a specific case; to generalize from limited information
explanation_mandarin: 用片面的认识来概括整体，以部分代表整体。
explanation_english: To make a sweeping generalization based on incomplete information or a small sample size; to generalize from the particular to the general; to draw a conclusion about a whole based on limited evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁以偏概全啦，唔係個個後生仔都唔捱得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4 laa1, m4 hai6 go3 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 m4 ngaai4 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么以偏概全，不是每个年轻人都吃不了苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't generalize like that. Not every young person can't handle hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淨係睇咗佢一兩個行為就話佢係壞人，噉樣以偏概全唔公平嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing6 hai6 tai2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 loeng5 go3 hang4 wai4 zau6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 waai6 jan4, gam2 joeng2 ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只看了他一两个行为就说他是坏人，这样以偏概全是不公平的。
examples.english_sentence: Judging him to be a bad person based on only one or two actions is an unfair generalization.

mandarin_meaning: 以儆效尤 (yǐ jǐng xiào yóu)
english_meaning: To punish one as a warning to others; to make an example of someone to deter others.
explanation_mandarin: 惩罚一个人，警戒其他人效仿坏事。 通过惩罚一个坏的例子，来警告其他人不要做同样的事情。
explanation_english: To punish one person as a warning to others, deterring them from imitating the bad behavior. It involves making an example of someone who has done something wrong to discourage others from doing the same thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細炒咗嗰個成日遲到嘅同事，以儆效尤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 caau2 zo2 go2 go3 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 ge3 tung4 si6, ji5 ging2 haau6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板解雇了那个总是迟到的同事，以儆效尤。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired the colleague who was always late, as a warning to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官判佢坐監，以儆效尤，等其他人唔敢再犯同樣嘅罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 pun3 keoi5 co5 gaam1, ji5 ging2 haau6 jau4, dang2 kei4 taa1 jan4 m4 gam2 zoi3 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官判他坐牢，以儆效尤，让其他人不敢再犯同样的罪。
examples.english_sentence: The judge sentenced him to prison as a warning to others, so that others would not dare to commit the same crime again.

synonyms: [杀鸡儆猴 (shā jī jǐng hóu) - (Mandarin synonym, not directly applicable to Cantonese)

english_meaning: in order to avoid; so as not to; lest
explanation_mandarin: 表示避免某种不希望发生的情况。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a clause expressing a purpose or reason for preventing something undesirable from happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好早啲出門口，以免趕唔切返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2, ji5 min5 gon2 ng4 cit3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好早点出门，以免赶不上上班。
examples.english_sentence: You better leave home earlier so as not to be late for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住帶遮，以免淋濕身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 daai3 ze1, ji5 min5 lam4 sip3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记住带伞，以免淋湿。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring an umbrella, so as not to get wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該提前做好準備，以免到時手忙腳亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 tai4 cin4 zou6 hou2 zeon2 bei6, ji5 min5 dou3 si4 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该提前做好准备，以免到时手忙脚乱。
examples.english_sentence: We should prepare in advance so as not to be in a fluster when the time comes.

english_meaning: within; inside; less than; under
explanation_mandarin: 表示在一定范围或界限之内。
explanation_english: Indicates being within a certain range or limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個鐘頭以內要返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 ji5 noi6 jiu3 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个小时以内要回到家。
examples.english_sentence: I have to be home within an hour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三十蚊以內嘅嘢，我請你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 sap6 man1 ji5 noi6 ge3 je5, ngo5 cheng2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 三十块钱以内的东西，我请你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll treat you to anything under thirty dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加人數會喺一百人以內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 jan4 sou3 wui5 hai2 jat1 baak3 jan4 ji5 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加人数会在一百人以内。
examples.english_sentence: The number of participants will be within 100 people.

cantonese: 以其人之道還治其人之身
jyutping: ji5 kei4 jan4 zi1 dou6 waan4 zi6 kei4 jan4 zi1 san1
mandarin_meaning: 以其人之道还治其人之身
english_meaning: To treat a person in the same way they treat others; to give someone a taste of their own medicine; tit for tat.
explanation_mandarin: 用某人所用的手段来反击某人自身。通常指以同样的手段报复对方。
explanation_english: To retaliate against someone using the same methods or tactics that they themselves use. It implies delivering justice or revenge in kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，我哋咪以其人之道還治其人之身囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ngo5 dei6 mai1 ji5 kei4 jan4 zi1 dou6 waan4 zi6 kei4 jan4 zi1 san1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，我们只好以其人之道还治其人之身了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble, so we'll just give him a taste of his own medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呃我錢，我一定要以其人之道還治其人之身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aak1 ngo5 cin2, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ji5 kei4 jan4 zi1 dou6 waan4 zi6 kei4 jan4 zi1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗我的钱，我一定要以其人之道还治其人之身。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated me out of money, I must pay him back in his own coin.

english_meaning: before, formerly, in the past
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的时间，以往。
explanation_english: Refers to a time in the past, formerly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以前好鍾意食雪糕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 syut3 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前很喜欢吃冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: I used to really like eating ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅香港唔係咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 m4 hai6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的香港不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong wasn't like this in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以前喺邊度返工㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 cin4 hai2 bin1 dou6 faan1 gung1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以前在哪里工作？
examples.english_sentence: Where did you work before?

english_meaning: to strike a stone with an egg (idiom); to attempt the impossible; to invite defeat; to fight a losing battle
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用脆弱的东西去碰坚硬的东西，自取灭亡。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes using something fragile to strike against something hard, resulting in self-destruction. It means attempting something impossible or inviting defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司咁細，同間大公司爭生意，咪即係以卵擊石囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam3 sai3, tung4 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zaang1 saang1 ji3, mai1 zik1 hai6 ji5 lon2 gik1 sek6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司这么小，跟那家大公司抢生意，不就是以卵击石吗。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is so small, competing with that big company for business is just like striking a stone with an egg.

english_meaning: and; as well as
explanation_mandarin: 连接并列的词或词组。
explanation_english: Connects parallel words or phrases; and; as well as.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食蘋果以及橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2 ji5 gap6 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃苹果以及橙子。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat apples as well as oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講英文、普通話以及廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 ying1 man4, pou2 tung1 waa2 ji5 gap6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说英语、普通话以及广东话。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak English, Mandarin and Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要水、食物以及藥物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 seoi2, sik6 mat6 ji5 gap6 yoek6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要水、食物以及药物。
examples.english_sentence: We need water, food, and medicine.

english_meaning: Harmony is to be prized; Peace is of utmost importance; Emphasize harmony; Valuing harmony above all else.
explanation_mandarin: 指以和平和睦为最可贵，强调避免冲突，保持和谐。
explanation_english: It emphasizes the importance of maintaining peace and harmony, and avoiding conflicts as much as possible. It suggests prioritizing harmonious relationships and peaceful resolution over asserting one's own position or winning an argument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲嘢讓一步海闊天空，以和為貴吖嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 je5 joeng6 jat1 bou6 hoi2 fut3 tin1 hung1, ji5 wo4 wai4 gwai3 aa1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些事情退一步海阔天空，以和为贵嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes taking a step back opens up a whole new world; harmony is to be prized, you know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家和萬事興，一家人最緊要以和為貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 wo4 maan6 si6 hing1, jat1 gaa1 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ji5 wo4 wai4 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家和万事兴，一家人最重要的是以和为贵。
examples.english_sentence: If the family is harmonious, everything will prosper. It's most important for a family to value harmony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意都係以和為貴，唔好傷咗大家嘅感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 dou1 hai6 ji5 wo4 wai4 gwai3, m4 hou2 soeng1 zo2 daai6 gaa1 ge3 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意也是以和为贵，不要伤了大家的感情。
examples.english_sentence: In doing business, it's best to value harmony, don't damage everyone's relationship.

english_meaning: Harmony is to be prized; Peace is of utmost importance.
explanation_mandarin: 指以和睦相处为最重要的原则。强调避免冲突，保持和谐的关系。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of maintaining harmony and peace in relationships and situations. It advocates for avoiding conflict and prioritizing amicable resolutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，以和爲貴，唔好再嘈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, ji5 wo4 wai4 gwai3, m4 hou2 zoi3 cou4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，以和为贵，不要再吵了。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, harmony is to be prized, let's not argue anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日都話以和爲貴，所以公司裏面就算有啲唔公平嘅嘢，都好少會有人出聲。
