examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 ji5 wo4 wai4 gwai3, so2 ji5 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6 zau6 syun3 jau5 di1 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 je5, dou1 hou2 siu2 wui5 jau5 jan4 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是说以和为贵，所以公司里就算有些不公平的事情，也很少会有人出声。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always says harmony is to be prized, so even if there are some unfair things in the company, very few people will speak up.

english_meaning: since; ever since
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间起点，相当于“以来”。
explanation_english: Indicates a starting point in time; equivalent to "since" or "ever since".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從畢業以嚟，我哋就冇見過面啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 bat1 jip6 ji5 lai4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 min6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从毕业以来，我们就没有见过面了。
examples.english_sentence: We haven't seen each other since graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自佢走咗以嚟，我一直都好掛住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 keoi5 zau2 zo2 ji5 lai4, ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他走了以后，我一直都很想念他。
examples.english_sentence: I've been missing him ever since he left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港回歸以嚟，變化都幾大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 wui4 gwai1 ji5 lai4, bin3 faa3 dou1 gei2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港回归以来，变化挺大的。
examples.english_sentence: There have been quite big changes in Hong Kong since the handover.

english_meaning: besides; apart from; other than
explanation_mandarin: 表示排除某个范围，类似于“除了…之外”。
explanation_english: Indicates exclusion from a certain range, similar to 'besides...'. It means 'other than', 'except', 'apart from'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗佢以外，冇人知呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 keoi5 ji5 ngoi6, mou5 jan4 zi1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了他以外，没人知道这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Apart from him, nobody knows about this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有其他興趣以外，最鍾意就係睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 hing3 ceoi3 ji5 ngoi6, zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zau6 hai6 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了其他兴趣以外，我最喜欢的就是看电影。
examples.english_sentence: Besides other hobbies, my favorite thing to do is watch movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司做嘅嘢都係電腦程式以外嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 zou6 ge3 je5 dou1 hai6 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1 ji5 ngoi6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他公司做的事情都是电脑程式以外的事情。
examples.english_sentence: The things his company does are all things other than computer programming.

english_meaning: to defeat the many with the few; to win against overwhelming odds
explanation_mandarin: 以少数的兵力战胜多数的敌人。形容力量悬殊，但最终取得了胜利。
explanation_english: To defeat a large enemy force with a small one. It describes a situation where the odds are stacked against you, but you ultimately succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波雖然人少，但係憑住出色嘅戰術，都以寡敵眾，贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 seui1 jin4 jan4 siu2, daan6 hai6 pang4 zyu6 chuk1 sik1 ge3 zin3 seot6, dou1 ji5 gwaa2 dik6 zung3, wing4 zo2 cheung4 bei2 choi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的球队虽然人少，但是凭借出色的战术，仍然以少胜多，赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Although their team was small in number, they won the game against overwhelming odds by relying on excellent tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺創業初期，我哋資金有限，面對咁多競爭對手，簡直係以寡敵眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 chong3 jip6 choh1 kei4, ngo5 dei6 zi1 gam1 jau5 haan6, min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 ging6 zang1 deui3 sau2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ji5 gwaa2 dik6 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在创业初期，我们资金有限，面对这么多竞争对手，简直是以少胜多。
examples.english_sentence: In the early stages of the business, we had limited funds and faced so many competitors; it was practically a case of defeating the many with the few.

english_meaning: to defeat a large number with a small force; to win against overwhelming odds
explanation_mandarin: 形容用少数兵力战胜多数敌人的情况。也比喻用较小的力量战胜强大的力量。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a small force defeats a large number of enemies. Also used metaphorically to describe overcoming powerful forces with limited resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋憑住堅強嘅意志，以寡敵衆，最終贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 pang4 zyu6 gin1 keung4 ge3 ji3 zi3, ji5 gwaa2 dik6 zung3, zeoi3 zung1 wing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们凭借坚强的意志，以少胜多，最终赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: With strong will, they won the game against all odds.

english_meaning: cure like with like; treat an ailment by eating something that resembles the affected part
explanation_mandarin: 认为吃形状与身体某部位相似的食物可以治疗或增强该部位的功能。属于一种迷信的食疗观念。
explanation_english: The belief that eating food that resembles a particular body part can cure or strengthen that part. It's a superstitious concept of dietary therapy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家成日話食核桃補腦，都係以形補形嘅一種講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 yan4 ga1 sing4 yat6 waa6 sik6 hat6 tou4 bou2 nou5, dou1 hai6 ji5 ying4 bou2 ying4 ge3 yat1 zhung2 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家总是说吃核桃补脑，这都是以形补形的一种说法。
examples.english_sentence: Old people always say that eating walnuts is good for the brain. This is just one type of 'cure like with like' belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信曬以形補形嗰套嘢，有病都係要睇醫生嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 ji5 ying4 bou2 ying4 go2 tou3 ye5, yau5 beng6 dou1 hai6 yiu3 tai2 yi1 sang1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要全信以形补形那一套，生病了还是要看医生的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely believe in the 'cure like with like' thing. You still need to see a doctor when you're sick.

english_meaning: in the past, formerly, previously
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的一段时间，之前。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time in the past, before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以往好勤力㗎，唔知點解而家咁懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wong5 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3, m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 ji4 gaa1 gam3 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以往很努力的，不知道为什么现在这么懒。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be very hardworking, I don't know why he's so lazy now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以往嘅經驗話我哋知，做嘢要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wong5 ge3 ging1 gim6 waa6 ngo5 dei6 zi1, zou6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以往的经验告诉我们，做事要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Past experience tells us to be more careful when working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司以往嘅政策比較寬鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 wong5 ge3 zing3 caak3 bei2 gaau3 fun1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司以往的政策比较宽松。
examples.english_sentence: The company's previous policies were more relaxed.

english_meaning: after; afterwards; later; in the future
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间在某个时间点之后。
explanation_english: Indicates the time after a certain point in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住畢業以後去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 bat1 jip6 ji5 hau6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算毕业以后去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to travel after graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以後唔好咁樣做喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 hau6 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 zou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以后不要这样做啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do it like this in the future!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話結婚以後想生小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 git3 fan1 ji5 hau6 soeng2 saang1 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说结婚以后想要生孩子。
examples.english_sentence: She said she wants to have children after getting married.

english_meaning: to return good for evil; to recompense injury with kindness
explanation_mandarin: 用恩惠来回报仇恨。指不记仇，反而对有仇怨的人做好事。
explanation_english: To repay hatred or injury with kindness and virtue. It implies forgiving and treating one's enemies with generosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁對你，你仲要以德報怨，真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 deoi3 nei5, nei5 zung6 jiu3 ji5 dak1 bou3 jyun3, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那样对你，你还要以德报怨，真是很难得。
examples.english_sentence: He treated you like that, yet you still repay evil with good. That's truly commendable.

english_meaning: to convince people with virtue; to win people over through moral influence
explanation_mandarin: 用道德的力量使人信服。强调通过自身的良好品德和行为来赢得他人的尊重和服从，而不是依靠权力或武力。
explanation_english: To convince or subdue people through virtue and morality, rather than force or power. It emphasizes gaining respect and obedience through one's own good character and actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都以德服人，所以大家都好尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ji5 dak1 fuk6 jan4, so2 ji5 daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是以德服人，所以大家都非常尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: He always convinces people with virtue, so everyone respects him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做領袖唔應該淨係靠權力，而係要以德服人先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ling5 deoi2 m4 jing1 goi1 zing6 hai6 kaau3 kyun4 lik6, ji4 hai6 jiu3 ji5 dak1 fuk6 jan4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做领导不应该只靠权力，而是要以德服人才行。
examples.english_sentence: A leader shouldn't rely solely on power; they need to convince people with virtue.

english_meaning: to put oneself in someone else's shoes, to be empathetic
explanation_mandarin: 设身处地地为别人着想，理解别人的感受。
explanation_english: To consider things from another person's perspective; to have empathy and understanding for others' feelings and situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人應該以心為心，咁先可以建立良好嘅人際關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jing1 goi1 ji5 sam1 wai4 sam1, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin3 lap6 loeng4 hou2 ge3 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人应该将心比心，这样才能建立良好的人际关系。
examples.english_sentence: One should put oneself in other's shoes; only then can one build good interpersonal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢可以以心為心，明白我嘅難處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 ji5 sam1 wai4 sam1, ming4 baak6 ngo5 ge3 naan4 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他/她能将心比心，明白我的难处。
examples.english_sentence: I hope he/she can put themselves in my shoes and understand my difficulties.

english_meaning: To put oneself in another's shoes; to be empathetic; to consider things from another's perspective
explanation_mandarin: 把别人的心当作自己的心；设身处地为别人着想。
explanation_english: To take other people's feelings as your own; to put yourself in their position and think from their perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以心為心咁諗下，佢都唔係想咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 sam1 wai4 sam1 gam2 lam2 haa5, keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 soeng2 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你设身处地地想想，他也不是想这样的。
examples.english_sentence: If you put yourself in his shoes, he didn't want it to be like this either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要以心爲心，先可以得到人哋嘅尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 ji5 sam1 wai4 sam1, sin1 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 jan4 dei6 ge3 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要设身处地，才可以得到别人的尊重。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be empathetic when working, only then can you gain others' respect.

english_meaning: to repay kindness with malice; to bite the hand that feeds you
explanation_mandarin: 用怨恨来报答别人的恩德。指忘恩负义，恩将仇报。
explanation_english: To repay kindness with hatred or malice; an act of ingratitude where one responds to help with harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫咗佢咁多，佢竟然以怨報德，真係冇良心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 zo2 keoi5 gam3 do1, keoi5 ging2 jin4 ji5 jyun3 bou3 dak1, zan1 hai6 mou5 loeng4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮了他这么多，他竟然以怨报德，真是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: You helped him so much, and he actually repaid your kindness with malice. He really has no conscience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人收留咗佢，點知佢偷咗佢哋啲錢走佬，真係以怨報德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 sau1 lau4 zo2 keoi5, dim2 zi1 keoi5 tau1 zo2 keoi5 dei6 dik1 cin2 zau2 lou2, zan1 hai6 ji5 jyun3 bou3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人收留了他，没想到他偷了他们的钱跑了，真是以怨报德。
examples.english_sentence: The family took him in, but he stole their money and ran away. It's truly repaying kindness with malice.

mandarin_meaning: 以暴制暴, 以暴易暴
english_meaning: To replace violence with violence; fighting violence with violence; like for like violence.
explanation_mandarin: 用暴力来代替暴力，指用同样残暴的手段去对待残暴的行为。
explanation_english: To use violence to suppress violence; to respond to violence with more violence, often perpetuating a cycle of aggression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只會以暴易暴，解決唔到問題㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zi2 wui5 ji5 bou6 jik6 bou6, gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做只会以暴易暴，解决不了问题的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this will only replace violence with violence; it won't solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔應該以暴易暴，應該用法律去制裁暴力行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 jing1 goi1 ji5 bou6 jik6 bou6, jing1 goi1 jung6 faat3 leot6 heoi3 zai3 choi4 bou6 lik6 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不应该以暴易暴，应该用法律去制裁暴力行为。
examples.english_sentence: The government should not respond to violence with violence; they should use the law to sanction violent acts.

english_meaning: to undercut someone by selling at a loss; to destroy a competitor by using one's capital to sell below cost; to engage in a price war
explanation_mandarin: 指用自己的资本来损伤别人。通常指商家为了打败竞争对手，不惜亏本销售商品，以达到排挤或击垮对方的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to using one's own capital to harm others. It usually refers to merchants who, in order to defeat competitors, are willing to sell goods at a loss in order to squeeze out or defeat the other party. It implies using a price war to eliminate competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司咁有錢，佢哋根本就係以本傷人，想逼死其他細公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam3 jau5 cin2, keoi5 dei6 gun2 bun2 zau6 hai6 ji5 bun2 soeng1 jan4, soeng2 bik1 sei2 kei4 taa1 sai3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司那么有钱，他们根本就是在不惜血本伤人，想逼死其他小公司。
examples.english_sentence: That company is so rich, they are basically undercutting everyone, trying to force other small companies to go bankrupt.

english_meaning: to overcome the unyielding with the yielding; to conquer the strong with the weak; yielding overcomes firmness
explanation_mandarin: 用柔软的方式战胜刚强的力量。意思是柔能克刚，以退为进。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to overcome hardness with softness; to use yielding methods to conquer strength. It emphasizes that sometimes, being flexible and adaptable is more effective than being forceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對啲咁惡嘅客人，都要以柔克剛先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 di1 gam3 ok3 ge3 haak3 yan4, dou1 jiu3 ji5 jau4 hak1 gong1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么凶的客人，也要以柔克刚才行。
examples.english_sentence: Facing such aggressive customers, you have to use a soft approach to win them over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都硬碰硬，唔識得以柔克剛，所以成日搞到自己好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 ngaang6 pung3 ngaang6, m4 sik1 dak1 ji5 jau4 hak1 gong1, so2 ji5 sing4 jat6 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是硬碰硬，不懂得以柔克刚，所以总是搞得自己很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He always confronts head-on, doesn't know how to use the principle of overcoming the unyielding with the yielding, so he always makes things difficult for himself.

english_meaning: To overcome the unyielding with the yielding; to conquer strength through gentleness.
explanation_mandarin: 用柔软的方法来制服刚强的一方。
explanation_english: To defeat a strong and aggressive opponent or situation by using a gentle, flexible, or yielding approach rather than direct confrontation. It emphasizes the power of adaptability and indirect methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對啲蠻不講理嘅人，有時以柔制剛仲有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 di1 maan4 bat1 gong2 lei5 ge3 jan4, jau5 si4 ji5 jau4 zai3 gong1 zung6 jau5 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对那些蛮不讲理的人，有时候以柔克刚更有效。
examples.english_sentence: When facing unreasonable people, sometimes it's more effective to overcome strength with gentleness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判嘅時候，佢用咗以柔制剛嘅策略，最終達成咗協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 pun3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 yung6 zo2 ji5 jau4 zai3 gong1 ge3 chaak3 leuk6, zeoi3 chung1 daat6 sing4 zo2 hip3 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在谈判的时候，他用了以柔克刚的策略，最终达成了协议。
examples.english_sentence: During the negotiation, he used the strategy of overcoming strength with gentleness, and ultimately reached an agreement.

english_meaning: to abuse power for personal gain; to use one's authority for personal benefit
explanation_mandarin: 利用职权来谋取私人的利益。
explanation_english: To exploit one's power or authority for personal gain; to engage in corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅經理以權謀私，成日拎公司嘅資源去自己用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 ging1 lei5 ji5 kyun4 mau4 si1, sing4 jat6 ling1 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 zi6 gei2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的经理以权谋私，总是拿公司的资源自己用。
examples.english_sentence: The manager of their company abuses his power for personal gain, always taking company resources for his own use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污嘅官員以權謀私，最終一定會受到法律嘅制裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 ge3 gun1 jyun4 ji5 kyun4 mau4 si1, zeoi3 zung1 jat1 ding6 wui5 sau6 dou3 faat3 leot6 ge3 zai3 caai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污的官员以权谋私，最终一定会受到法律的制裁。
examples.english_sentence: Corrupt officials who abuse their power for personal gain will eventually be punished by law.

english_meaning: and so on; and so forth; by analogy; by parity of reasoning
explanation_mandarin: 依照这个规律，可以推论到其他类似的情况。
explanation_english: Following this pattern or rule, similar conclusions can be drawn for other related situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭三個月嘅銷售額好好，希望之後都可以以此類推啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 saam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 siu1 sau3 ngaak2 hou2 hou2, hei1 mong6 zi1 hau6 dou1 ho2 ji5 ji2 ci2 leoi6 teoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前三个月的销售额很好，希望之后都可以以此类推。
examples.english_sentence: The sales figures for the first three months were very good. Hopefully, the same pattern will continue afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你買夠一百蚊嘢就有九折，買夠兩百蚊嘢就有八折，以此類推。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 maai5 gau3 jat1 baak3 man1 je5 zau6 jau5 gau2 dit3, maai5 gau3 loeng5 baak3 man1 je5 zau6 jau5 baat3 dit3, ji5 ci2 leoi6 teoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你买够一百元的东西就有九折，买够两百元的东西就有八折，以此类推。
examples.english_sentence: If you buy $100 worth of items, you get a 10% discount; if you buy $200 worth of items, you get a 20% discount, and so on.

english_meaning: to die to prove one's integrity/determination
explanation_mandarin: 指用死亡来表明自己的志向或决心，通常含有为了维护某种信念或原则而牺牲生命的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to using death to demonstrate one's will or determination. It usually implies sacrificing one's life to uphold a certain belief or principle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗證明自己嘅清白，竟然選擇以死明志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zing3 ming4 zi6 ge3 cing1 baak6, ging2 jin4 syun2 zaak6 ji5 si2 ming4 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了证明自己的清白，他竟然选择以死明志。
examples.english_sentence: In order to prove his innocence, he actually chose to die to prove his integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己冇辦法完成任務，於是想以死明志，表示佢嘅責任感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 mou5 baan6 faat3 waan4 sing4 jam6 mou6, yu1 si6 soeng2 ji5 si2 ming4 zi3, biu2 si6 keoi5 ge3 zaak3 jam6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己没有办法完成任务，于是想以死明志，表示他的责任感。
examples.english_sentence: He felt that he couldn't complete the task, so he wanted to die to prove his determination, showing his sense of responsibility.

english_meaning: fight poison with poison; cure evil with evil; fight fire with fire
explanation_mandarin: 指用含有毒性的药物来治疗毒疮、毒症；也比喻用恶劣的手段对付恶劣的手段。
explanation_english: Literally, 'use poison to attack poison.' It refers to using poisonous substances to treat poisonous sores or diseases. Figuratively, it means to fight evil with evil or to counter a negative situation with equally drastic measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，可能要以毒攻毒先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 ji5 duk6 gung1 duk6 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，可能要以毒攻毒才行了。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we might have to fight fire with fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係已經差到咁，你想用其他方法修補都好難，或者以毒攻毒會有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ji5 ging1 caa1 dou3 gam3, nei5 soeng2 yung6 kei4 taa1 fong1 faat3 sau1 bou2 dou1 hou2 naan4, waak6 ze2 ji5 duk6 gung1 duk6 wui5 jau5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的关系已经很差了，你想用其他方法修复也很难，或许以毒攻毒会有用。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is already so bad that it's hard to repair using other methods. Maybe fighting fire with fire will work.

english_meaning: to think (wrongly); to assume; to consider (that)
explanation_mandarin: 认为，觉得，通常表示错误的判断或假设。
explanation_english: To think or believe (often mistakenly); to assume; to consider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為你聽日會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 nei5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为你明天会来。
examples.english_sentence: I thought you would come tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好叻，其實乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, kei4 sat6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很厉害，其实什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's very capable, but actually he doesn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為你已經走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 nei5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为你已经走了。
examples.english_sentence: I thought you had already left.

english_meaning: to think (wrongly); to assume; to consider; to believe
explanation_mandarin: 认为，觉得，但实际上并非如此。
explanation_english: To think, assume, or consider something to be the case, but often implying that the thought or assumption is incorrect or naive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以爲佢會嚟，點知佢冇到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 wui5 lai4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 mou5 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他会来，结果他没到。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he would come, but it turned out he didn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以爲我唔知你做過啲咩嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 zou6 gwo3 di1 me1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为我不知道你做过什么。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I don't know what you've done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以爲好容易啫，點知咁難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 hou2 yung4 yi6 ze1, dim2 zi1 gam3 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为很容易而已，结果这么难弄。
examples.english_sentence: I thought it would be easy, but it turned out to be so difficult.

english_meaning: to think; to believe; to consider; to assume (wrongly)
explanation_mandarin: 认为，觉得。通常表示错误的判断或假设。
explanation_english: To think, believe, or consider. Usually implies a mistaken judgement or assumption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以爲佢聽日會嚟，點知佢冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他明天会来，结果他没来。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he would come tomorrow, but he didn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以爲呢件事好容易搞掂，點知咁複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 jung4 ji6 gaau2 dim6, dim2 zi1 gam3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这件事很容易解决，结果这么复杂。
examples.english_sentence: I thought this matter would be easy to resolve, but it turned out to be so complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以爲讀完大學就乜都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 duk6 jyun4 daai6 hok6 zau6 mat1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为读完大学就什么都懂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume that you know everything after graduating from university.

english_meaning: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth; Tit for tat.
explanation_mandarin: 用对方施加的手段回敬对方。比喻以同样的手段报复。
explanation_english: To retaliate in kind; to get even by inflicting similar harm. It means to repay an injury or insult with a similar one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣搞串個Party，我一定要以牙還牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gaau2 cyun3 go3 Paa1 ti1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样搅乱派对，我一定要以牙还牙。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up the party like that, I definitely have to retaliate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你蝦我先，我咪以牙還牙囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa1 ngo5 sin1, ngo5 mai1 ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先欺负我，所以我才以牙还牙啊。
examples.english_sentence: You bullied me first, so I'm just retaliating.

english_meaning: bartering, to exchange goods for goods
explanation_mandarin: 用自己的物品交换别人的物品，不涉及金钱交易。
explanation_english: To exchange goods directly for other goods without using money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日以物易物，例如用米換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 ji5 mat6 jik6 mat6, lai6 jyu4 yung6 mai5 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人经常以物换物，例如用米换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people often bartered, for example, exchanging rice for clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以物易物，用佢個舊手機換咗部單車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 mat6 jik6 mat6, yung6 keoi5 go3 gau6 sau2 gei1 wun6 zo2 bou6 daan1 che1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以物换物，用他的旧手机换了一辆自行车。
examples.english_sentence: They bartered, exchanging his old phone for a bicycle.

english_meaning: to convince people with reason; to persuade through reasoning
explanation_mandarin: 用道理使人信服。
explanation_english: To convince or persuade someone by using reason and logic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁惡死啦，試下以理服人吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 sei2 laa1, si3 haa5 ji5 lei5 fuk6 jan4 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么凶，试着用道理说服别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so aggressive. Try to convince people with reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得喺討論嘅時候，以理服人好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hai2 tou2 leon6 ge3 si4 hau6, ji5 lei5 fuk6 jan4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得在讨论的时候，以理服人很重要。
examples.english_sentence: I think it's very important to convince people with reason in a discussion.

english_meaning: in order to show; to demonstrate; to indicate; as a sign of
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种行为或行动是为了表达某种意图或态度。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain action or behavior is carried out to express a particular intention or attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋開個派對以示慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 go3 paai1 deoi2 ji5 si6 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们开个派对以示庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: We're having a party to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗份禮物畀我，以示感謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 ngo5, ji5 si6 gam2 ze6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了我一份礼物，以示感谢。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a gift to show his gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要準時交功課，以示對老師嘅尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, ji5 si6 deoi3 lou5 si1 ge3 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要准时交作业，以示对老师的尊重。
examples.english_sentence: We need to submit our homework on time to show respect for the teacher.

english_meaning: for safety's sake; to ensure safety; as a safety precaution
explanation_mandarin: 为了确保安全，采取某种行动或措施。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that a certain action or measure is taken to ensure safety and avoid potential risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以策安全，我哋應該戴返個頭盔先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 caak3 on1 cyun4, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 daai3 faan1 go3 tau4 kwai1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了安全起见，我们应该先把头盔戴上。
examples.english_sentence: For safety's sake, we should put on our helmets first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行夜路嘅時候，以策安全，最好帶埋支電筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 je6 lou6 ge3 si4 hau6, ji5 caak3 on1 cyun4, zeoi3 hou2 daai3 maai4 zi1 din6筒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走夜路的时候，为了安全起见，最好带上手电筒。
examples.english_sentence: When walking at night, it's best to bring a flashlight for safety's sake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以策安全，你都係攞返張副本backup定先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 caak3 on1 cyun4, nei5 dou1 hai6 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 fu3 bun2 backup ding6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了安全起见，你还是先拿一份副本备份一下。
examples.english_sentence: To ensure safety, you should make a backup copy first.

english_meaning: to the extent that; down to; up to and including; so much so that
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、范围的扩大或延伸，通常表示递进关系，有时也表示结果。
explanation_english: Expresses an extension or increase in degree or scope, usually indicating a progressive relationship; sometimes it also expresses a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，以至俾老細炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, ji5 zi3 bei2 lou5 sai3 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不做事，以至于被老板炒鱿鱼了。
examples.english_sentence: He never does any work, to the extent that he got fired by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日溫書溫到好夜，以至第二日上堂都冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 hou2 je6, ji5 zi3 dai6 ji6 jat6 soeng5 tong4 dou1 mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天复习功课到很晚，以至于第二天上课都没精神。
examples.english_sentence: He studies until very late every day, to the extent that he has no energy in class the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食又貴又唔好食，以至冇乜人幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6, ji5 zi3 mou5 mat1 jan4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西又贵又不好吃，以至于没什么人光顾。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is expensive and not tasty, so much so that not many people patronize it.

english_meaning: to the point of; to such an extent that; even to; so that
explanation_mandarin: 表示达到某种程度或结果。相当于“以致于”、“甚至”。
explanation_english: Indicates reaching a certain degree or result. Equivalent to "to the point of", "even to", or "so that".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太過努力工作，以至於病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 gwo3 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3, ji5 zhi3 jyu1 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太过努力工作，以至于生病了。
examples.english_sentence: He worked too hard, to the point that he got sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人排隊排到以至於塞住咗成條街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 paai4 dou3 ji5 zhi3 jyu1 sak1 zyu6 zo2 sing4 tiu4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们排队排到以至于堵塞了整条街。
examples.english_sentence: People lined up to the point that the whole street was blocked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事唔上心，以至於搞砸咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 m4 soeng5 sam1, ji5 zhi3 jyu1 gaau2 zaap3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事不上心，以至于搞砸了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't care about this matter, to the extent that he messed it up.

english_meaning: resulting in; leading to; so that; with the result that; consequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示由于前边的原因而造成了后边的结果。跟普通话意思基本相同。
explanation_english: Indicates that the preceding cause has resulted in the following consequence. The meaning is essentially the same as in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做功課，以致考試唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, ji5 zi3 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不做作业，以致考试不及格。
examples.english_sentence: He never does his homework, resulting in failing the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太過勞累，以致病倒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 gwo3 lou4 leoi5, ji5 zi3 beng6 dou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太劳累了，以致病倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He overworked himself, resulting in him getting sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落太大雨，以致好多地方都水浸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 taai3 daai6 jyu5, ji5 zi3 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 seoi2 zam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了很大的雨，以致很多地方都淹水了。
examples.english_sentence: It rained so heavily, resulting in many places being flooded.

english_meaning: Israel
explanation_mandarin: 西亚国家，位于地中海东岸。
explanation_english: A country in Western Asia, located on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以色列同巴勒斯坦嘅衝突持續咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 sik1 lit6 tung4 baa1 lak6 si1 taan2 ge3 cung1 fat1 ci4 zuk6 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以色列和巴勒斯坦的冲突持续了很久。
examples.english_sentence: The conflict between Israel and Palestine has been going on for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗以色列旅行，仲影咗好多相返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ji4 sik1 lit6 leoi5 hang4, zung6 ying2 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng2 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了以色列旅行，还拍了很多照片回来。
examples.english_sentence: He went to Israel for travelling and took many pictures back.

english_meaning: to punish someone for their speech; to persecute someone for what they say
explanation_mandarin: 指因为说了某些话而被定罪处罚。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of being convicted and punished because of something that was said. It often implies unfair or unjust persecution for expressing opinions or beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會，我哋好驚以言入罪，所以講嘢都好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2, ngo5 dei6 hou2 geng1 ji5 jin4 jap6 zeoi6, so2 ji5 gong2 je5 dou1 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会，我们很害怕因言获罪，所以说话都很小心。
examples.english_sentence: In this society, we are very afraid of being punished for our speech, so we are very careful about what we say.

english_meaning: to spread misinformation; to spread rumors; to propagate errors
explanation_mandarin: 指把本来就不正确的话又错误地传出去，越传越错。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the situation where incorrect information is passed on and distorted as it spreads, leading to greater inaccuracies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲謠言就係噉樣以訛傳訛，越傳越離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jiu4 jin4 zau6 hai6 gam2 joeng2 ji5 ngo4 cyun4 ngo4, yut6 cyun4 yut6 lei4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些谣言就是这样以讹传讹，越传越离谱。
examples.english_sentence: That's how these rumors spread misinformation, becoming more and more outrageous as they go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好聽人哋以訛傳訛，自己查清楚先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ting1 jan4 dei6 ji5 ngo4 cyun4 ngo4, zi6 gei2 caa4 cing1 chu2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要听别人以讹传讹，自己查清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to people spreading misinformation; investigate it yourself first.

english_meaning: to judge people by their appearance; judging a book by its cover
explanation_mandarin: 根据外貌来判断人的品质或才能。指以外表来衡量人的价值。
explanation_english: To judge people based solely on their appearance. It implies that someone is being evaluated superficially without considering their character, skills, or other qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁以貌取人啦，佢雖然睇落唔起眼，但係其實好有才華㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji5 maau6 ceoi2 jan4 laa1, keoi5 seoi1 jin4 tai2 lok6 m4 hei2 ngaan5, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 hou2 jau5 choi4 waa4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么以貌取人，他虽然看起来不起眼，但其实很有才华的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge a book by its cover. Although he may not look impressive, he's actually very talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅招聘經理成日以貌取人，所以請親都係啲得個樣嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 chiu1 ping3 ging1 lei5 sing4 jat6 ji5 maau6 ceoi2 jan4, so2 ji5 cheng2 chan1 dou1 hai6 di1 dak1 go3 joeng2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的招聘经理总是以貌取人，所以请来的都是些只有外貌的人。
examples.english_sentence: The recruitment manager of this company always judges people by their appearance, so he always hires people who are only good-looking.

english_meaning: in order to; so as to; so that; thereby; for the purpose of
explanation_mandarin: 表示目的或手段，相当于“以便”、“用以”、“藉以”。多用于书面语。
explanation_english: A conjunction used to indicate purpose or means, similar to "in order to," "so as to," or "thereby." Mostly used in formal written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力學習，以資將來可以為社會作出貢獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 hok6 zaap6, ji5 zi1 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 wai4 se5 wui2 zok3 ceot1 gung3 hi献.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力学习，以便将来可以为社会做出贡献。
examples.english_sentence: We must study hard so that we can contribute to society in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我捐咗啲錢，以資支持佢哋嘅教育事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gyun1 zo2 di1 cin2, ji5 zi1 zi1 ci4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gaau3 juk6 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我捐了一些钱，用以支持他们的教育事业。
examples.english_sentence: I donated some money to support their educational undertaking.

english_meaning: to lead by example, to set an example by one's own conduct
explanation_mandarin: 指用自己的行为做出榜样。
explanation_english: To lead by example, meaning to demonstrate the behavior you expect from others through your own actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日叫我哋OT，但係佢自己就準時收工，咁點以身作則啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 OT, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zau6 zeon2 si4 sau1 gung1, gam2 dim2 ji5 san1 zok3 zak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是叫我们加班，但是他自己就准时下班，这怎么能以身作则呢？
examples.english_sentence: The boss always tells us to work overtime, but he himself leaves on time. How can he lead by example?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師應該以身作則，唔好上堂玩手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jing1 goi1 ji5 san1 zok3 zak1, m4 hou2 soeng5 tong4 waan2 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师应该以身作则，不要上课玩手机。
examples.english_sentence: Teachers should lead by example and not play on their phones during class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為父母，我哋要以身作則，教導仔女正確嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 fu6 mou5, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji5 san1 zok3 zak1, gaau3 dou6 zai2 neoi5 zing3 kok3 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为父母，我们要以身作则，教导子女正确的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: As parents, we must lead by example and teach our children the correct values.

english_meaning: to risk one's life; to put oneself in harm's way
explanation_mandarin: 指亲自冒着危险。
explanation_english: To personally risk danger; to deliberately put oneself in a dangerous situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁衝動以身犯險啦，搵其他人幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6 ji5 san1 faan6 him2 laa1, wan2 kei4 taa1 jan4 bang1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么冲动以身试险，找其他人帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive and put yourself in harm's way, ask someone else for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗救人，唔理自己嘅安危，以身犯險，真係好勇敢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gau3 jan4, m4 lei5 zi6 gei2 ge3 on1 ngai4, ji5 san1 faan6 him2, zan1 hai6 hou2 jung5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了救人，他不顾自己的安危，以身试险，真是很勇敢。
examples.english_sentence: In order to save people, he disregarded his own safety and put himself in harm's way, he's really brave.

english_meaning: To offer oneself in marriage as a way of showing gratitude or appreciation; to pledge oneself to someone
explanation_mandarin: 古代女子报答恩情的常见说法，表示愿意嫁给对方。
explanation_english: A traditional expression used primarily by women in ancient times to express deep gratitude by offering themselves in marriage to the person they wish to repay. It implies a deep sense of indebtedness and a willingness to dedicate oneself to the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢救咗我條命，我諗住以身相許報答佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 zo2 ngo5 tiu4 ming6, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ji5 san1 soeng1 heoi2 bou3 daap3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他救了我的命，我想以身相许报答他。
examples.english_sentence: He saved my life, I'm thinking of offering myself in marriage to repay him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年輕人好少講以身相許呢啲咁老土嘅嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 hou2 siu2 gong2 ji5 san1 soeng1 heoi2 ni1 di1 gam3 lou5 tou2 ge3 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人很少说以身相许这种老套的话了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people rarely say such old-fashioned things like 'offering oneself in marriage'.

english_meaning: to test the law by violating it; to deliberately break the law; to risk punishment
explanation_mandarin: 指明知法律禁止，却故意违反，冒险触犯法律。
explanation_english: To deliberately break the law, knowing the consequences; to test the law by violating it, and risking punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以身試法呀，做犯法嘢係要坐監㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 san1 si3 faat3 aa3, zou6 faan6 faat3 je5 hai6 jiu3 co5 gaam1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以身试法，做违法的事情是要坐牢的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't break the law! Committing illegal acts means going to jail!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人貪小便宜，以身試法偷嘢，真係唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 taam1 siu2 bin6 ji4, ji5 san1 si3 faat3 tau1 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人贪图小便宜，以身试法偷东西，真是不值得。
examples.english_sentence: Some people are greedy and risk breaking the law to steal things, it's really not worth it.

english_meaning: to retreat in order to advance; to bide one's time; to yield in order to gain
explanation_mandarin: 采取退让的策略，实际上是为了更有利地前进。表面上是退却，实则是为了下一步更好的发展。
explanation_english: A strategy of retreating or yielding initially in order to gain a more advantageous position or outcome later on. It implies a tactical retreat for future advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次唔同佢爭，都係以退為進啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 m4 tung4 keoi5 zaang1, dou1 hai6 ji5 teoi3 wai4 zeon3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次不和他争，都是以退为进而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's not competing with him this time, it's just a tactic of retreating to advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時以退為進，反而會有意想不到嘅收穫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 ji5 teoi3 wai4 zeon3, faan2 ji4 wui5 jau5 ji3 seung2 bat1 dou3 ge3 sau1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候以退为进，反而会有意想不到的收获。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes retreating to advance can unexpectedly lead to gains.

english_meaning: To retreat in order to advance; to give ground to gain ground; strategic retreat
explanation_mandarin: 采取退让的姿态，以便更好地前进。指一种策略或手段，表面上是退让，实际上是为了最终达到目的。
explanation_english: A strategy of retreating temporarily to gain an advantage later. It implies a tactical withdrawal with the ultimate goal of advancing or succeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次肯讓步，可能係以退爲進啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 hang2 joeng6 bou6, ho2 nang4 hai6 ji5 teoi3 wai4 zeon3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次肯让步，可能是以退为进。
examples.english_sentence: He is willing to compromise this time, perhaps it's a strategic retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判嘅時候，有時都要識得以退爲進嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 pun3 ge3 si4 hau6, jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 sik1 dak1 ji5 teoi3 wai4 zeon3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在谈判的时候，有时候也要懂得采用以退为进的策略。
examples.english_sentence: In negotiations, you sometimes need to know how to employ a strategic retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明唔係真係放棄，佢只係以退爲進，想揾個更好嘅機會咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 fong3 hei3, keoi5 zi2 hai6 ji5 teoi3 wai4 zeon3, soeng2 wan2 go3 gang3 hou2 ge3 gei1 wui2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明不是真的放弃，他只是以退为进，想找个更好的机会而已。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming didn't really give up, he is just taking a strategic retreat, wanting to find a better opportunity.

english_meaning: to await the fatigued at one's ease; to conserve one's strength and await the exhaustion of the enemy; to wait at one's ease for a laboring opponent
explanation_mandarin: 指作战时做好充分准备，养精蓄锐，等疲惫的敌人来犯时才迎击。
explanation_english: To wait in a prepared and rested state for an opponent who is tired or unprepared; to conserve energy and await an opportune moment to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以逸待勞，喺度等佢哋嚟就啱㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 jat6 doi6 lou4, hai2 dou6 dang2 keoi5 dei6 lai4 zau6 ngaam1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以逸待劳，在这里等他们来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: We'll wait in a state of readiness here for them to come, that's the right thing to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想用持久戰拖垮我哋，但係我哋可以以逸待勞，唔使咁快出手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 yung6 chi4 gau2 zin3 to1 kwaa2 ngo5 dei6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ji5 jat6 doi6 lou4, m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 chut1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想用持久战拖垮我们，但是我们可以以逸待劳，不用这么快出手。
examples.english_sentence: They want to wear us down with a war of attrition, but we can conserve our strength and await their exhaustion, no need to rush into action.

english_meaning: just in case; to be on the safe side; for contingency
explanation_mandarin: 为了预防可能发生的意外情况。
explanation_english: Used to express the idea of taking precautions or preparing for a potential contingency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 帶遮以防萬一下雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 ze1 ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1 haa6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 带伞以防万一下雨。
examples.english_sentence: Take an umbrella just in case it rains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買定啲藥，以防萬一病咗有得食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ding6 di1 joek6, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1 beng6 zo2 jau5 dak1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买一些药，以防万一生病了可以吃。
examples.english_sentence: Buy some medicine, just in case you get sick and have something to take.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 帶多張信用卡以防萬一唔夠錢使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 do1 zoeng1 seon3 jyun4 kaat1 ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1 m4 gau3 cin2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多带一张信用卡以防万一钱不够用。
examples.english_sentence: Bring an extra credit card just in case you don't have enough money.

mandarin_meaning: 以马内利 (神与我们同在)
english_meaning: Emmanuel (God with us)
explanation_mandarin: 源自希伯来语，意为“神与我们同在”。在基督教中，常用来指耶稣。
explanation_english: From Hebrew, meaning "God with us." In Christianity, it is often used to refer to Jesus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節嘅時候，我哋會唱以馬內利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 coeng3 ji5 maa5 noi6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞节的时候，我们会唱以马内利。
examples.english_sentence: During Christmas, we sing Emmanuel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係以馬內利教會嘅信徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ji5 maa5 noi6 lei6 gaau3 wui2 ge3 seon3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是以马内利教会的信徒。
examples.english_sentence: He is a believer of Emmanuel Church.

english_meaning: three (of something/someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指三个。比“三个”更口语化。
explanation_english: Refers to 'three'. More colloquial than simply saying 'three'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仨一齊去睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们仨一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's three go to the movies together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得返佢哋仨喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 faan1 keoi5 dei6 saa1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只剩下他们三个在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Only the three of them are left here.

english_meaning: plural marker (used after personal pronouns or nouns referring to people)
explanation_mandarin: 表示复数，用在人称代词或指人的名词后面。
explanation_english: A plural marker used after personal pronouns or nouns referring to people to indicate plurality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋们都好锺意食点心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mun1 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都很喜欢吃点心。
examples.english_sentence: We all love eating dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋们去咗旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mun1 heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: They went travelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友们好乖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 peng4 jau5 mun1 hou2 gwaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们很乖。
examples.english_sentence: The children are well-behaved.

english_meaning: to admire; to rely on; to look up to; to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬佩服；依靠，依赖。
explanation_english: To respect and admire; to rely on, to depend on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好仰慕你嘅才華呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 joeng5 mou6 nei5 ge3 coi4 waa4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常仰慕你的才华啊。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire your talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人靠晒佢養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 kaau3 saai3 keoi5 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人都靠他养活。
examples.english_sentence: His whole family depends on him.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on, to count on
explanation_mandarin: 依赖，依靠别人或某种力量。
explanation_english: To rely on or depend on someone or something for support or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次可以順利完成任務，真係仰仗你嘅幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 waan4 sing4 jam6 mou6, zan1 hai6 joeng5 zoeng6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这次能够顺利完成任务，真是仰仗你的帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We were able to complete the task successfully this time, thanks to your help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職都係仰仗佢阿爸嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 dou1 hai6 joeng5 zoeng6 keoi5 aa3 baa1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职都是仰仗他爸爸的关系。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted by relying on his father's connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仰仗科學嘅進步嚟改善生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joeng5 zoeng6 fo1 hok6 ge3 zeon3 bou6 lai4 gaai2 sin6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们仰仗科学的进步来改善生活。
examples.english_sentence: We rely on the progress of science to improve our lives.

english_meaning: to lie on one's back, supine
explanation_mandarin: 身体向上的平卧姿势。
explanation_english: To lie flat on one's back; the supine position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫佢仰臥喺床上檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 keoi5 joeng5 ngo6 hai2 chong4 soeng6 gim2 cha4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫他仰卧在床上检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor asked him to lie on his back on the bed for examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意仰臥睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 joeng5 ngo6 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢仰卧着看电视。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to lie on his back and watch TV.

english_meaning: sit-up
explanation_mandarin: 一种健身运动，平躺在地上，屈膝，然后利用腹部肌肉的力量将身体抬起。
explanation_english: A physical exercise designed to strengthen the abdominal muscles, in which a person lies on their back with knees bent, and raises the torso.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都做三十個仰卧起坐練腹肌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 zou6 saam1 sap6 go3 joeng5 ngo6 hei2 co5 lin6 fuk1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都做三十个仰卧起坐练腹肌。
examples.english_sentence: I do thirty sit-ups every day to train my abdominal muscles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完仰卧起坐之後，覺得條腰好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 joeng5 ngo6 hei2 co5 zi1 hau6, gok3 dak1 tiu4 jiu1 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做完仰卧起坐之后，觉得腰很痛。
examples.english_sentence: After he finished doing sit-ups, he felt a pain in his lower back.

english_meaning: to admire; to look up to
explanation_mandarin: 敬仰羡慕。
explanation_english: To admire and respect someone deeply; to look up to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直都好仰慕佢嘅才華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 joeng5 mou6 keoi5 ge3 coi4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直都很仰慕他的才华。
examples.english_sentence: I have always admired his talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都好仰慕佢，因為佢好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 joeng5 mou6 keoi5, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都很仰慕他，因为他很成功。
examples.english_sentence: Many people admire him because he is very successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅老師非常仰慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 lou5 si1 fei1 soeng4 joeng5 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的老师非常仰慕。
examples.english_sentence: He greatly admires his teacher.

english_meaning: to look up (at), to admire, to look up to
explanation_mandarin: 抬头向上看；敬仰，敬佩。
explanation_english: To look upwards (literally); to admire and respect someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好仰望佢阿爸，覺得佢阿爸好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 joeng5 mong6 keoi5 aa3 baa4, gok3 dak1 keoi5 aa3 baa4 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很仰慕他爸爸，觉得他爸爸很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He really admires his father, and thinks his father is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仰望住天上嘅星星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joeng5 mong6 zyu6 tin1 soeng6 ge3 sing1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们仰望着天上的星星。
examples.english_sentence: We are looking up at the stars in the sky.

english_meaning: lie on one's back; supine position
explanation_mandarin: 身体向后平躺，面朝上的姿势；也指仰卧的动作。
explanation_english: The posture of lying flat on one's back, facing upward; also refers to the act of lying supine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意仰臥喺梳化度睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 joeng5 ngo6 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢仰卧在沙发上看电视。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to lie on his back on the sofa and watch TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我每日做啲仰臥起坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 di1 joeng5 ngo6 hei2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我每天做些仰卧起坐。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to do some sit-ups every day.

english_meaning: sit-up
explanation_mandarin: 一种健身运动，身体仰卧，然后坐起。
explanation_english: A physical exercise in which a person lies on their back and raises their torso up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都做十個仰臥起坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 zou6 sap6 go3 joeng5 ngo6 hei2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都做十个仰卧起坐。
examples.english_sentence: I do ten sit-ups every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想練腹肌，所以成日做仰臥起坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 lin6 fuk1 gei1, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 zou6 joeng5 ngo6 hei2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想锻炼腹肌，所以经常做仰卧起坐。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to train his abs, so he often does sit-ups.

english_meaning: to commit suicide by taking poison, to poison oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指通过服用毒药来结束自己的生命。是一个比较直接的说法，略带贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to ending one's life by taking poison. It's a rather direct term, carrying a slightly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時諗唔開，竟然仰葯自殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 lam2 m4 hoi1, ging2 jin4 joeng5 joek6 zi6 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时想不开，竟然服毒自杀了。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't think straight for a moment, and actually committed suicide by poisoning himself.

english_meaning: to commit suicide by taking poison; to poison oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指通过吞服药物（通常是毒药）来结束自己的生命。
explanation_english: Refers to ending one's life by ingesting medication (usually poison).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為失戀而仰藥自殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai4 sat1 lyun2 ji4 joeng5 joek6 zi6 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为失恋而服毒自杀。
examples.english_sentence: He committed suicide by taking poison because he was heartbroken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁傻，咩事都唔好仰藥解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 so4, me1 si6 dou1 m4 hou2 joeng5 joek6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么傻，什么事都不要服毒解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, don't try to solve problems by taking poison.

english_meaning: still, yet, also, even more
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、范围或状态的继续、递进或附加。可以表示“还”、“仍然”、“更加”等意思。
explanation_english: Indicates continuation, progression, or addition of degree, scope, or state. Can mean "still", "yet", "also", "even more".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲未食飯呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 mei6 sik6 faan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还没吃饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: You haven't eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲高過我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 gou1 gwo3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他比我还要高。
examples.english_sentence: He is even taller than me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗佢，仲有邊個嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 keoi5, zung6 jau5 bin1 go3 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了他，还有谁来？
examples.english_sentence: Besides him, who else is coming?

english_meaning: Still guessing; Still trying to guess
explanation_mandarin: 表示还在猜测，没有确定答案或结果。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is still guessing and doesn't have a definite answer or result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲估緊佢幾時會嚟啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 gu2 gan2 keoi5 gei2 si4 wui5 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还在猜他什么时候会来啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you still guessing when he will come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好仲估啦，直接問佢咪知囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zung6 gu2 laa1, zik6 zip3 man6 keoi5 mai1 zi1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再猜了，直接问他不是就知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop guessing, just ask him and you'll know.

english_meaning: Is there even a need to ask?
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情显而易见，不需要再问。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is so obvious that there is no need to ask the question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，仲使問你生日會唔會嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 nei5, zung6 sai2 man6 nei5 sang1 jat6 wui2 m4 wui5 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么疼你，还用问你生日会会不会来吗？
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much, is there even a need to ask if he'll come to your birthday party?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁忙，仲使問你今晚有冇時間食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 mong4, zung6 sai2 man6 nei5 gam1 maan1 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么忙，还用问你今晚有没有时间吃饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're so busy, is there even a need to ask if you have time for dinner tonight?

english_meaning: still, yet
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况仍然持续，没有改变。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation is still ongoing or has not changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲係好肚餓呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 hai6 hou2 tou5 ngo6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还是好饿呀！
examples.english_sentence: I'm still very hungry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲係唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 hai6 m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还是不肯认错。
examples.english_sentence: He still refuses to admit his mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲係度做緊嘢呀？咁辛苦嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 hai6 dou6 zou6 gan2 je5 aa3? gam3 san1 fu2 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还在工作啊？真辛苦！
examples.english_sentence: Are you still working? That's hard work!

english_meaning: moreover; besides; in addition to; let alone
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系，进一步强调。比“还”更强烈的语气，表示“更何况”，“而且”，“再加上”的意思。
explanation_english: Expresses a progressive relationship, further emphasizing something. It's a stronger expression than "haai4" (還), meaning "moreover", "besides", "in addition to", or "let alone". Implies that if one thing is true, something else is even more so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格，仲兼俾阿媽鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gaak3, zung6 gim1 bei2 aa3 maa1 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试没及格，而且还被妈妈骂了。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and, moreover, got scolded by his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨，仲兼咁大風，真係唔想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, zung6 gim1 gam3 daai6 fung1, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨，而且风这么大，真的不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, and it's so windy on top of that. I really don't want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工人工低，仲兼要成日OT，梗係要辭職啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 dai1, zung6 gim1 jiu3 seng4 jat6 OT, gang2 hai6 jiu3 ci4 zik1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作工资低，而且还要经常加班，当然要辞职啦！
examples.english_sentence: This job has a low salary and requires overtime all the time, of course I'm going to resign!

english_meaning: Not so angry anymore / Less angry now
explanation_mandarin: 表示生气程度降低，没有之前那么生气了。仲：更，还。冇咁：没有那么。
explanation_english: Indicates a decrease in anger; not as angry as before. '仲' (zung6) means 'still' or 'even more'. '冇咁' (mou5 gam3) means 'not so' or 'not as'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我解釋咗之後，佢仲冇咁嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaai2 sik1 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zung6 mou5 gam3 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我解释之后，她就不那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: After I explained, she wasn't so angry anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買返個雪糕俾佢，佢就仲冇咁嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 faan1 go3 syut3 gou1 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 zau6 zung6 mou5 gam3 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买回一个冰淇淋给她，她就不会那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Buy her an ice cream, and she won't be so angry anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完你咁講，我仲冇咁嬲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 nei5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zung6 mou5 gam3 nau1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完你这么说，我就没那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing what you said, I'm not so angry anymore.

english_meaning: Moreover, furthermore, even more so
explanation_mandarin: 表示在已经说明的情况下，进一步强调或补充说明情况更严重或更明显。
explanation_english: Expresses further emphasis or supplements an existing statement, indicating that the situation is even more serious or obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁忙，仲加病埋，點頂得順呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 mong4, zung6 gaa1 beng6 maai4, dim2 ding2 dak1 seon6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么忙，更何况还病了，怎么受得了啊？
examples.english_sentence: He is so busy, and moreover, he's sick, how can he cope?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋咁細，仲加咁貴，真係唔抵買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gam3 sai3, zung6 gaa1 gam3 gwai3, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子这么小，更加这么贵，真是不值得买。
examples.english_sentence: The house is so small and, even more so, so expensive, it's really not worth buying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工咁辛苦，仲加人工又唔高，梗係想轉工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, zung6 gaa1 jan4 gung1 jau6 m4 gou1, gang2 hai6 soeng2 zyun2 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么辛苦，而且工资又不高，当然想换工作了。
examples.english_sentence: The job is so tough and, furthermore, the salary isn't high, of course, he wants to change jobs.

english_meaning: How dare you say that?; You still have the nerve to say that?; To actually say such a thing!
explanation_mandarin: 表示对对方说的话感到非常不满、愤怒或惊讶，通常带有一种责备的语气，隐含的意思是对方不应该说出那样的话，或者做了不应该做的事。用于表达强烈的不满或反感。
explanation_english: Expresses strong dissatisfaction, anger, or surprise at what someone has said. It usually carries a tone of reproach, implying that the person shouldn't have said such a thing, or shouldn't have done what they did. Used to express strong displeasure or repugnance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞成咁嘅樣，仲好講？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 sing4 gam2 ge3 joeng2, zung6 hou2 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你搞成这个样子，还敢说？
examples.english_sentence: You messed it up like this, how dare you say that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都遲到咗成粒鐘，你仲好講呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 ci4 dou3 zo2 sing4 lap1 zung1, nei5 zung6 hou2 gong2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都迟到了一整个小时，你还敢说？
examples.english_sentence: You're an hour late, you still have the nerve to say that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做錯嘢仲好講藉口！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 co3 je5 zung6 hou2 gong2 jik3 hau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做错了事还敢找借口！
examples.english_sentence: You dare to make excuses after doing something wrong!

english_meaning: How could that be allowed to continue? What a mess that would be! That would be terrible!
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况严重，后果不堪设想，带有夸张的语气。 通常用于反问句，表示极度否定。
explanation_english: Expresses a serious situation with potentially dire consequences. It carries an exaggerated tone. Typically used in rhetorical questions to express strong disapproval or negation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔做功課，仲得了？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, zung6 dak1 liu5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不做作业，那还得了？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't do your homework again, what a mess that would be!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣落去，仲得了㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, zung6 dak1 liu5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样下去，那还得了？
examples.english_sentence: If he continues like this, what will become of him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋知道咗真相，仲得了呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 dou3 zo2 zan1 seong2, zung6 dak1 liu5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们知道了真相，那还得了？
examples.english_sentence: If they knew the truth, what a terrible situation that would be?

english_meaning: also; still have; furthermore; in addition
explanation_mandarin: 表示除了之前提到的之外，还有其他的。
explanation_english: Indicates that in addition to what has already been mentioned, there is still something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗蘋果、橙，仲有香蕉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 ping4 gwo2, caang2, zung6 jau5 hoeng1 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了苹果、橙子，还有香蕉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought apples, oranges, and also bananas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，識講英文，仲有法文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, sik1 gong2 jing1 man2, zung6 jau5 faat3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，会说英文，还会法语。
examples.english_sentence: He is very clever, he can speak English and also French.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完功課，仲有好多嘢要搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完功课，还有很多事情要处理。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing homework, there are still many things to handle.

english_meaning: arbitration
explanation_mandarin: 争议双方在没有诉诸法院的情况下，通过第三方公正人的判断来解决争议。
explanation_english: The process of resolving a dispute or a grievance by referring it to an impartial third party (an arbitrator or panel of arbitrators) for a decision or award.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅勞資糾紛最後決定用仲裁嚟解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 yung6 zung3 cai4 lai4 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的劳资纠纷最后决定用仲裁来解决。
examples.english_sentence: The labor dispute in the company was finally decided to be resolved through arbitration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅合同入面有條款講明如果出現爭議，一定要先經過仲裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hap6 tung4 jap6 min6 jau5 tiu4 kwan2 gong2 ming4 jyu4 gwo2 ceot1 hin3 zaang1 jeoi6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 sin1 ging1 gwo3 zung3 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的合同里有条款说明如果出现争议，一定要先经过仲裁。
examples.english_sentence: There's a clause in their contract that states that if a dispute arises, it must first go through arbitration.

english_meaning: still need to; also want; furthermore; on top of that
explanation_mandarin: 表示除了已经提及的情况之外，还有额外的需求、愿望或情况。
explanation_english: Indicates an additional need, desire, or situation on top of what has already been mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經好飽，但係仲要食多舊蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hou2 baau2, daan6 hai6 zung6 jiu3 sik6 do1 gau6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经很饱了，但是还要再吃一块蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: I'm already full, but I still want to eat another piece of cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單止遲到，仲要唔認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 ci4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 m4 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅迟到，而且还不认错。
examples.english_sentence: He was not only late, but he also refused to admit his mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要返工，仲要OT，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, zung6 jiu3 OT, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上班，还要加班，真可怜。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work tomorrow, and on top of that, I have to work overtime. How miserable!

english_meaning: to separate, to part; divorce (dated)
explanation_mandarin: 分开；离开。多用于古代书面语，现代口语较少使用。
explanation_english: To separate; to part. Mostly used in classical written Chinese, and rarely used in modern spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後都係仳咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 pei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后还是离婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They ended up getting divorced.

english_meaning: divorce
explanation_mandarin: 指夫妻双方通过法律程序解除婚姻关系。
explanation_english: To formally end a marriage; divorce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結咗十年婚，最終都係要仳離收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 zo2 sap6 nin4 fan1, zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 jiu3 pei2 lei4 sau1 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年，最终还是要离婚收场。
examples.english_sentence: They were married for ten years, but ultimately ended up in divorce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家香港嘅離婚率都幾高，好多夫妻都選擇仳離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 ga1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lei4 fan1 leut2 dou1 gei2 gou1, hou2 do1 fu1 chai1 dou1 syun2 jaak6 pei2 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在香港的离婚率挺高，很多夫妻都选择离婚。
examples.english_sentence: The divorce rate in Hong Kong is quite high now; many couples choose to divorce.

english_meaning: to place a coffin temporarily before burial; to postpone burial
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中，指暂时停放棺材，等待安葬。也指推迟或延缓处理某事。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it refers to temporarily placing a coffin before burial, awaiting the proper time or arrangement. It can also mean to postpone or delay dealing with a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企仵住咗個阿爺嘅棺材喺屋企，等緊吉日落葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ng5 zyu6 zo2 go3 aa3 je4 ge3 gun1 caai4 hai2 uk1 kei5, dang2 gan2 gat1 jat6 lok6 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家把爷爷的棺材停放在家里，等待吉日下葬。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has kept the grandfather's coffin in the house, waiting for an auspicious day for burial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁麻煩，不如仵一仵先，諗清楚點做先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 maa4 faan4, bat1 jyu4 ng5 jat1 ng5 sin1, nam2 cing1 chu2 dim2 zou6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么麻烦，不如先缓一缓，想清楚怎么做再说。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so troublesome, why don't we postpone it and think clearly about how to proceed.

english_meaning: coroner, forensic examiner, autopsy official
explanation_mandarin: 古代负责检验尸体的官员，类似于现代的法医或验尸官。
explanation_english: In ancient times, an official responsible for examining corpses, similar to a modern-day forensic examiner or coroner. They investigated the cause of death, often in cases of suspected foul play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲仵作真係唔容易做，要面對咁多恐怖嘅屍體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 ng5 zok3 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6 zou6, jiu3 min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 hung2 bou3 ge3 si1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的验尸官真不容易做，要面对这么多恐怖的尸体。
examples.english_sentence: The coroners in the past really had a tough job, having to face so many horrifying corpses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候，夢想係做仵作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2, mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 ng5 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候的梦想是做法医。
examples.english_sentence: His childhood dream was to become a coroner.

english_meaning: Mortician; Funeral worker; Embalmer
explanation_mandarin: 指从事处理尸体，进行殡葬服务的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to people who handle corpses and provide funeral services, including preparing the body for burial or cremation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做仵工，專門幫死人化妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ng5 gung1, zyun1 mun4 bong1 sei2 jan4 faa3 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做殡葬工，专门帮死人化妆。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a mortician, specializing in applying makeup to the deceased.

english_meaning: item; piece; matter; measure word (for things, clothing, events, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 用來計算事情、東西、衣服等的量詞；有時候也指事情或東西本身。
explanation_english: A measure word used to count things, items, clothes, events, etc.; sometimes refers to the thing or matter itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有件重要嘅嘢要同你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 gin6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5 jiu3 tung4 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有件重要的事要跟你说。
examples.english_sentence: I have something important to tell you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is none of your business.

english_meaning: partner (romantic); piece of cargo; item; matter; affair
explanation_mandarin: 在不同的语境下有不同的含义。可以指恋爱对象或伴侣（通常是单身人士寻觅的对象），也可以指货物、物件，或者指某件事情。
explanation_english: Has different meanings depending on the context. Can refer to a romantic partner (usually a prospective one for single people), a piece of cargo or item, or a matter/affair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都單身咁耐，屋企人好想佢快啲搵個件頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 daan1 san1 gam3 noi6, uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 soeng2 keoi5 faai3 di1 wan2 go3 gin6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他单身这么久了，家人很想他快点找个对象。
examples.english_sentence: He's been single for so long, his family really wants him to find a partner soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批件頭要幾時送到倉啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat1 gin6 tau4 jiu3 gei2 si4 sung3 dou3 cong1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这批货物什么时候送到仓库啊？
examples.english_sentence: When will this batch of cargo be delivered to the warehouse?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理呢啲濕碎件頭啦，專心做好自己嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 ni1 di1 sap1 seoi3 gin6 tau4 laa1, zyun1 sam1 zou2 hou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理这些琐碎的事，专心做好你自己的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with these trivial matters, focus on doing your own thing.

english_meaning: price; value
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或服务的价值，通常用货币表示。
explanation_english: Refers to the value of a commodity or service, usually expressed in terms of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫几多价啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gei2 do1 gaa3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this shirt?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅楼价升得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 lau4 gaa3 sing1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的房价涨得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The housing prices have increased significantly this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我觉得呢个价钱太贵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 taai3 gwai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这个价格太贵了。
examples.english_sentence: I think this price is too expensive.

english_meaning: any; to allow; to appoint; to assume (office)
explanation_mandarin: 表示任何，听凭，或者担任职务。
explanation_english: Indicates 'any', 'allow', or 'to hold a position'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有咩事，任講唔嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 me1 si6, jam6 gong2 m4 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有什么事，随便说，我不会生气。
examples.english_sentence: If you have anything to say, feel free to say it, I won't get angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隨你點做，任你鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 nei5 dim2 zou6, jam6 nei5 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便你怎么做，随你喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: Do as you please, whatever you like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀老細任用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 jam6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板任命。
examples.english_sentence: He was appointed by the boss.

english_meaning: No matter what... don't get angry; Allow (someone) to do whatever they want without getting angry
explanation_mandarin: 指无论对方做什么，都表示允许而且不生气，体现了对对方的包容和迁就。
explanation_english: Refers to allowing someone to do whatever they want without getting angry. It demonstrates tolerance and accommodation towards the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你任佢點樣鬧都唔嬲，真係好脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jam6 keoi5 dim2 joeng2 naau6 dou1 m4 nau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你任他怎么骂都不生气，真是好脾气。
examples.english_sentence: You let him scold you however he wants and you don't even get angry. You really have a good temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都任我點樣買嘢都唔嬲，我真係好愛佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 jam6 ngo5 dim2 joeng2 maai5 je5 dou1 m4 nau1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 oi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是任我随便买东西都不生气，我真的好爱她。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always lets me buy whatever I want without getting angry, I really love her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢任佢個仔點樣曳都唔嬲，實在太縱容佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam6 keoi5 go3 zai2 dim2 joeng2 jai6 dou1 m4 nau1, sat6 zai6 taai3 zung3 jung4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他任他的儿子怎么调皮都不生气，实在太纵容他了。
examples.english_sentence: He lets his son be naughty however he wants without getting angry. He is really spoiling him.

mandarin_meaning: 无论⋯都不生气 / 随便⋯都不生气
english_meaning: No matter what... I won't get angry / I'm okay with whatever... I won't get angry.
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论对方做什么，自己都不会生气。隐含着宽容、迁就对方的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that no matter what the other person does, one will not get angry. It implies tolerance and accommodation towards the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 任你點鬧，我都唔嬲你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam6 nei5 dim2 naau6, ngo5 dou1 m4 nau1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论你怎么骂，我都不会生你的气。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how much you scold me, I won't be angry with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 任佢點樣使錢，我都唔嬲，最緊要佢開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam6 keoi5 dim2 joeng2 sai2 cin2, ngo5 dou1 m4 nau1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 keoi5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便他怎么花钱，我都不会生气，最重要的是他开心。
examples.english_sentence: I won't be angry no matter how he spends money, the most important thing is that he is happy.

english_meaning: favoritism; nepotism; to appoint people based on personal connections rather than ability
explanation_mandarin: 指任用人只看关系亲疏，不看人的才能和品德。
explanation_english: Appointing people based on personal relationships and favoritism, rather than on their talent or merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司咁細，都仲要任人唯親，遲早執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam3 sai3, dou1 zung1 jiu3 jam6 jan4 wai4 can1, ci4 zou2 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司这么小，还要任人唯亲，迟早倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The company is so small, and they still practice nepotism. It's going to close down sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好任人唯親，要睇下佢哋嘅能力先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jam6 jan4 wai4 can1, jiu3 tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 nang4 lik6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要任人唯亲，要看看他们的能力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't practice favoritism; you need to look at their abilities first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府最忌就係任人唯親，會影響管治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zeoi3 gei6 zau6 hai6 jam6 jan4 wai4 can1, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 gun2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府最忌讳的就是任人唯亲，会影响管治。
examples.english_sentence: The government should avoid nepotism the most; it will affect governance.

english_meaning: To be at someone's mercy; to be a sitting duck; to be helpless and at the mercy of others; to be completely vulnerable
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处于弱势地位，完全听凭别人摆布、欺凌。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is in a weak and vulnerable position, completely at the mercy of others and subject to their manipulation or exploitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔團結，就會任人宰割㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 tyun4 git3, zau6 wui5 jam6 jan4 zoi2 got3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不团结，就会任人宰割的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't unite, we'll be at the mercy of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司財政出現問題，好似任人宰割咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 coi4 zing3 ceot1 jin6 man6 tai4, hou2 ci5 jam6 jan4 zoi2 got3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司财政出现问题，好像任人宰割一样。
examples.english_sentence: The company's finances are in trouble, it's like they're a sitting duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋無權無勢，咪即係任人宰割囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mou5 kuen4 mou5 sai3, mai1 zik1 hai6 jam6 jan4 zoi2 got3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们无权无势，不就是任人宰割吗。
examples.english_sentence: They have no power or influence, so they're basically at everyone's mercy.

english_meaning: to be at someone's mercy; to be a fish on the chopping block; to be helpless and easily exploited
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处于被控制的境地，毫无反抗能力，只能任凭别人摆布和欺凌。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is completely at the mercy of another, unable to resist or defend themselves from exploitation or mistreatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔團結，就會變成任人魚肉㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 tyun4 git3, zau6 wui bin3 sing4 jam6 jan4 jyu4 juk6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不团结，就会变成任人宰割的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't unite, we will become easy prey for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個弱肉強食嘅社會，唔努力啲就會任人魚肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 joek6 juk6 koeng4 sik6 ge3 se5 wui2, m4 nou5 lik6 di1 zau6 wui jam6 jan4 jyu4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个弱肉强食的社会，不努力就会任人宰割。
examples.english_sentence: In this dog-eat-dog world, if you don't work hard, you'll be at the mercy of others.

english_meaning: any, whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示指代不确定的事物或范围，相当于“任何的”。
explanation_english: Indicates an indefinite thing or range, equivalent to 'any'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇任何嘢想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 jam6 ho4 je5 soeng2 gong2.
