examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有任何话想说。
examples.english_sentence: I have nothing to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做任何嘢都要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 jam6 ho4 je5 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做任何事都要小心。
examples.english_sentence: You have to be careful with anything you do.

english_meaning: during one's term of office
explanation_mandarin: 指在某人担任职务的期间。
explanation_english: Refers to the period during which someone holds a position of office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺任內做咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam6 noi6 zou6 zo2 ho2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在任期内做了很多事。
examples.english_sentence: He did a lot of things during his term of office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策係佢任內推行嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 hai6 keoi5 jam6 noi6 tui1 hang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策是在他任期内推行的。
examples.english_sentence: This policy was implemented during his term.

english_meaning: mission; task; assignment
explanation_mandarin: 指指定要做的事情，或承担的职责。
explanation_english: A specific piece of work assigned to someone to do; a duty or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅任務係要準時完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 jam6 mou6 hai6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 wun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的任务是要准时完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Our mission is to complete this project on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功完成咗艱巨嘅任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 wun4 sing4 zo2 gaan1 geoi6 ge3 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功完成了艰巨的任务。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully completed a difficult task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅任務係幫手執拾下啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 jam6 mou6 hai6 bong1 sau2 zap1 sap1 haa5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的任务是帮忙收拾一下东西。
examples.english_sentence: Your task is to help tidy up a bit.

english_meaning: to bear hardship without complaint; to work hard and bear grievances without complaint; diligent and uncomplaining
explanation_mandarin: 指承担劳苦的工作，也能够忍受委屈，不抱怨。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is willing to work hard and endure hardship or unfair treatment without complaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好任勞任怨，交帶嘅嘢一定會做好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jam6 lou4 jam6 jyun3, gaau1 daai3 ge3 je5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很任劳任怨，交代的事情一定会做好。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very diligent and uncomplaining person; he will definitely do well in the things he's asked to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽為咗頭家，任勞任怨咁做咗咁多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 wai6 zo2 tau4 ga1, jam6 lou4 jam6 jyun3 gam2 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈为了家庭，任劳任怨地做了这么多年。
examples.english_sentence: My mom has worked hard and endured hardship for the family for so many years, without complaint.

english_meaning: Choose as you please; you have the option to choose
explanation_mandarin: 指给予选择的自由，可以随意挑选。
explanation_english: Indicates the freedom to choose, you can pick whatever you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲嘢任君選擇，鍾意乜嘢就攞乜嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 jam6 gwan1 syun2 zaak6, zung1 yi3 mat1 je5 zau6 lo2 mat1 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的东西任你选择，喜欢什么就拿什么吧！
examples.english_sentence: You can choose whatever you like here, take whatever you want!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅套餐任君選擇兩個主菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 tou3 caan1 jam6 gwan1 syun2 zaak6 loeng5 go3 zyu2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的套餐你可以任选两个主菜。
examples.english_sentence: For this set meal, you can choose any two main courses.

english_meaning: to appoint; appointment
explanation_mandarin: 委派某人担任职务。也可作为名词，指委派的职务。
explanation_english: To formally assign a person to a position or job. Can also be used as a noun referring to the act or the position itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府任命咗佢做新嘅環境局局長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jan6 ming6 zo2 keoi5 zou6 san1 ge3 waan4 ging2 guk6 guk2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府任命他为新的环境局局长。
examples.english_sentence: The government appointed him as the new Secretary for the Environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅任命引起咗好多爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan6 ming6 jan5 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 zang1 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的任命引起了很多争议。
examples.english_sentence: His appointment caused a lot of controversy.

english_meaning: willful, headstrong, capricious, wayward
explanation_mandarin: 指人一意孤行，不听劝告，随心所欲。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is willful, stubborn, and acts according to their own desires, disregarding advice or reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好任性，成日唔聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam6 sing3, seng4 jat6 m4 ting1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很任性，总是听不进别人的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is really willful, he never listens to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔任性啲都正常嘅，但係大人就唔應該咁樣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 jam6 sing3 di1 dou1 zing3 soeng4 ge3, daan6 hai6 daai6 jan4 zau6 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 joeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子任性一点也正常，但是大人就不应该这样了。
examples.english_sentence: It's normal for children to be a bit willful, but adults shouldn't be like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁任性啦，考慮下人哋嘅感受啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jam6 sing3 laa1, haau2 leoi6 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 sau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么任性了，考虑一下别人的感受吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so willful, consider other people's feelings.

english_meaning: arbitrary; at will; optional; randomly
explanation_mandarin: 表示听凭自己的意愿，不受任何限制。
explanation_english: Meaning to do as one pleases, without any restrictions or limitations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以任意咁做嘢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 jam6 ji3 gam2 zou6 je5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能任意这么做事的！
examples.english_sentence: You can't just do things arbitrarily like that!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有錢，可以任意揮霍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 cin2, ho2 ji5 jam6 ji3 fai1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有钱，可以任意挥霍。
examples.english_sentence: He's very rich and can squander money as he pleases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅規矩係唔可以任意停車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 kwai1 geoi2 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 jam6 ji3 ting4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的规矩是不可以随意停车。
examples.english_sentence: The rules here are that you can't park arbitrarily.

english_meaning: to act arbitrarily, to act wilfully, to do as one pleases, to be reckless and unrestrained
explanation_mandarin: 随心所欲，胡作非为，不受任何约束。
explanation_english: To act as one pleases, without any restraint or regard for consequences; to be wilful and reckless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢恃住自己係老細個仔，就喺公司任意妄為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci5 zyu6 zi6 gei2 hai6 lou5 sai3 go3 zai2, zau6 hai2 gung1 si1 jam6 ji3 mong5 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仗着自己是老板的儿子，就在公司里任意妄为。
examples.english_sentence: Relying on the fact that he's the boss's son, he acts arbitrarily in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔可以任意妄為，一定要尊重市民嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 ho2 ji5 jam6 ji3 mong5 wai4, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 si5 man4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不可以任意妄为，一定要尊重市民的意见。
examples.english_sentence: The government cannot act arbitrarily; it must respect the opinions of the citizens.

english_meaning: to act arbitrarily and recklessly; to do whatever one pleases; to act wilfully
explanation_mandarin: 指随心所欲，毫无顾忌地做坏事。
explanation_english: To act as one pleases without regard to consequences or proper behavior; to be unrestrained in one's actions, especially in doing bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有權就任意妄爲，根本冇人敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 kwun4 zau6 jam6 ji3 mong5 wai4, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有了权力就胡作非为，根本没人敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: He abuses his power by acting recklessly and arbitrarily, and no one dares to speak up.

synonyms: 為所欲為 (wai4 so2 juk6 wai4)

english_meaning: no matter; regardless of; despite
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论哪种情况，结果都一样。
explanation_english: Indicates that regardless of the situation, the result remains the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 任憑你點講，我都唔會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam6 ping4 nei5 dim2 gong2, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论你怎么说，我都不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what you say, I won't believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 任憑落幾大雨，我都要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam6 ping4 lok6 gei2 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不管下多大的雨，我都要上班。
examples.english_sentence: Regardless of how heavy the rain is, I still have to go to work.

english_meaning: choose freely; free to choose; take your pick
explanation_mandarin: 随意挑选，没有限制。
explanation_english: To choose freely, without restrictions. Indicates that one has the liberty to select anything they want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲嘢你任揀，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 nei5 jam6 gaan2, m4 sai2 hak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的东西你随便选，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: You can choose anything you want here, don't be shy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我請客，你想食乜都任揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 cheng2 haak3, nei5 seung2 sik6 mat1 dou1 jam6 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我请客，你想吃什么都可以随便选。
examples.english_sentence: It's my treat today, you can choose anything you want to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫喺度，你任揀啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 hai2 dou6, nei5 jam6 gaan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服在这里，你随便选吧。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes are here, you can choose whatever you like.

english_meaning: to teach; to take a teaching post
explanation_mandarin: 担任教师的职位，从事教学工作。
explanation_english: To hold a teaching position; to be employed as a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺中學任教超過十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zung1 hok6 jam6 gaau3 ciu3 gwo3 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在中学任教超过十年。
examples.english_sentence: He has been teaching in a secondary school for over ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥大學畢業之後就喺間小學任教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 hai2 gaan1 siu2 hok6 jam6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥大学毕业之后就在一间小学任教。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating from university, my brother started teaching at a primary school.

english_meaning: term of office; tenure
explanation_mandarin: 担任职务的期限。
explanation_english: The period of time for which a person holds a position, especially an elected one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅任期就快完喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam6 kei4 zau6 faai3 jyun4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的任期快要结束了。
examples.english_sentence: His term of office is almost over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺任期內推行多啲改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 jam6 kei4 noi6 teoi1 hang4 do1 di1 goi2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在任期内推行更多的改革。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to implement more reforms during his term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺任期屆滿之前做出重大嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jam6 kei4 gaai3 mun5 zi1 cin4 zou6 ceot1 zung6 daai6 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在任期届满之前做出重大的决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make any major decisions before your term expires.

english_meaning: to appoint; to employ; to give a position to
explanation_mandarin: 委派使用。指授予职位，起用人才。
explanation_english: To appoint or employ someone, especially to a position of responsibility or authority; to put someone in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司好重視人才，會任用有能力嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 toi4 coi4, wui5 jam6 yung6 jau5 nang4 lik6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司很重视人才，会任用有能力的人。
examples.english_sentence: Their company values talent and will appoint capable people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細決定任用佢做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 kyut3 ding6 jam6 yung6 keoi5 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板决定任命他做经理。
examples.english_sentence: The boss decided to appoint him as the manager.

mandarin_meaning: 任凭; 听任; 随便
english_meaning: to allow; to let; to leave to; at the mercy of; to do as one pleases; to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 表示听凭、任凭对方做某事，不加干涉。
explanation_english: Indicates allowing or permitting someone to do something without interference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔做功課，就任由你啦，到時唔合格唔好喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, zau6 jam6 jau4 nei5 laa1, dou3 si4 m4 hap6 gaak3 m4 hou2 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不做功课，就随你便吧，到时候不及格别哭。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to do your homework, I'll let you. Don't cry if you fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣，屋企人任由佢周圍去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, uk1 kei2 jan4 jam6 jau4 keoi5 zau1 wai4 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候，家里人任由他到处去玩。
examples.english_sentence: When he was little, his family let him play around everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以任由啲壞人咁樣做落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 jam6 jau4 di1 waai6 jan4 gam2 joeng2 zou6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能任由那些坏人这样继续下去。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot let those bad people continue to do things like this.

english_meaning: to hold a post; to hold office; to be employed at
explanation_mandarin: 担任某种职务或工作。
explanation_english: To hold a certain position or work; to be employed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司任職咗十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 jam6 zik1 zo2 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司任职十年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working at that company for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家任職經理嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jam6 zik1 ging1 lei5 ge3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在担任经理的职位。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently holding the position of manager.

english_meaning: a heavy load and a long road; a demanding task and a long way to go; to shoulder heavy responsibilities
explanation_mandarin: 比喻责任重大，要经历长期的奋斗。
explanation_english: Describes a great responsibility and a long, arduous journey ahead. It signifies a demanding task that requires sustained effort and dedication over a considerable period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 振興香港經濟，我哋嘅任重道遠啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan3 hing1 hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3, ngo5 dei6 ge3 jam6 cung5 dou6 jyun5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 振兴香港的经济，我们的任务任重道远啊！
examples.english_sentence: Revitalizing Hong Kong's economy, we have a heavy load and a long road ahead!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個環境問題，絕對係任重道遠㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 waan4 ging2 man6 tai4, zyut3 deoi3 hai6 jam6 cung5 dou6 jyun5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个环境问题，绝对是任重道远。
examples.english_sentence: Solving this environmental problem is definitely a heavy load and a long road ahead.

english_meaning: All-you-can-eat; buffet
explanation_mandarin: 指一种餐饮形式，顾客支付一定费用后，可以在限定时间内随意取用食物。
explanation_english: Refers to a dining format where customers pay a fixed price and can consume as much food as they want within a specific time limit; often used to describe a buffet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去食任食火鍋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 jam6 sik6 fo2 wo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去吃自助火锅吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for all-you-can-eat hot pot tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有任食嘅壽司，好抵食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 jam6 sik6 ge3 sau6 si1, hou2 dai2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅有自助寿司，很划算的！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has all-you-can-eat sushi, it's a great deal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意食任食，因為可以食好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 jam6 sik6, yan1 wai6 ho2 ji5 sik6 hou2 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢吃自助餐，因为可以吃很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes all-you-can-eat buffets because he can eat a lot.

english_meaning: share; portion; copy; part; lot; MW for jobs, gifts, newspapers, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 量词，表示份额、部分、拷贝等。
explanation_english: Measure word indicating a share, portion, copy, or part of something. Also used as a classifier for jobs, gifts, newspapers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一份報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 fan6 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一份报纸。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a newspaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每人一份禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 jan4 jat1 fan6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每人一份礼物。
examples.english_sentence: Each person gets a gift.

english_meaning: for the sake of; out of consideration for; out of regard for; on account of
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为某人的情分、关系或面子而采取某种行动或做法。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or practice is taken because of someone's feelings, relationship, or face (saving face). Expresses consideration or deference to someone's situation or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇喺我哋咁多年朋友份上，今次我就原諒你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hai2 ngo5 dei6 gam3 do1 nin4 pang4 jau5 fan6 soeng6, gam1 ci3 ngo5 zau6 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看在我们多年朋友的情分上，这次我就原谅你吧。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of our many years of friendship, I'll forgive you this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇喺佢咁辛苦份上，我哋都幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hai2 keoi5 gam3 san1 fu2 fan6 soeng6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 bong1 haa6 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看在他这么辛苦的情分上，我们也帮把手吧。
examples.english_sentence: Out of consideration for how hard he's working, let's give him a hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇喺我阿媽嘅份上，唔好搞咁多嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hai2 ngo5 aa3 maa1 ge3 fan6 soeng6, m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看在我妈妈的情面上，不要搞那么多事情啦。
examples.english_sentence: For my mother's sake, don't make so much trouble.

english_meaning: personality, character, the kind of person (someone is)
explanation_mandarin: 指某人的品格、性格和行为方式。
explanation_english: Refers to someone's character, personality, and way of behaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人份人幾好嘅，好肯幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 fan6 jan4 gei2 hou2 ge3, hou2 hang2 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人的人品挺好的，很乐于助人。
examples.english_sentence: This person has a good personality, and is very willing to help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢份人好奇怪，成日都唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他的为人很奇怪，总是不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: I think his personality is very strange, I never know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔了解佢份人，唔好咁快下定論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 liu5 gaai2 keoi5 fan6 jan4, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 haa6 ding6 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都不了解他的为人，不要这么快下结论。
examples.english_sentence: You don't understand his character, don't jump to conclusions so quickly.

english_meaning: one's duty; one's responsibility; work that falls within one's job description
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人职责范围内的事情，应该做的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to matters that fall within one's duties and responsibilities; things that one is expected to do as part of their job or role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我份內事，唔使咁客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 fan6 noi6 si6, m4 sai2 gam3 hak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我的分内事，不用这么客气。
examples.english_sentence: This is my responsibility, no need to be so polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做好自己份內事就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 fan6 noi6 si6 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做好你自己的分内事就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Just do your own duty well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡力做好我份內事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 zou6 hou2 ngo5 fan6 noi6 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽力做好我的分内事的。
examples.english_sentence: I will do my best to fulfil my responsibilities.

english_meaning: especially; particularly; extra; additionally
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出一般程度，更加；特别。
explanation_english: Indicates something is beyond the usual extent or degree; especially; particularly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨天，份外覺得凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 tin1, fan6 ngoi6 gok3 dak1 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨天，格外觉得冷。
examples.english_sentence: It feels especially cold on a rainy day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到你咁精神，我都覺得份外開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 nei5 gam3 zing1 san4, ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 fan6 ngoi6 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到你这么精神，我也觉得格外开心。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing you so energetic, I also feel especially happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅月亮份外光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 jyut6 loeng6 fan6 ngoi6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的月亮格外亮。
examples.english_sentence: The moon is especially bright tonight.

english_meaning: extra work; additional task; something beyond one's duty
explanation_mandarin: 指职责范围以外的事情，额外的任务或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to tasks or work that are outside one's normal job responsibilities or duties; something extra.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個星期我做咗好多份外事，真係好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 fan6 ngoi6 si6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个星期我做了很多额外的事情，真的很累。
examples.english_sentence: I've done a lot of extra work this week, I'm really tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都要人幫佢做埋啲份外事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jan4 bong1 keoi5 zou6 maai4 di1 fan6 ngoi6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是要别人帮他做那些额外的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He always asks others to help him with those extra tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日叫我做份外事啦，我已經夠忙㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 zou6 fan6 ngoi6 si6 laa1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 gau3 mong4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是叫我做额外的事了，我已经够忙的了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always ask me to do extra work, I'm already busy enough.

mandarin_meaning: 份钱, 份额; 也指成员、分子
english_meaning: Share of money, contribution (especially for weddings, funerals, birthdays etc.); member, element, factor
explanation_mandarin: 指为了庆祝或哀悼场合而贡献的钱，也指集体中的一份子或因素。
explanation_english: Refers to a contribution of money given for celebratory or mournful occasions, such as weddings, birthdays, or funerals. It can also refer to a member of a group, or a contributing factor to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚，我哋要夾返份子先得。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 giu3 ngo5 kei5 maai4 jat1 bin1, dang2 keoi5 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叫我站到一边去，等他处理。
examples.english_sentence: He told me to stand aside and let him handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 企埋一邊先，陣間再講。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 先站到一边去，一会儿再说。
examples.english_sentence: Stand aside for now, we'll talk later.

english_meaning: Waiter, server (in a restaurant, tea house, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指在餐馆、茶楼等场所负责招呼客人、点菜、上菜等的服务人员。
explanation_english: Refers to a waiter or server in a restaurant, tea house, or similar establishment who is responsible for greeting customers, taking orders, and serving food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，叫個企堂嚟落單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, giu3 go3 kei5 tong4 lei4 lok6 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请叫个服务员来点菜。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, can we call a waiter to take our order?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間茶餐廳啲企堂好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 di1 kei5 tong4 hou2 jau5 lai5 mau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的服务员很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: The waiters in this 'cha chaan teng' (Hong Kong-style cafe) are very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前喺酒樓做企堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai2 zau2 lau4 zou6 kei5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前在酒楼做服务员。
examples.english_sentence: He used to work as a waiter in a Chinese restaurant.

english_meaning: to stand still; stand properly; stay put
explanation_mandarin: 指站稳不动，不要随意走动或晃动。强调稳定和固定。
explanation_english: Refers to standing still without moving or swaying. Emphasizes stability and steadiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企定定喺度，唔好周围走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 ding6 ding6 hai2 dou6, m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站稳在这里，不要到处走。
examples.english_sentence: Stand still here, don't walk around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影相嘅時候，記得企定定，唔好郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ying2 seung2 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 kei5 ding6 ding6, m4 hou2 yuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍照的时候，记得站稳，不要动。
examples.english_sentence: When taking photos, remember to stand still and don't move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震嘅時候，最好企定定，捉住啲穩固嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 kei5 ding6 ding6, juk1 jyu5 di1 wan2 gu3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震的时候，最好站稳，抓住一些稳固的东西。
examples.english_sentence: During an earthquake, it's best to stand still and grab onto something sturdy.

english_meaning: to expect; to hope for; expectation
explanation_mandarin: 期望，希望。既可以作动词，表示希望，也可以作名词，表示期望的事情或状态。
explanation_english: To expect, to hope for. It can be used as a verb to express hope, or as a noun to represent the thing or state that is hoped for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我企望你將來可以成為一個有用嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kei5 mong6 nei5 jeung1 loi4 ho2 ji5 sing4 wai4 yat1 go3 yau5 yung6 ge3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我期望你将来可以成为一个有用的人。
examples.english_sentence: I expect you to become a useful person in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好對佢嘅承諾有太高嘅企望啦，佢成日都講一套做一套嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 deui3 keui5 ge3 sing4 nok6 yau5 taai3 go1 ge3 kei5 mong6 laa1, keui5 sing4 yat6 dou1 gong2 yat1 tou3 zou6 yat1 tou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要对他的承诺有太高的期望，他总是说一套做一套的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have too high expectations for his promises, he always says one thing and does another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對呢個計劃嘅成功有好大嘅企望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deui3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 gung1 yau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 kei5 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对这个计划的成功有很大的期望。
examples.english_sentence: We have high expectations for the success of this plan.

english_meaning: enterprise; business; corporation
explanation_mandarin: 指从事生产、经营活动，具有一定规模和组织的经济实体。
explanation_english: A commercial enterprise or business; a company or firm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間企業規模好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 kei5 jip6 kwai1 mou2 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家企业的规模很大。
examples.english_sentence: This enterprise is very large in scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間跨國企業做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 kwaa3 gwok3 kei5 jip6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家跨国企业工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a multinational corporation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多中小企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 zung1 siu2 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多中小企业。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has a lot of small and medium-sized enterprises.

english_meaning: Entrepreneur
explanation_mandarin: 指经营企业，具有创新精神，承担风险的人。
explanation_english: A person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個成功嘅企業家，搞咗好多唔同嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sing4 gung1 ge3 kei5 jip6 gaa1, gaau2 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位成功的企业家，做了很多不同的生意。
examples.english_sentence: He is a successful entrepreneur who has started many different businesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港需要更多有創意嘅企業家，帶領經濟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 jau5 cong3 ji3 ge3 kei5 jip6 gaa1, daai3 ling5 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港需要更多有创意的企业家，带领经济发展。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong needs more creative entrepreneurs to lead economic development.

english_meaning: To work as a shop assistant; to stand behind a counter
explanation_mandarin: 指在商店或零售店中站在柜台后面工作，负责销售、收银等工作。
explanation_english: Refers to working behind a counter in a shop or retail store, being responsible for sales, cashier duties, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後就喺間百貨公司企櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 hai2 gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 kei5 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业之后就在一家百货公司站柜台。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating, he worked as a shop assistant in a department store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人唔係好主動，所以阿媽安排佢去企櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 m4 hai6 hou2 zyu2 dung6, so2 ji5 aa3 maa1 on1 paai4 keoi5 heoi3 kei5 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不是很主动，所以妈妈安排他去站柜台。
examples.english_sentence: He's not a very proactive person, so his mother arranged for him to work as a shop assistant.

english_meaning: to stand crookedly / to stand unsteadily / to take the wrong side; to be biased
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指站立时身体倾斜不正。 引申意义是比喻立场不稳、偏袒一方，或者做人不正派。
explanation_english: Literally means to stand crookedly or unsteadily. Metaphorically, it refers to taking the wrong side or being biased, or behaving improperly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企歪咗，扶下佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 waai1 zo2, fu4 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站歪了，扶他一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're standing crookedly, help him a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好企歪喎，要企喺我哋呢边啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 kei5 waai1 wo3, jiu3 kei5 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ni1 bin1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要站错队了，要站在我们这边啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't take the wrong side, you have to be on our side!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁明顯，你都企歪，真係冇得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 ming4 hin2, nei5 dou1 kei5 waai1, zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情这么明显，你都偏袒，真是没救了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so obvious, and you're still biased, there's really no hope for you.

english_meaning: Stand a bit more to the side; lean a bit more.
explanation_mandarin: 表示稍微倾斜或偏离原来的位置站立。 '企' 是站立的意思，'歪' 是倾斜不正的意思，'啲' 表示稍微。
explanation_english: Indicates to stand slightly to the side, or to lean a bit. '企' means to stand, '歪' means crooked or tilted, and '啲' means a little bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你企歪啲，擋住我睇電視喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 kei5 waai1 di1, dong2 zyu6 ngo5 tai2 din6 si6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你站歪一点，挡住我看电视了。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, stand a little to the side, you're blocking my view of the TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相影緊，你企歪啲，等我可以擺埋啲嘢上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 ying2 gan2, nei5 kei5 waai1 di1, dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 baai2 maai4 di1 ye5 seung5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在拍照呢，你站歪一点，这样我可以把东西也放上去。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking a picture, stand a little to the side so I can put these things in as well.

english_meaning: tidy, neat, well-groomed
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物整洁、干净、有条理。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is tidy, neat, and well-organized. Can refer to physical appearance or the state of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好企理，日日都執拾得乾乾淨淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 kei5 lei5, jat1 jat1 dou1 zap1 sap1 dak1 gon1 gon1 zing1 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很整洁，每天都收拾得干干净净。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very tidy person, he cleans up everything every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間房唔企理喎，執拾下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 fong2 m4 kei5 lei5 wo3, zap1 sap1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的房间不整洁，收拾一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your room isn't tidy, clean it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 著衫都要著得企理啲先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 saam1 dou1 jiu3 zoek3 dak1 kei5 lei5 di1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穿衣服也要穿得整洁一些才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: You should dress neatly.

english_meaning: to stand firm, to be resolute, to hold one's ground, to stand one's ground
explanation_mandarin: 指坚持自己的立场或观点，不轻易妥协或改变。
explanation_english: Refers to maintaining one's stance or viewpoint and not easily compromising or changing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論點都好，我都會企硬支持你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 dim2 dou1 hou2, ngo5 dou1 wui5 kei5 ngaang6 zi1 chi4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何，我都会坚定地支持你。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what, I will stand firm and support you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢件事上面，我哋一定要企硬，唔可以退讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 seung6 min6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 kei5 ngaang6, m4 ho2 ji5 teoi3 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这件事上，我们一定要立场坚定，不能退让。
examples.english_sentence: On this matter, we must stand firm and not yield.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫佢哋加班，但係佢哋企硬唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 keoi5 dei6 gaa1 baan1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 kei5 ngaang6 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫他们加班，但是他们坚决不肯。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked them to work overtime, but they stood firm and refused.

english_meaning: stand firm; stabilise; get a firm footing
explanation_mandarin: 指站立稳当，也可以引申为地位稳固，或者情况稳定。
explanation_english: Literally means to stand firmly. It can also be extended to mean to establish a secure position, to stabilise a situation, or to gain a firm footing (e.g., in a company or market).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企穩啲呀，陣間跌親就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 wan2 di1 aa3, zan6 gaan1 dit3 can1 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站稳一点，一会儿摔倒就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Stand firm, it wouldn't be good if you fell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司企穩咗陣腳，而家升咗做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 kei5 wan2 zo2 zan6 geok3, ji4 gaa1 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司站稳了脚跟，现在升职做了经理。
examples.english_sentence: He has established a firm footing in the company and has now been promoted to manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市唔穩定，要睇定啲先可以企穩陣腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 m4 wan2 ding6, jiu3 tai2 ding6 di1 sin1 ho2 ji5 kei5 wan2 zan6 geok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市不稳定，要看清楚一些才能站稳脚跟。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market is unstable, you need to observe carefully before you can establish a firm footing.

english_meaning: shower stall, shower cubicle
explanation_mandarin: 指一种用来淋浴的封闭式空间，通常由玻璃或塑料制成，底部设有排水口。
explanation_english: A shower stall or cubicle, an enclosed space specifically designed for showering, usually made of glass or plastic with a drain at the bottom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企個廁所有個企缸，沖涼方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 ci3 so2 jau5 go3 kei5 gong1, cung1 loeng4 fong1 bin6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家里的厕所有一个淋浴间，洗澡方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: My bathroom has a shower stall, it's much more convenient to shower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅企缸好細，轉身都唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 kei5 gong1 hou2 sai3, zyun3 san1 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的淋浴间很小，转身都不方便。
examples.english_sentence: The shower stall in this hotel is very small, it's not even easy to turn around.

english_meaning: street walker, prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上站立招揽顾客的性工作者。
explanation_english: Refers to a sex worker who stands on the street soliciting customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拉咗幾個喺旺角企街嘅女人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 laai1 zo2 gei2 go3 hai2 wong6 gok3 kei5 gaai1 ge3 neoi2 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了几个在旺角站街的女人。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested several women who were street walkers in Mong Kok.

english_meaning: threaten to jump (from a building, etc.) as a form of protest or suicide attempt
explanation_mandarin: 指以站在高处（如建筑物、桥梁等）边缘，威胁跳下去的方式来表达诉求、抗议或试图自杀的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of standing on the edge of a high place (such as a building or bridge) and threatening to jump as a way to express demands, protest, or attempt suicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為俾人呃咗好多錢，就走咗去天台企跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zau6 zau2 zo2 heoi3 tin1 toi1 kei5 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他被人骗了很多钱，就跑到天台去跳楼威胁。
examples.english_sentence: Because he was scammed out of a lot of money, he went to the rooftop and threatened to jump.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方接報後，立刻趕到現場處理企跳事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zip3 bou3 hau6, lik1 hak1 gon2 dou3 jin6 coeng4 cyu5 lei5 kei5 tiu3 si6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方接到报告后，立刻赶到现场处理跳楼威胁事件。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the report, the police immediately rushed to the scene to handle the threatened suicide attempt.

english_meaning: to stand up
explanation_mandarin: 从坐着或躺着的状态变为站立的状态。
explanation_english: To rise to a standing position from sitting or lying down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到國歌，我哋要企身致敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 gwok3 go1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kei5 san1 zi3 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到国歌，我们要站起来致敬。
examples.english_sentence: Upon hearing the national anthem, we should stand up to show respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐咗成日，終於企身伸個懶腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 zo2 sing4 jat6, zung1 jyu1 kei5 san1 san1 go3 laan5 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐了一整天，终于站起来伸个懒腰。
examples.english_sentence: He sat all day, finally standing up to stretch.

mandarin_meaning: 站着煲粥/汤；比喻拖延时间，磨洋工
english_meaning: To stand and cook congee/soup; Metaphorically, to procrastinate, to drag one's feet, to work without making progress
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是站着煮粥或汤。形容一个人做事情非常慢，就像站着煮粥一样，很久都没有煮好。比喻拖延时间，磨洋工，效率低下。
explanation_english: Literally means to stand and cook congee or soup. It describes someone working very slowly, like standing and cooking congee which takes a long time to finish. Metaphorically, it means to procrastinate, drag one's feet, work inefficiently, or take an excessively long time to complete a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好企身煲啦，快啲搞掂佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 kei5 san1 bou1 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拖拖拉拉的，快点完成它吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't procrastinate, finish it quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日企身煲，所以進度好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 kei5 san1 bou1, so2 ji5 zeon3 dou6 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是拖拖拉拉的，所以进度很慢。
examples.english_sentence: He always drags his feet at work, so the progress is very slow.

synonyms: 拖泥带水 (to1 nei4 daai3 seoi2)

english_meaning: stand and lead; standing collar; upturned collar
explanation_mandarin: （名词）指衣服的立领，通常是高领。 (动词) 比喻比别人略胜一筹，走在前面，领先。
explanation_english: (noun) Refers to a standing collar, usually a high collar, on clothing. (verb) To be slightly better than others; to be ahead; to lead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫嘅企領好型啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 ge3 kei5 ling5 hou2 ying4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的立领很帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: The standing collar of this shirt is so cool!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個行業嘅發展度企領緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 yip6 ge3 faat3 zin2 dou6 kei5 ling5 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个行业的发展中处于领先地位。
examples.english_sentence: He is leading in the development of this industry.

english_meaning: Penguin
explanation_mandarin: 一种不会飞的鸟类，生活在南极或其他寒冷地区。
explanation_english: A flightless bird living in Antarctica or other cold regions.

mandarin_meaning: 形容连续失败、倒霉、情况糟糕
english_meaning: Describing a continuous streak of bad luck, failure, or a terrible situation
explanation_mandarin: 连续地、不断地遇到不好的事情或情况。强调程度和频率。
explanation_english: Describes experiencing a series of unfortunate events or a consistently bad situation. Emphasizes the degree and frequency of the negativity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係伏伏伏呀，返工遲到，重要整爛咗部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 fuk6 fuk6 fuk6 aa3, faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 zing2 laan6 zo2 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真是倒霉透了，上班迟到，还弄坏了手机。
examples.english_sentence: I'm having a really terrible day today. I was late for work and I also broke my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試伏伏伏，唔合格就慘啦。

english_meaning: bouncing around, jumping around actively; hyperactive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或动物精力充沛，活泼好动，不停地跳来跳去。
explanation_english: Describes a person or animal that is energetic, lively, and actively jumping around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔喺度伏伏跳，真係好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 hai2 dou6 fuk6 fuk6 tiu3, zan1 hai6 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们在这里活蹦乱跳，真吵。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are bouncing around here, it's so noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗仔好精神，成日伏伏跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 zai2 hou2 zing1 san4, seng4 jat6 fuk6 fuk6 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小狗很有精神，整天活蹦乱跳。
examples.english_sentence: The puppy is very energetic and bounces around all day.

english_meaning: to crouch down; to lie low; to duck down
explanation_mandarin: 指身体降低高度，趴下或蹲下，以躲避某些东西（例如：子弹，攻击等），或者表示忍让、服从。
explanation_english: Refers to lowering the body's height, crouching, or lying down to avoid something (e.g., bullets, attacks) or to indicate tolerance/submission/lying low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到槍聲，佢即刻伏低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 cheung1 seng1, keui5 jik1 hak1 fuk6 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到枪声，他立刻趴下。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the gunshot, he immediately ducked down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細鬧人，唯有伏低認錯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 naau6 yan4, wai4 yau5 fuk6 dai1 ying6 tso3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板骂人，只能低头认错了。
examples.english_sentence: When the boss scolds, you can only lie low and admit your mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇戏嘅时候，前面个人好高，我要伏低先睇到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hei3 ge3 si4 hau6, chin4 min6 ge3 go3 yan4 hou2 gou1, ngo5 yiu3 fuk6 dai1 sin1 tai2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看电影的时候，前面的人很高，我要趴低才能看到。
examples.english_sentence: When watching a movie, the person in front is very tall, I have to crouch down to see.

mandarin_meaning: 指那些总是隐藏实力，等待时机爆发的人; 扮猪吃老虎的人
english_meaning: Someone who hides their abilities or intentions; a wolf in sheep's clothing; someone who plays dumb to deceive others.
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上看起来很普通，甚至有点笨，但实际上非常有能力，并且隐藏实力等待机会的人。 类似于“扮猪吃老虎”。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who appears ordinary, even foolish, but is actually very capable and hides their abilities while waiting for an opportunity. Similar to the idiom "playing dumb to get the better of someone".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇佢平時咁傻更更，其實佢係個伏兒人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 keoi5 ping4 si4 gam3 so4 gang1 gang1, kei4 sat6 keoi5 hai6 go3 fuk6 ji4 jan4 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他平时傻乎乎的，其实他是个扮猪吃老虎的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his apparent foolishness; he's actually a wolf in sheep's clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇少佢，佢肯定係個伏兒人，一出手就知龍與鳳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 hang2 ding6 hai6 go3 fuk6 ji4 jan4, jat1 chut1 sau2 zau6 zi1 lung4 jyu5 fung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别小看他，他肯定是个隐藏实力的人，一出手就知道他的厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he's definitely someone who's hiding his abilities. You'll know how skilled he is when he takes action.

synonyms: 扮豬食老虎 (baan6 zyu1 sik6 lou5 fu2)

mandarin_meaning: 埋伏的士兵; 埋伏; 伏击
english_meaning: ambush; ambush troops; hidden forces
explanation_mandarin: 原指埋伏起来的士兵，伺机突袭。引申为事先埋伏的人或力量，等待时机行动。
explanation_english: Originally refers to soldiers lying in ambush, waiting for an opportunity to launch a surprise attack. It is now extended to refer to people or forces lying in wait, waiting for the right moment to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條路口度擺咗好多伏兵，等住對方嘅車隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 tiu4 lou6 hau2 dou6 baai2 zo2 hou2 do1 fuk6 bing1, dang2 zyu6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 ce1 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在路口设置了很多伏兵，等着对方的车队。
examples.english_sentence: They set up many ambush troops at the intersection, waiting for the other side's convoy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，呢件事可能有伏兵㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, ni1 gin6 si6 ho2 nang4 jau5 fuk6 bing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，这件事可能隐藏着陷阱/暗算。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there might be hidden forces in this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚佢哋背後有伏兵，所以唔敢輕舉妄動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ging1 keoi5 dei6 bui3 hau6 jau5 fuk6 bing1, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 hing1 geoi2 mong5 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕他们背后有埋伏，所以不敢轻举妄动。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid they have an ambush behind them, so I dare not act rashly.

mandarin_meaning: 隐藏的问题; 潜在的危险
english_meaning: hidden problem; underlying risk; potential danger
explanation_mandarin: 指隐藏在表面之下，不容易被发现的问题或危险。常常指一些事情表面看起来平静，但实际上暗藏危机。
explanation_english: Refers to a problem or danger hidden beneath the surface, not easily detected. Often describes situations where things appear calm on the surface, but in reality, there are underlying risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司表面好似好賺錢咁，但其實伏冰好多，隨時會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 biu2 min6 hou2 ci5 hou2 zaan6 cin2 gam2, daan6 kei4 sat6 fuk6 bing1 hou2 do1, ceoi4 si4 wui5 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司表面上看起来很赚钱，但实际上隐藏着很多问题，随时会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This company seems to be making a lot of money on the surface, but in reality, there are many hidden problems, and it could close down at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇清楚先好投資啊，唔好見佢講到天花龍鳳就信晒，小心伏冰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 tau4 zi1 aa3, m4 hou2 gin3 keoi5 gong2 dou3 tin1 faa1 lung4 fung6 zau6 seon3 saai3, siu2 sam1 fuk6 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你仔细看清楚再投资啊，不要见他说得天花乱坠就全信，小心隐藏的风险。
examples.english_sentence: Look carefully before you invest, don't believe everything he says just because it sounds good, be careful of hidden risks.

english_meaning: hide-and-seek
explanation_mandarin: 一种儿童游戏，一人当鬼，蒙上眼睛或背过身去数数，其他人藏起来，然后当鬼的人去找藏起来的人。
explanation_english: A children's game where one player closes their eyes and counts while the other players hide, and the first player then tries to find them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊玩伏匿匿啦，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 waan2 fuk6 nik1 nik1 laa1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起玩捉迷藏吧，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Let's play hide-and-seek together, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔最鍾意玩伏匿匿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 waan2 fuk6 nik1 nik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们最喜欢玩捉迷藏。
examples.english_sentence: Children love to play hide-and-seek the most.

mandarin_meaning: 有陷阱的意味；有危险的预兆
english_meaning: A feeling that something is a trap or a setup; a sense of impending danger or deception
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事或情况让人觉得有陷阱，可能会遇到危险或被骗，通常是一种直觉感受。
explanation_english: Refers to a feeling or sense that something is a trap, a setup, or that there is impending danger or deception. It's often an intuitive feeling about a situation or person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢咁筍，實有伏味嘅，小心啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 gam3 seon2, sat6 jau5 fuk6 mei6 ge3, siu2 sam1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事情这么划算，肯定有陷阱，小心一点好。
examples.english_sentence: This deal is too good to be true; there's definitely a trap in it. Be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁鬼好聽，我感覺到有啲伏味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 gwai2 hou2 teng1, ngo5 gam2 gok3 dou2 jau5 di1 fuk6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说得这么好听，我感觉有点不对劲。
examples.english_sentence: He's being so sweet; I can sense something fishy is going on.

english_meaning: to die; to be found dead (often in a prone position); to lie dead; to be a corpse
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后尸体倒卧在地，通常用于比较正式或严肃的语境。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's dead body lying prostrate on the ground. Usually used in more formal or serious contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭嘅時候，經常都會見到伏屍遍野嘅景象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 ge3 si4 hau6, ging1 seung4 dou1 wui5 gin3 dou2 fuk6 si1 pin3 ye5 ge3 ging2 seung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争的时候，经常都会见到尸横遍野的景象。
examples.english_sentence: During war, you often see scenes of corpses lying everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企伏屍幾日先至俾人發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 fuk6 si1 gei2 jat6 sin1 zi3 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里倒毙了好几天才被人发现。
examples.english_sentence: He was found dead at home after lying there for several days.

english_meaning: ambush, lie in ambush
explanation_mandarin: 埋伏袭击。指隐藏起来伺机袭击敌人。
explanation_english: To ambush; to lie in ambush; to attack from a concealed position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條路嘅轉彎位伏擊敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 tiu4 lou6 ge3 zyun2 waan1 wai2 fuk6 gik1 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在那条路的转弯处伏击敌人。
examples.english_sentence: They ambushed the enemy at the bend in the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺度伏擊佢哋，唔俾佢哋咁容易走甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 dou6 fuk6 gik1 keoi5 dei6, m4 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gam3 jung4 ji6 zau2 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在那里伏击他们，不让他们那么容易逃脱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ambush them there, not letting them escape so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺嗰度伏擊咗班毒販。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 go2 dou6 fuk6 gik1 zo2 baan1 duk6 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在那里伏击了一群毒贩。
examples.english_sentence: The police ambushed a group of drug dealers there.

english_meaning: Volt (unit of electrical potential difference)
explanation_mandarin: 电压的单位，简称伏，符号是V。
explanation_english: The unit of electromotive force or electrical potential difference in the SI system, equivalent to the difference in potential between two points in a conductor carrying one ampere when the power dissipated between the points is one watt. Symbol: V

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電器要兩百二十伏特先用得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 hei3 jiu3 loeng5 baak3 ji6 sap6 ji6 fuk6 dak6 sin1 yung6 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电器需要220伏特才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: This electrical appliance requires 220 volts to work.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先看看电池是多少伏特的。
examples.english_sentence: Check how many volts the battery is first.

english_meaning: Vodka
explanation_mandarin: 一种烈性蒸馏酒，通常由谷物或马铃薯制成。
explanation_english: A distilled alcoholic beverage, typically made from grains or potatoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚不如飲杯伏特加啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 bat1 jyu4 jam2 bui1 fuk6 dak6 gaa1 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不如喝一杯伏特加吧？
examples.english_sentence: How about we have a glass of vodka tonight?

english_meaning: foreshadowing; prefiguration; hint; plant
explanation_mandarin: 指文艺作品中，为了预示后来的情节而预先埋伏的线索或暗示。
explanation_english: A literary device where an author drops subtle hints about plot developments to come.  It's a technique used to create anticipation and suspense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲頭先嘅劇情已經有伏筆，睇落去就會明㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 tau4 sin1 ge3 kek6 ching4 ji5 ging1 jau5 fuk6 bat1, tai2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 wui5 ming4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影前面的剧情已经有伏笔了，看下去就会明白的。
examples.english_sentence: The beginning of this movie has foreshadowing, you'll understand it if you keep watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本書寫咗好多伏筆，好吸引人睇落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 syu1 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 fuk6 bat1, hou2 kap1 yan4 tai2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的书写了很多伏笔，很吸引人看下去。
examples.english_sentence: His book has a lot of foreshadowing, it's very interesting to read.

english_meaning: foreshadowing, setup
explanation_mandarin: 指事先埋伏下来的线索或暗示，为后面的情节发展做铺垫。
explanation_english: Refers to a foreshadowing, a hint or clue planted earlier in a story or situation, which serves as a setup for later developments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲好多伏線，睇到最後先知原來之前嘅情節係有意思嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 hou2 do1 fuk6 sin3, tai2 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 zi1 jyun4 lai4 zi1 cin4 ge3 cing4 zit3 hai6 jau5 ji3 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影有很多伏笔，看到最后才知道原来之前的情节是有意义的。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has a lot of foreshadowing, you only realize the significance of the previous plot points when you get to the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅對白入面有好多伏線，暗示咗佢嘅真實身份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 deoi3 baak6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 fuk6 sin3, am3 si6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 zan1 sat6 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的对白里面有很多伏笔，暗示了他的真实身份。
examples.english_sentence: There are many hints in his dialogue, foreshadowing his true identity.

english_meaning: Much worse than a crashed helicopter; a complete disaster; to fail spectacularly; a total flop.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事情糟糕透顶，比直升机坠毁还要惨。表示彻底失败，非常惨烈。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is exceptionally bad, even worse than a helicopter crash. It indicates a complete failure, a spectacular flop, or a disastrous outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試真係伏過直升機，全部唔識做！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zan1 hai6 fuk6 gwo3 zik6 sing1 gei1, cyun4 bou6 m4 sik1 zou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试真是糟透了，完全不会做！
examples.english_sentence: This exam was a complete disaster, I couldn't answer anything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅新戲伏過直升機，票房勁差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 hei3 fuk6 gwo3 zik6 sing1 gei1, piu3 fong2 ging6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新电影简直是惨不忍睹，票房非常差。
examples.english_sentence: His new movie was a complete flop, the box office was terrible.

mandarin_meaning: 俯首贴耳; 服服帖帖
english_meaning: obedient; submissive; docile; to be completely obedient and compliant
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常顺从，不敢反抗的样子。比喻完全听从别人的命令。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being extremely obedient and compliant, not daring to resist. It implies complete obedience to someone else's commands or wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從老細炒咗佢一鑊之後，佢就變得伏首貼耳，咩都聽晒老細嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 lou5 sai3 caau2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 wok6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 bin3 dak1 fuk6 sau2 tip3 ji5, me1 dou1 ting1晒 lou5 sai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从老板炒了他一次之后，他就变得服服帖帖，什么都听老板的。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since the boss fired him once, he has become completely obedient, listening to everything the boss says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企好惡㗎，但係喺老婆面前就伏首貼耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 ok3 gaa3, daan6 hai6 hai2 lou5 po2 min6 cin4 zau6 fuk6 sau2 tip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里很凶的，但是在老婆面前就服服帖帖。
examples.english_sentence: He is very fierce at home, but he is very obedient in front of his wife.

english_meaning: to throw a tantrum; to lose one's temper; to get angry
explanation_mandarin: 指发脾气，怒气冲冲的样子。
explanation_english: Refers to losing one's temper; being in a state of anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日咁伐啦，有咩事慢慢講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 gam3 fat1 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 maan6 maan2 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是这么发脾气，有什么事慢慢说不就好了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always throw such a tantrum. If there's anything, just speak slowly and calmly, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一唔順超就伐，真係好煩。

english_meaning: to rest, to take a break, to stop (doing something)

explanation_english: To cease work or activity in order to relax, refresh oneself, or recover strength.

english_meaning: vacation, holiday, leave
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指一段时间的休息，通常指工作、学习的暂停。动词：指放假，休息。
explanation_english: Noun: A period of time taken off from work or studies for rest and relaxation; a vacation or holiday. Verb: To take a vacation or leave.

english_meaning: shock (medical condition)
explanation_mandarin: 指因有效循环血量不足，组织灌注不足，细胞代谢障碍，导致重要器官功能障碍的一种综合征。
explanation_english: A medical condition in which there is insufficient blood flow throughout the body, resulting in inadequate tissue perfusion, impaired cellular metabolism, and dysfunction of vital organs.

examples.english_sentence: He suddenly went into shock. Luckily, the ambulance arrived quickly.

english_meaning: Take two days off

explanation_english: "Hau" means to rest, "maa" refers to a pair or two, and "day" means day. It signifies taking two days off work or studies.

english_meaning: to suspend one's studies; to take a break from school

examples.english_sentence: He has to suspend his studies for a year because he is sick.

examples.english_sentence: His family has financial difficulties, so he was forced to suspend his studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 休學之後，佢打算出去做嘢儲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau1 hok6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 daa2 syun3 cheot1 heoi3 zou6 je5 chu5 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 休学之后，他打算出去工作赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: After suspending his studies, he plans to go out to work and save money.

english_meaning: market closure; to close the market (e.g., for a holiday)
explanation_mandarin: 指股市、期货市场等停止交易。可以是暂时性的，如因节假日休市；也可以是永久性的，如公司退市。
explanation_english: Refers to the closing of stock market, futures market, etc. Trading is halted. This can be temporary, such as for a holiday, or permanent, such as a company delisting.

examples.english_sentence: Due to the typhoon, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange announced that the market will be closed today.

english_meaning: Recess, adjournment (of a court hearing)
explanation_mandarin: 指法庭暂时停止审理案件，休息一段时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary break or adjournment during a court hearing.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种情况下，我们申请休庭。
examples.english_sentence: In this situation, we request a recess.

english_meaning: rest, take a break
explanation_mandarin: 停止工作或活动，放松身心。
explanation_english: To stop working or engaging in activity in order to relax, refresh oneself, or recover strength.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kam4 jat6 jau1 sik1 zo2, gam1 jat6 jing1 goi1 zing1 san4 di1 laa1.

english_meaning: to rest, to take a break
explanation_mandarin: 休息，稍作停顿。
explanation_english: To rest; to take a break; to pause for a short period.

explanation_mandarin: 指供人休息的地方，通常配备座椅、绿化等设施。

english_meaning: truce, armistice, ceasefire, to suspend hostilities
explanation_mandarin: 暂时停止战争或冲突。

examples.english_sentence: During the fishing moratorium, fishermen are not allowed to go out to sea to fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 休漁期可以畀啲魚有機會繁殖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau1 jyu4 kei4 ho2 ji5 bei2 di1 jyu4 jau5 gei1 wui2 faan4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 禁渔期可以让鱼有机会繁殖。
examples.english_sentence: The fishing moratorium allows the fish to have a chance to reproduce.

english_meaning: off duty

explanation_english: Refers to the time when someone is not working, especially for staff who work in shifts and are off duty.

examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, an off-duty police officer caught a pickpocket.

explanation_mandarin: 指生物体或计算机等设备进入一种低活动状态，以节省能量或适应不利环境。

examples.english_sentence: Some animals enter a state of dormancy in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦設定咗自動休眠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sat3 ding6 zo2 zi6 dung6 jau1 min4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑设置了自动休眠。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is set to automatically go into sleep mode.

english_meaning: leisure, relaxation, relaxed
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或学习之余的空闲时间，用于放松身心，享受生活。
explanation_english: Refers to free time outside of work or study, used for relaxing and enjoying life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺休閒時間睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 jau1 haan4 si4 gaan3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在休闲时间看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I like to watch movies in my leisure time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅休閒活動係行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jau1 haan4 wut6 dung6 hai6 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的休闲活动是爬山。
examples.english_sentence: His leisure activity is hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假期我想過得休閒啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 kei4 ngo5 soeng2 gwo3 dak1 jau1 haan4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假期我想过得休闲一点。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a more relaxed vacation.

english_meaning: to recuperate; to recover; to convalesce; to rest and recuperate
explanation_mandarin: 指通过休息、调整等方式，使身体或精神恢复健康状态。
explanation_english: To rest and recover from illness, injury, or exertion; to convalesce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，需要休養一排先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, seoi1 jiu3 jau1 joeng5 jat1 paai4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，需要休养一段时间才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick and needs to recuperate for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫佢返屋企休養，唔好咁操勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 keoi5 faan1 uk1 kei2 jau1 joeng5, m4 hou2 gam3 cou1 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫他回家休养，不要太操劳。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told him to go home and rest, and not to overwork himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手術之後，最緊要嘅係休養好身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ge3 hai6 jau1 joeng5 hou2 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手术之后，最重要的是休养好身体。
examples.english_sentence: After the surgery, the most important thing is to recuperate and restore your health.

english_meaning: to recuperate and multiply; to rest and build up strength
explanation_mandarin: 指在战争或社会动荡后，减轻人民负担，恢复和发展生产，使国家安定繁荣。
explanation_english: To allow a period of rest and recovery, particularly after a war or period of hardship, in order to rebuild the economy and strength of a nation or community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打完仗之後，政府應該俾人民休養生息，先可以重建社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 jyun4 zoeng3 zi1 hau6, zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 bei2 jan4 man4 jau1 joeng5 sang1 sik1, sin1 ho2 ji5 cung4 gin3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争结束后，政府应该让人民休养生息，才可以重建社会。
examples.english_sentence: After the war, the government should allow the people a period of rest and recuperation in order to rebuild society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅疫情，好多公司都想休養生息下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 jik1 cing4, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 soeng2 jau1 joeng5 sang1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的疫情，很多公司都想休养生息一下。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of the pandemic, many companies want to have a period of rest and recovery.

english_meaning: porter, manual laborer, coolie
explanation_mandarin: 指从事体力劳动，搬运重物的工人，通常指社会地位较低的劳动者。
explanation_english: Refers to a manual laborer who carries heavy objects, often implying a lower social status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都要做伕，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 fu1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都要做搬运工，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: They have to work as porters every day, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅香港有好多碼頭伕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 maa5 tau4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的香港有很多码头搬运工。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, Hong Kong had many dock porters.

english_meaning: many, numerous, multitude, everybody
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量多，也可指大众、大家。
explanation_english: Indicates a large quantity or number. Can also refer to the public or everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人围埋咗喺度，真系人山人众啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 wai4 maai4 zo2 hai2 dou6, zan1 hai6 jan4 saan1 jan4 zung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人围在一起，真是人山人海啊！
examples.english_sentence: Many people gathered around, it's a sea of people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多人众口一词，你都唔信？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 jan4 zung3 hau2 jat1 ci4, nei5 dou1 m4 seon3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么多人异口同声，你都不相信？
examples.english_sentence: So many people agree on this, don't you believe it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以帮到普罗大众啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou3 pou2 lo4 dai6 zung3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以帮助到普罗大众。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can help the general public.

english_meaning: partner, companion; fellow, guy; things, goods
explanation_mandarin: 作为名词，指一起做事的人，伙伴；作为量词，用于表示人数，特别是用于不熟悉的或者不太尊重的人；也指东西，物件。
explanation_english: As a noun, it refers to someone who works together with others, a partner; as a measure word, it's used to indicate the number of people, especially for unfamiliar or less respected individuals; also refers to things, objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅好伙記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 hou2 fo2 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的好伙伴。
examples.english_sentence: He is my good partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班伙記成日都遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 fo2 gei2 seng4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群家伙总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: That group of fellows are always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲伙嘢好重呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo2 je5 hou2 cung5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西很重啊！
examples.english_sentence: These things are so heavy!

english_meaning: partner, companion, comrade
explanation_mandarin: 一同工作、生活或从事某种活动的人。
explanation_english: A person who works, lives, or engages in some activity together with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅工作伙伴好好人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 gung1 zok3 fo2 bun6 hou2 hou2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的工作伙伴人很好。
examples.english_sentence: My work partner is a very nice person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係生意伙伴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 saang1 ji3 fo2 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是生意伙伴。
examples.english_sentence: They are business partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢係從小到大嘅伙伴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai6 cung4 siu2 dou3 daai6 ge3 fo2 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他从小到大就是伙伴。
examples.english_sentence: He and I have been partners since we were young.

english_meaning: to collaborate with, to conspire with, to join forces with
explanation_mandarin: 指与他人一起做某事（通常是不好的事情），有勾结，合伙的意思。
explanation_english: To collaborate with someone (often in a negative context), implying collusion or joining forces, often for illicit purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋伙同啲黑社會人士一齊做非法嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fo2 tung4 di1 hak1 se6 wui2 yan4 si6 yat1 cai4 zou6 fei1 faat3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们和黑社会人士一起做非法的事情。
examples.english_sentence: They collaborated with members of the Triads to do illegal things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伙同個同事一齊呃公司啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fo2 tung4 go3 tung4 si6 yat1 cai4 aak1 gung1 si1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和同事一起骗公司的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He conspired with his colleague to swindle money from the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑佢伙同其他人犯案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 keoi5 fo2 tung4 kei4 taa1 yan4 faan6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑他和其它人合伙犯罪。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect that he colluded with others to commit the crime.

mandarin_meaning: 人数; 数量; 份数
english_meaning: number of people; quantity; portions
explanation_mandarin: 指人数，数量或份数。通常用于非正式场合，尤其在吃饭或分东西的时候。
explanation_english: Refers to the number of people, quantity, or portions. Usually used in informal settings, especially when eating or distributing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食飯有幾多伙數呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 faan6 jau5 gei2 do1 fo2 sou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃饭有多少人？
examples.english_sentence: How many people are eating tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕切開四伙數啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 cit3 hoi1 sei3 fo2 sou3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕切成四份刚刚好。
examples.english_sentence: Cutting this cake into four portions is just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢哋總共有幾多伙數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 zung2 gung1 jau5 gei2 do1 fo2 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他们总共有多少人。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how many people they have in total.

mandarin_meaning: 店员; 服务员; 伙伴
english_meaning: shop assistant; waiter/waitress; partner; mate
explanation_mandarin: 1. （旧时）指商店里的店员、伙计。 2. 现在常指餐馆、茶楼等服务行业的员工，如服务员。 3. 有时也指一起工作或合作的人，即伙伴、同事。 4. (非正式) 用于称呼陌生人，尤其是在餐馆等地方引起服务员注意。
explanation_english: 1. (Old usage) Shop assistant or employee in a store. 2. Commonly refers to staff in service industries like restaurants and tea houses, such as waiter/waitress. 3. Sometimes refers to someone you work with or cooperate with, i.e., partner or colleague. 4. (Informal) Used to address a stranger, especially in restaurants, to get their attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伙計，唔該埋單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 gai3, m4 goi1 maai4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员，麻烦结账。
examples.english_sentence: Waiter/Waitress, please bring the bill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係公司嘅好伙計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 hou2 fo2 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是公司的好伙伴。
examples.english_sentence: They are good partners in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲人好多都叫鋪頭嘅員工做伙計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 hou2 do1 dou1 giu3 pou3 tau2 ge3 jyun4 gung1 zou6 fo2 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前很多人都叫店铺的员工做伙计。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many people called shop employees 'shop assistants'.

english_meaning: Waiter/Waitress (in a restaurant); Colleague
explanation_mandarin: 在餐馆或茶餐厅等场所称呼服务人员；也指同事或一起工作的人。
explanation_english: Used to address or refer to waiters/waitresses in restaurants or tea restaurants; Also refers to colleagues or people working together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伙記，埋單！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 gei3, maai4 daan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员，结账！
examples.english_sentence: Waiter/Waitress, the bill please!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同公司嘅伙記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 gung1 si1 ge3 fo2 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同一家公司的同事。
examples.english_sentence: We are colleagues from the same company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個新嚟嘅伙記幾醒目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 san1 lai4 ge3 fo2 gei3 gei2 sing2 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个新来的同事很机灵。
examples.english_sentence: That new colleague is quite clever.

english_meaning: Cook, chef
explanation_mandarin: 指厨房里负责做饭的人，通常是厨师。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge of cooking in the kitchen, usually the cook or chef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間餐廳做伙頭，煮嘢食好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zou6 fo2 tau4, zyu2 je5 sik6 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在餐厅做厨师，做菜很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a cook in a restaurant and is very good at cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯以前都係喺酒樓做伙頭嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 ji5 cin4 dou1 hai6 hai2 zau2 lau4 zou6 fo2 tau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父以前也是在酒楼做厨师的。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle used to be a cook in a restaurant.

english_meaning: cook; chef
explanation_mandarin: 指厨房里负责烹饪的人，即厨师或者伙夫。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge of cooking in the kitchen, namely a cook or chef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明細細個就想做伙頭君，因為佢好鍾意煮嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 soeng2 zou6 fo2 tau4 gwan1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 zyu2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明从小就想当厨师，因为他很喜欢做饭。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming wanted to be a cook since he was little because he likes cooking very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅伙頭君好有經驗，煮嘅嘢食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fo2 tau4 gwan1 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6, zyu2 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的厨师很有经验，做的饭菜很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The chef in this restaurant is very experienced, and the food he cooks is delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 大老粗，没有文化的人当领导
english_meaning: A rough and uncultured person in a leadership position; a person who lacks education but holds authority.
explanation_mandarin: 形容没有文化或水平不高的人当上了领导，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks education or ability and has been promoted to a leadership position. This term is often used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識就做咗老細，真係伙頭將軍囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zau6 zou6 zo2 lou5 sai3, zan1 hai6 fo2 tau4 zoeng1 gwan1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂就当了老板，真是个大老粗。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything and became the boss, he's really a rough and uncultured leader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司而家啲管理層都係伙頭將軍，亂晒籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 di1 gun2 lei5 cang4 dou1 hai6 fo2 tau4 zoeng1 gwan1, lyun6晒lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司现在的管理层都是一些没什么文化的人，乱成一团。
examples.english_sentence: The management team of this company are all uncultured leaders, it's a complete mess.

english_meaning: cook; kitchen staff; amateur/unprofessional group
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队中的炊事人员。也比喻非专业、临时组成的队伍或人员。
explanation_english: Originally referred to kitchen staff in the army. It is also used to describe an amateur or unprofessional team or group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一班伙頭軍嚟㗎，搞搞震冇幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 baan1 fo2 tau4 gwan1 lai4 gaa3, gaau2 gaau2 zan3 mou5 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一帮临时组成的队伍，瞎折腾，没什么帮助。
examples.english_sentence: They are an amateur group, just making a fuss and not being helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好期望太高，始終都係伙頭軍嚟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1, ci2 zung1 dou1 hai6 fo2 tau4 gwan1 lai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要期望太高，毕竟只是些非专业人士而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't expect too much, they are just amateurs after all.

english_meaning: meals; board; provisions
explanation_mandarin: 指集体或机构提供的饭菜或食物供应。
explanation_english: Refers to meals or food supply provided collectively or by an institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司包埋伙食，慳返唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 baau1 maai4 fo2 sik6, haan1 faan1 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司包伙食，省了不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: The company provides meals, saving quite a bit of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校嘅伙食好好，好多學生都鍾意喺學校食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 fo2 sik6 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 hok6 sang1 dou1 zung1 ji3 hai2 hok6 haau6 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校的伙食很好，很多学生都喜欢在学校吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: The meals at this school are very good, many students like to eat at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺工地做嘢，伙食都係自己搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 dei6 zou6 je5, fo2 sik6 dou1 hai6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工地工作，伙食都是自己解决。
examples.english_sentence: He works on the construction site, and he takes care of his own meals.

english_meaning: meal allowance; food expenses
explanation_mandarin: 指用于饮食方面的费用，通常是公司或机构提供的用餐补贴。
explanation_english: Expenses related to food, often a meal allowance provided by a company or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每個月都會畀啲伙食費我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 bei2 di1 fo2 sik6 fai3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每个月都会给我们一些伙食费。
examples.english_sentence: The company gives us some meal allowance every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲嘢咁貴，嗰少少伙食費邊夠使啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, go2 siu2 siu2 fo2 sik6 fai3 bin1 gau3 sai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在东西这么贵，那一点点伙食费哪里够用啊？
examples.english_sentence: Things are so expensive now, is that little meal allowance enough?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工包埋伙食費，都幾好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 baau1 maai4 fo2 sik6 fai3, dou1 gei2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作包括伙食费，挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: His job includes meal allowance, it's quite good.

english_meaning: can, to be able to, will, to meet, to gather, a meeting, an association, a society
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词, 名词, 助动词
explanation_mandarin: 1. 能够，懂得做：会说 | 会游泳。 2. 将要：他会来的。 3. 聚集，相见：开会 | 晚会。 4. 团体，组织：工会 | 教会。
explanation_english: 1. To be able to, to know how to: can speak, can swim. 2. Will, going to: He will come. 3. To meet, to gather: to hold a meeting, evening party. 4. A group, an organization: Labour Union, Church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識講廣東話，但係唔係講得好會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, daan6 hai6 m4 hai6 gong2 dak1 hou2 wui5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会说广东话，但是说得不太好。
examples.english_sentence: I can speak Cantonese, but I don't speak it very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日會唔會嚟呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天会来吗？
examples.english_sentence: Will you come tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚有個聯歡會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 jau5 go3 lyun4 fun1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚有一个联欢会。
examples.english_sentence: We have a party tonight.

english_meaning: How; How come; What's up; What's wrong
explanation_mandarin: 在口语中， "伝" 表示询问情况，原因，或者惊讶，类似于普通话的“怎么”，“怎么样”。常用在句首或句中。
explanation_english: In colloquial Cantonese, "伝" (dim2) is used to ask about a situation, reason, or express surprise. It's similar to "How?" or "What's up?" in English. It's commonly used at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伝解畫呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 waa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 怎么回事啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's going on?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伝解你咁唔開心嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 nei5 gam3 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么不开心？
examples.english_sentence: How come you are so unhappy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伝算呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: What should we do?

english_meaning: child; kid; children
explanation_mandarin: 指小孩子，多用于口语。
explanation_english: Refers to children, mostly used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班伢仔好鬼嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 ngaa4 zai2 hou2 gwai2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群孩子很吵。
examples.english_sentence: That group of children are very noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好蝦啲細伢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haa1 di1 sai3 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要欺负小孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bully the young children.

english_meaning: small child, baby, infant
explanation_mandarin: 指小孩子，通常是比较小的孩子或婴儿。语气比较亲昵。
explanation_english: Refers to a small child, usually a very young child or baby. The tone is affectionate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔仲係伢伢仔，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 zung6 hai6 ngaa4 ngaa4 zai2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的孩子还是个小婴儿，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: His child is still a baby, he doesn't understand anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好蝦啲伢伢仔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 haa1 di1 ngaa4 ngaa4 zai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要欺负小孩子了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bully the small children.

mandarin_meaning: 伯父; 大伯; 叔伯
english_meaning: father's elder brother; uncle (father's elder brother); elder
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲的哥哥，即伯父；也可用作对年长男性的尊称。
explanation_english: Refers to one's father's elder brother (paternal uncle). Can also be used as a respectful form of address for an older man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去伯父屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 baak3 fu2 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去伯父家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to my uncle's house for Chinese New Year visit tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李伯，早晨！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 baak3, zou2 san4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李伯，早安！
examples.english_sentence: Good morning, Uncle Lee!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大伯好錫我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 baak3 hou2 sek3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大伯很疼我们。
examples.english_sentence: My eldest uncle is very fond of us.
