english_meaning: neck and neck, about the same, equally matched
explanation_mandarin: 形容两者水平或能力差不多，难分高下。
explanation_english: Describes two things or people as being of similar ability or level, with little to distinguish between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅成績伯仲之間，都好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leong5 go3 ge3 sing4 jik1 baak3 zung6 zi1 gaan1, dou1 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的成绩不相上下，都很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Their results are neck and neck, both are very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅產品喺市場上競爭激烈，品質都伯仲之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 ging6 zang1 gik1 lit6, ban2 zat1 dou1 baak3 zung6 zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的产品在市场上竞争激烈，质量也难分高下。
examples.english_sentence: The competition between these two companies' products is fierce in the market, and the quality is about the same.

english_meaning: Uncle (father's older brother); a polite form of address for an older man
explanation_mandarin: 称呼父亲的哥哥。 也可用于礼貌地称呼年长的男性。
explanation_english: Refers to one's father's older brother. It can also be used as a polite way to address an older man, similar to 'Uncle' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去伯伯屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 baak3 baak1 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去伯父家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to our uncle's house to celebrate Chinese New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯伯，唔該幫我攞個行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 baak1, m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 lo2 go3 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔，请帮我拿一下行李。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, please help me with my luggage.

english_meaning: Earth God, local deity
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中对土地神的称呼，通常保佑地方平安、五谷丰登。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, a term for the Earth God, a local deity who is believed to protect the area and ensure good harvests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年過年我哋都會去拜伯公，祈求一家平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 baai3 baak3 gung1, kei4 kau4 jat1 gaa1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年过年我们都会去拜土地公，祈求一家平安。
examples.english_sentence: Every Lunar New Year, we go to worship the Earth God, praying for peace and safety for the whole family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟細細地，但係個伯公好靈㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 sai3 sai3 dei6, daan6 hai6 go3 baak3 gung1 hou2 ling4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间庙小小的，但是那个土地公很灵验的。
examples.english_sentence: The temple is small, but the Earth God there is very efficacious.

mandarin_meaning: 土地公树；被视为土地公庇佑的树
english_meaning: God of Earth tree; tree believed to be protected by the God of Earth
explanation_mandarin: 指在一些地方，人们会认为某些树木是土地公所庇佑的，通常会在树旁设置土地公的神位或香炉，进行祭拜。这种树就被称为“伯公树”。
explanation_english: Refers to a tree that is believed to be protected by the God of Earth (土地公). In some places, people will set up a shrine or incense burner next to the tree and worship it. Such a tree is called a "God of Earth tree".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋村口有棵好大嘅伯公樹，啲村民成日去拜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cyun1 hau2 jau5 fo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 baak3 gung1 syu6, di1 cyun1 man4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 baai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们村口有一棵很大的土地公树，村民们经常去拜。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big God of Earth tree at the entrance of our village, and the villagers often go to worship it.

english_meaning: Belize
explanation_mandarin: 中美洲国家伯利兹的音译名称。
explanation_english: Transliteration of the name of Belize, a country in Central America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講伯利茲嘅潛水好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 gong2 baak3 lei6 zi1 ge3 cim4 seoi2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说伯利兹的潜水很有名。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that diving in Belize is very famous.

english_meaning: Friend with benefits; casual sexual partner
explanation_mandarin: 指关系介于朋友和恋人之间，但主要以性关系维系的伴侣。
explanation_english: Refers to a relationship between friends and lovers, but mainly maintained through a sexual relationship.  A 'friend with benefits'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話自己係伯友關係，唔會認真發展落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 baak3 jau2 gwaan1 hai6, m4 wui5 jing6 zan1 faat3 zin2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他们是炮友关系，不会认真发展下去。
examples.english_sentence: They say they have a friends-with-benefits relationship and won't seriously develop it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點睇伯友呢種關係？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 tai2 baak3 jau2 ni1 zung2 gwaan1 hai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么看待炮友这种关系？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think of the friends-with-benefits relationship?

english_meaning: Aunt (father's elder brother's wife)
explanation_mandarin: 称呼父亲的哥哥的妻子。
explanation_english: The wife of one's father's elder brother. Used as a form of address for one's father's elder brother's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去伯娘屋企拜年呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 baak3 noeng4 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去伯母家拜年啊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to my aunt's house for Chinese New Year tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯娘煮嘅嘢食好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 noeng4 zyu2 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯母做的东西很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: My aunt's cooking is very delicious!

mandarin_meaning: 老奶奶; 祖母的长辈
english_meaning: Great-aunt (paternal grandfather's sister); Old woman (polite term)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指祖父的姐妹，即伯祖母。2. (敬称)年纪较大的女性。
explanation_english: 1. Father's aunt (grandfather's sister).  2. (Respectful term) Elderly woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個伯婆好錫啲細路仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 baak3 po4 hou2 sek3 di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位老奶奶很疼爱小孩子。
examples.english_sentence: That old lady is very fond of children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺嗰個伯婆已經過咗身好多年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 go2 go3 baak3 po4 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 san1 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷的那位伯祖母已经去世很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather's great-aunt has already passed away for many years.

synonyms: 婆婆 (po4 po4) (can also refer to older women in general)

english_meaning: To have a creepy feeling; To have goosebumps (from fear); To feel uneasy and uncomfortable
explanation_mandarin: 形容因害怕、不安或受到惊吓而感到不舒服或起鸡皮疙瘩的感觉。 类似“毛骨悚然”。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being uncomfortable or having goosebumps due to fear, unease, or being startled. Similar to 'having the creeps'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋咁黑咁靜，搞到我伯有呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gam3 hak1 gam3 zing6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 baak3 jau5 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子这么黑这么静，搞得我心里发毛啊！
examples.english_sentence: The house is so dark and quiet, it gives me the creeps!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢令我覺得伯有，唔想再同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 baak3 jau5, m4 soeng2 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话让我觉得心里发毛，不想再和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: What he said made me feel uneasy, I don't want to talk to him anymore.

english_meaning: Bole, someone who recognizes and cultivates talent; talent scout; astute judge of ability
explanation_mandarin: 比喻善于发现、选拔和使用人才的人。
explanation_english: A person who is good at discovering, selecting, and utilizing talented individuals; a talent scout or someone who appreciates talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係我嘅伯樂，如果唔係佢，我都唔會有今日嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 baak3 lok6, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 jau5 gam1 jat6 ge3 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是我的伯乐，如果不是他，我也不会有今天的成就。
examples.english_sentence: He's really my Bole; if it weren't for him, I wouldn't have the achievements I have today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好難得遇到一個伯樂賞識自己嘅才能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 naan4 dak1 jyu6 dou2 jat1 go3 baak3 lok6 soeng2 sik1 zi6 gei2 ge3 coi4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很难得遇到一个伯乐赏识自己的才能。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to encounter a talent scout who appreciates your talent.

english_meaning: Aunt (father's elder brother's wife), Madam
explanation_mandarin: 称呼父亲的哥哥的妻子。也用于尊称与自己父母同辈的已婚女性。
explanation_english: Term of address for the wife of one's father's elder brother. Also used as a respectful form of address for a woman of one's parents' generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯母，你好呀！我係小明嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 mou5, nei5 hou2 aa3! ngo5 hai6 siu2 ming4 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯母，您好！我是小明的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Auntie, hello! I'm a friend of Siu Ming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去伯母屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 baak3 mou5 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去伯母家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to my aunt's house tomorrow for Chinese New Year.

english_meaning: Earl, Count (noble title); Piaget (Swiss watch brand)
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲贵族爵位的一种，等级在侯爵之下，子爵之上。 另外，也指瑞士名表品牌“伯爵”。
explanation_english: A title of nobility in Europe, ranking below a marquis and above a viscount. It can also refer to the Swiss watch brand Piaget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個伯爵，屋企好有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 baak3 zoek3, uk1 kei5 hou2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个伯爵，家里很有钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is an Earl and his family is very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意伯爵錶嘅設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 baak3 zoek3 biu1 ge3 sai3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢伯爵表的设计。
examples.english_sentence: I really like the design of Piaget watches.

english_meaning: father's elder brother; uncle (father's elder brother); a polite form of address for a man of one's father's generation
explanation_mandarin: 称呼父亲的哥哥；也用于尊称与父亲辈分相当的男性长辈。
explanation_english: Term of address for father's elder brother; also used as a respectful form of address for a man of one's father's generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會同阿爸去拜訪我嘅伯父。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 tung4 aa3 baa1 heoi3 baai3 fong2 ngo5 ge3 baak3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会和爸爸去拜访我的伯父。
examples.english_sentence: I will visit my uncle (father's elder brother) with my father tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯父，你好！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 fu6, nei5 hou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父，您好！
examples.english_sentence: Hello, Uncle!

english_meaning: Father-in-law (husband's father)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的父亲，即公公。
explanation_english: Refers to the father of one's husband; father-in-law (husband's father).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要同我老公返去見伯爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 lou5 gung1 faan1 heoi3 gin3 baak3 je4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要和我老公回去见公公。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go back with my husband to see my father-in-law tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯爺好錫佢個孫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 je4 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公公很疼爱他的孙子。
examples.english_sentence: The father-in-law loves his grandson very much.

english_meaning: Great-uncle (paternal grandfather's brother)
explanation_mandarin: 指爷爷的哥哥，即伯祖父。
explanation_english: Refers to the brother of one's paternal grandfather; great-uncle (paternal side).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時，成日去伯爺公屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, sing4 jat6 heoi3 baak3 je4 gung1 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去伯祖父家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to my great-uncle's house to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯爺公好錫我哋啲後生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 je4 gung1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 dei6 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯祖父很疼爱我们这些年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: My great-uncle is very fond of us young people.

english_meaning: Great-grandmother (paternal side)
explanation_mandarin: 指祖父的母亲，即爷爷的妈妈。
explanation_english: Refers to the mother of one's grandfather, i.e., the grandmother on the paternal side. It's a respectful term for one's great-grandmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日去伯爺婆屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 baak3 je4 po4 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去老祖母家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to my great-grandmother's house to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伯爺婆今年已經一百歲，身體都仲好硬朗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 je4 po4 gam1 nin4 ji5 ging1 jat1 baak3 seoi3, san1 tai2 dou1 zung1 hou2 ngaang6 long5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老祖母今年已经一百岁了，身体还很硬朗。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandmother is already one hundred years old this year, and she is still very healthy.

english_meaning: President (of a country)
explanation_mandarin: 音译词，指总统。通常指美国总统。
explanation_english: A transliteration of the word "President," usually referring to the President of the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國嘅伯理璽天德換咗人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 ge3 baa3 lei5 sai2 tin1 dak1 wun6 zo2 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国的总统换人了。
examples.english_sentence: The President of the United States has changed.

english_meaning: to guess, to estimate, to reckon
explanation_mandarin: 推测，估计，根据不充分的依据进行判断。
explanation_english: To guess, estimate, or reckon something based on incomplete or limited information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估佢聽日會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜他明天会来。
examples.english_sentence: I guess he will come tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估下呢份嘢值幾多錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 haa5 ni1 fan6 je5 zik6 gei2 do1 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜猜这份东西值多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: Can you guess how much this thing is worth?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估計佢唔會同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 gai3 keoi5 m4 wui5 tung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计他不会同意。
examples.english_sentence: I reckon he won't agree.

english_meaning: guessing, just guessing, speculating
explanation_mandarin: 指随便地猜测，没有认真思考或精确的依据。
explanation_english: Refers to casually guessing without serious thought or precise evidence. It implies a lighthearted or uncertain approach to making an assumption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估估下啫，唔好咁認真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 gu2 haa5 ze1, m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是随便猜猜而已，不要那么认真啦。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just guessing, don't take it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都係估估下，唔一定啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 hai6 gu2 gu2 haa5, m4 jat1 ding6 ngaam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也是随便猜猜，不一定对的。
examples.english_sentence: You're just guessing, it's not necessarily correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋估估下佢會唔會嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gu2 gu2 haa5 keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们猜猜他会不会来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's guess whether he will come or not.

english_meaning: valuation, estimate, assess the value
explanation_mandarin: 评估价值；估计价格。
explanation_english: To assess the value of something; to estimate the price or worth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅估值超過一百億。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gu2 zik6 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 baak3 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的估值超过一百亿元。
examples.english_sentence: The valuation of this company exceeds 10 billion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗專業人士嚟做估值報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cheng2 zo2 zyun1 jip6 yan4 si6 lai4 zou6 gu2 zik6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了专业人士来做估值报告。
examples.english_sentence: They hired professionals to do a valuation report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要重新估值呢個項目嘅潛力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 san1 gu2 zik6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 cim4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要重新评估这个项目的潜力。
examples.english_sentence: We need to re-evaluate the potential of this project.

english_meaning: to estimate (value or price), to appraise, to value
explanation_mandarin: 对物品或服务进行估算，确定其价值或价格。
explanation_english: To estimate or appraise the value or price of an item or service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵人嚟幫間屋估價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 bong1 gaan1 uk1 gu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找人来帮这间房子估价。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find someone to appraise the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估價太高喇，冇人會買㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 gaa3 taai3 go1 laa3, mou5 jan4 wui5 maai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你估价太高了，没有人会买的。
examples.english_sentence: Your price estimate is too high, no one will buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行會請專業人士嚟估價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 wui5 ceng2 zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6 lai4 gu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行会请专业人士来估价。
examples.english_sentence: The bank will hire professionals to do the appraisal.

english_meaning: didn't expect; unexpectedly; surprisingly
explanation_mandarin: 表示出乎意料，没有预料到。
explanation_english: Expresses surprise or unexpectedness. It means that something was not anticipated or predicted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到佢咁後生就攞獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 lo2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到他这么年轻就获奖了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect him to win an award at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到今日咁多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou2 gam1 jat6 gam3 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到今天这么多人。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect so many people today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到你會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou2 nei5 wui5 gam3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到你会这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect you to do that.

english_meaning: To guess the song (game); musical charades
explanation_mandarin: 一种游戏，通过听一小段音乐或歌声来猜测歌名或歌曲。
explanation_english: A game where players guess a song by listening to a short excerpt of the music or singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚不如玩估歌仔啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 bat1 jyu4 waan2 gu2 go1 zai2 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚不如玩猜歌游戏吧？
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we play a song-guessing game tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢估歌仔好叻㗎，通常都估中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu2 go1 zai2 hou2 lek1 gaa3, tung1 soeng4 dou1 gu2 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他猜歌很厉害的，通常都能猜中。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good at guessing songs, he usually gets them right.

english_meaning: to estimate, to calculate roughly
explanation_mandarin: 大概地計算或預測。
explanation_english: To make an approximate calculation or prediction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要估算吓今年嘅收入先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gu2 syun3 haa5 gam1 nin4 ge3 sau1 jap6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得先估算一下今年的收入。
examples.english_sentence: We need to estimate this year's income first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估算吓幾耐先會落完雨？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 syun3 haa5 gei2 noi6 sin1 wui5 lok6 jyun4 jyu5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你估計一下要多久才会下完雨？
examples.english_sentence: Estimate how long it will take for the rain to stop.

english_meaning: estimate; reckon; assess; suppose
explanation_mandarin: 推测；估计；大概计算。
explanation_english: To estimate; to reckon; to assess; to suppose. To make an approximate calculation or judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估計佢聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 gai3 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: I estimate that it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估計呢份工嘅人工大約有兩萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 gai3 ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 daai6 joek3 jau5 loeng5 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计这份工作的工资大约有两万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: I reckon the salary for this job is about twenty thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁估計，要有證據先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gu2 gai3, jiu3 jau5 zing3 geoi3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便乱猜，要有证据才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just guess wildly, you need evidence.

english_meaning: to guess; to estimate; to suppose
explanation_mandarin: 猜测、估算，通常指对某件事进行推测或估量。
explanation_english: To guess, estimate, or suppose. It usually refers to making a conjecture or estimate about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估話佢今日唔會嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 waa6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计他今天不会来了。
examples.english_sentence: I guess he won't come today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估話佢幾時會返嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 waa6 keoi5 gei2 si4 wui5 faan1 lei4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你估计他什么时候会回来？
examples.english_sentence: When do you reckon he'll be back?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估話呢件事唔係咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 waa6 ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计这件事没那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: I suppose this matter isn't so simple.

english_meaning: To guess the leader's intentions; to second-guess the leader
explanation_mandarin: 指猜测领导的想法或意图，以便迎合他们或做出符合他们期望的行动。
explanation_english: Refers to guessing the leader's thoughts or intentions in order to cater to them or take actions that meet their expectations. Often used in a negative context, implying a lack of independent thinking and excessive compliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日估領袖啦，應該自己諗清楚先做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gu2 ling5 zau6 laa1, ying1 goi1 zi6 gei2 lam2 ching1 chu2 sin1 zou6 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是猜测领导意图了，应该自己想清楚再做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to guess the leader's intentions, you should think clearly for yourself before doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最叻就係估領袖，所以升得咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 lek1 zau6 hai6 gu2 ling5 zau6, so2 ji5 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最擅长的就是猜测领导意图，所以升得这么快。
examples.english_sentence: His greatest talent is guessing the leader's intentions, which is why he got promoted so quickly.

english_meaning: to accompany; to keep company; to partner
explanation_mandarin: 陪同；陪伴。
explanation_english: To accompany; to be with someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想搵人伴我睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 soeng2 wan2 jan4 bun6 ngo5 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想找人陪我看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find someone to accompany me to watch a movie tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日伴住佢阿婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bun6 zyu6 keoi5 aa3 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她总是陪伴着他/她的奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: He/She always keeps his/her grandma company.

english_meaning: partner, companion
explanation_mandarin: 指在一起生活、工作或旅行的人，通常指夫妻、情侣或亲密的同伴。
explanation_english: A person with whom one lives, works, or travels with; usually refers to spouses, romantic partners, or close companions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係一對好好嘅伴侶，成日都一齊去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 jat1 deoi3 hou2 hou2 ge3 bun6 leoi5, sing4 jat6 dou1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是一对很好的伴侣，经常一起去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They are a great couple, and they often travel together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以搵到一個可以共度一生嘅伴侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 jat1 go3 ho2 ji5 gung6 dou6 jat1 sang1 ge3 bun6 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以找到一个可以共度一生的伴侣。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to find a partner to spend my life with.

english_meaning: Serving a ruler is like living with a tiger; serving a king is a precarious business
explanation_mandarin: 形容陪伴在君王身边就像陪伴在老虎身边一样危险，一不小心就会惹祸上身。
explanation_english: Describes the precariousness of serving a ruler, comparing it to living with a tiger, where one wrong move can bring about disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代做皇帝嘅近身侍衛，真係伴君如伴虎，要時刻小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6 zou6 wong4 dai3 ge3 gan6 san1 si6 wai6, zan1 hai6 bun6 gwan1 jyu4 bun6 fu2, jiu3 si4 hak1 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代做皇帝的近身侍卫，真是伴君如伴虎，要时刻小心。
examples.english_sentence: Being a personal guard to the emperor in ancient times was truly like living with a tiger; you had to be careful at all times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司做嘢都要小心，尤其係面對啲高層，有時真係伴君如伴虎呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 je5 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1, jau4 kei4 hai6 min6 deoi3 di1 gou1 cang4, jau5 si4 zan1 hai6 bun6 gwan1 jyu4 bun6 fu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司工作也要小心，尤其是面对那些高层，有时真是伴君如伴虎啊。
examples.english_sentence: You have to be careful working in the company, especially when dealing with the senior management; sometimes it's really like serving a tiger.

english_meaning: backing vocals, to sing backup
explanation_mandarin: 为主要歌手提供背景音乐或和声。
explanation_english: To provide backing vocals or harmony for a main singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗啲專業伴唱嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 di1 zyun1 jip6 bun6 coeng3 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了一些专业的伴唱来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: They hired some professional backing vocalists to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要多啲人嚟做伴唱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 do1 di1 jan4 lai4 zou6 bun6 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多人来做伴唱。
examples.english_sentence: We need more people to sing backup.

english_meaning: accompaniment; to accompany
explanation_mandarin: 用乐器或歌唱来衬托主要的乐器或歌唱。
explanation_english: To provide a musical accompaniment; the musical part that provides the accompaniment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鋼琴彈得好好，成日幫人伴奏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong3 kam4 taan4 dak1 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4 bun6 zau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他钢琴弹得很好，经常帮别人伴奏。
examples.english_sentence: He plays the piano very well and often accompanies others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅伴奏好優美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 bun6 zau3 hou2 jau1 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的伴奏很优美。
examples.english_sentence: The accompaniment of this song is very beautiful.

english_meaning: bridesmaid
explanation_mandarin: 婚礼中陪伴新娘的女性朋友，通常负责协助新娘处理婚礼事宜。
explanation_english: A female friend or relative who attends the bride at a wedding and helps her with various tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次結婚，搵咗佢嘅兩個表妹做伴娘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 git3 fan1, wan2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 loeng5 go3 biu2 mui2 zou6 bun6 noeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这次结婚，找了她的两个表妹做伴娘。
examples.english_sentence: She's getting married this time and asked her two female cousins to be her bridesmaids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做伴娘都幾辛苦㗎，要幫手搞好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bun6 noeng2 dou1 gei2 san1 fu2 gaa3, jiu3 bong1 sau2 gaau2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当伴娘还挺辛苦的，要帮忙处理很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: Being a bridesmaid is quite tiring, you have to help with a lot of things.

english_meaning: backup dancer
explanation_mandarin: 为主要表演者伴随舞蹈的舞者。
explanation_english: A dancer who performs alongside a main performer or singer, typically as part of a choreographed routine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演唱會有成班伴舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 jau5 sing4 baan1 bun6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演唱会有一群伴舞。
examples.english_sentence: His concert has a group of backup dancers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想成為一個專業嘅伴舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 zyun1 jip6 ge3 bun6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她梦想成为一个专业的伴舞。
examples.english_sentence: She dreams of becoming a professional backup dancer.

english_meaning: groomsman, best man
explanation_mandarin: 婚礼中协助新郎的人，通常是新郎的朋友或家人。
explanation_english: A male attendant to the bridegroom at a wedding, usually a close friend or relative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月結婚，請咗我做伴郎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 fan1, cheng2 zo2 ngo5 zou6 bun6 long4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月结婚，请我做伴郎。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting married next month and asked me to be a groomsman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅伴郎團好後生，個個都好靚仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 bun6 long4 tyun4 hou2 hau6 saang1, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 leng3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的伴郎团很年轻，个个都很帅。
examples.english_sentence: Their groomsmen party is very young and everyone is very handsome.

english_meaning: to accompany; to follow; to go along with; to attend
explanation_mandarin: 指跟随、陪伴，一同发生或存在。
explanation_english: To accompany, to follow, to occur or exist together with something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅成長伴隨住好多開心嘅回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 sing4 zoeng2 bun6 ceoi4 zyu6 hou2 do1 hoi1 sam1 ge3 wui4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的成长伴随着很多开心的回忆。
examples.english_sentence: Our growth is accompanied by many happy memories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個病通常伴隨住發燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng6 tung1 soeng4 bun6 ceoi4 zyu6 faat3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个病通常伴随着发烧。
examples.english_sentence: This illness is usually accompanied by fever.

english_meaning: clever, quick-witted, nimble
explanation_mandarin: 形容人机灵，反应快，聪明。
explanation_english: Describes a person as being agile, quick-witted, and clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個細路仔好伶俐㗎，乜嘢都學得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 ling4 lei6 gaa3, mat1 je5 dou1 hok6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的小孩很聪明伶俐，什么都学得很快。
examples.english_sentence: His child is very clever and quick-witted, learning everything very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個女仔鬼咁伶，識得氹人開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 neoi5 zai2 gwai2 gam3 ling4, sik1 dak1 tam5 jan4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个女孩非常聪明伶俐，懂得哄人开心。
examples.english_sentence: This girl is very clever and knows how to make people happy.

english_meaning: actor; actress; performer (especially in traditional Chinese opera)
explanation_mandarin: 指戏曲演员，也泛指艺人。
explanation_english: Refers to actors and actresses in traditional Chinese opera; also a general term for performers or artists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個已經想做個出色嘅伶人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 soeng2 zou6 go3 ceot1 sik1 ge3 ling4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就想成为一个出色的戏曲演员。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to be an outstanding opera performer since he was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔好少會學做伶人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 siu2 wui5 hok6 zou6 ling4 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少有年轻人学习做戏曲演员了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, few young people learn to be opera performers.

english_meaning: lonely, solitary, isolated
explanation_mandarin: 形容孤单，没有人依靠。
explanation_english: Describes being lonely, alone, and without anyone to rely on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人住喺山上面，覺得好伶仃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6, gok3 dak1 hou2 ling4 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人住在山上，觉得很孤独。
examples.english_sentence: He lives alone on the mountain and feels very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗咁多嘢之後，佢變得好伶仃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 je5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 bin3 dak1 hou2 ling4 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历这么多事之后，他变得很孤独。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so much, he became very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到啲老人家自己一個行街，真係覺得佢哋好伶仃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 haang4 gaai1, zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 hou2 ling4 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那些老人家自己一个人逛街，真的觉得他们很孤单。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing those elderly people walking alone on the street, I really feel that they are very lonely.

english_meaning: Lingdingyang (Lingding Ocean, an area of sea in the Pearl River Estuary)
explanation_mandarin: 伶仃洋，是珠江口外的一个海域，位于香港以西，澳门以东。以内伶仃岛而得名。
explanation_english: Lingdingyang is an area of sea in the Pearl River Estuary, located west of Hong Kong and east of Macau. It is named after Nei Lingding Island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 港珠澳大橋橫跨伶仃洋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zyu1 ou3 daai6 kiu4 waang4 kwaa3 ling4 ding1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 港珠澳大桥横跨伶仃洋。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge spans the Lingding Ocean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭船經過伶仃洋，風浪好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 syun4 ging1 gwo3 ling4 ding1 joeng4, fung1 long6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐船经过伶仃洋，风浪很大。
examples.english_sentence: We passed through Lingding Ocean by boat, and the waves were very big.

english_meaning: clever, quick-witted, nimble, bright, sharp
explanation_mandarin: 形容人聪明，反应快，做事敏捷。
explanation_english: Describes someone as clever, quick-witted, and agile in their actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女好伶俐，學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi5 hou2 ling4 lei6, hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女儿很聪明伶俐，学东西很快。
examples.english_sentence: Her daughter is very clever and learns things quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路仔幾伶俐㗎，醒目過人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 gei2 ling4 lei6 gaa3, seng2 muk6 gwo3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩子挺伶俐的，比别人聪明。
examples.english_sentence: This kid is quite clever, more intelligent than others.

mandarin_meaning: 伶牙俐齿 (líng yá lì chǐ)
english_meaning: eloquent; having a sharp tongue; quick-witted and articulate; glib
explanation_mandarin: 形容人口齿伶俐，能说会道，反应敏捷。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is eloquent, articulate, and quick-witted. Often implies a cleverness in speech, sometimes to the point of being glib or using words skillfully to their advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔伶牙利齒，次次辯論都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 ling4 ngaa4 lei6 ci2, ci3 ci3 bin6 leon6 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人伶牙俐齿，每次辩论都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's so eloquent that he wins every debate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢咁多，佢伶牙利齒㗎，呃你都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gam3 do1, keoi5 ling4 ngaa4 lei6 ci2 gaa3, aak1 nei5 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太相信他，他伶牙俐齿的，骗你都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him too much; he's very glib and could easily trick you without you realizing it.

english_meaning: to stretch, to extend, to reach out
explanation_mandarin: 将肢体或物体向外或向上延伸。 引申指扩展，延展。
explanation_english: To stretch out a limb or object. By extension, it can also mean to expand or extend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伸手俾我睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 sau2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伸手给我看看。
examples.english_sentence: Stretch out your hand and let me see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伸晒啲手腳出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 saai3 di1 sau2 goek3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把手脚都伸展开了。
examples.english_sentence: He stretched out his arms and legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樹枝伸到好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu6 zi1 san1 dou3 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树枝伸展得很远。
examples.english_sentence: The branches stretched out very far.

english_meaning: to extend, to stretch out, to reach out
explanation_mandarin: 指向外或向前伸展。
explanation_english: To extend outwards or forwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伸出手想同我握手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 ceot1 sau2 soeng2 tung4 ngo5 ak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伸出手想和我握手。
examples.english_sentence: He extended his hand to shake hands with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樹嘅枝條伸出嚟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu6 ge3 zi1 tiu4 san1 ceot1 lai4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树的枝条都伸出来了。
examples.english_sentence: The branches of the trees have all stretched out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伸出援手幫人係一件好事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ceot1 wun4 sau2 bong1 yan4 hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伸出援手帮助别人是一件好事。
examples.english_sentence: Lending a helping hand to others is a good thing.

english_meaning: to stretch, to extend, to expand
explanation_mandarin: 拉長或擴大身體或物體的長度或範圍。
explanation_english: To lengthen or widen the body or an object by pulling or extending it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做運動之前，記得要伸展吓啲筋骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wan6 dung6 zi1 cin4, gei3 dak1 jiu3 san1 zin2 haa5 di1 gin1 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动之前，记得要伸展一下筋骨。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to stretch your muscles before exercising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伸展雙手想攞到個波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 zin2 soeng1 sau2 soeng2 lo2 dou2 go3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伸展双手想要拿到那个球。
examples.english_sentence: He stretched out his hands to get the ball.

english_meaning: to extend, to stretch, to prolong, to spread
explanation_mandarin: 指向某个事物在空间或时间上扩展或延续。
explanation_english: To extend or stretch out in space or time; to prolong or continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路伸延到山頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 san1 jin4 dou3 saan1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路延伸到山顶。
examples.english_sentence: The road extends to the top of the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅影響力伸延到海外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 san1 jin4 dou3 hoi2 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的影响力延伸到海外。
examples.english_sentence: Their influence extends overseas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望呢個項目可以伸延我哋嘅業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ho2 ji5 san1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这个项目可以延伸我们的业务。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully this project can extend our business.

english_meaning: to uphold, to promote, to extend, to vindicate, to assert
explanation_mandarin: 扩展、推广、维护（正义等）。
explanation_english: To extend, promote, or uphold (especially justice, rights, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要伸張正義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 san1 zoeng1 zeng3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要伸张正义。
examples.english_sentence: We must uphold justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋致力於伸張人權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi3 lik6 jyu1 san1 zoeng1 jan4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们致力于伸张人权。
examples.english_sentence: They are dedicated to promoting human rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要伸張自己嘅權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 san1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyun4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要伸张自己的权利。
examples.english_sentence: We need to assert our own rights.

english_meaning: to uphold justice; to champion justice; to see justice done
explanation_mandarin: 主持公道，维护正义。
explanation_english: To uphold what is right and fair; to advocate for justice and ensure it prevails.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗伸張正義，唔怕得罪啲有權有勢嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 liu5 san1 zoeng1 zing3 ji6, m4 paa3 dak1 zeoi5 di1 jau5 kuen4 jau5 sai3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了伸张正义，他不怕得罪那些有权有势的人。
examples.english_sentence: In order to uphold justice, he is not afraid of offending those who are powerful and influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該企出嚟伸張正義，唔好俾啲壞人繼續橫行霸道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 kei5 chut1 lai4 san1 zoeng1 zing3 ji6, m4 hou2 bei2 di1 waai6 jan4 gai3 zuk1 waang4 hang4 baa3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该站出来伸张正义，不要让坏人继续横行霸道。
examples.english_sentence: We should stand up to uphold justice and not let the bad guys continue to act lawlessly and tyrannically.

english_meaning: to stretch
explanation_mandarin: 舒展身体，通常在早上或长时间坐着后。
explanation_english: To stretch one's body, usually in the morning or after sitting for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝朝起身都會伸個懶腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 ziu1 hei2 san1 dou1 wui5 san1 go3 laan5 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天早上起床都会伸个懒腰。
examples.english_sentence: I stretch every morning when I get up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐咗咁耐，伸返個懶腰先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 zo2 gam3 noi6, san1 faan1 go3 laan5 jiu1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐了这么久，先伸个懒腰。
examples.english_sentence: I've been sitting for so long, let me stretch first.

english_meaning: to stretch out one's hand; to ask for help; to rely on others (often negatively)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是伸出手。比喻向别人要东西或者依赖别人。
explanation_english: Literally means to stretch out one's hand. Figuratively, it means to ask for something from others or to rely on others, often with a negative connotation suggesting laziness or dependence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日伸手問屋企攞錢啦，自己搵嘢做下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 san1 sau2 man6 uk1 kei2 lo2 cin2 laa1, zi6 gei2 wan2 je5 zou6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是伸手问家里要钱了，自己找点事情做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always ask your family for money, find something to do yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好懶，咩都想伸手攞著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 laan5, me1 dou1 soeng2 san1 sau2 lo2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很懒，什么都想伸手占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's very lazy, he always wants to get advantages without putting in any effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住靠伸手，凡事要靠自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 kaau3 san1 sau2, faan4 si6 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着依靠别人，凡事都要靠自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about relying on others, you need to rely on yourself for everything.

jyutping: san1 sau2 bat1 gin3 ng5 zi2
english_meaning: pitch black; so dark you can't see your hand in front of your face
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常黑暗，什么都看不见。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where it is extremely dark, to the point where you cannot see anything, even your own hand in front of your face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日落大雨，行入條後巷，伸手不見五指，乜都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, haang4 jap6 tiu4 hau6 hong2, san1 sau2 bat1 gin3 ng5 zi2, mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天下了大雨，走进那条后巷，伸手不见五指，什么都看不到。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday it rained heavily, and when I walked into that back alley, it was pitch black; I couldn't see anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停電之後，間屋伸手不見五指，我即刻搵咗支蠟燭出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 din6 zi1 hau6, gaan1 uk1 san1 sau2 bat1 gin3 ng5 zi2, ngo5 zik1 hak1 wan2 zo2 zi1 laap6 zuk1 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停电之后，房间里伸手不见五指，我立刻找了一支蜡烛出来。
examples.english_sentence: After the power outage, the room was pitch black, so I immediately found a candle.

synonyms: 烏燈黑火 (wu1 dang1 hak1 fo2)

english_meaning: Freeloader, someone who relies on others to do everything for them, a person who asks for help without making any effort themselves.
explanation_mandarin: 指那些遇到问题不经过自己思考和努力，直接向别人求助的人，形容依赖性强，不主动。
explanation_english: Refers to people who, when faced with a problem, don't think or make an effort themselves, but directly ask others for help. It describes someone with strong dependency and a lack of initiative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做伸手派啦，自己試下搵資料先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 san1 sau2 paai3 laa1, zi6 gei2 si3 haa5 wan2 zi1 liu2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别做伸手党了，自己试着找资料先吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a freeloader, try to find the information yourself first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日問人攞功課答案，真係典型嘅伸手派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 man6 jan4 lo2 gung1 fo3 daap3 aan3, zan1 hai6 din2 jing4 ge3 san1 sau2 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是问别人要作业答案，真是典型的伸手党。
examples.english_sentence: He always asks others for homework answers, he's a typical freeloader.

english_meaning: People who rely on others for money or support, moochers, freeloaders; literally 'reaching-hand party'
explanation_mandarin: 指那些依赖他人经济支持的人，特别是指成年后仍然依靠父母供养的年轻人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are financially dependent on others, especially young adults who are supported by their parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都三十幾歲人啦，仲係個伸手黨，真係唔生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 saam1 sap6 gei2 seoi3 jan4 laa3, zung6 hai6 go3 san1 sau2 dong2, zan1 hai6 m4 sang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都三十几岁了，还是个伸手族，真是不争气。
examples.english_sentence: He's already in his thirties and still a freeloader; he's really disappointing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，好多都變成伸手黨，乜都靠屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, hou2 do1 dou1 bin3 sing4 san1 sau2 dong2, mat1 dou1 kaau3 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，很多都变成了伸手族，什么都靠家里人。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people have become freeloaders, relying on their families for everything.

english_meaning: to stretch and contract; to expand and contract; extendable; retractable
explanation_mandarin: 指物体长度或面积的增大和缩小。
explanation_english: Refers to the increase and decrease in the length or area of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個遮可以伸縮，收埋嗰陣唔會咁阻碇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ze1 ho2 ji5 san1 suk1, sau1 maai4 go2 zan6 m4 wui5 gam3 zo2 ding3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把伞可以伸缩，收起来的时候不会那么碍事。
examples.english_sentence: This umbrella is retractable, so it won't be so bulky when folded up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 橡筋有伸縮性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng6 gan1 jau5 san1 suk1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 橡皮筋有伸缩性。
examples.english_sentence: Rubber bands are elastic.

english_meaning: to stretch; to extend; to crane (one's neck)
explanation_mandarin: 使某物变得更长；将身体的一部分延长。
explanation_english: To make something longer; to extend a part of the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伸長條頸想睇清楚發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 coeng4 tiu4 geng2 soeng2 tai2 cing1 co2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伸长脖子想看清楚发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He craned his neck to see clearly what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好伸長隻手攞嘢，企起身啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 san1 coeng4 zek3 sau2 lo2 je5, kei5 hei2 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要伸长手臂拿东西，站起来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stretch your arm to get things, stand up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路伸長去到好遠嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 san1 coeng4 heoi3 dou3 hou2 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路延伸到很远的地方。
examples.english_sentence: This road extends to a very far place.

english_meaning: to serve; to attend to; to wait on
explanation_mandarin: 服侍，照料。 多用于较为正式的场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To serve, to attend to, to wait on. Often used in more formal contexts or written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都伺候佢阿嫲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 ci5 hau6 keoi5 aa3 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都照顾他的奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: He takes care of his grandma every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企伺候啲花草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 ci5 hau6 di1 faa1 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里照料花草。
examples.english_sentence: He tends to the flowers and plants at home.

english_meaning: to serve; to attend to; to look after
explanation_mandarin: 服侍，照顾，通常指比较周到的照顾或服务。
explanation_english: To serve or attend to someone, usually implying attentive and thorough care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日伺候佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 ci5 hau6 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都侍候他妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He serves his mother every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使伺候我，我自己嚟就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 ci5 hau6 ngo5, ngo5 zi6 gei2 lai4 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用伺候我，我自己来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to serve me, I can do it myself.

english_meaning: server
explanation_mandarin: 提供网络服务的计算机系统或软件。
explanation_english: A computer system or software that provides services to other computer systems or clients over a network.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個伺服器壞咗，所以上唔到網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si6 fuk6 hei3 waai6 zo2, so2 ji5 soeng5 m4 dou2 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务器坏了，所以上不了网。
examples.english_sentence: The server is down, so I can't access the internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司要買多幾部伺服器嚟應付增加嘅流量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jiu3 maai5 do1 gei2 bou6 si6 fuk6 hei3 lai4 ying3 fu6 zang1 ga1 ge3 lau4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司要买多几台服务器来应付增加的流量。
examples.english_sentence: Our company needs to buy a few more servers to cope with the increased traffic.

english_meaning: to bide one's time; to wait for an opportunity; to watch for a chance
explanation_mandarin: 等待机会，准备行动。
explanation_english: To wait for a favorable opportunity to act; to lie in wait.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋伺機而動，準備喺個市況好嘅時候入貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 si6 gei1 ji4 dung6, zeon2 bei6 zoi6 go3 si5 fong3 hou2 ge3 si4 hau6 jap6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们伺机而动，准备在市场行情好的时候进货。
examples.english_sentence: They are waiting for the right moment to act, preparing to buy goods when the market is good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會伺機同老細傾加人工嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 si6 gei1 tung4 lou5 sai3 king1 gaa1 jan4 gung1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会伺机和老板谈涨工资的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I will wait for the opportunity to talk to my boss about a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賊仔伺機入屋偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caak6 zai2 si6 gei1 jap6 uk1 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小偷伺机入屋偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: The thief waited for a chance to break into the house to steal things.

english_meaning: to resemble; to seem; like; similar to
explanation_mandarin: 表示相似，像的意思。也可以表示好像，似乎。
explanation_english: Indicates similarity, resemblance. Can also mean 'seems like', 'appears to be'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢似佢阿爸噉高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci5 keoi5 aa3 baa1 gam2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和他爸爸一样高。
examples.english_sentence: He is as tall as his dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨噉嘅，似會落好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 gam2 ge3, ci5 wui5 lok6 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下着这么大的雨，好像会下很久。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining so heavily, it seems like it will rain for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个好似样。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩很相像。
examples.english_sentence: They two look very alike.

english_meaning: to seem; as if; seemingly
explanation_mandarin: 表示不肯定，带有推测的语气。相当于“好像”、“仿佛”。
explanation_english: Indicates uncertainty and expresses a speculative tone. Equivalent to "seemingly" or "as if."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢似乎唔係好開心喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 fu4 m4 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他似乎不太高兴啊。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't seem very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅天氣似乎會落雨噉喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hei3 ci4 fu4 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的天气似乎要下雨的样子。
examples.english_sentence: The weather today seems like it's going to rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋似乎有啲嘢瞞住我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ci4 fu4 jau5 di1 ye5 maan1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们似乎有些事情瞒着我们。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like they are hiding something from us.

mandarin_meaning: 似乎很有道理；煞有介事
english_meaning: seeming plausible; putting on airs; seeming elaborate or complicated when it's not
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面上看似有道理，但實際上可能並非如此；也形容人裝模作樣，故意把事情弄得很複雜。
explanation_english: Describes something that appears plausible or makes sense on the surface but may not be true or as complex as it seems. It can also describe someone who is putting on airs, acting important, or making something unnecessarily complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到件事似層層咁，但係我唔係好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 gin6 si6 ci5 cang4 cang4 gam2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把这件事说得煞有介事，但我不太相信。
examples.english_sentence: He made the matter sound very plausible, but I don't really believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞到咁似層層啦，其實好簡單啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 gam2 ci5 cang4 cang4 laa1, kei4 sat6 hou2 gaan2 daan1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别弄得这么复杂，其实很简单。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make it seem so complicated; it's actually very simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日都似層層，好似咩都識咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 ci5 cang4 cang4, hou2 ci5 me1 dou1 sik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人总是装模作样，好像什么都懂似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on airs, acting like he knows everything.

synonyms: 煞有介事 (saat3 jau5 gaai3 si6)

english_meaning: specious; plausible but actually wrong; seemingly right but actually wrong; misleading
explanation_mandarin: 表面上好像是对的，但实际上是错误的。
explanation_english: Appearing to be correct or true but actually false; superficially resembling truth or correctness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢聽落好有道理，但其實似是而非，千祈唔好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 ting1 lok6 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5, daan6 kei4 sat6 ci5 si6 ji4 fei1, cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话听起来很有道理，但其实似是而非，千万不要相信。
examples.english_sentence: What he said sounds reasonable, but it's actually specious, don't believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲廣告成日用啲似是而非嘅講法嚟吸引人買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gwong2 gou3 seng4 jat6 yung6 di1 ci5 si6 ji4 fei1 ge3 gong2 faat3 lai4 kap1 jan5 mai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些广告经常用一些似是而非的说法来吸引人买东西。
examples.english_sentence: These advertisements often use specious claims to attract people to buy things.

english_meaning: Seemingly familiar; deja vu
explanation_mandarin: 好像以前认识或见过，感觉熟悉但又想不起来。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of familiarity when encountering something or someone for the first time, as if one has seen or experienced it before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我第一次嚟呢個地方，但係感覺好似曾相識噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1, daan6 hai6 gam2 gok3 hou2 ci5 cang4 seung1 sik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我第一次来这个地方，但是感觉好像似曾相识。
examples.english_sentence: It's my first time coming to this place, but it feels strangely familiar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好似曾相識，我諗我喺邊度見過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 yeung2 hou2 ci5 cang4 seung1 sik1, ngo5 lam2 ngo5 hai2 bin1 dou6 gin3 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子好像似曾相识，我想我在哪里见过他。
examples.english_sentence: His face looks familiar; I think I've seen him somewhere before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔嘅情節好似曾相識，係咪抄襲㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 ching4 jit3 hou2 ci5 cang4 seung1 sik1, hai6 mai1 caau1 sik6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的情节好像似曾相识，是抄袭的吗？
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this story feels familiar; is it plagiarism?

english_meaning: looking presentable; looking legitimate; looking convincing; mimicking someone well
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表或行为看起来很像样，但可能实际上不是真的或没有真材实料。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that looks presentable, convincing, or authentic, but may lack genuine substance or be fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學啲專家講嘢，講到似模似樣，但係問佢真係嘅嘢，佢就答唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 di1 zyun1 gaa1 gong2 je5, gong2 dou3 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng2, daan6 hai6 man6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 ge3 je5, keoi5 zau6 daap3 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学专家说话，说得有模有样，但是问他真正的东西，他就答不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He mimics the way experts speak, doing it quite convincingly, but when you ask him about the real stuff, he can't answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個冒牌貨整到似模似樣，唔小心睇都唔知係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mou6 paai3 fo3 zeng2 dou3 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng2, m4 siu2 sam1 tai2 dou1 m4 zi1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个冒牌货做得有模有样，不小心看都不知道是假的。
examples.english_sentence: This counterfeit product is made so convincingly; if you don't look carefully, you won't even know it's fake.

english_meaning: decent; presentable; respectable; looking good; promising; satisfactory; up to standard
explanation_mandarin: 指外表或行为表现达到一定的标准，看起来体面、靠谱、令人满意。
explanation_english: Refers to appearing decent, presentable, respectable, satisfactory, or up to standard, either in appearance or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅打扮好似樣啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ge3 daa2 bun6 hou2 ci5 joeng2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天的打扮很体面。
examples.english_sentence: She looks decent today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃睇起嚟好似樣，應該可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 tai2 hei2 lai4 hou2 ci5 joeng2, jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划看起来很靠谱，应该可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan looks promising and should be successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔似樣，點可以升職啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 ci5 joeng2, dim2 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不靠谱，怎么能升职呢？
examples.english_sentence: You don't do your work properly, how can you get a promotion?

english_meaning: like; as if; similar to
explanation_mandarin: 表示好像、似乎的意思，放在句尾，表示相似的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates a resemblance or similarity, placed at the end of a sentence to express a state of likeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似發咗癲似的，周圍亂跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 faat3 zo2 din1 si6 dik1, zau1 wai4 lyun6 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像发了疯似的，到处乱跑。
examples.english_sentence: He's running around everywhere as if he's gone mad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落狗屎似的，咁大雨！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 gau2 si2 si6 dik1, gam3 daai6 jyu5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下得像狗屎一样，这么大的雨！
examples.english_sentence: It's raining cats and dogs! Such heavy rain!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢凍到震哂，好似無著衫似的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dung3 dou3 zan3 saai3, hou2 ci5 mou5 zoek3 saam1 si6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冷得直发抖，好像没穿衣服似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's shivering from the cold, as if he's not wearing any clothes.

english_meaning: to resemble completely; to be just like; to be a spitting image of
explanation_mandarin: 指非常相像，几乎完全一样。 形容外貌、性格、行为等方面的高度相似。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree of resemblance, almost identical.  Describes a strong similarity in appearance, personality, behaviour, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹似足餅印噉樣，真係好難分得出邊個打邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui6 ci5 zuk1 beng2 jan3 gam2 joeng2, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fan1 dak1 ceot1 bin1 go3 daa2 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们姐妹俩简直像饼印一样，真的很难分清楚谁是谁。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters look exactly like each other, it's really hard to tell them apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路似足佢老豆，衰衰格格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 ci5 zuk1 keoi5 lou5 dau2, seoi1 seoi1 gaak3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩很像他的爸爸，坏坏的。
examples.english_sentence: That child is just like his father, mischievous and naughty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫似足真嘅噉，畫得好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ci5 zuk1 zan1 ge3 gam2, waa2 dak1 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画简直就像真的一样，画得好漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: This painting looks just like the real thing, it's painted beautifully.

english_meaning: Paradoxical; seemingly wrong but actually right; apparently wrong but actually correct
explanation_mandarin: 表面上看来不对，实际上却是对的。
explanation_english: Describes something that appears to be wrong or contradictory on the surface, but upon closer examination, is actually true or valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時啲嘢就係咁，似非而是，要深入諗吓先知啱唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 di1 je5 zau6 hai6 gam2, ci5 fei1 ji4 si6, jiu3 sam1 jap6 nam2 haa5 sin1 zi1 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候事情就是这样，似是而非，要深入思考一下才知道对不对。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes things are like that, paradoxical, you have to think deeply to know if it's right or wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢似非而是，好難捉摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 ci5 fei1 ji4 si6, hou2 naan4 zuk1 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话似是而非，很难捉摸。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is paradoxical, hard to grasp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個理論聽落似非而是，但係好多科學家都支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 teng1 lok6 ci5 fei1 ji4 si6, daan6 hai6 hou2 do1 fo1 hok6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个理论听起来似是而非，但是很多科学家都支持。
examples.english_sentence: This theory sounds paradoxical, but many scientists support it.

english_meaning: Used for transliteration
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 量词 (usually appearing in transliterated words)
partOfSpeech_english: Measure word (usually appearing in transliterated words)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用于外来语的音译，例如“伽利略”。
explanation_english: Primarily used for transliterating foreign words, such as in "Galileo". It often doesn't carry a specific meaning on its own, but contributes to the overall sound of the borrowed word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伽利略係一位好出名嘅科學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 lei6 luk6 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 fo1 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伽利略是一位很有名的科学家。
examples.english_sentence: Galileo is a very famous scientist.

english_meaning: to till land; to cultivate rented land; tenant farming
explanation_mandarin: 指租种别人的田地。
explanation_english: To cultivate land as a tenant farmer; to rent and till land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠佃人哋啲田嚟養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 tin4 jan4 dei6 di1 tin4 lai4 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠租种别人的田地来养家。
examples.english_sentence: He supports his family by tenant farming other people's land.

english_meaning: but; however; yet
explanation_mandarin: 表示转折关系，相当于“但是”、“可是”。
explanation_english: Indicates a contrast or a change in direction, similar to 'but' or 'however'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去旅行，但係冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, daan6 hai6 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去旅行，但是没钱。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to travel, but I don't have money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，但係有啲懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 jau5 di1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，但是有点懒。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart, but a bit lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應承咗幫你，但係我真係好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing1 sing3 zo2 bong1 nei5, daan6 hai6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我答应了帮你，但是我真的很忙。
examples.english_sentence: I promised to help you, but I'm really busy.

english_meaning: but, however
explanation_mandarin: 表示转折关系，相当于“但是”。
explanation_english: Indicates a contrast or change of direction, similar to 'but' or 'however'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去睇戲，但係冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 hei3, daan6 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去看电影，但是没有时间。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to go see a movie, but I don't have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好聰明，但係唔勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 ming4, daan6 hai6 m4 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，但是不勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart, but not hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好好食，但係好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 hou2 sik6, daan6 hai6 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃，但是很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is very delicious, but it's very expensive.

english_meaning: every, any, as long as, so long as, whenever
explanation_mandarin: 表示只要出现某种情况，就会发生某种结果。通常和“都”、“就”等词语连用。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain result will occur as long as a certain condition exists. Usually used with words like '都' or '就'.  Equivalent to 'as long as', 'whenever'. Can also mean 'every' or 'any'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 但凡落雨，我就唔想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 faan4 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 zau6 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要一下雨，我就不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever it rains, I don't want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 但凡佢講嘅嘢，你都要諗清楚先好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 faan4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, nei5 dou1 jiu3 lam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是他说的话，你都要想清楚再相信。
examples.english_sentence: Anything he says, you should think carefully before believing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 但凡係佢經手嘅project，都一定會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 faan4 hai6 keoi5 ging1 sau2 ge3 project, dou1 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是经过他手的项目，一定会成功。
examples.english_sentence: Every project he's involved in is bound to be successful.

english_meaning: but, however
explanation_mandarin: 表示转折关系。相当于“可是”、“不过”。
explanation_english: Expresses a contrast or a change in direction; equivalent to 'but' or 'however'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去睇戲，但是冇人陪我去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 hei3, daan6 si6 mou5 jan4 pui4 ngo5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去看电影，但是没有人陪我去。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the movies, but no one will go with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好聰明，但是有啲懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 ming4, daan6 si6 jau5 di1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，但是有点懒。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart, but a little lazy.

english_meaning: only want, merely hope, just seeking
explanation_mandarin: 表示仅仅希望或要求达到某个目的或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates merely hoping or requesting to achieve a certain goal or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我但求你哋開心咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daan6 kau4 nei5 dei6 hoi1 sam1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只希望你们开心就好了。
examples.english_sentence: I only want you guys to be happy, that's all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢但求安安穩穩咁過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan6 kau4 on1 on1 wan2 wan2 gam2 gwo3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只求安稳地过日子。
examples.english_sentence: He only wants to live a stable and peaceful life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工但求夠糊口就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 daan6 kau4 gau3 wu4 hau2 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作只求能够糊口就行。
examples.english_sentence: I only want this job to be enough to make a living.

english_meaning: I wish, I hope, if only
explanation_mandarin: 表示希望或愿望，常带有略微无奈或期待的心情。
explanation_english: Expressing a wish or hope, often with a sense of slight resignation or anticipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 但願聽日唔好落雨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 jyun6 ting1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 但愿明天不要下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 但願佢可以考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 jyun6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 但愿他能考到好成绩。
