english_meaning: Florence (city in Italy)
explanation_mandarin: 意大利城市名，文艺复兴的发源地。
explanation_english: The name of a city in Italy, known as the birthplace of the Renaissance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年想去佛羅倫斯旅行，睇吓啲藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 fat1 lo4 lun4 si1 leoi5 hang4, tai2 haa5 di1 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年想去佛罗伦萨旅行，看看那些艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Florence next year to see the artworks.

english_meaning: trick, skill, gimmick, something fancy and elaborate
explanation_mandarin: 指一些花哨、不实用的技巧或方法，也可以指一些比较花样的东西。
explanation_english: Refers to flashy, impractical tricks, skills, or methods. It can also refer to something fancy and elaborate, often with an implication of being superficial or unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲功夫淨係得個佛蘭，唔實際嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei1 gung1 fu1 zing6 hai6 dak1 go3 fat1 laan2, m4 sat6 zai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功夫只是花架子，不实际的。
examples.english_sentence: His kung fu is all for show, it's not practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多佛蘭做乜啊？簡單啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 fat1 laan2 zou6 mat1 aa3? gaan2 daan1 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞那么多花样做什么？简单点不就好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you adding so many gimmicks? It would be better if it were simpler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計太多佛蘭，唔夠實用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 taai3 do1 fat1 laan2, m4 gau3 sat6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计太多花样，不够实用。
examples.english_sentence: This design has too many frills and isn't practical enough.

english_meaning: Buddha's Birthday
explanation_mandarin: 佛教节日，纪念释迦牟尼佛的诞辰。
explanation_english: A Buddhist festival commemorating the birth of Siddhartha Gautama (the Buddha).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日佛誕會去寺廟拜佛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 fat1 daan3 wui5 heoi3 zi2 miu2 baai3 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天佛诞会去寺庙拜佛。
examples.english_sentence: We'll go to the temple to worship Buddha tomorrow on Buddha's Birthday.

english_meaning: Buddha Jumps Over the Wall (a rich and complex seafood and meat soup/stew)
explanation_mandarin: 佛跳墙是一道非常名贵的闽菜，以多种海鲜和肉类为主料，慢炖而成。因其香味浓郁，相传连和尚闻到都会忍不住跳墙来品尝，故得名。
explanation_english: "Buddha Jumps Over the Wall" is a very famous and expensive Fujian cuisine. It is mainly composed of various seafood and meats, slow-cooked into a thick soup/stew. It is said that the aroma is so tempting that even a monk would jump over the wall to taste it, hence the name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日屋企人食飯，不如我哋叫個佛跳牆啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 uk1 kei2 jan4 sik6 faan6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 giu3 go3 fat6 tiu3 coeng4 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天家里人吃饭，不如我们点个佛跳墙吧？
examples.english_sentence: The family is having dinner tomorrow, how about we order a Buddha Jumps Over the Wall?

mandarin_meaning: 泥菩萨也有火性 / 再好的人也会发火
english_meaning: Even Buddha has fire / Even the most patient person has a limit to their patience.
explanation_mandarin: 形容再好脾气的人也会有生气发怒的时候。强调即使是圣人也会有忍无可忍的时候。
explanation_english: Describes that even the most good-natured or patient person will eventually get angry. It emphasizes that even saints have a limit to their patience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我忍咗你好耐㗎啦，佛都有火呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan2 zo2 nei5 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa1, fat1 dou1 jau5 fo2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忍你很久了，泥菩萨也有火性!
examples.english_sentence: I've put up with you for so long, even Buddha has fire!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再激佢啦，佛都有火，你都唔想見到佢發嬲啦嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gik1 keoi5 laa1, fat1 dou1 jau5 fo2, nei5 dou1 m4 soeng2 gin3 dou3 keoi5 faat3 nau1 laa1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再激他了，泥菩萨也有火性，你也不想看到他生气吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, even Buddha has fire. You don't want to see him get angry, right?

english_meaning: Buddhism, the Buddhist faith, the Buddhist order
explanation_mandarin: 佛教；佛教的教义、寺院等。
explanation_english: Buddhism; refers to the Buddhist faith, doctrines, monasteries, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候就入咗佛門修行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 jap6 zo2 fat6 mun4 sau1 hang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就进入佛门修行。
examples.english_sentence: He entered the Buddhist order to practice when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間寺廟係佛門清靜之地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zi6 miu6 hai6 fat6 mun4 cing1 zing6 zi1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座寺庙是佛门清静之地。
examples.english_sentence: This temple is a tranquil place of Buddhism.

english_meaning: Buddha
explanation_mandarin: 佛教创始人释迦牟尼的称号。
explanation_english: The title of Siddhartha Gautama, the founder of Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛陀嘅教義對好多人影響好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 to4 ge3 gaau3 ji6 deoi3 hou2 do1 jan4 ying2 heong2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛陀的教义对很多人影响很大。
examples.english_sentence: The teachings of the Buddha have a great influence on many people.

english_meaning: affected; pretentious; to act or behave artificially; to show off; to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不自然，故意表现出某种姿态或情感，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is unnatural, deliberately showing off a certain posture or emotion, usually with a negative connotation. It implies artificiality and a lack of sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好作㗎，成日喺度扮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zok3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baan6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很做作，整天在那里装样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very pretentious person, always acting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁作啦，咁樣好假呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zok3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 gaa2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么做作了，这样很假。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so affected, it seems very fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我面前作，我唔信你嗰套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 zok3, ngo5 m4 seon3 nei5 go2 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我面前装模作样，我不相信你那一套。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on an act in front of me, I don't believe that.

english_meaning: to make a decision; to be in charge; to call the shots; to decide for
explanation_mandarin: 做决定，当家作主。
explanation_english: To make a decision; to be in charge; to take responsibility for a decision; to decide on something, often implying authority or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話呢啲嘢由我作主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 ni1 di1 je5 jau4 ngo5 zok3 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说这些事情由我做主。
examples.english_sentence: Mom said I could make the decisions on these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好幫佢哋作主啦，等佢哋自己解決啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bong1 keoi5 dei6 zok3 zyu2 laa1, dang2 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要替他们做主了，让他们自己解决吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't decide for them, let them solve it themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以幫你作主，你要自己諗清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zok3 zyu2, nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 nam2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能替你做主，你自己要考虑清楚。
examples.english_sentence: I can't decide for you; you need to think clearly for yourself.

english_meaning: to cause trouble, to stir up unrest, to rebel, to make mischief
explanation_mandarin: 指制造混乱，引起骚乱，或进行叛乱活动。
explanation_english: To cause trouble, create chaos or disturbance, or engage in rebellious activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路成日喺度作亂，真係冇時停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zok3 lyun6, zan1 hai6 mou5 si4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群小孩子整天在这里捣乱，真是一刻都不停歇。
examples.english_sentence: This group of kids are always causing trouble here, they never stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺課堂上面作亂，影響其他人上堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 min6 zok3 lyun6, jing2 hoeng2 kei4 taa1 jan4 soeng5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在课堂上捣乱，影响其他人上课。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make trouble in class, it affects other people's lessons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想喺社會度作亂，破壞安寧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 hai2 se5 wui2 dou6 zok3 lyun6, po3 waai6 on1 ning4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想在社会上作乱，破坏安宁。
examples.english_sentence: They want to stir up trouble in society and disrupt the peace.

english_meaning: to accompany; to keep someone company; to be a companion
explanation_mandarin: 陪伴，一起行动或在一起。
explanation_english: To accompany, to act together or be together with someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我陪你作伴吖？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 pui4 nei5 zok3 bun6 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我陪你吧？
examples.english_sentence: How about I keep you company?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚一個人行夜路，所以叫我作伴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 je6 lou6, so2 ji5 giu3 ngo5 zok3 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕一个人走夜路，所以叫我陪伴。
examples.english_sentence: He is afraid of walking alone at night, so he asked me to accompany him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊作伴去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zok3 bun6 heoi3 leoi5 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起陪伴去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: Let's travel together and keep each other company.

english_meaning: to give evidence, to testify, to provide a statement (to the police/court)
explanation_mandarin: 指在法庭或警察等司法机关提供证词，作为证据使用。
explanation_english: To give evidence or testimony, usually to the police or in court, as a witness. It implies giving a formal statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭作供，指證被告有罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 zok3 gung1, zi2 zing3 bei6 gou3 jau5 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法庭作证，指认被告有罪。
examples.english_sentence: He testified in court, identifying the defendant as guilty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察叫我哋去警署作供，講下當時嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 giu3 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ging2 syu2 zok3 gung1, gong2 haa5 dong1 si4 ge3 cing4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察叫我们去警署作证，说一下当时的情况。
examples.english_sentence: The police asked us to go to the police station to give a statement about what happened at the time.

english_meaning: to value, to estimate, to price; valuation
explanation_mandarin: 对某物进行估价，确定价格。
explanation_english: To assess the value of something; to determine a price or estimate a value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋作價幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zok3 gaa3 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子估价多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this house valued at?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋作價二百蚊賣咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zok3 gaa3 ji6 baak3 man1 maai6 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们估价两百块钱把它卖掉了。
examples.english_sentence: We sold it for a price of two hundred dollars.

english_meaning: to make; to create; to produce; to come up with; to issue; to commit (a mistake); to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 表示进行某种行为、行动，带有创造、产生、虚构的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates performing an action, often with a sense of creating, producing, fabricating, or pretending. It can also refer to committing a mistake or making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作出咗一個重要嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做出了一个重要的决定。
examples.english_sentence: He made an important decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好作出咁嘅行為啦，好醜怪㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zok3 ceot1 gam3 ge3 hang4 wai4 laa1, hou2 cau2 gwaai3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做出这样的行为啦，很丢人的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't behave like that, it's embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作出好多藉口嚟解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 ceot1 hou2 do1 ze3 hau2 lai4 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他编造了很多借口来解释。
examples.english_sentence: He made up many excuses to explain.

mandarin_meaning: 启动; 开始运作; 发动
english_meaning: to start; to begin to operate; to trigger; to act up (of machinery, equipment, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指机器、设备等开始运行或发生故障，也指开始行动或启动。
explanation_english: Refers to machinery, equipment, etc. starting to operate or malfunctioning. It can also mean to start an action or initiate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器作動咗之後，就自動生產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 zok3 dung6 zo2 zi1 hau6, zau6 zi6 dung6 sang1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器启动之后，就自动生产。
examples.english_sentence: After the machine started, it produced automatically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知點解部電腦突然間作動唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 bou6 din6 nou5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 zok3 dung6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道为什么电脑突然间无法启动。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why the computer suddenly can't start up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋開始作動去解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 zok3 dung6 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开始行动去解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: They started to act to solve the problem.

english_meaning: To feign; to pretend; to make a show of; to posture
explanation_mandarin: 指做出某种动作或姿态，但实际上并没有真正执行或意图，带有表演或假装的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to making a certain movement or gesture, but not actually executing or intending to do so, often with a performative or pretentious element.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作勢打我，嚇到我死死吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 sai3 daa2 ngo5, haak3 dou3 ngo5 sei2 sei2 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假装要打我，吓得我半死。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to hit me, scaring me half to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度作勢啦，知你唔會真係咁做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zok3 sai3 laa1, zi1 nei5 m4 wui5 zan1 hai6 gam2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里装模作样了，知道你不会真的这么做的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend here. I know you won't really do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作勢行開，點知又返轉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 sai3 haang4 hoi1, dim2 zi1 jau6 faan1 zyun3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假装走开，没想到又回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to leave, but unexpectedly came back.

english_meaning: to rebel; to revolt; to mutiny; to defy authority; to go against
explanation_mandarin: 指反抗统治者或权威，也泛指不服从管教，与人作对。
explanation_english: Refers to rebelling against rulers or authority. More generally, it means to disobey, to be defiant, or to go against someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日同我作反啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 zok3 faan2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别总是跟我作对了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop rebelling against me all the time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個班學生作反，罷課抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 baan1 hok6 sang1 zok3 faan2, baa6 fo3 kong3 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那班学生造反，罢课抗议。
examples.english_sentence: The students in that class rebelled and boycotted classes to protest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽阿媽話，擺明係作反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 aa3 maa1 waa2, baai2 ming4 hai6 zok3 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听妈妈的话，摆明就是作反。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to his mother, it's clearly rebellion.

mandarin_meaning: 去世, 去逝, 过世
english_meaning: to pass away, to die
explanation_mandarin: 婉辞，指人去世。
explanation_english: A euphemism for 'to pass away' or 'to die'. It's a more polite or indirect way of saying someone has died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日作古喇，真係好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 zok3 gu2 laa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天去世了，真的很可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away yesterday. It's such a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講李伯伯作古咗，佢啲仔女好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 lei5 baak3 baak3 zok3 gu2 zo2, keoi5 di1 zai2 neoi5 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说李伯伯去世了，他的孩子们很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that Uncle Li passed away, and his children are very sad.

english_meaning: work (of art, literature, music, etc.); opus
explanation_mandarin: 指创作出来的艺术品、文学作品、音乐作品等。
explanation_english: Refers to a created work of art, literary work, musical composition, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係佢嘅最新作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 zeoi3 san1 zok3 pan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是他的最新作品。
examples.english_sentence: This is his latest work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意呢位畫家嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 ni1 wai2 waa2 gaa1 ge3 zok3 pan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢这位画家的作品。
examples.english_sentence: I really like this painter's works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份畢業作品攞咗獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bat1 jip6 zok3 pan2 lo2 zo2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的毕业作品获奖了。
examples.english_sentence: His graduation project won an award.

english_meaning: to feel nauseous, to feel like vomiting
explanation_mandarin: 指感到恶心，有想呕吐的感觉。
explanation_english: To feel nauseous; to have the sensation of needing to vomit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聞到陣味覺得有啲作嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man4 dou2 zan6 mei6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 zok3 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我闻到这股味道觉得有点恶心。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a bit nauseous when I smell this odor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢暈船暈到作嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan4 syun4 wan4 dou3 zok3 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他晕船晕到想吐。
examples.english_sentence: He's so seasick that he feels like vomiting.

english_meaning: To feel nauseous and bored; to feel sick and fed up; to be disgusted and annoyed
explanation_mandarin: 形容感到恶心、想吐，同时又觉得非常厌烦和无聊。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of nausea and a desire to vomit, coupled with a strong sense of boredom and annoyance. It suggests a combination of physical discomfort and mental weariness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日聽佢講埋啲無聊嘢，聽到我都作嘔作悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 teng1 keoi5 gong2 maai4 di1 mou4 liu4 je5, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 zok3 au2 zok3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是听他说那些无聊的事情，听得我都恶心厌烦。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so sick and tired of listening to him talk about all that boring stuff. It makes me feel nauseous and bored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲咁悶，睇到我都作嘔作悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 mun6, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 zok3 au2 zok3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影这么无聊，看得我都恶心厌烦。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is so boring, watching it makes me feel nauseous and fed up.

english_meaning: to sit on the fence; to watch from the sidelines; to look on unconcerned
explanation_mandarin: 比喻置身事外，在一旁观看事态发展，不予干涉。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to watch from the sidelines, remaining neutral and uninvolved in a situation or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個人嘈交，我哋最好作壁上觀，費事捲入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 cou4 gaau1, ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 zok3 bik1 soeng6 gun1, fai3 si6 gyun2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人吵架，我们最好袖手旁观，免得卷进去。
examples.english_sentence: They're arguing, we'd better sit on the fence to avoid getting involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到同事有困難，唔應該作壁上觀，應該幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 tung4 si6 jau5 kwan3 naan4, m4 jing1 goi1 zok3 bik1 soeng6 gun1, jing1 goi1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到同事有困难，不应该袖手旁观，应该帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: When you see a colleague in difficulty, you shouldn't sit on the fence, you should help.

english_meaning: to dream; to have a dream; to daydream; to fantasize
explanation_mandarin: 指睡眠时产生幻觉；比喻幻想，不切实际的空想。
explanation_english: Refers to experiencing hallucinations during sleep; metaphorically, it means to fantasize or daydream, to engage in unrealistic wishful thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日作夢啦，醒下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zok3 mung6 laa1, sing2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是做梦了，醒醒吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be daydreaming, wake up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴晚作咗個好奇怪嘅夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 ngaan5 zok3 zo2 go3 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚做了一个很奇怪的梦。
examples.english_sentence: I had a very strange dream last night.

english_meaning: to exaggerate; to boast; to show off; to overstate
explanation_mandarin: 指夸大事实，说大话，吹牛。 也指为了面子或某种目的而故意夸张或装腔作势。
explanation_english: To exaggerate facts, boast, or show off. Also, to deliberately exaggerate or put on airs for the sake of face or for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日作大，啲嘢講到天花龍鳳噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zok3 daai6, di1 je5 gong2 dou3 tin1 faa1 lung4 fung6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是夸大其词，把事情说得天花乱坠。
examples.english_sentence: He always exaggerates, making things sound incredibly impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好作大啦，你邊有可能做到咁多嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zok3 daai6 laa1, nei5 bin1 jau5 ho2 nang4 zou6 dou3 gam3 do1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别吹牛了，你怎么可能做那么多事情？
examples.english_sentence: Don't boast, how could you possibly do so much?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明無錢，但係又想作大，扮到好有錢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 cin2, daan6 hai6 jau6 soeng2 zok3 daai6, baan6 dou3 hou2 jau5 cin2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没钱，但又想炫耀，装得很有钱的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly has no money, but he wants to show off, pretending to be very rich.

english_meaning: to commit crimes and violate the law; to engage in all sorts of evil
explanation_mandarin: 指做出奸邪、触犯法律的事情。形容人坏事做尽。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to committing crimes and violating the law. It describes someone who does all sorts of evil things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日作奸犯科，遲早都會俾人捉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 zok3 gaan1 faan6 fo1, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天为非作歹，迟早都会被抓的。
examples.english_sentence: They commit crimes and violate the law all the time; sooner or later, they will be caught.

english_meaning: to lord it over others; to abuse one's power; to act like a tyrant
explanation_mandarin: 倚仗权势，为所欲为，横行霸道。
explanation_english: To abuse one's power and position to bully others; to act in an overbearing and oppressive manner; to behave like a tyrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一攞到權就作威作福，真係乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lo2 dou2 kyun4 zau6 zok3 wai1 zok3 fuk1, zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一得到权力就开始作威作福，真是令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got power, he started lording it over everyone, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己係老細就可以喺公司作威作福呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hai6 lou5 sai3 zau6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 zok3 wai1 zok3 fuk1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为自己是老板就可以在公司作威作福。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you're the boss, you can abuse your power in the company.

english_meaning: to be a guest; to visit
explanation_mandarin: 到别人家或地方去当客人。
explanation_english: To be a guest; to visit someone's house or place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去你屋企作客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2 zok3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期会去你家做客。
examples.english_sentence: I will visit your house next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打擾你哋作客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si3, daa2 jiu2 nei5 dei6 zok3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你们做客。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry to interrupt your visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今晚會嚟我哋屋企作客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan1 wui5 lai4 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 zok3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今晚会来我们家做客。
examples.english_sentence: They will visit our house tonight.

english_meaning: writer, author
explanation_mandarin: 指以写作为职业的人。
explanation_english: A person who writes books, articles, etc., especially as a profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係做個作家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 go3 zok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一个作家。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a writer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇佢嘅作品，佢真係一位出色嘅作家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 keoi5 ge3 zok3 ban2, keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 wai2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 zok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢看他的作品，他真是一位出色的作家。
examples.english_sentence: I really enjoy reading his works. He's a truly outstanding writer.

english_meaning: To confirm; to verify; to ascertain; to make something official; to put something into effect
explanation_mandarin: 使之成为事实；确认事情的真实性或有效性；正式实施。
explanation_english: To make something a reality; to confirm the truth or validity of something; to put something into official effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話聽日嘅會議作實取消，唔使返公司啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 ting1 jat6 ge3 wui2 ji5 zok3 sat6 hui2 siu1, m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说明天的会议确认取消了，不用回公司了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said that tomorrow's meeting is confirmed to be canceled, so we don't need to go back to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盡快將呢個計劃作實，唔可以再拖落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 zoeng1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zok3 sat6, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尽快落实这个计划，不能再拖延下去了。
examples.english_sentence: We should confirm this plan as soon as possible, we can't delay it any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭已經作實咗佢嘅罪行，佢一定會受到懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 ji5 ging1 zok3 sat6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 zeoi6 hang4, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 sau6 dou3 ching4 phạt6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭已经确认了他的罪行，他一定会受到惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: The court has already confirmed his crime, he will definitely be punished.

english_meaning: To deliberately oppose; to go against; to be at odds with; to antagonize
explanation_mandarin: 故意与人或事作对，表示对抗或反对。
explanation_english: To deliberately act against someone or something, indicating opposition or antagonism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪專登同我作對㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 zyun1 dang1 tung4 ngo5 zok3 deoi3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是故意跟我作对？
examples.english_sentence: Are you deliberately going against me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都同老細作對，遲早俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 tung4 lou5 sai3 zok3 deoi3, ci4 zou2 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是跟老板作对，迟早会被炒鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: He is always antagonizing his boss, sooner or later he will be fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意同大人作對，都係想引起人注意啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 tung4 daai6 jan4 zok3 deoi3, dou1 hai6 soeng2 hing2 hei2 jan4 zyu3 yi3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜欢跟大人作对，都是想引起人注意而已。
examples.english_sentence: Children like to oppose adults, they just want to attract attention.

english_meaning: to invalidate; to cancel; to nullify; to void
explanation_mandarin: 使失去效力; 取消; 宣布无效。
explanation_english: To render something invalid, ineffective, or null and void. To cancel or revoke something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張車飛過咗期，已經作廢咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 ce1 fei1 gwo3 zo2 kei4, ji5 ging1 zok3 fai3 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张车票过期了，已经作废了。
examples.english_sentence: This train ticket has expired, it's already invalid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為你冇簽名，所以份合約作廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 nei5 mou5 cim1 meng2, so2 ji5 fan6 hap6 joek3 zok3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为你没有签名，所以这份合同作废。
examples.english_sentence: Because you didn't sign, the contract is null and void.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布之前嘅政策作廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 zi1 cin4 ge3 zing3 caak3 zok3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布之前的政策作废。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced that the previous policies were invalidated.

english_meaning: to tease, to make fun of, to play tricks on, to fool
explanation_mandarin: 指戏弄、捉弄别人，使人感到不愉快或尴尬。
explanation_english: To tease, play tricks on, or make fun of someone, often causing them to feel unhappy or embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再作弄佢啦，佢就嚟喊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zok3 lung6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zau6 lai4 haam3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再捉弄他了，他快要哭了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease him anymore, he's about to cry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日作弄啲新人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zok3 lung6 di1 san1 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是戏弄那些新人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always play tricks on the new people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意作弄人，不過冇惡意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zok3 lung6 jan4, bat1 gwo3 mou5 ok3 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢捉弄人，不过没有恶意的。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to tease people, but he doesn't mean any harm.

english_meaning: to cheat (in an exam, game, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指在考试、比赛等场合中使用不正当手段获取优势。
explanation_english: To engage in dishonest practices to gain an unfair advantage, especially in exams or competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試作弊，俾老師捉到正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 zok3 bai6, bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊，被老师抓了个正着。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated on the exam and was caught red-handed by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打麻雀唔可以作弊㗎，唔係冇人同你玩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 maa1 zoek3 m4 ho2 ji5 zok3 bai6 gaa3, m4 hai6 mou5 jan4 tung4 nei5 waan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻将不可以作弊的，不然没人和你玩了。
examples.english_sentence: You can't cheat at mahjong, otherwise no one will play with you.

mandarin_meaning: 捣鬼; 搞鬼; 作妖
english_meaning: to act strangely; to act up; to cause trouble; to play tricks; to be mischievous; to manifest in an unusual way (e.g., a ghost)
explanation_mandarin: 指做出奇怪或不寻常的举动，通常带有负面含义。可以指人捣乱、恶作剧，也可以指不好的事情发生或奇怪的现象出现。
explanation_english: Refers to behaving strangely or unusually, usually with negative connotations. It can refer to people causing trouble or playing pranks, or to bad things happening or strange phenomena occurring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦成日作怪，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sing4 jat6 zok3 gwaai3, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑总是出问题，不知道怎么回事。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is always acting up, I don't know what's wrong with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度作怪，乖乖哋坐低！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zok3 gwaai3, gwaai1 gwaai1 dei2 co5 dai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里捣乱，乖乖地坐下！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble here, sit down and behave!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，佢發神經作怪啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 faat3 san4 ging1 zok3 gwaai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他，他发神经搞怪而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mind him, he's just being weird.

english_meaning: daily routine; work and rest schedule
explanation_mandarin: 指工作和休息的时间安排。
explanation_english: Refers to the schedule of work and rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅作息時間唔一樣，所以好少見到面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zok3 sik1 si4 gaan3 m4 jat1 joeng6, so2 ji5 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的作息时间不一样，所以很少见面。
examples.english_sentence: Our work and rest schedules are different, so we rarely see each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要保持健康，作息要定時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 bou2 ci4 gin6 hong1, zok3 sik1 jiu3 ding6 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要保持健康，作息要有规律。
examples.english_sentence: To stay healthy, you need to have a regular work and rest schedule.

english_meaning: to do evil, to commit evil deeds, to do wicked things
explanation_mandarin: 指做坏事、行恶。
explanation_english: To commit evil deeds; to perform wicked actions; to do bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日作惡，一定會有報應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zok3 ok3, jat1 ding6 wui5 jau5 bou3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是作恶，一定会有报应的。
examples.english_sentence: He always does evil deeds, he will definitely be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作惡多端嘅人，通常都冇好下場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 ok3 do1 dyun1 ge3 jan4, tung1 soeng4 dou1 mou5 hou2 haa6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作恶多端的人，通常都没有好下场。
examples.english_sentence: People who commit a lot of evil deeds usually don't have a good ending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以作惡，要做好事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zok3 ok3, jiu3 zou6 hou2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以作恶，要做好事。
examples.english_sentence: We must not commit evil, we must do good deeds.

english_meaning: to commit numerous evils; to be extremely wicked
explanation_mandarin: 指做了很多坏事，罪恶累累。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has committed many evil deeds and is steeped in wickedness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多傷天害理嘅事，真係作惡多端。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 soeng1 tin1 hoi6 lei5 ge3 si6, zan1 hai6 zok3 ok3 do1 dyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多伤天害理的事，真是罪恶多端。
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many outrageous things; he is truly extremely wicked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個黑社會大佬作惡多端，最後都俾警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hak1 se5 wui2 dai6 lou2 zok3 ok3 do1 dyun1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个黑社会老大罪恶多端，最后都被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: That triad boss committed numerous evils and was eventually arrested by the police.

english_meaning: to fight, to battle, to wage war, to compete (in a contest)
explanation_mandarin: 指进行战斗，或比喻为达到某个目标而努力。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in combat or metaphorically refers to striving to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為咗爭取勝利而作戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 zo2 zang1 ceoi2 sing3 lei6 ji4 zok3 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为了争取胜利而作战。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fight for victory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺球場上面作戰，爭奪冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 min6 zok3 zin3, zang1 dyut6 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在球场上作战，争夺冠军。
examples.english_sentence: They are competing on the field for the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多困難，我哋都要作戰到底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 zok3 zin3 dou3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多困难，我们都要作战到底。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many difficulties, we must fight to the end.

english_meaning: to make up a story; to fabricate; to lie
explanation_mandarin: 指虚构故事，捏造事实，说谎。
explanation_english: Refers to creating a fictional story, fabricating facts, or lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日作故仔，冇人信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zok3 gu3 zai2, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是编故事，没人相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes up stories, nobody believes what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再作故仔呃我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zok3 gu3 zai2 ngaak1 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再编故事骗我了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make up stories to deceive me anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作故仔嘅能力真係一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 gu3 zai2 ge3 nang4 lik6 zan1 hai6 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他编故事的能力真是一流。
examples.english_sentence: His ability to make up stories is truly first-class.

english_meaning: to count; to be valid; to be effective; to be considered binding; to stand
explanation_mandarin: 表示承认、有效、算数。指某件事或承诺被认可，具有效力。
explanation_english: To count, to be valid, to be effective, to be considered binding. It refers to the recognition of something or a promise as valid and effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話過會請我食飯㗎，唔作數唔得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gwo3 wui5 cheng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6 gaa3, m4 zok3 sou3 m4 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说过要请我吃饭的，不算数不行。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would treat me to a meal, he can't go back on his word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗幫我嘅，一定要作數㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 sing4 zo2 bong1 ngo5 ge3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zok3 sou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应了要帮我的，一定要算数啊！
examples.english_sentence: You promised to help me, you must keep your word!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講出口嘅嘢就要作數，唔可以反口覆舌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 chut1 hau2 ge3 ye5 zau6 jiu3 zok3 sou3, m4 ho2 ji5 faan2 hau2 fuk1 shet6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说出口的话就要算数，不可以食言。
examples.english_sentence: You should keep your word for what you said, you can't go back on it.

english_meaning: composition; writing an essay
explanation_mandarin: 指写文章，尤指学生作为练习而写的文章。
explanation_english: To write a composition, especially an essay written by a student as an exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要交份中文作文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 fan6 zung1 man2 zok3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要交一篇中文作文。
examples.english_sentence: I need to hand in a Chinese composition tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫啲作文成日都攞A㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 di1 zok3 man2 seng4 jat6 dou1 lo2 A gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的作文总是得A。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets an A for his compositions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最憎就係寫作文，諗到頭都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zang1 zau6 hai6 se2 zok3 man2, nam2 dou3 tau4 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最讨厌的就是写作文，想到头都疼。
examples.english_sentence: What I hate the most is writing compositions, it gives me a headache.

english_meaning: to compose (music); musical composition
explanation_mandarin: 创作乐曲；编写音乐。
explanation_english: To create or compose a piece of music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好細個就開始作曲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zok3 kuk1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很小的时候就开始作曲了。
examples.english_sentence: He started composing music when he was very young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌係邊個作曲㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 bin1 go3 zok3 kuk1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌是谁作曲的？
examples.english_sentence: Who composed this song?

english_meaning: composer
explanation_mandarin: 指创作音乐作品的人。
explanation_english: A person who composes music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想成為一個出名嘅作曲家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 cheut1 ming4 ge3 zok3 kuk1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一个著名的作曲家。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a famous composer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌係由一位香港作曲家寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 jau4 jat1 wai2 hoeng1 gong2 zok3 kuk1 gaa1 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌是一位香港作曲家写的。
examples.english_sentence: This song was written by a Hong Kong composer.

english_meaning: to commit a crime, to perpetrate a crime
explanation_mandarin: 指进行犯罪活动，实施犯罪行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of engaging in criminal activities and committing criminal acts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑佢哋係呢單銀行劫案嘅作案者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 keoi5 dei6 hai6 ni1 daan1 ngan4 hong4 hip3 on3 ge3 zok3 on3 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑他们是这起银行抢劫案的作案者。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect that they are the perpetrators of this bank robbery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一路計劃住作案，點知俾差人拉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 lou6 gai3 waak6 zyu6 zok3 on3, dim2 zi1 bei2 caai1 jan4 laai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直在计划作案，没想到被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: They were planning to commit a crime, but they were arrested by the police.

english_meaning: Homework; Assignment; Operation; Task
explanation_mandarin: 在学校里，学生需要完成的功课，或者泛指需要完成的任务。
explanation_english: Tasks or schoolwork that students need to complete. More generally refers to any task that needs to be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好多作業要做呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 zok3 jip6 jiu3 zou6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有很多作业要做啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have a lot of homework to do today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅作業分配得唔平均。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zok3 jip6 fan1 pui3 dak1 m4 ping4 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的任务分配得不平均。
examples.english_sentence: The tasks for this project are not distributed evenly.

english_meaning: Operating System
explanation_mandarin: 管理计算机硬件与软件资源的程序，同时也是计算机系统的内核与基石。
explanation_english: The software that manages computer hardware and software resources and provides common services for computer programs. It is the core and foundation of the computer system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: Windows 係一個好常用嘅作業系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: win1 dou2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 soeng4 yung6 ge3 zok3 jip6 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: Windows是一个很常用的操作系统。
examples.english_sentence: Windows is a very commonly used operating system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦要升級個作業系統先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 jiu3 sing1 gap1 go3 zok3 jip6 hai6 tung2 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电脑要升级操作系统才行了。
examples.english_sentence: My computer needs to upgrade the operating system.

english_meaning: to make merry, to enjoy oneself, to seek pleasure
explanation_mandarin: 享受快乐，寻找乐趣，通常指娱乐活动。
explanation_english: To enjoy oneself, to seek pleasure, often referring to recreational activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去酒吧作樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 jiu1 baa1 zok3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常去酒吧寻欢作乐。
examples.english_sentence: They often go to bars to make merry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假梗係要好好作樂一下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 gang2 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zok3 lok6 jat1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假当然要好好地享乐一下啦。
examples.english_sentence: Of course, we should enjoy ourselves during the holidays.

english_meaning: to sing (a song); to perform a song
explanation_mandarin: 唱歌，表演歌曲。
explanation_english: To sing; to perform a song. It usually implies a performance of some kind, rather than just singing along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺台上作歌，唱得好好聽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 toi4 soeng6 zok3 go1, coeng3 dak1 hou2 hou2 teng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在台上唱歌，唱得非常好听啊！
examples.english_sentence: They are singing on the stage, and they sing very well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有歌星嚟作歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 jau5 go1 sing1 lai4 zok3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有歌星来唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: There's a singer coming to perform tonight.

english_meaning: to act recklessly; to court death; to ask for trouble; to be courting disaster
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做一些非常危险或者不明智的事情，导致不好的结果。含有自找麻烦，自取灭亡的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately doing something very dangerous or unwise, leading to bad consequences. It implies asking for trouble or courting disaster. It describes actions that are self-destructive or invite negative outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明知佢咁嬲，仲走去撩佢，真係作死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 zi1 keoi5 gam3 nau1, zung6 zau2 heoi3 liu1 keoi5, zan1 hai6 zok6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明知道他这么生气，还去惹他，真是作死。
examples.english_sentence: You knew he was so angry, and you still went to provoke him. You're really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁作死啦，咁危險嘅嘢都敢試！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zok6 sei2 laa1, gam3 ngai4 him2 ge3 je5 dou1 gam2 si3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么作死啦，这么危险的东西都敢尝试！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so reckless! You dare to try such a dangerous thing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都唔瞓覺打機，咁落去真係作死㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 m4 fan3 gaau3 daa2 gei1, gam3 lok6 heoi3 zan1 hai6 zok6 sei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都不睡觉打游戏，这样下去真是作死啊。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games every day without sleeping. Continuing like this is really courting disaster.

english_meaning: Practice magic/sorcery; Practice religious rituals; Method; Way of doing things
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指施行法术或宗教仪式。2. 指处理事情的方法或方式。
explanation_english: 1. To perform magic or religious rituals, often involving chanting, gestures, and the use of symbolic objects. 2. Method or way of doing things; approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要搵師傅嚟作法驅鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 wan2 si1 fu6 lai4 zok3 faat3 keoi1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要找师傅来作法驱鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to find a master to perform magic rituals to exorcise the ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種作法唔啱我心水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 zok3 faat3 m4 ngaam1 ngo5 sam1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种做法不合我的心意。
examples.english_sentence: This method doesn't suit my preference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅作法越來越離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zok3 faat3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 lei4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的做法越来越离谱。
examples.english_sentence: The company's methods are becoming more and more outrageous.

english_meaning: Hoist oneself with one's own petard; be hoist with one's own petard; be caught in one's own trap; fall victim to one's own trickery; to be harmed by one's own scheme
explanation_mandarin: 指自己制定某种方法或规则，结果却使自己受害。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is harmed by their own plans or rules that they established.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗埋啲陰濕橋去害人，點知今次作法自斃，衰咗喺自己度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lam2 maai4 di1 jam1 sap1 kiu2 heoi3 hoi6 jan4, dim2 zi1 gam1 ci3 zok3 faat3 zi6 bai6, seoi1 zo2 hai2 zi6 gei2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想一些阴险的办法去害人，没想到这次作法自毙，失败在了自己手里。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes up with sneaky schemes to harm others, but this time he was hoist with his own petard and failed because of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁過份呀，小心作法自斃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gwo3 fan6 aa3, siu2 sam1 zok3 faat3 zi6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要太过分啊，小心作法自毙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go too far, be careful you don't get caught in your own trap.

english_meaning: thirsty
explanation_mandarin: 感到口干想喝水。
explanation_english: Feeling dry and wanting to drink water; thirsty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行咗咁耐，我開始作渴喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 zo2 gam3 noi6, ngo5 hoi1 chi2 zok3 hot3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走了这么久，我开始口渴了。
examples.english_sentence: After walking for so long, I'm starting to get thirsty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽咁曬，好容易作渴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 gam3 saai3, hou2 yung4 yi6 zok3 hot3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳这么晒，很容易口渴的。
examples.english_sentence: It's so sunny, it's easy to get thirsty.

english_meaning: to count; to be valid; to take as the standard; to take as final; to be the determining factor
explanation_mandarin: 表示以某个事物或标准作为依据或最终决定。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or a standard is taken as a basis or a final decision. It implies something is considered valid or definitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嘅嘢唔可以作準㗎，佢成日都變卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ge3 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 zok3 zeon2 gaa3, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bin3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不能作数，他总是变卦。
examples.english_sentence: What he says cannot be taken as final, he always changes his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約上面寫嘅嘢先至可以作準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 soeng6 min6 se2 ge3 je5 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 zok3 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同上写的东西才可以作准。
examples.english_sentence: Only what is written in this contract can be taken as the standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你阿媽講嘅嘢先作準，佢話唔得就唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 aa3 maa1 gong2 ge3 je5 sin1 zok3 zeon2, keoi5 waa6 m4 dak1 zau6 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你妈妈说的话才算数，她说不行就是不行。
examples.english_sentence: What your mother says is final, if she says no, it's no.

english_meaning: as; to act as; to take something as; achievement; conduct
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词; 动词; 名词
explanation_mandarin: 1. 当作，看作。2. 行为；表现。 3. （表示以某种身份或性质出现）。
explanation_english: 1. To take something as, to regard as. 2. Behavior, conduct. 3. To act as, serve as.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作為一個老師，好盡責㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 lou5 si1, hou2 zeon6 zaak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他作为一个老师，很尽责的。
examples.english_sentence: As a teacher, he is very responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要以佢嘅成就作為榜樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji5 keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 zok3 wai4 bong2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要以他的成就作为榜样。
examples.english_sentence: We should take his achievements as an example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作為令到人好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zok3 wai4 ling6 dou3 jan4 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为令人很失望。
examples.english_sentence: His conduct is very disappointing.

english_meaning: as; to act as; to be; in the capacity of; considering
explanation_mandarin: 1. 作为，当作。表示身份、性质等。2. 行动，做事。
explanation_english: 1. As; in the capacity of. Indicates a role, function, or nature. 2. To act; to do; to perform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作爲一個老師，好有責任感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 lou5 si1, hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一名老师，他很有责任感。
examples.english_sentence: As a teacher, he is very responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作爲一個香港人，我好鍾意飲奶茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 naai5 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为香港人，我非常喜欢喝奶茶。
examples.english_sentence: As a Hongkonger, I really like to drink milk tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢作爲公司嘅代表，可以做好啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 zok3 wai4 gung1 si1 ge3 doi6 biu2, ho2 ji5 zou6 hou2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他作为公司的代表，可以把事情做好一些。
examples.english_sentence: I hope that as a representative of the company, he can do things better.

english_meaning: as; to act as; to take something as; in the capacity of
explanation_mandarin: 表示身份、性质或作用；当作；充当
explanation_english: as, serving as; to act as, function as; to take (something) as; in the capacity of; regarding, concerning (less common). Often indicates a role or function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢作爲學生代表，要喺畢業典禮上面講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok3 wai4 hok6 saang1 doi6 biu2, jiu3 hai2 bat1 jip6 din2 lai5 soeng6 min6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他作为学生代表，要在毕业典礼上讲话。
examples.english_sentence: As the student representative, he needs to give a speech at the graduation ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住將呢個 project 作爲我嘅畢業論文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 ni1 go3 project zok3 wai4 ngo5 ge3 bat1 jip6 leon6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算把这个项目作为我的毕业论文。
examples.english_sentence: I intend to use this project as my graduation thesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作爲一個負責任嘅公民，我哋應該投票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 fu6 zaak3 jam3 ge3 gung1 man4, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 tau4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个负责任的公民，我们应该投票。
examples.english_sentence: As a responsible citizen, we should vote.

english_meaning: To boast; to brag; to show off; to talk big
explanation_mandarin: 指人为了炫耀或虚张声势而说大话，吹牛。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who talks big, boasts, or brags in order to show off or create a false impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都作牙，話自己好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zok3 ngaa4, waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是吹牛，说自己很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He always boasts, saying he is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日作牙啦，冇人信你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zok3 ngaa4 laa1, mou5 jan4 seon3 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是吹牛了，没人相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always brag, no one believes you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度作牙，話自己識得好多明星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 zok3 ngaa4, waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 hou2 do1 ming4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里吹牛，说自己认识很多明星。
examples.english_sentence: He's bragging there, saying he knows a lot of celebrities.

english_meaning: to be pretentious; to put on an act; to feign; to act affectedly; to be showy
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人故意做作，装出某种姿态或行为，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is being deliberately pretentious, putting on an act, or feigning a particular attitude or behavior. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老闆面前成日作狀，想博佢好感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 seng4 jat6 zok3 zong6, soeng2 bok3 keoi5 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前总是装模作样，想博得他的好感。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act in front of the boss, trying to gain his favour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁作狀啦，好假呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zok3 zong6 laa1, hou2 gaa2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么做作了，好假啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pretentious, it's so fake!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到咁作狀，唔知去邊度呀？

examples.english_sentence: Exercise has a great effect on the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作用係幫手聯絡各個部門。

examples.english_sentence: His role is to help liaise with various departments.

english_meaning: to paint, to draw

explanation_english: Refers to the act of creating paintings or drawings, including using various painting tools and materials to draw images on paper, canvas, or other surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意作畫，成日畫啲風景畫。

examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mother would teach me how to paint.

english_meaning: to fake illness, to feign sickness, to pretend to be sick
explanation_mandarin: 假装生病，通常是为了逃避责任或引起注意。
explanation_english: To pretend to be sick, usually to avoid responsibility or to gain attention. It implies a deliberate act of deception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都作病唔返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zok3 beng6 m4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装病不上班。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be sick and doesn't go to work.

examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be sick anymore, no one will believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢個樣就知佢作病㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 zau6 zi1 keoi5 zok3 beng6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他的样子就知道他在装病了。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at him, you can tell he's faking being sick.

english_meaning: To haunt; to cause trouble (usually by supernatural forces or negative influences); to act up; to be at work (e.g., jealousy is at work)
explanation_mandarin: 指鬼神或某种不好的因素在暗中捣乱，使人或事物发生不好的变化。
explanation_english: Refers to ghosts, spirits, or some negative factors secretly causing trouble, leading to negative changes in people or things. Often used to attribute unexplained problems or negative behavior to unseen forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗都係啲污糟嘢作祟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 dou1 hai6 di1 wu1 zou1 je5 zok3 seoi6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得应该是脏东西在作怪吧。
examples.english_sentence: I think it's probably just some unclean spirits haunting us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係心理作用作祟，先至會咁諗啫。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是心理作用在作祟，才会这么想吧。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe it's just your mind playing tricks on you; that's why you think that way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日咁反常，唔知乜嘢作祟呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gam3 faan2 soeng4, m4 zi1 mat1 je5 zok3 seoi6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天这么反常，不知道是什么在作怪呢？
examples.english_sentence: He's acting so strangely today, I wonder what's causing it.

mandarin_meaning: 积德, 行善, 祈福
english_meaning: To accumulate merit, to do good deeds, to pray for blessings
explanation_mandarin: 指通过做好事、捐款、参与慈善活动等方式来积累功德，祈求好运和福报。
explanation_english: Refers to accumulating merit by doing good deeds, donating money, participating in charitable activities, etc., in order to pray for good luck and blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日捐錢畀慈善機構，希望可以作福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zok3 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常捐钱给慈善机构，希望可以积德。
examples.english_sentence: He often donates money to charities, hoping to accumulate merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該多啲做善事，為自己同埋下一代作福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 do1 di1 zou6 sin6 si6, wai6 zi6 gei2 tung4 maai4 haa6 jat1 doi6 zok3 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多做善事，为自己和下一代积德。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more good deeds to accumulate merit for ourselves and future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面好多人都喺度作福，希望神明保佑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu2 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hai2 dou6 zok3 fuk1, hei1 mong6 san4 ming4 bou2 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里很多人都在祈福，希望神明保佑。
examples.english_sentence: Many people are praying for blessings in the temple, hoping for divine protection.

english_meaning: Year-end banquet for employees and business partners; Last day of worship for the Earth God
explanation_mandarin: 指农历腊月十六的尾牙，是商家一年中最后一次祭拜土地公的日子，也是宴请员工的日子。
explanation_english: Refers to the year-end banquet traditionally held on the 16th day of the twelfth lunar month. It is the last day of the year for businesses to worship the Earth God and also an opportunity to treat employees to a feast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日公司作禡，有得食好嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gung1 si1 zok3 maa6, jau5 dak1 sik6 hou2 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天公司尾牙，有好吃的东西了！
examples.english_sentence: The company is having its year-end banquet tomorrow, there will be good food to eat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年作禡，老細話會抽獎㗎！

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的尾牙，老板说会抽奖啊！
examples.english_sentence: The boss said there will be a lucky draw at this year's year-end banquet!

english_meaning: to answer, to reply, to respond
explanation_mandarin: 回答问题或要求。
explanation_english: To answer a question or request.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候要认真作答。
examples.english_sentence: You have to answer seriously during the exam.

examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 cheung4 sai3 zok3 daap3 mui5 jat1 tiu4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你详细回答每一条问题。
examples.english_sentence: Please answer each question in detail.

english_meaning: to spin a cocoon around oneself; to tie oneself up in a cocoon of one's own making; to create one's own problems; hoist oneself with one's own petard
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做了某事，结果反而使自己受困。 形容做了蠢事而自食其果。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where someone's own actions or decisions lead to their own problems or constraints. It implies that a person has created a difficult situation for themselves through their own doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢嘅，成日作繭自縛，抵佢咁慘嘅。

examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he always creates his own problems, so it's his own fault he's in such a bad situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁堅持己見啦，如果唔係嘅話，好容易作繭自縛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gin1 ci4 gei2 gin3 laa1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 ge3 waa2, hou2 yung4 yi6 zok3 gaan2 zi6 bok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么坚持己见了，不然的话，很容易作茧自缚的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, otherwise, you'll easily create problems for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅政策咁嚴苛，根本就係作繭自縛，點會有人想喺度做嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jing4 zaak3 gam3 jim4 ho1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 zok3 gaan2 zi6 bok3, dim2 wui jau5 jan4 soeng2 hai2 dou6 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的政策这么严苛，根本就是作茧自缚，怎么会有人想在这里工作啊？
examples.english_sentence: This company's policies are so strict, it's basically self-defeating, how would anyone want to work here?

english_meaning: to arrange, to decorate, to furnish, to set up
explanation_mandarin: 指将物品摆放好，进行布置和装饰，使环境更加美观。
explanation_english: To arrange and decorate items, to furnish a space, and to make the environment more aesthetically pleasing.

english_meaning: to drop (the matter); to abandon (a plan); to cancel
explanation_mandarin: 停止进行，放弃。
explanation_english: To stop doing something; to abandon a plan or idea; to cancel.

examples.english_sentence: We've talked for a long time and haven't reached a consensus, why don't we just drop it?

examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, jin2 coeng3 wui2 wai4 jau5 zok3 baa6.

english_meaning: to nurture talent; to cultivate outstanding individuals
explanation_mandarin: 培养有才能的人。
explanation_english: To nurture and cultivate talented individuals; to train and develop outstanding people, especially for a specific purpose or field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一世人都係作育英才，桃李滿天下。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都在培养人才，桃李满天下。
examples.english_sentence: He has spent his whole life nurturing talents; his students are everywhere.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的词很有诗意。
examples.english_sentence: The lyrics he writes are very poetic.

english_meaning: to testify; to give evidence; to bear witness
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭或其它正式场合提供证据，证明某事属实。
explanation_english: To give evidence or testimony in a court or other formal setting, proving the truth of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭作證，證明被告有罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 zok3 zing3, zing3 ming4 bei6 gou3 jau5 zeoi6.

examples.english_sentence: He testified in court, proving that the defendant was guilty.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你愿不愿意作证，说出真相？
examples.english_sentence: Are you willing to testify and tell the truth?

examples.english_sentence: They all need someone to testify to support their claims.

english_meaning: to have a guilty conscience; to betray oneself through a guilty conscience
explanation_mandarin: 做了坏事怕人知道，心里总是感到不安。
explanation_english: Describing someone who feels uneasy or anxious because they have done something wrong and fear being discovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日避開我嘅眼神，擺明係作賊心虛啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei6 hoi1 ngo5 ge3 ngaan5 san4, baai2 ming4 hai6 zok3 caak6 sam1 heoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是避开我的眼神，很明显是做贼心虚了。
examples.english_sentence: He always avoids my gaze, it's obvious he has a guilty conscience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大聲做乜啊？唔通你作賊心虛咩？

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那么大声干什么？难道你做贼心虚吗？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so loud? Are you feeling guilty?

mandarin_meaning: 糟蹋, 糟践, 自轻自贱
english_meaning: to waste, to spoil; to treat oneself or someone else poorly; to undervalue; to be self-deprecating; to devalue
explanation_mandarin: 指不珍惜，浪费，轻视，或自我贬低的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of not cherishing, wasting, despising, or self-deprecating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁後生就唔做嘢，咁樣作賤自己㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hau6 san1 zau6 m4 zou6 je5, gam2 joeng2 zok6 zin6 zi6 gei2 gaa3?

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说自己不漂亮，真是自轻自贱。
examples.english_sentence: She always says she's not pretty, she's really putting herself down.

english_meaning: to compete (in a competition); to participate in a competition; to play (in a game/match)
explanation_mandarin: 参加比赛。通常指体育比赛。
explanation_english: To participate in a competition, usually referring to sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日會代表香港去奧運作賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 heoi3 ou3 wan6 zok3 coi3.

examples.english_sentence: He will represent Hong Kong in the Olympics tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波今個禮拜六會作賽，希望到時你可以嚟支持我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 luk6 wui5 zok3 coi3, hei1 mong6 dou3 si4 nei5 ho2 ji5 lai4 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6.

examples.english_sentence: Our team will be playing this Saturday. We hope you can come and support us.

explanation_english: Refers to despising, wasting, or spoiling something or someone. It can also refer to trampling on someone's dignity or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁作踐自己啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zok3 zin6 zi6 gei2 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么糟蹋自己了，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste yourself like that, it's not good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日作踐啲嘢食，食剩咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zok3 zin6 di1 je5 sik6, sik6 sing6 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是浪费食物，剩下这么多。
examples.english_sentence: He always wastes food, leaving so much behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁作踐佢嘅感情啦，佢對你咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zok3 zin6 keoi5 ge3 gam2 ching4 laa1, keoi5 deoi3 nei5 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么践踏她的感情了，她对你这么好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trample on her feelings like that, she's so good to you.

english_meaning: To feign tears; to pretend to cry; to act pitiful
explanation_mandarin: 假装哭泣，博取同情。通常带有贬义，指故意装出可怜的样子。
explanation_english: To pretend to cry or act pitifully, usually to gain sympathy. It carries a negative connotation, suggesting insincerity and manipulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一唔順意就作雨，好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 m4 seon6 ji3 zau6 zok3 jyu5, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一不顺心就装可怜，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He pretends to cry whenever he's unhappy, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪喺度作雨啦，我都唔會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 hai2 dou6 zok3 jyu5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里装可怜了，我都不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop feigning tears, I won't believe you anyway.

english_meaning: style; way (of doing things); manner
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作、学习等方面表现出来的风格、态度和方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the style, attitude, and manner in which someone works or studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢嘅作風好有效率㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 ge3 zok3 fung1 hou2 jau5 haau6 leot2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作作风很有效率。
examples.english_sentence: His style of working is very efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅作風同以前好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zok3 fung1 tung4 ji5 cin4 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的作风和以前很不一样。
examples.english_sentence: Their style is very different from before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意佢哋嘅作風，太官僚主義喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zok3 fung1, taai3 gun1 liu4 zyu2 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢他们的作风，太官僚主义了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like their style, it's too bureaucratic.

english_meaning: To throw one's weight around; to act bossy; to throw one's weight around and show off.
explanation_mandarin: 指仗势欺人，摆架子，自以为是，耀武扬威。
explanation_english: Refers to abusing one's power and authority to bully others, putting on airs, acting self-important, and showing off arrogantly. It implies someone is behaving in a domineering and pretentious manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一升職就開始作鹽作光，真係乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sing1 zik1 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zok3 jim4 zok3 gwong1, zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一升职就开始作威作福，真令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got promoted, he started throwing his weight around, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己大晒，唔好成日喺度作鹽作光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 daai6 saai3, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zok3 jim4 zok3 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为自己了不起，不要总是在这里作威作福。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're so great, don't always throw your weight around here.

synonyms: 呼風喚雨 (fu1 fung1 wun6 jyu5)
耀武揚威 (yiu6 mou5 joeng4 wai1)

english_meaning: flattery, to flatter, to be obsequious
explanation_mandarin: 指用花言巧语来奉承、讨好别人。形容一个人善于用虚伪的言辞去迎合他人，以获取利益。
explanation_english: Refers to using flowery language to flatter and please others. Describes a person who is good at using false words to cater to others in order to gain benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔好鬼佞㗎，成日係老細面前擦鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 yau5 zai2 hou2 gwai2 ning6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 caat3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很会奉承，总是在老板面前拍马屁。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is very flattering, always sucking up to the boss.

english_meaning: you
explanation_mandarin: 第二人称单数代词，指称对方。
explanation_english: Second person singular pronoun, referring to the person being addressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫咩名呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 me1 meng2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫什么名字？
examples.english_sentence: What's your name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好掛住你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想你啊！
examples.english_sentence: I miss you so much!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten yet?

mandarin_meaning: 你这个死脑筋/你这笨蛋
english_meaning: You idiot/You blockhead/You deadhead
explanation_mandarin: 一种略带责备和玩笑意味的说法，指对方很笨，反应迟钝，像个死人头一样不灵活。
explanation_english: A mildly accusatory and playful way of calling someone an idiot or blockhead, implying they are slow-witted and inflexible, like a deadhead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個死人頭，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 sei2 jan4 tau4, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个死脑筋，这么简单的事情都不会做！
examples.english_sentence: You idiot, you can't even do something this simple!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你個死人頭，行快啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 go3 sei2 jan4 tau4, haang4 faai3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你这个死脑筋，走快点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, you blockhead, walk faster!

english_meaning: you (plural)
explanation_mandarin: 指称复数第二人称，即“你们”。
explanation_english: The plural form of 'you'. Refers to more than one person being addressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你們聽日有冇時間呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mun4 ting1 jat6 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们明天有时间吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you (plural) have time tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你好！ 你們想食啲咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hou2! nei5 mun4 soeng2 sik6 di1 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 您好！你们想吃点什么？
examples.english_sentence: Hello! What would you (plural) like to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係送俾你們嘅禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 sung3 bei2 nei5 mun4 ge3 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是送给你们的礼物。
examples.english_sentence: These are gifts for you (plural).

jyutping: nei5 zou6 co1 jat1 ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5
mandarin_meaning: 你做初一，我做十五 (lit.)/ 你怎样对我，我就怎样对你 (figurative)
english_meaning: You do the first, I'll do the fifteenth. / Tit for tat / An eye for an eye
explanation_mandarin: 表面意思是指你做初一，我做正月十五，实际上比喻对方怎么对待我，我就怎么对待对方，以牙还牙，以眼还眼。
explanation_english: Literally means 'You do the first (day of the month), I'll do the fifteenth (day of the month)'. Figuratively, it means 'Tit for tat' or 'An eye for an eye'. It describes a situation where someone retaliates in kind for an offense or injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢蝦我，我就唔會畀佢好過，你做初一我做十五囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa1 ngo5, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 bei2 keoi5 hou2 gwo3, nei5 zou6 co1 jat1 ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欺负我，我也不会让他好过，你做初一，我做十五。
examples.english_sentence: He bullies me, so I won't let him off easily. Tit for tat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為人哋好恰呀，你做初一我做十五，到時後悔都嚟唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 jan4 dei6 hou2 hap1 aa3, nei5 zou6 co1 jat1 ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5, dou3 si4 hau6 fui3 dou1 lai4 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为别人好欺负，你做初一，我做十五，到时候后悔都来不及。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think others are easy to bully. You do the first, I'll do the fifteenth. You'll regret it when it's too late.

jyutping: nei5 zou6 co1 jat1, ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5
mandarin_meaning: 你做初一，我做十五 (literally translates to the same thing, indicating retaliation)
english_meaning: Tit for tat; An eye for an eye; You do something bad to me first, and I will retaliate in kind.
explanation_mandarin: 指你先做出不好的事情，我就会用同样的方式报复你。强调以牙还牙，以眼还眼。
explanation_english: This idiom means if you do something bad to me first, I will retaliate in the same way. It emphasizes the principle of 'an eye for an eye'. The 'first day of the month' and the 'fifteenth day of the month' are used as placeholders to indicate a cyclical and reciprocal action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日蝦我，今次我要俾佢知，你做初一，我做十五！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haa1 ngo5, gam1 ci3 ngo5 jiu3 bei2 keoi5 zi1, nei5 zou6 co1 jat1, ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是欺负我，这次我要让他知道，你做初一，我做十五！
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies me. This time I'll let him know, tit for tat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為我咁容易俾你恰，你做初一，我做十五㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 nei5 hap1, nei5 zou6 co1 jat1, ngo5 zou6 sap6 ng5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为我这么容易被你欺负，你做初一，我做十五的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can bully me so easily, I'll give you tit for tat!

synonyms: 以牙還牙 (ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4)

english_meaning: You just wait and see!
explanation_mandarin: 表示威胁或警告的口语表达，通常表达说话者生气，并暗示将会采取行动。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression of threat or warning, usually expressing anger and implying that the speaker will take action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同我定，我一定會報仇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 ngo5 deng6, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 bou3 cau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给我等着，我一定会报仇！
examples.english_sentence: You just wait, I'll definitely get my revenge!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同我定，遲早我會證明你係錯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 ngo5 deng6, chi4 zou2 ngo5 wui5 zheng3 ming4 nei5 hai6 cho3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给我等着，迟早我会证明你是错的。
examples.english_sentence: You just wait, sooner or later I'll prove you wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同我定，我會令你後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 ngo5 deng6, ngo5 wui5 ling6 nei5 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给我等着，我会让你后悔。
examples.english_sentence: You just wait, I'll make you regret it.

english_meaning: And you?/What about you?/How about you?
explanation_mandarin: 询问对方情况，相当于普通话的“你呢？”通常在陈述完自己的情况后使用，表示反问，询问对方的情况。
explanation_english: Used to ask about the other person's situation, similar to "And you?" or "What about you?" in English. It's usually used after stating one's own situation, indicating a return question to inquire about the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好攰，你呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6, nei1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很累，你呢？
examples.english_sentence: I'm very tired today, and you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意飲咖啡，你呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yam2 gaa3 fe1, nei1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢喝咖啡，你呢？
examples.english_sentence: I like drinking coffee, what about you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我準備去旅行，你呢？今年有冇計劃去邊度玩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, nei1 ne1? gam1 nin4 jau5 mou5 gai3 waak6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我准备去旅行，你呢？今年有没有计划去哪里玩啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to travel, and you? Do you have any plans to go somewhere fun this year?

english_meaning: you (plural)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中“你们”的说法。
explanation_english: "You" in the plural form in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋今日想食啲乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们今天想吃什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What do you guys want to eat today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋系边度嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 hai6 bin1 dou6 lei4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们是从哪里来的？
examples.english_sentence: Where are you guys from?

mandarin_meaning: 你们这些人; 你手下的人
english_meaning: You people; Your people; Your group (often used with a negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 指称对方所属的群体，通常带有负面评价或不满情绪。也可以指对方的手下或团队。
explanation_english: Refers to the group to which the person you are speaking to belongs, usually with a negative connotation or dissatisfaction. It can also refer to the person's subordinates or team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲人成日遲到，點做嘢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 jan4 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, dim2 zou6 je5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们这些人总是迟到，怎么工作的？
examples.english_sentence: You people are always late, how do you even work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲人搞成咁嘅樣，真係冇眼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 jan4 gaau2 sing4 gam2 ge3 joeng2, zan1 hai6 mou5 ngaan5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你手下的人弄成这个样子，真是没眼看。
examples.english_sentence: Your people made such a mess, it's really unbearable to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同你啲人合作，佢哋好唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 di1 jan4 hap6 jok3, keoi5 dei6 hou2 m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和你们这些人合作，他们很不靠谱。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to cooperate with you people, they are very unreliable.

english_meaning: Hello; Hi
explanation_mandarin: 表示问候，相当于“你好”。
explanation_english: A greeting, equivalent to 'Hello' or 'Hi'. Used to address someone when meeting them or starting a conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你好呀！好耐冇見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hou2 aa3! hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你好呀！好久不见了！
examples.english_sentence: Hello! Long time no see!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你好，請問廁所喺邊度呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hou2, cing2 man6 ci3 so2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你好，请问洗手间在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Hello, excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你好，我想買一張去香港嘅飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hou2, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 zoeng1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你好，我想买一张去香港的机票。
examples.english_sentence: Hello, I'd like to buy a ticket to Hong Kong.

english_meaning: You are really good/You are awesome/You're something else (often used sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用来赞扬别人做得很好，很厉害。有时候也带有一些讽刺意味，表示对方做了出乎意料的事情（无论好坏）。
explanation_english: Generally used to praise someone for doing something well or being capable. Sometimes, it can be used sarcastically, implying that someone has done something unexpected (whether good or bad). The tone is crucial for understanding the intended meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就搞掂咗份報告，你好嘢喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3, nei5 hou2 je5 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就搞定了这份报告，你真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: You finished the report so quickly, you're really something!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考到第一名，你好嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, nei5 hou2 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考到第一名，你真棒！
examples.english_sentence: You got first place in the exam, you're awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你竟然偷嘢，你好嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ging2 jin4 tau1 je5, nei5 hou2 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你竟然偷东西，你真厉害啊！(讽刺)
examples.english_sentence: You actually stole something, you're something else! (sarcastically)

english_meaning: You wish!
explanation_mandarin: 表示对方的想法不切实际，不可能实现，带有嘲讽或拒绝的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses that the other person's idea is unrealistic, impossible to achieve, and carries a sarcastic or rejecting tone. It implies that the desired outcome is highly unlikely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話唔做嘢都有錢收？你就想啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 m4 zou6 je5 dou1 jau5 cin2 sau1? nei5 zau6 soeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说不做事也有钱拿？你想得美！
examples.english_sentence: You're saying you can get paid without working? You wish!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔讀書都考到第一？你就想啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 duk6 syu1 dou1 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1? nei5 zau6 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不读书也能考到第一名？你想得美。
examples.english_sentence: You think you can get first place without studying? You wish!

synonyms: 你想得美 (nei5 soeng2 dak1 mei5)

english_meaning: mutual consent; consensual; willing to do something for each other
explanation_mandarin: 指双方都愿意，没有强迫。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where both parties are willing and there is no coercion or force involved. It emphasizes the voluntary nature of the agreement or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事你情我願，冇人逼佢哋。
