examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 nei5 cing4 ngo5 jyun6, mou5 jan4 bik1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是两厢情愿的，没人强迫他们。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is of mutual consent, no one forced them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果係你情我願嘅交易，咁就冇問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 nei5 cing4 ngo5 jyun6 ge3 gaau1 yik6, gam2 zau6 mou5 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果是两厢情愿的交易，那就没问题了。
examples.english_sentence: If it's a consensual transaction, then there's no problem.

english_meaning: To push and yield to each other; To defer to each other; To show mutual courtesy
explanation_mandarin: 形容彼此谦让，互相推辞，不争抢。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people defer to each other, showing politeness and not competing or scrambling for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個你推我讓，都唔肯做大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 nei5 teoi1 ngo5 joeng6, dou1 m4 hang2 zou6 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个互相推让，都不肯当老大。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them deferred to each other, neither was willing to be the leader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都咁客氣，你推我讓，都唔肯先攞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 gam3 haak3 hei3, nei5 teoi1 ngo5 joeng6, dou1 m4 hang2 sin1 lo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都这么客气，互相推让，都不肯先拿。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is being so polite, deferring to each other, and no one wants to take it first.

cantonese: 你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈
jyutping: nei5 ging3 ngo5 jat1 cek3, ngo5 ging3 nei5 jat1 zoeng6
mandarin_meaning: 你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈 (literally); 礼尚往来 (metaphorically)
english_meaning: You respect me one foot, I'll respect you ten feet (literally); Treat others as they treat you, but even more generously (metaphorically); Reciprocity, but with added generosity.
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种互相尊重的态度，但程度会更大。 如果别人对你好，你会以更大的善意回报。强调互相尊重，互惠互利，并超出预期的回报。
explanation_english: Expresses an attitude of mutual respect, but with an emphasis on exceeding the level of respect given. If someone treats you well, you will return the favor with even greater kindness and respect. It highlights the importance of reciprocity and mutual benefit, often exceeding expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁幫你，你咪要你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 bong1 nei5, nei5 mai1 jiu3 nei5 ging3 ngo5 jat1 cek3, ngo5 ging3 nei5 jat1 zoeng6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么帮你，你当然要礼尚往来，对他更好啦。
examples.english_sentence: He helped you so much, of course you should reciprocate and treat him even better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意就係咁，你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈，大家先可以合作長久。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 zau6 hai6 gam2, nei5 ging3 ngo5 jat1 cek3, ngo5 ging3 nei5 jat1 zoeng6, daai6 gaa1 sin1 ho2 ji5 hap6 jok3 coeng4 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意就是这样，你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈，大家才可以长期合作。
examples.english_sentence: That's how business works. You respect me one foot, I'll respect you ten feet, then we can have a long-term cooperation.

jyutping: nei5 jau5 nei5, ngo5 jau5 ngo5
english_meaning: You have your way, and I have mine; To each their own; Do your own thing.
explanation_mandarin: 表示每个人都有自己的想法、做法或生活方式，互不干涉。
explanation_english: Expresses that everyone has their own ideas, ways of doing things, or lifestyles, and they don't interfere with each other. It implies a degree of independence and acceptance of different approaches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有你嘅諗法，我有我嘅諗法，你有你，我有我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 nei5 ge3 lam2 faat3, ngo5 jau5 ngo5 ge3 lam2 faat3, nei5 jau5 nei5, ngo5 jau5 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有你的想法，我有我的想法，你有你的，我有你的吧。
examples.english_sentence: You have your ideas, and I have mine. You do you, and I'll do me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意咁做，你有你，我有我，唔使理佢咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 gam2 zou6, nei5 jau5 nei5, ngo5 jau5 ngo5, m4 sai2 lei5 keoi5 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢这么做，你有你的，我有我的，不用管他那么多。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to do it that way. You do your own thing, and I'll do mine. Don't worry about him so much.

cantonese: 你有張良計，我有過牆梯
jyutping: nei5 jau5 zoeng1 loeng4 gai3, ngo5 jau5 gwo3 coeng4 tai1
mandarin_meaning: 你有你的计策，我也有我的办法
english_meaning: If you have your plan, I have my solution; for every trick, there's a counter-trick.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻对方有计谋，我方也有对策。表示不甘示弱，能应对挑战。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone has a plan or strategy, but the other person has a counter-plan or solution to overcome it. It implies a sense of resilience and the ability to respond to challenges effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住壟斷市場，但係你有張良計，我有過牆梯，我哋可以開發新產品嚟競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 lung5 dyun2 si5 coeng4, daan6 hai6 nei5 jau5 zoeng1 loeng4 gai3, ngo5 jau5 gwo3 coeng4 tai1, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 faat3 san1 caan2 ban2 lai4 ging6 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想垄断市场，但是你有你的计策，我也有我的办法，我们可以开发新产品来竞争。
examples.english_sentence: They're planning to monopolize the market, but if they have their plan, we have our solution. We can develop new products to compete.

synonyms: 兵來將擋，水來土掩 (bing1 loi4 zoeng3 dong2, seoi2 loi4 tou2 jim2)

mandarin_meaning: 你死了是你的事/关我什么事
english_meaning: If you die, it's your problem/None of my business
explanation_mandarin: 表示对别人的不幸或困境漠不关心，不负责任的态度，意味着某人的死亡或者倒霉与自己无关，自己不会承担任何责任。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference or lack of responsibility towards someone else's misfortune or predicament. It implies that someone's death or bad luck is their own problem and that the speaker will not take any responsibility for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢借錢唔還，都係你死你事，唔關我事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 keoi5 ze3 cin2 m4 waan4, dou1 hai6 nei5 sei2 nei5 si6, m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算他借钱不还，也是你自己的事，不关我的事。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he doesn't pay back the money he borrowed, it's your problem, it's none of my business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唔聽人講，到時出咗事，你死你事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 m4 teng1 jan4 gong2, dou3 si4 ceot1 zo2 si6, nei5 sei2 nei5 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不听人劝，到时候出了事，你死了是你的事。
examples.english_sentence: You're so unwilling to listen to advice. If something goes wrong later, it's your problem.

synonyms: 關人鬼事 (gwaan1 jan4 gwai2 si6)
唔關我事 (m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6)

english_meaning: a life-and-death struggle; mortal combat; one must die for the other to live
explanation_mandarin: 形容双方矛盾尖锐，斗争激烈，必须有一方灭亡才能解决问题。
explanation_english: Describes an intense conflict between two parties where one must be defeated for the other to survive; a situation of extreme rivalry or animosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波係你死我活嘅決戰，輸咗就冇機會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 hai6 nei5 sei2 ngo5 wut6 ge3 kyut3 zin3, syu1 zo2 zau6 mou5 gei1 wui2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场球赛是一场你死我活的决战，输了就没有机会了。
examples.english_sentence: This game is a life-and-death battle. If we lose, we won't have another chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上，競爭有時都會變到你死我活咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6, ging6 zang1 jau5 si4 dou1 wui5 bin3 dou3 nei5 sei2 ngo5 wut6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，竞争有时也会变得你死我活。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, competition can sometimes become a life-and-death struggle.

jyutping: nei5 dong3 ngo5 hai6 san4 zyu2 paai2
mandarin_meaning: 你把我当成摆设/你把我当成死人
english_meaning: You treat me like a decoration/You treat me like I'm dead/You take me for granted and ignore me.
explanation_mandarin: 神主牌指的是祠堂里供奉祖先灵位的牌位，通常是静止不动的。这句话比喻对方把你当作没有生命的物品，对你的意见或存在视而不见，不尊重你。
explanation_english: "神主牌" refers to an ancestral tablet in a shrine, which is typically static and unchanging. This phrase is used to describe someone who is being treated as if they are an inanimate object, their opinions or presence ignored, and they are not respected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋開會都唔問我意見，你當我係神主牌呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 hoi1 wui2 dou1 m4 man6 ngo5 ji3 gin3, nei5 dong3 ngo5 hai6 san4 zyu2 paai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们开会都不问我意见，是把我当成摆设吗？
examples.english_sentence: You guys don't even ask for my opinion in the meeting. Do you think I'm just a decoration?

english_meaning: To stare at each other blankly; to look at each other in silence and confusion.
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家面对困境或尴尬局面，不知所措，互相看着对方却无法解决问题。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people are facing a difficult or awkward situation and are at a loss for what to do, looking at each other without any solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦突然死咗機，我哋你眼望我眼，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 dat6 jin4 si2 zo2 gei1, ngo5 dei6 nei5 ngaan5 mong6 ngo5 ngaan5, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑突然死机了，我们大眼瞪小眼，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The computer suddenly crashed, and we were staring at each other blankly, not knowing what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆問邊個做錯咗，我哋你眼望我眼，冇人敢認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 man6 bin1 go3 zou6 co3 zo2, ngo5 dei6 nei5 ngaan5 mong6 ngo5 ngaan5, mou5 jan4 gam2 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板问是谁做错了，我们大眼瞪小眼，没有人敢承认。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked who made the mistake, and we all stared at each other blankly, no one daring to admit it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課咁難，我同佢你眼望我眼，大家都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 gam3 naan4, ngo5 tung4 keoi5 nei5 ngaan5 mong6 ngo5 ngaan5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份功课太难了，我和他大眼瞪小眼，大家都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: The homework is so difficult, he and I were staring at each other blankly, none of us know how to do it.

jyutping: nei5 zi1, ngo5 zi1, daan1 ngaan5 lou2 dou1 zi1
mandarin_meaning: 你知，我知道，独眼龙都知道
english_meaning: You know, I know, even a one-eyed man knows (it's an open secret)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事情非常明显，大家都知道，已是公开的秘密。
explanation_english: Describes something very obvious, that everyone knows, and is an open secret. A one-eyed man is used as a figure to suggest that even someone with limited vision would be able to see the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係，你知，我知，單眼佬都知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, nei5 zi1, ngo5 zi1, daan1 ngaan5 lou2 dou1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的关系，你知，我知道，大家都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship, you know, I know, even a one-eyed man knows.

synonyms: 人所共知 (jan4 so2 gung1 zi1)
街知巷聞 (gaai1 zi1 hong2 man4)

english_meaning: Your mother's...
explanation_mandarin: 一种粗俗的骂人话，表示不满或愤怒，等同于“你妈的”。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese expression used to express anger, frustration, or annoyance. It's similar to saying "your mother's" in a derogatory way. It's considered very rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老味，又搞搞震！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 mei6, jau6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你妈的，又在捣乱！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, you're messing things up again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老味，做乜咁鬼蠢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 mei6, zou6 mat1 gam3 gwai2 ceon2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你妈的，怎么这么笨？
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, why are you so stupid?

mandarin_meaning: 你可真棒！/ 你厉害！ (讽刺)
english_meaning: You're so great! / You're so awesome! (sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种讽刺的赞赏，通常用于对方做了一些不太明智或者让人无语的事情之后，并非真心赞赏。类似于“你真行！”，但语气更加强烈和不屑。
explanation_english: Expresses sarcastic appreciation, usually used when someone has done something unwise or speechless, not genuinely praising them. Similar to "You're something!" but with a stronger and more disdainful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔睇清楚就買咗呢部爛鬼嘢，你老板呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 tai2 cing1 chu2 zau6 maai5 zo2 ni1 bou6 laan6 gwai2 je5, nei5 lou5 baan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你没看清楚就买了这破东西，你真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: You bought this crappy thing without checking carefully, you're so awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又遲到，重要話自己塞車，你老板！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 ci4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 waa6 zi6 gei2 sak1 che1, nei5 lou5 baan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又迟到了，还要说自己堵车，真是厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He's late again and claims it's because of traffic, you're something!

english_meaning: Your mother
explanation_mandarin: 对对方母亲的称呼，通常带有侮辱或挑衅的意味。
explanation_english: A reference to someone's mother, usually used as an insult or provocation. Highly offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老母臭X！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 mou2 cau3 hai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你妈臭X！
examples.english_sentence: Your mother's a cunt!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收聲啦，你老母！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 seng1 laa1, nei5 lou5 mou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 闭嘴吧，你妈！
examples.english_sentence: Shut up, you mother!

english_meaning: your ancestors; a curse meaning 'screw you' or 'go to hell'
explanation_mandarin: 指对方的祖先，带有侮辱和诅咒的意味，相当于骂对方的祖宗十八代。
explanation_english: Refers to someone's ancestors, but used as an insult and a curse. It is similar to cursing someone's entire lineage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老祖！我唔撚會放過你㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 zou2! ngo5 m4 lan2 wui5 fong3 gwo3 nei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会放过你！
examples.english_sentence: Screw you! I will not let you go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做對得住你老祖咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 deoi3 dak1 zyu6 nei5 lou5 zou2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做对得起你的祖先吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you acting in a way that honors your ancestors?

synonyms: 屌你老母 (diu2 nei5 lou5 mou2)

mandarin_meaning: 你说了算; 你的老板
english_meaning: Whatever you say; You're the boss; Your boss
explanation_mandarin: 两种意思：一是字面意义，指对方的老板。二是表示同意对方的说法，含有无奈或者服从的意味。
explanation_english: Two meanings: Firstly, the literal meaning refers to the other person's boss. Secondly, it expresses agreement with the other person's statement, often with a sense of helplessness or obedience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老闆講乜就乜啦，我哋都冇得say。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 baan2 gong2 mat1 zau6 mat1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou5 dak1 say1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老板说什么就是什么吧，我们都没得说。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever your boss says, goes. We have no say in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦好啦，你老闆啦，你想點咪點囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1 hou2 laa1, nei5 lou5 baan2 laa1, nei5 soeng2 dim2 mai1 dim2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吧好吧，你说了算，你想怎样就怎样吧。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, alright, you're the boss. Do whatever you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日記得問下你老闆先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gei3 dak1 man6 haa5 nei5 lou5 baan2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天记得先问问你的老板。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to ask your boss first tomorrow.

english_meaning: Think whatever you want; It's up to you what you think; Do what you want
explanation_mandarin: 表示对方的意见与自己无关，随对方怎么想，表达一种不理会、不在乎的态度。
explanation_english: This phrase expresses indifference or dismissal towards someone else's thoughts or opinions. It implies 'it's your business what you think' or 'I don't care what you think'. It can also be used to give someone permission to do something, but with a hint of not caring about the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會逼你做決定，你諗你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 bik1 nei5 zou6 kyut3 ding6, nei5 nam2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会强迫你做决定，你想你的吧。
examples.english_sentence: I won't force you to make a decision, think whatever you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講乜都唔重要，你諗你咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 mat1 dou1 m4 zung6 jiu3, nei5 nam2 nei5 mai6 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说什么都不重要，你想你的就好了。
examples.english_sentence: What he says isn't important, just think what you want.

mandarin_meaning: 你在说什么啊？/ 你说话啊！
english_meaning: Are you saying something?/ Say something!
explanation_mandarin: 用于表达惊讶、催促或者不理解对方说的话。根据语境，可以是略带责备，也可以是单纯的询问。
explanation_english: Used to express surprise, urge someone to speak, or indicate that you don't understand what the other person is saying. Depending on the context, it can be slightly reproachful or simply a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先講咗咁多嘢，你都唔應機，你講嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, nei5 dou1 m4 ying3 gei1, nei5 gong2 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才说了这么多，你都没反应，你说句话啊？
examples.english_sentence: I said so much just now, and you didn't respond. Are you going to say something?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢呀？ 我聽唔到你講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 aa3? ngo5 ting1 m4 dou2 nei5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在说什么啊？我听不到你在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Are you saying something? I can't hear what you're saying.

english_meaning: You are pathetic/useless/incompetent.
explanation_mandarin: 表达对某人表现不满、失望或鄙视的情绪，含贬义。
explanation_english: An expression used to express dissatisfaction, disappointment, or disdain towards someone's performance. It carries a negative connotation and implies the person is pathetic, useless, or incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鹵味㗎，咁簡單嘅嘢都做唔掂？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 mei2 gaa3, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真没用，这么简单的东西都做不好？
examples.english_sentence: You're so useless, you can't even do something this simple?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 波都唔識踢，你鹵味到呢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bo1 dou1 m4 sik1 tek3, nei5 lou5 mei2 dou3 ni1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球都不会踢，你真差劲！
examples.english_sentence: You can't even kick a ball, you're so pathetic!

english_meaning: he/she/it
explanation_mandarin: 第三人称单数代词，用于指代男性、女性或无生命的物体。
explanation_english: Third-person singular pronoun, used to refer to a male, female, or inanimate object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢去咗邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他/她去了哪里。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know where he/she went.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 它很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: It's very cute.

english_meaning: they, them
explanation_mandarin: 人称代词，第三人称复数，指代一群人。
explanation_english: Personal pronoun, third person plural, referring to a group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今日唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今天不会来。
examples.english_sentence: They won't come today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好耐冇見佢哋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 keoi5 dei6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很久没见到他们了。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't seen them for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知佢哋住邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 zyu6 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道他们住在哪里吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know where they live?

english_meaning: He wishes! / Dream on!
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人想做的事情不太可能发生或者实现，带有讽刺的语气。
explanation_english: Used to express disbelief or ridicule at someone's desires or expectations, implying that their wishes are unrealistic or unlikely to come true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就想攞冠軍，佢連初賽都入唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 soeng2 lo2 gun3 gwan1, keoi5 lin4 co1 coi3 dou1 jap6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想拿冠军，他连初赛都进不去。
examples.english_sentence: He wishes he could win the championship, he can't even get past the preliminary round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就想唔做嘢都有錢使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 soeng2 m4 zou6 je5 dou1 jau5 cin2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想不做事也有钱花。
examples.english_sentence: He wishes he could have money to spend without working.

english_meaning: It's his problem if he dies; it's his own business if he dies.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人出了事，与自己无关，不关心或不想负责任。语气比较冷漠。
explanation_english: Expressing indifference or lack of responsibility towards someone's misfortune. It implies a cold and uncaring attitude, meaning that if something bad happens to them, it's their own problem and doesn't concern the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽我勸告，一意孤行，到時真係出咗事，咪佢死佢事囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 ngo5 hyun3 gou3, jat1 ji3 gu1 haang4, dou3 si4 zan1 hai6 chut1 zo2 si6, mai6 keoi5 sei2 keoi5 si6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听我的劝告，一意孤行，到时候真的出了事，就是他自己的事了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to my advice and goes his own way. If something really bad happens to him then, it's his own business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔想幫佢，咪由得佢囉，佢死佢事啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 soeng2 bong1 keoi5, mai6 jau4 dak1 keoi5 lo1, keoi5 sei2 keoi5 si6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不想帮他，那就随他去吧，他死了也是他的事。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to help him, then just leave him be, it's his own problem if he dies.

mandarin_meaning: 死就死吧，关我什么事; 随他去死，我不在乎
english_meaning: Let him/her die, who cares?; Serve him/her right; Good riddance
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人的不幸遭遇漠不关心，带有幸灾乐祸的意味。语气比较强烈，略带鄙视。
explanation_english: Expressing indifference or schadenfreude towards someone's misfortune. It carries a strong tone of contempt and disregard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，呃咗人咁多錢，而家俾人捉咗，佢死佢賤啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, aak1 zo2 jan4 gam3 do1 cin2, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zo2, keoi5 sei2 keoi5 zin6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，骗了别人那么多钱，现在被抓了，活该！
examples.english_sentence: He was so bad, defrauding so much money from others. Now that he's been caught, serve him right!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強成日恰我哋，佢死佢賤，抵佢無好下場！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 sing4 jat6 hap1 ngo5 dei6, keoi5 sei2 keoi5 zin6, dai2 keoi5 mou5 hou2 haa6 coeng4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强总是欺负我们，活该他没有好下场！
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung always bullies us, good riddance to him, he deserves a bad ending!

english_meaning: His/her mother; A vulgar term expressing anger, annoyance, or disbelief (similar to "motherfucker")
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是“他的/她的母亲”。但在粤语中，单独使用或在句子中使用时，通常用作粗俗的语气词，表达愤怒、惊讶或不耐烦等负面情绪，类似于普通话中的“他妈的”。
explanation_english: Literally means "his/her mother." However, in Cantonese, it is often used as a vulgar interjection to express anger, surprise, impatience, or other negative emotions, similar to the English "motherfucker." The intensity and connotation depend heavily on context and tone of voice. It can also be used as a noun to refer to someone's mother but is very rarely used in a polite or formal setting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老母！又塞車！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 mou2! jau6 sak1 ce1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他妈的！又堵车！
examples.english_sentence: Motherfucker! Another traffic jam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搞我，唔係我鬧佢老母㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 ngo5, m4 hai6 ngo5 naau6 keoi5 lou5 mou2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好别再惹我，不然我就要骂他妈的了！
examples.english_sentence: You better not mess with me again, or I'll start swearing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明去咗佢老母度探佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 heoi3 zo2 keoi5 lou5 mou2 dou6 taam3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明去他妈妈那探望他。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming went to his mother's place to visit her.

synonyms: 頂你個肺 (ding2 nei5 go3 fai3)
屌你老母 (diu2 nei5 lou5 mou2)

cantonese: 佢認第二冇人敢認第一
jyutping: keoi5 jing6 dai6 ji6 mou5 jan4 gam2 jing6 dai6 jat1
mandarin_meaning: 他称第二，没人敢称第一
english_meaning: He/She admits to being second to none.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在某个领域非常杰出，无人能比，非常自信且实力强大。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is outstanding and unmatched in a particular field, possessing great confidence and strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到打機，佢認第二冇人敢認第一㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 daa2 gei1, keoi5 jing6 dai6 ji6 mou5 jan4 gam2 jing6 dai6 jat1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说到打游戏，他称第二没人敢称第一。
examples.english_sentence: When it comes to playing video games, he admits to being second to none.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫畫咁叻，認第二冇人敢認第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 gam3 lek1, jing6 dai6 ji6 mou5 jan4 gam2 jing6 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画这么厉害，称第二没人敢称第一。
examples.english_sentence: He is so good at painting, no one dares to claim to be better than him.

synonyms: 首屈一指 (sau2 kwat1 jat1 zhi2)
獨佔鰲頭 (duk6 zaam3 ngou4 tau4)

english_meaning: commission, brokerage
explanation_mandarin: 指为他人介绍生意或提供服务所获得的报酬。
explanation_english: A fee or percentage paid to a salesperson or agent for services rendered in the course of a transaction, usually the sale of goods or property; commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣樓抽咗好多佣金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 lau2 cau1 zo2 hou2 do1 jung2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖房子抽了很多佣金。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of commission from selling the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工底薪唔高，主要靠佣金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 dai2 sam1 m4 gou1, zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 jung2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作底薪不高，主要靠佣金。
examples.english_sentence: This job doesn't have a high base salary; it mainly relies on commission.

english_meaning: commission
explanation_mandarin: 因经手交易而获得的报酬，按交易额的一定比例计算。
explanation_english: A fee or payment paid to an agent or employee for transacting a piece of business; usually a percentage of the value of the transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做地產經紀，主要收入嚟自佣金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 dei6 caan2 ging1 gai3, zyu2 jiu3 sau1 jap6 lai4 zi6 jung2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做房地产经纪，主要收入来自佣金。
examples.english_sentence: I work as a real estate agent, and my main income comes from commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工底薪唔高，主要靠跑數攞佣金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 dai2 sam1 m4 gou1, zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 paau2 sou3 lo2 jung2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作底薪不高，主要靠业绩提成拿佣金。
examples.english_sentence: This job has a low basic salary, mainly relying on sales performance to get commission.

english_meaning: to admire; to respect; to esteem; to wear (as an accessory)
explanation_mandarin: 表示敬佩、钦佩；也指佩戴。
explanation_english: To admire or respect someone greatly; can also refer to wearing something as an accessory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好佩服佢嘅毅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 pui3 fu6 keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很佩服他的毅力。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire his perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日佩咗條靚頸鏈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 pui3 zo2 tiu4 leng3 geng2 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天戴了一条漂亮的项链。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a beautiful necklace today.

english_meaning: to wear (accessories); to put on (medals, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指将饰品、徽章等物品戴在身上。
explanation_english: To wear or put on accessories, medals, badges, or other items on the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日佩戴咗一隻好靚嘅戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 pui3 daai3 zo2 jat1 zek3 hou2 leng3 ge3 gaan2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天戴了一枚很漂亮的戒指。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a very beautiful ring today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加典禮嘅時候，記得佩戴襟章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 din2 lai5 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 pui3 daai3 kam1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加典礼的时候，记得佩戴胸章。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wear the badge when attending the ceremony.

english_meaning: to admire; to be impressed; to respect
explanation_mandarin: 表示钦佩、敬佩，对某人的能力、成就等感到敬重。
explanation_english: To admire or respect someone for their abilities, achievements, or qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好佩服佢嘅毅力，咁辛苦都堅持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 pui3 fuk6 keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6, gam3 san1 fu2 dou1 gin1 chi4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常佩服他的毅力，这么辛苦都坚持下去。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire his perseverance. He insists on continuing even though it's so hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做到咁嘅成績，真係令人佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 dou3 gam3 ge3 sing4 jik1, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就取得这样的成绩，真是令人佩服。
examples.english_sentence: He has achieved so much at such a young age; it's truly admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅勇氣真係令人佩服，敢挑戰自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yung5 hei3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6, gam2 tiu1 zin3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的勇气真是令人佩服，敢于挑战自己。
examples.english_sentence: His courage is truly admirable. He dares to challenge himself.

english_meaning: man, old man (often used informally or derogatorily)
explanation_mandarin: 指男人，通常带有一种不正式或略带贬义的色彩。可以指一般的男人，也可以指年长的男人。
explanation_english: Refers to a man, often used informally and sometimes with a slightly derogatory connotation. It can refer to a general man, or an older man. It can also be used to refer to foreigners, especially Westerners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個佬好串，唔理人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou2 hou2 cyun3, m4 lei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男人很傲慢，不理人。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is very arrogant, he ignores people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個鬼佬，唔識講廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 gwai2 lou2, m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个外国人，不会说粤语。
examples.english_sentence: He is a foreigner, he doesn't know how to speak Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢啦，個老嘢成日都發癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 laa1, go3 lou5 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 faat3 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他了，那个老头子整天都发疯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with him, that old man is always going crazy.

english_meaning: to close; to shut; to fit; to join; to combine; suitable; proper; appropriate
explanation_mandarin: 表示关闭、合拢、适合、配合等意思。
explanation_english: Indicates closing, shutting, fitting, matching, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佮埋啲嘢佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 maai4 di1 je5 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把那些东西合起来。
examples.english_sentence: Put those things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋好佮我腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 hap6 ngo5 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes fit my feet well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔佮拍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hap6 paak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不合拍。
examples.english_sentence: We don't get along well / We are not compatible.

english_meaning: All, everything, entirely, completely
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，统统，所有的意思。通常用于描述某件事情涉及所有事物或人员。
explanation_english: Expresses 'all', 'everything', or 'entirely'. Usually used to describe something involving all things or people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋佮佮冚都走晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaap3 gaap3 ham6 dou1 zau2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全部都走了。
examples.english_sentence: They have all left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢佮佮冚俾佢攞晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 gaap3 gaap3 ham6 bei2 keoi5 lo2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的钱都被他拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He took all the money.

english_meaning: Perfectly fits, perfectly matches, a snug fit
explanation_mandarin: 形容物件配合得非常完美，没有丝毫偏差或不协调。
explanation_english: Describes objects that fit together perfectly, without any deviation or mismatch. Can also describe people who get along very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫我著上身佮佮嵌呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 zoek3 soeng5 san1 gap3 gap3 ham6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服我穿上身非常合身啊！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits me perfectly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格佮佮嵌，好啱傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 gap3 gap3 ham6, hou2 ngaam1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格非常合拍，很聊得来。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are a perfect match, they get along very well.

mandarin_meaning: 妥妥的，搞定，完全没问题
english_meaning: Perfectly done, completely settled, no problem at all
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情完成得非常完美，没有任何问题，状态非常好，或者事情完全搞定，可以放心。
explanation_english: Describes something that is perfectly done, with no problems at all, in an excellent state, or completely settled, leaving no room for worry. Often used to express confidence and reassurance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，呢件事佮佮掂嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 gap6 gap6 dim1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，这件事妥妥的没问题！
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, this matter is perfectly settled!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂份功課之後，就可以佮佮掂咁去玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 fan6 gung1 fo3 zi1 hau6, zau6 ho2 ji5 gap6 gap6 dim1 gam2 heoi3 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成作业之后，就可以完全搞定地去玩了。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing the homework, we can go play with no worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你搞掂佢，保證佮佮掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, bou2 zing3 gap6 gap6 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你搞定他，保证完全没问题。
examples.english_sentence: I'll help you take care of him, guaranteed perfectly done.

english_meaning: to pretend, to feign, to simulate
explanation_mandarin: 假装，装作某种样子。
explanation_english: To pretend to be or do something; to feign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢佯裝唔知道發生咩事噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 zong1 m4 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假装不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended not to know what was happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度佯裝可憐啦，冇人會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 joeng4 zong1 ho2 lin4 laa1, mou5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里装可怜了，没有人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be pitiful here, no one will believe you.

english_meaning: to claim falsely, to profess, to allege
explanation_mandarin: 虚假地声称或宣称。
explanation_english: To falsely claim or profess something; to allege something that is not true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢佯稱自己係醫生，但係根本冇讀過醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 cing1 zi6 gei2 hai6 ji1 sang1, daan6 hai6 gan1 bun2 mou5 duk6 gwo3 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假称自己是医生，但是根本没有学过医。
examples.english_sentence: He falsely claimed to be a doctor, but he never studied medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個騙子佯稱可以幫我哋投資，結果呃晒我哋啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 pin3 zi2 joeng4 cing1 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 tau4 zi1, git3 gwo2 aak1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个骗子假称可以帮我们投资，结果骗光了我们的钱。
examples.english_sentence: That swindler claimed he could help us invest, but he ended up scamming all our money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢佯稱唔舒服，所以冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 cing1 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假称不舒服，所以没上班。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be unwell, so he didn't go to work.

english_meaning: hundred
explanation_mandarin: 一百的另一种写法，常见于支票或正式场合。
explanation_english: An alternative way to write 'hundred', often used in cheques or formal occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張支票要寫佰幾蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 jiu3 se2 baak3 gei2 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张支票要写一百多块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This cheque needs to be written for a little over a hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話份禮物值佰幾蚊咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 fan6 lai5 mat6 zik6 baak3 gei2 man1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这份礼物值一百多块钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: He said that the gift is only worth a little over a hundred dollars.

english_meaning: good; fine; excellent
explanation_mandarin: 表示好，优秀，美好。
explanation_english: Indicates good, fine, excellent, or beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日表現得好佳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天表现得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He performed very well today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物質素好佳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 seoi3 hou2 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物质量很好。
examples.english_sentence: The food quality of this restaurant is very good.

english_meaning: beautiful woman; fair lady
explanation_mandarin: 指容貌美丽的女子。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman of beautiful appearance; a fair lady.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一位佳人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 wai2 gaai1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是一位美人。
examples.english_sentence: She is truly a beautiful woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲嘅女主角係一個公認嘅佳人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 ge3 neoi5 zyu2 gok3 hai6 jat1 go3 gung1 jing6 ge3 gaai1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的女主角是一个公认的美人。
examples.english_sentence: The female lead of this movie is a recognized beautiful woman.

english_meaning: Having a date with a beautiful woman
explanation_mandarin: 指跟美丽的女子有约会。
explanation_english: Refers to having a date or appointment with a beautiful woman. Often used humorously or to excuse oneself from other commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，各位，我今晚佳人有約，要早啲走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1 aa3, gok3 wai2, ngo5 gam1 maan1 gaai1 jan4 jau5 joek3, jiu3 zou2 di1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思啊，各位，我今晚佳人有约，要早点走。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry everyone, I have a date with a beautiful woman tonight, so I have to leave early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己佳人有約，都唔知真定假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 gaai1 jan4 jau5 joek3, dou1 m4 zi1 zan1 ding6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说自己佳人有约，都不知道是真的还是假的。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he has a date with a beautiful woman, I don't even know if it's true or not.

english_meaning: masterpiece, excellent work, fine piece (of art, literature, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指优秀的、精美的作品，多用于艺术、文学等领域。
explanation_english: Refers to an excellent or exquisite work, often used in the fields of art, literature, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲真係佳作嚟㗎，值得睇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 zan1 hai6 gaai1 zok3 lai4 gaa3, zik6 dak1 tai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真是佳作，值得一看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is truly a masterpiece; it's worth watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅書法作品可以話係佳作，好有功力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 syu1 faat3 zok3 ban2 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 gaai1 zok3, hou2 jau5 gung1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的书法作品可以说是佳作，很有功底。
examples.english_sentence: His calligraphy can be considered a masterpiece; he's very skilled.

english_meaning: ideal couple; perfect match
explanation_mandarin: 指相貌、才华、性格等方面都很般配的夫妻或情侣。
explanation_english: Refers to a couple who are well-matched in terms of appearance, talent, personality, etc.; an ideal couple or a perfect match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個真係天生嘅佳偶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 tin1 sang1 ge3 gaai1 ngau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个真是天生的一对佳偶。
examples.english_sentence: They are truly a match made in heaven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嗰陣，人人都話佢哋係佳偶天成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 go2 zan6, jan4 jan4 dou1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 gaai1 ngau5 tin1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚的时候，人人都说他们是佳偶天成。
examples.english_sentence: When they got married, everyone said they were a match made in heaven.

english_meaning: A match made in heaven; a perfect couple
explanation_mandarin: 指美好的姻缘是上天注定的，形容婚姻非常完美，匹配。
explanation_english: Refers to a beautiful marriage predestined by fate. It describes a very perfect and well-matched marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個真係佳偶天成，咁夾嘅人好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 gaai1 ngau5 tin1 sing4, gam3 gaap3 ge3 jan4 hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩真是天作之合，这么合得来的人很少见。
examples.english_sentence: They are truly a match made in heaven; it's rare to see people so compatible.

english_meaning: good son-in-law; desirable son-in-law
explanation_mandarin: 指优秀、理想的女婿。
explanation_english: Refers to an excellent and desirable son-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女婿又叻仔又孝順，真係一個佳婿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi5 sai3 jau6 lek1 zai2 jau6 haau3 seon6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 gaai1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女婿既聪明又孝顺，真是一个好女婿。
examples.english_sentence: Her son-in-law is both smart and filial, truly a good son-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多父母都想自己個女可以揾到個佳婿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 fu6 mou5 dou1 soeng2 zi6 gei2 go3 neoi2 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 go3 gaai1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多父母都希望自己的女儿可以找到一个好女婿。
examples.english_sentence: Many parents hope that their daughter can find a good son-in-law.

english_meaning: Fine writing, masterpiece, excellent article
explanation_mandarin: 指文章写得非常好，是优秀的篇章。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of writing that is very well-written; an excellent article or chapter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇嘢真係佳章嚟，寫得好有深度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 je5 zan1 hai6 gaai1 zoeng1 lai4, se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 sam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章真是佳作，写得很有深度。
examples.english_sentence: This article is truly a masterpiece; it is written with great depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅論文絕對可以稱得上係佳章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 leon6 man4 zyut6 deoi3 ho2 ji5 cing1 dak1 soeng5 hai6 gaai1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的论文绝对可以称得上是佳作。
examples.english_sentence: His thesis can definitely be considered a masterpiece.

english_meaning: Festive season; festival
explanation_mandarin: 美好的节日，值得庆祝的日子。
explanation_english: A festive occasion or holiday; a day or period of celebration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你佳節快樂，身體健康！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 gaai1 zit3 faai3 lok6, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你节日快乐，身体健康！
examples.english_sentence: Happy holidays and good health to you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年嘅中秋節都係一個佳節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 ge3 zung1 cau1 zit3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 gaai1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年的中秋节都是一个佳节。
examples.english_sentence: The Mid-Autumn Festival every year is a festive occasion.

mandarin_meaning: 好成绩; 优秀的成绩
english_meaning: excellent result; outstanding achievement; good performance
explanation_mandarin: 指优异的成绩或表现。
explanation_english: Refers to excellent results or outstanding performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺考試攞到佳績，屋企人都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 haau2 si3 lo2 dou3 gaai1 jik1, uk1 kei2 yan4 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在考试中取得了佳绩，家里人都很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He achieved excellent results in the exam, and his family is very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港運動員喺奧運會上創出佳績，為港爭光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 wan6 dung6 yun4 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 soeng6 chong3 cheot1 gaai1 jik1, wai4 gong2 zang1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港运动员在奥运会上创造了佳绩，为香港争光。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong athletes achieved excellent results in the Olympics, bringing glory to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今年嘅業績創出佳績，股價升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ge3 yip6 jik1 chong3 cheot1 gaai1 jik1, gu2 gaa3 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司今年的业绩创出了佳绩，股价上涨了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance this year has achieved excellent results, and the stock price has risen a lot.

english_meaning: a story of virtue or achievement; a praiseworthy tale; a legend
explanation_mandarin: 指美好的事情或传闻，值得称赞和传颂的故事。
explanation_english: Refers to a beautiful and admirable story or legend, something worthy of praise and being passed down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅愛情故事，喺學校入面係一段佳話嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 oi3 ching4 gu2 si6, hai2 hok6 haau6 jap6 min6 hai6 jat1 dyun6 gaai1 waa2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的爱情故事，在学校里是一段佳话。
examples.english_sentence: Their love story is a legend in the school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋捐錢起學校，真係一單善舉，傳為佳話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gyun1 chin2 hei2 hok6 haau6, zan1 hai6 jat1 daan1 sin6 geoi2, chyun4 wai4 gaai1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们捐钱建学校，真是一件善举，传为佳话。
examples.english_sentence: Their donation to build a school is truly an act of charity, and has become a legendary story.

english_meaning: fine wine; vintage wine; exquisite brew
explanation_mandarin: 指酿造精良、品质上乘的酒。
explanation_english: Refers to wine or other alcoholic beverage of excellent quality and brewing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支佳釀係我哋嘅珍藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 gaai1 zoeng6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zan1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶美酒是我们的珍藏。
examples.english_sentence: This fine wine is our treasured collection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢特登開咗支佳釀慶祝佢升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak6 dang1 hoi1 zo2 zi1 gaai1 zoeng6 hing3 zuk1 keoi5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他特意开了一瓶美酒庆祝他升职。
examples.english_sentence: He specially opened a fine wine to celebrate his promotion.

english_meaning: good news, glad tidings
explanation_mandarin: 指好的消息，令人高兴的消息。
explanation_english: Refers to good news, a piece of news that brings joy or happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到大學嘅取錄通知，真係佳音啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 daai6 hok6 ge3 cheoi2 luk6 tung1 zi1, zan1 hai6 gaai1 jam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到大学的录取通知，真是个好消息啊！
examples.english_sentence: Receiving the university admission offer, that's really good news!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司終於扭虧為盈，對股東嚟講絕對係佳音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zung1 jyu1 nau2 kwai1 wai4 ying4, deoi3 gu2 dung1 lai4 gong2 zyut6 deoi3 hai6 gaai1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司终于扭亏为盈，对股东来说绝对是好消息。
examples.english_sentence: Their company finally turned a profit from a loss; that's definitely good news for the shareholders.

english_meaning: delicacy, fine dish, gourmet food
explanation_mandarin: 精美的菜肴；美味的食物。
explanation_english: Delicious and skillfully prepared food; a delicacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅佳餚真係好好味，每次嚟食都好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 gaai1 jaau4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 mei6, mui5 ci3 lai4 sik6 dou1 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的佳肴真的很好吃，每次来吃都很满意。
examples.english_sentence: The delicacies at this restaurant are really delicious, I'm always satisfied when I come here to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢煮嘅佳餚色香味俱全，簡直係藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu2 ge3 gaai1 jaau4 sik1 heung1 mei6 geoi1 cyun4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的佳肴色香味俱全，简直是艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: The delicacies he cooks are perfect in color, aroma, and taste; they are simply works of art.

english_meaning: beautiful woman; belle; beauty (especially in a competition)
explanation_mandarin: 指容貌美丽的女子，通常指参加选美比赛或有类似头衔的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a beautiful woman, usually referring to women participating in beauty pageants or holding similar titles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅香港小姐選美，好多佳麗都好靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 siu2 je2 syun2 mei5, hou2 do1 gaai1 lai6 dou1 hou2 leng3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的香港小姐选美，很多佳丽都很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's Miss Hong Kong pageant has many beauties who are very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前都係選美佳麗嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 dou1 hai6 syun2 mei5 gaai1 lai6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前也是选美佳丽。
examples.english_sentence: She used to be a beauty pageant contestant.

english_meaning: to merge, to combine, to amalgamate, to join
explanation_mandarin: 结合在一起。将不同的东西或部分合成为一个整体。
explanation_english: To combine or merge together; to integrate different things or parts into a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如將兩間公司併埋一齊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 zoeng1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 bing3 maai4 jat1 cai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如把两家公司合并在一起吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we merge the two companies together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將所有嘅數據併入呢個文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 sou3 geoi3 bing3 jap6 ni1 go3 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把所有的数据并入这个文件。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to merge all the data into this document.

english_meaning: complication
explanation_mandarin: 疾病发展过程中，因病情变化而发生的其他疾病。
explanation_english: A secondary disease or condition aggravating or resulting from an existing one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完手術之後出現咗好多併發症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 ceot1 jin6 zo2 hou2 do1 bing3 faat3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做完手术后出现了许多并发症。
examples.english_sentence: He developed many complications after the surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 糖尿病嘅併發症好可怕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong4 niu6 beng6 ge3 bing3 faat3 zing3 hou2 ho2 paa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糖尿病的并发症很可怕的。
examples.english_sentence: The complications of diabetes are very scary.

english_meaning: Mergers and acquisitions (M&A)
explanation_mandarin: 指一家公司购买或合并另一家公司，以扩大规模、市场份额或获得其他战略优势。
explanation_english: Refers to the process where one company buys out or merges with another, typically to expand its scale, market share, or achieve other strategic advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司俾另一間大公司併購咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 ling6 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 bing3 gau3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司被另一家大公司并购了。
examples.english_sentence: This company was acquired by a larger company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 併購可以幫公司擴大規模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bing3 gau3 ho2 ji5 bong1 gung1 si1 kwok3 daai6 gui1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 并购可以帮助公司扩大规模。
examples.english_sentence: Mergers and acquisitions can help companies expand their scale.

english_meaning: Flippant, frivolous, lighthearted, casual, cheeky
explanation_mandarin: 形容人言行举止轻浮、不庄重、不认真。
explanation_english: Describes a person's speech or behavior as frivolous, lacking seriousness, or casual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好佻皮，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 tiu1 pei4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很轻佻，整天搞事。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very cheeky person, always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁佻啦，認真啲做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tiu1 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么轻佻，认真一点工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so flippant, be serious when you work.

english_meaning: naughty, mischievous, playful
explanation_mandarin: 形容人（通常是小孩）爱恶作剧，不听话，喜欢搞怪。
explanation_english: Describes someone (usually a child) who is naughty, mischievous, disobedient, and likes to play pranks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好佻皮，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 tiu3 pei4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩很顽皮，整天恶作剧。
examples.english_sentence: That child is very naughty, always playing pranks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁佻皮啦，聽話啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tiu3 pei4 laa1, ting1 waa6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么调皮了，听话一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so mischievous, be more obedient.

english_meaning: Good; excellent; outstanding; better than others
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，佼通常指比别人好，更优秀，出色。可以用在不同方面，例如形容某人能力强，或者某件事做得好。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "佼" usually means better than others, more outstanding, or excellent. It can be used in various aspects, such as describing someone's strong abilities or something being done well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課做得好佼啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 gaau1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的作业做得真好啊！
examples.english_sentence: He/She did a really good job on his/her homework!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食真係好佼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明嘅表現好佼，應該俾佢升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 ge3 biu2 hin3 hou2 gaau1, ying1 goi1 bei2 keoi5 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明的表现很好，应该给他升职。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming's performance is outstanding; he should be promoted.

mandarin_meaning: 杰出人物; 出类拔萃的人
english_meaning: outstanding person; paragon; elite; someone who excels
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一方面非常突出，非常优秀的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is outstanding and excellent in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺佢哋嗰班入邊係佼佼者，成績最好嘅一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 keoi5 dei6 go2 baan1 jap6 bin1 hai6 gaau2 gaau2 ze2, sing4 jik1 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在他们班里是佼佼者，成绩最好的一个。
examples.english_sentence: He is the best in his class, truly outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺演藝界，佢都算係佼佼者，好多人都好欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jin2 ngai6 gaai3, keoi5 dou1 syun3 hai6 gaau2 gaau2 ze2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在演艺界，他也算是佼佼者，很多人都很欣赏他。
examples.english_sentence: In the entertainment industry, he is considered outstanding, and many people admire him.

english_meaning: to use; to employ; to spend; to enable; to make
explanation_mandarin: 使用，利用。也指花费，使用金钱或时间。使唤，命令。
explanation_english: To use, employ, or utilize something. Can also refer to spending money or time. Can also mean to make, cause, or enable something to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我使咗好多錢買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我花了很多钱买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I spent a lot of money buying things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以使呢部電腦嚟做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 sai2 ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 lai4 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用这台电脑来做功课。
examples.english_sentence: You can use this computer to do your homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好使我幫你呀，你自己搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sai2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 aa3, nei5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让我帮你，你自己解决它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make me help you, solve it yourself.

english_meaning: Why bother?, What's the need?
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有必要或不需要做某事。反问语气。
explanation_english: Expresses that there is no need or necessity to do something. Rhetorical question implying that something is unnecessary or pointless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使乜咁擔心呀？佢識得照顧自己嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 gam3 daam1 sam1 aa3? keoi5 sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 何必这么担心呢？他懂得照顾自己的。
examples.english_sentence: Why bother worrying so much? He knows how to take care of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使乜咁貴呀？出面平好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 gam3 gwai3 aa3? ceot1 min6 peng4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 何必这么贵呢？外面便宜很多。
examples.english_sentence: Why does it have to be so expensive? It's much cheaper outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使乜解釋咁多，佢哋唔會明嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 gaai2 sik1 gam3 do1, keoi5 dei6 m4 wui ming4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪用解释这么多，他们不会明白的。
examples.english_sentence: What's the need to explain so much, they won't understand anyway.

english_meaning: Need I say?
explanation_mandarin: 反问语气，表示事情显而易见，不需要再多说。
explanation_english: A rhetorical question indicating that something is obvious and doesn't need to be mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，使乜講呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 nei5, sai2 mat1 gong2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么疼你，还用说吗？
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much, need I say?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁大雨，使乜講都知會塞車啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, sai2 mat1 gong2 dou1 zi1 wui5 sak1 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下这么大雨，还用说都知道会堵车啦。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining so heavily today, need I say it's obvious there will be traffic jam.

mandarin_meaning: 只用人不投资；空手套白狼
english_meaning: To exploit people without investing in them; to get something for nothing by exploiting others.
explanation_mandarin: 形容只利用别人，不付出任何成本或代价。指利用他人为自己谋取利益，而自己不承担任何风险或付出。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone only uses other people without investing any cost or price. It refers to using others to seek benefits for oneself without undertaking any risks or paying any costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都使人唔使本，遲早冇人會幫佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 sai2 jan4 m4 sai2 bun2, ci4 zou2 mou5 jan4 wui5 bong1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是只用人不投资，迟早没人会帮他的。
examples.english_sentence: He always exploits people without investing in them; sooner or later, no one will help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司咁孤寒，成日使人唔使本，啲員工做唔長㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam3 gu1 hon1, sing4 jat6 sai2 jan4 m4 sai2 bun2, di1 jyun4 gung1 zou6 m4 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很吝啬，总是只用人不投资，员工做不长的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is so stingy, always exploiting people without investing in them; the employees won't stay long.

english_meaning: to exert; to use; to unleash; to bring into play; to put forth
explanation_mandarin: 用出某种力量、技巧或手段。
explanation_english: To exert force, skills, or methods; to use or employ something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢使出渾身解數，都係贏唔到比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai2 ceot1 wan4 san1 gaai2 sou3, dou1 hai6 wing4 m4 dou2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他使出浑身解数，还是赢不了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He exerted every skill he had, but still couldn't win the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏呢場波，我哋一定要使出必殺技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bo1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sai2 ceot1 bit1 saat3 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场球，我们一定要使出必杀技。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win this game, we must unleash our special move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保護自己，使出咗防狼噴霧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2, sai2 ceot1 zo2 fong4 long4 pun3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了保护自己，她使出了防狼喷雾。
examples.english_sentence: In order to protect herself, she used pepper spray.

mandarin_meaning: 使得; 导致; 以致
english_meaning: to cause; to make; to lead to; to result in; to enable
explanation_mandarin: 表示导致某种结果或情况发生。相当于“使得”、“致使”、“以致”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something causes a certain result or situation to occur. Equivalent to "to cause", "to lead to", or "to result in".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨使到我遲咗到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 jyu5 sai2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 zo2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨使得我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: The heavy rain caused me to be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅努力使到佢成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 sai2 dou3 keoi5 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的努力使他成功了。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts led him to success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個新政策使到好多人唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 san1 zing3 caak3 sai2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新政策使得很多人不开心。
examples.english_sentence: This new policy made many people unhappy.

english_meaning: to exert effort; to put forth strength; to make an effort; to use force
explanation_mandarin: 用力，使出力量。
explanation_english: To exert effort, to use strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使勁啲推啦，推唔郁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 ging6 di1 teoi1 laa1, teoi1 m4 juk1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用力推一下，推不动啊！
examples.english_sentence: Push harder, it won't budge!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經使曬勁喇，都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 sai2 saai3 ging6 laa3, dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经使出全力了，还是搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: I've already given it my all, and it still won't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使勁啲，點會成功㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 ging6 di1, dim2 wui sing4 gung1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不努力一点，怎么会成功呢？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't put in the effort, how will you succeed?

english_meaning: mission, vocation, calling, task
explanation_mandarin: 指被赋予的重要任务或责任。
explanation_english: A task or responsibility assigned to someone, usually of great importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得佢嘅使命係要幫啲窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 si3 ming6 hai6 jiu3 bong1 di1 kung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得他的使命是要帮助穷人。
examples.english_sentence: He feels his mission is to help the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋嘅共同使命，一定要成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 tung4 si3 ming6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们的共同使命，一定要成功。
examples.english_sentence: This is our common mission, we must succeed.

english_meaning: sense of mission, sense of purpose, dedication
explanation_mandarin: 指一种认为自己肩负着重要责任，必须完成特定任务的感觉。
explanation_english: A feeling of responsibility towards a specific task or cause, often implying a strong commitment and sense of purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對保護環境好有使命感㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2 hou2 jau5 si3 ming6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对保护环境很有使命感。
examples.english_sentence: They have a strong sense of mission when it comes to protecting the environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個醫生，佢覺得自己有使命感去救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1, keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 jau5 si3 ming6 gam2 heoi3 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个医生，他觉得自己有使命感去救人。
examples.english_sentence: As a doctor, he feels a sense of mission to save people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅使命感驅使佢日以繼夜咁工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si3 ming6 gam2 keoi1 sai2 keoi5 jat6 ji5 gwai3 je6 gam2 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的使命感驱使他日以继夜地工作。
examples.english_sentence: His sense of mission drives him to work day and night.

mandarin_meaning: 爱指使人的女人；颐指气使的女人
english_meaning: Bossy woman; A woman who likes to order people around
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢命令别人做事，颐指气使的女人。通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who likes to order people around and is bossy. It usually has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好使婆，成日指指點點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai2 po4, seng4 jat6 zi2 zi2 dim2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是个爱指使人的女人，整天指指点点。
examples.english_sentence: She's such a bossy woman, always pointing fingers and giving orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁使婆啦，自己嘢自己做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sai2 po4 laa1, zi6 gei2 je5 zi6 gei2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么爱指使人了，自己的事情自己做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so bossy, do your own things yourself.

synonyms: 老闆娘 (lou5 baan2 noeng4) - often used ironically

mandarin_meaning: 指使人做事的女人；爱指使人的女人
english_meaning: A bossy woman; a woman who likes to order people around; a demanding woman.
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢指使别人做事情的女人，带有贬义。通常形容比较强势且喜欢发号施令的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who likes to order people around, with a negative connotation. It usually describes a strong-willed woman who likes to give orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好使媽，成日指指點點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 hou2 sai2 maa1, sing4 jat6 zi2 zi2 dim2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这个人很喜欢指使人，总是指指点点。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very bossy person, always pointing fingers and telling people what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做個使媽，咁樣冇人鍾意你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 go3 sai2 maa1, gam2 yeung2 mou5 yan4 zung1 yi3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做一个爱指使人的人，这样没人会喜欢你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a bossy person, no one will like you that way.

english_meaning: can, able to, okay, all right, feasible, works, permissible
explanation_mandarin: 表示可以，行，能，或者表示许可、同意。也可用作形容词，表示某事物可行。
explanation_english: Indicates permission, agreement, feasibility, or ability. Can also be used as an adjective to describe something as feasible or workable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做使得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 sik1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做是可以的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚得唔得閒啊？使得嘅話，我哋出嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3? sik1 dak1 ge3 waa2, ngo5 dei6 cheut1 lai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有空吗？如果可以的话，我们出去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tonight? If you are, let's go out for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦使得唔使得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sik1 dak1 m4 sik1 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑能用吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this computer working?

mandarin_meaning: 使诈，耍赖，采取不正当手段
english_meaning: to use underhanded tactics, to cheat, to play dirty, to act unfairly
explanation_mandarin: 指使用不正当的、不公平的手段去达到目的。通常带有负面含义，表示不光彩的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to using improper, unfair means to achieve a goal. It usually carries a negative connotation, indicating disgraceful behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好使橫手呀，光明正大噉競爭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sai2 waang4 sau2 aa3, gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6 gam2 ging6 zang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别使诈啊，光明正大地竞争吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use underhanded tactics, let's compete fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日使橫手，所以冇人信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sai2 waang4 sau2, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍赖，所以没人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays dirty, so no one trusts him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏場比賽，佢竟然使橫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jeng4 coeng4 bei2 coi3, keoi5 ging2 jin4 sai2 waang4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得比赛，他竟然采取不正当手段。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win the game, he actually resorted to underhanded tactics.

english_meaning: It's not going to kill you; What's the big deal?
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事不情愿，觉得做了也不会有什么大不了的，略带抱怨或讽刺的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses reluctance towards doing something but implies that it won't cause any significant harm. Often used with a tone of complaint or sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫手拎下嘢使死咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 sau2 ling1 haa5 je5 sai2 sei2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我拿一下东西又不会死？
examples.english_sentence: What's the big deal with helping me carry things?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到少少使死咩，使唔使咁惡呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 siu2 siu2 sai2 sei2 me1, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 ok3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到一点又不会死，需要这么凶吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is being a little late going to kill you? Do you have to be so mean?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做多份工使死咩，唔好咁懶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 do1 fan6 gung1 sai2 sei2 me1, m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多做一份工作又不会死，不要这么懒。
examples.english_sentence: Doing some extra work won't kill you, don't be so lazy.

english_meaning: So; thus; that's the way it is; inevitable; natural consequence
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发展的结果是必然的，自然而然的。
explanation_english: Indicates that the result of the development of events is inevitable and natural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁嘅結果都係事勢使然啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 ge3 git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 si6 sai3 sai2 jin4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样的结果也是形势使然罢了。
examples.english_sentence: This outcome is just the way things are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力，成功都係使然嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nou5 lik6, sing4 gung1 dou1 hai6 sai2 jin4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，成功也是必然的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard; success is inevitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後分手，都係性格唔夾使然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 fan1 sau2, dou1 hai6 sing3 gaak3 m4 gaap3 sai2 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后分手，也是性格不合使然。
examples.english_sentence: Their breakup in the end was due to their incompatible personalities.

mandarin_meaning: 卖力干活; 被人驱使
english_meaning: To work like an ox; to be driven like cattle; to be exploited, overworked
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常努力地工作，或者被人像牛一样驱使，拼命干活，通常带有负面意味。
explanation_english: Describes working extremely hard, or being driven to work relentlessly like an ox. It often carries a negative connotation of being exploited or overworked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都使牛咁使，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 sai2 ngau4 gam2 sai2, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都被当作牛一样使唤，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He's being worked like an ox every day, it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港做嘢就係咁，唔使牛點得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 je5 zau6 hai6 gam2, m4 sai2 ngau4 dim2 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港工作就是这样，不拼命工作怎么行呢？
examples.english_sentence: That's how it is working in Hong Kong, how can you get by without working like an ox?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姐唔好咁使牛啲工人啦，人哋都要休息㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ze1 m4 hou2 gam2 sai2 ngau4 di1 gung1 jan4 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 jiu3 jau1 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板娘不要这么使唤工人了，他们也需要休息的。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, don't overwork the workers so much, they need to rest too.

english_meaning: to use, to employ, to apply
explanation_mandarin: 运用，利用。
explanation_english: To make use of something; to utilize or employ something for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機好易使用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hou2 ji6 si2 jung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器很容易使用。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is very easy to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識得使用好多種電腦軟件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 dak1 si2 jung6 hou2 do1 zung2 din6 nou5 jyun5 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会使用很多种电脑软件。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to use many kinds of computer software.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該好好使用資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 hou2 hou2 si2 jung6 zi1 yuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该好好利用资源。
examples.english_sentence: We should make good use of resources.

english_meaning: user
explanation_mandarin: 使用某种东西或服务的人。
explanation_english: A person who uses something, such as a product, service, or system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個App嘅使用者介面好user-friendly，容易上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 App ge3 si2 jung2 ze2 gaai3 min6 hou2 user-friendly, jung4 yi6 soeng5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个App的用户界面很友好，容易上手。
examples.english_sentence: This app's user interface is very user-friendly and easy to get started with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要收集使用者嘅意見，改善產品嘅功能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 gaap3 si2 jung2 ze2 ge3 yi3 gin3, goi2 sin6 caan2 ban2 ge3 gung1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要收集用户的意见，改善产品的功能。
examples.english_sentence: We need to collect user feedback to improve the product's features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個軟件嘅主要使用者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 jyun5 gin2 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 si2 jung2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个软件的主要使用者。
examples.english_sentence: He is the main user of this software.

english_meaning: Envoy, delegation, mission
explanation_mandarin: 指奉命出使外国的官员或代表团。
explanation_english: Refers to an official or delegation sent to a foreign country on a mission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係嚟自美國嘅使節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 lai4 zi6 mei5 gwok3 ge3 sai2 jit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是来自美国的使节。
examples.english_sentence: They are envoys from the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅使節團會討論貿易問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 sai2 jit3 tyun4 wui5 tou2 leon6 mau6 jik6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的使节团会讨论贸易问题。
examples.english_sentence: This delegation will discuss trade issues.

mandarin_meaning: 使者; 信使; 代表
english_meaning: envoy; messenger; delegate
explanation_mandarin: 奉命出使的人；传递信息的人；代表。
explanation_english: A person sent on a mission; a messenger; a delegate; someone representing a group or entity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係和平使者，希望可以化解雙方嘅矛盾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wo4 ping4 sai2 ze2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 faa3 gaai2 soeng1 fong1 ge3 maau5 teon5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是和平使者，希望可以化解双方的矛盾。
examples.english_sentence: He is a peace envoy, hoping to resolve the conflict between the two sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被委任做公司嘅特別使者，去同客戶談判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 wai2 jam3 zou6 gung1 si1 ge3 dak6 bit6 sai2 ze2, heoi3 tung4 haak3 wu6 taam4 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被任命为公司的特别使者，去和客户谈判。
examples.english_sentence: He was appointed as the company's special delegate to negotiate with the client.

english_meaning: expenses, costs, expenditure
explanation_mandarin: 指花费的钱或费用。
explanation_english: Refers to the money spent or the cost of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月嘅使費都幾多喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 sai2 fai3 dou1 gei2 do1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的花费还挺多的。
examples.english_sentence: The expenses this month are quite a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估吓今晚食飯要使費幾多錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 haa5 gam1 maan1 sik6 faan6 jiu3 sai2 fai3 gei2 do1 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜猜今晚吃饭要花多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: Guess how much it will cost to have dinner tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出國旅行嘅使費好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gwok3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 sai2 fai3 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出国旅行的费用很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The expenses for traveling abroad are very expensive.

jyutping: sai2 tung4 ngan4 gaap3 daai6 seng1
mandarin_meaning: 小题大作, 小钱大声
english_meaning: To make a big fuss over a small amount of money; penny-wise, pound-foolish (in a complaining way).
explanation_mandarin: 形容人为了一点点小钱而大声喧哗，夸大其词，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who makes a big commotion or complains loudly over a small amount of money. It usually implies a lack of perspective and a tendency to overreact to minor financial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使唔使咁誇張呀？使銅銀夾大聲，得嗰幾蚊都要嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 kwaa1 zoeng1 aa3? sai2 tung4 ngan4 gaap3 daai6 seng1, dak1 go2 gei2 man1 dou1 jiu3 caau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有必要这么夸张吗？小题大作，就为了那几块钱也要吵。
examples.english_sentence: Is it necessary to be so dramatic? You're making a fuss over a few dollars.

english_meaning: to spend money
explanation_mandarin: 花费金钱，使用金钱。
explanation_english: To spend money; to use money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意使錢買衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sai2 cin2 maai5 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢花钱买衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to spend money buying clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂使錢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 sai2 cin2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱花钱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't spend money recklessly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要慳啲使錢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haan1 di1 sai2 cin2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得省着点花钱才行。
examples.english_sentence: We have to spend money more economically.

english_meaning: to be stubborn, to be willful, to act headstrong
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人固执己见，不听劝告，任性妄为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stubborn, doesn't listen to advice, and acts willfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就開始使頸，大個咗都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 sai2 geng2, daai6 go3 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始任性，长大了都不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: He started being stubborn when he was little, I don't know what to do when he grows up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁使頸啦，聽下人哋嘅意見都好吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sai2 geng2 laa1, teng1 haa5 yan4 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3 dou1 hou2 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么任性了，听听别人的意见也好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, it's good to listen to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使頸都冇用㗎，阿媽唔會俾你買嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 geng2 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3, aa3 maa1 m4 wui2 bei2 nei5 maai5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再任性也没用，妈妈不会给你买的。
examples.english_sentence: Being stubborn won't help, Mom won't buy it for you.

english_meaning: embassy
explanation_mandarin: 一国在另一国首都设置的代表该国政府的机构，负责处理两国之间的外交事务。
explanation_english: The official residence or offices of an ambassador in a foreign country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去美國使館搞簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3 si2 gun2 gaau2 cin1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去美国大使馆办签证。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the American embassy tomorrow to apply for a visa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使館嘅職員通常都識好多種語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si2 gun2 ge3 zik1 jyun4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 sik1 ho2 do1 zung2 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大使馆的职员通常都会很多种语言。
examples.english_sentence: Embassy staff usually know many languages.

english_meaning: To act shamelessly; to act unreasonably; to act like a rogue; to be a pain in the neck; to be difficult
explanation_mandarin: 指胡搅蛮缠，不讲道理，以不正当的手段或态度强求，或者故意找麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to acting unreasonably, refusing to listen to reason, using improper means or attitudes to force something, or deliberately causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度使𢃇啦，畀啲時間我搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sai2 lei2 laa1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里耍赖了，给我点时间搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act shamelessly here, give me some time to sort it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都使𢃇，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sai2 lei2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍赖，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts shamelessly, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再使𢃇，我就唔理你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 sai2 lei2, ngo5 zau6 m4 lei5 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再耍赖，我就不理你了。
examples.english_sentence: If you act shamelessly again, I won't pay attention to you.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说八道; 聊天; 瞎扯
english_meaning: To chat, to gossip, to shoot the breeze; to talk nonsense; to boast or brag
explanation_mandarin: 指闲聊，没有目的地地聊天，有时带有一些吹嘘或胡说八道的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting idly, chatting without a specific purpose, sometimes with a hint of boasting or talking nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日係度侃大山，講埋啲冇可能嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hon2 daai6 saan1, gong2 maai4 di1 mou5 ho2 nang4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里侃大山，说一些不可能的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He's always here shooting the breeze, talking about impossible things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺度侃啦，做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hon2 laa1, zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老在这里闲聊了，工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop chatting all the time, let's get to work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺度侃咗成個鐘，都唔知講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 dou6 hon2 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1, dou1 m4 zi1 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在那里聊了一个小时，都不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them chatted there for an hour, I don't even know what they were talking about.

english_meaning: to speak frankly and with ease; to speak eloquently; to hold forth
explanation_mandarin: 形容理直气壮、从容不迫地说话。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks frankly, confidently, and eloquently, often at length, without hesitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對住鏡頭侃侃而談，睇落好有自信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 geng3 tau4 hon2 hon2 ji4 taam4, tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 zi6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对着镜头侃侃而谈，看起来很有自信。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke eloquently in front of the camera, looking very confident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個研討會上面，侃侃而談自己嘅研究成果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 jin4 tou2 wui2 soeng6 min6, hon2 hon2 ji4 taam4 zi6 gei2 ge3 jin4 gau3 sing4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在研讨会上侃侃而谈自己的研究成果。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke eloquently about his research findings at the seminar.

english_meaning: nephew (brother's or sister's son)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟或姐妹的儿子。
explanation_english: Son of one's brother or sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個侄好鬼精靈㗎。
