examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zat6 hou2 gwai2 zing1 ling4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄子非常聪明。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew is very clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅侄仔喺外國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zat6 zai2 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的侄子在国外读书。
examples.english_sentence: His nephew is studying abroad.

english_meaning: nephew (son of a sibling)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟姐妹的儿子。
explanation_english: Son of one's sibling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個侄仔今年五歲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zat6 zai2 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄子今年五岁了。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew is five years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好錫佢個侄仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 zat6 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱他的侄子。
examples.english_sentence: He is very fond of his nephew.

english_meaning: niece (brother's or brother-in-law's daughter)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟或弟媳的女儿。
explanation_english: The daughter of one's brother or brother-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個侄女今年五歲，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zat6 neoi5 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄女今年五岁，很可爱的。
examples.english_sentence: My niece is five years old this year, she's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好錫佢個侄女，成日買嘢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 zat6 neoi5, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱他的侄女，经常买东西给她。
examples.english_sentence: He dotes on his niece, always buying things for her.

english_meaning: to come, to arrive, to occur, future
explanation_mandarin: 表示从别的地方到说话人所在的地方，或事物发生。
explanation_english: Indicates movement towards the speaker's location or the occurrence of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日嚟咗香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 loi4 zo2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天来香港了。
examples.english_sentence: He came to Hong Kong yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日你會唔會嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 loi4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天你会来吗？
examples.english_sentence: Will you come tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣間我嚟接你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 gaan1 ngo5 loi4 zip3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一会儿我来接你。
examples.english_sentence: I will pick you up later.

english_meaning: too late; not in time; there's not enough time
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间不够，无法赶上或完成某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is not enough time to catch up or complete something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嚟唔切㗎啦，班車開咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai4 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa3, baan1 ce1 hoi1 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们来不及了，班车已经开了。
examples.english_sentence: We're not going to make it. The bus has already left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕唔切份報告，聽日先交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 m4 cit3 fan6 bou3 gou3, ting1 jat6 sin1 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶不及这份报告，明天再交吧。
examples.english_sentence: I can't finish the report in time. I'll hand it in tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家先出門口？嚟唔切睇戲㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 sin1 ceot1 mun4 hau2? lai4 m4 cit3 tai2 hei3 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才出门？来不及看电影了！
examples.english_sentence: Leaving home now? You won't make it to the movie!

english_meaning: next life, afterlife, reincarnation
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后，灵魂转生到下一辈子的世界。
explanation_english: Refers to the world that a person's soul is reincarnated into after death; the next life; the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望來世可以再見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 loi4 sai3 ho2 ji5 zoi3 gin3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望下辈子可以再见到你。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to see you again in the next life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係有來世，我都希望可以做番你嘅仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 jau5 loi4 sai3, ngo5 dou1 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zou6 faan1 nei5 ge3 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的有来世，我也希望可以再做你的子女。
examples.english_sentence: If there really is an afterlife, I hope I can be your children again.

english_meaning: hard-earned, not easily come by, difficult to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或成果得来不容易，需要付出很多努力才能获得。
explanation_english: Describes something or an achievement that is hard-earned or not easily obtained, requiring a lot of effort to achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個獎係我哋隊波嚟之不易嘅成果，我哋付出咗好多努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 lai4 zi1 bat1 ji6 ge3 sing4 gwo2, ngo5 dei6 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个奖是我们球队来之不易的成果，我们付出了很多努力。
examples.english_sentence: This award is a hard-earned achievement for our team. We put in a lot of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成功係嚟之不易嘅，要堅持先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gung1 hai6 lai4 zi1 bat1 ji6 ge3, jiu3 gin1 ci4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成功是来之不易的，要坚持才行。
examples.english_sentence: Success is hard-earned; you need to persevere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嚟之不易，你要好好珍惜啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 lai4 zi1 bat1 ji6, nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作来之不易，你要好好珍惜啊。
examples.english_sentence: This job is hard-earned; you should cherish it.

english_meaning: Western cuisine
explanation_mandarin: 指西方的菜肴。带有一定的怀旧色彩，也可能略带调侃或贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to Western cuisine. It carries a nostalgic tone and can sometimes be slightly mocking or derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，覺得食來佬菜好高級㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, gok3 dak1 sik6 laai4 lou2 coi3 hou2 gou1 kap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我觉得吃西餐是很高级的。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I thought eating Western food was very sophisticated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話要食來佬菜，但係其實只係想食薯條啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 jiu3 sik6 laai4 lou2 coi3, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 so2 tiu4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说要吃西餐，但其实只是想吃薯条而已。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he wants to eat Western food, but actually he just wants to eat french fries.

english_meaning: Foreign goods, imported goods
explanation_mandarin: 指从外国进口的商品。以前香港人称外国人为“老”，所以外国的商品就叫“来佬货”。
explanation_english: Refers to goods imported from foreign countries. In the past, Hong Kong people called foreigners 'lou' (佬), so foreign goods were called 'laai lou fo' (來佬貨).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架車係來佬貨，所以咁貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 ce1 hai6 laai4 lou2 fo3, so2 ji5 gam3 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车是外国进口的，所以这么贵。
examples.english_sentence: This car is imported, that's why it's so expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衫好多都係喺歐洲買嘅來佬貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saam1 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 hai2 au1 zau1 maai5 ge3 laai4 lou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的很多衣服都是在欧洲买的外国货。
examples.english_sentence: Many of his clothes are foreign goods bought in Europe.

english_meaning: Coming and going; to-ing and fro-ing; back and forth repeatedly; frequently
explanation_mandarin: 形容频繁地来回走动或变化。
explanation_english: Describes the frequent movement back and forth, or repeated changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企來來去去，好似有啲心神不定噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 loi4 loi4 heoi3 heoi3, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 sam1 san4 bat1 ding6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里来来回回走动，好像有些心神不定。
examples.english_sentence: He was pacing back and forth at home, looking a bit restless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街嘅人來來去去，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ge3 jan4 loi4 loi4 heoi3 heoi3, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街上的人来来往往，非常热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The people on this street are coming and going, it's very lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅關係都係來來去去，一時好一時唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 dou1 hai6 loi4 loi4 heoi3 heoi3, jat1 si4 hou2 jat1 si4 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的关系也是来来回回的，一时好一时不好。
examples.english_sentence: Our relationship is up and down, good one moment and bad the next.

english_meaning: letter (that arrives); to receive a letter
explanation_mandarin: 指收到的信件；收到信件的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to a letter that has been received; the action of receiving a letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日收到封來信，係我個老友寄嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 fung1 loi4 seon3, hai6 ngo5 go3 lou5 jau5 gei3 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天收到一封来信，是我朋友寄来的。
examples.english_sentence: I received a letter yesterday. It was sent by my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都冇來信，唔知做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 loi4 seon3, m4 zi1 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是没有来信，不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He never sends letters, I wonder what he's doing.

english_meaning: letter received, incoming correspondence
explanation_mandarin: 收到对方的信件。正式场合用语。
explanation_english: A formal term referring to a letter or correspondence that has been received. It indicates incoming mail or an incoming letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到你嘅來函，好多謝你嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 loi4 haam4, hou2 do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到了你的来信，非常感谢你的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Received your letter, thank you very much for your opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司收到好多關於呢個產品嘅來函。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 ge3 loi4 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司收到了很多关于这个产品的来信。
examples.english_sentence: Our company received a lot of letters regarding this product.

english_meaning: to arrive; to come; to reach
explanation_mandarin: 表示到达某个地方或某个时间点。
explanation_english: Indicates arriving at a certain place or point in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋終於來到香港啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 loi4 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们终于来到香港啦！
examples.english_sentence: We finally arrived in Hong Kong!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嚟到嘅時候已經好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lai4 dou3 ge3 si4 hau6 ji5 ging1 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们来到的时候已经很晚了。
examples.english_sentence: It was already very late when they arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天就快來到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zau6 faai3 loi4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天快要来到了。
examples.english_sentence: Summer is coming soon.

english_meaning: coming on strong; approaching menacingly; with overwhelming force; threateningly
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或情况气势很大，来得很猛烈。
explanation_english: Describes something (an event, situation, person, etc.) as having a strong, imposing momentum; coming with great force and threatening potential danger or disruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅疫情來勢洶洶，大家要小心防疫呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 jik1 ching4 loi4 sai3 hung1 hung1, daai6 ga1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 fong4 jik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的疫情来势汹汹，大家要小心防疫啊。
examples.english_sentence: This outbreak is coming on strong, everyone needs to be careful with prevention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司嚟勢洶洶，好快就搶咗好多生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 lai4 sai3 hung1 hung1, hou2 faai3 zau6 cheung2 zo2 hou2 do1 saang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司来势汹汹，很快就抢了很多生意。
examples.english_sentence: Their company came on strong and quickly grabbed a lot of business.

english_meaning: to come and go freely; to be at ease in one's movements; unimpeded
explanation_mandarin: 形容行动非常自由，不受任何阻碍。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being able to come and go freely, without any restrictions or obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學識咗啲功夫之後，身手變得來去自如。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 sik1 zo2 di1 gung1 fu1 zi1 hau6, san1 sau2 bin3 dak1 loi4 heoi3 zi6 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学会了一些功夫之后，身手变得来去自如。
examples.english_sentence: After learning some Kung Fu, his movements became unrestricted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咗自動駕駛技術，你就可以喺車度來去自如咁休息或者工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zo2 zi6 dung6 gaa3 si2 gei6 seot6, nei5 zoeng6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ce1 dou6 loi4 heoi3 zi6 jyu4 gam2 jau1 sik1 waak6 ze2 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有了自动驾驶技术，你就可以在车里来去自如地休息或者工作。
examples.english_sentence: With self-driving technology, you can freely relax or work in the car.

synonyms: 暢通無阻 (coeng3 tung1 mou4 zo2)

english_meaning: to return; to go back and forth; round trip
explanation_mandarin: 指往返，去一次又回来一次。
explanation_english: Refers to going back and forth, making a round trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要來回來公司返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 loi4 wui4 loi4 gung1 si1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要来回公司上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to commute to the company every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張機票係來回嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 gei1 piu3 hai6 loi4 wui4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张机票是来回的。
examples.english_sentence: This ticket is round trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 來回嘅車費好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loi4 wui4 ge3 ce1 fai3 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 来回的车费很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The round-trip fare is very expensive.

english_meaning: next year
explanation_mandarin: 指紧接着的下一年。
explanation_english: Refers to the following year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋來年會搞個大型嘅籌款活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loi4 nin4 wui5 gaau2 go3 daai6 hing4 ge3 cau1 fun2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明年会举办一个大型的筹款活动。
examples.english_sentence: We will hold a large fundraising event next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望來年經濟可以好啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 loi4 nin4 ging1 zai3 ho2 ji5 hou2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望明年经济可以好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, the economy will be better next year.

english_meaning: to come and go; to have dealings with; interaction; intercourse
explanation_mandarin: 表示往来，交往，互动。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of coming and going, interacting, or having dealings with someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅來往好密切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 loi4 wong5 hou2 mat6 chit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的来往很密切。
examples.english_sentence: Their interaction is very close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路好多車來往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 do1 che1 loi4 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路有很多车来往。
examples.english_sentence: There is a lot of traffic on this road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢已經冇來往好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 mou5 loi4 wong5 hou2 noi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他已经很久没有来往了。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't had any contact with him for a long time.

english_meaning: to have enough time; to be in time; to be able to make it
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间还够，能够赶上或完成某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is still enough time to catch or complete something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家出門口都來得及嘅，唔會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 dou1 loi4 dak1 gap6 ge3, m4 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在出门还来得及，不会迟到的。
examples.english_sentence: You still have enough time if you leave now, you won't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲有五分鐘，應該來得及搭到巴士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 ng5 fan1 zung1, jing1 goi1 loi4 dak1 gap6 daap3 dou2 baa1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还有五分钟，应该赶得上公交车。
examples.english_sentence: We still have five minutes, we should be able to catch the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁趕，我諗住來得及嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 gon2, ngo5 nam2 zyu6 loi4 dak1 gap6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么赶，我想着来得及的。
examples.english_sentence: No need to rush, I thought we would be in time.

english_meaning: purpose of visit, intention, motive
explanation_mandarin: 来访或做某事的意图、目的。
explanation_english: The purpose or intention for visiting or doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知你今日嚟嘅來意係咩呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 nei5 gam1 jat6 lai4 ge3 loi4 ji3 hai6 me1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道你今天来的目的是什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: I wonder what your purpose of visiting today is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅來意好明顯，咪就係想借錢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 loi4 ji3 hou2 ming4 hin2, mai1 zau6 hai6 soeng2 ze3 cin2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的来意很明显，不就是想借钱嘛。
examples.english_sentence: His intention is very clear, it's just to borrow money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想知道你哋公司嘅來意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 dou3 nei5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 loi4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想知道你们公司的来意。
examples.english_sentence: I want to know your company's purpose.

english_meaning: news; source; incoming material; processed with imported materials
explanation_mandarin: （1）消息，信息。 （2）指来源，来路。 （3）来料加工：指由外商提供原材料，经加工后再返销给外商的一种贸易方式。
explanation_english: (1) News; information. (2) Origin; source. (3) (In the context of manufacturing/business) Material that is supplied (typically from overseas) for processing; also refers to processing trade where materials are supplied by a foreign company for processing and re-export.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱收到啲來料話聽日打風啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou2 di1 loi4 liu2 waa6 ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚刚收到消息说明天要刮台风了。
examples.english_sentence: I just received news that there's going to be a typhoon tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨係來料加工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 hai6 loi4 liu2 gaa1 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货是来料加工的。
examples.english_sentence: These goods are processed with supplied materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢消息來料靈通㗎，問佢包冇衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu1 sik1 loi4 liu2 ling4 tung1 gaa3, man6 keoi5 baau1 mou5 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的消息来源很灵通，问他保证没错。
examples.english_sentence: His news sources are very well-informed, you can't go wrong asking him.

mandarin_meaning: 来日方长 (lái rì fāng cháng)
english_meaning: The future stretches out before us; there is plenty of time.
explanation_mandarin: 指未来的日子还很长，还有足够的时间。
explanation_english: It refers to the future being long and there being enough time to do things. Used to encourage someone not to be discouraged or to suggest that there's no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心，來日方長，仲有好多機會嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1, loi4 jat6 fong1 coeng4, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 gei1 wui2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么担心，来日方长，还有很多机会的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, the future stretches out before us, there are still many opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次唔成功唔緊要，來日方長，下次再努力過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 m4 sing4 gung1 m4 gan2 jiu3, loi4 jat6 fong1 coeng4, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次不成功不要紧，来日方长，下次再努力吧。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter if you don't succeed this time. There's plenty of time; try harder next time.

english_meaning: origin, source, background, history
explanation_mandarin: 指人的出身、经历，或事物的来源、出处。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's origin, background, or experience, or the source or origin of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅來歷好神秘，冇人知佢以前做過乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 loi4 lik6 hou2 san4 bei3, mou5 jan4 zi1 keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的来历很神秘，没人知道他以前做过什么。
examples.english_sentence: His background is very mysterious; no one knows what he did before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅來歷好複雜，要查清楚先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lik6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的来历很复杂，要查清楚才行。
examples.english_sentence: The origin of this matter is very complicated; it needs to be investigated thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢本書嘅來歷好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 loi4 lik6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这本书的来历很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I am very interested in the origin of this book.

english_meaning: of unknown origin; of dubious origin; mysterious
explanation_mandarin: 指出处或来源不清楚、不明白，带有某种不信任或怀疑的意味。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone whose origin or source is unknown, unclear, or suspicious, often implying a lack of trust or uncertainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個男人來歷不明，唔好咁易信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 naam4 jan2 loi4 lik6 bat1 ming4, m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男人来历不明，不要轻易相信他。
examples.english_sentence: That man is of unknown origin; don't trust him so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥來歷不明，唔敢亂食呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 loi4 lik6 bat1 ming4, m4 gam2 lyun6 sik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药来历不明，不敢乱吃啊。
examples.english_sentence: These medicines are of dubious origin; I don't dare take them carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街執到個銀包，但係入面啲錢來歷不明，唔知點處理好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 zap1 dou2 go3 ngan4 baau1, daan6 hai6 jap6 min6 di1 cin2 loi4 lik6 bat1 ming4, m4 zi1 dim2 cyu2 lei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上捡到一个钱包，但是里面的钱来历不明，不知道怎么处理好。
examples.english_sentence: I found a wallet on the street, but the money inside is of unknown origin. I don't know how to handle it.

synonyms: 唔知邊度嚟 (m4 zi1 bin1 dou6 lei4)
身份不明 (san1 fan2 bat1 ming4)

english_meaning: source; origin; derivation
explanation_mandarin: 事物发源的地方；事情发生的根由。
explanation_english: The place from which something originates; the cause or origin of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據來源係邊度呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 lai4 jyun4 hai6 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据来源是哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where does the data source for this report come from?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要知道資金嘅來源先至可以決定點樣處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zi1 dou3 zi1 gam1 ge3 lai4 jyun4 sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 dim2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要知道资金的来源才能决定怎样处理。
examples.english_sentence: We need to know the source of the funds before we can decide how to handle them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個謠言嘅來源唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jiu4 jin4 ge3 lai4 jyun4 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个谣言的来源不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The source of this rumor is unclear.

english_meaning: menstruation; a trend arriving; to be trendy
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指女性月经来潮。2. 比喻某种潮流或趋势的兴起和流行。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a woman's menstruation. 2. Metaphorically refers to the rise and popularity of a certain trend or tendency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日嚟咗潮，所以心情唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 lei4 zo2 ciu4, so2 ji5 sam1 ching4 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她昨天来月经了，所以心情不太好。
examples.english_sentence: She got her period yesterday, so she's not in a good mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排復古風又嚟潮啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 fuk1 gu2 fung1 jau6 lei4 ciu4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近复古风又开始流行了！
examples.english_sentence: Retro style is trendy again these days!

english_meaning: next life; afterlife; reincarnation
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后的下一辈子，通常与佛教或道教的轮回观念有关。
explanation_english: Refers to the next life after death, often associated with the Buddhist or Taoist concept of reincarnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望來生可以投胎做有錢人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 loi4 sang1 ho2 ji5 tau4 toi1 zou6 jau5 cin2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望来生可以投胎做有钱人啊。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, in the next life, I can be reincarnated as a rich person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係有來生，我希望可以再見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 jau5 loi4 sang1, ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zoi3 gin3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的有来生，我希望可以再见到你。
examples.english_sentence: If there really is an afterlife, I hope to see you again.

english_meaning: See you in the next life
explanation_mandarin: 表示永别，无法再相见，希望来世再见。
explanation_english: Expresses a final farewell, implying that the speaker does not expect to meet the listener again in this life, but hopes to meet them in the next life. Often used in situations involving death or a permanent separation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今世緣盡喇，來生再見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 sai3 jyun4 zeon6 laa3, loi4 saang1 zoi3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今生的缘分尽了，来生再见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Our fate in this life is exhausted, see you in the next life.

mandarin_meaning: 缘由, 来历, 原因
english_meaning: origin, cause, reason, background, history
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的起因、经过或根源。
explanation_english: Refers to the cause, process, or origin of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知件事嘅來由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 gei3 si6 ge3 loi4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道这件事的来由。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know the reason for this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你解釋下件事嘅來由啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaai2 sik1 haa5 gei3 si6 ge3 loi4 jau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你解释一下这件事的来龙去脉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Explain the background of this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事嘅來由一無所知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 jau4 jat1 mou4 so2 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事的来龙去脉一无所知。
examples.english_sentence: He knows nothing about the origin of this matter.

english_meaning: The one who comes; the visitor; the newcomer; those who come
explanation_mandarin: 指来的人，可以是单数也可以是复数。通常用于泛指。
explanation_english: Refers to the person (or people) who comes. Can be singular or plural. Often used generically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚟緊嘅新經理就係佢，佢就係我哋期待嘅來者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei4 gan2 ge3 san1 ging1 lei5 zau6 hai6 keoi5, keoi5 zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 kei4 doi6 ge3 loi4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即将到来的新经理就是他，他就是我们期待的来者。
examples.english_sentence: The upcoming new manager is him, he is the one we've been anticipating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好對啲來者咁惡，佢哋可能唔熟路啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 deoi3 di1 loi4 ze2 gam3 ok3, keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 m4 suk6 lou6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要对那些来的人那么凶，他们可能不熟悉路而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so harsh to those who come, they might just not be familiar with the area.

english_meaning: to refuse nobody who comes; welcome all comers; no discrimination
explanation_mandarin: 指对于前来的人或事物一概不拒绝，无论好坏都接受。
explanation_english: Refers to accepting all people or things that come, regardless of whether they are good or bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人來者不拒，咩朋友都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 loi4 ze2 bat1 keoi5, me1 pang4 jau5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这人来者不拒，什么朋友都认识。
examples.english_sentence: He's the type of person who welcomes all comers; he knows all sorts of friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅老闆來者不拒，咩客都招待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lou5 baan2 loi4 ze2 bat1 keoi5, me1 haak3 dou1 ziu1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的老板来者不拒，什么客人都招待。
examples.english_sentence: The owner of this restaurant welcomes all comers and serves all kinds of customers.

jyutping: loi4 ji4 bat1 wong5 fei1 lai5 jaa5
english_meaning: It is impolite not to reciprocate; courtesy demands reciprocity; to return the same favor/treatment.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是受到别人的礼遇，如果不回报，就显得没有礼貌。强调礼尚往来，有来有往才是符合礼节的行为。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of reciprocity and that it is considered impolite not to return a favor or courtesy. It implies that a proper exchange of gifts or treatment is essential for maintaining good relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請我食飯，我下次都要請返佢，嚟而唔往非禮也嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6, ngo5 haa6 ci3 dou1 jiu3 cheng2 faan1 keoi5, lei4 ji4 bat1 wong5 fei1 lai5 jaa5 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他请我吃饭，我下次也要请回他，来而不往非礼也嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He treated me to a meal, so I should treat him next time; it's impolite not to reciprocate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫咗我咁多，我一定要報答你，嚟而唔往非禮也，唔係嘅話我會過意唔去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 daap3 nei5, lei4 ji4 bat1 wong5 fei1 lai5 jaa5, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 ngo5 wui gwo3 ji3 m4 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮了我这么多，我一定要报答你，来而不往非礼也，不然的话我会过意不去的。
examples.english_sentence: You've helped me so much; I must repay you. It's impolite not to reciprocate, otherwise I'll feel bad about it.

synonyms: 禮尚往來 (lai5 seung6 wong5 loi4)

english_meaning: to arrive; to come; to approach
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或时间即将到达或者已经到达。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or a time is about to arrive or has already arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年就快來臨喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 zau6 faai3 loi4 lam4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年就要来临了！
examples.english_sentence: The New Year is almost here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴風雨即將來臨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fung1 jyu5 zik1 zoeng1 loi4 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴风雨即将到来。
examples.english_sentence: A storm is approaching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅挑戰來臨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 tiu1 zin3 loi4 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的挑战来临。
examples.english_sentence: New challenges are coming.

english_meaning: to come from; from
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物或人从某个地方或来源而来。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or someone originates from a certain place or source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢來自美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loi4 zi6 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他来自美国。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個消息來自報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 loi4 zi6 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个消息来自报纸。
examples.english_sentence: This news comes from the newspaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅靈感來自生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ling4 gam2 loi4 zi6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的灵感来自生活。
examples.english_sentence: His inspiration comes from life.

english_meaning: to visit; to call on; to pay a visit
explanation_mandarin: 指前来拜访，访问。
explanation_english: Refers to coming to visit; to call on someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下個禮拜會嚟訪我哋公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 wui2 lei4 fong2 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下个星期会来拜访我们公司。
examples.english_sentence: They will visit our company next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多外國遊客嚟訪香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ngoi6 gwok3 jau4 haak3 lei4 fong2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多外国游客来香港访问。
examples.english_sentence: Many foreign tourists visit Hong Kong.

english_meaning: guest, visitor
explanation_mandarin: 指被邀请或前来参加活动、会议等的客人。
explanation_english: A guest or visitor, typically someone who is invited or attends an event, meeting, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位來賓，歡迎嚟到我哋嘅婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 wai2 loi4 ban1, waan1 ying4 lai4 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各位来宾，欢迎来到我们的婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: Distinguished guests, welcome to our wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好多來賓都提早到咗會場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 loi4 ban1 dou1 tai4 zou2 dou3 zo2 wui2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很多来宾都提前到了会场。
examples.english_sentence: Many guests arrived at the venue early today.

english_meaning: origin; source; background; connections
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的来源、来历，也指人的背景或门路。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin or source of something. It can also refer to a person's background or connections (usually referring to ways to get things done, often through illicit means).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲錢來路唔正，唔好同佢有咁多瓜葛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei1 cin2 lai4 lou6 m4 zeng3, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 jau5 gam3 do1 gwaa1 got3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的钱来路不正，不要和他有太多瓜葛。
examples.english_sentence: His money is from questionable sources, don't get too involved with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件貨嘅來路好清楚，可以放心買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fo3 ge3 lai4 lou6 hou2 cing1 co2, ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件货的来源很清楚，可以放心买。
examples.english_sentence: The origin of this item is very clear, you can buy it with confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似幾有來路，好多嘢都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 gei2 jau5 lai4 lou6, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像很有门路，很多事情都能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have connections; he can handle many things.

english_meaning: of unknown origin; of dubious origin; suspicious
explanation_mandarin: 指来源、出处不清楚，难以确定。带有不确定或可疑的意味。
explanation_english: Describes something with an unknown or unclear origin, often implying suspicion or uncertainty about its source or legitimacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲來路不明嘅藥，你都唔好亂咁食呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 loi4 lou6 bat1 ming4 ge3 yoek6, nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam3 sik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些来路不明的药，你最好不要乱吃。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't randomly take these medicines of unknown origin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗筆來路不明嘅錢去投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 bat1 loi4 lou6 bat1 ming4 ge3 cin2 heoi3 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一笔来路不明的钱去投资。
examples.english_sentence: He took some money of dubious origin to invest.

mandarin_meaning: 来路不正的货物，来源不明的商品
english_meaning: Goods of dubious origin; goods from an unknown or suspicious source
explanation_mandarin: 指来源不明或不正当的货物，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to goods of unknown or questionable origin, often carrying a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲手袋咁平，唔會係來路菜啩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sau2 doi2 gam3 peng4, m4 wui5 hai6 lai4 lou6 coi3 gwaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些手提包这么便宜，不会是来路不正的吧？
examples.english_sentence: These handbags are so cheap, could they be from a dubious source?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賣啲來路菜，都唔知佢喺邊度攞貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maai6 di1 lai4 lou6 coi3, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai2 bin1 dou6 lo2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是卖一些来路不明的货，都不知道他从哪里拿货。
examples.english_sentence: He always sells goods of dubious origin, I don't even know where he gets them from.

english_meaning: Goods of dubious origin; goods from an unknown or unreliable source; shady goods
explanation_mandarin: 指来路不明、质量没有保证的货物。
explanation_english: Refers to goods of unknown origin or of questionable quality. It implies that the source or manufacturing process is not transparent or reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲電器嚟路貨，唔好買呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 din6 hei3 lai4 lou6 fo3, m4 hou2 maai5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些电器是来路货，不要买啊！
examples.english_sentence: These electrical appliances are of dubious origin, don't buy them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣嘅衫全部都係嚟路貨，好易爛嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 ge3 saam1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 lai4 lou6 fo3, hou2 ji6 laan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖的衣服全部都是来路货，很容易烂的。
examples.english_sentence: All the clothes he sells are of dubious origin, they are easily damaged.

english_meaning: to feel a spark; to have chemistry (with someone); to feel a connection (with someone)
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人之间有吸引力，产生好感。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of attraction or chemistry between two people. It suggests a mutual feeling of interest and connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋第一次見面就覺得好來電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 zau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 loi4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们第一次见面就觉得很来电。
examples.english_sentence: We felt a strong connection the first time we met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似唔係好來電咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 loi4 din6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人好像没什么感觉。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like there isn't much chemistry between those two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢有冇來電啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 jau5 mou5 loi4 din6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和他有没有来电啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you feel any chemistry with him/her?

english_meaning: Caller ID
explanation_mandarin: 显示来电号码的功能。
explanation_english: A feature on telephones that displays the caller's phone number to the person being called.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電話冇來電顯示，唔知邊個打嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 loi4 din6 hin2 si6, m4 zi1 bin1 go3 daa2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电话没有来电显示，不知道是谁打来的。
examples.english_sentence: My phone doesn't have Caller ID, so I don't know who's calling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲電話通常都有來電顯示㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 din6 waa2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 loi4 din6 hin2 si6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的电话通常都有来电显示了。
examples.english_sentence: These days, phones usually have Caller ID.

english_meaning: background; backing; origin; connections; influence
explanation_mandarin: 指人的背景、来历、身份或所依靠的势力。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's background, origin, identity, or the power they rely on. It often implies that someone is influential or has powerful connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚟頭唔細㗎，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai4 tau4 m4 sai3 gaa3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的来头可不小，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He has quite a background; you should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅老闆好似好有來頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 ci5 hou2 jau5 lai4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的老板好像很有来头。
examples.english_sentence: The boss of this company seems to have a powerful background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知佢有咩來頭？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 me1 lai4 tau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道他有什么来头吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know what his background is?

english_meaning: letter (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 书信，多用于正式场合或书面语。通常指收到的信件。
explanation_english: A letter, especially one received; often used in formal contexts and written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到你嘅來鴻，我好開心呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 loi4 hung4, ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到你的来信，我很高兴啊。
examples.english_sentence: I was so happy to receive your letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋等咗好耐都未收到佢嘅來鴻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mei6 sau1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 loi4 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们等了很久都没收到他的来信。
examples.english_sentence: We've been waiting for a long time but haven't received a letter from him.

mandarin_meaning: 来龙去脉 (lái lóng qù mài)
english_meaning: origin and development; ins and outs; whole story; the complete picture
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情的来历和发展经过。指事物的前因后果。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin and development of a matter; the entire story from beginning to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以講清楚件事嘅來龍去脈俾我聽嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 gong2 cing1 chu2 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6 bei2 ngo5 teng1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把事情的来龙去脉说清楚给我听吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you tell me the whole story of what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢解釋咗成件事嘅來龍去脈，我先明白發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai2 sik1 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6, ngo5 sin1 ming4 baak6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他解释了事情的来龙去脉，我才明白发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the whole story, and only then did I understand what had happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要了解一個政策，就要研究佢嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 liu2 gaai2 jat1 go3 zing3 caak3, zau6 jiu3 jin4 gau3 keoi5 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要了解一项政策，就要研究它的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: To understand a policy, you need to study its origin and development.

synonyms: 前因後果 (cin4 jan1 hau6 gwo2)

english_meaning: extravagant, luxurious, wasteful
explanation_mandarin: 指超出需要的，过度花费的，不必要的。
explanation_english: Refers to exceeding what is needed, spending excessively, or being unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生活好侈㗎，成日買貴嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sang1 wut6 hou2 ci2 gaa3, sing4 jat6 maai5 gwai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生活很奢侈，经常买很贵的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He lives an extravagant life, always buying expensive things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢太侈啦，我哋唔需要買噉多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 taai3 ci2 laa3, ngo5 dei6 m4 seoi1 jiu3 maai5 gam2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西太奢侈了，我们不需要买这么多。
examples.english_sentence: These things are too luxurious, we don't need to buy so much.

english_meaning: example; rule; precedent; regulation; case
explanation_mandarin: 例子，事例；规律，惯例；条例，规则。
explanation_english: Example, instance; rule, convention; regulation, rule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舉個例嚟聽下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi2 go3 lai6 lai4 ting1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 举个例子来听听。
examples.english_sentence: Give an example to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係公司嘅慣例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 gwaan3 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是公司的惯例。
examples.english_sentence: This is the company's standard practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔跟規矩，成日破例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gan1 kwai1 geoi2, seng4 jat6 po3 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不遵守规矩，总是破例。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't follow the rules and always breaks them.

english_meaning: menstruation, period
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的月经。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman's menstrual period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排唔舒服，可能就嚟嚟例假啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 m4 syu1 fuk6, ho2 nang4 zau6 lai4 lai4 lai6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近不太舒服，可能快来月经了。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't been feeling well lately, I might be getting my period soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔嚟游水，話嚟例假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 lei4 jau4 seoi2, waa6 lai4 lai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天不来游泳，说是来月经了。
examples.english_sentence: She's not coming swimming today, she said she has her period.

english_meaning: example sentence
explanation_mandarin: 用来举例说明的句子。
explanation_english: A sentence used to illustrate the meaning or usage of a word or phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字嘅例句係乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 lai6 geoi3 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词的例句是什么呀？
examples.english_sentence: What is the example sentence for this word?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師要我哋寫幾個例句嚟解釋個生字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 se2 gei2 go3 lai6 geoi3 lai4 gai2 sik1 go3 sang1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师要我们写几个例句来解释这个生字。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher wants us to write a few example sentences to explain this new word.

english_meaning: exception; case that does not conform to the rule
explanation_mandarin: 通常情况之外的情况；不符合一般规律或规则的情况。
explanation_english: A case that deviates from the general rule or pattern; an instance that does not conform to what is typical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 通常我哋都唔加班，但係今次係個例外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung1 soeng4 ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 gaa1 baan1, daan6 hai6 gam1 ci3 hai6 go3 lai6 ngoai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 通常我们都不加班，但是这次是个例外。
examples.english_sentence: Normally we don't work overtime, but this time is an exception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對所有人都好好，幾乎冇例外。

examples.english_sentence: He is very nice to everyone, with almost no exceptions.

examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 heoi3 cyu3, lai6 jyu4 hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jyun4, dik6 si6 nei4 lok6 jyun4 tung4 taai3 ping4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多好去处，例如海洋公园、迪士尼乐园和太平山。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many nice places to visit, for example, Ocean Park, Disneyland and Victoria Peak.

english_meaning: example, instance
explanation_mandarin: 用来说明某个道理或者情况的具体事物或事情。
explanation_english: A specific thing or matter used to illustrate a principle or situation.

examples.english_sentence: Let's look at an example.

english_meaning: Routine; perfunctory act; going through the motions
explanation_mandarin: 指例行公事，走过场，敷衍了事。通常指一些缺乏诚意和实质内容的行动或程序。
explanation_english: Refers to a routine or perfunctory act; going through the motions. Often used to describe actions or procedures that lack sincerity and substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲只係例戲啫，唔使咁认真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zi2 hai6 lai6 hei3 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 jin6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些只是走走过场而已，不用那么认真。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a routine, you don't need to take it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 开会都系例戏，倾嚟倾去都係嗰啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 dou1 hai6 lai6 hei3, king1 lai4 king1 heoi3 dou1 hai6 go2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会只是走过场，谈来谈去都是那些事情。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting is just going through the motions; it's always the same old stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做嘢成日都例戲咁，求其交货就算。

examples.english_sentence: They always do things perfunctorily, just handing in the work to get it over with.

english_meaning: regular meeting, routine meeting
explanation_mandarin: 定期举行的会议，一般指工作相关的例行会议。
explanation_english: A regular or routine meeting, usually related to work and held on a scheduled basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每個禮拜都有例會，匯報下進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 lai5 baai1 dou1 jau5 lai6 wui2, wui6 bou3 haa5 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每个星期都有例会，汇报一下进度。
examples.english_sentence: We have a regular meeting every week to report on the progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日嘅例會取消咗，因為經理病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ge3 lai6 wui2 ceoi2 siu1 zo2, jan1 wai6 ging1 lei5 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的例会取消了，因为经理生病了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow's regular meeting is cancelled because the manager is sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝個例會開咗成兩個鐘，好長呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 go3 lai6 wui2 hoi1 zo2 seng4 loeng5 go3 zung1, hou2 coeng4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上例会开了整整两个小时，好长啊！
examples.english_sentence: The regular meeting this morning lasted for two hours, it was so long!

english_meaning: soup of the day; daily soup; complimentary soup
explanation_mandarin: 餐馆或餐厅每日提供的固定的汤，通常是免费或价格较低。
explanation_english: The soup of the day offered in restaurants, often complimentary or at a low price. Usually a simple, standard soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅例湯係西洋菜蜜棗煲豬骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 lai6 tong1 hai6 sai1 joeng4 coi3 mat6 zou2 bou1 zyu1 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的例汤是西洋菜蜜枣煲猪骨。
examples.english_sentence: Today's soup of the day is watercress, jujube, and pork bone soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋叫咗晚餐，跟餐有例湯送。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 maan5 caan1, gan1 caan1 jau5 lai6 tong1 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们点了晚餐，套餐送例汤。
examples.english_sentence: We ordered dinner, and the set meal comes with a complimentary soup of the day.

english_meaning: as usual; standard procedure; the usual; standard order
explanation_mandarin: 指按老规矩办事，或者指日常、通常的状况或要求。在餐馆点菜时，也指点常规的菜色。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things according to the usual practice or standard procedure. It can also describe a common or typical situation or request. When ordering food in a restaurant, it can refer to ordering the regular dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次嚟都係例牌叫嗰幾樣嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 lai4 dou1 hai6 lai6 paai2 giu3 go2 gei2 joeng6 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次来都是照例点那几样东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: Every time he comes, he always orders the same few things as usual.

examples.jyutping_sentence: lai6 paai2 lai4 gong2, sing1 kei4 luk6 jat6 dou1 do1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按老规矩来说，星期六日人都很多的。
examples.english_sentence: As usual, there are a lot of people on Saturdays and Sundays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆例牌都係最後一個走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 lai6 paai2 dou1 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板照例都是最后一个走的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always the last one to leave, as usual.

english_meaning: Signature dish; standard order; something routine or expected
explanation_mandarin: 原指餐厅里最受欢迎或厨师最擅长的菜肴。引申指某人经常点或擅长做的事情，也指意料之中的事情。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the most popular dish in a restaurant or the chef's specialty. By extension, it refers to something someone often orders or is good at doing, or something that is expected or routine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去茶餐廳食嘢，佢嘅例牌菜一定係乾炒牛河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 je5, keoi5 ge3 lai6 paai4 coi3 jat1 ding6 hai6 gon1 caau2 ngau4 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去茶餐厅吃饭，他的拿手菜一定是干炒牛河。
examples.english_sentence: When he goes to a Cha Chaan Teng (Hong Kong style cafe) to eat, his signature dish is always stir-fried beef ho fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都遲到，遲到已經係佢嘅例牌菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3, ci4 dou3 ji5 ging1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 lai6 paai4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都迟到，迟到已经是他的招牌菜了。
examples.english_sentence: He's late every day, being late is his standard routine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次去唱K都一定唱呢首歌，真係佢嘅例牌菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 heoi3 coeng3 K dou1 jat1 ding6 coeng3 ni1 sau2 go1, zan1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 lai6 paai4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次去唱K都一定会唱这首歌，真是他的拿手好歌。
examples.english_sentence: He always sings this song whenever he goes to karaoke, it's definitely his signature song.

english_meaning: routine, customary, standard practice
explanation_mandarin: 按照惯例或规定进行；经常性的。
explanation_english: Done as a matter of routine; according to custom or established procedure.

examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 cin4, ngo5 dou1 wui5 lai6 hang4 gim2 caa4 jat1 ci3 email.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天上班前，我都会例行检查一次邮件。
examples.english_sentence: Every day before work, I routinely check my email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係例行公事，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 lai6 hang4 gung1 si6, m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是例行公事，不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a routine matter; there's no need to be so nervous.

english_meaning: routine matter; a matter of routine; standard procedure
explanation_mandarin: 指按照惯例必须做的公事或事情。
explanation_english: Refers to official business or matters that must be done according to convention or routine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢都係例行公事啫，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 dou1 hai6 lai6 hang4 gung1 si6 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是例行公事而已，不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: These are just routine matters, no need to be so nervous.

examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 zi2 hai6 lai6 hang4 gung1 si6, kau4 kei4 tin4 haa5 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 填写这张表格只是例行公事，随便填一下就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Filling out this form is just a routine matter, just fill it out casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都要做嘅文件審批，都係例行公事嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 ge3 man4 gin2 sam2 pai1, dou1 hai6 lai6 hang4 gung1 si6 lei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都要做的文件审批，都是例行公事而已。
examples.english_sentence: The document approval he does every day is just a routine matter.

mandarin_meaning: 规矩, 规定, 惯例
english_meaning: rule, regulation, convention, precedent
explanation_mandarin: 指已有的规定、惯例或规则。
explanation_english: Refers to established regulations, conventions, or rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有好多例規要遵守㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 lai6 kwai1 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有很多规矩要遵守的。
examples.english_sentence: The company has many rules to follow.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 po3 waai6 ni1 dou6 ge3 lai6 kwai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要破坏这里的规矩啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't break the rules here.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gan1 zuk1 lai6 kwai1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们完全按照规定办事。
examples.english_sentence: We follow the rules strictly when working.

english_meaning: Example; Instance; Proof
explanation_mandarin: 用事例来证明或说明。
explanation_english: An example or instance used as evidence or proof.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案例就是一个很好的例证，说明了法律的重要性。
examples.english_sentence: This case is a good example to illustrate the importance of law.

english_meaning: example, instance, illustration
explanation_mandarin: 用来证明或说明某种说法、现象的例子或证据。
explanation_english: An example or evidence used to prove or illustrate a statement or phenomenon.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 geoi3 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 lai6 zing3, zing3 ming4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lau2 gaa3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数据就是一个很好的例证，证明香港的房价真的很贵。
examples.english_sentence: This data is a good example proving that Hong Kong's housing prices are really expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功就係一個例證，話畀我哋聽努力係有回報嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 lai6 zing3, waa6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 teng1 nu5 lik6 hai6 jau5 wui4 bou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功就是一个例证，告诉我们努力是有回报的。
examples.english_sentence: His success is an example that tells us hard work pays off.

english_meaning: to be late, to arrive late
explanation_mandarin: 指到达时间晚于预计或规定的时间。
explanation_english: Refers to arriving later than the expected or scheduled time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日例遲啦，人哋會唔鍾意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lai6 ci4 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 zung1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是迟到，别人会不喜欢的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be late, people won't like it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今朝例遲咗半個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ziu1 lai6 ci4 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天早上迟到了半个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He was half an hour late this morning.

english_meaning: example problem; worked example
explanation_mandarin: 为了说明某个理论或解题方法而给出的具体例子题。
explanation_english: An example problem given to illustrate a theory or problem-solving method; a worked example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺黑板度講解緊一道例題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 hak1 baan2 dou6 gong2 gaai2 gan2 jat1 dou6 lai6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师在黑板上讲解一道例题。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is explaining an example problem on the blackboard.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的每章后面都有很多例题可以参考。
examples.english_sentence: Each chapter of this book has many example problems for reference.

english_meaning: set meal (usually rice with dishes); combo meal
explanation_mandarin: 指餐厅或饭馆提供的搭配好的、价格固定的套餐饭。通常包括米饭和若干配菜。
explanation_english: Refers to a set meal offered in a restaurant or eatery, usually consisting of rice with several side dishes and sold at a fixed price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日間餐廳嘅例飯有排骨同埋菜心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lai6 faan6 jau5 paai4 gwat1 tung4 maai4 coi3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这家餐厅的套餐饭有排骨和菜心。
examples.english_sentence: Today's set meal at this restaurant has spare ribs and choy sum (Chinese flowering cabbage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住叫個例飯就算喇，趕時間呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 giu3 go3 lai6 faan6 zau6 syun3 laa3, gon2 si4 gaan3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想点个套餐饭就算了，赶时间啊。
examples.english_sentence: I think I'll just order a set meal, I'm in a hurry.

english_meaning: to serve; to wait upon; to attend to
explanation_mandarin: 服侍，侍候。指在旁边照顾或伺候。
explanation_english: To serve, to wait upon. To attend to someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登請咗個工人嚟侍候佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 dang1 ceng2 zo2 go3 gung1 jan4 lai4 si6 hau6 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他特意请了一个工人来伺候他妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He specially hired a domestic helper to serve his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使侍候我，我自己嚟就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 si6 hau6 ngo5, ngo5 zi6 gei2 lai4 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用伺候我，我自己来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to wait on me, I can do it myself.

english_meaning: Waiter; Male server
explanation_mandarin: 指在餐馆、酒吧等场所提供服务的男性服务员。
explanation_english: Refers to a male waiter or server, typically in a restaurant or bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，侍仔，埋單！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, si6 zai2, maai4 daan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你好，服务员，结账！
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, waiter, bill please!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個侍仔好勤力，周圍走嚟走去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si6 zai2 hou2 kan4 lik6, zau1 wai4 zau2 lai4 zau2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个服务员很勤快，到处走来走去。
examples.english_sentence: That waiter is very diligent, running around everywhere.

english_meaning: to serve; to attend to; to wait on
explanation_mandarin: 服侍，照顾。
explanation_english: To serve; to attend to someone; to wait on someone; often implies a sense of deference or obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都侍候佢老豆，好孝順㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 si6 hau6 keoi5 lou5 dou6, hou2 haau3 seon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都伺候他爸爸，很孝顺的。
examples.english_sentence: He serves his father every day, he's very filial.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是你的工人，不用那样伺候你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not your servant, I don't need to wait on you like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲有錢人屋企，通常都有好多工人侍候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jau5 cin2 jan4 uk1 kei5, tung1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 jan4 si6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有钱人家里，通常都有很多工人伺候。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, rich families usually had many servants to attend to them.

english_meaning: to serve, to attend to (someone, especially elders or superiors)
explanation_mandarin: 指恭敬地服侍、照料他人，尤其指对长辈或地位较高的人的服侍。
explanation_english: To serve, attend to, or take care of someone, typically elders or those in a position of authority, with respect and diligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好孝順，日日侍奉佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 haau3 seon6, jat1 jat1 si6 fung6 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很孝顺，每天都服侍他妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He is very filial and serves his mother every day.

english_meaning: to pay mortgage installments; mortgage repayment
explanation_mandarin: 指定期向银行或金融机构偿还购房贷款。通常每月支付一次，包括本金和利息。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of regularly paying mortgage installments to a bank or financial institution for a home loan. Typically paid monthly and includes both principal and interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個月都要供樓，壓力好大㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 gung1 lau2, aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个月都要还房贷，压力很大的！
examples.english_sentence: I have to pay the mortgage every month, it's very stressful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆一齊供樓，生活都幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 jat1 cai4 gung1 lau2, sang1 wut6 dou1 gei2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩一起还房贷，生活挺辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: They pay the mortgage together as a couple, and their life is quite tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，供樓供到人都癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, gung1 lau2 gung1 dou3 jan4 dou1 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房价那么贵，还房贷还到人都疯了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong house prices are so expensive, paying the mortgage drives people crazy.

english_meaning: Contribution; to contribute; payment (e.g., to a pension fund, mortgage, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指定期缴纳一定金额的款项，用于某种目的，如养老金、房贷等。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of making regular payments towards a specific purpose, such as a pension fund, mortgage, or other similar commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要準時供款買樓㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 gung1 fun2 maai5 lau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须准时供房贷买房。
examples.english_sentence: We need to make mortgage payments on time to buy the apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你每個月供幾多錢強積金啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mui5 go3 jyut6 gung1 gei2 do1 cin2 koeng4 jik1 gam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你每个月供多少钱的强积金？
examples.english_sentence: How much MPF do you contribute each month?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無力供款，間屋俾銀行收返咗。

examples.english_sentence: He couldn't afford the payments, and the bank foreclosed on his house.

english_meaning: water supply; to supply water
explanation_mandarin: 提供水；提供饮用水或工业用水。
explanation_english: To supply water; provision of water for drinking, industrial, or other purposes.

examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 gai2 sin6 gung1 seoi2 hai6 tung2, kok3 bou2 si5 man4 jau5 gon1 zing6 ge3 seoi2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府需要改善供水系统，确保市民有干净的水喝。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to improve the water supply system to ensure that citizens have clean water to drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 受乾旱影響，農田供水不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau6 gon1 hon5 jing2 hoeng2, nung4 tin4 gung1 seoi2 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 受干旱影响，农田供水不足。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the drought, the water supply to the farmland is insufficient.

synonyms: 供應用水 (gung1 jing3 yung6 seoi2)

english_meaning: supply and demand
explanation_mandarin: 供给和需求。经济学中指商品或服务的可获得数量和人们对其的需求之间的关系。
explanation_english: Supply and demand. In economics, the relationship between the amount of a commodity or service that is available and the desire of buyers for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排口罩嘅供求好緊張，好難買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 hau2 zaau3 ge3 gung1 kau4 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, hou2 naan4 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近口罩的供求关系很紧张，很难买到。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the supply and demand for masks has been very tight, and it's hard to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果需求增加，但供應冇變，價格就會上升，呢個就係供求定律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 seoi1 kau4 zeng1 gaa1, daan6 gung1 jing3 mou5 bin3, gaa3 gaak3 zau6 wui5 soeng5 sing1, ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 gung1 kau4 ding6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果需求增加，但是供应没有变，价格就会上升，这就是供求定律。
examples.english_sentence: If demand increases but supply remains unchanged, the price will rise, and that is the law of supply and demand.

english_meaning: to confess, to state in court, to give evidence (as a witness)
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭上或警方面前供述案情。
explanation_english: To state facts or information formally, often in a court of law or to the police; to confess or provide evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向警方供稱佢冇參與打鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 ging2 fong1 gung1 ching3 keoi5 mou5 caam1 jyu5 daa2 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向警方供认他没有参与打架。
examples.english_sentence: He confessed to the police that he was not involved in the fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 被告喺法庭上面供稱自己係無辜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei6 gou3 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 min6 gung1 ching3 zi6 gei2 hai6 mou4 gu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被告在法庭上供认自己是无辜的。
examples.english_sentence: The defendant stated in court that he was innocent.

english_meaning: to supply; to provide
explanation_mandarin: 提供所需的物品、资源或服务。
explanation_english: To provide the necessary goods, resources, or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要供給市民足夠嘅醫療服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gung1 gap1 si5 man4 zuk1 gau3 ge3 ji1 liu4 fuk1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要给市民提供足够的医疗服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to provide sufficient medical services to citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司主要供給零件畀汽車廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 gung1 gap1 ling4 gin2 bei2 hei3 ce1 cong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司主要给汽车厂供给零件。
examples.english_sentence: This company mainly supplies parts to car factories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保有足夠嘅糧食供給災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 loeng4 sik6 gung1 gap1 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保有足够的粮食供给灾民。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure there is enough food to supply to the disaster victims.

english_meaning: Rights issue, rights offering
explanation_mandarin: 上市公司为了筹集资金，按照现有股东的持股比例，让股东以低于市场价的价格购买公司新发行的股票。
explanation_english: A rights issue (or rights offering) is an invitation to existing shareholders to purchase additional new shares in the company. This is typically offered at a discount to the market price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司又嚟供股，真係冇錢再買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jau6 lai4 gung1 gu2, zan1 hai6 mou5 cin2 zoi3 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司又来配股了，真的没钱再买了。
examples.english_sentence: This company is doing another rights issue; I really don't have any money to buy more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗清楚先好決定要唔要供股呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 m4 jiu3 gung1 gu2 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你考虑清楚再决定要不要参与配股啊。
examples.english_sentence: Think carefully before deciding whether or not to participate in the rights issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔供股，你嘅股權就會被攤薄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gung1 gu2, nei5 ge3 gu2 kyun4 zau6 wui5 bei6 taan1 bok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不参与配股，你的股权就会被稀释。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't participate in the rights issue, your shareholding will be diluted.

english_meaning: to provide meals; to prepare food
explanation_mandarin: 指准备并提供饭菜，尤指给长辈或需要照顾的人。
explanation_english: Refers to preparing and providing meals, especially for elders or those in need of care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每日都要供膳畀阿爺阿嫲食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 gung1 sin6 bei2 aa3 je4 aa3 maa1 sik6.

examples.english_sentence: We have to provide meals for our grandparents every day.

examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan5 jyun2 dou1 jau5 zyun1 jan4 fu6 zaak3 gung1 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 养老院都有专人负责供餐。
examples.english_sentence: Nursing homes have designated personnel responsible for providing meals.

english_meaning: confession; statement; deposition; testimony
explanation_mandarin: 指在警局、法庭等场合，嫌疑人或证人提供的证词或口供。
explanation_english: A statement or deposition given by a suspect or witness, typically in a police station or court of law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺警署錄咗份供詞，承認自己偷咗嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ging2 cyu5 luk6 zo2 fan6 gung1 ci4, sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 tau1 zo2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在警察局录了一份口供，承认自己偷了东西。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a statement at the police station, admitting that he stole something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官要求佢如實講出供詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 jiu1 kiu4 keoi5 jyu4 sat6 gong2 ceot1 gung1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官要求他如实讲出口供。
examples.english_sentence: The judge required him to tell the truth in his statement.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份口供的内容对他很不利。
examples.english_sentence: The contents of this statement are very unfavorable to him.

english_meaning: supply exceeds demand; oversupply
explanation_mandarin: 供应的数量超过需求，导致商品价格下降或滞销。
explanation_english: A situation where the supply of a product or service is greater than the demand, leading to price decreases or unsold goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市供過於求，啲樓價跌咗好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 gung1 gwo3 jyu1 kau4, di1 lau2 gaa3 dit3 zo2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房地产市场供过于求，房价跌了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: The property market has an oversupply, and house prices have fallen a lot.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 haau2 zaau3 gung1 gwo3 jyu1 kau4, so2 ji5 peng4 zo2 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在口罩供过于求，所以便宜了这么多。
examples.english_sentence: Now there's an oversupply of masks, so they've become so much cheaper.

english_meaning: to supply electricity; power supply
explanation_mandarin: 提供电力。
explanation_english: To provide electricity; the act of supplying electricity or the system that does so.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 gung1 din6 m4 wan2 ding6, seng4 jat6 ting4 din6.

examples.english_sentence: The power supply in this area is unstable, and there are frequent power outages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發電廠負責供電俾成個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 din6 cong2 fu6 zaak3 gung1 din6 bei2 seng4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发电厂负责给整个城市供电。
examples.english_sentence: The power plant is responsible for supplying electricity to the entire city.

english_meaning: to provide for (parents, monks, etc.); to support; to offer (to Buddha or deities)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆努力工作，供養父母。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩努力工作，赡养父母。
examples.english_sentence: The couple work hard to support their parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都去寺廟供養佛像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zi6 miu2 gung1 joeng5 fat6 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都去寺庙供养佛像。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the temple every day to offer to the Buddha statues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學習供養三寶嘅精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 gung1 joeng5 saam1 bou2 ge3 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习供养三宝的精神。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn the spirit of offering to the Three Jewels.

english_meaning: to lean on; to rely on; to depend on; according to; to comply with; to obey
explanation_mandarin: 动词：表示依靠，依赖；介词：表示按照，根据；也有顺从的意思。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ji1 laai6 keoi5 maa4 maa1 ge3 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很依赖他妈妈的照顾。
examples.english_sentence: He is very dependent on his mother's care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依你嘅意思去做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1 heoi3 zou6.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听你的。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go along with you.

english_meaning: as usual; according to precedent; habitually; as per usual; according to custom
explanation_mandarin: 按照往常的规矩或惯例。
explanation_english: According to the usual practice, custom, or rule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依例，每個星期日我都會同屋企人飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 lai6, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dou1 wui5 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jam2 caa4.

examples.english_sentence: As usual, I have tea with my family every Sunday.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 lai6 dou1 hai6 ci4 dou3 ge3, m4 sai2 dang2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他照例都会迟到的，不用等他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's habitually late, so there's no need to wait for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依例，呢份報告要喺星期五之前交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 lai6, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 zi1 cin4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照例，这份报告要在星期五之前交。
examples.english_sentence: As per usual, this report needs to be submitted before Friday.

english_meaning: reluctant to part; unwilling to say goodbye
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常留恋，舍不得离开。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of reluctance to part or say goodbye, indicating a strong attachment and unwillingness to separate.

examples.english_sentence: When leaving, they reluctantly said goodbye to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畢業典禮嗰日，同學仔個個都依依不捨，唔想咁快就分開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jip6 din2 lai5 go2 jat6, tung4 hok6 zai2 go3 go3 dou1 ji1 ji1 bat1 se2, m4 soeng2 gam3 faai3 zau6 fan1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕业典礼那天，同学们个个都依依不舍，不想这么快就分开。
examples.english_sentence: On the graduation ceremony day, all the classmates were reluctant to part and didn't want to separate so soon.

english_meaning: hesitant, mumbling, vague and unclear, indecisive
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话吞吞吐吐，表达不清楚。也形容人做事犹豫不决。
explanation_english: Describes someone speaking hesitantly or unclearly. It can also describe someone who is indecisive or hesitant in action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢依依哦哦，聽唔清楚佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ji1 ji1 o1 o1, ting1 m4 cing1 co2 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话吞吞吐吐的，听不清楚他想做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks hesitantly, it's hard to understand what he wants to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好依依哦哦啦，快啲做決定！

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hesitant, make a decision quickly!

english_meaning: Slightly moving, fidgeting, twitching (often repetitive and small movements)
explanation_mandarin: 形容轻微地、重复地动来动去，通常指细小的动作。
explanation_english: Describes slight, repetitive movements, usually referring to small actions like twitching or fidgeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺嗰陣成日依依郁郁，好難唔整醒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 ji1 ji1 yuk1 yuk1, hou2 naan4 m4 zing2 sing2 keoi5.

examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 ji1 ji1 yuk1 yuk1, mou5 saai3 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫生病之后，只懂得稍微动一下，没精神了。
examples.english_sentence: After the cat got sick, it only twitches and has no energy.

english_meaning: Whispering intimately, murmuring affectionately, cooing
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣之间亲密地低声说话，有时也指小声嘀咕。
explanation_english: Describes the intimate whispering or affectionate murmuring between lovers. It can also refer to muttering quietly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日都依依鵝鵝，唔知講緊乜嘢秘密。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个总是亲昵耳语，不知道在说什么秘密。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always whispering intimately; I wonder what secrets they are sharing.

english_meaning: Even; smooth; uniform; distributed evenly
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面或分布状态均匀、平整，没有凹凸或不平衡之处。也可以指使之变得均匀或平均。
explanation_english: Describes a surface or distribution that is even, smooth, and uniform, without bumps or imbalances. Can also refer to the act of making something even or uniform.

english_meaning: to copy; to imitate; to follow suit; to do as told
explanation_mandarin: 意思是按照指示或模仿别人去做。通常指缺乏独立思考，完全按照指示或别人的做法行动。
explanation_english: It means to follow instructions or imitate someone else. It often refers to a lack of independent thinking and acting completely according to instructions or someone else's actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日依司執人哋做嘢啦，要有自己嘅諗法。

examples.english_sentence: Don't always copy what others do, you should have your own ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識依司執，老闆叫佢做乜就做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 ji1 si1 zap1, lou5 baan2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mat1 zau6 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会照做，老板叫他做什么就做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to follow suit, he does whatever the boss tells him to do.

mandarin_meaning: 哇哇大叫; 鬼哭狼嚎

explanation_mandarin: 形容大声叫喊，通常带有夸张或害怕的意味，有时也指无理取闹。
explanation_english: Describes someone screaming and shouting loudly, often in an exaggerated or frightened manner. It can also imply making an unreasonable fuss or a disturbance.

examples.english_sentence: Don't make such a racket, the neighbors will complain.

explanation_english: A microorganism used in fermenting dough or beverages.

english_meaning: What is said here stays here; let's forget what was said here; what happens here stays here
explanation_mandarin: 表示所说的话只在当前场合有效，不要对外传播或过多追究。暗示谈话内容可能较为敏感或不重要。
explanation_english: This idiom means that what is said in this specific situation or conversation should not be repeated or spread to others. It implies that the conversation may be sensitive or unimportant and should be forgotten afterwards.
