english_meaning: Administrative Officer (AO); Civil Servant
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府中的行政主任职位，通常指高级公务员。
explanation_english: Refers to the position of Administrative Officer (AO) in the Hong Kong government, usually referring to senior civil servants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到依文士，前途無限呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 aa3 man1 si6, cin4 tou4 mou4 haan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了行政主任，前途无量啊！
examples.english_sentence: He passed the exam to become an Administrative Officer. His future is bright!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想做依文士唔容易㗎，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 zou6 aa3 man1 si6 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想做行政主任不容易的，竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to become an Administrative Officer. The competition is fierce.

english_meaning: on time; punctually; as scheduled
explanation_mandarin: 按照规定的时间；准时。
explanation_english: At the designated time; punctually; as scheduled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得聽日要依時返工呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ji1 si4 faan1 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得明天要按时上班啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to be on time for work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋依時喺餐廳門口見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji1 si4 hai2 caan1 teng1 mun4 hau2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们按时在餐厅门口见。
examples.english_sentence: We'll meet at the restaurant entrance on time.

english_meaning: on time; at the appointed time
explanation_mandarin: 指按照规定的时间或安排
explanation_english: Refers to being on time or following the schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得依時依候返工啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 ji1 si4 ji1 hau6 faan1 gung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得按时上班啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to be on time for work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我依時依候食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 ji1 si4 ji1 hau6 sik6 yoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我按时吃药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to take the medicine on time.

english_meaning: to recite verbatim from a book; to read directly from the book; to follow the book literally
explanation_mandarin: 指按照书本上的说法直接讲述，形容人说话或做事死板，不懂得灵活变通。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who speaks or acts rigidly according to the book, without any flexibility or adaptability. It implies a lack of independent thinking or understanding beyond the literal text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都依書直說，唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是照本宣科，不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He always recites verbatim from the book and doesn't know how to be flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師唔希望學生只係依書直說，而係要理解內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 m4 hei1 mong6 hok6 sang1 zi2 hai6 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, ji4 hai6 jiu3 lei5 gaai2 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师不希望学生只是照本宣科，而是要理解内容。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher doesn't want students to just recite verbatim from the book, but to understand the content.

english_meaning: to read directly from the book; to recite verbatim; to follow the book blindly; to be pedantic
explanation_mandarin: 按照书本上的话直接说出来，形容人只会照搬书本，不加思考。
explanation_english: To speak or act exactly as written in a book; to be overly literal and follow the book without applying critical thinking or considering context. It often implies a lack of understanding or independent thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上堂淨係識得依書直說，悶到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 tong4 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, mun6 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上课只会照本宣科，无聊死了。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to read directly from the book in class, it's so boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好依書直說呀，試下自己理解下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3 aa3, si3 haa5 zi6 gei2 lei5 gaai2 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要照本宣科，试着自己理解一下先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just read from the book, try to understand it yourself first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁依書直說，要靈活運用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, jiu3 ling4 wut6 wan6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么死板地照本宣科，要灵活运用。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid in following the book, you need to be flexible.

english_meaning: To read directly from the book; to recite verbatim; to follow the book exactly; to be unimaginative or unoriginal.
explanation_mandarin: 指按照书本上的文字直接讲述，没有自己的理解和发挥。多指机械地照搬书本，缺乏创新或变通。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking or acting exactly as written in a book, without any personal interpretation or creativity. It often implies a lack of originality and a rigid adherence to the text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上堂淨係依書直説，悶到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 tong4 zing6 hai6 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, mun6 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上课只是照本宣科，闷死了。
examples.english_sentence: He just reads directly from the book in class, it's so boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫論文唔可以淨係依書直説，要加自己嘅分析同意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 leon6 man4 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 ji1 syu1 zik6 syut3, jiu3 gaa1 zi6 gei2 ge3 fan1 sik1 tung4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写论文不可以只是照本宣科，要加上自己的分析和意见。
examples.english_sentence: When writing a thesis, you can't just recite verbatim from the book, you need to add your own analysis and opinions.

english_meaning: recently; these days; lately
explanation_mandarin: 表示最近一段时间，一段时间内。
explanation_english: Refers to the recent period, a duration of time; these days, lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依期好忙啊，日日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 kei4 hou2 mong4 aa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很忙啊，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very busy these days, having to work overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依期天氣忽冷忽熱，好易病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 kei4 tin1 hei3 fat1 laang5 fat1 jit6, hou2 ji6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气忽冷忽热，很容易生病。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been fluctuating a lot lately, making it easy to get sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依期興緊呢個牌子嘅化妝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 kei4 hing1 gan2 ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 faa3 zong1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近流行这个牌子的化妆品。
examples.english_sentence: This brand of cosmetics is trending these days.

mandarin_meaning: 一会儿这样，一会儿那样；一会儿一个样
english_meaning: Changing one's mind frequently; being inconsistent; indecisive.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人经常改变主意，一会儿一个样，没有定性。
explanation_english: Describes someone who frequently changes their mind or behavior, lacking consistency or a fixed plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好依樣嗰樣啦，快啲決定去唔去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji1 joeng2 go2 joeng2 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一会儿这样一会儿那样了，快点决定去不去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep changing your mind, just decide whether you're going or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日依樣嗰樣，搞到大家都唔知點跟佢好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 ji1 joeng2 go2 joeng2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gan1 keoi5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是变来变去，搞得大家都不知道怎么跟着他才好。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so inconsistent with his work, it makes it hard for everyone to know how to follow him.

english_meaning: to copy slavishly; to imitate mechanically; to follow suit without understanding
explanation_mandarin: 比喻单纯模仿，没有创造性，不理解其本质。
explanation_english: It refers to mechanically imitating something without understanding the underlying principles or being creative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得依樣畫葫蘆，冇自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 ji1 joeng6 waak6 wu4 lou2, mou5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会照猫画虎，没有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to copy slavishly, he doesn't have his own ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好依樣畫葫蘆，要學識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji1 joeng6 waak6 wu4 lou2, jiu3 hok6 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要照猫画虎，要学会灵活变通。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just copy mechanically, you need to learn to be flexible.

english_meaning: in order; in sequence; one by one
explanation_mandarin: 按照一定的次序。
explanation_english: In order; according to a certain sequence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家請依次排隊上車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 cing2 ji1 ci3 paai4 deoi2 soeng5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请大家依次排队上车。
examples.english_sentence: Please line up in order to get on the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會依次處理你哋嘅申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ji1 ci3 cyu5 lei5 nei5 dei6 ge3 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会依次处理你们的申请。
examples.english_sentence: We will process your applications in order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請依次噉填寫表格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 ji1 ci3 gam2 tin4 se2 biu2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请依次填写表格。
examples.english_sentence: Please fill out the form in order.

english_meaning: reliance; to rely on; to depend on; to resort to; where one belongs; a haven; a place to call home; ultimate destination; source of support
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指最终的归宿，可以是有形的地点，也可以是抽象的概念，比如信仰或理想。动词：指归向或依赖于某个事物。
explanation_english: As a noun: the place or concept to which one ultimately belongs or turns; can be a physical place or an abstract idea like faith or an ideal. As a verb: to turn to or depend on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家庭係我嘅精神依歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 ting4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zing1 san4 ji1 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家庭是我的精神归宿。
examples.english_sentence: Family is my spiritual home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最終都係依歸咗傳統價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 hai6 ji1 gwai1 zo2 cyun4 tung2 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最终还是归向了传统价值观。
examples.english_sentence: They eventually reverted to traditional values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個困難嘅時候，我哋嘅依歸就係互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 ge3 ji1 gwai1 zau6 hai6 wu6 seong1 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个困难的时候，我们的依靠就是互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: In this difficult time, our reliance is on supporting each other.

english_meaning: according to law; in accordance with the law; legally
explanation_mandarin: 按照法律规定。
explanation_english: According to legal provisions; legally; in accordance with the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要依法辦事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji1 faat3 baan6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须依法办事。
examples.english_sentence: We must act according to the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察依法拘捕咗疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 chaat3 ji1 faat3 keoi1 bou6 zo2 ji4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察依法逮捕了嫌疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested the suspect according to the law.

english_meaning: to sob, to whimper
explanation_mandarin: 形容低声哭泣，通常指压抑的哭泣。
explanation_english: To cry softly and quietly, often in a suppressed manner. Usually implies controlled or restrained weeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇完套戲之後，忍唔住依泣起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 jyun4 tou3 hei3 zi1 hau6, jan2 m4 zyu6 ji1 jap1 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看完电影之后，忍不住啜泣起来。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the movie, she couldn't help but sob.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，佢依泣咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, keoi5 ji1 jap1 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息，她啜泣了很久。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news, she sobbed for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥跌親之後，依泣住唔敢起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 dit3 can1 zi1 hau6, ji1 jap1 zyu6 m4 gam2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子摔倒之后，啜泣着不敢起身。
examples.english_sentence: After falling down, the child sobbed and didn't dare to get up.

english_meaning: still; as before
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况没有改变；还是像原来一样。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation has not changed; remains as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢畢業好耐，但係佢依然好關心學校嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 bat1 jip6 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ji1 jin4 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 hok6 haau6 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他毕业很久了，但是他仍然很关心学校的发展。
examples.english_sentence: Although he graduated a long time ago, he still cares a lot about the development of the school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 十年過去，呢條街嘅景色依然冇變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6 nin4 gwo3 heoi3, ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ge3 ging2 sik1 ji1 jin4 mou5 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 十年过去了，这条街的景色依然没有变。
examples.english_sentence: Ten years have passed, but the scenery of this street remains unchanged.

mandarin_meaning: 依然故我 (yī rán gù wǒ)
english_meaning: still one's old self; remaining the same; unchanged
explanation_mandarin: 指仍然保持原来的样子，没有改变。形容人的性格、习惯或状态没有变化。
explanation_english: Refers to remaining as one was before, without any changes. It describes a person's character, habits, or state remaining unchanged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢移民咗咁多年，都依然故我，一樣咁鍾意打麻雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 man4 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, dou1 ji1 jin4 gu3 ngo5, jat1 joeng6 gam3 zung1 ji3 daa2 maa4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他移民这么多年了，还是依然故我，一样那么喜欢打麻将。
examples.english_sentence: He immigrated for so many years, but he is still his old self, still likes to play mahjong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢經歷咗好多嘢，但係性格依然故我，都係咁樂觀開朗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, daan6 hai6 sing3 gaak3 ji1 jin4 gu3 ngo5, dou1 hai6 gam3 lok6 gun1 hoi1 long5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他经历了很多事情，但是性格依然故我，还是那么乐观开朗。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has experienced a lot, his personality remains unchanged, still so optimistic and cheerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論環境點變，我都會依然故我，堅持自己嘅原則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 waan4 ging2 dim2 bin3, ngo5 dou1 wui5 ji1 jin4 gu3 ngo5, gin1 chi4 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyun1 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论环境怎么变，我都会依然故我，坚持自己的原则。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how the environment changes, I will remain my old self and adhere to my principles.

english_meaning: according to, in accordance with, in light of, to follow, to comply with
explanation_mandarin: 表示按照或根据某种标准、规定或指示。
explanation_english: To act or proceed according to a standard, rule, or instruction; to follow or comply with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依照規矩，你唔可以咁樣做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 ziu3 kwai1 geoi2, nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按照规矩，你不能这样做。
examples.english_sentence: According to the rules, you can't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會依照你嘅指示去處理呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ji1 ziu3 nei5 ge3 zi2 si1 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会按照你的指示去处理这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We will handle this matter according to your instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依照天氣預報，聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 ziu3 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3, ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按照天气预报，明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 龇牙咧嘴；不怀好意地笑
english_meaning: To grin maliciously; to show one's teeth in a threatening or mocking way; to smirk
explanation_mandarin: 形容人露出牙齿，笑容不怀好意，带有一种挑衅或者嘲讽的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person showing their teeth in a smile that is malicious, threatening, mocking, or insincere. It implies a negative intent behind the smile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽完就依牙鬆弶咁望住我，肯定諗住搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ting1 jyun4 zau6 ji1 ngaa4 sung1 gong6 gam2 mong5 zyu6 ngo5, hak1 ding6 nam2 zyu6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听完就龇牙咧嘴地看着我，肯定想着要搞事情。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he heard it, he smirked at me, he's definitely planning to cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日依牙鬆弶啦，有咩咪出聲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ji1 ngaa4 sung1 gong6 laa1, jau5 me1 mai1 ceot1 seng1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是龇牙咧嘴的，有什么就说出来嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep smirking, if you have something to say, just say it.

mandarin_meaning: 顶嘴, 抬杠, 不服气
english_meaning: To talk back, to argue back defiantly, to be insubordinate, to be argumentative
explanation_mandarin: 指不服气，顶嘴，故意抬杠，对长辈或权威表现出不尊重和不服从的态度。
explanation_english: Refers to talking back defiantly, arguing stubbornly, or being insubordinate. It implies a disrespectful and disobedient attitude towards elders or figures of authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁依牙鬆鋼啦，聽下阿爸講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji1 ngaa4 sung1 gong3 laa1, teng1 haa5 aa3 baa4 gong2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么顶嘴了，听爸爸说话吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so argumentative. Listen to what your father has to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路成日依牙鬆鋼，真係好難教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 seng4 jat6 ji1 ngaa4 sung1 gong3, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个孩子总是顶嘴，真难教。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is always talking back; he's really hard to teach.

english_meaning: vaguely; dimly; indistinctly
explanation_mandarin: 指记忆、印象等模糊不清，不甚明朗。
explanation_english: Refers to something being vague, indistinct, or remembered faintly. It describes a state of being unclear or dimly perceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我依稀記得細個嘅時候嚟過呢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji1 hei1 gei3 dak1 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 lai4 gwo3 ni1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我依稀记得小时候来过这里。
examples.english_sentence: I vaguely remember coming here when I was a kid.

mandarin_meaning: 侯王 (古代爵位); 指侯王廟
english_meaning: Marquis and King (ancient titles); Refers to Hau Wong Temple (a temple dedicated to a loyal minister of the Song Dynasty)
explanation_mandarin: 侯王原指古代的爵位，侯和王。在香港，通常指侯王廟，即供奉楊侯王的廟宇。楊侯王是宋朝末年忠臣楊亮節，隨宋帝南下避難，在香港一帶病逝，後人建廟紀念。
explanation_english: Originally, Marquis and King were ancient nobility titles. In Hong Kong, it usually refers to Hau Wong Temple, a temple dedicated to Yang Leung-Kit (楊亮節), a loyal minister of the late Song Dynasty. Yang Leung-Kit followed the Song Emperor south to seek refuge and died of illness in the Hong Kong area. Later, people built temples to commemorate him.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案件涉及有人侵吞公款。
examples.english_sentence: This case involves someone embezzling public funds.

mandarin_meaning: 算上...一起玩；拉上...一起玩
english_meaning: To include... in playing; to bring... along to play
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人或某物也算进来一起玩耍，强调把某人或某物一起考虑进去。
explanation_english: Indicates including someone or something in playing; emphasizes considering someone or something together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋打邊爐，侵埋你男朋友玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 daa2 bin1 lou4, cam1 maai4 nei5 naam4 pang4 jau5 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃火锅，把你男朋友也叫上一起玩吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're having hot pot tonight, let's include your boyfriend in the fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去行山，侵埋阿婆去玩，佢成日話想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1, cam1 maai4 aa3 po4 heoi3 waan2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天去爬山，把奶奶也带去玩吧，她总是说想去。
examples.english_sentence: We're going hiking tomorrow, let's bring grandma along, she always says she wants to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋踢波，侵埋個細佬玩，佢都好想玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tek3 bo1, cam1 maai4 go3 sai3 lou2 waan2, keoi5 dou1 hou2 soeng2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们踢足球，把弟弟也算上一起玩，他也很想玩。
examples.english_sentence: We're playing soccer, let's include my younger brother, he really wants to play too.

mandarin_meaning: 侵占; 侵吞; 掠夺
english_meaning: to seize; to encroach upon; to usurp; to plunder; to deprive
explanation_mandarin: 指用不正当的手段侵犯并夺取别人的财物或权利。
explanation_english: To invade and seize someone's property or rights by illegitimate means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司嘅專利俾競爭對手侵奪咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 ge3 zyun1 lei6 bei2 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 cam1 dyut6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的专利被竞争对手侵占了。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's patent was usurped by competitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以俾人侵奪你嘅權利啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 cam1 dyut6 nei5 ge3 kyun4 lei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以让人侵占你的权利啊！
examples.english_sentence: You can't let others infringe upon your rights!

english_meaning: to infringe upon, to encroach upon, to violate, to harm
explanation_mandarin: 侵犯别人的权利、利益等。
explanation_english: To infringe upon someone's rights, interests, etc.; to violate or harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋侵害咗我哋嘅版權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cim1 hoi6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 baan2 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们侵害了我们的版权。
examples.english_sentence: They infringed upon our copyright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策侵害咗市民嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 cim1 hoi6 zo2 si5 man4 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策侵害了市民的利益。
examples.english_sentence: This policy infringes upon the interests of citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴力行為侵害咗社會嘅安寧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 lik6 hang4 wai4 cim1 hoi6 zo2 se5 wui2 ge3 on1 ning4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴力行为侵害了社会的安宁。
examples.english_sentence: Violent acts infringe upon the peace and tranquility of society.

english_meaning: copyright infringement, infringement, violation of rights
explanation_mandarin: 指违反著作权、专利权、商标权等知识产权的行为。
explanation_english: An act of violating intellectual property rights such as copyright, patent rights, and trademark rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅產品侵權，俾人告咗上法庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 pin2 cam1 kyun4, bei2 jan4 gou3 zo2 soeng5 faat3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的产品侵权了，被人告上了法庭。
examples.english_sentence: Their product infringed on copyright, and they were sued in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下載盜版軟件係一種侵權行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6载 dou6 baan2軟 gin2 hai6 jat1 zung2 cam1 kyun4 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下载盗版软件是一种侵权行为。
examples.english_sentence: Downloading pirated software is an act of copyright infringement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重知識產權，避免侵權行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 zi1 sik1 caan2 kyun4, bei6 min5 cam1 kyun4 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重知识产权，避免侵权行为。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect intellectual property rights and avoid acts of infringement.

english_meaning: disappointing; discouraging; a letdown; to dampen spirits
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发展不顺利，让人感到扫兴、失望，情绪低落。可以形容某件事，也可以形容某种行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation or event that is disappointing, discouraging, or a letdown. It can describe an event or an action that dampens someone's spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落雨，真係侵氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 jyu5, zan1 hai6 cam1 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下雨，真是扫兴！
examples.english_sentence: It's raining tonight, what a disappointment!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日潑人冷水，好侵氣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 put3 jan4 laang5 seoi2, hou2 cam1 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是给人泼冷水，很令人扫兴的。
examples.english_sentence: He always pours cold water on people, it's very discouraging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來諗住去睇戲，點知賣曬飛，真係侵氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 lai4 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 tai2 hei3, dim2 zi1 maai6 saai3 fei1, zan1 hai6 cam1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来打算去看电影，没想到票卖完了，真是扫兴。
examples.english_sentence: I originally planned to go to the cinema, but the tickets were all sold out, what a letdown.

english_meaning: to infringe, to violate, to invade, to encroach on
explanation_mandarin: 侵入并冒犯，侵略或干涉。
explanation_english: To intrude upon and offend; to invade or interfere with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋侵犯咗我哋嘅私隱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cam1 faan6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 si1 yan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们侵犯了我们的隐私。
examples.english_sentence: They violated our privacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以侵犯人權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 cam1 faan6 yan4 gyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能侵犯人权。
examples.english_sentence: Human rights must not be violated.

english_meaning: invasion; aggression; to invade; to commit aggression
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或政权以武力侵犯并占领另一个国家或政权的领土和主权。
explanation_english: The act of invading and occupying another country or territory by force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第二次世界大戰期間，日本侵略咗好多亞洲國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 ji6 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3 gei1 gaan1, jat6 bun2 cam1 loek6 zo2 hou2 do1 aa3 zau1 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第二次世界大战期间，日本侵略了很多亚洲国家。
examples.english_sentence: During World War II, Japan invaded many Asian countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅行為係一種侵略，必須受到譴責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 wai4 hai6 jat1 zung2 cam1 loek6, bit1 seoi1 sau6 dou3 hin2責.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行为是一种侵略，必须受到谴责。
examples.english_sentence: Their behavior is a form of aggression and must be condemned.

english_meaning: Aggressiveness, invasiveness
explanation_mandarin: 指具有侵犯、攻击、扩张等性质的倾向或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the tendency or behavior of having an aggressive, offensive, or expansive nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有侵略性，乜都要爭贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 cam1 loek6 sing3, mat1 dou1 jiu3 zaang1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很有侵略性，什么都要争赢。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very aggressive person and wants to win at everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅市場推廣策略好有侵略性，好快就搶佔咗好多市場份額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 si5 coeng4 tui1 gwong2 caak3 loek6 hou2 jau5 cam1 loek6 sing3, hou2 faai3 zau6 coeng2 zim3 zo2 hou2 do1 si5 coeng4 fan6 ngaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的市场推广策略很有侵略性，很快就抢占了很多市场份额。
examples.english_sentence: This company's marketing strategy is very aggressive, and they quickly seized a lot of market share.

english_meaning: erosion, corrosion, to erode, to corrode, to encroach upon
explanation_mandarin: 逐渐破坏或腐蚀，尤指通过自然力或化学作用。
explanation_english: To gradually destroy or wear away (something) by natural forces (such as water, wind, or ice) or chemical processes; to corrode.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲海岸線俾海水侵蝕得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hoi2 ngon6 sin3 bei2 hoi2 seoi2 cam1 sik6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海岸线被海水侵蚀得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The coastline is being heavily eroded by the seawater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅公信力正逐步俾一啲醜聞侵蝕緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 gung1 seon3 lik6 zing3 zuk6 bou6 bei2 jat1 di1 cau2 man4 cam1 sik6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的公信力正逐步被一些丑闻侵蚀。
examples.english_sentence: The government's credibility is being gradually eroded by some scandals.

english_meaning: to invade; to attack; to intrude; to sweep over
explanation_mandarin: 指敌军侵入并袭击，或者指自然灾害等侵扰。
explanation_english: Refers to the invasion and attack by enemy troops, or the intrusion of natural disasters, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風侵襲香港，好多地方都水浸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 cam1 zaap6 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 seoi2 zam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风侵袭香港，很多地方都水淹了。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon invaded Hong Kong, and many places were flooded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次流感侵襲性好強，好多人都中招。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 lau4 gam2 cam1 zaap6 sing3 hou2 koeng4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung3 ziu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次流感的侵袭性很强，很多人都感染了。
examples.english_sentence: This flu is highly invasive, and many people are infected.

english_meaning: companion, partner, mate
explanation_mandarin: 指陪伴在一起的人，通常指朋友、配偶或伴侣。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who accompanies another, usually a friend, spouse, or partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅最佳伴侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 bun6 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的最佳伴侣。
examples.english_sentence: He is my best companion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我嘅旅伴一齊去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 leoi5 bun6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的旅伴一起去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I went on a trip with my travel partner.

mandarin_meaning: 狭窄; 拘束; 不通风; 局促; 困住
english_meaning: cramped; confined; stuffy; restricted; limited; to feel trapped; to be stuck
explanation_mandarin: 形容空间狭小不通风，或形容心情不舒畅，感到拘束、不自由。也可表示被困住，无法脱身。
explanation_english: Describes a space that is small, cramped, and poorly ventilated. It can also describe a feeling of being uncomfortable, restricted, or not free. It can also mean to be trapped or stuck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房咁細，好侷促啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 sai3, hou2 guk6 cuk1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么小，感觉很局促啊！
examples.english_sentence: The room is so small, it feels very cramped!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺屋企悶到侷親，出去行下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 uk1 kei2 mun6 dou3 guk6 can1, cheut1 heoi3 haang4 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在家里闷到快要憋坏了，出去走走吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so bored being at home, I'm feeling trapped. Let's go out for a walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好侷身侷勢，冇乜發展空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 guk6 san1 guk6 sai3, mou5 mat1 faat3 zin2 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很受拘束，没什么发展空间。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very restrictive, with little room for development.

mandarin_meaning: 拘束, 不自在, 狭窄
english_meaning: restrained, uncomfortable, cramped, narrow
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境狭窄，令人感到不舒服，或形容行为举止不自然、拘谨。
explanation_english: Describes a cramped or narrow environment that makes one feel uncomfortable. It can also describe behaviour that is unnatural, restrained, or awkward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房咁細，覺得好侷促。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 sai3, gok3 dak1 hou2 guk6 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么小，感觉很拘束。
examples.english_sentence: The room is so small, I feel very cramped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次同老闆食飯，覺得好侷促。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 tung4 lou5 baan2 sik6 faan6, gok3 dak1 hou2 guk6 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次和老板吃饭，觉得很不自在。
examples.english_sentence: It's my first time eating with the boss, I feel very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁侷促嘅環境下做嘢，好難集中精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 guk6 cuk1 ge3 waan4 ging2 haa6 zou6 je5, hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1 ging1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么狭窄的环境下工作，很难集中精神。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to concentrate when working in such a cramped environment.

english_meaning: limit, confine, restrict
explanation_mandarin: 限制在一定的范围之内。
explanation_english: To limit, confine, or restrict to a certain scope or extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅資源好侷限，所以要好好咁利用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi1 jyun4 hou2 guk6 haam6, so2 ji5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 gam2 lei6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的资源很有限，所以要好好利用。
examples.english_sentence: Our resources are limited, so we must make good use of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾自己嘅諗法侷限咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3 guk6 haam6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让自己的想法局限了你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let your own ideas limit you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策侷限咗我哋嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jing3 caak3 guk6 haam6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策限制了我们的发展。
examples.english_sentence: This policy has limited our development.

english_meaning: convenient, cheap
explanation_mandarin: 方便，便宜。 也可以用作副词，表示顺便，就。
explanation_english: Convenient, inexpensive (cheap). Can also be used as an adverb meaning 'then', 'so', 'while you're at it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好便㗎，啲嘢又好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 bin6 gaa3, di1 je5 jau6 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很便宜，东西也很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is cheap, and the food is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁便出埋去幫我買包煙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 bin6 ceot1 maai4 heoi3 bong1 ngo5 maai5 baau1 jin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你既然要出去，就帮我买包烟吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since you're going out, buy me a pack of cigarettes while you're at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭地鐵最便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dei6 tit3 zeoi3 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐地铁最方便。
examples.english_sentence: Taking the subway is the most convenient.

english_meaning: poop, feces, excrement (childish)
explanation_mandarin: （儿语）指排泄物，大便。
explanation_english: (childish) Refers to excrement, feces, poop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要去疴便便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 o1 bin6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去拉大便。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go poop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB啱啱屙咗便便，要換片片啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 ngaam1 ngaam1 o1 zo2 bin6 bin6, jiu3 wun6 pin3 pin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝刚刚拉了便便，要换尿布了。
examples.english_sentence: The baby just pooped, we need to change the diaper.

english_meaning: convenient; convenience
explanation_mandarin: 指方便，顺利，容易做到。
explanation_english: Referring to something that is convenient, easy, and smooth to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭好便利，行幾步就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 hou2 bin6 lei6, haang4 gei2 bou6 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店很方便，走几步就到了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is very convenient, it's just a few steps away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上購物真係好便利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 kau3 mat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 bin6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上购物真的很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Online shopping is really convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗顧客嘅便利，我哋延長咗營業時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 guk1 haak3 ge3 bin6 lei6, ngo5 dei6 jin4 coeng4 zo2 ying4 jip6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了顾客的方便，我们延长了营业时间。
examples.english_sentence: For the convenience of our customers, we have extended our business hours.

english_meaning: convenience store
explanation_mandarin: 提供快速购物和服务的零售店，通常营业时间长，商品种类繁多，方便顾客随时购买。
explanation_english: A retail store that offers a wide variety of merchandise and services for quick purchase, typically with extended hours of operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我落樓去便利店買包紙巾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lok6 lau2 heoi3 bin6 lei6 dim3 maai5 baau1 ji2 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下楼去便利店买包纸巾。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going downstairs to the convenience store to buy a pack of tissues.

english_meaning: Penny (British currency unit)
explanation_mandarin: 香港人对英国货币单位“便士”的称呼。通常用于指代比较小的金额。
explanation_english: The Cantonese term for "penny," a unit of British currency. Commonly used to refer to small amounts of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個糖好平咋，只係幾便士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tong2 hou2 peng4 zaa3, zi2 hai6 gei2 bin6 si6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个糖很便宜，只是几便士。
examples.english_sentence: This candy is very cheap, only a few pennies.

english_meaning: cheap, inexpensive, bargain
explanation_mandarin: 形容价格低廉，不贵。
explanation_english: Describes something that is low in price; inexpensive; a good deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好便宜喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 bin1 ji4 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服好便宜啊！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is so cheap!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間餐廳嘅嘢食幾便宜嘅，你可以試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 gei2 bin1 ji4 ge3, nei5 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们餐厅的东西挺便宜的，你可以试试。
examples.english_sentence: The food at their restaurant is quite cheap, you can try it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買到張便宜機票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 dou2 zoeng1 bin1 ji4 gei1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买到一张便宜机票。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cheap plane ticket.

mandarin_meaning: 占便宜的人; 爱贪小便宜的人
english_meaning: Someone who takes advantage of others; cheapskate; someone who's always looking for a bargain or to get something for free
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢占别人便宜，爱贪小便宜的人。带贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who likes to take advantage of others or is always looking for a bargain or something for free. It has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣攞着數，真係個便宜仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu2 dim2 joeng2 lo2 zoek6 sou3, zan1 hai6 go3 bin1 ji4 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎么占便宜，真是个爱贪小便宜的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to get an advantage, he's such a cheapskate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做個便宜仔，咁樣會俾人睇唔起㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 go3 bin1 ji4 zai2, gam2 joeng2 wui5 bei2 jan4 tai2 m4 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做个爱占小便宜的人，这样会被人看不起的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a cheapskate, people will look down on you.

english_meaning: Stepfather; Non-biological father (often used sarcastically or negatively)
explanation_mandarin: 指非亲生的父亲，通常带有一种无奈或戏谑的语气。也可用于讽刺关系不好或没有感情的继父。
explanation_english: Refers to a non-biological father, usually with a tone of resignation or mockery. It can also be used to sarcastically refer to a stepfather with whom one has a bad or loveless relationship. The '便宜' (bin1 ji4) implies 'cheap' or 'easy', suggesting the role was acquired without the usual bond of fatherhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣，佢阿媽改嫁，所以佢就有個便宜老豆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, keoi5 aa3 maa1 goi2 gaa3, so2 ji5 keoi5 zau6 jau5 go3 bin1 ji4 lou5 dau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候，他妈妈改嫁了，所以他就有了一个继父。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, his mother remarried, so he got a stepfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我個便宜老豆關係唔係好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 go3 bin1 ji4 lou5 dau6 gwaan1 hai6 m4 hai6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的继父关系不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: My relationship with my stepfather isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話個便宜老豆唔錫佢，好慘㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 go3 bin1 ji4 lou5 dau6 m4 sek3 keoi5, hou2 caam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说他的继父不疼他，很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He always says that his stepfather doesn't love him, it's very pitiful.

english_meaning: Don't be greedy for petty advantages; Don't be tempted by small gains.
explanation_mandarin: 告诫人们不要贪图小利，以免遭受更大的损失。
explanation_english: A saying that warns people not to be greedy for small advantages, lest they suffer greater losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界邊有咁大隻蛤乸隨街跳㗎，便宜莫貪啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 bin1 jau5 gam3 daai6 zek3 gap3 naa2 ceoi4 gaai1 tiu3 gaa3, bin1 ji4 mok6 taam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界上哪有这么好的事情，不要贪小便宜啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world. Don't be greedy for small advantages!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想攞著數，但係又唔聽人講「便宜莫貪」，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 lo2 zoek3 sou3, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 ting1 jan4 gong2 "bin1 ji4 mok6 taam1", ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占便宜，但是又不听人说“不要贪小便宜”，迟早会出事。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to take advantage, but he doesn't listen to the saying "Don't be greedy for petty advantages", sooner or later something will happen.

mandarin_meaning: 说风凉话，说不负责任的话
english_meaning: to talk irresponsibly, to talk without thinking, to make irresponsible remarks, to talk glibly
explanation_mandarin: 指说话不负责任，不经过大脑思考，轻率地说出一些不负责任或者事后难以承担的话语。常常带有贬义色彩，指责对方说话轻浮，不认真。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking irresponsibly, without thinking carefully, and casually making irresponsible or difficult-to-fulfill statements. It often has a derogatory connotation, criticizing the other party for speaking frivolously and not seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度便宜說話啦，你又唔知件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 bin1 ji4 syut3 waa2 laa1, nei5 jau6 m4 zi1 gin6 si6 ge3 lai4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里说风凉话了，你又不知道事情的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk irresponsibly here, you don't even know the whole story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都便宜說話，所以無人鍾意同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bin1 ji4 syut3 waa2, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说风凉话，所以没有人喜欢和他合作。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks irresponsibly, so no one likes to work with him.

english_meaning: urge to defecate; need to go to the toilet (for bowel movement)
explanation_mandarin: 想排便的感觉。
explanation_english: The feeling or urge to defecate; the sensation of needing to have a bowel movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我突然之間覺得有便意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dat6 jin4 zi1 gaan1 gok3 dak1 jau5 bin6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我突然间觉得有便意。
examples.english_sentence: I suddenly feel the urge to defecate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗呢杯咖啡之後，我即刻有便意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 zo2 ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 jau5 bin6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了这杯咖啡之后，我立刻有了便意。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking this cup of coffee, I immediately felt the urge to defecate.

mandarin_meaning: 便于携带, 方便携带
english_meaning: portable, easy to carry
explanation_mandarin: 容易携带，方便运输的。
explanation_english: Easy to carry or move around; portable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦好便攜，帶去旅行都唔會覺得重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 hou2 bin6 kwai4, daai3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 dou1 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑很便携，带去旅行也不会觉得重。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is very portable, it won't feel heavy taking it on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲便攜式充電器真係好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 bin6 kwai4 sik1 cung1 din6 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的便携式充电器真的很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Portable chargers are really convenient nowadays.

english_meaning: easy to; convenient for
explanation_mandarin: 容易；方便。
explanation_english: To be easy to; to be convenient for; facilitating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機嘅設計便於操作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 sai3 gai3 bin6 jyu1 cau1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的设计便于操作。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this machine is easy to operate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將會議改喺個交通便於嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 wui6 ji5 goi2 hai2 go3 gaau1 tung1 bin6 jyu1 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们将会议改在一个交通便利的地方。
examples.english_sentence: We're changing the meeting to a location with easy access.

english_meaning: casual wear; informal dress
explanation_mandarin: 指非正式的服装，日常穿着的衣服，通常舒适且随意。
explanation_english: Refers to informal clothing, everyday wear, usually comfortable and casual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔使著校服，可以著便服返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 zoek3 haau6 fuk6, ho2 ji5 zoek3 bin6 fuk6 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不用穿校服，可以穿便装上学。
examples.english_sentence: Today we don't have to wear school uniforms, we can wear casual clothes to school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢通常都係著便服，好少著西裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 zoek3 bin6 fuk6, hou2 siu2 zoek3 sai1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通常都穿便装，很少穿西装。
examples.english_sentence: He usually wears casual wear, rarely wears a suit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去行山著便服就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 saan1 zoek3 bin6 fuk6 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去爬山穿便装就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: We can just wear casual clothes for hiking.

english_meaning: Casual dress day, mufti day
explanation_mandarin: 指允许人们穿着非正式服装（便装）的日子，通常出现在学校或公司，以筹款或营造轻松氛围。
explanation_english: A day, usually at a school or workplace, when people are allowed to wear informal clothes (casual clothes or 'mufti') often as a fundraiser or to create a more relaxed atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係便服日，你可以著自己鍾意嘅衫返學啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 bin6 fuk6 jat6, nei5 ho2 ji5 zoek3 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3 ge3 saam1 faan1 hok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是便装日，你可以穿自己喜欢的衣服上学了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is casual dress day, you can wear clothes you like to school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司搞便服日，啲同事個個都著得好輕鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gaau2 bin6 fuk6 jat6, di1 tung4 si6 go3 go3 dou1 zoek3 dak1 hou2 hing1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司举办便装日，同事们都穿得很轻松。
examples.english_sentence: The company is holding a casual dress day, all the colleagues are dressed casually.

english_meaning: note, memo
explanation_mandarin: 简短的纸条，通常用于留言或简要信息传递。
explanation_english: A short note, usually for leaving a message or conveying brief information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我留咗張便條喺枱面俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lau4 zo2 zoeng1 bin6 tiu4 hai2 toi2 min6 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我留了一张便条在桌面上给你。
examples.english_sentence: I left a note on the table for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗張便條話要早走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 zoeng1 bin6 tiu4 waa6 jiu3 zou2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一张便条说要早点离开。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a note saying he had to leave early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫我寫張便條俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 se2 zoeng1 bin6 tiu4 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我写一张便条给他。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me write a note for him.

english_meaning: urination and defecation; to urinate and defecate
explanation_mandarin: 指排泄大小便的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of urination and defecation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔仲未識得自己控制便溺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 zung6 mei6 sik1 dak1 zi6 gei2 hung3 zai3 bin6 nik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子还不知道自己控制大小便。
examples.english_sentence: The child doesn't yet know how to control their urination and defecation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果病人唔可以自行便溺，護士會幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 beng6 yan4 m4 ho2 yi5 zi6 hang4 bin6 nik1, wu6 si6 wui5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果病人不能自己排泄大小便，护士会帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: If the patient cannot urinate or defecate on their own, the nurse will help.

english_meaning: bento box, lunchbox
explanation_mandarin: 指用盒子装好的饭菜，通常是预先做好的，方便携带和食用。
explanation_english: A boxed meal, typically pre-made for convenience, easy to carry and eat. Commonly referred to as a bento box.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日帶咗便當返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 daai3 zo2 bin6 dong1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天带了盒饭上班。
examples.english_sentence: I brought a lunchbox to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個便當好豐富，有肉有菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bin6 dong1 hou2 fung1 fu3, jau5 juk6 jau5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个盒饭很丰盛，有肉有菜。
examples.english_sentence: This bento box is very abundant, with meat and vegetables.

english_meaning: constipation
explanation_mandarin: 指排便困难，大便干燥或排便次数减少。
explanation_english: A condition in which bowel movements are infrequent or difficult to pass; may involve hard stools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近成日便祕，可能係飲水唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 bin6 bei3, ho2 nang4 hai6 jam2 seoi2 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近老是便秘，可能是喝水不够。
examples.english_sentence: I've been constipated a lot lately, probably because I'm not drinking enough water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為食咗好多熱氣嘢，搞到便祕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 jit6 hei3 je5, gaau2 dou3 bin6 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为吃了很多上火的东西，导致便秘。
examples.english_sentence: He got constipated because he ate a lot of 'heaty' food.

english_meaning: Constipation
explanation_mandarin: 排便困难，粪便干燥 (páibiàn kùnnan, fènbiàn gānzào)
explanation_english: A condition in which bowel movements are infrequent or difficult to pass; constipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排便秘好犀利，都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai2 bin6 bei3 hou2 sai1 lei6, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近便秘很严重，都不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: I've been having really bad constipation lately, and I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為食得太少菜，搞到便秘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sik6 dak1 taai3 siu2 coi3, gaau2 dou3 bin6 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为吃太少的蔬菜，导致便秘。
examples.english_sentence: He became constipated because he ate too few vegetables.

english_meaning: plainclothes (police)
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿制服，穿普通衣服执行任务的警察。
explanation_english: Refers to police officers who are not wearing uniforms and are performing duties in ordinary clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日我見到有幾個便衣喺公園捉人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 gei2 go3 bin6 ji1 hai2 gung1 jyun2 zuk1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天我看到有几个便衣在公园抓人。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I saw some plainclothes police arresting people in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲，呢度成日有便衣巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, ni1 dou6 sing4 jat6 jau5 bin6 ji1 sun4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心点，这里经常有便衣巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there are often plainclothes police patrolling here.

english_meaning: plainclothes policeman / policewoman, undercover cop
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿制服，穿着普通服装执行任务的警察。
explanation_english: Refers to a police officer who is not in uniform and wears civilian clothing while on duty, often for undercover operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲便衣警匿埋喺條巷度，捉緊啲毒販。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bin6 ji1 ging2 nik1 maai4 hai2 tiu4 hong2 dou6, zuk1 gan2 di1 duk6 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些便衣警察躲在巷子里，正在抓那些毒贩。
examples.english_sentence: The plainclothes police officers were hiding in the alley, catching the drug dealers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行路小心啲，可能周圍都係便衣警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1, ho2 nang4 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 bin6 ji1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走路小心点，可能周围都是便衣警察。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you walk, there might be plainclothes police officers around.

english_meaning: casual wear; informal attire
explanation_mandarin: 指非正式的服装，日常穿着的服装。
explanation_english: Refers to informal clothing, suitable for everyday wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日公司唔使著西裝，著便裝就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gung1 si1 m4 sai2 zoek3 sai1 zong1, zoek3 bin6 zong1 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天公司不用穿西装，穿便服就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow, we don't need to wear suits to the office, casual wear is fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意著便裝行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 bin6 zong1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢穿便服去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to wear casual clothes for hiking.

english_meaning: plainclothes police officer
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿制服，穿着普通服装执行任务的警察。
explanation_english: A police officer who is not wearing a uniform and is dressed in civilian clothes, usually for undercover work or when anonymity is desired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺街撞到兩個便裝警員，佢哋捉緊個賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 zong6 dou2 loeng5 go3 bin6 zong1 ging2 jyun4, keoi5 dei6 zuk1 gan2 go3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上碰到了两个便衣警察，他们正在抓一个小偷。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into two plainclothes police officers on the street yesterday. They were catching a thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 便裝警員通常喺人多嘅地方巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin6 zong1 ging2 jyun4 tung1 soeng4 hai2 jan4 do1 ge3 dei6 fong1 seon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 便衣警察通常在人多的地方巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: Plainclothes police officers usually patrol in crowded areas.

english_meaning: Simple meal; casual meal; home-style meal
explanation_mandarin: 指简单、不讲究的饭菜，通常是在家吃的家常饭。
explanation_english: Refers to a simple, unpretentious meal, usually a home-style meal eaten at home. It implies a relaxed and informal dining setting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋今晚食便飯算啦，唔想煮得咁複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 sik6 bin6 faan6 syun3 laa1, m4 soeng2 zyu2 dak1 gam3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们今晚吃便饭吧，不想煮得那么复杂。
examples.english_sentence: How about we just have a simple meal tonight? I don't want to cook anything too complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁客氣，嚟我屋企食餐便飯啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3, lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 caan1 bin6 faan6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么客气，来我家吃顿便饭而已。
examples.english_sentence: No need to be so polite, it's just a casual meal at my house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係自己煮便飯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 zi6 gei2 zyu2 bin6 faan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常都是自己煮便饭吃。
examples.english_sentence: He often cooks simple meals for himself.

english_meaning: Silly, foolish, stupid
explanation_mandarin: 形容人笨，反应迟钝。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stupid, silly, or slow-witted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁俁㗎，下次小心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 ngong4 gaa3, haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么笨，下次小心点吧。
examples.english_sentence: You are so clumsy in doing things, be careful next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁俁啦，教咗你咁多次都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngong4 laa1, gaau3 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨了，教了你这么多次都不会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, I've taught you so many times and you still don't understand.

english_meaning: to be; yes
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定判断，相当于“是”；用作语气词，表示肯定或同意。
explanation_english: To be (linking verb); Used to indicate affirmation or agreement; can also function as 'yes'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪香港人呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是香港人吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you from Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係呀，我知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 aa3, ngo5 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是的，我知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Yes, I know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: This is my friend.

english_meaning: Everyone; Anybody; Everyone knows; It's obvious
explanation_mandarin: 表示普遍性，相当于“谁都”，“所有人都”。强调事情显而易见，人尽皆知。
explanation_english: Expresses universality, meaning 'everyone', 'anybody'. It also implies that something is obvious or well-known to everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳咁出名，係人都知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 ceot1 ming4, hai6 jan4 dou1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么有名，谁都知道。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is so famous; everyone knows it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，係人都唔鍾意同佢做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, hai6 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，谁都不喜欢和他一起工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is so lazy; nobody likes to work with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，係人都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, hai6 jan4 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房价这么贵，谁都知道。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's property prices are so expensive; everyone knows.

english_meaning: Always..., Even if it is or isn't..., Every now and then...
explanation_mandarin: 表示频繁发生某种情况，带有责备或抱怨的语气。指不管是不是某种情况，都经常发生，带有无奈或不满的情绪。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens frequently, often with a tone of reproach or complaint. It implies that regardless of whether it is a certain situation or not, it happens often, carrying a feeling of helplessness or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係又話頭痛，唔係又話唔舒服，到底搞乜啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 jau6 waa6 tau4 tung3, m4 hai6 jau6 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, dou3 dai2 gaau2 mat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你动不动就说头痛，不是说不舒服，到底在搞什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're always saying you have a headache or that you're not feeling well, what's going on?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係又遲到，唔係又唔交功課，真係攞佢冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jau6 ci4 dou3, m4 hai6 jau6 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, zan1 hai6 lo2 keoi5 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，不是不交功课，真是拿他没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late or doesn't hand in his homework, there's really no way to deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦係又壞，唔係又hang機，激死人喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 hai6 jau6 waai6, m4 hai6 jau6 hang1 gei1, gik1 sei2 jan4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑动不动就坏，不是死机，气死人了！
examples.english_sentence: This computer is always breaking down or freezing, it's so frustrating!

jyutping: hai6 jau6 dim2 m4 hai6 jau6 dim2
english_meaning: So what if it is, so what if it isn't?
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种不在乎、无所谓的态度。不管结果如何，都无所谓，不关心。
explanation_english: Expresses an attitude of indifference or nonchalance. Indicates that the speaker doesn't care about the outcome or consequences of something, whether it's true or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢偷嘢，係又點唔係又點，我都唔care。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 tau1 je5, hai6 jau6 dim2 m4 hai6 jau6 dim2, ngo5 dou1 m4 care.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他偷东西，是又怎样不是又怎样，我都不在乎。
examples.english_sentence: You say he stole something, so what if he did, so what if he didn't, I don't care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意點諗咪點諗囉，係又點唔係又點，關我咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 dim2 nam2 mai1 dim2 nam2 lo1, hai6 jau6 dim2 m4 hai6 jau6 dim2, gwaan1 ngo5 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢怎么想就怎么想呗，是又怎样不是又怎样，关我什么事啊？
examples.english_sentence: Think whatever you want, so what if it is, so what if it isn't? What's it to me?

synonyms: 關我咩事 (gwaan1 ngo5 me1 si6)

english_meaning: Yes, indeed; That's right; Is that so?
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定、附和、或者惊讶的语气词。根据语境可以表示同意、确认，或者略带惊讶的疑问。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express agreement, confirmation, or surprise. Depending on the context, it can mean 'Yes', 'That's right', or 'Is that so?' with a hint of surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日唔返工呀？係呀，我放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1 aa3? hai6 aa3, ngo5 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天不上班吗？是啊，我放假。
examples.english_sentence: You're not going to work tomorrow? Yes, I'm on holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日落大雨呀？係呀，落到好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 aa3? hai6 aa3, lok6 dou3 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天下了大雨吗？ 是啊，下得很大。
examples.english_sentence: Did it rain heavily yesterday? Yes, it rained really hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢結婚呀？ 係呀？真係恭喜佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 git3 fan1 aa3? hai6 aa3? zan1 hai6 gung1 hei2 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他要结婚了？ 是吗？ 真的是恭喜他！
examples.english_sentence: He said he's getting married? Is that so? Really, congratulations to him!

english_meaning: By the way; That reminds me; So...
explanation_mandarin: 用在转换话题或想起某事时，引起注意，类似于“对了”。有时也可以用来开始一个谈话，类似“那个”。
explanation_english: Used to change the topic or when remembering something, to draw attention. Similar to "by the way" or "that reminds me." Sometimes it can be used to start a conversation, similar to "so..." or "well...".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係呢，你聽日得唔得閒呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 ne1, nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对了，你明天有空吗？
examples.english_sentence: By the way, are you free tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係呢，我諗起我仲有啲嘢要買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 ne1, ngo5 lam2 hei2 ngo5 zung6 jau5 di1 je5 jiu3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对了，我想起来我还有些东西要买。
examples.english_sentence: That reminds me, I remember I still have some things to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係呢，不如我哋去食飯啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 ne1, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个，不如我们去吃饭吧？
examples.english_sentence: So, shall we go grab some food?

mandarin_meaning: 就这样, 总是这样, 只是这样
english_meaning: That's it, That's all, Just like that, Always like that, That's how it is
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情就这样了，无可奈何或者表示默认、接受当前状况。 也可表示事情总是如此。
explanation_english: Expresses acceptance, resignation, or a matter-of-fact attitude towards a situation. It can also indicate that something is always done in a particular way. Can also mean 'that's it' or 'that's all'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人係咁㗎啦，你唔好咁介意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaai3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是这样的人，你不要太介意。
examples.english_sentence: That's just the way he is, don't take it too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司啲嘢係咁嘅，做得唔好就要俾人鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 di1 je5 hai6 gam2 ge3, zou6 dak1 m4 hou2 zau6 jiu3 bei2 jan4 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的事情就是这样的，做得不好就要被人骂。
examples.english_sentence: That's how things are at our company, if you don't do well, you'll get scolded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係咁啦，冇計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 laa1, mou5 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就这样吧，没办法。
examples.english_sentence: That's it, nothing can be done.

english_meaning: just about like this; that's about it; so-so
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、范围或质量等大概如此，没有更多或更少，没有更好或更坏。通常表示一种不满意或一般的态度。
explanation_english: Indicates that the degree, scope, or quality is approximately like this, neither more nor less, neither better nor worse. It usually expresses a sense of dissatisfaction or a general attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅嘢食都係咁上下啦，唔好期望太高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 dou1 hai6 gam2 soeng6 haa6 laa1, m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西也就这样了，别期望太高。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is just about like this, don't expect too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅英文水平都係咁上下，應付日常對話冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jing1 man4 seoi2 ping4 dou1 hai6 gam2 soeng6 haa6, jing3 fu6 jat1 soeng4 deoi3 waa6 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语水平也就那样，应付日常对话没问题。
examples.english_sentence: His English level is so-so, enough to handle daily conversations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績都係咁上下，都算預咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 dou1 hai6 gam2 soeng6 haa6, dou1 syun3 jyu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩也就这样，也算是预料到了。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results are just about what I expected, I had anticipated it.

english_meaning: That's all for now; I'll leave it at that; Talk to you later
explanation_mandarin: 表示结束对话，暂时就这样，以后再继续。
explanation_english: A phrase used to end a conversation, implying that you will talk again later. It's a polite way to say goodbye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日仲要返工，係咁先啦，拜拜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 zung6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, hai6 gam2 sin1 laa1, baai1 baai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天还要上班，先这样吧，再见！
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work tomorrow, that's all for now, bye!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我趕時間，係咁先，下次再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, hai6 gam2 sin1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我赶时间，先这样，下次再聊。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm in a rush, that's all for now, we'll chat next time.

synonyms: 下次再講 (haa6 ci3 zoi3 gong2)

english_meaning: Just so-so; just a little bit; casually; superficially
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很轻或状态很随便，不认真。有时也表示谦虚。
explanation_english: Indicates a slight degree, casualness, or a lack of seriousness. Can also be used to express modesty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係係咁咦溫咗下書啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 hai6 gam2 ji1 wan1 zo2 haa5 syu1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是随便复习了一下书而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only studied the book very casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工都係係咁咦做下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 dou1 hai6 hai6 gam2 ji1 zou6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作都是随便做做的。
examples.english_sentence: He just does his job casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我畫畫都係係咁咦，唔係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waa2 waa2 dou1 hai6 hai6 gam2 ji1, m4 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我画画只是随便画画，不是很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: My drawing is just so-so, I'm not very good.

mandarin_meaning: 就是这样的; 情况是这样的
english_meaning: It's like this; This is how it is; The situation is like this
explanation_mandarin: 常用于口语中，表示接下来要解释情况，或事情就是这样，没有其他办法。
explanation_english: A common colloquial phrase used to introduce an explanation, or to indicate that the situation is as described and there's no other way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係咁嘅，我聽日要返工，唔可以同你哋去玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 ge3, ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 dei6 heoi3 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是这样的，我明天要上班，不能和你们去玩了。
examples.english_sentence: It's like this, I have to go to work tomorrow, so I can't go out with you guys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事係咁嘅，佢唔係故意遲到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hai6 gam2 ge3, keoi5 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ci4 dou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情是这样的，他不是故意迟到的。
examples.english_sentence: The situation is like this, he didn't intentionally arrive late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇辦法㗎，係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 baan6 faat3 gaa3, hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有办法，就是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: There's no way around it, that's just how it is.

mandarin_meaning: 就这么大; 仅此而已; 没什么了不起
english_meaning: That's all; that's it; nothing more than that; not a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很低，事情的规模或重要性很小，带有不屑一顾的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates a small extent, scale, or importance of something, often with a dismissive tone.  Implies that the thing being described isn't a big deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工係辛苦啲啫，係咁大件事咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 hai6 san1 fu2 di1 ze1, hai6 gam2 daai6 gin6 si6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作是辛苦一点而已，有什么大不了的？
examples.english_sentence: The job is just a bit harder, is it really that big of a deal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係唔記得帶鎖匙啫，係咁大件事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4 ze1, hai6 gam2 daai6 gin6 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是忘记带钥匙而已，有什么大不了的吗？
examples.english_sentence: He just forgot to bring his keys, is it really that big of a deal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗少少錢啫，係咁大件事咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 siu2 siu2 cin2 ze1, hai6 gam2 daai6 gin6 si6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是掉了点钱而已，有什么大不了的？
examples.english_sentence: It's just a bit of money that was dropped, is it really that big of a deal?

english_meaning: just a token; just a formality; to do something perfunctorily; just a little bit; just for show
explanation_mandarin: 表示只是象征性地做一下，或者只是略微表示心意，并不认真对待或要求做得完美。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something perfunctorily, just as a formality or a token gesture, without serious effort or expectation of perfection. It implies a small or minimal contribution or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係咁意嘅心意，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 gam2 ji3 ge3 sam1 ji3, m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些只是略表心意，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a small token of my appreciation, no need to be polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係咁意做下樣啫，唔係真係想幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam2 ji3 zou6 haa5 joeng2 ze1, m4 hai6 zan1 hai2 soeng2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是随便做个样子，不是真的想帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He's just doing it for show, he doesn't really want to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係咁意慶祝一下就算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 gam2 ji3 hing3 zuk1 jat1 haa5 zau6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们随便庆祝一下就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's just have a small celebration and that's it.

english_meaning: very difficult to deal with; very troublesome; problematic
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或人非常难搞、棘手，让人觉得麻烦。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as very difficult to deal with, troublesome, or problematic, causing inconvenience or annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個客真係係咁歹，咩都要改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haak3 zan1 hai6 hai6 gam2 daai2, me1 dou1 jiu3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个客人真的很难搞，什么都要改。
examples.english_sentence: This customer is really troublesome; they want to change everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢咁複雜，真係係咁歹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, zan1 hai6 hai6 gam2 daai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么复杂，真的很难搞。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated; it's really difficult to handle.

english_meaning: Really? Is that so?
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、怀疑、反问或附和对方的语气词。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express surprise, doubt, agreement, or to invite further elaboration from the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢中咗六合彩頭獎，係咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung1 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2, hai6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他中了六合彩头奖，真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: He said he won the first prize in the Mark Six lottery, really?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日落大雨？係咩？我唔知喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5? hai6 me1? ngo5 m4 zi1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天下了大雨？是吗？我不知道啊。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily yesterday? Really? I didn't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢辭咗職？係咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 ci4 zo2 zik1? hai6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他辞职了？是吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said he resigned? Really?

english_meaning: Is it?
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问，询问是否为真。
explanation_english: Used to form a question, asking if something is true or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪唔舒服呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是不舒服啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you feeling unwell?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係咪真㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 mai1 zan1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is it true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪要走啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 jiu3 zau2 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要走了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you leaving now?

english_meaning: is it? / yes or no? / to be or not to be?
explanation_mandarin: 用于询问是否为真，相当于普通话的“是不是”。可以单独使用，也可以放在句尾作为反问。
explanation_english: Used to ask if something is true, equivalent to Mandarin's "是不是" (shì bù shì). It can be used alone or at the end of a sentence as a question tag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係唔係真㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 m4 hai6 zan1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is it true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意食雪糕，係唔係啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 sik6 syut3 gou1, hai6 m4 hai6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢吃冰淇淋，是不是？
examples.english_sentence: You like eating ice cream, right?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係唔係你搞搞震？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 m4 hai6 nei5 gaau2 gaau2 zan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是不是你在捣乱？
examples.english_sentence: Are you the one causing trouble?

english_meaning: Yes / That's right / Indeed
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定，同意对方的说法或陈述。
explanation_english: Expresses agreement or affirmation to what someone has said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得啱啊，係啊，我同意你嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 aa3, hai6 aa3, ngo5 tung3 yi3 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说得对啊，是啊，我同意你的看法。
examples.english_sentence: You're right. Yes, I agree with your view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係好熱啊！係啊，熱到出晒汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6 aa3! hai6 aa3, jit6 dou3 ceot1晒 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真的很热啊！是啊，热得全身都是汗。
examples.english_sentence: It's really hot today! Yes, so hot that I'm all sweaty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻煮嘢食啊，係啊，佢煮嘅餸好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 zyu2 je5 sik6 aa3, hai6 aa3, keoi5 zyu2 ge3 sung3 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很会做饭啊，是啊，她做的菜很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: She's good at cooking. Yes, the dishes she cooks are delicious.

english_meaning: Yes, right; I know, right?; Yeah, yeah; Whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意、肯定，或敷衍、不耐烦等语气。具体含义根据语境而定。
explanation_english: "係啦" is a modal particle/interjection used to express agreement, confirmation, or even indifference or impatience depending on the context. It can mean "Yes, that's right," "I know, right?" or a dismissive "Yeah, yeah," or "Whatever."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得啱呀，係啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 aa3, hai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说得对啊，是啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's right, yes, right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話係咪好熱呀？係啦，熱到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 hai6 mai6 hou2 jit6 aa3? hai6 laa1, jit6 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说是不是很热？是啦，热死了。
examples.english_sentence: You said it's very hot, right? I know, right? It's incredibly hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係啦，係啦，你講咩都啱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 laa1, hai6 laa1, nei5 gong2 me1 dou1 ngaam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是啦，是啦，你说什么都对啦。
examples.english_sentence: Yeah, yeah, everything you say is right.

mandarin_meaning: 就这样; 总是这样; 总是
english_meaning: That's how it is; Like that; Always like that; Continuously; So be it; Fine
explanation_mandarin: “係噉”在不同语境下有多种含义。可以表示“就这样”，表示事情已经确定，无法改变；也可以表示“总是这样”，带有一种无奈或者习以为常的语气；还可以表示“总是”，表示一种持续的状态。在口语中也可以用来表示“好吧”、“那就这样吧”。
explanation_english: "係噉" has multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean "That's how it is," indicating that things are settled and unchangeable. It can also mean "Always like that," expressing a sense of helplessness or familiarity. It can also mean "Always," indicating a continuous state. In colloquial speech, it can also be used to mean "Okay" or "So be it".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都遲到，係噉㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3, hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，就是这样的啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, that's just how he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔聽話？係噉罰你企喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 teng1 waa6? hai6 gam2 fat6 nei5 kei5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不听话？那就罚你站在这里。
examples.english_sentence: You're not listening? So I'll punish you by making you stand here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係噉先啦，拜拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 sin1 laa1, baai1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就这样吧，再见。
examples.english_sentence: So be it for now, bye bye.

english_meaning: That's all for now; Gotta go now; Talk to you later
explanation_mandarin: 口语中表示结束谈话或对话，表示要告别或暂时结束。语气较为随意。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase used to end a conversation or dialogue, indicating that one is about to say goodbye or end the conversation for the time being. It has a casual tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，唔講咁多住，我仲有嘢做，係噉先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, m4 gong2 gam3 do1 zyu6, ngo5 zung6 jau5 je5 zou6, hai6 gam2 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，不多说了，我还有事要做，先这样！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I won't say much more, I still have things to do, gotta go now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日再打畀你，係噉先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5, hai6 gam2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天再打电话给你，就这样吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you again tomorrow, that's all for now.

english_meaning: So-so; Just okay; Nothing special
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度不高，仅仅是一般水平，不值得称赞或特别关注。
explanation_english: Used to describe something as being just average, nothing special, or so-so. Indicates a lack of excellence or outstanding qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問我份工做得點呀？係噉咦啦，都冇乜特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 ngo5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 dim2 aa3? hai6 gam2 ji1 laa1, dou1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问我工作做得怎么样？就那样吧，没什么特别的。
examples.english_sentence: You asked how my job is going? It's just so-so, nothing special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫畫得係噉咦啫，未算好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waa2 waa2 dak1 hai6 gam2 ji1 ze1, mei6 syun3 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画画得一般般，还不能算很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings are just so-so, not considered very skillful yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食係噉咦，唔值得特登嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hai6 gam2 ji1, m4 zik6 dak1 dak6 dang1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一般般，不值得特意来吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is just okay, not worth making a special trip to eat.

english_meaning: It's like this; That's how it is; So it is
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的情况是这样的，用于解释或过渡。
explanation_english: Used to explain or transition to a new point; indicates that the situation is as follows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係噉嘅，我哋今日要早啲收工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 ge3, ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 di1 sau1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是这样的，我们今天要早点下班。
examples.english_sentence: So it is, we need to finish work earlier today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係噉嘅，佢哋唔嚟㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 ge3, keoi5 dei6 m4 lai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是这样的，他们不来了。
examples.english_sentence: That's how it is, they're not coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係噉嘅，我諗住聽日去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 ge3, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是这样的，我打算明天去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: It's like this, I'm planning to go hiking tomorrow.

english_meaning: just a little bit, just a token, just for fun, perfunctorily
explanation_mandarin: 表示随便、略微、敷衍的意思。指不认真、不在意地做某事，或者仅仅是象征性地表示一下。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something casually, slightly, or perfunctorily. It implies doing something without seriousness or attention, or merely giving a token gesture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係噉意畫咗幅畫送俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 gam2 ji3 waak6 zo2 fuk1 waa2 sung3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我随便画了幅画送给你。
examples.english_sentence: I just drew a picture for you as a token gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工都係係噉意做下㗎啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 dou1 hai6 hai6 gam2 ji3 zou6 haa5 gaa3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作也只是随便做一下而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's just doing his job perfunctorily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係真係想贏，係噉意玩下啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 weng4, hai6 gam2 ji3 waan2 haa5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是真的想赢，只是随便玩玩而已。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really want to win, just playing for fun.

mandarin_meaning: 就是说，也就是说，大概是
english_meaning: That's to say, in other words, roughly speaking, maybe
explanation_mandarin: 表示对之前话语的解释、补充、猜测或者缓和语气。可以用来引出另一种表达方式或可能性。
explanation_english: Used to explain, supplement, speculate, or soften the tone of what was said earlier. It can be used to introduce another way of expressing something or a possibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應該唔嚟㗎喇，係噉話佢聽日要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing1 goi1 m4 lai4 gaa3 laa1, hai6 gam2 waa2 keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他应该不会来了，也就是说他明天要上班。
examples.english_sentence: He probably won't come, that's to say, he has to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢，係噉話都算幾貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 chin2, hai6 gam2 waa2 dou1 syun3 gei2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格，也就是说算挺贵的。
examples.english_sentence: This price, in other words, is quite expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似唔舒服，係噉話尋日已經病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 chi5 m4 syu1 fuk6, hai6 gam2 waa2 cam4 jat6 ji5 ging1 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像不舒服，大概是昨天已经病了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't seem well, maybe he got sick yesterday.

english_meaning: to act imposing, to throw one's weight around, to be pompous and arrogant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人仗势欺人，摆出很厉害的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who abuses their power and acts in an arrogant and imposing manner.
