examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗經理之後，成日都係威係勢咁，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 wai1 hai6 sai3 gam2, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当了经理之后，整天都摆架子，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: After he became the manager, he's always acting imposing, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你叻啲就係威係勢，呢度大把人叻過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 lek1 di1 zau6 hai6 wai1 hai6 sai3, ni1 dou6 daai6 baa2 jan4 lek1 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你厉害一点就摆架子，这里多的是比你厉害的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you're a little bit better you can throw your weight around, there are plenty of people here who are better than you.

mandarin_meaning: 当然, 肯定, 是这样子的
english_meaning: Of course, definitely, that's how it is
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定的语气，相当于“当然”、“肯定是这样子的”等。也可用作感叹词，表达对某事理所当然的认同。
explanation_english: An expression of affirmation, meaning 'of course,' 'definitely,' or 'that's how it is.' It can also be used as an interjection to express agreement or recognition of something obvious or a given.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁努力，實會成功嘅啦。係波！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 nou5 lik6, sat6 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3 laa1. hai6 bo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么努力，一定会成功的。当然！
examples.english_sentence: You work so hard, you will definitely succeed. Of course!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 梗係要買樓啦，係波，唔買樓點結婚啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gang2 hai6 jiu3 maai5 lau2 laa1, hai6 bo1, m4 maai5 lau2 dim2 git3 fan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当然要买房啦，那是肯定的，不买房怎么结婚啊？
examples.english_sentence: Of course, we have to buy a flat; definitely, how can we get married without buying a flat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔，考試一定攞A。係波！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 zai2, haau2 si3 jat1 ding6 lo2 ei1. hai6 bo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，考试一定得A。当然！
examples.english_sentence: He is so smart, he will definitely get an A in the exam. Of course!

english_meaning: Is it true? Really?
explanation_mandarin: 用于表示怀疑或惊讶，询问对方所说是否属实。
explanation_english: Used to express doubt or surprise, asking if what someone said is true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話你中咗六合彩頭獎？係眞唔係呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 nei5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2? hai6 zan1 m4 hai6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说你中了六合彩头奖？是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said you won the Mark Six first prize? Is that true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風要停工？係眞唔係㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1 jiu3 ting4 gung1? hai6 zan1 m4 hai6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天刮台风要停工？是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are we really off work tomorrow because of the typhoon?

english_meaning: Is it true? Really?
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问，询问对方所说的是否属实。带有惊讶、怀疑或难以置信的语气。
explanation_english: Used to express doubt or disbelief, asking if something is actually true. It conveys a sense of surprise, skepticism, or incredulity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢中咗六合彩頭獎，係真唔係啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2, hai6 zan1 m4 hai6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他中了六合彩头奖，是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said he won the Mark Six first prize, is it true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己識飛，係真唔係㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 fei1, hai6 zan1 m4 hai6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会飞，是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: He said he can fly, is it really true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你升咗職，係真唔係呀？恭喜你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing1 zo2 zik1, hai6 zan1 m4 hai6 aa3? gung1 hei2 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你升职了，是真的吗？恭喜你！
examples.english_sentence: You got promoted, is it true? Congratulations!

english_meaning: insist on; deliberately want to; have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示故意要这样做，带有任性或不听劝告的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses the idea of deliberately doing something, often against advice or in a stubborn manner. It implies a sense of insistence or obstinacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫你唔好去，你係要去，到時瀨嘢就唔好喊啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3, nei5 hai6 jiu3 heoi3, dou3 si4 laai6 je5 zau6 m4 hou2 haam3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫你不要去，你偏要去，到时候倒霉就别哭!
examples.english_sentence: I told you not to go, but you insist on going. Don't cry if you get into trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明咁貴，佢係要買，真係唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 gam3 gwai3, keoi5 hai6 jiu3 maai5, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明这么贵，他偏要买，真不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: It's clearly so expensive, but he insists on buying it. I really don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係叫咗你唔好掂嗰部機咩？你係要掂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 giu3 zo2 nei5 m4 hou2 dim6 go2 bou6 gei1 me1? nei5 hai6 jiu3 dim6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是叫你不要碰那部机器吗？你非要碰！
examples.english_sentence: Didn't I tell you not to touch that machine? You had to touch it!

english_meaning: reasonable; makes sense; right; on the right track
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事或某人说的话有道理，可信，符合逻辑。
explanation_english: Describes something that is reasonable, makes sense, believable, or follows logic. It often indicates agreement or approval of an idea or statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢都幾係路喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 dou1 gei2 hai6 lou6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话还挺有道理的。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is quite reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法好似係路啲喎，試下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 ci5 hai6 lou6 di1 wo3, si3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法好像靠谱一点，先试试看。
examples.english_sentence: This method seems more reasonable; let's try it out first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣諗係啱嘅，都幾係路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 nam2 hai6 aam1 ge3, dou1 gei2 hai6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样想是对的，挺有道理的。
examples.english_sentence: You're right to think that way, it makes a lot of sense.

english_meaning: always, invariably, inevitably; insists on (doing something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示总是，无论什么情况都这样；或者表示偏偏、硬要，带有不悦或无奈的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates 'always' or 'invariably' in all situations. It can also mean 'insists on', 'had to be', expressing annoyance or helplessness. Often used to emphasize the undesirable frequency or inevitability of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係都唔聽我講，搞到咁嘅田地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dou1 m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2, gaau2 dou3 gam2 ge3 tin4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是/偏偏不听我的话，搞成现在这个样子。
examples.english_sentence: He always/insisted on not listening to me, which has led to this mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨係都唔帶遮，抵佢病嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 hai6 dou1 m4 daai3 ze1, dai2 keoi5 beng6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨总是/偏偏不带伞，活该他生病。
examples.english_sentence: He always/insists on not bringing an umbrella in the rain, it's his own fault he's sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係都話自己冇錯，真係激死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 co3, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是/偏偏说自己没错，真是气死人。
examples.english_sentence: He always/insists that he is not wrong, it's so infuriating.

english_meaning: insist on; determined to; be bent on; have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示坚持做某事，即使有阻碍或不合逻辑。
explanation_english: Indicates insistence on doing something, even when there are obstacles or it is illogical.  Implies stubbornness or a strong desire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫你唔好去，你係都要去！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3, nei5 hai6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫你不要去，你偏要去！
examples.english_sentence: I told you not to go, but you insist on going!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知唔得，但係都要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 m4 dak1, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道不行，但偏要试一下。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knows it won't work, but he insists on trying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算落雨，佢都係都要去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算下雨，他也要去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it's raining, he still insists on going hiking.

english_meaning: to urge; to press; to hasten; to promote
explanation_mandarin: 催促，使加快行动或发生。
explanation_english: To urge; to press someone to do something quickly or to hasten an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你促吓佢哋快啲做完佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cuk1 haa5 keoi5 dei6 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你催一下他们快点做完它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Urge them to finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好促我住啦，我盡緊力㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cuk1 ngo5 zyu6 laa1, ngo5 zeon6 gan2 lik6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要催我了，我正在尽力了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't urge me, I'm doing my best.

english_meaning: to impel; to urge; to drive; to promote; to facilitate
explanation_mandarin: 推动，使…发生或实现。
explanation_english: To cause something to happen; to bring about; to motivate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔景氣促使好多公司執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 hei3 cuk1 si2 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不景气促使很多公司倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The poor economy has caused many companies to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事促使佢下定決心改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 cuk1 si2 keoi5 haa6 ding6 kyut3 sam1 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事促使他下定决心改变。
examples.english_sentence: This event prompted him to make up his mind to change.

english_meaning: to bring about, to help to bring about, to facilitate, to contribute to the success of
explanation_mandarin: 促使事情成功或发生；促使事情达成。
explanation_english: To facilitate the success or occurrence of something; to help bring about an agreement or positive outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅努力最終促成咗呢項合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 nou5 lik6 zeoi3 chung1 cuk1 sing4 zo2 ni1 hong6 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的努力最终促成了这项合作。
examples.english_sentence: Their efforts ultimately led to this collaboration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫手，促成咗呢單生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2, cuk1 sing4 zo2 ni1 daan1 seng1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的帮助，促成了这笔生意。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your help, you facilitated this business deal.

english_meaning: to have a heart-to-heart talk, to have a long and intimate conversation
explanation_mandarin: 指两人或多人近距离坐着，膝盖靠近，进行长时间的深入交谈，通常涉及重要话题或分享彼此的感受。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more people sitting close together, often knee to knee, engaging in a long and in-depth conversation, typically discussing important topics or sharing their feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢琴晚促膝長談咗幾個鐘，講咗好多心底話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 kam4 ngaan5 cuk1 sat1 coeng4 taam4 zo2 gei2 go3 zung1, gong2 zo2 ho2 do1 sam1 dai2 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天晚上和他促膝长谈了几个小时，说了好多心里话。
examples.english_sentence: I had a heart-to-heart talk with him for a few hours last night, and we shared a lot of our deepest thoughts.

english_meaning: to urge; to press; to call on (someone to do something)
explanation_mandarin: 敦促，请求，推动。
explanation_english: To urge someone to do something; to request or prompt an action or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋促請政府改善醫療服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cuk1 cing2 zing3 fu2 gai2 sin6 ji1 liu4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们促请政府改善医疗服务。
examples.english_sentence: We urge the government to improve healthcare services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民促請發展商盡快完成工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 cuk1 cing2 faat3 zin2 soeng1 zeoi6 faai3 wan4 sing4 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民促请开发商尽快完成工程。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens are urging the developer to complete the construction as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋促請公司加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cuk1 cing2 gung1 si1 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们促请公司加薪。
examples.english_sentence: They are urging the company to raise salaries.

english_meaning: to promote; to advance; to accelerate
explanation_mandarin: 推动事物向前发展；促使。
explanation_english: To advance or encourage the progress of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策有助促進經濟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 jau5 zo6 cuk1 zeon3 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策有助于促进经济发展。
examples.english_sentence: This policy helps to promote economic development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動可以促進身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 cuk1 zeon3 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动可以促进身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: Exercise can promote physical health.

english_meaning: promotion, sales promotion
explanation_mandarin: 为了刺激销售而采取的行动或措施，通常包括降价、打折、赠品等。
explanation_english: Activities or measures taken to stimulate sales, usually including price reductions, discounts, giveaways, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排好多舖頭都有促銷活動，不如去睇下有冇啱你嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dou1 jau5 cuk1 siu1 wut6 dung6, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngaam1 nei5 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多商店都有促销活动，不如去看看有没有适合你的东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, many shops have promotions, why don't you go and see if there's anything suitable for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司做緊新年促銷，啲貨平咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 gan2 san1 nin4 cuk1 siu1, di1 fo3 ping4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正在做新年促销，东西便宜了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The company is having a New Year's promotion, the goods are much cheaper.

english_meaning: hungry
explanation_mandarin: 肚子空，想吃东西的状态。
explanation_english: Feeling a need or desire for food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好俄呀，有嘢食冇呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngo4 aa3, jau5 je5 sik6 mou5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好饿啊，有东西吃吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm so hungry, is there anything to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我俄到冇力行路啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ngo4 dou3 mou5 lik6 haang4 lou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我饿得没力气走路了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, I'm so hungry I don't have the energy to walk anymore.

english_meaning: Russia
explanation_mandarin: 一个国家，位于东欧和北亚。
explanation_english: A country located in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候讀過好多關於俄國嘅故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 duk6 gwo3 hou2 do1 gwaan1 jyu1 ngo4 gwok3 ge3 gu3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候读过很多关于俄罗斯的故事。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I read many stories about Russia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想去俄國旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 ngo4 gwok3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想去俄罗斯旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to travel to Russia.

english_meaning: Russian (language)
explanation_mandarin: 指俄羅斯語，俄羅斯民族的語言。
explanation_english: Refers to the Russian language, the language of the Russian people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識講少少俄文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 gong2 siu2 siu2 ngo4 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会说一点俄语。
examples.english_sentence: I can speak a little Russian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你學過俄文未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hok6 gwo3 ngo4 man2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你学过俄语吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever studied Russian?

english_meaning: Russia
explanation_mandarin: 指位于欧洲和亚洲的大国俄罗斯联邦。
explanation_english: Refers to the Russian Federation, a large country located in Europe and Asia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下年想去俄羅斯旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 ngo4 lo4 si1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明年想去俄罗斯旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We want to travel to Russia next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識講俄羅斯文啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 ngo4 lo4 si1 man2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会说俄语啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to speak Russian?

english_meaning: Tetris
explanation_mandarin: 一种电子游戏，游戏画面由许多规则的小方块组成，玩家需要将这些方块以最佳的方式拼合成完整的一行或多行，以消除它们。
explanation_english: A video game in which players manipulate falling blocks (tetrominoes) to create horizontal lines without gaps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日打俄羅斯方塊，玩到唔瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 daa2 ngo4 lo4 si1 fong1 faai3, waan2 dou3 m4 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常玩俄罗斯方块，玩到不睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often played Tetris until I didn't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個app有俄羅斯方塊玩，你試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 app jau5 ngo4 lo4 si1 fong1 faai3 waan2, nei5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个app有俄罗斯方块玩，你试试。
examples.english_sentence: This app has Tetris, you should try it.

english_meaning: Russian language
explanation_mandarin: 指俄罗斯使用的语言。
explanation_english: The language spoken in Russia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講俄語㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 ngo4 jyu5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说俄语。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak Russian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住學俄語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 hok6 ngo4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算学习俄语。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of learning Russian.

english_meaning: handsome, good-looking
explanation_mandarin: 形容人容貌清秀好看。
explanation_english: Describes a person's appearance as attractive and good-looking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔生得好俊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 saang1 dak1 hou2 zeon3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他儿子长得很帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: His son is very handsome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣時好俊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 si4 hou2 zeon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候很帅的。
examples.english_sentence: He was very handsome when he was young.

english_meaning: handsome, good-looking (usually referring to men)
explanation_mandarin: 形容男子容貌英俊好看。
explanation_english: Describes a man's appearance as handsome and good-looking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣時幾俊俏㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 si4 gei2 zeon3 ciu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候挺俊俏的。
examples.english_sentence: He was quite handsome when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個男主角生得好俊俏，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 naam4 zyu2 gok3 saang1 dak1 hou2 zeon3 ciu3, hou2 kap1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男主角长得很俊俏，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The male lead is very handsome, very attractive.

mandarin_meaning: 祭祀用的礼器，古代用于盛放祭品的器具
english_meaning: Sacrificial vessel, ancient utensil for holding sacrificial offerings
explanation_mandarin: 古代祭祀时盛放祭品的器具。在粤语中，这个字比较少单独使用，常出现在一些含有文化典故或书面语的表达中。
explanation_english: An ancient utensil used during sacrificial ceremonies to hold offerings. In Cantonese, this word is rarely used on its own, but it may appear in expressions with cultural allusions or in formal written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字平時好少用，喺啲古文或者祭祀儀式先會見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ping4 si4 hou2 siu2 yung6, hai2 di1 gu2 man4 waak6 ze2 zai3 si3 yi4 sik1 sin1 wui gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字平时很少用，在一些古文或者祭祀仪式上才能看到。
examples.english_sentence: This word is rarely used in everyday conversation. You'll only see it in ancient texts or sacrificial rituals.

english_meaning: pretty, charming, smart, clever (used to describe someone's appearance or behaviour)
explanation_mandarin: 形容外貌漂亮，性格活泼伶俐。
explanation_english: Describes someone's appearance as pretty and charming, or their personality as lively and clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女好俏皮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi2 hou2 ciu3 pei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女儿非常俏皮。
examples.english_sentence: Her daughter is very playful and charming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫著上身好俏呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zoek3 soeng5 san1 hou2 ciu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服穿在身上很俏丽。
examples.english_sentence: This dress looks really pretty on you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好鬼俏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 gwai2 ciu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说话很俏皮。
examples.english_sentence: She speaks in a very witty and clever way.

english_meaning: mischievous, playful, saucy, witty
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物活泼、调皮，略带幽默感。
explanation_english: Describing someone or something as lively, mischievous, and slightly humorous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好俏皮，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 ciu3 pei4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子很俏皮，总是恶作剧。
examples.english_sentence: He has a mischievous look and is always playing pranks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅歌詞好俏皮，好好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 go1 ci4 hou2 ciu3 pei4, hou2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的歌词很俏皮，很好听。
examples.english_sentence: The lyrics of this song are very playful and it's very catchy.

english_meaning: clever; quick; nimble; agile; sharp
explanation_mandarin: 形容人聪明、敏捷、反应快。
explanation_english: Describes someone as clever, quick-witted, and responsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好俐，學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 lei6, hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很伶俐，学东西很快。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very clever person and learns things quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁俐醒，一定識解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lei6 seng2, jat1 ding6 sik1 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，一定懂得解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: You're so smart, you'll definitely know how to solve this problem.

english_meaning: efficient, quick and neat, capable and decisive
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事干脆利落，不拖泥带水。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is efficient, quick, and decisive in their actions; not dragging their feet or being hesitant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好俐落，好快就搞掂晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 lei6 lok6, hou2 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很干脆利落，很快就把所有事情都处理好了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very efficient at his work and finished everything very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計好俐落，睇落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 hou2 lei6 lok6, tai2 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计很简洁利落，看起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This design is very neat and efficient; it looks very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢可唔可以俐落啲呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 lei6 lok6 di1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话可以干脆点吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you be more direct and concise when you speak?

english_meaning: puppet, scapegoat, clay figure buried with the dead (historical)
explanation_mandarin: 最初指古代殉葬用的木偶或土偶。现在通常比喻受人操纵、替人承担罪责的人。
explanation_english: Originally referred to wooden or clay figures buried with the dead in ancient times. Now, it's usually used as a metaphor for someone who is controlled by others, a puppet, or a scapegoat who takes the blame for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係個老細嘅阿二俑，有咩事都係佢孭鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 go3 lou5 sai3 ge3 aa3 ji6 jung2, jau5 me1 si6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 be1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是老板的傀儡，有什么事都是他背黑锅。
examples.english_sentence: He's just the boss's puppet, he takes the blame for everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做人哋嘅擋箭牌，唔好做人哋嘅俑呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 dong2 zin3 paai4, m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 jung2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做别人的挡箭牌，不要做别人的替死鬼啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone else's shield, don't be someone else's scapegoat!

english_meaning: vulgar, common, inelegant, popular, conventional
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏品味，不文雅，庸俗的；也指通俗的，大众化的。
explanation_english: Refers to lacking taste, being inelegant, vulgar; also refers to being popular or common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙好俗喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 hou2 zuk6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子很俗气。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is very vulgar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很粗俗。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is very vulgar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻歌好俗氣，不過都幾好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 go1 hou2 zuk6 hei3, bat1 gwo3 dou1 gei2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很通俗，但是也挺好听的。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very popular, but it's quite nice to listen to.

english_meaning: extremely vulgar; unbearably tacky; disgustingly common
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常庸俗，让人难以忍受。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely vulgar, tacky, or common, to the point of being unbearable or disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着衫啲品味真係俗不可耐，成身都係名牌但襯埋一齊好核突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 di1 ban2 mei6 zan1 hai6 zuk6 bat1 ho2 noi6, seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 ming4 paai4 daan6 can3 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 hat6 dat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的穿衣品味真是俗不可耐，全身都是名牌但搭配在一起很丑。
examples.english_sentence: Her fashion sense is unbearably tacky. She wears all these designer brands but they look awful together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情俗不可耐，估到晒啲情節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 zuk6 bat1 ho2 noi6, gu2 dou3晒啲cing4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情俗不可耐，所有情节都猜得到。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is extremely vulgar and predictable; you can guess all the details.

english_meaning: the mundane world, the secular world, the world of mortals
explanation_mandarin: 指充满世俗欲望和烦恼的世界，与宗教或精神境界相对。
explanation_english: Refers to the world filled with worldly desires, troubles, and concerns, often contrasted with religious or spiritual realms. It represents the everyday, non-spiritual existence of humans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想離開俗世，去寺廟修行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 lei4 hoi1 suk6 sai3, heoi3 zi2 miu2 sau1 hang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想离开世俗，去寺庙修行。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to leave the mundane world and practice spiritual cultivation in a temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇破咗俗世嘅名利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 po3 zo2 suk6 sai3 ge3 ming4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看破了世俗的名利。
examples.english_sentence: He has seen through the fame and fortune of the secular world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋始終都係生活喺俗世裏面，唔能夠完全脫離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ci2 chung1 dou1 hai6 sang1 wut6 hai2 suk6 sai3 leoi5 min6, m4 nang4 gau3 wun4 cyun4 tyut3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们始终还是生活在世俗里面，不能完全脱离。
examples.english_sentence: We ultimately live in the mundane world and cannot completely escape from it.

english_meaning: custom, convention, common practice, vulgar custom
explanation_mandarin: 一般的习惯，传统做法，有时指不好的旧习惯。
explanation_english: General habits, traditional practices, sometimes referring to bad old habits or customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲俗例好奇怪，唔准女人上船㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 zuk6 lai6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, m4 zeon2 neoi5 jan2 soeng5 syun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的习俗很奇怪，不准女人上船。
examples.english_sentence: The customs here are very strange, women are not allowed on the boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 按照俗例，新年要派利是嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on3 ziu3 zuk6 lai6, san1 nin4 jiu3 paai3 lei6 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按照习俗，新年要发红包的。
examples.english_sentence: According to custom, you have to give out red envelopes during Chinese New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該跟住啲舊俗例，要有新嘅思維。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 gan1 zeoi6 di1 gau6 zuk6 lai6, jiu3 jau5 san1 ge3 si1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该遵循那些旧习俗，要有新的思维。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't follow those old customs, we need to have new thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 庸俗的物品; 品味低俗的东西
english_meaning: Tacky goods; Vulgar or tasteless items; Low-quality goods
explanation_mandarin: 指品质或品味低俗，不符合较高标准的物品。
explanation_english: Refers to items of low quality or poor taste, not meeting higher standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲俗品唔好擺出嚟啦，好失禮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zuk6 ban2 m4 hou2 baai2 chut1 lai4 laa1, hou2 sat1 lai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些俗气的物品就不要摆出来了，很丢人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't display these tacky things, it's embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買嘅嘢成日都係俗品，冇品味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 ge3 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 zuk6 ban2, mou5 ban2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买的东西总是很庸俗，没有品味。
examples.english_sentence: The things he buys are always tacky and have no taste.

english_meaning: cliché; trite; hackneyed; corny
explanation_mandarin: 形容情节、手法、想法等老一套，缺乏新意。
explanation_english: Describes something (plot, method, idea, etc.) that is old-fashioned, lacking originality, and predictable. Often used to describe something that is overused and therefore boring or uninteresting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好俗套，一睇就知個結局係點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 zuk6 tou3, jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 go3 git3 guk6 hai6 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很老套，一看就知道结局是什么了。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is so clichéd, you can tell what the ending will be just by watching the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅求婚方式好俗套，都係喺餐廳跪低送戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kau4 fan1 fong1 sik1 hou2 zuk6 tou3, dou1 hai6 hai2 can1 teng1 gwai1 dai1 sung3 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的求婚方式很老套，还是在餐厅跪下送戒指。
examples.english_sentence: His proposal was very cliché, he knelt down in a restaurant and gave a ring.

english_meaning: Vulgar character; non-standard character; colloquial character
explanation_mandarin: 指非规范的、约定俗成的汉字写法，通常笔画比较简省，但并非正规的简化字。
explanation_english: Refers to non-standard or commonly used but unofficial Chinese characters, often simplified in strokes but not officially recognized as simplified characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字係個俗字嚟嘅，正式文件唔可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 hai6 go3 zuk6 zi6 lai4 ge3, zing3 sik1 man4 gin2 m4 ho2 ji5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字是个俗字，正式文件不可以使用。
examples.english_sentence: This character is a vulgar character; you can't use it in official documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲字成日寫啲俗字，睇到我都唔知佢寫乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi6 seng4 jat6 se2 di1 zuk6 zi6, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 se2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的字总是写一些俗字，看得我都不知道他写什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always writes vulgar characters; I can't understand what he's writing.

mandarin_meaning: 庸俗, 土气, 不高雅
english_meaning: tacky, vulgar, in poor taste, lacking in sophistication, unsophisticated
explanation_mandarin: 形容品味不高，缺乏文化修养或审美能力，显得庸俗、老土。
explanation_english: Describes something that is in poor taste, lacks sophistication, and is considered vulgar or unsophisticated. It can refer to appearance, behavior, or anything lacking refinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著衫好俗氣，成日著啲螢光色嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 hou2 zuk6 hei3, seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 ying4 gwong1 sik1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿衣服很俗气，总是穿一些荧光色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses very tackily, always wearing clothes in neon colours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢屋企啲裝修好俗氣，用晒啲金光閃閃嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 uk1 kei2 di1 zong1 sau1 hou2 zuk6 hei3, yung6 saai3 di1 gam1 gwong1 sim2 sim2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得她家的装修很俗气，全都用一些金光闪闪的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I think the decoration in her house is very tacky, using all kinds of gaudy, glittering things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁俗氣啦，講嘢要有啲品味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zuk6 hei3 laa1, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 di1 ban2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么庸俗了，说话要有点品味。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so vulgar, speak with some taste.

english_meaning: commonly known as; popularly called
explanation_mandarin: 一般大众所称呼的，非正式的名称。
explanation_english: A common or popular name for something, often different from its official or technical name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人俗稱巴士做「巴士」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 suk6 cing1 baa1 si2 zou6 "baa1 si2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人俗称巴士为“巴士”。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people commonly call buses "baa1 si2" (巴士).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種植物俗稱「吊鐘」，因為佢啲花好似吊鐘噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 z植mat6 suk6 cing1 "diu3 zung1", jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei1 faa1 hou2 ci5 diu3 zung1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种植物俗称“吊钟”，因为它的花像吊钟一样。
examples.english_sentence: This plant is commonly known as "diu3 zung1" (hanging bell) because its flowers look like hanging bells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 維他命C俗稱「抗壞血酸」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 taa1 ming6 C suk6 cing1 "kong3 waai6 hyut3 syun1".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 维生素C俗称“抗坏血酸”。
examples.english_sentence: Vitamin C is commonly known as "ascorbic acid".

english_meaning: common saying; proverb; adage
explanation_mandarin: 普遍流传的，通俗易懂的话语或谚语。
explanation_english: A common saying, proverb, or adage that is widely circulated and easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗話話：「早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。」
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 waa2 waa6: "zou2 hei2 dik1 niu5 ji4 jau5 cung4 hek3."
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说：「早起的鸟儿有虫吃。」
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, "The early bird catches the worm."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有句俗話講：「橋唔怕舊，最緊要受。」
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 geoi3 suk6 waa2 gong2: "kiu2 m4 pa3 gau6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 sau6."
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有句俗话说：「桥不怕旧，最紧要受。」
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, "An old bridge is good as long as it can bear the weight."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正如俗話所講，唔好咁快下定論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng3 jyu4 suk6 waa2 so2 gong2, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 haa6 ding6 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正如俗话说的那样，不要这么快下定论。
examples.english_sentence: Just as the saying goes, don't jump to conclusions so quickly.

english_meaning: common saying; proverb; idiom; colloquial expression
explanation_mandarin: 民间流传的通俗语句，通常蕴含生活经验或哲理。
explanation_english: A common saying or expression that has been passed down through generations, usually containing practical wisdom or philosophical insights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句嘢係一句俗語，好多人都會咁講嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 je5 hai6 jat1 geoi3 zuk6 jyu5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 gam2 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话是一句俗语，很多人都会这么说。
examples.english_sentence: This saying is a proverb; many people say it like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有話「一分耕耘，一分收穫」，你努力啲就會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 jyu5 jau5 waa6 "jat1 fan1 gaang1 wan4, jat1 fan1 sau1 wok6", nei5 nou5 lik6 di1 zau6 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说“一分耕耘，一分收获”，你努力一些就会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, "No pain, no gain"; if you work harder, you will succeed.

english_meaning: As the saying goes; Proverbs say; There's an old saying that...
explanation_mandarin: 表示引用一句普遍为人所知的俗语或谚语来佐证观点或表达某种意思。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a common saying or proverb to support an argument or express a certain idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有云：早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 jyu5 jau5 wan4: zou2 hei2 dik1 niu5 ji4 jau5 cung4 hek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说：早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes: The early bird catches the worm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有云：人比人，比死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 jyu5 jau5 wan4: jan4 bei2 jan4, bei2 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说：人比人，气死人。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes: Comparison is the thief of joy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有云：唔怕生壞命，最怕改壞名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 jyu5 jau5 wan4: m4 paa3 sang1 waai6 ming6, zeoi3 paa3 goi2 waai6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说：不怕生错命，就怕改错名。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes: It's not so bad to be born unlucky, but it's terrible to give yourself a bad name (reputation).

english_meaning: As the saying goes; There's a saying that...
explanation_mandarin: 表示接下来要引用一句俗语或者常见的说法，用来引出观点或论据。
explanation_english: It introduces a common saying or proverb, often used to introduce a viewpoint or argument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有話，早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 jyu5 jau5 waa6, zou2 hei2 dik1 niu5 ji4 jau5 cung4 hek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, the early bird catches the worm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有話，勤力啲，包你掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 jyu5 jau5 waa6, kan4 lik6 di1, baau1 nei5 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 常言道，勤奋一点，保证你成功。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, be more diligent, and you're guaranteed success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語有話，唔聽老人言，吃虧在眼前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 jyu5 jau5 waa6, m4 ting1 lou5 jan4 jin4, hek3 kwai1 zoi6 ngaan5 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说，不听老人言，吃亏在眼前。
examples.english_sentence: As the saying goes, if you don't listen to the elderly, you'll suffer losses right away.

english_meaning: proverb, saying, adage
explanation_mandarin: 民间流传的通俗语句，通常带有深刻的道理或者经验。
explanation_english: A popular saying or proverb, usually expressing a common truth or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有句俗諺話：「早起的鳥兒有蟲吃」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 geoi3 suk6 ngaan6 waa6: "zou2 hei2 dik1 niu5 ji4 jau5 cung4 hek3".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有句俗话说：“早起的鸟儿有虫吃”。
examples.english_sentence: There's a proverb that says: "The early bird catches the worm."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係啲老人家成日講嘅俗諺嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 seng4 jat6 gong2 ge3 suk6 ngaan6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是老人家经常说的俗语。
examples.english_sentence: These are all proverbs that old people often say.

mandarin_meaning: 庸俗的品格; 没有高尚情操
english_meaning: vulgar character; lacking refinement or noble spirit; common; ordinary
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人品格庸俗，没有高尚的情操，只追求物质享受或世俗的东西。
explanation_english: Describes a person with a vulgar character, lacking refinement or noble spirit, and only pursuing material enjoyment or worldly things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好俗骨，成日淨係諗住點樣發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zuk6 gwat1, seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很庸俗，整天只想怎么发财。
examples.english_sentence: That person is very vulgar, always thinking about how to get rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁俗骨啦，有啲嘢唔係用錢可以衡量嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zuk6 gwat1 laa1, jau5 di1 je5 m4 hai6 jung6 cin2 ho2 ji5 hang4 loeng4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么庸俗了，有些东西不是用钱可以衡量的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so vulgar, some things can't be measured by money.

english_meaning: prisoner of war; captive
explanation_mandarin: 指战争中被俘获的人。也指俘获，捉住。
explanation_english: Refers to a person captured in war. Also refers to capturing or seizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打仗嗰陣俘虜咗好多敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 zoeng3 go2 zan6 fu1 lou5 zo2 ho2 do1 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在打仗的时候俘虏了很多敌人。
examples.english_sentence: They captured many enemies during the war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好虐待俘虜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 dai6 fu1 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要虐待俘虏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mistreat prisoners of war.

english_meaning: to capture, to take prisoner, to win over (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指捉住敌人；比喻用手段或技巧赢得对方的爱慕或支持。
explanation_english: Literally, to capture enemies. Figuratively, to win someone's affection or support through means or skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅甜言蜜語俘獲咗唔少女仔嘅芳心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5 fu1 wok6 zo2 m4 siu2 neoi2 zai2 ge3 fong1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的甜言蜜语俘获了很多女孩子的心。
examples.english_sentence: His sweet talk captured the hearts of many girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭中，好多士兵被俘獲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zeng1 zung1, hou2 do1 si1 bing1 bei6 fu1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争中，很多士兵被俘虏。
examples.english_sentence: Many soldiers were captured during the war.

english_meaning: captive, prisoner of war; to capture, to take prisoner
explanation_mandarin: 指被俘获的敌人或人；也指抓获，俘获。
explanation_english: Refers to an enemy or person who has been captured; also refers to the act of capturing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打勝仗，俘虜咗好多敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 sing3 zoeng3, fu1 lou5 zo2 hou2 do1 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打了胜仗，俘虏了很多敌人。
examples.english_sentence: They won the battle and captured many enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾佢嘅魅力俘虜咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 mei5 lik6 fu1 lou5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被他的魅力俘虏了。
examples.english_sentence: She was captivated by his charm.

mandarin_meaning: 一些，某些；表示輕視的詞綴
english_meaning: Some, certain (used to indicate a small quantity); a prefix used to show slight disdain
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量不多，一些，某些。也可用於表示輕視的詞綴，語氣較輕。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity, some, certain. Can also be used as a suffix to express a slight disdain or belittlement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗啲甜品我食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 di1 lei5 tim4 ban2 ngo5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我一些甜点吃。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me some desserts to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲錢都唔夠用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lei5 cin2 dou1 m4 gau3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些钱都不够用。
examples.english_sentence: This little bit of money isn't even enough.

english_meaning: vulgar; uncouth; colloquial; unrefined
explanation_mandarin: 指言语、行为等粗俗、不文雅，不符合规范。
explanation_english: Describes language, behavior, etc., that is vulgar, uncouth, and does not conform to standards of refinement; colloquial and sometimes considered unrefined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好俚俗，成日講粗口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 lei5 suk6, seng4 jat6 gong2 cou1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很粗俗，总是说脏话。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very vulgarly, always swearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲俚俗嘅講法，唔應該喺正式場合用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lei5 suk6 ge3 gong2 faat3, m4 ying1 goi1 hai2 zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些粗俗的说法，不应该在正式场合使用。
examples.english_sentence: These vulgar expressions should not be used in formal occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好學埋啲咁俚俗嘅嘢，要講文明嘅話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hok6 maai4 di1 gam3 lei5 suk6 ge3 ye5, yiu3 gong2 man4 ming4 ge3 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要学那些粗俗的东西，要说文明的话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't learn such vulgar things; you should speak politely.

english_meaning: slang, colloquialism, idiom
explanation_mandarin: 指民间流行的、非正式的、通俗的语言，通常带有地方特色或时代特色。
explanation_english: Refers to informal, popular language used by the general public, often with regional or temporal characteristics. It encompasses slang, colloquialisms, and idioms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都夾雜住啲俚語，好難聽得明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gaap3 zaap6 zyu6 di1 lei5 jyu5, hou2 naan4 ting1 dak1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是夹杂着俚语，很难听懂。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses slang when he speaks, it's hard to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句俚語好多後生仔都唔識㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 lei5 jyu5 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 m4 sik1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句俚语很多年轻人都不知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Many young people don't know this slang.

english_meaning: to protect; to defend; to guarantee; to ensure
explanation_mandarin: 保护，维护，保证，担保
explanation_english: To protect, defend, safeguard; to guarantee, ensure; to bail out, vouch for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要保重身體啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 bou2 zung6 san1 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要保重身体啊！
examples.english_sentence: You have to take care of yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我保證今次一定會做好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou2 zing3 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 wui5 zou6 hou2 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我保证这次一定会做好它。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee I will do it well this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫朋友保咗個釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 pang4 jau5 bou2 zo2 go3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮朋友保释了。
examples.english_sentence: He bailed his friend out.

english_meaning: Pray for...a smooth process; Pray for...success; May...go smoothly.
explanation_mandarin: 保佑…顺利进行。 通常在祈求事情顺利或祝福他人时使用。
explanation_english: To pray for something to go smoothly. Usually used when praying for success or blessing others, often omitting the specific thing being prayed for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保佑你考試大順利呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 jau6 nei5 haau2 si3 daai6 seon6 lei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你考试顺利!
examples.english_sentence: May you have great success in your exams!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋保佑BB仔快高長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou2 jau6 BB zai2 faai3 gou1 zoeng2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们祈祷宝宝快高长大。
examples.english_sentence: We pray that the baby grows up quickly and healthily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保佑大家身體健康，出入平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 jau6 daai6 gaa1 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, ceot1 jap6 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保佑大家身体健康，出入平安。
examples.english_sentence: May everyone be healthy, and safe in their travels.

mandarin_meaning: 保住, 守住, 维持
english_meaning: to keep, to maintain, to preserve, to protect, to hold on to
explanation_mandarin: 保持现有的状态或东西，不让失去。
explanation_english: To maintain the current state or thing, not letting it be lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要保住呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou2 zyu6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要保住这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: We must keep this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力咁保住自己嘅紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 bou2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gei2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地保持自己的记录。
examples.english_sentence: He worked hard to maintain his record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望我可以保住個獎學金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 bou2 zyu6 go3 zoeng2 hok6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望我可以保住这个奖学金。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can keep this scholarship.

english_meaning: to bless; to protect and bless; blessing; divine protection
explanation_mandarin: 神灵或上天保护、帮助某人或某事顺利进行。
explanation_english: To bless, protect, and assist someone or something, usually by a divine power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望天主保佑我哋一家人身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 tin1 zyu2 bou2 yau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望天主保佑我们一家人身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: I hope God will bless my family with good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢嘅祖先會保佑佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 zou2 sin1 wui5 bou2 yau6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的祖先会保佑他。
examples.english_sentence: He said his ancestors would bless him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祈求菩薩保佑我考試順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 kau4 pou4 saat3 bou2 yau6 ngo5 haau2 si5 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祈求菩萨保佑我考试顺利。
examples.english_sentence: I pray that Buddha will bless me with success in my exams.

english_meaning: I guarantee you'll win; I assure you'll win (gambling context)
explanation_mandarin: 在赌博中，表示保证对方会赢。
explanation_english: In a gambling context, it means to guarantee someone's win. It's a confident statement assuring someone they will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今鋪我保你大，信我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 pou1 ngo5 bou2 nei5 daai6, seon3 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这局我保证你赢，相信我吧！
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee you'll win this round, trust me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有信心，好似真係保你大咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 seon3 sam1, hou2 ci5 zan1 hai6 bou2 nei5 daai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有信心，好像真的能保证你赢一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's so confident, it's like he can really guarantee your win.

english_meaning: to maintain value; to hedge against inflation
explanation_mandarin: 维持或增加价值，防止因通货膨胀等因素导致贬值。
explanation_english: To maintain or increase value, protecting against devaluation due to inflation or other factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓可以保值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 ho2 ji5 bou2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房可以保值。
examples.english_sentence: Buying property can maintain its value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 黃金通常都畀人認為係可以保值嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 gam1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 bei2 jan4 wing4 wai4 hai6 ho2 ji5 bou2 zik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 黄金通常都被人认为是保值的。
examples.english_sentence: Gold is generally considered to be a good store of value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲錢唔值錢，買啲嘢保值好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 cin2 m4 zik6 cin2, maai5 di1 je5 bou2 zik6 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在钱不值钱了，买些东西保值比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Money is losing its value these days, it's better to buy something to maintain its value.

english_meaning: health care; health protection; to maintain good health
explanation_mandarin: 为保护和增进健康而采取的措施。也可作动词，指采取保护健康的措施。
explanation_english: Measures taken to protect and improve health. It can also be used as a verb, referring to taking measures to protect health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人越來越注重保健。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 yut6 lai4 yut6 zyu3 zung6 bou2 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人越来越注重保健。
examples.english_sentence: People nowadays are paying more and more attention to health care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都食保健食品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 sik6 bou2 gin6 sik6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都吃保健食品。
examples.english_sentence: He takes health supplements every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動都係一種保健嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 dou1 hai6 jat1 zung2 bou2 gin6 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动也是一种保健的方法。
examples.english_sentence: Exercise is also a way to maintain good health.

english_meaning: health supplements; health products
explanation_mandarin: 指有益于健康的食品或产品，通常用于补充营养，增强体质，但并非药品。
explanation_english: Health supplements or products that are beneficial to health, usually used to supplement nutrition and enhance physical fitness, but are not drugs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗好多保健品畀阿爸阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 bou2 gin6 ban2 bei2 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了好多保健品给爸爸妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a lot of health supplements for his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂食保健品，最好問吓醫生先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 sik6 bou2 gin6 ban2, zeoi3 hou2 man6 haa5 yi1 sang1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱吃保健品，最好问一下医生先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take health supplements randomly; it's best to consult a doctor first.

synonyms: 營養補充劑 (ying4 yeong5 bo2 chung1 zai1)

english_meaning: Bulgaria (country name)
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲国家名：保加利亚。
explanation_english: Bulgaria, a country in Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年想去保加利亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 bou2 gaa1 lei6 aa3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年想去保加利亚旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Bulgaria next year.

english_meaning: to save one's life; to stay alive; to survive
explanation_mandarin: 保护生命，维持生存。
explanation_english: To protect one's life; to preserve one's life; to stay alive and avoid death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山最緊要係安全，保命要緊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 on1 cyun4, bou2 ming6 jiu3 gan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山最重要的是安全，保命要紧啊！
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing when hiking is safety, saving your life is crucial!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到危險嘅時候，第一時間保命先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou2 ngai4 him2 ge3 si4 hau6, dai6 jat1 si4 gaan3 bou2 ming6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到危险的时候，第一时间保命要紧。
examples.english_sentence: When facing danger, saving your life should be the first priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，最緊要保命，唔好亂咁投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 bou2 ming6, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，最重要的是保命，不要乱投资。
examples.english_sentence: With the economy being bad, the most important thing is to survive, don't invest recklessly.

english_meaning: insurance policy
explanation_mandarin: 保险公司签发的证明保险合同成立的书面文件。
explanation_english: A written document issued by an insurance company that serves as evidence of an insurance contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份保單就快到期喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 bou2 daan1 zau6 faai3 dou3 kei4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的保险单快到期了。
examples.english_sentence: My insurance policy is expiring soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咗咩保險啊？我想參考下你份保單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 zo2 me1 bou2 him2 aa3? ngo5 soeng2 caam1 kaau2 haa5 nei5 fan6 bou2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买了什么保险？我想参考一下你的保单。
examples.english_sentence: What insurance have you bought? I want to refer to your policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買保險之前要睇清楚份保單嘅條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 bou2 him2 zi1 cin4 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 fan6 bou2 daan1 ge3 tiu4 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买保险之前要看清楚保险单的条款。
examples.english_sentence: Before buying insurance, you need to read the terms and conditions of the policy carefully.

english_meaning: medical parole; medical release on bail
explanation_mandarin: 指罪犯因患有严重疾病，经监狱或看守所批准，准予保释出狱接受治疗。
explanation_english: Refers to the release of a prisoner on bail to receive medical treatment due to a serious illness, with the approval of the prison or detention center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體狀況太差，申請咗保外就醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 zong6 fong3 taai3 caa1, san1 cheng2 zo2 bou2 ngoi6 zau6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身体状况太差，申请了保外就医。
examples.english_sentence: His health condition is too poor, so he applied for medical parole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢有嚴重嘅心臟病，所以獲得批准保外就醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 keoi5 jau5 yim4 zung6 ge3 sam1 zong6 beng6, so2 ji5 wok6 dak1 pai1 zhun2 bou2 ngoi6 zau6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他有严重的心脏病，所以获得批准保外就医。
examples.english_sentence: Because he has a serious heart condition, he was approved for medical parole.

english_meaning: nanny, babysitter
explanation_mandarin: 主要指受雇照顾小孩的女性。
explanation_english: A woman employed to care for children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋請咗個保姆返嚟幫手湊小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 bou2 mou5 faan1 lai4 bong1 sau2 cou3 siu2 peng4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们请了个保姆回来帮忙照顾小孩。
examples.english_sentence: We hired a nanny to help take care of the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工係做保姆，專門湊人哋嘅BB。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hai6 zou6 bou2 mou5, zyun1 mun4 cou3 jan4 dei6 ge3 bi1 bi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的工作是做保姆，专门照顾别人的婴儿。
examples.english_sentence: Her job is a nanny, specializing in taking care of other people's babies.

english_meaning: van for hire; nanny van; chauffeur-driven van (often used by celebrities)
explanation_mandarin: 一种专门为明星、艺人或家庭提供服务的车辆，通常空间较大，内设舒适，可以用来休息、换装、化妆等。一般配备司机，有时也会有保姆或助理随行。
explanation_english: A van that is specifically used to transport celebrities, artists, or families. It is usually spacious, comfortably furnished, and can be used for resting, changing clothes, applying makeup, etc. It is generally equipped with a driver and sometimes accompanied by a nanny or assistant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲明星出入都係坐保姆車㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ming4 sing1 ceot1 jap6 dou1 hai6 zo6 bou2 mou5 ce1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明星们出入都是坐保姆车的。
examples.english_sentence: Celebrities always travel in a nanny van.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍戲嗰陣，部保姆車就係佢哋嘅休息室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 hei3 go2 zan2, bou2 mou5 ce1 zau6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jau1 sik1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拍戏的时候，保姆车就是他们的休息室。
examples.english_sentence: When they are filming, the nanny van is their resting room.

english_meaning: to preserve; to conserve; to keep; to maintain
explanation_mandarin: 使事物保持原来的状态，不使受到损坏或变质。
explanation_english: To keep something in its original condition, preventing damage or deterioration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好保存呢啲歷史文物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 bou2 cyun4 ni1 di1 lik6 si2 man4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要好好保存这些历史文物。
examples.english_sentence: We must preserve these historical relics well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻歌係我哋保存得最耐嘅回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 go1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 bou2 cyun4 dak1 zeoi3 noi6 ge3 wui4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌是我们保存最久的回忆。
examples.english_sentence: This song is our longest-lasting memory.

english_meaning: conservative; to conserve
explanation_mandarin: （形容词）指思想、行动等守旧，不求改变或进步；（动词）指保护使不受损失或变质。
explanation_english: (adjective) conservative; holding traditional attitudes and values and cautious about change or innovation, typically in relation to politics or religion; (verb) to conserve; to protect (something, especially an environmentally or culturally important place or thing) from harm or destruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好保守，唔鍾意嘗試新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 baau2 sau2, m4 zung1 ji3 si3 soeng4 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很保守，不喜欢尝试新事物。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very conservative person and doesn't like trying new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法比較保守，但係都幾穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 bei2 gaau3 baau2 sau2, daan6 hai6 dou1 gei2 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法比较保守，但是也挺稳妥的。
examples.english_sentence: This method is relatively conservative, but it's quite safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要保守環境，留畀下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 baau2 sau2 waan4 ging2, lau4 bei2 haa6 jat1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要保护环境，留给下一代。
examples.english_sentence: We need to conserve the environment and leave it for the next generation.

english_meaning: Conservative Party
explanation_mandarin: 指奉行保守主义政治立场的政党。
explanation_english: Refers to a political party that adheres to a conservative political stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英國嘅保守黨啱啱贏咗選舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 gwok3 ge3 bou2 sau2 dong2 aam1 aam1 wing4 zo2 syun2 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 英国的保守党刚刚赢了选举。
examples.english_sentence: The Conservative Party in the UK just won the election.

english_meaning: security guard
explanation_mandarin: 负责维护安全和秩序的人员。
explanation_english: A person employed to protect property, premises, or people from harm or danger; a security guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個保安好盡責，成日巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bou2 on1 hou2 zeon6 zaak3, sing4 jat6 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个保安很尽责，经常巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: That security guard is very responsible and patrols often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大廈門口見到個保安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 haa6 mun4 hau2 gin3 dou2 go3 bou2 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大厦门口看到一个保安。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a security guard at the entrance of the building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲保安都幾nice㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 bou2 on1 dou1 gei2 nice gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的保安都挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: The security guards here are quite nice.

english_meaning: To defend the family and protect the country; To defend one's home and country.
explanation_mandarin: 保卫家庭和国家，抵抗外敌入侵。

english_meaning: to guarantee; to ensure; to safeguard; guarantee

explanation_english: Noun: Insurance, a system of economic protection against possible loss. Adjective: Safe, secure, reliable. Verb: To guarantee, to ensure.

examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee you'll be alright.

english_meaning: fuse
explanation_mandarin: 一种安全装置，当电流超过安全值时，熔断以保护电路。

mandarin_meaning: 宝路华 (品牌名), 精工 (舊稱)
english_meaning: Bulova (brand name), Seiko (old name)
explanation_mandarin: 「保露華」是一個手錶品牌名Bulova的音譯。在香港，老一輩的人也可能用「保露華」來稱呼精工錶 (Seiko)，因為以前精工錶還沒有正式的中文品牌名，人們就用相似的發音來稱呼。
explanation_english: "保露華" (bou2 lou6 waa4) is the Cantonese transliteration of the watch brand Bulova. In Hong Kong, older generations may also use "保露華" to refer to Seiko watches because Seiko did not have a formal Chinese brand name in the past, and people used a similar-sounding name to refer to it.

examples.english_sentence: My grandfather's Bulova watch has been worn for decades, and it still works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日將精工錶叫做「保露華」，其實兩樣嘢嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 zing1 gung1 biu1 giu3 zou6 "bou2 lou6 waa4", kei4 sat6 loeng5 joeng6 je5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人总是把精工表叫做宝路华，其实是两样东西。
examples.english_sentence: People used to call Seiko watches Bulova, but they are actually two different things.

english_meaning: chivalry, righteousness, gallantry
explanation_mandarin: 指见义勇为，扶危济困的精神和行为。

mandarin_meaning: 相信, 信任; 相信, 认为; 书信, 信件

explanation_mandarin: 动词：相信，信任；认为。名词：书信，信件。
explanation_english: Verb: to believe, to trust; to think, to consider. Noun: letter, message.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信有鬼吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you believe in ghosts?

english_meaning: to take something as true; to believe something to be true; to swallow something hook, line, and sinker

explanation_english: To believe something that may not necessarily be true; to accept something as truth without questioning.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to believe what others say.

examples.english_sentence: He always believes the fake news, it's hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信以為眞佢嘅花言巧語呀，佢係個大話精嚟㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要信以为真他的花言巧语啊，他是个大话精来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe his sweet talk, he's a liar.

english_meaning: to believe something to be true; to take something seriously
explanation_mandarin: 相信某事物是真的。形容轻信。以为是真的。
explanation_english: To believe something is actually true; to take something at face value.  It implies gullibility or being easily deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話講得咁真，你唔好信以為真啊。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他谎话说的那么真，你不要信以为真啊。
examples.english_sentence: He tells lies so convincingly, don't believe him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新聞好多都係假嘅，唔好信以為真呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 man4 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3, m4 hou2 seon3 ji5 wai4 zan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多新闻都是假的，不要信以为真。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of news is fake, don't take it all as truth.

english_meaning: to take something as true; to believe something is real
explanation_mandarin: 相信某事是真实的，通常指轻易相信或不加辨别地相信。
explanation_english: To believe something is true, often implying naivety or gullibility; to accept something at face value without questioning its authenticity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日信以爲眞人哋講嘅嘢，好易俾人呃。

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 ji5 wai4 zan1 san1 man4 ge3嘢, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易信以为真新闻上的东西，很多都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't so easily believe what's in the news; a lot of it is fake.

english_meaning: to take something as true, to believe something is real
explanation_mandarin: 把某事当成真实的事情来相信。
explanation_english: To believe something is real or true, to take something at face value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日信以爲真，好易俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 seon3 ji5 wai4 zan1, hou2 ji6 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是信以为真，很容易被人骗。
examples.english_sentence: He always believes everything he hears, he's easily fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信以爲真呀，佢講笑啫。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要信以为真啊，他只是开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe him, he's just joking.

english_meaning: belief, faith, creed

examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人都有自己的政治信仰。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has their own political beliefs.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 seon3 joeng5 dung6 jiu4 zo2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 tung4 keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 m4 jat1 joeng6.

examples.english_sentence: My belief in him has wavered because what he says and what he does are not the same.

english_meaning: letter, mail

examples.english_sentence: I received a letter yesterday.

english_meaning: to trust, to have confidence in
explanation_mandarin: 相信并任用。指相信其为人或能力，并委以重任。
explanation_english: To believe in and have confidence in someone or something. It refers to trusting someone's character or ability and entrusting them with important tasks.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要赢得同事的信任。
examples.english_sentence: You must earn the trust of your colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅信任已經破裂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 seon3 jam6 ji5 ging1 po3 lyut3 zo2.

english_meaning: To completely believe; to believe something wholeheartedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示完全相信某件事或某个人，程度非常高。
explanation_english: Expresses the idea of completely believing something or someone, indicating a very strong degree of belief.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话我完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: I completely believe what he says.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他深信自己会中六合彩。
examples.english_sentence: He wholeheartedly believes that he will win the lottery.

synonyms: 深信不疑 (sam1 seon3 bat1 ji4)

jyutping: seon3 zak1 jau5 bat1 seon3 zak1 mou4
english_meaning: Believe it and it exists, don't believe it and it doesn't.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说，有些事情的真假与否取决于你是否相信它。如果你相信，它就存在；如果你不相信，它就不存在。强调主观信念对事物存在与否的影响。
explanation_english: This idiom means that the existence or truth of certain things depends on whether you believe them or not. If you believe, it exists; if you don't, it doesn't. It emphasizes the influence of subjective belief on the existence of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢呢，信則有不信則無嘅啫。你信有鬼，咪覺得周圍都有鬼囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 ne1, seon3 zak1 jau5 bat1 seon3 zak1 mou4 ge3 ze1. nei5 seon3 jau5 gwai2, mai1 gok3 dak1 zau1 wai4 dou1 jau5 gwai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西呢，信则有不信则无嘛。你相信有鬼，不就觉得周围都有鬼吗。
examples.english_sentence: These things are a matter of 'believe it and it exists, don't believe it and it doesn't'. If you believe in ghosts, you'll feel they're all around you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水呢家嘢，真係信則有不信則無，有啲人覺得好靈驗，有啲人就覺得係迷信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 ne1 gaa1 je5, zan1 hai6 seon3 zak1 jau5 bat1 seon3 zak1 mou4, jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 ling4 jim6, jau5 di1 jan4 zau6 gok3 dak1 hai6 mai4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水这东西，真是信则有不信则无，有些人觉得很灵验，有些人就觉得是迷信。
examples.english_sentence: Feng Shui is really a case of 'believe it and it exists, don't believe it and it doesn't'. Some people find it very effective, while others consider it superstition.

english_meaning: to speak carelessly; to blurt out whatever comes to mind; to talk irresponsibly; to talk nonsense
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不负责任地随便乱说，没有根据。
explanation_english: Describes someone speaking irresponsibly and carelessly without any basis.

examples.english_sentence: He always makes irresponsible remarks; you can't trust what he says.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 seon3 hau2 ci1 wong4, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 liu5 gaai2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng3.

examples.english_sentence: Don't believe his irresponsible remarks; he doesn't understand the truth of the matter at all.

explanation_english: Refers to historical records that are considered credible and reliable. It implies that the historian (史官) recorded the facts accurately and truthfully, leading to high confidence in the authenticity of the historical account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅嘢唔可以當信史咁睇，好多嘢都係佢自己加鹽加醋。

examples.english_sentence: If you want to study history, you need to refer to reliable historical records.

explanation_english: A large seabird known for its ability to fly long distances.

explanation_english: A person who delivers letters, packages, and other items.
