explanation_mandarin: 形容人容易相信别人，比较天真，容易被骗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easily convinced and trusts others easily, often to the point of being naive and easily deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好信肉，成日俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 seon3 juk6, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很天真，总是被人骗。
examples.english_sentence: He is very gullible, always getting scammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁信肉啦，呢個世界好多壞人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 seon3 juk6 laa1, ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 hou2 do1 waai6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么天真了，这个世界很多坏人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so gullible, there are many bad people in this world.

english_meaning: signal
explanation_mandarin: 指传递信息的符号或工具。
explanation_english: A sign or gesture that conveys information; a device used to transmit a signal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電話冇信號啊，打唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 waa2 mou5 seon3 hou6 aa3, daa2 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话没有信号啊，打不出去。
examples.english_sentence: The phone has no signal, I can't make a call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 交通燈嘅信號好重要，睇清楚先過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 tung1 dang1 ge3 seon3 hou6 hou2 zung6 jiu3, tai2 cing1 co2 sin1 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 交通灯的信号很重要，看清楚再过马路。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic light signals are very important, look carefully before crossing the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗個秘密信號我，我知佢想走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 go3 bei3 mat6 seon3 hou6 ngo5, ngo5 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我一个秘密信号，我知道他想走了。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a secret signal, I know he wants to leave.

english_meaning: Signal flare
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于发出信号的弹药，通常在紧急情况下使用，可以发出光或烟。
explanation_english: A device that emits a bright light or smoke for signaling distress or providing illumination, often used in emergency situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺海上遇到危險，所以射咗支信號彈求救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hoi2 soeng6 jyu6 dou3 ngai4 him2, so2 ji5 se6 zo2 zi1 seon3 hou6 daan6 kau4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在海上遇到危险，所以发射了信号弹求救。
examples.english_sentence: They encountered danger at sea, so they fired a signal flare for help.

english_meaning: Believers, followers (of a religion or leader)
explanation_mandarin: 指信仰某种宗教或追随某个领袖的群体。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people who believe in a particular religion or follow a certain leader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟吸引咗好多信衆嚟參拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 seon3 zung3 lai4 caam1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座庙吸引了很多信徒来参拜。
examples.english_sentence: This temple has attracted many believers to worship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺信衆心目中地位好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 seon3 zung3 sam1 muk6 zung1 dei6 wai2 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在信徒心目中的地位很高。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very high status in the eyes of the believers.

english_meaning: trust (finance); trusteeship
explanation_mandarin: 一种法律安排，将财产的所有权转移给受托人，受托人有义务为受益人的利益管理和分配该财产。
explanation_english: A legal arrangement where ownership of assets is transferred to a trustee, who is obligated to manage and distribute the assets for the benefit of the beneficiaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋設立咗一個信託基金嚟保障仔女嘅將來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sat3 lap6 zo2 jat1 go3 seon3 tok3 gei1 gam1 lai4 bou2 zoeng3 zai2 neoi5 ge3 zoeng1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们设立了一个信托基金来保障子女的将来。
examples.english_sentence: They set up a trust fund to secure their children's future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司負責管理好多人嘅退休金信託。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 fu3 zaak3 gun2 lei5 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 teoi3 jau1 gam1 seon3 tok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司负责管理很多人的退休金信托。
examples.english_sentence: This company is responsible for managing many people's pension trusts.

english_meaning: to vow solemnly, to make a solemn pledge, to promise faithfully
explanation_mandarin: 指誓言说得非常诚恳可信。旦旦：诚恳的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the act of making a solemn and sincere oath or promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信誓旦旦咁講一定會改過自新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 sai6 daan3 daan3 gam2 gong2 jat1 ding6 wui5 goi2 gwo3 zi6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他信誓旦旦地说一定会改过自新。
examples.english_sentence: He vowed solemnly that he would definitely turn over a new leaf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋信誓旦旦咁保證，今次一定唔會再遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seon3 sai6 daan3 daan3 gam2 bou2 zing3, gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 zoi3 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们信誓旦旦地保证，这次一定不会再迟到。
examples.english_sentence: They solemnly promised that they definitely wouldn't be late again this time.

english_meaning: reputation; credit; prestige
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会交往中所获得的信用和名誉。
explanation_english: Refers to the credit and reputation earned in social interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅信譽好好，好多人都信佢哋嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 seon3 jyu6 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 seon3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的信誉很好，很多人都相信他们的产品。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a good reputation, and many people trust their products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 建立良好嘅信譽需要時間同努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 lap6 loeng4 hou2 ge3 seon3 jyu6 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 tung4 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建立良好的信誉需要时间和努力。
examples.english_sentence: Building a good reputation takes time and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢再咁樣呃人，遲早都會冇晒信譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 aak1 jan4, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 mou5晒 seon3 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他再这样骗人，迟早都会失去所有信誉。
examples.english_sentence: If he continues to cheat people like this, he will eventually lose all credibility.

english_meaning: credit, loan
explanation_mandarin: 指借贷双方以信用为基础进行的借贷活动。
explanation_english: Refers to lending activities conducted on the basis of credit between lenders and borrowers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司需要攞信貸嚟擴張業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 lo2 seon3 daai3 lai4 kwok3 zoeng1 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司需要获得信贷来扩张业务。
examples.english_sentence: His company needs to obtain credit to expand its business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請信貸之前，最好比較下唔同銀行嘅利率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 seon3 daai3 zi1 cin4, zeoi3 hou2 bei2 gaau3 haa5 m4 tung4 ngan4 hong4 ge3 leot6 leoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在申请信贷之前，最好比较一下不同银行的利率。
examples.english_sentence: Before applying for credit, it's best to compare the interest rates of different banks.

english_meaning: credit rating
explanation_mandarin: 对借款人（个人或机构）的信用风险进行的评估，通常以等级形式表示。
explanation_english: An evaluation of the credit risk of a borrower (individual or organization), usually expressed as a grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想借多啲錢，但係信貸評級唔夠高，銀行唔批。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ze3 do1 di1 cin2, daan6 hai6 seon3 daai3 ping4 kap1 m4 gau3 gou1, ngan4 hong4 m4 pai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想借更多的钱，但是信用评级不够高，银行不批准。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to borrow more money, but his credit rating isn't high enough, so the bank won't approve it.

english_meaning: trust, rely on, have confidence in
explanation_mandarin: 相信并依靠；对人或事物抱有信心。
explanation_english: To have confidence in someone or something; to depend on someone or something because you believe they are reliable and trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好信賴我嘅朋友，有咩事都會搵佢幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 seon3 laai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5, jau5 me1 si6 dou1 wui5 wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很信任我的朋友，有什么事都会找他帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I trust my friend a lot, I will ask for his help if anything happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我信賴呢間公司嘅產品，質量好有保證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon3 laai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2, zat1 loeng6 hou2 jau5 bou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我信赖这家公司的产品，质量很有保证。
examples.english_sentence: I trust the products of this company, the quality is well-guaranteed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病人要信賴醫生嘅專業判斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 yan2 jiu3 seon3 laai6 ji1 sang1 ge3 zyun1 jip6 pun3 dyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病人要信赖医生的专业判断。
examples.english_sentence: Patients need to trust the doctor's professional judgement.

mandarin_meaning: 迷信，相信不好的预兆或鬼神
english_meaning: to be superstitious, to believe in evil omens/spirits
explanation_mandarin: 指相信一些没有科学依据的说法或事物，特别是那些与鬼神、预兆、迷信活动等相关的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to believing in things that have no scientific basis, especially those related to ghosts, omens, superstitious activities, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁信邪啦，啲嘢冇根據㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 seon3 ce4 laa1, di1 je5 mou5 gan1 geoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么迷信了，那些东西没有根据的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so superstitious, those things have no basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢病咗之後，佢阿媽就開始信邪，成日去拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 aa3 maa1 zau6 hoi1 ci2 seon3 ce4, seng4 jat6 heoi3 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他生病之后，他妈妈就开始迷信，整天去拜神。
examples.english_sentence: Since he got sick, his mother has become superstitious and goes to worship gods every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信邪到呢，乜都睇通勝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 ce4 dou3 ni1, mat1 dou1 tai2 tung1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迷信到什么都看黄历。
examples.english_sentence: He's so superstitious that he checks the Chinese almanac for everything.

english_meaning: to believe; to trust
explanation_mandarin: 表示相信某人的话或某件事情是真的。是“相信”和“信任”的口语表达。
explanation_english: Means to believe someone's words or that something is true. A colloquial expression for 'believe' and 'trust'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢我信鏡晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 ngo5 seon3 geng3晒 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话我都完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: I believe everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，我唔信鏡你喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, ngo5 m4 seon3 geng3 nei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，我不信任你了。
examples.english_sentence: The way you're doing this, I don't trust you anymore.

english_meaning: chariot; vehicle (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 「俥」是「車」的異體字，在古代可以指戰車或一般的車輛。現代粵語口語中很少單獨使用，多出現在一些象棋術語中，例如「俥」表示象棋中的「車」。
explanation_english: "俥" is a variant character of "車 (che1)", meaning chariot or vehicle in ancient times. It is rarely used alone in modern Cantonese colloquial speech, but it appears in some Chinese chess (象棋) terms, where "俥" represents the "車" (rook/chariot).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 捉象棋嘅時候，我鍾意用俥嚟攻擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 zoeng6 kei2 ge3 si4 hau2, ngo5 zung1 yi3 yung6 ce1 lai4 gung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下象棋的时候，我喜欢用車来攻击。
examples.english_sentence: When playing Chinese chess, I like to attack with the rook.

english_meaning: private; personal; pertaining to oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示属于个人的，私有的。 常用于“俬伙”等词语中。
explanation_english: Indicates something private, personal, or belonging to oneself. Often used in words like "俬伙" (si1 fo2).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗啲俬伙嘢走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 di1 si1 fo2 je5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一些私人物品走了。
examples.english_sentence: He took some of his personal belongings and left.

mandarin_meaning: 修理; 修理; 装修; 修改
english_meaning: to repair; to mend; to fix; to renovate; to cultivate; to study; to practice
explanation_mandarin: 修理，使恢复完整或正常状态；装饰，改进；学习，练习；修改，改正。
explanation_english: To repair, mend, or fix something to restore it to its original or working condition; to renovate or decorate; to study, learn, or practice a skill; to modify or correct something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，我要攞去整修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, ngo5 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zeng2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，我要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken, I need to take it to be repaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備緊修葺間舊屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 gan2 sau1 cep3 gaan1 gau6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备装修那间旧房子。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing to renovate the old house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀大學嘅時候修過經濟學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 daai6 hok6 ge3 si4 hau6 sau1 gwo3 ging1 zai3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我读大学的时候修过经济学。
examples.english_sentence: I studied economics when I was in university.

english_meaning: amend legislation, amend a bill, amend an ordinance
explanation_mandarin: 修改法律条文或规章制度。
explanation_english: To amend or revise a law, regulation, or ordinance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃修例，加強對網絡欺凌嘅管制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 sau1 lai6, gaa1 keung4 deoi3 mong5 lok6 hei1 ling4 ge3 gun2 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划修订条例，加强对网络欺凌的管制。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to amend the legislation to strengthen the regulation of cyberbullying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次修例引起咗社會廣泛嘅關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sau1 lai6 ging2 hei2 zo2 se5 wui2 gwong2 faan3 ge3 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次修订条例引起了社会广泛的关注。
examples.english_sentence: This amendment of the legislation has aroused widespread public concern.

english_meaning: to trim; to prune; to clip
explanation_mandarin: 用剪刀等工具除去多余的部分，使整齐美观。
explanation_english: To cut off irregular or unwanted parts to make something neater or tidier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要修剪一下啲盆栽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau1 zin2 jat1 haa5 di1 pun4 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要修剪一下那些盆栽。
examples.english_sentence: We need to trim the potted plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫個仔修剪頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 go3 zai2 sau1 zin2 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给儿子修剪头发。
examples.english_sentence: He is giving his son a haircut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 修剪指甲可以保持衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 zin2 zi2 gaap3 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 wai6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 修剪指甲可以保持卫生。
examples.english_sentence: Trimming your nails can maintain hygiene.

mandarin_meaning: 修士, 基督教男修道士
english_meaning: monk, friar (Christian)
explanation_mandarin: 天主教或东正教的男性修道士，为了宗教信仰而隐居或住在修道院的人。
explanation_english: A male member of a religious order living in a monastery and committed to religious vows, particularly in the Catholic or Orthodox Christian traditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間修道院住咗好多修士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 siu1 dou6 yun2 zyu6 zo2 hou2 do1 siu1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间修道院住了很多修士。
examples.english_sentence: That monastery is home to many monks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定做修士，一生奉獻畀上帝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zou6 siu1 si6, jat1 sang1 fung6 hin3 bei2 soeng5 dai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定做修士，一生奉献给上帝。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to become a monk, dedicating his life to God.

english_meaning: nun
explanation_mandarin: 献身宗教，在教会中服务的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who has taken solemn vows and dedicated her life to religious service, typically living in a convent or monastery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間教堂有好多修女喺度幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaau3 tong4 jau5 hou2 do1 sau1 neoi5 hai2 dou6 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个教堂有很多修女在那里帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: There are many nuns helping out at that church.

english_meaning: to repair; to fix; to mend; to reconcile; to patch up (a relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指将损坏的东西修理好。2. 指修复或改善关系。
explanation_english: 1. To repair or fix something that is broken. 2. To reconcile or improve a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電視機修好咗未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 si6 gei1 sau1 hou2 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视机修好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is the television fixed yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄妹終於修好咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 mui6 zung1 jyu1 sau1 hou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄妹终于和好了。
examples.english_sentence: The two siblings finally reconciled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將舊電腦修好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gau6 din6 nou5 sau1 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把旧电脑修好。
examples.english_sentence: I want to get the old computer repaired.

english_meaning: to revise, to amend, to modify, revision, amendment
explanation_mandarin: 修改訂正。將原有的東西加以修改，使其更加完善或符合新的要求。
explanation_english: To revise or amend something, making it more perfect or in line with new requirements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要修定一下份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 ding6 jat1 haa5 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要修订一下这份合同。
examples.english_sentence: We need to revise the contract a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份法例需要修定先至可以實施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 faat3 leoi6 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 ding6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sat6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份法律需要修订后才可以实施。
examples.english_sentence: This law needs to be revised before it can be implemented.

english_meaning: to build; to repair; to construct
explanation_mandarin: 建造或修理（建筑物、道路等）。
explanation_english: To build or repair (buildings, roads, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府準備修建一條新嘅公路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zyun2 bei6 sau1 gin3 jat1 tiu4 san1 ge3 gung1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府准备修建一条新的公路。
examples.english_sentence: The government is preparing to build a new highway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要修建呢間舊屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 gin3 ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要修建这间旧房子。
examples.english_sentence: We need to repair this old house.

english_meaning: to repair, to restore, to renovate
explanation_mandarin: 使恢复原状；修理使完整或恢复正常状态。
explanation_english: To restore to its original condition; to repair to make something complete or to return it to a normal state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，要拎去修復先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 sau1 fuk6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，要拿去修理才行。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken, it needs to be taken for repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舊屋需要修復一下先可以住人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 fuk6 jat1 haa5 sin1 ho2 ji5 zyu6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间旧房子需要修复一下才可以住人。
examples.english_sentence: This old house needs to be renovated before it is habitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生幫佢修復咗條斷咗嘅骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 bong1 keoi5 sau1 fuk6 zo2 tiu4 dyun3 zo2 ge3 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生帮他修复了断掉的骨头。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor repaired his broken bone.

english_meaning: to cultivate moral character, to nurture one's temperament, to cultivate one's mind and improve one's character
explanation_mandarin: 通过改善自身的心态和行为，培养高尚的品德和气质。
explanation_english: To cultivate one's moral character and temperament by improving one's mindset and behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退休之後，佢就開始種花、寫書法，修心養性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3休 ji4 hau6, keoi5 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zhung2 faa1, se2 syu1 faat3, sau1 sam1 joeng5 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退休之后，他就开始种花、写书法，修身养性。
examples.english_sentence: After retirement, he started gardening and practicing calligraphy to cultivate his mind and character.

english_meaning: leisurely, relaxed, carefree
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活或行动悠闲自在，没有压力或烦恼。
explanation_english: Describes a life or action that is leisurely, relaxed, and without pressure or worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，生活變得好修悠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3休之hau6, sang1 wut6 bin3 dak1 hou2 sau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，生活变得很悠闲。
examples.english_sentence: After he retired, his life became very leisurely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意放假嘅時候，可以修悠咁喺屋企睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 fong3 gaa3 ge3 si4 hau6, ho2 ji5 sau1 jau4 gam2 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢放假的时候，可以悠闲地在家里看书。
examples.english_sentence: I like to relax and read at home during holidays.

synonyms: 悠然自得 (jau4 jin4 zi6 dak1)

english_meaning: to amend the constitution; constitutional amendment
explanation_mandarin: 修改宪法。 作为动词，指修改宪法的行为；作为名词，指对宪法进行的修改。
explanation_english: To amend the constitution. As a verb, it refers to the act of amending the constitution; as a noun, it refers to the amendment to the constitution itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府建議修憲嚟回應市民嘅訴求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gin3 ji5 sau1 hin3 lai4 wui4 ying3 si5 man4 ge3 sou3 kiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府建议修改宪法来回应市民的诉求。
examples.english_sentence: The government suggests amending the constitution to respond to the citizens' demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 修憲嘅過程通常都好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 hin3 ge3 gwo3 ching4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 修改宪法的过程通常都很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The process of amending the constitution is usually very complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會對修憲有好多唔同嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 deoi3 sau1 hin3 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会对修改宪法有很多不同的意见。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different opinions in society regarding constitutional amendment.

mandarin_meaning: 修成正果 (xiū chéng zhèng guǒ)
english_meaning: To achieve fruition; to reach a successful conclusion; to be successfully completed (often referring to a relationship culminating in marriage); to attain enlightenment (Buddhism)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词/成语 (dòng cí / chéng yǔ)
explanation_mandarin: 原本是佛教用语，指通过修行达到最终的境界。现在常用来比喻经过努力，最终获得了成功或圆满的结果，特别是爱情方面，指两人最终结婚。
explanation_english: Originally a Buddhist term referring to achieving enlightenment through practice. Now it's commonly used to describe achieving a successful or satisfactory outcome after much effort, especially in romance, meaning a couple finally getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗十年拖，終於修成正果喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 sap6 nin4 to1, zung1 jyu1 sau1 sing4 zing3 gwo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了十年恋爱，终于修成正果了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for ten years, and they've finally achieved fruition (gotten married).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多困難，呢個項目終於修成正果啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zung1 jyu1 sau1 sing4 zing3 gwo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多困难，这个项目终于修成正果了。
examples.english_sentence: After so many difficulties, this project has finally achieved fruition.

synonyms: 開花結果 (hoi1 faa1 git3 gwo2)
功德圓滿 (gung1 dak1 jyun4 mun5)

english_meaning: to revise; to modify; to amend
explanation_mandarin: 更改或修正。
explanation_english: To change or correct something, usually a text or a plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要修改呢份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu1 gaai2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要修改这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: We need to revise this report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢修改咗佢嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu1 gaai2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他修改了他的计划。
examples.english_sentence: He modified his plan.

english_meaning: to repair, to tidy up, to trim, to groom, to retouch (a photo)
explanation_mandarin: 修理使之完整或整洁；整理使之有条理；修饰使之更好看。
explanation_english: To repair something to make it complete or tidy; to tidy up to make it organized; to groom or embellish to make it look better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車撞凹咗，要攞去車房修整下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 zong6 ngau1 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 ce1 fong2 sau1 zing2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞凹了，要送到修车行修理一下。
examples.english_sentence: The car is dented, it needs to be taken to the garage to be repaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都花好多時間修整儀容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 faa1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 sau1 zing2 ji4 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都花很多时间修饰仪容。
examples.english_sentence: She spends a lot of time grooming herself every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲相影得唔靚，可以用軟件修整下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 soeng2 ying2 dak1 m4 leng3, ho2 ji5 yung6 ryun5 gin2 sau1 zing2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些照片拍得不好看，可以用软件修饰一下。
examples.english_sentence: These photos aren't very nice, you can use software to retouch them.

english_meaning: to study; to pursue studies; to complete a course of study; to graduate (after completing studies)
explanation_mandarin: 指学习知识和技能，或完成学业。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of acquiring knowledge and skills, or completing a course of study. It can also mean 'to graduate' after the successful completion of studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺英國修業咗三年，學咗好多嘢返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 sau1 jip6 zo2 saam1 nin4, hok6 zo2 ho2 do1 ye5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在英国修业了三年，学了很多东西回来。
examples.english_sentence: He studied in England for three years and learned a lot of things before returning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望仔女可以順利修業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 zai2 neoi5 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 sau1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望子女可以顺利完成学业。
examples.english_sentence: We hope our children can successfully complete their studies.

english_meaning: to revise, to correct, to amend
explanation_mandarin: 修改使正确；改正错误。
explanation_english: To revise and make correct; to correct errors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要修正呢份報告嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 siu1 zing3 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要修正这份报告的错误。
examples.english_sentence: We need to correct the errors in this report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃仲有好多地方需要修正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 seoi1 jiu3 siu1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划还有很多地方需要修正。
examples.english_sentence: There are still many areas in this plan that need to be revised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢修正咗佢自己嘅講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu1 zing3 zo2 keoi5 zi6 gei2 ge3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他修正了自己的说法。
examples.english_sentence: He revised his statement.

english_meaning: self-cultivation; accomplishment; attainment; training; moral standing
explanation_mandarin: 指通过学习和实践，提升自身道德、知识、技能等方面的一种过程和境界。也指个人在某方面的造诣和水平。
explanation_english: Refers to a process and state of improving oneself in terms of morality, knowledge, and skills through learning and practice. It also refers to an individual's attainment and level in a certain area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅藝術修為好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngai6 seot1 sau1 wai4 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的艺术修为很高。
examples.english_sentence: His artistic attainment is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好考驗一個人嘅修為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 haau2 jim6 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 sau1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很考验一个人的修为。
examples.english_sentence: This matter greatly tests a person's self-cultivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要達到咁高嘅境界，需要長時間嘅修為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 daat6 dou3 gam3 gou1 ge3 ging2 gaai3, seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 sau1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要达到这么高的境界，需要长时间的修为。
examples.english_sentence: To reach such a high level, it requires a long period of self-cultivation.

english_meaning: to cultivate; to practice self-cultivation; to refine oneself (spiritually or physically); to temper oneself
explanation_mandarin: 通过长时间的努力和实践，提升自己的能力、品德或境界。
explanation_english: To cultivate oneself through practice and effort, aiming to improve one's skills, moral character, or spiritual state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都修煉氣功，希望身體好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 sau1 lin6 hei3 gung1, hei1 mong6 san1 tai2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都修炼气功，希望身体好一点。
examples.english_sentence: He practices Qigong every day, hoping to improve his health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要修煉EQ，先可以處理好人際關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 sau1 lin6 EQ, sin1 ho2 ji5 cyu2 lei5 hou2 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要修炼情商，才可以处理好人际关系。
examples.english_sentence: To be a good person, you need to cultivate your emotional intelligence (EQ) in order to handle interpersonal relationships well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成為一個專業嘅音樂家，需要長時間嘅修煉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 zyun1 jip6 ge3 jam1 ngok6 gaa1, seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 sau1 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成为一个专业的音乐家，需要长时间的修炼。
examples.english_sentence: To become a professional musician, it requires a long period of practice and refinement.

english_meaning: cultivation, self-cultivation, accomplishment, attainment (especially in virtue, knowledge, or skills)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过学习和实践提高自身的道德、学识或技能。强调个人内在的提升和完善。
explanation_english: Refers to the improvement of one's moral character, knowledge, or skills through learning and practice. Emphasizes personal inner growth and perfection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅修爲好高，做嘢好有分寸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau1 wai4 hou2 gou1, zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的修养很高，做事很有分寸。
examples.english_sentence: His cultivation is very high, and he acts with great discretion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要提升自己嘅修爲，就要不斷學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 tai4 sing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 sau1 wai4, zau6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要提升自己的修为，就要不断学习。
examples.english_sentence: To improve your self-cultivation, you need to keep learning.

english_meaning: to repair; to fix; to mend
explanation_mandarin: 使恢复正常或完好状态。 修复。
explanation_english: To restore something to a normal or working condition; to fix or mend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話壞咗，要攞去修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话坏了，要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: The phone is broken, I need to take it to be repaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞咗，修理費好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 zo2, sau1 lei5 fai3 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞了，修理费很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed, the repair cost is very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識修理電器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 sau1 lei5 din6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会修理电器。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to repair electrical appliances.

english_meaning: to manicure (nails); to trim nails
explanation_mandarin: 修剪和整理指甲，使之整洁美观。
explanation_english: To trim and shape fingernails, usually for cosmetic purposes. It involves cutting, filing, and polishing the nails to improve their appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都會去修甲，保持雙手靚靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 wui5 heoi3 sau1 gaap3, bou2 ci4 soeng1 sau2 leng3 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个星期都会去修指甲，保持双手美美的。
examples.english_sentence: I get my nails manicured every week to keep my hands looking nice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自己喺屋企修甲，慳返唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 gei2 hai2 uk1 kei2 sau1 gaap3, haan1 faan1 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她自己在家里修指甲，省了不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: She does her own manicures at home, which saves her a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 修甲之前最好浸一浸手，啲死皮會容易啲剪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 gaap3 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 zam3 jat1 zam3 sau2, di1 sei2 pei4 wui5 jung4 ji6 di1 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 修指甲之前最好泡一下手，死皮会比较容易剪。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to soak your hands before a manicure, so the dead skin will be easier to cut.

english_meaning: to build, to construct, to repair and build
explanation_mandarin: 建造或修理建筑物、道路等。
explanation_english: To build or repair buildings, roads, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃喺郊區修築一條新公路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hai2 haau1 kui1 sau1 zuk1 jat1 tiu4 san1 gung1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划在郊区修建一条新公路。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to build a new highway in the suburbs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用咗好多時間嚟修築個花園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 lai4 sau1 zuk1 go3 faa1 yun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们花了很多时间来修建花园。
examples.english_sentence: They spent a lot of time building the garden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個古蹟需要修築先可以繼續開放俾公眾參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 zik1 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 zuk1 sin1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 hoi1 fong3 bei2 gung1 zung3 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个古迹需要修建才可以继续开放给公众参观。
examples.english_sentence: This historical site needs to be repaired before it can be reopened to the public.

english_meaning: to cultivate, to practice (spiritual or physical discipline), to train oneself, self-cultivation
explanation_mandarin: 通过长期的实践和学习，提升自己的技能、品德或修为。
explanation_english: To improve one's skills, character, or cultivation through long-term practice and learning. Often used in the context of martial arts, spiritual disciplines, or personal development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都去道觀修練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 dou6 gun1 sau1 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都去道观修炼。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the Taoist temple to practice self-cultivation every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間修練自己嘅功夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 sau1 lin6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间修炼自己的功夫。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time practicing his martial arts skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想成功就要不斷修練自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 sing4 gung1 zau6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 sau1 lin6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想要成功就要不断修炼自己。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to succeed, you need to constantly cultivate yourself.

synonyms: 鍛鍊 (duan3 lin4 in Mandarin, dyun3 lin6 in Cantonese)
修行 (xiu1 xing2 in Mandarin, sau1 hang4 in Cantonese)

english_meaning: Scene of carnage; fierce battleground; chaotic situation; embarrassing scene involving love triangles or conflicts.
explanation_mandarin: 源于佛教用语，指阿修罗之间互相争斗的战场。引申指非常混乱、争斗激烈的场合，特别是感情方面的纠纷或冲突所造成的尴尬局面。
explanation_english: Originating from Buddhist terminology, referring to the battleground where Asuras fight each other. It is used metaphorically to describe a very chaotic and fiercely competitive situation, especially an embarrassing situation caused by emotional disputes or conflicts, often involving love triangles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三個嘅感情關係真係修羅場咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 ge3 gam2 cing4 gwaan1 hai6 zan1 hai6 sau1 lo4 coeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三个人的感情关系真像修罗场一样。
examples.english_sentence: The emotional relationship between those three is really like a scene of carnage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，佢哋嘈到好似修羅場咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge2 zan6, keoi5 dei6 cou4 dou3 hou2 ci5 sau1 lo4 coeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他们吵得像修罗场一样。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, they were arguing so loudly, it was like a chaotic battleground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅競爭好激烈，日日都好似修羅場噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, jat1 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 sau1 lo4 coeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的竞争非常激烈，每天都像修罗场一样。
examples.english_sentence: The competition in this company is very fierce, it's like a battleground every day.

english_meaning: to study; to learn; to take a course
explanation_mandarin: 学习；修习课程，通常指系统性的学习。
explanation_english: To study; to take a course of study. Often refers to systematic learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個學期會修習法文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 wui5 sau1 zaap6 faat3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个学期会修习法文。
examples.english_sentence: I will be taking French next semester.

examples.jyutping_sentence: kei5 hai2 saan1 deng2 ho2 ji5 fu2 ham3 sing4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 站在山顶可以俯瞰整个城市。
examples.english_sentence: Standing on the mountaintop, you can have a bird's-eye view of the entire city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由飛機上面俯瞰，啲樓好似積木咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 fei1 gei1 soeng6 min6 fu2 ham3, di1 lau2 hou2 ci5 zik1 muk6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从飞机上俯瞰，那些楼房好像积木一样。
examples.english_sentence: Looking down from the plane, the buildings look like building blocks.

english_meaning: prone (lying face down)
explanation_mandarin: 身体朝下，脸朝下的躺着。
explanation_english: To lie with the front of the body facing downwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發燒發到成個人都軟晒，淨係識得喺張床上面俯臥住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 siu1 faat3 dou3 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 jyun5 saai3, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hai2 zoeng1 chong4 soeng6 min6 fu2 ngo6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发烧烧得浑身无力，只会趴在床上。
examples.english_sentence: He had a fever and was so weak that he could only lie prone on the bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做掌上壓嘅時候，首先要俯臥喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zoeng2 soeng6 aat3 ge3 si4 hau6, sau2 sin1 jiu3 fu2 ngo6 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做俯卧撑的时候，首先要俯卧在地上。
examples.english_sentence: When doing push-ups, you first need to lie prone on the ground.

english_meaning: to swoop down; to dive; to plummet
explanation_mandarin: 指从高处快速向下冲，通常形容飞行器或鸟类。
explanation_english: To rush downward from a high position, often used to describe the movement of aircraft or birds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機突然間俯衝落嚟，嚇死人喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 dat6 jin4 gaan1 fu2 cung1 lok6 lai4, haak3 sei2 jan4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机突然俯冲下来，吓死人了！
examples.english_sentence: The airplane suddenly swooped down, it was so scary!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老鷹發現獵物，就即刻俯衝落去捉佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 ying1 faat3 yin6 lip6 mat6, zau6 jik1 hak1 fu2 cung1 lok6 heoi3 zuk1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老鹰发现猎物，就立刻俯冲下去抓它。
examples.english_sentence: When the eagle spotted its prey, it immediately dived down to catch it.

english_meaning: Angle of depression; downward angle
explanation_mandarin: 指从高处向下看时，视线与水平线之间的夹角。
explanation_english: Refers to the angle between the line of sight and the horizontal line when looking down from a higher position. It's the downward angle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由呢個俯角望落去，成個城市都好似細咗好多噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 ni1 go3 fu2 gok3 mong6 lok6 heoi3, sing4 go3 sing4 si5 dou1 hou2 ci5 sai3 zo2 hou2 do1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从这个俯角看下去，整个城市好像小了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Looking down from this angle of depression, the whole city seems much smaller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攝影師用咗個俯角嚟影張相，睇落個人好細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se3 ying2 si1 yung6 zo2 go3 fu2 gok3 lai4 ying2 zoeng1 soeng2, tai2 lok6 go3 jan4 hou2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摄影师用了个俯角来拍这张照片，看上去人很小。
examples.english_sentence: The photographer used a downward angle to take this photo, making the person look very small.

english_meaning: to bow one's head; to submit; to yield
explanation_mandarin: 低头表示顺服或屈服。也指低着头。
explanation_english: To bow one's head, indicating submission or yielding. It can also simply mean to lower one's head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最後都係俯首認罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 fu2 sau2 jing6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最后还是俯首认罪了。
examples.english_sentence: He eventually bowed his head and confessed his guilt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺強權面前，佢選擇咗俯首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 koeng4 kyun4 min6 cin4, keoi5 syun2 zaak6 zo2 fu2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在强权面前，他选择了屈服。
examples.english_sentence: He chose to submit in the face of powerful forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係俯首執起地上嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 fu2 sau2 zap1 hei2 dei6 soeng6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是低头捡起地上的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He just lowered his head to pick up something from the ground.

english_meaning: to be completely obedient, to submit meekly, to be submissive and obedient
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常顺从，恭顺的样子。俯首：低头；帖耳：耳朵贴着脸，表示恭顺。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being extremely obedient and compliant. '俯首' (fu2 sau2) means to lower one's head, and '帖耳' (tip3 ji5) means the ears are close to the face, indicating obedience and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老細面前，永遠都係俯首帖耳，乜都聽佢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4, wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 fu2 sau2 tip3 ji5, mat1 dou1 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前，永远都是俯首帖耳，什么都听他的。
examples.english_sentence: He is always completely obedient in front of his boss, listening to everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我會對你俯首帖耳，我唔會任你擺佈㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 wui5 deoi3 nei5 fu2 sau2 tip3 ji5, ngo5 m4 wui5 jam6 nei5 baai2 bou6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为我会对你服服帖帖的，我不会任你摆布的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I'll be completely obedient to you; I won't let you control me!

english_meaning: to bow the head and acknowledge oneself as a subject; to submit unconditionally
explanation_mandarin: 低头表示臣服，比喻完全屈服。
explanation_english: To bow one's head and acknowledge oneself as a subject of a ruler. Figuratively, it means to submit unconditionally or surrender completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢幾勁都好，我都唔會咁易俯首稱臣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 keoi5 gei2 ging6 dou1 hou2, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 gam3 ji6 fu2 sau2 cing1 san4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算他再厉害，我也不会轻易俯首称臣的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he's really good, I won't submit to him that easily.

english_meaning: all; entirely; completely; together
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，都。
explanation_english: Indicates 'all', 'entirely', 'completely', or 'together'. It implies that everything or everyone is included.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋俱係學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 geoi1 hai6 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们都是学生。
examples.english_sentence: They are all students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢俱賣晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 geoi1 maai6 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西都卖完了。
examples.english_sentence: Everything is sold out.

english_meaning: complete; all-inclusive; comprehensive
explanation_mandarin: 指所有需要的東西都齊備。
explanation_english: Refers to having everything necessary; complete in all respects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式真係應有盡有，中西日韓俱全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 zan1 hai6 ying1 yau5 zeon6 yau5, zung1 sai1 jat6 hon4 keoi1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜品真是应有尽有，中西日韩的都有。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant really has everything, including Chinese, Western, Japanese, and Korean cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋嘅設備好俱全，可以即刻搬入去住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 ge3 sat1 bei6 hou2 keoi1 cyun4, ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 bun1 jap6 heoi3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子的设备很齐全，可以立刻搬进去住。
examples.english_sentence: The house is fully equipped and you can move in right away.

english_meaning: club
explanation_mandarin: 指具有特定目的或兴趣爱好的人们组成的团体，并常设有活动场所。
explanation_english: A group of people organized for a particular purpose or activity, often with a dedicated place for meetings and activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候參加過學校嘅美術俱樂部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 caam1 gaa1 gwo3 hok6 haau6 ge3 mei5 seot6 keoi1 lok6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候参加过学校的美术俱乐部。
examples.english_sentence: I joined the art club at school when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有個健身俱樂部，你想唔想去睇下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 go3 gin6 san1 keoi1 lok6 bou6, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有个健身俱乐部，你想不想去看看？
examples.english_sentence: There's a fitness club here, do you want to go check it out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個足球俱樂部嘅忠實粉絲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zuk1 kau4 keoi1 lok6 bou6 ge3 zung1 sat6 fan2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是足球俱乐部的忠实粉丝。
examples.english_sentence: He is a loyal fan of the football club.

mandarin_meaning: 逗留; 徘徊; 閒逛
english_meaning: To linger; to loiter; to hang around
explanation_mandarin: 指无目的地在某处停留或走动，通常带有闲散或等待的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to staying or walking around a place aimlessly, often with a sense of leisure or waiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公園度俳，唔知做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 paai1, m4 zi1 dou3 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是呆在公园里闲逛，不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He is always loitering in the park, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人哋門口俳啦，好阻埞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 dei6 mun4 hau2 paai1 laa1, hou2 zo2 deng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在别人门口徘徊了，很碍事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hang around in front of other people's doors, it's very obstructive.

english_meaning: Haiku
explanation_mandarin: 一种日本传统短诗，由五、七、五共十七个音节组成。
explanation_english: A traditional form of Japanese poetry consisting of three lines with a syllable count of 5, 7, and 5, respectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗好多首關於秋天嘅俳句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 sau2 gwaan1 jyu1 chau1 tin1 ge3 paai4 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了很多首关于秋天的俳句。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote many haikus about autumn.

english_meaning: salary; stipend; emolument
explanation_mandarin: 古代官吏的薪水，也泛指薪水。
explanation_english: Formerly, salary or stipend of an official. Now, generally refers to salary or wages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份俸祿唔錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 fung2 luk6 m4 co3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的薪水不错。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅官員靠收受賄賂嚟增加俸祿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 gun1 jyun4 kaau3 sau1 sau6 wai6 lu3 lai4 zang1 gaa1 fung2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的官员靠收受贿赂来增加俸禄。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, officials relied on bribes to increase their salary.

english_meaning: Careless, sloppy, sloppy, negligent; shoddy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不认真，马虎，或者形容衣着不整洁，邋遢。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless or negligent in their work, or describes someone who is untidy and sloppy in their appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好俹㗎，成日都出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 laat3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很马虎，总是出错。
examples.english_sentence: He is very careless in his work and often makes mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好着得咁俹出街啦，影响市容㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoek3 dak1 gam3 laat3 ceot1 gaai1 laa1, jing2 hoeng2 si5 jung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要穿得那么邋遢出门，影响市容的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dress so sloppily when you go out, it affects the appearance of the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份报告写得好俹，要重新写过。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 laat3, jiu3 cung4 san1 se2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得很马虎，要重新写过。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written very carelessly, it needs to be rewritten.

english_meaning: I, me (informal, rustic)
explanation_mandarin: 俺是粤语中非正式的，略带乡土气息的“我”的说法。通常用于比较随意的场合，或者想表达一种比较亲切、朴实的感觉。
explanation_english: "俺" is an informal and somewhat rustic way of saying "I" or "me" in Cantonese. It's typically used in casual situations or to express a friendly, down-to-earth feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俺覺得呢個主意唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan2 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这个主意不错。
examples.english_sentence: I think this idea is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣講俺啦，俺會唔好意思嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 gong2 aan2 laa1, aan2 wui5 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说我啦，我会不好意思的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about me, I'll be embarrassed.

synonyms: 自己 (zi6 gei2) - in some contexts

english_meaning: to give; to let; to allow
explanation_mandarin: 给予；让；允许
explanation_english: To give; to let; to allow someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾啲錢我吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 cin2 ngo5 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我点钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾我睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我看看。
examples.english_sentence: Let me see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他走。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him go.

english_meaning: to be done to (by someone), to be acted upon (by someone)
explanation_mandarin: 表示被动，遭受某事，被某人做了某事。
explanation_english: Indicates the passive voice, meaning 'to be done to' or 'to be acted upon' by someone. It implies that someone is the recipient of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾人呃咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被人骗了钱。
examples.english_sentence: I was scammed out of my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被炒鱿鱼了。
examples.english_sentence: He was fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢俾人攞晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 bei2 jan4 lo2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西都被人拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: Everything has been taken by someone.

english_meaning: To be taken advantage of; to be manipulated; to be exploited; to be swindled
explanation_mandarin: 指被人占便宜，被人利用，被人欺负或摆布。
explanation_english: Refers to being taken advantage of, exploited, manipulated, or swindled by someone. The literal translation is 'to be stewed by someone,' implying being cooked slowly and thoroughly to the other person's advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁老實，成日俾人燉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lou5 sat6, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太老实了，总是被人欺负。
examples.english_sentence: He's so honest, he always gets taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢呀，唔好俾人燉啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 aa3, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 deon6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨啊，别被人摆布了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't let yourself be manipulated!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司好衰㗎，專登燉啲新嚟嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 seoi1 gaa3, zyun1 dang3 deon6 di1 san1 lai4 ge3 gung1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司很坏的，专门欺负新来的员工。
examples.english_sentence: That company is really bad, they deliberately exploit new employees.

english_meaning: to be given the side-eye; to be looked down upon; to be scorned
explanation_mandarin: 指因为做了不好的事情或者不受欢迎，被人用眼睛向上翻，露出眼白，表示轻视或厌恶。
explanation_english: Refers to being scorned or looked down upon by someone rolling their eyes at you, exposing the whites of their eyes. It signifies contempt, disapproval, or disgust towards someone's actions or character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到咗成個鐘，俾阿Sir白眼都抵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, bei2 aa3 Sir1 baak6 ngaan5 dou1 dai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迟到了一个小时，被老师翻白眼也是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: I was an hour late, so it's fair enough that the teacher gave me the side-eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，淨係掛住玩，梗係俾人白眼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, zing6 hai6 gwaa3 zyu6 waan2, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 baak6 ngaan5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天不做事，只顾着玩，当然会被人翻白眼啦。
examples.english_sentence: He does nothing but play all day, of course he'll be given the side-eye.

english_meaning: To give way; to make room; to give (someone) a chance; to yield a position (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 给予或腾出空间；给予机会或让步。可以是实际的让出座位，也可以是比喻意义的给予机会或权力。
explanation_english: To give or vacate space; to give an opportunity or concession. Can be a literal yielding of a seat or a figurative giving of an opportunity or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆上車，你俾位佢坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 soeng5 ce1, nei5 bei2 wai2 keoi5 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶上车了，你给她让个座吧。
examples.english_sentence: The elderly woman got on the bus, you should give her your seat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有勢力，好難俾位後生仔上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 sai3 lik6, hou2 naan4 bei2 wai2 hau6 saang1 zai2 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里很有势力，很难给年轻人机会上位。
examples.english_sentence: He is very influential in the company, it's hard to give younger people a chance to advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾位我諗下，我決定咗再覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 wai2 ngo5 lam2 haa5, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zoi3 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给我点时间想想，我决定了再回复你。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some time to think about it, I'll reply to you once I've made a decision.

jyutping: bei2 go3 dung1 gwaa1 nei5 zou6 daam2
english_meaning: To give you a winter melon to use as courage/gall
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人胆小如鼠，胆子小到需要用冬瓜来代替。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being extremely timid, implying their courage is so lacking that a winter melon would have to substitute for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁驚青，真係要俾個冬瓜你做膽至得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 geng1 ceng1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 bei2 go3 dung1 gwaa1 nei5 zou6 daam2 zi3 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么害怕，真的要给你个冬瓜当胆子才行了。
examples.english_sentence: You are so easily scared, you really need a winter melon to use as courage.

jyutping: bei2 go3 tin1 nei5 zou6 daam2
mandarin_meaning: 胆大包天; 胆子大得没边
english_meaning: To be extremely audacious; to have extreme confidence; to be recklessly bold.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人胆子极大，什么都不怕，肆无忌惮。比喻人非常大胆，甚至到了无法无天的程度。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is incredibly daring and fearless, to the point of being reckless. It implies that the person has so much confidence that they are beyond the bounds of reasonable behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁都敢做，真係俾個天佢做膽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 dou1 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 bei2 go3 tin1 keoi5 zou6 daam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然敢做这样的事，真是胆大包天！
examples.english_sentence: He dares to do such a thing, he's really recklessly bold!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁俾個天自己做膽，小心出事呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 bei2 go3 tin1 zi6 gei2 zou6 daam2, siu2 sam1 ceot1 si6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么胆大妄为，小心出事啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so recklessly bold, be careful something bad happens!

english_meaning: To give you an official position; a sarcastic remark implying someone is acting like they have authority when they don't.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是给你一个官位让你来当。通常是讽刺别人自以为是，假装自己有权力，实际上没有。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to give you an official position to do.' It's usually used sarcastically to imply someone is acting as if they have authority or importance when they actually don't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使唔使俾個官你做呀？乜嘢都管！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 bei2 go3 gun1 nei5 zou6 aa3? mat1 je5 dou1 gun2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要不要给你个官当啊？什么都管！
examples.english_sentence: Do you want me to give you an official position? You control everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞氣啦，又唔係俾個官你做，使唔使咁緊張呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou4 hei3 laa1, jau6 m4 hai6 bei2 go3 gun1 nei5 zou6, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么生气了，又不是给你当官，用不用这么紧张啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, it's not like you're getting an official position, why so stressed?

english_meaning: Business card, calling card
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于商业或个人用途的卡片，上面印有姓名、联系方式等信息。
explanation_english: A small card printed with a person's name, job title, company, and contact information, used for professional or personal networking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該俾張卡片我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bei2 zoeng1 kaa1 pin3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一张名片。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a business card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度派緊卡片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 paai3 gan2 kaa1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在这里发名片。
examples.english_sentence: I'm handing out business cards here.

english_meaning: to give a business card; to exchange business cards
explanation_mandarin: 递交名片，通常在社交场合或商务交往中使用。
explanation_english: To give or exchange business cards, typically used in social or business situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次見面，我哋通常會互相俾咭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6, ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 wu6 soeng1 bei2 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次见面，我们通常会互相给名片。
examples.english_sentence: The first time we meet, we usually exchange business cards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好唔記得俾咭俾佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 bei2 kaat1 bei2 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要忘记给他名片啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't forget to give him your business card!

english_meaning: To be struck by Heaven; to be punished by Heaven; to be cursed by God
explanation_mandarin: 指做坏事的人会受到上天的惩罚。是一种诅咒或愤怒的表达。
explanation_english: Used to express the belief that someone who does bad deeds will be punished by Heaven (or God). It's a curse or an expression of anger/disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰格，遲早俾天收！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, ci4 zou2 bei2 tin1 sau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，迟早会被天谴的！
examples.english_sentence: He's so awful, he'll be punished by Heaven sooner or later!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呃人錢嘅人，一定俾天收！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aak1 jan4 cin2 ge3 jan4, jat1 ding6 bei2 tin1 sau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骗别人钱的人，一定会遭天谴的！
examples.english_sentence: People who cheat others out of their money will surely be punished by Heaven!

english_meaning: to put your heart into something; to work hard; to make an effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示用心、努力去做某事，希望能够做好。
explanation_english: To put your heart and effort into doing something; to work hard with the intention of doing it well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試啦，你要俾心機溫書啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3 laa3, nei5 jiu3 bei2 sam1 gei1 wan1 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试了，你要用心复习啊！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, you need to put your heart into studying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好重要，你要俾心機做啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 zung6 jiu3, nei5 jiu3 bei2 sam1 gei1 zou6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很重要，你要努力做啊！
examples.english_sentence: This job is very important, you need to put effort into it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然好難，但係都要俾心機學落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hou2 naan4, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 bei2 sam1 gei1 hok6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然很难，但是也要努力地学下去。
examples.english_sentence: Although it's difficult, you still need to put effort into learning it.

mandarin_meaning: 即使给我我都不会要/看上
english_meaning: I wouldn't even consider it/him/her/them; I wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole; I wouldn't give it a second glance
explanation_mandarin: 表示即使免费给，或者条件再好，也绝对不会接受或喜欢。形容非常嫌弃或不屑一顾。
explanation_english: Indicates a strong dislike or disdain for something or someone. Even if offered for free or under favorable conditions, one would not accept or consider it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅衰樣，俾我都唔吼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 seoi1 joeng2, bei2 ngo5 dou1 m4 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长那么丑的样子，即使给我我都不会要的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so ugly, I wouldn't even consider him if you gave him to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋咁殘舊，俾我都唔吼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gam3 caan4 gau6, bei2 ngo5 dou1 m4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间房子这么破旧，即使给我我都不会要的。
examples.english_sentence: That house is so dilapidated, I wouldn't even consider it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人咁乞人憎，俾我都唔吼佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gam3 hat1 jan4 zang1, bei2 ngo5 dou1 m4 hau2 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的为人那么令人讨厌，即使给我我都不会和他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an annoying person, I wouldn't even consider being his friend.

synonyms: 睇都唔睇一眼 (tai2 dou1 m4 tai2 jat1 ngaan5)
睬佢都傻 (coi2 keoi5 dou1 so4)

english_meaning: Even if you gave it to me, I wouldn't want it
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事物极度厌恶或不感兴趣，即使免费得到也不愿意接受。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong dislike or disinterest in something, to the point that one would not even accept it for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衫咁核突，俾我都唔睺啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saam1 gam3 hat6 dat1, bei2 ngo5 dou1 m4 hau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服那么丑，即使给我我也不要。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are so ugly, even if you gave them to me, I wouldn't want them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部舊電話咁慢，俾我都唔睺呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 gam3 maan6, bei2 ngo5 dou1 m4 hau1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电话这么慢，即使给我我也不要啊。
examples.english_sentence: This old phone is so slow, even if you gave it to me, I wouldn't want it.

jyutping: bei2 tiu4 sang1 lou6 haang4 haa5
mandarin_meaning: 给条活路走走; 给人一条生路
english_meaning: Give someone a chance to survive; Give someone a way out; Cut someone some slack.
explanation_mandarin: “俾”是“给”的意思。“生路”是“活路，生存的出路”的意思。“行下”是“走一下”的意思。整个短语的意思是“给人一条活路走走”，通常用于请求别人宽容或手下留情，不要把事情做绝，给别人留有余地。
explanation_english: "俾 (bei2)" means "to give". "生路 (sang1 lou6)" means "a way out; a chance to survive". "行下 (haang4 haa5)" means "to walk a bit; to give it a try". The whole phrase means "Give someone a way to survive." It is usually used to request someone to be lenient or show mercy, not to push things to the extreme, and to leave some leeway for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細，我知錯喇，俾條生路行下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3, ngo5 zi1 co3 laa3, bei2 tiu4 sang1 lou6 haang4 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，我知道错了，就给我一条活路走吧！
examples.english_sentence: Boss, I know I'm wrong. Please give me a chance!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大佬，我唔係故意嘅，俾條生路行下吖！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lou2, ngo5 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ge3, bei2 tiu4 sang1 lou6 haang4 haa5 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大哥，我不是故意的，给我一条活路吧！
examples.english_sentence: Big brother, I didn't do it on purpose, please cut me some slack!

synonyms: 網開一面 (mong5 hoi1 jat1 min6)

english_meaning: to add oil; to refuel; to cheer on; to encourage
explanation_mandarin: 原指给汽车加油，引申为鼓励、支持某人或某事，使之更有力量或热情。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to add oil'. It can refer to refuelling a vehicle but is more commonly used figuratively to mean to cheer someone on, encourage them, or boost their efforts. Similar to the English phrase 'to give someone a boost'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考緊試呀，大家俾油啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gan2 si3 aa3, daai6 gaa1 bei2 jau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正在考试，大家加油啊！
examples.english_sentence: Exams are happening, everyone cheer up and do your best!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車冇油，要去俾油先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4, jiu3 heoi3 bei2 jau4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车没油了，要先去加油才行。
examples.english_sentence: The car is out of fuel, we need to refuel it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力，我哋梗係要俾油支持佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nou5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 gang2 hai6 jiu3 bei2 jau4 zi1 chi4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，我们当然要鼓励他支持他啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's working so hard, of course we have to encourage and support him.

english_meaning: if; in case; supposing; if it were...
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设关系，相当于“要是”、“如果”。
explanation_english: Expressing a hypothetical situation. Equivalent to 'if' or 'in case'. It sets up a conditional scenario.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾着我係你，我就唔會咁做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 ngo5 hai6 nei5, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我是你，我就不会这么做了。
examples.english_sentence: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾着聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明天下雨，我们就不会去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾着佢肯努力啲，成績一定會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 keoi5 hang2 nu5 lik6 di1, sing4 zik1 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他肯努力一点，成绩一定会更好。
examples.english_sentence: If he were willing to work a little harder, his grades would definitely be better.

mandarin_meaning: 要是...的话; 如果...的话
english_meaning: If; Suppose; If it were the case...
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设，相当于“要是”、“如果”。用于提出一个假设的情况，然后说明在这种情况下会发生什么。
explanation_english: Expresses a hypothetical situation, similar to 'if' or 'suppose'. Used to introduce a hypothetical scenario and then explain what would happen in that situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾著我係你，我就唔會咁做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 ngo5 hai6 nei5, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我是你，我就不会这么做了。
examples.english_sentence: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾著落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾著佢有錢，佢一定會買部新車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoek6 keoi5 jau5 cin2, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 maai5 bou6 san1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他有钱，他一定会买一辆新车。
examples.english_sentence: If he had money, he would definitely buy a new car.

english_meaning: To be (unexpectedly) humiliated or embarrassed (usually due to a blunder or misstep)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻某人因为疏忽或者失误而突然感到丢脸、尴尬，像是踩到西瓜皮一样，失去平衡，狼狈不堪。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone experiencing an unexpected humiliation or embarrassment due to a blunder, misstep, or oversight. It's like stepping on a watermelon rind and losing balance, leading to an awkward and shameful situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個會議上面講錯咗嘢，俾西瓜皮踩噉樣，好瘀呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 wui2 yi5 soeng6 min6 gong2 co3 zo2 je5, bei2 sai1 gwaa1 pei4 caai2 gam2 joeng2, hou2 yu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上说错了话，就像踩到西瓜皮一样，很丢脸啊。
examples.english_sentence: He said something wrong in the meeting, it was like stepping on a watermelon rind, so embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好醒，點知最後都係俾西瓜皮踩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 seng2, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 bei2 sai1 gwaa1 pei4 caai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很聪明，没想到最后还是栽了跟头。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he was so smart, but in the end, he still got humiliated.

english_meaning: to be told off, to be scolded, to receive criticism
explanation_mandarin: 指受到责备或批评。
explanation_english: Refers to being scolded, criticized, or reprimanded. Implies that someone has done something wrong and is receiving a verbal dressing-down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日遲到，梗係俾老細說話聽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gang2 hai6 bei2 lou5 sai3 syut3 waa2 teng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是迟到，肯定会被老板骂的。
examples.english_sentence: You're always late, of course you'll be told off by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔聽話，俾阿媽說話聽好正常㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 teng1 waa6, bei2 aa3 maa1 syut3 waa2 teng1 hou2 zing3 soeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不听话，被妈妈骂是很正常的。
examples.english_sentence: It's normal for kids to be scolded by their mother if they don't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，返屋企一定俾阿爸說話聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, faan1 uk1 kei2 jat1 ding6 bei2 aa3 baa1 syut3 waa2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，回家肯定会被爸爸骂的。
examples.english_sentence: This exam was so bad, I'm definitely going to be scolded by my dad when I get home.

english_meaning: to be scolded; to be criticized; to receive a lecture; to get a telling-off
explanation_mandarin: 指受到别人的批评或指责。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving criticism or being lectured by someone. It implies being on the receiving end of someone's disapproval or reprimand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔做功課，阿媽實俾說話你聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, aa3 maa1 sat1 bei2 syut3 waa2 nei5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不做作业，妈妈肯定会批评你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't do your homework again, your mom will definitely scold you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日我遲到，俾老闆俾咗一輪説話聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 ngo5 ci4 dou3, bei2 lou5 baan2 bei2 zo2 jat1 leon4 syut3 waa2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天我迟到了，被老板训了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I was late, and the boss gave me a lecture.

english_meaning: to give money, to pay
explanation_mandarin: 给予金钱，付款。
explanation_english: To give money to someone, to pay for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食完嘢要俾錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 jyun4 je5 jiu3 bei2 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃完东西要给钱的。
examples.english_sentence: You have to pay after you finish eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得俾錢我啊，我幫你買咗嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 bei2 cin2 ngo5 aa3, ngo5 bong1 nei5 maai5 zo2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得给我钱啊，我帮你买了东西。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to give me the money, I bought something for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爭人好多錢，成日俾人追住嚟俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 zeoi1 zyu6 lai4 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠人很多钱，总是被人追着要钱。
examples.english_sentence: He owes people a lot of money, and is always being chased for payment.

english_meaning: To be struck by lightning (used as a curse)
explanation_mandarin: 诅咒别人被雷劈，表示非常强烈的厌恶或愤怒。
explanation_english: A Cantonese curse wishing someone will be struck by lightning, expressing extreme dislike or anger. It's a strong and often impolite expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁衰格，真係應該俾雷劈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, zan1 hai6 jing1 goi1 bei2 leoi4 pek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么差劲，真应该被雷劈啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're such a terrible person, you really deserve to be struck by lightning!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講大話俾雷劈㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 leoi4 pek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说谎会被雷劈的！
examples.english_sentence: You'll be struck by lightning for lying!

mandarin_meaning: 给电话 / 留电话号码
english_meaning: To give (someone) a phone call / To give (someone) one's phone number.
explanation_mandarin: 指打电话给某人，或者给某人留下电话号码。
explanation_english: Refers to either giving someone a phone call or providing someone with one's phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日有俾電話我，但係我冇聽到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 jau5 bei2 din6 waa2 ngo5, daan6 hai6 ngo5 mou5 teng1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天有给我打电话，但是我没听到。
examples.english_sentence: He called me yesterday, but I didn't hear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以俾電話我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 din6 waa2 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I have your phone number?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得俾電話我，唔好唔記得呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 bei2 din6 waa2 ngo5, m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得给我打电话，不要忘记啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to call me, don't forget!

english_meaning: to give face (to someone)
explanation_mandarin: 给某人留面子，尊重某人，不让某人难堪。
explanation_english: To give someone face, to show respect to someone, to avoid embarrassing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我老細叫我做嘢，點都要俾啲面佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou5 sai3 giu3 ngo5 zou6 je5, dim2 dou1 jiu3 bei2 di1 min6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我做事，总要给他一点面子吧。
examples.english_sentence: My boss asked me to do something, I should give him some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁堅持，咪俾面佢，應承咗佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gin1 chi4, mai6 bei2 min6 keoi5, jing3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坚持，就给他个面子，答应他吧。
examples.english_sentence: He is so persistent, just give him face and agree to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次算俾面你，下次唔好再犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 chi3 syun3 bei2 min6 nei5, haa6 chi3 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次算给你面子，下次不要再犯。
examples.english_sentence: I'm giving you face this time, don't do it again next time.

english_meaning: A gathering or event where attendance or participation is primarily out of politeness or to show respect, rather than genuine interest.
explanation_mandarin: 指为了给对方一个面子而参加的聚会或活动，并非出于真正的兴趣或意愿。
explanation_english: Refers to a gathering or event that someone attends out of politeness or to give 'face' to the host, rather than from genuine interest or enjoyment. It emphasizes the social obligation or pressure to attend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴晚去咗個俾面派對，悶到我想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 maan1 heoi3 zo2 go3 bei2 min6 paai3 deoi3, mun6 dou3 ngo5 soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚去了一个给面子的聚会，闷得我想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I went to a 'giving face' party last night, it was so boring I wanted to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺結婚酒，就算唔熟都要去，當俾面派對啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 git3 fan1 zau2, zau6 syun3 m4 suk6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3, dong3 bei2 min6 paai3 deoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他办结婚喜宴，就算不熟也要去，就当是给面子的聚会吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's having a wedding banquet, even if we're not close, we still have to go, consider it a 'giving face' party.

english_meaning: sleep paralysis
explanation_mandarin: 指睡眠时感觉自己清醒，但无法移动身体，好像被鬼压住一样。
explanation_english: Refers to the experience of being conscious but unable to move during sleep. It's often described as feeling like something is pressing down on you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚我瞓覺俾鬼矺，郁都郁唔到，好恐怖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 ngaan1 ngo5 fan3 gaau3 bei2 gwai2 caak3, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2, hou2 hung2 bou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚我睡觉鬼压床了，动都动不了，好恐怖啊！
examples.english_sentence: Last night I experienced sleep paralysis. I couldn't move at all. It was so scary!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講壓力太大嘅時候，容易俾鬼矺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6 ge3 si4 hau6, jung4 ji6 bei2 gwai2 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说压力太大的时候，容易鬼压床。
examples.english_sentence: It's said that when you're under a lot of stress, you're more likely to experience sleep paralysis.

english_meaning: To be very unlucky; to be jinxed; to be haunted by bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常倒霉，运气极差，好像被鬼捉弄了一样。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme bad luck or misfortune, as if one is being tormented by ghosts. It implies that the bad luck is unusual and severe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係俾鬼砸啊，返工遲到，仲要俾老細鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 bei2 gwai2 zaap6 aa3, faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真是倒霉透了，上班迟到，还要被老板骂。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really jinxed today! I was late for work and got scolded by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做咩都唔順利，可能俾鬼砸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 me1 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6, ho2 nang4 bei2 gwai2 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近做什么都不顺利，可能撞邪了。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't had any luck with anything recently; he might be jinxed.

english_meaning: To be pinned down by a ghost; to be extremely unlucky; to have a string of bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“被鬼压住”。 原指睡觉时感觉胸闷，无法动弹，好像被鬼压在身上。引申为非常倒霉，做什么都不顺利。
explanation_english: Literally means "to be pinned down by a ghost." Originally refers to the sensation of being unable to move while sleeping, as if a ghost were pressing down on you. By extension, it means to be extremely unlucky, with everything going wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係俾鬼磧，返工遲到，仲要俾老細鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 bei2 gwai2 zaak3, faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真是倒霉透顶，上班迟到，还被老板骂了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really having a string of bad luck today. I was late for work, and my boss scolded me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁愁眉苦臉啦，都唔係俾鬼磧，下次做好啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5 laa1, dou1 m4 hai6 bei2 gwai2 zaak3, haa6 ci3 zou6 hou2 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要愁眉苦脸的，又不是倒了大霉，下次做好点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so gloomy, it's not like you're having the worst luck ever. Just do better next time.

english_meaning: sleep paralysis; to be pinned down by a ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指睡眠时感到身体无法动弹，好像被鬼压住一样。
explanation_english: Refers to the sensation of being unable to move during sleep, as if being pinned down by a ghost. This is sleep paralysis, a condition where one is temporarily unable to move or speak upon waking or falling asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋晚瞓瞓吓俾鬼責，郁都郁唔到，好恐怖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 maan1 fan3 fan3 haa5 bei2 gwai2 zaak3, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2, hou2 hung2 bou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚睡着睡着突然鬼压床了，动都动不了，好恐怖啊！
examples.english_sentence: I experienced sleep paralysis last night while sleeping. I couldn't move at all. It was so scary!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能你太攰，所以先會俾鬼責嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 nei5 taai3 gui6, so2 ji5 sin1 wui5 bei2 gwai2 zaak3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能你太累了，所以才会鬼压床的。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe you're too tired, that's why you experienced sleep paralysis.

english_meaning: to be bewitched, to be infatuated; to be blinded by something (like love, money, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容被某种事物迷惑，失去理智，就像被鬼附身一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is so infatuated or obsessed with something that they lose their reason or good judgment, as if possessed by a ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾鬼迷啊？點解要借咁多錢俾佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 gwai2 mai4 aa3? dim2 gai2 jiu3 ze3 gam3 do1 cin2 bei2 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你鬼迷心窍了吗？ 为什么借这么多钱给他？
examples.english_sentence: Are you out of your mind? Why would you lend him so much money?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾個明星迷到俾鬼迷咁，日日掛住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 ming4 sing1 mai4 dou3 bei2 gwai2 mai4 gam2, jat1 jat1 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被那个明星迷得神魂颠倒，每天都想着他。
examples.english_sentence: She's so infatuated with that celebrity, she thinks about him every day.

english_meaning: to be teased; to be made fun of; to be played for a fool; to be tricked
explanation_mandarin: 指被人戏弄、捉弄、愚弄，被人占了便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to being teased, made fun of, tricked, or taken advantage of by someone else. It implies that the person being 'teased by the turtle' has been made to look foolish or naive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日俾龜逗，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei2 gwai1 dau6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是被人捉弄，真可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He is always being made fun of, it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易信人呀，唔係好易俾龜逗㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 jan4 aa3, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 bei2 gwai1 dau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易相信别人，不然很容易被耍的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, otherwise you'll be easily fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾條sales 龜逗咗，買咗啲無用嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 tiu4 sales gwai1 dau6 zo2, maai5 zo2 di1 mou4 jung6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被那个销售员耍了，买了一些没用的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I was tricked by the salesman and bought some useless things.

mandarin_meaning: 被人利用的人；被人占便宜的人
english_meaning: Someone who is easily taken advantage of; a sucker; a dupe
explanation_mandarin: 指容易被欺骗、利用，占便宜的人。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is easily deceived, taken advantage of, or exploited. Usually has a negative connotation. It implies the person is naive and easily fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁容易信人，真係抵你俾人當倀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4, zan1 hai6 dai2 nei5 bei2 jan4 dong3 caang1.
