english_meaning: to go back on one's word; to renege on a promise; to back out of a deal
explanation_mandarin: 指在协议或者承诺之后，改变主意，不履行约定。类似于反悔、毁约。
explanation_english: Refers to changing one's mind and not fulfilling an agreement or promise after it has been made. Similar to reneging or breaking a contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之前傾好咗個價，你而家唔可以倒掟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 king1 hou2 zo2 go3 gaa3, nei5 ji4 gaa1 m4 ho2 ji5 dou2 deng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之前已经谈好了价格，你现在不可以反悔的！
examples.english_sentence: We already agreed on the price before, you can't go back on your word now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日倒掟，下次唔好再同佢合作啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou2 deng3, haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是出尔反尔，下次不要再和他合作了。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes back on his word, let's not cooperate with him again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為講完就算，唔可以倒掟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 gong2 jyun4 zau6 syun3, m4 ho2 ji5 dou2 deng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为说完就算了，不可以反悔的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just saying it is enough, you can't back out of it!

english_meaning: to fall head over heels; to fall headfirst; to tumble head over heels
explanation_mandarin: 指头部朝下摔倒，也形容一下子失去平衡摔倒。
explanation_english: Refers to falling headfirst, or losing balance and tumbling. Often used to describe a sudden and uncontrolled fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，差啲倒掟頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, caa1 di1 dou2 ding3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，差点摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: He was not careful while walking and almost fell head over heels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔喺公園玩，唔小心倒掟頭，喊晒口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 hai2 gung1 jyun2 waan2, m4 siu2 sam1 dou2 ding3 tau4, haam3 saai3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子在公园玩，不小心摔倒了，哭了起来。
examples.english_sentence: The child was playing in the park and accidentally fell headfirst, crying.

english_meaning: countdown
explanation_mandarin: 动词：按相反的顺序数数，尤指从大的数字到小的数字，通常与计时有关。名词：按相反顺序数数的行为或过程。
explanation_english: Verb: To count backward to zero, often in relation to a set time period or event. Noun: The act or process of counting backward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊倒數新年！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 dou3 sou3 san1 nin4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起倒数新年！
examples.english_sentence: Let's countdown to the New Year together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有十日就考試啦，開始倒數！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 sap6 jat6 zau6 haau2 si5 laa1, hoi1 ci2 dou3 sou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 还有十天就考试了，开始倒数！
examples.english_sentence: There are only ten days left until the exam, let's start the countdown!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會之前會有倒數㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 zi1 cin4 wui5 jau5 dou3 sou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会之前会有倒数的。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a countdown before the concert.

english_meaning: to die suddenly and unexpectedly, especially in public; to be found dead (often implying an undignified or unexpected death)
explanation_mandarin: 指突然死亡，通常指在公共场所或无人看管的情况下死去，带有不体面或意外的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to dying suddenly and unexpectedly, often in a public place or unattended, implying an undignified or unexpected death. It can also imply dying from overexertion or due to extreme hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日OT，驚佢有一日會喺公司倒斃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ou1 ti1, geng1 keoi5 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou2 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常加班，担心他有一天会在公司猝死。
examples.english_sentence: He works overtime all the time, I'm worried he'll drop dead at the office one day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日新聞話有個露宿者喺街邊倒斃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 san1 man4 waa6 jau5 go3 lou6 suk1 ze2 hai2 gaai1 bin1 dou2 bai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天新闻说有个露宿者在街边暴毙了。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday the news reported that a homeless person was found dead on the street.

english_meaning: reflection, reflected image
explanation_mandarin: 指物体在水面、镜面等光滑表面形成的影像。
explanation_english: The image of an object reflected in a surface such as water or a mirror.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 湖面嘅倒映好靚啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu4 min6 ge3 dou3 ying2 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 湖面的倒影很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: The reflection on the lake surface is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺玻璃窗上面見到自己嘅倒映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bo1 lei1 cheung1 soeng6 min6 gin3 dou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 dou3 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在玻璃窗上看到了自己的倒影。
examples.english_sentence: He saw his reflection in the glass window.

english_meaning: Sudden cold spell after the beginning of spring; Late spring cold snap
explanation_mandarin: 指春天天气转暖后，突然出现一段时间的寒冷天气。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden return to cold weather after the weather has started to warm up in spring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅倒春寒好犀利，搞到啲花都謝晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 dou2 ceon1 hon4 hou2 sai1 lei6, gaau2 dou3 di1 faa1 dou1 se6晒。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的倒春寒很厉害，弄得花都谢了。
examples.english_sentence: This year's late spring cold snap is very strong, causing all the flowers to wither.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話下個禮拜會有倒春寒，記得著多件衫呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 jau5 dou2 ceon1 hon4, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台说下个星期会有倒春寒，记得多穿一件衣服啊。
examples.english_sentence: The observatory says there will be a late spring cold snap next week, remember to wear an extra layer of clothing.

english_meaning: Putting the cart before the horse; to mistake the effect for the cause
explanation_mandarin: 把结果当成原因，颠倒因果关系。
explanation_english: To reverse cause and effect; to mistake the result for the cause. To treat something as a cause that is actually an effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣諗嘢係倒果為因嚟㗎，佢成功唔係因為懶，而係因為佢背後嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 nam2 je5 hai6 dou3 gwo2 wai4 yan1 lai4 gaa3, keoi5 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 laan5, ji4 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 bui3 hau6 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样想是本末倒置了，他成功不是因为懒，而是因为他背后的努力。
examples.english_sentence: You're thinking about this the wrong way; you're putting the cart before the horse. He succeeded not because he was lazy, but because of the hard work he put in behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倒果為因，唔係因為你唔開心所以落雨，係因為落雨所以你唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dou3 gwo2 wai4 yan1, m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1 so2 ji5 lok6 jyu5, hai6 jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5 so2 ji5 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要本末倒置，不是因为你不开心所以下雨，是因为下雨所以你不开心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the cart before the horse; it's not raining because you're unhappy, it's that you're unhappy because it's raining.

english_meaning: to put the cart before the horse; to mistake the effect for the cause; reverse cause and effect
explanation_mandarin: 把结果当成原因，颠倒了事情的因果关系。
explanation_english: To mistake the result for the cause; to reverse the cause and effect; to put the cart before the horse. It refers to incorrectly identifying the cause of a situation, leading to flawed reasoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格就話個老師教得唔好，根本係倒果爲因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gaak3 zau6 waa6 go3 lou5 si1 gaau3 dak1 m4 hou2, gan1 bun2 hai6 dou2 gwo2 wai4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试没及格就说老师教得不好，根本是颠倒因果。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and blamed the teacher for not teaching well, which is completely putting the cart before the horse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倒果爲因，唔係你勤力先有收穫㗎咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dou2 gwo2 wai4 jan1, m4 hai6 nei5 kan4 lik6 sin1 jau5 sau1 wok6 gaa3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要颠倒因果，不是你努力才会有收获的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the cart before the horse. Isn't it that you only get results because you work hard?

english_meaning: unlucky, to have bad luck, to be out of luck
explanation_mandarin: 表示运气不好，遭遇不幸的事情。
explanation_english: Describes a situation of having bad luck or experiencing unfortunate events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係倒楣，返工遲到又整爛咗電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 dou2 mui1, faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3 jau6 zeng2 laan6 zo2 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真倒霉，上班迟到又弄坏了手机。
examples.english_sentence: Today is really unlucky, I was late for work and broke my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倒楣啦，下次會好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dou2 mui1 laa1, haa6 ci3 wui5 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么倒霉啦，下次会好一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unlucky, it will be better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日炒股票輸咗好多錢，真係倒楣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 caau2 gu2 piu3 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 dou2 mui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天炒股输了很多钱，真倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money speculating on stocks yesterday, how unlucky.

english_meaning: to make a mold; to cast; identical; carbon copy
explanation_mandarin: 原指用模子翻製，現在多用來形容事物或人非常相似，一模一樣。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the process of making a mold or casting something, it is now commonly used to describe things or people that are very similar or identical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹倒模咁款，唔係熟人真係分唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 dou3 mou4 gam2 kwan2, m4 hai6 suk6 jan4 zan1 hai6 fan1 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们姐妹俩长得一模一样，不是熟人真的分不出来。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters look identical; you really can't tell them apart unless you know them well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲設計成日都倒模人哋嘅，完全冇創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 cit3 gai3 sing4 jat6 dou1 dou3 mou4 jan4 dei6 ge3, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的设计总是抄袭别人的，完全没有创意。
examples.english_sentence: This company's designs always copy others; they have no creativity at all.

synonyms: 一模一樣 (jat1 mou4 jat1 joeng2)

english_meaning: to pour water; to fetch water; (slang) to fail, to collapse, to go belly up
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指倒水。引申义（俚语）指失败、垮掉、搞砸。
explanation_english: The literal meaning is to pour water. The extended meaning (slang) refers to failure, collapse, or messing something up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我倒杯水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 dou2 bui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我倒一杯水。
examples.english_sentence: Please pour me a glass of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好似就嚟倒水咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 dou2 seoi2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司好像快要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: That company seems to be on the verge of collapsing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞到件事倒水呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 gin6 si6 dou2 seoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搞得事情搞砸了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess things up.

synonyms: 執笠 (zaap1 lap1) - for the collapse meaning

english_meaning: Cold sweat; sweat that breaks out after a fever or during a sudden drop in body temperature
explanation_mandarin: 指在发烧或者剧烈运动后，身体突然降温时出的冷汗。
explanation_english: Refers to cold sweat that breaks out after a fever or during a sudden drop in body temperature, often following strenuous exercise or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚發燒，退燒嘅時候出咗好多倒汗水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 faat3 siu1, teoi3 siu1 ge3 si4 hau6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 dou2 hon6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上发烧，退烧的时候出了很多冷汗。
examples.english_sentence: I had a fever last night, and when the fever broke, I broke out in a lot of cold sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑完步之後，飲咗凍嘢，即刻出倒汗水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, yam2 zo2 dung3 je5, zik1 hak1 ceot1 dou2 hon6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑步之后，喝了冰的东西，立刻出了冷汗。
examples.english_sentence: After running, he drank something cold, and immediately broke out in a cold sweat.

english_meaning: to spill; to pour out
explanation_mandarin: 指液体或其他散状物因倾斜而溢出或翻倒。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a liquid or other loose material spilling out or tipping over due to tilting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力啊，會倒瀉啲嘢飲嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 aa3, wui5 dou2 se3啲嘢飲嘅!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大力啊，会把饮料洒出来的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so strong, you'll spill the drink!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心倒瀉咗成杯咖啡喺件衫度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 dou2 se3 zo2 seng4 bui1 gaa3 fe1 hai2 gin6 saam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心把一整杯咖啡洒在了衣服上。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally spilled a whole cup of coffee on his shirt.

english_meaning: A complete mess, chaotic situation; like a basket of crabs spilling out (referring to the crabs scrambling in all directions).
explanation_mandarin: 形容场面混乱，秩序荡然无存，就像一箩筐螃蟹倒出来一样，四处乱爬。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is completely chaotic and disorderly, as if a basket of crabs has been spilled, with crabs scrambling in all directions. It implies a loss of control and a state of utter confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日個會開到倒瀉籮蟹咁，完全冇人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 go3 wui2 hoi1 dou3 dou2 se2 lo4 haai5 gam2, wun4 cyun4 mou5 jan4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的会议开得一团糟，完全没人听。
examples.english_sentence: Today's meeting was a complete mess, no one was listening at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房俾佢哋搞到倒瀉籮蟹咁，真係唔知點執好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gaau2 dou3 dou2 se2 lo4 haai5 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 zap1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间被他们弄得乱七八糟，真不知道怎么收拾。
examples.english_sentence: The room has been turned into a complete mess by them, I really don't know how to tidy it up.

english_meaning: To mess things up; to cause trouble; to create a blunder; to spill the tea
explanation_mandarin: 比喻闯祸或者把事情搞砸。原意是把茶倒泻了，引申为发生意外事故，导致事情变得混乱或者失败。
explanation_english: Metaphorically means to mess things up or cause trouble. The literal meaning is to spill tea. The idiom is used to describe an unexpected incident that leads to a chaotic or failed situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係倒瀉茶囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 dou2 se3 caa4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是搞砸了吗！
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is just going to mess things up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時唔小心，倒瀉茶，搞到成個project要重做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 m4 siu2 sam1, dou2 se3 caa4, gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 project jiu3 cung4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时不小心，出了乱子，搞得整个项目要重做。
examples.english_sentence: He was careless for a moment, messed things up, and the whole project had to be redone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係倒瀉茶，唔知點收科好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 dou2 se3 caa4, m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是闯祸了，不知道怎么收场才好。
examples.english_sentence: This time we've really messed things up, I don't know how to clean up this mess.
